	public abstract class ExcelCalcFunction
	{
		private Function equivalentExcelFunction;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static List<ExcelCalcValue> argumentsListTemp;

		internal virtual TokenClass ReturnTokenClass => GetEquivalentExcelFunction()?.ReturnClass ?? TokenClass.Reference;

		internal virtual bool IsOperator => false;

		internal virtual bool IsSelectorFunction => false;

		internal bool IsAlwaysDirty => GetEquivalentExcelFunction()?.IsVolatile ?? false;

		public abstract string Name { get; }

		public abstract int MinArgs { get; }

		public abstract int MaxArgs { get; }

		private void OnAfterEvaluationPerformed(ref ExcelCalcValue result)
		{
			if (ReturnTokenClass == TokenClass.Value)
			{
				ExcelCalcErrorValue excelCalcErrorValue = result.ToErrorValue();
				if (excelCalcErrorValue != null)
				{
					result = new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcErrorValue);
				}
			}
			if (result.IsReference)
			{
				result.IsDynamicReference = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnAfterFunctionEvaluation(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack)
		{
			numberStack.OnAfterFunctionEvaluation();
		}

		private void OnBeforeFunctionEvaluation(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			numberStack.OnBeforeFunctionEvaluation(this, argumentCount);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal Function GetEquivalentExcelFunction()
		{
			return equivalentExcelFunction;
		}

		internal virtual TokenClass GetExpectedParameterClass(int index)
		{
			return GetEquivalentExcelFunction()?.GetExpectedParameterClass(index) ?? TokenClass.Reference;
		}

		internal static Workbook GetWorkbook(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack)
		{
			if (numberStack.FormulaOwner is RefBase refBase)
			{
				return refBase.Workbook;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal virtual bool WillParameterBeDereferenced(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected ExcelCalcFunction()
		{
			if (!IsOperator)
			{
				string name = Name;
				string text = name.ToUpper(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				string text2;
				if ((text2 = text) != null && text2 == "ERRORTYPE")
				{
					equivalentExcelFunction = Function.ERROR_TYPE;
				}
				else
				{
					equivalentExcelFunction = Function.GetFunction(name);
				}
			}
		}

		public void PerformEvaluation(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			OnBeforeFunctionEvaluation(numberStack, argumentCount);
			try
			{
				PerformEvaluationInternal(numberStack, argumentCount);
			}
			finally
			{
				OnAfterFunctionEvaluation(numberStack);
			}
		}

		internal void PerformEvaluationInternal(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			int num = numberStack.Count();
			ExcelCalcValue result;
			try
			{
				result = Evaluate(numberStack, argumentCount);
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				result = new ExcelCalcValue(value);
			}
			finally
			{
				numberStack.Reset(num - argumentCount);
			}
			if (result == null)
			{
				result = new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.NA, Utilities.GetString("Error_NullFunctionResult", GetType().Name)));
			}
			OnAfterEvaluationPerformed(ref result);
			numberStack.Push(result);
		}

		protected abstract ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount);

		internal static bool PopArrayList(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount, List<double> valueArray, bool ignoreEmptyValues, bool checkForExceptions)
		{
			int num = numberStack.Count();
			ExcelCalcErrorValue excelCalcErrorValue = null;
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < argumentCount; i++)
				{
					ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
					double result;
					if (excelCalcValue.IsReference && excelCalcValue.ToReference().IsEnumerable)
					{
						IExcelCalcReferenceCollection references = excelCalcValue.ToReference().References;
						foreach (IExcelCalcReference item in references)
						{
							ExcelCalcValue value = item.Value;
							if (!ignoreEmptyValues || !value.IsNull)
							{
								if (checkForExceptions && value.IsError)
								{
									excelCalcErrorValue = value.ToErrorValue();
									return false;
								}
								if (!value.ToDouble(out result))
								{
									excelCalcErrorValue = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num);
									return false;
								}
								valueArray.Add(result);
							}
						}
						continue;
					}
					if (excelCalcValue.IsReference)
					{
						excelCalcValue = excelCalcValue.ToReference().Value;
					}
					if (ignoreEmptyValues && excelCalcValue.IsNull)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (checkForExceptions && excelCalcValue.IsError)
					{
						excelCalcErrorValue = excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue();
						return false;
					}
					if (excelCalcValue.IsArray || excelCalcValue.IsArrayGroup)
					{
						ArrayProxy[] array = excelCalcValue.ToArrayProxyGroup();
						for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
						{
							foreach (ExcelCalcValue item2 in (IEnumerable<ExcelCalcValue>)array[j])
							{
								if (!ignoreEmptyValues || !item2.IsNull)
								{
									if (checkForExceptions && item2.IsError)
									{
										excelCalcErrorValue = excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue();
										return false;
									}
									if (!item2.ToDouble(out result))
									{
										excelCalcErrorValue = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num);
										return false;
									}
									valueArray.Add(result);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out result))
						{
							excelCalcErrorValue = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num);
							return false;
						}
						valueArray.Add(result);
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				numberStack.Reset(num - argumentCount);
				if (excelCalcErrorValue != null)
				{
					numberStack.Push(new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcErrorValue));
				}
			}
		}

		protected ExcelCalcValue[] GetArguments(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount, bool skipEmptyValues)
		{
			return GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount, skipEmptyValues, skipHiddenCells: false);
		}

		protected ExcelCalcValue[] GetArguments(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount, bool skipEmptyValues, bool skipHiddenCells)
		{
			if (argumentsListTemp == null)
			{
				argumentsListTemp = new List<ExcelCalcValue>(argumentCount);
			}
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < argumentCount; i++)
				{
					GetArguments(argumentsListTemp, numberStack.Pop(), skipEmptyValues, skipHiddenCells);
				}
				return argumentsListTemp.ToArray();
			}
			finally
			{
				argumentsListTemp.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal void GetArgumentsInOrder(List<ExcelCalcValue> list, ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount, bool skipEmptyValues)
		{
			List<ExcelCalcValue> list2 = new List<ExcelCalcValue>(argumentCount);
			for (int i = 0; i < argumentCount; i++)
			{
				list2.Add(numberStack.Pop());
			}
			list2.Reverse();
			for (int j = 0; j < argumentCount; j++)
			{
				GetArguments(list, list2[j], skipEmptyValues, skipHiddenCells: false);
			}
		}

		internal void GetArguments(List<ExcelCalcValue> list, ExcelCalcValue val, bool skipEmptyValues, bool skipHiddenCells)
		{
			if (val.IsReference)
			{
				IExcelCalcReference excelCalcReference = val.ToReference();
				if (excelCalcReference.IsEnumerable)
				{
					foreach (IExcelCalcReference reference in excelCalcReference.References)
					{
						if (!ShouldSkipReference(skipHiddenCells, reference))
						{
							GetArguments(list, reference.Value, skipEmptyValues, skipHiddenCells);
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				if (!ShouldSkipReference(skipHiddenCells, excelCalcReference))
				{
					GetArguments(list, excelCalcReference.Value, skipEmptyValues, skipHiddenCells);
				}
			}
			else if (val.IsArray)
			{
				GetArguments(list, val.ToArrayProxy(), skipEmptyValues, skipHiddenCells);
			}
			else if (val.IsArrayGroup)
			{
				ArrayProxy[] array = val.ToArrayProxyGroup();
				ArrayProxy[] array2 = array;
				foreach (ArrayProxy array3 in array2)
				{
					GetArguments(list, array3, skipEmptyValues, skipHiddenCells);
				}
			}
			else if (!skipEmptyValues || !val.IsNull)
			{
				list.Add(val);
			}
		}

		private void GetArguments(List<ExcelCalcValue> list, ArrayProxy array, bool skipEmptyValues, bool skipHiddenCells)
		{
			int length = array.GetLength(0);
			int length2 = array.GetLength(1);
			for (int i = 0; i < length2; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < length; j++)
				{
					GetArguments(list, array[j, i], skipEmptyValues, skipHiddenCells);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool ShouldSkipReference(bool skipHiddenCells, IExcelCalcReference reference)
		{
			if (skipHiddenCells && ExcelCalcEngine.GetResolvedReference(reference) is CellCalcReference { IsHidden: not false })
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsDateTime(ExcelCalcValue value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value.IsReference && value.ToReference().IsEnumerable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return value.GetResolvedValue(willUseValueInCalculations: false) is DateTime;
		}

		public virtual bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue Add(ExcelCalcValue left, ExcelCalcValue right)
		{
			if (!left.ToDouble(out var result) || !right.ToDouble(out var result2))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(result + result2);
		}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue Divide(ExcelCalcValue left, ExcelCalcValue right)
		{
			if (!left.ToDouble(out var result) || !right.ToDouble(out var result2))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			if (result2 == 0.0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(result / result2);
		}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue Multiply(ExcelCalcValue left, ExcelCalcValue right)
		{
			if (!left.ToDouble(out var result) || !right.ToDouble(out var result2))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(result * result2);
		}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue Subtract(ExcelCalcValue left, ExcelCalcValue right)
		{
			if (!left.ToDouble(out var result) || !right.ToDouble(out var result2))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(result - result2);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class BuiltInFunctionBase : ExcelCalcFunction
	{
		internal BuiltInFunctionBase()
		{
		}
	}
	internal abstract class UltraCalcBinaryOperatorBase : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		internal override bool IsOperator => true;

		internal override TokenClass ReturnTokenClass => TokenClass.Value;

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal override TokenClass GetExpectedParameterClass(int index)
		{
			if (index == 0 || index == 1)
			{
				return TokenClass.Value;
			}
			return base.GetExpectedParameterClass(index);
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue2.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			return Evaluate(excelCalcValue2, excelCalcValue);
		}

		protected abstract ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcValue left, ExcelCalcValue right);
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionAverage : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "average";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => int.MaxValue;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return !isCreatedFromRegionReference;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue[] arguments = GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount, skipEmptyValues: true);
			return EvaluateHelper(arguments);
		}

		public override bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue EvaluateHelper(IList<ExcelCalcValue> args)
		{
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (ExcelCalcValue arg in args)
			{
				if (arg != null)
				{
					if (arg.IsError)
					{
						return new ExcelCalcValue(arg.ToErrorValue());
					}
					if (!arg.IsString && !arg.IsBoolean && arg.ToDouble(out var result))
					{
						num2 += result;
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			num2 /= (double)num;
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num2);
		}
	}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue EvaluateHelper(IList<ExcelCalcValue> args)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (ExcelCalcValue arg in args)
			{
				if (arg != null)
				{
					if (arg.IsError)
					{
						return new ExcelCalcValue(arg.ToErrorValue());
					}
					if (!arg.IsString && arg.ToDouble(out var result))
					{
						num += result;
					}
				}
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionConcat : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		internal override bool IsOperator => true;

		internal override TokenClass ReturnTokenClass => TokenClass.Value;

		public override string Name => "&";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal override TokenClass GetExpectedParameterClass(int index)
		{
			if (index == 0 || index == 1)
			{
				return TokenClass.Value;
			}
			return base.GetExpectedParameterClass(index);
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue2.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			string text = excelCalcValue.ToString();
			string text2 = excelCalcValue2.ToString();
			return new ExcelCalcValue(text2 + text);
		}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionConcatenate : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "concatenate";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => int.MaxValue;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			List<ExcelCalcValue> list = new List<ExcelCalcValue>();
			for (int i = 0; i < argumentCount; i++)
			{
				list.Add(numberStack.Pop());
			}
			for (int num = list.Count; num > 0; num--)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = list[num - 1];
				if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(excelCalcValue.ToString());
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(stringBuilder.ToString());
		}

		public override bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}

			ExcelCalcValue[] arguments = GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount, skipEmptyValues: true);
			return EvaluateHelper(arguments);
		}

		public override bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue EvaluateHelper(IList<ExcelCalcValue> args)
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			foreach (ExcelCalcValue arg in args)
			{
				if (arg != null)
				{
					if (arg.IsError)
					{
						return new ExcelCalcValue(arg.ToErrorValue());
					}
					if (!arg.IsString && arg.ToDouble(out var result))
					{
						num *= result;
					}
				}
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionRound : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "round";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = null;
			if (argumentCount == 3)
			{
				excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue3 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue2.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (excelCalcValue3.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue3.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (excelCalcValue != null && excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue2.ToDouble(out var result))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue3.ToDouble(out var result2))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			result2 = MathUtilities.RoundToExcelDisplayValue(result2);
			double result3 = 0.0;
			if (excelCalcValue != null)
			{
				if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out result3))
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				if ((int)result3 < 0 || (int)result3 > 1)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(Round(result2, (int)result, (int)result3));
		}

		internal static double Round(double number, int power)
		{
			return Round(number, power, 0);
		}

		internal static double Round(double number, int power, int roundStyle)
		{
			if (roundStyle == 0)
			{
				return MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(number, power);
			}
			if (power <= 15)
			{
				return Math.Round(number, power);
			}
			double num = Math.Pow(10.0, power);
			double a = MathUtilities.RoundToExcelDisplayValue(number * num);
			return Math.Round(a) / num;
		}
	}

			{

			if (result2 == 0.0 && result == 0.0)

				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div));

			return new ExcelCalcValue(Math.Atan2(result, result2));

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionFloor : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "floor";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			double result = 1.0;
			if (argumentCount > 1)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
				if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
				}
				if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out result))
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue2.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue2.ToDouble(out var result2))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (result2 == 0.0 && result == 0.0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(0);
			}
			if (result == 0.0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div));
			}
			int num = ((!(result2 < 0.0)) ? 1 : (-1));
			int num2 = ((!(result < 0.0)) ? 1 : (-1));
			if (result2 != 0.0 && result != 0.0 && 0 < num && num2 < 0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			double num3 = Math.Floor(MathUtilities.RoundToExcelDisplayValue(result2 / result)) * result;
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num3);
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionLog : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "log";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = null;
			if (argumentCount == 2)
			{
				excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue2.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (excelCalcValue != null && excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			double result;
			if (excelCalcValue != null)
			{
				if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out result))
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				result = 10.0;
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue2.ToDouble(out var result2))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			if (result2 == 0.0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(Math.Log(result2, result));
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionFV : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "fv";

		public override int MinArgs => 3;

		public override int MaxArgs => 5;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			int option = 0;
			if (argumentCount == 5)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
				if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
				{
					return excelCalcValue;
				}
				option = excelCalcValue.ToInt32();
			}
			double result = 0.0;
			if (argumentCount >= 4)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
				if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue2.ToErrorValue());
				}
				if (!excelCalcValue2.ToDouble(out result))
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue3 = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue4 = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue5 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue5.IsError)
			{
				return excelCalcValue5;
			}
			if (excelCalcValue4.IsError)
			{
				return excelCalcValue4;
			}
			if (excelCalcValue3.IsError)
			{
				return excelCalcValue3;
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue3.ToDouble(out var result2) || !excelCalcValue4.ToDouble(out var result3) || !excelCalcValue5.ToDouble(out var result4))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(CalculateFV(result4, result3, result2, result, option));
		}

		internal static double CalculateFV(double rate, double period, double payment, double startingValue, int option)
		{
			return (payment * ((Math.Pow(1.0 + rate, (option == 0) ? period : (period + 1.0)) - 1.0) / rate) - ((option == 0) ? 0.0 : payment) + startingValue * Math.Pow(1.0 + rate, period)) * -1.0;
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionEven : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "even";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 1;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out var result))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			double num = Math.Ceiling(Math.Abs(result));
			double num2 = num + Math.Abs(Math.IEEERemainder(num, 2.0));
			if (result < 0.0)
			{
				num2 *= -1.0;
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num2);
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionOdd : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "odd";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 1;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return excelCalcValue;
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out var result))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			double num = Math.Ceiling(Math.Abs(result));
			double num2 = Math.Abs(Math.IEEERemainder(num, 2.0));
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				num += 1.0;
			}
			if (result < 0.0)
			{
				num *= -1.0;
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionLeft : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "left";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return !isCreatedFromRegionReference;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			int num = 1;
			if (argumentCount > 1)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
				if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
				}
				num = excelCalcValue.ToInt32();
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
				}
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue2.ToErrorValue());
			}
			string text = excelCalcValue2.ToString();
			return new ExcelCalcValue(text.Substring(0, (num > text.Length) ? text.Length : num));
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionRight : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "right";

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionValue : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		private static readonly char[] CurrencySymbols = new char[30]
		{
			'$', '\u0080', '£', '¤', '¥', '৲', '৳', '฿', '៛', '₠',
			'₡', '₢', '₣', '₤', '₦', '₧', '₨', '₩', '₪', '₫',
			'€', '₭', '₮', '₯', '﷼', '﹩', '＄', '￡', '￥', '￦'
		};

		public override string Name => "value";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 1;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			bool flag = false;
			double value = 0.0;
			if (excelCalcValue.Value is string)
			{
				string text = ((string)excelCalcValue.Value).Trim();
				text = (text.EndsWith("kr") ? text.Substring(0, text.Length - 2) : ((!text.StartsWith("R$") && !text.StartsWith("S/")) ? text.Trim(CurrencySymbols) : text.Substring(2, text.Length - 2)));
				flag = MathUtilities.DoubleTryParse(text, numberStack.Culture, out value);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				flag = excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out value);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(value);
		}
	}

				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(numberStack.Pop().ToErrorValue());

				if (num < 0)

				}
			}
			if (numberStack.Peek().IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(numberStack.Pop().ToErrorValue());

			string text = numberStack.Pop().ToString();
			if (num > text.Length - 1)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			if (numberStack.Peek().IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(numberStack.Pop().ToErrorValue());
			}
			int num2 = -1;
			string text2 = numberStack.Pop().ToString();
			num2 = ((text2.Length == 0) ? 1 : text.IndexOf(text2, num));
			if (num2 != -1)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(num2 + 1);
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
		}

				return excelCalcValue;
			}
			string text = excelCalcValue.ToString();

			int num2 = excelCalcValue3.ToInt32() - 1;

			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			if (num > text2.Length - num2)
			{
				num = text2.Length - num2;
			}
			string value = text2.Substring(0, num2) + text + text2.Substring(num2 + num);
			return new ExcelCalcValue(value);
		}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionDate : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "date";

		public override int MinArgs => 3;

		public override int MaxArgs => 3;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue3 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue3.IsError)
			{
				return excelCalcValue3;
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue3.ToDouble(out var result))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return excelCalcValue2;
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue2.ToDouble(out var result2))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return excelCalcValue;
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out var result3))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(result);
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor(result2);
			int num3 = (int)Math.Floor(result3);
			if (num < 1900)
			{
				num += 1900;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				int num4 = num2 - 1;
				int num5 = num4 / 12;
				if (num5 > 0)
				{
					num += num5;
					num2 = num4 % 12 + 1;
				}
				if (10000 <= num)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				int num6 = DateTime.DaysInMonth(num, num2);
				if (num3 <= num6)
				{
					break;
				}
				num3 -= num6;
				num2++;
			}
			if (num < 1900)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			Workbook workbook = ExcelCalcFunction.GetWorkbook(numberStack);
			if (workbook != null && workbook.DateSystem == DateSystem.From1904 && num < 1904)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (10000 <= num)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(num, num2, num3);
			return new ExcelCalcValue(dateTime);
		}
	}

			num3 %= 24;
			TimeSpan timeValue = new TimeSpan(num3, num2, num);

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionMedian : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "median";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => int.MaxValue;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return !isCreatedFromRegionReference;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			if (!ExcelCalcFunction.PopArrayList(numberStack, argumentCount, list, ignoreEmptyValues: true, checkForExceptions: true))
			{
				return numberStack.Pop();
			}
			list.Sort();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			int num = list.Count / 2;
			double num2;
			if (list.Count % 2 == 1)
			{
				num2 = list[num];
			}
			else
			{
				double num3 = (list[num - 1] + list[num]) / 2.0;
				num2 = num3;
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num2);
		}

		{

		protected ExcelCalcValue CalculateVariance(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue[] arguments = GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount, skipEmptyValues: true);
			return EvaluateHelper(arguments);
		}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue EvaluateHelper(IList<ExcelCalcValue> args)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (ExcelCalcValue arg in args)
			{
				if (arg == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (arg.IsError)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(arg.ToErrorValue());
				}
				if (!arg.IsString)
				{
					if (!arg.ToDouble(out var result))
					{
						return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
					}
					num += result;
					num2++;
				}
			}
			switch (num2)
			{
			case 0:
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			case 1:
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div));
			default:
			{
				num /= (double)num2;
				double num3 = 0.0;
				foreach (ExcelCalcValue arg2 in args)
				{
					if (arg2 != null)
					{
						if (arg2.IsError)
						{
							return new ExcelCalcValue(arg2.ToErrorValue());
						}
						if (!arg2.ToDouble(out var result2))
						{
							return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
						}
						double num4 = result2 - num;
						num3 += num4 * num4;
					}
				}
				double num5 = num3 / (double)(num2 - 1);
				return new ExcelCalcValue(num5);
			}
			}
		}
	}

			if (dateTime <= new DateTime(1900, 3, 1))
			{
				dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(-1.0);

			DayOfWeek dayOfWeek = dateTime.DayOfWeek;
			int num2;
			switch (num)
			{
			case 1:

			case 2:
				num2 = ((dayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Sunday) ? 7 : 0);

				num2 = ((dayOfWeek != DayOfWeek.Sunday) ? (-1) : 6);
				break;
			default:
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			int num3 = (int)dayOfWeek;

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionWeekNum : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "weeknum";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			DayOfWeek dayOfWeek;
			switch ((argumentCount != 2) ? 1 : numberStack.Pop().ToInt32())
			{
			case 1:
				dayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Sunday;
				break;
			case 2:
				dayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Monday;
				break;
			default:
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			DateTime date = numberStack.Pop().ToDateTime().Date;
			DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(date.Year, 1, 1);
			DateTime dateTime2 = dateTime;
			while (dateTime2.DayOfWeek != dayOfWeek)
			{
				dateTime2 = dateTime2.AddDays(1.0);
			}
			int num = (date - dateTime2).Days / 7 + 1;
			if (dateTime != dateTime2 && date >= dateTime2)
			{
				num++;
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionWorkDay : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "workday";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 3;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return !isCreatedFromRegionReference;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue[] arguments = GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount - 2, skipEmptyValues: true);
			if (!GetHolidayList(arguments, out var holidays, out var errorValue))
			{
				return errorValue;
			}
			int num = numberStack.Pop().ToInt32();
			DateTime date = numberStack.Pop().ToDateTime().Date;
			DateTime dateTime = date;
			int num2 = Math.Abs(num);
			int num3 = 0;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				int num4 = ((num >= 0) ? 1 : (-1));
				do
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(num4);
					num3 += (IsWorkDay(dateTime, holidays) ? 1 : 0);
				}
				while (num3 < num2);
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(dateTime);
		}

		public override bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return parameterIndex == 2;
		}

		private bool IsWorkDay(DateTime workDay, Dictionary<DateTime, object> holidays)
		{
			if (IsWeekend(workDay))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (holidays != null && holidays.ContainsKey(workDay))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool GetHolidayList(ExcelCalcValue[] holidayRefs, out Dictionary<DateTime, object> holidays, out ExcelCalcValue errorValue)
		{
			if (holidayRefs.Length > 0)
			{
				holidays = new Dictionary<DateTime, object>(holidayRefs.Length);
				foreach (ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue in holidayRefs)
				{
					if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
					{
						errorValue = new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
						return false;
					}
					DateTime date = excelCalcValue.ToDateTime().Date;
					if (!IsWeekend(date) && !holidays.ContainsKey(date))
					{
						holidays.Add(date, null);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				holidays = null;
			}
			errorValue = null;
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsWeekend(DateTime date)
		{
			return IsWeekend(date.DayOfWeek);
		}

		internal static bool IsWeekend(DayOfWeek dayOfWeek)
		{
			if (dayOfWeek != DayOfWeek.Saturday)
			{
				return dayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Sunday;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class UltraCalcFunctionXBase2Dec : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		protected internal abstract long MinNumber { get; }

		protected internal abstract long MaxNumber { get; }

		protected internal abstract int NumberSystem { get; }

		protected internal abstract long MaxLength { get; }

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 1;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return !isCreatedFromRegionReference;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			string text = excelCalcValue.ToString();
			if (text.Length > MaxLength)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			ExcelCalcErrorValue error;
			long num = ConvertFromNumberSystem(numberStack.Culture, text, NumberSystem, MinNumber, MaxNumber, out error);
			if (error != null)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(error);
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
		}

		internal static long ConvertFromNumberSystem(CultureInfo culture, string number, int numberSystem, long minNumber, long maxNumber, out ExcelCalcErrorValue error)
		{
			error = null;
			number = number.Trim();
			long num = 0L;
			int length = number.Length;
			char[] array = number.ToCharArray();
			long num2 = 1L;
			char c = '\0';
			for (int num3 = length - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				char c2 = array[num3];
				if (c2 != '-')
				{
					if (!long.TryParse(c2.ToString(), NumberStyles.Float | NumberStyles.AllowThousands, culture, out var result))
					{
						result = c2 - 65;
						result += 10;
					}
					if (result >= numberSystem)
					{
						c = c2;
					}
					else
					{
						num += result * num2;
						num2 *= numberSystem;
					}
				}
			}
			if (c != 0)
			{
				error = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num, Utilities.GetString("Error_InvalidNumberSystemDigit", c, number, numberSystem));
				return 0L;
			}
			if (maxNumber < num)
			{
				num -= maxNumber - minNumber + 1;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionConvert : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		internal class UnitInfo
		{
			private string unit;

			private bool isMetric;

			private double prefixMulitplier;

			private MeasurementUnitCategory measurementUnitCategory;

			public string Unit => unit;

			public bool IsMetric => isMetric;

			public double PrefixMultipler => prefixMulitplier;

			public MeasurementUnitCategory MeasurementUnitCategory => measurementUnitCategory;

			public static UnitInfo FromString(string unit)
			{
				string text = unit;
				double multipler = 1.0;
				MeasurementUnitCategory unitCategory = GetUnitCategory(text);
				if (unitCategory == MeasurementUnitCategory.Unknown)
				{
					text = text.Substring(1);
					unitCategory = GetUnitCategory(text);
					if (unitCategory == MeasurementUnitCategory.Unknown)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (!TryGetPrefixMultiplier(unit.Substring(0, 1), out multipler))
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				bool flag = IsMetricUnit(text);
				if (!flag && multipler != 1.0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new UnitInfo(text, flag, multipler, unitCategory);
			}

			private UnitInfo(string unit, bool isMetric, double prefixMulitplier, MeasurementUnitCategory measurementUnitCategory)
			{
				this.unit = unit;
				this.isMetric = isMetric;
				this.prefixMulitplier = prefixMulitplier;
				this.measurementUnitCategory = measurementUnitCategory;
			}

				switch (unit)
				{
				case "g":
				case "sg":
				case "lbm":
				case "u":
				case "ozm":
					return MeasurementUnitCategory.WeightAndMass;

				case "HPh":
				case "hh":
				case "Wh":

				case "flb":
				case "BTU":

					return MeasurementUnitCategory.Energy;

				case "qt":

				case "l":
				case "lt":

				default:
					return MeasurementUnitCategory.Unknown;
				}
			}

			private static bool TryGetPrefixMultiplier(string prefix, out double multipler)
			{
				switch (prefix)
				{
				case "E":
					multipler = 1E+18;
					return true;
				case "P":
					multipler = 1000000000000000.0;
					return true;
				case "T":
					multipler = 1000000000000.0;
					return true;
				case "G":
					multipler = 1000000000.0;
					return true;
				case "M":
					multipler = 1000000.0;
					return true;
				case "k":
					multipler = 1000.0;
					return true;
				case "h":
					multipler = 100.0;
					return true;
				case "e":
					multipler = 10.0;
					return true;
				case "d":
					multipler = 0.1;
					return true;
				case "c":
					multipler = 0.01;
					return true;
				case "m":
					multipler = 0.001;
					return true;
				case "u":
					multipler = 1E-06;
					return true;
				case "n":
					multipler = 1E-09;
					return true;
				case "p":
					multipler = 1E-12;
					return true;
				case "f":
					multipler = 1E-15;
					return true;
				case "a":
					multipler = 1E-18;
					return true;
				default:
					multipler = 1.0;
					return false;
				}
			}

			{
				switch (baseUnit)
				{
				case "g":

					return false;
				case "sec":
					return true;
				case "yr":
				case "day":
				case "hr":
				case "mn":
					return false;
				case "Pa":
				case "p":
				case "atm":
				case "at":
				case "mmHg":
					return true;
				case "N":
				case "dyn":
				case "dy":
					return true;
				case "lbf":
					return false;
				case "J":
				case "e":

				case "cal":
				case "eV":
				case "ev":
				case "Wh":
				case "wh":
					return true;
				case "HPh":

				case "BTU":
				case "btu":
					return false;
				case "HP":
				case "h":
					return false;
				case "W":
				case "w":
					return true;
				case "T":
				case "ga":
					return true;
				case "C":

				case "F":

					return false;

					return true;
				case "tsp":
				case "tbs":
				case "oz":
				case "cup":
				case "pt":
				case "us_pt":
				case "uk_pt":
				case "qt":
				case "gal":
					return false;
				case "l":
				case "lt":
					return true;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException("baseUnit must be a unit with no metric prefix", "baseUnit");
				}
			}
		}

		internal enum MeasurementUnitCategory
		{
			Unknown,
			WeightAndMass,
			Distance,
			Time,
			Pressure,
			Force,
			Energy,
			Power,
			Magnetism,
			Temperature,
			LiquidMeasure
		}

		public override string Name => "convert";

		public override int MinArgs => 3;

		public override int MaxArgs => 3;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return !isCreatedFromRegionReference;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			string unit = numberStack.Pop().ToString();
			string unit2 = numberStack.Pop().ToString();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			double num = excelCalcValue.ToDouble();
			UnitInfo unitInfo = UnitInfo.FromString(unit2);
			UnitInfo unitInfo2 = UnitInfo.FromString(unit);
			if (unitInfo == null || unitInfo2 == null)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.NA));
			}
			MeasurementUnitCategory measurementUnitCategory = unitInfo2.MeasurementUnitCategory;
			MeasurementUnitCategory measurementUnitCategory2 = unitInfo.MeasurementUnitCategory;
			if (measurementUnitCategory == MeasurementUnitCategory.Unknown || measurementUnitCategory2 == MeasurementUnitCategory.Unknown || measurementUnitCategory != measurementUnitCategory2)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.NA));
			}
			unit2 = unitInfo.Unit;
			unit = unitInfo2.Unit;
			num *= unitInfo.PrefixMultipler;
			double num2;
			switch (measurementUnitCategory)
			{
			case MeasurementUnitCategory.WeightAndMass:
				num2 = ConvertWeight(num, unit2, unit);
				break;
			case MeasurementUnitCategory.Distance:
				num2 = ConvertDistance(num, unit2, unit);
				break;
			case MeasurementUnitCategory.Time:
				num2 = ConvertTime(num, unit2, unit);
				break;
			case MeasurementUnitCategory.Pressure:
				num2 = ConvertPressure(num, unit2, unit);
				break;
			case MeasurementUnitCategory.Force:
				num2 = ConvertForce(num, unit2, unit);
				break;
			case MeasurementUnitCategory.Energy:
				num2 = ConvertEnergy(num, unit2, unit);
				break;
			case MeasurementUnitCategory.Power:
				num2 = ConvertPower(num, unit2, unit);
				break;
			case MeasurementUnitCategory.Magnetism:
				num2 = ConvertMagnetism(num, unit2, unit);
				break;
			case MeasurementUnitCategory.Temperature:
				num2 = ConvertTemperature(num, unit2, unit);
				break;
			case MeasurementUnitCategory.LiquidMeasure:
				num2 = ConvertLiquidMeasure(num, unit2, unit);
				break;
			default:
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.NA));
			}
			num2 /= unitInfo2.PrefixMultipler;
			num2 = MathUtilities.RoundToExcelDisplayValue(num2);
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num2);
		}

		private static double ConvertTime(double number, string fromUnit, string toUnit)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			num = fromUnit switch
			{
				"yr" => number * 365.25 * 24.0 * 60.0 * 60.0, 
				"day" => number * 24.0 * 60.0 * 60.0, 
				"hr" => number * 60.0 * 60.0, 
				"mn" => number * 60.0, 
				"sec" => number, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("fromUnit"), 
			};
			int num2 = (int)Math.Round(num, 0);
			int milliseconds = (int)((num - (double)num2) * 1000.0);
			TimeSpan timeSpan = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, num2, milliseconds);
			return toUnit switch
			{
				"yr" => timeSpan.TotalDays / 365.25, 
				"day" => timeSpan.TotalDays, 
				"hr" => timeSpan.TotalHours, 
				"mn" => timeSpan.TotalMinutes, 
				"sec" => timeSpan.TotalSeconds, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("toUnit"), 
			};
		}

		private static double ConvertWeight(double number, string fromUnit, string toUnit)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			num = fromUnit switch
			{
				"sg" => number * 14593.9029372064, 
				"lbm" => number * 453.59237, 
				"ozm" => number * 28.349523125, 
				"g" => number, 
				"u" => number * 1.66053100460465E-24, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("fromUnit"), 
			};
			return toUnit switch
			{
				"u" => num / 1.66053100460465E-24, 
				"g" => num, 
				"ozm" => num / 28.349523125, 
				"lbm" => num / 453.59237, 
				"sg" => num / 14593.9029372064, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("toUnit"), 
			};
		}

		private static double ConvertDistance(double number, string fromUnit, string toUnit)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			num = fromUnit switch
			{
				"Nmi" => number * 72913.3858267717, 
				"mi" => number * 63360.0, 
				"m" => number * 39.3700787401575, 
				"yd" => number * 36.0, 
				"ft" => number * 12.0, 
				"in" => number, 
				"pica" => number * 0.166666666666667, 
				"Pica" => number * 0.0138888888888889, 
				"ang" => number * 3.93700787401575E-09, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("fromUnit"), 
			};
			return toUnit switch
			{
				"ang" => num / 3.93700787401575E-09, 
				"pica" => num / 0.166666666666667, 
				"Pica" => num / 0.0138888888888889, 
				"in" => num, 
				"ft" => num / 12.0, 
				"yd" => num / 36.0, 
				"m" => num / 39.3700787401575, 
				"mi" => num / 63360.0, 
				"Nmi" => num / 72913.3858267717, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("toUnit"), 
			};
		}

		private static double ConvertPressure(double number, string fromUnit, string toUnit)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			switch (fromUnit)
			{
			case "Pa":
			case "p":
				num = number * 0.0075006168270417;
				break;
			case "atm":
			case "at":
				num = number * 760.0;
				break;
			case "mmHg":
				num = number;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("fromUnit");
			}
			switch (toUnit)
			{
			case "mmHg":
				return num;
			case "Pa":
			case "p":
				return num / 0.0075006168270417;
			case "atm":
			case "at":
				return num / 760.0;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("toUnit");
			}
		}

		private static double ConvertForce(double number, string fromUnit, string toUnit)
		{
			double num = 0.0;

				num = number;

			case "dy":
				num = number * 1E-05;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("fromUnit");
			}
			switch (toUnit)
			{
			case "dyn":
			case "dy":
				return num / 1E-05;
			case "N":
				return num;
			case "lbf":
				return num / 4.4482216152605;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("toUnit");
			}
		}

		private static double ConvertPower(double number, string fromUnit, string toUnit)

		private static double ConvertMagnetism(double number, string fromUnit, string toUnit)

				"T" => num2 / num,

			};
		}

		private static double ConvertTemperature(double number, string fromUnit, string toUnit)
		{
			fromUnit = GetTemperatureUnitResolved(fromUnit);
			toUnit = GetTemperatureUnitResolved(toUnit);
			if (string.Compare(fromUnit, toUnit) == 0)
			{
				return number;
			}
			switch (fromUnit)
			{
			case "C":
				return toUnit switch
				{
					"F" => number * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0, 
					"K" => number + 273.15, 
					_ => throw new ArgumentException("toUnit"), 
				};
			case "F":
			{
				double num = (number - 32.0) / 9.0 * 5.0;
				return toUnit switch
				{
					"C" => num, 
					"K" => num + 273.15, 
					_ => throw new ArgumentException("toUnit"), 
				};
			}
			case "K":
			{
				double num = number - 273.15;
				return toUnit switch
				{
					"C" => num, 
					"F" => num * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0, 
					_ => throw new ArgumentException("toUnit"), 
				};
			}
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("fromUnit");
			}
		}

		private static string GetTemperatureUnitResolved(string unit)
		{
			switch (unit)
			{
			case "C":
			case "cel":
				return "C";
			case "F":
			case "fah":
				return "F";
			case "K":
			case "kel":
				return "K";
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("unit");
			}
		}
	}

	{
		public override string Name => "n";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 1;

		{
			return !isCreatedFromRegionReference;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			double num;
			if (excelCalcValue.IsBoolean)
			{
				num = (excelCalcValue.ToBoolean() ? 1 : 0);
				return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
			}
			object resolvedValue = excelCalcValue.GetResolvedValue();
			if (resolvedValue is DateTime)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue((DateTime)resolvedValue);
			}
			if (resolvedValue is string)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(0);
			}
			if (excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out num))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(0);
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionFact : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "fact";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 1;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			decimal num = excelCalcValue.ToDecimal();
			if (num < 0m)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			int number = (int)num;
			double num2 = Factorial(number);
			if (double.IsInfinity(num2))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num2);
		}

		internal static double Factorial(int number)
		{
			return Factorial(number, 1);
		}

		internal static double Factorial(int number, int step)
		{
			if (number == 0)
			{
				number = 1;
			}
			double num = 1.0;
			for (int num2 = number; num2 > 1; num2 -= step)
			{
				num *= (double)num2;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionGcd : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "gcd";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => int.MaxValue;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return !isCreatedFromRegionReference;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue[] arguments = GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount, skipEmptyValues: true);
			int num = arguments[0].ToInt();
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (arguments.Length == 1)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < arguments.Length; i++)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = arguments[i];
				if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
				}
				int num2 = excelCalcValue.ToInt();
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				num = GCD(num, num2);
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
		}

		public override bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal static int GCD(int num1, int num2)
		{
			if (num2 == 0)
			{
				return num1;
			}
			return GCD(num2, num1 % num2);
		}
	}

		public override string Name => "lcm";

		public override int MaxArgs => int.MaxValue;

			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < arguments.Length; i++)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = arguments[i];

				if (num2 < 0)

		internal static int LCM(int num1, int num2)
		{
			if (num1 == 0 && num2 == 0)

				return 0;

		}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionMultinomial : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "multinomial";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => int.MaxValue;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return !isCreatedFromRegionReference;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue[] arguments = GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount, skipEmptyValues: true);
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 1.0;
			foreach (ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue in arguments)
			{
				if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
				}
				int num3 = excelCalcValue.ToInt();
				if (num3 < 0)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				num += num3;
				num2 *= UltraCalcFunctionFact.Factorial(num3);
			}
			double num4 = UltraCalcFunctionFact.Factorial(num);
			double num5 = num4 / num2;
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num5);
		}

		public override bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionMRound : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "mround";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return !isCreatedFromRegionReference;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			double num = excelCalcValue.ToDouble();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue2.ToErrorValue());
			}
			double num2 = excelCalcValue2.ToDouble();
			if ((num2 < 0.0 && num > 0.0) || (num2 > 0.0 && num < 0.0))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			double num3 = MRound(num2, num);
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num3);
		}

		internal static double MRound(double number, double multiple)
		{
			double num = number / multiple;
			if (double.IsInfinity(num) || double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			num += 0.5;
			num = Math.Floor(num);
			return num * multiple;
		}
	}

			public RomanNumeral(int number)
			{
				if (number < 0 || number > 3999)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Number must be between 1 and 3999", "number");
				}
				this.number = number;
			}

			{
				return ToString(0);
			}

			{
				if (form)
				{
					return ToString(0);
				}
				return ToString(4);
			}

			public string ToString(int form)
			{
				if (number == 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return GetRomanNumeral(number, form);
			}

			internal static string GetRomanNumeral(int number, int form)
			{
				List<Tuple<int, string>> list = form switch
				{
					0 => ClassicValues, 
					1 => ConciseValues1, 
					2 => ConciseValues2, 
					3 => ConciseValues3, 
					4 => SimplifiedValues, 
					_ => throw new ArgumentException("form"), 
				};
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				_ = string.Empty;
				foreach (Tuple<int, string> item in list)
				{
					while (number >= item.Item1)
					{
						number -= item.Item1;
						stringBuilder.Append(item.Item2);
					}
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

			{
				num = 0;
			}
			excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();

		{
			List<ExcelCalcValue> list = new List<ExcelCalcValue>();

			{
				list.Insert(0, numberStack.Pop());
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());

			if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out var result))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(result);
			if (num < 1 || list.Count < num)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			return list[num - 1];

			if (num == 0 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))

			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
				if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
				{
					return excelCalcValue;

				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));

			int num2 = (int)result;
			bool skipHiddenCells = false;
			if (num2 > 100)
			{
				skipHiddenCells = true;
				num2 -= 100;

			List<ExcelCalcValue> list = new List<ExcelCalcValue>();

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionText : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		private static Regex timeRegex;

		public override string Name => "text";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		private static Regex TimeRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (timeRegex == null)
				{
					string arg = string.Format("({0}{1})", "(?'Hours'[0-9]{1,4})\\s*", "(\\s+(?'AMPM'(a|p)m?)\\s*)");
					string arg2 = string.Format("({0}:{1}(:{2}({3})?)?{4}?)", "(?'Hours'[0-9]{1,4})\\s*", "\\s*(?'Minutes'[0-9]?[0-9])\\s*", "\\s*(?'Seconds'[0-9]?[0-9])\\s*", ".\\s*(?'Milliseconds'[0-9]{0,4})[0-9]*\\s*", "(\\s+(?'AMPM'(a|p)m?)\\s*)");
					string arg3 = string.Format("({0}:{1}{2}{3}?)", "\\s*(?'Minutes'[0-9]?[0-9])\\s*", "\\s*(?'Seconds'[0-9]?[0-9])\\s*", ".\\s*(?'Milliseconds'[0-9]{0,4})[0-9]*\\s*", "(\\s+(?'AMPM'(a|p)m?)\\s*)");
					timeRegex = new Regex($"^({arg}|{arg2}|{arg3})$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.IgnorePatternWhitespace | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
				}
				return timeRegex;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return excelCalcValue2;
			}
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return excelCalcValue;
			}
			if (excelCalcValue.IsBoolean)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			string text = excelCalcValue2.ToString();
			string format = excelCalcValue.ToString();
			double result;
			bool flag = excelCalcValue2.ToDouble(out result);
			if (!flag && excelCalcValue2.IsString)
			{
				double? num = ParseTime(text);
				DateTime result2;
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					result = num.Value;
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (DateTime.TryParse(text, out result2))
				{
					double? num2 = ExcelCalcValue.DateTimeToExcelDate(excelCalcValue2.Workbook, result2);
					if (num2.HasValue)
					{
						result = num2.Value;
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			double value = double.NaN;
			if (flag)
			{
				value = result;
			}
			ValueFormatter valueFormatter = new ValueFormatter(excelCalcValue2.Workbook, format, numberStack.Culture);
			if (!valueFormatter.TryFormatValue(value, text, out var formattedText))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(formattedText);
		}

		internal double? ParseTime(string valueString)
		{
			Match match = TimeRegex.Match(valueString);
			if (!match.Success)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int result = 0;
			int result2 = 0;
			int result3 = 0;
			int result4 = 0;
			Group obj = match.Groups["Hours"];
			if (obj.Length != 0)
			{
				int.TryParse(obj.Value, out result);
			}
			Group obj2 = match.Groups["Minutes"];
			if (obj2.Length != 0)
			{
				int.TryParse(obj2.Value, out result2);
			}
			Group obj3 = match.Groups["Seconds"];
			if (obj3.Length != 0)
			{
				int.TryParse(obj3.Value, out result3);
			}
			Group obj4 = match.Groups["Milliseconds"];
			if (obj4.Length != 0)
			{
				string text = obj4.Value;
				while (text.Length < 4)
				{
					text += "0";
				}
				int.TryParse(text, out result4);
			}
			Group obj5 = match.Groups["AMPM"];
			if (obj5.Length != 0)
			{
				if (result >= 12)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (obj5.Value.StartsWith("P", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					result += 12;
				}
			}
			return (double)result / 24.0 + (double)result2 / 1440.0 + (double)result3 / 86400.0 + (double)result4 / 864000000.0;
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionSearch : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "search";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 3;

		protected internal override bool DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(int parameterIndex, bool isCreatedFromRegionReference)
		{

		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = null;

	internal abstract class UltraCalcConditionalFunctionBase : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		private class CriteriaEvaluator
		{
			private enum Operator
			{
				Equals,
				NotEquals,
				GreaterThan,
				GreaterThanOrEqual,
				LessThan,
				LessThanOrEqual
			}

			private ExcelCalcValue _operand;

			private string _operandResolvedStrValue;

			private object _operandResolvedValue;

			private Operator _operator;

			public CriteriaEvaluator(CultureInfo culture, object criteria)
			{
				_operandResolvedStrValue = criteria?.ToString();
				string text = criteria as string;
				object value2;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					bool flag = true;
					string text2 = null;
					switch (text[0])
					{
					case '=':
						_operator = Operator.Equals;
						text2 = text.Substring(1);
						break;
					case '<':
						flag = false;
						if (text.Length > 1)
						{
							switch (text[1])
							{
							case '>':
								_operator = Operator.NotEquals;
								text2 = text.Substring(2);
								break;
							case '=':
								_operator = Operator.LessThanOrEqual;
								text2 = text.Substring(2);
								break;
							}
						}
						if (text2 == null)
						{
							_operator = Operator.LessThan;
							text2 = text.Substring(1);
						}
						break;
					case '>':
						flag = false;
						if (text.Length > 1 && text[1] == '=')
						{
							_operator = Operator.GreaterThanOrEqual;
							text2 = text.Substring(2);
						}
						else
						{
							_operator = Operator.GreaterThan;
							text2 = text.Substring(1);
						}
						break;
					default:
						text2 = text;
						break;
					}
					_operandResolvedStrValue = text2;
					if (MathUtilities.DoubleTryParse(text2.Trim(), culture, out var value))
					{
						value2 = value;
						if (!flag)
						{
							_operandResolvedStrValue = null;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						value2 = text2;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					value2 = criteria;
				}
				_operand = new ExcelCalcValue(value2);
				_operandResolvedValue = _operand.GetResolvedValue(willUseValueInCalculations: false);
			}

			public bool MeetsCriteria(ExcelCalcValue testValue)
			{
				object resolvedValue = testValue.GetResolvedValue(willUseValueInCalculations: false);
				if (ExcelCalcValue.IsErrorHelper(resolvedValue))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ExcelCalcValue.IsNullHelper(resolvedValue) != ExcelCalcValue.IsNullHelper(_operandResolvedValue))
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				if (ExcelCalcValue.IsStringHelper(resolvedValue))
				{
					if (_operandResolvedStrValue == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				if (ExcelCalcValue.IsBooleanHelper(resolvedValue) != ExcelCalcValue.IsBooleanHelper(_operandResolvedValue))
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = ExcelCalcValue.CompareToHelper(testValue, resolvedValue, _operand, flag ? _operandResolvedStrValue : _operandResolvedValue);
				return _operator switch
				{
					Operator.Equals => num == 0, 
					Operator.NotEquals => num != 0, 
					Operator.GreaterThan => num > 0, 
					Operator.GreaterThanOrEqual => num >= 0, 
					Operator.LessThan => num < 0, 
					Operator.LessThanOrEqual => num <= 0, 
					_ => false, 
				};
			}
		}

		private class EvaluateHelper
		{
			private CriteriaEvaluator evaluator;

			private UltraCalcConditionalFunctionBase owner;

			private ArrayProxy rangeArray;

			private double totalValue;

			public int ValueCount => valueCount;

			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.evaluator = evaluator;
				this.rangeArray = rangeArray;
			}

			public void ValueCallback(ExcelCalcValue currentValue, ArrayValueContext valueContext)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue value = rangeArray.GetValue(valueContext);
				if (evaluator.MeetsCriteria(value))
				{
					valueCount++;
					if (owner.ShouldTotalValues && currentValue.ToDouble(out var result))
					{
						totalValue += result;
					}
				}
				if (rangeArray.AreValuesReusable)
				{
					ExcelCalcNumberStack.OnReusableValueReleased(value);
				}
			}
		}

			if (excelCalcValue != null && (excelCalcValue.IsArrayGroup || !excelCalcValue.IsReference))

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionColumn : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		private const int ReferenceErrorIndex = -1;

		public override string Name => "column";

		public override int MinArgs => 0;

		public override int MaxArgs => 1;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			int[,] columnNumbersFromReference;
			if (argumentCount == 0)
			{
				columnNumbersFromReference = GetColumnNumbersFromReference(numberStack.FormulaOwner);
			}
			else
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
				if (!excelCalcValue.IsReference)
				{
					if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
					{
						return excelCalcValue;
					}
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
				}
				columnNumbersFromReference = GetColumnNumbersFromReference(excelCalcValue.ToReference());
			}
			if (columnNumbersFromReference[0, 0] == -1)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Reference));
			}
			int length = columnNumbersFromReference.GetLength(0);
			int length2 = columnNumbersFromReference.GetLength(1);
			ExcelCalcValue[,] array = new ExcelCalcValue[length, length2];
			for (int i = 0; i < length2; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < length; j++)
				{
					array[j, i] = new ExcelCalcValue(columnNumbersFromReference[j, i]);
				}
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(array);
		}

		private static int[,] GetColumnNumbersFromReference(IExcelCalcReference reference)
		{
			if (reference.Context is CellCalcReference cellCalcReference)
			{
				return new int[1, 1] { { cellCalcReference.ColumnIndex + 1 } };
			}
			if (reference.Context is WorksheetRegion region)
			{
				return GetColumnNumbersFromRegion(region);
			}
			if (reference.Context is ReadOnlyCollection<WorksheetRegion> readOnlyCollection)
			{
				if (readOnlyCollection.Count != 1)
				{
					return new int[1, 1] { { -1 } };
				}
				return GetColumnNumbersFromRegion(readOnlyCollection[0]);
			}
			return new int[1, 1] { { -1 } };
		}

		private static int[,] GetColumnNumbersFromRegion(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			int[,] array = new int[region.Width, region.Height];
			for (int i = 0; i < region.Height; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < region.Width; j++)
				{
					array[j, i] = region.FirstColumn + j + 1;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		{
			return false;
		}
	}
