	internal abstract class UltraCalcFunctionTwoMatrixFunction : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		protected delegate double SumElementCallback1(double element1);

		protected delegate double SumElementCallback2(double element1, double element2);

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected ExcelCalcValue EvaluateHelper(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, SumElementCallback2 callback)
		{
			GetArguments(numberStack, out var error, out var matrix, out var matrix2);
			if (error != null)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(error);
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(SumElements(matrix, matrix2, callback));
		}

		protected static double CalculatePearsonsCorrelationCoefficient(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, out ExcelCalcErrorValue error)
		{
			error = null;
			GetArguments(numberStack, out error, out var matrix, out var matrix2);
			if (error != null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			GetTotals(matrix, matrix2, out var elementCount, out var total, out var total2);
			double average1 = total / (double)elementCount;
			double average2 = total2 / (double)elementCount;
			double num = SumElements(matrix, matrix2, (double element1, double element2) => (element1 - average1) * (element2 - average2));
			double num2 = SumElements(matrix, (double element) => Math.Pow(element - average1, 2.0));
			double num3 = SumElements(matrix2, (double element) => Math.Pow(element - average2, 2.0));
			double num4 = Math.Sqrt(num2 * num3);
			if (num4 == 0.0)
			{
				error = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div);
				return 0.0;
			}
			return num / num4;
		}

		protected static void GetArguments(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, out ExcelCalcErrorValue error, out double[,] matrix1, out double[,] matrix2)
		{
			error = null;
			matrix1 = null;
			matrix2 = null;
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				error = excelCalcValue2.ToErrorValue();
				return;
			}
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				error = excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue();
				return;
			}
			ArrayProxy arrayProxy = excelCalcValue2.ToArrayProxy();
			int length = arrayProxy.GetLength(0);
			int length2 = arrayProxy.GetLength(1);
			ArrayProxy arrayProxy2 = excelCalcValue.ToArrayProxy();
			int length3 = arrayProxy2.GetLength(0);
			int length4 = arrayProxy2.GetLength(1);
			if (length != length3 || length2 != length4)
			{
				error = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.NA);
				return;
			}
			matrix1 = MatrixUtilities.ConvertArrayToMatrix(arrayProxy, MatrixUtilities.NonNumericElementBehavior.Ignore, out error);
			if (error == null)
			{
				matrix2 = MatrixUtilities.ConvertArrayToMatrix(arrayProxy2, MatrixUtilities.NonNumericElementBehavior.Ignore, out error);
			}
		}

		protected static void GetCompareInfo(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, out double regressionLineSlope, out double regressionLineYIntercept, out ExcelCalcErrorValue error)
		{
			error = null;
			regressionLineSlope = 0.0;
			regressionLineYIntercept = 0.0;
			GetArguments(numberStack, out error, out var matrix, out var matrix2);
			if (error == null)
			{
				GetCompareInfo(matrix, matrix2, out var _, out var _, out regressionLineSlope, out regressionLineYIntercept, out error);
			}
		}

		protected static void GetCompareInfo(double[,] knownYs, double[,] knownXs, out double knownYAverage, out double knownXAverage, out double regressionLineSlope, out double regressionLineYIntercept, out ExcelCalcErrorValue error)
		{
			error = null;
			regressionLineSlope = 0.0;
			regressionLineYIntercept = 0.0;
			GetTotals(knownYs, knownXs, out var elementCount, out var total, out var total2);
			knownYAverage = total / (double)elementCount;
			knownXAverage = total2 / (double)elementCount;
			double knownYAverageCopy = knownYAverage;
			double knownXAverageCopy = knownXAverage;
			double num = SumElements(knownYs, knownXs, (double elementY, double elementX) => (elementY - knownYAverageCopy) * (elementX - knownXAverageCopy));
			double num2 = SumElements(knownXs, (double elementX) => Math.Pow(elementX - knownXAverageCopy, 2.0));
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				error = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div);
				return;
			}
			regressionLineSlope = num / num2;
			regressionLineYIntercept = knownYAverage - regressionLineSlope * knownXAverage;
		}

		protected static void GetTotals(double[,] matrix1, double[,] matrix2, out int elementCount, out double total1, out double total2)
		{
			int length = matrix1.GetLength(0);
			int length2 = matrix1.GetLength(1);
			elementCount = length * length2;
			total1 = 0.0;
			total2 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < length2; j++)
				{
					double num = matrix1[i, j];
					double num2 = matrix2[i, j];
					if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsNaN(num2))
					{
						elementCount--;
						matrix1[i, j] = double.NaN;
						matrix2[i, j] = double.NaN;
					}
					else
					{
						total1 += num;
						total2 += num2;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected static double SumElements(double[,] matrix, SumElementCallback1 callback)
		{
			int length = matrix.GetLength(0);
			int length2 = matrix.GetLength(1);
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < length2; j++)
				{
					double num2 = matrix[i, j];
					if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
					{
						num += callback(num2);
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected static double SumElements(double[,] matrix1, double[,] matrix2, SumElementCallback2 callback)
		{
			int length = matrix1.GetLength(0);
			int length2 = matrix1.GetLength(1);
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < length2; j++)
				{
					double num2 = matrix1[i, j];
					double num3 = matrix2[i, j];
					if (!double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsNaN(num3))
					{
						num += callback(num2, num3);
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

			double num2 = UltraCalcFunctionTwoMatrixFunction.SumElements(matrix2, callback);

	internal abstract class UltraCalcFunctionLookupBase : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override int MinArgs => 3;

		public override int MaxArgs => 4;

		private static int? CompareValues(ExcelCalcValue testValue, bool lookupValueIsString, string lookupValueString, bool lookupValueIsBoolean, bool lookupValueBoolean, double lookupValueNumber, Regex matchRegex)
		{
			object resolvedValue = testValue.GetResolvedValue();
			if (Utilities.IsNullResolved(resolvedValue))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (lookupValueIsString)
			{
				if (!ExcelCalcValue.IsStringHelper(resolvedValue))
				{
					return null;
				}
				string text = testValue.ToStringHelper(resolvedValue, testValue.Culture);
				if (matchRegex == null)
				{
					return StringUtilities.StringCompare(text, lookupValueString, testValue.Culture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase);
				}
				Match match = matchRegex.Match(text);
				if (match.Success && match.Length == text.Length)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (lookupValueIsBoolean)
			{
				if (!testValue.IsBoolean)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return testValue.ToBoolean().CompareTo(lookupValueBoolean);
			}
			if (!testValue.ToDoubleHelper(resolvedValue, out var result, testValue.Culture, out var _))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return result.CompareTo(lookupValueNumber);
		}

		protected static Regex ConvertLookupValueToRegex(string lookupValue)
		{
			bool hasWildcards;
			return Utilities.CreateWildcardRegex(lookupValue, out hasWildcards);
		}

		protected static int LookupValue(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<int, ExcelCalcValue>> lookupRange, ExcelCalcValue lookupValue, int matchType)
		{
			bool isString = lookupValue.IsString;
			string text = (isString ? lookupValue.ToString() : null);
			bool isBoolean = lookupValue.IsBoolean;
			bool lookupValueBoolean = isBoolean && lookupValue.ToBoolean();
			double result = 0.0;
			if (!isBoolean && !isString)
			{
				lookupValue.ToDouble(out result);
			}
			Regex matchRegex = null;
			if (isString && matchType == 0)
			{
				matchRegex = ConvertLookupValueToRegex(text);
			}
			int result2 = -1;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, ExcelCalcValue> item in lookupRange)
			{
				int key = item.Key;
				ExcelCalcValue value = item.Value;
				value.IsDynamicReference = true;
				int? num = CompareValues(value, isString, text, isBoolean, lookupValueBoolean, result, matchRegex);
				if (!num.HasValue)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (num.Value == 0)
				{
					return key;
				}
				if (matchType == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (matchType < 0)
				{
					if (num.Value > 0)
					{
						result2 = key;
					}
				}
				else if (num.Value < 0)
				{
					result2 = key;
				}
			}
			return result2;
		}

		protected static bool TryParseRangeLookupArg(ExcelCalcValue rangeLookupArg, out bool rangeLookup)
		{
			rangeLookup = true;
			if (rangeLookupArg != null)
			{
				if (rangeLookupArg.IsBoolean)
				{
					rangeLookup = rangeLookupArg.ToBoolean();
				}
				else if (rangeLookupArg.IsDateTime)
				{
					rangeLookup = true;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!rangeLookupArg.ToDouble(out var result))
					{
						return false;
					}
					rangeLookup = result != 0.0;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool WillParameterBeDereferenced(int parameterIndex)
		{
			if (parameterIndex == 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionRow : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		private const int ReferenceErrorIndex = -1;

		public override string Name => "row";

		public override int MinArgs => 0;

		public override int MaxArgs => 1;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			int[,] rowNumbersFromReference;
			if (argumentCount == 0)
			{
				rowNumbersFromReference = GetRowNumbersFromReference(numberStack.FormulaOwner);
			}
			else
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
				if (!excelCalcValue.IsReference)
				{
					if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
					{
						return excelCalcValue;
					}
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
				}
				rowNumbersFromReference = GetRowNumbersFromReference(excelCalcValue.ToReference());
			}
			if (rowNumbersFromReference[0, 0] == -1)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Reference));
			}
			int length = rowNumbersFromReference.GetLength(0);
			int length2 = rowNumbersFromReference.GetLength(1);
			ExcelCalcValue[,] array = new ExcelCalcValue[length, length2];
			for (int i = 0; i < length2; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < length; j++)
				{
					array[j, i] = new ExcelCalcValue(rowNumbersFromReference[j, i]);
				}
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(array);
		}

		private static int[,] GetRowNumbersFromReference(IExcelCalcReference reference)
		{
			if (reference.Context is CellCalcReference cellCalcReference)
			{
				return new int[1, 1] { { cellCalcReference.Row.Index + 1 } };
			}
			if (reference.Context is WorksheetRegion region)
			{
				return GetRowNumbersFromRegion(region);
			}
			if (reference.Context is ReadOnlyCollection<WorksheetRegion> readOnlyCollection)
			{
				if (readOnlyCollection.Count != 1)
				{
					return new int[1, 1] { { -1 } };
				}
				return GetRowNumbersFromRegion(readOnlyCollection[0]);
			}
			return new int[1, 1] { { -1 } };
		}

		private static int[,] GetRowNumbersFromRegion(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			int[,] array = new int[region.Width, region.Height];
			for (int i = 0; i < region.Height; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < region.Width; j++)
				{
					array[j, i] = region.FirstRow + i + 1;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal override bool WillParameterBeDereferenced(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return excelCalcValue2;
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue.IsReference || !excelCalcValue2.IsReference)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			RegionGroupCalcReference regionGroupCalcReference = RegionGroupCalcReference.FromReference(excelCalcValue.ToReference());
			RegionGroupCalcReference regionGroupCalcReference2 = RegionGroupCalcReference.FromReference(excelCalcValue2.ToReference());
			if (regionGroupCalcReference == null || regionGroupCalcReference2 == null || regionGroupCalcReference.Worksheet == null || regionGroupCalcReference.Worksheet != regionGroupCalcReference2.Worksheet)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(RegionGroupCalcReference.Union(regionGroupCalcReference, regionGroupCalcReference2));
		}

		internal override TokenClass GetExpectedParameterClass(int index)
		{
			if (index == 0 || index == 1)
			{
				return TokenClass.Reference;
			}
			return base.GetExpectedParameterClass(index);
		}

		internal override bool WillParameterBeDereferenced(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ExcelCalcNumberStack
	{
		private readonly AppliedFormula currentFormula;

		private int currentFunctionTokenIndex = -1;

		private ExcelCalcFunction currentFunction;

		private int currentFunctionArgumentCount;

		private int stackCountBeforeFunctionEvaluation;

		private readonly TokenClass finalTokenClass;

		private readonly IExcelCalcReference formulaOwner;

		private bool isInOptimizableSelector;

		private Workbook cachedWorkbook;

		private List<ExcelCalcValue> numberStack;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static ObjectPool<ExcelCalcValue, object> _valuePool;

		internal AppliedFormula CurrentFormula => currentFormula;

		internal int CurrentFunctionTokenIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return currentFunctionTokenIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				currentFunctionTokenIndex = value;
			}
		}

		internal TokenClass FinalTokenClass => finalTokenClass;

		internal IExcelCalcReference FormulaOwner => formulaOwner;

		internal bool IsInOptimizableSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return isInOptimizableSelector;
			}
			set
			{
				isInOptimizableSelector = value;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetCell OwningCell
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(FormulaOwner is CellCalcReference cellCalcReference))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return cellCalcReference.Row.Cells[cellCalcReference.ColumnIndex];
			}
		}

		internal Workbook Workbook
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedWorkbook == null)
				{
					if (!(ExcelCalcEngine.GetResolvedReference(FormulaOwner) is RefBase refBase))
					{
						return null;
					}
					cachedWorkbook = refBase.Workbook;
				}
				return cachedWorkbook;
			}
		}

		internal CultureInfo Culture
		{
			get
			{
				if (Workbook != null)
				{
					return Workbook.CultureResolved;
				}
				return Utilities.CurrentCulture;
			}
		}

		internal ExcelCalcNumberStack(IExcelCalcReference formulaOwner, AppliedFormula formula)
			: this()
		{
			currentFormula = formula;
			this.formulaOwner = formulaOwner;
			finalTokenClass = CalcUtilities.GetExpectedFormulaResultTokenClass(this.formulaOwner);
		}

		private void OnValuePeeked(ref ExcelCalcValue value)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = BeforeReturnValue(value, numberStack.Count);
			if (!object.ReferenceEquals(excelCalcValue, value))
			{
				numberStack[numberStack.Count - 1] = excelCalcValue;
				value = excelCalcValue;
			}
		}

		private void OnValuePopped(ref ExcelCalcValue value)
		{
			value = BeforeReturnValue(value, numberStack.Count + 1);
		}

		private void OnValuePushed(ref ExcelCalcValue value)
		{
			object resolvedValue = value.GetResolvedValue(willUseValueInCalculations: false);
			AppliedFormula appliedFormula = resolvedValue as AppliedFormula;
			if (appliedFormula != null)
			{
				Workbook workbook = Workbook;
				if (!value.IsDynamicReference && appliedFormula.Formula.DoesHaveRelativeReferences())
				{
					WorksheetCell owningCell = OwningCell;
					if (owningCell != null)
					{
						Formula formula = appliedFormula.Formula.Clone();
						formula.OffsetReferences(workbook, owningCell.Row, owningCell.ColumnIndexInternal, new Point(owningCell.ColumnIndex, owningCell.RowIndex));
						appliedFormula = workbook.CompileFormula(appliedFormula.TargetReference, formula);
					}
				}
				value = appliedFormula.EvaluateHelper(workbook, formulaOwner, IsInOptimizableSelector);
			}
			value.CalculationContext = new CalculationContext(this, TokenClass.Reference);
			if (IsInOptimizableSelector && value.IsReference)
			{
				value.IsDynamicReference = true;
			}
		}

		private ExcelCalcValue BeforeReturnValue(ExcelCalcValue value, int stackCountBeforePeekOrPop)
		{
			if (currentFunction == null)
			{
				value.CalculationContext.ExpectedTokenClass = FinalTokenClass;
			}
			else
			{
				int num = currentFunctionArgumentCount - 1 - (stackCountBeforeFunctionEvaluation - stackCountBeforePeekOrPop);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					bool flag = currentFunction.WillParameterBeDereferenced(num);
					value.CalculationContext.ExpectedTokenClass = currentFunction.GetExpectedParameterClass(num);
					if (FormulaOwner != null && flag && value.IsReference && value.IsDynamicReference && (!((AppliedFormula)FormulaOwner.Formula).IsArrayFormula || currentFunction.GetExpectedParameterClass(num) != TokenClass.Value))
					{
						FormulaOwner.Formula.AddDynamicReference(value.ToReference());
						value.IsDynamicReference = false;
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal ExcelCalcValue GetParameterForCurrentFunction(int currentFunctionParamIndex)
		{
			int num = stackCountBeforeFunctionEvaluation - currentFunctionArgumentCount + currentFunctionParamIndex;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(null);
			}
			return numberStack[num];
		}

		internal void OnAfterFunctionEvaluation()
		{
			currentFunction = null;
			currentFunctionArgumentCount = 0;
		}

		internal void OnBeforeFunctionEvaluation(ExcelCalcFunction function, int argumentCount)
		{
			stackCountBeforeFunctionEvaluation = numberStack.Count;
			currentFunction = function;
			currentFunctionArgumentCount = argumentCount;
		}

		public ExcelCalcNumberStack()
		{
			numberStack = new List<ExcelCalcValue>();
			if (_valuePool == null)
			{
				_valuePool = new ObjectPool<ExcelCalcValue, object>((object value) => new ExcelCalcValue(value), delegate(ExcelCalcValue value, object v)
				{
					value.Initialize(v);
				});
			}
		}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue CreateReusableValue(object value)
		{
			return _valuePool.GetItem(value);
		}

		internal static void OnReusableValueReleased(ExcelCalcValue value)
		{
			value.IsDynamicReference = false;
			value.CalculationContext = default(CalculationContext);
			_valuePool.OnItemReleased(value);
		}

		public void Push(ExcelCalcValue value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			OnValuePushed(ref value);
			numberStack.Add(value);
		}

		public ExcelCalcValue Pop()
		{
			ExcelCalcValue value = numberStack[numberStack.Count - 1];
			numberStack.RemoveAt(numberStack.Count - 1);
			OnValuePopped(ref value);
			return value;
		}

		public ExcelCalcValue Peek()
		{
			ExcelCalcValue value = numberStack[numberStack.Count - 1];
			OnValuePeeked(ref value);
			return value;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			numberStack.Clear();
		}

		public void Reset(int elements)
		{
			numberStack.RemoveRange(elements, numberStack.Count - elements);
		}

		public int Count()
		{
			return numberStack.Count;
		}
	}
	internal class ValueFormatter

			public bool GeneratedFractionUsesFullNumber => generatedFractionUsesFullNumber;

			public bool HasVerbatimString => hasVerbatimString;

			public int FractionDigitCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (!hasDecimalSeparator)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					if (cachedFractionDigitCount < 0)
					{
						cachedFractionDigitCount = 0;
						bool flag = false;
						for (int i = 0; i < parts.Count; i++)
						{
							if (parts[i] is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart)
							{
								if (wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.Scientific || wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.ScientificWithSign)
								{
									break;
								}
								if (wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.DecimalSeparator)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								else if (flag && WellKnownPart.IsDigit(wellKnownPart.Type))
								{
									cachedFractionDigitCount++;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return cachedFractionDigitCount;
				}
			}

			public int? GeneratedDenominatorSpecifiedValue
			{
				get
				{
					return generatedDenominatorSpecifiedValue;
				}
				set
				{
					generatedDenominatorSpecifiedValue = value;
				}
			}

			public int? GeneratedDenominatorMaxDigitCount
			{
				get
				{
					return generatedDenominatorMaxDigitCount;
				}
				set
				{
					generatedDenominatorMaxDigitCount = value;
				}
			}

			public int GeneratedDenominatorDigitCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (!hasFractionSeparator)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					if (cachedGeneratedDenominatorDigitCount < 0)
					{
						cachedGeneratedDenominatorDigitCount = 0;
						bool flag = false;
						for (int i = 0; i < parts.Count; i++)
						{
							if (parts[i] is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart)
							{
								if (wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.FractionSeparator)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
								else if (flag && WellKnownPart.IsDigit(wellKnownPart.Type))
								{
									cachedGeneratedDenominatorDigitCount++;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return cachedGeneratedDenominatorDigitCount;
				}
			}

			public int GeneratedNumeratorDigitCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (!hasFractionSeparator || !generatedNumeratorPartIndex.HasValue)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					if (cachedGeneratedNumeratorDigitCount < 0)
					{
						cachedGeneratedNumeratorDigitCount = 0;
						for (int i = generatedNumeratorPartIndex.Value; i < parts.Count; i++)
						{
							if (parts[i] is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart)
							{
								if (wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.FractionSeparator)
								{
									break;
								}
								if (WellKnownPart.IsDigit(wellKnownPart.Type))
								{
									cachedGeneratedNumeratorDigitCount++;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return cachedGeneratedNumeratorDigitCount;
				}
			}

			public int GroupShiftCount => groupShiftCount;

			public bool HasAMPMPart => hasAMPMPart;

			internal bool HasAnyDateParts => hasDateParts;

			internal bool HasAnyTimeParts => hasTimeParts;

			public bool HasCustomComparison => hasCustomComparison;

			public bool HasDecimalSeparator => hasDecimalSeparator;

			public bool HasScientificNotation => hasScientificNotation;

			public bool IsForcedDateTimeStyle
			{
				get
				{
					if (!forcedLongDateStyle)
					{
						return forcedLongTimeStyle;
					}
					return true;
				}
			}

			public bool IsValid => isValid;

			public Part LastPart
			{
				get
				{
					if (parts.Count == 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return parts[parts.Count - 1];
				}
			}

			public int NumberDigitCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (hasFractionSeparator && generatedFractionUsesFullNumber)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					if (cachedNumberDigitCount < 0)
					{
						cachedNumberDigitCount = 0;
						for (int i = 0; i < parts.Count && (!generatedNumeratorPartIndex.HasValue || i != generatedNumeratorPartIndex.Value); i++)
						{
							if (parts[i] is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart)
							{
								if (wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.DecimalSeparator || wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.Scientific || wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.ScientificWithSign)
								{
									break;
								}
								if (WellKnownPart.IsDigit(wellKnownPart.Type))
								{
									cachedNumberDigitCount++;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return cachedNumberDigitCount;
				}
			}

			public int PercentCount => percentCount;

			public int ScientificExponentDigitCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (!hasScientificNotation)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					if (cachedScientificExponentDigitCount < 0)
					{
						cachedScientificExponentDigitCount = 0;
						bool flag = false;
						for (int i = 0; i < parts.Count; i++)
						{
							if (!(parts[i] is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart))
							{
								continue;
							}
							if (wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.Scientific || wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.ScientificWithSign)
							{
								flag = true;
							}
							else if (flag)
							{
								if (wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.DecimalSeparator)
								{
									break;
								}
								if (WellKnownPart.IsDigit(wellKnownPart.Type))
								{
									cachedScientificExponentDigitCount++;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return cachedScientificExponentDigitCount;
				}
			}

			public SectionType SectionType => sectionType;

			internal void AddPaddingCharacters(ValueFormatterContext context, int paddingPosition, char paddingChar, ref int width)
			{
				if (paddingChar != 0 && paddingPosition >= 0)
				{
					int num = context.AvailablePixels - width;
					double widthAsDouble = context.GetTextWidthHelper.GetWidthAsDouble(paddingChar.ToString());
					int num2 = (int)((double)num / widthAsDouble);
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						string value = new string(paddingChar, num2);
						context.FormattedText.Insert(paddingPosition, value);
						context.FormattedTextForMeasurement.Insert(paddingPosition, value);
					}
				}
			}

			private void AdjustFormattedTextForAvailableWidth(ValueFormatterContext context, ref FormulaValueInfo info, FormatValueState state, ref bool shouldReMeasure)
			{
				if (context.GetTextWidthHelper == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int width = context.GetTextWidthHelper.GetWidth(context.FormattedTextForMeasurement.ToString());
				int num = context.AvailablePixels;
				for (int i = 0; i < context.FormattedText.Length; i++)
				{
					char c = context.FormattedText[i];
					if (c == '.')
					{
						if (PercentCount == 0)
						{
							if (info.DecimalSizeCorrection < 0)
							{
								info.DecimalSizeCorrection = Math.Max(0, context.GetTextWidthHelper.GetWidth("0") - context.GetTextWidthHelper.GetWidth("."));
							}
							num -= info.DecimalSizeCorrection;
						}
					}
					else if (HasScientificNotation && c == 'E' && i < context.FormattedText.Length - 1)
					{
						if (context.FormattedText[i + 1].ToString() == culture.NumberFormat.NegativeSign || context.FormattedText[i + 1].ToString() == culture.NumberFormat.PositiveSign)
						{
							num -= Math.Max(0, context.GetTextWidthHelper.GetWidth("0") - context.GetTextWidthHelper.GetWidth(context.FormattedText[i + 1].ToString()));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						UnicodeCategory unicodeCategory = CharUnicodeInfo.GetUnicodeCategory(c);
						if (unicodeCategory == UnicodeCategory.OtherLetter)
						{
							num--;
						}
					}
				}
				if (width <= num)
				{
					AddPaddingCharacters(context, info.PaddingPosition, info.PaddingChar, ref width);
					return;
				}
				if (context.Value == 0.0)
				{
					context.ClearText();
					return;
				}
				if (!info.HasGeneralPart && !info.HasVerbatimPart)
				{
					context.ClearText();
					return;
				}
				if (info.HasVerbatimPart && sectionIndex != 0)
				{
					context.ClearText();
					return;
				}
				if (0 < state.FractionDigitsUsedInVerbatimString && info.MinimumFractionDigitsNeeded < state.FractionDigitsUsedInVerbatimString)
				{
					state.FractionDigitsAllowedInVerbatimString = state.FractionDigitsUsedInVerbatimString - 1;
				}
				else
				{
					if (info.TriedUsingScientificValues)
					{
						context.ClearText();
						return;
					}
					info.TriedUsingScientificValues = true;
					for (int num2 = 5; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						context.ClearText();
						FormatSection formatSection = new FormatSection(formatter, sectionIndex, culture);
						if (info.HasVerbatimPart)
						{
							formatSection.AddScientificParts(num2);
						}
						else
						{
							foreach (Part part in parts)
							{
								if (part is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart)
								{
									if (wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.GeneralString)
									{
										formatSection.AddScientificParts(num2);
									}
									else
									{
										formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(wellKnownPart.Type);
									}
								}
								else if (part is LiteralFormatPart literalFormatPart)
								{
									formatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(literalFormatPart.Text, literalFormatPart.Type);
								}
							}
						}
						formatSection.FormatValue(ref context, out var usedFractionDigits);
						if (context.TextLength != 0 && usedFractionDigits == num2)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
					if (info.MinimumFractionDigitsNeeded == 0)
					{
						context.ClearText();
						return;
					}
					if (info.HasVerbatimPart || parts.Count > 1)
					{
						context.UseRoundedValue = true;
						context.ClearText();
						return;
					}
					state.FractionDigitsAllowedInVerbatimString = 0;
				}
				shouldReMeasure = true;
			}

			public FormatSection(ValueFormatter formatter, int sectionIndex, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				this.culture = culture;
				this.formatter = formatter;
				this.sectionIndex = sectionIndex;
				switch (this.sectionIndex)
				{
				case 0:
					compareOperator = CompareOperator.GreaterThan;
					compareOperand = 0.0;
					break;
				case 1:
					compareOperator = CompareOperator.LessThan;
					compareOperand = 0.0;
					break;
				}
			}

			public void AddLiteralFormatPart(char c, LiteralType type = LiteralType.Normal)
			{
				AddLiteralFormatPart(c.ToString(), type);
			}

			public void AddLiteralFormatPart(string text, LiteralType type = LiteralType.Normal)
			{
				parts.Add(new LiteralFormatPart(text, type));
			}

			private void AddScientificParts(int numberOfScientificFractionalDigits)
			{
				AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero);
				if (numberOfScientificFractionalDigits != 0)
				{
					AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DecimalSeparator);
					AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero);
					for (int i = 1; i < numberOfScientificFractionalDigits; i++)
					{
						AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrEmpty);
					}
				}
				AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.ScientificWithSign);
				AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero);
				AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero);
			}

			public void AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType type)
			{
				AddWellKnownPart(type, 1);
			}

			public void AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType type, int repeatCount)
			{
				if (WellKnownPart.IsDigit(type))
				{
					cachedGeneratedDenominatorDigitCount = -1;
					cachedGeneratedNumeratorDigitCount = -1;
					cachedNumberDigitCount = -1;
					cachedFractionDigitCount = -1;
					cachedScientificExponentDigitCount = -1;
				}
				if (WellKnownPart.IsDate(type))
				{
					hasDateParts = true;
					SetSectionType(SectionType.Date);
				}
				else if (WellKnownPart.IsTime(type))
				{
					hasTimeParts = true;
					SetSectionType(SectionType.Date);
				}
				switch (type)
				{
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortLL:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortLU:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortUL:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortUU:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMChinese:
					hasAMPMPart = true;
					break;
				case WellKnownPartType.DecimalSeparator:
					hasDecimalSeparator = true;
					break;
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrEmpty:
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero:
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrWhitespace:
					SetSectionType(SectionType.Number);
					if (!(LastPart is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart4) || (!WellKnownPart.IsDigit(wellKnownPart4.Type) && wellKnownPart4.Type != WellKnownPartType.DecimalSeparator))
					{
						ResetGroupShiftCount();
					}
					break;
				case WellKnownPartType.FractionSeparator:
				{
					if (hasFractionSeparator || hasScientificNotation)
					{
						isValid = false;
						return;
					}
					hasFractionSeparator = true;
					bool flag = false;
					generatedFractionIsOptional = true;
					for (int num3 = parts.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
					{
						Part part3 = parts[num3];
						if (!(part3 is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart3))
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							if (generatedNumeratorPartIndex.HasValue)
							{
								if (wellKnownPart3.Type == WellKnownPartType.DecimalSeparator)
								{
									isValid = false;
									return;
								}
								if (WellKnownPart.IsDigit(wellKnownPart3.Type))
								{
									if (flag)
									{
										generatedFractionUsesFullNumber = false;
									}
									else
									{
										generatedNumeratorPartIndex = num3;
									}
								}
							}
							else if (wellKnownPart3.Type == WellKnownPartType.DecimalSeparator || WellKnownPart.IsDigit(wellKnownPart3.Type))
							{
								generatedNumeratorPartIndex = num3;
							}
							if (!flag && wellKnownPart3.Type == WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero)
							{
								generatedFractionIsOptional = false;
							}
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.GeneralString:
					SetSectionType(SectionType.Text);
					break;
				case WellKnownPartType.GroupShiftPlaceholder:
				{
					for (int num = parts.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						Part part = parts[num];
						if (!(part is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart))
						{
							ResetGroupShiftCount();
							break;
						}
						if (wellKnownPart.Type == WellKnownPartType.GroupShiftPlaceholder)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					groupShiftCount += repeatCount;
					break;
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds1:
				case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds2:
				case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds3:
					hasMillisecondPart = true;
					break;
				case WellKnownPartType.Percent:
					SetSectionType(SectionType.Number);
					percentCount++;
					break;
				case WellKnownPartType.Scientific:
				case WellKnownPartType.ScientificWithSign:
					SetSectionType(SectionType.Number);
					if (hasScientificNotation || hasFractionSeparator)
					{
						isValid = false;
						return;
					}
					hasScientificNotation = true;
					ResetGroupShiftCount();
					break;
				case WellKnownPartType.VerbatimString:
					hasVerbatimString = true;
					SetSectionType(SectionType.Text);
					break;
				case WellKnownPartType.YearsShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.YearsLong:
				{
					for (int num2 = parts.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						Part part2 = parts[num2];
						if (part2 is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart2)
						{
							switch (wellKnownPart2.Type)
							{
							case WellKnownPartType.EraEnglishName:
							case WellKnownPartType.EraAbbreviatedName:
							case WellKnownPartType.EraName:
								break;
							default:
								continue;
							}
							type = WellKnownPartType.EraYearsLong;
							break;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.BuddhistYearsLong:
					if (cultureForDates != null)
					{
						type = WellKnownPartType.YearsLong;
					}
					break;
				case WellKnownPartType.BuddhistYearsShort:
					if (cultureForDates != null)
					{
						type = WellKnownPartType.YearsShort;
					}
					break;
				}
				parts.Add(new WellKnownPart(type, repeatCount));
			}

			public string ConvertNumberTextToNativeDigits(string valueText)
			{
				if (!shouldConvertNativeDigits)
				{
					return valueText;
				}
				NumberFormatInfo numberFormat = CultureForDatesResolved.NumberFormat;
				string[] nativeDigits = numberFormat.NativeDigits;
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				foreach (char c in valueText)
				{
					if ('0' <= c && c <= '9')
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(nativeDigits[c - 48]);
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(c);
					}
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}

			internal Calendar CreateCalendar(int calendarId)
			{
				switch (calendarId)
				{
				case 0:
					return CultureForDatesResolved.Calendar;
				case 1:
				case 2:
				case 9:
				case 10:
				case 11:
				case 12:
					return new GregorianCalendar((GregorianCalendarTypes)calendarId);
				case 3:
					return new JapaneseCalendar();
				case 4:
					return new TaiwanCalendar();
				case 5:
					return new KoreanCalendar();
				case 6:
					return new HijriCalendar();
				case 7:
					return new ThaiBuddhistCalendar();
				case 8:
					return new HebrewCalendar();
				case 13:
					return new JulianCalendar();
				case 14:
					return new JapaneseLunisolarCalendar();
				case 15:
					return new ChineseLunisolarCalendar();
				case 20:
					return new KoreanLunisolarCalendar();
				case 21:
					return new TaiwanLunisolarCalendar();
				case 22:
					return new PersianCalendar();
				case 23:
					return new UmAlQuraCalendar();
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}

			public string CultureFormatDay(DateTime dateTime, FormatValueState state, int requiredNumberOfDigits)
			{
				int value = ((dateTime.Year != 1899 || CalendarResolved.GetYear(dateTime) != 1899) ? ((!(state.OriginalValue < ExcelBoundaryEnd) || !(state.OriginalValue >= ExcelBoundaryStart) || !(dateTime < ExcelBoundaryDate)) ? CalendarResolved.GetDayOfMonth(dateTime) : (CalendarResolved.GetDayOfMonth(dateTime.AddDays(-1.0)) + 1)) : 0);
				return CultureFormatNumber(value, requiredNumberOfDigits);
			}

			public string CultureFormatDay(DateTime dateTime, FormatValueState state, string format)
			{
				if (dateTime < ExcelBoundaryDate)
				{
					dateTime = ExcelCalcValue.ExcelDateToDateTime(Formatter.workbook, state.OriginalValue, shouldCorrect1900Dates: false, allowDateBeforeMinimum: true).Value;
				}
				return dateTime.ToString(format, CultureForDatesResolved);
			}

			public string CultureFormatMonth(DateTime dateTime, FormatValueState state, int requiredNumberOfDigits)
			{
				int value = ((dateTime.Year == 1899 && CalendarResolved.GetYear(dateTime) == 1899) ? 1 : ((!(state.OriginalValue < ExcelBoundaryEnd) || !(state.OriginalValue >= ExcelBoundaryStart) || !(dateTime < ExcelBoundaryDate)) ? CalendarResolved.GetMonth(dateTime) : CalendarResolved.GetMonth(dateTime.AddDays(-1.0))));
				return CultureFormatNumber(value, requiredNumberOfDigits);
			}

			public string CultureFormatMonth(DateTime dateTime, FormatValueState state, string format)
			{
				if (dateTime.Year == 1899 && CalendarResolved.GetYear(dateTime) == 1899)
				{
					return new DateTime(1900, 1, 1).ToString(format, CultureForDatesResolved);
				}
				if (state.OriginalValue < ExcelBoundaryEnd && state.OriginalValue >= ExcelBoundaryStart && dateTime < ExcelBoundaryDate)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(-1.0);
				}
				return dateTime.ToString(format, CultureForDatesResolved);
			}

			public string CultureFormatNumber(double value, bool allowScientificRepresentation = true)
			{
				string text = (allowScientificRepresentation ? value.ToString(Culture) : MathUtilities.DoubleToStringNonScientific(value, Culture));
				if (HasVerbatimString)
				{
					return text;
				}
				return ConvertNumberTextToNativeDigits(text);
			}

			public string CultureFormatNumber(int value)
			{
				return CultureFormatNumber(value, 1);
			}

			public string CultureFormatNumber(int value, int requiredNumberOfDigits)
			{
				NumberFormatInfo numberFormat = CultureForDatesResolved.NumberFormat;
				string[] array = InvariantCultureNativeDigits;
				if (!HasVerbatimString)
				{
					array = numberFormat.NativeDigits;
				}
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(requiredNumberOfDigits);
				while (true)
				{
					int num;
					if (value == 0)
					{
						if (stringBuilder.Length >= requiredNumberOfDigits)
						{
							break;
						}
						num = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						num = value % 10;
						value /= 10;
					}
					stringBuilder.Insert(0, array[num]);
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}

			public string CultureFormatYear(DateTime dateTime, int requiredNumberOfDigits)
			{
				return CultureFormatYear(CalendarResolved, dateTime, requiredNumberOfDigits);
			}

			public string CultureFormatYear(Calendar calendar, DateTime dateTime, int requiredNumberOfDigits)
			{
				int num = calendar.GetYear(dateTime);
				if (dateTime.Year == 1899 && num == 1899)
				{
					num = 1900;
				}
				if (requiredNumberOfDigits == 2)
				{
					num %= 100;
				}
				return CultureFormatNumber(num, requiredNumberOfDigits);
			}

			public void FormatText(ref ValueFormatterContext context)
			{
				context.InitializeForFormatText();
				int paddingPosition = -1;
				char paddingChar = '\0';
				if (!HasVerbatimString && sectionIndex != 3)
				{
					context.SetText(context.Text);
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (Part part in parts)
					{
						if (part is WellKnownPart { Type: WellKnownPartType.GeneralString })
						{
							context.SetText(context.Text);
							break;
						}
						string text = part.GetText(this, context.Text);
						LiteralFormatPart literalFormatPart = part as LiteralFormatPart;
						if (literalFormatPart != null && literalFormatPart.Type == LiteralType.Repeated)
						{
							paddingPosition = context.TextLength;
							paddingChar = literalFormatPart.Text[0];
						}
						if (text == null)
						{
							context.Result = false;
							return;
						}
						if (literalFormatPart != null && literalFormatPart.Type == LiteralType.Placeholder)
						{
							context.AppendText(text, literalFormatPart.Text);
						}
						else
						{
							context.AppendText(text);
						}
					}
				}
				context.VerifyFormattedTextWidth(this, paddingChar, paddingPosition);
			}

			public void FormatValue(ref ValueFormatterContext context, out int usedFractionDigits)
			{
				usedFractionDigits = 0;
				context.InitializeForFormatValue(this);
				if (SectionType == SectionType.Number && !HasScientificNotation && !HasFractionSeparator && !HasDecimalSeparator && PercentCount == 0)
				{
					context.Value = MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(context.Value);
				}
				if (context.Value < 0.0)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					switch (sectionIndex)
					{
					case 0:
						flag = !hasCustomComparison || compareOperand != 0.0;
						break;
					case 1:
						if (formatter.formatSections[2] != null)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (HasVerbatimString)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						else if (!HasCustomComparison)
						{
							FormatSection formatSection = formatter.formatSections[0];
							if (formatSection.HasCustomComparison && formatSection.compareOperand != 0.0)
							{
								flag = true;
							}
						}
						break;
					case 2:
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						context.AppendText(culture.NumberFormat.NegativeSign);
					}
				}
				FormatValueState formatValueState = new FormatValueState(this, context.Value, context.UseExpandedFractionLimit);
				string value = context.FormattedText.ToString();
				string value2 = context.FormattedTextForMeasurement.ToString();
				FormulaValueInfo info = default(FormulaValueInfo);
				info.MinimumFractionDigitsNeeded = Math.Max(0, -MathUtilities.FloorOfLog10(Math.Abs(context.Value)));
				info.DecimalSizeCorrection = -1;
				info.HasGeneralPart = false;
				info.HasVerbatimPart = false;
				info.TriedUsingScientificValues = false;
				while (true)
				{
					info.PaddingPosition = -1;
					info.PaddingChar = '\0';
					if (SectionType == SectionType.Text && HasVerbatimString)
					{
						info.HasVerbatimPart = true;
						context.AppendText(GetVerbatimString(formatValueState));
					}
					else if (forcedLongDateStyle)
					{
						if (!formatValueState.DateTime.HasValue)
						{
							context.ClearText();
							break;
						}
						context.AppendText(formatValueState.DateTime.Value.ToLongDateString());
					}
					else if (forcedLongTimeStyle)
					{
						if (!formatValueState.DateTime.HasValue)
						{
							context.ClearText();
							break;
						}
						context.AppendText(formatValueState.DateTime.Value.ToLongTimeString());
					}
					else
					{
						foreach (Part part in parts)
						{
							string text = part.GetText(this, formatValueState);
							LiteralFormatPart literalFormatPart = part as LiteralFormatPart;
							if (literalFormatPart != null && literalFormatPart.Type == LiteralType.Repeated)
							{
								info.PaddingPosition = context.TextLength;
								info.PaddingChar = literalFormatPart.Text[0];
							}
							else if (part is WellKnownPart { Type: WellKnownPartType.GeneralString })
							{
								info.HasGeneralPart = true;
							}
							if (text == null)
							{
								context.ClearText();
								return;
							}
							if (literalFormatPart != null && literalFormatPart.Type == LiteralType.Placeholder)
							{
								context.AppendText(text, literalFormatPart.Text);
							}
							else
							{
								context.AppendText(text);
							}
						}
					}
					usedFractionDigits = formatValueState.FractionFormatDigitsUsed;
					bool shouldReMeasure = false;
					AdjustFormattedTextForAvailableWidth(context, ref info, formatValueState, ref shouldReMeasure);
					if (!shouldReMeasure)
					{
						break;
					}
					context.FormattedText.Clear();
					context.FormattedText.Append(value);
					context.FormattedTextForMeasurement.Clear();
					context.FormattedTextForMeasurement.Append(value2);
				}
			}

			public string GetColor()
			{
				return color;
			}

			public WellKnownPart GetLastDateTimePart()
			{
				for (int num = parts.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (parts[num] is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart && WellKnownPart.IsDateTime(wellKnownPart.Type))
					{
						return wellKnownPart;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public string GetVerbatimString(FormatValueState state)
			{
				double absoluteValue = state.AbsoluteValue;
				if (absoluteValue == 0.0)
				{
					return CultureFormatNumber(absoluteValue);
				}
				bool flag = false;
				if (state.FractionDigitsAllowedInVerbatimString == -1)
				{
					double num = (state.UseExpandedFractionLimit ? 1E-05 : 0.0001);
					if (absoluteValue < num)
					{
						int num2 = (state.UseExpandedFractionLimit ? 20 : 9);
						double num3 = Round(absoluteValue, num2);
						if (num3 == 0.0)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							string text = CultureFormatNumber(num3, allowScientificRepresentation: false);
							int num4 = (state.UseExpandedFractionLimit ? 21 : 11);
							if (text.Length <= num4)
							{
								state.FractionDigitsUsedInVerbatimString = num2;
								return text;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						double num5 = (state.UseExpandedFractionLimit ? 1E+21 : 99999999999.5);
						if (num5 <= absoluteValue)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					int num6 = MathUtilities.FloorOfLog10(Math.Abs(absoluteValue));
					double num7 = absoluteValue / Math.Pow(10.0, num6);
					if (num7 < 1.0 && state.UseExpandedFractionLimit)
					{
						num7 *= 10.0;
						num6--;
					}
					string text2 = CultureFormatNumber(Math.Abs(num6), 2);
					int num8 = (state.UseExpandedFractionLimit ? 16 : 7);
					int digits = Math.Max(0, num8 - text2.Length);
					string text3 = CultureFormatNumber(Math.Round(num7, digits));
					string text4 = ((num6 < 0) ? Culture.NumberFormat.NegativeSign : Culture.NumberFormat.PositiveSign);
					return text3 + "E" + text4 + text2;
				}
				int num9;
				if (absoluteValue < 1.0)
				{
					num9 = (state.UseExpandedFractionLimit ? 20 : 9);
				}
				else
				{
					int num10 = MathUtilities.FloorOfLog10(Math.Abs(absoluteValue)) + 1;
					int num11 = (state.UseExpandedFractionLimit ? 15 : 10);
					num9 = Math.Max(0, num11 - num10);
				}
				if (state.FractionDigitsAllowedInVerbatimString != -1)
				{
					num9 = Math.Min(state.FractionDigitsAllowedInVerbatimString, num9);
				}
				state.FractionDigitsUsedInVerbatimString = num9;
				return CultureFormatNumber(Round(absoluteValue, num9), allowScientificRepresentation: false);
			}

			public void InsertGroupSeparators(ref string text, int currentDigitPosition, string numberText)
			{
				InsertGroupSeparators(ref text, currentDigitPosition, numberText, culture.NumberFormat.NumberGroupSeparator);
			}

			public void InsertGroupSeparators(ref string text, int currentDigitPosition, string numberText, string separator)
			{
				if (!shouldShowGroupSeparators)
				{
					return;
				}
				int[] numberGroupSizes = culture.NumberFormat.NumberGroupSizes;
				int length = text.Length;
				int num = NumberDigitCount - currentDigitPosition + (length - 1) - 1;
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < numberGroupSizes.Length; i++)
				{
					int num3 = numberGroupSizes[i];
					num2 += num3;
					if (num < num2)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (num - (length - 1) <= num2)
					{
						text = text.Insert(num - num2 + 1, separator);
					}
					if (i == numberGroupSizes.Length - 1)
					{
						if (num3 == 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						i--;
					}
				}
			}

			public bool MeetsCriteria(double value)
			{
				return compareOperator switch
				{
					CompareOperator.AnyValue => true, 
					CompareOperator.Equals => value == compareOperand, 
					CompareOperator.NotEquals => value != compareOperand, 
					CompareOperator.LessThan => value < compareOperand, 
					CompareOperator.LessThanOrEquals => value <= compareOperand, 
					CompareOperator.GreaterThan => value > compareOperand, 
					CompareOperator.GreaterThanOrEquals => value >= compareOperand, 
					_ => true, 
				};
			}

			public void ResetGroupShiftCount()
			{
				groupShiftCount = 0;
			}

			public bool SetColor(string color)
			{
				if (this.color != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				this.color = color;
				return true;
			}

			public bool SetComparisonType(CompareOperator compareOperator, double compareOperand)
			{
				return SetComparisonType(compareOperator, compareOperand, hasCustomComparison: true);
			}

			public bool SetComparisonType(CompareOperator compareOperator, double compareOperand, bool hasCustomComparison)
			{
				if (this.hasCustomComparison)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (sectionIndex >= 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				this.hasCustomComparison = hasCustomComparison;
				this.compareOperator = compareOperator;
				this.compareOperand = compareOperand;
				return true;
			}

			public bool SetLocaleId(int localeId)
			{
				if (cultureForDates != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (localeId)
				{
				case 63488:
					parts.Clear();
					forcedLongDateStyle = true;
					SetSectionType(SectionType.Date);
					return true;
				case 62464:
					parts.Clear();
					forcedLongTimeStyle = true;
					SetSectionType(SectionType.Date);
					return true;
				default:
					try
					{
						int bits = Utilities.GetBits(localeId, 24, 31);
						int bits2 = Utilities.GetBits(localeId, 16, 23);
						localeId = Utilities.GetBits(localeId, 0, 15);
						if (localeId == 0)
						{
							int num = bits;
							if (num == 1 || num == 13)
							{
								localeId = 1054;
							}
						}
						cultureForDates = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo(localeId);
						string[] nativeDigits = cultureForDates.NumberFormat.NativeDigits;
						for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
						{
							if (i.ToString() != nativeDigits[i])
							{
								shouldConvertNativeDigits = true;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (cultureForDates.TwoLetterISOLanguageName == "ja")
						{
							calendarForEras = CreateCalendar(3);
						}
						calendar = CreateCalendar(bits2) ?? calendar;
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
					return true;
				}
			}

			public void SetSectionType(SectionType sectionType)
			{
				if (this.sectionType != sectionType)
				{
					if (this.sectionType != SectionType.Default)
					{
						isValid = false;
					}
					else
					{
						this.sectionType = sectionType;
					}
				}
			}

			public bool ShouldOmitFractionSection(FormatValueState state)
			{
				if (generatedFractionIsOptional)
				{
					return state.GeneratedNumerator == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void ShowGroupSeparators()
			{
				shouldShowGroupSeparators = true;
			}
		}

		private class GetTextWidthHelper
		{
			private readonly WorksheetCellFormatData _cellFormat;

			private readonly TextMetricsProviderBase _metricsProvider;

			public bool IsForDisplay => _metricsProvider.IsDisplayProvider;

			public GetTextWidthHelper(TextMetricsProviderBase metricsProvider, WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat)
			{
				_cellFormat = cellFormat;
				_metricsProvider = metricsProvider;
			}

			public int GetWidth(string text)
			{
				return _metricsProvider.MeasureText(_cellFormat, text).Width;
			}

			public double GetWidthAsDouble(string text)
			{
				return _metricsProvider.MeasureText(_cellFormat, text).Width;
			}
		}

		private class ValueFormatterContext
		{
			public int AvailablePixels;

			public object CellValue;

			public GetTextWidthHelper GetTextWidthHelper;

			public SectionType FormattedAs;

			public bool UseHashes;

			public bool UseRoundedValue;

			public readonly StringBuilder FormattedText = new StringBuilder();

			public readonly StringBuilder FormattedTextForMeasurement = new StringBuilder();

			public bool? Result;

			public string Text;

			public double Value;

			public string Color;

			public bool UseExpandedFractionLimit;

			public int TextLength => FormattedText.Length;

			private void CheckForTooWideBooleanValueCore()
			{
				if (CellValue is bool && GetTextWidthHelper != null)
				{
					int width = GetTextWidthHelper.GetWidth(Text);
					if (AvailablePixels < width)
					{
						UseHashes = true;
						Result = false;
					}
				}
			}

			private void InitializeForTryFormatValueCore()
			{
				if (CellValue is bool && !(bool)CellValue)
				{
					AvailablePixels--;
				}
				UseHashes = false;
				FormattedAs = SectionType.Text;
			}

			private void InitializeForTryFormatNumberCore()
			{
				UseHashes = true;
				FormattedAs = SectionType.Number;
			}

			private void InitializeForFormatTextCore()
			{
				UseHashes = false;
			}

			private void InitializeForFormatValueCore(FormatSection section)
			{
				UseRoundedValue = false;
				FormattedAs = section.SectionType;
			}

			private void PreProcessMeasurementText(ref string text)
			{
				if (FormattedAs == SectionType.Number && GetTextWidthHelper != null && !GetTextWidthHelper.IsForDisplay)
				{
					text = text.Replace(' ', '0');
				}
			}

			private void ResetHelper()
			{
				AvailablePixels = 0;
				CellValue = null;
				GetTextWidthHelper = null;
				FormattedAs = SectionType.Default;
				UseHashes = false;
				UseRoundedValue = false;
			}

			private void VerifyFormattedTextWidthCore(FormatSection section, char paddingChar, int paddingPosition)
			{
				if (GetTextWidthHelper != null)
				{
					int width = GetTextWidthHelper.GetWidth(FormattedTextForMeasurement.ToString());
					if (width <= AvailablePixels)
					{
						section.AddPaddingCharacters(this, paddingPosition, paddingChar, ref width);
					}
					else if (CellValue is bool || paddingPosition >= 0)
					{
						UseHashes = true;
						ClearText();
					}
				}
			}

			public void AppendText(string text, string placeholderText = null)
			{
				FormattedText.Append(text);
				if (placeholderText != null)
				{
					text = placeholderText;
				}
				else
				{
					PreProcessMeasurementText(ref text);
				}
				FormattedTextForMeasurement.Append(text);
			}

			public void ClearText()
			{
				FormattedText.Clear();
				FormattedTextForMeasurement.Clear();
			}

			public void InitializeForTryFormatValue()
			{
				InitializeForTryFormatValueCore();
			}

			public void CheckForTooWideBooleanValue()
			{
				CheckForTooWideBooleanValueCore();
			}

			public void InitializeForTryFormatNumber()
			{
				InitializeForTryFormatNumberCore();
			}

			public void InitializeForFormatText()
			{
				InitializeForFormatTextCore();
			}

			public void VerifyFormattedTextWidth(FormatSection section, char paddingChar, int paddingPosition)
			{
				VerifyFormattedTextWidthCore(section, paddingChar, paddingPosition);
			}

			public void InitializeForFormatValue(FormatSection section)
			{
				InitializeForFormatValueCore(section);
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				FormattedText.Clear();
				FormattedTextForMeasurement.Clear();
				Result = null;
				Text = null;
				Value = double.NaN;
				ResetHelper();
			}

			public void SetText(string text)
			{
				ClearText();
				FormattedText.Append(text);
				PreProcessMeasurementText(ref text);
				FormattedTextForMeasurement.Append(text);
			}
		}

		{

				get

						return _section.HasAnyTimeParts;

					return false;

			}
