		}

		private class FormatValueState
		{
			private double absoluteValue;

			private int currentDigitPosition;

			private NumberSection currentNumberSection;

			private DateTime? dateTime;

			private int fractionDigitsAllowedInVerbatimString = -1;

			private int fractionDigitsUsedInVerbatimString = -1;

			private int fractionFormatDigitsUsed;

			private string fractionPortionText;

			private int generatedDenominator;

			private bool generatedDenominatorIsLeftAligned;

			private string generatedDenominatorText;

			private int generatedNumerator;

			private string generatedNumeratorText;

			private double numberPortion;

			private string numberPortionText;

			private double originalValue;

			private int scientificExponent;

			private string scientificExponentText;

			private FormatSection section;

			internal readonly bool UseExpandedFractionLimit;

			public double AbsoluteValue => absoluteValue;

			public int CurrentDigitPosition
			{
				get
				{
					return currentDigitPosition;
				}
				set
				{
					currentDigitPosition = value;
				}
			}

			public NumberSection CurrentNumberSection => currentNumberSection;

			public DateTime? DateTime
			{
				get
				{
					if (!dateTime.HasValue)
					{
						dateTime = ExcelCalcValue.ExcelDateToDateTime(section.Formatter.workbook, originalValue, shouldCorrect1900Dates: true, allowDateBeforeMinimum: true);
					}
					return dateTime;
				}
			}

			public int FractionDigitsAllowedInVerbatimString
			{
				get
				{
					return fractionDigitsAllowedInVerbatimString;
				}
				set
				{
					fractionDigitsAllowedInVerbatimString = value;
				}
			}

			public int FractionDigitsUsedInVerbatimString
			{
				get
				{
					return fractionDigitsUsedInVerbatimString;
				}
				set
				{
					fractionDigitsUsedInVerbatimString = value;
				}
			}

			public int FractionFormatDigitsUsed => fractionFormatDigitsUsed;

			public string FractionPortionText => fractionPortionText;

			public int GeneratedDenominator => generatedDenominator;

			public bool GeneratedDenominatorIsLeftAligned
			{
				get
				{
					return generatedDenominatorIsLeftAligned;
				}
				set
				{
					generatedDenominatorIsLeftAligned = value;
				}
			}

			public string GeneratedDenominatorText => generatedDenominatorText;

			public int GeneratedNumerator => generatedNumerator;

			public string GeneratedNumeratorText => generatedNumeratorText;

			public double OriginalValue => originalValue;

			public double NumberPortion => numberPortion;

			public string NumberPortionText => numberPortionText;

			public int ScientificExponent => scientificExponent;

			public string ScientificExponentText => scientificExponentText;

			public FormatValueState(FormatSection section, double value, bool useExpandedExponentLimit)
			{
				this.section = section;
				originalValue = value;
				absoluteValue = Math.Abs(originalValue);
				UseExpandedFractionLimit = useExpandedExponentLimit;
				if (section.HasFractionSeparator)
				{
					double num;
					if (section.GeneratedFractionUsesFullNumber)
					{
						SetCurrentNumberSection(NumberSection.GeneratedNumerator);
						num = absoluteValue;
					}
					else
					{
						numberPortion = MathUtilities.Truncate(absoluteValue);
						numberPortionText = section.CultureFormatNumber(numberPortion, allowScientificRepresentation: false);
						num = absoluteValue - numberPortion;
					}
					if (section.GeneratedDenominatorSpecifiedValue.HasValue)
					{
						generatedDenominator = section.GeneratedDenominatorSpecifiedValue.Value;
						generatedNumerator = (int)Round(num * (double)generatedDenominator);
					}
					else
					{
						if (!section.GeneratedDenominatorMaxDigitCount.HasValue)
						{
							return;
						}
						Reduce(num, section.GeneratedDenominatorMaxDigitCount.Value, out var numerator, out var denominator);
						generatedDenominator = denominator;
						generatedNumerator = numerator;
					}
					if (generatedDenominator == generatedNumerator && !section.GeneratedFractionUsesFullNumber)
					{
						numberPortion += 1.0;
						numberPortionText = section.CultureFormatNumber(numberPortion, allowScientificRepresentation: false);
						generatedNumerator = 0;
					}
					generatedDenominatorText = section.CultureFormatNumber(generatedDenominator);
					generatedNumeratorText = section.CultureFormatNumber(generatedNumerator);
				}
				else if (section.HasScientificNotation)
				{
					if (absoluteValue == 0.0)
					{
						scientificExponent = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						scientificExponent = MathUtilities.FloorOfLog10(absoluteValue);
						int num2 = scientificExponent % section.NumberDigitCount;
						if (scientificExponent % section.NumberDigitCount != 0)
						{
							if (scientificExponent < 0)
							{
								scientificExponent -= section.NumberDigitCount + num2;
							}
							else
							{
								scientificExponent -= num2;
							}
						}
					}
					scientificExponentText = section.CultureFormatNumber(Math.Abs(scientificExponent));
					double value2 = absoluteValue / Math.Pow(10.0, scientificExponent);
					value2 = Round(value2, Math.Min(section.FractionDigitCount, 15));
					numberPortion = (int)MathUtilities.Truncate(value2);
					numberPortionText = section.CultureFormatNumber(numberPortion, allowScientificRepresentation: false);
					string text = section.CultureFormatNumber(value2, allowScientificRepresentation: false);
					int num3 = text.IndexOf(this.section.Culture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator);
					if (num3 < 0)
					{
						fractionPortionText = string.Empty;
					}
					else
					{
						fractionPortionText = text.Substring(num3 + 1);
					}
					SetCurrentNumberSection(NumberSection.ScientificCoefficient);
				}
				else
				{
					double num4 = absoluteValue;
					if (section.GroupShiftCount != 0)
					{
						num4 /= Math.Pow(1000.0, section.GroupShiftCount);
					}
					if (section.PercentCount != 0)
					{
						num4 *= Math.Pow(100.0, section.PercentCount);
					}
					if (num4 != 0.0 && section.SectionType != SectionType.Date)
					{
						num4 = Round(num4, Math.Min(section.FractionDigitCount, 15));
					}
					numberPortion = MathUtilities.Truncate(num4);
					numberPortionText = section.CultureFormatNumber(numberPortion, allowScientificRepresentation: false);
					string text2 = section.CultureFormatNumber(num4, allowScientificRepresentation: false);
					int num5 = text2.IndexOf(this.section.Culture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator);
					if (num5 < 0)
					{
						fractionPortionText = string.Empty;
					}
					else
					{
						fractionPortionText = text2.Substring(num5 + 1);
					}
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fractionPortionText))
				{
					fractionPortionText = section.ConvertNumberTextToNativeDigits(fractionPortionText);
				}
			}

			public void OnDecimalSeparatorEncountered()
			{
				switch (currentNumberSection)
				{
				case NumberSection.Number:
					SetCurrentNumberSection(NumberSection.Fraction);
					break;
				case NumberSection.ScientificCoefficient:
					SetCurrentNumberSection(NumberSection.ScientificCoefficientFraction);
					break;
				case NumberSection.ScientificExponent:
					SetCurrentNumberSection(NumberSection.ScientificExponentFraction);
					break;
				case NumberSection.Fraction:
				case NumberSection.GeneratedNumerator:
				case NumberSection.GeneratedDenominator:
				case NumberSection.ScientificCoefficientFraction:
				case NumberSection.ScientificExponentFraction:
					break;
				}
			}

			public void OnFractionEncountered()
			{
				SetCurrentNumberSection(NumberSection.GeneratedDenominator);
			}

			public void OnFractionDigitUsed()
			{
				fractionFormatDigitsUsed++;
			}

			internal void OnLiteralEncountered()
			{
				if (section.HasFractionSeparator && !section.GeneratedFractionUsesFullNumber && currentNumberSection == NumberSection.Number)
				{
					SetCurrentNumberSection(NumberSection.GeneratedNumerator);
				}
			}

			internal void OnScientificNotationSeparatorEncountered()
			{
				SetCurrentNumberSection(NumberSection.ScientificExponent);
			}

			private static void Reduce(double value, int limitDigits, out int numerator, out int denominator)
			{
				denominator = 1;
				numerator = (int)value;
				double num = value;
				int num2 = (int)Math.Pow(10.0, limitDigits) - 1;
				int num3 = 0;
				double num4 = (double)numerator / (double)denominator;
				double num5 = Math.Abs(value - num4);
				int num6 = denominator;
				int num7 = numerator;
				while (value - num4 != 0.0 && num != Math.Floor(num))
				{
					num = 1.0 / (num - Math.Floor(num));
					int num8 = denominator * (int)Math.Floor(num) + num3;
					if (num8 > num2)
					{
						break;
					}
					num3 = denominator;
					denominator = num8;
					numerator = (int)Round(value * (double)denominator);
					num4 = (double)numerator / (double)denominator;
					double num9 = Math.Abs(value - num4);
					if (num9 < num5)
					{
						num5 = num9;
						num6 = denominator;
						num7 = numerator;
					}
				}
				denominator = num6;
				numerator = num7;
			}

			public void ResetCurrentDigitPosition()
			{
				currentDigitPosition = 0;
			}

			private void SetCurrentNumberSection(NumberSection numberSection)
			{
				currentNumberSection = numberSection;
				ResetCurrentDigitPosition();
			}
		}

		private abstract class Part
		{
			public abstract string GetText(FormatSection section, string text);

			public abstract string GetText(FormatSection section, FormatValueState state);
		}

		[DebuggerDisplay("LiteralPart: '{text,nq}'")]
		private class LiteralFormatPart : Part
		{
			private string _text;

			private LiteralType _type;

			public string Text => _text;

			public LiteralType Type => _type;

			public LiteralFormatPart(string text, LiteralType type)
			{
				_text = text;
				_type = type;
			}

			public override string GetText(FormatSection section, string text)
			{
				return GetTextHelper();
			}

			public override string GetText(FormatSection section, FormatValueState state)
			{
				state.OnLiteralEncountered();
				return GetTextHelper();
			}

			private string GetTextHelper()
			{
				if (_type == LiteralType.Repeated)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (_type == LiteralType.Placeholder)
				{
					return " ";
				}
				return _text;
			}
		}

		[DebuggerDisplay("WellKnownPart: {type}")]
		private class WellKnownPart : Part
		{
			private int repeatCount;

			private WellKnownPartType type;

			public WellKnownPartType Type => type;

			public WellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType type, int repeatCount)
			{
				this.type = type;
				this.repeatCount = repeatCount;
			}

			public override string GetText(FormatSection section, string text)
			{
				switch (type)
				{
				case WellKnownPartType.GeneralString:
				case WellKnownPartType.VerbatimString:
					return text;
				case WellKnownPartType.Whitespace:
					return " ";
				default:
					return string.Empty;
				}
			}

			public override string GetText(FormatSection section, FormatValueState state)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = DateTime.MinValue;
				if (IsDateTime(type) && type != WellKnownPartType.HoursTotal && type != WellKnownPartType.MinutesTotal && type != WellKnownPartType.SecondsTotal)
				{
					if (state.OriginalValue < 0.0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (!state.DateTime.HasValue)
					{
						return null;
					}
					dateTime = state.DateTime.Value;
				}
				switch (type)
				{
				case WellKnownPartType.Whitespace:
					return " ";
				case WellKnownPartType.Percent:
					return section.Culture.NumberFormat.PercentSymbol;
				case WellKnownPartType.DecimalSeparator:
				{
					string text3 = string.Empty;
					if (state.CurrentNumberSection == NumberSection.Number)
					{
						if (1.0 <= state.AbsoluteValue && section.NumberDigitCount == 0)
						{
							text3 += state.NumberPortionText;
						}
					}
					else if (state.CurrentNumberSection == NumberSection.GeneratedNumerator && section.GeneratedNumeratorDigitCount == 0)
					{
						text3 += state.GeneratedNumeratorText;
					}
					text3 += section.Culture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator;
					state.OnDecimalSeparatorEncountered();
					return text3;
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrEmpty:
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero:
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrWhitespace:
				{
					if (type == WellKnownPartType.DigitOrWhitespace && !state.GeneratedDenominatorIsLeftAligned && state.CurrentNumberSection == NumberSection.GeneratedDenominator)
					{
						state.GeneratedDenominatorIsLeftAligned = true;
						state.ResetCurrentDigitPosition();
					}
					string digitText = GetDigitText(section, state);
					state.CurrentDigitPosition++;
					return digitText;
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.GroupShiftPlaceholder:
					return string.Empty;
				case WellKnownPartType.FractionSeparator:
					state.OnFractionEncountered();
					if (section.ShouldOmitFractionSection(state))
					{
						return " ";
					}
					return "/";
				case WellKnownPartType.Scientific:
				case WellKnownPartType.ScientificWithSign:
				{
					state.OnScientificNotationSeparatorEncountered();
					string text4 = "E";
					if (state.ScientificExponent < 0 || type == WellKnownPartType.ScientificWithSign)
					{
						text4 += ((state.ScientificExponent < 0) ? section.Culture.NumberFormat.NegativeSign : section.Culture.NumberFormat.PositiveSign);
					}
					return text4;
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.EraYearsShort:
					if (section.CalendarForErasResolved.GetNumberOfEras() != 1)
					{
						return section.CultureFormatNumber(section.CalendarForErasResolved.GetYear(dateTime), 1);
					}
					goto case WellKnownPartType.YearsLong;
				case WellKnownPartType.EraYearsLong:
					if (section.CalendarForErasResolved.GetNumberOfEras() != 1)
					{
						return section.CultureFormatNumber(section.CalendarForErasResolved.GetYear(dateTime), 2);
					}
					goto case WellKnownPartType.YearsLong;
				case WellKnownPartType.EraEnglishName:
				case WellKnownPartType.EraAbbreviatedName:
				case WellKnownPartType.EraName:
				{
					Calendar calendarForErasResolved = section.CalendarForErasResolved;
					if (calendarForErasResolved.GetNumberOfEras() == 1)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					int era = calendarForErasResolved.GetEra(dateTime);
					DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = (DateTimeFormatInfo)section.CultureForDatesResolved.DateTimeFormat.Clone();
					dateTimeFormatInfo.Calendar = calendarForErasResolved;
					switch (type)
					{
					case WellKnownPartType.EraEnglishName:
					{
						for (char c = 'A'; c <= 'Z'; c = (char)(c + 1))
						{
							string text2 = c.ToString();
							if (dateTimeFormatInfo.GetEra(text2) == era)
							{
								return text2;
							}
						}
						return string.Empty;
					}
					case WellKnownPartType.EraAbbreviatedName:
						return dateTimeFormatInfo.GetAbbreviatedEraName(era);
					default:
						return dateTimeFormatInfo.GetEraName(era);
					}
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.YearsShort:
					return section.CultureFormatYear(dateTime, 2);
				case WellKnownPartType.YearsLong:
					return section.CultureFormatYear(dateTime, 4);
				case WellKnownPartType.BuddhistYearsShort:
					return section.CultureFormatYear(section.CreateCalendar(7), dateTime, 2);
				case WellKnownPartType.BuddhistYearsLong:
					return section.CultureFormatYear(section.CreateCalendar(7), dateTime, 4);
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthsShort:
					return section.CultureFormatMonth(dateTime, state, 1);
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthsLong:
					return section.CultureFormatMonth(dateTime, state, 2);
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthShortDescription:
					return section.CultureFormatMonth(dateTime, state, "MMM");
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthLongDescription:
					return section.CultureFormatMonth(dateTime, state, "MMMM");
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthFirstLetter:
					return section.CultureFormatMonth(dateTime, state, "MMMM")[0].ToString();
				case WellKnownPartType.DaysShort:
					return section.CultureFormatDay(dateTime, state, 1);
				case WellKnownPartType.DaysLong:
					return section.CultureFormatDay(dateTime, state, 2);
				case WellKnownPartType.DayShortDescription:
					return section.CultureFormatDay(dateTime, state, "ddd");
				case WellKnownPartType.DayLongDescription:
					return section.CultureFormatDay(dateTime, state, "dddd");
				case WellKnownPartType.HoursShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.HoursLong:
				{
					int requiredNumberOfDigits = ((type == WellKnownPartType.HoursShort) ? 1 : 2);
					int num5 = dateTime.TimeOfDay.Hours;
					if (section.HasAMPMPart)
					{
						if (num5 == 0)
						{
							num5 = 12;
						}
						else if (12 < num5)
						{
							num5 -= 12;
						}
					}
					return section.CultureFormatNumber(num5, requiredNumberOfDigits);
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.HoursTotal:
				case WellKnownPartType.MinutesTotal:
				case WellKnownPartType.SecondsTotal:
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					double num3;
					switch (type)
					{
					default:
						num3 = 24.0;
						break;
					case WellKnownPartType.MinutesTotal:
						num3 = 1440.0;
						break;
					case WellKnownPartType.SecondsTotal:
						num3 = 86400.0;
						flag2 = !section.HasMillisecondPart;
						break;
					}
					double num4 = state.AbsoluteValue * num3;
					if (flag2)
					{
						num4 += 0.5;
					}
					return section.ConvertNumberTextToNativeDigits(Math.Floor(num4).ToString(new string('0', repeatCount)));
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.MinutesShort:
					return section.CultureFormatNumber(dateTime.TimeOfDay.Minutes);
				case WellKnownPartType.MinutesLong:
					return section.CultureFormatNumber(dateTime.TimeOfDay.Minutes, 2);
				case WellKnownPartType.SecondsShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.SecondsLong:
				{
					int num2 = dateTime.TimeOfDay.Seconds;
					if (!section.HasMillisecondPart && 500 <= dateTime.TimeOfDay.Milliseconds)
					{
						num2++;
					}
					if (type == WellKnownPartType.SecondsShort)
					{
						return section.CultureFormatNumber(num2);
					}
					return section.CultureFormatNumber(num2, 2);
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds1:
				case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds2:
				case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds3:
				{
					int num;
					switch (type)
					{
					case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds1:
						num = 2;
						break;
					case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds2:
						num = 1;
						break;
					case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds3:
						num = 0;
						break;
					default:
						return string.Empty;
					}
					int value = (int)Round((double)dateTime.TimeOfDay.Milliseconds / Math.Pow(10.0, num));
					return section.Culture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator + section.CultureFormatNumber(value);
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortLL:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortLU:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortUL:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortUU:
				{
					bool flag = dateTime.TimeOfDay.Hours < 12;
					string text = dateTime.ToString("%t", section.CultureForDatesResolved);
					if (type switch
					{
						WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortLL => true, 
						WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortLU => flag, 
						WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortUL => !flag, 
						_ => false, 
					})
					{
						text = text.ToLower();
					}
					return text;
				}
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMLong:
					return dateTime.ToString("tt", section.CultureForDatesResolved);
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMChinese:
					if (dateTime.TimeOfDay.Hours < 12)
					{
						return "上午";
					}
					return "下午";
				case WellKnownPartType.GeneralString:
				case WellKnownPartType.VerbatimString:
					return section.GetVerbatimString(state);
				default:
					return string.Empty;
				}
			}

			public void ConvertMonthPartToMinutePart()
			{
				switch (type)
				{
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthsShort:
					type = WellKnownPartType.MinutesShort;
					break;
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthsLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthShortDescription:
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthLongDescription:
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthFirstLetter:
					type = WellKnownPartType.MinutesLong;
					break;
				}
			}

			private string GetDigitText(FormatSection section, FormatValueState state)
			{
				string digitTextHelper = GetDigitTextHelper(section, state);
				if (digitTextHelper != null)
				{
					return digitTextHelper;
				}
				switch (type)
				{
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrEmpty:
					return string.Empty;
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero:
					digitTextHelper = section.CultureFormatNumber(0, 1);
					if (state.CurrentNumberSection == NumberSection.Number)
					{
						section.InsertGroupSeparators(ref digitTextHelper, state.CurrentDigitPosition, state.NumberPortionText);
					}
					return digitTextHelper;
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrWhitespace:
					digitTextHelper = " ";
					if (state.CurrentNumberSection == NumberSection.Number)
					{
						section.InsertGroupSeparators(ref digitTextHelper, state.CurrentDigitPosition, state.NumberPortionText, " ");
					}
					return digitTextHelper;
				default:
					return string.Empty;
				}
			}

			private string GetDigitTextHelper(FormatSection section, FormatValueState state)
			{
				switch (state.CurrentNumberSection)
				{
				case NumberSection.Number:
				case NumberSection.ScientificCoefficient:
					return GetDigitTextHelper(section, state, state.NumberPortion, state.NumberPortionText, section.NumberDigitCount, isLeftAligned: false);
				case NumberSection.Fraction:
				case NumberSection.ScientificCoefficientFraction:
				{
					string digitTextHelper = GetDigitTextHelper(section, state, null, state.FractionPortionText, section.FractionDigitCount, isLeftAligned: true);
					if (digitTextHelper != null)
					{
						state.OnFractionDigitUsed();
					}
					return digitTextHelper;
				}
				case NumberSection.ScientificExponent:
					return GetDigitTextHelper(section, state, state.ScientificExponent, state.ScientificExponentText, section.ScientificExponentDigitCount, isLeftAligned: false);
				case NumberSection.ScientificExponentFraction:
					return null;
				case NumberSection.GeneratedDenominator:
					if (section.ShouldOmitFractionSection(state))
					{
						if (state.CurrentDigitPosition == 0)
						{
							return " ";
						}
						return GetDigitTextHelper(section, state, 0.0, new string(' ', state.GeneratedDenominatorText.Length), section.GeneratedDenominatorDigitCount, state.GeneratedDenominatorIsLeftAligned);
					}
					return GetDigitTextHelper(section, state, state.GeneratedDenominator, state.GeneratedDenominatorText, section.GeneratedDenominatorDigitCount, state.GeneratedDenominatorIsLeftAligned);
				case NumberSection.GeneratedNumerator:
					if (section.ShouldOmitFractionSection(state))
					{
						return GetDigitTextHelper(section, state, 0.0, new string(' ', state.GeneratedNumeratorText.Length), section.GeneratedNumeratorDigitCount, isLeftAligned: false);
					}
					return GetDigitTextHelper(section, state, state.GeneratedNumerator, state.GeneratedNumeratorText, section.GeneratedNumeratorDigitCount, isLeftAligned: false);
				default:
					return string.Empty;
				}
			}

			private string GetDigitTextHelper(FormatSection section, FormatValueState state, double? numberSectionValue, string numberSectionText, int digitCount, bool isLeftAligned)
			{
				if (numberSectionText == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (isLeftAligned)
				{
					if (state.CurrentDigitPosition < numberSectionText.Length)
					{
						return numberSectionText[state.CurrentDigitPosition].ToString();
					}
					return null;
				}
				if (numberSectionValue.HasValue && numberSectionValue.Value == 0.0 && (!section.HasFractionSeparator || state.CurrentNumberSection != NumberSection.Number || !section.ShouldOmitFractionSection(state)))
				{
					switch (type)
					{
					case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrEmpty:
						return string.Empty;
					case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrWhitespace:
						return " ";
					}
				}
				string text = null;
				int num = numberSectionText.Length - digitCount;
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					text = ((state.CurrentDigitPosition != 0) ? numberSectionText[num + state.CurrentDigitPosition].ToString() : numberSectionText.Substring(0, num + 1));
				}
				else
				{
					int num2 = state.CurrentDigitPosition + num;
					if (num2 >= 0)
					{
						text = numberSectionText[num2].ToString();
					}
				}
				if (text != null && (state.CurrentNumberSection == NumberSection.Number || state.CurrentNumberSection == NumberSection.ScientificCoefficient))
				{
					section.InsertGroupSeparators(ref text, state.CurrentDigitPosition, numberSectionText);
				}
				return text;
			}

			public static bool IsDate(WellKnownPartType type)
			{
				switch (type)
				{
				case WellKnownPartType.BuddhistYearsShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.BuddhistYearsLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.DaysShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.DaysLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.DayShortDescription:
				case WellKnownPartType.DayLongDescription:
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthsShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthsLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthShortDescription:
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthLongDescription:
				case WellKnownPartType.MonthFirstLetter:
				case WellKnownPartType.YearsShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.YearsLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.EraYearsShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.EraYearsLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.EraEnglishName:
				case WellKnownPartType.EraAbbreviatedName:
				case WellKnownPartType.EraName:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}

			public static bool IsDateTime(WellKnownPartType type)
			{
				if (!IsDate(type))
				{
					return IsTime(type);
				}
				return true;
			}

			public static bool IsDigit(WellKnownPartType type)
			{
				switch (type)
				{
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrEmpty:
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero:
				case WellKnownPartType.DigitOrWhitespace:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}

			{
				switch (type)
				{
				case WellKnownPartType.HoursShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.HoursLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.HoursTotal:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}

			{
				switch (type)
				{
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortLL:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortLU:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortUL:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortUU:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.AMPMChinese:
				case WellKnownPartType.HoursShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.HoursLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.HoursTotal:
				case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds1:
				case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds2:
				case WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds3:
				case WellKnownPartType.MinutesShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.MinutesLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.MinutesTotal:
				case WellKnownPartType.SecondsShort:
				case WellKnownPartType.SecondsLong:
				case WellKnownPartType.SecondsTotal:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		public GetCellTextResult FormatValue(double value, string text, object cellValue, int availablePixels, TextMetricsProviderBase metricsProvider, WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat, bool useExpandedFractionLimit)
		{
			GetTextWidthHelper getTextWidthHelper = null;
			if (cellFormat != null)
			{
				getTextWidthHelper = new GetTextWidthHelper(metricsProvider, cellFormat);
			}
			GetCellTextResult result = new GetCellTextResult
			{
				NumericValue = value
			};
			string text2 = null;
			bool flag;
			if (cellValue is ErrorValue)
			{
				result.Color = null;
				result.FormattedAs = SectionType.Text;
				text2 = text;
				if (getTextWidthHelper == null)
				{
					result.Text = text2;
					return result;
				}
				int width = getTextWidthHelper.GetWidth(text2);
				if (width <= availablePixels)
				{
					result.Text = text2;
					return result;
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			else
			{
				ValueFormatterContext context = GetValueFormatterContext();
				context.Value = value;
				context.Text = text;
				context.CellValue = cellValue;
				context.GetTextWidthHelper = getTextWidthHelper;
				context.AvailablePixels = availablePixels;
				context.UseExpandedFractionLimit = useExpandedFractionLimit;
				TryFormatValue(ref context);
				text2 = context.FormattedText.ToString();
				flag = context.UseHashes;
				result.FormattedAs = context.FormattedAs;
				result.Color = context.Color;
				bool? result2 = context.Result;
				_freeContexts.OnItemReleased(context);
				if (result2 == true)
				{
					result.Text = text2;
					return result;
				}
			}
			result.FormattedAs = SectionType.Text;
			if (flag && getTextWidthHelper != null)
			{
				result.Text = GetAllHashes(getTextWidthHelper, availablePixels);
				return result;
			}
			result.Text = text;
			return result;
		}

		private static string GetAllHashes(GetTextWidthHelper getTextWidthHelper, int availablePixels)
		{
			double widthAsDouble = getTextWidthHelper.GetWidthAsDouble('#'.ToString());
			int count = (int)((double)availablePixels / widthAsDouble);
			return new string('#', count);
		}

		public int GetSectionIndex(double value)
		{
			if (IsValid)
			{
				FormatSection formatSection = formatSections[0];
				if (formatSection.MeetsCriteria(value))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				FormatSection formatSection2 = formatSections[1];
				if (formatSection2 != null)
				{
					if (formatSection2.MeetsCriteria(value))
					{
						return 1;
					}
					FormatSection formatSection3 = formatSections[2];
					if (formatSection3 != null)
					{
						return 2;
					}
					if (!formatSection2.HasCustomComparison)
					{
						return 1;
					}
				}
				else if (!formatSection.HasCustomComparison)
				{
					return 0;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal ValueFormatterSectionInfo GetSectionInfo(int sectionIndex)
		{
			FormatSection section = formatSections[sectionIndex];
			return new ValueFormatterSectionInfo(section);
		}

		public SectionType GetSectionType(int sectionIndex)
		{
			if (!IsValid)
			{
				return SectionType.Default;
			}
			if (formatSections.Length <= sectionIndex)
			{
				return SectionType.Default;
			}
			return formatSections[sectionIndex]?.SectionType ?? SectionType.Default;
		}

		public SectionType GetSectionType(double value)
		{
			if (!IsValid)
			{
				return SectionType.Default;
			}
			FormatSection formatSection = formatSections[0];
			if (!formatSection.MeetsCriteria(value))
			{
				FormatSection formatSection2 = formatSections[1];
				if (formatSection2 != null)
				{
					formatSection = formatSection2;
					if (!formatSection.MeetsCriteria(value))
					{
						FormatSection formatSection3 = formatSections[2];
						if (formatSection3 != null)
						{
							formatSection = formatSection3;
						}
						else if (formatSection.HasCustomComparison)
						{
							return SectionType.Default;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (formatSection.HasCustomComparison)
				{
					return SectionType.Text;
				}
			}
			return formatSection.SectionType;
		}

		private void TryFormatRoundedValue(ref ValueFormatterContext context, double valueResolved)
		{
			if (context.UseRoundedValue)
			{
				context.Value = MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(valueResolved);
				TryFormatValue(ref context);
			}
		}

		public ValueFormatter(string format, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			formatSections = ParseFormat(format, culture);
		}

		private static ValueFormatterContext GetValueFormatterContext()
		{
			if (_freeContexts == null)
			{
				_freeContexts = new ObjectPool<ValueFormatterContext>(() => new ValueFormatterContext());
			}
			ValueFormatterContext item = _freeContexts.GetItem();
			item.Reset();
			return item;
		}

		private static int GetRepeatCharacterCount(string format, ref int i, params char[] possibleValues)
		{
			int j;
			for (j = 1; i + j < format.Length; j++)
			{
				char value = format[i + j];
				if (Array.IndexOf(possibleValues, value) < 0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			i += j - 1;
			return j;
		}

		private FormatSection[] ParseFormat(string format, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			char c = culture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator[0];
			char c2 = culture.NumberFormat.NumberGroupSeparator[0];
			FormatSection[] array = new FormatSection[4];
			int num = 0;
			FormatSection formatSection = (array[num] = new FormatSection(this, num, culture));
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < format.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!flag4)
				{
					break;
				}
				char c3 = format[i];
				try
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						formatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c3, LiteralType.Placeholder);
						flag = false;
						continue;
					}
					if (flag2 || flag3)
					{
						formatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c3, flag3 ? LiteralType.Repeated : LiteralType.Normal);
						flag2 = false;
						flag3 = false;
						continue;
					}
					switch (c3)
					{
					case ';':
						if (++num == 4)
						{
							return null;
						}
						formatSection = (array[num] = new FormatSection(this, num, culture));
						continue;
					case '_':
						flag = true;
						continue;
					case '*':
						flag3 = true;
						continue;
					case '\\':
						flag2 = true;
						continue;
					case 'G':
					case 'g':
						if (format.Substring(i).StartsWith("general", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
						{
							i += 6;
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.GeneralString);
							continue;
						}
						switch (GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, 'g'))
						{
						case 1:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.EraEnglishName);
							break;
						case 2:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.EraAbbreviatedName);
							break;
						default:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.EraName);
							break;
						}
						continue;
					case '@':
						formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.VerbatimString);
						continue;
					case '[':
						if (!ParseFormatWithinBracket(formatSection, format, culture, c, ref i))
						{
							return null;
						}
						continue;
					case '/':
						switch (formatSection.SectionType)
						{
						case SectionType.Default:
						case SectionType.Text:
							return null;
						case SectionType.Date:
							formatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c3);
							break;
						case SectionType.Number:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.FractionSeparator);
							if (!ParseFormatAfterFractionSeparator(formatSection, format, c, c2, ref i))
							{
								return null;
							}
							break;
						}
						continue;
					case '"':
					{
						int num2 = i + 1;
						bool flag7 = false;
						for (i = num2; i < format.Length; i++)
						{
							if (format[i] == '"')
							{
								flag7 = true;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (!flag7)
						{
							return null;
						}
						formatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(format.Substring(num2, i - num2));
						continue;
					}
					case '0':
						formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero);
						continue;
					case '#':
						formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrEmpty);
						continue;
					case '?':
						formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrWhitespace);
						continue;
					case '%':
						formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.Percent);
						continue;
					case 'b':
					{
						int repeatCharacterCount5 = GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, 'b');
						if (repeatCharacterCount5 <= 2)
						{
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.BuddhistYearsShort);
						}
						else
						{
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.BuddhistYearsLong);
						}
						continue;
					}
					case 'e':
					{
						int repeatCharacterCount3 = GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, 'e');
						if (repeatCharacterCount3 == 1)
						{
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.EraYearsShort);
						}
						else
						{
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.EraYearsLong);
						}
						continue;
					}
					case 'Y':
					case 'y':
					{
						int repeatCharacterCount4 = GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, 'y', 'Y');
						if (repeatCharacterCount4 <= 2)
						{
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.YearsShort);
						}
						else
						{
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.YearsLong);
						}
						continue;
					}
					case 'M':
					case 'm':
					{
						int repeatCharacterCount = GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, 'm', 'M');
						WellKnownPart lastDateTimePart = formatSection.GetLastDateTimePart();
						if (repeatCharacterCount <= 2 && lastDateTimePart != null && WellKnownPart.IsHour(lastDateTimePart.Type))
						{
							switch (repeatCharacterCount)
							{
							case 1:
								formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.MinutesShort);
								break;
							case 2:
								formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.MinutesLong);
								break;
							}
							continue;
						}
						switch (repeatCharacterCount)
						{
						case 1:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.MonthsShort);
							break;
						case 2:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.MonthsLong);
							break;
						case 3:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.MonthShortDescription);
							break;
						default:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.MonthLongDescription);
							break;
						case 5:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.MonthFirstLetter);
							break;
						}
						continue;
					}
					case 'D':
					case 'd':
						switch (GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, 'd', 'D'))
						{
						case 1:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DaysShort);
							break;
						case 2:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DaysLong);
							break;
						case 3:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DayShortDescription);
							break;
						default:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DayLongDescription);
							break;
						}
						continue;
					case 'H':
					case 'h':
						switch (GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, 'h', 'H'))
						{
						case 1:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.HoursShort);
							break;
						default:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.HoursLong);
							break;
						}
						continue;
					case 'S':
					case 's':
					{
						int repeatCharacterCount2 = GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, 's', 'S');
						formatSection.GetLastDateTimePart()?.ConvertMonthPartToMinutePart();
						switch (repeatCharacterCount2)
						{
						case 1:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.SecondsShort);
							break;
						default:
							formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.SecondsLong);
							break;
						}
						continue;
					}
					case 'A':
					case 'a':
						if (format.Length - i >= 3)
						{
							string text2 = format.Substring(i, 3);
							if (text2.Equals("a/p", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
							{
								i += 2;
								bool flag5 = text2[0] == 'a';
								bool flag6 = text2[2] == 'p';
								WellKnownPartType type = ((!flag5) ? (type = (flag6 ? WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortUL : WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortUU)) : (type = (flag6 ? WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortLL : WellKnownPartType.AMPMShortLU)));
								formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(type);
								continue;
							}
						}
						if (format.Length - i >= 5)
						{
							string text3 = format.Substring(i, 5);
							if (text3.Equals("am/pm", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
							{
								i += 4;
								formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.AMPMLong);
								continue;
							}
						}
						formatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c3);
						continue;
					case '上':
						if (format.Length - i >= 5)
						{
							string text = format.Substring(i, 5);
							if (text.Equals("上午/下午", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
							{
								i += 4;
								formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.AMPMChinese);
								continue;
							}
						}
						formatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c3);
						continue;
					case 'E':
						if (++i < format.Length)
						{
							switch (format[i])
							{
							case '-':
								formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.Scientific);
								break;
							case '+':
								formatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.ScientificWithSign);
								break;
							default:
								return null;
							}
							continue;
						}
						return null;
					case 'B':
					case 'N':
					case 'n':
						return null;
					}
					if (c3 == c)
					{
						if (!ParseNumberDecimalSeparator(format, formatSection, ref i))
						{
							return null;
						}
					}
					else if (c3 == c2)
					{
						if (!ParseNumberGroupSeparator(format, formatSection, c2, ref i))
						{
							return null;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						formatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c3);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					flag4 = formatSection.IsValid;
				}
			}
			if (!flag4)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (flag || flag2 || flag3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (array[1] != null)
			{
				if (array[0].HasVerbatimString)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (array[1].HasVerbatimString)
				{
					if (array[2] != null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (!array[0].HasCustomComparison)
					{
						array[0].SetComparisonType(CompareOperator.AnyValue, 0.0, hasCustomComparison: false);
					}
				}
				else if (array[2] == null && !array[0].HasCustomComparison)
				{
					array[0].SetComparisonType(CompareOperator.GreaterThanOrEquals, 0.0, hasCustomComparison: false);
				}
				if (array[2] != null && array[2].HasVerbatimString)
				{
					if (array[3] != null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (!array[1].HasCustomComparison)
					{
						array[1].SetComparisonType(CompareOperator.AnyValue, 0.0, hasCustomComparison: false);
					}
				}
				FormatSection formatSection2 = array[3];
				if (formatSection2 != null && formatSection2.SectionType != SectionType.Text && formatSection2.SectionType != SectionType.Default)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static bool ParseFormatAfterFractionSeparator(FormatSection currentFormatSection, string format, char decimalSeparator, char groupSeparator, ref int i)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			bool flag5 = false;
			bool flag6 = false;
			bool flag7 = false;
			i++;
			while (i < format.Length)
			{
				char c = format[i];
				if (flag5)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
					flag4 = true;
					currentFormatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c, LiteralType.Placeholder);
					flag5 = false;
				}
				else if (flag6 || flag7)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
					flag4 = true;
					currentFormatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c, flag7 ? LiteralType.Repeated : LiteralType.Normal);
					flag6 = false;
					flag7 = false;
				}
				else
				{
					if (c == ';')
					{
						i--;
						break;
					}
					switch (c)
					{
					case '_':
						flag5 = true;
						break;
					case '*':
						flag7 = true;
						break;
					case '\\':
						flag6 = true;
						break;
					case '#':
						if (flag3)
						{
							currentFormatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(0.ToString());
							break;
						}
						currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrEmpty);
						flag2 = true;
						text += c;
						break;
					case '?':
						if (flag3)
						{
							currentFormatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(' ');
							break;
						}
						currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrWhitespace);
						flag2 = true;
						text += c;
						break;
					case '0':
						if (flag3)
						{
							currentFormatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c);
							break;
						}
						currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero);
						flag2 = true;
						text += c;
						break;
					case '1':
					case '2':
					case '3':
					case '4':
					case '5':
					case '6':
					case '7':
					case '8':
					case '9':
						if (flag3)
						{
							currentFormatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c);
							break;
						}
						currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DigitOrZero);
						flag2 = true;
						text += c;
						flag = true;
						break;
					case '/':
					case '@':
					case 'B':
					case 'D':
					case 'E':
					case 'G':
					case 'H':
					case 'M':
					case 'N':
					case 'S':
					case 'Y':
					case 'b':
					case 'd':
					case 'e':
					case 'g':
					case 'h':
					case 'm':
					case 'n':
					case 's':
					case 'y':
						return false;
					default:
						if (c == decimalSeparator)
						{
							if (!flag4 || !flag3)
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
						else if (c == groupSeparator)
						{
							Part lastPart = currentFormatSection.LastPart;
							if (lastPart is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart && WellKnownPart.IsDigit(wellKnownPart.Type))
							{
								return false;
							}
							if (lastPart is LiteralFormatPart literalFormatPart && literalFormatPart.Text == decimalSeparator.ToString())
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
						if (flag2)
						{
							flag3 = true;
						}
						flag4 = true;
						currentFormatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c);
						break;
					}
				}
				i++;
			}
			if (flag5 || flag6 || flag7)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (text.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!int.TryParse(text, out var result) && flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (result == 0)
			{
				currentFormatSection.GeneratedDenominatorMaxDigitCount = text.Length;
			}
			else
			{
				currentFormatSection.GeneratedDenominatorSpecifiedValue = result;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ParseFormatWithinBracket(FormatSection currentFormatSection, string format, CultureInfo culture, char decimalSeparator, ref int i)
		{
			i++;
			int num = i;
			string text = format.Substring(num);
			char c = format[num];
			switch (c)
			{
			case 'H':
			case 'h':
			{
				int repeatCharacterCount3 = GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, 'h', 'H');
				GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, ' ');
				if (format.Length <= ++i || format[i] != ']')
				{
					return false;
				}
				currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.HoursTotal, repeatCharacterCount3);
				return true;
			}
			case 'S':
			case 's':
			{
				int repeatCharacterCount2 = GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, 's', 'S');
				GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, ' ');
				if (format.Length <= ++i || format[i] != ']')
				{
					return false;
				}
				currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.SecondsTotal, repeatCharacterCount2);
				return true;
			}
			case 'M':
			case 'm':
			{
				int repeatCharacterCount = GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, 'm', 'M');
				GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, ' ');
				if (format.Length <= ++i)
				{
					return false;
				}
				_ = format[i];
				switch (format[i])
				{
				case ']':
					currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.MinutesTotal, repeatCharacterCount);
					return true;
				case 'A':
				case 'a':
					return TestForBracketedColor(currentFormatSection, format, num, text, ref i, "magenta");
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
			case 'C':
			case 'c':
				if (text.StartsWith("color", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					i = num + 5;
					if (!ParseNumberAfterBracketedOperator(format, isForColorIndex: true, culture, decimalSeparator, ref i, out var number2))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (number2 < 1.0 || 56.0 < number2)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!currentFormatSection.SetColor(number2.ToString()))
					{
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return TestForBracketedColor(currentFormatSection, format, num, text, ref i, "cyan");
			case '$':
			{
				bool flag = false;
				i++;
				char c2;
				for (; i < format.Length; currentFormatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(c2), i++)
				{
					c2 = format[i];
					switch (c2)
					{
					case '-':
						break;
					case ']':
						return true;
					default:
						continue;
					}
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string text2 = string.Empty;
				i++;
				while (i < format.Length)
				{
					char c3 = format[i];
					if (c3 == ' ')
					{
						if (text2.Length != 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, ' ');
					}
					else
					{
						if (('0' > c3 || c3 > '9') && ('a' > c3 || c3 > 'f') && ('A' > c3 || c3 > 'F'))
						{
							break;
						}
						text2 += c3;
					}
					i++;
				}
				if (i < format.Length && format[i] == ']')
				{
					if (!int.TryParse(text2, NumberStyles.HexNumber, currentFormatSection.Culture, out var result))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (!currentFormatSection.SetLocaleId(result))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (currentFormatSection.IsForcedDateTimeStyle)
					{
						i++;
						while (i < format.Length)
						{
							if (format[i] == ';')
							{
								i--;
								break;
							}
							i++;
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				while (i < format.Length)
				{
					if (format[i] == ']')
					{
						return true;
					}
					i++;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case '<':
			case '=':
			case '>':
			{
				if (text.Length < 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				CompareOperator compareOperator;
				switch (text.Substring(0, 2))
				{
				case "<>":
					i += 2;
					compareOperator = CompareOperator.NotEquals;
					break;
				case "<=":
					i += 2;
					compareOperator = CompareOperator.LessThanOrEquals;
					break;
				case ">=":
					i += 2;
					compareOperator = CompareOperator.GreaterThanOrEquals;
					break;
				default:
					switch (c)
					{
					case '=':
						compareOperator = CompareOperator.Equals;
						break;
					case '<':
						compareOperator = CompareOperator.LessThan;
						break;
					case '>':
						compareOperator = CompareOperator.GreaterThan;
						break;
					default:
						return false;
					}
					i++;
					break;
				}
				ParseNumberAfterBracketedOperator(format, isForColorIndex: false, culture, decimalSeparator, ref i, out var number);
				if (!currentFormatSection.SetComparisonType(compareOperator, number))
				{
					return false;
				}
				while (i < format.Length)
				{
					if (format[i] == ']')
					{
						return true;
					}
					i++;
				}
				return false;
			}
			default:
				return TestForBracketedColor(currentFormatSection, format, num, text, ref i, "blue", "black", "green", "red", "white", "yellow");
			}
		}

		private static bool ParseNumberAfterBracketedOperator(string format, bool isForColorIndex, CultureInfo culture, char decimalSeparator, ref int i, out double number)
		{
			number = 0.0;
			if (isForColorIndex)
			{
				if (i == format.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (format[i] == ' ')
				{
					GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref i, ' ');
					i++;
				}
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			for (; i < format.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = format[i];
				switch (c)
				{
				case '+':
				case '-':
					if (isForColorIndex)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (text.Length != 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					text += c;
					continue;
				default:
					if ('0' <= c && c <= '9')
					{
						text += c;
						continue;
					}
					if (c == decimalSeparator)
					{
						text += c;
						continue;
					}
					break;
				case ']':
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (text.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!MathUtilities.DoubleTryParse(text, culture, out number))
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (i < format.Length)
			{
				if (format[i] == ']')
				{
					return true;
				}
				i++;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseNumberDecimalSeparator(string format, FormatSection currentFormatSection, ref int formatIndex)
		{
			if (currentFormatSection.SectionType == SectionType.Text)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (currentFormatSection.SectionType == SectionType.Default)
			{
				currentFormatSection.SetSectionType(SectionType.Number);
			}
			else if (currentFormatSection.SectionType == SectionType.Date)
			{
				if (formatIndex < format.Length - 1 && format[formatIndex + 1] == '0')
				{
					formatIndex++;
					switch (GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref formatIndex, '0'))
					{
					case 1:
						currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds1);
						return true;
					case 2:
						currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds2);
						return true;
					case 3:
						currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.Milliseconds3);
						return true;
					default:
						return false;
					}
				}
				currentFormatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(format[formatIndex]);
				return true;
			}
			currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.DecimalSeparator);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseNumberGroupSeparator(string format, FormatSection currentFormatSection, char groupSeparator, ref int formatIndex)
		{
			int repeatCharacterCount = GetRepeatCharacterCount(format, ref formatIndex, groupSeparator);
			if (currentFormatSection.LastPart is WellKnownPart wellKnownPart && WellKnownPart.IsDigit(wellKnownPart.Type))
			{
				char c = '\0';
				if (formatIndex < format.Length - 1)
				{
					c = format[formatIndex + 1];
				}
				char c2 = c;
				if (c2 == '#' || c2 == '0' || c2 == '?')
				{
					if (currentFormatSection.HasScientificNotation)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!currentFormatSection.HasDecimalSeparator)
					{
						currentFormatSection.ShowGroupSeparators();
					}
				}
				else if (!currentFormatSection.HasScientificNotation)
				{
					currentFormatSection.AddWellKnownPart(WellKnownPartType.GroupShiftPlaceholder, repeatCharacterCount);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				currentFormatSection.AddLiteralFormatPart(format[formatIndex]);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static double Round(double value, int decimals = 0)
		{
			return MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value, decimals);
		}

		private static bool TestForBracketedColor(FormatSection currentFormatSection, string format, int firstCharacterInBracketIndex, string stringFromBracket, ref int i, params string[] colors)
		{
			foreach (string text in colors)
			{
				if (!stringFromBracket.StartsWith(text, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!currentFormatSection.SetColor(text))
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (i = firstCharacterInBracketIndex + text.Length; i < format.Length; i++)
				{
					if (format[i] == ']')
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool TryFormatValue(double value, string text, out string formattedText)
		{
			ValueFormatterContext context = GetValueFormatterContext();
			context.Value = value;
			context.Text = text;
			TryFormatValue(ref context);
			formattedText = context.FormattedText.ToString();
			bool? result = context.Result;
			_freeContexts.OnItemReleased(context);
			return result.Value;
		}

		private void TryFormatValue(ref ValueFormatterContext context)
		{
			context.InitializeForTryFormatValue();
			if (!IsValid)
			{
				context.Result = false;
				return;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(context.Value))
			{
				for (int num = formatSections.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					FormatSection formatSection = formatSections[num];
					if (formatSection != null)
					{
						if (formatSection.SectionType == SectionType.Date || formatSection.SectionType == SectionType.Number)
						{
							context.CheckForTooWideBooleanValue();
							if (!context.Result.HasValue)
							{
								context.SetText(context.Text);
								context.Result = true;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							formatSection.FormatText(ref context);
							context.Result = context.TextLength != 0;
							context.Color = formatSection.GetColor();
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				context.Result = false;
				return;
			}
			context.InitializeForTryFormatNumber();
			double num2 = MathUtilities.RoundToExcelDisplayValue(context.Value);
			FormatSection formatSection2 = formatSections[0];
			if (!formatSection2.MeetsCriteria(num2))
			{
				FormatSection formatSection3 = formatSections[1];
				if (formatSection3 != null)
				{
					formatSection2 = formatSection3;
					if (!formatSection2.MeetsCriteria(num2))
					{
						FormatSection formatSection4 = formatSections[2];
						if (formatSection4 != null)
						{
							formatSection2 = formatSection4;
						}
						else if (formatSection2.HasCustomComparison)
						{
							context.Result = false;
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (formatSection2.HasCustomComparison)
				{
					context.SetText(num2.ToString());
					context.Result = true;
					return;
				}
			}
			formatSection2.FormatValue(ref context, out var _);
			context.Color = formatSection2.GetColor();
			if (context.TextLength == 0)
			{
				TryFormatRoundedValue(ref context, num2);
			}
			context.Result = context.TextLength != 0;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ArrayProxy : IEnumerable<ExcelCalcValue>, IEnumerable
	{
		private ExcelCalcValue owningValue;

		public ExcelCalcValue this[int x, int y] => GetValue(new ArrayValueContext(x, y));

		internal abstract bool AreValuesReusable { get; }

		internal virtual bool ContainsReferences => false;

		internal ExcelCalcValue OwningValue
		{
			get
			{
				return owningValue;
			}
			set
			{
				owningValue = value;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<ExcelCalcValue> IEnumerable<ExcelCalcValue>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			int width = GetLength(0);
			int height = GetLength(1);
			for (int i = 0; i < width; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < height; j++)
				{
					yield return this[i, j];
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<ExcelCalcValue>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public abstract int GetLength(int dimension);

		internal abstract ExcelCalcValue GetValueHelper(ArrayValueContext valueContext);

		internal abstract ExcelCalcValue[,] ToArray();

		internal IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<int, ExcelCalcValue>> GetIterator(int dimension, int index)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, ExcelCalcValue> pair in GetIteratorHelper(dimension, index))
			{
				ArrayProxy arrayProxy = this;
				KeyValuePair<int, ExcelCalcValue> keyValuePair = pair;
				arrayProxy.CopyStateToContainedValue(keyValuePair.Value);
				yield return pair;
			}
		}

		internal abstract IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<int, ExcelCalcValue>> GetIteratorHelper(int dimension, int index);

		internal virtual void IterateValues(bool shouldIterateBlanks, Action<ExcelCalcValue, ArrayValueContext> valueCallback)
		{
			int length = GetLength(0);
			int length2 = GetLength(1);
			for (int i = 0; i < length2; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < length; j++)
				{
					valueCallback(this[j, i], new ArrayValueContext(j, i));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ThrowOutOfBoundsException()
		{
			throw new IndexOutOfRangeException(Utilities.GetString("LE_IndexOutOfRangeException_ArrayBounds"));
		}

		internal void CopyStateToContainedValue(ExcelCalcValue value)
		{
			if (owningValue != null)
			{
				value.CalculationContext = owningValue.CalculationContext;
				if (ContainsReferences)
				{
					value.IsDynamicReference = owningValue.IsDynamicReference;
				}
			}
		}

		internal ExcelCalcValue GetValue(ArrayValueContext context)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue valueHelper = GetValueHelper(context);
			CopyStateToContainedValue(valueHelper);
			return valueHelper;
		}
	}
	internal struct ArrayValueContext
	{
		public readonly WorksheetRow OwnerRow;

		public readonly int X;

		public readonly int Y;

		public ArrayValueContext(int x, int y)
		{
			OwnerRow = null;
			X = x;
			Y = y;
		}

		public ArrayValueContext(WorksheetRow ownerRow, int x, int y)
		{
			OwnerRow = ownerRow;
			X = x;
			Y = y;
		}

	public class ExcelCalcErrorValue
	{
		internal static readonly ExcelCalcErrorValue NameError = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Name);

		private ExcelCalcErrorCode errorCode;

		private string errorMessage;

		private object errorValue;

		public string Message => errorMessage;

		public object ErrorValue => errorValue;

		private void InitializeMessageFromExcelCodes(ExcelCalcErrorCode code)
		{
			switch (code)
			{
			case ExcelCalcErrorCode.Null:
				errorMessage = Utilities.GetString("Error_UCErrorCode_Null");
				break;
			case ExcelCalcErrorCode.Name:
				errorMessage = Utilities.GetString("Error_UCErrorCode_Name");
				break;
			}
		}

		public ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode code)
		{
			errorCode = code;
			switch (code)
			{
			case ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div:
				errorMessage = Utilities.GetString("Error_UCErrorCode_Div");
				break;
			case ExcelCalcErrorCode.NA:
				errorMessage = Utilities.GetString("Error_UCErrorCode_NA");
				break;
			case ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num:
				errorMessage = Utilities.GetString("Error_UCErrorCode_Num");
				break;
			case ExcelCalcErrorCode.Reference:
				errorMessage = Utilities.GetString("Error_UCErrorCode_Reference");
				break;
			case ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value:
				errorMessage = Utilities.GetString("Error_UCErrorCode_Value");
				break;
			default:
				errorMessage = Utilities.GetString("Error_UCErrorCode_Unknown");
				break;
			}
			InitializeMessageFromExcelCodes(code);
		}

		public ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode code, string message)
		{
			errorCode = code;
			errorMessage = message;
		}

		public ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode code, string message, object value)
		{
			errorCode = code;
			errorMessage = message;
			errorValue = value;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (errorCode == ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div)
			{
				return Utilities.GetString("Value_UCErrorCode_Div");
			}
			if (errorCode == ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num)
			{
				return Utilities.GetString("Value_UCErrorCode_Num");
			}
			if (errorCode == ExcelCalcErrorCode.NA)
			{
				return Utilities.GetString("Value_UCErrorCode_NA");
			}
			if (errorCode == ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value)
			{
				return Utilities.GetString("Value_UCErrorCode_Value");
			}
			if (errorCode == ExcelCalcErrorCode.Reference)
			{
				return Utilities.GetString("Value_UCErrorCode_Reference");
			}
			if (errorCode == ExcelCalcErrorCode.Null)
			{
				return Utilities.GetString("Value_UCErrorCode_Null");
			}
			if (errorCode == ExcelCalcErrorCode.Name)
			{
				return Utilities.GetString("Value_UCErrorCode_Name");
			}
			return Utilities.GetString("Value_UCErrorCode_Unknown");
		}

		internal void RaiseException()
		{
			if (errorValue is UltraCalcException)
			{
				throw (UltraCalcException)errorValue;
			}
			throw new UltraCalcErrorException(this);
		}
	}

		private void ExceptionHandler(Exception e)
		{
			if (e is UltraCalcErrorException)
			{
				value = ((UltraCalcErrorException)e).Value;
			}
			else if (e is DivideByZeroException)
			{
				value = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div, e.Message, e);
			}
			else if (e is ArithmeticException)
			{
				value = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num, e.Message, e);
			}
			else if (e is InvalidCastException)
			{
				value = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num, e.Message, e);
			}
			else if (e is FormatException)
			{
				value = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value, e.Message, e);
			}
			else
			{
				value = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value, e.Message, e);
			}
		}

		public static bool AreValuesEqual(ExcelCalcValue x, ExcelCalcValue y)
		{
			if (x == null)
			{
				return null == y;
			}
			if (y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object resolvedValue = x.GetResolvedValue();
			object resolvedValue2 = y.GetResolvedValue();
			if (x.IsString && y.IsString)
			{
				string text = resolvedValue.ToString();
				string text2 = resolvedValue2.ToString();
				if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(text, text2, x.Culture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (resolvedValue is IComparable && resolvedValue2 is IComparable && resolvedValue.GetType() == resolvedValue2.GetType())
			{
				return ((IComparable)resolvedValue).CompareTo(resolvedValue2) == 0;
			}
			if (resolvedValue == null)
			{
				if (resolvedValue2 == null || (resolvedValue2 is string && (string)resolvedValue2 == string.Empty) || (resolvedValue2 is bool && !(bool)resolvedValue2))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (resolvedValue2 == null && ((resolvedValue is string && (string)resolvedValue == string.Empty) || (resolvedValue is bool && !(bool)resolvedValue)))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x.IsBoolean ^ y.IsBoolean)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.IsString ^ y.IsString)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.ToDouble(out var result) && y.ToDouble(out var result2))
			{
				return result == result2;
			}
			return string.Equals(x.ToString(), y.ToString());
		}

		int IComparable.CompareTo(object value)

		public static int CompareTo(ExcelCalcValue x, ExcelCalcValue y)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(x, y))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(x, null))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(y, null))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return CompareToHelper(x, x.GetResolvedValue(), y, y.GetResolvedValue());
		}

		internal static int CompareToHelper(ExcelCalcValue x, object resolvedXValue, ExcelCalcValue y, object resolvedYValue)
		{
			CultureInfo culture = x.Culture;
			bool flag = IsBooleanHelper(resolvedXValue);
			bool flag2 = IsBooleanHelper(resolvedYValue);
			if (flag && !flag2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (flag2 && !flag)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			bool flag3 = IsStringHelper(resolvedXValue);
			bool flag4 = IsStringHelper(resolvedYValue);
			if (flag3 && !flag4)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (flag4 && !flag3)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (flag3 && flag4)
			{
				string strA = x.ToStringHelper(resolvedXValue, culture);
				string strB = y.ToStringHelper(resolvedYValue, culture);
				return string.Compare(strA, strB);
			}
			if (x.ToDoubleHelper(resolvedXValue, out var result, culture, out var exception) && y.ToDoubleHelper(resolvedYValue, out var result2, culture, out exception))
			{
				result = MathUtilities.RoundToExcelDisplayValue(result);
				result2 = MathUtilities.RoundToExcelDisplayValue(result2);
				return result.CompareTo(result2);
			}
			if (resolvedXValue != null && resolvedYValue != null && resolvedXValue.GetType() == resolvedYValue.GetType() && resolvedXValue is IComparable comparable)
			{
				return comparable.CompareTo(resolvedYValue);
			}
			string strA2 = x.ToStringHelper(resolvedXValue, culture);
			string strB2 = y.ToStringHelper(resolvedYValue, culture);
			return string.Compare(strA2, strB2);
		}

		private bool ToDouble(out double result, IFormatProvider provider, out Exception exception)
		{
			object resolvedValue = GetResolvedValue();
			return ToDoubleHelper(resolvedValue, out result, provider, out exception);
		}

		internal bool ToDoubleHelper(object resolvedValue, out double result, IFormatProvider provider, out Exception exception)
		{
			exception = null;
			if (resolvedValue is double)
			{
				result = (double)resolvedValue;
				return true;
			}
			if (IsNullHelper(resolvedValue))
			{
				result = 0.0;
				return true;
			}
			if (resolvedValue is string)
			{
				if (MathUtilities.DoubleTryParse((string)resolvedValue, provider, out result))
				{
					return true;
				}
				exception = new FormatException();
				return false;
			}
			if (resolvedValue is DateTime)
			{
				double? num = DateTimeToExcelDate(Workbook, (DateTime)resolvedValue);
				if (!num.HasValue)
				{
					exception = new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
					result = 0.0;
					return false;
				}
				result = num.Value;
				return true;
			}
			try
			{
				if (resolvedValue is IConvertible convertible)
				{
					result = convertible.ToDouble(provider);
					return true;
				}
				result = 0.0;
				return false;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				exception = ex;
				result = 0.0;
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DateTime ToDateTime()
		{
			return ToDateTime(Culture);
		}

		public DateTime ToDateTime(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			if (!ToDateTimeHelper(provider, out var dateTime))
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException();
			}
			return dateTime;
		}

		internal bool ToDateTimeHelper(IFormatProvider provider, out DateTime dateTime)
		{
			object resolvedValue = GetResolvedValue(willUseValueInCalculations: true, raiseExceptionOnError: true);
			if (resolvedValue is DateTime)
			{
				dateTime = (DateTime)resolvedValue;
				return true;
			}
			if (ToDouble(out var result, provider, out var _))
			{
				DateTime? dateTime2 = ExcelDateToDateTime(Workbook, result);
				if (!dateTime2.HasValue)
				{
					dateTime = DateTime.MinValue;
					return false;
				}
				dateTime = dateTime2.Value;
				return true;
			}
			if (resolvedValue is long)
			{
				try
				{
					dateTime = new DateTime((long)resolvedValue);
					return true;
				}
				catch (ArgumentOutOfRangeException)
				{
					dateTime = DateTime.MinValue;
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (resolvedValue is IConvertible)
			{
				dateTime = ((IConvertible)resolvedValue).ToDateTime(provider);
				return true;
			}
			dateTime = DateTime.MinValue;
			return false;
		}

		public float ToSingle()
		{
			return ToSingle(Culture);
		}

		public float ToSingle(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			return (float)ToDouble(provider);
		}

		public bool ToBoolean()
		{
			return ToBoolean(Culture);
		}

		public bool ToBoolean(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			object resolvedValue = GetResolvedValue(willUseValueInCalculations: true, raiseExceptionOnError: true);
			if (resolvedValue is bool)
			{
				return (bool)resolvedValue;
			}
			if (IsNullHelper(resolvedValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (resolvedValue is string text)
			{
				if (bool.TryParse(text, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
				throw new FormatException();
			}
			return ToDouble(provider) != 0.0;
		}

			return ToInt32(Culture);

		public int ToInt32(IFormatProvider provider)

		public string ToString(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			object resolvedValue = GetResolvedValue();
			return ToStringHelper(resolvedValue, provider);
		}

		internal string ToStringHelper(object resolvedValue, IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			if (resolvedValue is bool flag)
			{
				return flag.ToString(provider).ToUpper();
			}
			if (resolvedValue is DateTime && ToDoubleHelper(resolvedValue, out var result, provider, out var _))
			{
				return result.ToString(provider);
			}
			if (resolvedValue is IConvertible)
			{
				return ((IConvertible)resolvedValue).ToString(provider);
			}
			if (resolvedValue is ExcelCalcErrorValue)
			{
				return ((ExcelCalcErrorValue)resolvedValue).ToString();
			}
			if (resolvedValue is UltraCalcErrorException)
			{
				return ((UltraCalcErrorException)resolvedValue).ToString();
			}
			if (resolvedValue == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			return resolvedValue.ToString();
		}

			if (resolvedValue is IConvertible convertible)

				return convertible.ToChar(provider);

			throw new InvalidCastException();
