		public bool ToDecimal(out decimal result)
		{
			Exception exception;
			return ToDecimalHelper(out result, Culture, out exception);
		}

		public decimal ToDecimal(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			if (ToDecimalHelper(out var result, provider, out var exception))
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (exception == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException();
			}
			throw exception;
		}

		private bool ToDecimalHelper(out decimal result, IFormatProvider provider, out Exception exception)
		{
			exception = null;
			object resolvedValue = GetResolvedValue(willUseValueInCalculations: true, raiseExceptionOnError: true);
			if (IsNullHelper(resolvedValue))
			{
				result = 0m;
				return true;
			}
			if (resolvedValue is DateTime)
			{
				double? num = DateTimeToExcelDate(Workbook, (DateTime)resolvedValue);
				if (!num.HasValue)
				{
					exception = new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
					result = 0m;
					return false;
				}
				result = (decimal)num.Value;
				return true;
			}
			if (resolvedValue is IConvertible)
			{
				try
				{
					result = ((IConvertible)resolvedValue).ToDecimal(provider);
					return true;
				}
				catch (FormatException ex)
				{
					if (resolvedValue is string text && MathUtilities.DecimalTryParse(text, provider, out var num2))
					{
						result = num2;
						return true;
					}
					exception = ex;
					result = 0m;
					return false;
				}
			}
			result = 0m;
			return false;
		}

		public static double? DateTimeToExcelDate(Workbook workbook, DateTime dateValue)
		{
			return DateTimeToExcelDate(workbook, dateValue, shouldCorrect1900Dates: true);
		}

		public static double? DateTimeToExcelDate(Workbook workbook, DateTime dateValue, bool shouldCorrect1900Dates)
		{
			if (dateValue.Ticks == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num;
			try
			{
				num = dateValue.ToOADate();
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag = shouldCorrect1900Dates;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (workbook != null && workbook.DateSystem == DateSystem.From1904)
			{
				num -= 1462.0;
				flag = false;
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (flag && dateValue < new DateTime(1900, 3, 1))
			{
				num -= 1.0;
			}
			if (!flag2 && num == 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static DateTime? ExcelDateToDateTime(Workbook workbook, double excelDate)
		{
			return ExcelDateToDateTime(workbook, excelDate, shouldCorrect1900Dates: true);
		}

		public static DateTime? ExcelDateToDateTime(Workbook workbook, double excelDate, bool shouldCorrect1900Dates)
		{
			return ExcelDateToDateTime(workbook, excelDate, shouldCorrect1900Dates, allowDateBeforeMinimum: false);
		}

		internal static DateTime? ExcelDateToDateTime(Workbook workbook, double excelDate, bool shouldCorrect1900Dates, bool allowDateBeforeMinimum)
		{
			bool flag = shouldCorrect1900Dates;
			if (workbook != null && workbook.DateSystem == DateSystem.From1904)
			{
				excelDate += 1462.0;
				flag = false;
			}
			if (excelDate >= 2958466.0 || excelDate <= -657435.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DateTime dateTime;
			try
			{
				dateTime = Utilities.DateTimeFromOADate(excelDate);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (flag && dateTime < new DateTime(1900, 3, 1) && excelDate >= 0.0)
			{
				dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
			}
			if (!allowDateBeforeMinimum && dateTime < new DateTime(1900, 1, 1))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dateTime;
		}

		public static TimeSpan ExcelDateToTimeOfDay(double excelDate, bool useDayInfo = false)
		{
			if (!useDayInfo && excelDate >= 0.0)
			{
				excelDate %= 1.0;
			}
			try
			{
				return TimeSpan.FromDays(excelDate);
			}
			catch
			{
				return TimeSpan.Zero;
			}
		}

		public static double TimeOfDayToExcelDate(TimeSpan timeValue, bool useDayInfo = false)
		{
			double num = timeValue.TotalDays;
			if (!useDayInfo && num >= 1.0)
			{
				num %= 1.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public object GetResolvedValue(bool willUseValueInCalculations)
		{
			return GetResolvedValue(willUseValueInCalculations, raiseExceptionOnError: false);
		}

		internal object GetResolvedValue(bool willUseValueInCalculations, bool raiseExceptionOnError)
		{
			return GetResolvedValue(this, willUseValueInCalculations, raiseExceptionOnError);
		}

		private object GetResolvedValue(ExcelCalcValue originalValue, bool willUseValueInCalculations, bool raiseExceptionOnError)
		{
			return GetResolvedValue(originalValue, willUseValueInCalculations, splitArraysForValueParameters: true, raiseExceptionOnError);
		}

		private object GetResolvedValue(ExcelCalcValue originalValue, bool willUseValueInCalculations, bool splitArraysForValueParameters, bool raiseExceptionOnError)
		{
			if (value is IExcelCalcReference)
			{
				ExcelCalcErrorValue errorValue;
				IExcelCalcReference excelCalcReference = ToReference(willUseValueInCalculations, splitArraysForValueParameters, out errorValue);
				if (excelCalcReference == null)
				{
					return errorValue;
				}
				return excelCalcReference.Value?.GetResolvedValue(originalValue, willUseValueInCalculations, splitArraysForValueParameters, raiseExceptionOnError);
			}
			object obj = value;
			if (splitArraysForValueParameters && CalculationContext.ExpectedTokenClass == TokenClass.Value)
			{
				if (value is ArrayProxy arrayProxy)
				{
					obj = GetSingleValue(originalValue, arrayProxy, raiseExceptionOnError, willUseValueInCalculations);
				}
				else if (value is ArrayProxyGroup arrayProxyGroup)
				{
					obj = ((arrayProxyGroup.Length == 1) ? GetSingleValue(originalValue, arrayProxyGroup[0], raiseExceptionOnError, willUseValueInCalculations) : new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
				}
			}
			if (value is double && double.IsInfinity((double)value))
			{
				obj = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num);
			}
			if (raiseExceptionOnError && obj is ExcelCalcErrorValue excelCalcErrorValue)
			{
				excelCalcErrorValue.RaiseException();
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	public class FormulaParseException : Exception
	{
		private int charIndexOfError;

		private string formulaValue;

		private string portionWithError;

		public int CharIndexOfError => charIndexOfError;

		public string FormulaValue => formulaValue;

		public override string Message
		{
			get
			{
				string message = base.Message;
				if (portionWithError == null)
				{
					return message;
				}
				string text = Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_Message_PortionWithError", portionWithError);
				if (message == null)
				{
					return text;
				}
				return message + Environment.NewLine + text;
			}
		}

		public string PortionWithError => portionWithError;

		protected FormulaParseException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			if (info == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("info");
			}
			charIndexOfError = info.GetInt32("CharIndexOfError");
			formulaValue = info.GetString("FormulaValue");
			portionWithError = info.GetString("PortionWithError");
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (info == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("info");
			}
			info.AddValue("CharIndexOfError", charIndexOfError);
			info.AddValue("FormulaValue", formulaValue);
			info.AddValue("PortionWithError", portionWithError);
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		public FormulaParseException()
		{
		}

		public FormulaParseException(string message)
			: base(message)
		{
		}

		public FormulaParseException(string message, Exception innerException)
			: base(message, innerException)
		{
		}

		public FormulaParseException(int charIndexOfError, string formulaValue, string message, string portionWithError)
			: this(message)
		{
			this.charIndexOfError = charIndexOfError;
			this.formulaValue = formulaValue;
			this.portionWithError = portionWithError;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DataValidationRule : ICloneable
	{
		private string errorMessageDescription;

		private string errorMessageTitle;

		private DataValidationErrorStyle errorStyle;

		private string inputMessageDescription;

		private string inputMessageTitle;

		private DataValidationRuleCollection parentCollection;

		private bool showErrorMessageForInvalidValue;

		internal abstract bool AllowNullInternal { get; set; }

		internal abstract DataValidationType ValidationType { get; }

		public string ErrorMessageDescription
		{
			get
			{
				return errorMessageDescription;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(errorMessageDescription == value))
				{
					ValidateMessage(value, "ErrorMessageDescription", 225);
					errorMessageDescription = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public string ErrorMessageTitle
		{
			get
			{
				return errorMessageTitle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(errorMessageTitle == value))
				{
					ValidateMessage(value, "ErrorMessageTitle", 32);
					errorMessageTitle = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public DataValidationErrorStyle ErrorStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return errorStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (errorStyle != value)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(DataValidationErrorStyle), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(DataValidationErrorStyle));
					}
					errorStyle = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public string InputMessageDescription
		{
			get
			{
				return inputMessageDescription;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(inputMessageDescription == value))
				{
					ValidateMessage(value, "InputMessageDescription", 255);
					inputMessageDescription = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public string InputMessageTitle
		{
			get
			{
				return inputMessageTitle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(inputMessageTitle == value))
				{
					ValidateMessage(value, "InputMessageTitle", 32);
					inputMessageTitle = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShowErrorMessageForInvalidValue
		{
			get
			{
				return showErrorMessageForInvalidValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (showErrorMessageForInvalidValue != value)
				{
					showErrorMessageForInvalidValue = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShowInputMessage
		{
			get
			{
				return showInputMessage;
			}
			set
			{
				if (showInputMessage != value)
				{
					showInputMessage = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual FormulaType FormulaType => FormulaType.NonListDataValidationFormula;

		internal DataValidationRuleCollection ParentCollection => parentCollection;

		internal Workbook Workbook => Worksheet?.Workbook;

		internal Worksheet Worksheet
		{
			get
			{
				if (parentCollection == null)
				{
					return null;

			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		internal DataValidationRule()
		{
			errorStyle = DataValidationErrorStyle.Stop;
			showErrorMessageForInvalidValue = true;
			showInputMessage = true;
		}

		public DataValidationRule Clone()
		{
			DataValidationRule dataValidationRule = (DataValidationRule)MemberwiseClone();
			dataValidationRule.parentCollection = null;
			return dataValidationRule;
		}

		internal void ValidateMessage(string message, string propertyName, int maxCharacters)
		{

			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_InvalidMessageLength", propertyName, maxCharacters));
			}
		}

	[DebuggerDisplay("FormattedString: {UnformattedString}")]
	public class FormattedString : IWorksheetCellOwnedValue, ICloneable, IComparable<FormattedString>, IFormattedString, IFormattedItem
	{
		private StringElement element;

		private IFormattedStringOwner owner;

		private GenericCachedCollection<StringElement> sharedStringTable;

		object IFormattedItem.Owner => Owner;

		Workbook IFormattedItem.Workbook => Workbook;

		bool IWorksheetCellOwnedValue.IsOwnedByAllCellsAppliedTo => true;

		public string UnformattedString
		{
			get
			{
				return element.UnformattedString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(UnformattedString == value))
				{
					if (value == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentNullException("unformattedString", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_UnformattedString"));
					}
					BeforeSet();
					element.UnformattedString = value;
					AfterSet();
					if (Owner != null)
					{
						Owner.OnUnformattedStringChanged(this);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal StringElement Element => element;

		internal IFormattedStringOwner Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				if (owner != value)
				{
					owner = value;
					Worksheet worksheet = ((owner == null) ? null : owner.Worksheet);
					SetWorksheet(worksheet);
				}
			}
		}

		internal int UnformattedStringLength => element.UnformattedStringLength;

		internal Worksheet Worksheet
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return owner.Worksheet;
			}
		}

		internal Workbook Workbook
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return owner.Worksheet?.Workbook;
			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		internal FormattedString(Workbook workbook, StringElement element)
			: this(workbook, element, isElementInCache: false, addElementToCache: true)
		{
		}

		internal FormattedString(Workbook workbook, StringElement element, bool isElementInCache, bool addElementToCache)
		{
			if ((isElementInCache || addElementToCache) && workbook != null)
			{
				sharedStringTable = workbook.SharedStringTable;
			}
			if (addElementToCache)
			{
				this.element = GenericCacheElement.FindExistingOrAddToCache(element, sharedStringTable);
			}
			else
			{
				this.element = element;
			}
		}

		public FormattedString(string unformattedString)
		{
			if (unformattedString == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("unformattedString", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_UnformattedString"));
			}
			unformattedString = Utilities.FixupCellString(unformattedString);
			element = new StringElement(unformattedString);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is FormattedString formattedString))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return element.Equals(formattedString.element);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return element.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return UnformattedString;
		}

		int IComparable<FormattedString>.CompareTo(FormattedString other)
		{
			return element.CompareTo(other.element);
		}

		IFormattedRunOwner IFormattedItem.GetOwnerAt(int startIndex)
		{
			return ConvertToFormattedStringElement();
		}

		void IFormattedItem.OnFormattingChanged()
		{
		}

		void IFormattedString.SetWorkbook(Workbook workbook)
		{
			StringElement.SetWorkbook(workbook, owner, ref sharedStringTable, ref element);
		}

		{
			SetOwningCell(row, columnIndex);

		internal void SetOwningCell(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			if (row == null)
			{
				Owner = null;
			}
			else
			{
				Owner = row.Cells[columnIndex];
			}
		}

		void IWorksheetCellOwnedValue.VerifyNewOwner(WorksheetRow ownerRow, short ownerColumnIndex)
		{
			VerifyNewOwner(ownerRow.Cells[ownerColumnIndex]);
		}

		internal void VerifyNewOwner(IFormattedStringOwner newOwner)
		{
			VerifyOwner();
			if (owner != null && !owner.Equals(newOwner))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_FormattedStringAlreadyOwned"));
			}
		}

		internal void AfterSet()
		{
			GenericCacheElement.AfterSet(sharedStringTable, ref element);
		}

		internal void BeforeSet()
		{
			VerifyOwner();
			GenericCacheElement.BeforeSet(sharedStringTable, ref element, willModifyElement: true);
		}

		private void ClearCollectionOnInvalidOwner()
		{
			if (sharedStringTable != null)
			{
				sharedStringTable = null;
				element = GenericCacheElement.FindExistingOrAddToCache(element, null);
			}
		}

		public FormattedString Clone()
		{
			Workbook workbook = ((sharedStringTable == null) ? null : sharedStringTable.Workbook);
			return new FormattedString(workbook, element);
		}

		internal FormattedStringElement ConvertToFormattedStringElement()
		{
			if (element is FormattedStringElement result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return (FormattedStringElement)(element = FormattedStringElement.Create(element));
		}

		public FormattedStringFont GetFont(int startIndex)
		{
			if (startIndex < 0)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("startIndex", startIndex, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_NegativeStartIndex"));
			}
			return new FormattedStringFont(this, startIndex, 0);
		}

		public FormattedStringFont GetFont(int startIndex, int length)
		{
			if (startIndex < 0)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("startIndex", startIndex, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_NegativeStartIndex"));
			}
			if (length < 1)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("length", length, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_LengthMustBePositive"));
			}
			return new FormattedStringFont(this, startIndex, length);
		}

		public IEnumerable<FormattedStringFont> GetFormattingRuns()
		{
			int totalLength = UnformattedString.Length;
			if (Element is FormattedStringElement { HasFormatting: not false } formattedStringElement)
			{
				FormattingRunBase startOfNextContiguousRun = null;
				foreach (FormattingRunBase run in formattedStringElement.FormattingRuns)
				{
					if (startOfNextContiguousRun == null)
					{
						if (run.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute != 0)
						{
							yield return GetFont(0, run.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute);
						}
						startOfNextContiguousRun = run;
					}
					else if ((startOfNextContiguousRun.HasFont || run.HasFont) && !startOfNextContiguousRun.GetFontInternal().Element.HasSameData(run.GetFontInternal().Element))
					{
						int start = startOfNextContiguousRun.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute;
						int length = run.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute - start;
						yield return GetFont(start, length);
						startOfNextContiguousRun = run;
					}
				}
				if (startOfNextContiguousRun != null)
				{
					yield return GetFont(length: totalLength - startOfNextContiguousRun.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute, startIndex: startOfNextContiguousRun.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				yield return GetFont(0, totalLength);
			}
		}

		internal FormattingRunBase[] GetFormattingRunsInternal()
		{
			if (element is FormattedStringElement)
			{
				return ((FormattedStringElement)element).FormattingRuns.ToArray();
			}
			return new FormattingRunBase[0];
		}

		internal void OnRooted(GenericCachedCollection<StringElement> sharedStringTable)
		{
			GenericCacheElement.SetCollection(sharedStringTable, ref this.sharedStringTable, ref element);
		}

		internal void SetWorksheet(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			Workbook workbook = null;
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
			}
			((IFormattedString)this).SetWorkbook(workbook);
		}

		internal void VerifyOwner()
		{
			WorksheetCell worksheetCell = owner as WorksheetCell;
			if (worksheetCell != null && (!(worksheetCell.Value is FormattedString formattedString) || formattedString.Element != Element))
			{
				owner = null;
				ClearCollectionOnInvalidOwner();
			}
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("FormattedText: {ToString()}")]
	public class FormattedText : ICloneable, IFormattedItem
	{
		internal const string NewLine = "\n";

		private string cachedUnformattedString;

		private IFormattedTextOwner owner;

		private FormattedTextParagraphCollection paragraphs;

		private CT_TextBodyProperties roundTrip2007Properties;

		private VerticalTextAlignment verticalAlignment = VerticalTextAlignment.Top;

		object IFormattedItem.Owner => Owner;

		Workbook IFormattedItem.Workbook => Workbook;

		public FormattedTextParagraphCollection Paragraphs => paragraphs;

		public VerticalTextAlignment VerticalAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return verticalAlignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (VerticalAlignment != value)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(VerticalTextAlignment), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(VerticalTextAlignment));
					}
					verticalAlignment = value;
					OnFormattingChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal IFormattedTextOwner Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				if (owner != value)
				{
					owner = value;
					Worksheet worksheet = ((owner == null) ? null : owner.Worksheet);
					SetWorksheet(worksheet);
				}
			}
		}

		internal CT_TextBodyProperties RoundTrip2007Properties
		{
			get
			{
				return roundTrip2007Properties;
			}
			set
			{
				roundTrip2007Properties = value;
			}
		}

		internal Worksheet Worksheet
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return owner.Worksheet;
			}
		}

		internal Workbook Workbook
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return owner.Worksheet?.Workbook;
			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		internal FormattedText()
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Expected O, but got Unknown
			paragraphs = new FormattedTextParagraphCollection(this);
			CT_TextBodyProperties val = new CT_TextBodyProperties();
			val.ColumnsRightToLeft = false;
			roundTrip2007Properties = val;
		}

		public FormattedText(string unformattedString)
			: this()
		{
			if (unformattedString == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("unformattedString", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_UnformattedString"));
			}
			List<int> lineIndexes;
			List<string> newlines;
			List<string> lines = Utilities.GetLines(unformattedString, out lineIndexes, out newlines);
			for (int i = 0; i < lineIndexes.Count; i++)
			{
				int startIndex = lineIndexes[i];
				string unformattedString2 = lines[i];
				string text = null;
				if (i < newlines.Count)
				{
					text = newlines[i];
				}
				FormattedTextParagraph paragraph = new FormattedTextParagraph(this, startIndex, unformattedString2, text);
				paragraphs.InsertInternal(i, paragraph, text);
			}
			ClearCache();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (cachedUnformattedString == null)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				for (int i = 0; i < paragraphs.Count; i++)
				{
					FormattedTextParagraph formattedTextParagraph = paragraphs[i];
					stringBuilder.Append(formattedTextParagraph.UnformattedString);
					if (i < paragraphs.Count - 1)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(formattedTextParagraph.EndingNewLine);
					}
				}
				cachedUnformattedString = stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return cachedUnformattedString;
		}

		IFormattedRunOwner IFormattedItem.GetOwnerAt(int startIndex)
		{
			for (int num = paragraphs.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				FormattedTextParagraph formattedTextParagraph = paragraphs[num];
				if (formattedTextParagraph.StartIndex <= startIndex)
				{
					return formattedTextParagraph;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		void IFormattedItem.OnFormattingChanged()
		{
			OnFormattingChanged();
		}

		public FormattedText Clone()
		{
			FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText();
			formattedText.verticalAlignment = verticalAlignment;
			formattedText.Paragraphs.InitializeFrom(Paragraphs);
			formattedText.ClearCache();
			return formattedText;
		}

		public FormattedTextFont GetFont(int startIndex)
		{
			if (startIndex < 0)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("startIndex", startIndex, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_NegativeStartIndex"));
			}
			return new FormattedTextFont(this, startIndex, 0);
		}

		public FormattedTextFont GetFont(int startIndex, int length)
		{
			if (startIndex < 0)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("startIndex", startIndex, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_NegativeStartIndex"));
			}
			if (length < 1)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("length", length, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_LengthMustBePositive"));
			}
			return new FormattedTextFont(this, startIndex, length);
		}

		public IEnumerable<FormattedTextFont> GetFormattingRuns()
		{
			int totalLength = ToString().Length;
			FormattingRunBase startOfNextContiguousRun = null;
			foreach (FormattedTextParagraph paragraph in Paragraphs)
			{
				foreach (FormattedTextRun run in paragraph.GetFormattingRuns(Workbook))
				{
					if (startOfNextContiguousRun == null)
					{
						if (run.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute != 0)
						{
							yield return GetFont(0, run.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute);
						}
						startOfNextContiguousRun = run;
					}
					else if ((startOfNextContiguousRun.HasFont || run.HasFont) && !startOfNextContiguousRun.GetFontInternal().Element.HasSameData(run.GetFontInternal().Element))
					{
						int start = startOfNextContiguousRun.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute;
						int length = run.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute - start;
						yield return GetFont(start, length);
						startOfNextContiguousRun = run;
					}
				}
			}
			if (startOfNextContiguousRun != null)
			{
				yield return GetFont(length: totalLength - startOfNextContiguousRun.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute, startIndex: startOfNextContiguousRun.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearCache()
		{
			cachedUnformattedString = null;
		}

		internal void OnFormattingChanged()
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.OnFormattingChanged(this);
			}
		}

		internal void OnParagraphUnformattedStringChanged(FormattedTextParagraph paragraph, int oldLengthResolved, int newLengthResolved)
		{
			int num = paragraphs.IndexOf(paragraph);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				int num2 = newLengthResolved - oldLengthResolved;
				for (int i = num + 1; i < paragraphs.Count; i++)
				{
					paragraphs[i].StartIndex += num2;
				}
				ClearCache();
				if (owner != null)
				{
					owner.OnUnformattedStringChanged(this);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetWorksheet(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			Workbook workbook = null;
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
			}
			_ = workbook?.SharedStringTable;
			GenericCachedCollection<WorkbookFontData> rootCollection = workbook?.Fonts;
			foreach (FormattedTextParagraph paragraph in Paragraphs)
			{
				foreach (FormattingRunBase formattingRun in paragraph.GetFormattingRuns(workbook))
				{
					if (formattingRun.HasFont)
					{
						formattingRun.GetFontInternal(workbook).OnRooted(rootCollection);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyNewOwner(WorksheetShapeWithText newOwner)
		{
			if (owner != null && owner != newOwner)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_FormattedTextAlreadyOwned"));
			}
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Formula: {ToString(),nq}")]
	public class Formula : IWorksheetCellOwnedValue, ICloneable
	{
		internal class ConnectReferencesVisitor : FormulaTokenModifierVisitor
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static ConnectReferencesVisitor _instance;

			private bool _shouldConnect;

			private ConnectReferencesVisitor()
			{
			}

			public override void Reset()
			{
				base.Reset();
			}

			public override bool VisitArea3DToken(Area3DToken token)
			{
				return VisitCellReferenceTokenHelper(token);
			}

			public override bool VisitAreaToken(AreaToken token)
			{
				return VisitCellReferenceTokenHelper(token);
			}

			public override bool VisitCellReferenceToken(CellReferenceToken token)
			{
				return VisitCellReferenceTokenHelper(token);
			}

			public override bool VisitNameToken(NameToken token)
			{
				if (_shouldConnect)
				{
					return ConnectNameToken(base.Context, token);
				}
				if (!token.NamedReference.IsConnected)
				{
					return false;
				}
				NamedReferenceBase namedReference = token.NamedReference;
				token.NamedReference = new NamedReferenceUnconnected(namedReference.Name, namedReference.CurrentFormat, namedReference.Type);
				return true;
			}

			public override bool VisitNameXToken(NameXToken token)
			{
				if (_shouldConnect)
				{
					return ConnectNameXToken(base.Context, token);
				}
				if (!token.NamedReference.IsConnected)
				{
					return false;
				}
				NamedReferenceBase namedReference = token.NamedReference;
				token.WorksheetReference = token.WorksheetReference.Disconnect();
				token.NamedReference = new NamedReferenceUnconnected(namedReference.Name, namedReference.CurrentFormat, namedReference.Type);
				return true;
			}

			public override bool VisitRef3DToken(Ref3DToken token)
			{
				return VisitCellReferenceTokenHelper(token);
			}

			public override bool VisitRefToken(RefToken token)
			{
				return VisitCellReferenceTokenHelper(token);
			}

			public override bool VisitStructuredTableReference(StructuredTableReference token)
			{
				WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReference = token.WorkbookReference;
				NamedReferenceBase tableReference = token.TableReference;
				if (_shouldConnect)
				{
					token.WorkbookReference = workbookReference.Connect(base.Context);
					NamedReferenceBase table = token.GetTable(base.Context);
					if (table != null)
					{
						token.TableReference = table;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					token.WorkbookReference = workbookReference.Disconnect();
					token.TableReference = new NamedReferenceUnconnected(tableReference.Name, token.WorkbookReference, hidden: false, tableReference.CurrentFormat);
				}
				if (tableReference == token.TableReference)
				{
					return workbookReference != token.WorkbookReference;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public static bool ConnectNameToken(FormulaContext context, NameToken token)
			{
				NamedReferenceBase namedReference = token.NamedReference;
				string name = namedReference.Name;
				if (name == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				NamedReferenceBase namedReferenceBase = null;
				switch (namedReference.Type)
				{
				case NameType.Normal:
					if (context.Worksheet != null)
					{
						namedReferenceBase = context.Workbook.NamedReferences.Find(name, context.Worksheet);
					}
					if (namedReferenceBase == null && context.Workbook != null)
					{
						namedReferenceBase = context.Workbook.GetWorkbookScopedNamedItem(name);
					}
					break;
				case NameType.AddInFunctionName:
				{
					if (context.Workbook == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					WorkbookReferenceBase addInFunctionsWorkbookReference = context.Workbook.AddInFunctionsWorkbookReference;
					namedReferenceBase = addInFunctionsWorkbookReference.GetNamedReference(name, addInFunctionsWorkbookReference, createIfNotPresent: true);
					break;
				}
				}
				if (namedReferenceBase != null)
				{
					token.NamedReference = namedReferenceBase;
				}
				return namedReference != token.NamedReference;
			}

			public static bool ConnectNameXToken(FormulaContext context, NameXToken token)
			{
				NamedReferenceBase namedReference = token.NamedReference;
				token.WorksheetReference = token.WorksheetReference.Connect(context);
				switch (namedReference.Type)
				{
				case NameType.Normal:
				case NameType.OleObject:
				{
					NamedReferenceBase namedReference2 = token.WorksheetReference.GetNamedReference(token.Name);
					if (namedReference2 != null)
					{
						token.NamedReference = namedReference2;
					}
					break;
				}
				case NameType.AddInFunctionName:
				{
					if (context.Workbook == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					AddInFunctionsWorkbookReference addInFunctionsWorkbookReference = context.Workbook.AddInFunctionsWorkbookReference;
					token.NamedReference = addInFunctionsWorkbookReference.GetNamedReference(namedReference.Name, addInFunctionsWorkbookReference, createIfNotPresent: true);
					break;
				}
				}
				return namedReference != token.NamedReference;
			}

			public static ConnectReferencesVisitor Initialize(FormulaContext context, bool shouldConnect)
			{
				if (_instance == null)
				{
					_instance = new ConnectReferencesVisitor();
				}
				ConnectReferencesVisitor connectReferencesVisitor = _instance;
				if (connectReferencesVisitor.Context != null)
				{
					connectReferencesVisitor = new ConnectReferencesVisitor();
				}
				connectReferencesVisitor.Context = context;
				connectReferencesVisitor._shouldConnect = shouldConnect;
				return connectReferencesVisitor;
			}

			public bool VisitCellReferenceTokenHelper(CellReferenceToken token)
			{
				WorksheetReference worksheetReference = token.WorksheetReference;
				if (worksheetReference != null)
				{
					if (_shouldConnect)
					{
						token.WorksheetReference = worksheetReference.Connect(base.Context);
					}
					else
					{
						token.WorksheetReference = worksheetReference.Disconnect();
					}
				}
				return worksheetReference != token.WorksheetReference;
			}
		}

		private class ConvertTableReferencesToRangesVisitor : FormulaTokenModifierVisitor
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static ConvertTableReferencesToRangesVisitor _instance;

			private WorksheetTable _table;

			private ConvertTableReferencesToRangesVisitor()
			{
			}

			public override void Reset()
			{
				_table = null;
				base.Reset();
			}

			public override bool VisitNameToken(NameToken token)
			{
				if ((token.ScopeReference == null || token.ScopeReference == base.Context.Workbook) && token.NamedReference == _table)
				{
					WorksheetRegion dataAreaRegion = _table.DataAreaRegion;
					if (dataAreaRegion != null)
					{
						base.CurrentReplacementToken = new Area3DToken(_table.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.GetWorksheetReference(_table.Worksheet.Name, null), new CellAddressRange(dataAreaRegion), token.TokenClass);
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override bool VisitStructuredTableReference(StructuredTableReference token)
			{
				if (base.Context.Workbook != null && token.WorkbookReference == base.Context.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference && _table == token.TableReference && token.GetCalcValue(base.Context) is TableCalcReferenceBase { Region: { } region })
				{
					base.CurrentReplacementToken = new Area3DToken(token.WorkbookReference.GetWorksheetReference(_table.Worksheet.Name, null), new CellAddressRange(region), token.TokenClass);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public static ConvertTableReferencesToRangesVisitor Initialize(FormulaContext context, WorksheetTable table)
			{
				if (_instance == null)
				{
					_instance = new ConvertTableReferencesToRangesVisitor();
				}
				_instance._table = table;
				_instance.Context = context;
				return _instance;
			}
		}

		private class OffsetReferencesVisitor : FormulaTokenModifierVisitor
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static OffsetReferencesVisitor _instance;

			private Point _offset;

			private OffsetReferencesVisitor()
			{
			}

			public override void Reset()
			{
				_offset = Utilities.PointEmpty;
				base.Reset();
			}

			public override bool VisitAreaToken(AreaToken token)
			{
				bool result;
				if (!token.AreRelativeAddressesOffsets)
				{
					token.CellAddressRange = token.CellAddressRange.Offset(base.Context, _offset, allowRollover: false);
					result = true;
				}
				else
				{
					result = false;
				}
				WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = token.CellAddressRange.ToAbsoluteAddress(base.Context, token.AreRelativeAddressesOffsets, allowRollover: false);
				if (worksheetRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex < 0 || worksheetRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex < 0 || base.Context.Workbook.MaxColumnCount <= worksheetRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex || base.Context.Workbook.MaxRowCount <= worksheetRegionAddress.LastRowIndex)
				{
					base.CurrentReplacementToken = token.CreateEquivalentRefErrorToken();
					return true;
				}
				return result;
			}

			public override bool VisitExpToken(ExpToken token)
			{
				token.CellAddress = token.CellAddress.Offset(base.Context, _offset);
				return true;
			}

			public override bool VisitMemAreaOperator(MemAreaOperator token)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < token.Ranges.Length; i++)
				{
					ref CellAddressRange reference = ref token.Ranges[i];
					reference = token.Ranges[i].Offset(base.Context, _offset);
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override bool VisitRefToken(RefToken token)
			{
				bool result;
				if (!token.AreRelativeAddressesOffsets)
				{
					token.CellAddress = token.CellAddress.Offset(base.Context, _offset, allowRollover: false);
					result = true;
				}
				else
				{
					result = false;
				}
				WorksheetCellAddress worksheetCellAddress = token.CellAddress.ToAbsoluteAddress(base.Context, token.AreRelativeAddressesOffsets, allowRollover: false);
				if (worksheetCellAddress.ColumnIndex < 0 || worksheetCellAddress.RowIndex < 0 || base.Context.Workbook.MaxColumnCount <= worksheetCellAddress.ColumnIndex || base.Context.Workbook.MaxRowCount <= worksheetCellAddress.RowIndex)
				{
					base.CurrentReplacementToken = token.CreateEquivalentRefErrorToken();
					return true;
				}
				return result;
			}

			public override bool VisitTblToken(TblToken token)
			{
				token.CellAddress = token.CellAddress.Offset(base.Context, _offset);
				return true;
			}

			public static OffsetReferencesVisitor Initialize(FormulaContext context, Point offset)
			{
				if (_instance == null)
				{
					_instance = new OffsetReferencesVisitor();
				}
				_instance._offset = offset;
				_instance.Context = context;
				return _instance;
			}
		}

		private class CellsShiftedVisitor : FormulaTokenModifierVisitor
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static CellsShiftedVisitor _instance;

			private CellShiftOperation _shiftOperation;

			private ICellShiftOperationOverride _operationOverride;

			private ReferenceShiftType _shiftType;

			private CellsShiftedVisitor()
			{
			}

			public override void Reset()
			{
				_shiftOperation = default(CellShiftOperation);
				base.Reset();
			}

			public override bool VisitAreaToken(AreaToken token)
			{
				WorksheetCellAddress owningCellAddress = base.Context.OwningCellAddress;
				WorksheetCellAddress cellAddress = owningCellAddress;
				if (base.Context.Worksheet == _shiftOperation.Worksheet)
				{
					_shiftOperation.ShiftCellAddress(ref cellAddress);
				}
				bool flag = owningCellAddress != cellAddress;
				WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = token.CellAddressRange.ToAbsoluteAddress(base.Context, token.AreRelativeAddressesOffsets);
				WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress = worksheetRegionAddress;
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (token.GetWorksheetContainingReference(base.Context) == _shiftOperation.Worksheet)
				{

		private class ArgumentInfoGenerator : FormulaTokenEvaluator<ushort>
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			public static ArgumentInfoGenerator _instance;

			private ArgumentInfo?[] _argumentInfo;

			private ArgumentInfoGenerator()
			{
			}

			public override void Reset()
			{
				_argumentInfo = null;
				base.Reset();
			}

			protected override ushort EvaluateBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token, ushort firstOperand, ushort secondOperand)
			{
				ushort currentTokenIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
				ref ArgumentInfo? reference = ref _argumentInfo[firstOperand];
				reference = new ArgumentInfo(currentTokenIndex, 0);
				ref ArgumentInfo? reference2 = ref _argumentInfo[secondOperand];
				reference2 = new ArgumentInfo(currentTokenIndex, 1);
				return currentTokenIndex;
			}

			protected override ushort EvaluateFunctionToken(IFunctionToken token, ushort functionName, ushort[] arguments)
			{
				ushort currentTokenIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
				for (ushort num = 0; num < arguments.Length; num++)
				{
					ref ArgumentInfo? reference = ref _argumentInfo[arguments[num]];
					reference = new ArgumentInfo(currentTokenIndex, num);
				}
				return currentTokenIndex;
			}

			protected override ushort EvaluateOperandToken(OperandToken token)
			{
				return _currentTokenIndex;
			}

			protected override ushort EvaluateParenToken(ParenToken token, ushort contents)
			{
				ushort currentTokenIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
				ref ArgumentInfo? reference = ref _argumentInfo[contents];
				reference = new ArgumentInfo(currentTokenIndex, 0);
				return currentTokenIndex;
			}

			protected override ushort EvaluateUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token, ushort operand)
			{
				ushort currentTokenIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
				ref ArgumentInfo? reference = ref _argumentInfo[operand];

				return currentTokenIndex;
			}

		internal Formula(byte creationCellReferenceModeEncoded, FormulaType type)
		{
			this.creationCellReferenceModeEncoded = creationCellReferenceModeEncoded;
			postfixTokenList = FormulaToken.EmptyArray;
			this.type = type;
		}

		internal Formula(ArrayFormula arrayFormula)
			: this(arrayFormula.creationCellReferenceModeEncoded, FormulaType.Formula)
		{
			IsArrayOrSharedFormula = true;
			postfixTokenList = new FormulaToken[1]
			{
				new ExpToken(arrayFormula.CellRange.FirstColumnInternal, arrayFormula.CellRange.FirstRow)
			};
		}

		internal Formula(WorksheetDataTable dataTable)
			: this((byte)dataTable.Worksheet.Workbook.CellReferenceMode, FormulaType.Formula)
		{
			IsDataTableInterior = true;
			WorksheetRegion cellsInTable = dataTable.CellsInTable;
			postfixTokenList = new FormulaToken[1]
			{
				new TblToken((short)(cellsInTable.FirstColumnInternal + 1), cellsInTable.FirstRow + 1)
			};
		}

		internal Formula(Formula formula)
			: this(formula.creationCellReferenceModeEncoded, formula.type)
		{
			parsedWorkbookFormatEncoded = formula.parsedWorkbookFormatEncoded;
			flags = formula.flags;
			postfixTokenList = new FormulaToken[formula.postfixTokenList.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < postfixTokenList.Length; i++)
			{
				FormulaToken formulaToken = formula.postfixTokenList[i];
				FormulaToken formulaToken2 = formulaToken.Accept(CloneTokenVisitor.Instance);
				postfixTokenList[i] = formulaToken2;
			}
		}

		{
			return ToString((CellReferenceMode)creationCellReferenceModeEncoded);

			SetOwningCell(row, columnIndex);
		}

		internal void SetOwningCell(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			if (owningCellRow != row || owningCellColumnIndex != columnIndex)
			{
				if (owningCellRow != null)
				{
					DisconnectReferences();
				}
				owningCellRow = row;
				owningCellColumnIndex = columnIndex;
				ClearCache();
				if (owningCellRow != null && !IsConnected)
				{
					ReconnectReferences(new FormulaContext(owningCellRow.Worksheet, owningCellRow.Index, owningCellColumnIndex, owningCellRow.Worksheet.CurrentFormat, this));
				}
			}
		}

		public void ApplyTo(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			if (cell == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("cell");
			}
			if (cell.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"), "cell");
			}
			ApplyTo(cell.Row, cell.ColumnIndexInternal);
		}

		internal virtual void ApplyTo(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			row.Worksheet.VerifyFormula(this, row, columnIndex);
			if (row.GetCellValueRaw(columnIndex) is IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue { BlockedRegion: var blockedRegion } worksheetRegionBlockingValue && (blockedRegion.FirstRow != blockedRegion.LastRow || blockedRegion.FirstColumn != blockedRegion.LastColumn))
			{
				worksheetRegionBlockingValue.ThrowBlockingException();
			}
			ApplyTo(row, columnIndex, row, columnIndex);
		}

		public void ApplyTo(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			if (region == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("region");
			}
			ApplyTo(new WorksheetRegion[1] { region });
		}

		public void ApplyTo(WorksheetRegion[] regions)
		{
			ApplyTo(regions, null, -1);
		}

		internal void AddAppliedFormula(AppliedFormula compiledFormula, IExcelCalcReference baseReference)
		{
			if (appliedFormulas == null)
			{
				appliedFormulas = new List<AppliedFormula>();
			}
			appliedFormulas.Add(compiledFormula);
		}

		internal Formula ApplyTo(WorksheetRow firstCellAppliedToRow, short firstCellAppliedToColumnIndex, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			WorksheetCellBlock cellBlock = row.GetCellBlock(columnIndex);
			if (cellBlock.GetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex) is IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue worksheetRegionBlockingValue)
			{
				worksheetRegionBlockingValue.RemoveFromRegion();
			}
			Formula formula = this;
			if (OwningCellRow != null || (firstCellAppliedToRow != null && (columnIndex != firstCellAppliedToColumnIndex || row.Index != firstCellAppliedToRow.Index)))
			{
				formula = formula.Clone();
			}
			Workbook workbook = row.Worksheet.Workbook;
			if (!IsSharedFormula && firstCellAppliedToRow != null)
			{
				Point offset = new Point(columnIndex - firstCellAppliedToColumnIndex, row.Index - firstCellAppliedToRow.Index);
				formula.OffsetReferences(workbook, row, columnIndex, offset);
			}
			if (CurrentFormat != workbook.CurrentFormat)
			{
				FormatLimitErrors formatLimitErrors = workbook.InitializeFormatLimitErrors();
				CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode = workbook?.CellReferenceMode ?? CellReferenceMode.A1;
				formula.VerifyFormatLimits(workbook, formatLimitErrors, workbook.CurrentFormat, cellReferenceMode, parseFormula: true, row, columnIndex);
				if (formatLimitErrors.HasErrors)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_FormulaReferencesInvalidCells"));
				}
			}
			formula.ApplyToCell(row, columnIndex, cellBlock);
			bool flag = formula.Workbook != null && formula.Workbook.IsLoading;
			if (!flag && formula.HasHyperlink)
			{
				WorksheetHyperlink.ApplyHyperlinkStyleToRegion(new WorksheetRegion(row.Worksheet, row.Index, columnIndex, row.Index, columnIndex));
			}
			if (!flag && !Utilities.TestFlag(row.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(columnIndex).FormatOptionsResolved, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting))
			{
				AppliedFormula appliedFormula = row.GetCellCalcReference(columnIndex).AppliedFormula;
				if (appliedFormula != null)
				{
					foreach (RefBase item in (IEnumerable<IExcelCalcReference>)appliedFormula.References)
					{
						IList<WorksheetRegion> regionGroup = item.GetRegionGroup();
						if (regionGroup != null && regionGroup.Count != 0 && regionGroup[0].Worksheet.Workbook == appliedFormula.TargetReference.Workbook)
						{
							WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = regionGroup[0];
							string formatStringResolved = worksheetRegion.TopRow.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(worksheetRegion.FirstColumnInternal).FormatStringResolved;
							if (!string.Equals(formatStringResolved, "General", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
							{
								row.GetCellFormat(columnIndex).FormatString = formatStringResolved;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return formula;
		}

		internal virtual void ApplyTo(WorksheetRegion[] regions, WorksheetRow anchorRow, short anchorColumnIndex)
		{
			if (regions == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("regions");
			}
			if (regions.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_NoRegionsInArray"), "regions");
			}
			if (anchorRow != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < regions.Length; i++)
				{
					if (regions[i].Contains(anchorRow, anchorColumnIndex))
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = regions[0].Worksheet;
			for (int j = 1; j < regions.Length; j++)
			{
				if (regions[j].Worksheet == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionsShiftedOffWorksheet"), "regions");
				}
				if (regions[j].Worksheet != worksheet)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionsFromMixedWorksheets"), "regions");
				}
			}
			Utilities.VerifyBlockedRegions(regions);
			for (int k = 0; k < regions.Length; k++)
			{
				regions[k].ApplyFormulaToRegion(this, ref anchorRow, ref anchorColumnIndex);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void ApplyToCell(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, WorksheetCellBlock cellBlock)
		{
			cellBlock.SetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex, this, checkForBlockingValues: false, out var replacementBlock);
			cellBlock = replacementBlock ?? cellBlock;
		}

		internal virtual Formula Clone()
		{
			return new Formula(this);
		}

		internal void ReconnectReferences(Workbook workbook)
		{
			ReconnectReferences(new FormulaContext(workbook, this));
		}

		internal void ReconnectReferences(FormulaContext context)
		{
			ConnectReferencesVisitor visitor = ConnectReferencesVisitor.Initialize(context, shouldConnect: true);
			ModifyTokens(visitor);
			IsConnected = true;
		}

		internal void ConvertTableReferencesToRanges(Workbook workbook, WorksheetTable table)
		{
			FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(workbook, this);
			ModifyTokens(ConvertTableReferencesToRangesVisitor.Initialize(context, table));
		}

		internal void DisconnectReferences()
		{
			if (IsConnected)
			{
				ConnectReferencesVisitor visitor = ConnectReferencesVisitor.Initialize(new FormulaContext(Workbook, this), shouldConnect: false);
				ModifyTokens(visitor);
				IsConnected = false;
			}
		}

		internal bool DoesHaveRelativeReferences()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < postfixTokenList.Length; i++)
			{
				if (postfixTokenList[i] is CellReferenceToken { HasRelativeAddresses: not false })
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsEquivalentTo(Formula formula)
		{
			if (OwningCellRow == null || formula.OwningCellRow == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Type != formula.Type)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (PostfixTokenList.Length != formula.PostfixTokenList.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			FormulaContext sourceContext = new FormulaContext(Workbook, this);
			FormulaContext comparisonContext = new FormulaContext(formula.Workbook, formula);
			for (int i = 0; i < PostfixTokenList.Length; i++)
			{
				FormulaToken formulaToken = PostfixTokenList[i];
				FormulaToken comparisonToken = formula.PostfixTokenList[i];
				if (!formulaToken.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void OffsetReferences(Workbook workbook, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, Point offset)
		{
			if (!IsSharedFormula && offset != Utilities.PointEmpty)
			{
				Worksheet worksheet = row?.Worksheet;
				FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(workbook, worksheet, row, columnIndex, this);
				ModifyTokens(OffsetReferencesVisitor.Initialize(context, offset));
			}
		}

		internal bool OnCellsShifted(Worksheet owningWorksheet, CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride, ReferenceShiftType shiftType)
		{
			short columnIndex = OwningCellColumnIndex;
			int owningCellRowIndex = -1;
			if (OwningCellRow != null)
			{
				if (OwningCellRow.Worksheet == shiftOperation.Worksheet)
				{
					WorksheetCellAddress addressBeforeShift = shiftOperation.GetAddressBeforeShift(new WorksheetCellAddress(OwningCellRow.Index, OwningCellColumnIndex));
					columnIndex = addressBeforeShift.ColumnIndex;
					owningCellRowIndex = addressBeforeShift.RowIndex;
				}
				else
				{
					owningCellRowIndex = OwningCellRow.Index;
				}
			}
			FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(owningWorksheet, owningCellRowIndex, columnIndex, CurrentFormat, this);
			return ModifyTokens(CellsShiftedVisitor.Initialize(context, shiftOperation, operationOverride, shiftType));
		}

		internal void OnCurrentFormatChanged(Workbook workbook, WorkbookFormat oldFormat)
		{
			CurrentFormat = workbook.CurrentFormat;
			CurrentFormatChangedVisitor currentFormatChangedVisitor = CurrentFormatChangedVisitor.Initialize(new FormulaContext(workbook, this), oldFormat, workbook.CurrentFormat);
			currentFormatChangedVisitor.VisitAll();
		}

		internal void OnTableResized()
		{
			if (appliedFormulas != null)
			{
				List<AppliedFormula> oldCompiledFormulas = new List<AppliedFormula>(appliedFormulas);
				appliedFormulas = null;
				RecompileFormulasHelper(oldCompiledFormulas);
			}
			ClearCache();
		}

		internal bool OnTableResizing(WorksheetTable table, List<WorksheetTableColumn> columnsBeingRemoved)
		{
			FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(table.Workbook, this);
			TableResizingVisitor tableResizingVisitor = TableResizingVisitor.Initialize(context, table, columnsBeingRemoved);
			if (!tableResizingVisitor.VisitAll())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!tableResizingVisitor.IsTableReferenced)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ClearCache();
			if (appliedFormulas != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < appliedFormulas.Count; i++)
				{
					appliedFormulas[i].TargetReference?.SetAndCompileFormula(null, canClearPreviouslyCalculatedValue: false, forceSet: true, shouldRemoveCompiledFormulas: false);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void OnTableColumnsRenamed(WorksheetTable table, List<KeyValuePair<WorksheetTableColumn, string>> changedColumnNames)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < postfixTokenList.Length; i++)
			{
				if (postfixTokenList[i] is StructuredTableReference structuredTableReference)
				{
					structuredTableReference.OnTableColumnsRenamed(table, changedColumnNames);
				}
			}
			ClearCache();
		}

		internal bool TryGetArgumentInfo(int tokenIndex, out int parentTokenIndex, out int argumentIndex)
		{
			parentTokenIndex = -1;
			argumentIndex = -1;
			if (this.argumentInfo == null)
			{
				this.argumentInfo = new ArgumentInfo?[PostfixTokenList.Length];
				ArgumentInfoGenerator.Initialize(new FormulaContext(Workbook, this), this.argumentInfo).Evaluate();
			}
			if (this.argumentInfo.Length <= tokenIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ArgumentInfo? argumentInfo = this.argumentInfo[tokenIndex];
			if (!argumentInfo.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			parentTokenIndex = argumentInfo.Value.ParentTokenIndex;
			argumentIndex = argumentInfo.Value.ArgumentIndex;
			return true;
		}

		internal void OnArgumentInfoGenerated(ArgumentInfo?[] argumentInfo)
		{
			if (this.argumentInfo == null)
			{
				this.argumentInfo = argumentInfo;
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyFormatLimits(Workbook workbook, FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, bool parseFormula, WorksheetRow owningCellRow = null, short owningCellColumnIndex = -1)
		{
			ConvertTableReferencesToRanges(workbook, null);
			FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(workbook, Worksheet, owningCellRow ?? OwningCellRow, (owningCellColumnIndex < 0) ? OwningCellColumnIndex : owningCellColumnIndex, this, Culture, cellReferenceMode, testFormat);
			VerifyFormatLimitsVisitor verifyFormatLimitsVisitor = VerifyFormatLimitsVisitor.Initialize(context, limitErrors, testFormat);
			verifyFormatLimitsVisitor.VisitAll();
			if (parseFormula && postfixTokenList.Length != 0)
			{
				FormulaStringGenerator formulaStringGenerator = FormulaStringGenerator.Initialize(context);
				string result = formulaStringGenerator.Evaluate().Result;
				if (!TryParse(result, cellReferenceMode, testFormat, out var _, out var _))
				{
					limitErrors.AddError(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidForWorkbookFormat"));
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void VerifyNewOwner(WorksheetRow ownerRow, short ownerColumnIndex)
		{
			if (owningCellRow != null && (owningCellRow != ownerRow || owningCellColumnIndex != ownerColumnIndex))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_FormulaAlreadyOwned"));
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyTokenReferences()
		{
			if (!AreTokenReferencesResolved)
			{
				TokenReferenceResolver tokenReferenceResolver = TokenReferenceResolver.Initialize(new FormulaContext(Workbook, this));
				tokenReferenceResolver.Evaluate();
				AreTokenReferencesResolved = true;
			}
		}

		internal static Formula CreateFormula(CellReferenceMode creationMode, FormulaType type)
		{
			if (type == FormulaType.ArrayFormula)
			{
				return new ArrayFormula((byte)creationMode);
			}
			return new Formula((byte)creationMode, type);
		}

		public static bool Equals(Formula formulaA, Formula formulaB, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			if (formulaA == null && formulaB == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((formulaA == null) ^ (formulaB == null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (formulaA == formulaB)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (formulaA.GetType() != formulaB.GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			FormulaStringGenerator formulaStringGenerator = FormulaStringGenerator.Initialize(new FormulaContext(formulaA, cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), ignoreWhitespace: true);
			EvaluationResult<string> evaluationResult = formulaStringGenerator.Evaluate();
			FormulaStringGenerator formulaStringGenerator2 = FormulaStringGenerator.Initialize(new FormulaContext(formulaB, cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), ignoreWhitespace: true);
			EvaluationResult<string> evaluationResult2 = formulaStringGenerator2.Evaluate();
			return string.Compare(evaluationResult.Result, evaluationResult2.Result, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0;
		}

			return TryParse(value, cellReferenceMode, FormulaType.Formula, fileFormat, culture, null, out formula, out exception);
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, FormulaType type, WorkbookFormat fileFormat, CultureInfo culture, List<WorkbookReferenceBase> indexedReferencesDuringLoad, out Formula formula, out FormulaParseException exception)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value", "The formula string cannot be null.");
			}
			if (!Utilities.IsCellReferenceModeDefined(cellReferenceMode))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("cellReferenceMode", (int)cellReferenceMode, typeof(CellReferenceMode));
			}
			if (!Utilities.IsWorkbookFormatDefined(fileFormat))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("fileFormat", (int)fileFormat, typeof(WorkbookFormat));
			}
			try
			{
				formula = FormulaParser.ParseFormula(value, cellReferenceMode, type, fileFormat, culture, indexedReferencesDuringLoad, out exception);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				exception = new FormulaParseException(ex.Message, ex);
				formula = null;
			}
			return formula != null;
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string value, FormulaType type, FormulaContext context, List<WorkbookReferenceBase> indexedReferencesDuringLoad, out Formula formula, out FormulaParseException exception)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value", "The formula string cannot be null.");
			}
			formula = FormulaParser.ParseFormula(value, type, context, indexedReferencesDuringLoad, out exception);
			return formula != null;
		}

		internal void ClearCache()
		{
			argumentInfo = null;
		}

		private bool GetFlag(InternalFlags flag)
		{
			return (flags & flag) == flag;
		}

		private bool ModifyTokens(FormulaTokenModifierVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitAll();
			if (visitor.IsFormulaModified)
			{
				OnTokensModified();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnTokensModified()
		{
			ClearCache();
			RecompileFormulas();
		}

		private void RecompileFormulas()
		{
			if (appliedFormulas != null)
			{
				List<AppliedFormula> oldCompiledFormulas = new List<AppliedFormula>(appliedFormulas);
				RecompileFormulasHelper(oldCompiledFormulas);
			}
		}

		private void RecompileFormulasHelper(List<AppliedFormula> oldCompiledFormulas)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < oldCompiledFormulas.Count; i++)
			{
				AppliedFormula appliedFormula = oldCompiledFormulas[i];
				appliedFormula.TargetReference?.SetAndCompileFormula(this, canClearPreviouslyCalculatedValue: false, forceSet: true, shouldRemoveCompiledFormulas: true);
			}
		}

		private void SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				flags &= (InternalFlags)(byte)(~(int)flag);
			}
		}

		internal string ToStringHelper(CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (postfixTokenList.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(this, cellReferenceMode, culture);
			FormulaStringGenerator formulaStringGenerator = FormulaStringGenerator.Initialize(context);
			return formulaStringGenerator.Evaluate().Result;
		}
	}
}

	internal abstract class FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult>
	{
		private FormulaContext _context;

		protected ushort _currentTokenIndex;

		private bool _hasError;

		public FormulaContext Context
		{
			get
			{
				return _context;
			}
			protected set
			{
				_context = value;
			}
		}

		protected bool HasError => _hasError;

		protected virtual FormulaToken[] PostfixTokenList => _context.Formula.PostfixTokenList;

		public virtual TResult DefaultVisit(FormulaToken token)
		{
			return default(TResult);
		}

		protected void OnError()
		{
			_hasError = true;
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			_context = null;
			_hasError = false;
		}

		public bool VisitAll()
		{
			ushort? tokenWithErrorIndex;
			bool result = VisitAllHelper(out tokenWithErrorIndex);
			Reset();
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual bool VisitAllHelper(out ushort? tokenWithErrorIndex)
		{
			tokenWithErrorIndex = null;
			FormulaToken[] postfixTokenList = PostfixTokenList;
			ushort num = (ushort)postfixTokenList.Length;
			ushort num2;
			for (num2 = 0; num2 < num; num2++)
			{
				_currentTokenIndex = num2;
				postfixTokenList[num2].Accept(this);
				num2 = _currentTokenIndex;
				if (_hasError)
				{
					tokenWithErrorIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

	internal abstract class FormulaTokenModifierVisitor : FormulaTokenVisitor<bool>
	{
		private FormulaToken _currentReplacementToken;

		private bool _isFormulaModified;

		protected FormulaToken CurrentReplacementToken
		{
			get
			{
				return _currentReplacementToken;
			}
			set
			{
				_currentReplacementToken = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsFormulaModified => _isFormulaModified;

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_currentReplacementToken = null;
			base.Reset();
		}

		protected override bool VisitAllHelper(out ushort? tokenWithErrorIndex)
		{
			_isFormulaModified = false;
			tokenWithErrorIndex = null;
			FormulaToken[] postfixTokenList = PostfixTokenList;
			int num = postfixTokenList.Length;
			for (_currentTokenIndex = 0; _currentTokenIndex < num; _currentTokenIndex++)
			{
				if (postfixTokenList[_currentTokenIndex].Accept(this))
				{
					_isFormulaModified = true;
				}
				if (_currentReplacementToken != null)
				{
					_isFormulaModified = true;
					postfixTokenList[_currentTokenIndex] = _currentReplacementToken;
					_currentReplacementToken = null;
				}
				if (base.HasError)
				{
					tokenWithErrorIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class FormulaTokenEvaluator<TStackItem> : FormulaTokenVisitor<bool>
	{
		protected readonly Stack<TStackItem> _stack;

		public Stack<TStackItem> Stack => _stack;

		protected FormulaTokenEvaluator()
		{
			_stack = new Stack<TStackItem>();
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_stack.Clear();
			base.Reset();
		}

		public sealed override bool VisitBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token)
		{
			return VisitBinaryOperatorTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public sealed override bool VisitCellReferenceToken(CellReferenceToken token)
		{
			return VisitOperandTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public sealed override bool VisitFunctionOperator(FunctionOperator token)
		{
			return VisitFunctionTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public sealed override bool VisitFunctionToken(IFunctionToken token)
		{
			return VisitFunctionTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public sealed override bool VisitFunctionVOperator(FunctionVOperator token)
		{
			return VisitFunctionTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public sealed override bool VisitOperandToken(OperandToken token)
		{
			return VisitOperandTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public sealed override bool VisitParenToken(ParenToken token)
		{
			return VisitParenTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public sealed override bool VisitRef3DToken(Ref3DToken token)
		{
			return VisitOperandTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public sealed override bool VisitReferenceToken(ReferenceToken token)
		{
			return VisitOperandTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public sealed override bool VisitRefToken(RefToken token)
		{
			return VisitOperandTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public sealed override bool VisitUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token)
		{
			return VisitUnaryOperatorTokenHelper(token);
		}

		protected virtual TStackItem CreateFunctionNameStackItem(IFunctionToken token, string functionName)
		{
			return default(TStackItem);
		}

		public virtual EvaluationResult<TStackItem> Evaluate()
		{
			return Evaluate(shouldResetAfterEvaluation: true);
		}

		public EvaluationResult<TStackItem> Evaluate(bool shouldResetAfterEvaluation)
		{
			try
			{
				_stack.Clear();
				if (!VisitAllHelper(out var tokenWithErrorIndex))
				{
					return new EvaluationResult<TStackItem>(tokenWithErrorIndex);
				}
				if (_stack.Count != 1)
				{
					return new EvaluationResult<TStackItem>(null);
				}
				return new EvaluationResult<TStackItem>(_stack.Pop());
			}
			finally
			{
				if (shouldResetAfterEvaluation)
				{
					Reset();
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract TStackItem EvaluateBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token, TStackItem firstOperand, TStackItem secondOperand);

		protected abstract TStackItem EvaluateFunctionToken(IFunctionToken token, TStackItem functionName, TStackItem[] arguments);

		protected abstract TStackItem EvaluateOperandToken(OperandToken token);

		protected abstract TStackItem EvaluateParenToken(ParenToken token, TStackItem contents);

		protected abstract TStackItem EvaluateUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token, TStackItem operand);

		private bool VisitBinaryOperatorTokenHelper(BinaryOperatorToken token)
		{
			if (_stack.Count < 2)
			{
				OnError();
				return false;
			}
			TStackItem secondOperand = _stack.Pop();
			TStackItem firstOperand = _stack.Pop();
			TStackItem item = EvaluateBinaryOperatorToken(token, firstOperand, secondOperand);
			_stack.Push(item);
			return true;
		}

		private bool VisitFunctionTokenHelper(IFunctionToken token)
		{
			TStackItem[] array = new TStackItem[token.ArgumentCount];
			for (int num = array.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				array[num] = _stack.Pop();
			}
			Function function = token.Function;
			if (function == null)
			{
				OnError();
				return false;
			}
			TStackItem functionName = ((!function.IsAddIn) ? CreateFunctionNameStackItem(token, function.Name) : _stack.Pop());
			TStackItem item = EvaluateFunctionToken(token, functionName, array);
			_stack.Push(item);
			return true;
		}

		private bool VisitOperandTokenHelper(OperandToken token)
		{
			TStackItem item = EvaluateOperandToken(token);
			_stack.Push(item);
			return true;
		}

		private bool VisitParenTokenHelper(ParenToken token)
		{
			if (_stack.Count < 1)
			{
				OnError();
				return false;
			}
			TStackItem item = EvaluateParenToken(token, _stack.Pop());
			_stack.Push(item);
			return true;
		}

		private bool VisitUnaryOperatorTokenHelper(UnaryOperatorToken token)
		{
			if (_stack.Count < 1)
			{
				OnError();
				return false;
			}
			TStackItem item = EvaluateUnaryOperatorToken(token, _stack.Pop());
			_stack.Push(item);
			return true;
		}
	}
}

	public interface IWorkbookFont
	{

		ExcelDefaultableBoolean Bold { get; set; }

		WorkbookColorInfo ColorInfo { get; set; }

		int Height { get; set; }

		ExcelDefaultableBoolean Italic { get; set; }

		string Name { get; set; }

		ExcelDefaultableBoolean Strikeout { get; set; }

		FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle SuperscriptSubscriptStyle { get; set; }

		FontUnderlineStyle UnderlineStyle { get; set; }

	}
	public abstract class FormattedFontBase : IWorkbookFont
	{
		private readonly IFormattedItem formattedItem;

		private readonly int startIndex;

		private readonly int length;

		[Obsolete("The FormattedFontBase.Color is deprecated. It has been replaced by FormattedFontBase.ColorInfo.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo = ColorInfo;
				if (colorInfo == null)
				{
					return ColorsInternal.Empty;
				}
				return colorInfo.GetResolvedColor(formattedItem.Workbook);
			}
			set
			{
				value = Utilities.RemoveAlphaChannel(value);
				ColorInfo = Utilities.ToColorInfo(value);
			}
		}

		public ExcelDefaultableBoolean Bold
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFontProperty((IWorkbookFont f) => f.Bold, ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default);
			}
			set
			{
				Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(value);
				SetFontProperty(value, ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default, delegate(IWorkbookFont f, ExcelDefaultableBoolean v)
				{
					f.Bold = v;
				});
			}
		}

		public WorkbookColorInfo ColorInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFontProperty((IWorkbookFont f) => f.ColorInfo, null);
			}
			set
			{
				SetFontProperty(value, null, delegate(IWorkbookFont f, WorkbookColorInfo v)
				{
					f.ColorInfo = v;
				});
			}
		}

		public int Height
		{
			get
			{

		internal FormattedFontBase(IFormattedItem formattedItem, int startIndex, int length)

			this.length = length;
		}

		public void SetFontFormatting(IWorkbookFont source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_SourceFont"));
			}
			Name = source.Name;
			Height = source.Height;
			ColorInfo = source.ColorInfo;
			Bold = source.Bold;
			Italic = source.Italic;
			Strikeout = source.Strikeout;
			SuperscriptSubscriptStyle = source.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle;
			UnderlineStyle = source.UnderlineStyle;
		}

		internal virtual void AfterSet()
		{
			formattedItem.OnFormattingChanged();
		}

		internal virtual void BeforeSet()
		{
		}

		internal virtual IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver GetFontDefaultsResolver(Workbook workbook)
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal abstract void GetRunsInRange(Workbook workbook, List<FormattingRunBase> runs, int firstCharacterAfterFont, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver fontDefaultsResolver, out FormattingRunBase lastRunEnumerated);

		internal void GetRunsFromOwnerInRange(IFormattedRunOwner owner, Workbook workbook, List<FormattingRunBase> runs, int firstCharacterAfterFont, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver fontDefaultsResolver, ref FormattingRunBase lastRunEnumerated)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(owner.StartIndex, startIndex);
			List<FormattingRunBase> formattingRuns = owner.GetFormattingRuns(workbook);
			for (int i = 0; i < formattingRuns.Count; i++)
			{
				FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase = formattingRuns[i];
				try
				{
					if (formattingRunBase.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute < num)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (runs.Count == 0 && num < formattingRunBase.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute)
					{
						FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase2 = owner.CreateRun(num);
						if (lastRunEnumerated != null)
						{
							formattingRunBase2.InitializeFrom(lastRunEnumerated, workbook);
						}
						else
						{
							fontDefaultsResolver?.ResolveDefaults(formattingRunBase2.GetFontInternal(workbook).Element);
						}
						owner.InsertRun(i, formattingRunBase2);
						formattingRunBase = formattingRunBase2;
					}
					if (firstCharacterAfterFont <= formattingRunBase.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute)
					{
						break;
					}
					runs.Add(formattingRunBase);
				}
				finally
				{
					lastRunEnumerated = formattingRunBase;
				}
			}
		}

		internal FormattingRunBase TryGetFirstRunControllingCharacter(List<FormattingRunBase> formattingRuns, int index)
		{
			for (int num = formattingRuns.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase = formattingRuns[num];
				if (formattingRunBase.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute <= index)
				{
					return formattingRunBase;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private List<FormattingRunBase> GetControlledRuns(IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver fontDefaultsResolver)
		{
			Workbook workbook = formattedItem.Workbook;
			List<FormattingRunBase> list = new List<FormattingRunBase>();
			string text = formattedItem.ToString();
			int num = ((Length != 0) ? (StartIndex + Length) : text.Length);
			GetRunsInRange(workbook, list, num, fontDefaultsResolver, out var lastRunEnumerated);
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				IFormattedRunOwner ownerAt = formattedItem.GetOwnerAt(startIndex);
				if (ownerAt != null)
				{
					FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase = ownerAt.CreateRun(startIndex);
					if (lastRunEnumerated != null)
					{
						formattingRunBase.InitializeFrom(lastRunEnumerated, workbook);
					}
					else
					{
						fontDefaultsResolver?.ResolveDefaults(formattingRunBase.GetFontInternal(workbook).Element);
					}
					list.Add(formattingRunBase);
					ownerAt.AddRun(formattingRunBase);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 0 && num < text.Length)
			{
				IFormattedRunOwner ownerAt2 = formattedItem.GetOwnerAt(num);
				if (ownerAt2 != null)
				{
					List<FormattingRunBase> formattingRuns = ownerAt2.GetFormattingRuns(workbook);
					FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase2 = TryGetFirstRunControllingCharacter(formattingRuns, num);
					if (formattingRunBase2 == null || formattingRunBase2.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute < num)
					{
						FormattingRunBase otherRun = list[list.Count - 1];
						FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase3 = ownerAt2.CreateRun(num);
						formattingRunBase3.InitializeFrom(otherRun, workbook);
						int runIndex = 0;
						if (formattingRunBase2 != null)
						{
							runIndex = formattingRuns.IndexOf(formattingRunBase2) + 1;
						}
						ownerAt2.InsertRun(runIndex, formattingRunBase3);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private TValue GetFontProperty<TValue>(Func<IWorkbookFont, TValue> propertyGetter, TValue defaultValue)
		{
			VerifyState();
			FormattingRunBase startingRun = StartingRun;
			if (startingRun != null)
			{
				return propertyGetter(startingRun.GetFont(FormattedItem.Workbook));
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private void SetFontProperty<TValue>(TValue value, TValue defaultValue, Action<IWorkbookFont, TValue> propertySetter)
		{
			if (!AllowDefaultValues && object.Equals(value, defaultValue))
			{
				return;
			}
			VerifyState();
			BeforeSet();
			Workbook workbook = formattedItem.Workbook;
			IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver fontDefaultsResolver = GetFontDefaultsResolver(workbook);
			foreach (FormattingRunBase controlledRun in GetControlledRuns(fontDefaultsResolver))
			{
				if (controlledRun != null)
				{
					propertySetter(controlledRun.GetFont(workbook), value);
				}
			}
			AfterSet();
		}

		private void VerifyState()
		{
			if (formattedItem.Owner == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_FormattedStringNotOwned"));
			}
			int num = startIndex;
			if (0 < length)
			{
				num += length;
			}
			if (formattedItem.ToString().Length < num)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidCharacterRange"));
			}
		}
	}

		public bool Hidden
		{
			get
			{
				return HiddenInternal;
			}

			{
				VerifyIsValid();
				if (Hidden != value)
				{
					SetHidden(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract int Index { get; }

		public int OutlineLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return OutlineLevelInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyIsValid();
				if (OutlineLevel != value)
				{
					if (value < 0 || 7 < value)
					{
						throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LER_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_OutlineLevel"));
					}
					OutlineLevelInternal = (byte)value;
				}
			}
		}

		public Worksheet Worksheet => worksheet;

		internal WorksheetCellFormatProxy CellFormatInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (cellFormat == null && worksheet != null)
				{
					Workbook workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
					GenericCachedCollectionEx<WorksheetCellFormatData> cellFormatCollection = null;
					if (workbook != null)
					{
						cellFormatCollection = workbook.CellFormats;
					}
					cellFormat = CreateCellFormatProxy(cellFormatCollection);
				}
				return cellFormat;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool HasDataIgnoreHidden
		{
			get
			{
				if (OutlineLevel != 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (HasCellFormat && !CellFormatInternal.IsEmpty)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		{
			if (Hidden != value)
			{
				WorksheetElementResizeContext worksheetElementResizeContext = null;
				if (notifyShapes && Worksheet.DoesNeedElementResizeNotification)
				{

				}
				HiddenInternal = value;
				OnHiddenChanged();
				worksheetElementResizeContext?.Close();
			}
		}

		{
		}
