		private class OleLinkInfoComparer : IEqualityComparer<ValueTuple<string, Uri>>
		{
			public static readonly OleLinkInfoComparer Instance = new OleLinkInfoComparer();

			private OleLinkInfoComparer()
			{
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<ValueTuple<string, Uri>>.Equals(ValueTuple<string, Uri> x, ValueTuple<string, Uri> y)
			{
				if (StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(x.Item1, y.Item1))
				{
					return x.Item2 == y.Item2;
				}
				return false;
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<ValueTuple<string, Uri>>.GetHashCode(ValueTuple<string, Uri> obj)
			{
				return StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.GetHashCode(obj.Item1) ^ (obj.Item2.GetHashCode() << 3);
			}
		}

				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CalculationMode), value))
				{
					throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(CalculationMode));
				}
				switch (value)
				{
				case CalculationMode.Manual:
					Recalculate(includeNonDirtyFormulas: false, calculationMode == CalculationMode.Automatic);
					break;
				case CalculationMode.AutomaticExceptForDataTables:
					if (calculationMode == CalculationMode.Automatic)
					{
						Recalculate();
					}
					break;
				}
				calculationMode = value;
			}
		}

		public SizeF ScreenDpi
		{
			get
			{
				return _screenDpi;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_screenDpi == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!value.IsEmpty && (!IsDpiValueValid(value.Height) || !IsDpiValueValid(value.Width) || (value.Height > 0f && value.Width == 0f) || (value.Height == 0f && value.Width > 0f)))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidDpi"));
				}
				_screenDpi = value;
				ResetZeroCharacterWidth();
				foreach (Worksheet item in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)Worksheets)
				{
					item.OnScreenDpiChanged();
				}
			}
		}

					if (cachedStructuredStorageFile.Key.EndsWith(value))

		internal int ZeroCharacterWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (zeroCharacterWidth == 0)
				{
					try
					{
						using TextMetricsProviderBase textMetricsProviderBase = CreateDefaultTextMetricsProvider(this);
						WorksheetCellFormatData styleFormatInternal = Styles.NormalStyle.StyleFormatInternal;
						Size size = textMetricsProviderBase.MeasureText(styleFormatInternal, "0", null, scaleForDpi: false);
						if (ZeroCharacterWidthCorrections.TryGetValue(styleFormatInternal.FontNameResolved, out var value))
						{
							float key = (float)((double)styleFormatInternal.FontHeightResolved / 20.0);
							if (value.TryGetValue(key, out var value2))
							{
								if (value2)
								{
									size.Width++;
								}
								else
								{
									size.Width--;
								}
							}
						}
						textMetricsProviderBase.ScaleForDpi(ref size);
						zeroCharacterWidth = size.Width;
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						zeroCharacterWidth = 7;
					}
				}
				return zeroCharacterWidth;
			}
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, SortedList<float, bool>> ZeroCharacterWidthCorrections
		{
			get
			{
				if (zeroCharacterWidthCorrections == null)
				{
					zeroCharacterWidthCorrections = new Dictionary<string, SortedList<float, bool>>(StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
					SortedList<float, bool> sortedList = new SortedList<float, bool>();
					sortedList[1f] = true;
					sortedList[3f] = true;
					sortedList[6f] = true;
					sortedList[7f] = false;
					sortedList[10f] = false;
					sortedList[13f] = false;
					sortedList[22f] = false;
					sortedList[25f] = false;
					sortedList[34f] = false;
					sortedList[37f] = false;
					sortedList[40f] = false;
					sortedList[49f] = false;
					zeroCharacterWidthCorrections["Arial"] = sortedList;
					sortedList = new SortedList<float, bool>();
					sortedList[1f] = true;
					sortedList[3f] = true;
					sortedList[6f] = true;
					if (ProcessDpi.Width == 120f)
					{
						sortedList[11f] = false;
						sortedList[17f] = false;
						sortedList[23f] = false;
					}
					zeroCharacterWidthCorrections["Calibri"] = sortedList;
					sortedList = new SortedList<float, bool>();
					sortedList[1f] = true;
					sortedList[3f] = true;
					sortedList[4f] = false;
					sortedList[7f] = false;
					sortedList[13f] = false;
					sortedList[19f] = false;
					sortedList[22f] = false;
					sortedList[28f] = false;
					sortedList[34f] = false;
					sortedList[37f] = false;
					sortedList[43f] = false;
					sortedList[49f] = false;
					zeroCharacterWidthCorrections["Courier New"] = sortedList;
					sortedList = new SortedList<float, bool>();
					sortedList[1f] = true;
					sortedList[3f] = true;
					sortedList[6f] = true;
					sortedList[10f] = false;
					sortedList[19f] = false;
					sortedList[22f] = false;
					zeroCharacterWidthCorrections["Times New Roman"] = sortedList;
					sortedList = new SortedList<float, bool>();
					sortedList[1f] = true;
					sortedList[3f] = true;
					sortedList[6f] = true;
					sortedList[10f] = false;
					sortedList[13f] = false;
					sortedList[16f] = false;
					sortedList[25f] = false;
					sortedList[28f] = false;
					sortedList[31f] = false;
					sortedList[43f] = false;
					sortedList[46f] = false;
					sortedList[49f] = false;
					zeroCharacterWidthCorrections["Tahoma"] = sortedList;
					sortedList = new SortedList<float, bool>();
					sortedList[1f] = true;
					sortedList[3f] = true;
					sortedList[6f] = true;
					zeroCharacterWidthCorrections["MS PGothic"] = sortedList;
					zeroCharacterWidthCorrections[UnicodeStrings.MSPGothicJPName] = sortedList;
				}
				return zeroCharacterWidthCorrections;
			}
		}

		{
			SetFileWriteProtectionPasswordHelper(password, null, userName, shouldUpdateUserName: true);
		}

		private void SetFileWriteProtectionPasswordHelper(string password, SecureString passwordSecure, string userName, bool shouldUpdateUserName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
			{
				password = null;
			}
			_fileWriteProtectionPasswordSecure = passwordSecure;
			_fileWriteProtectionPassword = password;
			PendingFileWriteProtectionValidationInfo = null;
			if (shouldUpdateUserName)
			{
				UpdateFileWriteProtectedBy(userName);
			}
		}

		public void SetFileWriteProtectionPassword(SecureString password, string userName = null)
		{
			SetFileWriteProtectionPasswordHelper(null, password, userName, shouldUpdateUserName: true);
		}

		public void SetOpenPassword(string password)
		{
			_openPasswordSecure = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
			{
				password = null;
			}
			_openPassword = password;
		}

		public void SetOpenPassword(SecureString password)
		{
			_openPassword = null;
			_openPasswordSecure = password;
		}

			throw new EncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException();
		}

		private void UpdateFileWriteProtectedBy(string userName)
		{
			if (HasFileWriteProtectionPassword)
			{
				if (userName == null)
				{
					userName = Environment.UserName;
				}
				FileWriteProtectedBy = userName;
			}
			else
			{
				FileWriteProtectedBy = null;
			}
		}

		public bool ValidateFileWriteProtectionPassword(string password)
		{
			return ValidateFileWriteProtectionPasswordHelper(password);
		}

		public bool ValidateFileWriteProtectionPassword(SecureString password)
		{
			string password2 = null;
			if (password != null)
			{
				password2 = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(Utilities.ExtractSecureStringUnicode(password, throwOnError: true));
			}
			return ValidateFileWriteProtectionPasswordHelper(password2, password);
		}

		private bool ValidateFileWriteProtectionPasswordHelper(string password, SecureString sourceSecureString = null)
		{
			if (PendingFileWriteProtectionValidationInfo != null)
			{
				if (password == null || !PendingFileWriteProtectionValidationInfo.ValidatePassword(Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(password)))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (sourceSecureString != null)
				{
					SetFileWriteProtectionPasswordHelper(null, sourceSecureString, null, shouldUpdateUserName: false);
					return true;
				}
				SetFileWriteProtectionPasswordHelper(password, null, null, shouldUpdateUserName: false);
				return true;
			}
			if (HasFileWriteProtectionPassword)
			{
				return password == Encoding.Unicode.GetString(GetFileWriteProtectionPasswordUnicode());
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Workbook(WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(WorkbookFormat), format))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("format", (int)format, typeof(WorkbookFormat));
			}
			calcEngine = new ExcelCalcEngine(this);
			currentFormat = format;
			WorkbookFontData defaultElement = new WorkbookFontData(this);
			fonts = new GenericCachedCollectionEx<WorkbookFontData>(defaultElement, this, 512);
			palette = new WorkbookColorPalette(this);
			sharedStringTable = new SharedStringTable(this);
			cellFormats = new WorksheetCellFormatCollection(new WorksheetCellFormatData(this, WorksheetCellFormatType.CellFormat)
			{
				Style = Styles.NormalStyle
			}, this);
			_formatLimitErrors = new FormatLimitErrors(this);
			_protection = new WorkbookProtection(this);
			Preferred2003EncryptionMode = (InPlaceTransformEncryptionMode)2;
			Preferred2007EncryptionMode = (OleDataSpacesEncryptionMode)(format == WorkbookFormat.StrictOpenXml);
		}

		internal void Recalculate(bool includeNonDirtyFormulas, bool shouldCalculateDataTables)
		{
			if (!IsLoading)
			{

			}
		}

		public void ResumeCalculations()
		{
			if (calculationSuspensionCount > 0)
			{
				calculationSuspensionCount--;
			}
			if (calculationSuspensionCount == 0 && namedReferenceConnectionPending)
			{
				IterateFormulas(delegate(Worksheet ws, Formula f)
				{
					f.ReconnectReferences(this);
				});
				namedReferenceConnectionPending = false;
			}
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, WorkbookSaveOptions saveOptions = null)
		{
			saveOptions = saveOptions ?? new WorkbookSaveOptions();
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_SaveStream"));
			}
			if (!stream.CanSeek)
			{
				using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
				{
					Save(memoryStream, saveOptions);
					byte[] buffer = memoryStream.GetBuffer();
					stream.Write(buffer, 0, (int)memoryStream.Length);
					return;
				}
			}
			VerifyBeforeSave(saveOptions);
			WorkItemScheduler.Synchronous().Execute(SaveHelper(stream, saveOptions));
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, IPackageFactory packageFactory)
		{
			Save(stream, new WorkbookSaveOptions
			{
				PackageFactory = packageFactory
			});
		}

		public void SetCurrentFormat(WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			if (currentFormat != format)
			{
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(WorkbookFormat), format))
				{
					throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("format", (int)format, typeof(WorkbookFormat));
				}
				FormatLimitErrors formatLimitErrors = InitializeFormatLimitErrors();
				VerifyFormatLimits(formatLimitErrors, format);
				if (formatLimitErrors.HasErrors)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_WorkbookDataViolatesFormatLimits"));
				}
				UpdateCellFormatLimit(format);
				WorkbookFormat oldFormat = currentFormat;
				SetCurrentFormatInternal(format);
				OnCurrentFormatChanged(oldFormat);
			}
		}

		public static WorkbookFormat? GetWorkbookFormat(string fileName)
		{
			return Path.GetExtension(fileName).ToLower() switch
			{
				".xls" => WorkbookFormat.Excel97To2003, 
				".xlt" => WorkbookFormat.Excel97To2003Template, 
				".xlsx" => WorkbookFormat.Excel2007, 
				".xlsm" => WorkbookFormat.Excel2007MacroEnabled, 
				".xltm" => WorkbookFormat.Excel2007MacroEnabledTemplate, 
				".xltx" => WorkbookFormat.Excel2007Template, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public static bool IsWorkbookEncrypted(Stream stream)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Utilities.VerifyNotNull((object)stream, "stream");
			long position = stream.Position;
			try
			{
				if (!StructuredStorageManager.IsStructuredStorageStream(stream))
				{
					return false;
				}
				StructuredStorageManager val = new StructuredStorageManager(stream, true);
				try
				{
					if (OleDataSpaces.IsEncrypted(val))
					{
						return true;
					}
					using Stream biff8WorkbookStream = val.GetFileStream("Workbook");
					if (WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003.IsWorkbookEncrypted(biff8WorkbookStream))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				if (stream.CanSeek)
				{
					stream.Position = position;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal Formula GetTotalFormula(WorksheetTableColumn column, ST_TotalsRowFunction totalsRowFunction)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			int num;
			switch ((int)totalsRowFunction)
			{
			case 0:
			case 9:
				return null;
			case 1:
				num = 101;
				break;
			case 3:
				num = 102;
				break;
			case 2:
				num = 103;
				break;
			case 4:
				num = 104;
				break;
			case 5:
				num = 105;
				break;
			case 7:
				num = 107;
				break;
			case 6:
				num = 109;
				break;
			case 8:
				num = 110;
				break;
			default:
				return null;
			}
			if (Utilities.Is2003Format(CurrentFormat))
			{
				WorksheetTable table = column.Table;
				if (table == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				table.GetDataAreaRowIndexes(out var dataAreaTopRowIndex, out var dataAreaBottomRowIndex);
				string arg = new CellAddressRange(new CellAddress(dataAreaTopRowIndex, rowAddressIsRelative: true, column.WorksheetColumnIndex, columnAddressIsRelative: true), new CellAddress(dataAreaBottomRowIndex, rowAddressIsRelative: true, column.WorksheetColumnIndex, columnAddressIsRelative: true)).ToString(dataAreaBottomRowIndex + 1, column.WorksheetColumnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets: false, CellReferenceMode, CurrentFormat);
				return Formula.Parse($"=SUBTOTAL({num},{arg})", CellReferenceMode, CurrentFormat, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			return Formula.Parse($"=SUBTOTAL({num},[{column.Name}])", CellReferenceMode, CurrentFormat, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		internal ST_TotalsRowFunction GetTotalRowFunction(WorksheetTableColumn column)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Formula totalFormula = column.TotalFormula;
			if (totalFormula == null)
			{
				return (ST_TotalsRowFunction)0;
			}
			ST_TotalsRowFunction? totalRowFunctionHelper = GetTotalRowFunctionHelper(column, totalFormula);
			if (totalRowFunctionHelper.HasValue)
			{
				return totalRowFunctionHelper.Value;
			}
			return (ST_TotalsRowFunction)9;
		}

		private ST_TotalsRowFunction? GetTotalRowFunctionHelper(WorksheetTableColumn column, Formula formula)
		{
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (formula.PostfixTokenList.Length != 3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(formula.PostfixTokenList[0] is IntToken intToken))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ST_TotalsRowFunction value;
			switch (intToken.Value)
			{
			case 101:
				value = (ST_TotalsRowFunction)1;
				break;
			case 102:
				value = (ST_TotalsRowFunction)3;
				break;
			case 103:
				value = (ST_TotalsRowFunction)2;
				break;
			case 104:
				value = (ST_TotalsRowFunction)4;
				break;
			case 105:
				value = (ST_TotalsRowFunction)5;
				break;
			case 107:
				value = (ST_TotalsRowFunction)7;
				break;
			case 109:
				value = (ST_TotalsRowFunction)6;
				break;
			case 110:
				value = (ST_TotalsRowFunction)8;
				break;
			default:
				return null;
			}
			if (formula.PostfixTokenList[1] is AreaToken areaToken)
			{
				WorksheetTable table = column.Table;
				WorksheetRegion targetRegion = areaToken.CellAddressRange.GetTargetRegion(table.Worksheet, table.DataAreaRegion.LastRow + 1, column.WorksheetColumnIndex, areaToken.AreRelativeAddressesOffsets);
				if (targetRegion == null || !column.DataAreaRegion.Equals(targetRegion))
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			else if (!Utilities.Is2003Format(CurrentFormat))
			{
				CultureInfo cultureResolved = CultureResolved;
				if (!(formula.PostfixTokenList[1] is StructuredTableReference structuredTableReference) || StringUtilities.StringCompare(structuredTableReference.SimpleColumnName, column.Name, cultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) != 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (structuredTableReference.TableName != null && StringUtilities.StringCompare(structuredTableReference.TableName, column.Table.Name, cultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) != 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (!(formula.PostfixTokenList[2] is FunctionVOperator functionVOperator) || functionVOperator.Function != Function.SUBTOTAL)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal static double GetTwipsPerPixel(Workbook workbook, bool vertical)
		{
			return 1440.0 / GetScreenDpi(workbook, vertical);
		}

		internal static void GetWorkbookOptions(Workbook workbook, out CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, out WorkbookFormat currentFormat, out CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				cellReferenceMode = CellReferenceMode.A1;
				currentFormat = WorkbookFormat.Excel2007;
				culture = Utilities.CurrentCulture;
			}
			else
			{
				cellReferenceMode = workbook.CellReferenceMode;
				currentFormat = workbook.CurrentFormat;
				culture = workbook.CultureResolved;
			}
		}

		internal WorkbookReferenceBase GetWorkbookReference(string workbookFilePath)
		{
			if (workbookFilePath == null || workbookFilePath == LoadingPath)
			{
				return CurrentWorkbookReference;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(LoadingPath))
			{
				try
				{
					string fileName = Path.GetFileName(workbookFilePath);
					string fileName2 = Path.GetFileName(LoadingPath);
					if (string.Equals(fileName, fileName2, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						Uri uri = new Uri(workbookFilePath, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
						if (!uri.IsAbsoluteUri)
						{
							uri = new Uri(Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(LoadingPath), workbookFilePath));
						}
						if (uri.IsFile)
						{
							string fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(uri.AbsolutePath);
							if (string.Equals(fullPath, LoadingPath, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
							{
								return CurrentWorkbookReference;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (workbookFilePath == "<AddInFunctions>")
			{
				return AddInFunctionsWorkbookReference;
			}
			if (externalWorkbooks == null)
			{
				externalWorkbooks = new Dictionary<string, WorkbookReferenceBase>(StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			if (!externalWorkbooks.TryGetValue(workbookFilePath, out var value))
			{
				value = new ExternalWorkbookReference(workbookFilePath, this);
				externalWorkbooks.Add(workbookFilePath, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal OleLinkWorkbookReference GetWorkbookReference(string progId, Uri objectLink)
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (externalWorkbooks == null)
			{
				externalWorkbooks = new Dictionary<string, WorkbookReferenceBase>(StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			}
			if (_oleLinkReferences == null)
			{
				_oleLinkReferences = new Dictionary<ValueTuple<string, Uri>, OleLinkWorkbookReference>(OleLinkInfoComparer.Instance);
			}
			ValueTuple<string, Uri> key = ValueTuple.Create<string, Uri>(progId, objectLink);
			if (!_oleLinkReferences.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				value = new OleLinkWorkbookReference(key.Item1, key.Item2, this);
				_oleLinkReferences.Add(key, value);
				externalWorkbooks[value.FileName] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal void IterateFormulas(Action<Worksheet, Formula> callback, IEnumerable<NamedReferenceBase> namedReferences, IList<Worksheet> worksheets)
		{
			foreach (NamedReference namedReference in namedReferences)
			{
				if (namedReference.FormulaInternal != null)
				{
					callback(null, namedReference.FormulaInternal);
				}
			}
			IterateFormulasHelper(callback, worksheets);
		}

		private void IterateFormulasHelper(Action<Worksheet, Formula> callback, IList<Worksheet> worksheets)
		{
			foreach (Worksheet worksheet in worksheets)
			{
				if (worksheet.HasDataValidationRules)
				{
					foreach (DataValidationRule key in ((IDictionary<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>)worksheet.DataValidationRules).Keys)
					{
						Formula formula = key.GetFormula1(null);
						Formula formula2 = key.GetFormula2(null);
						if (formula != null)
						{
							callback(worksheet, formula);
						}
						if (formula2 != null)
						{
							callback(worksheet, formula2);
						}
					}
				}
				if (worksheet.HasConditionalFormattingRoundTripData)
				{
					using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream();
					using WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 workbookSaveManagerExcel = new WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007(this, stream, new WorkbookSaveOptions(), (ST_ConformanceClass)1);
					ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager documentManager = workbookSaveManagerExcel.DocumentManager;
					((OfficeDocumentManager)documentManager).Initialize();
					foreach (UnknownStructure conditionalFormattingRoundTripDatum in worksheet.ConditionalFormattingRoundTripData)
					{
						foreach (UnknownElementCache child in conditionalFormattingRoundTripDatum.RootElement.Children)
						{
							foreach (UnknownElementCache descendant in child.GetDescendants("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/formula", (OfficeDocumentManager)(object)documentManager))
							{
								if (descendant.RoundTripTag is Tuple<Formula, string> tuple)
								{
									callback(worksheet, tuple.Item1);
								}
							}
							foreach (UnknownElementCache descendant2 in child.GetDescendants("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/spreadsheetml/main/cfvo", (OfficeDocumentManager)(object)documentManager))
							{
								if (descendant2.RoundTripTag is Tuple<Formula, string> tuple2)
								{
									callback(worksheet, tuple2.Item1);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				IterateFormulas(worksheet, worksheet.Shapes, callback);
				List<CellCalcReference[]> list = new List<CellCalcReference[]>();
				foreach (WorksheetRow item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)worksheet.Rows)
				{
					if (!item.HasCellCalcReferences)
					{
						continue;
					}
					list.Clear();
					list.AddRange(item.CellCalcReferences.Values);
					for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
					{
						CellCalcReference[] array = list[i];
						foreach (CellCalcReference cellCalcReference in array)
						{
							if (cellCalcReference != null && cellCalcReference.IsPrimaryOwnerOfFormula)
							{
								Formula excelFormula = cellCalcReference.ExcelFormula;
								if (excelFormula != null)
								{
									callback(worksheet, excelFormula);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void IterateFormulas<T>(Worksheet worksheet, ICollection<T> shapes, Action<Worksheet, Formula> callback) where T : WorksheetShape
		{
			foreach (T shape in shapes)
			{
				if (shape is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
				{
					IterateFormulas(worksheet, worksheetShapeGroup.Shapes, callback);
				}
				if (shape is WorksheetChart { BraiFormulas: not null } worksheetChart)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < worksheetChart.BraiFormulas.Count; i++)
					{
						callback(worksheet, worksheetChart.BraiFormulas[i]);
					}
				}
				if (shape is UnknownShape { ShapeData2007: not null } unknownShape && unknownShape.ShapeData2007.FmlaMacro != null)
				{
					callback(worksheet, unknownShape.ShapeData2007.FmlaMacro);
				}
				if (shape.Obj == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (shape.Obj.Macro != null && shape.Obj.Macro.Fmla != null)
				{
					shape.Obj.Macro.Fmla.IterateFormulas(worksheet, callback);
				}
				if (shape.Obj.LinkFmla != null && shape.Obj.LinkFmla.Fmla != null)
				{
					shape.Obj.LinkFmla.Fmla.IterateFormulas(worksheet, callback);
				}
				if (shape.Obj.List != null && shape.Obj.List.Fmla != null)
				{
					shape.Obj.List.Fmla.IterateFormulas(worksheet, callback);
				}
				if (shape.Obj.PictFmla == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (shape.Obj.PictFmla.Fmla != null)
				{
					shape.Obj.PictFmla.Fmla.IterateFormulas(worksheet, callback);
				}
				if (shape.Obj.PictFmla.Key != null)
				{
					if (shape.Obj.PictFmla.Key.FmlaLinkedCell != null)
					{
						shape.Obj.PictFmla.Key.FmlaLinkedCell.IterateFormulas(worksheet, callback);
					}
					if (shape.Obj.PictFmla.Key.FmlaListFillRange != null)
					{
						shape.Obj.PictFmla.Key.FmlaListFillRange.IterateFormulas(worksheet, callback);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnStyleRemoved(WorkbookStyle style)
		{
			WorkbookStyle normalStyle = Styles.NormalStyle;
			List<WorksheetCellFormatData> list = new List<WorksheetCellFormatData>();
			foreach (WorksheetCellFormatData item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetCellFormatData>)CellFormats)
			{
				if (item.Style == style)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = list[i];
				WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData2 = worksheetCellFormatData.CloneInternal();
				worksheetCellFormatData2.Style = normalStyle;
				if (CellFormats.Find(worksheetCellFormatData2) != null)
				{
					flag = true;
					continue;
				}
				CellFormats.Remove(worksheetCellFormatData);
				worksheetCellFormatData.Style = normalStyle;
				CellFormats.AddDirect(worksheetCellFormatData);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Worksheet item2 in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)Worksheets)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetRow item3 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)item2.Rows)
				{
					if (item3.HasCellFormat && item3.CellFormat.Style == style)
					{
						item3.CellFormat.Style = normalStyle;
					}
					if (!item3.HasCellFormatsForCells)
					{
						continue;
					}
					WorksheetCellFormatBlock[] cellFormatsForCells = item3.CellFormatsForCells;
					for (int j = 0; j < cellFormatsForCells.Length; j++)
					{
						WorksheetCellFormatBlock worksheetCellFormatBlock = cellFormatsForCells[j];
						if (worksheetCellFormatBlock.CellFormats == null)
						{
							break;
						}
						for (int k = 0; k < worksheetCellFormatBlock.CellFormats.Length; k++)
						{
							WorksheetCellFormatData element = worksheetCellFormatBlock.CellFormats[k];
							if (element != null && element.Style == style)
							{
								GenericCacheElementEx.BeforeSetEx(ref element, willModifyElement: true);
								element.Style = normalStyle;
								GenericCacheElementEx.AfterSetEx(CellFormats, ref element);
								worksheetCellFormatBlock.CellFormats[k] = element;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock in item2.ColumnBlocks)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatData element2 = columnBlock.CellFormat;
					if (element2.Style == style)
					{
						GenericCacheElementEx.BeforeSetEx(ref element2, willModifyElement: true);
						element2.Style = normalStyle;
						GenericCacheElementEx.AfterSetEx(CellFormats, ref element2);
						columnBlock.CellFormat = element2;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnWorksheetRemoved(Worksheet worksheet, int oldIndex)
		{
			CurrentWorkbookReference.OnWorksheetRemoved(oldIndex);
			if (WindowOptions.SelectedWorksheet == worksheet)
			{
				if (Worksheets.Count > 0)
				{
					WindowOptions.SelectedWorksheet = Worksheets[0];
				}
				else
				{
					WindowOptions.SelectedWorksheet = null;
				}
			}
			if (HasNamedReferences)
			{
				HashSet<NamedReference> referencedNamesBeingRemoved = null;
				for (int num = NamedReferences.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					NamedReference namedReference = NamedReferences[num];
					if (namedReference.Scope == worksheet)
					{
						if (referencedNamesBeingRemoved == null)
						{
							referencedNamesBeingRemoved = new HashSet<NamedReference>();
							IterateFormulas(delegate(Worksheet ws, Formula f)
							{
								FormulaToken[] postfixTokenList = f.PostfixTokenList;
								foreach (FormulaToken formulaToken in postfixTokenList)
								{
									if (formulaToken is NameToken { NamedReference: NamedReference namedReference2 } && namedReference2.Scope == worksheet)
									{
										referencedNamesBeingRemoved.Add(namedReference2);
									}
								}
							});
						}
						if (!referencedNamesBeingRemoved.Contains(namedReference) || workbookScopedNamedItems.ContainsKey(namedReference.Name))
						{
							NamedReferences.RemoveAt(num);
						}
						else
						{
							namedReference.ScopeInternal = this;
							workbookScopedNamedItems.Add(namedReference.Name, namedReference);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			IterateFormulas(delegate(Worksheet ws, Formula f)
			{
				f.OnWorksheetRemoved(worksheet, oldIndex);
			});
			if (HasCustomViews)
			{
				foreach (CustomView item in (IEnumerable<CustomView>)CustomViews)
				{
					item.OnWorksheetRemoved(worksheet);
				}
			}
			_worksheetsBySheetId.Remove(worksheet.SheetId);
			_worksheetBeingRemoved = null;
		}

		internal RefBase ParseReference(string reference, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow originRow, short originColumnIndex, out bool isNamedReference, bool ignoreInsignificantTokens = false)
		{
			isNamedReference = false;
			if (!Formula.TryParse("=" + reference, cellReferenceMode, CurrentFormat, CultureResolved, out var formula))
			{
				return null;
			}
			FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(this, worksheet, originRow, originColumnIndex, formula);
			formula.ReconnectReferences(context);
			return ParseReference(context, out isNamedReference, ignoreInsignificantTokens);
		}

		internal RefBase ParseReference(FormulaContext context, out bool isNamedReference, bool ignoreInsignificantTokens = false)
		{
			Formula formula = context.Formula;
			isNamedReference = false;
			if (formula.PostfixTokenList.Length == 1)
			{
				return ParseReference(formula.PostfixTokenList[0], context, out isNamedReference);
			}
			Stack<RefBase> stack = new Stack<RefBase>();
			for (int i = 0; i < formula.PostfixTokenList.Length; i++)
			{
				FormulaToken formulaToken = formula.PostfixTokenList[i];
				if (formulaToken is UnionOperator)
				{
					if (stack.Count < 2)
					{
						return null;
					}
					RegionGroupCalcReference regionGroupCalcReference = RegionGroupCalcReference.FromReference(stack.Pop());
					if (regionGroupCalcReference == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					RegionGroupCalcReference regionGroupCalcReference2 = RegionGroupCalcReference.FromReference(stack.Pop());
					if (regionGroupCalcReference2 == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (regionGroupCalcReference.Worksheet != regionGroupCalcReference2.Worksheet)
					{
						return null;
					}
					stack.Push(RegionGroupCalcReference.Union(regionGroupCalcReference, regionGroupCalcReference2));
				}
				else if (!ignoreInsignificantTokens || ((!(formulaToken is AttrTokenBase) || formulaToken is AttrSumToken) && !(formulaToken is ParenToken)))
				{
					bool isNamedReference2;
					RefBase refBase = ParseReference(formulaToken, context, out isNamedReference2);
					if (refBase == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					stack.Push(refBase);
				}
			}
			if (stack.Count == 1)
			{
				return stack.Peek();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private RefBase ParseReference(FormulaToken token, FormulaContext context, out bool isNamedReference)
		{
			isNamedReference = false;
			if (!(token is ReferenceToken { IsExternalReference: false } referenceToken))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (referenceToken is CellReferenceToken cellReferenceToken)
			{
				if (cellReferenceToken.IsReferenceError)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (context.OwningCellAddress == WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference && cellReferenceToken.AreRelativeAddressesOffsets && cellReferenceToken.HasRelativeAddresses)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_RelativeR1C1AddressNeedsOriginCell"));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				isNamedReference = referenceToken is NameToken || referenceToken is StructuredTableReference;
			}
			if (context.OwningCellAddress == WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference && referenceToken is StructuredTableReference { HasThisRowKeyword: not false })
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CurrentTableRowAddressNeedsOriginCell"));
			}
			RefBase refBase = referenceToken.GetCalcValue(context) as RefBase;
			if (refBase == ExcelReferenceError.Instance || refBase is NamedCalcReferenceUnconnected)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return refBase;
		}

		internal void VerifyItemName(string name, NamedReferenceBase item)
		{
			object obj = this;
			if (item != null)
			{
				obj = item.Scope;
			}
			if (HasNamedReferences)
			{
				NamedReference[] array = NamedReferences.FindAll(name);
				NamedReference[] array2 = array;
				foreach (NamedReference namedReference in array2)
				{
					if (namedReference != item && (item.IsNameUniqueAcrossScopes || namedReference.IsNameUniqueAcrossScopes || namedReference.Scope == obj))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_NamedReferenceNameAlreadyExists", name));
					}
				}
			}
			WorksheetTable table = GetTable(name);
			if (table != null && table != item)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_NamedReferenceNameAlreadyExists", name));
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyFormula(Formula formula, WorksheetRow formulaOwnerRow, short formulaOwnerColumnIndex)
		{
			if (IsLoading)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < formula.PostfixTokenList.Length; i++)
			{
				FormulaToken formulaToken = formula.PostfixTokenList[i];
				if (formulaToken is TblToken)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_DataTableFormulaCannotBeApplied"));
				}
				if (!(formulaToken is StructuredTableReference structuredTableReference))
				{
					continue;
				}
				WorksheetTable worksheetTable = null;
				if (structuredTableReference.TableName == null)
				{
					if (formulaOwnerRow != null)
					{
						worksheetTable = formulaOwnerRow.GetCellAssociatedTableInternal(formulaOwnerColumnIndex);
					}
					if (worksheetTable == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_TableReferenceMustBeUsedFromInsideTable"));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					worksheetTable = GetWorkbookScopedNamedItem(structuredTableReference.TableName) as WorksheetTable;
					if (worksheetTable == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_TableReferenceToMissingTable"));
					}
				}
				bool flag = true;
				if (structuredTableReference.SimpleColumnName != null)
				{
					flag = worksheetTable.Columns[structuredTableReference.SimpleColumnName] != null;
				}
				else if (structuredTableReference.InnerStructuredReference != null)
				{
					string firstColumnName = structuredTableReference.InnerStructuredReference.FirstColumnName;
					string lastColumnName = structuredTableReference.InnerStructuredReference.LastColumnName;
					flag = (firstColumnName == null || worksheetTable.Columns[firstColumnName] != null) && (lastColumnName == null || worksheetTable.Columns[lastColumnName] != null);
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_TableReferenceToMissingTableColumn"));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyWorksheetName(Worksheet excludeWorksheet, string worksheetName, string paramName)
		{
			foreach (Worksheet item in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)Worksheets)
			{
				if (item != excludeWorksheet && StringUtilities.StringCompare(item.Name, worksheetName, CultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_WorksheetNameAlreadyExists", item.Name), paramName);
				}
			}
		}

		private static WorkItem<Workbook> LoadHelper(Stream stream, string parameterName, WorkbookLoadOptions loadOptions, bool isStreamDecrypted = false, WorkbookFormat? format = null)
		{
			Workbook workbook = null;
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then<bool, Workbook>(OleDataSpaces.TryDecrypt(stream, (Func<byte[]>)loadOptions.GetOpenPasswordUnicode, (Func<Stream, OleDataSpacesEncryptionMode, WorkItem>)((Stream s, OleDataSpacesEncryptionMode encryptionMode) => WorkItemExtensions.Then<Workbook>(LoadHelper(s, parameterName, loadOptions, isStreamDecrypted: true), (Action<WorkItem<Workbook>>)delegate(WorkItem<Workbook> t)
			{
				//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				workbook = WorkItemExtensions.GetResult<Workbook>(t);
				workbook.Preferred2007EncryptionMode = encryptionMode;
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0)), (Action)delegate
			{
				ThrowInvalidPasswordException(loadOptions.HasOpenPassword);
			}, (Action)ThrowEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException), (Func<WorkItem<bool>, WorkItem<Workbook>>)delegate(WorkItem<bool> t2)
			{
				if (WorkItemExtensions.GetResult<bool>(t2))
				{
					return WorkItem.FromResult<Workbook>(workbook);
				}
				WorkbookFormat formatResolved = format ?? Utilities.GetWorkbookFormat(stream, "stream", loadOptions);
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(WorkbookFormat), formatResolved))
				{
					throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("format", (int)formatResolved, typeof(WorkbookFormat));
				}
				workbook = new Workbook(formatResolved);
				workbook.WasOpenPasswordUsedOnLoad = isStreamDecrypted;
				SetOpenPasswordOnWorkbook(loadOptions, workbook);
				workbook.isLoading = true;
				workbook.SuspendCalculations();
				workbook.LoadingPath = Utilities.GetFileName(stream);

				{

					case WorkbookFormat.Excel97To2003Template:
						return LoadBIFF8File(workbook, stream, parameterName, loadOptions);
					case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007:
					case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007MacroEnabled:
					case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007MacroEnabledTemplate:
					case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007Template:
					case WorkbookFormat.StrictOpenXml:
						return LoadXLSXFile(workbook, stream, loadOptions);
					default:
						return (WorkItem)null;
					}
				}, (Action)delegate
				{
					workbook.isLoading = false;
					workbook.ResumeCalculations();
					workbook.CalcEngine.DirtyVolatileFormulasDelayed();
					ClearUnusedOpenPasswordOnWorkbook(workbook);
				}), (Func<Workbook>)(() => workbook), (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		private static WorkItem LoadBIFF8File(Workbook workbook, Stream stream, string parameterName, WorkbookLoadOptions loadOptions)
		{
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Expected O, but got Unknown
			for (int num = workbook.Styles.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (!workbook.Styles[num].IsAutomatic)
				{
					workbook.Styles.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			return Async.Using<StructuredStorageManager>(new StructuredStorageManager(stream, true), (Func<StructuredStorageManager, WorkItem>)delegate(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorageManager)
			{
				//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002a: Expected O, but got Unknown
				DocumentSummaryInformation documentSummaryInformation = new DocumentSummaryInformation();
				SummaryInformation summaryInformation = new SummaryInformation();
				using (Stream stream2 = structuredStorageManager.GetFileStream("\u0005SummaryInformation"))
				{
					if (stream2 != null && stream2.Length != 0)
					{
						((InformationBase)summaryInformation).Load(stream2);
					}
				}
				using (Stream stream3 = structuredStorageManager.GetFileStream("\u0005DocumentSummaryInformation"))
				{
					if (stream3 != null && stream3.Length != 0)
					{
						((InformationBase)documentSummaryInformation).Load(stream3);
					}
				}
				Stream workbookStream = structuredStorageManager.GetFileStream("Workbook");
				if (workbookStream == null)
				{
					workbookStream = structuredStorageManager.GetFileStream("Book");
					if (workbookStream == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_FileDoesntContainsWorkbookStream"), parameterName);
					}
				}
				Stream encryptionStream = structuredStorageManager.GetFileStream("encryption");
				return WorkItemExtensions.Then(Async.Try((Func<WorkItem>)delegate
				{
					string fileName = Utilities.GetFileName(stream);
					return WorkItemExtensions.Then(Async.Using<WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003>(new WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003(workbook, workbookStream, fileName, loadOptions), (Func<WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003, WorkItem>)((WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager) => WorkItemExtensions.Then(loadManager.Load(), (Action)delegate
					{
						loadManager.LoadRC4CryptoAPIEncryptionStream(encryptionStream, documentSummaryInformation, summaryInformation);
					}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0))), (Action)delegate
					{
						workbook.CacheAdditionalStructuredStorageFiles(structuredStorageManager, structuredStorageManager.RootDirectory, string.Empty);
					}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
				}, (Action)delegate
				{
					workbookStream.Close();
					if (encryptionStream != null)
					{
						encryptionStream.Close();
					}
				}), (Action)delegate
				{
					workbook.DocumentProperties.Load(summaryInformation, documentSummaryInformation);
				}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
			});
		}

		private static WorkItem LoadXLSXFile(Workbook workbook, Stream stream, WorkbookLoadOptions loadOptions)
		{
			return Async.Using<WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2007>(new WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2007(workbook, stream, loadOptions), (Func<WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2007, WorkItem>)((WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2007 loadManager) => loadManager.Load()));
		}

		private WorkItem SaveHelper(Stream stream, WorkbookSaveOptions saveOptions)
		{
			string fileName = Utilities.GetFileName(stream);
			if (fileName != null)
			{
				WorkbookFormat workbookFormat = Utilities.GetWorkbookFormat(fileName, stream, saveOptions);
				if (workbookFormat == WorkbookFormat.Excel2007 && currentFormat == WorkbookFormat.StrictOpenXml)
				{
					workbookFormat = WorkbookFormat.StrictOpenXml;
				}
				if ((workbookFormat != (WorkbookFormat)(-1) && workbookFormat != currentFormat) || Path.GetExtension(fileName).ToLower() == ".xlsb")
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ExtensionDoesntMatchCurrentFormat"));
				}
			}
			switch (currentFormat)
			{
			case WorkbookFormat.Excel97To2003:
			case WorkbookFormat.Excel97To2003Template:
				return SaveBIFF8File(stream, saveOptions);
			case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007:
			case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007MacroEnabled:
			case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007MacroEnabledTemplate:
			case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007Template:
			case WorkbookFormat.StrictOpenXml:
				return SaveXLSXFile(stream, saveOptions);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private WorkItem SaveBIFF8File(Stream stream, WorkbookSaveOptions saveOptions)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return Async.Using<StructuredStorageManager>(new StructuredStorageManager(stream, false), (Func<StructuredStorageManager, WorkItem>)delegate(StructuredStorageManager structuredStorageManager)
			{
				if (documentProperties != null)
				{
					documentProperties.Save(structuredStorageManager);
				}
				return WorkItemExtensions.Then(Async.Using<Stream>(structuredStorageManager.AddFile("Workbook"), (Func<Stream, WorkItem>)((Stream workbookStream) => Async.Using<WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003>(new WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003(this, workbookStream, Utilities.GetFileName(stream), saveOptions), (Func<WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003, WorkItem>)((WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager) => saveManager.Save())))), (Action)delegate
				{
					if (cachedStructuredStorageFiles != null)
					{
						foreach (KeyValuePair<string, byte[]> cachedStructuredStorageFile in cachedStructuredStorageFiles)
						{
							using Stream stream2 = structuredStorageManager.AddFile(cachedStructuredStorageFile.Key);
							stream2.Write(cachedStructuredStorageFile.Value, 0, cachedStructuredStorageFile.Value.Length);
						}
					}
				}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
			});
		}

		private WorkItem SaveXLSXFile(Stream stream, WorkbookSaveOptions saveOptions)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (HasOpenPassword)
			{
				return OleDataSpaces.Encrypt(stream, Preferred2007EncryptionMode, GetOpenPasswordUnicode(), (Func<Stream, WorkItem>)((Stream s) => SaveXLSXFileHelper(s, saveOptions)));
			}
			return SaveXLSXFileHelper(stream, saveOptions);
		}

		private WorkItem SaveXLSXFileHelper(Stream stream, WorkbookSaveOptions saveOptions)
		{
			return Async.Using<WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007>(new WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007(this, stream, saveOptions, (ST_ConformanceClass)(CurrentFormat == WorkbookFormat.StrictOpenXml)), (Func<WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007, WorkItem>)((WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager) => saveManager.Save()));
		}

		private void VerifyBeforeSave(WorkbookSaveOptions saveOptions = null)
		{
			IList<Worksheet> list = WorkbookSaveOptions.GetFilter(saveOptions).GetWorksheets(this);
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantSaveWithNoWorksheets"));
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (Worksheet item in list)
			{
				if (item.DisplayOptions.Visibility == WorksheetVisibility.Visible)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantSaveWithNoVisibleWorksheets"));
			}
			if (HasCustomViews)
			{
				foreach (CustomView item2 in (IEnumerable<CustomView>)CustomViews)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					foreach (Worksheet item3 in list)
					{
						DisplayOptions displayOptions = item2.GetDisplayOptions(item3);
						if (displayOptions != null && displayOptions.Visibility == WorksheetVisibility.Visible)
						{
							flag2 = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (!flag2)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CustomViewNoVisibleWorksheets", item2.Name));
					}
				}
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			foreach (Worksheet item4 in list)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetProtectedRange allowedEditRange in item4.Protection.AllowedEditRanges)
				{
					if (allowedEditRange.Ranges.Count == 0)
					{
						flag3 = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag3)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantSaveEditRangeWithoutRange"));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			if (VBAData2007 != null && Utilities.Is2007Format(testFormat) && !Utilities.IsMacroEnabledFormat(testFormat))
			{
				limitErrors.AddError(Utilities.GetString("LE_FormatLimitError_MacroWorkbook"));
			}
			if (HasNamedReferences)
			{
				NamedReferences.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			}
			if (worksheets != null)
			{
				worksheets.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			}
		}

		{
			Function function = Function.GetFunction(functionName);

			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsDpiValueValid(double dpiValue)
		{
			if (0.0 <= dpiValue && !double.IsNaN(dpiValue))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(dpiValue);
			}
			return false;
		}

	internal abstract class GenericCacheElement
	{
		private int referenceCount;

		public int ReferenceCount => referenceCount;

		public GenericCacheElement()
		{
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return base.Equals(obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public abstract object Clone(Workbook workbook);

		public abstract bool HasSameData(GenericCacheElement otherElement);

		public void DecrementReferenceCount()
		{
			referenceCount--;
		}

		public void IncrementReferenceCount()
		{
			referenceCount++;
		}

		protected virtual void OnWorkbookChanged(bool resetStyle)
		{
		}

		public static void AfterSet<T>(GenericCachedCollection<T> collection, ref T element) where T : GenericCacheElement
		{
			element = FindExistingOrAddToCache(element, collection);
		}

		public static void BeforeSet<T>(GenericCachedCollection<T> collection, ref T element, bool willModifyElement) where T : GenericCacheElement
		{
			Release(element, collection);
			if (willModifyElement && element.ReferenceCount > 0)
			{
				Workbook workbook = collection.Workbook;
				element = (T)element.Clone(workbook);
			}
		}

		internal static T FindExistingOrAddToCache<T>(T newElement, GenericCachedCollection<T> collection) where T : GenericCacheElement
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				if (newElement.ReferenceCount <= 0)
				{
					return newElement;
				}
				return (T)newElement.Clone(null);
			}
			collection.FindOrAdd(newElement, out var equivalentElement);
			equivalentElement.IncrementReferenceCount();
			return equivalentElement;
		}

		public static void Release<T>(T element, GenericCachedCollection<T> collection) where T : GenericCacheElement
		{
			if (collection != null)
			{
				element.DecrementReferenceCount();
			}
			if (collection != null && element.referenceCount <= 0)
			{
				collection.Remove(element);
			}
		}

		internal static void SetCollection<T>(GenericCachedCollection<T> newCollection, ref GenericCachedCollection<T> collection, ref T element) where T : GenericCacheElement
		{
			if (collection != newCollection)
			{
				BeforeSet(collection, ref element, willModifyElement: true);
				collection = newCollection;
				AfterSet(collection, ref element);
			}
		}

		protected void ResetReferenceCount()
		{
			referenceCount = 0;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class GenericCacheElementEx : GenericCacheElement
	{
		private IGenericCachedCollectionEx collection;

		private Workbook workbook;

		private bool isFrozen;

		public IGenericCachedCollectionEx Collection
		{
			get
			{
				return collection;
			}
			protected set
			{
				collection = value;
				if (collection != null && Workbook == null)
				{
					Workbook = collection.Workbook;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsFrozen
		{
			get
			{
				return isFrozen;
			}
			protected set
			{
				isFrozen = value;
			}
		}

		public Workbook Workbook
		{
			get
			{
				return workbook;
			}
			protected set
			{
				SetWorkbookInternal(value, resetStyle: true);
			}
		}

		public GenericCacheElementEx(Workbook workbook)
		{
			this.workbook = workbook;
		}

		public virtual void OnAddedToRootCollection(IGenericCachedCollectionEx collection)
		{
			Collection = collection;
		}

		public virtual void OnRemovedFromRootCollection()
		{
			Collection = null;
		}

		public abstract void CopyValues(GenericCacheElement element);

		protected abstract void VerifyCanSetValue();

		public static void AfterSetEx<T>(GenericCachedCollection<T> collection, ref T element) where T : GenericCacheElementEx
		{
			element = FindExistingOrAddToCacheEx(element, collection);
		}

		public static GenericCachedCollection<T> BeforeSetEx<T>(ref T element, bool willModifyElement) where T : GenericCacheElementEx
		{
			GenericCachedCollection<T> result = ReleaseEx(element);
			if (willModifyElement && element.ReferenceCount > 0)
			{
				element = (T)element.Clone();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			return Clone(Workbook);
		}

		internal static T FindExistingOrAddToCacheEx<T>(T newElement, GenericCachedCollection<T> collection) where T : GenericCacheElementEx
		{
			T equivalentElement;
			if (collection == null)
			{
				equivalentElement = ((newElement.ReferenceCount > 0) ? ((T)newElement.Clone()) : newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				if (newElement.collection == collection)
				{
					equivalentElement = newElement;
				}
				else
				{
					collection.FindOrAdd(newElement, out equivalentElement);
				}
				equivalentElement.IncrementReferenceCount();
			}
			return equivalentElement;
		}

		public static GenericCachedCollection<T> ReleaseEx<T>(T element) where T : GenericCacheElementEx
		{
			GenericCachedCollection<T> genericCachedCollection = element.Collection as GenericCachedCollection<T>;
			if (genericCachedCollection != null)
			{
				element.DecrementReferenceCount();
			}
			if (genericCachedCollection != null && element.ReferenceCount <= 0)
			{
				genericCachedCollection.Remove(element);
			}
			return genericCachedCollection;
		}

		internal static void SetCollectionEx<T>(GenericCachedCollection<T> newCollection, ref T element) where T : GenericCacheElementEx
		{
			GenericCachedCollection<T> genericCachedCollection = element.Collection as GenericCachedCollection<T>;
			if (genericCachedCollection != newCollection)
			{
				BeforeSetEx(ref element, willModifyElement: true);
				genericCachedCollection = newCollection;
				AfterSetEx(genericCachedCollection, ref element);
			}
		}

		internal void SetWorkbookInternal(Workbook value, bool resetStyle)
		{
			if (workbook != value)
			{
				workbook = value;
				OnWorkbookChanged(resetStyle);
			}
		}
	}

				return _strikeout;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanSetValue();
				if (_strikeout != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyExcelDefaultableBoolean(value, "value");
					_strikeout = value;
					_cachedHashCodeIsValid = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle SuperscriptSubscriptStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return _superscriptSubscriptStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanSetValue();
				if (_superscriptSubscriptStyle != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(value, "value");
					_superscriptSubscriptStyle = value;
					_cachedHashCodeIsValid = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public FontUnderlineStyle UnderlineStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return _underlineStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanSetValue();
				if (_underlineStyle != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(value, "value");
					_underlineStyle = value;
					_cachedHashCodeIsValid = false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (_bold == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default && _colorInfo == null && _height < 0 && _italic == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default && _name == null && _strikeout == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default && _superscriptSubscriptStyle == FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.Default)
				{
					return _underlineStyle == FontUnderlineStyle.Default;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public WorkbookFontData(Workbook workbook)
			: base(workbook)
		{
		}

		private WorkbookFontData(WorkbookFontData source)
			: this(source, source.Workbook)
		{
		}

		private WorkbookFontData(WorkbookFontData source, Workbook workbook)
			: this(workbook)
		{
			_bold = source._bold;
			_colorInfo = source._colorInfo;
			_height = source._height;
			_italic = source._italic;
			_name = source._name;
			_strikeout = source._strikeout;
			_superscriptSubscriptStyle = source._superscriptSubscriptStyle;
			_underlineStyle = source._underlineStyle;
		}

		public override object Clone(Workbook workbook)
		{
			return CloneInternal(workbook);
		}

		public WorkbookFontData CloneInternal(Workbook workbook)
		{
			return new WorkbookFontData(this, workbook);
		}

		public override void CopyValues(GenericCacheElement element)
		{
			if (element is WorkbookFontData fontFormatting)
			{
				SetFontFormatting(fontFormatting);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return HasSameData(obj as GenericCacheElement);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (!_cachedHashCodeIsValid)
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (_name != null)
				{
					num ^= _name.GetHashCode();
				}
				num ^= _height << 1;
				if (_colorInfo != null)
				{
					num ^= _colorInfo.GetHashCode() << 2;
				}
				num ^= _bold.ToInt() << 3;
				num ^= _italic.ToInt() << 4;
				num ^= _strikeout.ToInt() << 5;
				num ^= (int)_superscriptSubscriptStyle << 6;
				num ^= (int)_underlineStyle << 7;
				_cachedHashCode = num;
				_cachedHashCodeIsValid = true;
			}
			return _cachedHashCode;
		}

		public override bool HasSameData(GenericCacheElement otherElement)
		{
			if (otherElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (this == otherElement)
			{
				return true;
			}
			WorkbookFontData workbookFontData = (WorkbookFontData)otherElement;
			if (_height != workbookFontData._height)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_bold != workbookFontData._bold)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_italic != workbookFontData._italic)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_strikeout != workbookFontData._strikeout)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_superscriptSubscriptStyle != workbookFontData._superscriptSubscriptStyle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_underlineStyle != workbookFontData._underlineStyle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_name != workbookFontData._name)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_colorInfo != workbookFontData._colorInfo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void VerifyCanSetValue()
		{
			if (base.IsFrozen)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ReadOnlyFont"));
			}
		}

		public void SetFontFormatting(IWorkbookFont source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_SourceFont"));
			}
			_name = source.Name;
			_height = source.Height;
			_colorInfo = source.ColorInfo;
			_bold = source.Bold;
			_italic = source.Italic;
			_strikeout = source.Strikeout;
			_superscriptSubscriptStyle = source.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle;
			_underlineStyle = source.UnderlineStyle;
			_cachedHashCodeIsValid = false;
		}

		internal static WorkbookFontData Combine(WorkbookFontData highPriorityFnt, WorkbookFontData lowPriorityFnt)
		{
			return Combine(highPriorityFnt, lowPriorityFnt, null);
		}

		internal static WorkbookFontData Combine(WorkbookFontData highPriorityFnt, WorkbookFontData lowPriorityFnt, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver defaultsResolver)
		{
			WorkbookFontData workbookFontData = new WorkbookFontData(lowPriorityFnt);
			if (defaultsResolver != null)
			{
				highPriorityFnt = new WorkbookFontData(highPriorityFnt);
				defaultsResolver.ResolveDefaults(highPriorityFnt);
			}
			workbookFontData.SelectiveCopyValues(highPriorityFnt);
			return workbookFontData;
		}

		internal void Freeze()
		{
			if (base.Collection == null)
			{
				base.IsFrozen = true;
			}
		}

		internal WorkbookFontData ResolvedFontData(IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver defaultsResolver)
		{
			if (defaultsResolver == null)
			{
				defaultsResolver = UltimateFontDefaultsResolver.Instance;
			}
			WorkbookFontData workbookFontData = new WorkbookFontData(this);
			defaultsResolver?.ResolveDefaults(workbookFontData);
			return workbookFontData;
		}

		private void SelectiveCopyValues(WorkbookFontData source)
		{
			if (source._name != null)
			{
				_name = source._name;
			}
			if (source._height != -1)
			{
				_height = source._height;
			}
			if (source._bold != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
			{
				_bold = source._bold;
			}
			if (source._italic != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
			{
				_italic = source._italic;
			}
			if (source._strikeout != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
			{
				_strikeout = source._strikeout;
			}
			if (source._superscriptSubscriptStyle != FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.Default)
			{
				_superscriptSubscriptStyle = source._superscriptSubscriptStyle;
			}
			if (source._underlineStyle != FontUnderlineStyle.Default)
			{
				_underlineStyle = source._underlineStyle;
			}
			if (source._colorInfo != null)
			{
				_colorInfo = source._colorInfo;
			}
			_cachedHashCodeIsValid = false;
		}
	}

		internal void SetFontFormatting(IWorkbookFont source, bool callBeforeAndAfterSet, CellFormatValueChangedOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_SourceFont"));
			}
			CellFormatValue differences = WorkbookFontProxy.GetDifferences(owningProxy.Font, source);
			if (differences != 0)
			{
				owningProxy.OnPropertyChanging(differences);
			}
			GenericCachedCollection<WorksheetCellFormatData> collection = (callBeforeAndAfterSet ? owningProxy.BeforeSet() : null);
			try
			{
				owningProxy.Element.FontInternal.SetFontFormatting(source);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (callBeforeAndAfterSet)
				{
					owningProxy.AfterSet(collection);
				}
			}
			if (differences != 0)
			{
				owningProxy.OnPropertyChanged(differences, options);
			}
		}

		private void SetFontProperty<TValue>(TValue value, CellFormatValue valueType, bool callBeforeAndAfterSet, CellFormatValueChangedOptions options, Func<IWorkbookFont, TValue> propertyGetter, Action<IWorkbookFont, TValue> propertySetter)
		{
			owningProxy.SetFontProperty(value, valueType, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options, propertyGetter, propertySetter);
		}

	internal abstract class GenericCacheElementProxy<T> where T : GenericCacheElementEx
	{
		protected T element;

		public virtual T Element => element;

		public GenericCacheElementProxy(T element, GenericCachedCollectionEx<T> collection)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				this.element = GenericCacheElementEx.FindExistingOrAddToCacheEx(element, collection);
			}
		}

		public GenericCacheElementProxy(GenericCachedCollectionEx<T> collection)
			: this(collection.DefaultElement, collection)
		{
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is GenericCacheElementProxy<T> genericCacheElementProxy))
			{
				return false;
			}
			T val = Element;
			return val.Equals(genericCacheElementProxy.Element);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			T val = Element;
			return val.GetHashCode();
		}

		public virtual void AfterSet(GenericCachedCollection<T> collection)
		{
			GenericCacheElementEx.AfterSetEx(collection, ref element);
		}

		public GenericCachedCollection<T> BeforeSet()
		{
			return BeforeSet(willModifyElement: true);
		}

		public virtual GenericCachedCollection<T> BeforeSet(bool willModifyElement)
		{
			return GenericCacheElementEx.BeforeSetEx(ref element, willModifyElement);
		}

		public void OnRooted(GenericCachedCollection<T> rootCollection)
		{
			SetCollection(rootCollection);
		}

		public void OnUnrooted()
		{
			SetCollection(null);
		}

		protected void SetToElement(T newElement)
		{
			if (Element != newElement)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (newElement.IsFrozen)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (newElement.Collection != null && element.Collection != newElement.Collection)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (newElement.Collection == null && element.Collection == null)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					T val = Element;
					Workbook workbook = val.Workbook;
					newElement = (T)newElement.Clone(workbook);
				}
				GenericCachedCollection<T> collection = BeforeSet(willModifyElement: false);
				element = newElement;
				AfterSet(collection);
			}
		}

		private void SetCollection(GenericCachedCollection<T> rootCollection)
		{
			_ = Element;
			GenericCacheElementEx.SetCollectionEx(rootCollection, ref element);
		}
	}

		{
			base.AfterSet(collection);
			if (owningCellFormat != null)
			{
				owningCellFormat.OnFontChanged();
			}
		}

		internal static CellFormatValue GetDifferences(IWorkbookFont font1, IWorkbookFont font2)
		{
			CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)0;
			if (font1.Bold != font2.Bold)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FontBold;
			}
			if (font1.ColorInfo != font2.ColorInfo)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FontColorInfo;
			}
			if (font1.Height != font2.Height)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FontHeight;
			}
			if (font1.Italic != font2.Italic)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FontItalic;
			}
			if (font1.Name != font2.Name)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FontName;
			}
			if (font1.Strikeout != font2.Strikeout)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FontStrikeout;
			}
			if (font1.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle != font2.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle;
			}
			if (font1.UnderlineStyle != font2.UnderlineStyle)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FontUnderlineStyle;
			}
			return cellFormatValue;
		}

		public void SetFontFormatting(IWorkbookFont source)
		{
			SetFontFormattingInternal(source, raiseNotifocation: true);
		}

		internal void SetFontFormattingInternal(IWorkbookFont source, bool raiseNotifocation)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_SourceFont"));
			}
			if (source is WorkbookFontData toElement)
			{
				SetToElement(toElement);
			}
			else if (source is WorkbookFontProxy workbookFontProxy)
			{
				saveIndex = workbookFontProxy.saveIndex;
				SetToElement(workbookFontProxy.Element);
			}
			else
			{
				GenericCachedCollection<WorkbookFontData> collection = BeforeSet();
				Element.SetFontFormatting(source);
				AfterSet(collection);
			}
		}

		private Color GetColor(WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo)
		{
			if (colorInfo == null)
			{
				return ColorsInternal.Empty;
			}
			Workbook workbook = Element.Workbook;
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				return ColorsInternal.Empty;
			}
			return colorInfo.GetResolvedColor(workbook);
		}

		private void SetFontProperty<TValue>(TValue value, Func<IWorkbookFont, TValue> propertyGetter, Action<IWorkbookFont, TValue> propertySetter)
		{
			TValue y = propertyGetter(this);
			if (!EqualityComparer<TValue>.Default.Equals(value, y))
			{
				GenericCachedCollection<WorkbookFontData> collection = BeforeSet();
				propertySetter(element, value);
				AfterSet(collection);
			}
		}
	}

		public WorksheetCellFormatOptions FormatOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return _formatOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanSetValue();
				value &= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.All;
				if (_formatOptions != value)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptions = _formatOptions;
					SetFormatOptionsInternal(value);
					OnFormatOptionsChanged(formatOptions);
					if (_valueChangeCallback != null)
					{
						_valueChangeCallback(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.All);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public string FormatString
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Workbook == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.Workbook.Formats[_formatStringIndex];
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanSetValue();
				if (FormatString == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					Workbook workbook = base.Workbook;
					if (workbook != null)
					{
						if (workbook.ValidateFormatStrings)
						{
							ValueFormatter valueFormatter = new ValueFormatter(workbook, value, workbook.CultureResolved);
							if (!valueFormatter.IsValid && !workbook.IsLoading)
							{
								throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidFormatString"), "value");
							}
						}
						_formatStringIndex = workbook.Formats.Add(value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_formatStringIndex = -1;
				}
				OnValueSet(CellFormatValue.FormatString);
			}
		}

		public int Indent
		{
			get
			{
				return _indent;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanSetValue();
				if (Indent != value)
				{
					if (value != -1 && (value < 0 || 250 < value))
					{
						throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_Indent"));
					}
					_indent = value;
					OnValueSet(CellFormatValue.Indent);
				}
			}

		public WorkbookStyle Style
		{
			get
			{
				return EnsureNonNullStyle(_style);
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanSetValue();
				value = EnsureNonNullStyle(value);
				if (_style == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					if (Type == WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotSetParentStyleOnStyle"));
					}
					if (value.Workbook != base.Workbook)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ParentStyleFromOtherWorkbook"), "value");
					}
				}
				if (_style != null && base.Collection != null)
				{
					_style.OnChildFormatDetached();
				}
				if (_style != null && value != null && !base.Workbook.IsLoading)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptions = _style.StyleFormatInternal.FormatOptions;
					formatOptions &= ~value.StyleFormatInternal.FormatOptions;
					formatOptions = FilterOutOptionsWithAllUltimateDefaults(formatOptions);
					CacheResolvedFormatOptionsValues(formatOptions, _style.StyleFormatInternal);
				}
				_style = value;
				if (_style != null && base.Collection != null)
				{
					_style.OnChildFormatAttached();
				}
				if (_style != null && (base.Workbook == null || !base.Workbook.IsLoading))
				{
					FormatOptions &= ~_style.StyleFormatInternal.FormatOptions;
				}
				if (_valueChangeCallback != null)
				{
					_valueChangeCallback(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.All);
				}
			}
		}

		internal int FormatStringIndexResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (_formatStringIndex < 0)
				{
					if (Utilities.TestFlag(FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting))
					{
						if (_cachedStyleValues != null)
						{
							return _cachedStyleValues.FormatStringIndexResolved;
						}
					}
					else if (Style != null)
					{
						return Style.StyleFormatInternal.FormatStringIndexResolved;
					}
					return 0;
				}
				return _formatStringIndex;
			}
		}

		internal bool AddIndent
		{
			get
			{
				return _addIndent;
			}
			set
			{
				_addIndent = value;
			}
		}

		internal int ComputedBottomIndent
		{
			get
			{
				int num = IndentResolved;
				if (num != 0)
				{
					int computedRotation = ComputedRotation;
					if (computedRotation != 255)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						VerticalCellAlignment verticalAlignmentResolved = VerticalAlignmentResolved;
						if (verticalAlignmentResolved != VerticalCellAlignment.Bottom && verticalAlignmentResolved != VerticalCellAlignment.Distributed)
						{
							num = 0;
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal int ComputedLeftIndent
		{
			get
			{
				int num = IndentResolved;
				if (num != 0)
				{
					HorizontalCellAlignment alignmentResolved = AlignmentResolved;
					if (alignmentResolved != HorizontalCellAlignment.Left && alignmentResolved != HorizontalCellAlignment.Distributed)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
					else if (RotationResolved != 0)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal int ComputedRightIndent
		{
			get
			{
				int num = IndentResolved;
				if (num != 0)
				{
					HorizontalCellAlignment alignmentResolved = AlignmentResolved;
					if (alignmentResolved != HorizontalCellAlignment.Right && alignmentResolved != HorizontalCellAlignment.Distributed)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal int ComputedTopIndent
		{
			get
			{
				int num = IndentResolved;
				if (num != 0)
				{
					int computedRotation = ComputedRotation;
					if (computedRotation != 255)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						VerticalCellAlignment verticalAlignmentResolved = VerticalAlignmentResolved;
						if (verticalAlignmentResolved != VerticalCellAlignment.Top && verticalAlignmentResolved != VerticalCellAlignment.Distributed)
						{
							num = 0;
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal int ComputedRotation
		{
			get
			{
				int num = RotationResolved;
				if (num != 0)
				{
					switch (AlignmentResolved)
					{
					case HorizontalCellAlignment.Fill:
					case HorizontalCellAlignment.CenterAcrossSelection:
						num = 0;
						break;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal bool ComputedShrinkToFit
		{
			get
			{
				if (ShrinkToFitResolved == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True)
				{
					if (ComputedWrapText)
					{
						return false;
					}
					switch (AlignmentResolved)
					{
					case HorizontalCellAlignment.General:
					case HorizontalCellAlignment.Left:
					case HorizontalCellAlignment.Center:
					case HorizontalCellAlignment.Right:
					case HorizontalCellAlignment.CenterAcrossSelection:
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool ComputedWrapText
		{
			get
			{
				switch (VerticalAlignmentResolved)
				{
				case VerticalCellAlignment.Justify:
				case VerticalCellAlignment.Distributed:
					return true;
				default:
					switch (AlignmentResolved)
					{
					case HorizontalCellAlignment.Fill:
						return false;
					case HorizontalCellAlignment.Justify:
					case HorizontalCellAlignment.Distributed:
						return true;
					default:
						return WrapTextResolved == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool DoesReverseColorsForSolidFill
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_isForFillOrSortCondition)
				{
					return _type != WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

				_formatStringIndex = value;
				OnValueSet(CellFormatValue.FormatString);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Type == WorksheetCellFormatType.CellFormat && base.Workbook != null)
				{
					return base.Workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement.Equals(this);
				}
				if (FormatOptions != WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Style != null && !Style.IsNormalStyle)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsForFillOrSortCondition
		{
			get

				return _isForFillOrSortCondition;
			}
			set
			{
				_isForFillOrSortCondition = value;
			}
		}

				return _type;

			set

					_cachedHashCode = null;
					Style = null;
				}
			}
