		public Color GetColor(WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo)
		{
			if (colorInfo == null)
			{
				return ColorsInternal.Empty;
			}
			return colorInfo.GetResolvedColor(base.Workbook);
		}

		public CellFill UpdateFillPattern(CellFill resolvedFill, FillPatternStyle pattern)
		{
			return UpdateFillPattern(resolvedFill, pattern, this, DoesReverseColorsForSolidFill);
		}

		internal static CellFill UpdateFillPattern(CellFill resolvedFill, FillPatternStyle pattern, IWorksheetCellFormat format, bool doesReverseColorsForSolidFill)
		{
			if (pattern.IsDefaultStyle())
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (pattern == FillPatternStyle.None)
			{
				return CellFill.NoColor;
			}
			CellFillPattern cellFillPattern = resolvedFill as CellFillPattern;
			WorkbookColorInfo fileFormatFillPatternColor = GetFileFormatFillPatternColor(resolvedFill, backgroundColor: true, resolveNullValues: true, format, doesReverseColorsForSolidFill);
			WorkbookColorInfo fileFormatFillPatternColor2 = GetFileFormatFillPatternColor(resolvedFill, backgroundColor: false, resolveNullValues: true, format, doesReverseColorsForSolidFill);
			if (cellFillPattern != null && cellFillPattern.PatternStyle == FillPatternStyle.Solid)
			{
				return CellFill.CreatePatternFill(fileFormatFillPatternColor2, fileFormatFillPatternColor, pattern);
			}
			return CellFill.CreatePatternFill(fileFormatFillPatternColor, fileFormatFillPatternColor2, pattern);
		}

		public CellFill UpdatedFillPatternColor(CellFill resolvedFill, Color color, bool backgroundColor)
		{
			return UpdatedFillPatternColor(resolvedFill, color, backgroundColor, DoesReverseColorsForSolidFill);
		}

		internal static CellFill UpdatedFillPatternColor(CellFill resolvedFill, Color color, bool backgroundColor, bool doesReverseColorsForSolidFill)
		{
			if (resolvedFill is CellFillPattern { PatternStyle: var fillPatternStyle } cellFillPattern)
			{
				if (Utilities.ColorIsEmpty(color))
				{
					color = (backgroundColor ? SystemColorsInternal.WindowColor : SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColor);
				}
				else if (fillPatternStyle == FillPatternStyle.None)
				{
					fillPatternStyle = ((!backgroundColor) ? FillPatternStyle.Solid : FillPatternStyle.Gray50percent);
				}
				if (backgroundColor)
				{
					return new CellFillPattern(new WorkbookColorInfo(color), cellFillPattern.GetFileFormatForegroundColorInfo(doesReverseColorsForSolidFill), fillPatternStyle, doesReverseColorsForSolidFill, isCreatedInternally: false);
				}
				return new CellFillPattern(cellFillPattern.GetFileFormatBackgroundColorInfo(doesReverseColorsForSolidFill), new WorkbookColorInfo(color), fillPatternStyle, doesReverseColorsForSolidFill, isCreatedInternally: false);
			}
			if (Utilities.ColorIsEmpty(color))
			{
				return null;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_DeprecatedFillColorSetWithGradientFill"));
		}

		public WorksheetCellFormatData(Workbook workbook, WorksheetCellFormatType type)
			: base(workbook)
		{
			_type = type;
			ResetFormatOptions(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.All);
		}

		void IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver.ResolveDefaults(WorkbookFontData font)
		{
			if (font.Bold == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
			{
				font.Bold = FontBoldResolved;
			}
			if (font.ColorInfo == null)
			{
				font.ColorInfo = FontColorInfoResolved;
			}
			font.ColorInfo = VerifyFontColorInfoForSave(font.ColorInfo);
			if (font.Height < 0)
			{
				font.Height = FontHeightResolved;
			}
			if (font.Italic == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
			{
				font.Italic = FontItalicResolved;
			}
			if (font.Name == null)
			{
				font.Name = FontNameResolved;
			}
			if (font.Strikeout == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
			{
				font.Strikeout = FontStrikeoutResolved;
			}
			if (font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle == FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.Default)
			{
				font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle = FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyleResolved;
			}
			if (font.UnderlineStyle == FontUnderlineStyle.Default)
			{
				font.UnderlineStyle = FontUnderlineStyleResolved;
			}
		}

		public override object Clone(Workbook workbook)
		{
			return CloneInternal(workbook);
		}

		public WorksheetCellFormatData CloneInternal()
		{
			return CloneInternal(base.Workbook);
		}

		public WorksheetCellFormatData CloneInternal(Workbook workbook)
		{
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				workbook = base.Workbook;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = new WorksheetCellFormatData(workbook, Type);
			worksheetCellFormatData._addIndent = _addIndent;
			worksheetCellFormatData._alignment = _alignment;
			worksheetCellFormatData._bottomBorderColorInfo = _bottomBorderColorInfo;
			worksheetCellFormatData._bottomBorderStyle = _bottomBorderStyle;
			worksheetCellFormatData._cachedHashCode = _cachedHashCode;
			worksheetCellFormatData._diagonalBorderColorInfo = _diagonalBorderColorInfo;
			worksheetCellFormatData._diagonalBorders = _diagonalBorders;
			worksheetCellFormatData._diagonalBorderStyle = _diagonalBorderStyle;
			worksheetCellFormatData._fill = _fill;
			worksheetCellFormatData._formatOptions = _formatOptions;
			worksheetCellFormatData._fontScheme = _fontScheme;
			worksheetCellFormatData._formatStringIndex = _formatStringIndex;
			worksheetCellFormatData._indent = _indent;
			worksheetCellFormatData._isForFillOrSortCondition = _isForFillOrSortCondition;
			worksheetCellFormatData._leftBorderColorInfo = _leftBorderColorInfo;
			worksheetCellFormatData._leftBorderStyle = _leftBorderStyle;
			worksheetCellFormatData._locked = _locked;
			worksheetCellFormatData._previousDiagonalBorders = _previousDiagonalBorders;
			worksheetCellFormatData._rightBorderColorInfo = _rightBorderColorInfo;
			worksheetCellFormatData._rightBorderStyle = _rightBorderStyle;
			worksheetCellFormatData._rotation = _rotation;
			worksheetCellFormatData._shrinkToFit = _shrinkToFit;
			worksheetCellFormatData._topBorderColorInfo = _topBorderColorInfo;
			worksheetCellFormatData._topBorderStyle = _topBorderStyle;
			worksheetCellFormatData._type = _type;
			worksheetCellFormatData._valueChangeCallback = _valueChangeCallback;
			worksheetCellFormatData._verticalAlignment = _verticalAlignment;
			worksheetCellFormatData._wrapText = _wrapText;
			if (_cachedStyleValues != null)
			{
				worksheetCellFormatData._cachedStyleValues = _cachedStyleValues.CloneInternal(workbook);
			}
			if (workbook != null && _style != null)
			{
				if (workbook != _style.Workbook)
				{
					worksheetCellFormatData._style = workbook.Styles[_style.Name];
				}
				else
				{
					worksheetCellFormatData._style = _style;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				worksheetCellFormatData._style = null;
			}
			WorkbookFontData workbookFontData = _font.Element;
			if (workbookFontData.Workbook != workbook || workbookFontData.IsFrozen)
			{
				workbookFontData = workbookFontData.CloneInternal(workbook);
			}
			worksheetCellFormatData._font = new WorkbookFontProxy(workbookFontData, workbook, worksheetCellFormatData);
			return worksheetCellFormatData;
		}

		public override void CopyValues(GenericCacheElement element)
		{
			if (element is WorksheetCellFormatData formatting)
			{
				SetFormatting(formatting);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatData otherFormat = obj as WorksheetCellFormatData;
			return EqualsInternal(otherFormat);
		}

		internal bool EqualsInternal(WorksheetCellFormatData otherFormat)
		{
			if (otherFormat == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, otherFormat))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_type != otherFormat._type)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return HasSameData(otherFormat);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (!_cachedHashCode.HasValue)
			{
				int num = (int)_type;
				if (_font.Element != null)
				{
					num ^= _font.Element.GetHashCode() << 1;
				}
				num ^= _formatStringIndex << 2;
				num ^= _locked.ToInt() << 3;
				num ^= _wrapText.ToInt() << 4;
				num ^= _shrinkToFit.ToInt() << 5;
				num ^= (int)_alignment << 6;
				num ^= (int)_verticalAlignment << 7;
				num ^= _rotation << 8;
				num ^= _indent << 9;
				num ^= (int)_leftBorderStyle << 10;
				num ^= (int)_rightBorderStyle << 11;
				num ^= (int)_topBorderStyle << 12;
				num ^= (int)_bottomBorderStyle << 13;
				if (_leftBorderColorInfo != null)
				{
					num ^= _leftBorderColorInfo.GetHashCode() << 14;
				}
				if (_rightBorderColorInfo != null)
				{
					num ^= _rightBorderColorInfo.GetHashCode() << 15;
				}
				if (_topBorderColorInfo != null)
				{
					num ^= _topBorderColorInfo.GetHashCode() << 16;
				}
				if (_bottomBorderColorInfo != null)
				{
					num ^= _bottomBorderColorInfo.GetHashCode() << 17;
				}
				if (_fill != null)
				{
					num ^= _fill.GetHashCode() << 18;
				}
				num ^= (int)_formatOptions << 19;
				if (_diagonalBorderColorInfo != null)
				{
					num ^= _diagonalBorderColorInfo.GetHashCode() << 20;
				}
				num ^= (int)_diagonalBorders << 21;
				num ^= (int)_diagonalBorderStyle << 22;
				if (_addIndent)
				{
					num ^= 0x800000;
				}
				if (_style != null)
				{
					num ^= _style.GetHashCode();
				}
				_cachedHashCode = num;
			}
			return _cachedHashCode.Value;
		}

		public override bool HasSameData(GenericCacheElement otherElement)
		{
			if (this == otherElement)
			{
				return true;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = (WorksheetCellFormatData)otherElement;
			if (_formatOptions != worksheetCellFormatData._formatOptions)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_formatStringIndex != worksheetCellFormatData._formatStringIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_locked != worksheetCellFormatData._locked)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_wrapText != worksheetCellFormatData._wrapText)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_shrinkToFit != worksheetCellFormatData._shrinkToFit)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_alignment != worksheetCellFormatData._alignment)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_verticalAlignment != worksheetCellFormatData._verticalAlignment)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_rotation != worksheetCellFormatData._rotation)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_indent != worksheetCellFormatData._indent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_leftBorderStyle != worksheetCellFormatData._leftBorderStyle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_rightBorderStyle != worksheetCellFormatData._rightBorderStyle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_topBorderStyle != worksheetCellFormatData._topBorderStyle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_bottomBorderStyle != worksheetCellFormatData._bottomBorderStyle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_leftBorderColorInfo != worksheetCellFormatData._leftBorderColorInfo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_rightBorderColorInfo != worksheetCellFormatData._rightBorderColorInfo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_topBorderColorInfo != worksheetCellFormatData._topBorderColorInfo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_bottomBorderColorInfo != worksheetCellFormatData._bottomBorderColorInfo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(_fill, worksheetCellFormatData._fill))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_diagonalBorderColorInfo != worksheetCellFormatData._diagonalBorderColorInfo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_diagonalBorders != worksheetCellFormatData._diagonalBorders)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_diagonalBorderStyle != worksheetCellFormatData._diagonalBorderStyle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!_font.Element.Equals(worksheetCellFormatData._font.Element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_addIndent != worksheetCellFormatData._addIndent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_style != worksheetCellFormatData._style)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_cachedStyleValues == null)
			{
				if (worksheetCellFormatData._cachedStyleValues != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (!_cachedStyleValues.EqualsInternal(worksheetCellFormatData._cachedStyleValues))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnAddedToRootCollection(IGenericCachedCollectionEx collection)
		{
			base.OnAddedToRootCollection(collection);
			if (_font != null && base.Workbook != null)
			{
				_font.OnRooted(base.Workbook.Fonts);
			}
			if (Style != null)
			{
				Style.OnChildFormatAttached();
			}
		}

		public override void OnRemovedFromRootCollection()
		{
			base.OnRemovedFromRootCollection();
			if (FontInternal != null)
			{
				FontInternal.OnUnrooted();
			}
			if (Style != null)
			{
				Style.OnChildFormatDetached();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnWorkbookChanged(bool resetStyle)
		{
			base.OnWorkbookChanged(resetStyle);
			if (_cachedStyleValues != null)
			{
				_cachedStyleValues.Workbook = base.Workbook;
			}
			if (resetStyle || (Style != null && Style.Workbook != base.Workbook))
			{
				Style = null;
			}
			if (_font != null)
			{
				_font.OnUnrooted();
				if (base.Workbook != null)
				{
					_font.OnRooted(base.Workbook.Fonts);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void VerifyCanSetValue()
		{
			if (base.IsFrozen)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ReadOnlyFormat"));
			}
		}

		public void SetFormatting(IWorksheetCellFormat source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_SourceFormatting"));
			}
			VerifyCanSetValue();
			if (source is WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptions = _formatOptions;
				_font.SetFontFormatting(worksheetCellFormatData.FontInternal.Element);
				_alignment = worksheetCellFormatData._alignment;
				_bottomBorderColorInfo = worksheetCellFormatData._bottomBorderColorInfo;
				_bottomBorderStyle = worksheetCellFormatData._bottomBorderStyle;
				_diagonalBorderColorInfo = worksheetCellFormatData._diagonalBorderColorInfo;
				_diagonalBorders = worksheetCellFormatData._diagonalBorders;
				_diagonalBorderStyle = worksheetCellFormatData._diagonalBorderStyle;
				_fill = worksheetCellFormatData._fill;
				_formatOptions = worksheetCellFormatData._formatOptions;
				_formatStringIndex = worksheetCellFormatData._formatStringIndex;
				_indent = worksheetCellFormatData._indent;
				_leftBorderColorInfo = worksheetCellFormatData._leftBorderColorInfo;
				_leftBorderStyle = worksheetCellFormatData._leftBorderStyle;
				_locked = worksheetCellFormatData._locked;
				_rightBorderColorInfo = worksheetCellFormatData._rightBorderColorInfo;
				_rightBorderStyle = worksheetCellFormatData._rightBorderStyle;
				_rotation = worksheetCellFormatData._rotation;
				_shrinkToFit = worksheetCellFormatData._shrinkToFit;
				if (Type != WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat)
				{
					_style = worksheetCellFormatData._style;
				}
				_topBorderColorInfo = worksheetCellFormatData._topBorderColorInfo;
				_topBorderStyle = worksheetCellFormatData._topBorderStyle;
				_verticalAlignment = worksheetCellFormatData._verticalAlignment;
				_wrapText = worksheetCellFormatData._wrapText;
				_cachedHashCode = null;
				OnValueSet(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting);
				OnValueSet(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting);
				OnValueSet(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting);
				OnValueSet(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting);
				OnValueSet(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting);
				OnValueSet(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting);
				OnFormatOptionsChanged(formatOptions);
			}
			else
			{
				_font.SetFontFormatting(source.Font);
				FormatString = source.FormatString;
				Locked = source.Locked;
				WrapText = source.WrapText;
				ShrinkToFit = source.ShrinkToFit;
				Alignment = source.Alignment;
				VerticalAlignment = source.VerticalAlignment;
				Rotation = source.Rotation;
				Indent = source.Indent;
				LeftBorderStyle = source.LeftBorderStyle;
				RightBorderStyle = source.RightBorderStyle;
				TopBorderStyle = source.TopBorderStyle;
				BottomBorderStyle = source.BottomBorderStyle;
				LeftBorderColorInfo = source.LeftBorderColorInfo;
				RightBorderColorInfo = source.RightBorderColorInfo;
				TopBorderColorInfo = source.TopBorderColorInfo;
				BottomBorderColorInfo = source.BottomBorderColorInfo;
				Fill = source.Fill;
				DiagonalBorderColorInfo = source.DiagonalBorderColorInfo;
				DiagonalBorders = source.DiagonalBorders;
				DiagonalBorderStyle = source.DiagonalBorderStyle;
				if (Type == WorksheetCellFormatType.CellFormat)
				{
					Style = source.Style;
				}
				FormatOptions = source.FormatOptions;
			}
		}

		internal void CacheResolvedFormatOptionsValues(WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptionsToCopy, WorksheetCellFormatData styleFormat)
		{
			if (Type == WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat || formatOptionsToCopy == WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_cachedStyleValues == null)
			{
				_cachedStyleValues = new WorksheetCellFormatData(base.Workbook, WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat);
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToCopy, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting))
			{
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(styleFormat.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting))
				{
					_cachedStyleValues._formatStringIndex = styleFormat._formatStringIndex;
				}
				_cachedStyleValues.FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting;
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToCopy, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting))
			{
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(styleFormat.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting))
				{
					_cachedStyleValues._alignment = styleFormat._alignment;
					_cachedStyleValues._indent = styleFormat._indent;
					_cachedStyleValues._rotation = styleFormat._rotation;
					_cachedStyleValues._shrinkToFit = styleFormat._shrinkToFit;
					_cachedStyleValues._verticalAlignment = styleFormat._verticalAlignment;
					_cachedStyleValues._wrapText = styleFormat._wrapText;
				}
				_cachedStyleValues.FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting;
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToCopy, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting))
			{
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(styleFormat.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting))
				{
					WorkbookFontData workbookFontData = new WorkbookFontData(base.Workbook);
					WorkbookFontData element = styleFormat.FontInternal.Element;
					workbookFontData.Bold = element.Bold;
					workbookFontData.ColorInfo = element.ColorInfo;
					workbookFontData.Height = element.Height;
					workbookFontData.Italic = element.Italic;
					workbookFontData.Name = element.Name;
					workbookFontData.Strikeout = element.Strikeout;
					workbookFontData.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle = element.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle;
					workbookFontData.UnderlineStyle = element.UnderlineStyle;
					_cachedStyleValues.Font.SetFontFormatting(workbookFontData);
				}
				_cachedStyleValues.FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting;
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToCopy, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting))
			{
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(styleFormat.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting))
				{
					_cachedStyleValues._bottomBorderColorInfo = styleFormat._bottomBorderColorInfo;
					_cachedStyleValues._bottomBorderStyle = styleFormat._bottomBorderStyle;
					_cachedStyleValues._diagonalBorderColorInfo = styleFormat._diagonalBorderColorInfo;
					_cachedStyleValues._diagonalBorders = styleFormat._diagonalBorders;
					_cachedStyleValues._diagonalBorderStyle = styleFormat._diagonalBorderStyle;
					_cachedStyleValues._leftBorderColorInfo = styleFormat._leftBorderColorInfo;
					_cachedStyleValues._leftBorderStyle = styleFormat._leftBorderStyle;
					_cachedStyleValues._rightBorderColorInfo = styleFormat._rightBorderColorInfo;
					_cachedStyleValues._rightBorderStyle = styleFormat._rightBorderStyle;
					_cachedStyleValues._topBorderColorInfo = styleFormat._topBorderColorInfo;
					_cachedStyleValues._topBorderStyle = styleFormat._topBorderStyle;
				}
				_cachedStyleValues.FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting;
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToCopy, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting))
			{
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(styleFormat.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting))
				{
					_cachedStyleValues._fill = styleFormat._fill;
				}
				_cachedStyleValues.FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting;
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToCopy, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting))
			{
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(styleFormat.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting))
				{
					_cachedStyleValues._locked = styleFormat._locked;
				}
				_cachedStyleValues.FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting;
			}
			FormatOptions |= formatOptionsToCopy;
		}

		internal void Freeze()
		{
			if (!(base.Collection is GenericCachedCollection<WorksheetCellFormatData>))
			{
				base.IsFrozen = true;
				FontInternal.Element.Freeze();
			}
		}

		public static object GetDefaultValue(CellFormatValue value)
		{
			switch (value)
			{
			case CellFormatValue.Alignment:
				return KnownBoxes.HorizontalCellAlignment_Default;
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.FontColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.FontName:
			case CellFormatValue.FormatString:
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
				return null;
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
				return KnownBoxes.CellBorderLineStyle_Default;
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders:
				return KnownBoxes.DiagonalBorders_Default;
			case CellFormatValue.Fill:
				return null;
			case CellFormatValue.FontBold:
			case CellFormatValue.FontItalic:
			case CellFormatValue.FontStrikeout:
			case CellFormatValue.Locked:
			case CellFormatValue.ShrinkToFit:
			case CellFormatValue.WrapText:
				return KnownBoxes.ExcelDefaultableBoolean_Default;
			case CellFormatValue.FontHeight:
			case CellFormatValue.Indent:
			case CellFormatValue.Rotation:
				return KnownBoxes.Int32_NegativeOne;
			case CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle:
				return KnownBoxes.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle_Default;
			case CellFormatValue.FontUnderlineStyle:
				return KnownBoxes.FontUnderlineStyle_Default;
			case CellFormatValue.Style:
				return null;
			case CellFormatValue.VerticalAlignment:
				return KnownBoxes.VerticalCellAlignment_Default;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal FillPatternStyle GetFillPattern(CellFill fill)
		{
			return GetFillPattern(fill, this);
		}

		internal static FillPatternStyle GetFillPattern(CellFill fill, IWorksheetCellFormat format)
		{
			if (fill == null)
			{
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(format.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting))
				{
					return FillPatternStyle.None;
				}
				return FillPatternStyle.Default;
			}
			if (fill is CellFillPattern cellFillPattern)
			{
				return cellFillPattern.PatternStyle;
			}
			if (fill is CellFillGradient)
			{
				return FillPatternStyle.Solid;
			}
			return FillPatternStyle.Default;
		}

		internal WorkbookColorInfo GetFileFormatFillPatternColor(CellFill fill, bool backgroundColor, bool resolveNullValues)
		{
			return GetFileFormatFillPatternColor(fill, backgroundColor, resolveNullValues, this, DoesReverseColorsForSolidFill);
		}

		internal static WorkbookColorInfo GetFileFormatFillPatternColor(CellFill fill, bool backgroundColor, bool resolveNullValues, IWorksheetCellFormat format, bool doesReverseColorsForSolidFill)
		{
			WorkbookColorInfo workbookColorInfo = (backgroundColor ? new WorkbookColorInfo(SystemColorsInternal.WindowColor) : WorkbookColorInfo.Automatic);
			WorkbookColorInfo result = (resolveNullValues ? workbookColorInfo : null);
			if (fill == null)
			{
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(format.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting))
				{
					return workbookColorInfo;
				}
				return result;
			}
			if (fill is CellFillPattern cellFillPattern)
			{
				if (backgroundColor)
				{
					return cellFillPattern.GetFileFormatBackgroundColorInfo(doesReverseColorsForSolidFill);
				}
				return cellFillPattern.GetFileFormatForegroundColorInfo(doesReverseColorsForSolidFill);
			}
			if (fill is CellFillGradient cellFillGradient)
			{
				if (backgroundColor)
				{
					return WorkbookColorInfo.Automatic;
				}
				return cellFillGradient.Stops[0].ColorInfo;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal object GetResolvedValue(CellFormatValue property, GetAdjacentBorderValueCallback callback)
		{
			bool isFromAdjacentBorder;
			object resolvedValueHelper = GetResolvedValueHelper(property, callback, out isFromAdjacentBorder);
			if (!isFromAdjacentBorder && callback != null && Utilities.IsEdgeBorderValue(property) && object.Equals(resolvedValueHelper, GetUltimateDefault(property)))
			{
				CellFormatValue associatedBorderValue = Utilities.GetAssociatedBorderValue(property);
				object value = GetValue(associatedBorderValue);
				if ((IsValueDefault(associatedBorderValue, value) || object.Equals(value, GetUltimateDefault(associatedBorderValue))) && callback(property, out var value2))
				{
					return value2;
				}
			}
			return resolvedValueHelper;
		}

		private object GetResolvedValueHelper(CellFormatValue property, GetAdjacentBorderValueCallback callback, out bool isFromAdjacentBorder)
		{
			isFromAdjacentBorder = false;
			object value = GetValue(property);
			if (!IsValueDefault(property, value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatOptions flag = FormatOptionForValue(property);
			if (Type == WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat && !Utilities.TestFlag(FormatOptions, flag))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (callback != null && Type == WorksheetCellFormatType.CellFormat && Utilities.IsEdgeBorderValue(property) && callback(property, out value))
			{
				isFromAdjacentBorder = true;
				return value;
			}
			value = GetResolvedDefault(property, out var resolveThruStyleIfPossible);
			if (resolveThruStyleIfPossible && Type != WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat)
			{
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(FormatOptions, flag))
				{
					if (_cachedStyleValues != null)
					{
						value = _cachedStyleValues.GetResolvedValue(property);
					}
				}
				else if (Style != null)
				{
					value = Style.StyleFormatInternal.GetResolvedValue(property);
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public object GetValue(CellFormatValue valueToGet)
		{
			return valueToGet switch
			{
				CellFormatValue.Alignment => KnownBoxes.Get(Alignment), 
				CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo => BottomBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle => KnownBoxes.Get(BottomBorderStyle), 
				CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo => DiagonalBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders => KnownBoxes.Get(DiagonalBorders), 
				CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle => KnownBoxes.Get(DiagonalBorderStyle), 
				CellFormatValue.Fill => Fill, 
				CellFormatValue.FontBold => KnownBoxes.Get(Font.Bold), 
				CellFormatValue.FontColorInfo => Font.ColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.FontHeight => KnownBoxes.Get(Font.Height), 
				CellFormatValue.FontItalic => KnownBoxes.Get(Font.Italic), 
				CellFormatValue.FontName => Font.Name, 
				CellFormatValue.FontStrikeout => KnownBoxes.Get(Font.Strikeout), 
				CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle => KnownBoxes.Get(Font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle), 
				CellFormatValue.FontUnderlineStyle => KnownBoxes.Get(Font.UnderlineStyle), 
				CellFormatValue.FormatString => FormatString, 
				CellFormatValue.Indent => KnownBoxes.Get(Indent), 
				CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo => LeftBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle => KnownBoxes.Get(LeftBorderStyle), 
				CellFormatValue.Locked => KnownBoxes.Get(Locked), 
				CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo => RightBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle => KnownBoxes.Get(RightBorderStyle), 
				CellFormatValue.Rotation => KnownBoxes.Get(Rotation), 
				CellFormatValue.ShrinkToFit => KnownBoxes.Get(ShrinkToFit), 
				CellFormatValue.Style => Style, 
				CellFormatValue.FormatOptions => KnownBoxes.Get(FormatOptions), 
				CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo => TopBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle => KnownBoxes.Get(TopBorderStyle), 
				CellFormatValue.VerticalAlignment => KnownBoxes.Get(VerticalAlignment), 
				CellFormatValue.WrapText => KnownBoxes.Get(WrapText), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal List<ExtProp> GetXFEXTProps()
		{
			List<ExtProp> list = new List<ExtProp>();
			TryAddXFEXTColorInfo(BottomBorderColorInfoResolved, ExtPropType.BottomBorderColor, list);
			TryAddXFEXTColorInfo(DiagonalBorderColorInfoResolved, ExtPropType.DiagonalBorderColor, list);
			TryAddXFEXTColorInfo(LeftBorderColorInfoResolved, ExtPropType.LeftBorderColor, list);
			TryAddXFEXTColorInfo(RightBorderColorInfoResolved, ExtPropType.RightBorderColor, list);
			TryAddXFEXTColorInfo(TopBorderColorInfoResolved, ExtPropType.TopBorderColor, list);
			WorkbookColorInfo workbookColorInfo = VerifyFontColorInfoForSave(FontColorInfoResolved);
			if (workbookColorInfo != null)
			{
				list.Add(new ExtPropColor(workbookColorInfo, ExtPropType.CellTextColor));
			}
			FillResolved?.PopulateXFEXTProps(this, list);
			int indentResolved = IndentResolved;
			if (15 < indentResolved)
			{
				list.Add(new ExtPropTextIndentationLevel((ushort)indentResolved));
			}
			if (_fontScheme != FontScheme.Nil)
			{
				list.Add(new ExtPropFontScheme(_fontScheme));
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal List<XFProp> GetXFProps()
		{
			bool flag = Type == WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat;
			List<XFProp> list = new List<XFProp>();
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					if (Alignment != HorizontalCellAlignment.Default)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropHorizontalAlignment(Alignment));
					}
					if (Indent != -1)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropTextIndentationLevel((ushort)Math.Min(Indent, 15)));
					}
					if (Rotation != -1)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropTextRotation((byte)Rotation));
					}
					if (ShrinkToFit != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropBool(XFPropType.ShrinkToFit, ShrinkToFit));
					}
					if (VerticalAlignment != VerticalCellAlignment.Default)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropVerticalAlignment(VerticalAlignment));
					}
					if (WrapText != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropBool(XFPropType.WrappedText, WrapText));
					}
				}
				if (15 < Indent)
				{
					list.Add(new XFPropTextIndentationLevelRelative((short)(Indent - 15)));
				}
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting))
			{
				if (BottomBorderColorInfo != null || BottomBorderStyle != CellBorderLineStyle.Default)
				{
					list.Add(new XFPropBorder(XFPropType.BottomBorder, BottomBorderColorInfoResolved, BottomBorderStyleResolved));
				}
				if (DiagonalBorderColorInfo != null || TopBorderStyle != CellBorderLineStyle.Default)
				{
					list.Add(new XFPropBorder(XFPropType.TopBorder, TopBorderColorInfoResolved, TopBorderStyleResolved));
				}
				if (LeftBorderColorInfo != null || LeftBorderStyle != CellBorderLineStyle.Default)
				{
					list.Add(new XFPropBorder(XFPropType.LeftBorder, LeftBorderColorInfoResolved, LeftBorderStyleResolved));
				}
				if (RightBorderColorInfo != null || RightBorderStyle != CellBorderLineStyle.Default)
				{
					list.Add(new XFPropBorder(XFPropType.RightBorder, RightBorderColorInfoResolved, RightBorderStyleResolved));
				}
				if (BottomBorderColorInfo != null || TopBorderStyle != CellBorderLineStyle.Default)
				{
					list.Add(new XFPropBorder(XFPropType.TopBorder, TopBorderColorInfoResolved, TopBorderStyleResolved));
				}
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(DiagonalBorders, DiagonalBorders.DiagonalDown))
				{
					list.Add(new XFPropBool(XFPropType.DiagonalDownBorder, value: true));
				}
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(DiagonalBorders, DiagonalBorders.DiagonalUp))
				{
					list.Add(new XFPropBool(XFPropType.DiagonalUpBorder, value: true));
				}
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting))
			{
				FillResolved?.PopulateXFProps(this, list);
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					WorkbookFontData element = FontInternal.Element;
					if (element.Bold != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropFontBold(element.Bold));
					}
					if (element.ColorInfo != null)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropColor(XFPropType.FontColor, VerifyFontColorInfoForSave(element.ColorInfo)));
					}
					if (element.Height != -1)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropFontHeight((uint)element.Height));
					}
					if (element.Italic != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropBool(XFPropType.FontItalic, element.Italic));
					}
					if (element.Name != null)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropFontName(element.Name));
					}
					if (element.Strikeout != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropBool(XFPropType.FontItalic, element.Strikeout));
					}
					if (element.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle != FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.Default)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropFontSubscriptSuperscript(element.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle));
					}
					if (element.UnderlineStyle != FontUnderlineStyle.Default)
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropFontUnderline(element.UnderlineStyle));
					}
				}
				if (_fontScheme != FontScheme.Nil)
				{
					list.Add(new XFPropFontScheme(_fontScheme));
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting) && FormatStringIndex != -1)
				{
					if (base.Workbook != null && base.Workbook.Formats.IsStandardFormat(FormatStringIndex))
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropNumberFormatId((ushort)FormatStringIndex));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(new XFPropNumberFormat((ushort)FormatStringIndex, FormatString));
					}
				}
				if (Utilities.TestFlag(FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting) && Locked != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
				{
					list.Add(new XFPropBool(XFPropType.Locked, Locked));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal bool IsAnyBorderPropertySet()
		{
			if (!(BottomBorderColorInfo != null) && BottomBorderStyle == CellBorderLineStyle.Default && !(DiagonalBorderColorInfo != null) && DiagonalBorders == DiagonalBorders.Default && DiagonalBorderStyle == CellBorderLineStyle.Default && !(LeftBorderColorInfo != null) && LeftBorderStyle == CellBorderLineStyle.Default && !(RightBorderColorInfo != null) && RightBorderStyle == CellBorderLineStyle.Default && !(TopBorderColorInfo != null))
			{
				return TopBorderStyle != CellBorderLineStyle.Default;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsValueDefault(CellFormatValue value, object testValue)
		{
			if (value == CellFormatValue.FormatOptions)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return object.Equals(testValue, GetDefaultValue(value));
		}

		internal void OnFontChanged()
		{
			if (FontNameResolved == "Calibri")
			{
				_fontScheme = FontScheme.Minor;
			}
			else if (FontNameResolved == "Cambria")
			{
				_fontScheme = FontScheme.Major;
			}
			else
			{
				_fontScheme = FontScheme.Nil;
			}
			OnValueSet(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting);
		}

		internal void ResetValue(CellFormatValue value)
		{
			SetValue(value, GetDefaultValue(value));
		}

		public void SetValue(CellFormatValue valueToSet, object value)
		{
			switch (valueToSet)
			{
			case CellFormatValue.Alignment:
				Alignment = (HorizontalCellAlignment)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
				BottomBorderColorInfo = (WorkbookColorInfo)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
				BottomBorderStyle = (CellBorderLineStyle)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo:
				DiagonalBorderColorInfo = (WorkbookColorInfo)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders:
				DiagonalBorders = (DiagonalBorders)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle:
				DiagonalBorderStyle = (CellBorderLineStyle)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.Fill:
				Fill = (CellFill)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontBold:
				Font.Bold = (ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontColorInfo:
				Font.ColorInfo = (WorkbookColorInfo)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontHeight:
				Font.Height = (int)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontItalic:
				Font.Italic = (ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontName:
				Font.Name = (string)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontStrikeout:
				Font.Strikeout = (ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle:
				Font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle = (FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontUnderlineStyle:
				Font.UnderlineStyle = (FontUnderlineStyle)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FormatString:
				FormatString = (string)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.Indent:
				Indent = (int)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
				LeftBorderColorInfo = (WorkbookColorInfo)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
				LeftBorderStyle = (CellBorderLineStyle)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.Locked:
				Locked = (ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
				RightBorderColorInfo = (WorkbookColorInfo)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
				RightBorderStyle = (CellBorderLineStyle)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.Rotation:
				Rotation = (int)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.ShrinkToFit:
				ShrinkToFit = (ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.Style:
				Style = (WorkbookStyle)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FormatOptions:
				FormatOptions = (WorksheetCellFormatOptions)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
				TopBorderColorInfo = (WorkbookColorInfo)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
				TopBorderStyle = (CellBorderLineStyle)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.VerticalAlignment:
				VerticalAlignment = (VerticalCellAlignment)value;
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.WrapText:
				WrapText = (ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value;
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void TryAddXFEXTColorInfo(WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo, ExtPropType propType, List<ExtProp> xfextProps)
		{
			if (!(colorInfo == null))
			{
				ColorableItem item;
				switch (propType)
				{
				case ExtPropType.TopBorderColor:
				case ExtPropType.BottomBorderColor:
				case ExtPropType.LeftBorderColor:
				case ExtPropType.RightBorderColor:
				case ExtPropType.DiagonalBorderColor:
					item = ColorableItem.CellBorder;
					break;
				case ExtPropType.CellTextColor:
					item = ColorableItem.CellFont;
					break;
				case ExtPropType.ForegroundColor:
				case ExtPropType.BackgroundColor:
					item = ColorableItem.CellFill;
					break;
				default:
					item = ColorableItem.CellBorder;
					break;
				}
				if (!colorInfo.IsSupportedIn2003(base.Workbook, item))
				{
					xfextProps.Add(new ExtPropColor(colorInfo, propType));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void TryAddXFPropColorInfo(WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo, XFPropType propType, List<XFProp> xfextProps)
		{
			if (!(colorInfo == null))
			{
				ColorableItem item;
				switch (propType)
				{
				case XFPropType.ForegroundColor:
				case XFPropType.BackgroundColor:
					item = ColorableItem.CellFill;
					break;
				default:
					item = ColorableItem.CellBorder;
					break;
				}
				if (!colorInfo.IsSupportedIn2003(base.Workbook, item))
				{
					xfextProps.Add(new XFPropColor(propType, colorInfo));
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ConvertColorForBorder(ref WorkbookColorInfo color)
		{
			if (!(color == null) && color.Color.HasValue && color.Color.Value == SystemColorsInternal.WindowFrameColor)
			{
				color = new WorkbookColorInfo(SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColor, null, color.Tint, isLoading: false);
			}
		}

		private WorkbookStyle EnsureNonNullStyle(WorkbookStyle style)
		{
			if (style == null && Type != WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat && base.Workbook != null)
			{
				return base.Workbook.Styles.NormalStyle;
			}
			return style;
		}

		private WorksheetCellFormatOptions FilterOutOptionsWithAllUltimateDefaults(WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptions)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatOptions result = WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None;
			FilterOutOptionsWithAllUltimateDefaultsHelper(formatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting, ref result);
			FilterOutOptionsWithAllUltimateDefaultsHelper(formatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting, ref result);
			FilterOutOptionsWithAllUltimateDefaultsHelper(formatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting, ref result);
			FilterOutOptionsWithAllUltimateDefaultsHelper(formatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting, ref result);
			FilterOutOptionsWithAllUltimateDefaultsHelper(formatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting, ref result);
			FilterOutOptionsWithAllUltimateDefaultsHelper(formatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting, ref result);
			return result;
		}

		private void FilterOutOptionsWithAllUltimateDefaultsHelper(WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions option, ref WorksheetCellFormatOptions result)
		{
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptions, option) && !HasAllUltimateDefaults(option))
			{
				result |= option;
			}
		}

		internal static WorksheetCellFormatOptions FormatOptionForValue(CellFormatValue value)
		{
			switch (value)
			{
			case CellFormatValue.Alignment:
			case CellFormatValue.Indent:
			case CellFormatValue.Rotation:
			case CellFormatValue.ShrinkToFit:
			case CellFormatValue.VerticalAlignment:
			case CellFormatValue.WrapText:
				return WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting;
			case CellFormatValue.Fill:
				return WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting;
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders:
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
				return WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting;
			case CellFormatValue.FormatString:
				return WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting;
			case CellFormatValue.Locked:
				return WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting;
			case CellFormatValue.FontBold:
			case CellFormatValue.FontColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.FontHeight:
			case CellFormatValue.FontItalic:
			case CellFormatValue.FontName:
			case CellFormatValue.FontStrikeout:
			case CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.FontUnderlineStyle:
				return WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting;
			case CellFormatValue.FormatOptions:
			case CellFormatValue.Style:
				return WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None;
			default:
				return WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None;
			}
		}

		private static CellFormatValue GetAssociatedValues(WorksheetCellFormatOptions styleOption)
		{
			return styleOption switch
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting => CellFormatValue.NumberFormattingProperties, 
				WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting => CellFormatValue.AlignmentFormattingProperties, 
				WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting => CellFormatValue.FontFormattingProperties, 
				WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting => CellFormatValue.BorderFormattingProperties, 
				WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting => CellFormatValue.FillFormattingProperties, 
				WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting => CellFormatValue.ProtectionFormattingProperties, 
				_ => (CellFormatValue)0, 
			};
		}

		private void GetChangesRequiredForChangedFormatOption(WorksheetCellFormatOptions oldFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptionToTest, ref WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptionsToReset, ref WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptionsToCopyFromStyle)
		{
			bool flag = Utilities.TestFlag(oldFormatOptions, formatOptionToTest);
			bool flag2 = Utilities.TestFlag(FormatOptions, formatOptionToTest);
			if (flag != flag2)
			{
				if (!flag2)
				{
					formatOptionsToReset |= formatOptionToTest;
				}
				else
				{
					formatOptionsToCopyFromStyle |= formatOptionToTest;
				}
			}
		}

		private object GetResolvedDefault(CellFormatValue value, out bool resolveThruStyleIfPossible)
		{
			resolveThruStyleIfPossible = true;
			switch (value)
			{
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle:
			{
				WorkbookColorInfo diagonalBorderColorInfo = DiagonalBorderColorInfo;
				DiagonalBorders diagonalBorders = DiagonalBorders;
				if (diagonalBorderColorInfo != null || Utilities.TestFlag(diagonalBorders, DiagonalBorders.DiagonalDown) || Utilities.TestFlag(diagonalBorders, DiagonalBorders.DiagonalUp))
				{
					resolveThruStyleIfPossible = false;
					return CellBorderLineStyle.Thin;
				}
				break;
			}
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
			{
				WorkbookColorInfo workbookColorInfo = (WorkbookColorInfo)GetValue(Utilities.GetAssociatedBorderValue(value));
				if (workbookColorInfo != null)
				{
					resolveThruStyleIfPossible = false;
					return CellBorderLineStyle.Thin;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return GetUltimateDefault(value);
		}

		private object GetResolvedValue(CellFormatValue property)
		{
			return GetResolvedValue(property, null);
		}

		private static object GetUltimateDefault(CellFormatValue value)
		{
			switch (value)
			{
			case CellFormatValue.Alignment:
				return KnownBoxes.HorizontalCellAlignment_General;
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.FontColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
				return WorkbookColorInfo.Automatic;
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
				return KnownBoxes.CellBorderLineStyle_None;
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders:
				return KnownBoxes.DiagonalBorders_None;
			case CellFormatValue.Fill:
				return CellFill.NoColor;
			case CellFormatValue.FontBold:
			case CellFormatValue.FontItalic:
			case CellFormatValue.FontStrikeout:
			case CellFormatValue.ShrinkToFit:
			case CellFormatValue.WrapText:
				return KnownBoxes.ExcelDefaultableBoolean_False;
			case CellFormatValue.FontHeight:
				return WorkbookFontData.DefaultFontHeightBox;
			case CellFormatValue.FontName:
				return "Calibri";
			case CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle:
				return KnownBoxes.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle_None;
			case CellFormatValue.FontUnderlineStyle:
				return KnownBoxes.FontUnderlineStyle_None;
			case CellFormatValue.FormatString:
				return "General";
			case CellFormatValue.Indent:
			case CellFormatValue.Rotation:
				return KnownBoxes.Int32_Zero;
			case CellFormatValue.Locked:
				return KnownBoxes.ExcelDefaultableBoolean_True;
			case CellFormatValue.VerticalAlignment:
				return KnownBoxes.VerticalCellAlignment_Bottom;
			case CellFormatValue.FormatOptions:
			case CellFormatValue.Style:
				return null;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public bool HasAllUltimateDefaults(WorksheetCellFormatOptions option)
		{
			CellFormatValue associatedValues = GetAssociatedValues(option);
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue << 1))
			{
				if ((associatedValues & cellFormatValue) != 0 && !object.Equals(GetResolvedValue(cellFormatValue), GetUltimateDefault(cellFormatValue)))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnValueSet(CellFormatValue property)
		{
			OnValueSet(FormatOptionForValue(property));
		}

		private void OnValueSet(WorksheetCellFormatOptions associatedStyleOption)
		{
			_cachedHashCode = null;
			switch (associatedStyleOption)
			{
			case WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting:
				UpdateUseNumberFormattingFlag();
				break;
			case WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting:
				UpdateUseAlignmentFormattingFlag();
				break;
			case WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting:
				UpdateUseFontFormattingFlag();
				break;
			case WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting:
				UpdateUseBorderFormattingFlag();
				break;
			case WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting:
				UpdateUsePatternsFormattingFlag();
				break;
			case WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting:
				UpdateUseProtectionFormattingFlag();
				break;
			}
			if (_valueChangeCallback != null)
			{
				_valueChangeCallback(associatedStyleOption);
			}
		}

		internal void ResetFormatOptions(WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptionsToReset)
		{
			if (formatOptionsToReset == WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToReset, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting))
			{
				_formatStringIndex = -1;
				if (_valueChangeCallback != null)
				{
					_valueChangeCallback(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting);
				}
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToReset, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting))
			{
				_alignment = HorizontalCellAlignment.Default;
				_indent = -1;
				_rotation = -1;
				_shrinkToFit = ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default;
				_wrapText = ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default;
				_verticalAlignment = VerticalCellAlignment.Default;
				if (_valueChangeCallback != null)
				{
					_valueChangeCallback(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting);
				}
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToReset, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting))
			{
				if (_font == null)
				{
					_font = new WorkbookFontProxy(new WorkbookFontData(base.Workbook), base.Workbook, this);
				}
				else
				{
					_font.SetFontFormatting(new WorkbookFontData(base.Workbook));
				}
				if (_valueChangeCallback != null)
				{
					_valueChangeCallback(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting);
				}
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToReset, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting))
			{
				_bottomBorderColorInfo = null;
				_bottomBorderStyle = CellBorderLineStyle.Default;
				_diagonalBorderColorInfo = null;
				_diagonalBorders = DiagonalBorders.Default;
				_diagonalBorderStyle = CellBorderLineStyle.Default;
				_leftBorderColorInfo = null;
				_leftBorderStyle = CellBorderLineStyle.Default;
				_rightBorderColorInfo = null;
				_rightBorderStyle = CellBorderLineStyle.Default;
				_topBorderColorInfo = null;
				_topBorderStyle = CellBorderLineStyle.Default;
				if (_valueChangeCallback != null)
				{
					_valueChangeCallback(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting);
				}
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToReset, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting))
			{
				_fill = null;
				if (_valueChangeCallback != null)
				{
					_valueChangeCallback(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting);
				}
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatOptionsToReset, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting))
			{
				_locked = ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default;
				if (_valueChangeCallback != null)
				{
					_valueChangeCallback(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting);
				}
			}
			_cachedHashCode = null;
			if (_cachedStyleValues != null)
			{
				_cachedStyleValues.FormatOptions &= ~formatOptionsToReset;
				if (_cachedStyleValues.FormatOptions == WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None)
				{
					_cachedStyleValues = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateUseAlignmentFormattingFlag()
		{
			if (Alignment != HorizontalCellAlignment.Default || Indent != -1 || Rotation != -1 || ShrinkToFit != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default || VerticalAlignment != VerticalCellAlignment.Default || WrapText != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
			{
				FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateUseBorderFormattingFlag()
		{
			if (IsAnyBorderPropertySet())
			{
				FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateUseFontFormattingFlag()
		{
			if (!FontInternal.Element.IsEmpty)
			{
				FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateUseNumberFormattingFlag()
		{
			if (FormatString != null)
			{
				FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateUsePatternsFormattingFlag()
		{
			if (Fill != null)
			{
				FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateUseProtectionFormattingFlag()
		{
			if (Locked != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
			{
				FormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting;
			}
		}

		private WorkbookColorInfo VerifyFontColorInfoForSave(WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo)
		{
			if (colorInfo != null && base.Workbook != null)
			{
				int num = base.Workbook.Palette.FindIndex(colorInfo, ColorableItem.CellFont);
				if (66 <= num && num <= 81)
				{
					Color color = Utilities.ColorFromArgb(Utilities.ColorToArgb(colorInfo.GetResolvedColor(base.Workbook)));
					return new WorkbookColorInfo(color);
				}
			}
			return colorInfo;
		}

		internal void SetFormatOptionsInternal(WorksheetCellFormatOptions value)
		{
			_formatOptions = value;
			_cachedHashCode = null;
			if (_valueChangeCallback != null)
			{
				_valueChangeCallback(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.All);
			}
		}

		private void OnFormatOptionsChanged(WorksheetCellFormatOptions oldFormatOptions)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptionsToReset = WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None;
			WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptionsToCopyFromStyle = WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None;
			GetChangesRequiredForChangedFormatOption(oldFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting, ref formatOptionsToReset, ref formatOptionsToCopyFromStyle);
			GetChangesRequiredForChangedFormatOption(oldFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting, ref formatOptionsToReset, ref formatOptionsToCopyFromStyle);
			GetChangesRequiredForChangedFormatOption(oldFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting, ref formatOptionsToReset, ref formatOptionsToCopyFromStyle);
			GetChangesRequiredForChangedFormatOption(oldFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting, ref formatOptionsToReset, ref formatOptionsToCopyFromStyle);
			GetChangesRequiredForChangedFormatOption(oldFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting, ref formatOptionsToReset, ref formatOptionsToCopyFromStyle);
			GetChangesRequiredForChangedFormatOption(oldFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting, ref formatOptionsToReset, ref formatOptionsToCopyFromStyle);
			ResetFormatOptions(formatOptionsToReset);
			if (Style != null)
			{
				CacheResolvedFormatOptionsValues(formatOptionsToCopyFromStyle, Style.StyleFormatInternal);
			}
		}

		internal void SetStyleInternal(WorkbookStyle style)
		{
			_style = style;
			_cachedHashCode = null;
			if (_valueChangeCallback != null)
			{
				_valueChangeCallback(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.All);
			}
		}
	}

		internal virtual bool GetAdjacentBorderValue(CellFormatValue borderProperty, out object value)
		{
			value = null;
			if (_proxy.Owner == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatData adjacentFormatForBorderResolution = _proxy.Owner.GetAdjacentFormatForBorderResolution(_proxy, borderProperty);
			if (adjacentFormatForBorderResolution == null || !Utilities.TestFlag(adjacentFormatForBorderResolution.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting))
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = adjacentFormatForBorderResolution.GetResolvedValue(Utilities.GetOppositeBorderValue(borderProperty), null);
			return true;
		}

			ThrowOnSet();
		}

		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ResolvedFormatCannotBeModified"));
		}

	internal abstract class WorksheetCellFormatProxy : GenericCacheElementProxy<WorksheetCellFormatData>, IWorksheetCellFormat
	{
		private WorkbookFontOwnerAccessor fontAccessor;

		private IWorksheetCellFormatProxyOwner owner;

		Color IWorksheetCellFormat.BottomBorderColor
		{
			get
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = Element;

			: this((parentCollection == null) ? new WorksheetCellFormatData(null, WorksheetCellFormatType.CellFormat) : parentCollection.Workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement, parentCollection, owner)
		{
		}

		private CellFormatValue GetDifferences(IWorksheetCellFormat source)
		{
			return GetDifferences(source, Element);
		}

		internal static CellFormatValue GetDifferences(IWorksheetCellFormat source, WorksheetCellFormatData formatData)
		{
			CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)0;
			if (formatData.Alignment != source.Alignment)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.Alignment;
			}
			if (formatData.BottomBorderColorInfo != source.BottomBorderColorInfo)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo;
			}
			if (formatData.BottomBorderStyle != source.BottomBorderStyle)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle;
			}
			if (formatData.DiagonalBorderColorInfo != source.DiagonalBorderColorInfo)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo;
			}
			if (formatData.DiagonalBorders != source.DiagonalBorders)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders;
			}
			if (formatData.DiagonalBorderStyle != source.DiagonalBorderStyle)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(formatData.Fill, source.Fill))
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.Fill;
			}
			if (source is WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData)
			{
				if (formatData.FormatStringIndex != worksheetCellFormatData.FormatStringIndex)
				{
					cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FormatString;
				}
			}
			else if (source is WorksheetCellFormatProxy worksheetCellFormatProxy)
			{
				if (formatData.FormatStringIndex != worksheetCellFormatProxy.Element.FormatStringIndex)
				{
					cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FormatString;
				}
			}
			else if (formatData.FormatString != source.FormatString)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FormatString;
			}
			if (formatData.Indent != source.Indent)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.Indent;
			}
			if (formatData.LeftBorderColorInfo != source.LeftBorderColorInfo)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo;
			}
			if (formatData.LeftBorderStyle != source.LeftBorderStyle)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle;
			}
			if (formatData.Locked != source.Locked)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.Locked;
			}
			if (formatData.RightBorderColorInfo != source.RightBorderColorInfo)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo;
			}
			if (formatData.RightBorderStyle != source.RightBorderStyle)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle;
			}
			if (formatData.Rotation != source.Rotation)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.Rotation;
			}
			if (formatData.ShrinkToFit != source.ShrinkToFit)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.ShrinkToFit;
			}
			if (formatData.Style != source.Style)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.Style;
			}
			if (formatData.FormatOptions != source.FormatOptions)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.FormatOptions;
			}
			if (formatData.TopBorderColorInfo != source.TopBorderColorInfo)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo;
			}
			if (formatData.TopBorderStyle != source.TopBorderStyle)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle;
			}
			if (formatData.VerticalAlignment != source.VerticalAlignment)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.VerticalAlignment;
			}
			if (formatData.WrapText != source.WrapText)
			{
				cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.WrapText;
			}
			return cellFormatValue | WorkbookFontProxy.GetDifferences(formatData.Font, source.Font);
		}

		internal void SetFontProperty<TValue>(TValue value, CellFormatValue valueType, bool callBeforeAndAfterSet, CellFormatValueChangedOptions options, Func<IWorkbookFont, TValue> propertyGetter, Action<IWorkbookFont, TValue> propertySetter)
		{
			TValue y = propertyGetter(FontInternal);
			if (EqualityComparer<TValue>.Default.Equals(value, y))
			{
				if ((options & CellFormatValueChangedOptions.AlwaysSendChangeNotifications) != CellFormatValueChangedOptions.DefaultBehavior)
				{
					OnPropertyChanging(valueType);
					OnPropertyChanged(valueType, options);
				}
				return;
			}
			OnPropertyChanging(valueType);
			GenericCachedCollection<WorksheetCellFormatData> collection = null;
			if (callBeforeAndAfterSet)
			{
				collection = BeforeSet();
			}
			propertySetter(Element.FontInternal, value);
			if (callBeforeAndAfterSet)
			{
				AfterSet(collection);
			}
			OnPropertyChanged(valueType, options);
		}

		private bool SetFormatProperty<TValue>(TValue value, CellFormatValue valueType, bool callBeforeAndAfterSet, CellFormatValueChangedOptions options, Func<WorksheetCellFormatData, TValue> propertyGetter, Action<WorksheetCellFormatData, TValue> propertySetter)
		{
			TValue y = propertyGetter(Element);
			if (EqualityComparer<TValue>.Default.Equals(value, y))
			{
				if ((options & CellFormatValueChangedOptions.AlwaysSendChangeNotifications) != CellFormatValueChangedOptions.DefaultBehavior)
				{
					OnPropertyChanging(valueType);
					OnPropertyChanged(valueType, options);
				}
				return false;
			}
			OnPropertyChanging(valueType);
			GenericCachedCollection<WorksheetCellFormatData> collection = null;
			if (callBeforeAndAfterSet)
			{
				collection = BeforeSet();
			}
			propertySetter(Element, value);
			if (callBeforeAndAfterSet)
			{
				AfterSet(collection);
			}
			OnPropertyChanged(valueType, options);
			return true;
		}

		public void SetFormatting(IWorksheetCellFormat source)
		{
			SetFormatting(source, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.DefaultBehavior);
		}

		internal void SetFormatting(IWorksheetCellFormat source, CellFormatValueChangedOptions options)
		{
			_ = Element.Workbook;
			WorksheetCellFormatType type = element.Type;
			CellFormatValue differences = GetDifferences(source);
			if (differences != 0)
			{
				OnPropertyChanging(differences);
			}
			SetFormattingHelper(source);
			if (element.Type != type)
			{
				GenericCachedCollection<WorksheetCellFormatData> collection = BeforeSet();
				element.Type = type;
				AfterSet(collection);
			}
			if (differences != 0)
			{
				OnPropertyChanged(differences, options);
			}
		}

		internal void SetFormattingHelper(IWorksheetCellFormat source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_SourceFormatting"));
			}
			if (source is WorksheetCellFormatData toElementHelper)
			{
				SetToElementHelper(toElementHelper);
				return;
			}
			if (source is WorksheetCellFormatProxy worksheetCellFormatProxy)
			{
				SetToElementHelper(worksheetCellFormatProxy.Element);
				return;
			}
			GenericCachedCollection<WorksheetCellFormatData> collection = BeforeSet();
			Element.SetFormatting(source);
			AfterSet(collection);
		}

		private void SetToElementHelper(WorksheetCellFormatData data)
		{
			SetToElement(data);
		}

		public void SetValue(CellFormatValue valueToSet, object value)
		{
			SetValue(valueToSet, value, callBeforeAndAfterSet: true, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.DefaultBehavior);
		}

		public void SetValue(CellFormatValue valueToSet, object value, bool callBeforeAndAfterSet, CellFormatValueChangedOptions options)
		{
			switch (valueToSet)
			{
			case CellFormatValue.Alignment:
				SetAlignment((HorizontalCellAlignment)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
				SetBottomBorderColorInfo((WorkbookColorInfo)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
				SetBottomBorderStyle((CellBorderLineStyle)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo:
				SetDiagonalBorderColorInfo((WorkbookColorInfo)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders:
				SetDiagonalBorders((DiagonalBorders)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle:
				SetDiagonalBorderStyle((CellBorderLineStyle)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.Fill:
				SetFill((CellFill)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontBold:
				FontInternal.SetBold((ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontColorInfo:
				FontInternal.SetColorInfo((WorkbookColorInfo)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontHeight:
				FontInternal.SetHeight((int)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontItalic:
				FontInternal.SetItalic((ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontName:
				FontInternal.SetName((string)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontStrikeout:
				FontInternal.SetStrikeout((ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle:
				FontInternal.SetSuperscriptSubscriptStyle((FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FontUnderlineStyle:
				FontInternal.SetUnderlineStyle((FontUnderlineStyle)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FormatOptions:
				SetFormatOptions((WorksheetCellFormatOptions)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.FormatString:
				SetFormatString((string)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.Indent:
				SetIndent((int)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
				SetLeftBorderColorInfo((WorkbookColorInfo)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
				SetLeftBorderStyle((CellBorderLineStyle)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.Locked:
				SetLocked((ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
				SetRightBorderColorInfo((WorkbookColorInfo)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
				SetRightBorderStyle((CellBorderLineStyle)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.Rotation:
				SetRotation((int)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.ShrinkToFit:
				SetShrinkToFit((ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.Style:
				SetStyle((WorkbookStyle)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
				SetTopBorderColorInfo((WorkbookColorInfo)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
				SetTopBorderStyle((CellBorderLineStyle)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.VerticalAlignment:
				SetVerticalAlignment((VerticalCellAlignment)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.WrapText:
				SetWrapText((ExcelDefaultableBoolean)value, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				break;
			}
		}
