	public abstract class DisplayOptions
	{
		internal const int DefaultMagnificationInPageBreakView = 60;

		internal const int DefaultMagnificationInPageLayoutView = 100;

		internal const int DefaultMagnificationInNormalView = 100;

		private Worksheet worksheet;

		private FrozenPaneSettings frozenPaneSettings;

		private bool useAutomaticGridlineColor = true;

		private int gridlineColorIndex = 64;

		private bool panesAreFrozen;

		private ExcelDefaultableBoolean showExpansionIndicatorBelowGroupedRows;

		private ExcelDefaultableBoolean showExpansionIndicatorToRightOfGroupedColumns;

		private bool showFormulasInCells;

		private bool showGridlines = true;

		private bool showOutlineSymbols = true;

		private bool showRowAndColumnHeaders = true;

		private bool showRulerInPageLayoutView = true;

		private bool showZeroValues = true;

		private UnfrozenPaneSettings unfrozenPaneSettings;

		private WorksheetView view;

		private WorksheetVisibility visibility;

		private WorksheetSelection selection;

		private PaneLocation activePane = PaneLocation.TopLeft;

		public FrozenPaneSettings FrozenPaneSettings
		{
			get
			{
				if (frozenPaneSettings == null)
				{
					frozenPaneSettings = new FrozenPaneSettings(this);
				}
				return frozenPaneSettings;
			}
		}

		public Color GridlineColor
		{
			get
			{
				return worksheet.Workbook.Palette.GetColorAtAbsoluteIndex(gridlineColorIndex).ToNative();
			}
			set
			{
				if (GridlineColor != value)
				{
					if (Utilities.ColorIsEmpty(value))
					{
						gridlineColorIndex = 64;
						useAutomaticGridlineColor = true;
					}
					else
					{
						gridlineColorIndex = worksheet.Workbook.Palette.FindIndex(value, ColorableItem.WorksheetGrid);
						useAutomaticGridlineColor = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool PanesAreFrozen
		{
			get
			{
				return panesAreFrozen;
			}
			set
			{
				panesAreFrozen = value;
			}
		}

		public ExcelDefaultableBoolean ShowExpansionIndicatorBelowGroupedRows
		{
			get
			{
				return showExpansionIndicatorBelowGroupedRows;
			}
			set
			{
				showExpansionIndicatorBelowGroupedRows = value;
			}
		}

		public ExcelDefaultableBoolean ShowExpansionIndicatorToRightOfGroupedColumns
		{
			get
			{
				return showExpansionIndicatorToRightOfGroupedColumns;
			}
			set
			{
				showExpansionIndicatorToRightOfGroupedColumns = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShowFormulasInCells
		{
			get
			{
				return showFormulasInCells;
			}
			set
			{
				showFormulasInCells = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShowGridlines
		{
			get
			{
				return showGridlines;
			}
			set
			{
				showGridlines = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShowOutlineSymbols
		{
			get
			{
				return showOutlineSymbols;
			}
			set
			{
				showOutlineSymbols = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShowRowAndColumnHeaders
		{
			get
			{
				return showRowAndColumnHeaders;
			}
			set
			{
				showRowAndColumnHeaders = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShowRulerInPageLayoutView
		{
			get
			{
				return showRulerInPageLayoutView;
			}
			set
			{
				showRulerInPageLayoutView = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShowZeroValues
		{
			get
			{
				return showZeroValues;
			}
			set
			{
				showZeroValues = value;
			}
		}

		public UnfrozenPaneSettings UnfrozenPaneSettings
		{
			get
			{
				if (unfrozenPaneSettings == null)
				{
					unfrozenPaneSettings = new UnfrozenPaneSettings(this);
				}
				return unfrozenPaneSettings;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetView View
		{
			get
			{
				return view;
			}
			set
			{
				if (view != value)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(WorksheetView), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(WorksheetView));
					}
					SetView(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public WorksheetVisibility Visibility
		{
			get
			{
				return visibility;
			}
			set
			{
				if (visibility != value)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(WorksheetVisibility), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(WorksheetVisibility));
					}
					visibility = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal PaneLocation ActivePane
		{
			get
			{
				return activePane;
			}
			set
			{
				activePane = value;
			}
		}

		internal int GridlineColorIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return gridlineColorIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				_ = useAutomaticGridlineColor;
				gridlineColorIndex = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasSelection => selection != null;

		internal WorksheetSelection Selection
		{
			get
			{
				if (selection == null)
				{
					selection = new WorksheetSelection();
				}
				return selection;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowExpansionIndicatorBelowGroupedRowsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (showExpansionIndicatorBelowGroupedRows != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
				{
					return showExpansionIndicatorBelowGroupedRows == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True;
				}
				return Worksheet.ShowExpansionIndicatorBelowGroup;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowExpansionIndicatorToRightOfGroupedColumnsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (showExpansionIndicatorToRightOfGroupedColumns != ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
				{
					return showExpansionIndicatorToRightOfGroupedColumns == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool UseAutomaticGridlineColor
		{
			get
			{
				return useAutomaticGridlineColor;
			}
			set
			{
				useAutomaticGridlineColor = value;
			}
		}

		internal Worksheet Worksheet => worksheet;

		internal DisplayOptions(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetCore();
		}

		protected virtual void ResetCore()
		{
			if (frozenPaneSettings != null)
			{
				frozenPaneSettings.ResetCore();
			}
			useAutomaticGridlineColor = true;
			gridlineColorIndex = 64;
			panesAreFrozen = false;
			showFormulasInCells = false;
			showGridlines = true;
			showOutlineSymbols = true;
			showRowAndColumnHeaders = true;
			showRulerInPageLayoutView = true;
			showZeroValues = true;
			showExpansionIndicatorToRightOfGroupedColumns = ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default;
			showExpansionIndicatorBelowGroupedRows = ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default;
			if (unfrozenPaneSettings != null)
			{
				unfrozenPaneSettings.ResetCore();
			}
			ClearSelection();
			activePane = PaneLocation.TopLeft;
			view = WorksheetView.Normal;
			visibility = WorksheetVisibility.Visible;
		}

		internal virtual void InitializeFrom(DisplayOptions displayOptions)
		{
			FrozenPaneSettings.InitializeFrom(displayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings);
			useAutomaticGridlineColor = displayOptions.useAutomaticGridlineColor;
			gridlineColorIndex = displayOptions.gridlineColorIndex;
			panesAreFrozen = displayOptions.panesAreFrozen;
			showFormulasInCells = displayOptions.showFormulasInCells;
			showGridlines = displayOptions.showGridlines;
			showOutlineSymbols = displayOptions.showOutlineSymbols;
			showRowAndColumnHeaders = displayOptions.showRowAndColumnHeaders;
			showRulerInPageLayoutView = displayOptions.showRulerInPageLayoutView;
			showZeroValues = displayOptions.showZeroValues;
			UnfrozenPaneSettings.InitializeFrom(displayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings);
			view = displayOptions.view;
			visibility = displayOptions.visibility;
			if (displayOptions.HasSelection)
			{
				Selection.InitializeFrom(displayOptions.Selection);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearSelection();
			}
			activePane = displayOptions.activePane;
		}

		internal virtual void SetView(WorksheetView newView)
		{
			view = newView;
		}

		public void ClearSelection()
		{
			activePane = PaneLocation.TopLeft;
			selection = null;
		}

		internal void OnCurrentFormatChanged()
		{
			VerifySelectionInfo();
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeFrozenPaneSettings()
		{
			if (panesAreFrozen && frozenPaneSettings != null)
			{
				return frozenPaneSettings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeUnfrozenPaneSettings()
		{
			if (!panesAreFrozen && unfrozenPaneSettings != null)
			{
				return unfrozenPaneSettings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void VerifySelectionInfo()
		{
			PaneSettingsBase paneSettingsBase = (PanesAreFrozen ? ((PaneSettingsBase)FrozenPaneSettings) : ((PaneSettingsBase)UnfrozenPaneSettings));
			int num = ((!paneSettingsBase.HasHorizontalSplit) ? 1 : 2);
			int num2 = ((!paneSettingsBase.HasVerticalSplit) ? 1 : 2);
			if (PanesAreFrozen)
			{
				if (num == 2 && num2 == 2)
				{
					ActivePane = PaneLocation.BottomRight;
				}
				else if (num2 == 2)
				{
					ActivePane = PaneLocation.TopRight;
				}
				else if (num == 2)
				{
					ActivePane = PaneLocation.BottomLeft;
				}
				else
				{
					ActivePane = PaneLocation.TopLeft;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (ActivePane)
				{
				case PaneLocation.BottomRight:
					if (num < 2 || num2 < 2)
					{
						ActivePane = PaneLocation.TopLeft;
					}
					break;
				case PaneLocation.TopRight:
					if (num2 < 2)
					{
						ActivePane = PaneLocation.TopLeft;
					}
					break;
				case PaneLocation.BottomLeft:
					if (num < 2)
					{
						ActivePane = PaneLocation.TopLeft;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!HasSelection)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num3 = selection.PaneSelections.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				PaneLocation location = selection.PaneSelections[num3].Location;
				bool flag = false;
				switch (location)
				{
				case PaneLocation.BottomRight:
					flag = num < 2 || num2 < 2;
					break;
				case PaneLocation.TopRight:
					flag = num2 < 2;
					break;
				case PaneLocation.BottomLeft:
					flag = num < 2;
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					selection.PaneSelections.RemoveAt(num3);
				}
			}
			WorksheetPaneSelection worksheetPaneSelection = Selection.GetSelection(ActivePane);
			if (worksheetPaneSelection == null)
			{
				Selection.PaneSelections.Add(WorksheetPaneSelection.CreateDefault(ActivePane));
			}
			int num4 = worksheet.Rows.MaxCount - 1;
			int num5 = worksheet.Columns.MaxCount - 1;
			foreach (WorksheetPaneSelection paneSelection in selection.PaneSelections)
			{
				for (int num6 = paneSelection.Ranges.Count - 1; num6 >= 0; num6--)
				{
					WorksheetRegionAddress range = paneSelection.Ranges[num6];
					if (range.FirstColumnIndex > num5 || range.LastColumnIndex > num5 || range.FirstRowIndex > num4 || range.LastRowIndex > num4)
					{
						range = new WorksheetRegionAddress(Math.Min(range.FirstRowIndex, num4), Math.Min(range.LastRowIndex, num4), (short)Math.Min(range.FirstColumnIndex, num5), (short)Math.Min(range.LastColumnIndex, num5));
						paneSelection.Ranges[num6] = range;
					}
					if ((range.FirstColumnIndex != 0 || range.LastColumnIndex < num5) && (range.FirstRowIndex != 0 || range.LastRowIndex < num4))
					{
						worksheet.ExtendRegionForMergedCells(ref range);
						paneSelection.Ranges[num6] = range;
					}
				}
				if (paneSelection.ActiveCell.ColumnIndex > num5 || paneSelection.ActiveCell.RowIndex > num4)
				{
					paneSelection.ActiveCell = new WorksheetCellAddress(Math.Min(paneSelection.ActiveCell.RowIndex, num4), (short)Math.Min(paneSelection.ActiveCell.ColumnIndex, num5));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class WorksheetDisplayOptions : DisplayOptions
	{
		private int magnificationInNormalView = 100;

		private int magnificationInPageBreakView = 60;

		private int magnificationInPageLayoutView = 100;

		private bool orderColumnsRightToLeft;

		private bool showWhitespaceInPageLayoutView = true;

		private bool isTabSelected;

		private WorkbookColorInfo tabColorInfo;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Obsolete("The WorksheetDisplayOptions.TabColor is deprecated. It has been replaced by WorksheetDisplayOptions.TabColorInfo.")]
		public Color TabColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (TabColorInfo == null)
				{
					return ColorsInternal.Empty;
				}
				return TabColorInfo.GetResolvedColor(base.Worksheet.Workbook);
			}
			set
			{
				if (Utilities.ColorIsEmpty(value))
				{
					TabColorInfo = null;
				}
				else
				{
					TabColorInfo = new WorkbookColorInfo(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public int MagnificationInNormalView
		{
			get
			{
				return magnificationInNormalView;
			}
			set
			{
				if (magnificationInNormalView != value)
				{
					if (value < 10 || 400 < value)
					{
						throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_MagnificationLevel"));
					}
					SetMagnificationField(WorksheetView.Normal, ref magnificationInNormalView, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public int MagnificationInPageBreakView
		{
			get
			{
				return magnificationInPageBreakView;
			}
			set
			{
				if (magnificationInPageBreakView != value)
				{
					if (value < 10 || 400 < value)
					{
						throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_MagnificationLevel"));
					}
					SetMagnificationField(WorksheetView.PageBreakPreview, ref magnificationInPageBreakView, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public int MagnificationInPageLayoutView
		{
			get
			{
				return magnificationInPageLayoutView;
			}
			set
			{
				if (magnificationInPageLayoutView != value)
				{
					if (value < 10 || 400 < value)
					{
						throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_MagnificationLevel"));
					}
					SetMagnificationField(WorksheetView.PageLayout, ref magnificationInPageLayoutView, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool OrderColumnsRightToLeft
		{
			get
			{
				return orderColumnsRightToLeft;
			}
			set
			{
				orderColumnsRightToLeft = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShowWhitespaceInPageLayoutView
		{
			get
			{
				return showWhitespaceInPageLayoutView;
			}
			set
			{
				showWhitespaceInPageLayoutView = value;
			}
		}

		public WorkbookColorInfo TabColorInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return tabColorInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				tabColorInfo = value;
			}
		}

		internal int CurrentMagnificationLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return GetMagnificationLevel(base.View);
			}
			set
			{
				switch (base.View)
				{
				default:
					MagnificationInNormalView = value;
					break;
				case WorksheetView.PageBreakPreview:
					MagnificationInPageBreakView = value;
					break;
				case WorksheetView.PageLayout:
					MagnificationInPageLayoutView = value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsTabSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return isTabSelected;
			}
			set
			{
				isTabSelected = value;
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetDisplayOptions(Worksheet worksheet)
			: base(worksheet)
		{
		}

		protected override void ResetCore()
		{
			base.ResetCore();
			magnificationInNormalView = 100;
			magnificationInPageBreakView = 60;
			magnificationInPageLayoutView = 100;
			orderColumnsRightToLeft = false;
			showWhitespaceInPageLayoutView = true;
			tabColorInfo = null;
		}

		internal override void SetView(WorksheetView newView)
		{
			if (!base.PanesAreFrozen && base.Worksheet != null && base.Worksheet.Workbook != null && !base.Worksheet.Workbook.IsLoading)
			{
				int magnificationLevel = GetMagnificationLevel(base.View);
				int magnificationLevel2 = GetMagnificationLevel(newView);
				base.UnfrozenPaneSettings.UpdateExtentsForZoomChange(magnificationLevel, magnificationLevel2);
			}
			base.SetView(newView);
		}

		private int GetMagnificationLevel(WorksheetView view)
		{
			return view switch
			{
				WorksheetView.PageBreakPreview => MagnificationInPageBreakView, 
				WorksheetView.PageLayout => MagnificationInPageLayoutView, 
				_ => MagnificationInNormalView, 
			};
		}

		private void SetMagnificationField(WorksheetView viewForMagnificationChanged, ref int magnificationMember, int newValue)
		{
			if (base.View == viewForMagnificationChanged && !base.PanesAreFrozen && base.Worksheet != null && base.Worksheet.Workbook != null && !base.Worksheet.Workbook.IsLoading)
			{
				base.UnfrozenPaneSettings.UpdateExtentsForZoomChange(magnificationMember, newValue);
			}
			magnificationMember = newValue;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class EscherRecordBase
	{
		private EscherRecordContainerBase parentRecord;

		private byte version;

		private ushort instance;

		private uint recordLength;

		public EscherRecordContainerBase ParentRecord
		{
			get
			{
				return parentRecord;
			}
			set
			{
				parentRecord = value;
			}
		}

		public ushort Instance
		{
			get
			{
				return instance;
			}
			protected set
			{
				instance = value;
			}
		}

		public uint RecordLength
		{
			get
			{
				return recordLength;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (ParentRecord != null)
				{
					if (recordLength < value)
					{
						ParentRecord.RecordLength += value - recordLength;
					}
					else
					{
						ParentRecord.RecordLength -= recordLength - value;
					}
				}
				recordLength = value;
			}
		}

		public abstract EscherRecordType Type { get; }

		protected EscherRecordBase(byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
		{
			this.version = version;
			this.instance = instance;
			this.recordLength = recordLength;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Type.ToString() + ": " + recordLength;
		}

		public abstract void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager);

		public virtual void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			int num = 0;
			num |= version;
			num |= (instance & 0xFFF) << 4;
			num |= (int)((uint)Type << 16);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((uint)num);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(recordLength);
		}

		public static EscherRecordBase LoadRecord(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, EscherRecordContainerBase parentRecord = null)
		{
			uint num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			uint num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			byte b = (byte)(num & 0xF);
			ushort num3 = (ushort)((num & 0xFFF0) >> 4);
			EscherRecordType type = (EscherRecordType)((num & 0xFFFF0000u) >> 16);
			EscherRecordBase escherRecordBase = CreateEscherRecord(type, b, num3, num2);
			if (escherRecordBase == null)
			{
				return escherRecordBase;
			}
			escherRecordBase.parentRecord = parentRecord;
			long position = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position + num2;
			escherRecordBase?.Load(loadManager);
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = position;
			return escherRecordBase;
		}

		private static EscherRecordBase CreateEscherRecord(EscherRecordType type, byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case EscherRecordType.DrawingGroupContainer:
				return new DrawingGroupContainer(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.BLIPStoreContainer:
				return new BLIPStoreContainer(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.DrawingContainer:
				return new DrawingContainer(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.GroupContainer:
				return new GroupContainer(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.ShapeContainer:
				return new ShapeContainer(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.SolverContainer:
				return new SolverContainer(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.DrawingGroup:
				return new DrawingGroup(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.BLIPStoreEntry:
				return new BLIPStoreEntry(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.Drawing:
				return new Drawing(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.GroupShape:
				return new GroupShape(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.Shape:
				return new Shape(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.PropertyTable1:
				return new PropertyTable1(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.ClientTextbox:
				return new ClientTextBox(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.ChildAnchor:
				return new ChildAnchor(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.ClientAnchor:
				return new ClientAnchor(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.ClientData:
				return new ClientData(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.ConnectorRule:
				return new ConnectorRule(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.CalloutRule:
				return new CalloutRule(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.Regroup:
				return new Regroup(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.Selections:
				return new Selections(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.SplitMenuColors:
				return new SplitMenuColors(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.PropertyTable2:
				return new PropertyTable2(version, instance, recordLength);
			case EscherRecordType.PropertyTable3:
				return new PropertyTable3(version, instance, recordLength);
			default:
				if (61464 <= (int)type && (int)type <= 61719)
				{
					return new BLIP(type, version, instance, recordLength);
				}
				return null;
			case EscherRecordType.Textbox:
			case EscherRecordType.Anchor:
			case EscherRecordType.AlignRule:
			case EscherRecordType.ArcRule:
			case EscherRecordType.ClientRule:
			case EscherRecordType.ClassID:
			case EscherRecordType.ColorMRU:
			case EscherRecordType.DeletedPSPL:
			case EscherRecordType.OLEObject:
			case EscherRecordType.ColorScheme:
				return null;
			}
		}
	}

		private static bool TrySaveEmfFile(Metafile image, Stream stream)

	internal abstract class TextMetricsProviderBase : IDisposable
	{
		protected readonly Workbook _workbook;

		public virtual bool IsDisplayProvider => false;

		protected TextMetricsProviderBase(Workbook workbook)
		{
			_workbook = workbook;
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
		}

		public abstract double GetDefaultRowHeight(WorksheetCellFormatData format);

		public abstract Size MeasureText(WorksheetCellFormatData format, string text, Size? proposedSize = null, bool scaleForDpi = true, bool forceSingleLine = false);

		public virtual double GetUnderlineHeight(WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		public static bool ShouldAddUnderlineHeight(FontUnderlineStyle underlineStyle)
		{
			if (underlineStyle != FontUnderlineStyle.SingleAccounting)
			{
				return underlineStyle == FontUnderlineStyle.DoubleAccounting;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void ScaleForDpi(ref Size size)
		{
			double screenDpi = Workbook.GetScreenDpi(_workbook, vertical: false);
			if (screenDpi != (double)Workbook.ProcessDpi.Width)
			{
				double num = screenDpi / (double)Workbook.ProcessDpi.Width;
				size.Width = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero((double)size.Width * num);
			}
			double screenDpi2 = Workbook.GetScreenDpi(_workbook, vertical: true);
			if (screenDpi2 != (double)Workbook.ProcessDpi.Height)
			{
				double num2 = screenDpi2 / (double)Workbook.ProcessDpi.Height;
				size.Height = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero((double)size.Height * num2);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WinFormsTextMetricsProvider : TextMetricsProviderBase
	{
		private const int MinRowHeight = 7;

		private static readonly Size MaxSize = new Size(int.MaxValue, int.MaxValue);

		private readonly Dictionary<WorksheetCellFormatData, Font> _cachedFonts;

		private readonly Graphics _graphics;

		private readonly Bitmap _tempBitmap;

		public WinFormsTextMetricsProvider(Workbook workbook)
			: base(workbook)
		{
			_cachedFonts = new Dictionary<WorksheetCellFormatData, Font>();
			_tempBitmap = new Bitmap(1, 1);
			_graphics = Graphics.FromImage(_tempBitmap);
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			_graphics.Dispose();
			_tempBitmap.Dispose();
			foreach (Font value in _cachedFonts.Values)
			{
				value.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private Font GetFont(WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			if (!_cachedFonts.TryGetValue(format, out var value))
			{
				string fontNameResolved = format.FontNameResolved;
				FontFamily fontFamily;
				try
				{
					fontFamily = new FontFamily(fontNameResolved);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					fontFamily = new FontFamily("Arial");
				}
				FontStyle fontStyle = FontStyle.Regular;
				if (format.FontBoldResolved == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True && fontFamily.IsStyleAvailable(FontStyle.Bold))
				{
					fontStyle |= FontStyle.Bold;
				}
				if (format.FontItalicResolved == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True && fontFamily.IsStyleAvailable(FontStyle.Italic))
				{
					fontStyle |= FontStyle.Italic;
				}
				if (format.FontUnderlineStyleResolved != FontUnderlineStyle.None && fontFamily.IsStyleAvailable(FontStyle.Underline))
				{
					fontStyle |= FontStyle.Underline;
				}
				if (format.FontStrikeoutResolved == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True && fontFamily.IsStyleAvailable(FontStyle.Strikeout))
				{
					fontStyle |= FontStyle.Strikeout;
				}
				value = Utilities.CreateFont(fontNameResolved, (float)format.FontHeightResolved / 20f, fontFamily, fontStyle);
				_cachedFonts.Add(format, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override double GetDefaultRowHeight(WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			Font font = GetFont(format);
			bool addUnderlineHeight = TextMetricsProviderBase.ShouldAddUnderlineHeight(format.FontUnderlineStyleResolved);
			try
			{
				return GetMeasuredRowHeightUnsafe(font, addUnderlineHeight);
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return GetMeasuredRowHeightSafe(font, addUnderlineHeight);
			}
			catch (DllNotFoundException)
			{
				return GetMeasuredRowHeightSafe(font, addUnderlineHeight);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return GetMeasuredRowHeightSafe(font, addUnderlineHeight);
			}
		}

		private double GetMeasuredRowHeightSafe(Font font, bool addUnderlineHeight)
		{
			FontFamily fontFamily = font.FontFamily;
			int emHeight = fontFamily.GetEmHeight(font.Style);
			int lineSpacing = fontFamily.GetLineSpacing(font.Style);
			float height = font.GetHeight(_graphics);
			double num = height * (float)lineSpacing / (float)emHeight;
			double num2 = ((double)height + num) / 2.0;
			if (addUnderlineHeight)
			{
				num2 += GetUnderlineHeightSafe(font);
			}
			return Math.Max(7.0, num2);
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private int GetMeasuredRowHeightUnsafe(Font font, bool addUnderlineHeight)
		{
			int num = 0;
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr intPtr2 = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr intPtr3 = IntPtr.Zero;
			NativeWindowMethods.TEXTMETRIC textmetric;
			try
			{
				intPtr = _graphics.GetHdc();
				intPtr3 = font.ToHfont();
				intPtr2 = NativeWindowMethods.SelectObjectApi(intPtr, intPtr3);
				NativeWindowMethods.GetTextMetricsApi(intPtr, out textmetric);
				if (addUnderlineHeight)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.GetOutlineTextMetricsApi(intPtr, out var textmetric2);
					num = textmetric2.otmsUnderscoreSize * 3;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (intPtr2 != IntPtr.Zero && intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SelectObjectApi(intPtr, intPtr2);
				}
				if (intPtr3 != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.DeleteObjectApi(intPtr3);
				}
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					_graphics.ReleaseHdc();
				}
			}
			int num2 = Math.Max(1, textmetric.tmExternalLeading);
			if (num2 % 2 == 0)
			{
				num2--;
			}
			int num3 = textmetric.tmAscent + 2 * Math.Max(2, textmetric.tmDescent) + num2 - textmetric.tmInternalLeading;
			if (addUnderlineHeight)
			{
				num3 += num;
			}
			return num3;
		}

		public override double GetUnderlineHeight(WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			Font font = GetFont(format);
			return GetUnderlineHeight(font);
		}

		private double GetUnderlineHeight(Font font)
		{
			try
			{
				return GetUnderlineHeightUnsafe(font);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return GetUnderlineHeightSafe(font);
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private double GetUnderlineHeightUnsafe(Font font)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr intPtr2 = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr intPtr3 = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				intPtr = _graphics.GetHdc();
				intPtr3 = font.ToHfont();
				intPtr2 = NativeWindowMethods.SelectObjectApi(intPtr, intPtr3);
				NativeWindowMethods.GetOutlineTextMetricsApi(intPtr, out var textmetric);
				return textmetric.otmsUnderscoreSize * 3;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (intPtr2 != IntPtr.Zero && intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SelectObjectApi(intPtr, intPtr2);
				}
				if (intPtr3 != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.DeleteObjectApi(intPtr3);
				}
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					_graphics.ReleaseHdc();
				}
			}
		}

		private double GetUnderlineHeightSafe(Font font)
		{
			double num = (double)font.FontFamily.GetLineSpacing(font.Style) / 130.0;
			return MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(Math.Max(1.0, (double)font.Height / num)) * 3.0;
		}

		public override Size MeasureText(WorksheetCellFormatData format, string text, Size? proposedSize = null, bool scaleForDpi = true, bool forceSingleLine = false)
		{
			TextFormatFlags textFormatFlags = TextFormatFlags.WordBreak | TextFormatFlags.NoPadding;
			if (forceSingleLine)
			{
				textFormatFlags |= TextFormatFlags.SingleLine;
			}
			Font font = GetFont(format);
			Size size = MeasureTextCore(_graphics, text, font, textFormatFlags, proposedSize);
			if (TextMetricsProviderBase.ShouldAddUnderlineHeight(format.FontUnderlineStyleResolved))
			{
				size.Height += (int)GetUnderlineHeight(font);
			}
			if (scaleForDpi)
			{
				ScaleForDpi(ref size);
			}
			return size;
		}

		private static Size MeasureTextCore(Graphics graphics, string text, Font font, TextFormatFlags flags, Size? proposedSize = null)
		{
			Size proposedSize2 = proposedSize ?? MaxSize;
			Size proposedSize3 = new Size((int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero((double)proposedSize2.Width), (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero((double)proposedSize2.Height));
			try
			{
				Size size = TextRenderer.MeasureText(graphics, text, font, proposedSize3, flags);
				if (size.Width > proposedSize2.Width && (flags & TextFormatFlags.TextBoxControl) == 0)
				{
					return MeasureTextCore(graphics, text, font, flags | TextFormatFlags.TextBoxControl, proposedSize);
				}
				return new Size(size.Width, size.Height);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return MeasureTextSafe(graphics, text, font, proposedSize2, flags, averageSingleCharacterMeasurements: true);
			}
		}

		private static Size MeasureTextSafe(Graphics graphics, string text, Font font, Size proposedSize, TextFormatFlags flags, bool averageSingleCharacterMeasurements)
		{
			if (text.Length == 0)
			{
				return new Size(0, MeasureTextSafe(graphics, "0", font, proposedSize, flags, averageSingleCharacterMeasurements: false).Height);
			}
			if (averageSingleCharacterMeasurements && text.Length == 1 && proposedSize == MaxSize)
			{
				Size size = MeasureTextSafe(graphics, new string(text[0], 10), font, proposedSize, flags, averageSingleCharacterMeasurements: false);
				return new Size(size.Width / 10, size.Height);
			}
			if ((flags & TextFormatFlags.SingleLine) != TextFormatFlags.Default)
			{
				text = text.Replace("\r", string.Empty);
				text = text.Replace("\n", string.Empty);
			}
			StringFormat stringFormat = new StringFormat();
			stringFormat.SetMeasurableCharacterRanges(new CharacterRange[1]
			{
				new CharacterRange(0, text.Length)
			});
			Region[] array = graphics.MeasureCharacterRanges(text, font, new RectangleF(size: new SizeF(proposedSize.Width, proposedSize.Height), location: PointF.Empty), stringFormat);
			try
			{
				RectangleF bounds = array[0].GetBounds(graphics);
				return new Size((int)(bounds.Right + 1f), (int)(bounds.Bottom + 1f));
			}
			finally
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i].Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private class PopulateFontFamilyMappingsHelper
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<string, FontFamilyInternal> _fontFamilies;

			public PopulateFontFamilyMappingsHelper(Dictionary<string, FontFamilyInternal> fontFamilies)
			{
				_fontFamilies = fontFamilies;
			}

			public int EnumFontFamExProc(ref NativeWindowMethods.ENUMLOGFONT lpelf, ref NativeWindowMethods.NEWTEXTMETRIC lpntm, uint FontType, IntPtr lParam)
			{
				string lfFaceName = lpelf.elfLogFont.lfFaceName;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(lfFaceName))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				switch ((NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily)(byte)(lpelf.elfLogFont.lfPitchAndFamily & 0x70))
				{
				case NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.DEFAULT_PITCH:
					_fontFamilies[lfFaceName] = FontFamilyInternal.DontCare;
					break;
				case NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.FF_ROMAN:
					_fontFamilies[lfFaceName] = FontFamilyInternal.Roman;
					break;
				case NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.FF_SWISS:
					_fontFamilies[lfFaceName] = FontFamilyInternal.Swiss;
					break;
				case NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.FF_MODERN:
					_fontFamilies[lfFaceName] = FontFamilyInternal.Modern;
					break;
				case NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.FF_SCRIPT:
					_fontFamilies[lfFaceName] = FontFamilyInternal.Script;
					break;
				case NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.FF_DECORATIVE:
					_fontFamilies[lfFaceName] = FontFamilyInternal.Decorative;
					break;
				default:
					_fontFamilies[lfFaceName] = FontFamilyInternal.DontCare;
					break;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

			private static Color UpdateChannel(Color color, ColorChannelRGB channel, Func<double> getNewValue)
			{
				try
				{
					byte b = (byte)Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(getNewValue()), 255.0));
					return channel switch
					{
						ColorChannelRGB.R => Color.FromArgb(color.A, b, color.G, color.B), 
						ColorChannelRGB.G => Color.FromArgb(color.A, color.R, b, color.B), 
						ColorChannelRGB.B => Color.FromArgb(color.A, color.R, color.G, b), 
						_ => Color.FromArgb(b, color.R, color.G, color.B), 
					};
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return color;
				}
			}

			private static Color UpdateChannel(Color color, ColorChannelHSL channel, Func<int, double> getNewValueFromOriginal)
			{
				try
				{
					ConvertRGBToHLS(color, out var h, out var l, out var s);
					int num = (int)Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(getNewValueFromOriginal(channel switch
					{
						ColorChannelHSL.S => s, 
						ColorChannelHSL.L => l, 
						_ => h, 
					})), 240.0));
					return channel switch
					{
						ColorChannelHSL.L => ConvertHLSToRGB(h, num, s), 
						ColorChannelHSL.S => ConvertHLSToRGB(h, l, num), 
						_ => ConvertHLSToRGB(num, l, s), 
					};
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return color;
				}
			}
		}

		public class Int16Comparer : Comparer<short>
		{

			}

			public override int Compare(short x, short y)
			{
				if (x < y)
				{
					return -1;

				return 0;
			}
		}

			private static void ApplyColorTransforms(EG_ColorChoice colorChoice, Workbook workbook, ref WorkbookColorInfo color)
			{
				//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00fc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0108: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0140: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (colorChoice.ColorTransforms.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (color.ThemeColorType.HasValue && !color.Tint.HasValue)
				{
					if (colorChoice.ColorTransforms.Count == 1)
					{
						IEG_ColorTransform obj = colorChoice.ColorTransforms[0];
						ColorTransform_LumMod val = (ColorTransform_LumMod)(object)((obj is ColorTransform_LumMod) ? obj : null);
						if (val != null)
						{
							color = new WorkbookColorInfo(color.ThemeColorType.Value, (100.0 - ST_Percentage.op_Implicit(((CT_Percentage)val).Value)) / -100.0);
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (colorChoice.ColorTransforms.Count == 2)
					{
						IEG_ColorTransform obj2 = colorChoice.ColorTransforms[0];
						ColorTransform_LumMod val2 = (ColorTransform_LumMod)(object)((obj2 is ColorTransform_LumMod) ? obj2 : null);
						IEG_ColorTransform obj3 = colorChoice.ColorTransforms[1];
						ColorTransform_LumOff val3 = (ColorTransform_LumOff)(object)((obj3 is ColorTransform_LumOff) ? obj3 : null);
						if (val2 == null && val3 == null)
						{
							IEG_ColorTransform obj4 = colorChoice.ColorTransforms[1];
							val2 = (ColorTransform_LumMod)(object)((obj4 is ColorTransform_LumMod) ? obj4 : null);
							IEG_ColorTransform obj5 = colorChoice.ColorTransforms[0];
							val3 = (ColorTransform_LumOff)(object)((obj5 is ColorTransform_LumOff) ? obj5 : null);
						}
						if (val2 != null && val3 != null && Math.Abs(ST_Percentage.op_Implicit(((CT_Percentage)val2).Value) + ST_Percentage.op_Implicit(((CT_Percentage)val3).Value) - 100.0) < 1E-05)
						{
							color = new WorkbookColorInfo(color.ThemeColorType.Value, ST_Percentage.op_Implicit(((CT_Percentage)val2).Value) / 100.0);
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				Color color2 = color.GetResolvedColor(workbook);
				foreach (IEG_ColorTransform colorTransform in colorChoice.ColorTransforms)
				{
					color2 = colorTransform.Accept<Color, Color>((IEG_ColorTransformVisitor<Color, Color>)ColorTransformsApplicator.Instance, color2);
				}
				color = new WorkbookColorInfo(color2);
			}
		}

		public static Calendar CreateCalendar(CalendarType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				CalendarType.Gregorian => new GregorianCalendar(), 
				CalendarType.GregorianArabic => new GregorianCalendar(GregorianCalendarTypes.Arabic), 
				CalendarType.GregorianMeFrench => new GregorianCalendar(GregorianCalendarTypes.MiddleEastFrench), 
				CalendarType.GregorianUs => new GregorianCalendar(GregorianCalendarTypes.USEnglish), 
				CalendarType.GregorianXlitEnglish => new GregorianCalendar(GregorianCalendarTypes.TransliteratedEnglish), 
				CalendarType.GregorianXlitFrench => new GregorianCalendar(GregorianCalendarTypes.TransliteratedFrench), 
				CalendarType.Hebrew => new HebrewCalendar(), 
				CalendarType.Hijri => new HijriCalendar(), 
				CalendarType.Japan => new JapaneseCalendar(), 
				CalendarType.Korea => new KoreanCalendar(), 
				CalendarType.None => CurrentCulture.Calendar, 
				CalendarType.Saka => CurrentCulture.Calendar, 
				CalendarType.Taiwan => new TaiwanCalendar(), 
				CalendarType.Thai => new ThaiBuddhistCalendar(), 
				_ => CurrentCulture.Calendar, 
			};
		}

		public static Font CreateFont(string fontName, float emSize, FontFamily family, FontStyle style)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!family.IsStyleAvailable(style))
				{
					if (family.IsStyleAvailable(FontStyle.Bold))
					{
						style = FontStyle.Bold;
					}
					else if (family.IsStyleAvailable(FontStyle.Italic))
					{
						style = FontStyle.Italic;
					}
					else if (family.IsStyleAvailable(FontStyle.Strikeout))
					{
						style = FontStyle.Strikeout;
					}
					else if (family.IsStyleAvailable(FontStyle.Underline))
					{
						style = FontStyle.Underline;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return new Font(fontName, emSize, style);
		}

		private static ImageCodecInfo GetEncoderInfo(ImageFormat format)
		{
			ImageCodecInfo[] imageEncoders = ImageCodecInfo.GetImageEncoders();
			for (int i = 0; i < imageEncoders.Length; i++)
			{
				if (imageEncoders[i].FormatID == format.Guid)
				{
					return imageEncoders[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string GetResolvedPath(Workbook workbook, Uri uri)
		{
			if (uri.IsAbsoluteUri)
			{
				return Uri.UnescapeDataString(uri.AbsoluteUri);
			}
			string loadingPath = workbook.LoadingPath;
			string originalString = uri.OriginalString;
			string text;
			if (originalString.StartsWith("/"))
			{
				if (loadingPath == null)
				{
					text = "C:";
					try
					{
						text = Path.GetPathRoot(Environment.CurrentDirectory);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				else
				{
					text = Path.GetPathRoot(loadingPath);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				text = loadingPath ?? string.Empty;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return originalString;
			}
			if (Uri.TryCreate(Path.Combine(text, originalString), UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute, out var result))
			{
				return Uri.UnescapeDataString(result.LocalPath);
			}
			return originalString;
		}

		public static Stream GetStream(Workbook workbook, Uri uri)
		{
			string resolvedPath = GetResolvedPath(workbook, uri);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(resolvedPath))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (resolvedPath.StartsWith("http", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				using (WebClient webClient = new WebClient())
				{
					return new MemoryStream(webClient.DownloadData(resolvedPath));
				}
			}
			return new FileStream(resolvedPath, FileMode.Open);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static Bitmap ImageFromRGBPixelArray(byte[] rgbValues, ushort width, ushort height)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height);
			bool flag = false;
			BitmapData bitmapData = null;
			try
			{
				bitmapData = bitmap.LockBits(new Rectangle(Point.Empty, bitmap.Size), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb);
				Marshal.Copy(rgbValues, 0, bitmapData.Scan0, rgbValues.Length);
				flag = true;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				if (bitmapData != null)
				{
					bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmapData);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < height; j++)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < width; k++)
					{
						int blue = rgbValues[i++];
						int green = rgbValues[i++];
						int red = rgbValues[i++];
						bitmap.SetPixel(k, j, Color.FromArgb(red, green, blue));
					}
					for (; i % 4 != 0; i++)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			bitmap.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipX);
			return bitmap;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static byte[] ImageToRGBPixelArray(Bitmap image, out ushort width, out ushort height)
		{
			byte[] array = null;
			width = (ushort)image.Width;
			height = (ushort)image.Height;
			int num = RoundUpToMultiple(width * 3, 4);
			array = new byte[num * height];
			image.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipX);
			bool flag = false;
			BitmapData bitmapData = null;
			try
			{
				bitmapData = image.LockBits(new Rectangle(Point.Empty, image.Size), ImageLockMode.ReadOnly, PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb);
				Marshal.Copy(bitmapData.Scan0, array, 0, array.Length);
				flag = true;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				if (bitmapData != null)
				{
					image.UnlockBits(bitmapData);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
					{
						Color pixel = image.GetPixel(j, i);
						array[num2++] = pixel.B;
						array[num2++] = pixel.G;
						array[num2++] = pixel.R;
					}
					while (num2 % 4 != 0)
					{
						array[num2++] = 0;
					}
				}
			}
			image.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipX);
			return array;
		}

			}
			catch

		private static void PopulateFontFamilyMappingsUnsafe(Dictionary<string, FontFamilyInternal> fontFamilies)
		{
			Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromHwnd(IntPtr.Zero);
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				IntPtr hdc = graphics.GetHdc();
				NativeWindowMethods.LOGFONT lOGFONT = new NativeWindowMethods.LOGFONT();
				lOGFONT.lfCharSet = 1;
				intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf((object)lOGFONT));
				Marshal.StructureToPtr((object)lOGFONT, intPtr, fDeleteOld: true);
				PopulateFontFamilyMappingsHelper populateFontFamilyMappingsHelper = new PopulateFontFamilyMappingsHelper(fontFamilies);
				NativeWindowMethods.EnumFontFamiliesExApi(hdc, intPtr, populateFontFamilyMappingsHelper.EnumFontFamExProc, IntPtr.Zero, 0u);
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.ReleaseHdc();
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SaveImageHelper(Image image, ImageFormat preferredFormat, Stream stream, ref bool isSaved)
		{
			ImageCodecInfo encoderInfo = GetEncoderInfo(preferredFormat);
			if (encoderInfo != null)
			{
				System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder quality = System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder.Quality;
				EncoderParameters encoderParameters = new EncoderParameters(1);
				encoderParameters.Param[0] = new EncoderParameter(quality, 100L);
				image.Save(stream, encoderInfo, encoderParameters);
				stream.Flush();
				isSaved = true;
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateSortCultureCore(ref CultureInfo culture, SortMethod sortMethod)
		{
			if (sortMethod == SortMethod.Stroke)
			{
				switch (culture.LCID)
				{
				case 2052:
				case 3076:
				case 4100:
				case 5124:
					culture = new CultureInfo(0x20000 | culture.LCID);
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (culture.LCID == 1028)
			{
				culture = new CultureInfo(197636);
			}
		}

		public static byte[] ExtractSecureStringUnicode(SecureString value, bool throwOnError)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value.Length == 0)
			{
				return new byte[0];
			}
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				intPtr = Marshal.SecureStringToGlobalAllocUnicode(value);
				byte[] array = new byte[value.Length * 2];
				Marshal.Copy(intPtr, array, 0, array.Length);
				return array;
			}
			catch
			{
				if (throwOnError)
				{
					throw;
				}
				return null;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Marshal.ZeroFreeGlobalAllocUnicode(intPtr);
				}
			}
		}

		public static byte[] GetPasswordUnicode(string password, SecureString passwordSecure)
		{

			}
			return null;
		}

		}

		public static Color ApplyShade(Color value, double shade)
		{
			double num = RGBToLinearRGB((double)(int)value.R / 255.0);
			double num2 = RGBToLinearRGB((double)(int)value.G / 255.0);
			double num3 = RGBToLinearRGB((double)(int)value.B / 255.0);
			double value2 = ((num * shade < 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((num * shade > 1.0) ? 1.0 : (num * shade)));
			double value3 = ((num2 * shade < 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((num2 * shade > 1.0) ? 1.0 : (num2 * shade)));
			double value4 = ((num3 * shade < 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((num3 * shade > 1.0) ? 1.0 : (num3 * shade)));
			double num4 = LinearRGBToRGB(value2);
			double num5 = LinearRGBToRGB(value3);
			double num6 = LinearRGBToRGB(value4);
			return Color.FromArgb(255, (byte)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num4 * 255.0), (byte)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num5 * 255.0), (byte)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num6 * 255.0));
		}

		private static double RGBToLinearRGB(double value)
		{
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (value <= 0.04045)
			{
				return value / 12.92;
			}
			if (value <= 1.0)
			{
				return Math.Pow((value + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		private static double LinearRGBToRGB(double value)
		{
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (value <= 0.0031308)
			{
				return value * 12.92;
			}
			if (value < 1.0)
			{
				return 1.055 * Math.Pow(value, 5.0 / 12.0) - 0.055;
			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		public static Color ApplyTint(Color baseColor, double tint)
		{
			if (tint == 0.0)
			{
				return baseColor;
			}
			ConvertRGBToHLS(baseColor, out var h, out var l, out var s);
			int l2 = l;
			if (tint < 0.0)
			{
				l2 = (int)MathUtilities.Truncate((double)l * (1.0 + tint));
			}
			else if (tint > 0.0)
			{
				l2 = (int)MathUtilities.Truncate((double)l * (1.0 - tint)) + (240 - (int)MathUtilities.Truncate(240.0 * (1.0 - tint)));
			}
			return ConvertHLSToRGB(h, l2, s);
		}

		public static int BinarySearch<T>(IList<T> list, T value, IComparer<T> comparer)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = list.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num) / 2;
				T x = list[num3];
				int num4 = comparer.Compare(x, value);
				if (num4 == 0)
				{
					return num3;
				}
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
				}
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		public static int BinarySearch<T>(List<WeakReference> weakReferences, T value, IComparer<T> comparer, bool allowDuplicates, out T foundValue)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = weakReferences.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num) / 2;
				T val = (T)GetWeakReferenceTarget(weakReferences[num3]);
				if (val == null)
				{
					weakReferences.RemoveAt(num3);
					num2--;
					continue;
				}
				int num4 = comparer.Compare(val, value);
				if (num4 == 0)
				{
					foundValue = val;
					if (allowDuplicates)
					{
						return ~num3;
					}
					return num3;
				}
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
				}
			}
			foundValue = default(T);
			return ~num;
		}

		internal static void ClearBits(ref byte value, int firstBitIndex, int lastBitIndex)
		{
			int num = lastBitIndex - firstBitIndex + 1;
			int num2 = (1 << num) - 1 << firstBitIndex;
			value &= (byte)(~num2);
		}

		internal static void ClearBits(ref ushort value, int firstBitIndex, int lastBitIndex)
		{
			int num = lastBitIndex - firstBitIndex + 1;
			int num2 = (1 << num) - 1 << firstBitIndex;
			value &= (ushort)(~num2);
		}

		internal static void ClearBits(ref uint value, int firstBitIndex, int lastBitIndex)
		{
			int num = lastBitIndex - firstBitIndex + 1;
			uint num2 = (uint)((1 << num) - 1 << firstBitIndex);
			value &= ~num2;
		}

		internal static void ClearBits(ref ulong value, int firstBitIndex, int lastBitIndex)
		{
			int num = lastBitIndex - firstBitIndex + 1;
			ulong num2 = (ulong)((long)((1 << num) - 1) << firstBitIndex);
			value &= ~num2;
		}

		public static Uri CleanUri(Uri uri)
		{
			if (!uri.IsAbsoluteUri)
			{
				return uri;
			}
			string originalString = uri.OriginalString;
			if (!originalString.StartsWith("file://"))
			{
				return uri;
			}
			originalString = originalString.Substring("file://".Length);
			if (originalString.Length != 0 && originalString[0] == '/')
			{
				originalString = originalString.Substring(1);
			}
			return new Uri(originalString, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
		}

		public static bool CompareFillsForSortOrFilter(Workbook workbook, WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat, CellFill expectedFill)
		{
			CellFill cellFill = cellFormat.FillResolved;
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				cellFill = cellFill.ToResolvedColorFill(workbook);
				expectedFill = expectedFill.ToResolvedColorFill(workbook);
			}
			CellFillPattern cellFillPattern = cellFill as CellFillPattern;
			CellFillPattern cellFillPattern2 = expectedFill as CellFillPattern;
			if (cellFillPattern != null && cellFillPattern2 != null)
			{
				if (cellFillPattern.PatternStyle == FillPatternStyle.None)
				{
					return cellFillPattern2.PatternStyle == FillPatternStyle.None;
				}
				if (cellFillPattern.PatternStyle == FillPatternStyle.Solid)
				{
					if (cellFillPattern2.PatternStyle == FillPatternStyle.Solid)
					{
						return cellFillPattern.BackgroundColorInfo == cellFillPattern2.BackgroundColorInfo;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return cellFill.Equals(expectedFill);
		}

		public static Guid ComputeMD4Hash(byte[] data)
		{
			data = Utilities.AppendDataForMD4(data);
			uint A = 1732584193u;
			uint A2 = 4023233417u;
			uint A3 = 2562383102u;
			uint A4 = 271733878u;
			uint[] array = new uint[16];
			for (int i = 0; i < data.Length; i += 64)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++)
				{
					array[j] = BitConverter.ToUInt32(data, i + j * 4);
				}
				uint num = A;

				uint num3 = A3;
				uint num4 = A4;
				MD4Round1Operation(ref A, A2, A3, A4, array, 0, 3);

				MD4Round1Operation(ref A4, A, A2, A3, array, 5, 7);
				MD4Round1Operation(ref A3, A4, A, A2, array, 6, 11);
				MD4Round1Operation(ref A2, A3, A4, A, array, 7, 19);
				MD4Round1Operation(ref A, A2, A3, A4, array, 8, 3);
				MD4Round1Operation(ref A4, A, A2, A3, array, 9, 7);
				MD4Round1Operation(ref A3, A4, A, A2, array, 10, 11);
				MD4Round1Operation(ref A2, A3, A4, A, array, 11, 19);
				MD4Round1Operation(ref A, A2, A3, A4, array, 12, 3);
				MD4Round1Operation(ref A4, A, A2, A3, array, 13, 7);
				MD4Round1Operation(ref A3, A4, A, A2, array, 14, 11);
				MD4Round1Operation(ref A2, A3, A4, A, array, 15, 19);
				MD4Round2Operation(ref A, A2, A3, A4, array, 0, 3);
				MD4Round2Operation(ref A4, A, A2, A3, array, 4, 5);
				MD4Round2Operation(ref A3, A4, A, A2, array, 8, 9);
				MD4Round2Operation(ref A2, A3, A4, A, array, 12, 13);

				MD4Round2Operation(ref A3, A4, A, A2, array, 9, 9);
				MD4Round2Operation(ref A2, A3, A4, A, array, 13, 13);

				MD4Round2Operation(ref A4, A, A2, A3, array, 6, 5);

				MD4Round2Operation(ref A2, A3, A4, A, array, 15, 13);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A, A2, A3, A4, array, 0, 3);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A4, A, A2, A3, array, 8, 9);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A3, A4, A, A2, array, 4, 11);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A2, A3, A4, A, array, 12, 15);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A, A2, A3, A4, array, 2, 3);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A4, A, A2, A3, array, 10, 9);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A3, A4, A, A2, array, 6, 11);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A2, A3, A4, A, array, 14, 15);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A, A2, A3, A4, array, 1, 3);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A4, A, A2, A3, array, 9, 9);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A3, A4, A, A2, array, 5, 11);

				MD4Round3Operation(ref A3, A4, A, A2, array, 7, 11);
				MD4Round3Operation(ref A2, A3, A4, A, array, 15, 15);
				A += num;
				A2 += num2;
				A3 += num3;
				A4 += num4;
			}
			byte[] array2 = new byte[16];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(A), 0, array2, 0, 4);
			Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(A2), 0, array2, 4, 4);
			Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(A3), 0, array2, 8, 4);
			Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(A4), 0, array2, 12, 4);
			return new Guid(array2);
		}

		private static void MD4Round1Operation(ref uint A, uint B, uint C, uint D, uint[] X, int i, int s)
		{
			A = Utilities.RotateBitsLeft(A + ((B & C) | (~B & D)) + X[i], s);
		}

		private static void MD4Round2Operation(ref uint A, uint B, uint C, uint D, uint[] X, int i, int s)
		{
			A = Utilities.RotateBitsLeft(A + ((B & C) | (B & D) | (C & D)) + X[i] + 1518500249, s);
		}

		private static void MD4Round3Operation(ref uint A, uint B, uint C, uint D, uint[] X, int i, int s)
		{
			A = Utilities.RotateBitsLeft(A + (B ^ C ^ D) + X[i] + 1859775393, s);
		}

		public static uint ComputeMsoCrc32(uint crcValue, byte[] data)
		{
			InitMsoCrc32Cache();
			foreach (byte b in data)
			{
				byte b2 = (byte)((crcValue >> 24) ^ b);
				crcValue <<= 8;
				crcValue ^= msoCrc32Cache[b2];
			}
			return crcValue;
		}

		private static void InitMsoCrc32Cache()
		{
			if (msoCrc32Cache != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			msoCrc32Cache = new uint[256];
			for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++)
			{
				uint num = (uint)(i << 24);
				for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++)
				{
					if ((num & 0x80000000u) != 0)
					{
						num <<= 1;
						num ^= 0xAF;
					}
					else
					{
						num <<= 1;
					}
				}
				num &= 0xFFFF;
				msoCrc32Cache[i] = num;
			}
		}

		public static Color ConvertHLSToRGB(int h, int l, int s)
		{
			int num;
			int num2;
			int num3;
			if (s == 0)
			{
				num = (num2 = (num3 = l * 255 / 240));
			}
			else
			{
				int num4 = ((l > 120) ? (l + s - (l * s + 120) / 240) : ((l * (240 + s) + 120) / 240));
				int n = 2 * l - num4;
				num = (HueToRGB(n, num4, h + 80) * 255 + 120) / 240;
				num2 = (HueToRGB(n, num4, h) * 255 + 120) / 240;
				num3 = (HueToRGB(n, num4, h - 80) * 255 + 120) / 240;
			}
			return Color.FromArgb(255, (byte)num, (byte)num2, (byte)num3);
		}

		public static void ConvertRGBToHLS(Color rgb, out int h, out int l, out int s)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(Math.Max(rgb.R, rgb.G), rgb.B);
			int num2 = Math.Min(Math.Min(rgb.R, rgb.G), rgb.B);
			l = ((num + num2) * 240 + 255) / 510;
			if (num == num2)
			{
				s = 0;
				h = 160;
				return;
			}
			if (l <= 120)
			{
				s = ((num - num2) * 240 + (num + num2) / 2) / (num + num2);
			}
			else
			{
				s = ((num - num2) * 240 + (510 - num - num2) / 2) / (510 - num - num2);
			}
			int num3 = ((num - rgb.R) * 40 + (num - num2) / 2) / (num - num2);
			int num4 = ((num - rgb.G) * 40 + (num - num2) / 2) / (num - num2);
			int num5 = ((num - rgb.B) * 40 + (num - num2) / 2) / (num - num2);
			if (rgb.R == num)
			{
				h = num5 - num4;
			}
			else if (rgb.G == num)
			{
				h = 80 + num3 - num5;
			}
			else
			{
				h = 160 + num4 - num3;
			}
			if (h < 0)
			{
				h += 240;
			}
			if (h > 240)
			{
				h -= 240;
			}
		}

		{
			if (onlyCopyNonDefaultValues)
			{
				CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)0;
				for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue2 = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue2 != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue2 = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue2 << 1))
				{
					if ((values & cellFormatValue2) != 0 && cellFormatValue2 != CellFormatValue.FormatOptions && !sourceFormat.IsValueDefault(cellFormatValue2))
					{
						cellFormatValue |= cellFormatValue2;
					}
				}
				values = cellFormatValue;
			}
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue3 = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue3 != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue3 = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue3 << 1))
			{
				if ((values & cellFormatValue3) != 0)
				{
					CopyCellFormatValue(sourceFormat, targetFormat, cellFormatValue3, callBeforeAndAfterSet, options);
				}
			}
		}

		public static string CreateReferenceString(string workbookFilePath, bool isWorkbookFilePathIndexed, string firstWorksheetName, string lastWorksheetName)
		{
			if (workbookFilePath == "<AddInFunctions>")
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			string text = null;
			if (firstWorksheetName != null)
			{
				if (lastWorksheetName == null)
				{
					text = firstWorksheetName;
					flag = FormulaParser.ShouldWorksheetNameBeQuoted(firstWorksheetName);
				}
				else
				{
					text = $"{firstWorksheetName}:{lastWorksheetName}";
					flag = FormulaParser.ShouldWorksheetNameBeQuoted(firstWorksheetName) || FormulaParser.ShouldWorksheetNameBeQuoted(lastWorksheetName);
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(workbookFilePath))
			{
				if (firstWorksheetName == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return string.Format("'{0}'!", text.Replace("'", "''"));
				}
				return $"{text}!";
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(firstWorksheetName) || workbookFilePath == firstWorksheetName)
			{
				if (!isWorkbookFilePathIndexed && FormulaParser.ShouldWorksheetNameBeQuoted(workbookFilePath))
				{
					return string.Format("'{0}'!", workbookFilePath.Replace("'", "''"));
				}
				return $"{workbookFilePath}!";
			}
			int num = workbookFilePath.LastIndexOfAny(new char[2] { PathDirectorySeparatorChar, PathAltDirectorySeparatorChar });
			bool flag2 = flag;
			string text2;
			if (isWorkbookFilePathIndexed)
			{
				text2 = $"{workbookFilePath}{text}";
			}
			else
			{
				string text3 = workbookFilePath.Substring(0, num + 1);
				string text4 = workbookFilePath.Substring(num + 1);
				text2 = $"{text3}[{text4}]{text}";
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3) || FormulaParser.ShouldWorksheetNameBeQuoted(text4))
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				return string.Format("'{0}'!", text2.Replace("'", "''"));
			}
			return $"{text2}!";
		}

		public static Regex CreateWildcardRegex(string searchText, out bool hasWildcards)
		{
			hasWildcards = false;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("\\A" + Regex.Escape(searchText) + "\\z");
			for (int i = 0; i < stringBuilder.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (stringBuilder[i])
				{
				case '~':
					stringBuilder.Remove(i++, 1);
					if (i < stringBuilder.Length - 1 && stringBuilder[i] == '\\')
					{
						char c = stringBuilder[i + 1];
						if (c == '*' || c == '?')
						{
							stringBuilder.Remove(i, 1);
						}
					}
					break;
				case '\\':
					switch (stringBuilder[i + 1])
					{
					case '?':
						stringBuilder.Remove(i, 2);
						stringBuilder.Insert(i, ".");
						hasWildcards = true;
						break;
					case '*':
						stringBuilder.Remove(i, 2);
						stringBuilder.Insert(i, ".*");
						hasWildcards = true;
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return new Regex(stringBuilder.ToString(), RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
		}

		public static Color DecodeLongRGBA(uint value)
		{
			byte red = (byte)(value & 0xFF);
			byte green = (byte)((value & 0xFF00) >> 8);
			byte blue = (byte)((value & 0xFF0000) >> 16);
			byte alpha = (byte)((value & 0xFF000000u) >> 24);
			return Color.FromArgb(alpha, red, green, blue);
		}

		public static double DecodeRKValue(uint rkValue)
		{
			bool flag = (rkValue & 1) == 1;
			bool flag2 = (rkValue & 2) == 2;
			uint num = rkValue & 0xFFFFFFFCu;
			if (flag2)
			{
				double num2 = (int)num >> 2;
				if (flag)
				{
					num2 /= 100.0;
				}
				return num2;
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[8];
			byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes(num);
			bytes.CopyTo(array, 4);
			double num3 = BitConverter.ToDouble(array, 0);
			if (flag)
			{
				num3 /= 100.0;
			}
			return num3;
		}

		public static string DecodeURL(string currentPath, string encodedPath)
		{
			if (encodedPath.Trim().Length == 0)
			{
				return currentPath;
			}
			if (encodedPath[0] != '\u0001')
			{
				return encodedPath;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (currentPath != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Path.GetDirectoryName(currentPath));
				stringBuilder.Append(PathDirectorySeparatorChar);
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < encodedPath.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (encodedPath[i])
				{
				case 1:
				{
					stringBuilder.Length = 0;
					char c = encodedPath[++i];
					if (c == '@')
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(PathDirectorySeparatorChar);
						stringBuilder.Append(PathDirectorySeparatorChar);
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(c);
						stringBuilder.Append(PathVolumeSeparatorChar);
						stringBuilder.Append(PathDirectorySeparatorChar);
					}
					break;
				}
				case 2:
					stringBuilder.Length = 0;
					stringBuilder.Append(Path.GetPathRoot(currentPath));
					break;
				case 3:
					stringBuilder.Append(PathDirectorySeparatorChar);
					break;
				case 4:
				{
					string path = stringBuilder.ToString();
					stringBuilder.Length = 0;
					stringBuilder.Append(Path.GetDirectoryName(path));
					stringBuilder.Append(PathDirectorySeparatorChar);
					break;
				}
				case 5:
				{
					byte[] bytes = Workbook.InvariantCompressedTextEncoding.GetBytes(encodedPath[++i].ToString());
					stringBuilder.Length = 0;
					stringBuilder.Append(encodedPath.Substring(++i, bytes[0]));
					i += stringBuilder.Length;
					break;
				}
				default:
					stringBuilder.Append(encodedPath[i]);
					break;
				case 6:
				case 7:
					break;
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static bool DoesOperationCompletelyContainRange(ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride, WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress)
		{
			return DoesOperationCompletelyContainRange(operationOverride, regionAddress.FirstRowIndex, regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, regionAddress.LastRowIndex, regionAddress.LastColumnIndex);
		}

		internal static bool DoesOperationCompletelyContainRange(ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride, int firstRow, int firstColumn, int lastRow, int lastColumn)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (operationOverride.ShiftsColumns)
			{
				result = operationOverride.Index <= firstColumn && operationOverride.Index + operationOverride.Count - 1 >= lastColumn;
			}
			else if (operationOverride.ShiftsRows)
			{
				result = operationOverride.Index <= firstRow && operationOverride.Index + operationOverride.Count - 1 >= lastRow;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static bool DoesOperationIntersectWithRange(ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride, WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress)
		{
			return DoesOperationIntersectWithRange(operationOverride, regionAddress.FirstRowIndex, regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, regionAddress.LastRowIndex, regionAddress.LastColumnIndex);
		}

		internal static bool DoesOperationIntersectWithRange(ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride, int firstRow, int firstColumn, int lastRow, int lastColumn)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (operationOverride.ShiftsColumns)
			{
				result = operationOverride.Index <= lastColumn && operationOverride.Index + operationOverride.Count - 1 >= firstColumn;
			}
			else if (operationOverride.ShiftsRows)
			{
				result = operationOverride.Index <= lastRow && operationOverride.Index + operationOverride.Count - 1 >= firstRow;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static string EncodeURL(string path)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append('\u0001');
			if (Path.IsPathRooted(path))
			{
				string pathRoot = Path.GetPathRoot(path);
				stringBuilder.Append('\u0001');
				if (pathRoot.StartsWith(string.Concat(PathDirectorySeparatorChar, PathDirectorySeparatorChar)))
				{
					int num = pathRoot.LastIndexOf(PathDirectorySeparatorChar);
					if (num < 0)
					{
						num = pathRoot.LastIndexOf(PathAltDirectorySeparatorChar);
					}
					if (num < 0)
					{
						num = pathRoot.Length;
					}
					stringBuilder.Append("@" + pathRoot.Substring(2, num - 2));
					stringBuilder.Append('\u0003');
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(pathRoot.Substring(0, 1));
				}
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				while (true)
				{
					string fileName = Path.GetFileName(path);
					if (fileName == null || fileName.Length == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					list.Insert(0, fileName);
					path = Path.GetDirectoryName(path);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					string value = list[i];
					stringBuilder.Append(value);
					if (i < list.Count - 1)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append('\u0003');
					}
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			if (Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(path, UriKind.Absolute))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append('\u0005');
				stringBuilder.Append(EncodingDefault.GetString(new byte[1] { (byte)path.Length }));
				stringBuilder.Append(path);
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return path;
		}

		internal static int EncodingGetCodePage(Encoding encoding)
		{
			return encoding.CodePage;
		}

		internal static Encoding EncodingGetEncoding(int codePage)
		{
			return Encoding.GetEncoding(codePage);
		}

		public static string EscapeWildcards(string value)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(value);
			for (int i = 0; i < stringBuilder.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = stringBuilder[i];
				if (c == '*' || c == '?')
				{
					stringBuilder.Insert(i++, "~");
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static void EnsureMagnificationIsValid(ref int magnification)
		{
			if (10 > magnification || magnification > 400)
			{
				magnification = 100;
			}
		}

		public static string FixupCellString(string value)
		{
			return value?.Replace("\0", "");
		}

		public static Formula FormulaFromCellValueRaw(object valueRaw)
		{
			if (valueRaw is WorksheetDataTable worksheetDataTable)
			{
				return worksheetDataTable.InteriorCellFormula;
			}
			return valueRaw as Formula;
		}

		public static float FromFixedPoint16_16Value(uint value)
		{
			short num = (short)(value >> 16);
			ushort num2 = (ushort)(value & 0xFFFF);
			return (float)num + (float)(int)num2 / 65536f;
		}

		private static int GetAddressNumberHelper(int addressNumber, bool addressNumberIsOffset, int originCellIndex, int maxAddress)
		{
			if (!addressNumberIsOffset)
			{
				return addressNumber;
			}
			addressNumber += originCellIndex;
			if (addressNumber < 0)
			{
				addressNumber += maxAddress;
			}
			else if (maxAddress <= addressNumber)
			{
				addressNumber -= maxAddress;
			}
			return addressNumber;
		}

		public static CellFormatValue GetAssociatedBorderValue(CellFormatValue value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo => CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle, 
				CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle => CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo => CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle, 
				CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle => CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo => CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle, 
				CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle => CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo => CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle, 
				CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle => CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo => CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle, 
				CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle => CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo, 
				_ => value, 
			};
		}

		internal static int GetBits(byte value, int firstBitIndex, int lastBitIndex)
		{
			int num = lastBitIndex - firstBitIndex + 1;
			int num2 = (1 << num) - 1;
			return (value >> firstBitIndex) & num2;
		}

		internal static int GetBits(ushort value, int firstBitIndex, int lastBitIndex)
		{
			int num = lastBitIndex - firstBitIndex + 1;
			int num2 = (1 << num) - 1;
			return (value >> firstBitIndex) & num2;
		}

		internal static int GetBits(uint value, int firstBitIndex, int lastBitIndex)
		{
			int num = lastBitIndex - firstBitIndex + 1;
			int num2 = (1 << num) - 1;
			return (int)((value >> firstBitIndex) & num2);
		}

		internal static int GetBits(int value, int firstBitIndex, int lastBitIndex)
		{
			int num = lastBitIndex - firstBitIndex + 1;
			int num2 = (1 << num) - 1;
			return (value >> firstBitIndex) & num2;
		}

		internal static int GetBits(ulong value, int firstBitIndex, int lastBitIndex)
		{
			int num = lastBitIndex - firstBitIndex + 1;
			ulong num2 = (ulong)(1 << num) - 1uL;
			return (int)((value >> firstBitIndex) & num2);
		}

		public static CellAddressRange? GetCellAddressRange(ReferenceToken referenceToken)
		{
			if (referenceToken is AreaToken areaToken)
			{
				return areaToken.CellAddressRange;
			}
			if (referenceToken is AreaNToken areaNToken)
			{
				return areaNToken.CellAddressRange;
			}
			if (referenceToken is Area3DNToken area3DNToken)
			{
				return area3DNToken.CellAddressRange;
			}
			if (referenceToken is Area3DToken area3DToken)
			{
				return area3DToken.CellAddressRange;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static int GetColumnNumber(int columnNumber, bool columnNumberIsOffset, WorksheetRow originCellRow, short originCellColumnIndex)
		{
			return GetAddressNumberHelper(columnNumber, columnNumberIsOffset, originCellColumnIndex, Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(originCellRow.Worksheet.CurrentFormat));
		}

		public static string GetDateSeparator(this DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo)
		{
			return dateTimeFormatInfo.DateSeparator;
		}

		public static Stream GetEmbeddedResourceStream(string relativePath)
		{
			string name = "Infragistics.Documents.Excel." + relativePath;
			return GetCurrentAssembly().GetManifestResourceStream(name);
		}

		public static int GetFirstMonthOfQuarter(int quarter)
		{
			return (quarter - 1) * 3 + 1;
		}

		public static FontFamilyInternal GetFontFamilyInternal(string fontName)
		{
			if (fontName == null)
			{
				return FontFamilyInternal.DontCare;
			}
			if (_fontFamilies.TryGetValue(fontName, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return FontFamilyInternal.DontCare;
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, FontFamilyInternal> PopulateFontFamilyMappings()
		{
			Dictionary<string, FontFamilyInternal> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, FontFamilyInternal>();
			PrePopulateFontFamilyMappings(dictionary);
			PopulateFontFamilyMappingsNative(dictionary);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static StringElement GetFormattedStringElement(object value)
		{
			if (value is StringElement result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (value is FormattedString formattedString)
			{
				return formattedString.Element;
			}
			if (value is FormattedStringValueReference formattedStringValueReference)
			{
				return formattedStringValueReference.Element;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static List<string> GetLines(string value, out List<int> lineIndexes, out List<string> newlines)
		{
			lineIndexes = new List<int>();
			lineIndexes.Add(0);
			newlines = new List<string>();
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (value[i])
				{
				case '\r':
					list.Add(value.Substring(num, i - num));
					if (i < value.Length - 1 && value[i + 1] == '\n')
					{
						newlines.Add("\r\n");
						i++;
					}
					else
					{
						newlines.Add("\r");
					}
					num = i + 1;
					lineIndexes.Add(num);
					break;
				case '\n':
					newlines.Add("\n");
					list.Add(value.Substring(num, i - num));
					num = i + 1;
					lineIndexes.Add(num);
					break;
				}
			}
			list.Add(value.Substring(num));
			return list;
		}

		public static CellFormatValue GetOppositeBorderValue(CellFormatValue value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo => CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle => CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle, 
				CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo => CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle => CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle, 
				CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo => CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle => CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle, 
				CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo => CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo, 
				CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle => CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle, 
				_ => value, 
			};
		}

		public static List<CellAddressRange> GetRangesFromFormula(Formula formula)
		{
			List<CellAddressRange> list = new List<CellAddressRange>();
			if (formula == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			FormulaToken[] postfixTokenList = formula.PostfixTokenList;
			foreach (FormulaToken formulaToken in postfixTokenList)
			{
				if (!(formulaToken is MemOperatorBase) && !(formulaToken is UnionOperator))
				{
					if (formulaToken is Ref3DToken ref3DToken)
					{
						list.Add(new CellAddressRange(ref3DToken.CellAddress, ref3DToken.CellAddress));
					}
					else if (formulaToken is Area3DToken area3DToken)
					{
						list.Add(area3DToken.CellAddressRange);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
