		public static WorkbookFormat GetWorkbookFormat(Stream stream, string parameterName, WorkbookOptionsBase options)
		{
			return GetWorkbookFormat(stream, parameterName, throwExcepionOnError: true, options);
		}

		private static WorkbookFormat GetWorkbookFormat(Stream stream, string parameterName, bool throwExcepionOnError, WorkbookOptionsBase options)
		{
			if (stream == null || stream.Length == 0)
			{
				return (WorkbookFormat)(-1);
			}
			if (StructuredStorageManager.IsStructuredStorageStream(stream))
			{
				return WorkbookFormat.Excel97To2003;
			}
			try
			{
				IPackage val = options.PackageFactoryResolved.Open(stream, FileMode.Open);
				try
				{
					WorkbookFormat? workbookFormat = GetWorkbookFormat(val);
					if (workbookFormat.HasValue)
					{
						return workbookFormat.Value;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			if (throwExcepionOnError)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidFileFormat"), parameterName);
			}
			return (WorkbookFormat)(-1);
		}

		private static WorkbookFormat? GetWorkbookFormat(IPackage package)
		{
			foreach (IPackageRelationship relationship in package.GetRelationships())
			{
				if (relationship.RelationshipType != "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" && relationship.RelationshipType != "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/officeDocument")
				{
					continue;
				}
				Uri targetPartPath = PackageUtilities.GetTargetPartPath(relationship);
				IPackagePart part = package.GetPart(targetPartPath);
				switch (part.ContentType)
				{
				case "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml":
					if (relationship.RelationshipType == "http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/officeDocument")
					{
						return WorkbookFormat.StrictOpenXml;
					}
					return WorkbookFormat.Excel2007;
				case "application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.macroEnabled.main+xml":
					return WorkbookFormat.Excel2007MacroEnabled;
				case "application/vnd.ms-excel.template.macroEnabled.main+xml":
					return WorkbookFormat.Excel2007MacroEnabledTemplate;
				case "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.template.main+xml":
					return WorkbookFormat.Excel2007Template;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static WorkbookFormat GetWorkbookFormat(string fileName, Stream workbookStream, WorkbookOptionsBase options)
		{
			return GetWorkbookFormat(fileName, workbookStream, null, throwExcepionOnError: false, options);
		}

		public static WorkbookFormat GetWorkbookFormat(string fileName, string parameterName, WorkbookOptionsBase options, Stream associatedStream = null)
		{
			return GetWorkbookFormat(fileName, associatedStream, parameterName, throwExcepionOnError: true, options);
		}

		private static WorkbookFormat GetWorkbookFormat(string fileName, Stream workbookStream, string parameterName, bool throwExcepionOnError, WorkbookOptionsBase options)
		{
			WorkbookFormat? workbookFormat = Workbook.GetWorkbookFormat(fileName);
			if (workbookFormat.HasValue)
			{
				return workbookFormat.Value;
			}
			if (workbookStream != null)
			{
				return GetWorkbookFormat(workbookStream, parameterName, throwExcepionOnError, options);
			}
			return GetWorkbookFormatFromPath(fileName, parameterName, throwExcepionOnError, options);
		}

		private static int HueToRGB(int n1, int n2, int hue)
		{
			if (hue < 0)
			{
				hue += 240;
			}
			if (hue > 240)
			{
				hue -= 240;
			}
			if (hue < 40)
			{
				return n1 + ((n2 - n1) * hue + 20) / 40;
			}
			if (hue < 120)
			{
				return n2;
			}
			if (hue < 160)
			{
				return n1 + ((n2 - n1) * (160 - hue) + 20) / 40;
			}
			return n1;
		}

		public static bool IsNumber(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is sbyte) && !(value is byte) && !(value is short) && !(value is ushort) && !(value is int) && !(value is uint) && !(value is long) && !(value is ulong) && !(value is float) && !(value is double))
			{
				return value is decimal;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsNumericType(object value)
		{
			if (value is double d)
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(d) || double.IsNaN(d))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			Type type = value.GetType();
			if (type.IsPrimitive() || type == typeof(decimal))
			{
				if (type != typeof(bool) && type != typeof(char))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsRotatedShapeAngle(float angle)
		{
			if (!(angle >= 45f))
			{
				if (angle < -45f)
				{
					return (angle - 45f) % 180f < -90f;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return (angle + 45f) % 180f >= 90f;
		}

		public static bool IsUnicodeString(string value)
		{
			int num;
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i += num)
			{
				num = value.Length - i;
				if (num > 100)
				{
					num = 100;
				}
				byte[] bytes = Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(value.Substring(i, num));
				for (int j = 1; j < bytes.Length; j += 2)
				{
					if (bytes[j] != 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static T MergeObject<T>(T majorObject, T minorObject) where T : class
		{
			if (minorObject == null)
			{
				return majorObject;
			}
			if (majorObject == null)
			{
				return minorObject;
			}
			Type type = majorObject.GetType();
			if (type != minorObject.GetType())
			{
				return majorObject;
			}
			try
			{
				T val = (T)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
				PropertyInfo[] properties = type.GetProperties();
				foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
				{
					try
					{
						object value = propertyInfo.GetValue(majorObject, null);
						object value2 = propertyInfo.GetValue(minorObject, null);
						Type propertyType = propertyInfo.PropertyType;
						if (typeof(IList).IsAssignableFrom(propertyType))
						{
							IList list = (IList)value;
							IList list2 = (IList)value2;
							IList list3 = ((list.Count != 0) ? list : list2);
							IList list4 = (IList)propertyInfo.GetValue(val, null);
							foreach (object item in list3)
							{
								list4.Add(item);
							}
						}
						else if (propertyInfo.CanWrite)
						{
							object value3 = ((propertyType.IsValueType() || propertyType == typeof(string)) ? (value ?? value2) : MergeObject(value, value2));
							propertyInfo.SetValue(val, value3, null);
						}
						else if (!(propertyType == typeof(bool)))
						{
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				return val;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return majorObject;
			}
		}

		public static bool ParseA1CellAddress(string address, WorkbookFormat format, CultureInfo culture, out short columnIndex, out int rowIndex)
		{
			return ParseA1CellAddress(address, 0, address.Length, format, culture, out columnIndex, out rowIndex);
		}

		public static bool ParseA1CellAddress(string valueWithAddress, int addressStartIndex, int length, WorkbookFormat format, CultureInfo culture, out short columnIndex, out int rowIndex)
		{
			columnIndex = 0;
			rowIndex = 0;
			bool isRelative = false;
			if (!FormulaParser.ParseColumnAddressA1(valueWithAddress, addressStartIndex, format, culture, ref columnIndex, ref isRelative, out var matchLength))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool isRelative2 = false;
			if (!FormulaParser.ParseRowAddressA1(valueWithAddress, addressStartIndex + matchLength, format, ref rowIndex, ref isRelative2, out var matchLength2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return matchLength2 + matchLength == length;
		}

		public static WorksheetRegion ParseA1RegionAddress(string address, Worksheet worksheet, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ParseA1RegionAddress(address, worksheet.CurrentFormat, culture, out var firstRowIndex, out var firstColumnIndex, out var lastRowIndex, out var lastColumnIndex);
			if (0 <= lastRowIndex)
			{
				return worksheet.GetCachedRegion(firstRowIndex, firstColumnIndex, lastRowIndex, lastColumnIndex);
			}
			if (0 <= firstRowIndex)
			{
				return worksheet.GetCachedRegion(firstRowIndex, firstColumnIndex, firstRowIndex, firstColumnIndex);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static void ParseA1RegionAddress(string address, WorkbookFormat format, CultureInfo culture, out int firstRowIndex, out short firstColumnIndex, out int lastRowIndex, out short lastColumnIndex)
		{
			firstRowIndex = -1;
			firstColumnIndex = -1;
			lastRowIndex = -1;
			lastColumnIndex = -1;
			address = address.TrimEnd();
			int num = address.IndexOf(':');
			short columnIndex3;
			int rowIndex3;
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				string text = address.Substring(0, num);
				text = text.TrimEnd();
				string text2 = address.Substring(num + 1);
				text2 = text2.TrimStart();
				bool flag = false;
				short columnIndex = 0;
				int rowIndex = 0;
				short columnIndex2 = 0;
				int rowIndex2 = 0;
				if (ParseA1CellAddress(text, format, culture, out columnIndex, out rowIndex) && ParseA1CellAddress(text2, format, culture, out columnIndex2, out rowIndex2))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					bool isRelative = false;
					if (FormulaParser.ParseColumnAddressA1(text, 0, format, culture, ref columnIndex, ref isRelative, out var matchLength))
					{
						if (matchLength != text.Length)
						{
							return;
						}
						if (FormulaParser.ParseColumnAddressA1(text2, 0, format, culture, ref columnIndex2, ref isRelative, out matchLength))
						{

		public static void ReduceFraction(ref int numerator, ref int denominator)
		{
			if (numerator == denominator)
			{
				numerator = 1;
				denominator = 1;
				return;
			}
			if (numerator == -denominator)
			{
				numerator = 1;
				denominator = -1;
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Primes.Length; i++)
			{
				int num = Primes[i];
				if (numerator < num || denominator < num)
				{
					break;
				}
				while (numerator % num == 0 && denominator % num == 0)
				{
					numerator /= num;
					denominator /= num;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void RGBToCIELAB(Color color, out double l, out double a, out double b)
		{
			double num = (double)(int)color.R / 255.0;
			double num2 = (double)(int)color.G / 255.0;
			double num3 = (double)(int)color.B / 255.0;
			double num4 = num * 0.412453 + num2 * 0.35758 + num3 * 0.180423;
			double num5 = num * 0.212671 + num2 * 0.71516 + num3 * 0.072169;
			double num6 = num * 0.019334 + num2 * 0.119193 + num3 * 0.950227;
			double num7 = RGBToCIELABHelper(num4 / 0.95047);
			double num8 = RGBToCIELABHelper(num5 / 1.0);
			double num9 = RGBToCIELABHelper(num6 / 1.08883);
			l = 116.0 * num8 - 16.0;
			a = 500.0 * (num7 - num8);
			b = 200.0 * (num8 - num9);
		}

		private static double RGBToCIELABHelper(double value)
		{
			if (value > 0.008856)
			{
				return Math.Pow(value, 1.0 / 3.0);
			}
			return 7.787 * value + 0.13793103448275862;
		}

			{
				format.SetValue(associatedBorderValue, value, callBeforeAndAfterSet: true, options);

			{
				adjacentFormat.ResetValue(oppositeBorderValue, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventAdjacentBorderSyncronization);
				adjacentFormat.ResetValue(associatedBorderValue2, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventAdjacentBorderSyncronization);
			}
		}

		public static uint ToFixedPoint16_16Value(double value)
		{
			double num = MathUtilities.Truncate(value);
			short num2 = (short)num;
			num = Math.Abs(value % 1.0) * 65536.0;
			ushort num3 = (ushort)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num);
			return (uint)((num2 << 16) + num3);
		}

		public static void TrimFormattingRuns(IFormattedRunOwner runOwner)
		{
			List<FormattingRunBase> formattingRuns = runOwner.GetFormattingRuns(null);
			string unformattedString = runOwner.UnformattedString;
			int num = formattingRuns.Count - 1;
			while (num >= 0 && unformattedString.Length <= formattingRuns[num].FirstFormattedCharInOwner)
			{
				FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase = formattingRuns[num];
				if (formattingRunBase.HasFont)
				{
					formattingRunBase.GetFontInternal(null).OnUnrooted();
				}
				formattingRuns.RemoveAt(num);
				num--;
			}
		}

		public static bool TryEncodeRKValue(double value, out uint rkValue)
		{
			rkValue = 0u;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
			{
				byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes(value);
				if (bytes[0] == 0 && bytes[1] == 0 && bytes[2] == 0 && bytes[3] == 0 && (bytes[4] & 3) == 0)
				{
					rkValue = BitConverter.ToUInt32(bytes, 4);
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				if (value % 1.0 == 0.0 && -536870912.0 <= value && value <= 536870911.0)
				{
					rkValue = (uint)((int)value << 2);
					rkValue |= 2u;
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				value *= 100.0;
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					rkValue |= 1u;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryGetNumericValue(Workbook workbook, object value, out double numericValue)
		{
			if (value is DateTime)
			{
				double? num = ExcelCalcValue.DateTimeToExcelDate(workbook, (DateTime)value);
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					numericValue = num.Value;
					return true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (value is double)
				{
					numericValue = (double)value;
					return true;
				}
				if (value is int)
				{
					numericValue = (int)value;
					return true;
				}
				if (value is float || value is long || value is ulong || value is uint || value is short || value is ushort || value is sbyte || value is byte || value is decimal)
				{
					try
					{
						CultureInfo provider = CurrentCulture;
						if (workbook != null)
						{
							provider = workbook.CultureResolved;
						}
						numericValue = Convert.ToDouble(value, provider);
						return true;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (value is TimeSpan)
					{
						numericValue = ExcelCalcValue.TimeOfDayToExcelDate((TimeSpan)value, useDayInfo: true);
						return true;
					}
					if (value == ErrorValue.Circularity)
					{
						numericValue = 0.0;
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			numericValue = double.NaN;
			return false;
		}

		public static string UnescapeWildcards(string value)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(value);
			for (int i = 0; i < stringBuilder.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = stringBuilder[i];
				if (c == '~')
				{
					stringBuilder.Remove(i, 1);
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static void VerifyBlockedRegions(WorksheetRegion[] regions, HashSet<IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue> verifiedBlockingRegions = null)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = regions[0].Worksheet;
			foreach (WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion in regions)
			{
				for (int j = worksheetRegion.FirstRow; j <= worksheetRegion.LastRow; j++)
				{
					WorksheetRow ifCreated = worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(j);
					if (ifCreated == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (short num = worksheetRegion.FirstColumnInternal; num <= worksheetRegion.LastColumnInternal; num++)
					{
						if (ifCreated.GetCellValueRaw(num) is IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue worksheetRegionBlockingValue)
						{
							if (!worksheetRegion.Contains(worksheetRegionBlockingValue.BlockedRegion))
							{
								worksheetRegionBlockingValue.ThrowBlockingException();
							}
							verifiedBlockingRegions?.Add(worksheetRegionBlockingValue);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void VerifyEnumValue<T>(T value, string paramName)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(T), value))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(paramName, Convert.ToInt32(value), typeof(T));

		public static void VerifyRowCount(Worksheet worksheet, int count, string paramName)
		{
			int maxCount = worksheet.Rows.MaxCount;
			if (0 <= count && count <= maxCount)
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(paramName, count, GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_InvalidRowCount", count, 0, maxCount));
		}

		public static void VerifyRowIndex(Worksheet worksheet, int index, string paramName)
		{
			int maxCount = worksheet.Rows.MaxCount;
			if (0 <= index && index <= maxCount - 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(paramName, index, GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_InvalidRowIndex", index, 0, maxCount - 1));
		}

		public static ImageHolder GetImageHolder(this ImageData imageData)
		{
			ImageHolder imageHolder = imageData.Tag as ImageHolder;
			if (imageHolder == null)
			{
				using (MemoryStream imageStream = new MemoryStream(imageData.Data))
				{
					imageHolder = GetImageHolder(imageStream, imageData.Format);
				}
				imageData.Tag = imageHolder;
			}
			return imageHolder;
		}

		private static ImageHolder GetImageHolder(Stream imageStream, ImageFormat format)
		{
			using Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(imageStream);
			Bitmap bitmap2;
			switch (bitmap.PixelFormat)
			{
			case PixelFormat.Undefined:
			case PixelFormat.Format1bppIndexed:
			case PixelFormat.Format4bppIndexed:
			case PixelFormat.Format8bppIndexed:
			case PixelFormat.Format16bppArgb1555:
			case PixelFormat.Format16bppGrayScale:
				bitmap2 = new Bitmap(bitmap);
				break;
			default:
			{
				bitmap2 = new Bitmap(bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height, bitmap.PixelFormat);
				using (Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap2))
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, bitmap.Size);
					graphics.DrawImage(bitmap, rectangle, rectangle, GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			PropertyItem[] propertyItems = bitmap.PropertyItems;
			foreach (PropertyItem propertyItem in propertyItems)
			{
				bitmap2.SetPropertyItem(propertyItem);
			}
			return new ImageHolder(bitmap2, bitmap.RawFormat);
		}

		public static BorderThickness GetThickness(this CellBorderLineStyle style)
		{
			switch (style)
			{
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Thick:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Double:
				return BorderThickness.Thick;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Medium:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.MediumDashed:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.MediumDashDot:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.MediumDashDotDot:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.SlantedDashDot:
				return BorderThickness.Medium;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.None:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Thin:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Dashed:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Dotted:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Hair:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.DashDot:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.DashDotDot:
				return BorderThickness.Thin;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Default:
				return BorderThickness.Thin;
			default:
				return BorderThickness.Thin;
			}
		}

		public static ST_BorderStyle ToST_BorderStyle(this CellBorderLineStyle cellBorderLineStyle)
		{
			switch (cellBorderLineStyle)
			{
			case CellBorderLineStyle.DashDot:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)9;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.DashDotDot:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)11;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Dashed:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)3;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Dotted:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)4;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Double:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)6;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Hair:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)7;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Medium:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)2;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.MediumDashDot:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)10;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.MediumDashDotDot:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)12;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.MediumDashed:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)8;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Default:
			case CellBorderLineStyle.None:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)0;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.SlantedDashDot:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)13;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Thick:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)5;
			case CellBorderLineStyle.Thin:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)1;
			default:
				return (ST_BorderStyle)0;
			}
		}

			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			WorksheetCellAddress item = new WorksheetCellAddress(marker.Row, (short)marker.Col);
			int columnWidthInTwips = worksheet.GetColumnWidthInTwips(marker.Col, treatAllAsVisible: true);
			int rowHeightInTwips = worksheet.GetRowHeightInTwips(marker.Row, treatAllAsVisible: true);
			ST_Coordinate colOff = marker.ColOff;
			double twips = ((ST_Coordinate)(ref colOff)).GetTwips();
			ST_Coordinate rowOff = marker.RowOff;
			double twips2 = ((ST_Coordinate)(ref rowOff)).GetTwips();
			PointF item2 = new PointF((float)(twips * 100.0 / (double)columnWidthInTwips), (float)(twips2 * 100.0 / (double)rowHeightInTwips));
			return Tuple.Create(item, item2);
		}

		public static WorksheetView ToWorksheetView(this ST_SheetViewType sheetViewType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)sheetViewType switch
			{
				0 => WorksheetView.Normal, 
				1 => WorksheetView.PageBreakPreview, 
				2 => WorksheetView.PageLayout, 
				_ => WorksheetView.Normal, 
			};
		}

		public static WorksheetVisibility ToWorksheetVisibility(this ST_SheetState visibility)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)visibility switch
			{
				1 => WorksheetVisibility.Hidden, 
				2 => WorksheetVisibility.StrongHidden, 
				0 => WorksheetVisibility.Visible, 
				_ => WorksheetVisibility.Visible, 
			};
		}
	}

		private struct FontNameHeightPair
		{
			public readonly int Height;

			public readonly string Name;

			public FontNameHeightPair(string name, int height)
			{
				Name = name;
				Height = height;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is FontNameHeightPair fontNameHeightPair))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Name == fontNameHeightPair.Name)
				{
					return Height == fontNameHeightPair.Height;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return Name.GetHashCode() ^ Height.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		internal int MeasuredRowHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (measuredRowHeight == 0 || measuredRowHeight_DefaultFontVersion != workbook.DefaultFontVersion)
				{
					measuredRowHeight_DefaultFontVersion = workbook.DefaultFontVersion;
					WorksheetCellFormatData styleFormatInternal = workbook.Styles.NormalStyle.StyleFormatInternal;
					_ = styleFormatInternal.FontNameResolved;
					_ = styleFormatInternal.FontHeightResolved;
					double num = 0.0;
					Dictionary<FontNameHeightPair, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<FontNameHeightPair, bool>();
					using (TextMetricsProviderBase textMetricsProviderBase = Workbook.CreateDefaultTextMetricsProvider(Workbook))
					{
						foreach (WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock in ColumnBlocks)
						{
							WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat = columnBlock.CellFormat;
							string fontNameResolved = cellFormat.FontNameResolved;
							int fontHeightResolved = cellFormat.FontHeightResolved;
							FontNameHeightPair key = new FontNameHeightPair(fontNameResolved, fontHeightResolved);
							if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(key))
							{
								dictionary.Add(key, value: true);
								num = Math.Max(num, textMetricsProviderBase.GetDefaultRowHeight(cellFormat));
							}
						}
					}
					if (DefaultRowHasThickTop)
					{
						num += 1.0;
					}
					if (DefaultRowHasThickBottom)
					{
						num += 1.0;
					}
					measuredRowHeight = Math.Min((int)Workbook.ConvertPixelsToTwips(Workbook, num, vertical: true), 8192);
				}
				return measuredRowHeight;
			}
		}

		internal bool DefaultRowHasThickBottom
		{
			get
			{
				return _defaultRowHasThickBottom;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_defaultRowHasThickBottom != value)
				{
					_defaultRowHasThickBottom = value;
					ResetMeasuredRowHeight();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool DefaultRowHasThickTop
		{
			get
			{
				return _defaultRowHasThickTop;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_defaultRowHasThickTop != value)
				{
					_defaultRowHasThickTop = value;
					ResetMeasuredRowHeight();
				}
			}
		}

					_visitedHyperlinkCells = new List<WorksheetCell>();
				}
				return _visitedHyperlinkCells;
			}
		}

		{

			SetDefaultColumnWidthHelper(ConvertToCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(value, units), createUndo);
			if (Workbook != null && !Workbook.IsLoading)
			{
				ShouldSaveDefaultColumnWidths256th = true;
			}
			if (alignTo8Pixels)
			{
				double num = GetDefaultColumnWidth(WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Pixel);
				num = Math.Ceiling(num / 8.0) * 8.0;
				SetDefaultColumnWidthHelper(ConvertToCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(num, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Pixel), createUndo);
			}
			_lastSetDefaultColumnWidthInfo = new SetColumnWidthInfo(value, units, alignTo8Pixels);
		}

		internal void AddCachedRegion(WorksheetRegion region, out WorksheetRegion foundRegion)
		{
			AddCachedRegion(region, allowDuplicates: false, out foundRegion);
		}

		private void AddCachedRegion(WorksheetRegion region, bool allowDuplicates, out WorksheetRegion foundRegion)
		{
			int num = Utilities.BinarySearch(cachedRegions, region, WorksheetRegion.HorizontalSorter.Instance, allowDuplicates, out foundRegion);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				cachedRegions.Insert(~num, new WeakReference(region));
			}
		}

		internal bool AreCellsNonTrivial(int rowIndex, short firstColumnIndex, short lastColumnIndex)
		{
			return AreCellsNonTrivial(rowIndex, rowIndex, firstColumnIndex, lastColumnIndex, isPerformingShift: false);
		}

		private bool AreCellsNonTrivial(int firstRowIndex, int lastRowIndex, short firstColumnIndex, short lastColumnIndex, bool isPerformingShift)
		{
			WorksheetRegionAddress region = new WorksheetRegionAddress(firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex, firstColumnIndex, lastColumnIndex);
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				workbook.CalcEngine.VerifyCalcNetwork();
				foreach (WorksheetRow item in Rows.GetItemsInRange(firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex))
				{
					if (item == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (short num = firstColumnIndex; num <= lastColumnIndex; num++)
					{
						CellCalcReference cellCalcReference = item.TryGetCellCalcReference(num);
						if (cellCalcReference != null && !isPerformingShift && workbook.CalcEngine.IsReferenced(cellCalcReference))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (HasMergedCellRegions)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < MergedCellsRegions.Count; i++)
				{
					WorksheetMergedCellsRegion worksheetMergedCellsRegion = MergedCellsRegions[i];
					if (worksheetMergedCellsRegion.FirstRow <= lastRowIndex && firstRowIndex <= worksheetMergedCellsRegion.LastRow && firstColumnIndex <= worksheetMergedCellsRegion.LastColumnInternal && worksheetMergedCellsRegion.FirstColumnInternal <= lastColumnIndex)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Tables.Count; j++)
			{
				WorksheetTable worksheetTable = Tables[j];
				WorksheetRegionAddress wholeTableAddress = worksheetTable.WholeTableAddress;
				if (wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex <= lastRowIndex && firstRowIndex <= wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex && firstColumnIndex <= wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex && wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex <= lastColumnIndex)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < DataTables.Count; k++)
			{
				WorksheetDataTable worksheetDataTable = DataTables[k];
				WorksheetRegion cellsInTable = worksheetDataTable.CellsInTable;
				if (cellsInTable != null && cellsInTable.Worksheet != null && cellsInTable.FirstRow <= lastRowIndex && firstRowIndex <= cellsInTable.LastRow && firstColumnIndex <= cellsInTable.LastColumnInternal && cellsInTable.FirstColumnInternal <= lastColumnIndex)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (IsDataPresentInRow(firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex, firstColumnIndex, lastColumnIndex))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!isPerformingShift && HasDataValidationRules && DataValidationRules.Contains(region))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal WorksheetColumnBlock[] CloneColumnBlocks(short columnIndex, short count)
		{
			WorksheetColumnBlock block;
			int num = GetBlockIndexHelper(columnIndex, count, isInsertOperation: false, out block);
			short num2 = columnIndex;
			short num3 = (short)(columnIndex + count - 1);
			WorksheetColumnBlock[] result;
			if (block.LastColumnIndex >= num3)
			{
				result = new WorksheetColumnBlock[1] { block.Clone(Workbook, num2, num3) };
			}
			else
			{
				List<WorksheetColumnBlock> list = new List<WorksheetColumnBlock>();
				WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = block.Clone(Workbook, num2, block.LastColumnIndex);
				list.Add(worksheetColumnBlock);
				int num4 = count - worksheetColumnBlock.CountOfColumns;
				num2 = (short)(num2 + worksheetColumnBlock.CountOfColumns);
				while (num4 > 0)
				{
					num++;
					block = columnBlocks[num];
					worksheetColumnBlock = block.Clone(Workbook, num2, Math.Min(block.LastColumnIndex, num3));
					list.Add(worksheetColumnBlock);
					num4 -= worksheetColumnBlock.CountOfColumns;
					num2 += (short)worksheetColumnBlock.CountOfColumns;
				}
				result = list.ToArray();
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal double ConvertCharactersPaddingExcludedToPixels(double displayWidth)
		{
			double num = ZeroCharacterWidth;
			int columnWidthPadding = GetColumnWidthPadding(num);
			double num2 = num + (double)columnWidthPadding;
			double value = ((!(displayWidth < 1.0)) ? (displayWidth * num + (double)columnWidthPadding) : (displayWidth * num2));
			value = MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value);
			if (DisplayOptions.ShowFormulasInCells)
			{
				value *= 2.0;
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal double ConvertCharactersToPixels(double width, bool snapToPixels)
		{
			double num = width * (double)ZeroCharacterWidth;
			if (snapToPixels)
			{
				num = MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num);
			}
			if (DisplayOptions.ShowFormulasInCells)
			{
				num *= 2.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal double ConvertFromCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(int character256ths, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit units, bool snapToPixels = true)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyWorksheetColumnWidthUnit(units);
			if (character256ths < 0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			double num = character256ths;
			if (units == WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Character256th)
			{
				return num;
			}
			double num2 = num / 256.0;
			if (units == WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Character)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			double num3 = ConvertCharactersToPixels(num2, snapToPixels);
			switch (units)
			{
			case WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Pixel:
				return num3;
			case WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.CharacterPaddingExcluded:
				return ConvertPixelsToCharactersPaddingExcluded(num3);
			default:
			{
				double num4 = Workbook.ConvertPixelsToTwips(Workbook, num3, vertical: false);
				return units switch
				{
					WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Twip => num4, 
					WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Point => Workbook.ConvertTwipsToPoints(num4), 
					_ => double.NaN, 
				};
			}
			}
		}

		internal double ConvertPixelsToCharacters(double pixels)
		{
			if (DisplayOptions.ShowFormulasInCells)
			{
				pixels = Math.Floor(pixels / 2.0);
			}
			return pixels / (double)ZeroCharacterWidth;
		}

		internal double ConvertPixelsToCharactersPaddingExcluded(double pixels)
		{
			if (DisplayOptions.ShowFormulasInCells)
			{
				pixels = Math.Floor(pixels / 2.0);
			}
			double num = ZeroCharacterWidth;
			int columnWidthPadding = GetColumnWidthPadding(num);
			double num2 = num + (double)columnWidthPadding;
			double value = ((!(pixels < num2)) ? ((pixels - (double)columnWidthPadding) / num) : (pixels / num2));
			return MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value, 2);
		}

		internal int ConvertToCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(double value, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit units, bool snapToPixels = true)
		{
			if (double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InfiniteColumnWidth"), "value");
			}
			Utilities.VerifyWorksheetColumnWidthUnit(units);
			if (double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			switch (units)
			{
			case WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Character:
				value *= 256.0;
				break;
			case WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.CharacterPaddingExcluded:
				value = ConvertCharactersPaddingExcludedToPixels(value);
				goto case WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Pixel;
			case WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Pixel:
				value = ConvertPixelsToCharacters(value);
				goto case WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Character;
			case WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Point:
				value = Workbook.ConvertPointsToTwips(value);
				goto case WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Twip;
			case WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Twip:
				value = Workbook.ConvertTwipsToPixels(Workbook, value, vertical: false, snapToPixels);
				goto case WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Pixel;
			}
			return (int)MathUtilities.Truncate(value);
		}

		}

		internal void ExtendRegionForMergedCells(ref WorksheetRegionAddress range, HashSet<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion> intersectingRegions = null)
		{
			if (!HasMergedCellRegions)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = range;
			foreach (WorksheetMergedCellsRegion item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>)MergedCellsRegions)
			{
				WorksheetRegionAddress address = item.Address;
				if (address.IntersectsWith(range))
				{
					intersectingRegions?.Add(item);
					short firstColumnIndex = range.FirstColumnIndex;
					int firstRowIndex = range.FirstRowIndex;
					short lastColumnIndex = range.LastColumnIndex;
					int lastRowIndex = range.LastRowIndex;
					if (address.FirstColumnIndex < firstColumnIndex)
					{
						firstColumnIndex = address.FirstColumnIndex;
					}
					if (address.FirstRowIndex < firstRowIndex)
					{
						firstRowIndex = address.FirstRowIndex;
					}
					if (address.LastColumnIndex > lastColumnIndex)
					{
						lastColumnIndex = address.LastColumnIndex;
					}
					if (address.LastRowIndex > lastRowIndex)
					{
						lastRowIndex = address.LastRowIndex;
					}
					range = new WorksheetRegionAddress(firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex, firstColumnIndex, lastColumnIndex);
				}
			}
			if (range != worksheetRegionAddress && (intersectingRegions == null || intersectingRegions.Count < MergedCellsRegions.Count))
			{
				ExtendRegionForMergedCells(ref range, intersectingRegions);
			}
		}

			AddCachedRegion(worksheetRegion, out var foundRegion);
			return foundRegion ?? worksheetRegion;
		}

		internal WorksheetTable GetCellAssociatedTableInternal(int rowIndex, short columnIndex)
		{
			WorksheetTableCollection worksheetTableCollection = Tables;
			for (int i = 0; i < worksheetTableCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetTable worksheetTable = worksheetTableCollection[i];
				if (worksheetTable.Contains(rowIndex, columnIndex))
				{
					return worksheetTable;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal WorksheetCellFormatData GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(WorksheetRow row, int rowIndex, short columnIndex, out bool hasTableStyle, bool includeTableStyleFormats = false)
		{
			hasTableStyle = false;
			WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormatElementReadOnly = GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(row, columnIndex);
			if (!includeTableStyleFormats)
			{
				return cellFormatElementReadOnly;
			}
			WorksheetTable cellAssociatedTableInternal = GetCellAssociatedTableInternal(rowIndex, columnIndex);

		internal WorksheetRegionAddress GetUsedRange(int minRow, int maxRow, short minColumn, short maxColumn, bool includeShapes)
		{
			int num = minColumn;
			int num2 = minRow;
			int num3 = maxColumn;
			int num4 = maxRow;

			WorksheetCellFormatData objB = ((Workbook != null) ? Workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement : null);
			for (int num5 = list.Count - 1; num5 >= 0; num5--)
			{
				WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = list[num5];
				if (worksheetColumnBlock.OutlineLevel != 0)
				{
					num = worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex + 1;
					break;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock2 = list[i];
				if (worksheetColumnBlock2.OutlineLevel != 0)
				{
					num3 = worksheetColumnBlock2.FirstColumnIndex;
					break;
				}
				if (!object.Equals(worksheetColumnBlock2.CellFormat, objB))
				{
					num3 = worksheetColumnBlock2.FirstColumnIndex;
					break;
				}
			}
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in Rows.GetItemsInRange(minRow, maxRow, enumerateForwards: true))
			{
				if (!item.HasCellFormat && !item.HasCellFormatsForCells && !item.HasCustomHeight && item.GetCellBlocksWithValues().FirstOrDefault().Value == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				num2 = item.Index;
				if (num4 > num2)
				{
					num4 = num2;
				}
				foreach (CellDataContext cellsWithDatum in item.GetCellsWithData(num + 1, maxColumn))
				{
					num = cellsWithDatum.ColumnIndex;
				}
				using (IEnumerator<CellDataContext> enumerator3 = item.GetCellsWithData(minColumn, num3).GetEnumerator())
				{
					if (enumerator3.MoveNext())
					{
						CellDataContext current3 = enumerator3.Current;
						if (current3.ColumnIndex < num3)
						{
							num3 = current3.ColumnIndex;
						}
					}
				}
				if (item.HasCellFormatsForCells)
				{
					int? lastColumnIndexWithFormatting = item.GetLastColumnIndexWithFormatting((short)num, maxColumn);
					if (lastColumnIndexWithFormatting.HasValue)
					{
						num = lastColumnIndexWithFormatting.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			if (HasCellOwnedComments)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetCellAddress key in CellOwnedComments.Keys)
				{
					if (key.RowIndex >= minRow && key.RowIndex <= maxRow)
					{
						if (key.RowIndex < num4)
						{
							num4 = key.RowIndex;
						}
						if (key.ColumnIndex < num3)
						{
							num3 = key.ColumnIndex;
						}
						if (key.ColumnIndex > num)
						{
							num = key.ColumnIndex;
						}
						if (key.RowIndex > num2)
						{
							num2 = key.RowIndex;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (HasCellOwnedAssociatedMergedCellsRegions)
			{
				WorksheetRegionAddress other = new WorksheetRegionAddress(minRow, maxRow, minColumn, maxColumn);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<WorksheetCellAddress, WorksheetMergedCellsRegion> cellOwnedAssociatedMergedCellsRegion in CellOwnedAssociatedMergedCellsRegions)
				{
					WorksheetRegionAddress address = cellOwnedAssociatedMergedCellsRegion.Value.Address;
					if (address.IntersectsWith(other))
					{
						if (address.FirstRowIndex < num4)
						{
							num4 = address.FirstRowIndex;
						}
						if (address.FirstColumnIndex < num3)
						{
							num3 = address.FirstColumnIndex;
						}
						if (address.LastColumnIndex > num)
						{
							num = address.LastColumnIndex;
						}
						if (address.LastRowIndex > num2)
						{
							num2 = address.LastRowIndex;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (includeShapes && (num < maxColumn || num2 < maxRow))

					if (bottomRightCornerCellInternal.ColumnIndex > num)
					{
						num = Math.Min(bottomRightCornerCellInternal.ColumnIndex, maxColumn);
					}
				}
			}

			}
			if (num4 < minRow)
			{

			}
			if (num > maxColumn)
			{
				num = maxColumn;
			}
			if (num2 > maxRow)
			{
				num2 = maxRow;
			}
			if (num3 > num)
			{
				num3 = num;
			}
			if (num4 > num2)
			{

			}

		internal void OnColumnsInserted(short columnIndex, short count)
		{
			int blockIndexHelper = GetBlockIndexHelper(columnIndex, count, isInsertOperation: true, out var block);
			short maxColumnCountInternal = workbook.MaxColumnCountInternal;
			int firstModifiedBlockIndex = blockIndexHelper;
			short num = (short)(block.LastColumnIndex + 1);
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = blockIndexHelper + 1; i < columnBlocks.Count; i++)
			{
				if (num >= maxColumnCountInternal)
				{
					num2++;
					continue;
				}
				WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = columnBlocks[i];
				int num3 = worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex + 1 - worksheetColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex;
				worksheetColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex = num;
				worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex = (short)Math.Min(num + num3 - 1, maxColumnCountInternal - 1);
				num = (short)(worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex + 1);
			}
			while (num2 > 0)
			{
				blockIndexHelper = columnBlocks.Count - 1;
				RemoveBlockHelper(blockIndexHelper, columnBlocks[blockIndexHelper]);
				num2--;
			}
			FixupColumnBlockIndices(firstModifiedBlockIndex);
		}

		internal void OnColumnsRemoved(short columnIndex, short count)
		{
			int num = BinarySearchForColumnBlock(columnIndex);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num - 1;
			}
			WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = columnBlocks[num];
			int num2 = count;
			int num3 = num;
			if (worksheetColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex == columnIndex && worksheetColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex + count >= worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex + 1)
			{
				num2 -= worksheetColumnBlock.CountOfColumns;
				RemoveBlockHelper(num, worksheetColumnBlock);
				if (num < columnBlocks.Count)
				{
					WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock2 = columnBlocks[num];
					int countOfColumns = worksheetColumnBlock2.CountOfColumns;
					worksheetColumnBlock2.FirstColumnIndex = columnIndex;
					worksheetColumnBlock2.LastColumnIndex = (short)(columnIndex + countOfColumns - 1);
				}
				if (num3 > 0)
				{
					num3--;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int num4 = Math.Min(worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex + 1 - columnIndex, count);
				worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex -= (short)num4;
				num2 -= num4;
				num++;
			}
			while (num2 > 0)
			{
				worksheetColumnBlock = columnBlocks[num];
				int countOfColumns2 = worksheetColumnBlock.CountOfColumns;
				if (countOfColumns2 <= num2)
				{
					num2 -= countOfColumns2;
					RemoveBlockHelper(num, worksheetColumnBlock);
				}
				else
				{

		internal void OnCurrentFormatChanged()
		{
			WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = columnBlocks[columnBlocks.Count - 1];

		}

		private void ReapplyColumnBlock(WorksheetColumnBlock oldColumnBlock)
		{
			short firstColumnIndex = oldColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex;
			short lastColumnIndex = oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex;
			WorksheetColumnBlock block;
			int num = GetBlockIndexHelper(firstColumnIndex, (short)(lastColumnIndex - (firstColumnIndex + 1)), isInsertOperation: false, out block);
			bool flag = block == oldColumnBlock;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (block.LastColumnIndex >= oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex)
				{
					return;
				}
				num2 = oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex - block.LastColumnIndex;
				block.LastColumnIndex = oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex;
			}
			else if (block.FirstColumnIndex == oldColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex)
			{
				if (block.LastColumnIndex == oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex)
				{
					columnBlocks[num] = oldColumnBlock;
					return;
				}
				if (block.LastColumnIndex > oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex)
				{
					columnBlocks.Insert(num, oldColumnBlock);
					block.FirstColumnIndex = (short)(oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex + 1);
					return;
				}
				num2 = oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex - block.LastColumnIndex;
				columnBlocks[num] = oldColumnBlock;
			}
			else if (oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex >= block.LastColumnIndex)
			{
				num2 = oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex - block.LastColumnIndex;
				block.LastColumnIndex = (short)(oldColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex - 1);
				columnBlocks.Insert(num + 1, oldColumnBlock);
			}
			else
			{
				short lastColumnIndex2 = block.LastColumnIndex;
				block.LastColumnIndex = (short)(oldColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex - 1);
				columnBlocks.Insert(num + 1, oldColumnBlock);
				if (lastColumnIndex2 > oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex)
				{
					columnBlocks.Insert(num + 2, block.Clone(workbook, (short)(oldColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex + 1), lastColumnIndex2));
				}
			}
			while (num2 > 0)
			{
				num++;
				block = columnBlocks[num];
				if (num2 >= block.CountOfColumns)
				{
					num2 -= block.CountOfColumns;
					columnBlocks.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					block.FirstColumnIndex += (short)num2;
					num2 = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ReapplyFilters(int firstRowIndex, int lastRowIndex, List<IFilterable> filterableItems)
		{
			if (Workbook != null && Workbook.IsLoading)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (filterableItems.Count == 0)
			{
				if (DefaultRowHidden)
				{
					for (int i = firstRowIndex; i <= lastRowIndex; i++)
					{
						Rows[i].Hidden = false;
					}
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (WorksheetRow item in Rows.GetItemsInRange(firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex))
					{
						item.Hidden = false;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < filterableItems.Count; j++)
			{
				IFilterable filterable = filterableItems[j];
				if (!filterable.Filter.OnBeforeFilterColumn(this, firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex, filterable.ColumnIndex))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			for (int k = firstRowIndex; k <= lastRowIndex; k++)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Rows.GetIfCreated(k);
				bool flag = false;
				for (int l = 0; l < filterableItems.Count; l++)
				{
					IFilterable filterable2 = filterableItems[l];
					if (!filterable2.Filter.MeetsCriteria(this, worksheetRow, filterable2.ColumnIndex))
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag != IsRowHidden(worksheetRow))
				{
					if (worksheetRow == null)
					{
						worksheetRow = Rows[k];
					}
					worksheetRow.Hidden = flag;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ReduceRangeForIntersectingMergedCells(ref WorksheetRegionAddress range)
		{
			if (!HasMergedCellRegions)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetMergedCellsRegion item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>)MergedCellsRegions)
			{
				WorksheetRegionAddress address = item.Address;
				if (address.IntersectsWith(range) && !range.Contains(address))
				{
					short num = range.FirstColumnIndex;
					int num2 = range.FirstRowIndex;
					short num3 = range.LastColumnIndex;
					int num4 = range.LastRowIndex;
					if (address.FirstColumnIndex < num)
					{
						num = (short)(address.LastColumnIndex + 1);
					}
					if (address.FirstRowIndex < num2)
					{
						num2 = address.LastRowIndex + 1;
					}
					if (address.LastColumnIndex > num3)
					{
						num3 = (short)(address.FirstColumnIndex - 1);
					}
					if (address.LastRowIndex > num4)
					{
						num4 = address.FirstRowIndex - 1;
					}
					range = new WorksheetRegionAddress(num2, num4, num, num3);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveDisconnectedVisitedHyperlinks()
		{
			if (_visitedHyperlinkCells == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = _visitedHyperlinkCells.Count;
			int num = 0;
			for (int num2 = count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if (_visitedHyperlinkCells[num2].Worksheet == null)
				{
					_visitedHyperlinkCells[num2] = _visitedHyperlinkCells[count - num - 1];
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				_visitedHyperlinkCells.RemoveRange(count - num, num);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveIntersectingMergedCellRegions(WorksheetRegionAddress range, HashSet<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion> regionsToSkip = null)
		{
			if (!HasMergedCellRegions)

				if ((regionsToSkip == null || !regionsToSkip.Contains(worksheetMergedCellsRegion)) && range.IntersectsWith(worksheetMergedCellsRegion.Address))
				{

				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveVisitedHyperlink(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			if (_visitedHyperlinkCells == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = _visitedHyperlinkCells.Count;
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				WorksheetCell worksheetCell = _visitedHyperlinkCells[num];
				if (worksheetCell.Row == row && worksheetCell.ColumnIndexInternal == columnIndex)
				{
					_visitedHyperlinkCells[num] = _visitedHyperlinkCells[count - 1];
					_visitedHyperlinkCells.RemoveAt(count - 1);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetColumnBlock SplitColumnBlock(short firstColumnIndex, short lastColumnIndex)
		{
			int blockIndex;
			WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = GetColumnBlock(firstColumnIndex, out blockIndex);
			short lastColumnIndex2 = worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex;
			if (worksheetColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex != firstColumnIndex)
			{
				worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex = (short)(firstColumnIndex - 1);
				WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock2 = new WorksheetColumnBlock(firstColumnIndex, lastColumnIndex2, worksheetColumnBlock);
				blockIndex++;
				columnBlocks.Insert(blockIndex, worksheetColumnBlock2);
				worksheetColumnBlock = worksheetColumnBlock2;
			}
			if (worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex != lastColumnIndex)
			{
				worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex = lastColumnIndex;
				WorksheetColumnBlock item = new WorksheetColumnBlock((short)(lastColumnIndex + 1), lastColumnIndex2, worksheetColumnBlock);
				columnBlocks.Insert(blockIndex + 1, item);
			}
			return worksheetColumnBlock;
		}

		internal bool TryGetDateTimeFromCell(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, out DateTime value)
		{
			value = DateTime.MinValue;
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			if (row == null || !Utilities.TryGetNumericValue(workbook, row.GetCellValueInternal(columnIndex), out var numericValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			DateTime? dateTime = ExcelCalcValue.ExcelDateToDateTime(workbook, numericValue);
			if (!dateTime.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormatElementReadOnly = GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(row, columnIndex);
			ValueFormatter valueFormatter = ((workbook != null) ? workbook.Formats.GetValueFormatter(cellFormatElementReadOnly.FormatStringIndexResolved) : new ValueFormatter(null, cellFormatElementReadOnly.FormatStringResolved, Culture));
			if (!valueFormatter.IsValid || valueFormatter.GetSectionType(numericValue) != ValueFormatter.SectionType.Date)
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = dateTime.Value;
			return true;
		}

		internal WorksheetColumnBlock TryMergeColumnBlock(short columnIndex)
		{
			int blockIndex;
			WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = GetColumnBlock(columnIndex, out blockIndex);
			if (worksheetColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex != 0)
			{
				WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock = GetColumnBlock((short)(worksheetColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex - 1));
				if (worksheetColumnBlock.Equals(columnBlock))
				{
					ColumnBlocks.RemoveAt(blockIndex);
					GenericCacheElementEx.ReleaseEx(worksheetColumnBlock.CellFormat);
					columnBlock.LastColumnIndex = worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex;
					worksheetColumnBlock = columnBlock;
				}
			}
			int num = Columns.MaxCount - 1;
			if (worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex != num)
			{
				int blockIndex2;
				WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock2 = GetColumnBlock((short)(worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex + 1), out blockIndex2);
				if (worksheetColumnBlock.Equals(columnBlock2))
				{
					ColumnBlocks.RemoveAt(blockIndex2);
					GenericCacheElementEx.ReleaseEx(columnBlock2.CellFormat);
					worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex = columnBlock2.LastColumnIndex;
				}
			}
			return worksheetColumnBlock;
		}

		internal bool VerifyCellAddress(ref WorksheetRow row, ref short columnIndex, ref int cellShiftHistoryVersion)
		{
			if (CellShiftHistoryVersion == cellShiftHistoryVersion)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int cellShiftHistoryVersion2 = CellShiftHistoryVersion;
			int cellRowIndex = row.Index;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = cellShiftHistoryVersion; i < cellShiftHistoryVersion2; i++)
			{
				CellShiftOperation cellShiftOperation = CellShiftHistory[i];
				if (!cellShiftOperation.RowInstancesShift)
				{
					ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult = cellShiftOperation.ShiftCellAddress(ref cellRowIndex, ref columnIndex);
					flag |= shiftAddressResult.DidShift;
					if (shiftAddressResult.IsDeleted)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag && cellRowIndex != row.Index)
			{
				row = Rows[cellRowIndex];
			}
			cellShiftHistoryVersion = cellShiftHistoryVersion2;
			return true;
		}
