		private CellShiftResult VerifyCellShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, List<ArrayFormula> arrayFormulasToShift, List<WorksheetTable> tablesToShift, List<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion> mergedRegionsToShift, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride)
		{
			WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddressBeforeShift = shiftOperation.RegionAddressBeforeShift;
			WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddressAfterShift = shiftOperation.RegionAddressAfterShift;
			if (regionAddressAfterShift != regionAddressBeforeShift)
			{
				bool flag;
				if (shiftOperation.IsVertical)
				{
					int num = Rows.MaxCount - 1;
					flag = regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex < regionAddressAfterShift.LastRowIndex && num <= regionAddressAfterShift.LastRowIndex;
				}
				else
				{
					int num2 = Columns.MaxCount - 1;
					flag = regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex < regionAddressAfterShift.LastColumnIndex && num2 <= regionAddressAfterShift.LastColumnIndex;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					WorksheetRegionAddress? deletedRegionAddress = shiftOperation.DeletedRegionAddress;
					if (deletedRegionAddress.HasValue)
					{
						WorksheetRegionAddress value = deletedRegionAddress.Value;
						if (AreCellsNonTrivial(value.FirstRowIndex, value.LastRowIndex, value.FirstColumnIndex, value.LastColumnIndex, isPerformingShift: true))
						{
							return CellShiftResult.ErrorLossOfData;
						}
					}
					else if (regionAddressAfterShift.FirstRowIndex < 0 || regionAddressAfterShift.FirstColumnIndex < 0)
					{
						return CellShiftResult.ErrorLossOfData;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (WorksheetTable item2 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetTable>)Tables)
			{
				if (!item2.IsResizing && !shiftOperation.VerifyShiftForNonSplittableItem(operationOverride, tablesToShift, item2, item2.WholeTableAddress))
				{
					return CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitTable;
				}
			}
			foreach (WorksheetMergedCellsRegion item3 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>)MergedCellsRegions)
			{
				if (!shiftOperation.VerifyShiftForNonSplittableItem(operationOverride, mergedRegionsToShift, item3, item3.Address))
				{
					return CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitMergedRegion;
				}
			}
			foreach (WorksheetDataTable item4 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetDataTable>)DataTables)
			{
				WorksheetRegionAddress cellsInTableAddress = item4.CellsInTableAddress;
				if (cellsInTableAddress.IsValid && !shiftOperation.VerifyShiftForNonSplittableItem(operationOverride, null, item4, cellsInTableAddress))
				{
					return CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitBlockingValue;
				}
			}
			int startIndex = Math.Min(regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex, regionAddressAfterShift.FirstRowIndex);
			int endIndex = Math.Max(regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex, regionAddressAfterShift.LastRowIndex);
			short startIndex2 = Math.Min(regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex, regionAddressAfterShift.FirstColumnIndex);
			short endIndex2 = Math.Max(regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex, regionAddressAfterShift.LastColumnIndex);
			Dictionary<IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue, byte> dictionary = new Dictionary<IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue, byte>();
			foreach (WorksheetRow item5 in Rows.GetItemsInRange(startIndex, endIndex))
			{
				foreach (CellDataContext cellsWithDatum in item5.GetCellsWithData(startIndex2, endIndex2))
				{
					if (!(item5.GetCellValueRaw(cellsWithDatum.ColumnIndex) is IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue { BlockedRegion: not null } worksheetRegionBlockingValue) || dictionary.ContainsKey(worksheetRegionBlockingValue))
					{
						continue;
					}
					dictionary[worksheetRegionBlockingValue] = 0;
					WorksheetRegion blockedRegion = worksheetRegionBlockingValue.BlockedRegion;
					if (worksheetRegionBlockingValue is ArrayFormula item)
					{
						if (!shiftOperation.VerifyShiftForNonSplittableItem(operationOverride, arrayFormulasToShift, item, blockedRegion.Address))
						{
							return CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitBlockingValue;
						}
					}
					else if (!shiftOperation.VerifyShiftForNonSplittableItem(operationOverride, null, worksheetRegionBlockingValue, blockedRegion.Address))
					{
						return CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitBlockingValue;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (WorksheetShape item6 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)Shapes)
			{
				if (!VerifyCellShiftForShape(item6, shiftOperation, operationOverride))
				{
					return CellShiftResult.ErrorLossOfObject;
				}
			}
			foreach (WorksheetCellComment value2 in CellOwnedComments.Values)
			{
				if (!VerifyCellShiftForShape(value2, shiftOperation, operationOverride))
				{
					return CellShiftResult.ErrorLossOfObject;
				}
			}
			return CellShiftResult.Success;
		}

		private bool VerifyCellShiftForShape(WorksheetShape shape, CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride)
		{
			WorksheetCellAddress shiftedTopLeftCellAddress;
			PointF shiftedTopLeftCellPosition;
			WorksheetCellAddress shiftedBottomRightCellAddress;
			PointF shiftedBottomRightCellPosition;
			ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult = shape.ShiftShapeHelper(shiftOperation, operationOverride, shape.GetBoundsInTwips(), out shiftedTopLeftCellAddress, out shiftedTopLeftCellPosition, out shiftedBottomRightCellAddress, out shiftedBottomRightCellPosition);
			if (shiftAddressResult.DidShift && shiftAddressResult.IsDeleted && shiftAddressResult.DeleteReason == CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetBottom)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void VerifyNameIsValid(string name, string paramName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(paramName, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_WorksheetName"));
			}
			if (name.IndexOfAny(new char[7] { ':', '\\', '/', '?', '*', '[', ']' }) >= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidWorksheetName"), paramName);
			}
			if (name.StartsWith("'") || name.EndsWith("'"))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidWorksheetNameStartingQuote"), paramName);
			}
			if (name.Length > 31)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_WorksheetNameTooLong"), paramName);
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			Columns.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			Rows.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			if (HasMergedCellRegions)
			{
				MergedCellsRegions.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			}
			PrintOptions.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
		}

		internal void VerifyFormula(Formula formula, WorksheetRow formulaOwnerRow, short formulaOwnerColumnIndex)
		{
			Workbook?.VerifyFormula(formula, formulaOwnerRow, formulaOwnerColumnIndex);
		}

		private WorksheetColumnBlock AddDefaultColumnBlock(short startIndex = 0)
		{
			WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = new WorksheetColumnBlock(startIndex, (short)(workbook.MaxColumnCountInternal - 1), workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement);
			worksheetColumnBlock.CellFormat.IncrementReferenceCount();
			columnBlocks.Add(worksheetColumnBlock);
			return worksheetColumnBlock;
		}

		private int BinarySearchForColumnBlock(short columnIndex)
		{
			if (columnBlocks == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = columnBlocks.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num) / 2;
				WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = columnBlocks[num3];
				if (worksheetColumnBlock == null)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (worksheetColumnBlock.ContainsColumn(columnIndex))
				{
					return num3;
				}
				int num4 = worksheetColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex - columnIndex;
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
				}
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		private void ClearCells(WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddressToClear, bool isVerticalShift, bool shiftsRows, int? indexOfRowOrColumnForInitializingCellFormat)
		{
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = ((indexOfRowOrColumnForInitializingCellFormat.HasValue && isVerticalShift) ? Rows.GetIfCreated(indexOfRowOrColumnForInitializingCellFormat.Value) : null);
			if (worksheetRow != null && worksheetRow.Cells.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = regionAddressToClear.FirstRowIndex; i <= regionAddressToClear.LastRowIndex; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRow worksheetRow2 = Rows[i];
					worksheetRow2.ClearCells(regionAddressToClear.FirstColumnIndex, regionAddressToClear.LastColumnIndex, worksheetRow);
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in Rows.GetItemsInRange(regionAddressToClear.FirstRowIndex, regionAddressToClear.LastRowIndex))
			{
				if (isVerticalShift)
				{
					item.ClearCells(regionAddressToClear.FirstColumnIndex, regionAddressToClear.LastColumnIndex, worksheetRow);
				}
				else
				{
					item.ClearCells(regionAddressToClear.FirstColumnIndex, regionAddressToClear.LastColumnIndex, null, indexOfRowOrColumnForInitializingCellFormat);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CleanCachedRegions()
		{
			IterateCachedRegions(null);
		}

		private void FixupColumnBlockIndices(int firstModifiedBlockIndex)
		{
			WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = columnBlocks[firstModifiedBlockIndex];
			for (int i = firstModifiedBlockIndex + 1; i < columnBlocks.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock2 = columnBlocks[i];
				int countOfColumns = worksheetColumnBlock2.CountOfColumns;
				worksheetColumnBlock2.FirstColumnIndex = (short)(worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex + 1);
				worksheetColumnBlock2.LastColumnIndex = (short)(worksheetColumnBlock2.FirstColumnIndex + countOfColumns - 1);
				worksheetColumnBlock = worksheetColumnBlock2;
			}
			if (worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex < workbook.MaxColumnCountInternal - 1 && !worksheetColumnBlock.IsEmpty)
			{
				worksheetColumnBlock = AddDefaultColumnBlock((short)(worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex + 1));
			}
			worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex = (short)(workbook.MaxColumnCountInternal - 1);
		}

		private int GetBlockIndexHelper(short columnIndex, short count, bool isInsertOperation, out WorksheetColumnBlock block)
		{
			int maxColumnCountInternal = workbook.MaxColumnCountInternal;
			int num;
			if (columnIndex == 0)
			{
				block = columnBlocks[0];
				if (isInsertOperation)
				{
					if (block.IsEmpty)
					{
						block.LastColumnIndex = (short)Math.Min(block.LastColumnIndex + count, maxColumnCountInternal - 1);
					}
					else
					{
						block = new WorksheetColumnBlock(columnIndex, count, workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement);
						columnBlocks.Insert(0, block);
					}
				}
				num = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				num = ((!isInsertOperation) ? BinarySearchForColumnBlock(columnIndex) : BinarySearchForColumnBlock((short)(columnIndex - 1)));
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = ~num - 1;
				}
				block = columnBlocks[num];
				if (isInsertOperation)
				{
					block.LastColumnIndex = (short)Math.Min(block.LastColumnIndex + count, maxColumnCountInternal - 1);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void GetCellOrRegionHelper(string address, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorksheetCell originCell, out WorksheetCell cell, out WorksheetRegion[] regions, out bool throwOnError)
		{
			if (originCell != null && originCell.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"), "originCell");
			}
			throwOnError = true;
			if (address == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("address");
			}
			address = address.TrimStart();
			GetCellOrRegionHelper(address, cellReferenceMode, originCell, out var firstRowIndex, out var firstColumnIndex, out var lastRowIndex, out var lastColumnIndex);
			cell = null;
			regions = null;
			if (0 <= lastRowIndex)
			{
				regions = new WorksheetRegion[1] { GetCachedRegion(firstRowIndex, firstColumnIndex, lastRowIndex, lastColumnIndex) };
			}
			else if (0 <= firstRowIndex)
			{
				cell = Rows[firstRowIndex].Cells[firstColumnIndex];
			}
			else
			{
				if (Workbook == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				cell = null;
				regions = null;
				WorksheetRow originRow = null;
				short originColumnIndex = -1;
				if (originCell != null)
				{
					originRow = originCell.Row;
					originColumnIndex = originCell.ColumnIndexInternal;
				}
				bool isNamedReference;
				RefBase refBase = Workbook.ParseReference(address.Trim(), cellReferenceMode, this, originRow, originColumnIndex, out isNamedReference);
				if (isNamedReference)
				{
					throwOnError = false;
				}
				if (refBase == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (refBase is CellCalcReference cellCalcReference)
				{
					if (refBase.Row.Worksheet == this)
					{
						cell = cellCalcReference.Row.Cells[cellCalcReference.ColumnIndex];
					}
					return;
				}
				object context = refBase.Context;
				if (context is NamedReference namedReference)
				{
					cell = namedReference.ReferencedCell;
					if (cell == null)
					{
						WorksheetRegion referencedRegion = namedReference.ReferencedRegion;
						if (referencedRegion != null)
						{
							regions = new WorksheetRegion[1] { referencedRegion };
						}
						else
						{
							regions = namedReference.ReferencedRegions;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					cell = context as WorksheetCell;
					if (cell == null)
					{
						WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = context as WorksheetRegion;
						IEnumerable<WorksheetRegion> enumerable = context as IEnumerable<WorksheetRegion>;
						if (worksheetRegion != null)
						{
							regions = new WorksheetRegion[1] { worksheetRegion };
						}
						else if (enumerable != null)
						{
							regions = new List<WorksheetRegion>(enumerable).ToArray();
						}
					}
				}
				if (cell != null && cell.Worksheet != this)
				{
					cell = null;
				}
				if (regions != null && regions.Length != 0 && regions[0].Worksheet != this)
				{
					regions = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void GetCellOrRegionHelper(string address, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorksheetCell originCell, out int firstRowIndex, out short firstColumnIndex, out int lastRowIndex, out short lastColumnIndex)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CellReferenceMode), cellReferenceMode))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("cellReferenceMode", (int)cellReferenceMode, typeof(CellReferenceMode));
			}
			WorksheetRow originCellRow = null;
			short originCellColumnIndex = -1;
			if (originCell != null)
			{
				originCellRow = originCell.Row;
				originCellColumnIndex = originCell.ColumnIndexInternal;
			}
			WorkbookFormat currentFormat = CurrentFormat;
			CultureInfo culture = Culture;
			Utilities.ParseRegionAddress(address, currentFormat, cellReferenceMode, culture, originCellRow, originCellColumnIndex, out firstRowIndex, out firstColumnIndex, out lastRowIndex, out lastColumnIndex);
			if (firstRowIndex < 0 && cellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.R1C1 && originCell == null)
			{
				Utilities.ParseRegionAddress(address, currentFormat, cellReferenceMode, culture, Rows[0], 0, out firstRowIndex, out firstColumnIndex, out lastRowIndex, out lastColumnIndex);
				if (0 <= firstRowIndex)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_RelativeR1C1AddressNeedsOriginCell"));
				}
			}
		}

		private static int GetColumnWidthPadding(double zeroCharacterWidth)
		{
			return (int)Math.Ceiling(zeroCharacterWidth / 4.0) * 2 + 1;
		}

		private void HideUnhideItemsCore(int? startIndex, int? count, bool isRows, bool newHiddenState)
		{
			int num = (isRows ? Rows.MaxCount : Columns.MaxCount);
			int num2 = startIndex ?? 0;
			int num3 = count ?? (startIndex.HasValue ? 1 : num);
			int num4 = num2 + num3 - 1;
			if (num2 < 0 || num3 < 0 || num <= num4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidRowOrColumnRange"));
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (isRows && DefaultRowHidden != newHiddenState)
			{
				int num5 = num4 - num2;
				if (Rows.MaxCount / 2 < num5)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			WorksheetElementResizeContext worksheetElementResizeContext = null;
			if (DoesNeedElementResizeNotification)
			{
				worksheetElementResizeContext = (isRows ? WorksheetElementResizeContext.CreateForMultiRowsVisibilityChange(this, num2, num4, newHiddenState, flag) : WorksheetElementResizeContext.CreateForMultiColumnsVisibilityChange(this, num2, num4, newHiddenState));
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				SetDefaultRowHidden(newHiddenState, notifyShapes: false);
			}
			if (isRows)
			{
				if (DefaultRowHidden == newHiddenState)
				{
					foreach (WorksheetRow item in Rows.GetItemsInRange(num2, num4))
					{
						item.SetHidden(newHiddenState, notifyShapes: false);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					for (int i = num2; i <= num4; i++)
					{
						Rows[i].SetHidden(newHiddenState, notifyShapes: false);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SplitColumnBlock((short)num2, (short)num2);
				SplitColumnBlock((short)num4, (short)num4);
				foreach (WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock in ColumnBlocks)
				{
					if (num2 <= columnBlock.FirstColumnIndex && columnBlock.LastColumnIndex <= num4)
					{
						columnBlock.Hidden = newHiddenState;
					}
				}
			}
			worksheetElementResizeContext?.Close();
		}

		private void IterateCachedRegions(IterateCachedRegionCallback callback)
		{
			if (cachedRegions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<WorksheetRegion> list = null;
			for (int num = cachedRegions.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = (WorksheetRegion)Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(cachedRegions[num]);
				if (worksheetRegion == null)
				{
					cachedRegions.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else if (callback != null)
				{
					callback(worksheetRegion, out var modified);
					if (modified)
					{
						cachedRegions.RemoveAt(num);
						if (worksheetRegion.Worksheet != null)
						{
							if (list == null)
							{
								list = new List<WorksheetRegion>();
							}
							list.Add(worksheetRegion);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (list != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRegion region = list[i];
					AddCachedRegion(region, allowDuplicates: true, out var _);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnScreenDpiChanged()
		{
			if (_lastSetDefaultColumnWidthInfo != null)
			{
				SetDefaultColumnWidth(_lastSetDefaultColumnWidthInfo.Value, _lastSetDefaultColumnWidthInfo.Units, _lastSetDefaultColumnWidthInfo.AlignTo8Pixels, createUndo: false);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveBlockHelper(int blockindex, WorksheetColumnBlock block)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat = block.CellFormat;
			if (cellFormat != null)
			{
				GenericCacheElementEx.ReleaseEx(cellFormat);
				if (cellFormat.ReferenceCount > 0)
				{
					block.CellFormat = cellFormat.CloneInternal();
				}
			}
			columnBlocks.RemoveAt(blockindex);
		}

		private static void UnrootStringsInShapes(IWorksheetShapeOwner owner)
		{
			foreach (WorksheetShape item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)owner.Shapes)
			{
				if (item is WorksheetShapeWithText { Text: not null } worksheetShapeWithText)
				{
					worksheetShapeWithText.Text.SetWorksheet(null);
				}
				if (item is WorksheetShapeGroup owner2)
				{
					UnrootStringsInShapes(owner2);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetDefaultColumnWidthHelper(int value, bool createUndo)
		{
			if (value < 0)
			{
				value = 0;
			}
			if (65535 < value)
			{
				value = 65535;
			}
			if (DefaultColumnWidth != value)
			{
				if (createUndo)
				{
					SetDefaultColumnWidthImpl(value);
				}
				else
				{
					defaultColumnWidth = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetDefaultColumnWidthImpl(int value)
		{
			defaultColumnWidth = value;
			_lastSetDefaultColumnWidthInfo = new SetColumnWidthInfo(value, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Character256th, alignTo8Pixels: false);
		}

		private void SetDefaultRowHeightImpl(int value)
		{
			int num = defaultRowHeight;
			defaultRowHeight = value;
			Rows.OnDefaultRowHeightChanged();
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)Rows)
			{
				if (item.Height < 0 || item.Height == num)
				{
					item.Height = value;
				}
				else
				{
					item.ResetResolvedRowHeight();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResetMeasuredRowHeight()
		{
			measuredRowHeight = 0;
		}

		private void SetDefaultRowHidden(bool value, bool notifyShapes = true)
		{
			if (DefaultRowHidden != value)
			{
				WorksheetElementResizeContext worksheetElementResizeContext = null;
				if (notifyShapes && DoesNeedElementResizeNotification)
				{
					worksheetElementResizeContext = WorksheetElementResizeContext.CreateForMultiRowsVisibilityChange(this, 0, rows.MaxCount - 1, null, wasDefaultHiddenStateChanged: true);
				}
				defaultRowHidden = value;
				Rows.ResetHeightCache(onlyVisibilityChanged: true);
				worksheetElementResizeContext?.Close();
			}
		}
	}
	internal interface ICellShiftOperationOverride
	{
		int Count { get; }

		int Index { get; }

		bool IsRemoveOperation { get; }

		bool IsUndoOperation { get; }

		bool PerformsShift { get; }

		bool ShiftsColumns { get; }

		bool ShiftsRows { get; }

		Worksheet Worksheet { get; }

		void OnBeforeShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation);

		bool PerformShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation);
	}
	public class WorksheetProtectedRange
	{
		private GenericSecurityDescriptor _securityDescriptor;

		private Worksheet _worksheet;

		private bool _isProtected;

		private string _title;

		private WorksheetProtectedRangeRegionCollection _ranges;

		internal readonly WorkbookPasswordInfo PasswordInfo;

		public string SecurityDescriptor
		{
			get
			{
				if (_securityDescriptor != null)
				{
					return _securityDescriptor.GetSddlForm(AccessControlSections.All);
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					_securityDescriptor = null;
				}
				else
				{
					_securityDescriptor = new RawSecurityDescriptor(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool HasPassword => PasswordInfo.HasPassword;

		public bool IsProtected
		{
			get
			{
				return _isProtected;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_isProtected = value;
			}
		}

		public ICollection<WorksheetRegion> Ranges => _ranges;

		public string Title
		{
			get
			{
				return _title;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_WorksheetProtectedRangeTitleCantBeNull"));
				}
				if (!(value != _title))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value.Length > 255)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_WorksheetProtectedRangeTitleTooLong"));
				}
				if (_worksheet != null)
				{
					WorksheetProtectedRange worksheetProtectedRange = _worksheet.Protection.AllowedEditRanges.Find(value);
					if (worksheetProtectedRange != null && worksheetProtectedRange != this)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DuplicateWorksheetProtectedRangeTitle", value));
					}
				}
				_title = value;
			}
		}

		public Worksheet Worksheet
		{
			get
			{
				return _worksheet;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_worksheet = value;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetProtectedRange(string name, string password)
			: this(name)
		{
			SetPassword(password);
		}

		public WorksheetProtectedRange(string name, SecureString password)
			: this(name)
		{
			SetPassword(password);
		}

		internal WorksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission[] GetPermissions()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(SecurityDescriptor))
			{
				return new WorksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission[0];
			}
			RawSecurityDescriptor rawSecurityDescriptor = new RawSecurityDescriptor(SecurityDescriptor);
			WorksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission[] array = new WorksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission[rawSecurityDescriptor.DiscretionaryAcl.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				GenericAce genericAce = rawSecurityDescriptor.DiscretionaryAcl[i];
				SecurityIdentifier securityIdentifier = null;
				if (genericAce is CommonAce)
				{
					securityIdentifier = ((CommonAce)genericAce).SecurityIdentifier;
				}
				if (securityIdentifier == null)
				{
					try
					{
						byte[] binaryForm = new byte[genericAce.BinaryLength];
						genericAce.GetBinaryForm(binaryForm, 0);
						securityIdentifier = new SecurityIdentifier(binaryForm, 0);
					}
					catch
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				IdentityReference identityReference = securityIdentifier.Translate(typeof(IdentityReference));
				bool flag = genericAce.AceType == AceType.AccessAllowed;
				ref WorksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission reference = ref array[i];
				reference = new WorksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission(identityReference.Value, !flag);
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal byte[] GetSecurityDescriptorAsBinaryForm()
		{
			byte[] array = null;
			if (_securityDescriptor != null)
			{
				array = new byte[_securityDescriptor.BinaryLength];
				_securityDescriptor.GetBinaryForm(array, 0);
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal string GetSecurityDescriptorAsSddlForm()
		{
			string result = null;
			if (_securityDescriptor != null)
			{
				result = _securityDescriptor.GetSddlForm(AccessControlSections.All);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void InitializeSecurityDescriptor(byte[] binaryForm)
		{
			_securityDescriptor = new RawSecurityDescriptor(binaryForm, 0);
		}

		internal void InitializeSecurityDescriptor(string sddlForm)
		{
			_securityDescriptor = new RawSecurityDescriptor(sddlForm);
		}

		public void SetSecurityDescriptor(params WorksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission[] permissions)
		{
			if (permissions == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("permissions");
			}
			RawAcl rawAcl = new RawAcl(0, permissions.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < permissions.Length; i++)
			{
				WorksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission worksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission = permissions[i];
				NTAccount nTAccount = new NTAccount(worksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission.AccountName);
				SecurityIdentifier sid = (SecurityIdentifier)nTAccount.Translate(typeof(SecurityIdentifier));
				AceQualifier qualifier = (worksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission.DenyEdit ? AceQualifier.AccessDenied : AceQualifier.AccessAllowed);
				CommonAce ace = new CommonAce(AceFlags.None, qualifier, 1, sid, isCallback: false, null);
				rawAcl.InsertAce(i, ace);
			}
			SecurityIdentifier securityIdentifier = new SecurityIdentifier("S-1-1-0");
			RawSecurityDescriptor securityDescriptor = new RawSecurityDescriptor(ControlFlags.DiscretionaryAclPresent | ControlFlags.SelfRelative, securityIdentifier, securityIdentifier, null, rawAcl);
			_securityDescriptor = securityDescriptor;
		}

		public void SetPassword(string password)
		{
			PasswordInfo.SetPassword(password);
		}

		public void SetPassword(SecureString password)

			PasswordInfo.SetPassword(password);
		}

		public void Unprotect(string password)
		{
			if (!PasswordInfo.HasPassword || PasswordInfo.ValidatePassword(password))
			{
				IsProtected = false;
			}
		}

		public void Unprotect(SecureString password)
		{
			if (!PasswordInfo.HasPassword || PasswordInfo.ValidatePassword(password))
			{
				IsProtected = false;
			}
		}

			PasswordInfo = new WorkbookPasswordInfo();
		}

	internal class WorkbookPasswordInfo
	{
		private object _password;

		private ProtectionValidationInfo _pendingValidationInfo;

		private bool _isProtected;

		private Action _onIsProtectedChanged;

		internal bool HasPassword
		{
			get
			{
				if (PendingValidationInfo != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return _password != null;
			}
		}

		public bool IsProtected
		{
			get
			{
				return _isProtected;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (value != _isProtected)
				{
					_isProtected = value;
					if (_onIsProtectedChanged != null)
					{
						_onIsProtectedChanged();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal ProtectionValidationInfo PendingValidationInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return _pendingValidationInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _pendingValidationInfo)
				{
					_pendingValidationInfo = value;
					if (!_isProtected)
					{
						IsProtected = true;
					}
					else if (!HasPassword)
					{
						IsProtected = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetPassword(object password)
		{
			if (password is string)
			{
				SetPassword(password as string);
			}
			else
			{
				SetPassword(password as SecureString);
			}
		}

		internal void SetPassword(string password)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
			{
				password = null;
			}
			SetPasswordImpl(password);
		}

		internal void SetPassword(SecureString password)
		{
			SetPasswordImpl(password);
		}

		private void SetPasswordImpl(object password)
		{
			PendingValidationInfo = null;
			_password = password;
		}

		internal void Unprotect(object password)
		{
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!IsProtected)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!HasPassword)
			{
				Unprotect();
			}
			else if (password is SecureString)
			{
				if (!ValidatePassword(password as SecureString))
				{
					throw new InvalidPasswordException();
				}
				Unprotect();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!ValidatePassword(password as string))
				{
					throw new InvalidPasswordException();
				}
				Unprotect();
			}
		}

		internal bool ValidatePassword(string password)
		{
			return ValidatePasswordImpl(password);
		}

		internal bool ValidatePassword(SecureString password)
		{
			string password2 = null;
			if (password != null)
			{
				password2 = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(Utilities.ExtractSecureStringUnicode(password, throwOnError: true));
			}
			return ValidatePasswordImpl(password2, password);
		}

		private bool ValidatePasswordImpl(string password, SecureString sourceSecureString = null)
		{
			if (PendingValidationInfo != null)
			{
				if (password == null || !PendingValidationInfo.ValidatePassword(Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(password)))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (sourceSecureString != null)
				{
					SetPasswordImpl(sourceSecureString);
				}
				else
				{
					SetPasswordImpl(password);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (HasPassword)
			{
				return password == Encoding.Unicode.GetString(GetPasswordUnicode());
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal WorkbookPasswordInfo(Action onIsProtectedChanged = null)
		{
			_onIsProtectedChanged = onIsProtectedChanged;
		}

		internal byte[] GetPasswordUnicode()
		{
			return Utilities.GetPasswordUnicode(_password as string, _password as SecureString);
		}

		internal bool GetStrictPasswordValue(out string algorithmName, out byte[] hashValue, out byte[] saltValue, out uint? spinCount)
		{
			if (_pendingValidationInfo != null)
			{
				return _pendingValidationInfo.GetStrictVerifier(ref algorithmName, ref hashValue, ref saltValue, ref spinCount);
			}
			byte[] passwordUnicode = GetPasswordUnicode();
			if (passwordUnicode != null)
			{
				uint value = default(uint);
				hashValue = ProtectionValidationInfo.GetStrictVerifier(passwordUnicode, ref algorithmName, ref saltValue, ref value);
				if (hashValue != null)
				{
					spinCount = value;
					return true;
				}
			}
			algorithmName = null;
			hashValue = (saltValue = null);
			spinCount = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal ushort? GetXorPasswordValue()
		{
			if (_pendingValidationInfo != null)
			{
				return _pendingValidationInfo.GetXorObfuscationVerifier();
			}
			byte[] passwordUnicode = GetPasswordUnicode();
			if (passwordUnicode != null)
			{
				return InPlaceXorObfuscationTransform.CreateXorPasswordHashUnciode(passwordUnicode);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void InitializeIsProtected(bool isProtected)
		{
			_isProtected = isProtected;
		}

		internal void Protect(object password)
		{
			if (!IsProtected)
			{
				SetPassword(password);
				PendingValidationInfo = null;
				IsProtected = true;
			}
		}

		internal void Unprotect()
		{
			_password = null;
			_pendingValidationInfo = null;
			IsProtected = false;
		}
	}

	{

		private readonly string _accountName;

		public string AccountName => _accountName;

		public WorksheetProtectedRangeUserPermission(string accountName, bool denyEdit)
		{
			_accountName = accountName;
			_denyEdit = denyEdit;
		}
	}

		public void AddInternalNamedReference(NamedReference reference, bool isHidden)
		{
			if (reference.IsMacroName)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (isHidden)
			{
				if (!TryExtractCustomViewInfo(reference))
				{
					base.Workbook.HiddenNamedReferences.Add(reference);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.Workbook.NamedReferences.AddInternal(reference);
			}
		}

		public static object CombineHyperlinkTargetAndLocation(Workbook workbook, string target, string location)
		{
			if (location == null)
			{
				return target;
			}
			if (target != null)
			{
				return target + "#" + location;
			}
			int num = location.LastIndexOf('!');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				if (FormulaParser.IsValidNamedReference(location, workbook.CurrentFormat, Workbook.InvariantCultureForSerialization))
				{
					return ((object)workbook.NamedReferences.Find(location)) ?? ((object)location);
				}
				return location;
			}
			string text = location.Substring(0, num).Trim();
			string text2 = location.Substring(num + 1).Trim();
			if (text.Length >= 2 && text[0] == '\'' && text[text.Length - 1] == '\'')
			{
				text = text.Substring(1, text.Length - 1);
			}
			if (text2.Length >= 2 && text2[0] == '\'' && text2[text2.Length - 1] == '\'')
			{
				text2 = text2.Substring(1, text2.Length - 1);
			}
			if (!workbook.Worksheets.Exists(text))
			{
				return location;
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = workbook.Worksheets[text];
			if (FormulaParser.IsValidNamedReference(text2, workbook.CurrentFormat, Workbook.InvariantCultureForSerialization))
			{
				return ((object)workbook.NamedReferences.Find(text2, worksheet)) ?? ((object)location);
			}
			if (text2.Contains(":"))
			{
				return worksheet.GetRegion(text2);
			}
			return worksheet.GetCell(text2);
		}

		public Rectangle GetAbsoluteShapeBoundsInTwips(CT_Transform2D shapeTransform, float childRotation, CT_GroupTransform2D groupTransform, Rectangle groupBoundsInTwips)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00dd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0185: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double num = groupBoundsInTwips.Width;
			ST_PositiveCoordinate cX = groupTransform.ChildExtents.CX;
			double num2 = num / ((ST_PositiveCoordinate)(ref cX)).GetTwips();
			double num3 = groupBoundsInTwips.Height;
			ST_PositiveCoordinate cY = groupTransform.ChildExtents.CY;
			double num4 = num3 / ((ST_PositiveCoordinate)(ref cY)).GetTwips();
			ST_Coordinate x = shapeTransform.Offset.X;
			double twips = ((ST_Coordinate)(ref x)).GetTwips();
			ST_Coordinate x2 = groupTransform.ChildOffset.X;
			double num5 = (twips - ((ST_Coordinate)(ref x2)).GetTwips()) * num2;
			ST_Coordinate y = shapeTransform.Offset.Y;
			double twips2 = ((ST_Coordinate)(ref y)).GetTwips();
			ST_Coordinate y2 = groupTransform.ChildOffset.Y;
			double num6 = (twips2 - ((ST_Coordinate)(ref y2)).GetTwips()) * num4;
			int num7 = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero((double)groupBoundsInTwips.X + num5);
			int num8 = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero((double)groupBoundsInTwips.Y + num6);
			ST_PositiveCoordinate cX2 = shapeTransform.Extents.CX;
			int num9 = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num2 * ((ST_PositiveCoordinate)(ref cX2)).GetTwips());
			ST_PositiveCoordinate cY2 = shapeTransform.Extents.CY;
			int num10 = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num4 * ((ST_PositiveCoordinate)(ref cY2)).GetTwips());
			childRotation %= 360f;
			if (childRotation < 0f)
			{
				childRotation += 360f;
			}
			if (num7 == int.MinValue)
			{
				num7 = 0;
			}
			if (num8 == int.MinValue)
			{
				num8 = 0;
			}
			if (Utilities.Is2003Format(base.Workbook.CurrentFormat) || childRotation < 45f || (childRotation > 135f && childRotation < 215f) || childRotation > 315f)
			{
				if (num9 == int.MinValue)
				{
					num9 = 0;
				}
				if (num10 == int.MinValue)
				{
					num10 = 0;
				}
				return new Rectangle(num7, num8, num9, num10);
			}
			ST_PositiveCoordinate cX3 = shapeTransform.Extents.CX;
			int num11 = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num4 * ((ST_PositiveCoordinate)(ref cX3)).GetTwips());
			ST_PositiveCoordinate cY3 = shapeTransform.Extents.CY;
			int num12 = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num2 * ((ST_PositiveCoordinate)(ref cY3)).GetTwips());
			int num13 = (num9 - num11) / 2;
			int num14 = (num10 - num12) / 2;
			if (num11 == int.MinValue)
			{
				num11 = 0;
			}
			if (num12 == int.MinValue)
			{
				num12 = 0;
			}
			return new Rectangle(num7 + num13, num8 + num14, num11, num12);
		}

		public WorksheetReference GetWorksheetReference(int externalSheetIndex)
		{
			List<WorksheetReference> worksheetReferences = base.WorksheetReferences;
			if (externalSheetIndex < 0 || worksheetReferences.Count <= externalSheetIndex)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return worksheetReferences[externalSheetIndex];
		}

		public WorkItem Load()
		{
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then(LoadCore(), (Action)delegate
			{
				for (int num = base.Workbook.Worksheets.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (base.Workbook.Worksheets[num].Type != SheetType.Worksheet)
					{
						base.Workbook.Worksheets.RemoveAt(num);
					}
					else if (base.Workbook.Worksheets[num].IsProtected)
					{
						base.Workbook.Worksheets[num].Protection.InitializeIsProtectedOfRanges();
					}
				}
				Utilities.Is2003Format(base.Workbook.CurrentFormat);
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		public virtual void OnAfterLoadGlobalSettings()
		{
			Workbook workbook = base.Workbook;
			WorkbookWindowOptions windowOptions = workbook.WindowOptions;
			windowOptions.SelectedWorksheet = workbook.Worksheets[windowOptions.SelectedWorksheetIndex];
			if (workbook.HasCustomViews)
			{
				foreach (CustomView item in (IEnumerable<CustomView>)workbook.CustomViews)
				{
					int selectedWorksheetTabId = item.WindowOptions.SelectedWorksheetTabId;
					if (selectedWorksheetTabId >= 0)
					{
						Worksheet worksheetById = workbook.GetWorksheetById((ushort)selectedWorksheetTabId);
						if (worksheetById != null)
						{
							item.WindowOptions.SelectedWorksheet = worksheetById;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement = GetLoadedDefaultCellFormat();
			workbook.Fonts.DefaultElement = base.Fonts[0];
		}

		public void SetAreaFormatInfo<T>(WorksheetTableAreaFormatsCollection<T> areaFormats, T area, Func<T, CellFormatValue, bool> canAreaFormatValueBeSetCallback, WorkbookStyle style, WorksheetCellFormatData dxf)
		{
			SetAreaFormatInfo(areaFormats, area, canAreaFormatValueBeSetCallback, style, dxf, null);
		}

		public void SetAreaFormatInfo<T>(WorksheetTableAreaFormatsCollection<T> areaFormats, T area, Func<T, CellFormatValue, bool> canAreaFormatValueBeSetCallback, WorkbookStyle style, WorksheetCellFormatData dxf, WorksheetCellFormatData dxfBorders, params CellFormatValue[] borderValues)
		{
			if (style == null && dxf == null && dxfBorders == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dxf == null)
			{
				dxf = base.Workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat);
			}
			if (style == null)
			{
				style = base.Workbook.Styles.NormalStyle;
			}
			dxf.SetStyleInternal(style);
			if (dxfBorders != null && borderValues.Length != 0 && Utilities.TestFlag(dxfBorders.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < borderValues.Length; i++)
				{
					Utilities.CopyCellFormatValue(dxfBorders, dxf, borderValues[i]);
				}
			}
			WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<T> formatProxy = areaFormats.GetFormatProxy(base.Workbook, area);
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue << 1))
			{
				if (canAreaFormatValueBeSetCallback(area, cellFormatValue))
				{
					Utilities.CopyCellFormatValue(dxf, formatProxy, cellFormatValue);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ParseHiddenColumnsFromFormula(Worksheet worksheet, CustomView customView, Formula formula)
		{
			HiddenColumnCollection hiddenColumns = customView.GetHiddenColumns(worksheet);
			if (hiddenColumns == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<CellAddressRange> rangesFromFormula = Utilities.GetRangesFromFormula(formula);
			for (int i = 0; i < rangesFromFormula.Count; i++)
			{
				CellAddressRange cellAddressRange = rangesFromFormula[i];
				for (int j = cellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.Column; j <= cellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.Column; j++)
				{
					hiddenColumns.Add(worksheet.Columns[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ParseHiddenRowsFromFormula(Worksheet worksheet, CustomView customView, Formula formula)
		{
			HiddenRowCollection hiddenRows = customView.GetHiddenRows(worksheet);
			if (hiddenRows == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<CellAddressRange> rangesFromFormula = Utilities.GetRangesFromFormula(formula);
			for (int i = 0; i < rangesFromFormula.Count; i++)
			{
				CellAddressRange cellAddressRange = rangesFromFormula[i];
				for (int j = cellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.Row; j <= cellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.Row; j++)
				{
					hiddenRows.Add(worksheet.Rows[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool TryExtractCustomViewInfo(NamedReference reference)
		{
			if (!(reference.Scope is Worksheet worksheet))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Match match = CustomViewInfoName.Match(reference.Name);
			if (!match.Success)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string g = match.Value.Substring(2, 36).Replace("_", "");
			Guid id = new Guid(g);
			CustomView customView = base.Workbook.CustomViews[id];
			if (customView == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int length = match.Length;
			int length2 = reference.Name.Length - length;
			switch (reference.Name.Substring(length, length2).ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
			{
			case "cols":
				ParseHiddenColumnsFromFormula(worksheet, customView, reference.FormulaInternal);
				break;
			case "rows":
				ParseHiddenRowsFromFormula(worksheet, customView, reference.FormulaInternal);
				break;
			case "printarea":
			{
				PrintOptions printOptions = customView.GetPrintOptions(worksheet);
				NamedReferenceBase.LoadPrintAreas(reference, printOptions);
				break;
			}
			case "printtitles":
				NamedReferenceBase.LoadPrintTitles(reference, customView.GetPrintOptions(worksheet));
				break;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static LoadAdditionalDataTokenVisitor _instance;

			public byte[] Data;

			public int DataIndex;

			{
			}

			public override void Reset()
			{
				Data = null;
				DataIndex = 0;
				_loadManager = null;
				base.Reset();
			}

			public override void VisitArrayToken(ArrayToken token)
			{
				Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = _loadManager.CurrentRecordStream;
				int num = currentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex) + 1;
				int num2 = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex) + 1;
				token.Values = new Constant[num][];
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					token.Values[i] = new Constant[num2];
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
					{
						Constant nextConstant = Constant.GetNextConstant(currentRecordStream, ref Data, ref DataIndex);
						nextConstant.Load(currentRecordStream, ref Data, ref DataIndex);
						token.Values[k][j] = nextConstant;
					}
				}
			}

			public override void VisitMemAreaOperator(MemAreaOperator token)
			{
				Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = _loadManager.CurrentRecordStream;

				token.Ranges = new CellAddressRange[num];
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					ref CellAddressRange reference = ref token.Ranges[i];
					reference = currentRecordStream.ReadFormulaCellAddressRangeFromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
				}
			}

				token.CellAddressRange = _stream.ReadFormulaCellAddressRangeFromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
			}

			public override void VisitArrayToken(ArrayToken token)
			{
				_stream.ReadBytesFromBuffer(7, ref Data, ref DataIndex);
			}

			public override void VisitAttrChooseToken(AttrChooseToken token)
			{
				int num = _stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					_stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
				}
				_stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
			}

			public override void VisitAttrIfToken(AttrIfToken token)
			{
				_stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
			}

			public override void VisitAttrSkipToken(AttrSkipToken token)

				_stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
			}

			public override void VisitAttrSpaceToken(AttrSpaceToken token)
			{
				token.WhitespaceType = (WhitespaceType)_stream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
				token.NumberOfWhitespaceChars = _stream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
			}

			public override void VisitAttrSumToken(AttrSumToken token)
			{
				_stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
			}

			public override void VisitAttrVolatileToken(AttrVolatileToken token)
			{
				_stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
			}

			public override void VisitBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token)
			{
			}

			public override void VisitBoolToken(BoolToken token)
			{
				byte b = _stream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
				token.Value = b != 0;
			}

			public override void VisitErrToken(ErrToken token)
			{
				token.Value = ErrorValue.FromValue(_stream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex));
			}

			public override void VisitExpToken(ExpToken token)
			{
				int row = _stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
				short column = _stream.ReadInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
				token.CellAddress = new CellAddress(row, rowAddressIsRelative: false, column, columnAddressIsRelative: false);
			}

			public override void VisitFunctionOperator(FunctionOperator token)
			{
				token.Function = Function.GetFunction(_stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex));
				token.ArgumentCount = token.Function.MinParams;
			}

			public override void VisitFunctionVOperator(FunctionVOperator token)
			{
				byte b = _stream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
				b &= 0x7F;
				ushort num = _stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
				num &= 0x7FFF;
				token.ArgumentCount = b;
				token.Function = Function.GetFunction(num);
				if (token.Function.IsAddIn)
				{
					token.ArgumentCount--;
				}
			}

			public override void VisitIntToken(IntToken token)
			{
				token.Value = _stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
			}

			public override void VisitMemAreaOperator(MemAreaOperator token)
			{
				_stream.ReadUInt32FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);

			public override void VisitMemErrOperator(MemErrOperator token)

			}

			public override void VisitMissArgToken(MissArgToken token)
			{
			}

			public override void VisitNameToken(NameToken token)
			{
				ushort num = _stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
				_stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
				ResolveNamedReference(token, num - 1);
			}

			public override void VisitNameXToken(NameXToken token)
			{

			public override void VisitNumberToken(NumberToken token)
			{

			}

			{
				token.CellAddress = _stream.ReadFormulaCellAddressFromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);
			}

			public override void VisitStrToken(StrToken token)
			{
				token.Value = _stream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(LengthType.EightBit, ref Data, ref DataIndex).UnformattedString;
			}

			public override void VisitStructuredTableReference(StructuredTableReference token)
			{
			}

			{

			}

			{

					WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReferenceBase = workbookReferences[workbookReferences.Count - 1];

					}
					return workbookReferenceBase.GetWorksheetReference(worksheetName, lastWorksheetName);
				}
				int externalSheetIndex = _stream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref Data, ref DataIndex);

				}
			}

		private void LoadRC4CryptoAPIEncryptionStreamHelper(Stream encryptionStream, DocumentSummaryInformation documentSummaryInformation, SummaryInformation summaryInformation)
		{
			if (encryptionStream == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			InPlaceTransform readRecordTransform = ReadRecordTransform;
			InPlaceRC4CryptoAPIEncryptionTransform val = (InPlaceRC4CryptoAPIEncryptionTransform)(object)((readRecordTransform is InPlaceRC4CryptoAPIEncryptionTransform) ? readRecordTransform : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(encryptionStream);
			byte[] array = binaryReader.ReadBytes(8);
			val.Transform(array, 0u);
			uint num = BitConverter.ToUInt32(array, 0);
			BitConverter.ToUInt32(array, 4);
			encryptionStream.Position = num;
			array = binaryReader.ReadBytes((int)(encryptionStream.Length - encryptionStream.Position));
			val.Transform(array, 0u);
			int index = 0;
			uint uInt = Utilities.GetUInt32(array, ref index);
			for (int i = 0; i < uInt; i++)
			{
				uint uInt2 = Utilities.GetUInt32(array, ref index);
				uint uInt3 = Utilities.GetUInt32(array, ref index);
				ushort uInt4 = Utilities.GetUInt16(array, ref index);
				Utilities.GetByte(array, ref index);
				byte b = Utilities.GetByte(array, ref index);
				bool flag = (b & 1) == 1;
				Utilities.GetUInt32(array, ref index);
				int num2 = index;
				byte b2;
				byte b3;
				do
				{
					b2 = Utilities.GetByte(array, ref index);
					b3 = Utilities.GetByte(array, ref index);
				}
				while (b2 != 0 || b3 != 0);
				int count = index - num2 - 2;
				string text = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(array, num2, count);
				binaryReader.BaseStream.Position = uInt2;
				byte[] array2 = binaryReader.ReadBytes((int)uInt3);
				val.Transform(array2, (uint)uInt4);
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(array2);
				if (flag)
				{
					switch (text)
					{
					case "\u0005SummaryInformation":
						((InformationBase)summaryInformation).Load((Stream)memoryStream);
						break;
					case "\u0005DocumentSummaryInformation":
						((InformationBase)documentSummaryInformation).Load((Stream)memoryStream);
						break;
					default:
						base.Workbook.CacheAdditionalStructuredStorageFile(text, memoryStream);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (CurrentRecordStream != null)
				{
					CurrentRecordStream.Dispose();
					CurrentRecordStream = null;
				}
				if (_workbookStreamReader != null)
				{
					_workbookStreamReader.Close();
				}
				WorkbookStream.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		{
			if (Formats.Count <= 15)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Formats[15];
		}

		public void FinalizeNamedReference(NamedReference reference, Formula formula, bool hidden)
		{
			if (_areAllNamedReferencesLoaded)
			{
				if (formula != null)
				{
					ResolveCachedNamedRecordIndexes(formula);
				}
				reference.SetFormulaInternal(formula, synchronizeBuiltInReferences: false);
				AddInternalNamedReference(reference, hidden);
			}
			else
			{
				if (_pendingNamedReferencesToBeFinalized == null)
				{
					_pendingNamedReferencesToBeFinalized = new List<Tuple<NamedReference, Formula, bool>>();
				}
				_pendingNamedReferencesToBeFinalized.Add(Tuple.Create(reference, formula, hidden));
			}
		}

		protected override WorkItem LoadCore()
		{
			_xfRecordsStart = -1L;
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then(LoadAllRecords(), (Action)delegate
			{
				ProcessLoadedShapeIds();
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		public override void OnAfterLoadGlobalSettings()
		{
			base.OnAfterLoadGlobalSettings();
			_areAllNamedReferencesLoaded = true;
			foreach (NamedReferenceBase namedReference in base.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.NamedReferences)
			{
				if (namedReference.FormulaInternal != null)
				{
					ResolveCachedNamedRecordIndexes(namedReference.FormulaInternal);
				}
			}
			if (_pendingNamedReferencesToBeFinalized != null)
			{
				foreach (Tuple<NamedReference, Formula, bool> item in _pendingNamedReferencesToBeFinalized)
				{
					FinalizeNamedReference(item.Item1, item.Item2, item.Item3);
				}
				_pendingNamedReferencesToBeFinalized = null;
			}
			if (base.Workbook.ExternalWorkbooks != null)
			{
				foreach (WorkbookReferenceBase value in base.Workbook.ExternalWorkbooks.Values)
				{
					foreach (NamedReferenceBase namedReference2 in value.NamedReferences)
					{
						if (namedReference2.FormulaInternal != null)
						{
							ResolveCachedNamedRecordIndexes(namedReference2.FormulaInternal);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			_indexToNameRecordByNameToken.Clear();
		}

		public Rectangle GetGroupShapeChildBoundsInEmus(WorksheetShapeGroup group)
		{
			_childBoundsInEmusByGroupShape.TryGetValue(group, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public WorkbookStyle GetLoadedStyle(int styleIndex)
		{
			if (styleIndex == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (0 <= styleIndex && styleIndex < LoadedStyles.Count)
			{
				return LoadedStyles[styleIndex];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public WorksheetRow GetRow(Worksheet worksheet, int rowIndex)
		{
			if (_currentRowForLoadingCellValues != null && _currentRowForLoadingCellValues.Index == rowIndex && _currentRowForLoadingCellValues.Worksheet == worksheet)
			{
				return _currentRowForLoadingCellValues;
			}
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = null;
			if (_rowsInLoadingBlock != null)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow2 = _rowsInLoadingBlock[0];
				if (worksheetRow2 != null)
				{
					int num = rowIndex - worksheetRow2.Index;
					if (0 <= num && num < _rowsInLoadingBlock.Length)
					{
						worksheetRow = _rowsInLoadingBlock[num];
					}
				}
			}
			if (worksheetRow == null)
			{
				worksheetRow = (_currentRowForLoadingCellValues = worksheet.Rows[rowIndex]);
			}
			return worksheetRow;
		}

		public static bool IsWorkbookEncrypted(Stream biff8WorkbookStream)
		{
			if (biff8WorkbookStream == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			using BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(biff8WorkbookStream);
			if (biff8WorkbookStream.Length <= biff8WorkbookStream.Position + 4)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ushort num = binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
			if (num != 2057)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ushort num2 = binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
			biff8WorkbookStream.Position += num2;
			if (biff8WorkbookStream.Length <= biff8WorkbookStream.Position + 4)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ushort num3 = binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
			if (num3 == 134)
			{
				ushort num4 = binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
				biff8WorkbookStream.Position += num4;
				if (biff8WorkbookStream.Length <= biff8WorkbookStream.Position + 4)
				{
					return false;
				}
				num3 = binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
			}
			return num3 == 47;
		}

		public void OnRowLoaded(WorksheetRow row)
		{
			if (_rowsInLoadingBlock == null)
			{
				_rowsInLoadingBlock = new WorksheetRow[32];
			}
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = _rowsInLoadingBlock[0];
			if (worksheetRow == null)
			{
				_rowsInLoadingBlock[0] = row;
				return;
			}
			int num = row.Index - worksheetRow.Index;
			if (0 <= num && num < _rowsInLoadingBlock.Length)
			{
				_rowsInLoadingBlock[num] = row;
			}
		}

		public WorkItem VerifyFormatsLoaded()
		{
			if (_isVerifyingFormatsLoaded)
			{
				return null;
			}
			_isVerifyingFormatsLoaded = true;
			if (_deferredFONTRecords != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _deferredFONTRecords.Count; i++)
				{
					FONTRecord.LoadHelper(this, _deferredFONTRecords[i]);
				}
				_deferredFONTRecords = null;
			}
			if (_deferredXFRecords != null)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < _deferredXFRecords.Count; j++)
				{
					XFRecord.LoadHelper(this, _deferredXFRecords[j]);
				}
				_deferredXFRecords = null;
			}
			if (_deferredXFEXTRecords != null)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < _deferredXFEXTRecords.Count; k++)
				{
					XFEXTRecord.LoadHelper(this, _deferredXFEXTRecords[k]);
				}
				_deferredXFEXTRecords = null;
			}
			if (_deferredDXFRecords != null)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < _deferredDXFRecords.Count; l++)
				{
					DXFRecord.LoadHelper(this, _deferredDXFRecords[l]);
				}
				_deferredDXFRecords = null;
			}
			if (_deferredSTYLERecords != null)
			{
				for (int m = 0; m < _deferredSTYLERecords.Count; m++)
				{
					STYLERecord.LoadHelper(this, _deferredSTYLERecords[m]);
				}
				_deferredSTYLERecords = null;
			}
			if (_deferredSTYLEEXTRecords != null)
			{
				for (int n = 0; n < _deferredSTYLEEXTRecords.Count; n++)
				{
					STYLEEXTRecord.LoadHelper(this, _deferredSTYLEEXTRecords[n]);
				}
				_deferredSTYLEEXTRecords = null;
			}
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then(WorkItemExtensions.Then(Async.If(_deferredSstRecordPosition.HasValue, (Func<WorkItem>)(() => (WorkItem)(object)WorkItemExtensions.Then<long?>(LoadRecordDataAt(_deferredSstRecordPosition.Value), (Func<long?>)(() => _deferredSstRecordPosition = null), (WorkItemContinuationType)0)), (Func<WorkItem>)null), (Func<WorkItem>)(() => Async.If(_deferredExtSstRecordPosition.HasValue, (Func<WorkItem>)(() => (WorkItem)(object)WorkItemExtensions.Then<long?>(LoadRecordDataAt(_deferredExtSstRecordPosition.Value), (Func<long?>)(() => _deferredExtSstRecordPosition = null), (WorkItemContinuationType)0)), (Func<WorkItem>)null)), (WorkItemContinuationType)0), (Action)delegate
			{
				_isVerifyingFormatsLoaded = false;
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		private void GetShapeIdsAndRadioButtons(WorksheetShapeCollection shapes, Dictionary<ushort, WorksheetShape> shapeByObjIds, List<FtRboData> radioButtons)
		{
			foreach (WorksheetShape item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)shapes)
			{
				if (item is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
				{
					GetShapeIdsAndRadioButtons(worksheetShapeGroup.Shapes, shapeByObjIds, radioButtons);
				}
				if (item.Obj != null && item.Obj.Cmo != null)
				{
					shapeByObjIds[item.Obj.Cmo.Id] = item;
					if (item.Obj.RadioButton != null)
					{
						radioButtons.Add(item.Obj.RadioButton);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private WorkItem LoadAllRecords()
		{
			long num = WorkbookStream.Length - 2;
			while (WorkbookStream.Position <= num)
			{
				long position = WorkbookStream.Position;
				Biff8RecordStream biff8RecordStream = null;
				try
				{
					biff8RecordStream = new Biff8RecordStream(this);
					if (CurrentRecordStream.RecordType == BIFF8RecordType.Default)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (_xfRecordsStart < 0)
					{
						if (CurrentRecordStream.RecordType == BIFF8RecordType.XF)
						{
							_xfRecordsStart = position;
						}
					}
					else if (XfRecordData == null && CurrentRecordStream.RecordType != BIFF8RecordType.XF)
					{
						_commonData.CacheXFRecordData(_xfRecordsStart);
					}
					WorkItem val = LoadCurrentRecord();
					if (val == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Biff8RecordStream temp = biff8RecordStream;
					biff8RecordStream = null;
					return WorkItemExtensions.Then(WorkItemExtensions.Then(val, (Action<WorkItem>)delegate(WorkItem t)
					{
						if (temp != null)
						{
							temp.Dispose();
						}
						t.RethrowIfExceptional();
					}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0), (Func<WorkItem>)(() => LoadAllRecords()), (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
				}
				finally
				{
					biff8RecordStream?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void LoadFormulaData(Formula formula, ushort rpnTokenArraySize, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex)
		{
			formula.IsSharedFormula = formula.Type == FormulaType.SharedFormula;
			if (rpnTokenArraySize == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = dataIndex + rpnTokenArraySize;
			bool flag = false;
			FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(base.Workbook, formula);
			LoadTokenVisitor loadTokenVisitor = LoadTokenVisitor.Initialize(context, this, formula.Type == FormulaType.ExternalNamedReferenceFormula, data, dataIndex);
			List<FormulaToken> list = new List<FormulaToken>();
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = CurrentRecordStream;
			while (loadTokenVisitor.DataIndex < num)
			{
				_ = loadTokenVisitor.DataIndex;
				byte tokenCode = currentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref loadTokenVisitor.Data, ref loadTokenVisitor.DataIndex);
				FormulaToken formulaToken = FormulaToken.CreateToken(currentRecordStream, tokenCode, ref loadTokenVisitor.Data, ref loadTokenVisitor.DataIndex);
				if (formulaToken == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				formulaToken.Accept(loadTokenVisitor);
				if (formulaToken is AttrTokenBase { Volatile: not false })
				{
					formula.RecalculateAlways = true;
				}
				if (formulaToken is FunctionVOperator functionVOperator)
				{
					if (functionVOperator.Function.ID == 255)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else if (functionVOperator.Function.ID == 359)
					{
						formula.HasHyperlink = true;
					}
				}
				list.Add(formulaToken);
			}
			formula.PostfixTokenList = list.ToArray();
			data = loadTokenVisitor.Data;
			dataIndex = loadTokenVisitor.DataIndex;
			loadTokenVisitor.Reset();
			if (dataIndex != num)
			{
				dataIndex = num;
			}
			LoadAdditionalDataTokenVisitor loadAdditionalDataTokenVisitor = LoadAdditionalDataTokenVisitor.Initialize(context, this, data, dataIndex);
			loadAdditionalDataTokenVisitor.VisitAll();
			if (formula.PostfixTokenList.Length == 1)
			{
				FormulaToken formulaToken2 = formula.PostfixTokenList[0];
				if (formulaToken2 is ExpToken || formulaToken2 is TblToken)
				{
					formula.IsArrayOrSharedFormula = true;
					return;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				AddInFunctionResolver addInFunctionResolver = AddInFunctionResolver.Initialize(context);
				addInFunctionResolver.Evaluate();
			}
		}

		private WorkItem LoadRecordDataAt(long recordPosition)
		{
			long originalPosition = WorkbookStream.Position;
			WorkbookStream.Position = recordPosition;
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then(Async.Using<Biff8RecordStream>(new Biff8RecordStream(this), (Func<Biff8RecordStream, WorkItem>)((Biff8RecordStream stream) => LoadRecordHelper(_commonData.GetBiffRecord(stream.RecordType)))), (Action)delegate
			{
				WorkbookStream.Position = originalPosition;
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		private WorkItem LoadRecordHelper(Biff8RecordBase record)
		{
			if (!record.CanBeEncrypted)
			{
				CurrentRecordStream.Transform.SuspendTransformations();
			}
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then(Async.If(record.IsAsyncLoadingSupported, (Func<WorkItem>)(() => record.LoadAsync(this)), (Func<WorkItem>)delegate
			{
				record.Load(this);
				return (WorkItem)null;
			}), (Action)delegate
			{
				if (!record.CanBeEncrypted)
				{
					CurrentRecordStream.Transform.ResumeTransformations();
				}
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		private void ProcessLoadedShapeIds()
		{
			Dictionary<ushort, WorksheetShape> dictionary = new Dictionary<ushort, WorksheetShape>();
			List<FtRboData> list = new List<FtRboData>();
			foreach (Worksheet item in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)base.Workbook.Worksheets)
			{
				GetShapeIdsAndRadioButtons(item.Shapes, dictionary, list);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ushort, WorksheetShape> item2 in dictionary)
			{
				if (item2.Value is UnknownShape { IsOleShape: not false })
				{
					base.Workbook.ReservedObjIds.Add(item2.Key);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				FtRboData ftRboData = list[i];
				if (dictionary.TryGetValue(ftRboData.IdRadNext, out var value))
				{
					ftRboData.IdRadNextShape = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResolveCachedNamedRecordIndexes(Formula formula)
		{
			FormulaToken[] postfixTokenList = formula.PostfixTokenList;
			foreach (FormulaToken formulaToken in postfixTokenList)
			{
				if (formulaToken is NameToken nameToken && _indexToNameRecordByNameToken.TryGetValue(nameToken, out var value))
				{
					nameToken.Accept(_nameReferenceResolver, value);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.FormulaUtilities.Tokens
{
	internal abstract class FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult>
	{
		private FormulaContext _context;

		private ushort _currentTokenIndex;

		private bool _hasError;

		public FormulaContext Context
		{
			get
			{
				return _context;
			}
			protected set
			{
				_context = value;
			}
		}

		protected ushort CurrentTokenIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return _currentTokenIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				_currentTokenIndex = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual FormulaToken[] PostfixTokenList => _context.Formula.PostfixTokenList;

		public virtual TResult DefaultVisit(FormulaToken token, TArgument argument)
		{
			return default(TResult);
		}

		protected void OnError()
		{
			_hasError = true;
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			_context = null;
			_hasError = false;
		}

		public bool VisitAll(TArgument argument)
		{
			FormulaToken tokenWithError;
			bool result = VisitAllHelper(argument, out tokenWithError);
			Reset();
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual bool VisitAllHelper(TArgument argument, out FormulaToken tokenWithError)
		{
			tokenWithError = null;
			FormulaToken[] postfixTokenList = PostfixTokenList;
			int num = postfixTokenList.Length;
			for (_currentTokenIndex = 0; _currentTokenIndex < num; _currentTokenIndex++)
			{
				VisitToken(postfixTokenList[_currentTokenIndex], argument, out var replacementToken);
				if (replacementToken != null)
				{
					postfixTokenList[_currentTokenIndex] = replacementToken;
				}
				if (_hasError)
				{
					tokenWithError = postfixTokenList[_currentTokenIndex];
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual TResult VisitArea3DNToken(Area3DNToken token, TArgument argument)
		{
			return VisitAreaNToken(token, argument);
		}

		protected virtual TResult VisitToken(FormulaToken token, TArgument argument, out FormulaToken replacementToken)
		{
			replacementToken = null;

		}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.Serialization
{
	internal abstract class BiffRecordBase<RecordTypeEnum, LoadContextType, SaveContextType> where LoadContextType : WorkbookLoadManager where SaveContextType : WorkbookSaveManager
	{
		public delegate BiffRecordBase<RecordTypeEnum, LoadContextType, SaveContextType> CreateBiffRecordDelegate(RecordTypeEnum type);

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<RecordTypeEnum, BiffRecordBase<RecordTypeEnum, LoadContextType, SaveContextType>> records;

		public virtual bool IsAsyncLoadingSupported => false;

		public abstract RecordTypeEnum Type { get; }

		private static Dictionary<RecordTypeEnum, BiffRecordBase<RecordTypeEnum, LoadContextType, SaveContextType>> Records
		{
			get
			{
				if (records == null)
				{
					records = new Dictionary<RecordTypeEnum, BiffRecordBase<RecordTypeEnum, LoadContextType, SaveContextType>>();
				}
				return records;
			}
		}

		public abstract void Load(LoadContextType manager);

		public virtual WorkItem LoadAsync(LoadContextType manager)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public abstract void Save(SaveContextType manager);

		public virtual WorkItem SaveAsync(SaveContextType manager)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public static BiffRecordBase<RecordTypeEnum, LoadContextType, SaveContextType> GetBiffRecord(RecordTypeEnum type, CreateBiffRecordDelegate createBiffRecord)
		{
			if (Records.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = createBiffRecord(type);
			Records.Add(type, value);
			return value;
		}
	}
}

	internal class FILEPASSRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		private const ushort WEncryptionTypeXORObfuscation = 0;

		private const ushort WEncryptionTypeRC4Encryption = 1;

		public override bool CanBeEncrypted => false;

		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.FILEPASS;

		private static void FILEPASSRecordSaveHelper(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			FILEPASSRecordLoadHelper(loadManager);
			if (loadManager.ReadRecordTransform == null)
			{
				loadManager.Workbook.ThrowInvalidPasswordException();
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{

		}

		private static void FILEPASSRecordLoadHelper(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ca: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			byte[] openPasswordUnicode = loadManager.GetOpenPasswordUnicode();
			loadManager.Workbook.WasOpenPasswordUsedOnLoad = true;
			switch (loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16())
			{
			case 0:
			{
				ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				ushort num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				loadManager.ReadRecordTransform = (InPlaceTransform)(object)InPlaceXorObfuscationTransform.VerifyPassword(openPasswordUnicode, num, num2);
				return;
			}
			case 1:
			{
				CryptoVersion val = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadVersion();
				if (((CryptoVersion)(ref val)).IsRC4)
				{
					byte[] array = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadBytes(16);
					byte[] array2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadBytes(16);
					byte[] array3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadBytes(16);
					loadManager.ReadRecordTransform = (InPlaceTransform)(object)InPlaceRC4EncryptionTransform.VerifyPassword(openPasswordUnicode, array, array2, array3);
					return;
				}
				if (((CryptoVersion)(ref val)).IsRC4CryptoAPI)
				{
					new EncryptionHeaderFlags(loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32());
					loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
					EncryptionHeader val2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadEncryptionHeader();
					EncryptionVerifier val3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadEncryptionVerifier(32);
					if (val2.KeySize == 0)
					{
						val2.KeySize = 40u;
					}
					loadManager.ReadRecordTransform = (InPlaceTransform)(object)InPlaceRC4CryptoAPIEncryptionTransform.VerifyPassword(openPasswordUnicode, val3.Salt, ((EncryptionHeader)(ref val2)).CreateEncryptionAlgorithm((Action)null), ((EncryptionHeader)(ref val2)).CreateHashAlgorithm((Action)null), val2.KeySize, val3.EncryptedVerifier, val3.EncryptedVerifierHash);
					return;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			Workbook.ThrowEncryptionAlgorithmNotSupportedException();
		}

	internal class FILESHARINGRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		private const int MaxUserNameLength = 54;

		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.FILESHARING;

		private static void FILESHARINGRecordLoadHelper(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, ushort wResPass, string stUNUsername)
		{
			if (loadManager.IsWriteProtected)
			{
				loadManager.Workbook.PendingFileWriteProtectionValidationInfo = ProtectionValidationInfo.Create(wResPass);
				loadManager.Workbook.FileWriteProtectedBy = stUNUsername;
			}
		}

		private static void FILESHARINGRecordSaveHelper(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			if (saveManager.Workbook.HasFileWriteProtectionPassword)
			{
				ushort xorObfuscationVerifier = ProtectionValidationInfo.GetXorObfuscationVerifier(saveManager.Workbook.GetFileWriteProtectionPasswordUnicode());
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(xorObfuscationVerifier);
				string text = saveManager.Workbook.FileWriteProtectedByResolved;
				if (54 < text.Length)
				{
					text = text.Substring(0, 54);
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteXLUnicodeString(text);
			}
			else
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			}
		}

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			if (num == 0)
			{
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				return;
			}
			string stUNUsername = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadXLUnicodeString();
			FILESHARINGRecordLoadHelper(loadManager, num, stUNUsername);
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			FILESHARINGRecordSaveHelper(saveManager);
		}
	}

{
	private static SR loader;

	private ResourceManager[] resources;

	private SR()
	{
		string text = "Infragistics.Documents.Excel.strings;Infragistics.Documents.Excel.strings.CalcEngine";
		string[] array = text.Split(';');
		int num = 0;
		string[] array2 = array;
		foreach (string text2 in array2)
		{
			if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
		}
		resources = new ResourceManager[num];
		Assembly assembly = GetType().Assembly;
		int num2 = 0;
		string[] array3 = array;
		foreach (string text3 in array3)
		{
			if (text3 != null && text3.Length > 0)
			{
				resources[num2++] = new ResourceManager(text3, assembly);
			}
		}
	}

	private static SR GetLoader()
	{
		if (loader == null)
		{
			lock (typeof(SR))
			{
				if (loader == null)
				{
					loader = new SR();
				}
			}
		}
		return loader;
	}

	public static string GetString(string name)
	{
		return GetString(null, name);
	}

	public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetString(null, name, args);
	}

	public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
	{
		return GetString(culture, name, null);
	}

	public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: true, culture, name, args);
	}

	private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		string text = null;
		if (allowCustomizedStrings)
		{
			text = ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
		}
		if (text == null)
		{
			SR sR = GetLoader();
			if (sR == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			text = sR.GetString(name, culture);
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
		}
		if (args != null && args.Length > 0 && text.Length > 2)
		{
			try
			{
				text = string.Format(null, text, args);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		ResourceManager[] array = resources;
		foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
		{
			string text = resourceManager.GetString(name, culture);
			if (text != null)
			{
				return text;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name)
	{
		return GetUncustomizedString(null, name);
	}
