	{
		return GetUncustomizedString(null, name, args);
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
	{
		return GetUncustomizedString(culture, name, null);
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: false, culture, name, args);
	}

	public static object GetObject(string name)
	{
		return GetObject(null, name);
	}

	public static object GetObject(CultureInfo culture, string name)
	{
		return GetLoader()?.GetObject(name, culture);
	}

	private object GetObject(string name, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		ResourceManager[] array = resources;
		foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
		{
			object obj = resourceManager.GetObject(name, culture);
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return obj;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	[Obsolete("Deprecated. The BIFF8Writer class has been replaced by the Save instance methods of Workbook.", false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class BIFF8Writer
	{
		private BIFF8Writer()
		{
		}

		public static void WriteWorkbookToFile(Workbook workbook, string fileName)
		{
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("workbook", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_Workbook"));
			}
			workbook.Save(fileName);
		}

		public static void WriteWorkbookToStream(Workbook workbook, Stream outStream)
		{
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("workbook", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_Workbook"));
			}
			workbook.Save(outStream);
		}

		public static void WriteWorkbookToStreamEx(Workbook workbook, Stream outStream)
		{
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("workbook", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_Workbook"));
			}
			workbook.Save(outStream);
		}
	}
}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionQuotient : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "quotient";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue2.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out var result) || !excelCalcValue2.ToDouble(out var result2))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (result == 0.0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue((result2 - result2 % result) / result);
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionPower : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "power";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue2.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue2.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out var result) || !excelCalcValue2.ToDouble(out var result2))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			if (result2 == 0.0)
			{
				if (result == 0.0)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				if (result < 0.0)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div));
				}
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(Math.Pow(result2, result));
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionCount : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "count";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => int.MaxValue;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue[] arguments = GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount, skipEmptyValues: true);
			return EvaluateHelper(arguments);
		}

		public override bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue EvaluateHelper(IList<ExcelCalcValue> args)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ExcelCalcValue arg in args)
			{
				if (arg.IsBoolean || arg.IsError || arg.IsString)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (arg.ToDouble(out var _))
				{
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					arg.ToDateTime();
					num++;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionNPV : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "npv";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => int.MaxValue;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			ExcelCalcValue[] array = new ExcelCalcValue[argumentCount - 1];
			for (int i = 0; i < argumentCount - 1; i++)
			{
				array[i] = numberStack.Pop();
			}
			if (!numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			result += 1.0;
			int num2 = 1;
			for (int num3 = array.Length; num3 > 0; num3--)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = array[num3 - 1];
				double result2;
				if (excelCalcValue.IsReference && excelCalcValue.ToReference().IsEnumerable)
				{
					IExcelCalcReferenceCollection references = excelCalcValue.ToReference().References;
					foreach (IExcelCalcReference item in references)
					{
						ExcelCalcValue value = item.Value;
						if (value.IsError)
						{
							return new ExcelCalcValue(value.ToErrorValue());
						}
						if (value.ToDouble(out result2))
						{
							num += result2 / Math.Pow(result, num2++);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
					{
						return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
					}
					if (excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out result2))
					{
						num += result2 / Math.Pow(result, num2++);
					}
				}
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
		}

		public override bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return 1 <= parameterIndex;
		}
	}

		public override string Name => "pv";

		public override int MinArgs => 3;

		public override int MaxArgs => 5;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (argumentCount == 5)
			{
				num = numberStack.Pop().ToInt32();
			}
			double result = 0.0;
			if (argumentCount >= 4 && !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out result))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (!numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result2) || !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result3) || !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result4))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (num != 0)
			{
				result2 *= 1.0 + result4;
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue((result2 * (1.0 - Math.Pow(1.0 + result4, 0.0 - result3)) / result4 + result / Math.Pow(1.0 + result4, result3)) * -1.0);
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionPmt : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "pmt";

		public override int MinArgs => 3;

		public override int MaxArgs => 5;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (argumentCount == 5)
			{
				num = numberStack.Pop().ToInt32();
			}
			double result = 0.0;
			if (argumentCount >= 4 && !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out result))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (!numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result2) || !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result3) || !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result4))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (result != 0.0 && result4 != 0.0)
			{
				result = ((num == 0) ? (result * result4 / (1.0 - Math.Pow(result4 + 1.0, result3))) : (result * result4 / (1.0 - Math.Pow(result4 + 1.0, result3)) / (result4 + 1.0)));
			}
			if (result4 != 0.0)
			{
				if (num == 0)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue((result2 * (result4 / (1.0 - Math.Pow(result4 + 1.0, 0.0 - result3))) - result) * -1.0);
				}
				return new ExcelCalcValue((result2 / (1.0 + result4) * (result4 / (1.0 - Math.Pow(result4 + 1.0, 0.0 - result3))) - result) * -1.0);
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue((result2 / result3 - result) * -1.0);
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionDB : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "db";

		public override int MinArgs => 4;

		public override int MaxArgs => 5;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			int num = 12;
			if (argumentCount > 4)
			{
				num = numberStack.Pop().ToInt32();
			}
			int num2 = numberStack.Pop().ToInt32();
			if (num2 <= 0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (!numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result) || result <= 0.0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (!numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result2) || !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result3))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			double num3 = Math.Round(1.0 - Math.Pow(result2 / result3, 1.0 / result), 3);
			if ((double)num2 > result + 1.0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if ((double)num2 == result + 1.0 && num == 12)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			double num6 = result3;
			for (int i = 1; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				num4 = ((i != 1) ? (((double)i != result + 1.0 || num >= 12) ? (num6 * num3) : (num6 * num3 * (12.0 - (double)num) / 12.0)) : (num6 * num3 * ((double)num / 12.0)));
				num5 += num4;
				num6 -= num4;
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num4);
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionDDB : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "ddb";

		public override int MinArgs => 4;

		public override int MaxArgs => 5;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = ((argumentCount > 4) ? numberStack.Pop() : new ExcelCalcValue(2.0));
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue3 = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue4 = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue5 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsNull || excelCalcValue2.IsNull || excelCalcValue3.IsNull || excelCalcValue4.IsNull || excelCalcValue5.IsNull)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out var result) || !excelCalcValue2.ToDouble(out var result2) || !excelCalcValue3.ToDouble(out var result3) || !excelCalcValue4.ToDouble(out var result4) || !excelCalcValue5.ToDouble(out var result5))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			double num = result5 * Math.Pow(1.0 - result / result3, result2 - 1.0);
			double num2 = num - num * (1.0 - result / result3);
			if (result4 > num - num2)
			{
				num2 = ((!(num - result4 > 0.0)) ? 0.0 : (num - result4));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num2);
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionIntRate : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "intrate";

		public override int MinArgs => 4;

		public override int MaxArgs => 5;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			if (argumentCount > 4 && !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out result))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (result < 0.0 || result > 4.0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (!numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result2) || !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out var result3))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (result3 <= 0.0 || result2 <= 0.0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			DateTime dateTime = excelCalcValue.ToDateTime();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			DateTime dateTime2 = excelCalcValue2.ToDateTime();
			if (dateTime2 >= dateTime)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			double result4;
			double num;
			if (result == 0.0 || result == 4.0)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue3 = UltraCalcFunctionDays360.EvaluateHelper(dateTime2, dateTime, result == 4.0);
				if (!excelCalcValue3.ToDouble(out result4))
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				num = 360.0;
			}
			else
			{
				num = ((result == 1.0) ? 365.2422 : ((result != 2.0) ? 365.0 : 360.0));
				result4 = dateTime.Subtract(dateTime2).Days;
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue((result2 - result3) / result3 * (num / result4));
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionDays360 : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "days360";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 3;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			bool method = false;
			if (argumentCount > 2)
			{
				if (numberStack.Peek().IsError)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(numberStack.Pop().ToErrorValue());
				}
				method = numberStack.Pop().ToBoolean();
			}
			DateTime endDate = numberStack.Pop().ToDateTime();
			DateTime startDate = numberStack.Pop().ToDateTime();
			return EvaluateHelper(startDate, endDate, method);
		}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue EvaluateHelper(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate, bool method)
		{
			if (startDate.Day == 31)
			{
				startDate = new DateTime(startDate.Year, startDate.Month, 30);
			}
			if (endDate.Day == 31)
			{
				endDate = (method ? new DateTime(endDate.Year, endDate.Month, 30) : ((startDate.Day >= 30) ? new DateTime(endDate.Year, endDate.Month, 30) : new DateTime((endDate.Month < 12) ? endDate.Year : (endDate.Year + 1), (endDate.Month >= 12) ? 1 : (endDate.Month + 1), 1)));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(endDate.Year * 360 + endDate.Month * 30 + endDate.Day - (startDate.Year * 360 + startDate.Month * 30 + startDate.Day));
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionType : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "type";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 1;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			int num;
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				num = 16;
			}
			else if (excelCalcValue.IsBoolean)
			{
				num = 4;
			}
			else if (excelCalcValue.IsString)
			{
				num = 2;
			}
			else if (excelCalcValue.IsArray)
			{
				num = 64;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out var _))
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionIRR : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "irr";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			double num = 1E-07;
			double result = 0.1;
			if (argumentCount == 2)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
				if (!excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out result))
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				if (Math.Abs(result) < num)
				{
					result = 0.1;
				}
			}
			result += 1.0;
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			if (!excelCalcValue2.IsArrayRaw)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double result2 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				int num4 = 0;
				bool flag2 = false;
				bool flag3 = false;
				ArrayProxy arrayProxy = excelCalcValue2.ToArrayProxy();
				foreach (ExcelCalcValue item in (IEnumerable<ExcelCalcValue>)arrayProxy)
				{
					if (item.ToDouble(out result2))
					{
						if (result2 < 0.0)
						{
							flag3 = true;
						}
						else if (0.0 < result2)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
						num4++;
						if (flag)
						{
							num2 = result2;
							num3 = 0.0;
							flag = false;
						}
						else
						{
							num3 = num2 + num3 * result;
							num2 = result2 + num2 * result;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num4 < 2 || !flag3 || !flag2)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				double num5 = num2 / num3;
				result -= num5;
				if (Math.Abs(num5) < num)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(result - 1.0);
				}
				if (Math.Abs(result) < num)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
		}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionRate : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		private const int ITMAX = 110;

		private const double CEPS = 1E-10;

		public override string Name => "rate";

		public override int MinArgs => 3;

		public override int MaxArgs => 6;

		private bool calcFV(double rate, double term, double payment, double pv, int type, double fv, ref int sign)
		{
			double num = UltraCalcFunctionFV.CalculateFV(rate, term, payment, pv, type);
			num -= fv;
			sign = Math.Sign(num);
			return Math.Abs(num) < 1E-10;
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			double result2 = 0.0;
			double result3 = 0.0;
			double result4 = 0.0;
			int num = 0;
			double result5 = 0.1;
			switch (argumentCount)
			{
			default:
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			case 6:
				if (!numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out result5))
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				break;
			case 3:
			case 4:
			case 5:
				break;
			}
			if (argumentCount >= 5)
			{
				num = numberStack.Pop().ToInt();
				if (num < 0 || num > 1)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
				}
			}
			if (argumentCount >= 4 && !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out result))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			if (argumentCount >= 3)
			{
				if (!numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out result2) || !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out result3) || !numberStack.Pop().ToDouble(out result4))
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				if (result4 <= 0.0)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
				}
			}
			int sign = 0;
			if (calcFV(result5, result4, result3, result2, num, result, ref sign))
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(result5);
			}
			double num2 = 0.0001;
			double num3 = result5 + num2;
			double num4 = result5 - num2;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < 110 && !flag; i++)
			{
				int sign2 = 0;
				if (calcFV(num3, result4, result3, result2, num, result, ref sign2))
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(num3);
				}
				if (sign2 != sign)
				{
					flag = true;
					num4 = num3 - num2;
					continue;
				}
				if (num4 > -1.0)
				{
					if (calcFV(num4, result4, result3, result2, num, result, ref sign2))
					{
						return new ExcelCalcValue(num4);
					}
					if (sign2 != sign)
					{
						flag = true;
						num3 = num4 + num2;
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (i == 25 || i == 50 || i == 100)
				{
					num2 *= 10.0;
				}
				num3 += num2;
				num4 -= num2;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < 110; j++)
			{
				result5 = num4 + (num3 - num4) / 2.0;
				int sign3 = 0;
				if (calcFV(result5, result4, result3, result2, num, result, ref sign3))
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(result5);
				}
				int sign4 = 0;
				calcFV(num3, result4, result3, result2, num, result, ref sign4);
				if (sign3 == sign4)
				{
					num3 = result5;
				}
				else
				{
					num4 = result5;
				}
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionDateDiff : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "datediff";

		public override int MinArgs => 3;

		public override int MaxArgs => 3;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = numberStack.Pop();
			string interval = numberStack.Pop().ToString().ToLower()
				.Trim();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsNull || excelCalcValue2.IsNull)
			{
				ExcelCalcErrorValue value = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num);
				return new ExcelCalcValue(value);
			}
			DateTime date = excelCalcValue.ToDateTime();
			DateTime date2 = excelCalcValue2.ToDateTime();
			long num = DateDiffInvariant(numberStack.Culture, interval, date2, date);
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
		}

		private static double Fix(double number)
		{
			if (number >= 0.0)
			{
				return Math.Floor(number);
			}
			return 0.0 - Math.Floor(0.0 - number);
		}

		internal static FirstWeekOfYear GetFirstWeekOfYear(CalendarWeekRule calendarWeekRule)
		{
			return calendarWeekRule switch
			{
				CalendarWeekRule.FirstFourDayWeek => FirstWeekOfYear.FirstFourDays, 
				CalendarWeekRule.FirstFullWeek => FirstWeekOfYear.FirstFullWeek, 
				_ => FirstWeekOfYear.Jan1, 
			};
		}

		internal static long DateDiffInvariant(CultureInfo culture, string interval, DateTime date1, DateTime date2)
		{
			FirstDayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek = (FirstDayOfWeek)(culture.DateTimeFormat.FirstDayOfWeek + 1);
			FirstWeekOfYear firstWeekOfYear = GetFirstWeekOfYear(culture.DateTimeFormat.CalendarWeekRule);
			return CalcManagerUtilities.DateAndTimeDateDiff(interval, date1, date2, firstDayOfWeek, firstWeekOfYear);
		}

		internal static long DateDiffInvariant(CultureInfo culture, DateInterval interval, DateTime date1, DateTime date2)
		{
			FirstDayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek = (FirstDayOfWeek)(culture.DateTimeFormat.FirstDayOfWeek + 1);
			FirstWeekOfYear firstWeekOfYear = GetFirstWeekOfYear(culture.DateTimeFormat.CalendarWeekRule);
			return CalcManagerUtilities.DateAndTimeDateDiff(interval, date1, date2, firstDayOfWeek, firstWeekOfYear);
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionNetWorkDays : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "networkdays";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 3;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue[] arguments = GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount - 2, skipEmptyValues: true);
			if (!UltraCalcFunctionWorkDay.GetHolidayList(arguments, out var holidays, out var errorValue))
			{
				return errorValue;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = numberStack.Pop().ToDateTime().Date;
			DateTime dateTime2 = numberStack.Pop().ToDateTime().Date;
			int num = 1;
			if (dateTime2 > dateTime)
			{
				num = -1;
				DateTime dateTime3 = dateTime2;
				dateTime2 = dateTime;
				dateTime = dateTime3;
			}
			long num2 = UltraCalcFunctionDateDiff.DateDiffInvariant(numberStack.Culture, DateInterval.Day, dateTime2, dateTime);
			num2++;
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				int num3 = (int)(num2 / 7);
				int num4 = (int)(num2 % 7);
				num2 -= num3 * 2;
				switch (dateTime2.DayOfWeek)
				{
				case DayOfWeek.Monday:
				case DayOfWeek.Tuesday:
				case DayOfWeek.Wednesday:
				case DayOfWeek.Thursday:
				case DayOfWeek.Friday:
				case DayOfWeek.Saturday:
				{
					int num5 = (int)(8 - dateTime2.DayOfWeek);
					if (num4 >= num5)
					{
						num2 -= Math.Min(2, num5);
					}
					else if (num4 == num5 - 1)
					{
						num2 -= Math.Min(1, num5);
					}
					break;
				}
				case DayOfWeek.Sunday:
					if (num4 >= 1)
					{
						num2--;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (holidays != null)
				{
					foreach (DateTime key in holidays.Keys)
					{
						if (key >= dateTime2 && key <= dateTime)
						{
							num2--;
						}
					}
				}
				num2 *= num;
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num2);
		}

		public override bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return parameterIndex == 2;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class UltraCalcFunctionDec2XBase : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		internal const long MinNumberBin = -512L;

		internal const long MaxNumberBin = 511L;

		internal const long MinNumberOct = -536870912L;

		internal const long MaxNumberOct = 536870911L;

		internal const long MaxNumberHex = 549755813887L;

		protected internal abstract long MaxNumber { get; }

		protected internal abstract int NumberSystem { get; }

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (argumentCount == 2)
			{
				int num2 = numberStack.Pop().ToInt32();
				if (num2 <= 0)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				num = num2;
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			long num3 = excelCalcValue.ToInt64();
			if (num3 < MinNumber || num3 > MaxNumber)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			string text = ConvertToNumberSystem(num3, NumberSystem, MinNumber, MaxNumber);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				if (text.Length < 10 && text.Length > num)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			while (text.Length < num)
			{
				text = string.Format("{0}{1}", "0", text);
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(text);
		}

		internal static string ConvertToNumberSystem(long number, int numberSystem, long minNumber, long maxNumber)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (number < 0)
			{
				number -= minNumber;
				flag = true;
			}
			number &= maxNumber;
			if (flag)
			{
				number |= -minNumber;
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (number == 0)
			{
				text = "0";
			}
			while (number > 0)
			{
				long num = number % numberSystem;
				string arg;
				if (num < 10)
				{
					arg = num.ToString();
				}
				else
				{
					num -= 10;
					arg = ((char)(num + 65)).ToString();
				}
				text = $"{arg}{text}";
				number /= numberSystem;
			}
			return text;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class UltraCalcFunctionXBase2XBase : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		protected internal abstract long OriginalMinNumber { get; }

		protected internal abstract long OriginalMaxNumber { get; }

		protected internal abstract long NewMinNumber { get; }

		protected internal abstract long NewMaxNumber { get; }

		protected internal abstract int OriginalNumberSystem { get; }

		protected internal abstract int NewNumberSystem { get; }

		protected internal abstract long MaxLength { get; }

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (argumentCount == 2)
			{
				int num2 = numberStack.Pop().ToInt32();
				if (num2 <= 0)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				num = num2;
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			string text = excelCalcValue.ToString();
			if (text.Length > MaxLength)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			ExcelCalcErrorValue error;
			long num3 = UltraCalcFunctionXBase2Dec.ConvertFromNumberSystem(numberStack.Culture, text, OriginalNumberSystem, OriginalMinNumber, OriginalMaxNumber, out error);
			if (error != null)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(error);
			}
			if (num3 < NewMinNumber || NewMaxNumber < num3)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			string text2 = UltraCalcFunctionDec2XBase.ConvertToNumberSystem(num3, NewNumberSystem, NewMinNumber, NewMaxNumber);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				if (text2.Length < 10 && text2.Length > num)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			while (text2.Length < num)
			{
				text2 = string.Format("{0}{1}", "0", text2);
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(text2);
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionComplex : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		internal class ComplexNumber
		{
			private static ComplexNumber invalidComplexNumber;

			private static char[] signs = new char[2] { '+', '-' };

			private static double log10Multiplier = Math.Log10(Math.E);

			private static double log2Multiplier = Math.Log(Math.E, 2.0);

			private double realNumber;

			private double imaginaryNumber;

			private string suffix;

			private bool isValid;

			public double RealNumber
			{
				get
				{
					return realNumber;
				}
				set
				{
					realNumber = value;
				}
			}

			public double ImaginaryNumber => imaginaryNumber;

			public string Suffix
			{
				get
				{
					return suffix;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != "i" && value != "j")
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
					}
					suffix = value;
				}
			}

			public bool IsValid
			{
				get
				{
					if (double.IsInfinity(RealNumber) || double.IsNaN(RealNumber))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (double.IsInfinity(ImaginaryNumber) || double.IsNaN(ImaginaryNumber))
					{
						return false;
					}
					return isValid;
				}
			}

			public static ComplexNumber InvalidComplexNumber
			{
				get
				{
					if (invalidComplexNumber == null)
					{
						invalidComplexNumber = new ComplexNumber(0.0, 0.0, "i", isValid: false);
					}
					return invalidComplexNumber;
				}
			}

			internal ComplexNumber(double realNumber, double imaginaryNumber, string suffix)
				: this(realNumber, imaginaryNumber, suffix, isValid: true)
			{
			}

			internal ComplexNumber(CultureInfo culture, string complexNumber)
			{
				isValid = TryParseComplexNumber(culture, complexNumber, out realNumber, out imaginaryNumber, out suffix);
			}

			private ComplexNumber(double realNumber, double imaginaryNumber, string suffix, bool isValid)
			{
				this.realNumber = realNumber;
				this.imaginaryNumber = imaginaryNumber;
				this.suffix = suffix;
				this.isValid = isValid;
			}

			public static ComplexNumber operator /(ComplexNumber dividend, ComplexNumber divisor)
			{
				if (string.Compare(divisor.Suffix, dividend.Suffix) != 0)
				{
					return InvalidComplexNumber;
				}
				double num = Math.Pow(divisor.RealNumber, 2.0) + Math.Pow(divisor.ImaginaryNumber, 2.0);
				double num2 = (dividend.RealNumber * divisor.RealNumber + dividend.ImaginaryNumber * divisor.ImaginaryNumber) / num;
				double num3 = (dividend.ImaginaryNumber * divisor.RealNumber - dividend.RealNumber * divisor.ImaginaryNumber) / num;
				return new ComplexNumber(num2, num3, dividend.Suffix);
			}

			public static ComplexNumber operator *(ComplexNumber complexNumber1, ComplexNumber complexNumber2)
			{
				if (string.Compare(complexNumber1.Suffix, complexNumber2.Suffix) != 0)
				{
					return InvalidComplexNumber;
				}
				double num = complexNumber1.RealNumber * complexNumber2.RealNumber - complexNumber1.ImaginaryNumber * complexNumber2.ImaginaryNumber;
				double num2 = complexNumber1.RealNumber * complexNumber2.ImaginaryNumber + complexNumber1.ImaginaryNumber * complexNumber2.RealNumber;
				return new ComplexNumber(num, num2, complexNumber1.Suffix);
			}

			public static ComplexNumber operator *(ComplexNumber complexNumber1, double d)
			{
				string text = complexNumber1.Suffix;
				double num = complexNumber1.RealNumber * d;
				double num2 = complexNumber1.ImaginaryNumber * d;
				return new ComplexNumber(num, num2, text);
			}

			public static ComplexNumber operator +(ComplexNumber complexNumber1, ComplexNumber complexNumber2)
			{
				if (string.Compare(complexNumber1.Suffix, complexNumber2.Suffix) != 0)
				{
					return InvalidComplexNumber;
				}
				double num = complexNumber1.RealNumber + complexNumber2.RealNumber;
				double num2 = complexNumber1.ImaginaryNumber + complexNumber2.ImaginaryNumber;
				return new ComplexNumber(num, num2, complexNumber1.Suffix);
			}

			public static ComplexNumber operator -(ComplexNumber complexNumber1, ComplexNumber complexNumber2)
			{
				if (string.Compare(complexNumber1.Suffix, complexNumber2.Suffix) != 0)
				{
					return InvalidComplexNumber;
				}
				double num = complexNumber1.RealNumber - complexNumber2.RealNumber;
				double num2 = complexNumber1.ImaginaryNumber - complexNumber2.ImaginaryNumber;
				return new ComplexNumber(num, num2, complexNumber1.Suffix);
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				if (!IsValid)
				{
					return "#NUM";
				}
				return Complex(RealNumber, ImaginaryNumber, Suffix);
			}

			internal double Abs()
			{
				return Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(RealNumber, 2.0) + Math.Pow(ImaginaryNumber, 2.0));
			}

			internal double Argument()
			{
				if (ImaginaryNumber == 0.0 && RealNumber == 0.0)
				{
					throw new DivideByZeroException();
				}
				return Math.Atan2(ImaginaryNumber, RealNumber);
			}

			internal ComplexNumber Conjugate()
			{
				return new ComplexNumber(realNumber, 0.0 - imaginaryNumber, suffix);
			}

			internal ComplexNumber Cos()
			{
				double num = Math.Cos(RealNumber) * Math.Cosh(ImaginaryNumber);
				double num2 = 0.0 - Math.Sin(RealNumber) * Math.Sinh(ImaginaryNumber);
				return new ComplexNumber(num, num2, Suffix);
			}

			internal ComplexNumber Exponential()
			{
				double num = Math.Pow(Math.E, RealNumber);
				double num2 = Math.Cos(ImaginaryNumber) * num;
				double num3 = Math.Sin(ImaginaryNumber) * num;
				return new ComplexNumber(num2, num3, Suffix);
			}

			internal double Hypotenuse()
			{
				double num = Math.Pow(RealNumber, 2.0);
				double num2 = Math.Pow(ImaginaryNumber, 2.0);
				double d = num + num2;
				return Math.Sqrt(d);
			}

			internal ComplexNumber LN()
			{
				double d = Hypotenuse();
				double num = Math.Log(d);
				double num2 = Theta();
				return new ComplexNumber(num, num2, Suffix);
			}

			internal ComplexNumber Log10()
			{
				return LN() * log10Multiplier;
			}

			internal ComplexNumber Log2()
			{
				return LN() * log2Multiplier;
			}

			internal ComplexNumber Power(double power)
			{
				double x = Hypotenuse();
				double num = Theta();
				double num2 = Math.Pow(x, power);
				double num3 = num * power;
				double num4 = num2 * Math.Cos(num3);
				double num5 = num2 * Math.Sin(num3);
				return new ComplexNumber(num4, num5, Suffix);
			}

			internal ComplexNumber Sin()
			{
				double num = Math.Sin(RealNumber) * Math.Cosh(ImaginaryNumber);
				double num2 = Math.Cos(RealNumber) * Math.Sinh(ImaginaryNumber);
				return new ComplexNumber(num, num2, Suffix);
			}

			internal ComplexNumber Sqrt()
			{
				double d = Hypotenuse();
				double num = Theta();
				double num2 = Math.Sqrt(d);
				double num3 = num / 2.0;
				double num4 = num2 * Math.Cos(num3);
				double num5 = num2 * Math.Sin(num3);
				return new ComplexNumber(num4, num5, Suffix);
			}

			internal double Theta()
			{
				return Math.Atan2(ImaginaryNumber, RealNumber);
			}

			internal static bool TryParseComplexNumber(CultureInfo culture, string complexNumber, out double realNumber, out double imaginaryNumber, out string suffix)
			{
				complexNumber = complexNumber.Replace(" ", "");
				string[] array = SplitComplexNumber(complexNumber);
				switch (array.Length)
				{
				default:
					realNumber = 0.0;
					imaginaryNumber = 0.0;
					suffix = "i";
					return false;
				case 1:
				{
					string imaginaryNumberString = complexNumber;
					if (TryParseImaginaryNumber(culture, complexNumber, out imaginaryNumber, out suffix))
					{
						realNumber = 0.0;
						break;
					}
					imaginaryNumber = 0.0;
					if (MathUtilities.DoubleTryParse(complexNumber, culture, out realNumber))
					{
						break;
					}
					return false;
				}
				case 2:
				{
					string text = array[0];
					string imaginaryNumberString = array[1];
					if (!MathUtilities.DoubleTryParse(text, culture, out realNumber))
					{
						imaginaryNumber = 0.0;
						suffix = "i";
						return false;
					}
					if (!TryParseImaginaryNumber(culture, imaginaryNumberString, out imaginaryNumber, out suffix))
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				return true;
			}

			private static bool TryParseImaginaryNumber(CultureInfo culture, string imaginaryNumberString, out double imaginaryNumber, out string suffix)
			{
				suffix = (imaginaryNumberString.Contains("j") ? "j" : "i");
				if (!imaginaryNumberString.Contains("i") && !imaginaryNumberString.Contains("j"))
				{
					imaginaryNumber = 0.0;
					return false;
				}
				switch (imaginaryNumberString)
				{
				case "i":
				case "j":
				case "+i":
				case "+j":
					imaginaryNumber = 1.0;
					return true;
				case "-i":
				case "-j":
					imaginaryNumber = -1.0;
					return true;
				default:
					imaginaryNumberString = imaginaryNumberString.Replace("i", string.Empty);
					imaginaryNumberString = imaginaryNumberString.Replace("j", string.Empty);
					return MathUtilities.DoubleTryParse(imaginaryNumberString, culture, out imaginaryNumber);
				}
			}

			private static string[] SplitComplexNumber(string complexNumber)
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>(1);
				string text = complexNumber.Substring(0, 1);
				char[] array = complexNumber.ToCharArray();
				for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					char c = array[i];
					if (c == '-' || c == '+')
					{
						string text2 = array[i - 1].ToString().ToLower();
						if (text2 != "e")
						{
							list.Add(text);
							text = string.Empty;
						}
					}
					text += c;
				}
				list.Add(text);
				return list.ToArray();
			}

			internal static string Complex(double realNumber, double imaginaryNumber, string suffix)
			{
				realNumber = MathUtilities.RoundToExcelDisplayValue(realNumber);
				imaginaryNumber = MathUtilities.RoundToExcelDisplayValue(imaginaryNumber);
				if (realNumber == 0.0 && imaginaryNumber == 0.0)
				{
					return "0";
				}
				if (realNumber != 0.0 && imaginaryNumber == 0.0)
				{
					return realNumber.ToString("G");
				}
				string text = ((imaginaryNumber > 0.0) ? "+" : "-");
				string arg;
				if (realNumber != 0.0)
				{
					arg = realNumber.ToString("G");
				}
				else
				{
					arg = string.Empty;
					if (text == "+")
					{
						text = string.Empty;
					}
				}
				imaginaryNumber = Math.Abs(imaginaryNumber);
				string arg2 = string.Format("{0}{1}", text, (imaginaryNumber == 1.0) ? string.Empty : imaginaryNumber.ToString("G"));
				return $"{arg}{arg2}{suffix}";
			}
		}

		public override string Name => "complex";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 3;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			string text = ((argumentCount == 3) ? numberStack.Pop().ToString() : "i");
			if (string.Compare(text, "i", ignoreCase: false) != 0 && string.Compare(text, "j", ignoreCase: false) != 0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			double imaginaryNumber = excelCalcValue.ToDouble();
			excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			double realNumber = excelCalcValue.ToDouble();
			ComplexNumber complexNumber = new ComplexNumber(realNumber, imaginaryNumber, text);
			string value = complexNumber.ToString();
			return new ExcelCalcValue(value);
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionImaginary : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "imaginary";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 1;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			string complexNumber = numberStack.Pop().ToString();
			UltraCalcFunctionComplex.ComplexNumber complexNumber2 = new UltraCalcFunctionComplex.ComplexNumber(numberStack.Culture, complexNumber);
			if (!complexNumber2.IsValid)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(complexNumber2.ImaginaryNumber);
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionImProduct : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "improduct";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => int.MaxValue;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue[] arguments = GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount, skipEmptyValues: true);
			Array.Reverse(arguments);
			UltraCalcFunctionComplex.ComplexNumber complexNumber = null;
			string text = null;
			ExcelCalcValue[] array = arguments;
			foreach (ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue in array)
			{
				if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
				}
				UltraCalcFunctionComplex.ComplexNumber complexNumber2 = new UltraCalcFunctionComplex.ComplexNumber(numberStack.Culture, excelCalcValue.ToString());
				if (!complexNumber2.IsValid)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = complexNumber2.Suffix;
				}
				else if (complexNumber2.Suffix != text)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				if (complexNumber == null)
				{
					complexNumber = complexNumber2;
				}
				else
				{
					complexNumber *= complexNumber2;
				}
			}
			if (!complexNumber.IsValid)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(complexNumber.ToString());
		}

		public override bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionImSum : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "imsum";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => int.MaxValue;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue[] arguments = GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount, skipEmptyValues: true);
			Array.Reverse(arguments);
			UltraCalcFunctionComplex.ComplexNumber complexNumber = null;
			string text = null;
			ExcelCalcValue[] array = arguments;
			foreach (ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue in array)
			{
				if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
				}
				UltraCalcFunctionComplex.ComplexNumber complexNumber2 = new UltraCalcFunctionComplex.ComplexNumber(numberStack.Culture, excelCalcValue.ToString());
				if (!complexNumber2.IsValid)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = complexNumber2.Suffix;
				}
				else if (complexNumber2.Suffix != text)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
				}
				if (complexNumber == null)
				{
					complexNumber = complexNumber2;
				}
				else
				{
					complexNumber += complexNumber2;
				}
			}
			if (!complexNumber.IsValid)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(complexNumber.ToString());
		}

		public override bool CanParameterBeEnumerable(int parameterIndex)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionDollarFr : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "dollarfr";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			decimal num = excelCalcValue.ToDecimal();
			if (num < 0m)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			int num2 = (int)num;
			if (num2 == 0)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div));
			}
			excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			double num3 = excelCalcValue.ToDouble();
			double num4 = MathUtilities.Truncate(num3);
			double num5 = num3 - num4;
			num5 *= (double)num2;
			double num6 = CalculateBase(num2);
			num5 /= num6;
			num3 = num4 + num5;
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num3);
		}

		internal static double CalculateBase(int denominator)
		{
			double a = Math.Log10(denominator);
			double y = Math.Round(a);
			double num = Math.Pow(10.0, y);
			if (num < (double)denominator)
			{
				num *= 10.0;
			}
			return Math.Round(num, 0);
		}
	}

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionInfo : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "info";

		public override int MinArgs => 1;

		public override int MaxArgs => 1;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)

				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			return excelCalcValue.ToString() switch
			{
				"directory" => new ExcelCalcValue(Environment.CurrentDirectory), 
				"osversion" => new ExcelCalcValue(Environment.OSVersion.VersionString),

				_ => new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.NA)), 
			};

	internal class UltraCalcFunctionCombin : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		public override string Name => "combin";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			decimal num = excelCalcValue.ToDecimal();
			excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			decimal num2 = excelCalcValue.ToDecimal();
			int num3 = (int)num;
			int num4 = (int)num2;
			if (num2 < 0m || num < 0m || num4 < num3)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			double num5 = UltraCalcFunctionFact.Factorial(num4);
			double num6 = UltraCalcFunctionFact.Factorial(num3);
			int number = num4 - num3;
			double num7 = UltraCalcFunctionFact.Factorial(number);
			double num8 = num5 / (num6 * num7);
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num8);
		}
	}
	internal class UltraCalcFunctionRandBetween : BuiltInFunctionBase
	{
		private Random random = new Random();

		public override string Name => "randbetween";

		public override int MinArgs => 2;

		public override int MaxArgs => 2;

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			int num = excelCalcValue.ToInt();
			excelCalcValue = numberStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue());
			}
			int num2 = excelCalcValue.ToInt();
			if (num < num2)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num));
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(random.Next(num2, num + 1));
		}
	}

		public override string Name => "iferror";

		{
			ExcelCalcValue result = numberStack.Pop();

			object resolvedValue = excelCalcValue.GetResolvedValue();

				return result;

			return new ExcelCalcValue(resolvedValue);
		}

		protected override ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(ExcelCalcNumberStack numberStack, int argumentCount)

			ExcelCalcValue[] arguments = GetArguments(numberStack, argumentCount, skipEmptyValues: true);

		internal static ExcelCalcValue EvaluateHelper(IList<ExcelCalcValue> args)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ExcelCalcValue arg in args)
			{
				if (!arg.IsNull)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(num);
		}

		public bool Add(ExcelCalcFunction function)
		{
			if (function == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			string functionName = GetFunctionName(function);
			if (functionName.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			functions[functionName] = function;
			return true;
		}

		public bool AddLibrary(Assembly assembly)
		{
			if (assembly == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type[] types = assembly.GetTypes();
			foreach (Type type in types)
			{
				if (type.IsSubclassOf(typeof(ExcelCalcFunction)) && !type.IsAbstract)
				{
					object obj = assembly.CreateInstance(type.FullName);
					if (obj is ExcelCalcFunction function)
					{
						Add(function);
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string GetFunctionName(ExcelCalcFunction function)
		{
			string name = function.Name;
			if (name == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return name.ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		private void ValidateOperatorList()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < operators.Length; i++)
			{
			}
		}

		public ExcelCalcFunction GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction operatorType)
		{
			return operators[(int)operatorType];
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, ExcelCalcFunction> item in functions)
			{
				KeyValuePair<string, ExcelCalcFunction> keyValuePair = item;
				yield return keyValuePair.Value;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ObjectPool<T> where T : class
	{
		private const int MaxSize = 1024;

		private T[] _availableItems = new T[1024];

		private Func<T> _factoryMethod;

		private int _freeIndex;

		public ObjectPool(Func<T> factoryMethod)
		{
			_factoryMethod = factoryMethod;
		}

		public T GetItem()
		{
			if (_freeIndex == 0)
			{
				return _factoryMethod();
			}
			return _availableItems[--_freeIndex];
		}

		public void OnItemReleased(T item)
		{
			if (_freeIndex != 1024)
			{
				_availableItems[_freeIndex++] = item;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ObjectPool<T, TArg> where T : class
	{
		private const int MaxSize = 1024;

		private T[] _availableItems = new T[1024];

		private Func<TArg, T> _factoryMethod;

		private Action<T, TArg> _reInitializeMethod;

		private int _freeIndex;

		public ObjectPool(Func<TArg, T> factoryMethod, Action<T, TArg> reInitializeMethod)
		{
			_factoryMethod = factoryMethod;
			_reInitializeMethod = reInitializeMethod;
		}

		public T GetItem(TArg argument)
		{
			if (_freeIndex == 0)
			{
				return _factoryMethod(argument);
			}
			T val = _availableItems[--_freeIndex];
			_reInitializeMethod(val, argument);
			return val;
		}

		public void OnItemReleased(T item)
		{
			if (_freeIndex != 1024)
			{
				_availableItems[_freeIndex++] = item;
			}
		}
	}

		{
			return calendar.Eras.Length;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel
{
	internal static class MathUtilities
	{
		private static readonly string NonScientificFormatCode = "0." + new string('#', 324);

		private static double[] powersOf10 = new double[16]
		{
			1.0, 10.0, 100.0, 1000.0, 10000.0, 100000.0, 1000000.0, 10000000.0, 100000000.0, 1000000000.0,
			10000000000.0, 100000000000.0, 1000000000000.0, 10000000000000.0, 100000000000000.0, 1000000000000000.0
		};

		public static CultureInfo CurrentCulture => Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture;

		public static string DecimalToStringNonScientific(decimal value, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value.ToString(culture);
		}

		public static string DoubleToStringNonScientific(double value, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value.ToString(NonScientificFormatCode, culture);
		}

		public static bool DecimalTryParse(string text, IFormatProvider provider, out decimal value)
		{
			if (!decimal.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float | NumberStyles.AllowParentheses | NumberStyles.AllowThousands | NumberStyles.AllowCurrencySymbol, provider, out value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return EnforceExcelGroupingRules(text, provider, ref value);
		}

		public static bool DoubleTryParse(string text, IFormatProvider provider, out double value)
		{
			if (DoubleTryParseFast(text, out value))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float | NumberStyles.AllowParentheses | NumberStyles.AllowThousands | NumberStyles.AllowCurrencySymbol, provider, out value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return EnforceExcelGroupingRules(text, provider, ref value);
		}

		private static bool DoubleTryParseFast(string text, out double value)
		{
			value = 0.0;
			int length = text.Length;
			if (length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c < '0' || '9' < c)
				{
					return false;
				}
				value *= 10.0;
				value += c - 48;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool EnforceExcelGroupingRules<T>(string text, IFormatProvider provider, ref T value)
		{
			text = text.Trim();
			CompareInfo compareInfo = ((!(provider is CultureInfo cultureInfo)) ? CurrentCulture.CompareInfo : cultureInfo.CompareInfo);
			NumberFormatInfo numberFormatInfo = ((NumberFormatInfo)provider.GetFormat(typeof(NumberFormatInfo))) ?? CurrentCulture.NumberFormat;
			string text2 = text;
			int num = compareInfo.IndexOf(text, numberFormatInfo.NumberDecimalSeparator, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase);
			if (0 <= num)
			{
				text2 = text.Substring(0, num);
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = compareInfo.IndexOf(text, "E", CompareOptions.IgnoreCase);
				if (0 <= num2)
				{
					text2 = text.Substring(0, num2);
				}
			}
			for (int num3 = text2.Length - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (compareInfo.Compare(text2, num3, numberFormatInfo.NumberGroupSeparator.Length, numberFormatInfo.NumberGroupSeparator, 0, numberFormatInfo.NumberGroupSeparator.Length, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					char c = text2[num3];
					if (char.IsDigit(c))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					text2 = text2.Substring(0, num3 + 1);
					break;
				}
			}
			string[] array = text2.Split(new string[1] { numberFormatInfo.NumberGroupSeparator }, StringSplitOptions.None);
			int num4 = numberFormatInfo.NumberGroupSizes[0];
			for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i].Length < num4)
				{
					value = default(T);
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static int FloorOfLog10(double value)
		{
			return (int)Math.Floor(Math.Log10(value));
		}

		public static float MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(float value)
		{
			return (float)MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value, 0);
		}

		public static double MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(double value)
		{
			return MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value, 0);
		}

		public static double MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(double value, int digits)
		{
			return MidpointRoundingAwayFromZeroHelper(value, digits, shouldRoundShiftedValue: true);
		}

		private static double MidpointRoundingAwayFromZeroHelper(double value, int digits, bool shouldRoundShiftedValue)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			double num = ((digits >= 0 && digits <= 15) ? powersOf10[digits] : Math.Pow(10.0, digits));
			Math.Sign(value);
			double num2 = value * num;
			if (shouldRoundShiftedValue)
			{
				num2 = RoundToExcelDisplayValue(num2);
			}
			double value2 = num2 % 1.0;
			num2 = Truncate(num2);
			if (Math.Abs(value2) >= 0.5)
			{
				num2 += (double)Math.Sign(value2);
			}
			return num2 / num;
		}

		public static double RoundToExcelDisplayValue(double value)
		{
			if (value == 0.0)
			{
				return value;
			}
			int num = 14 - FloorOfLog10(Math.Abs(value));
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return MidpointRoundingAwayFromZeroHelper(value, num, shouldRoundShiftedValue: false);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static double Truncate(double value)
		{
			return Math.Truncate(value);
		}
	}
}

	internal interface IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue

	[DebuggerDisplay("ArrayFormula: \\{{ToString(),nq}\\}")]
	public class ArrayFormula : Formula, IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue
	{
		private WorksheetRegion cachedRegionWhileShifting;

		private WorksheetRegion cellRange;

		private Formula interiorCellFormula;

		internal override bool IsOwnedByAllCellsAppliedTo => false;

		WorksheetRegion IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue.BlockedRegion => cellRange;

		public WorksheetRegion CellRange => cellRange;

		internal Formula InteriorCellFormula
		{
			get
			{
				if (cellRange != null && interiorCellFormula == null)
				{
					interiorCellFormula = new Formula(this);
				}
				return interiorCellFormula;
			}
		}

		internal ArrayFormula(byte creationCellReferenceModeEncoded)
			: base(creationCellReferenceModeEncoded, FormulaType.ArrayFormula)
		{
		}

		internal ArrayFormula(ArrayFormula arrayFormula)
			: base((Formula)arrayFormula)
		{
		}

		internal override void ApplyTo(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			ApplyTo(new WorksheetRegion(row.Worksheet, row.Index, columnIndex, row.Index, columnIndex));
		}

		internal override void ApplyTo(WorksheetRegion[] regions, WorksheetRow anchorRow, short anchorColumnIndex)
		{
			if (regions == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("regions");
			}
			if (regions.Length != 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_ArrayFormulaMustHaveSingleRegion"), "regions");
			}
			if (cellRange != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ArrayFormulaAlreadyApplied"));
			}
			WorksheetRegion region = regions[0];
			ApplyToRegionHelper(region);
		}

		internal override void ApplyToCell(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, WorksheetCellBlock cellBlock)
		{
			ApplyToRegionHelper(row.Worksheet.GetCachedRegion(row.Index, columnIndex, row.Index, columnIndex));
		}

		internal override Formula Clone()
		{
			return new ArrayFormula(this);
		}

		internal override void VerifyNewOwner(WorksheetRow ownerRow, short ownerColumnIndex)
		{
		}

		void IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue.RemoveFromRegion()
		{
			ClearCellRange();
		}

		void IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue.ThrowBlockingException()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantChangeArrayFormula"));
		}

		void IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue.ThrowExceptionWhenMergedCellsInRegion()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ArrayFormulaInMergedCell"));
		}

		void IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue.ThrowExceptionWhenTableInRegion()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ArrayFormulaAppliedInTable"));
		}

		public void ClearCellRange()
		{
			if (cellRange != null)
			{
				WorksheetCellBlock.ClearBlockingValue(this);
				cellRange = null;
				interiorCellFormula = null;
			}
		}

		internal static ArrayFormula Parse(string value, Workbook workbook)
		{
			Workbook.GetWorkbookOptions(workbook, out var cellReferenceMode, out var currentFormat, out var culture);
			return Parse(value, cellReferenceMode, currentFormat, culture);
		}

		public new static ArrayFormula Parse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			return Parse(value, cellReferenceMode, Utilities.CurrentCulture);
		}

		public new static ArrayFormula Parse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return Parse(value, cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat.Excel2007, culture);
		}

		public new static ArrayFormula Parse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat fileFormat)
		{
			return Parse(value, cellReferenceMode, fileFormat, Utilities.CurrentCulture);
		}

		public new static ArrayFormula Parse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat fileFormat, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (TryParse(value, cellReferenceMode, fileFormat, culture, out var formula, out var exception))
			{
				return formula;
			}
			throw exception;
		}

		public static bool TryParse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, out ArrayFormula formula)
		{
			return TryParse(value, cellReferenceMode, Utilities.CurrentCulture, out formula);
		}

		public static bool TryParse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture, out ArrayFormula formula)
		{
			return TryParse(value, cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat.Excel2007, culture, out formula);
		}

		public static bool TryParse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, out ArrayFormula formula, out FormulaParseException exception)
		{
			return TryParse(value, cellReferenceMode, Utilities.CurrentCulture, out formula, out exception);
		}

		public static bool TryParse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture, out ArrayFormula formula, out FormulaParseException exception)
		{
			return TryParse(value, cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat.Excel2007, culture, out formula, out exception);
		}

		public static bool TryParse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat fileFormat, out ArrayFormula formula)
		{
			return TryParse(value, cellReferenceMode, fileFormat, Utilities.CurrentCulture, out formula);
		}

		public static bool TryParse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat fileFormat, CultureInfo culture, out ArrayFormula formula)
		{
			FormulaParseException exception;
			return TryParse(value, cellReferenceMode, fileFormat, culture, out formula, out exception);
		}

		public static bool TryParse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat fileFormat, out ArrayFormula formula, out FormulaParseException exception)
		{
			return TryParse(value, cellReferenceMode, fileFormat, Utilities.CurrentCulture, out formula, out exception);
		}

		public static bool TryParse(string value, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat fileFormat, CultureInfo culture, out ArrayFormula formula, out FormulaParseException exception)
		{
			Formula formula2;
			bool result = Formula.TryParse(value, cellReferenceMode, FormulaType.ArrayFormula, fileFormat, culture, null, out formula2, out exception);
			ArrayFormula arrayFormula = formula2 as ArrayFormula;
			formula = arrayFormula;
			return result;
		}

		internal void OnAfterShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride)
		{
			if (cachedRegionWhileShifting != null)
			{
				ApplyTo(cachedRegionWhileShifting);
				cachedRegionWhileShifting = null;
			}
		}

		internal bool OnBeforeShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, WorksheetRegionAddress? deletedRegionAddress)
		{
			if (cellRange == null || cellRange.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (deletedRegionAddress.HasValue && cellRange.FirstColumn >= deletedRegionAddress.Value.FirstColumnIndex && cellRange.FirstRow >= deletedRegionAddress.Value.FirstRowIndex && cellRange.LastColumn <= deletedRegionAddress.Value.LastColumnIndex && cellRange.LastRow <= deletedRegionAddress.Value.LastRowIndex)
			{
				ClearCellRange();
				return true;
			}
			if (cellRange != null && cellRange.Worksheet != null)
			{
				cachedRegionWhileShifting = cellRange;
				ClearCellRange();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ApplyToRegionHelper(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			if (region.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionsShiftedOffWorksheet"), "regions");
			}
			WorksheetCellBlock.VerifyRegionForBlockingValue(this, region, region);
			region.Worksheet.VerifyFormula(this, region.TopRow, region.FirstColumnInternal);
			cellRange = region;
			SetOwningCell(region.TopRow, region.FirstColumnInternal);
			WorksheetCellBlock.ApplyBlockingValue(this);
		}
	}

			{
				colorInfo = new WorkbookColorInfo(Utilities.ColorFromArgb(Utilities.ColorToArgb(colorInfo.Color.Value)), colorInfo.ThemeColorType, colorInfo.Tint, isLoading: false, preventUsingAutomaticColor: true);
			}
		}

	public sealed class CellFillPattern : CellFill
	{
		private readonly WorkbookColorInfo _backgroundColorInfo;

		private readonly WorkbookColorInfo _patternColorInfo;

		private readonly FillPatternStyle _patternStyle;

		public WorkbookColorInfo BackgroundColorInfo => _backgroundColorInfo;

		public FillPatternStyle PatternStyle => _patternStyle;

		public WorkbookColorInfo PatternColorInfo => _patternColorInfo;

		public CellFillPattern(WorkbookColorInfo backgroundColorInfo, WorkbookColorInfo patternColorInfo, FillPatternStyle patternStyle)
			: this(backgroundColorInfo, patternColorInfo, patternStyle, null)
		{
		}

		internal CellFillPattern(WorkbookColorInfo backgroundColorInfo, WorkbookColorInfo patternColorInfo, FillPatternStyle patternStyle, WorksheetCellFormatData owningFormat)
			: this(backgroundColorInfo, patternColorInfo, patternStyle, owningFormat, isCreatedInternally: false)
		{
		}

		internal CellFillPattern(WorkbookColorInfo backgroundColorInfo, WorkbookColorInfo patternColorInfo, FillPatternStyle patternStyle, WorksheetCellFormatData owningFormat, bool isCreatedInternally)
			: this(backgroundColorInfo, patternColorInfo, patternStyle, owningFormat?.DoesReverseColorsForSolidFill ?? false, isCreatedInternally)
		{
		}

		internal CellFillPattern(WorkbookColorInfo backgroundColorInfo, WorkbookColorInfo patternColorInfo, FillPatternStyle patternStyle, bool doesReverseColorsForSolidFill, bool isCreatedInternally)
		{
			if (patternStyle == FillPatternStyle.Solid && doesReverseColorsForSolidFill)
			{
				Utilities.SwapValues(ref backgroundColorInfo, ref patternColorInfo);
			}
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(patternStyle, "patternStyle");
			if (patternStyle.IsDefaultStyle())
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidEnumArgumentException_DefaultPatternCannotBeUsed"));
			}
			if (backgroundColorInfo == null)
			{
				backgroundColorInfo = new WorkbookColorInfo(SystemColorsInternal.WindowColor);
			}
			if (!isCreatedInternally)
			{
				CellFill.CorrectBackgroundColor(ref backgroundColorInfo);
			}
			if (patternColorInfo == null)
			{
				patternColorInfo = WorkbookColorInfo.Automatic;
			}
			_backgroundColorInfo = backgroundColorInfo;
			_patternStyle = patternStyle;
			_patternColorInfo = patternColorInfo;
		}

		internal CellFillPattern(int backgroundColorIndex, int foregroundColorIndex, FillPatternStyle patternStyle, WorksheetCellFormatData owningFormat)
			: this(new WorkbookColorInfo(owningFormat.Workbook, backgroundColorIndex), new WorkbookColorInfo(owningFormat.Workbook, foregroundColorIndex), patternStyle, owningFormat, isCreatedInternally: true)
		{
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is CellFillPattern cellFillPattern))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_patternStyle != cellFillPattern._patternStyle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_backgroundColorInfo != cellFillPattern._backgroundColorInfo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_patternColorInfo != cellFillPattern._patternColorInfo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int hashCode = _backgroundColorInfo.GetHashCode();
			hashCode ^= _patternColorInfo.GetHashCode();
			return hashCode ^ (int)_patternStyle;
		}

		internal override void PopulateXFEXTProps(WorksheetCellFormatData format, List<ExtProp> xfextProps)
		{
			WorkbookColorInfo fileFormatBackgroundColorInfo = GetFileFormatBackgroundColorInfo(format);
			WorkbookColorInfo fileFormatForegroundColorInfo = GetFileFormatForegroundColorInfo(format);
			switch (PatternStyle)
			{
			case FillPatternStyle.Solid:
				xfextProps.Add(new ExtPropColor(fileFormatForegroundColorInfo, ExtPropType.ForegroundColor));
				format.TryAddXFEXTColorInfo(fileFormatBackgroundColorInfo, ExtPropType.BackgroundColor, xfextProps);
				break;
			default:
				xfextProps.Add(new ExtPropColor(fileFormatBackgroundColorInfo, ExtPropType.BackgroundColor));
				format.TryAddXFEXTColorInfo(fileFormatForegroundColorInfo, ExtPropType.ForegroundColor, xfextProps);
				break;
			case FillPatternStyle.None:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal override void PopulateXFProps(WorksheetCellFormatData format, List<XFProp> xfextProps)
		{
			xfextProps.Add(new XFPropFillPattern(PatternStyle));
			if (format.Type == WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat)
			{
				xfextProps.Add(new XFPropColor(XFPropType.ForegroundColor, GetFileFormatForegroundColorInfo(format)));
				xfextProps.Add(new XFPropColor(XFPropType.BackgroundColor, GetFileFormatBackgroundColorInfo(format)));
				return;
			}
			WorkbookColorInfo fileFormatBackgroundColorInfo = GetFileFormatBackgroundColorInfo(format);
			WorkbookColorInfo fileFormatForegroundColorInfo = GetFileFormatForegroundColorInfo(format);
			switch (PatternStyle)
			{
			case FillPatternStyle.Solid:
				xfextProps.Add(new XFPropColor(XFPropType.ForegroundColor, fileFormatForegroundColorInfo));
				format.TryAddXFPropColorInfo(fileFormatBackgroundColorInfo, XFPropType.BackgroundColor, xfextProps);
				break;
			default:
				xfextProps.Add(new XFPropColor(XFPropType.BackgroundColor, fileFormatBackgroundColorInfo));
				format.TryAddXFPropColorInfo(fileFormatForegroundColorInfo, XFPropType.ForegroundColor, xfextProps);
				break;
			case FillPatternStyle.None:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal override CellFill ToResolvedColorFill(Workbook workbook)
		{
			if (_backgroundColorInfo.IsResolved && _patternColorInfo.IsResolved)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new CellFillPattern(_backgroundColorInfo.ToResolved(workbook), _patternColorInfo.ToResolved(workbook), _patternStyle, null, isCreatedInternally: true);
		}

		internal WorkbookColorInfo GetFileFormatBackgroundColorInfo(WorksheetCellFormatData owningFormat)
		{
			return GetFileFormatBackgroundColorInfo(owningFormat.DoesReverseColorsForSolidFill);
		}

		internal WorkbookColorInfo GetFileFormatBackgroundColorInfo(bool doesReverseColorsForSolidFill)
		{
			if (doesReverseColorsForSolidFill && _patternStyle == FillPatternStyle.Solid)
			{
				return _patternColorInfo;
			}
			return _backgroundColorInfo;
		}

		internal WorkbookColorInfo GetFileFormatForegroundColorInfo(WorksheetCellFormatData owningFormat)
		{
			return GetFileFormatForegroundColorInfo(owningFormat.DoesReverseColorsForSolidFill);
		}

		internal WorkbookColorInfo GetFileFormatForegroundColorInfo(bool doesReverseColorsForSolidFill)
		{
			if (doesReverseColorsForSolidFill && _patternStyle == FillPatternStyle.Solid)
			{
				return _backgroundColorInfo;
			}
			return _patternColorInfo;
		}
	}
	public abstract class CellFillGradient : CellFill
	{
		private readonly ReadOnlyCollection<CellFillGradientStop> _stops;

		public IList<CellFillGradientStop> Stops => _stops;

		internal CellFillGradient(CellFillGradientStop[] stops)
		{
			if (stops == null || stops.Length < 2)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_LessThanTwoGradientStops"), "stops");
			}
			_stops = new ReadOnlyCollection<CellFillGradientStop>(stops);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is CellFillGradient cellFillGradient))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_stops.Count != cellFillGradient._stops.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _stops.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!_stops[i].Equals(cellFillGradient._stops[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _stops.Count ^ _stops[0].GetHashCode() ^ _stops[_stops.Count - 1].GetHashCode();
		}

		internal override void PopulateXFEXTProps(WorksheetCellFormatData format, List<ExtProp> xfextProps)
		{
			xfextProps.Add(new ExtPropGradientFill(this));
		}

		internal CellFillGradientStop[] GetResolvedStops(Workbook workbook, out bool allStopsResolved)
		{
			CellFillGradientStop[] array = new CellFillGradientStop[Stops.Count];
			allStopsResolved = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < Stops.Count; i++)
			{
				CellFillGradientStop cellFillGradientStop = Stops[i];
				array[i] = cellFillGradientStop.ToResolvedColorStop(workbook);
				allStopsResolved &= cellFillGradientStop.ColorInfo.IsResolved;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal void PopulateStopXFProps(List<XFProp> xfextProps)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Stops.Count; i++)
			{
				CellFillGradientStop cellFillGradientStop = Stops[i];
				xfextProps.Add(new XFPropGradientStop(cellFillGradientStop.ColorInfo, cellFillGradientStop.Offset));
			}
		}
	}
