	public sealed class CellFillRectangularGradient : CellFillGradient
	{
		private readonly double _bottom;

		private readonly double _left;

		private readonly double _right;

		private readonly double _top;

		public double Bottom => _bottom;

		public double Left => _left;

		public double Right => _right;

		public double Top => _top;

		public CellFillRectangularGradient(double left, double top, double right, double bottom, params CellFillGradientStop[] stops)
			: base(stops)
		{
			ValidateInnerRectangleValue(left, "left");
			ValidateInnerRectangleValue(top, "top");
			ValidateInnerRectangleValue(right, "right");
			ValidateInnerRectangleValue(bottom, "bottom");
			_bottom = bottom;
			_left = left;
			_right = right;
			_top = top;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is CellFillRectangularGradient cellFillRectangularGradient))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_bottom != cellFillRectangularGradient._bottom)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_left != cellFillRectangularGradient._left)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_right != cellFillRectangularGradient._right)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_top != cellFillRectangularGradient._top)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!base.Equals((object)cellFillRectangularGradient))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _bottom.GetHashCode() ^ _left.GetHashCode() ^ _right.GetHashCode() ^ _top.GetHashCode() ^ base.GetHashCode();
		}

		internal override void PopulateXFProps(WorksheetCellFormatData format, List<XFProp> xfextProps)
		{
			xfextProps.Add(new XFPropGradientFill(isRectangular: true, 0.0, Left, Right, Top, Bottom));
			PopulateStopXFProps(xfextProps);
		}

		internal override CellFill ToResolvedColorFill(Workbook workbook)
		{
			bool allStopsResolved;
			CellFillGradientStop[] resolvedStops = GetResolvedStops(workbook, out allStopsResolved);
			if (allStopsResolved)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new CellFillRectangularGradient(_left, _top, _right, _bottom, resolvedStops);
		}

		private static void ValidateInnerRectangleValue(double value, string paramName)
		{
			if (value < 0.0 || 1.0 < value)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException(paramName, value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_InvalidRelativeRectangleValueForGradient"));
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class CellFillGradientStop
	{
		private readonly WorkbookColorInfo _colorInfo;

		private readonly double _offset;

		public WorkbookColorInfo ColorInfo => _colorInfo;

		public double Offset => _offset;

		public CellFillGradientStop(Color color, double offset)
			: this(new WorkbookColorInfo(color), offset)
		{
		}

		public CellFillGradientStop(WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo, double offset)
		{
			if (colorInfo.IsSystemColor)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidGradientStopColor"), "colorInfo");
			}
			if (offset < 0.0 || 1.0 < offset)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset", offset, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_InvalidGradientStopOffset"));
			}
			CellFill.CorrectBackgroundColor(ref colorInfo);
			_colorInfo = colorInfo;
			_offset = offset;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is CellFillGradientStop cellFillGradientStop))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_offset != cellFillGradientStop._offset)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_colorInfo != cellFillGradientStop._colorInfo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _colorInfo.GetHashCode() ^ _offset.GetHashCode();
		}

		internal CellFillGradientStop ToResolvedColorStop(Workbook workbook)
		{
			if (_colorInfo.IsResolved)
			{

		}
	}
	public sealed class WorkbookColorInfo
	{
		private enum ColorInfoState : byte
		{
			IsAutomatic = 1,
			IsRGB = 2,
			IsThemeColor = 4,
			IsTintValid = 8
		}

		private static readonly WorkbookColorInfo _automatic = new WorkbookColorInfo();

		private readonly Color _color;

		private readonly ColorInfoState _state;

		private readonly byte _themeColorType;

		private readonly double _tint;

		public static WorkbookColorInfo Automatic => _automatic;

		public Color? Color
		{
			get
			{
				if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsAutomatic))
				{
					return SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColor;
				}
				if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsRGB))
				{
					return _color.ToNative();
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public bool IsAutomatic => TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsAutomatic);

		public WorkbookThemeColorType? ThemeColorType
		{
			get
			{
				if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsThemeColor))
				{
					return (WorkbookThemeColorType)_themeColorType;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public double? Tint
		{
			get
			{
				if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsTintValid))
				{
					return _tint;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsResolved => _state == ColorInfoState.IsRGB;

		internal bool IsSystemColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsAutomatic)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsRGB))
				{
					return Utilities.ColorIsSystem(_color);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private WorkbookColorInfo()
		{
			_state = ColorInfoState.IsAutomatic;
		}

		public WorkbookColorInfo(Color color)
			: this(color, null, null, isLoading: false)
		{
		}

		public WorkbookColorInfo(Color color, double tint)
			: this(color, null, tint, isLoading: false)
		{
		}

		public WorkbookColorInfo(WorkbookThemeColorType themeColorType)
			: this(null, themeColorType, null, isLoading: false)
		{
		}

		public WorkbookColorInfo(WorkbookThemeColorType themeColorType, double tint)
			: this(null, themeColorType, tint, isLoading: false)
		{
		}

		internal WorkbookColorInfo(Color? color, WorkbookThemeColorType? themeColorType, double? tint, bool isLoading, bool preventUsingAutomaticColor = false)
		{
			if (!preventUsingAutomaticColor)
			{
				Color? color2 = color;
				Color windowTextColorStorage = SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColorStorage;
				if (color2.HasValue && color2.GetValueOrDefault() == windowTextColorStorage && !themeColorType.HasValue && !tint.HasValue)
				{
					_state = ColorInfoState.IsAutomatic;
					return;
				}
			}
			if (color.HasValue)
			{
				_state = ColorInfoState.IsRGB;
				_color = color.Value;
				ValidateColor(_color);
			}
			if (themeColorType.HasValue)
			{
				_state = ColorInfoState.IsThemeColor;
				ValidateThemeColor(themeColorType.Value);
				_themeColorType = (byte)themeColorType.Value;
			}
			if (tint.HasValue)
			{
				_state |= ColorInfoState.IsTintValid;
				_tint = tint.Value;
				ValidateTint(ref _tint, isLoading);
			}
		}

		internal WorkbookColorInfo(Workbook workbook, int index)
			: this(workbook.Palette.GetColorAtAbsoluteIndex(index))
		{
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			WorkbookColorInfo workbookColorInfo = obj as WorkbookColorInfo;
			if (workbookColorInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == workbookColorInfo;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num ^= (int)_state;
			num ^= _color.GetHashCode();
			num ^= _themeColorType;
			return num ^ _tint.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (IsAutomatic)
			{
				return Utilities.GetString("WorkbookColorInfo_Description", Utilities.GetString("WorkbookColorInfo_Automatic_Description"));
			}
			string text;
			if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsRGB))
			{
				text = _color.ToString();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsThemeColor))
				{
					return base.ToString();
				}
				text = ((WorkbookThemeColorType)_themeColorType).ToString();
			}
			if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsTintValid))
			{
				return Utilities.GetString("WorkbookColorInfo_WithTint_Description", text, _tint);
			}
			return Utilities.GetString("WorkbookColorInfo_Description", text);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(WorkbookColorInfo a, WorkbookColorInfo b)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(a, b))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((object)a == null || (object)b == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (a._state != b._state)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (a._themeColorType != b._themeColorType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (a._tint != b._tint)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!WorkbookColorPalette.AreEquivalent(a._color, b._color))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(WorkbookColorInfo a, WorkbookColorInfo b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public static implicit operator WorkbookColorInfo(Color color)
		{
			return new WorkbookColorInfo(color);
		}

		public static implicit operator WorkbookColorInfo(WorkbookThemeColorType themeColorType)
		{
			return new WorkbookColorInfo(themeColorType);
		}

		public Color GetResolvedColor()
		{
			return GetResolvedColor(null);
		}

		public Color GetResolvedColor(Workbook workbook)
		{
			return GetResolvedColorInternal(workbook).ToNative();
		}

		internal Color GetResolvedColorInternal(Workbook workbook, bool forceOpaque = true, bool useDefaultThemeColorsIfWorkbookNull = false)
		{
			if (IsAutomatic)
			{
				return SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColorStorage;
			}
			Color color;
			if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsRGB))
			{
				color = _color;
				if (forceOpaque && color.A != byte.MaxValue)
				{
					color = System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(255, _color.R, _color.G, _color.B);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsThemeColor))
				{
					return ColorsInternal.Empty;
				}
				if (workbook == null)
				{
					if (!useDefaultThemeColorsIfWorkbookNull)
					{
						throw new ArgumentNullException("workbook", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_WorkbookRequiredToResolveThemeColor"));
					}
					color = Workbook.CreateThemeColors()[_themeColorType];
				}
				else
				{
					color = workbook.ThemeColors[_themeColorType];
				}
			}
			if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsTintValid))
			{
				return Utilities.ApplyTint(color.ToNative(), _tint).ToStorage();
			}
			return color;
		}

		internal int GetIndex(Workbook workbook, ColorableItem item)
		{
			return workbook.Palette.FindIndex(this, item);
		}

		internal bool IsSupportedIn2003(Workbook workbook, ColorableItem item)
		{
			if (IsAutomatic)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsThemeColor) || TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsTintValid))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Color colorAtAbsoluteIndex = workbook.Palette.GetColorAtAbsoluteIndex(GetIndex(workbook, item));
			return WorkbookColorPalette.AreEquivalent(_color, colorAtAbsoluteIndex);
		}

		internal WorkbookColorInfo ToResolved(Workbook workbook, bool allowSystemColors = true)
		{
			if (IsResolved && (allowSystemColors || !IsSystemColor))
			{
				return this;
			}
			Color color = GetResolvedColor(workbook);
			if (!allowSystemColors && Utilities.ColorIsSystem(color))
			{
				color = Utilities.ColorFromArgb(Utilities.ColorToArgb(color));
			}
			return new WorkbookColorInfo(color, null, null, isLoading: false, preventUsingAutomaticColor: true);
		}

		private static bool TestFlag(ColorInfoState value, ColorInfoState flag)
		{
			return (value & flag) == flag;
		}

		private static void ValidateColor(Color color)
		{
			if (Utilities.ColorIsEmpty(color))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CannotCreateEmptyColorInfo"), "color");
			}
		}

		private static void ValidateThemeColor(WorkbookThemeColorType themeColor)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(themeColor, "themeColor");
		}

		private static void ValidateTint(ref double tint, bool isLoading)
		{
			if (tint < -1.0 || 1.0 < tint)
			{
				if (!isLoading)
				{
					throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("tint", tint, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_InvalidColorInfoTint"));
				}
				tint %= 2.0;
				if (tint < -1.0)
				{
					tint += 2.0;
				}
				else if (1.0 < tint)
				{
					tint -= 2.0;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class FormattingRunBase
	{
		private IFormattedRunOwner owner;

		private int firstFormattedCharInOwner;

		public abstract int FirstFormattedCharAbsolute { get; set; }

		public abstract bool HasFont { get; }

		public int FirstFormattedCharInOwner
		{
			get
			{
				return firstFormattedCharInOwner;
			}
			set
			{
				firstFormattedCharInOwner = value;
			}
		}

		public IFormattedRunOwner Owner => owner;

		public virtual string UnformattedString
		{
			get
			{
				List<FormattingRunBase> formattingRuns = Owner.GetFormattingRuns(null);
				int num = formattingRuns.IndexOf(this);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				object unformattedString = Owner.UnformattedString;
				if (unformattedString == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				string text = unformattedString.ToString();
				_ = text.Length;
				FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase = ((num < formattingRuns.Count - 1) ? formattingRuns[num + 1] : null);
				int num2 = firstFormattedCharInOwner;
				if (formattingRunBase != null)
				{
					return text.Substring(num2, formattingRunBase.firstFormattedCharInOwner - num2);
				}
				return text.Substring(num2);
			}
		}

		public FormattingRunBase(IFormattedRunOwner owner, int firstFormattedCharInOwner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			this.firstFormattedCharInOwner = firstFormattedCharInOwner;
		}

		public abstract IWorkbookFont GetFont(Workbook workbook);

		public abstract WorkbookFontProxy GetFontInternal(Workbook workbook);

		public FormattingRunBase Clone(Workbook workbook, IFormattedRunOwner newOwner)
		{
			FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase = newOwner.CreateRun(FirstFormattedCharAbsolute);
			formattingRunBase.InitializeFrom(this, workbook);
			return formattingRunBase;
		}

		public WorkbookFontProxy GetFontInternal()
		{
			return GetFontInternal(null);
		}

		public WorkbookFontProxy GetFontInternal(Workbook workbook, ref WorkbookFontProxy font)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				font = new WorkbookFontProxy(new WorkbookFontData(workbook), workbook);
			}
			return font;
		}

		public virtual void InitializeFrom(FormattingRunBase otherRun, Workbook workbook)
		{
			if (otherRun.HasFont)
			{
				IWorkbookFont font = GetFont(workbook);
				if (font is WorkbookFontProxy workbookFontProxy)
				{
					workbookFontProxy.SetFontFormattingInternal(otherRun.GetFont(workbook), raiseNotifocation: false);
				}
				else
				{
					font.SetFontFormatting(otherRun.GetFont(workbook));
				}
			}
		}
	}

		{
		}

	internal struct CellShiftOperation
	{
		private readonly WorksheetRegionAddress _regionAddressBeforeShift;

		private readonly bool _rowInstancesShift;

		private readonly int _shiftAmount;

		private readonly CellShiftType _shiftType;

		private readonly WorksheetTableResizeOperation _tableResizeOperation;

		private readonly Worksheet _worksheet;

		public WorksheetRegionAddress? DeletedRegionAddress
		{
			get
			{
				switch (_shiftType)
				{
				case CellShiftType.TableResizedWithoutShift:
				case CellShiftType.VerticalRotate:
					return null;
				case CellShiftType.HorizontalShift:
					if (_shiftAmount <= 0)
					{
						return new WorksheetRegionAddress(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex, (short)(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex + _shiftAmount), (short)(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex - 1));
					}
					return new WorksheetRegionAddress(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex, (short)(_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex + 1), (short)(_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex + _shiftAmount));
				case CellShiftType.VerticalShift:
					if (_shiftAmount <= 0)
					{
						return new WorksheetRegionAddress(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex + _shiftAmount, _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex - 1, _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex);
					}
					return new WorksheetRegionAddress(_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex + 1, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex + _shiftAmount, _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex);
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}
		}

		public WorksheetRegionAddress? InsertedRegionAddress
		{
			get

		public ShiftAddressResult ShiftCellAddress(ref int cellRowIndex, ref short cellColumnIndex)
		{
			switch (_shiftType)
			{
			case CellShiftType.TableResizedWithoutShift:
				return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
			case CellShiftType.VerticalRotate:
				if (!_regionAddressBeforeShift.Contains(cellRowIndex, cellColumnIndex))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (_shiftAmount <= 0)
				{
					int num = _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex - _shiftAmount - 1;
					if (cellRowIndex <= num)
					{
						int num2 = num - cellRowIndex;
						cellRowIndex = _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex - num2;
						return ShiftAddressResult.DidShiftResult;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int num3 = _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex - _shiftAmount + 1;
					if (num3 <= cellRowIndex)
					{
						int num4 = num3 - cellRowIndex;
						cellRowIndex = _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex + num4;
						return ShiftAddressResult.DidShiftResult;
					}
				}
				cellRowIndex += _shiftAmount;
				return ShiftAddressResult.DidShiftResult;
			case CellShiftType.HorizontalShift:
			{
				if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex > cellRowIndex || cellRowIndex > _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex)
				{
					break;
				}
				CellShiftDeleteReason deleteReason2 = CellShiftDeleteReason.NotDeleted;
				bool didShift2 = false;
				if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex <= cellColumnIndex && cellColumnIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex)
				{
					cellColumnIndex += (short)_shiftAmount;
					didShift2 = true;
					if (cellColumnIndex < 0)
					{
						deleteReason2 = CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetTop;
					}
					else if (_worksheet.Columns.MaxCount <= cellColumnIndex)
					{
						deleteReason2 = CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetBottom;
					}
				}
				else if (_shiftAmount <= 0)
				{
					if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex + _shiftAmount <= cellColumnIndex && cellColumnIndex < _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex)
					{
						didShift2 = true;
						deleteReason2 = ((cellColumnIndex + _shiftAmount >= 0) ? CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftUpCoveredAddress : CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetTop);
					}
				}
				else if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex < cellColumnIndex && cellColumnIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex + _shiftAmount)
				{
					didShift2 = true;
					deleteReason2 = ((_worksheet.Columns.MaxCount > cellColumnIndex + _shiftAmount) ? CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftDownCoveredAddress : CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetBottom);
				}
				return new ShiftAddressResult(didShift2, deleteReason2);
			}
			case CellShiftType.VerticalShift:
			{
				if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex > cellColumnIndex || cellColumnIndex > _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex)
				{
					break;
				}
				CellShiftDeleteReason deleteReason = CellShiftDeleteReason.NotDeleted;
				bool didShift = false;
				if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex <= cellRowIndex && cellRowIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex)
				{
					cellRowIndex += _shiftAmount;
					didShift = true;
					if (cellRowIndex < 0)
					{
						deleteReason = CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetTop;
					}
					else if (_worksheet.Rows.MaxCount <= cellRowIndex)
					{
						deleteReason = CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetBottom;
					}
				}
				else if (_shiftAmount <= 0)
				{
					if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex + _shiftAmount <= cellRowIndex && cellRowIndex < _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex)
					{
						didShift = true;
						deleteReason = ((cellRowIndex + _shiftAmount >= 0) ? CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftUpCoveredAddress : CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetTop);
					}
				}
				else if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex < cellRowIndex && cellRowIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex + _shiftAmount)
				{
					didShift = true;
					deleteReason = ((_worksheet.Rows.MaxCount > cellRowIndex + _shiftAmount) ? CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftDownCoveredAddress : CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetBottom);
				}
				return new ShiftAddressResult(didShift, deleteReason);
			}
			}
			return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
		}

		public ShiftAddressResult ShiftRegionAddress(ref WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride, bool leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet, bool allowSplitShift, out List<WorksheetRegionAddress> splitRegionAddresses)
		{
			splitRegionAddresses = null;
			switch (_shiftType)
			{
			case CellShiftType.TableResizedWithoutShift:
				if (!allowSplitShift && ShiftRegionAddressForTableResize(ref regionAddress))
				{
					return ShiftAddressResult.DidShiftResult;
				}
				return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
			case CellShiftType.VerticalRotate:
				if (!allowSplitShift && ShiftRegionAddressForTableResize(ref regionAddress))
				{
					return ShiftAddressResult.DidShiftResult;
				}
				if (!_regionAddressBeforeShift.IntersectsWith(regionAddress))
				{
					return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
				}
				break;
			case CellShiftType.HorizontalShift:
				if (_shiftAmount <= 0)
				{
					if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex < regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex)
					{
						return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
					}
				}
				else if (regionAddress.LastColumnIndex < _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex)
				{
					return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
				}
				break;
			case CellShiftType.VerticalShift:
				if (_shiftAmount <= 0)
				{
					if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex < regionAddress.FirstRowIndex)
					{
						return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
					}
				}
				else if (regionAddress.LastRowIndex < _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex)
				{
					return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (_shiftType == CellShiftType.HorizontalShift)
			{
				if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex <= regionAddress.FirstRowIndex && regionAddress.LastRowIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex)
				{
					CellShiftDeleteReason deleteReason = CellShiftDeleteReason.NotDeleted;
					bool didShift = false;
					if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex <= regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex && regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex)

						didShift = true;

						{
							regionAddress = regionAddress.WithLastColumnIndex((short)(_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex + _shiftAmount));
						}

						if (regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex < 0)
						{
							deleteReason = CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetTop;
						}
						else if (_worksheet.Columns.MaxCount <= regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex)
						{
							deleteReason = CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetBottom;
						}
					}
					else if (_shiftAmount > 0 && _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex < regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex && regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex + _shiftAmount)
					{
						didShift = true;
						regionAddress = regionAddress.WithFirstColumnIndex((short)(_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex + _shiftAmount + 1));
					}
					if (!leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet || _shiftAmount >= 0 || regionAddress.LastColumnIndex != _worksheet.Columns.MaxCount - 1)
					{
						if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex <= regionAddress.LastColumnIndex && regionAddress.LastColumnIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex)
						{
							didShift = true;
							if (_shiftAmount < 0 && regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex < _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex && _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex + _shiftAmount <= regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex)
							{
								regionAddress = regionAddress.WithFirstColumnIndex((short)(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex + _shiftAmount));
							}
							regionAddress = regionAddress.WithLastColumnIndex((short)(regionAddress.LastColumnIndex + _shiftAmount));
						}
						else if (_shiftAmount < 0 && _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex + _shiftAmount <= regionAddress.LastColumnIndex && regionAddress.LastColumnIndex < _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex)
						{
							didShift = true;
							regionAddress = regionAddress.WithLastColumnIndex((short)(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex + _shiftAmount - 1));
						}
					}
					if (regionAddress.LastColumnIndex < regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex)
					{
						deleteReason = ((_shiftAmount <= 0) ? ((regionAddress.LastColumnIndex >= 0) ? CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftUpCoveredAddress : CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetTop) : ((_worksheet.Columns.MaxCount > regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex) ? CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftDownCoveredAddress : CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetBottom));
					}
					return new ShiftAddressResult(didShift, deleteReason);
				}
				if (allowSplitShift && _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex <= regionAddress.LastRowIndex && regionAddress.FirstRowIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex)
				{
					WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress;
					WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress2;
					if (regionAddress.FirstRowIndex < _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex)

						regionAddress2 = new WorksheetRegionAddress(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex, regionAddress.LastRowIndex, regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, regionAddress.LastColumnIndex);
					}
					else
					{

						regionAddress2 = new WorksheetRegionAddress(regionAddress.FirstRowIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex, regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, regionAddress.LastColumnIndex);

					regionAddress = worksheetRegionAddress;
					if (!shiftAddressResult.IsDeleted)

						if (splitRegionAddresses == null)

							splitRegionAddresses = new List<WorksheetRegionAddress>();
						}
						splitRegionAddresses.Add(regionAddress2);
					}
					return ShiftAddressResult.DidShiftResult;
				}
			}
			else if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex <= regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex && regionAddress.LastColumnIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex)
			{
				switch (_shiftType)
				{
				case CellShiftType.VerticalRotate:
				{
					int cellRowIndex = regionAddress.FirstRowIndex;
					int cellRowIndex2 = regionAddress.LastRowIndex;

					ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult3 = ShiftCellAddress(ref cellRowIndex2, ref cellColumnIndex2);
					if (!shiftAddressResult2.DidShift && !shiftAddressResult3.DidShift)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (shiftAddressResult2.DidShift && shiftAddressResult3.DidShift)
					{

						{
							if (allowSplitShift)

								if (splitRegionAddresses == null)

								}
								WorksheetRegionAddress item = ((_shiftAmount <= 0) ? new WorksheetRegionAddress(cellRowIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex, cellColumnIndex, cellColumnIndex2) : new WorksheetRegionAddress(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex, cellRowIndex2, cellColumnIndex, cellColumnIndex2));
								splitRegionAddresses.Add(item);
							}
							if (_shiftAmount <= 0)
							{
								cellRowIndex = _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex;
							}
							else
							{
								cellRowIndex2 = _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex;
							}
						}
					}
					else if (allowSplitShift)
					{
						WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress2;
						WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress3;
						if (!shiftAddressResult2.DidShift)

							regionAddress3 = new WorksheetRegionAddress(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex, cellRowIndex2, cellColumnIndex, cellColumnIndex2);
						}
						else
						{
							worksheetRegionAddress2 = new WorksheetRegionAddress(_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex, cellRowIndex2, cellColumnIndex, cellColumnIndex2);
							regionAddress3 = new WorksheetRegionAddress(cellRowIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex, cellColumnIndex, cellColumnIndex2);
						}
						ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult4 = ShiftRegionAddress(ref regionAddress3, operationOverride, leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet, allowSplitShift, out splitRegionAddresses);
						regionAddress = worksheetRegionAddress2;
						if (!shiftAddressResult4.IsDeleted)
						{
							if (splitRegionAddresses == null)
							{
								splitRegionAddresses = new List<WorksheetRegionAddress>();
							}
							splitRegionAddresses.Add(regionAddress3);
						}
						return ShiftAddressResult.DidShiftResult;
					}
					regionAddress = new WorksheetRegionAddress(cellRowIndex, cellRowIndex2, cellColumnIndex, cellColumnIndex2);
					return ShiftAddressResult.DidShiftResult;
				}
				case CellShiftType.VerticalShift:
				{
					CellShiftDeleteReason deleteReason2 = CellShiftDeleteReason.NotDeleted;
					bool didShift2 = false;
					if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex <= regionAddress.FirstRowIndex && regionAddress.FirstRowIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex)
					{
						didShift2 = true;
						if (_shiftAmount > 0 && _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex < regionAddress.LastRowIndex && regionAddress.LastRowIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex + _shiftAmount)
						{
							regionAddress = regionAddress.WithLastRowIndex(_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex + _shiftAmount);
						}
						regionAddress = regionAddress.WithFirstRowIndex(regionAddress.FirstRowIndex + _shiftAmount);
						if (regionAddress.FirstRowIndex < 0)
						{
							deleteReason2 = CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetTop;
						}
						else if (_worksheet.Rows.MaxCount <= regionAddress.FirstRowIndex)
						{
							deleteReason2 = CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetBottom;
						}
					}
					else if (_shiftAmount > 0 && _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex < regionAddress.FirstRowIndex && regionAddress.FirstRowIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex + _shiftAmount)
					{
						didShift2 = true;
						regionAddress = regionAddress.WithFirstRowIndex(_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex + _shiftAmount + 1);
					}
					if (!leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet || _shiftAmount >= 0 || regionAddress.LastRowIndex != _worksheet.Rows.MaxCount - 1)
					{
						if (_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex <= regionAddress.LastRowIndex && regionAddress.LastRowIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex)
						{
							didShift2 = true;
							if (_shiftAmount < 0 && regionAddress.FirstRowIndex < _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex && _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex + _shiftAmount <= regionAddress.FirstRowIndex)
							{
								regionAddress = regionAddress.WithFirstRowIndex(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex + _shiftAmount);
							}
							regionAddress = regionAddress.WithLastRowIndex(regionAddress.LastRowIndex + _shiftAmount);
						}
						else if (_shiftAmount < 0 && _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex + _shiftAmount <= regionAddress.LastRowIndex && regionAddress.LastRowIndex < _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex)
						{
							didShift2 = true;
							regionAddress = regionAddress.WithLastRowIndex(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex + _shiftAmount - 1);
						}
					}
					if (regionAddress.LastRowIndex < regionAddress.FirstRowIndex)
					{
						deleteReason2 = ((_shiftAmount <= 0) ? ((regionAddress.LastRowIndex >= 0) ? CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftUpCoveredAddress : CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetTop) : ((_worksheet.Rows.MaxCount > regionAddress.FirstRowIndex) ? CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftDownCoveredAddress : CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetBottom));
					}
					return new ShiftAddressResult(didShift2, deleteReason2);
				}
				}
			}
			else if (allowSplitShift && _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex <= regionAddress.LastColumnIndex && regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex <= _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex)
			{
				WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress3;
				WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress4;
				if (regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex < _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex)
				{
					worksheetRegionAddress3 = new WorksheetRegionAddress(regionAddress.FirstRowIndex, regionAddress.LastRowIndex, regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, (short)(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex - 1));
					regionAddress4 = new WorksheetRegionAddress(regionAddress.FirstRowIndex, regionAddress.LastRowIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex, regionAddress.LastColumnIndex);
				}
				else
				{
					worksheetRegionAddress3 = new WorksheetRegionAddress(regionAddress.FirstRowIndex, regionAddress.LastRowIndex, (short)(_regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex + 1), regionAddress.LastColumnIndex);
					regionAddress4 = new WorksheetRegionAddress(regionAddress.FirstRowIndex, regionAddress.LastRowIndex, regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex);
				}
				ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult5 = ShiftRegionAddress(ref regionAddress4, operationOverride, leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet, allowSplitShift, out splitRegionAddresses);
				regionAddress = worksheetRegionAddress3;
				if (!shiftAddressResult5.IsDeleted)
				{
					if (splitRegionAddresses == null)
					{
						splitRegionAddresses = new List<WorksheetRegionAddress>();
					}
					splitRegionAddresses.Add(regionAddress4);
				}
				return ShiftAddressResult.DidShiftResult;
			}
			return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
		}

		private bool ShiftRegionAddressForTableResize(ref WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress)
		{
			if (_tableResizeOperation == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_tableResizeOperation.OldWholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex <= regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex && regionAddress.LastColumnIndex <= _tableResizeOperation.OldWholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex && (regionAddress.FirstRowIndex == _tableResizeOperation.OldDataAreaAddress.FirstRowIndex || regionAddress.FirstRowIndex == _tableResizeOperation.OldWholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex) && (regionAddress.LastRowIndex == _tableResizeOperation.OldDataAreaAddress.LastRowIndex || regionAddress.LastRowIndex == _tableResizeOperation.OldWholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex))
			{
				int num = _tableResizeOperation.NewWholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex - _tableResizeOperation.OldWholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex;
				regionAddress = new WorksheetRegionAddress(regionAddress.FirstRowIndex, regionAddress.LastRowIndex + num, regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, regionAddress.LastColumnIndex);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ProcessCellShift(ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride)
		{
			switch (_shiftType)
			{
			case CellShiftType.VerticalRotate:
			{
				Dictionary<int, Dictionary<short, Tuple<object, bool, IWorksheetCellFormat>>> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, Dictionary<short, Tuple<object, bool, IWorksheetCellFormat>>>();
				int num2;
				int num3;
				int startIndex;
				int endIndex;
				bool enumerateForwards2;
				if (_shiftAmount <= 0)
				{
					num2 = _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex - _shiftAmount;
					num3 = _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex;
					startIndex = _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex;
					endIndex = num2 - 1;
					enumerateForwards2 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex;
					num3 = _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex - _shiftAmount;
					startIndex = num3 + 1;
					endIndex = _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex;
					enumerateForwards2 = false;
				}
				foreach (WorksheetRow item in _worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(startIndex, endIndex))
				{
					int cellRowIndex = item.Index;
					short cellColumnIndex = _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex;
					ShiftCellAddress(ref cellRowIndex, ref cellColumnIndex);
					bool destinationRowHasFormat = _worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(cellRowIndex)?.HasCellFormat ?? false;
					Dictionary<short, Tuple<object, bool, IWorksheetCellFormat>> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<short, Tuple<object, bool, IWorksheetCellFormat>>();
					MoveRowOfWorksheetCellData(_worksheet, item, dictionary2, destinationRowHasFormat);
					dictionary[item.Index] = dictionary2;
				}
				WorksheetRow previouslyIteratedRow2 = null;
				foreach (WorksheetRow item2 in _worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(num2, num3, enumerateForwards2))
				{
					MoveRowOfWorksheetCellData(_worksheet, item2, previouslyIteratedRow2, item2.Index + _shiftAmount);
					previouslyIteratedRow2 = item2;
				}
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<int, Dictionary<short, Tuple<object, bool, IWorksheetCellFormat>>> item3 in dictionary)
					{
						int cellRowIndex2 = item3.Key;
						short cellColumnIndex2 = _regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex;
						Dictionary<short, Tuple<object, bool, IWorksheetCellFormat>> value = item3.Value;
						ShiftCellAddress(ref cellRowIndex2, ref cellColumnIndex2);
						MoveRowOfWorksheetCellData(_worksheet, value, cellRowIndex2);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			case CellShiftType.HorizontalShift:
			{
				if (operationOverride != null && operationOverride.PerformsShift && operationOverride.PerformShift(this))
				{
					break;
				}
				int num = RegionAddressAfterShift.FirstColumnIndex - RegionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex;
				bool flag = num < 0;
				{
					foreach (WorksheetRow item4 in _worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex))
					{
						IEnumerable<CellDataContext> enumerable = item4.GetCellsWithData(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastColumnIndex);
						if (!flag)
						{
							enumerable = enumerable.Reverse();
						}
						foreach (CellDataContext item5 in enumerable)
						{
							if (item5.CellBlock != null)
							{
								MoveWorksheetCellValue(item5.ColumnIndex, (short)(item5.ColumnIndex + num), item4, item5.CellBlock, item4, null, null);
							}
							MoveWorksheetCellFormat(item5.ColumnIndex, (short)(item5.ColumnIndex + num), item4, item4, null, null);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			case CellShiftType.VerticalShift:
			{
				if (operationOverride != null && operationOverride.PerformsShift && operationOverride.PerformShift(this))
				{
					break;
				}
				bool enumerateForwards = RegionAddressAfterShift.FirstRowIndex < RegionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex;
				WorksheetRow previouslyIteratedRow = null;
				{
					foreach (WorksheetRow item6 in _worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(_regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex, _regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex, enumerateForwards))
					{
						MoveRowOfWorksheetCellData(_worksheet, item6, previouslyIteratedRow, item6.Index + _shiftAmount);
						previouslyIteratedRow = item6;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			}
		}

		public bool VerifyShiftForNonSplittableItem<T>(ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride, List<T> itemsWithinShiftRegion, T item, WorksheetRegionAddress itemRegionAddress)
		{
			switch (_shiftType)
			{
			case CellShiftType.TableResizedWithoutShift:
				return VerifyTableResizeForNonSplittableItem(item, itemRegionAddress);
			case CellShiftType.HorizontalShift:
			{
				if (!VerifyTableResizeForNonSplittableItem(item, itemRegionAddress))
				{
					return false;
				}
				WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddressBeforeShift2 = RegionAddressBeforeShift;
				WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddressAfterShift2 = RegionAddressAfterShift;
				if (itemRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex < regionAddressBeforeShift2.FirstColumnIndex && itemRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex < regionAddressAfterShift2.FirstColumnIndex)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (regionAddressBeforeShift2.LastColumnIndex < itemRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex && regionAddressAfterShift2.LastColumnIndex < itemRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (regionAddressBeforeShift2.Contains(itemRegionAddress))
				{
					if (_shiftType == CellShiftType.VerticalRotate)
					{
						int num2 = ((_shiftAmount <= 0) ? (regionAddressBeforeShift2.FirstColumnIndex - _shiftAmount) : (regionAddressBeforeShift2.LastColumnIndex - _shiftAmount));
						bool flag3 = itemRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex < num2;
						bool flag4 = itemRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex < num2;
						if (flag3 != flag4)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					itemsWithinShiftRegion?.Add(item);
					return true;
				}
				if (operationOverride != null && operationOverride.ShiftsColumns && Utilities.DoesOperationIntersectWithRange(operationOverride, itemRegionAddress))
				{
					itemsWithinShiftRegion?.Add(item);
					return true;
				}
				if (regionAddressBeforeShift2.IntersectsWith(itemRegionAddress) || regionAddressAfterShift2.IntersectsWith(itemRegionAddress))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			case CellShiftType.VerticalRotate:
			case CellShiftType.VerticalShift:
			{
				if (!VerifyTableResizeForNonSplittableItem(item, itemRegionAddress))
				{
					return false;
				}
				WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddressBeforeShift = RegionAddressBeforeShift;
				WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddressAfterShift = RegionAddressAfterShift;
				if (itemRegionAddress.LastRowIndex < regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex && itemRegionAddress.LastRowIndex < regionAddressAfterShift.FirstRowIndex)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex < itemRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex && regionAddressAfterShift.LastRowIndex < itemRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (item is WorksheetTable worksheetTable && !worksheetTable.IsOperationValid(operationOverride))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (regionAddressBeforeShift.Contains(itemRegionAddress))
				{
					if (_shiftType == CellShiftType.VerticalRotate)
					{
						int num = ((_shiftAmount <= 0) ? (regionAddressBeforeShift.FirstRowIndex - _shiftAmount) : (regionAddressBeforeShift.LastRowIndex - _shiftAmount));
						bool flag = itemRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex < num;
						bool flag2 = itemRegionAddress.LastRowIndex < num;
						if (flag != flag2)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					itemsWithinShiftRegion?.Add(item);
					return true;
				}
				if (operationOverride != null && operationOverride.ShiftsRows && Utilities.DoesOperationIntersectWithRange(operationOverride, itemRegionAddress))
				{
					itemsWithinShiftRegion?.Add(item);
					return true;
				}
				if (regionAddressBeforeShift.IntersectsWith(itemRegionAddress) || regionAddressAfterShift.IntersectsWith(itemRegionAddress))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool VerifyTableResizeForNonSplittableItem<T>(T item, WorksheetRegionAddress itemRegionAddress)
		{
			if (_tableResizeOperation != null && _tableResizeOperation.NewWholeTableAddress.IntersectsWith(itemRegionAddress))
			{
				if (item is ArrayFormula && itemRegionAddress.IsSingleCell)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class ShiftAddressResult
	{
		public static readonly ShiftAddressResult NoShiftResult = new ShiftAddressResult(didShift: false);

		public static readonly ShiftAddressResult DidShiftResult = new ShiftAddressResult(didShift: true);

		private CellShiftDeleteReason _deleteReason;

		private bool _didShift;

		public CellShiftDeleteReason DeleteReason => _deleteReason;

		public bool DidShift => _didShift;

		public bool IsDeleted => _deleteReason != CellShiftDeleteReason.NotDeleted;

		private ShiftAddressResult(bool didShift)
			: this(didShift, CellShiftDeleteReason.NotDeleted)
		{
		}

		public ShiftAddressResult(bool didShift, CellShiftDeleteReason deleteReason)
		{
			_didShift = didShift;
			_deleteReason = deleteReason;
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("CustomView: {name}")]
	public class CustomView
	{
		private Workbook workbook;

		private Guid id;

		private bool savePrintOptions;

		private bool saveHiddenRowsAndColumns;

		private string name;

		private CustomViewWindowOptions windowOptions;

		private Dictionary<Worksheet, CustomViewDisplayOptions> worksheetDisplayOptions;

		private Dictionary<Worksheet, HiddenColumnCollection> worksheetHiddenColumns;

		private Dictionary<Worksheet, HiddenRowCollection> worksheetHiddenRows;

		private Dictionary<Worksheet, PrintOptions> worksheetPrintOptions;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(name != value))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("value", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_CustomViewName"));
				}
				if (workbook != null && workbook.HasCustomViews)
				{
					foreach (CustomView item in (IEnumerable<CustomView>)workbook.CustomViews)
					{
						if (item != this && StringUtilities.StringCompare(value, item.Name, workbook.CultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CustomViewNameAlreadyExists", item.Name), "value");
						}
					}
				}
				name = value;
			}
		}

		public bool SaveHiddenRowsAndColumns => saveHiddenRowsAndColumns;

		public bool SavePrintOptions => savePrintOptions;

		public CustomViewWindowOptions WindowOptions => windowOptions;

		internal Guid Id
		{
			get
			{
				if (id == default(Guid))
				{
					id = Guid.NewGuid();
				}
				return id;
			}
			set
			{
				id = value;
			}
		}

		internal Workbook Workbook => workbook;

		internal CustomView(Workbook workbook, bool savePrintOptions, bool saveHiddenRowsAndColumns)
		{
			this.workbook = workbook;
			this.savePrintOptions = savePrintOptions;
			this.saveHiddenRowsAndColumns = saveHiddenRowsAndColumns;
			worksheetDisplayOptions = new Dictionary<Worksheet, CustomViewDisplayOptions>();
			if (this.savePrintOptions)
			{
				worksheetPrintOptions = new Dictionary<Worksheet, PrintOptions>();
			}
			if (this.saveHiddenRowsAndColumns)
			{
				worksheetHiddenColumns = new Dictionary<Worksheet, HiddenColumnCollection>();
				worksheetHiddenRows = new Dictionary<Worksheet, HiddenRowCollection>();
			}
			windowOptions = new CustomViewWindowOptions(this);
			windowOptions.InitializeFrom(workbook.WindowOptions);
			foreach (Worksheet item in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)workbook.Worksheets)
			{
				OnWorksheetAdded(item);
			}
		}

		public void Apply()
		{
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantApplyRemovedCustomView"));
			}
			workbook.WindowOptions.InitializeFrom(WindowOptions);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Worksheet, CustomViewDisplayOptions> worksheetDisplayOption in worksheetDisplayOptions)
			{
				worksheetDisplayOption.Key.DisplayOptions.InitializeFrom(worksheetDisplayOption.Value);
			}
			if (savePrintOptions)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<Worksheet, PrintOptions> worksheetPrintOption in worksheetPrintOptions)
				{
					worksheetPrintOption.Key.PrintOptions.InitializeFrom(worksheetPrintOption.Value);
				}
			}
			if (!saveHiddenRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Worksheet, HiddenColumnCollection> worksheetHiddenColumn in worksheetHiddenColumns)
			{
				worksheetHiddenColumn.Key.Columns.InitializeFrom(worksheetHiddenColumn.Value);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Worksheet, HiddenRowCollection> worksheetHiddenRow in worksheetHiddenRows)
			{
				worksheetHiddenRow.Key.Rows.InitializeFrom(worksheetHiddenRow.Value);
			}
		}

		public CustomViewDisplayOptions GetDisplayOptions(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("worksheet");
			}
			if (worksheetDisplayOptions.TryGetValue(worksheet, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public HiddenColumnCollection GetHiddenColumns(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("worksheet");
			}
			if (!saveHiddenRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (worksheetHiddenColumns.TryGetValue(worksheet, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public HiddenRowCollection GetHiddenRows(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("worksheet");
			}
			if (!saveHiddenRowsAndColumns)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (worksheetHiddenRows.TryGetValue(worksheet, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public PrintOptions GetPrintOptions(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("worksheet");
			}
			if (!savePrintOptions)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (worksheetPrintOptions.TryGetValue(worksheet, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			workbook = null;
			worksheetDisplayOptions.Clear();
			if (savePrintOptions)
			{
				worksheetPrintOptions.Clear();
			}
			if (saveHiddenRowsAndColumns)
			{
				worksheetHiddenColumns.Clear();
				worksheetHiddenRows.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal void OnWorksheetAdded(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			CustomViewDisplayOptions customViewDisplayOptions = new CustomViewDisplayOptions(worksheet, this);
			customViewDisplayOptions.InitializeFrom(worksheet.DisplayOptions);
			worksheetDisplayOptions.Add(worksheet, customViewDisplayOptions);
			if (savePrintOptions)
			{
				PrintOptions printOptions = new PrintOptions(worksheet, isOwnedByCustomView: true);
				printOptions.InitializeFrom(worksheet.PrintOptions);
				worksheetPrintOptions.Add(worksheet, printOptions);
			}
			if (saveHiddenRowsAndColumns)
			{
				HiddenColumnCollection hiddenColumnCollection = new HiddenColumnCollection(worksheet, this);
				hiddenColumnCollection.InitializeFrom(worksheet);
				worksheetHiddenColumns.Add(worksheet, hiddenColumnCollection);
				HiddenRowCollection hiddenRowCollection = new HiddenRowCollection(worksheet, this);
				hiddenRowCollection.InitializeFrom(worksheet);
				worksheetHiddenRows.Add(worksheet, hiddenRowCollection);
			}
		}

		internal void OnWorksheetRemoved(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (WindowOptions.SelectedWorksheet == worksheet)
			{
				WindowOptions.SelectedWorksheet = null;
			}
			worksheetDisplayOptions.Remove(worksheet);
			if (savePrintOptions)
			{
				worksheetPrintOptions.Remove(worksheet);
			}
			if (saveHiddenRowsAndColumns)
			{
				worksheetHiddenColumns.Remove(worksheet);
				worksheetHiddenRows.Remove(worksheet);
			}
		}

		internal void SetSaveHiddenRowsAndColumns(bool value)
		{
			saveHiddenRowsAndColumns = value;
			if (!saveHiddenRowsAndColumns)
			{
				worksheetHiddenColumns = null;
				worksheetHiddenRows = null;
			}
		}

		internal void SetSavePrintOptions(bool value)
		{
			savePrintOptions = value;
			if (!savePrintOptions)
			{
				worksheetPrintOptions = null;
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			if (worksheetPrintOptions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PrintOptions value in worksheetPrintOptions.Values)
			{
				value.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			}
		}
	}
	public class CustomViewDisplayOptions : DisplayOptions
	{
		private int magnificationInCurrentView = 100;

		internal readonly CustomView Owner;

		public int MagnificationInCurrentView
		{
			get
			{
				return magnificationInCurrentView;
			}
			set
			{
				if (magnificationInCurrentView != value)
				{
					if (value < 10 || 400 < value)
					{
						throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_MagnificationLevel"));
					}
					magnificationInCurrentView = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal CustomViewDisplayOptions(Worksheet worksheet, CustomView owner)
			: base(worksheet)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		internal override void InitializeFrom(DisplayOptions displayOptions)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(displayOptions);
			if (displayOptions is WorksheetDisplayOptions worksheetDisplayOptions)
			{
				switch (worksheetDisplayOptions.View)
				{
				case WorksheetView.Normal:
					magnificationInCurrentView = worksheetDisplayOptions.MagnificationInNormalView;
					break;
				case WorksheetView.PageBreakPreview:
					magnificationInCurrentView = worksheetDisplayOptions.MagnificationInPageBreakView;
					break;
				case WorksheetView.PageLayout:
					magnificationInCurrentView = worksheetDisplayOptions.MagnificationInPageLayoutView;
					break;
				}
				if (!base.HasSelection)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int num = base.Selection.PaneSelections.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					WorksheetPaneSelection worksheetPaneSelection = base.Selection.PaneSelections[num];
					if (worksheetPaneSelection.Location != base.ActivePane)
					{
						base.Selection.PaneSelections.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (displayOptions is CustomViewDisplayOptions customViewDisplayOptions)
			{
				magnificationInCurrentView = customViewDisplayOptions.magnificationInCurrentView;
			}
		}

		protected override void ResetCore()
		{
			base.ResetCore();
			magnificationInCurrentView = 100;
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Count = {Count}")]
	public sealed class CustomViewCollection : IList<CustomView>, ICollection<CustomView>, IEnumerable<CustomView>, IEnumerable
	{
		private Workbook workbook;

		private List<CustomView> customViews;

		int ICollection<CustomView>.Count => Count;

		bool ICollection<CustomView>.IsReadOnly => false;

		CustomView IList<CustomView>.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public int Count => customViews.Count;

		public CustomView this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
				{
					throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
				}
				return customViews[index];
			}
		}

		internal CustomView this[Guid id]
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (CustomView customView in customViews)
				{
					if (customView.Id == id)
					{
						return customView;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal Workbook Workbook => workbook;

		internal CustomViewCollection(Workbook workbook)
		{
			this.workbook = workbook;
			customViews = new List<CustomView>();
		}

		void ICollection<CustomView>.Add(CustomView item)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantAddCustomView"));
		}

		void ICollection<CustomView>.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool ICollection<CustomView>.Contains(CustomView item)
		{
			return Contains(item);
		}

		void ICollection<CustomView>.CopyTo(CustomView[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			customViews.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<CustomView>.Remove(CustomView item)
		{
			return Remove(item);
		}

		IEnumerator<CustomView> IEnumerable<CustomView>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return customViews.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<CustomView>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		void IList<CustomView>.Insert(int index, CustomView item)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		int IList<CustomView>.IndexOf(CustomView item)
		{
			return customViews.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public CustomView Add(string name, bool savePrintOptions, bool saveHiddenRowsAndColumns)
		{
			CustomView customView = new CustomView(workbook, savePrintOptions, saveHiddenRowsAndColumns);
			customView.Name = name;
			customViews.Add(customView);
			return customView;
		}

		internal void Add(CustomView customView)
		{
			customViews.Add(customView);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = customViews.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(CustomView customView)
		{
			return customViews.Contains(customView);
		}

		public bool Remove(CustomView customView)
		{
			if (customView == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = customViews.IndexOf(customView);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			CustomView customView = customViews[index];
			customViews.RemoveAt(index);
			customView.OnRemovedFromCollection();
		}
	}
	public abstract class WindowOptions
	{
		internal const int defaultTabBarWidth = 600;

		private Workbook workbook;

		private ObjectDisplayStyle objectDisplayStyle;

		private ScrollBars scrollBars = ScrollBars.Both;

		private Worksheet selectedWorksheet;

		private bool tabBarVisible = true;

		private int tabBarWidth = 600;

		public ObjectDisplayStyle ObjectDisplayStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return objectDisplayStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (objectDisplayStyle != value)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ObjectDisplayStyle), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(ObjectDisplayStyle));
					}
					objectDisplayStyle = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public ScrollBars ScrollBars
		{
			get
			{
				return scrollBars;
			}
			set
			{
				if (scrollBars != value)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ScrollBars), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(ScrollBars));
					}
					scrollBars = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public Worksheet SelectedWorksheet
		{
			get
			{
				VerifySelectedWorksheet();
				return selectedWorksheet;
			}
			set
			{
				SetSelectedWorksheet(value, clearExistingSelection: true);
			}
		}

		public bool TabBarVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return tabBarVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != tabBarVisible)
				{
					tabBarVisible = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int TabBarWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return tabBarWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				if (tabBarWidth != value)
				{
					if (tabBarWidth < 0 || 1000 < tabBarWidth)
					{
						throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_TabBarWidth"));
					}
					tabBarWidth = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal abstract bool AllowNullSelectedWorksheet { get; }

		internal Workbook Workbook => workbook;

		internal WindowOptions(Workbook workbook)
		{
			this.workbook = workbook;
		}

		internal abstract DisplayOptions GetDisplayOptionsForWorksheet(Worksheet worksheet);

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			objectDisplayStyle = ObjectDisplayStyle.ShowAll;
			scrollBars = ScrollBars.Both;
			tabBarVisible = true;
			tabBarWidth = 600;
			if (AllowNullSelectedWorksheet)
			{
				selectedWorksheet = null;
			}
			else
			{
				selectedWorksheet = workbook.Worksheets[0];
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(WindowOptions windowOptions)
		{
			objectDisplayStyle = windowOptions.objectDisplayStyle;
			scrollBars = windowOptions.scrollBars;
			tabBarVisible = windowOptions.tabBarVisible;
			tabBarWidth = windowOptions.tabBarWidth;
			if (windowOptions.selectedWorksheet != null)
			{
				selectedWorksheet = windowOptions.selectedWorksheet;
				ResetSelection();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void ResetSelection()
		{
		}

		internal void SetSelectedWorksheet(Worksheet value, bool clearExistingSelection)
		{
			if (selectedWorksheet == value)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (value == null && !AllowNullSelectedWorksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_SelectedWorksheet"));
			}
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (value.Workbook != workbook)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_SelectedWorksheetFromOtherWorkbook"), "value");
				}
				DisplayOptions displayOptionsForWorksheet = GetDisplayOptionsForWorksheet(value);
				if (displayOptionsForWorksheet.Visibility != WorksheetVisibility.Visible)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_HiddenWorksheetCannotBeSelected"));
				}
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = selectedWorksheet;
			selectedWorksheet = value;
			worksheet?.OnSelectedChanged();
			if (selectedWorksheet != null)
			{
				selectedWorksheet.OnSelectedChanged();
			}
			if (clearExistingSelection)
			{
				ResetSelection();
			}
		}

		private void VerifySelectedWorksheet()
		{
			if (selectedWorksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DisplayOptions displayOptionsForWorksheet = GetDisplayOptionsForWorksheet(selectedWorksheet);
			if (displayOptionsForWorksheet.Visibility == WorksheetVisibility.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			int index = selectedWorksheet.Index;
			if (index < 0 && workbook.Worksheets.Count == 0)
			{
				selectedWorksheet = null;
				return;
			}
			for (int i = index + 1; i < workbook.Worksheets.Count; i++)
			{
				Worksheet worksheet = workbook.Worksheets[i];
				displayOptionsForWorksheet = GetDisplayOptionsForWorksheet(worksheet);
				if (displayOptionsForWorksheet.Visibility == WorksheetVisibility.Visible)
				{
					selectedWorksheet = worksheet;
					return;
				}
			}
			for (int num = index - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				Worksheet worksheet2 = workbook.Worksheets[num];
				displayOptionsForWorksheet = GetDisplayOptionsForWorksheet(worksheet2);
				if (displayOptionsForWorksheet.Visibility == WorksheetVisibility.Visible)
				{
					selectedWorksheet = worksheet2;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
