	public abstract class LimitedValueDataValidationRule : DataValidationRule
	{
		private bool allowNull;

		internal sealed override bool AllowNullInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return AllowNull;
			}
			set
			{
				AllowNull = value;
			}
		}

		public bool AllowNull
		{
			get
			{
				return allowNull;
			}
			set
			{
				if (allowNull != value)
				{
					allowNull = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal CellReferenceMode CellReferenceMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ParentCollection == null)
				{
					return CellReferenceMode.A1;
				}
				return base.ParentCollection.Worksheet.CellReferenceMode;
			}
		}

		internal CultureInfo Culture
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ParentCollection == null)
				{
					return Utilities.CurrentCulture;
				}
				return base.ParentCollection.Worksheet.Culture;
			}
		}

		internal WorkbookFormat CurrentFormat
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ParentCollection == null)
				{
					return WorkbookFormat.Excel2007;
				}
				return base.ParentCollection.Worksheet.CurrentFormat;
			}
		}

		internal LimitedValueDataValidationRule()
		{
			allowNull = true;
		}

		internal virtual bool IsTokenAllowedInFormula(FormulaToken token, bool isRootNode, bool isOnlyToken, bool isFormula1, WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			if (!isFormula1 && isRootNode && token.TokenClass != TokenClass.Value && token.TokenClass != TokenClass.Array)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (token.Token)
			{
			case Token.Exp:
			case Token.Tbl:
			case Token.Isect:
			case Token.Union:
			case Token.ArrayR:
			case Token.MemAreaR:
			case Token.MemNoMemR:
			case Token.ArrayV:
			case Token.MemAreaV:
			case Token.MemNoMemV:
			case Token.ArrayA:
			case Token.MemAreaA:
			case Token.MemNoMemA:
				return false;
			case Token.NameXR:
			case Token.Ref3dR:
			case Token.RefErr3dR:
			case Token.NameXV:
			case Token.Ref3dV:
			case Token.RefErr3dV:
			case Token.NameXA:
			case Token.Ref3dA:
			case Token.RefErr3dA:
				return !Utilities.Is2003Format(format);
			case Token.Area3DR:
			case Token.AreaErr3dR:
			case Token.Area3DV:
			case Token.AreaErr3dV:
			case Token.Area3DA:
			case Token.AreaErr3dA:
				return isFormula1;
			case Token.AreaR:
			case Token.AreaErrR:
			case Token.AreaNR:
			case Token.AreaV:
			case Token.AreaErrV:
			case Token.AreaNV:
			case Token.AreaA:
			case Token.AreaErrA:
			case Token.AreaNA:
				if (isFormula1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return !isOnlyToken;
			case Token.Extended:
				return true;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsTokenAllowedInNonListFormula(FormulaToken token, bool isRootNode, bool isOnlyToken, bool isFormula1)
		{
			if (isFormula1)
			{
				if (isRootNode && token.TokenClass != TokenClass.Value && token.TokenClass != TokenClass.Array)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (token.Token)
				{
				case Token.Area3DR:
				case Token.AreaErr3dR:
				case Token.Area3DV:
				case Token.AreaErr3dV:
				case Token.Area3DA:
				case Token.AreaErr3dA:
					return false;
				case Token.AreaR:
				case Token.AreaErrR:
				case Token.AreaNR:
				case Token.AreaV:
				case Token.AreaErrV:
				case Token.AreaNV:
				case Token.AreaA:
				case Token.AreaErrA:
				case Token.AreaNA:
					return !isOnlyToken;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal Formula ParseFormula(string formula, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(WorkbookFormat), format))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("format", (int)cellReferenceMode, typeof(WorkbookFormat));
			}
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CellReferenceMode), cellReferenceMode))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("cellReferenceMode", (int)cellReferenceMode, typeof(CellReferenceMode));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formula))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!Formula.TryParse(formula, cellReferenceMode, FormulaType, format, culture, null, out var formula2, out var exception))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidFormula"), exception);
			}
			return formula2;
		}

		internal Formula ResolveFormula(Formula originalFormula, string address, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture, bool addressIsTarget)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(WorkbookFormat), format))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("format", (int)format, typeof(WorkbookFormat));
			}
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CellReferenceMode), cellReferenceMode))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("cellReferenceMode", (int)cellReferenceMode, typeof(CellReferenceMode));
			}
			if (originalFormula == null || address == null)
			{
				return originalFormula;
			}
			if (culture == null)
			{
				culture = originalFormula.Culture;
			}
			Utilities.ParseRegionAddress(address, format, cellReferenceMode, culture, null, -1, out var firstRowIndex, out var firstColumnIndex, out var _, out var _);
			if (firstRowIndex < 0 || firstColumnIndex < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_InvalidAddress"), "address");
			}
			Formula formula = originalFormula.Clone();
			FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(base.Worksheet, firstRowIndex, firstColumnIndex, format, formula);
			Formula.SharedTokenConverter sharedTokenConverter = Formula.SharedTokenConverter.Initialize(context, !addressIsTarget);
			for (int i = 0; i < formula.PostfixTokenList.Length; i++)
			{
				formula.PostfixTokenList[i] = formula.PostfixTokenList[i].Accept(sharedTokenConverter);
			}
			sharedTokenConverter.Reset();
			formula.ClearCache();
			if (!addressIsTarget && base.Worksheet != null)
			{
				formula.ReconnectReferences(context);
			}
			return formula;
		}

		internal virtual void VerifyFormula(Formula formula, DataValidationRuleCollection collection, WorksheetReferenceCollection references, string formulaPropertyName, bool isOriginalFormula, bool isFormula1, WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			if (formula == null)
			{
				if (collection != null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_FormulaCannotBeNull", formulaPropertyName));
				}
				return;
			}
			Workbook workbook = null;
			if (collection != null)
			{
				workbook = collection.Worksheet.Workbook;
				format = collection.Worksheet.CurrentFormat;
			}
			if (isOriginalFormula)
			{
				int num = formula.PostfixTokenList.Length - 1;
				bool isOnlyToken = num == 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < formula.PostfixTokenList.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!IsTokenAllowedInFormula(formula.PostfixTokenList[i], i == num, isOnlyToken, isFormula1, format))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException("Invalid formula used in the data validation rule.");
					}
				}
			}
			Workbook workbook2 = null;
			Worksheet worksheet = null;
			if (collection != null)
			{
				worksheet = collection.Worksheet;
				workbook2 = worksheet.Workbook;
				if (formula.CurrentFormat != collection.Worksheet.CurrentFormat)
				{
					CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode = collection.Worksheet.CellReferenceMode;
					if (references == null)
					{
						references = collection[this];
					}
					if (references != null)
					{
						references.GetBoundingCells(out var topLeftCell, out var bottomRightCell);
						if (topLeftCell != null)
						{
							CultureInfo culture = formula.Culture;
							Formula formula2 = ResolveFormula(formula, topLeftCell.ToString(cellReferenceMode, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: false, useRelativeRow: false), formula.CurrentFormat, cellReferenceMode, culture, addressIsTarget: true);
							VerifyFormulaHelper(workbook, formula2, formulaPropertyName, format, cellReferenceMode);
							if (topLeftCell != bottomRightCell)
							{
								Formula formula3 = ResolveFormula(formula, bottomRightCell.ToString(cellReferenceMode, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: false, useRelativeRow: false), formula.CurrentFormat, cellReferenceMode, culture, addressIsTarget: true);
								VerifyFormulaHelper(workbook, formula3, formulaPropertyName, format, cellReferenceMode);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						VerifyFormulaHelper(workbook, formula, formulaPropertyName, format, cellReferenceMode);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < formula.PostfixTokenList.Length; j++)
			{
				if (!(formula.PostfixTokenList[j] is ReferenceToken referenceToken))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (referenceToken.IsExternalReference)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_FormulaCannotReferenceOtherWorkbook", formulaPropertyName));
				}
				if (workbook2 == null || workbook2.IsLoading)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Worksheet worksheetScope = worksheet;
				if (referenceToken.WorksheetReference is WorksheetReferenceLocal worksheetReferenceLocal)
				{
					worksheetScope = worksheetReferenceLocal.Worksheet;
				}
				if (referenceToken is NameToken nameToken)
				{
					NamedReferenceBase namedReferenceBase = workbook2.NamedReferences.Find(nameToken.Name, worksheetScope);
					if (namedReferenceBase == null && (nameToken.ScopeReference == null || nameToken.ScopeReference == workbook2))
					{
						namedReferenceBase = workbook2.GetWorkbookScopedNamedItem(nameToken.Name);
					}
					if (namedReferenceBase == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_FormulaCannotFindNamedReference", formulaPropertyName));
					}
					VerifyFormula(namedReferenceBase.FormulaInternal, collection, references, formulaPropertyName, isOriginalFormula: false, isFormula1, format);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyFormulaHelper(Workbook workbook, Formula formula, string formulaPropertyName, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			FormatLimitErrors formatLimitErrors = workbook.InitializeFormatLimitErrors();
			formula.VerifyFormatLimits(workbook, formatLimitErrors, format, cellReferenceMode, parseFormula: true, null, -1);
			if (formatLimitErrors.HasErrors)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_FormulaInvalidForWorkbookFormat", formulaPropertyName, format));
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class CustomDataValidationRule : LimitedValueDataValidationRule
	{
		private Formula formula;

		internal override DataValidationOperatorType OperatorType => DataValidationOperatorType.Between;

		internal override DataValidationType ValidationType => DataValidationType.Formula;

		internal override Formula GetFormula1(string address)
		{
			return GetFormulaInternal(address, base.CurrentFormat, base.CellReferenceMode, base.Culture);
		}

		internal override Formula GetFormula2(string address)
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal override bool IsTokenAllowedInFormula(FormulaToken token, bool isRootNode, bool isOnlyToken, bool isFormula1, WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			if (!base.IsTokenAllowedInFormula(token, isRootNode, isOnlyToken, isFormula1, format))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return LimitedValueDataValidationRule.IsTokenAllowedInNonListFormula(token, isRootNode, isOnlyToken, isFormula1);
		}

		internal override void OnAddedToCollection(DataValidationRuleCollection parentCollection)
		{
			base.OnAddedToCollection(parentCollection);
			if (formula != null)
			{
				FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(base.Worksheet, -1, -1, parentCollection.Worksheet.CurrentFormat, formula);
				formula.ReconnectReferences(context);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			if (formula != null)
			{
				formula.DisconnectReferences();
			}
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection();
		}

		internal override void SetFormula1(Formula formula, string address)
		{
			SetFormulaInternal(formula, address, base.CurrentFormat, base.CellReferenceMode, base.Culture);
		}

		internal override void SetFormula2(Formula formula, string address)
		{
		}

		internal override void VerifyState(DataValidationRuleCollection collection, WorksheetReferenceCollection references)
		{
			VerifyFormula(formula, collection, references, "formula", isOriginalFormula: true, isFormula1: true, base.CurrentFormat);
		}

		public string GetFormula(string address)
		{
			return GetFormula(address, base.CurrentFormat, base.CellReferenceMode, base.Culture);
		}

		public string GetFormula(string address, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return GetFormulaInternal(address, format, cellReferenceMode, culture)?.ToString(cellReferenceMode, culture);
		}

		public void SetFormula(string formula, string address)
		{
			SetFormula(formula, address, base.CurrentFormat, base.CellReferenceMode, base.Culture);
		}

		public void SetFormula(string formula, string address, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Formula formula2 = ParseFormula(formula, format, cellReferenceMode, culture);
			SetFormulaInternal(formula2, address, format, cellReferenceMode, culture);
		}

		internal Formula GetFormulaInternal(string address, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return ResolveFormula(formula, address, format, cellReferenceMode, culture, addressIsTarget: true);
		}

		private void SetFormulaInternal(Formula formula, string address, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			VerifyFormula(formula, base.ParentCollection, null, "formula", isOriginalFormula: true, isFormula1: true, format);
			this.formula = ResolveFormula(formula, address, format, cellReferenceMode, culture, addressIsTarget: false);
		}
	}
	public class DataValidationRuleCollection : IDictionary<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>, IEnumerable
	{
		private Dictionary<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection> rules;

		private Worksheet worksheet;

		ICollection<DataValidationRule> IDictionary<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>.Keys => ((IDictionary<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>)rules).Keys;

		ICollection<WorksheetReferenceCollection> IDictionary<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>.Values => ((IDictionary<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>)rules).Values;

		bool ICollection<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => rules.Count;

		public WorksheetReferenceCollection this[DataValidationRule rule]
		{
			get
			{
				return rules[rule];
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					Remove(rule);
					return;
				}
				Validate(rule, value);
				Remove(value);
				rules[rule] = value;
				rule.OnAddedToCollection(this);
			}
		}

		internal Worksheet Worksheet => worksheet;

		internal DataValidationRuleCollection(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			rules = new Dictionary<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>();
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
		}

		void IDictionary<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>.Add(DataValidationRule key, WorksheetReferenceCollection value)
		{
			Add(key, value);
		}

		bool IDictionary<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>.ContainsKey(DataValidationRule key)
		{
			return Contains(key);
		}

		bool IDictionary<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>.TryGetValue(DataValidationRule key, out WorksheetReferenceCollection value)
		{
			return TryGetReferences(key, out value);
		}

		void ICollection<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>.Add(KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection> item)
		{
			Add(item.Key, item.Value);
		}

		bool ICollection<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>.Contains(KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection> item)
		{
			if (TryGetReferences(item.Key, out var references))
			{
				return EqualityComparer<WorksheetReferenceCollection>.Default.Equals(references, item.Value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		void ICollection<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>.CopyTo(KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			((ICollection<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>)rules).CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>.Remove(KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection> item)
		{
			return ((ICollection<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>)rules).Remove(item);
		}

		IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>> IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return rules.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(DataValidationRule rule, WorksheetReferenceCollection references)
		{
			Add(rule, references, overwriteExistingRules: true);
		}

		public void Add(DataValidationRule rule, WorksheetReferenceCollection references, bool overwriteExistingRules)
		{
			if (references == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("references");
			}
			Validate(rule, references);
			if (!overwriteExistingRules && Contains(references))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_ReferencesAlreadyContainDVs"), "references");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < references.Regions.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRegionAddress other = references.Regions[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < worksheet.Tables.Count; j++)
				{
					WorksheetTable worksheetTable = worksheet.Tables[j];
					WorksheetRegion totalsRowRegion = worksheetTable.TotalsRowRegion;
					if (totalsRowRegion != null && totalsRowRegion.Address.IntersectsWith(other))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CannotApplyDVRuleToTotalCell"), "references");
					}
				}
			}
			Remove(references);
			AddInternal(rule, references);
		}

		public void Add(AnyValueDataValidationRule rule, WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			AddHelper(rule, cell);
		}

		public void Add(AnyValueDataValidationRule rule, WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			AddHelper(rule, region);
		}

		public void Add(CustomDataValidationRule rule, WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			AddHelper(rule, cell);
		}

		public void Add(CustomDataValidationRule rule, WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			AddHelper(rule, region);
		}

		public void Add(ListDataValidationRule rule, WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			AddHelper(rule, cell);
		}

		public void Add(ListDataValidationRule rule, WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			AddHelper(rule, region);
		}

		public void Add(OneConstraintDataValidationRule rule, WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			AddHelper(rule, cell);
		}

		public void Add(OneConstraintDataValidationRule rule, WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			AddHelper(rule, region);
		}

		public void Add(TwoConstraintDataValidationRule rule, WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			AddHelper(rule, cell);
		}

		public void Add(TwoConstraintDataValidationRule rule, WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			AddHelper(rule, region);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (rules.Count != 0)
			{
				List<DataValidationRule> list = new List<DataValidationRule>(rules.Keys);
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					Remove(list[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(DataValidationRule rule)
		{
			return rules.ContainsKey(rule);
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			ValidateCell(cell);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection> rule in rules)
			{
				WorksheetReferenceCollection value = rule.Value;
				if (value.Contains(cell))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetReferenceCollection references)
		{
			ValidateReferences(references);
			for (int i = 0; i < references.Regions.Count; i++)
			{
				if (Contains(references.Regions[i]))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			ValidateRegion(region);
			return Contains(region.Address);
		}

		internal bool Contains(WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection> rule in rules)
			{
				if (rule.Value.IntersectsWith(region))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DataValidationRule FindRule(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			ValidateCell(cell);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection> rule in rules)
			{
				if (rule.Value.Contains(cell))
				{
					return rule.Key;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool Remove(DataValidationRule rule)
		{
			if (rule == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("rule");
			}
			if (rule.ParentCollection != this)
			{
				return false;
			}
			rules.Remove(rule);
			rule.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			return true;
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			ValidateCell(cell);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection> rule in rules)
			{
				WorksheetReferenceCollection value = rule.Value;
				if (value.Contains(cell))
				{
					value.Remove(cell);
					if (value.CellsCount == 0)
					{
						Remove(rule.Key);
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetReferenceCollection references)
		{
			ValidateReferences(references);
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < references.Regions.Count; i++)
			{
				flag |= Remove(references.Regions[i]);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			ValidateRegion(region);
			return Remove(region.Address);
		}

		internal bool Remove(WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			List<DataValidationRule> list = new List<DataValidationRule>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection> rule in rules)
			{
				WorksheetReferenceCollection value = rule.Value;
				if (value.IntersectsWith(region))
				{
					value.Remove(region);
					if (value.CellsCount == 0)
					{
						list.Add(rule.Key);
					}
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				Remove(list[i]);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public bool TryGetReferences(DataValidationRule rule, out WorksheetReferenceCollection references)
		{
			return rules.TryGetValue(rule, out references);
		}

		internal void AddHelper(DataValidationRule rule, WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			ValidateCell(cell);
			Add(rule, WorksheetReferenceCollection.CreateFromCell(cell));
		}

		internal void AddHelper(DataValidationRule rule, WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			ValidateRegion(region);
			Add(rule, WorksheetReferenceCollection.CreateFromRegion(region));
		}

		internal void AddInternal(DataValidationRule rule, WorksheetReferenceCollection references)
		{
			if (rules.TryGetValue(rule, out var value))
			{
				value.Add(references);
				return;
			}
			rules.Add(rule, references);
			rule.OnAddedToCollection(this);
		}

		private void Validate(DataValidationRule rule, WorksheetReferenceCollection references)
		{
			if (rule == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("rule");
			}
			if (rule.ParentCollection != null && rule.ParentCollection != this)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_RuleAppliedOnOtherWorksheet"), "rule");
			}
			rule.VerifyState(this, references);
			if (references != null && references.Worksheet != worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_ReferencesFromOtherWorksheet"), "references");
			}
		}

		private void ValidateCell(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			if (cell == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("cell");
			}
			if (cell.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"), "cell");
			}
			if (cell.Worksheet != worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_CellFromOtherWorksheet"), "cell");
			}
		}

		private void ValidateReferences(WorksheetReferenceCollection references)
		{
			if (references == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("references");
			}
			if (references.Worksheet != worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_ReferencesFromOtherWorksheet"), "references");
			}
		}

		private void ValidateRegion(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			if (region == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("region");
			}
			if (region.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionShiftedOffWorksheet"), "region");
			}
			if (region.Worksheet != worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_RegionFromOtherWorksheet"), "region");
			}
		}
	}
	public enum DataValidationCriteria
	{
		WholeNumber = 1,
		Decimal = 2,
		Date = 4,
		Time = 5,
		TextLength = 6
	}
	public enum DataValidationErrorStyle
	{
		Stop,
		Warning,
		Information
	}
	public enum OneConstraintDataValidationOperator
	{
		EqualTo = 2,
		NotEqualTo = 3,
		GreaterThan = 4,
		GreaterThanOrEqualTo = 6,
		LessThan = 5,
		LessThanOrEqualTo = 7
	}
	public enum TwoConstraintDataValidationOperator
	{
		Between,
		NotBetween
	}
	public sealed class ListDataValidationRule : LimitedValueDataValidationRule
	{
		private bool showDropdown;

		private Formula valuesFormula;

		internal override FormulaType FormulaType => FormulaType.ListDataValidationFormula;

		internal override DataValidationOperatorType OperatorType => DataValidationOperatorType.Between;

		internal override DataValidationType ValidationType => DataValidationType.List;

		public bool ShowDropdown
		{
			get
			{
				return showDropdown;
			}
			set
			{
				if (showDropdown != value)
				{
					showDropdown = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public ListDataValidationRule()
		{
			showDropdown = true;
		}

		internal override Formula GetFormula1(string address)
		{
			return GetValuesFormulaInternal(address, base.CurrentFormat, base.CellReferenceMode, base.Culture);
		}

		internal override Formula GetFormula2(string address)
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal override bool IsTokenAllowedInFormula(FormulaToken token, bool isRootNode, bool isOnlyToken, bool isFormula1, WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			if (!base.IsTokenAllowedInFormula(token, isRootNode, isOnlyToken, isFormula1, format))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (isRootNode)
			{
				if (token.Token == Token.Str)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (token.TokenClass == TokenClass.Value || token.TokenClass == TokenClass.Array)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			switch (token.Token)
			{
			case Token.Area3DR:
			case Token.AreaErr3dR:
			case Token.Area3DV:
			case Token.AreaErr3dV:
			case Token.Area3DA:
			case Token.AreaErr3dA:
				return isOnlyToken;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal override void OnAddedToCollection(DataValidationRuleCollection parentCollection)
		{
			base.OnAddedToCollection(parentCollection);
			if (valuesFormula != null)
			{
				FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(base.Worksheet, -1, -1, base.Worksheet.CurrentFormat, valuesFormula);
				valuesFormula.ReconnectReferences(context);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			if (valuesFormula != null)
			{
				valuesFormula.DisconnectReferences();
			}
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection();
		}

		internal override void SetFormula1(Formula formula, string address)
		{
			SetValuesFormulaInternal(formula, address, base.CurrentFormat, base.CellReferenceMode, base.Culture);
		}

		internal override void SetFormula2(Formula formula, string address)
		{
		}

		internal override void VerifyFormula(Formula formula, DataValidationRuleCollection collection, WorksheetReferenceCollection references, string formulaPropertyName, bool isOriginalFormula, bool isFormula1, WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			base.VerifyFormula(formula, collection, references, formulaPropertyName, isOriginalFormula, isFormula1, format);
			if (formula == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FormulaToken formulaToken = formula.PostfixTokenList[0];
			StrToken strToken = formulaToken as StrToken;
			ReferenceToken referenceToken = formulaToken as ReferenceToken;
			if (strToken != null)
			{
				if (strToken.Value.Length == 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_ListFormulaCannotHaveEmptyString"));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (referenceToken == null || referenceToken is NameToken)
				{
					return;
				}
				CellAddressRange? cellAddressRange = Utilities.GetCellAddressRange(referenceToken);
				if (cellAddressRange.HasValue)
				{
					CellAddressRange valueOrDefault = cellAddressRange.GetValueOrDefault();
					if (valueOrDefault.TopLeftCellAddress.Row != valueOrDefault.BottomRightCellAddress.Row && valueOrDefault.TopLeftCellAddress.Column != valueOrDefault.BottomRightCellAddress.Column)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_ListFormulaReferenceMustBeOneDimensional"));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void VerifyState(DataValidationRuleCollection collection, WorksheetReferenceCollection references)
		{
			VerifyFormula(valuesFormula, collection, references, "valuesFormula", isOriginalFormula: true, isFormula1: true, base.CurrentFormat);
		}

		public string GetValuesFormula(string address)
		{
			return GetValuesFormula(address, base.CurrentFormat, base.CellReferenceMode, base.Culture);
		}

		public string GetValuesFormula(string address, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Formula valuesFormulaInternal = GetValuesFormulaInternal(address, format, cellReferenceMode, culture);
			if (valuesFormulaInternal == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CultureInfo cultureInfo = culture ?? base.Culture;
			if (valuesFormulaInternal.PostfixTokenList.Length == 1 && valuesFormulaInternal.PostfixTokenList[0] is StrToken strToken && ShouldSwapSeparators(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, cultureInfo))
			{
				object[] valuesHelper = GetValuesHelper(strToken.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, cultureInfo);
				return CreateFormulaString(valuesHelper, cultureInfo, cultureInfo);
			}
			return valuesFormulaInternal.ToString(cellReferenceMode, culture);
		}

		public void SetValues(params object[] values)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				SetValuesFormula(null, null);
				return;
			}
			if (values.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_MustHaveOneAcceptedValue"));
			}
			string text = CreateFormulaString(values, base.Culture, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			SetValuesFormula(text, null, base.CurrentFormat, base.CellReferenceMode, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		public void SetValuesFormula(string valuesFormula, string address)
		{
			SetValuesFormula(valuesFormula, address, base.CurrentFormat, base.CellReferenceMode, base.Culture);
		}

		public void SetValuesFormula(string valuesFormula, string address, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			CultureInfo cultureInfo = culture ?? base.Culture;
			Formula formula = ParseFormula(valuesFormula, format, cellReferenceMode, cultureInfo);
			if (formula != null && formula.PostfixTokenList.Length == 1 && formula.PostfixTokenList[0] is StrToken strToken && ShouldSwapSeparators(cultureInfo, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
			{
				object[] valuesHelper = GetValuesHelper(strToken.Value, cultureInfo, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				string formula2 = CreateFormulaString(valuesHelper, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				formula = ParseFormula(formula2, format, cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			SetValuesFormulaInternal(formula, address, format, cellReferenceMode, culture);
		}

		public bool TryGetValues(out object[] values)
		{
			values = null;
			if (valuesFormula == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(valuesFormula.PostfixTokenList[0] is StrToken strToken))
			{
				return false;
			}
			values = GetValuesHelper(strToken.Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, base.Culture);
			return true;
		}

		private static string CreateFormulaString(object[] values, CultureInfo valuesCulture, CultureInfo formulaCulture)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("=\"");
			bool flag = ShouldSwapSeparators(valuesCulture, formulaCulture);
			string numberDecimalSeparator = formulaCulture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator;
			char unionOperatorResolved = FormulaParser.GetUnionOperatorResolved(numberDecimalSeparator);
			bool flag2 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				object obj = values[i];
				if (obj != null)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					string text = Utilities.ConvertToString(obj, valuesCulture) ?? string.Empty;
					if (obj is bool)
					{
						text = text.ToUpper();
					}
					text = text.Replace("\"", "\"\"");
					if (flag)
					{
						text = SwapSeparators(text);
					}
					if (ValueNeedsSingleQuoteInFormulaString(obj, text, formulaCulture))
					{
						stringBuilder.Append('\'');
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(text);
					if (i != values.Length - 1)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(unionOperatorResolved);
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(unionOperatorResolved);
			}
			stringBuilder.Append('"');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal Formula GetValuesFormulaInternal(string address, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return ResolveFormula(valuesFormula, address, format, cellReferenceMode, culture, addressIsTarget: true);
		}

		private static object[] GetValuesHelper(string listOfValues, CultureInfo listCulture, CultureInfo valuesCulture)
		{
			char unionOperatorResolved = FormulaParser.GetUnionOperatorResolved(listCulture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator);
			string[] array = listOfValues.Split(new char[1] { unionOperatorResolved }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return new object[0];
			}
			bool flag = ShouldSwapSeparators(listCulture, valuesCulture);
			object[] array2 = new object[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				string text = array[i];
				if (MathUtilities.DoubleTryParse(text, listCulture, out var value))
				{
					array2[i] = value;
					continue;
				}
				if (FormulaParser.TryParseBoolean(text, out var booleanValue))
				{
					array2[i] = booleanValue;
					continue;
				}
				ErrorValue errorValue = FormulaParser.ParseError(text, listCulture);
				if (errorValue != null)
				{
					array2[i] = errorValue;
					continue;
				}
				text = text.Replace("\"\"", "\"");
				if (text.StartsWith("'"))
				{
					text = text.Substring(1);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					text = SwapSeparators(text);
				}
				array2[i] = text;
			}
			return array2;
		}

		private void SetValuesFormulaInternal(Formula valuesFormula, string address, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			VerifyFormula(valuesFormula, base.ParentCollection, null, "valuesFormula", isOriginalFormula: true, isFormula1: true, format);
			this.valuesFormula = ResolveFormula(valuesFormula, address, format, cellReferenceMode, culture, addressIsTarget: false);
		}

		private static bool ValueNeedsSingleQuoteInFormulaString(object value, string stringValue, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (stringValue.Length == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(value is ErrorValue) && FormulaParser.ParseError(stringValue, culture) != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(value is bool) && FormulaParser.TryParseBoolean(stringValue, out var _))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!Utilities.IsNumericType(value) && MathUtilities.DoubleTryParse(stringValue, culture, out var _))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ShouldSwapSeparators(CultureInfo sourceCulture, CultureInfo destinationCulture)
		{
			return destinationCulture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator == "," != (sourceCulture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator == ",");
		}

		private static string SwapSeparators(string value)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(value);
			for (int i = 0; i < stringBuilder.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (stringBuilder[i])
				{
				case ',':
					stringBuilder[i] = ';';
					break;
				case ';':
					stringBuilder[i] = ',';
					break;
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public abstract class ValueConstraintDataValidationRule : LimitedValueDataValidationRule
	{
		private DataValidationCriteria validationCriteria = DataValidationCriteria.Decimal;

		internal override DataValidationType ValidationType => (DataValidationType)validationCriteria;

		public DataValidationCriteria ValidationCriteria
		{
			get
			{
				return validationCriteria;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != validationCriteria)
				{
					SetValidationCriteria(value, "value");
				}
			}
		}

		internal ValueConstraintDataValidationRule()
		{
		}

		internal override bool IsTokenAllowedInFormula(FormulaToken token, bool isRootNode, bool isOnlyToken, bool isFormula1, WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			if (!base.IsTokenAllowedInFormula(token, isRootNode, isOnlyToken, isFormula1, format))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return LimitedValueDataValidationRule.IsTokenAllowedInNonListFormula(token, isRootNode, isOnlyToken, isFormula1);
		}

		internal override void VerifyFormula(Formula formula, DataValidationRuleCollection collection, WorksheetReferenceCollection references, string formulaPropertyName, bool isOriginalFormula, bool isFormula1, WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			base.VerifyFormula(formula, collection, references, formulaPropertyName, isOriginalFormula, isFormula1, format);
			if (formula == null || formula.PostfixTokenList.Length != 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			FormulaToken formulaToken = formula.PostfixTokenList[0];
			NumberToken numberToken = formulaToken as NumberToken;
			IntToken intToken = formulaToken as IntToken;
			if (formulaToken is ReferenceToken referenceToken)
			{
				if (!(referenceToken is NameToken) && (referenceToken is Area3DNToken || referenceToken is Area3DToken || referenceToken is AreaErr3DToken || referenceToken is AreaErrToken || referenceToken is AreaNToken || referenceToken is AreaToken))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_ConstraintFormulaMustBeNumberOrReference", formulaPropertyName));
				}
			}
			else if (numberToken == null && intToken == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_ConstraintFormulaMustBeNumberOrReference", formulaPropertyName));
			}
		}

		internal void SetValidationCriteria(DataValidationCriteria value, string paramName)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(DataValidationCriteria), value))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(paramName, (int)value, typeof(DataValidationCriteria));
			}
			validationCriteria = value;
		}

		internal static double? GetConstraint(Formula formula)
		{
			if (formula == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (formula.PostfixTokenList.Length != 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FormulaToken formulaToken = formula.PostfixTokenList[0];
			if (formulaToken is IntToken intToken)
			{
				return (int)intToken.Value;
			}
			if (formulaToken is NumberToken numberToken)
			{
				return numberToken.Value;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		{
			VerifyFormula(lowerConstraintFormula, base.ParentCollection, null, "lowerConstraintFormula", isOriginalFormula: true, isFormula1: true, format);
			double? constraint = ValueConstraintDataValidationRule.GetConstraint(lowerConstraintFormula);
			double? constraint2 = ValueConstraintDataValidationRule.GetConstraint(upperConstraintFormula);
			if (constraint.HasValue && constraint2.HasValue && constraint2.Value < constraint.Value)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_LowerGreaterThanUpperContraint"), "lowerConstraintFormula");
			}
			this.lowerConstraintFormula = ResolveFormula(lowerConstraintFormula, address, format, cellReferenceMode, culture, addressIsTarget: false);

			double? constraint2 = ValueConstraintDataValidationRule.GetConstraint(upperConstraintFormula);
			if (constraint.HasValue && constraint2.HasValue && constraint2.Value < constraint.Value)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DV_UpperLessThanLowerContraint"), "upperConstraintFormula");
			}
			this.upperConstraintFormula = ResolveFormula(upperConstraintFormula, address, format, cellReferenceMode, culture, addressIsTarget: false);
		}

	public class DisplayValueCollection : IList<string>, ICollection<string>, IEnumerable<string>, IEnumerable
	{
		private FixedValuesFilter _owner;

		private List<string> _displayValues = new List<string>();

		bool ICollection<string>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => _displayValues.Count;

		public string this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _displayValues[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
				}
				int num = IndexOf(value);
				if (num < 0 || num == index)
				{
					_displayValues[index] = value;
					_owner.OnModified();
					return;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DuplicateDisplayValue"), "item");
			}
		}

		internal DisplayValueCollection(FixedValuesFilter owner)
		{
			_owner = owner;
		}

		void ICollection<string>.CopyTo(string[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_displayValues.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		IEnumerator<string> IEnumerable<string>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _displayValues.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<string>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(string item)
		{
			VerifyItem(item);
			InternalInsert(_displayValues.Count, item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (_owner.GetAllowedItemCount() == _displayValues.Count)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_FixedValuesFilterMustAcceptAValue"));
			}
			for (int num = _displayValues.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				InternalRemove(num, raiseOnModified: false);
			}
			_owner.OnModified();
		}

		public bool Contains(string item)
		{
			return IndexOf(item) >= 0;
		}

		public int IndexOf(string item)
		{
			CultureInfo culture = _owner.Culture;
			for (int i = 0; i < _displayValues.Count; i++)
			{
				if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(item, _displayValues[i], culture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, string item)
		{
			VerifyItem(item);
			InternalInsert(index, item);
		}

		public bool Remove(string item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (_owner.GetAllowedItemCount() == 1)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_FixedValuesFilterMustAcceptAValue"));
			}
			_displayValues.RemoveAt(index);
			_owner.OnModified();
		}

		private void InternalInsert(int index, string value)
		{
			_displayValues.Insert(index, value);
			_owner.OnModified();
		}

		private void InternalRemove(int index, bool raiseOnModified)
		{
			_displayValues.RemoveAt(index);
			if (raiseOnModified)
			{
				_owner.OnModified();
			}
		}

		private void VerifyItem(string item)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			if (Contains(item))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DuplicateDisplayValue"), "item");
			}
		}
	}
	public class DocumentProperties
	{
		private Workbook workbook;

		private string _author;

		private string _category;

		private string _comments;

		internal void Load(SummaryInformation summaryInformation, DocumentSummaryInformation documentSummaryInformation)
		{
			string author = (string)summaryInformation.Properties[(SummaryPropertyType)4];
			string category = (string)documentSummaryInformation.Properties[(DocumentSummaryPropertyType)2];
			string comments = (string)summaryInformation.Properties[(SummaryPropertyType)6];
			string company = (string)documentSummaryInformation.Properties[(DocumentSummaryPropertyType)15];
			string keywords = (string)summaryInformation.Properties[(SummaryPropertyType)5];
			string manager = (string)documentSummaryInformation.Properties[(DocumentSummaryPropertyType)14];
			string subject = (string)summaryInformation.Properties[(SummaryPropertyType)3];
			string status = (string)documentSummaryInformation.Properties[(DocumentSummaryPropertyType)27];
			string title = (string)summaryInformation.Properties[(SummaryPropertyType)2];
			_author = author;
			_category = category;
			_comments = comments;
			_company = company;
			_keywords = keywords;
			_manager = manager;
			_subject = subject;
			_status = status;
			_title = title;
		}

		internal void Save(StructuredStorageManager manager)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SummaryInformation val = new SummaryInformation();
			DocumentSummaryInformation val2 = new DocumentSummaryInformation();
			val.Properties[(SummaryPropertyType)4] = ((_author == null) ? null : _author.Trim());
			val2.Properties[(DocumentSummaryPropertyType)2] = _category;
			val.Properties[(SummaryPropertyType)6] = _comments;
			val2.Properties[(DocumentSummaryPropertyType)15] = _company;
			val.Properties[(SummaryPropertyType)5] = _keywords;
			val2.Properties[(DocumentSummaryPropertyType)14] = ((_manager == null) ? null : _manager.Trim());
			val.Properties[(SummaryPropertyType)3] = _subject;
			val2.Properties[(DocumentSummaryPropertyType)27] = _status;
			val.Properties[(SummaryPropertyType)2] = _title;
			Stream stream = manager.AddFile("\u0005DocumentSummaryInformation");
			if (stream != null)
			{
				((InformationBase)val2).Save(stream);
			}
			Stream stream2 = manager.AddFile("\u0005SummaryInformation");
			if (stream2 != null)
			{
				((InformationBase)val).Save(stream2);
			}
		}
	}

	public class ErrorValue
	{
		internal const byte EmptyCellRangeIntersectionValue = 0;

		internal const byte DivisionByZeroValue = 7;

		internal const byte WrongOperandTypeValue = 15;

		internal const byte InvalidCellReferenceValue = 23;

		internal const byte WrongFunctionNameValue = 29;

		internal const byte ValueRangeOverflowValue = 36;

		internal const byte ArgumentOrFunctionNotAvailableValue = 42;

		internal const byte CircularityValue = byte.MaxValue;

		private static ErrorValue emptyCellRangeIntersection;

		private static ErrorValue divisionByZero;

		private static ErrorValue wrongOperandType;

		private static ErrorValue invalidCellReference;

		private static ErrorValue wrongFunctionName;

		private static ErrorValue valueRangeOverflow;

		private static ErrorValue argumentOrFunctionNotAvailable;

		private static ErrorValue circularity;

		private static readonly object lazyCreateSyncLock = new object();

		private byte value;

		public static ErrorValue ArgumentOrFunctionNotAvailable
		{
			get
			{
				if (argumentOrFunctionNotAvailable == null)
				{
					lock (lazyCreateSyncLock)
					{
						if (argumentOrFunctionNotAvailable == null)
						{
							argumentOrFunctionNotAvailable = new ErrorValue(42);
						}
					}
				}
				return argumentOrFunctionNotAvailable;
			}
		}

		public static ErrorValue Circularity
		{
			get
			{
				if (circularity == null)
				{
					lock (lazyCreateSyncLock)
					{
						if (circularity == null)
						{
							circularity = new ErrorValue(byte.MaxValue);
						}
					}
				}
				return circularity;
			}
		}

		public static ErrorValue DivisionByZero
		{
			get
			{
				if (divisionByZero == null)
				{
					lock (lazyCreateSyncLock)
					{
						if (divisionByZero == null)
						{
							divisionByZero = new ErrorValue(7);
						}
					}
				}
				return divisionByZero;
			}
		}

		public static ErrorValue EmptyCellRangeIntersection
		{
			get
			{
				if (emptyCellRangeIntersection == null)
				{
					lock (lazyCreateSyncLock)
					{
						if (emptyCellRangeIntersection == null)
						{
							emptyCellRangeIntersection = new ErrorValue(0);
						}
					}
				}
				return emptyCellRangeIntersection;
			}
		}

		public static ErrorValue InvalidCellReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (invalidCellReference == null)
				{
					lock (lazyCreateSyncLock)
					{
						if (invalidCellReference == null)
						{
							invalidCellReference = new ErrorValue(23);
						}
					}
				}
				return invalidCellReference;
			}
		}

		public static ErrorValue ValueRangeOverflow
		{
			get
			{
				if (valueRangeOverflow == null)
				{
					lock (lazyCreateSyncLock)
					{
						if (valueRangeOverflow == null)
						{
							valueRangeOverflow = new ErrorValue(36);
						}
					}
				}
				return valueRangeOverflow;
			}
		}

		public static ErrorValue WrongFunctionName
		{
			get
			{
				if (wrongFunctionName == null)
				{
					lock (lazyCreateSyncLock)
					{
						if (wrongFunctionName == null)
						{
							wrongFunctionName = new ErrorValue(29);
						}
					}
				}
				return wrongFunctionName;
			}
		}

		public static ErrorValue WrongOperandType
		{
			get
			{
				if (wrongOperandType == null)
				{
					lock (lazyCreateSyncLock)
					{
						if (wrongOperandType == null)
						{
							wrongOperandType = new ErrorValue(15);
						}
					}
				}
				return wrongOperandType;
			}
		}

		internal byte Value => value;

		private ErrorValue(byte value)
		{
			this.value = value;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return value switch
			{
				0 => "#NULL!", 
				7 => "#DIV/0!", 
				15 => "#VALUE!", 
				23 => "#REF!", 
				29 => "#NAME?", 
				36 => "#NUM!", 
				42 => "#N/A", 
				byte.MaxValue => "#CIRCULARITY!", 
				_ => value.ToString(Utilities.CurrentCulture), 
			};
		}

		internal static ErrorValue FromValue(byte value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				0 => EmptyCellRangeIntersection, 
				7 => DivisionByZero, 
				15 => WrongOperandType, 
				23 => InvalidCellReference, 
				29 => WrongFunctionName, 
				36 => ValueRangeOverflow, 
				42 => ArgumentOrFunctionNotAvailable, 
				byte.MaxValue => Circularity, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal ExcelCalcErrorValue ToCalcErrorValue()
		{
			return new ExcelCalcErrorValue(CalcUtilities.GetCalcErrorCode(value));
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.Filtering
