	public abstract class Filter
	{
		private WorksheetTableColumn _owner;

		internal CultureInfo Culture
		{
			get
			{
				if (_owner == null || _owner.Table == null)
				{
					return Utilities.CurrentCulture;
				}
				return _owner.Table.Culture;
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetTableColumn Owner => _owner;

		internal Filter(WorksheetTableColumn owner)
		{
			_owner = owner;
		}

		internal static GetCellTextResult GetCellText(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			if (row == null)
			{
				return new GetCellTextResult("");
			}
			GetCellTextParameters getCellTextParameters = new GetCellTextParameters(columnIndex);
			getCellTextParameters.TextFormatMode = TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth;
			getCellTextParameters.PreventTextFormattingTypes = PreventTextFormattingTypes.None;
			getCellTextParameters.UseCalculatedValues = true;
			return row.GetCellTextInternal(getCellTextParameters);
		}

		internal abstract bool HasSameData(Filter filter);

		internal abstract bool MeetsCriteria(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex);

		internal virtual bool OnBeforeFilterColumn(Worksheet worksheet, int firstRowIndex, int lastRowIndex, short columnIndex)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal void OnModified()
		{
			if (_owner != null)
			{
				_owner.OnFilterModified();
			}
		}

		internal void SetOwner(WorksheetTableColumn owner)
		{
			_owner = owner;
		}

		internal virtual bool ShouldSaveIn2003Formats(out bool needsAUTOFILTER12Record, out IList<string> allowedTextValues)
		{
			needsAUTOFILTER12Record = true;
			allowedTextValues = null;
			return true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DynamicValuesFilter : Filter
	{
		internal int Type2003 => (int)Type2007;

		internal abstract ST_DynamicFilterType Type2007 { get; }

		internal DynamicValuesFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		internal static DynamicValuesFilter CreateDynamicValuesFilter(WorkbookLoadManager loadManager, WorksheetTableColumn column, ST_DynamicFilterType type, double? value, double? maxValue)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DateTime? dateTime = GetDateTime(loadManager, maxValue);
			if ((int)type == 1 || (int)type == 2)
			{
				return CreateDynamicValuesFilter(column, type, value, null, dateTime);
			}
			return CreateDynamicValuesFilter(column, type, null, GetDateTime(loadManager, value), dateTime);
		}

		internal static DynamicValuesFilter CreateDynamicValuesFilter(WorksheetTableColumn column, ST_DynamicFilterType type, double? value, DateTime? valIsoValue, DateTime? maxValIsoValue)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a4: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00d4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011c: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if ((int)type == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (type - 24)
			{
			case 0:
			case 1:
			case 2:
			case 3:
				return new DatePeriodFilter(column, DatePeriodFilterType.Quarter, (byte)(type - 24) + 1);
			case 4:
			case 5:
			case 6:
			case 7:
			case 8:
			case 9:
			case 10:
			case 11:
			case 12:
			case 13:
			case 14:
			case 15:
				return new DatePeriodFilter(column, DatePeriodFilterType.Month, (byte)(type - 28) + 1);
			default:
			{
				if ((int)type == 1 || (int)type == 2)
				{
					AverageFilterType type2 = (((int)type != 1) ? AverageFilterType.BelowAverage : AverageFilterType.AboveAverage);
					if (value.HasValue)
					{
						return new AverageFilter(column, type2, value.Value);
					}
					return new AverageFilter(column, type2);
				}
				if ((int)type == 23)
				{
					if (valIsoValue.HasValue && maxValIsoValue.HasValue)
					{
						return new YearToDateFilter(column, valIsoValue.Value, maxValIsoValue.Value);
					}
					return new YearToDateFilter(column);
				}
				RelativeDateRangeOffset offset;
				RelativeDateRangeDuration duration;
				switch (type - 8)
				{
				case 0:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Next;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Day;
					break;
				case 1:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Current;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Day;
					break;
				case 2:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Previous;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Day;
					break;
				case 3:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Next;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Week;
					break;
				case 4:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Current;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Week;
					break;
				case 5:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Previous;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Week;
					break;
				case 6:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Next;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Month;
					break;
				case 7:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Current;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Month;
					break;
				case 8:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Previous;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Month;
					break;
				case 9:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Next;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Quarter;
					break;
				case 10:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Current;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Quarter;
					break;
				case 11:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Previous;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Quarter;
					break;
				case 12:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Next;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Year;
					break;
				case 13:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Current;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Year;
					break;
				case 14:
					offset = RelativeDateRangeOffset.Previous;
					duration = RelativeDateRangeDuration.Year;
					break;
				default:
					return null;
				}
				if (valIsoValue.HasValue && maxValIsoValue.HasValue)
				{
					return new RelativeDateRangeFilter(column, offset, duration, valIsoValue.Value, maxValIsoValue.Value);
				}
				return new RelativeDateRangeFilter(column, offset, duration);
			}
			}
		}

		private static DateTime? GetDateTime(WorkbookLoadManager loadManager, double? value)
		{
			if (!value.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ExcelCalcValue.ExcelDateToDateTime(loadManager.Workbook, value.Value);
		}
	}
	public class AverageFilter : DynamicValuesFilter
	{
		private double _average;

		private AverageFilterType _type;

		internal override ST_DynamicFilterType Type2007 => (ST_DynamicFilterType)(Type switch
		{
			AverageFilterType.AboveAverage => 1, 
			AverageFilterType.BelowAverage => 2, 
			_ => 0, 
		});

		public double Average => _average;

		public AverageFilterType Type
		{
			get
			{
				return _type;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Type != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(value);
					_type = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		internal AverageFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, AverageFilterType type)
			: base(owner)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(type);
			_type = type;
		}

		internal AverageFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, AverageFilterType type, double average)
			: this(owner, type)
		{
			_average = average;
		}

		internal override bool HasSameData(Filter filter)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, filter))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(filter is AverageFilter averageFilter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_average == averageFilter._average)
			{
				return _type == averageFilter._type;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool MeetsCriteria(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			object cellValue = WorksheetRow.GetCellValue(row, columnIndex);
			if (Utilities.TryGetNumericValue(worksheet.Workbook, cellValue, out var numericValue))
			{
				switch (Type)
				{
				case AverageFilterType.AboveAverage:
					return _average < numericValue;
				case AverageFilterType.BelowAverage:
					return numericValue < _average;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool OnBeforeFilterColumn(Worksheet worksheet, int firstRowIndex, int lastRowIndex, short columnIndex)
		{
			Workbook workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex))
			{
				object cellValueInternal = item.GetCellValueInternal(columnIndex);
				if (Utilities.TryGetNumericValue(workbook, cellValueInternal, out var numericValue))
				{
					num += numericValue;
					num2++;
				}
				if (cellValueInternal is ErrorValue)
				{
					_average = 0.0;
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (num2 == 0)
			{
				_average = 0.0;
				return true;
			}
			_average = num / (double)num2;
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class CustomFilter : Filter
	{
		private CustomFilterCondition _condition1;

		private CustomFilterCondition _condition2;

		private ConditionalOperator _conditionalOperator;

		public CustomFilterCondition Condition1
		{
			get
			{
				return _condition1;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Condition1 != value)
				{
					if (value == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
					}
					_condition1 = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		public CustomFilterCondition Condition2
		{
			get
			{
				return _condition2;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Condition2 != value)
				{
					_condition2 = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		public ConditionalOperator ConditionalOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return _conditionalOperator;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ConditionalOperator != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(value);
					_conditionalOperator = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		internal CustomFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, CustomFilterCondition condition)
			: this(owner, condition, null, ConditionalOperator.And)
		{
		}

		internal CustomFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, CustomFilterCondition condition1, CustomFilterCondition condition2, ConditionalOperator conditionalOperator)
			: base(owner)
		{
			if (condition1 == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("condition1");
			}
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(conditionalOperator);
			_condition1 = condition1;
			_condition2 = condition2;
			_conditionalOperator = conditionalOperator;
		}

		internal override bool HasSameData(Filter filter)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, filter))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(filter is CustomFilter customFilter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_conditionalOperator == customFilter._conditionalOperator && object.Equals(_condition1, customFilter._condition1))
			{
				return object.Equals(_condition2, customFilter._condition2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool MeetsCriteria(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			object cellValue = WorksheetRow.GetCellValue(row, columnIndex);
			bool flag = Condition1.MeetsCriteria(worksheet, row, columnIndex, cellValue);
			if (Condition2 == null)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			if (ConditionalOperator == ConditionalOperator.And)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Condition2.MeetsCriteria(worksheet, row, columnIndex, cellValue);
		}

		internal override bool ShouldSaveIn2003Formats(out bool needsAUTOFILTER12Record, out IList<string> allowedTextValues)
		{
			needsAUTOFILTER12Record = false;
			allowedTextValues = new List<string>();
			string resolvedSearchString = _condition1.GetResolvedSearchString();
			if (255 < resolvedSearchString.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			allowedTextValues.Add(resolvedSearchString);
			if (_condition2 != null)
			{
				resolvedSearchString = _condition2.GetResolvedSearchString();
				if (255 < resolvedSearchString.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				allowedTextValues.Add(resolvedSearchString);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class CustomFilterCondition
	{
		internal const string WildcardNChars = "*";

		internal const string WildcardSingleChar = "?";

		private readonly ExcelComparisonOperator _comparisonOperator;

		private readonly bool _hasWildcards;

		private readonly Regex _searchRegex;

		private readonly string _stringValue;

		private readonly object _value;

		public ExcelComparisonOperator ComparisonOperator => _comparisonOperator;

		public object Value => _value;

		internal bool HasWildcards => _hasWildcards;

		public CustomFilterCondition(ExcelComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, double value)
			: this(comparisonOperator, (object)value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidCustomFilterOperandNumber"), "value");
			}
		}

		public CustomFilterCondition(ExcelComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, DateTime value)
			: this(comparisonOperator, (object)value)
		{
			if (!ExcelCalcValue.DateTimeToExcelDate(null, value).HasValue)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidExcelDate"), "value");
			}
		}

		public CustomFilterCondition(ExcelComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, TimeSpan value)
			: this(comparisonOperator, (object)value)
		{
		}

		public CustomFilterCondition(ExcelComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, string value)
			: this(comparisonOperator, (object)value)
		{
		}

		internal CustomFilterCondition(ExcelComparisonOperator comparisonOperator, object value)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(comparisonOperator);
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (!(value is string) && MustComparisonOperatorBeUsedWithStrings(comparisonOperator))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidCustomFilterOperator"), "value");
			}
			_comparisonOperator = comparisonOperator;
			_value = value;
			_stringValue = WorksheetCellBlock.GetDefaultValueText(value);
			_stringValue = _stringValue.Trim();
			_searchRegex = Utilities.CreateWildcardRegex(GetResolvedSearchString(), out _hasWildcards);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is CustomFilterCondition customFilterCondition))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_comparisonOperator == customFilterCondition._comparisonOperator)
			{
				return object.Equals(_value, customFilterCondition._value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _comparisonOperator.GetHashCode() ^ _value.GetHashCode();
		}

		internal static CustomFilterCondition CreateCustomFilterCondition(ST_FilterOperator operatorValue, object value)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			string text = value as string;
			bool flag = text?.StartsWith("*") ?? false;
			bool flag2 = text?.EndsWith("*") ?? false;
			object value2;
			ExcelComparisonOperator comparisonOperator;
			switch (operatorValue - 1)
			{
			case 1:
				if (text == null || text.Length == 1 || (!flag && !flag2))
				{
					value2 = value;
					comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.Equals;
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						value2 = text.Substring(1, text.Length - 2);
						comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.Contains;
					}
					else
					{
						value2 = text.Substring(1);
						comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.EndsWith;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					value2 = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1);
					comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.BeginsWith;
				}
				break;
			case 4:
				if (text == null || text.Length == 1 || (!flag && !flag2))
				{
					value2 = value;
					comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.NotEqual;
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						value2 = text.Substring(1, text.Length - 2);
						comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotContain;
					}
					else
					{
						value2 = text.Substring(1);
						comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotEndWith;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					value2 = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1);
					comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotBeginWith;
				}
				break;
			case 3:
				value2 = value;
				comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThan;
				break;
			case 5:
				value2 = value;
				comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqual;
				break;
			case 0:
				value2 = value;
				comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThan;
				break;
			case 2:
				value2 = value;
				comparisonOperator = ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqual;
				break;
			default:
				return null;
			}
			return new CustomFilterCondition(comparisonOperator, value2);
		}

		internal string GetResolvedSearchString()
		{
			string text = _stringValue;
			switch (ComparisonOperator)
			{
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.Equals:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.NotEqual:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThan:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqual:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThan:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqual:
				return text;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.BeginsWith:
				if (!text.EndsWith("*"))
				{
					text += "*";
				}
				return text;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotBeginWith:
				if (!text.EndsWith("*"))
				{
					text += "*";
				}
				return text;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.EndsWith:
				if (!text.StartsWith("*"))
				{
					text = "*" + text;
				}
				return text;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotEndWith:
				if (!text.StartsWith("*"))
				{
					text = "*" + text;
				}
				return text;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.Contains:
				if (!text.StartsWith("*"))
				{
					text = "*" + text;
				}
				if (!text.EndsWith("*"))
				{
					text += "*";
				}
				return text;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotContain:
				if (!text.StartsWith("*"))
				{
					text = "*" + text;
				}
				if (!text.EndsWith("*"))
				{
					text += "*";
				}
				return text;
			default:
				return text;
			}
		}

		internal void GetSaveValues(WorkbookSaveManager saveManager, out ST_FilterOperator operatorValue, out object value)
		{
			value = Value;
			if (Utilities.TryGetNumericValue(saveManager.Workbook, value, out var numericValue))
			{
				value = numericValue;
			}
			string resolvedSearchString = GetResolvedSearchString();
			switch (ComparisonOperator)
			{
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.Equals:
				operatorValue = (ST_FilterOperator)2;
				break;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.NotEqual:
				operatorValue = (ST_FilterOperator)5;
				break;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThan:
				operatorValue = (ST_FilterOperator)4;
				break;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqual:
				operatorValue = (ST_FilterOperator)6;
				break;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThan:
				operatorValue = (ST_FilterOperator)1;
				break;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqual:
				operatorValue = (ST_FilterOperator)3;
				break;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.BeginsWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.EndsWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.Contains:
				operatorValue = (ST_FilterOperator)2;
				value = resolvedSearchString;
				break;
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotBeginWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotEndWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotContain:
				operatorValue = (ST_FilterOperator)5;
				value = resolvedSearchString;
				break;
			default:
				operatorValue = (ST_FilterOperator)2;
				value = resolvedSearchString;
				break;
			}
		}

		internal bool MeetsCriteria(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object testValue)
		{
			bool flag = WorksheetCellBlock.IsStringValue(testValue);
			double? num = null;
			if (Utilities.TryGetNumericValue(worksheet.Workbook, Value, out var numericValue))
			{
				num = numericValue;
			}
			switch (ComparisonOperator)
			{
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.Equals:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.NotEqual:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThan:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqual:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThan:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqual:
			{
				double? num2 = null;
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						if (MathUtilities.DoubleTryParse(testValue.ToString(), worksheet.Culture, out numericValue))
						{
							num2 = numericValue;
						}
					}
					else if (Utilities.TryGetNumericValue(worksheet.Workbook, testValue, out numericValue))
					{
						num2 = numericValue;
					}
				}
				if (!num2.HasValue || !num.HasValue)
				{
					if (!flag || !(Value is string))
					{
						switch (ComparisonOperator)
						{
						case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThan:
						case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqual:
						case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThan:
						case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqual:
							return false;
						}
					}
					GetCellTextParameters getCellTextParameters2 = new GetCellTextParameters(columnIndex);
					getCellTextParameters2.TextFormatMode = TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth;
					getCellTextParameters2.PreventTextFormattingTypes = PreventTextFormattingTypes.None;
					string text2 = WorksheetCellBlock.GetCellTextInternal(worksheet, row, getCellTextParameters2, testValue).Text;
					text2 = text2.Trim();
					int num3;
					if (_hasWildcards)
					{
						if (ComparisonOperator != ExcelComparisonOperator.Equals && ComparisonOperator != ExcelComparisonOperator.NotEqual)
						{
							return true;
						}
						num3 = ((!_searchRegex.Match(text2).Success) ? 1 : 0);
					}
					else
					{
						num3 = string.Compare(text2, _stringValue, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
					}
					switch (ComparisonOperator)
					{
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.Equals:
						return num3 == 0;
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.NotEqual:
						return num3 != 0;
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThan:
						return num3 > 0;
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqual:
						return num3 >= 0;
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThan:
						return num3 < 0;
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqual:
						return num3 <= 0;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (flag || Value is string)
					{
						switch (ComparisonOperator)
						{
						case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThan:
						case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqual:
						case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThan:
						case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqual:
							return false;
						}
					}
					double num4 = MathUtilities.RoundToExcelDisplayValue(num2.Value);
					double num5 = MathUtilities.RoundToExcelDisplayValue(num.Value);
					switch (ComparisonOperator)
					{
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.Equals:
						return num4 == num5;
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.NotEqual:
						return num4 != num5;
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThan:
						return num4 > num5;
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.GreaterThanOrEqual:
						return num4 >= num5;
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThan:
						return num4 < num5;
					case ExcelComparisonOperator.LessThanOrEqual:
						return num4 <= num5;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.BeginsWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotBeginWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.EndsWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotEndWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.Contains:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotContain:
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (ComparisonOperator != ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotBeginWith && ComparisonOperator != ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotContain)
					{
						return ComparisonOperator == ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotEndWith;
					}
					return true;
				}
				GetCellTextParameters getCellTextParameters = new GetCellTextParameters(columnIndex);
				getCellTextParameters.TextFormatMode = TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth;
				getCellTextParameters.PreventTextFormattingTypes = PreventTextFormattingTypes.None;
				string text = WorksheetCellBlock.GetCellTextInternal(worksheet, row, getCellTextParameters, testValue).Text;
				text = text.Trim();
				bool success = _searchRegex.Match(text).Success;
				switch (ComparisonOperator)
				{
				case ExcelComparisonOperator.BeginsWith:
				case ExcelComparisonOperator.EndsWith:
				case ExcelComparisonOperator.Contains:
					return success;
				case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotBeginWith:
				case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotEndWith:
				case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotContain:
					return !success;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static bool MustComparisonOperatorBeUsedWithStrings(ExcelComparisonOperator comparisonOperator)
		{
			switch (comparisonOperator)
			{
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.BeginsWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotBeginWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.EndsWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotEndWith:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.Contains:
			case ExcelComparisonOperator.DoesNotContain:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	public class DatePeriodFilter : DynamicValuesFilter
	{
		private DatePeriodFilterType _type;

		private int _value;

		internal override ST_DynamicFilterType Type2007 => (ST_DynamicFilterType)(Type switch
		{
			DatePeriodFilterType.Month => (byte)(28 + (Value - 1)), 
			DatePeriodFilterType.Quarter => (byte)(24 + (Value - 1)), 
			_ => 0, 
		});

		public DatePeriodFilterType Type
		{
			get
			{
				return _type;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Type != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(value);
					ValidatedValue(value, Value);
					Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(value);
					_type = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		public int Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Value != value)
				{
					ValidatedValue(Type, value);
					_value = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		internal DatePeriodFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, DatePeriodFilterType type, int value)
			: base(owner)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(type);
			ValidatedValue(type, value);
			_type = type;
			_value = value;
		}

		internal override bool HasSameData(Filter filter)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, filter))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(filter is DatePeriodFilter datePeriodFilter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_value == datePeriodFilter._value)
			{
				return _type == datePeriodFilter._type;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool MeetsCriteria(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			if (worksheet.TryGetDateTimeFromCell(row, columnIndex, out var value))
			{
				switch (Type)
				{
				case DatePeriodFilterType.Month:
					return value.Month == Value;
				case DatePeriodFilterType.Quarter:
					return Utilities.GetQuarter(value) == Value;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void ValidatedValue(DatePeriodFilterType type, int value)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			switch (type)
			{
			case DatePeriodFilterType.Month:
				if (value < 1 || 12 < value)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				break;
			case DatePeriodFilterType.Quarter:
				if (value < 1 || 4 < value)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidDatePeriodFilterValue"), "value");
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class DateRangeFilter : DynamicValuesFilter
	{
		private DateTime _end;

		private bool _isInitialized;

		private DateTime _start;

		public DateTime End
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_isInitialized)
				{
					ReinitializeRange();
				}
				return _end;
			}
		}

		public DateTime Start
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_isInitialized)
				{
					ReinitializeRange();
				}
				return _start;
			}
		}

		internal DateRangeFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		internal DateRangeFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, DateTime start, DateTime end)
			: base(owner)
		{
			_isInitialized = true;
			_start = start;
			_end = end;
		}

		internal override bool HasSameData(Filter filter)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, filter))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(filter is DateRangeFilter dateRangeFilter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_end == dateRangeFilter._end)
			{
				return _start == dateRangeFilter._start;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal sealed override bool MeetsCriteria(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			if (worksheet.TryGetDateTimeFromCell(row, columnIndex, out var value) && _start <= value && value < _end)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal sealed override bool OnBeforeFilterColumn(Worksheet worksheet, int firstRowIndex, int lastRowIndex, short columnIndex)
		{
			ReinitializeRange();
			return true;
		}

		internal void ReinitializeRange()
		{
			_isInitialized = true;
			ReinitializeRangeHelper(out _start, out _end);
		}

		internal abstract void ReinitializeRangeHelper(out DateTime start, out DateTime end);
	}

	public class FillFilter : Filter, IColorFilter
	{
		private CellFill _fill;

		bool IColorFilter.IsCellColorFilter => true;

		public CellFill Fill
		{
			get
			{
				return _fill;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Fill != null)
				{
					if (value == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
					}
					_fill = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		internal FillFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, CellFill fill)
			: base(owner)
		{
			if (fill == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("fill");
			}
			_fill = fill;
		}

		TResult IColorFilter.Accept<TArg, TResult>(IColorFilterVisitor<TArg, TResult> visitor, TArg argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitFillFilter(this, argument);
		}

		internal override bool HasSameData(Filter filter)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, filter))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(filter is FillFilter fillFilter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Workbook workbook = null;
			if (base.Owner != null)
			{
				workbook = base.Owner.Workbook;
			}
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				return object.Equals(_fill, fillFilter._fill);
			}
			return object.Equals(_fill.ToResolvedColorFill(workbook), fillFilter._fill.ToResolvedColorFill(workbook));
		}

		internal override bool MeetsCriteria(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormatElementReadOnly = worksheet.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(row, columnIndex);
			return Utilities.CompareFillsForSortOrFilter(worksheet.Workbook, cellFormatElementReadOnly, Fill);
		}

		internal static FillFilter CreateFillFilter(WorksheetTableColumn column, WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			if (format.Fill == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CellFill cellFill = format.Fill;
			CellFillPattern cellFillPattern = cellFill as CellFillPattern;
			if (!format.DoesReverseColorsForSolidFill && cellFillPattern != null && cellFillPattern.PatternStyle == FillPatternStyle.Solid)
			{
				cellFill = new CellFillPattern(cellFillPattern.PatternColorInfo, cellFillPattern.BackgroundColorInfo, FillPatternStyle.Solid, null, isCreatedInternally: true);
			}
			return new FillFilter(column, cellFill);
		}
	}
	public class FixedDateGroup
	{
		internal struct DateRange
		{
			public DateTime End;

			public DateTime Start;

			public DateRange(DateTime start, DateTime end)
			{
				Start = start;
				End = end;
			}
		}

		private readonly DateRange _range;

		private readonly Dictionary<CalendarType, DateRange> _rangesByCalendar;

		private readonly FixedDateGroupType _type;

		private readonly DateTime _value;

		public DateTime End => _range.End;

		public DateTime Start => _range.Start;

		public FixedDateGroupType Type => _type;

		public DateTime Value => _value;

		internal ST_DateTimeGrouping DateTimeGrouping => (ST_DateTimeGrouping)(Type switch
		{
			FixedDateGroupType.Second => 5, 
			FixedDateGroupType.Minute => 4, 
			FixedDateGroupType.Hour => 3, 
			FixedDateGroupType.Day => 2, 
			FixedDateGroupType.Month => 1, 
			FixedDateGroupType.Year => 0, 
			_ => 0, 
		});

		public FixedDateGroup(FixedDateGroupType type, DateTime value)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(type);
			if (!ExcelCalcValue.DateTimeToExcelDate(null, value).HasValue)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidExcelDate"), "value");
			}
			_type = type;
			_value = value;
			_rangesByCalendar = new Dictionary<CalendarType, DateRange>();
			GetRange(null, CalendarType.None, out _range);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is FixedDateGroup fixedDateGroup))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_type == fixedDateGroup._type && _range.Start == fixedDateGroup._range.Start)
			{
				return _range.End == fixedDateGroup._range.End;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _type.GetHashCode() ^ _range.Start.GetHashCode() ^ (_range.End.GetHashCode() << 1);
		}

		public void GetRange(CalendarType calendarType, out DateTime start, out DateTime end)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(calendarType);
			GetRange(null, calendarType, out var range);
			start = range.Start;
			end = range.End;
		}

		internal static FixedDateGroup CreateFixedDateGroup(ST_DateTimeGrouping dateTimeGrouping, ushort year, ushort? month, ushort? day, ushort? hour, ushort? minute, ushort? second)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)dateTimeGrouping switch
			{
				5 => new FixedDateGroup(FixedDateGroupType.Second, new DateTime(year, month.GetValueOrDefault(), day.GetValueOrDefault(), hour.GetValueOrDefault(), minute.GetValueOrDefault(), second.GetValueOrDefault())), 
				4 => new FixedDateGroup(FixedDateGroupType.Minute, new DateTime(year, month.GetValueOrDefault(), day.GetValueOrDefault(), hour.GetValueOrDefault(), minute.GetValueOrDefault(), 0)), 
				3 => new FixedDateGroup(FixedDateGroupType.Hour, new DateTime(year, month.GetValueOrDefault(), day.GetValueOrDefault(), hour.GetValueOrDefault(), 0, 0)), 
				2 => new FixedDateGroup(FixedDateGroupType.Day, new DateTime(year, month.GetValueOrDefault(), day.GetValueOrDefault())), 
				1 => new FixedDateGroup(FixedDateGroupType.Month, new DateTime(year, month.GetValueOrDefault(), 1)), 
				0 => new FixedDateGroup(FixedDateGroupType.Year, new DateTime(year, 1, 1)), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal void GetRange(Calendar calendar, CalendarType calendarType, out DateRange range)
		{
			lock (_rangesByCalendar)
			{
				if (!_rangesByCalendar.TryGetValue(calendarType, out range))
				{
					if (calendar == null)
					{
						calendar = Utilities.CreateCalendar(calendarType);
					}
					int era = calendar.GetEra(_value);
					int year = calendar.GetYear(_value);
					DateTime start;
					DateTime end;
					switch (Type)
					{
					default:
						start = new DateTime(_value.Year, _value.Month, _value.Day, _value.Hour, _value.Minute, _value.Second);
						end = start.AddSeconds(1.0);
						break;
					case FixedDateGroupType.Minute:
						start = new DateTime(_value.Year, _value.Month, _value.Day, _value.Hour, _value.Minute, 0);
						end = start.AddMinutes(1.0);
						break;
					case FixedDateGroupType.Hour:
						start = new DateTime(_value.Year, _value.Month, _value.Day, _value.Hour, 0, 0);
						end = start.AddHours(1.0);
						break;
					case FixedDateGroupType.Day:
						start = new DateTime(_value.Year, _value.Month, _value.Day, 0, 0, 0);
						end = start.AddDays(1.0);
						break;
					case FixedDateGroupType.Month:
					{
						int month = calendar.GetMonth(_value);
						start = calendar.ToDateTime(year, month, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, era);
						end = start.AddDays(calendar.GetDaysInMonth(year, month, era));
						break;
					}
					case FixedDateGroupType.Year:
						start = calendar.ToDateTime(year, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, era);
						end = start.AddDays(calendar.GetDaysInYear(year, era));
						break;
					}
					range = new DateRange(start, end);
					_rangesByCalendar.Add(calendarType, range);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("FixedDateGroupCollection: Count - {Count}")]
	public class FixedDateGroupCollection : IList<FixedDateGroup>, ICollection<FixedDateGroup>, IEnumerable<FixedDateGroup>, IEnumerable
	{
		private FixedValuesFilter _owner;

		private List<FixedDateGroup> _fixedDateGroups = new List<FixedDateGroup>();

		bool ICollection<FixedDateGroup>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => _fixedDateGroups.Count;

		public FixedDateGroup this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _fixedDateGroups[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
				}
				int num = IndexOf(value);
				if (num < 0 || num == index)
				{
					_fixedDateGroups[index] = value;
					return;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DuplicateFixedDateGroup"), "item");
			}
		}

		internal FixedDateGroupCollection(FixedValuesFilter owner)
		{
			_owner = owner;
		}

		void ICollection<FixedDateGroup>.CopyTo(FixedDateGroup[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_fixedDateGroups.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		IEnumerator<FixedDateGroup> IEnumerable<FixedDateGroup>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _fixedDateGroups.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<FixedDateGroup>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(FixedDateGroup item)
		{
			VerifyItem(item);
			InternalInsert(_fixedDateGroups.Count, item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (_owner.GetAllowedItemCount() == _fixedDateGroups.Count)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_FixedValuesFilterMustAcceptAValue"));
			}
			for (int num = _fixedDateGroups.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				InternalRemove(num, raiseOnModified: false);
			}
			_owner.OnModified();
		}

		public bool Contains(FixedDateGroup item)
		{
			return IndexOf(item) >= 0;
		}

		public int IndexOf(FixedDateGroup item)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _fixedDateGroups.Count; i++)
			{
				if (object.Equals(item, _fixedDateGroups[i]))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, FixedDateGroup item)
		{
			VerifyItem(item);
			InternalInsert(index, item);
		}

		public bool Remove(FixedDateGroup item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (_owner.GetAllowedItemCount() == 1)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_FixedValuesFilterMustAcceptAValue"));
			}
			InternalRemove(index, raiseOnModified: true);
		}

		private void InternalInsert(int index, FixedDateGroup group)
		{
			_fixedDateGroups.Insert(index, group);
			_owner.OnModified();
		}

		private void InternalRemove(int index, bool raiseOnModified)
		{
			_ = _fixedDateGroups[index];
			_fixedDateGroups.RemoveAt(index);
			if (raiseOnModified)
			{
				_owner.OnModified();
			}
		}

		private void VerifyItem(FixedDateGroup item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			if (Contains(item))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DuplicateFixedDateGroup"), "item");
			}
		}
	}
	public class FixedValuesFilter : Filter
	{
		private Calendar _calendar;

		private CalendarType _calendarType;

		private FixedDateGroupCollection _dateGroups;

		private DisplayValueCollection _displayValues;

		private bool _includeBlanks;

		public CalendarType CalendarType
		{
			get
			{
				return _calendarType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (CalendarType != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(value);
					_calendarType = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		public FixedDateGroupCollection DateGroups
		{
			get
			{
				if (_dateGroups == null)
				{
					_dateGroups = new FixedDateGroupCollection(this);
				}
				return _dateGroups;
			}
		}

		public DisplayValueCollection DisplayValues
		{
			get
			{
				if (_displayValues == null)
				{
					_displayValues = new DisplayValueCollection(this);
				}
				return _displayValues;
			}
		}

		public bool IncludeBlanks
		{
			get
			{
				return _includeBlanks;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IncludeBlanks != value)
				{
					if (!value && GetAllowedItemCount() == 1)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_FixedValuesFilterMustAcceptAValue"));
					}
					_includeBlanks = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		internal Calendar Calendar
		{
			get
			{
				if (_calendar == null)
				{
					_calendar = Utilities.CreateCalendar(CalendarType);
				}
				return _calendar;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsEmpty => GetAllowedItemCount() == 0;

		internal FixedValuesFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		internal override bool HasSameData(Filter filter)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, filter))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(filter is FixedValuesFilter fixedValuesFilter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_includeBlanks != fixedValuesFilter._includeBlanks || _calendarType != fixedValuesFilter._calendarType || DisplayValues.Count != fixedValuesFilter.DisplayValues.Count || DateGroups.Count != fixedValuesFilter.DateGroups.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < DisplayValues.Count; i++)
			{
				if (DisplayValues[i] != fixedValuesFilter.DisplayValues[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < DateGroups.Count; j++)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(DateGroups[j], fixedValuesFilter.DateGroups[j]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool MeetsCriteria(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			GetCellTextResult cellText = Filter.GetCellText(row, columnIndex);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cellText.Text))
			{
				return IncludeBlanks;
			}
			if (_displayValues != null && _displayValues.Contains(cellText.Text))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(cellText.NumericValue) && cellText.FormattedAs == ValueFormatter.SectionType.Date && _dateGroups != null && _dateGroups.Count != 0)
			{
				DateTime? dateTime = ExcelCalcValue.ExcelDateToDateTime(worksheet.Workbook, cellText.NumericValue);
				if (dateTime.HasValue)
				{
					DateTime value = dateTime.Value;
					for (int i = 0; i < _dateGroups.Count; i++)
					{
						FixedDateGroup fixedDateGroup = _dateGroups[i];
						fixedDateGroup.GetRange(Calendar, CalendarType, out var range);
						if (range.Start <= value && value < range.End)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool ShouldSaveIn2003Formats(out bool needsAUTOFILTER12Record, out IList<string> allowedTextValues)
		{
			int allowedItemCount = GetAllowedItemCount(filterItemsOver255Characters: true, out allowedTextValues);
			needsAUTOFILTER12Record = DateGroups.Count != 0 || allowedItemCount > 2;
			return allowedItemCount != 0;
		}

		internal int GetAllowedItemCount()
		{
			IList<string> allowedTextValues;
			return GetAllowedItemCount(filterItemsOver255Characters: false, out allowedTextValues);
		}

		internal int GetAllowedItemCount(bool filterItemsOver255Characters, out IList<string> allowedTextValues)
		{
			allowedTextValues = null;
			int num = 0;
			if (IncludeBlanks)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (_dateGroups != null)
			{
				num += _dateGroups.Count;
			}
			if (_displayValues != null)
			{
				allowedTextValues = new List<string>();
				if (filterItemsOver255Characters)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < _displayValues.Count; i++)
					{
						string text = _displayValues[i];
						if (text.Length <= 255)
						{
							allowedTextValues.Add(text);
							num++;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num += _displayValues.Count;
					allowedTextValues = _displayValues;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class FontColorFilter : Filter, IColorFilter
	{
		private WorkbookColorInfo _fontColorInfo;

		bool IColorFilter.IsCellColorFilter => false;

		public WorkbookColorInfo FontColorInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return _fontColorInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(FontColorInfo == null))
				{
					if (value == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
					}
					_fontColorInfo = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		internal FontColorFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, WorkbookColorInfo fontColorInfo)
			: base(owner)
		{
			if (fontColorInfo == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("fontColorInfo");
			}
			_fontColorInfo = fontColorInfo;
		}

		TResult IColorFilter.Accept<TArg, TResult>(IColorFilterVisitor<TArg, TResult> visitor, TArg argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitFontColorFilter(this, argument);
		}

		internal override bool HasSameData(Filter filter)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, filter))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(filter is FontColorFilter fontColorFilter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Workbook workbook = null;
			if (base.Owner != null)
			{
				workbook = base.Owner.Workbook;
			}
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				return _fontColorInfo == fontColorFilter._fontColorInfo;
			}
			return Utilities.ColorToArgb(_fontColorInfo.GetResolvedColorInternal(workbook)) == Utilities.ColorToArgb(fontColorFilter._fontColorInfo.GetResolvedColorInternal(workbook));
		}

		internal override bool MeetsCriteria(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormatElementReadOnly = worksheet.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(row, columnIndex);
			WorkbookColorInfo fontColorInfoResolved = cellFormatElementReadOnly.FontColorInfoResolved;
			Workbook workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				return fontColorInfoResolved == FontColorInfo;
			}
			return fontColorInfoResolved.GetResolvedColorInternal(workbook) == FontColorInfo.GetResolvedColorInternal(workbook);
		}

		internal static FontColorFilter CreateFontColorFilter(WorksheetTableColumn column, WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			if (!(format.Fill is CellFillPattern cellFillPattern))
			{
				return null;
			}
			WorkbookColorInfo fileFormatForegroundColorInfo = cellFillPattern.GetFileFormatForegroundColorInfo(format);
			return new FontColorFilter(column, fileFormatForegroundColorInfo);
		}
	}
	internal interface IColorFilterVisitor<TArg, TResult>
	{
		TResult VisitFillFilter(FillFilter value, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitFontColorFilter(FontColorFilter value, TArg argument);
	}

	public class RelativeDateRangeFilter : DateRangeFilter
	{
		private RelativeDateRangeDuration _duration;

		private RelativeDateRangeOffset _offset;

		internal override ST_DynamicFilterType Type2007
		{
			get
			{
				ST_DynamicFilterType[] array;
				switch (Duration)
				{
				case RelativeDateRangeDuration.Day:
					array = (ST_DynamicFilterType[])(object)new ST_DynamicFilterType[3]
					{
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)10,
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)9,
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)8
					};
					break;
				case RelativeDateRangeDuration.Week:
					array = (ST_DynamicFilterType[])(object)new ST_DynamicFilterType[3]
					{
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)13,
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)12,
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)11
					};
					break;
				case RelativeDateRangeDuration.Month:
					array = (ST_DynamicFilterType[])(object)new ST_DynamicFilterType[3]
					{
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)16,
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)15,
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)14
					};
					break;
				case RelativeDateRangeDuration.Quarter:
					array = (ST_DynamicFilterType[])(object)new ST_DynamicFilterType[3]
					{
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)19,
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)18,
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)17
					};
					break;
				case RelativeDateRangeDuration.Year:
					array = (ST_DynamicFilterType[])(object)new ST_DynamicFilterType[3]
					{
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)22,
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)21,
						(ST_DynamicFilterType)20
					};
					break;
				default:
					return (ST_DynamicFilterType)0;
				}
				return array[(int)Offset];
			}
		}

		public RelativeDateRangeDuration Duration
		{
			get
			{
				return _duration;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Duration != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(value);
					_duration = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		public RelativeDateRangeOffset Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return _offset;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Offset != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(value);
					_offset = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		internal RelativeDateRangeFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, RelativeDateRangeOffset offset, RelativeDateRangeDuration duration)
			: base(owner)
		{
			Initialize(offset, duration);
		}

		internal RelativeDateRangeFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, RelativeDateRangeOffset offset, RelativeDateRangeDuration duration, DateTime start, DateTime end)
			: base(owner, start, end)
		{
			Initialize(offset, duration);
		}

		private void Initialize(RelativeDateRangeOffset offset, RelativeDateRangeDuration duration)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(offset);
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(duration);
			_offset = offset;
			_duration = duration;
		}

		internal override bool HasSameData(Filter filter)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, filter))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(filter is RelativeDateRangeFilter relativeDateRangeFilter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_duration == relativeDateRangeFilter._duration && _offset == relativeDateRangeFilter._offset)
			{
				return base.HasSameData((Filter)relativeDateRangeFilter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void ReinitializeRangeHelper(out DateTime start, out DateTime end)
		{
			DateTime value = (end = (start = DateTime.Now));
			int num;
			switch (Offset)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case RelativeDateRangeOffset.Previous:
				num = -1;
				break;
			case RelativeDateRangeOffset.Current:
				num = 0;
				break;
			case RelativeDateRangeOffset.Next:
				num = 1;
				break;
			}
			switch (Duration)
			{
			case RelativeDateRangeDuration.Day:
				start = value.Date.AddDays(num);
				end = start.AddDays(1.0);
				break;
			case RelativeDateRangeDuration.Week:
				start = value.Date.AddDays(0 - value.DayOfWeek).AddDays(num * 7);
				end = start.AddDays(7.0);
				break;
			case RelativeDateRangeDuration.Month:
				start = new DateTime(value.Year, value.Month, 1).AddMonths(num);
				end = start.AddMonths(1);
				break;
			case RelativeDateRangeDuration.Quarter:
			{
				int num2 = value.Year;
				int num3 = Utilities.GetQuarter(value) + num;
				if (num3 < 1)
				{
					num2--;
					num3 += 4;
				}
				else if (4 < num3)
				{
					num2++;
					num3 -= 4;
				}
				start = new DateTime(num2, Utilities.GetFirstMonthOfQuarter(num3), 1);
				end = start.AddMonths(3);
				break;
			}
			case RelativeDateRangeDuration.Year:
				start = new DateTime(value.Year, 1, 1).AddYears(num);
				end = start.AddYears(1);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public class TopOrBottomFilter : DynamicValuesFilter
	{
		private double _referenceValue;

		private TopOrBottomFilterType _type;

		private int _value;

		[DebuggerBrowsable(DebuggerBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal override ST_DynamicFilterType Type2007 => (ST_DynamicFilterType)0;

		public TopOrBottomFilterType Type
		{
			get
			{
				return _type;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Type != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(value);
					_type = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		public int Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Value != value)
				{
					ValidateValue(value);
					_value = value;
					OnModified();
				}
			}
		}

		internal ST_FilterOperator FilterOperator
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsTop)
				{
					return (ST_FilterOperator)3;
				}
				return (ST_FilterOperator)6;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsPercent
		{
			get
			{
				if (Type != TopOrBottomFilterType.BottomPercentage)
				{
					return Type == TopOrBottomFilterType.TopPercentage;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsTop
		{
			get
			{
				if (Type != TopOrBottomFilterType.TopValues)
				{
					return Type == TopOrBottomFilterType.TopPercentage;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal double ReferenceValue => _referenceValue;

		internal TopOrBottomFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner)
			: this(owner, TopOrBottomFilterType.TopValues, 10)
		{
		}

		internal TopOrBottomFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, TopOrBottomFilterType type, int value)
			: base(owner)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(type);
			ValidateValue(value);
			_type = type;
			_value = value;
		}

		internal TopOrBottomFilter(WorksheetTableColumn owner, TopOrBottomFilterType type, int value, double referenceValue)
			: this(owner, type, value)
		{
			_referenceValue = referenceValue;
		}

		internal override bool HasSameData(Filter filter)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, filter))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(filter is TopOrBottomFilter topOrBottomFilter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_referenceValue == topOrBottomFilter._referenceValue && _type == topOrBottomFilter._type)
			{
				return _value == topOrBottomFilter._value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool MeetsCriteria(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			object cellValue = WorksheetRow.GetCellValue(row, columnIndex);
			if (Utilities.TryGetNumericValue(worksheet.Workbook, cellValue, out var numericValue))
			{
				if (IsTop)
				{
					return _referenceValue <= numericValue;
				}
				return numericValue <= _referenceValue;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool OnBeforeFilterColumn(Worksheet worksheet, int firstRowIndex, int lastRowIndex, short columnIndex)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			Workbook workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex))
			{
				object cellValueInternal = item.GetCellValueInternal(columnIndex);
				if (cellValueInternal is ErrorValue errorValue && errorValue != ErrorValue.Circularity)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Utilities.TryGetNumericValue(workbook, cellValueInternal, out var numericValue))
				{
					list.Add(numericValue);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			list.Sort();
			int num = ((!IsPercent) ? Math.Min(list.Count, Value) : (list.Count * Math.Min(100, Value) / 100));
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsTop)
			{
				_referenceValue = list[list.Count - num];
			}
			else
			{
				_referenceValue = list[num - 1];
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool ShouldSaveIn2003Formats(out bool needsAUTOFILTER12Record, out IList<string> allowedTextValues)
		{
			needsAUTOFILTER12Record = false;
			allowedTextValues = null;
			return true;
		}

		internal static TopOrBottomFilterType GetFilterType(bool percent, bool top)
		{
			if (percent)
			{
				if (top)
				{
					return TopOrBottomFilterType.TopPercentage;
				}
				return TopOrBottomFilterType.BottomPercentage;
			}
			if (top)
			{
				return TopOrBottomFilterType.TopValues;
			}
			return TopOrBottomFilterType.BottomValues;
		}

		private static void ValidateValue(int value)
		{
			if (value < 1 || 500 < value)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidTopOrBottomFilterValue"));
			}
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel

	internal class FixedLengthSegmentTree<T>
	{
		private class SegmentTreeNode
		{
			internal int nodeStartValue;

			internal int nodeEndValue;

			private List<T> itemsCoveringSubtree;

			private SegmentTreeNode leftChild;

			private SegmentTreeNode rightChild;

			public SegmentTreeNode(int nodeStartValue, int nodeEndValue)
			{
				this.nodeStartValue = nodeStartValue;
				this.nodeEndValue = nodeEndValue;
			}

			private void AddItemsToCollection<TCol>(HashSet<T> allowedItems, ref TCol collection, Func<TCol> collectionFactory) where TCol : ICollection<T>
			{
				AddItemsToCollection(itemsCoveringSubtree, allowedItems, ref collection, collectionFactory);
			}

			private static void AddItemsToCollection<TCol>(List<T> items, HashSet<T> allowedItems, ref TCol collection, Func<TCol> collectionFactory) where TCol : ICollection<T>
			{
				if (items == null || items.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (T item in items)
				{
					if (allowedItems == null || allowedItems.Remove(item))
					{
						if (collection == null)
						{
							collection = collectionFactory();
						}
						collection.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}

			public void GetBoundaryValue(bool getStartBoundary, ref int value)
			{
				(getStartBoundary ? leftChild : rightChild)?.GetBoundaryValue(getStartBoundary, ref value);
				if (value < 0 && itemsCoveringSubtree != null && itemsCoveringSubtree.Count != 0)
				{
					value = (getStartBoundary ? nodeStartValue : nodeEndValue);
				}
				else
				{
					(getStartBoundary ? rightChild : leftChild)?.GetBoundaryValue(getStartBoundary, ref value);
				}
			}

			public void GetItemsContainingRange<TCol>(FixedLengthSegmentTree<T> owner, int start, int end, HashSet<T> allowedItems, ref TCol items, Func<TCol> itemsFactory) where TCol : ICollection<T>
			{
				if (start < nodeStartValue || nodeEndValue < end)
				{
					return;
				}
				AddItemsToCollection(allowedItems, ref items, itemsFactory);
				if (nodeStartValue == nodeEndValue)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = (nodeEndValue + nodeStartValue) / 2;
				bool flag = start <= num;
				bool flag2 = end <= num;
				if (flag == flag2)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						if (leftChild != null)
						{
							leftChild.GetItemsContainingRange(owner, start, end, allowedItems, ref items, itemsFactory);
						}
					}
					else if (rightChild != null)
					{
						rightChild.GetItemsContainingRange(owner, start, end, allowedItems, ref items, itemsFactory);
					}
				}
				else if (leftChild != null && rightChild != null)
				{
					HashSet<T> items2 = null;
					leftChild.GetItemsContainingValue(start, allowedItems, ref items2, owner._owner.HashSetFactory);
					if (items2 != null)
					{
						List<T> items3 = null;
						rightChild.GetItemsContainingValue(end, items2, ref items3, owner._owner.ListFactory);
						AddItemsToCollection(items3, allowedItems, ref items, itemsFactory);
					}
				}
			}

			public void GetItemsContainingValue<TCol>(int value, HashSet<T> allowedItems, ref TCol items, Func<TCol> itemsFactory) where TCol : ICollection<T>
			{
				AddItemsToCollection(allowedItems, ref items, itemsFactory);
				if (nodeStartValue == nodeEndValue)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = (nodeEndValue + nodeStartValue) / 2;
				if (value <= num)
				{
					if (leftChild != null)
					{
						leftChild.GetItemsContainingValue(value, allowedItems, ref items, itemsFactory);
					}
				}
				else if (rightChild != null)
				{
					rightChild.GetItemsContainingValue(value, allowedItems, ref items, itemsFactory);
				}
			}

			public void GetItemsIntersectingWithRange<TCol>(int start, int end, HashSet<T> allowedItems, ref TCol items, Func<TCol> itemsFactory) where TCol : ICollection<T>, new()
			{
				if (end < nodeStartValue || nodeEndValue < start)
				{
					return;
				}
				AddItemsToCollection(allowedItems, ref items, itemsFactory);
				if (nodeStartValue != nodeEndValue)
				{
					int num = (nodeEndValue + nodeStartValue) / 2;
					if (start <= num && leftChild != null)
					{
						leftChild.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(start, end, allowedItems, ref items, itemsFactory);
					}
					if (num < end && rightChild != null)
					{
						rightChild.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(start, end, allowedItems, ref items, itemsFactory);
					}
				}
			}

			public void Insert(FixedLengthSegmentTree<T> owner, T item, int segmentStartValue, int segmentEndValue)
			{
				if (segmentStartValue <= nodeStartValue && nodeEndValue <= segmentEndValue)
				{
					if (itemsCoveringSubtree == null)
					{
						itemsCoveringSubtree = new List<T>();
					}
					itemsCoveringSubtree.Add(item);
					owner.totalCount++;
					return;
				}
				int num = (nodeEndValue + nodeStartValue) / 2;
				if (segmentStartValue <= num)
				{
					if (leftChild == null)
					{
						leftChild = new SegmentTreeNode(nodeStartValue, num);
					}
					leftChild.Insert(owner, item, segmentStartValue, segmentEndValue);
				}
				if (num < segmentEndValue)
				{
					if (rightChild == null)
					{
						rightChild = new SegmentTreeNode(num + 1, nodeEndValue);
					}
					rightChild.Insert(owner, item, segmentStartValue, segmentEndValue);
				}
			}

			public void Remove(FixedLengthSegmentTree<T> owner, T item, int segmentStartValue, int segmentEndValue)
			{
				if (segmentStartValue <= nodeStartValue && nodeEndValue <= segmentEndValue)
				{
					if (itemsCoveringSubtree != null && itemsCoveringSubtree.Remove(item))
					{
						owner.totalCount--;
					}
					return;
				}
				int num = (nodeEndValue + nodeStartValue) / 2;
				if (segmentStartValue <= num && leftChild != null)
				{
					leftChild.Remove(owner, item, segmentStartValue, segmentEndValue);
				}
				if (num < segmentEndValue && rightChild != null)
				{
					rightChild.Remove(owner, item, segmentStartValue, segmentEndValue);
				}
			}

			public void SetExistingChildNode(SegmentTreeNode existingNode)
			{
				int num = (nodeEndValue + nodeStartValue) / 2;
				if (existingNode.nodeEndValue <= num)
				{
					if (existingNode.nodeStartValue == nodeStartValue && existingNode.nodeEndValue == num)
					{
						leftChild = existingNode;
						return;
					}
					leftChild = new SegmentTreeNode(nodeStartValue, num);
					leftChild.SetExistingChildNode(existingNode);
				}
				else if (num < existingNode.nodeStartValue)
				{
					if (existingNode.nodeStartValue == num + 1 && existingNode.nodeEndValue == nodeEndValue)
					{
						rightChild = existingNode;
						return;
					}
					rightChild = new SegmentTreeNode(num + 1, nodeEndValue);
					rightChild.SetExistingChildNode(existingNode);
				}
			}
		}

		private SegmentTreeNode head;

		private readonly int _maxValue;

		private readonly RegionLookupTable<T> _owner;

		private int totalCount;

		public bool IsEmpty => totalCount == 0;

		public FixedLengthSegmentTree(RegionLookupTable<T> owner, int maxValue)
		{
			_owner = owner;
			_maxValue = maxValue;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			head = null;
		}

		private SegmentTreeNode CreateNode(int segmentStartValue, int segmentEndValue, int minimumNodeWidth)
		{
			int num;
			int num2;
			while (true)
			{
				num = segmentStartValue - segmentStartValue % minimumNodeWidth;
				num2 = num + minimumNodeWidth - 1;
				if (_maxValue <= num2)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (segmentEndValue <= num2)
				{
					break;
				}
				minimumNodeWidth *= 2;
			}
			return new SegmentTreeNode(num, num2);
		}

		public void GetBoundingIndexes(out int firstValue, out int lastValue)
		{
			firstValue = -1;
			lastValue = -1;
			if (head != null)
			{
				head.GetBoundaryValue(getStartBoundary: true, ref firstValue);
				head.GetBoundaryValue(getStartBoundary: false, ref lastValue);
			}
			else
			{
				firstValue = -1;
				lastValue = -1;
			}
		}

		public List<T> GetItemsContainingRange(int start, int end, HashSet<T> allowedItems)
		{
			List<T> items = null;
			if (head != null && head.nodeStartValue <= start && end <= head.nodeEndValue)
			{
				head.GetItemsContainingRange(this, start, end, allowedItems, ref items, _owner.ListFactory);
			}
			return items;
		}

		public HashSet<T> GetItemsContainingRangeSet(int start, int end)
		{
			HashSet<T> items = null;
			if (head != null && head.nodeStartValue <= start && end <= head.nodeEndValue)
			{
				head.GetItemsContainingRange(this, start, end, null, ref items, _owner.HashSetFactory);
			}
			return items;
		}

		public List<T> GetItemsContainingValue(int value, HashSet<T> allowedItems)
		{
			List<T> items = null;
			if (head != null && head.nodeStartValue <= value && value <= head.nodeEndValue)
			{
				head.GetItemsContainingValue(value, allowedItems, ref items, _owner.ListFactory);
			}
			return items;
		}

		public HashSet<T> GetItemsContainingValueSet(int value)
		{
			HashSet<T> items = null;
			if (head != null && head.nodeStartValue <= value && value <= head.nodeEndValue)
			{
				head.GetItemsContainingValue(value, null, ref items, _owner.HashSetFactory);
			}
			return items;
		}

		public List<T> GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(int start, int end, HashSet<T> allowedItems)
		{
			List<T> items = null;
			if (head != null && start <= head.nodeEndValue && head.nodeStartValue <= end)
			{
				head.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(start, end, allowedItems, ref items, _owner.ListFactory);
			}
			return items;
		}

		public HashSet<T> GetItemsIntersectingWithRangeSet(int start, int end)
		{
			HashSet<T> items = null;
			if (head != null && start <= head.nodeEndValue && head.nodeStartValue <= end)
			{
				head.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(start, end, null, ref items, _owner.HashSetFactory);
			}
			return items;
		}

		public void Insert(T item, int segmentStartValue, int segmentEndValue)
		{
			if (head == null)
			{
				head = CreateNode(segmentStartValue, segmentEndValue, 8);
			}
			else if (segmentStartValue < head.nodeStartValue || head.nodeEndValue < segmentEndValue)
			{
				int minimumNodeWidth = head.nodeEndValue - head.nodeStartValue + 1;
				SegmentTreeNode existingChildNode = head;
				head = CreateNode(Math.Min(segmentStartValue, head.nodeStartValue), Math.Max(segmentEndValue, head.nodeEndValue), minimumNodeWidth);
				head.SetExistingChildNode(existingChildNode);
			}
			head.Insert(this, item, segmentStartValue, segmentEndValue);
		}

		public void Remove(T item, int segmentStartValue, int segmentEndValue)
		{
			if (head != null)
			{
				head.Remove(this, item, segmentStartValue, segmentEndValue);
			}
		}
	}

		internal StringElement RemoveCarriageReturns(Workbook workbook)
		{
			string text = UnformattedString;
			int num = text.IndexOf('\r');

					text = text.Insert(num, "\n");

	internal class FormattedStringElement : StringElement, IFormattedRunOwner
	{

		int IFormattedRunOwner.StartIndex => 0;

		public List<FormattingRunBase> FormattingRuns
		{
			get
			{
				if (formattingRuns == null)
				{
					formattingRuns = new List<FormattingRunBase>();
				}
				return formattingRuns;
			}
		}

		public override bool HasFormatting
		{
			get
			{
				if (formattingRuns != null)
				{
					return formattingRuns.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public FormattedStringElement()
			: this(StringElement.EmptyStringUTF8)
		{
		}

		public FormattedStringElement(byte[] unformattedStringUTF8)
			: base(unformattedStringUTF8)

		}

		public FormattedStringElement(string unformattedString)
			: base(unformattedString)
		{
		}

		internal override TResult Accept<TArg, TResult>(IStringElementVisitor<TArg, TResult> visitor, TArg argument = default(TArg))
		{
			return visitor.VisitFormattedStringElement(this, argument);
		}

		public override object Clone(Workbook workbook)
		{
			FormattedStringElement formattedStringElement = new FormattedStringElement(base.UnformattedStringUTF8);
			if (HasFormatting)
			{
				foreach (FormattingRunBase formattingRun in FormattingRuns)
				{
					formattedStringElement.FormattingRuns.Add(formattingRun.Clone(workbook, formattedStringElement));
				}
			}
			return formattedStringElement;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return base.Equals(obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = base.UnformattedString.GetHashCode();
			if (HasFormatting)
			{
				num += FormattingRuns.Count;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override bool HasSameData(GenericCacheElement otherElement)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, otherElement))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(otherElement is FormattedStringElement formattedStringElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (formattedStringElement.UnformattedString != base.UnformattedString)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = (HasFormatting ? FormattingRuns.Count : 0);
			int num2 = (formattedStringElement.HasFormatting ? formattedStringElement.FormattingRuns.Count : 0);
			if (num != num2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (!FormattingRuns[i].Equals(formattedStringElement.FormattingRuns[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnUnformattedStringChanged()
		{
			if (HasFormatting)
			{
				Utilities.TrimFormattingRuns(this);
			}
		}

		void IFormattedRunOwner.AddRun(FormattingRunBase run)
		{
			if (run is FormattedStringRun item)
			{
				FormattingRuns.Add(item);
			}
		}

		FormattingRunBase IFormattedRunOwner.CreateRun(int absoluteStartIndex)
		{
			return new FormattedStringRun(this, absoluteStartIndex);
		}

		List<FormattingRunBase> IFormattedRunOwner.GetFormattingRuns(Workbook workbook)
		{
			return FormattingRuns;
		}

		void IFormattedRunOwner.InsertRun(int runIndex, FormattingRunBase run)
		{
			if (run is FormattedStringRun item)
			{
				FormattingRuns.Insert(runIndex, item);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearFormatting()
		{
			if (!HasFormatting)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < formattingRuns.Count; i++)
			{
				FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase = formattingRuns[i];
				if (formattingRunBase.HasFont)
				{
					formattingRunBase.GetFontInternal().OnUnrooted();
				}
			}
			formattingRuns = null;
		}

		internal static FormattedStringElement Create(StringElement element)
		{
			return new FormattedStringElement(element.UnformattedStringUTF8);
		}
	}
	internal class FormattedStringValueReference : IFormattedString
	{
		private StringElement element;

		private GenericCachedCollection<StringElement> sharedStringTable;

		private object value;

		public StringElement Element => element;

		public object Value => value;

		public FormattedStringValueReference(object value, Workbook workbook)
		{
			sharedStringTable = workbook?.SharedStringTable;
			this.value = value;
			string unformattedString = this.value.ToString();
			if (value is char && (char)value == '\0')
			{
				unformattedString = string.Empty;
			}
			element = GenericCacheElement.FindExistingOrAddToCache(new StringElement(unformattedString), sharedStringTable);
		}

		void IFormattedString.SetWorkbook(Workbook workbook)
		{
			StringElement.SetWorkbook(workbook, ref sharedStringTable, ref element);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return element.ToString();
		}
	}
