	public class FormattedStringFont : FormattedFontBase
	{
		internal override bool AllowDefaultValues => !(FormattedString.Owner is WorksheetCell);

		internal override FormattingRunBase StartingRun
		{
			get
			{
				FormattedString formattedString = FormattedString;
				if (formattedString.Element is FormattedStringElement { HasFormatting: not false } formattedStringElement)
				{
					FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase = TryGetFirstRunControllingCharacter(formattedStringElement.FormattingRuns, base.StartIndex);
					if (formattingRunBase != null)
					{
						return formattingRunBase;
					}
				}
				WorksheetCell worksheetCell = formattedString.Owner as WorksheetCell;
				if (worksheetCell != null && worksheetCell.Row != null)
				{
					IWorkbookFont font = worksheetCell.Row.GetResolvedCellFormatInternal(worksheetCell.ColumnIndexInternal).Font;
					return new CellFormattingRunPlaceholder(formattedString.Element, font);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal override Worksheet Worksheet => FormattedString?.Worksheet;

		internal override Workbook Workbook => FormattedString?.Workbook;

		public FormattedString FormattedString => (FormattedString)base.FormattedItem;

		internal FormattedStringFont(FormattedString formattedString, int startIndex, int length)
			: base(formattedString, startIndex, length)
		{
		}

		internal override IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver GetFontDefaultsResolver(Workbook workbook)
		{
			WorksheetCell worksheetCell = FormattedString.Owner as WorksheetCell;
			if (worksheetCell == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = worksheetCell.Worksheet;
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return worksheetCell.Row.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(worksheetCell.ColumnIndexInternal);
		}

		internal override void GetRunsInRange(Workbook workbook, List<FormattingRunBase> runs, int firstCharacterAfterFont, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver fontDefaultsResolver, out FormattingRunBase lastRunEnumerated)
		{
			lastRunEnumerated = null;
			FormattedString formattedString = FormattedString;
			if (formattedString.Element is FormattedStringElement { HasFormatting: not false } formattedStringElement)
			{
				GetRunsFromOwnerInRange(formattedStringElement, workbook, runs, firstCharacterAfterFont, fontDefaultsResolver, ref lastRunEnumerated);
			}
			if (lastRunEnumerated == null)
			{
				WorksheetCell worksheetCell = formattedString.Owner as WorksheetCell;
				if (worksheetCell != null)
				{
					lastRunEnumerated = StartingRun;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void AfterSet()
		{
			FormattedString formattedString = FormattedString;
			uint key = formattedString.Element.Key;
			formattedString.AfterSet();
			WorksheetCell worksheetCell = formattedString.Owner as WorksheetCell;
			if (worksheetCell != null && worksheetCell.Row != null)
			{
				uint key2 = formattedString.Element.Key;
				if (key != key2)
				{
					worksheetCell.Row.UpdateFormattedStringElementOnCell(worksheetCell.ColumnIndexInternal, formattedString.Element);
				}
			}
			base.AfterSet();
		}

		internal override void BeforeSet()
		{
			FormattedString.BeforeSet();
		}
	}
	internal class FormattedStringRun : FormattingRunBase, IComparable<FormattedStringRun>
	{
		private WorkbookFontProxy font;

		public override bool HasFont
		{
			get
			{
				if (font == null)
				{
					return FirstFormattedCharAbsolute == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override int FirstFormattedCharAbsolute
		{
			get
			{
				return base.FirstFormattedCharInOwner;
			}
			set
			{
				base.FirstFormattedCharInOwner = value;
			}
		}

		public FormattedStringRun(FormattedStringElement formattedString, int firstFormattedChar)
			: base(formattedString, firstFormattedChar)
		{
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is FormattedStringRun formattedStringRun))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.FirstFormattedCharInOwner != formattedStringRun.FirstFormattedCharInOwner)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(font, formattedStringRun.font))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override IWorkbookFont GetFont(Workbook workbook)
		{
			return GetFontInternal(workbook);
		}

		public override WorkbookFontProxy GetFontInternal(Workbook workbook)
		{
			return GetFontInternal(workbook, ref font);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return GetFontInternal().GetHashCode() + FirstFormattedCharAbsolute;
		}

		public int CompareTo(FormattedStringRun other)
		{
			return base.FirstFormattedCharInOwner - other.FirstFormattedCharInOwner;
		}
	}
	public class FormattedTextFont : FormattedFontBase
	{
		internal override FormattingRunBase StartingRun
		{
			get
			{
				FormattedText formattedText = FormattedText;
				Workbook workbook = formattedText.Workbook;
				List<FormattingRunBase> list = null;
				for (int num = formattedText.Paragraphs.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					FormattedTextParagraph formattedTextParagraph = formattedText.Paragraphs[num];
					List<FormattingRunBase> formattingRuns = formattedTextParagraph.GetFormattingRuns(workbook);
					FormattingRunBase formattingRunBase = TryGetFirstRunControllingCharacter(formattingRuns, base.StartIndex);
					if (formattingRunBase != null)
					{
						if (formattedTextParagraph.StartIndex + formattedTextParagraph.UnformattedString.Length <= base.StartIndex && list != null && list.Count != 0)
						{
							return list[0];
						}
						return formattingRunBase;
					}
					list = formattingRuns;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal override Worksheet Worksheet => FormattedText?.Worksheet;

		internal override Workbook Workbook => FormattedText?.Workbook;

		public FormattedText FormattedText => (FormattedText)base.FormattedItem;

		internal FormattedTextFont(FormattedText formattedString, int startIndex, int length)
			: base(formattedString, startIndex, length)
		{
		}

		internal override void GetRunsInRange(Workbook workbook, List<FormattingRunBase> runs, int firstCharacterAfterFont, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver fontDefaultsResolver, out FormattingRunBase lastRunEnumerated)
		{
			lastRunEnumerated = null;
			FormattedText formattedText = FormattedText;
			for (int i = 0; i < formattedText.Paragraphs.Count; i++)
			{
				FormattedTextParagraph owner = formattedText.Paragraphs[i];
				GetRunsFromOwnerInRange(owner, workbook, runs, firstCharacterAfterFont, fontDefaultsResolver, ref lastRunEnumerated);
				if (lastRunEnumerated != null && firstCharacterAfterFont <= lastRunEnumerated.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Paragraph: {UnformattedString}")]
	public class FormattedTextParagraph : IFormattedRunOwner
	{
		private HorizontalTextAlignment alignment = HorizontalTextAlignment.Left;

		private readonly string endingNewLine;

		private List<FormattingRunBase> formattingRuns;

		private FormattedText formattedText;

		private int startIndex;

		private string unformattedString;

		public HorizontalTextAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				return alignment;
			}
			set
			{
				if (alignment != value)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(HorizontalTextAlignment), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(HorizontalTextAlignment));
					}
					alignment = value;
					formattedText.OnFormattingChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public FormattedText FormattedText => formattedText;

		public int StartIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return startIndex;
			}
			internal set
			{
				startIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public string UnformattedString
		{
			get
			{
				return unformattedString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(UnformattedString == value))
				{
					if (value == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentNullException("unformattedString", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_UnformattedString"));
					}
					int lengthResolved = LengthResolved;
					unformattedString = value;
					Utilities.TrimFormattingRuns(this);
					if (formattedText != null)
					{
						formattedText.OnParagraphUnformattedStringChanged(this, lengthResolved, LengthResolved);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal string EndingNewLine => endingNewLine;

		internal int LengthResolved => GetLengthResolved(null);

		internal Worksheet Worksheet
		{
			get
			{
				if (formattedText == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return formattedText.Worksheet;
			}
		}

		internal Workbook Workbook
		{
			get
			{
				if (formattedText == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return formattedText.Workbook;
			}
		}

		internal FormattedTextParagraph(FormattedText owner, int startIndex, string unformattedString, string endingNewLine)
		{
			if (unformattedString == null)
			{
				unformattedString = string.Empty;
			}
			formattedText = owner;
			StartIndex = startIndex;
			this.unformattedString = unformattedString;
			this.endingNewLine = endingNewLine ?? "\n";
			formattingRuns = new List<FormattingRunBase>();
		}

		void IFormattedRunOwner.AddRun(FormattingRunBase run)
		{
			if (run is FormattedTextRun item)
			{
				formattingRuns.Add(item);
			}
		}

		FormattingRunBase IFormattedRunOwner.CreateRun(int absoluteStartIndex)
		{
			return new FormattedTextRun(this, absoluteStartIndex - startIndex);
		}

		List<FormattingRunBase> IFormattedRunOwner.GetFormattingRuns(Workbook workbook)
		{
			return GetFormattingRuns(workbook);
		}

		void IFormattedRunOwner.InsertRun(int runIndex, FormattingRunBase run)
		{
			if (run is FormattedTextRun item)
			{
				formattingRuns.Insert(runIndex, item);
			}
		}

		internal void AddFormattingRun(FormattedTextRun run)
		{
			InsertFormattingRun(formattingRuns.Count, run);
		}

		internal FormattedTextParagraph Clone(FormattedText newOwner)
		{
			FormattedTextParagraph formattedTextParagraph = new FormattedTextParagraph(newOwner, startIndex, unformattedString, endingNewLine);
			formattedTextParagraph.alignment = alignment;
			for (int i = 0; i < formattingRuns.Count; i++)
			{
				formattedTextParagraph.formattingRuns.Add(((FormattedTextRun)formattingRuns[i]).Clone(Workbook, formattedTextParagraph));
			}
			return formattedTextParagraph;
		}

		internal List<FormattingRunBase> GetFormattingRuns(Workbook workbook)
		{
			VerifyFormattingRuns(workbook);
			return formattingRuns;
		}

		internal void InsertFormattingRun(int runIndex, FormattedTextRun run)
		{
			formattingRuns.Insert(runIndex, run);
			VerifyFormattingRuns(null);
		}

		internal void OnRemovedFromFormattedString()
		{
			formattedText = null;
			StartIndex = 0;
		}

		private void VerifyFormattingRuns(Workbook workbook)
		{
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				workbook = Workbook;
			}
			if (formattingRuns.Count == 0 || formattingRuns[0].FirstFormattedCharAbsolute != startIndex)
			{
				formattingRuns.Insert(0, new FormattedTextRun(this, 0));
			}
		}

		internal int GetLengthResolved(bool? isLastParagraph)
		{
			if (!isLastParagraph.HasValue)
			{
				if (formattedText != null)
				{
					FormattedTextParagraphCollection paragraphs = formattedText.Paragraphs;
					isLastParagraph = paragraphs[paragraphs.Count - 1] == this;
				}
				else
				{
					isLastParagraph = false;
				}
			}
			int num = unformattedString.Length;
			if (!isLastParagraph.Value)
			{
				num += endingNewLine.Length;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class FormattedTextParagraphCollection : ICollection<FormattedTextParagraph>, IEnumerable<FormattedTextParagraph>, IEnumerable
	{
		private FormattedText owner;

		private List<FormattedTextParagraph> paragraphs = new List<FormattedTextParagraph>();

		bool ICollection<FormattedTextParagraph>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => paragraphs.Count;

		public FormattedTextParagraph this[int index] => paragraphs[index];

		internal FormattedTextParagraphCollection(FormattedText owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		void ICollection<FormattedTextParagraph>.Add(FormattedTextParagraph paragraph)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotAddParagraphDirectly"));
		}

		void ICollection<FormattedTextParagraph>.CopyTo(FormattedTextParagraph[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			paragraphs.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public FormattedTextParagraph Add(string paragraphText)
		{
			return Insert(paragraphs.Count, paragraphText);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = paragraphs.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(FormattedTextParagraph paragraph)
		{
			return paragraphs.Contains(paragraph);
		}

		public IEnumerator<FormattedTextParagraph> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return paragraphs.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public int IndexOf(FormattedTextParagraph paragraph)
		{
			return paragraphs.IndexOf(paragraph);
		}

		public FormattedTextParagraph Insert(int index, string paragraphText)
		{
			if (index < 0 || paragraphs.Count < index)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_BadInsertIndex"));
			}
			int startIndex = 0;
			if (0 < index)
			{
				FormattedTextParagraph formattedTextParagraph = paragraphs[index - 1];
				startIndex = formattedTextParagraph.StartIndex + formattedTextParagraph.GetLengthResolved(false);
			}
			FormattedTextParagraph formattedTextParagraph2 = new FormattedTextParagraph(owner, startIndex, paragraphText, null);
			InsertInternal(index, formattedTextParagraph2, null);
			return formattedTextParagraph2;
		}

		public bool Remove(FormattedTextParagraph paragraph)
		{
			if (paragraph.FormattedText != owner)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = paragraphs.IndexOf(paragraph);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || paragraphs.Count <= index)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_BadRemoveAtIndex"));
			}
			FormattedTextParagraph formattedTextParagraph = paragraphs[index];
			int lengthResolved = formattedTextParagraph.LengthResolved;
			paragraphs.RemoveAt(index);
			formattedTextParagraph.OnRemovedFromFormattedString();
			for (int i = index; i < paragraphs.Count; i++)
			{
				paragraphs[i].StartIndex -= lengthResolved;
			}
			owner.ClearCache();
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(FormattedTextParagraphCollection other)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < other.paragraphs.Count; i++)
			{
				paragraphs.Add(other.paragraphs[i].Clone(owner));
			}
		}

		internal void InsertInternal(int index, FormattedTextParagraph paragraph, string newLine)
		{
			if (0 < index)
			{
				paragraph.Alignment = paragraphs[index - 1].Alignment;
			}
			else if (index < paragraphs.Count)
			{
				paragraph.Alignment = paragraphs[index].Alignment;
			}
			int lengthResolved = paragraph.GetLengthResolved(index == paragraphs.Count);
			for (int i = index; i < paragraphs.Count; i++)
			{
				paragraphs[i].StartIndex += lengthResolved;
			}
			paragraphs.Insert(index, paragraph);
			owner.ClearCache();
		}
	}

	{

			}

		}

		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.FormulaUtilities
{
	internal class AddInFunctionResolver : FormulaTokenEvaluator<FormulaToken>
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static AddInFunctionResolver _instance;

		private AddInFunctionResolver()
		{
		}

		protected override FormulaToken EvaluateBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token, FormulaToken firstOperand, FormulaToken secondOperand)
		{
			return token;
		}

		protected override FormulaToken EvaluateFunctionToken(IFunctionToken token, FormulaToken functionName, FormulaToken[] arguments)
		{
			if (token.Function == Function.AddInFunction && functionName is NameToken nameToken)
			{
				token.Function = Function.GetFunction(nameToken.Name);
				NamedReferenceBase namedReference = nameToken.NamedReference;
				if (namedReference.Type == NameType.Normal)
				{
					nameToken.NamedReference = base.Context.Workbook.AddInFunctionsWorkbookReference.GetNamedReference(namedReference.Name, namedReference.Scope, createIfNotPresent: true);
				}
			}
			return token.FormulaToken;
		}

		protected override FormulaToken EvaluateOperandToken(OperandToken token)
		{
			return token;
		}

		protected override FormulaToken EvaluateParenToken(ParenToken token, FormulaToken contents)
		{
			return token;
		}

		protected override FormulaToken EvaluateUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token, FormulaToken operand)
		{
			return token;
		}

		public static AddInFunctionResolver Initialize(FormulaContext context)
		{
			if (_instance == null)
			{
				_instance = new AddInFunctionResolver();
			}
			_instance.Context = context;
			return _instance;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.FormulaUtilities.CalcEngine

	internal class AppliedFormula : IExcelCalcFormula
	{
		private ExcelCalcValue _calculatedValue;

		private readonly Formula _formula;

		private readonly AppliedFormulaReferenceCollection _references;

		private readonly RefBase _targetReference;

		IExcelCalcReference IExcelCalcFormula.BaseReference => TargetReference;

		IExcelCalcReferenceCollection IExcelCalcFormula.DynamicReferences => References.GetDynamicReferences();

		string IExcelCalcFormula.FormulaString => Formula.ToString();

		IExcelCalcReferenceCollection IExcelCalcFormula.References => References.GetStaticReferences();

		public ExcelCalcValue CalculatedValue
		{
			get
			{
				return _calculatedValue;
			}
			set
			{
				_calculatedValue = value;
			}
		}

		public Formula Formula => _formula;

		public bool HasAlwaysDirty => Formula.RecalculateAlways;

		public bool IsArrayFormula => Formula.Type == FormulaType.ArrayFormula;

		public AppliedFormulaReferenceCollection References => _references;

		public RefBase TargetReference => _targetReference;

		public AppliedFormula(Formula formula, RefBase targetReference, Workbook workbook)
		{
			_targetReference = targetReference;
			_formula = formula;
			_references = new AppliedFormulaReferenceCollection(this, workbook);
		}

		public AppliedFormula(WorksheetDataTable dataTable, RefBase targetReference, Workbook workbook)
			: this(dataTable.InteriorCellFormula, targetReference, workbook)
		{
			_calculatedValue = new ExcelCalcValue(0.0);
		}

		bool IExcelCalcFormula.AddDynamicReference(IExcelCalcReference reference)
		{
			ExcelCalcEngine calcEngine = null;
			Workbook workbook = TargetReference.Workbook;
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				calcEngine = workbook.CalcEngine;
			}
			return AddDynamicReference(reference, calcEngine);
		}

		ExcelCalcValue IExcelCalcFormula.Evaluate(IExcelCalcReference reference)
		{
			return EvaluateHelper(TargetReference.Workbook, reference, isInOptimizableSelector: false);
		}

		public bool AddDynamicReference(IExcelCalcReference reference, ExcelCalcEngine calcEngine)
		{
			IExcelCalcReference resolvedReference = ExcelCalcEngine.GetResolvedReference(reference);
			if (resolvedReference is ExcelReferenceError || resolvedReference is NamedCalcReferenceUnconnected)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return References.TryAddDynamicReference(resolvedReference, this, calcEngine);
		}

		public ExcelCalcValue Evaluate(Workbook workbook)
		{
			if (_targetReference.IsNamedReference)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return EvaluateHelper(workbook, _targetReference, isInOptimizableSelector: false);
		}

		public ExcelCalcValue EvaluateHelper(Workbook workbook, IExcelCalcReference ultimateTargetReference, bool isInOptimizableSelector)
		{
			if (_formula.IsDataTableInterior)
			{
				return _calculatedValue;
			}
			if (TargetReference.IsInNamedReferenceOnlyCircularity)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Name));
			}
			try
			{
				ExcelCalcNumberStack excelCalcNumberStack = new ExcelCalcNumberStack(ultimateTargetReference, this);
				excelCalcNumberStack.IsInOptimizableSelector = isInOptimizableSelector;
				FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(workbook, _formula);
				FormulaEvaluator formulaEvaluator = FormulaEvaluator.Initialize(context, TargetReference, excelCalcNumberStack);
				formulaEvaluator.VisitAll();
				if (excelCalcNumberStack.Count() == 0)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value));
				}
				ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = excelCalcNumberStack.Pop();
				if (excelCalcValue.Value is UltraCalcErrorException)
				{
					excelCalcValue = new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(((UltraCalcErrorException)excelCalcValue.Value).Value.Code));
				}
				return excelCalcValue;
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(value);
			}
		}

		public void OnAfterRecalculationOperation(ExcelCalcEngine calcEngine)
		{
			if (_references != null)
			{
				_references.ClearStaleDynamicReferences(this, calcEngine);
			}
		}
	}

	}

		private class StaticReferenceResolver : FormulaTokenEvaluator<StaticReferenceResolver.FormulaTokenNode>
		{
			public class FormulaTokenNode
			{
				private FormulaTokenNode[] _children;

				private FormulaToken _formulaToken;

				private bool _mayBeIgnored;

				private ushort _tokenIndex;

				public FormulaTokenNode[] Children => _children;

				public FormulaToken FormulaToken => _formulaToken;

				public bool MayBeIgnored
				{
					get
					{
						return _mayBeIgnored;
					}
					set
					{
						_mayBeIgnored = value;
					}
				}

				public ushort TokenIndex => _tokenIndex;

				public FormulaTokenNode(FormulaToken formulaToken, ushort tokenIndex)
				{
					_formulaToken = formulaToken;
					_tokenIndex = tokenIndex;
				}

				public FormulaTokenNode(FormulaToken formulaToken, ushort tokenIndex, params FormulaTokenNode[] children)
					: this(formulaToken, tokenIndex)
				{
					_children = children;
				}
			}

			[ThreadStatic]
			private static StaticReferenceResolver _instance;

			private Formula.ArgumentInfo?[] _argumentInfo;

			private StaticReferenceResolver()
			{
			}

			public override void Reset()
			{
				_argumentInfo = null;
				base.Reset();
			}

			protected override FormulaTokenNode EvaluateBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token, FormulaTokenNode firstOperand, FormulaTokenNode secondOperand)
			{
				ushort currentTokenIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
				ref Formula.ArgumentInfo? reference = ref _argumentInfo[firstOperand.TokenIndex];
				reference = new Formula.ArgumentInfo(currentTokenIndex, 0);
				ref Formula.ArgumentInfo? reference2 = ref _argumentInfo[secondOperand.TokenIndex];
				reference2 = new Formula.ArgumentInfo(currentTokenIndex, 1);
				return new FormulaTokenNode(token, currentTokenIndex, firstOperand, secondOperand);
			}

			protected override FormulaTokenNode EvaluateFunctionToken(IFunctionToken token, FormulaTokenNode functionName, FormulaTokenNode[] arguments)
			{
				ushort currentTokenIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
				Function function = token.Function;
				bool isOptimizableSelector = function.IsOptimizableSelector;
				for (ushort num = 0; num < arguments.Length; num++)
				{
					FormulaTokenNode formulaTokenNode = arguments[num];
					ref Formula.ArgumentInfo? reference = ref _argumentInfo[formulaTokenNode.TokenIndex];
					reference = new Formula.ArgumentInfo(currentTokenIndex, num);
					if (isOptimizableSelector && num != 0)
					{
						formulaTokenNode.MayBeIgnored = true;
					}
				}
				return new FormulaTokenNode(token.FormulaToken, currentTokenIndex, arguments);
			}

			protected override FormulaTokenNode EvaluateOperandToken(OperandToken token)
			{
				return new FormulaTokenNode(token, _currentTokenIndex);
			}

			protected override FormulaTokenNode EvaluateParenToken(ParenToken token, FormulaTokenNode contents)
			{
				ushort currentTokenIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
				ref Formula.ArgumentInfo? reference = ref _argumentInfo[contents.TokenIndex];
				reference = new Formula.ArgumentInfo(currentTokenIndex, 0);
				return new FormulaTokenNode(token, currentTokenIndex, contents);
			}

			protected override FormulaTokenNode EvaluateUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token, FormulaTokenNode operand)
			{
				ushort currentTokenIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
				ref Formula.ArgumentInfo? reference = ref _argumentInfo[operand.TokenIndex];
				reference = new Formula.ArgumentInfo(currentTokenIndex, 0);
				return new FormulaTokenNode(token, currentTokenIndex, operand);
			}

			public override bool VisitTblToken(TblToken token)
			{
				_stack.Push(new FormulaTokenNode(token, _currentTokenIndex));
				return true;
			}

			public static StaticReferenceResolver Initialize(FormulaContext context, Formula.ArgumentInfo?[] argumentInfo)
			{
				if (_instance == null)
				{
					_instance = new StaticReferenceResolver();
				}
				_instance.Context = context;
				_instance._argumentInfo = argumentInfo;
				return _instance;
			}
		}

		private BitArray _dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags;

		private readonly List<IExcelCalcReference> _references;

		private readonly int _staticReferenceCount;

		public AppliedFormulaReferenceCollection(AppliedFormula appliedFormula, Workbook workbook)
		{
			_references = new List<IExcelCalcReference>();
			FormulaContext formulaContext = new FormulaContext(workbook, appliedFormula.Formula);
			Formula.ArgumentInfo?[] argumentInfo = new Formula.ArgumentInfo?[formulaContext.Formula.PostfixTokenList.Length];
			StaticReferenceResolver staticReferenceResolver = StaticReferenceResolver.Initialize(formulaContext, argumentInfo);
			EvaluationResult<StaticReferenceResolver.FormulaTokenNode> evaluationResult = staticReferenceResolver.Evaluate();
			if (evaluationResult.Completed)
			{
				formulaContext.Formula.OnArgumentInfoGenerated(argumentInfo);
				UltraCalcFunctionFactory functionFactory = workbook.CalcEngine.FunctionFactory;
				AddStaticReferences(formulaContext, appliedFormula, functionFactory, evaluationResult.Result);
				_staticReferenceCount = _references.Count;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<IExcelCalcReference> IEnumerable<IExcelCalcReference>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _references.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _references.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void ClearStaleDynamicReferences(AppliedFormula appliedFormula, ExcelCalcEngine calcEngine)
		{
			int dynamicReferenceCount = GetDynamicReferenceCount();
			if (_dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags == null || dynamicReferenceCount == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = dynamicReferenceCount - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (!_dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags.Get(num))
				{
					int totalIndex = GetTotalIndex(num);
					IExcelCalcReference predecessor = _references[totalIndex];
					_references.RemoveAt(totalIndex);
					calcEngine.RemoveDynamicPredecessor(predecessor, appliedFormula.TargetReference);
				}
			}
			_dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags.SetAll(value: false);
		}

		public IExcelCalcReferenceCollection GetDynamicReferences()
		{
			return new DynamicReferenceCollection(this);
		}

		public IExcelCalcReferenceCollection GetStaticReferences()
		{
			return new StaticReferenceCollection(this);
		}

		public bool TryAddDynamicReference(IExcelCalcReference resolvedReference, AppliedFormula appliedFormula, ExcelCalcEngine calcEngine)
		{
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < _staticReferenceCount; i++)
			{
				if (_references[i].IsSubsetReference(resolvedReference))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (resolvedReference is CellCalcReference cellCalcReference)
			{
				int num = BinarySearchDynamicCells(cellCalcReference);
				if (0 <= num)
				{
					OnDynamicReferenceUsed(GetDynamicIndex(num));
					return false;
				}
				InsertReference(cellCalcReference, ~num, out var dynamicIndex);
				OnDynamicReferenceUsed(dynamicIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				int count = _references.Count;
				int num2 = 0;
				while (i < count)
				{
					IExcelCalcReference excelCalcReference = _references[i];
					if (!(excelCalcReference is CellCalcReference) && excelCalcReference.Equals(resolvedReference))
					{
						OnDynamicReferenceUsed(num2);
						return false;
					}
					i++;
					num2++;
				}
				int dynamicIndex2 = GetDynamicIndex(_references.Count);
				_references.Add(resolvedReference);
				OnDynamicReferenceUsed(dynamicIndex2);
			}
			calcEngine?.AddDynamicDependency(resolvedReference, appliedFormula.TargetReference);
			return true;
		}

		private void AddStaticReferences(FormulaContext context, AppliedFormula appliedFormula, UltraCalcFunctionFactory functionFactory, StaticReferenceResolver.FormulaTokenNode parentNode)
		{
			if (parentNode.MayBeIgnored)
			{
				return;
			}
			int parentTokenIndex;
			int argumentIndex;
			if (!(parentNode.FormulaToken is OperandToken currentArgument))
			{
				StaticReferenceResolver.FormulaTokenNode[] children = parentNode.Children;
				if (children != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < children.Length; i++)
					{
						AddStaticReferences(context, appliedFormula, functionFactory, children[i]);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (!context.Formula.TryGetArgumentInfo(parentNode.TokenIndex, out parentTokenIndex, out argumentIndex))
			{
				TryAddStaticReference(context, appliedFormula, currentArgument, willParameterBeDereferenced: true, CalcUtilities.GetExpectedFormulaResultTokenClass(appliedFormula.TargetReference));
			}
			else
			{
				FormulaToken formulaToken = context.Formula.PostfixTokenList[parentTokenIndex];
				ExcelCalcFunction excelCalcFunction = formulaToken.Accept(GetCalcFunctionVisitor.Instance, functionFactory);
				if (excelCalcFunction != null)
				{
					TryAddStaticReference(context, appliedFormula, currentArgument, excelCalcFunction.WillParameterBeDereferenced(argumentIndex), excelCalcFunction.GetExpectedParameterClass(argumentIndex));
				}
			}
		}

		private int BinarySearchDynamicCells(CellCalcReference cellReference)
		{
			int num = GetTotalIndex(0);
			int num2 = _references.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num) / 2;
				int num4 = CompareCells(cellReference, _references[num3] as CellCalcReference);
				if (num4 == 0)
				{
					return num3;
				}
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
				}
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		private static int CompareCells(CellCalcReference cellReference, CellCalcReference testValue)
		{
			if (cellReference == testValue)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (testValue == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			int num = testValue.ColumnIndex - cellReference.ColumnIndex;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = testValue.Row.Index - cellReference.Row.Index;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return testValue.Worksheet.SheetId - cellReference.Worksheet.SheetId;
		}

		private void EnsureDynamicReferencesSize(int dynamicIndex)
		{
			if (_dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags == null)
			{
				_dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags = new BitArray(dynamicIndex + 1);
			}
			else if (_dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags.Length <= dynamicIndex)
			{
				_dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags.Length *= 2;
			}
		}

		private int GetDynamicReferenceCount()
		{
			return _references.Count - _staticReferenceCount;
		}

		private int GetDynamicIndex(int totalIndex)
		{
			return totalIndex - _staticReferenceCount;
		}

		private int GetTotalIndex(int dynamicReferenceIndex)
		{
			return dynamicReferenceIndex + _staticReferenceCount;
		}

		private void InsertReference(IExcelCalcReference resolvedReference, int referenceIndex, out int dynamicIndex)
		{
			dynamicIndex = GetDynamicIndex(referenceIndex);
			if (_dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags != null)
			{
				int dynamicReferenceCount = GetDynamicReferenceCount();
				EnsureDynamicReferencesSize(dynamicReferenceCount);
				for (int num = dynamicReferenceCount - 1; num >= dynamicIndex; num--)
				{
					_dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags.Set(num + 1, _dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags.Get(num));
				}
			}
			_references.Insert(referenceIndex, resolvedReference);
		}

		private void OnDynamicReferenceUsed(int dynamicIndex)
		{
			EnsureDynamicReferencesSize(dynamicIndex);
			_dynamicReferencesAreUsedFlags.Set(dynamicIndex, value: true);
		}

		private void TryAddStaticReference(FormulaContext context, AppliedFormula appliedFormula, OperandToken currentArgument, bool willParameterBeDereferenced, TokenClass expectedParameterClass)
		{
			if (!willParameterBeDereferenced || !(currentArgument is ReferenceToken referenceToken) || (appliedFormula.TargetReference.IsNamedReference && referenceToken.HasRelativeAddresses) || (referenceToken is NameToken nameToken && nameToken.NamedReference.Type == NameType.AddInFunctionName) || !(referenceToken.GetCalcValue(context) is IExcelCalcReference excelCalcReference))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (context.Formula.Type == FormulaType.ArrayFormula && expectedParameterClass == TokenClass.Value)
			{
				object context2 = excelCalcReference.Context;
				if (context2 is WorksheetRegion { IsSingleCell: false } || (context2 is List<WorksheetRegion> list && (list.Count != 1 || !list[0].IsSingleCell)))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			_references.Add(excelCalcReference);
		}
	}
	internal class CalculationNetworkLinkedList : IEnumerable<RefBase>, IEnumerable
	{
		private RefBase _firstReference;

		private RefBase _lastReference;

		public RefBase FirstReference => _firstReference;

		public RefBase LastReference => _lastReference;

		public IEnumerator<RefBase> GetEnumerator()
		{
			for (RefBase current = _firstReference; current != null; current = current.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork)
			{
				yield return current;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void AddAfter(RefBase afterNode, RefBase value)
		{
			if (afterNode == null)
			{
				if (_firstReference != null)
				{
					_firstReference.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork = value;
				}
				value.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork = _firstReference;
				_firstReference = value;
				if (_lastReference == null)
				{
					_lastReference = value;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				value.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork = afterNode;
				if (afterNode.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork != null)
				{
					afterNode.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork = value;
					value.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork = afterNode.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				}
				afterNode.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork = value;
				if (_lastReference == afterNode)
				{
					_lastReference = value;
				}
			}
			value.IsInCalcNetwork = true;
		}

		public void AddBefore(RefBase beforeNode, RefBase value)
		{
			if (beforeNode == null)
			{
				if (_lastReference != null)
				{
					_lastReference.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork = value;
				}
				value.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork = _lastReference;
				_lastReference = value;
				if (_firstReference == null)
				{
					_firstReference = value;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				value.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork = beforeNode;
				if (beforeNode.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork != null)
				{
					beforeNode.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork = value;
					value.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork = beforeNode.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				}
				beforeNode.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork = value;
				if (_firstReference == beforeNode)
				{
					_firstReference = value;
				}
			}
			value.IsInCalcNetwork = true;
		}

		public void AddToBeginning(RefBase value)
		{
			AddAfter(null, value);
		}

		public void AddToEnd(RefBase value)
		{
			AddBefore(null, value);
		}

		public void Remove(RefBase value)
		{
			if (value.IsInCalcNetwork)
			{
				if (_firstReference == value)
				{
					_firstReference = value.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				}
				if (_lastReference == value)
				{
					_lastReference = value.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				}
				if (value.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork != null)
				{
					value.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork = value.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				}
				if (value.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork != null)
				{
					value.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork = value.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				}
				value.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork = null;
				value.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork = null;
				value.IsInCalcNetwork = false;
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			RefBase refBase = _firstReference;
			while (refBase != null)
			{
				RefBase nextReferenceInCalcNetwork = refBase.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				refBase.ResetCalcNetworkInfo();
				refBase = nextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
			}
			_firstReference = null;
			_lastReference = null;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.FormulaUtilities.CalcEngine
{
	internal static class CalcUtilities
	{
		public static bool ContainsReferenceHelper(WorksheetRegion referenceRegion, IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			if (referenceRegion == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (inReference.Context is CellCalcReference { Row: var row, ColumnIndex: var columnIndex })
			{
				return referenceRegion.Contains(row, columnIndex);
			}
			if (inReference.Context is WorksheetRegion region)
			{
				return referenceRegion.IntersectsWith(region);
			}
			if (inReference.Context is List<WorksheetRegion> list)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetRegion item in list)
				{
					if (referenceRegion.IntersectsWith(item))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static ExcelCalcValue CreateExcelCalcValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null || value is double || value is string)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(value);
			}
			if (value is ErrorValue errorValue)
			{
				if (errorValue == ErrorValue.Circularity)
				{
					return new ExcelCalcValue(0);
				}
				return new ExcelCalcValue(errorValue.ToCalcErrorValue());
			}
			if (value is FormattedString || value is StringBuilder || value is char || value is StringElement || value is FormattedStringValueReference)
			{
				value = value.ToString();
			}
			return new ExcelCalcValue(value);
		}

		public static ExcelCalcErrorCode GetCalcErrorCode(int excelErrorCode)
		{
			return excelErrorCode switch
			{
				42 => ExcelCalcErrorCode.NA, 
				7 => ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div, 
				0 => ExcelCalcErrorCode.Null, 
				23 => ExcelCalcErrorCode.Reference, 
				29 => ExcelCalcErrorCode.Name, 
				15 => ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value, 
				_ => ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num, 
			};
		}

		internal static TokenClass GetExpectedFormulaResultTokenClass(IExcelCalcReference reference)
		{
			if (reference == null)
			{
				return TokenClass.Value;
			}
			reference = ExcelCalcEngine.GetResolvedReference(reference);
			if (reference is CellCalcReference)
			{
				return TokenClass.Value;
			}
			if (reference is NamedCalcReferenceBase)
			{
				return TokenClass.Reference;
			}
			return TokenClass.Value;
		}

		public static IExcelCalcReference GetReference(string name, WorksheetRow originCellRow, short originCellColumnIndex, Worksheet worksheet, Workbook workbook)
		{
			return GetReference(name, originCellRow, originCellColumnIndex, worksheet, workbook, CellReferenceMode.A1);
		}

		public static IExcelCalcReference GetReference(string name, WorksheetRow originCellRow, short originCellColumnIndex, Worksheet worksheet, Workbook workbook, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				bool isNamedReference;
				RefBase refBase = workbook.ParseReference(name.TrimEnd(), cellReferenceMode, worksheet, originCellRow, originCellColumnIndex, out isNamedReference);
				if (refBase != null)
				{
					return refBase;
				}
			}
			return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
		}

		public static ExcelCalcValue[,] GetReferenceValuesForRegion(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			if (region == null)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue[0, 0];
			}
			if (region.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue[1, 1] { 
				{
					new ExcelCalcValue(ErrorValue.InvalidCellReference.ToCalcErrorValue())
				} };
			}
			ExcelCalcValue[,] array = new ExcelCalcValue[region.Width, region.Height];
			int num = region.FirstRow;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num <= region.LastRow)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = region.Worksheet.Rows[num];
				short num3 = region.FirstColumnInternal;
				short num4 = 0;
				while (num3 <= region.LastColumnInternal)
				{
					array[num4, num2] = CreateExcelCalcValue(worksheetRow.GetCellCalcReference(num3));
					num3++;
					num4++;
				}
				num++;
				num2++;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static IList<WorksheetRegion> GetRegionGroup(IExcelCalcReference reference)
		{
			if (!(ExcelCalcEngine.GetResolvedReference(reference) is RefBase refBase))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return refBase.GetRegionGroup() ?? ((IList<WorksheetRegion>)WorksheetRegion.EmptyArray);
		}

		internal static CellCalcReference GetSingleReference(CellCalcReference formulaOwner, WorksheetRegion region, out ExcelCalcErrorValue errorValue)
		{
			if (region.Worksheet == null)
			{
				errorValue = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Reference);
				return null;
			}
			errorValue = null;
			if (!SplitArrayForArrayFormula(formulaOwner, region.Width, region.Height, out var relativeColumn, out var relativeRow))
			{
				errorValue = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.NA);
				return null;
			}
			int index = relativeRow + region.FirstRow;
			short columnIndex = (short)(relativeColumn + region.FirstColumnInternal);
			return region.Worksheet.Rows[index].GetCellCalcReference(columnIndex);
		}

		public static object GetValueFormExcelCalcValue(object resolvedValue, bool getHyperlinkFriendlyName)
		{
			if (Utilities.IsNullResolved(resolvedValue))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (resolvedValue is ErrorValue)
			{
				return resolvedValue;
			}
			if (resolvedValue is string || resolvedValue is bool || resolvedValue is DateTime)
			{
				return resolvedValue;
			}
			if (!(resolvedValue is ExcelCalcErrorValue excelCalcErrorValue))
			{
				if (resolvedValue is HyperlinkResult hyperlinkResult)
				{
					if (getHyperlinkFriendlyName)
					{
						return hyperlinkResult.FriendlyName;
					}
					return hyperlinkResult;
				}
				try
				{
					double num = Convert.ToDouble(resolvedValue);
					if (double.IsNaN(num))
					{
						return ErrorValue.DivisionByZero;
					}
					return num;
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException)
				{
					return resolvedValue;
				}
			}
			return excelCalcErrorValue.Code switch
			{
				ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value => ErrorValue.WrongOperandType, 
				ExcelCalcErrorCode.Div => ErrorValue.DivisionByZero, 
				ExcelCalcErrorCode.NA => ErrorValue.ArgumentOrFunctionNotAvailable, 
				ExcelCalcErrorCode.Num => ErrorValue.ValueRangeOverflow, 
				ExcelCalcErrorCode.Null => ErrorValue.EmptyCellRangeIntersection, 
				ExcelCalcErrorCode.Name => ErrorValue.WrongFunctionName, 
				ExcelCalcErrorCode.Circularity => ErrorValue.Circularity, 
				_ => ErrorValue.InvalidCellReference, 
			};
		}

		public static bool IsSubsetReferenceHelper(WorksheetRegion referenceRegion, IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			if (referenceRegion == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (inReference.Context is CellCalcReference { Row: var row, ColumnIndex: var columnIndex })
			{
				return referenceRegion.Contains(row, columnIndex);
			}
			if (inReference.Context is WorksheetRegion region)
			{
				return referenceRegion.Contains(region);
			}
			if (inReference.Context is List<WorksheetRegion> list)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetRegion item in list)
				{
					if (referenceRegion.Contains(item))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static ExcelCalcValue SplitArrayForArrayFormula(ArrayProxy array, CellCalcReference formulaOwner)
		{
			if (!SplitArrayForArrayFormula(formulaOwner, array.GetLength(0), array.GetLength(1), out var relativeColumn, out var relativeRow))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return array[relativeColumn, relativeRow];
		}

		internal static bool SplitArrayForArrayFormula(CellCalcReference formulaOwner, int columnCount, int rowCount, out int relativeColumn, out int relativeRow)
		{
			formulaOwner.GetRelativeAddressesInArrayFormula(out relativeColumn, out relativeRow);
			if (columnCount <= relativeColumn)
			{
				if (columnCount != 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				relativeColumn = 0;
			}
			if (rowCount <= relativeRow)
			{
				if (rowCount != 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				relativeRow = 0;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
