		public void ResetCalcNetworkInfo()
		{
			NextReferenceInCalcNetwork = null;
			PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork = null;
			HasNewFormulaToBeCalculated = false;
			IsDirty = false;
			IsInCircularity = false;
			IsInCalcNetwork = false;
			IsInNamedReferenceOnlyCircularity = false;
			CalcNetworkSortState = NodeState.NotVisited;
			if (_successors != null)
			{
				_successors.Clear();
			}
		}

		public virtual RefBase ResolveReference(ref CalculationContext context, bool splitArraysForValueParameters, out ExcelCalcErrorValue errorValue)
		{
			errorValue = null;
			if (!splitArraysForValueParameters)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (context.ExpectedTokenClass != TokenClass.Value)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (!(CalculationContext.GetFormulaOwner(ref context) is CellCalcReference { HasArrayFormula: not false } cellCalcReference))
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ResolveReferenceForArrayFormula(cellCalcReference, out errorValue);
		}

		public void SetAndCompileFormula(Formula newExcelFormula, bool canClearPreviouslyCalculatedValue)
		{
			SetAndCompileFormula(newExcelFormula, canClearPreviouslyCalculatedValue, forceSet: false, shouldRemoveCompiledFormulas: true);
		}

		public void SetAndCompileFormula(Formula newExcelFormula, bool canClearPreviouslyCalculatedValue, bool forceSet, bool shouldRemoveCompiledFormulas)
		{
			if ((!forceSet && newExcelFormula == ExcelFormula) || !CanOwnFormula)
			{
				return;
			}
			RemoveFormula(shouldRemoveCompiledFormulas);
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			if (newExcelFormula == null || workbook == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			AppliedFormula appliedFormula = workbook.CompileFormula(this, newExcelFormula);
			if (appliedFormula != null)
			{
				newExcelFormula.AddAppliedFormula(appliedFormula, this);
				SetAppliedFormula(appliedFormula);
				workbook.AddFormula(appliedFormula);
				if (canClearPreviouslyCalculatedValue && !workbook.AreCalculationsSuspended && workbook.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Manual)
				{
					workbook.CalcEngine.VerifyCalcNetwork();
					Value = appliedFormula.Evaluate(workbook);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual RefBase ToDynamic()
		{
			return new DynamicReference(this);
		}

		protected ExcelCalcValue GetValue(bool addDynamicReferences)
		{
			RefBase reference = this;
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			workbook?.CalcEngine.TryReplaceDataTableInputCell(ref reference);
			if (addDynamicReferences && CalculationContext.WillUseValueInCalculations)
			{
				IExcelCalcReference formulaOwner = CalculationContext.GetFormulaOwner(ref reference.CalculationContext);
				if (formulaOwner != null)
				{
					if (formulaOwner.Formula is AppliedFormula appliedFormula && workbook != null)
					{
						appliedFormula.AddDynamicReference(reference, workbook.CalcEngine);
					}
					else
					{
						formulaOwner.Formula.AddDynamicReference(reference);
					}
				}
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = reference.ValueInternal;
			if (excelCalcValue != null)
			{
				excelCalcValue.CalculationContext = reference.CalculationContext;
			}
			else
			{
				excelCalcValue = ExcelCalcValue.Empty;
			}
			return excelCalcValue;
		}

		protected virtual RefBase ResolveReferenceForArrayFormula(CellCalcReference formulaOwner, out ExcelCalcErrorValue errorValue)
		{
			errorValue = null;
			return this;
		}

		protected virtual void SetAppliedFormula(AppliedFormula formula)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void SetValue(ExcelCalcValue value)
		{
		}

		private bool GetFlag(InternalFlags flag)
		{
			return (_flags & flag) == flag;
		}

		private void RemoveFormula(bool shouldRemoveCompiledFormula)
		{
			AppliedFormula appliedFormula = AppliedFormula;
			if (appliedFormula == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				if (shouldRemoveCompiledFormula)
				{
					appliedFormula?.Formula.RemoveAppliedFormula(appliedFormula);
				}
				workbook.RemoveFormula(appliedFormula);
				SetAppliedFormula(null);
			}
		}

		private void SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_flags &= (InternalFlags)(byte)(~(int)flag);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CellCalcReference : RefBase
	{
		private AppliedFormula _appliedFormula;

		private string _cachedElementName;

		private short _columnIndex;

		private WorksheetRow _row;

		public sealed override AppliedFormula AppliedFormula => _appliedFormula;

		public sealed override bool CanOwnFormula => true;

		public sealed override short ColumnIndex => _columnIndex;

		public override object Context => this;

		public sealed override string ElementName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_cachedElementName != null)
				{
					string name = base.Worksheet.Name;
					if (name.Length + 1 < _cachedElementName.Length)
					{
						int i = 0;
						int num = 0;
						for (; i < _cachedElementName.Length; i++)
						{
							char c = _cachedElementName[i];
							if (c == '\'')
							{
								if (num != 0 && num != name.Length)
								{
									_cachedElementName = null;
									break;
								}
								continue;
							}
							if (name.Length <= num)
							{
								if (c != '!')
								{
									_cachedElementName = null;
								}
								break;
							}
							if (c != name[num++])
							{
								_cachedElementName = null;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (_cachedElementName != null)
						{
							return _cachedElementName;
						}
					}
				}
				_cachedElementName = _row.GetCellAddressString(_columnIndex, CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: true);
				return _cachedElementName;
			}
		}

		public override IExcelCalcReferenceCollectionEx Predecessors
		{
			get
			{
				if (_appliedFormula != null)
				{
					return _appliedFormula.References;
				}
				return base.Predecessors;
			}
		}

		public override WorksheetRow Row => _row;

		protected sealed override ExcelCalcValue ValueInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (_row.Worksheet.Workbook == null)
				{
					return ExcelReferenceError.Instance.Value;
				}
				if (_appliedFormula != null)
				{
					return _appliedFormula.CalculatedValue;
				}
				return CalcUtilities.CreateExcelCalcValue(_row.GetCellValueInternal(_columnIndex));
			}
		}

		public sealed override Workbook Workbook => _row.Worksheet.Workbook;

		public bool IsHidden
		{
			get
			{
				if (_row.Hidden)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return _row.Worksheet.IsColumnHidden(_columnIndex);
			}
		}

		public bool IsPrimaryOwnerOfFormula
		{
			get
			{
				Formula excelFormula = base.ExcelFormula;
				if (excelFormula == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (_row == excelFormula.OwningCellRow)
				{
					return _columnIndex == excelFormula.OwningCellColumnIndex;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasArrayFormula => base.ExcelFormula is ArrayFormula;

		public CellCalcReference(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			_row = row;
			_columnIndex = columnIndex;
		}

		public override bool ContainsReference(IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			if (!(ExcelCalcEngine.GetResolvedReference(inReference) is RefBase refBase) || refBase is NamedCalcReferenceBase)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (refBase is CellCalcReference cellCalcReference)
			{
				return this == cellCalcReference;
			}
			IList<WorksheetRegion> regionGroup = CalcUtilities.GetRegionGroup(refBase);
			for (int i = 0; i < regionGroup.Count; i++)
			{
				if (regionGroup[i].Contains(_row, _columnIndex))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool EqualsReferenceHelper(IExcelCalcReference resolvedReference)
		{
			if (!(resolvedReference is CellCalcReference cellCalcReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_row == cellCalcReference._row)
			{
				return _columnIndex == cellCalcReference._columnIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _row.GetHashCode() ^ (_columnIndex << 16);
		}

		public sealed override IList<WorksheetRegion> GetRegionGroup()
		{
			return new WorksheetRegion[1] { _row.Worksheet.GetCachedRegion(_row.Index, _columnIndex, _row.Index, _columnIndex) };
		}

		public sealed override bool IsSubsetReference(IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			return ContainsReference(inReference);
		}

		protected sealed override void SetAppliedFormula(AppliedFormula appliedFormula)
		{
			_appliedFormula = appliedFormula;
		}

		protected sealed override void SetValue(ExcelCalcValue value)
		{
			if (_appliedFormula != null)
			{
				object obj = value.GetResolvedValue();
				if (Utilities.IsNullResolved(obj))
				{
					obj = 0.0;
				}
				else if (obj is HyperlinkResult && !(value.Value is HyperlinkResult))
				{
					obj = obj.ToString();
				}
				_appliedFormula.CalculatedValue = new ExcelCalcValue(obj);
			}
		}

		public void EnsureCalculated()
		{
			Workbook?.EnsureCalculated(this);
		}

		public void GetRelativeAddressesInArrayFormula(out int relativeColumn, out int relativeRow)
		{
			if (!(base.ExcelFormula is ArrayFormula { CellRange: var cellRange }))
			{
				relativeRow = 0;
				relativeColumn = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				relativeRow = _row.Index - cellRange.FirstRow;
				relativeColumn = _columnIndex - cellRange.FirstColumn;
			}
		}

		public void SetAppliedFormulaInternal(AppliedFormula appliedFormula)
		{
			SetAppliedFormula(appliedFormula);
		}

		public bool ShouldBeRecalculatedOnNextLoad()
		{
			if (base.IsDirty || base.IsInCircularity)
			{
				return true;
			}
			AppliedFormula appliedFormula = AppliedFormula;
			if (appliedFormula != null && appliedFormula.HasAlwaysDirty)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.CalcEngine
{
	internal class DependencyGraph
	{
		private class SuccessorsResolvedEnumerable : IEnumerable<RefBase>, IEnumerable, IEnumerator<RefBase>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private bool _isOnRegions;

			private readonly IEnumerable<RefBase> _successors;

			private IEnumerator<RefBase> _successorsEnumerator;

			private readonly RegionLookupTable<RegionCalcReferenceBase>.Result _regionLookupResult;

			private List<RegionCalcReferenceBase>.Enumerator _regionsContainingCell;

			public RefBase Current
			{
				get
				{
					if (!_isOnRegions)
					{
						return _successorsEnumerator.Current;
					}
					return _regionsContainingCell.Current;
				}
			}

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			public SuccessorsResolvedEnumerable(IEnumerable<RefBase> successors, RegionLookupTable<RegionCalcReferenceBase>.Result regionLookupResult)
			{
				_successors = successors;
				_regionLookupResult = regionLookupResult;
			}

			public IEnumerator<RefBase> GetEnumerator()
			{
				if (_successorsEnumerator != null)
				{
					return new SuccessorsResolvedEnumerable(_successors, _regionLookupResult).GetEnumerator();
				}
				_successorsEnumerator = _successors.GetEnumerator();
				if (_regionLookupResult.HasItems)
				{
					_regionsContainingCell = _regionLookupResult.Items.GetEnumerator();
				}
				return this;
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return GetEnumerator();
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
				_regionLookupResult.Dispose();
			}

			bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
			{
				if (!_isOnRegions)
				{
					if (_successorsEnumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (!_regionLookupResult.HasItems)
					{
						return false;
					}
					_isOnRegions = true;
				}
				return _regionsContainingCell.MoveNext();
			}

			void IEnumerator.Reset()
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		private class EvaluationEnumerator : IEnumerator<RefBase>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private RefBase _current;

			private readonly DependencyGraph _dependencyGraph;

			private bool _isFinished;

			private RefBase _nextReferenceToEvaluate;

			public RefBase Current => _current;

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			public EvaluationEnumerator(DependencyGraph dependencyGraph)
			{
				_dependencyGraph = dependencyGraph;
				_nextReferenceToEvaluate = _dependencyGraph._allReferences.FirstReference;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				_nextReferenceToEvaluate = null;
				_dependencyGraph._currentEvaluationEnumerator = null;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (_isFinished)
				{
					_current = null;
					return false;
				}
				if (_nextReferenceToEvaluate == null)
				{
					_nextReferenceToEvaluate = _dependencyGraph._allReferences.FirstReference;
				}
				if (_nextReferenceToEvaluate == null)
				{
					_isFinished = true;
					_current = null;
					return false;
				}
				RefBase refBase = _nextReferenceToEvaluate;
				while (refBase != null && !refBase.IsDirty)
				{
					refBase = refBase.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				}
				_current = refBase;
				if (_current != null)
				{
					_nextReferenceToEvaluate = _current.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
					return true;
				}
				_isFinished = true;
				_nextReferenceToEvaluate = null;
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_isFinished = false;
				_nextReferenceToEvaluate = null;
			}

			public void MoveBack(HashSet<RefBase> itemsToExclude)
			{
				while (_nextReferenceToEvaluate != null && itemsToExclude.Contains(_nextReferenceToEvaluate))
				{
					_nextReferenceToEvaluate = _nextReferenceToEvaluate.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				}
			}
		}

		private class FinishTimeSorter : IComparer<RefBase>
		{
			public static readonly FinishTimeSorter Instance = new FinishTimeSorter();

			private FinishTimeSorter()
			{
			}

			int IComparer<RefBase>.Compare(RefBase x, RefBase y)
			{
				if (x.CalcNetworkFinishTime < y.CalcNetworkFinishTime)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (x.CalcNetworkFinishTime > y.CalcNetworkFinishTime)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private class StronglyConnectedComponent
		{
			private readonly HashSet<RefBase> _references;

			public StronglyConnectedComponent(IEnumerable<RefBase> vertices)
			{
				_references = new HashSet<RefBase>(vertices);
			}

			public bool Contains(RefBase reference)
			{
				return _references.Contains(reference);
			}

			public void DirtyComponent(DependencyGraph graph)
			{
				foreach (RefBase reference in _references)
				{
					graph.DirtyReference(reference);
				}
			}

			public RefBase GetStartOfComponent(RefBase referenceInComponent)
			{
				RefBase previousReferenceInCalcNetwork = referenceInComponent.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				while (previousReferenceInCalcNetwork != null && previousReferenceInCalcNetwork.IsInCircularity && Contains(previousReferenceInCalcNetwork))
				{
					referenceInComponent = previousReferenceInCalcNetwork;
					previousReferenceInCalcNetwork = referenceInComponent.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				}
				return referenceInComponent;
			}

			public RefBase GetEndOfComponent(RefBase referenceInComponent)
			{
				RefBase nextReferenceInCalcNetwork = referenceInComponent.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				while (nextReferenceInCalcNetwork != null && nextReferenceInCalcNetwork.IsInCircularity && Contains(nextReferenceInCalcNetwork))
				{
					referenceInComponent = nextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
					nextReferenceInCalcNetwork = referenceInComponent.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				}
				return referenceInComponent;
			}

			public bool IsInCalcNetwork()
			{
				using (HashSet<RefBase>.Enumerator enumerator = _references.GetEnumerator())
				{
					if (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						RefBase current = enumerator.Current;
						return current.IsInCalcNetwork;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class StronglyConnectedComponentSorter : IComparer<RefBase>
		{
			public static readonly StronglyConnectedComponentSorter Instance = new StronglyConnectedComponentSorter();

			private StronglyConnectedComponentSorter()
			{
			}

			int IComparer<RefBase>.Compare(RefBase x, RefBase y)
			{
				CellCalcReference cellCalcReference = x as CellCalcReference;
				CellCalcReference cellCalcReference2 = y as CellCalcReference;
				if (cellCalcReference == null || cellCalcReference2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				int num = cellCalcReference.Row.Worksheet.Index - cellCalcReference2.Row.Worksheet.Index;
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num = cellCalcReference.Row.Index - cellCalcReference2.Row.Index;
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num = cellCalcReference.ColumnIndex - cellCalcReference2.ColumnIndex;
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private const int SafeFinishTimeGap = 2;

		private readonly CalculationNetworkLinkedList _allReferences;

		private readonly ExcelCalcEngine _calcEngine;

		private EvaluationEnumerator _currentEvaluationEnumerator;

		private bool _isGraphDirty;

		private readonly HashSet<RefBase> _allReferencesWithFormulas;

		private readonly Dictionary<Worksheet, RegionLookupTable<RegionCalcReferenceBase>> _regionsInGraph;

		private bool _shouldDirtyVolatileFormulas;

		private readonly List<StronglyConnectedComponent> _stronglyConnectedComponents;

		private readonly HashSet<RefBase> _volatileReferences;

		private static readonly Action<RefBase, RefBase> DFSAddSuccessorCallback = AddSuccessorResolved;

		private static readonly Func<RefBase, IEnumerable<IExcelCalcReference>> DFSGetPredecessors = (RefBase r) => r.Predecessors;

		private readonly Func<RefBase, IEnumerable<RefBase>> DFSGetSuccessors;

		private static readonly int[] ShellSortGaps = new int[8] { 701, 301, 132, 57, 23, 10, 4, 1 };

		public bool IsEmpty => _allReferences.FirstReference == null;

		public DependencyGraph(ExcelCalcEngine calcEngine)
		{
			_calcEngine = calcEngine;
			_allReferencesWithFormulas = new HashSet<RefBase>();
			_allReferences = new CalculationNetworkLinkedList();
			_regionsInGraph = new Dictionary<Worksheet, RegionLookupTable<RegionCalcReferenceBase>>();
			_stronglyConnectedComponents = new List<StronglyConnectedComponent>();
			_volatileReferences = new HashSet<RefBase>();
			DFSGetSuccessors = GetSuccessorsResolved;
		}

		public void AddDynamicDependency(RefBase predecessor, RefBase successor)
		{
			AddSuccessorResolved(predecessor, successor);
			if (!predecessor.IsInCalcNetwork)
			{
				TryInsertNewPredecessor(predecessor, successor, forceInsert: true);
			}
			if (predecessor.CalcNetworkFinishTime < successor.CalcNetworkFinishTime || AreInSameStronglyConnectedComponent(predecessor, successor))
			{
				return;
			}
			HashSet<RefBase> hashSet = GatherSuccessors(successor);
			if (_currentEvaluationEnumerator != null)
			{
				_currentEvaluationEnumerator.MoveBack(hashSet);
			}
			foreach (RefBase item in hashSet)
			{
				item.CalcNetworkSortState = NodeState.NotVisited;
				_allReferences.Remove(item);
			}
			if (hashSet.Contains(predecessor))
			{
				CleanupStronglyConnectedComponents();
				int suggestedStartTime = 0;
				if (_allReferences.LastReference != null)
				{
					suggestedStartTime = _allReferences.LastReference.CalcNetworkFinishTime + 2;
				}
				AddReferencesToNetwork(hashSet, null, wereReferencesAlreadyInNetwork: true, suggestedStartTime);
			}
			else
			{
				List<RefBase> list = new List<RefBase>(hashSet);
				list.Sort(FinishTimeSorter.Instance);
				foreach (RefBase item2 in list)
				{
					_allReferences.AddToEnd(item2);
				}
				EnsureFinishTimesDontOverlap(list[0]);
			}
			successor.IsDirty = true;
		}

		public void AddFormula(AppliedFormula formula)
		{
			DirtyGraph();
			RefBase targetReference = formula.TargetReference;
			if (!(targetReference is NamedCalcReferenceBase))
			{
				targetReference.HasNewFormulaToBeCalculated = true;
			}
			_allReferencesWithFormulas.Add(targetReference);
			if (formula.HasAlwaysDirty)
			{
				_volatileReferences.Add(targetReference);
			}
		}

		public void AddIfReferenced(RefBase reference)
		{
			TryInsertNewPredecessor(reference, null, forceInsert: false);
		}

		public void DirtyAllFormulas()
		{
			VerifyWithoutUpdatingPendingVolatileFormulas();
			foreach (RefBase allReferencesWithFormula in _allReferencesWithFormulas)
			{
				allReferencesWithFormula.IsDirty = true;
			}
		}

		public void DirtyReference(RefBase reference)
		{
			Queue<RefBase> queue = new Queue<RefBase>();
			queue.Enqueue(reference);
			while (queue.Count != 0)
			{
				RefBase refBase = queue.Dequeue();
				if (refBase.IsDirty)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (refBase.IsInCalcNetwork)
				{
					DirtySingleReference(refBase);
				}
				foreach (RefBase item in GetSuccessorsResolved(refBase))
				{
					if (!item.IsDirty)
					{
						queue.Enqueue(item);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void DirtyVolatileFormulas()
		{
			foreach (RefBase volatileReference in _volatileReferences)
			{
				DirtyReference(volatileReference);
			}
			foreach (StronglyConnectedComponent stronglyConnectedComponent in _stronglyConnectedComponents)
			{
				stronglyConnectedComponent.DirtyComponent(this);
			}
			_shouldDirtyVolatileFormulas = false;
		}

		public void DirtyVolatileFormulasDelayed()
		{
			_shouldDirtyVolatileFormulas = true;
		}

		public IEnumerator<RefBase> InitializeEvaluation()
		{
			_currentEvaluationEnumerator = new EvaluationEnumerator(this);
			return _currentEvaluationEnumerator;
		}

		public bool IsReferenced(RefBase reference)
		{
			VerifyWithoutUpdatingPendingVolatileFormulas();
			if (reference.IsInCalcNetwork)
			{
				return HasSuccessorsResolved(reference);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void OnCachedValueLoaded(CellCalcReference calcReference)
		{
			Formula excelFormula = calcReference.ExcelFormula;
			if (excelFormula != null && !excelFormula.IsDirtyOnLoad && !excelFormula.HasHyperlink)
			{
				calcReference.HasNewFormulaToBeCalculated = false;
			}
		}

		public void RemoveDynamicDependency(RefBase predecessor, RefBase successor)
		{
			predecessor.RemoveSuccessor(successor);
			if (AreInSameStronglyConnectedComponent(predecessor, successor, out var component) && component != null)
			{
				bool flag = predecessor.CalcNetworkFinishTime < successor.CalcNetworkFinishTime;
				RefBase startOfComponent = component.GetStartOfComponent(flag ? predecessor : successor);
				RefBase endOfComponent = component.GetEndOfComponent(flag ? successor : predecessor);
				ResortSegment(startOfComponent, endOfComponent);
			}
			if (!HasSuccessorsResolved(predecessor) && !predecessor.Predecessors.Any())
			{
				_allReferences.Remove(predecessor);
				predecessor.ResetCalcNetworkInfo();
			}
		}

		public void RemoveFormula(AppliedFormula formula)
		{
			DirtyGraph();
			RefBase targetReference = formula.TargetReference;
			targetReference.HasNewFormulaToBeCalculated = false;
			DirtyReference(targetReference);
			_allReferencesWithFormulas.Remove(targetReference);
			_volatileReferences.Remove(targetReference);
		}

		public void Verify()
		{
			VerifyWithoutUpdatingPendingVolatileFormulas();
			if (_shouldDirtyVolatileFormulas)
			{
				DirtyVolatileFormulas();
			}
		}

		private void VerifyWithoutUpdatingPendingVolatileFormulas()
		{
			if (!_isGraphDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			HashSet<RefBase> dirtyReferences = GetDirtyReferences();
			_allReferences.Reset();
			_regionsInGraph.Clear();
			_stronglyConnectedComponents.Clear();
			int suggestedStartTime = 0;
			AddReferencesToNetwork(_allReferencesWithFormulas, null, wereReferencesAlreadyInNetwork: false, suggestedStartTime);
			foreach (RefBase item in dirtyReferences)
			{
				if (item.IsInCalcNetwork)
				{
					item.IsDirty = true;
				}
			}
			foreach (RefBase allReferencesWithFormula in _allReferencesWithFormulas)
			{
				if (allReferencesWithFormula.HasNewFormulaToBeCalculated)
				{
					DirtyReference(allReferencesWithFormula);
					allReferencesWithFormula.HasNewFormulaToBeCalculated = false;
				}
			}
			_isGraphDirty = false;
		}

		public void AddReferencesToNetwork(IEnumerable<RefBase> references, RefBase referenceAfterAddedReferences, bool wereReferencesAlreadyInNetwork, int suggestedStartTime)
		{
			List<RefBase> list = new List<RefBase>();
			int time = suggestedStartTime;
			bool populateSuccessors = !wereReferencesAlreadyInNetwork;
			foreach (RefBase reference in references)
			{
				if (reference.CalcNetworkSortState == NodeState.NotVisited)
				{
					DepthFirstSearchPredecessorsOutOfNetwork(reference, populateSuccessors, ref time, list);
				}
			}
			foreach (RefBase item in list)
			{
				item.CalcNetworkSortState = NodeState.NotVisited;
				if (!wereReferencesAlreadyInNetwork && item is RegionCalcReferenceBase regionReference)
				{
					OnRegionAddedToNetwork(regionReference);
				}
			}
			RefBase referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious = referenceAfterAddedReferences;
			List<RefBase> list2 = new List<RefBase>();
			for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RefBase refBase = list[num];
				if (!refBase.IsInCalcNetwork)
				{
					DepthFirstSearchSuccessorsOutOfNetwork(refBase, ref time, out var isCircularity, list2);
					if (list2.Count != 1)
					{
						SortStronglyConnectedComponent(list2);
					}
					if (isCircularity)
					{
						_stronglyConnectedComponents.Add(new StronglyConnectedComponent(list2));
					}
					bool isInNamedReferenceOnlyCircularity = true;
					if (isCircularity)
					{
						for (int num2 = list2.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
						{
							RefBase refBase2 = list2[num2];
							if (!(refBase2 is NamedCalcReference))
							{
								isInNamedReferenceOnlyCircularity = false;
							}
						}
					}
					for (int num3 = list2.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
					{
						RefBase refBase3 = list2[num3];
						if (refBase3 != ExcelReferenceError.Instance)
						{
							_allReferences.AddBefore(referenceAfterAddedReferences, refBase3);
							referenceAfterAddedReferences = refBase3;
							if (isCircularity)
							{
								refBase3.IsInCircularity = true;
								refBase3.IsInNamedReferenceOnlyCircularity = isInNamedReferenceOnlyCircularity;
							}
						}
					}
					list2.Clear();
				}
			}
			EnsureFinishTimesDontOverlap(referenceAfterAddedReferences);
			EnsureFinishTimesDontOverlap(referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious);
		}

		private static void AddSuccessorResolved(RefBase predecessor, RefBase successor)
		{
			if (!(predecessor is CellCalcReference) || !(successor is RegionCalcReferenceBase))
			{
				predecessor.AddSuccessor(successor);
			}
		}

		private bool AreInSameStronglyConnectedComponent(RefBase reference1, RefBase reference2)
		{
			StronglyConnectedComponent component;
			return AreInSameStronglyConnectedComponent(reference1, reference2, out component);
		}

		private bool AreInSameStronglyConnectedComponent(RefBase reference1, RefBase reference2, out StronglyConnectedComponent component)
		{
			component = null;
			if (!reference1.IsInCircularity || !reference2.IsInCircularity)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (reference1 == reference2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			component = GetStronglyConnectedComponent(reference1);
			if (component != null)
			{
				return component.Contains(reference2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CleanupStronglyConnectedComponents()
		{
			for (int num = _stronglyConnectedComponents.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (!_stronglyConnectedComponents[num].IsInCalcNetwork())
				{
					_stronglyConnectedComponents.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DepthFirstSearchOutOfNetwork<TRef>(RefBase reference, bool isForwardsTime, ref int time, out bool isCircularity, List<RefBase> referencesOrderedByFinishTime, Func<RefBase, IEnumerable<TRef>> getEdgesCallback, Action<RefBase, RefBase> onEdgeDiscoveredAction) where TRef : IExcelCalcReference
		{
			isCircularity = false;
			if (reference.IsInCalcNetwork)
			{
				return;
			}
			Stack<RefBase> stack = new Stack<RefBase>();
			Stack<IEnumerator<TRef>> stack2 = new Stack<IEnumerator<TRef>>();
			StartVisitingReference(reference, isForwardsTime, ref time, getEdgesCallback, stack, stack2);
			while (stack.Count != 0)
			{
				RefBase refBase = stack.Peek();
				IEnumerator<TRef> enumerator = stack2.Peek();
				bool flag = false;
				while (!flag && enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (!(enumerator.Current is RefBase refBase2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					onEdgeDiscoveredAction?.Invoke(refBase2, refBase);
					switch (refBase2.CalcNetworkSortState)
					{
					case NodeState.NotVisited:
						if (!refBase2.IsInCalcNetwork)
						{
							StartVisitingReference(refBase2, isForwardsTime, ref time, getEdgesCallback, stack, stack2);
							flag = true;
						}
						break;
					case NodeState.Visiting:
						isCircularity = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					referencesOrderedByFinishTime.Add(refBase);
					FinishVisitingReference(refBase, isForwardsTime, ref time, enumerator, stack, stack2);
				}
			}
			if (!isForwardsTime && referencesOrderedByFinishTime.Count != 1)
			{
				referencesOrderedByFinishTime.Reverse();
			}
		}

		private void DepthFirstSearchPredecessorsOutOfNetwork(RefBase reference, bool populateSuccessors, ref int time, List<RefBase> referencesOrderedByFinishTime)
		{
			DepthFirstSearchOutOfNetwork(reference, isForwardsTime: true, ref time, out var _, referencesOrderedByFinishTime, DFSGetPredecessors, populateSuccessors ? DFSAddSuccessorCallback : null);
		}

		private void DepthFirstSearchSuccessorsOutOfNetwork(RefBase reference, ref int time, out bool isCircularity, List<RefBase> referencesOrderedByFinishTime)
		{
			DepthFirstSearchOutOfNetwork(reference, isForwardsTime: false, ref time, out isCircularity, referencesOrderedByFinishTime, DFSGetSuccessors, null);
		}

		private void DirtyGraph()
		{
			_isGraphDirty = true;
		}

		private void DirtySingleReference(RefBase reference)
		{
			if (reference.IsDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			reference.IsDirty = true;
			if (!_calcEngine.IsEvaluatingDataTables && reference is CellCalcReference cellCalcReference)
			{
				WorksheetDataTable dataTableFromExternalCellInternal = cellCalcReference.Row.GetDataTableFromExternalCellInternal(cellCalcReference.ColumnIndex);
				if (dataTableFromExternalCellInternal != null)
				{
					_calcEngine.NotifyDataTableModified(dataTableFromExternalCellInternal);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void EnsureFinishTimesDontOverlap(RefBase referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious)
		{
			if (referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RefBase refBase = referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork;
			if (refBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious != null && referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious.CalcNetworkFinishTime <= refBase.CalcNetworkFinishTime)
			{
				RefBase nextReferenceInCalcNetwork = referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				int num = refBase.CalcNetworkFinishTime + 1;
				if (nextReferenceInCalcNetwork != null && num < nextReferenceInCalcNetwork.CalcNetworkFinishTime)
				{
					referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious.CalcNetworkFinishTime = num;
				}
				else
				{
					referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious.CalcNetworkFinishTime = refBase.CalcNetworkFinishTime + 2;
				}
				refBase = referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious;
				referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious = referencePotentallyOverlappingPrevious.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
			}
		}

		private static void FinishVisitingReference<TRef>(RefBase visitingReference, bool isForwardsTime, ref int time, IEnumerator<TRef> edgesEnumerator, Stack<RefBase> visitingReferences, Stack<IEnumerator<TRef>> visitingReferenceEdges) where TRef : IExcelCalcReference
		{
			edgesEnumerator.Dispose();
			if (isForwardsTime)
			{
				visitingReference.CalcNetworkFinishTime = ++time;
			}
			else
			{
				visitingReference.CalcNetworkFinishTime = time--;
			}
			visitingReference.CalcNetworkSortState = NodeState.Visited;
			visitingReferences.Pop();
			visitingReferenceEdges.Pop();
		}

		private HashSet<RefBase> GatherPredecessors(RefBase predecessor)
		{
			HashSet<RefBase> hashSet = new HashSet<RefBase>();
			hashSet.Add(predecessor);
			Queue<RefBase> queue = new Queue<RefBase>();
			queue.Enqueue(predecessor);
			while (queue.Count != 0)
			{
				RefBase refBase = queue.Dequeue();
				foreach (IExcelCalcReference predecessor2 in refBase.Predecessors)
				{
					if (predecessor2 is RefBase item && hashSet.Add(item))
					{
						queue.Enqueue(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return hashSet;
		}

		private HashSet<RefBase> GatherSuccessors(RefBase successor)
		{
			HashSet<RefBase> hashSet = new HashSet<RefBase>();
			hashSet.Add(successor);
			Queue<RefBase> queue = new Queue<RefBase>();
			queue.Enqueue(successor);
			while (queue.Count != 0)
			{
				RefBase reference = queue.Dequeue();
				foreach (RefBase item in GetSuccessorsResolved(reference))
				{
					if (hashSet.Add(item))
					{
						queue.Enqueue(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return hashSet;
		}

		private HashSet<RefBase> GetDirtyReferences()
		{
			HashSet<RefBase> hashSet = new HashSet<RefBase>();
			for (RefBase refBase = _allReferences.FirstReference; refBase != null; refBase = refBase.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork)
			{
				if (refBase.IsDirty)
				{
					hashSet.Add(refBase);
				}
			}
			return hashSet;
		}

		private RegionLookupTable<RegionCalcReferenceBase>.Result GetRegionsInGraphContainingCell(CellCalcReference cellReference)
		{
			if (!_regionsInGraph.TryGetValue(cellReference.Worksheet, out var value))
			{
				return RegionLookupTable<RegionCalcReferenceBase>.Result.Empty;
			}
			return value.GetItemsContainingCell(cellReference.Row.Index, cellReference.ColumnIndex);
		}

		private StronglyConnectedComponent GetStronglyConnectedComponent(RefBase reference)
		{
			foreach (StronglyConnectedComponent stronglyConnectedComponent in _stronglyConnectedComponents)
			{
				if (stronglyConnectedComponent.Contains(reference))
				{
					return stronglyConnectedComponent;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IEnumerable<RefBase> GetSuccessorsResolved(RefBase reference)
		{
			IEnumerable<RefBase> successors = reference.GetSuccessors();
			if (!(reference is CellCalcReference cellReference))
			{
				return successors;
			}
			RegionLookupTable<RegionCalcReferenceBase>.Result regionsInGraphContainingCell = GetRegionsInGraphContainingCell(cellReference);
			if (!regionsInGraphContainingCell.HasItems)
			{
				regionsInGraphContainingCell.Dispose();
				return successors;
			}
			return new SuccessorsResolvedEnumerable(successors, regionsInGraphContainingCell);
		}

		private bool HasSuccessorsResolved(RefBase reference)
		{
			if (reference.HasSuccessors)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(reference is CellCalcReference cellReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			using RegionLookupTable<RegionCalcReferenceBase>.Result result = GetRegionsInGraphContainingCell(cellReference);
			return result.HasItems;
		}

		private void OnRegionAddedToNetwork(RegionCalcReferenceBase regionReference)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = regionReference.Worksheet;
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				if (!_regionsInGraph.TryGetValue(worksheet, out var value))
				{
					value = new RegionLookupTable<RegionCalcReferenceBase>(worksheet);
					_regionsInGraph[worksheet] = value;
				}
				value.Add(regionReference.Region, regionReference);
			}
		}

		private void ResortSegment(RefBase segmentStart, RefBase segmentEnd)
		{
			RefBase nextReferenceInCalcNetwork = segmentEnd.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
			int calcNetworkFinishTime = segmentStart.CalcNetworkFinishTime;
			List<RefBase> list = new List<RefBase>();
			RefBase refBase = segmentStart;
			while (refBase != nextReferenceInCalcNetwork)
			{
				RefBase nextReferenceInCalcNetwork2 = refBase.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
				refBase.CalcNetworkSortState = NodeState.NotVisited;
				_allReferences.Remove(refBase);
				list.Add(refBase);
				refBase = nextReferenceInCalcNetwork2;
			}
			CleanupStronglyConnectedComponents();
			int suggestedStartTime = calcNetworkFinishTime - 1;
			AddReferencesToNetwork(list, nextReferenceInCalcNetwork, wereReferencesAlreadyInNetwork: true, suggestedStartTime);
		}

		private void ShellSortReferences(List<RefBase> referencesInComponent, IComparer<RefBase> comparer)
		{
			int[] shellSortGaps = ShellSortGaps;
			foreach (int num in shellSortGaps)
			{
				for (int j = num; j < referencesInComponent.Count; j++)
				{
					RefBase refBase = referencesInComponent[j];
					int calcNetworkFinishTime = refBase.CalcNetworkFinishTime;
					int num2 = j;
					while (num2 >= num && comparer.Compare(referencesInComponent[num2 - num], refBase) > 0)
					{
						RefBase refBase2 = referencesInComponent[num2 - num];
						int calcNetworkFinishTime2 = refBase2.CalcNetworkFinishTime;
						refBase2.CalcNetworkFinishTime = calcNetworkFinishTime;
						calcNetworkFinishTime = calcNetworkFinishTime2;
						referencesInComponent[num2] = refBase2;
						num2 -= num;
					}
					refBase.CalcNetworkFinishTime = calcNetworkFinishTime;
					referencesInComponent[num2] = refBase;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SortStronglyConnectedComponent(List<RefBase> referencesInComponent)
		{
			ShellSortReferences(referencesInComponent, StronglyConnectedComponentSorter.Instance);
		}

		private static void StartVisitingReference<TRef>(RefBase reference, bool isForwardsTime, ref int time, Func<RefBase, IEnumerable<TRef>> getEdgesCallback, Stack<RefBase> visitingReferences, Stack<IEnumerator<TRef>> visitingReferenceEdges) where TRef : IExcelCalcReference
		{
			reference.CalcNetworkSortState = NodeState.Visiting;
			if (isForwardsTime)
			{
				time++;
			}
			else
			{
				time--;
			}
			visitingReferences.Push(reference);
			visitingReferenceEdges.Push(getEdgesCallback(reference).GetEnumerator());
		}

		private void TryInsertNewPredecessor(RefBase predecessor, RefBase suggestedReferenceAfterPredecessor, bool forceInsert)
		{
			if (predecessor is CellCalcReference)
			{
				if (forceInsert || HasSuccessorsResolved(predecessor))
				{
					predecessor.CalcNetworkFinishTime = _allReferences.FirstReference.CalcNetworkFinishTime - 2;
					_allReferences.AddToBeginning(predecessor);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!forceInsert && !HasSuccessorsResolved(predecessor))
				{
					return;
				}
				RefBase refBase = null;
				HashSet<RefBase> hashSet = GatherPredecessors(predecessor);
				foreach (RefBase item in hashSet)
				{
					if (!item.IsInCalcNetwork)
					{
						item.CalcNetworkSortState = NodeState.NotVisited;
					}
					else if (refBase == null || refBase.CalcNetworkFinishTime < item.CalcNetworkFinishTime)
					{
						refBase = item;
					}
				}
				RefBase refBase2;
				int suggestedStartTime;
				if (refBase != null)
				{
					refBase2 = refBase.NextReferenceInCalcNetwork;
					suggestedStartTime = refBase.CalcNetworkFinishTime + 2;
				}
				else if (suggestedReferenceAfterPredecessor != null)
				{
					refBase2 = suggestedReferenceAfterPredecessor;
					RefBase previousReferenceInCalcNetwork = suggestedReferenceAfterPredecessor.PreviousReferenceInCalcNetwork;
					suggestedStartTime = ((previousReferenceInCalcNetwork == null) ? (refBase2.CalcNetworkFinishTime - hashSet.Count * 2) : (previousReferenceInCalcNetwork.CalcNetworkFinishTime + 2));
				}
				else
				{
					refBase2 = _allReferences.FirstReference;
					suggestedStartTime = refBase2.CalcNetworkFinishTime - hashSet.Count * 2;
				}
				AddReferencesToNetwork(hashSet, refBase2, wereReferencesAlreadyInNetwork: false, suggestedStartTime);
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum NodeState : byte
	{
		NotVisited,
		Visiting,
		Visited
	}
	internal enum ReferenceActionCode
	{
		Create,
		Remove
	}
	internal class ExcelCalcEngine
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<RefBase, ushort> _circularIterationCounts;

		private readonly List<RefBase> _circularReferencesToReDirty;

		private RefBase _columnInputCellSource;

		private RefBase _columnInputCellTarget;

		private readonly DependencyGraph _dependencyGraph;

		private HashSet<WorksheetDataTable> _dirtyTables;

		private readonly HashSet<AppliedFormula> _evaluatedFormulas;

		private UltraCalcFunctionFactory _functionFactory;

		private bool _isEvaluatingDataTables;

		private bool _isRecalculating;

		private readonly Dictionary<WorksheetTable, List<RefBase>> _referencedTableMap;

		private RefBase _rowInputCellSource;

		private RefBase _rowInputCellTarget;

		private readonly Workbook _workbook;

		public UltraCalcFunctionFactory FunctionFactory => _functionFactory;

		public bool IsEvaluatingDataTables => _isEvaluatingDataTables;

		public bool IsRecalculating => _isRecalculating;

		public ExcelCalcEngine(Workbook workbook)
		{
			_workbook = workbook;
			_circularIterationCounts = new Dictionary<RefBase, ushort>();
			_circularReferencesToReDirty = new List<RefBase>();
			_dependencyGraph = new DependencyGraph(this);
			_dirtyTables = new HashSet<WorksheetDataTable>();
			_evaluatedFormulas = new HashSet<AppliedFormula>();
			_functionFactory = UltraCalcFunctionFactory.Default;
			_referencedTableMap = new Dictionary<WorksheetTable, List<RefBase>>();
		}

		public void AddDynamicDependency(IExcelCalcReference predecessor, RefBase successor)
		{
			if (GetResolvedReference(predecessor) is RefBase predecessor2)
			{
				_dependencyGraph.AddDynamicDependency(predecessor2, successor);
			}
		}

		public void AddFormula(AppliedFormula formula)
		{
			if (formula != null)
			{
				UpdateReferencedTableMap(formula, formula.TargetReference, isAdding: true);
				_dependencyGraph.AddFormula(formula);
			}
		}

		public void DirtyAllFormulas()
		{
			_dependencyGraph.DirtyAllFormulas();
		}

		public void DirtyVolatileFormulasDelayed()
		{
			_dependencyGraph.DirtyVolatileFormulasDelayed();
		}

		public void EnsureCalculated(CellCalcReference reference, bool shouldCalculateDataTables)
		{
			Recalculate(reference, shouldCalculateDataTables);
		}

		public void EnsureFunctionFactoryIsNotShared()
		{
			if (_functionFactory == UltraCalcFunctionFactory.Default)
			{
				_functionFactory = new UltraCalcFunctionFactory();
			}
		}

		public static IExcelCalcReference GetResolvedReference(IExcelCalcReference reference)
		{
			if (reference is RefBase refBase)
			{
				return refBase.ResolvedReference;
			}
			return reference;
		}

		public bool IsReferenced(RefBase reference)
		{
			return _dependencyGraph.IsReferenced(reference);
		}

		public void NotifyDataTableModified(WorksheetDataTable dataTable)
		{
			if (!_isEvaluatingDataTables)
			{
				_dirtyTables.Add(dataTable);
			}
		}

		public void NotifyNamedReferenceChange(NamedCalcReferenceBase changedReference, ReferenceActionCode action)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case ReferenceActionCode.Create:
				AddFormula(changedReference.AppliedFormula);
				break;
			case ReferenceActionCode.Remove:
				RemoveFormula(changedReference.AppliedFormula);
				break;
			}
		}

		public void NotifyTableDirtied(WorksheetTable table)
		{
			if (_referencedTableMap.TryGetValue(table, out var value))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < value.Count; i++)
				{
					_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(value[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void NotifyTableRemoved(WorksheetTable table)
		{
			_referencedTableMap.Remove(table);
		}

		public void NotifyValueChanged(CellCalcReference reference)
		{
			if (!_isEvaluatingDataTables)
			{
				WorksheetDataTable dataTableFromExternalCellInternal = reference.Row.GetDataTableFromExternalCellInternal(reference.ColumnIndex);
				if (dataTableFromExternalCellInternal != null)
				{
					NotifyDataTableModified(dataTableFromExternalCellInternal);
				}
			}
			if (!_dependencyGraph.IsEmpty)
			{
				DirtyVolatileFormulasDelayed();
				if (!reference.IsInCalcNetwork)
				{
					_dependencyGraph.AddIfReferenced(reference);
				}
				_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(reference);
			}
		}

		public void OnCachedValueLoaded(CellCalcReference calcReference)
		{
			_dependencyGraph.OnCachedValueLoaded(calcReference);
		}

		public void Recalculate(bool shouldCalculateDataTables)
		{
			Recalculate(null, shouldCalculateDataTables);
		}

		public void RemoveDynamicPredecessor(IExcelCalcReference predecessor, RefBase successor)
		{
			if (GetResolvedReference(predecessor) is RefBase predecessor2)
			{
				_dependencyGraph.RemoveDynamicDependency(predecessor2, successor);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveFormula(AppliedFormula formula)
		{
			if (formula != null)
			{
				UpdateReferencedTableMap(formula, formula.TargetReference, isAdding: false);
				_dependencyGraph.RemoveFormula(formula);
			}
		}

		public void VerifyCalcNetwork()
		{
			_dependencyGraph.Verify();
		}

		private void AfterFormulaEvaluationCompleted(RefBase reference, ExcelCalcValue evaluatedValue)
		{
			if (reference.IsInCircularity && _workbook.IterativeCalculationsEnabled)
			{
				ushort circularIterationCount = GetCircularIterationCount(reference);
				if (circularIterationCount < _workbook.MaxRecursionIterations)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					if (circularIterationCount > 1 && reference.Value.ToDouble(out var result) && evaluatedValue.ToDouble(out var result2) && Math.Abs(result2 - result) < Math.Abs(_workbook.MaxChangeInIteration))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						_circularReferencesToReDirty.Add(reference);
					}
				}
			}
			reference.Value = evaluatedValue;
		}

		private void CopyCalculatedValue(WorksheetRow sourceCellRow, short sourceCellColumnIndex, WorksheetRow targetCellRow, short targetCellColumnIndex)
		{
			CellCalcReference cellCalcReference = sourceCellRow.GetCellCalcReference(sourceCellColumnIndex);
			CellCalcReference cellCalcReference2 = targetCellRow.GetCellCalcReference(targetCellColumnIndex);
			ExcelCalcValue value = ((cellCalcReference.AppliedFormula == null) ? new ExcelCalcValue(sourceCellRow.GetCellValue(sourceCellColumnIndex)) : cellCalcReference.AppliedFormula.CalculatedValue);
			cellCalcReference2.Value = value;
			_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(cellCalcReference2);
		}

		private void EvaluateAllReferences()
		{
			_circularReferencesToReDirty.Clear();
			while (true)
			{
				using (IEnumerator<RefBase> enumerator = _dependencyGraph.InitializeEvaluation())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						EvaluateReference(enumerator.Current);
					}
				}
				if (_circularReferencesToReDirty.Count == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				foreach (RefBase item in _circularReferencesToReDirty)
				{
					_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(item);
				}
				_circularReferencesToReDirty.Clear();
			}
			_circularIterationCounts.Clear();
		}

		private void EvaluateFormulasForColumnInputDataTable(WorksheetDataTable dataTable)
		{
			WorksheetRowCollection rows = dataTable.Worksheet.Rows;
			WorksheetRegion interiorCells = dataTable.InteriorCells;
			WorksheetRegion cellsInTable = dataTable.CellsInTable;
			WorksheetRow sourceCellRow = rows[cellsInTable.FirstRow];
			short firstColumnInternal = cellsInTable.FirstColumnInternal;
			_columnInputCellSource = dataTable.GetColumnInputCellReference();
			for (int i = interiorCells.FirstRow; i <= interiorCells.LastRow; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = rows[i];
				_dependencyGraph.DirtyVolatileFormulas();
				_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(_columnInputCellSource);
				_columnInputCellTarget = worksheetRow.GetCellCalcReference(firstColumnInternal);
				EvaluateAllReferences();
				for (short num = interiorCells.FirstColumnInternal; num <= interiorCells.LastColumnInternal; num++)
				{
					CopyCalculatedValue(sourceCellRow, num, worksheetRow, num);
				}
				_columnInputCellTarget = null;
			}
			_dependencyGraph.DirtyVolatileFormulas();
			_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(_columnInputCellSource);
			_columnInputCellSource = null;
		}

		private void EvaluateFormulasForDataTable(WorksheetDataTable dataTable)
		{
			if (dataTable.Worksheet == null || dataTable.CellsInTable == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (dataTable.HasColumnInputCell)
				{
					if (dataTable.HasRowInputCell)
					{
						EvaluateFormulasForTwoInputDataTable(dataTable);
					}
					else
					{
						EvaluateFormulasForColumnInputDataTable(dataTable);
					}
				}
				else if (dataTable.HasRowInputCell)
				{
					EvaluateFormulasForRowInputDataTable(dataTable);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_columnInputCellSource = null;
				_columnInputCellTarget = null;
				_rowInputCellSource = null;
				_rowInputCellTarget = null;
			}
		}

		private void EvaluateFormulasForRowInputDataTable(WorksheetDataTable dataTable)
		{
			WorksheetRowCollection rows = dataTable.Worksheet.Rows;
			WorksheetRegion interiorCells = dataTable.InteriorCells;
			WorksheetRegion cellsInTable = dataTable.CellsInTable;
			short firstColumnInternal = cellsInTable.FirstColumnInternal;
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = rows[cellsInTable.FirstRow];
			_rowInputCellSource = dataTable.GetRowInputCellReference();
			for (short num = interiorCells.FirstColumnInternal; num <= interiorCells.LastColumnInternal; num++)
			{
				_rowInputCellTarget = worksheetRow.GetCellCalcReference(num);
				_dependencyGraph.DirtyVolatileFormulas();
				_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(_rowInputCellSource);
				EvaluateAllReferences();
				for (int i = interiorCells.FirstRow; i <= interiorCells.LastRow; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRow worksheetRow2 = rows[i];
					CopyCalculatedValue(worksheetRow2, firstColumnInternal, worksheetRow2, num);
				}
				_rowInputCellTarget = null;
			}
			_dependencyGraph.DirtyVolatileFormulas();
			_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(_rowInputCellSource);
			_rowInputCellSource = null;
		}

		private void EvaluateFormulasForTwoInputDataTable(WorksheetDataTable dataTable)
		{
			WorksheetRowCollection rows = dataTable.Worksheet.Rows;
			WorksheetRegion interiorCells = dataTable.InteriorCells;
			WorksheetRegion cellsInTable = dataTable.CellsInTable;
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = rows[cellsInTable.FirstRow];
			short firstColumnInternal = cellsInTable.FirstColumnInternal;
			short firstColumnInternal2 = interiorCells.FirstColumnInternal;
			_ = interiorCells.Width;
			_columnInputCellSource = dataTable.GetColumnInputCellReference();
			_rowInputCellSource = dataTable.GetRowInputCellReference();
			for (int i = interiorCells.FirstRow; i <= interiorCells.LastRow; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow2 = rows[i];
				_columnInputCellTarget = worksheetRow2.GetCellCalcReference(firstColumnInternal);
				for (short num = firstColumnInternal2; num <= interiorCells.LastColumnInternal; num++)
				{
					_rowInputCellTarget = worksheetRow.GetCellCalcReference(num);
					_dependencyGraph.DirtyVolatileFormulas();
					_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(_columnInputCellSource);
					_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(_rowInputCellSource);
					EvaluateAllReferences();
					CopyCalculatedValue(worksheetRow, firstColumnInternal, worksheetRow2, num);
					_rowInputCellTarget = null;
				}
				_columnInputCellTarget = null;
			}
			_dependencyGraph.DirtyVolatileFormulas();
			_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(_columnInputCellSource);
			_dependencyGraph.DirtyReference(_rowInputCellSource);
			_columnInputCellSource = null;
			_rowInputCellSource = null;
		}

		private void EvaluateReference(RefBase reference)
		{
			reference.IsDirty = false;
			if (reference is NamedCalcReferenceBase)
			{
				return;
			}
			AppliedFormula appliedFormula = reference.AppliedFormula;
			if (appliedFormula != null)
			{
				_evaluatedFormulas.Add(appliedFormula);
				ExcelCalcValue evaluatedValue = ((!reference.IsInCircularity || _workbook.IterativeCalculationsEnabled) ? appliedFormula.Evaluate(_workbook) : ((!(GetResolvedReference(reference) is NamedCalcReferenceBase)) ? new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Circularity)) : null));
				if (reference.IsInCircularity)
				{
					IncrementCircularIterationCount(reference);
				}
				AfterFormulaEvaluationCompleted(reference, evaluatedValue);
			}
		}

		private ushort GetCircularIterationCount(RefBase reference)
		{
			_circularIterationCounts.TryGetValue(reference, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		private void IncrementCircularIterationCount(RefBase reference)
		{
			_circularIterationCounts.TryGetValue(reference, out var value);
			value = (_circularIterationCounts[reference] = (ushort)(value + 1));
		}

		private void Recalculate(CellCalcReference ensureCalculatedReference, bool shouldCalculateDataTables)
		{
			if (_isRecalculating)
			{
				return;
			}
			_isRecalculating = true;
			try
			{
				_dependencyGraph.Verify();
				if (!ShouldRecalculate(ensureCalculatedReference, shouldCalculateDataTables))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (shouldCalculateDataTables && _dirtyTables.Count != 0)
				{
					_isEvaluatingDataTables = true;
					HashSet<WorksheetDataTable> dirtyTables = _dirtyTables;
					_dirtyTables = new HashSet<WorksheetDataTable>();
					foreach (WorksheetDataTable item in dirtyTables)
					{
						EvaluateFormulasForDataTable(item);
					}
					_isEvaluatingDataTables = false;
				}
				EvaluateAllReferences();
				foreach (AppliedFormula evaluatedFormula in _evaluatedFormulas)
				{
					evaluatedFormula.OnAfterRecalculationOperation(this);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_evaluatedFormulas.Clear();
				_isRecalculating = false;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldRecalculate(CellCalcReference ensureCalculatedReference, bool shouldCalculateDataTables)
		{
			if (ensureCalculatedReference == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ensureCalculatedReference.IsDirty)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!shouldCalculateDataTables || _dirtyTables.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			WorksheetDataTable cellAssociatedDataTableInternal = ensureCalculatedReference.Row.GetCellAssociatedDataTableInternal(ensureCalculatedReference.ColumnIndex);
			if (cellAssociatedDataTableInternal != null)
			{
				return _dirtyTables.Contains(cellAssociatedDataTableInternal);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void TryReplaceDataTableInputCell(ref RefBase reference)
		{
			RefBase refBase;
			if (_columnInputCellSource == reference)
			{
				refBase = _columnInputCellTarget;
			}
			else
			{
				if (_rowInputCellSource != reference)
				{
					return;
				}
				refBase = _rowInputCellTarget;
			}
			if (reference.CalculationContext.WillUseValueInCalculations)
			{
				CalculationContext.GetFormulaOwner(ref reference.CalculationContext)?.Formula.AddDynamicReference(refBase);
			}
			reference = refBase;
		}

		private void UpdateReferencedTableMap(IExcelCalcFormula formula, RefBase baseReference, bool isAdding)
		{
			if (!(formula is AppliedFormula appliedFormula))
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<WorksheetTable, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<WorksheetTable, bool>();
			FormulaToken[] postfixTokenList = appliedFormula.Formula.PostfixTokenList;
			for (int i = 0; i < postfixTokenList.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!(postfixTokenList[i] is ReferenceToken referenceToken))
				{
					continue;
				}
				WorksheetTable worksheetTable = null;
				if (referenceToken is NameToken nameToken)
				{
					worksheetTable = nameToken.NamedReference as WorksheetTable;
				}
				else if (referenceToken is StructuredTableReference structuredTableReference)
				{
					worksheetTable = structuredTableReference.TableReference as WorksheetTable;
				}
				if (worksheetTable == null || dictionary.ContainsKey(worksheetTable))
				{
					continue;
				}
				dictionary.Add(worksheetTable, value: true);
				if (!_referencedTableMap.TryGetValue(worksheetTable, out var value))
				{
					if (!isAdding)
					{
						continue;
					}
					value = new List<RefBase>();
					_referencedTableMap[worksheetTable] = value;
				}
				if (isAdding)
				{
					value.Add(baseReference);
				}
				else
				{
					value.Remove(baseReference);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	internal sealed class ExcelReferenceError : RefBase
	{
		public static readonly ExcelReferenceError Instance = new ExcelReferenceError();

		public sealed override short ColumnIndex => -1;

		public sealed override string ElementName => "#REF!";

		public sealed override WorksheetRow Row => null;

		protected sealed override ExcelCalcValue ValueInternal => new ExcelCalcValue(ExcelCalcErrorValue.ReferenceError);

		private ExcelReferenceError()
		{
		}

		public override void AddSuccessor(RefBase successor)
		{
		}

		public sealed override bool ContainsReference(IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool EqualsReferenceHelper(IExcelCalcReference resolvedReference)
		{
			return resolvedReference is ExcelReferenceError;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 1;
		}

		public sealed override bool IsSubsetReference(IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ExternalCellCalcReference : RefBase
	{
		private WorksheetCellAddress address;

		private WorksheetReferenceExternal worksheetReference;

		public sealed override short ColumnIndex => address.ColumnIndex;

		public sealed override string ElementName => worksheetReference.ReferenceName + address.ToString(useRelativeRow: false, useRelativeColumn: false, worksheetReference.WorkbookReference.TargetWorkbook.CurrentFormat, CellReferenceMode.A1);

		public sealed override WorksheetRow Row => null;

		protected sealed override ExcelCalcValue ValueInternal => new ExcelCalcValue(worksheetReference.GetCachedValue(address.RowIndex, address.ColumnIndex));

		public sealed override Workbook Workbook => worksheetReference.WorkbookReference.TargetWorkbook;

		public WorksheetCellAddress Address => address;

		public WorksheetReference WorksheetReference => worksheetReference;

		{

		}

		public sealed override bool ContainsReference(IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			IExcelCalcReference resolvedReference = ExcelCalcEngine.GetResolvedReference(inReference);
			if (resolvedReference is ExternalCellCalcReference externalCellCalcReference)
			{
				if (worksheetReference == externalCellCalcReference.worksheetReference)
				{
					return address == externalCellCalcReference.address;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (resolvedReference is ExternalRegionCalcReference externalRegionCalcReference)
			{
				if (worksheetReference == externalRegionCalcReference.WorksheetReference)
				{
					return externalRegionCalcReference.Address.Contains(address);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (resolvedReference is MultiSheetExternalCellCalcReference multiSheetExternalCellCalcReference)
			{
				if (worksheetReference.WorkbookReference == multiSheetExternalCellCalcReference.FirstWorksheetReference.WorkbookReference && multiSheetExternalCellCalcReference.FirstWorksheetReference.FirstWorksheetIndex <= worksheetReference.FirstWorksheetIndex && worksheetReference.FirstWorksheetIndex <= multiSheetExternalCellCalcReference.LastWorksheetReference.FirstWorksheetIndex)
				{
					return address == multiSheetExternalCellCalcReference.Address;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (resolvedReference is MultiSheetExternalRegionCalcReference multiSheetExternalRegionCalcReference)
			{
				if (worksheetReference.WorkbookReference == multiSheetExternalRegionCalcReference.FirstWorksheetReference.WorkbookReference && multiSheetExternalRegionCalcReference.FirstWorksheetReference.FirstWorksheetIndex <= worksheetReference.FirstWorksheetIndex && worksheetReference.FirstWorksheetIndex <= multiSheetExternalRegionCalcReference.LastWorksheetReference.FirstWorksheetIndex)
				{
					return multiSheetExternalRegionCalcReference.Address.Contains(address);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool EqualsReferenceHelper(IExcelCalcReference resolvedReference)
		{
			if (!(resolvedReference is ExternalCellCalcReference externalCellCalcReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (worksheetReference == externalCellCalcReference.worksheetReference)
			{
				return address == externalCellCalcReference.address;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{

		}

		}
