	internal sealed class FormulaEvaluator : FormulaTokenVisitor
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static FormulaEvaluator _instance;

		private IExcelCalcReference _directFormulaOwnerReference;

		private ExcelCalcNumberStack _evaluationStack;

		private UltraCalcFunctionFactory _functionFactory;

		private bool _isInOptimizableSelector;

		private Stack<bool> _isUsingOptimizedSelectorFunction = new Stack<bool>();

		private FormulaToken[] _postfixTokenList;

		private FormulaEvaluator()
		{
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_directFormulaOwnerReference = null;
			_evaluationStack = null;
			_functionFactory = null;
			_isInOptimizableSelector = false;
			_isUsingOptimizedSelectorFunction.Clear();
			_postfixTokenList = null;
			base.Reset();
		}

		public override void VisitAttrChooseToken(AttrChooseToken token)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = TryUseOptimizedSelectorFunction(token);
			if (excelCalcValue != null)
			{
				int num = -1;
				if (excelCalcValue.ToDouble(out var result))
				{
					num = (int)Math.Floor(result);
				}
				if (num < 1 || token.SkipTokenIndexes.Count < num)
				{
					_evaluationStack.Push(new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value)));
					SetNextToken(token.ChooseFunctionIndex);
				}
				else if (1 < num)
				{
					base.CurrentTokenIndex = token.SkipTokenIndexes[num - 2];
				}
			}
		}

		public override void VisitAttrIfToken(AttrIfToken token)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = TryUseOptimizedSelectorFunction(token);
			if (excelCalcValue == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (excelCalcValue.ToBoolean())
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				_evaluationStack.Push(new ExcelCalcValue(value));
				SetNextToken(token.IfFunctionIndex);
				return;
			}
			base.CurrentTokenIndex = token.SkipTokenIndexes[0];
			if (!token.HasFalseCondition)
			{
				_evaluationStack.Push(new ExcelCalcValue(false));
			}
		}

		public override void VisitAttrSkipToken(AttrSkipToken token)
		{
			if (_isUsingOptimizedSelectorFunction.Peek() && token.OwningSelectorFunctionIndex != 0)
			{
				SetNextToken(token.OwningSelectorFunctionIndex);
			}
		}

		public override void VisitBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token)
		{
			EvaluateFunction(token.Accept(GetCalcFunctionVisitor.Instance, _functionFactory), token, 2);
		}

		public override void VisitCellReferenceToken(CellReferenceToken token)
		{
			base.VisitCellReferenceToken(token);
			if (_directFormulaOwnerReference is NamedCalcReferenceBase && token.HasRelativeAddresses)
			{
				_evaluationStack.Peek().IsDynamicReference = true;
			}
		}

		public override void VisitFunctionOperator(FunctionOperator token)
		{
			VisitFunctionTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public override void VisitFunctionToken(IFunctionToken token)
		{
			VisitFunctionTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public override void VisitFunctionVOperator(FunctionVOperator token)
		{
			VisitFunctionTokenHelper(token);
		}

		public override void VisitNameToken(NameToken token)
		{
			if (token.NamedReference.Type != NameType.AddInFunctionName)
			{
				base.VisitNameToken(token);
			}
		}

		public override void VisitOperandToken(OperandToken token)
		{
			_evaluationStack.Push(new ExcelCalcValue(token.GetCalcValue(base.Context)));
		}

		public override void VisitUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token)
		{
			EvaluateFunction(token.Accept(GetCalcFunctionVisitor.Instance, _functionFactory), token, 1);
		}

		private bool CanUseOptimizedSelectorFunction(ISelectorFunctionOptimizationToken token)
		{
			FormulaToken formulaToken = _postfixTokenList[token.SelectorFunctionTokenIndex];
			if (formulaToken == null || token.SkipTokenIndexes.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ExcelCalcFunction excelCalcFunction = formulaToken.Accept(GetCalcFunctionVisitor.Instance, _functionFactory);
			if (excelCalcFunction == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				_evaluationStack.CurrentFunctionTokenIndex = token.SelectorFunctionTokenIndex;
				return !ShouldSplitParameter(excelCalcFunction, 0, _evaluationStack.Peek());
			}
			finally
			{
				_evaluationStack.CurrentFunctionTokenIndex = -1;
			}
		}

		private void EvaluateFunction(ExcelCalcFunction function, FormulaToken functionToken, int argumentCount)
		{
			if (function == null)
			{
				HandleUnknownFunction(argumentCount);
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				_evaluationStack.CurrentFunctionTokenIndex = base.CurrentTokenIndex;
				_evaluationStack.OnBeforeFunctionEvaluation(function, argumentCount);
				if (!PerformEvaluationForIntermediateResultArray(function, argumentCount))
				{
					function.PerformEvaluationInternal(_evaluationStack, argumentCount);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_evaluationStack.OnAfterFunctionEvaluation();
				_evaluationStack.CurrentFunctionTokenIndex = -1;
			}
		}

		private void HandleUnknownFunction(int argumentCount)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < argumentCount; i++)
			{
				_evaluationStack.Pop();
			}
			_evaluationStack.Push(new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Name)));
		}

		public static FormulaEvaluator Initialize(FormulaContext context, IExcelCalcReference directFormulaOwnerReference, ExcelCalcNumberStack evaluationStack)
		{
			if (_instance == null)
			{
				_instance = new FormulaEvaluator();
			}
			FormulaEvaluator formulaEvaluator = _instance;
			if (formulaEvaluator.Context != null)
			{
				formulaEvaluator = new FormulaEvaluator();
			}
			formulaEvaluator.Context = context;
			formulaEvaluator._directFormulaOwnerReference = directFormulaOwnerReference;
			formulaEvaluator._functionFactory = context.Workbook.CalcEngine.FunctionFactory;
			formulaEvaluator._evaluationStack = evaluationStack;
			formulaEvaluator._isInOptimizableSelector = evaluationStack.IsInOptimizableSelector;
			formulaEvaluator._postfixTokenList = context.Formula.PostfixTokenList;
			formulaEvaluator.Context.Formula.VerifyTokenReferences();
			return formulaEvaluator;
		}

		private bool PerformEvaluationForIntermediateResultArray(ExcelCalcFunction function, int argumentCount)
		{
			bool[] array = new bool[argumentCount];
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < argumentCount; i++)
			{
				if (ShouldSplitParameter(function, i, array))
				{
					flag = true;
					array[i] = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ExcelCalcValue[] array2 = new ExcelCalcValue[argumentCount];
			for (int num = argumentCount - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				array2[num] = _evaluationStack.Pop();
			}
			int num2 = 1;
			int num3 = 1;
			for (int j = 0; j < argumentCount; j++)
			{
				if (!array[j])
				{
					continue;
				}
				ArrayProxy arrayProxy = array2[j].ToArrayProxyRaw();
				if (arrayProxy == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int length = arrayProxy.GetLength(0);
				int length2 = arrayProxy.GetLength(1);
				if (length != 1)
				{
					if (num2 != 1 && num2 != length)
					{
						_evaluationStack.Push(new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value)));
						return true;
					}
					num2 = length;
				}
				if (length2 != 1)
				{
					if (num3 != 1 && num3 != length2)
					{
						_evaluationStack.Push(new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value)));
						return true;
					}
					num3 = length2;
				}
			}
			ExcelCalcValue[,] array3 = new ExcelCalcValue[num2, num3];
			for (int k = 0; k < num2; k++)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < num3; l++)
				{
					for (int m = 0; m < argumentCount; m++)
					{
						ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = array2[m];
						if (array[m])
						{
							ArrayProxy arrayProxy2 = excelCalcValue.ToArrayProxyRaw();
							int length3 = arrayProxy2.GetLength(0);
							int length4 = arrayProxy2.GetLength(1);
							int x = ((length3 != 1) ? k : 0);
							int y = ((length4 != 1) ? l : 0);
							excelCalcValue = arrayProxy2[x, y];
						}
						_evaluationStack.Push(excelCalcValue);
					}
					function.PerformEvaluationInternal(_evaluationStack, argumentCount);
					array3[k, l] = _evaluationStack.Pop();
				}
			}
			_evaluationStack.Push(new ExcelCalcValue(array3));
			return true;
		}

		private void SetNextToken(ushort tokenIndex)
		{
			base.CurrentTokenIndex = (ushort)(tokenIndex - 1);
		}

		private bool ShouldSplitParameter(ExcelCalcFunction function, int parameterIndex, bool[] parametersToSplit)
		{
			if (parametersToSplit != null && function.IsSelectorFunction && parameterIndex > 0 && parametersToSplit[0])
			{
				return _evaluationStack.GetParameterForCurrentFunction(parameterIndex).IsArrayRaw;
			}
			return ShouldSplitParameter(function, parameterIndex, _evaluationStack.GetParameterForCurrentFunction(parameterIndex));
		}

		private bool ShouldSplitParameter(ExcelCalcFunction function, int parameterIndex, ExcelCalcValue parameterValue)
		{
			if (function.GetExpectedParameterClass(parameterIndex) != TokenClass.Value)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!parameterValue.IsArrayRaw)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool isCreatedFromRegionReference = !((AppliedFormula)_evaluationStack.FormulaOwner.Formula).IsArrayFormula && parameterValue.IsReference;
			AppliedFormula currentFormula = _evaluationStack.CurrentFormula;
			if (currentFormula == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Workbook workbook = base.Context.Workbook;
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int parentTokenIndex = _evaluationStack.CurrentFunctionTokenIndex;
			UltraCalcFunctionFactory functionFactory = workbook.CalcEngine.FunctionFactory;
			while (parentTokenIndex != -1)
			{
				FormulaToken formulaToken = _postfixTokenList[parentTokenIndex];
				function = formulaToken.Accept(GetCalcFunctionVisitor.Instance, functionFactory);
				if (function != null)
				{
					if (!function.DoesParameterAllowIntermediateResultArray(parameterIndex, isCreatedFromRegionReference))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (function.GetExpectedParameterClass(parameterIndex) != TokenClass.Value)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				if (!currentFormula.Formula.TryGetArgumentInfo(parentTokenIndex, out parentTokenIndex, out parameterIndex))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private ExcelCalcValue TryUseOptimizedSelectorFunction(ISelectorFunctionOptimizationToken token)
		{
			bool flag = CanUseOptimizedSelectorFunction(token);
			PushOptimizableSelectorMarker(flag);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = _evaluationStack.Pop();
			if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				_evaluationStack.Push(new ExcelCalcValue(excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue()));
				SetNextToken(token.SelectorFunctionTokenIndex);
				return null;
			}
			return excelCalcValue;
		}

		private bool PopOptimizableSelectorMarker()
		{
			bool result = _isUsingOptimizedSelectorFunction.Pop();
			UpdateIsInOptimizableSelector();
			return result;
		}

		private void PushOptimizableSelectorMarker(bool value)
		{
			_isUsingOptimizedSelectorFunction.Push(value);
			UpdateIsInOptimizableSelector();
		}

		private void UpdateIsInOptimizableSelector()
		{
			_evaluationStack.IsInOptimizableSelector = _isInOptimizableSelector || _isUsingOptimizedSelectorFunction.Count != 0;
		}

		private void VisitFunctionTokenHelper(IFunctionToken token)
		{
			FormulaToken formulaToken = token.FormulaToken;
			ExcelCalcFunction excelCalcFunction = formulaToken.Accept(GetCalcFunctionVisitor.Instance, _functionFactory);
			if (excelCalcFunction == null || !excelCalcFunction.IsSelectorFunction || !PopOptimizableSelectorMarker())
			{
				EvaluateFunction(excelCalcFunction, formulaToken, token.ArgumentCount);
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class MatrixUtilities
	{
		public enum NonNumericElementBehavior
		{
			CausesError,
			TreatAsZero,
			Ignore
		}

		public static double CalculateCofactor(double[,] matrix, int n, int x, int y)
		{
			double[,] matrix2 = CreateMinorMatrix(matrix, n, x, y);
			double num = CalculateDeterminant(matrix2, n - 1);
			return Math.Pow(-1.0, y + x) * num;
		}

		public static double CalculateDeterminant(double[,] matrix, int n)
		{
			if (n == 1)
			{
				return matrix[0, 0];
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
			{
				double num2 = CalculateCofactor(matrix, n, i, 0);
				num += matrix[i, 0] * num2;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static double[,] CalculateInverse(double[,] matrix, int n, out ExcelCalcErrorValue error)
		{
			error = null;
			double num = CalculateDeterminant(matrix, n);
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				error = ErrorValue.ValueRangeOverflow.ToCalcErrorValue();
				return null;
			}
			double num2 = 1.0 / num;
			double[,] matrix2 = TransposeMatrix(matrix);
			double[,] array = new double[n, n];
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
				{
					array[i, j] = num2 * CalculateCofactor(matrix2, n, i, j);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static double[,] ConvertArrayToMatrix(ArrayProxy array, NonNumericElementBehavior nonNumericElementBehavior, out ExcelCalcErrorValue error)
		{
			error = null;
			int length = array.GetLength(0);
			int length2 = array.GetLength(1);
			double[,] array2 = new double[length, length2];
			for (int i = 0; i < length2; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < length; j++)
				{
					ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = array[j, i];
					if (excelCalcValue.IsError)
					{
						error = excelCalcValue.ToErrorValue();
						return null;
					}
					if (excelCalcValue.IsString || excelCalcValue.IsBoolean)
					{
						switch (nonNumericElementBehavior)
						{
						case NonNumericElementBehavior.CausesError:
							error = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value);
							return null;
						case NonNumericElementBehavior.TreatAsZero:
							array2[j, i] = 0.0;
							break;
						case NonNumericElementBehavior.Ignore:
							array2[j, i] = double.NaN;
							break;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						array2[j, i] = excelCalcValue.ToDouble();
					}
				}
			}
			return array2;
		}

		private static double[,] CreateMinorMatrix(double[,] matrix, int n, int sourceX, int sourceY)
		{
			double[,] array = new double[n - 1, n - 1];
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num < n)
			{
				if (num == sourceX)
				{
					num2--;
				}
				else
				{
					int num3 = 0;
					int num4 = 0;
					while (num3 < n)
					{
						if (num3 == sourceY)
						{
							num4--;
						}
						else
						{
							array[num2, num4] = matrix[num, num3];
						}
						num3++;
						num4++;
					}
				}
				num++;
				num2++;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static T[,] TransposeMatrix<T>(T[,] matrix)
		{
			int length = matrix.GetLength(0);
			int length2 = matrix.GetLength(1);
			T[,] array = new T[length2, length];
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < length2; j++)
				{
					array[j, i] = matrix[i, j];
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static ExcelCalcValue[,] TransposeMatrix(ArrayProxy matrix)
		{
			int length = matrix.GetLength(0);
			int length2 = matrix.GetLength(1);
			ExcelCalcValue[,] array = new ExcelCalcValue[length2, length];
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < length2; j++)
				{
					array[j, i] = matrix[i, j];
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class MultiSheetCellCalcReference : RefBase
	{
		private class MultiSheetCellReferencesCollection : IExcelCalcReferenceCollectionEx, IExcelCalcReferenceCollection, IEnumerable<IExcelCalcReference>, IEnumerable
		{
			private MultiSheetCellCalcReference reference;

			public MultiSheetCellReferencesCollection(MultiSheetCellCalcReference reference)
			{
				this.reference = reference;
			}

			public IEnumerator<IExcelCalcReference> GetEnumerator()
			{
				foreach (WorksheetRegion region in reference.regionGroup)
				{
					yield return region.TopRow.GetCellCalcReference(region.FirstColumnInternal);
				}
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return ((IEnumerable<IExcelCalcReference>)this).GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		private readonly WorksheetCellAddress address;

		private readonly Worksheet firstWorksheetReference;

		private readonly Worksheet lastWorksheetReference;

		private readonly MultiSheetCellReferencesCollection references;

		private readonly List<WorksheetRegion> regionGroup;

		private readonly ExcelCalcValue value;

		public sealed override short ColumnIndex => address.ColumnIndex;

		public override object Context => regionGroup;

		public sealed override string ElementName => Utilities.CreateReferenceString(null, firstWorksheetReference.Name, lastWorksheetReference.Name) + address.ToString(useRelativeRow: false, useRelativeColumn: false, firstWorksheetReference.CurrentFormat, CellReferenceMode.A1);

		public sealed override bool IsEnumerable => true;

		public sealed override IExcelCalcReferenceCollectionEx References => references;

		public sealed override WorksheetRow Row => firstWorksheetReference.Rows[address.RowIndex];

		protected sealed override ExcelCalcValue ValueInternal => value;

		public MultiSheetCellCalcReference(Worksheet firstWorksheetReference, Worksheet lastWorksheetReference, WorksheetCellAddress address)
		{
			this.firstWorksheetReference = firstWorksheetReference;
			this.lastWorksheetReference = lastWorksheetReference;
			this.address = address;
			WorksheetCollection worksheets = this.firstWorksheetReference.Workbook.Worksheets;
			WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress = new WorksheetRegionAddress(this.address.RowIndex, this.address.RowIndex, this.address.ColumnIndex, this.address.ColumnIndex);
			int num = this.lastWorksheetReference.Index - this.firstWorksheetReference.Index + 1;
			regionGroup = new List<WorksheetRegion>(num);
			ArrayProxy[] array = new ArrayProxy[num];
			int num2 = this.firstWorksheetReference.Index;
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num2 <= this.lastWorksheetReference.Index)
			{
				WorksheetRegion cachedRegion = worksheets[num2].GetCachedRegion(regionAddress);
				regionGroup.Add(cachedRegion);
				array[num3] = new RegionCalcReference.RegionArrayProxy(cachedRegion);
				num2++;
				num3++;
			}
			value = new ExcelCalcValue(array);
			references = new MultiSheetCellReferencesCollection(this);
		}

		public sealed override bool ContainsReference(IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			IList<WorksheetRegion> list = CalcUtilities.GetRegionGroup(inReference);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = list[i];
				if (worksheetRegion.Worksheet.Index >= firstWorksheetReference.Index && lastWorksheetReference.Index >= worksheetRegion.Worksheet.Index && worksheetRegion.Address.Contains(address))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool EqualsReferenceHelper(IExcelCalcReference resolvedReference)
		{
			if (!(resolvedReference is MultiSheetCellCalcReference multiSheetCellCalcReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (firstWorksheetReference == multiSheetCellCalcReference.firstWorksheetReference && lastWorksheetReference == multiSheetCellCalcReference.lastWorksheetReference)
			{
				return address == multiSheetCellCalcReference.address;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return firstWorksheetReference.GetHashCode() ^ (lastWorksheetReference.GetHashCode() << 1) ^ (address.GetHashCode() << 2);
		}

		public sealed override IList<WorksheetRegion> GetRegionGroup()
		{
			return regionGroup;
		}

		public sealed override bool IsSubsetReference(IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			IList<WorksheetRegion> list = CalcUtilities.GetRegionGroup(inReference);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = list[i];
				if (worksheetRegion.Worksheet.Index < firstWorksheetReference.Index || lastWorksheetReference.Index < worksheetRegion.Worksheet.Index)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!worksheetRegion.Address.Contains(address))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		public MultiSheetRegionCalcReference(Worksheet firstWorksheetReference, Worksheet lastWorksheetReference, WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress)
		{
			this.firstWorksheetReference = firstWorksheetReference;
			this.lastWorksheetReference = lastWorksheetReference;
			this.regionAddress = regionAddress;
			WorksheetCollection worksheets = this.firstWorksheetReference.Workbook.Worksheets;
			int num = this.lastWorksheetReference.Index - this.firstWorksheetReference.Index + 1;
			regionGroup = new List<WorksheetRegion>(num);
			ArrayProxy[] array = new ArrayProxy[num];
			int num2 = this.firstWorksheetReference.Index;
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num2 <= this.lastWorksheetReference.Index)
			{
				WorksheetRegion cachedRegion = worksheets[num2].GetCachedRegion(regionAddress);
				regionGroup.Add(cachedRegion);
				array[num3] = new RegionCalcReference.RegionArrayProxy(cachedRegion);

				WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = list[i];
				if (worksheetRegion.Worksheet.Index >= firstWorksheetReference.Index && lastWorksheetReference.Index >= worksheetRegion.Worksheet.Index && worksheetRegion.Address.IntersectsWith(regionAddress))

					return true;
				}
			}

		}

			}

		public sealed override bool IsSubsetReference(IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			IList<WorksheetRegion> list = CalcUtilities.GetRegionGroup(inReference);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = list[i];
				if (worksheetRegion.Worksheet.Index < firstWorksheetReference.Index || lastWorksheetReference.Index < worksheetRegion.Worksheet.Index)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!worksheetRegion.Address.Contains(regionAddress))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class RegionArrayProxyBase : ArrayProxy
	{
		private ExcelCalcValue[,] array;

		internal override bool AreValuesReusable => true;

		internal override bool ContainsReferences => true;

		public abstract WorksheetRegion Region { get; }

		public RegionArrayProxyBase()
		{
		}

		internal override IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<int, ExcelCalcValue>> GetIteratorHelper(int dimension, int index)
		{
			WorksheetRegion region = Region;
			if (region == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			if (region.Worksheet == null)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<int, ExcelCalcValue>(0, new ExcelCalcValue(ErrorValue.InvalidCellReference.ToCalcErrorValue()));
				yield break;
			}
			short firstColumnIndex = region.FirstColumnInternal;
			int firstRowIndex = region.FirstRow;
			short lastColumnIndex = region.LastColumnInternal;
			int lastRowIndex = region.LastRow;
			switch (dimension)
			{
			case 0:
			{
				short columnIndexAbsolute2 = (short)(firstColumnIndex + index);
				{
					foreach (WorksheetRow row2 in region.Worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex))
					{
						CellCalcReference cellCalcReference2 = GetCellCalcReferenceIfShouldIterateCell(row2, columnIndexAbsolute2);
						if (cellCalcReference2 != null)
						{
							ExcelCalcValue value2 = WrapCellReference(cellCalcReference2);
							yield return new KeyValuePair<int, ExcelCalcValue>(row2.Index - firstRowIndex, value2);
							ExcelCalcNumberStack.OnReusableValueReleased(value2);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			case 1:
			{
				int rowIndexAbsolute = firstRowIndex + index;
				WorksheetRow row = region.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(rowIndexAbsolute);
				if (row == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				for (short columnIndexAbsolute = firstColumnIndex; columnIndexAbsolute <= lastColumnIndex; columnIndexAbsolute++)
				{
					CellCalcReference cellCalcReference = GetCellCalcReferenceIfShouldIterateCell(row, columnIndexAbsolute);
					if (cellCalcReference != null)
					{
						ExcelCalcValue value = WrapCellReference(cellCalcReference);
						yield return new KeyValuePair<int, ExcelCalcValue>(columnIndexAbsolute - firstColumnIndex, value);
						ExcelCalcNumberStack.OnReusableValueReleased(value);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			default:
				ThrowOutOfBoundsException();
				break;
			}
		}

		public override int GetLength(int dimension)
		{
			WorksheetRegion region = Region;
			if (region == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			switch (dimension)
			{
			case 0:
				return region.Width;
			case 1:
				return region.Height;
			default:
				ThrowOutOfBoundsException();
				return -1;
			}
		}

		internal override ExcelCalcValue GetValueHelper(ArrayValueContext valueContext)
		{
			WorksheetRegion region = Region;
			if (region == null || region.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return new ExcelCalcValue(new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Reference));
			}
			if (valueContext.X < 0)
			{
				ThrowOutOfBoundsException();
			}
			if (valueContext.Y < 0)
			{
				ThrowOutOfBoundsException();
			}
			short num = (short)(region.FirstColumnInternal + valueContext.X);
			int num2 = region.FirstRow + valueContext.Y;
			if (region.LastColumnInternal < num)
			{
				ThrowOutOfBoundsException();
			}
			if (region.LastRow < num2)
			{
				ThrowOutOfBoundsException();
			}
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = valueContext.OwnerRow;
			if (worksheetRow == null || worksheetRow.Index != num2)
			{
				worksheetRow = region.Worksheet.Rows[num2];
			}
			return ExcelCalcNumberStack.CreateReusableValue(worksheetRow.GetCellCalcReference(num));
		}

		internal override void IterateValues(bool shouldIterateBlanks, Action<ExcelCalcValue, ArrayValueContext> valueCallback)
		{
			if (shouldIterateBlanks)
			{
				base.IterateValues(shouldIterateBlanks, valueCallback);
				return;
			}
			WorksheetRegion region = Region;
			int firstRow = region.FirstRow;
			int firstColumn = region.FirstColumn;
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in region.Worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(firstRow, region.LastRow))
			{
				int y = item.Index - firstRow;
				short firstColumnInternal = region.FirstColumnInternal;
				if (firstColumnInternal == region.LastColumn)
				{
					if (item.DoesCellExist(firstColumnInternal))
					{
						CellCalcReference cellCalcReference = item.GetCellCalcReference(firstColumnInternal);
						ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = WrapCellReference(cellCalcReference);
						valueCallback(excelCalcValue, new ArrayValueContext(item, firstColumnInternal - firstColumn, y));
						ExcelCalcNumberStack.OnReusableValueReleased(excelCalcValue);
					}
					continue;
				}
				foreach (CellDataContext cellsWithDatum in item.GetCellsWithData(firstColumnInternal, region.LastColumn))
				{
					CellCalcReference cellCalcReference2 = item.GetCellCalcReference(cellsWithDatum.ColumnIndex);
					ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue2 = WrapCellReference(cellCalcReference2);
					valueCallback(excelCalcValue2, new ArrayValueContext(item, cellsWithDatum.ColumnIndex - firstColumn, y));
					ExcelCalcNumberStack.OnReusableValueReleased(excelCalcValue2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override ExcelCalcValue[,] ToArray()
		{
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = CalcUtilities.GetReferenceValuesForRegion(Region);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static CellCalcReference GetCellCalcReferenceIfShouldIterateCell(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			return row.TryGetCellCalcReference(columnIndex, createReferenceIfCellHasValue: true);
		}

		private ExcelCalcValue WrapCellReference(CellCalcReference cellCalcReference)
		{
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = ExcelCalcNumberStack.CreateReusableValue(cellCalcReference);
			CopyStateToContainedValue(excelCalcValue);
			return excelCalcValue;
		}
	}

					yield return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
					yield break;
				}
				short firstColumnIndex = region.FirstColumnInternal;
				short lastColumnIndex = region.LastColumnInternal;
				foreach (WorksheetRow row in region.Worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(region.FirstRow, region.LastRow))
				{
					for (short columnIndex = firstColumnIndex; columnIndex <= lastColumnIndex; columnIndex++)
					{
						CellCalcReference cellReference = row.TryGetCellCalcReference(columnIndex, createReferenceIfCellHasValue: true);
						if (cellReference != null)

							cellReference.CalculationContext = regionReference.CalculationContext;
							yield return cellReference;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

	internal sealed class RegionGroupCalcReference : RefBase
	{
		private class GeneralReferencesCollection : IExcelCalcReferenceCollectionEx, IExcelCalcReferenceCollection, IEnumerable<IExcelCalcReference>, IEnumerable
		{
			private RegionGroupCalcReference reference;

			public GeneralReferencesCollection(RegionGroupCalcReference reference)
			{
				this.reference = reference;
			}

			public IEnumerator<IExcelCalcReference> GetEnumerator()
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < reference.regionsSortedHorizontally.Count; i++)
				{
					if (reference.regionsSortedHorizontally[i].Worksheet == null)
					{
						yield return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
						yield break;
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < reference.regionsSortedHorizontally.Count; j++)
				{
					WorksheetRegion region = reference.regionsSortedHorizontally[j];
					foreach (WorksheetRow row in region.Worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(region.FirstRow, region.LastRow))
					{
						for (short columnIndex = region.FirstColumnInternal; columnIndex <= region.LastColumnInternal; columnIndex++)
						{
							CellCalcReference cellReference = row.TryGetCellCalcReference(columnIndex, createReferenceIfCellHasValue: true);
							if (cellReference != null)
							{
								cellReference.CalculationContext = reference.CalculationContext;
								yield return cellReference;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return ((IEnumerable<IExcelCalcReference>)this).GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		private readonly ReadOnlyCollection<WorksheetRegion> regionsSortedHorizontally;

		private GeneralReferencesCollection referencesCollection;

		private ExcelCalcValue value;

		private WorksheetRegion lastRegion;

		public sealed override short ColumnIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (regionsSortedHorizontally.Count == 0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return regionsSortedHorizontally[0].FirstColumnInternal;
			}
		}

		public override object Context => regionsSortedHorizontally;

		public sealed override string ElementName
		{
			get
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				foreach (WorksheetRegion item in regionsSortedHorizontally)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(item.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: true));
					stringBuilder.Append(",");
				}
				if (stringBuilder.Length >= 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Remove(stringBuilder.Length - 1, 1);
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		public sealed override bool IsEnumerable => true;

		public sealed override IExcelCalcReferenceCollectionEx References
		{
			get
			{
				if (referencesCollection == null)
				{
					referencesCollection = new GeneralReferencesCollection(this);
				}
				return referencesCollection;
			}
		}

		public sealed override WorksheetRow Row
		{
			get
			{
				if (regionsSortedHorizontally.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = regionsSortedHorizontally[0];
				return worksheetRegion.TopRow;
			}
		}

		protected sealed override ExcelCalcValue ValueInternal => value;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<WorksheetRegion> Regions => regionsSortedHorizontally;

		private RegionGroupCalcReference(List<WorksheetRegion> regionsSortedHorizontally, WorksheetRegion lastRegion)
		{
			this.regionsSortedHorizontally = regionsSortedHorizontally.AsReadOnly();
			Initialize(lastRegion);
		}

		public RegionGroupCalcReference(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
			: this(row.Worksheet.GetCachedRegion(row.Index, columnIndex, row.Index, columnIndex))
		{
		}

		public RegionGroupCalcReference(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			regionsSortedHorizontally = new List<WorksheetRegion> { region }.AsReadOnly();
			Initialize(region);
		}

		private void Initialize(WorksheetRegion lastRegion)
		{
			ArrayProxy[] array = new ArrayProxy[regionsSortedHorizontally.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < regionsSortedHorizontally.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new RegionCalcReference.RegionArrayProxy(regionsSortedHorizontally[i]);
			}
			value = new ExcelCalcValue(array);
			this.lastRegion = lastRegion;
		}

		public sealed override bool ContainsReference(IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			IList<WorksheetRegion> regionGroup = CalcUtilities.GetRegionGroup(inReference);
			foreach (WorksheetRegion item in regionGroup)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetRegion item2 in regionsSortedHorizontally)
				{
					if (item2.IntersectsWith(item))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool EqualsReferenceHelper(IExcelCalcReference resolvedReference)
		{
			if (!(resolvedReference is RegionGroupCalcReference regionGroupCalcReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (regionsSortedHorizontally.Count != regionGroupCalcReference.regionsSortedHorizontally.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < regionsSortedHorizontally.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!regionsSortedHorizontally[0].Equals(regionGroupCalcReference.regionsSortedHorizontally[0]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return regionsSortedHorizontally.Count switch
			{
				0 => 0, 
				1 => regionsSortedHorizontally[0].GetHashCode(), 
				_ => regionsSortedHorizontally.Count ^ regionsSortedHorizontally[0].GetHashCode() ^ (regionsSortedHorizontally[regionsSortedHorizontally.Count - 1].GetHashCode() << 8), 
			};
		}

		public sealed override WorksheetRegion GetLastRegionGroup()
		{
			return lastRegion;
		}

		public sealed override IList<WorksheetRegion> GetRegionGroup()
		{
			return regionsSortedHorizontally;
		}

		public sealed override bool IsSubsetReference(IExcelCalcReference inReference)
		{
			IList<WorksheetRegion> regionGroup = CalcUtilities.GetRegionGroup(inReference);
			if (regionGroup.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetRegion item in regionGroup)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (WorksheetRegion item2 in regionsSortedHorizontally)
				{
					if (item2.Contains(item))
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected sealed override RefBase ResolveReferenceForArrayFormula(CellCalcReference formulaOwner, out ExcelCalcErrorValue errorValue)
		{
			if (regionsSortedHorizontally.Count != 1)
			{
				errorValue = new ExcelCalcErrorValue(ExcelCalcErrorCode.Value);
				return null;
			}
			return CalcUtilities.GetSingleReference(formulaOwner, regionsSortedHorizontally[0], out errorValue);
		}

		public static RegionGroupCalcReference FromReference(IExcelCalcReference reference)
		{
			reference = ExcelCalcEngine.GetResolvedReference(reference);
			if (reference is RegionGroupCalcReference result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (reference is CellCalcReference cellCalcReference)
			{
				return new RegionGroupCalcReference(cellCalcReference.Row, cellCalcReference.ColumnIndex);
			}
			if (reference is RegionCalcReferenceBase { Region: { } region })
			{
				return new RegionGroupCalcReference(region);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static IExcelCalcReference Intersect(RegionGroupCalcReference ref1, RegionGroupCalcReference ref2)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = ref1.Worksheet;
			if (worksheet == null || worksheet != ref2.Worksheet)
			{
				return ref1;
			}
			List<WorksheetRegion> list = new List<WorksheetRegion>();
			WorksheetRegion lastRegionGroup = ref1.GetLastRegionGroup();
			WorksheetRegion lastRegionGroup2 = ref2.GetLastRegionGroup();
			WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = null;
			foreach (WorksheetRegion item in ref1.regionsSortedHorizontally)
			{
				if (item.Worksheet == null)
				{
					return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
				}
				foreach (WorksheetRegion item2 in ref2.regionsSortedHorizontally)
				{
					if (item2.Worksheet == null)
					{
						return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
					}
					if ((item.FirstRow >= item2.FirstRow || item.LastRow >= item2.FirstRow) && (item2.LastRow >= item.FirstRow || item2.LastRow >= item.LastRow) && (item.FirstColumn >= item2.FirstColumn || item.LastColumn >= item2.FirstColumn) && (item2.LastColumn >= item.FirstColumn || item2.LastColumn >= item.LastColumn))
					{
						list.Add(item.Worksheet.GetCachedRegion(Math.Max(item.FirstRow, item2.FirstRow), Math.Max(item.FirstColumn, item2.FirstColumn), Math.Min(item.LastRow, item2.LastRow), Math.Min(item.LastColumn, item2.LastColumn)));
						if (worksheetRegion == null && item == lastRegionGroup && item2 == lastRegionGroup2)
						{
							worksheetRegion = list[list.Count - 1];
						}
					}
				}
			}
			list.Sort(WorksheetRegion.HorizontalSorter.Instance);
			if (worksheetRegion == null && list.Count > 0)
			{
				worksheetRegion = list[list.Count - 1];
			}
			return new RegionGroupCalcReference(list, worksheetRegion).GetResolvedReference();
		}

		public static IExcelCalcReference Range(RegionGroupCalcReference ref1, RegionGroupCalcReference ref2)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = ref1.Worksheet;
			if (worksheet == null || worksheet != ref2.Worksheet)
			{
				return ref1;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ref1.regionsSortedHorizontally.Count; i++)
			{
				if (ref1.regionsSortedHorizontally[i].Worksheet == null)
				{
					return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < ref2.regionsSortedHorizontally.Count; j++)
			{
				if (ref2.regionsSortedHorizontally[j].Worksheet == null)
				{
					return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
				}
			}
			List<WorksheetRegion> list = new List<WorksheetRegion>(ref1.regionsSortedHorizontally);
			list.Sort(WorksheetRegion.VerticalSorter.Instance);
			List<WorksheetRegion> list2 = new List<WorksheetRegion>(ref2.regionsSortedHorizontally);
			list2.Sort(WorksheetRegion.VerticalSorter.Instance);
			int firstRow = list[0].FirstRow;
			int firstRow2 = list2[0].FirstRow;
			int firstColumn = ref1.regionsSortedHorizontally[0].FirstColumn;
			int firstColumn2 = ref2.regionsSortedHorizontally[0].FirstColumn;
			int lastRow = list[list.Count - 1].LastRow;
			int lastRow2 = list2[list2.Count - 1].LastRow;
			int lastColumn = ref1.regionsSortedHorizontally[ref1.regionsSortedHorizontally.Count - 1].LastColumn;
			int lastColumn2 = ref2.regionsSortedHorizontally[ref2.regionsSortedHorizontally.Count - 1].LastColumn;
			WorksheetRegion cachedRegion = ref1.regionsSortedHorizontally[0].Worksheet.GetCachedRegion(Math.Min(firstRow, firstRow2), Math.Min(firstColumn, firstColumn2), Math.Max(lastRow, lastRow2), Math.Max(lastColumn, lastColumn2));
			return cachedRegion.CalcReference;
		}

		public static RefBase Union(RegionGroupCalcReference ref1, RegionGroupCalcReference ref2)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = ref1.Worksheet;
			if (worksheet == null || worksheet != ref2.Worksheet)
			{
				return ref1;
			}
			List<WorksheetRegion> list = new List<WorksheetRegion>();
			list.AddRange(ref1.regionsSortedHorizontally);
			list.AddRange(ref2.regionsSortedHorizontally);
			list.Sort(WorksheetRegion.HorizontalSorter.Instance);
			return new RegionGroupCalcReference(list, ref1.GetLastRegionGroup()).GetResolvedReference();
		}

		private RefBase GetResolvedReference()
		{
			if (regionsSortedHorizontally.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (regionsSortedHorizontally.Count != 1)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return regionsSortedHorizontally[0].CalcReference;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class TableCalcReferenceBase : RegionCalcReferenceBase
	{
		internal class TableReferenceArrayProxy : RegionArrayProxyBase
		{
			private TableCalcReferenceBase associatedReference;

			public override WorksheetRegion Region => associatedReference.Region;

			public TableReferenceArrayProxy(TableCalcReferenceBase associatedReference)
			{
				this.associatedReference = associatedReference;
			}
		}

		private readonly StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? _firstAreaKeyword;

		private readonly StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? _lastAreaKeyword;

		private readonly WorksheetRow _rowOfFormulaOwner;

		private readonly ExcelCalcValue _value;

		public sealed override Workbook Workbook => Table?.Workbook;

		protected sealed override ExcelCalcValue ValueInternal => _value;

		protected StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? FirstAreaKeyword => _firstAreaKeyword;

		protected StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? LastAreaKeyword => _lastAreaKeyword;

		public abstract WorksheetTable Table { get; }

		protected WorksheetRegion TableRegion
		{
			get
			{
				WorksheetTable table = Table;
				if (table == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!FirstAreaKeyword.HasValue)
				{
					return table.DataAreaRegion;
				}
				WorksheetRegion tableRegion = GetTableRegion(table, FirstAreaKeyword.Value);
				if (!LastAreaKeyword.HasValue)
				{
					return tableRegion;
				}
				WorksheetRegion tableRegion2 = GetTableRegion(table, LastAreaKeyword.Value);
				return WorksheetRegion.Union(tableRegion, tableRegion2);
			}
		}

		public TableCalcReferenceBase(WorksheetRow rowOfFormulaOwner, StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? firstAreaKeyword, StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? lastAreaKeyword)
		{
			_firstAreaKeyword = firstAreaKeyword;
			_lastAreaKeyword = lastAreaKeyword;
			_rowOfFormulaOwner = rowOfFormulaOwner;
			_value = new ExcelCalcValue(new TableReferenceArrayProxy(this));
		}

		public sealed override RefBase ResolveReference(ref CalculationContext context, bool splitArraysForValueParameters, out ExcelCalcErrorValue errorValue)
		{
			IExcelCalcReference formulaOwner = CalculationContext.GetFormulaOwner(ref context);
			if (formulaOwner != null)
			{
				StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? firstAreaKeyword = _firstAreaKeyword;
				if (firstAreaKeyword == StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.ThisRow && firstAreaKeyword.HasValue && formulaOwner is CellCalcReference cellCalcReference && cellCalcReference.Row != _rowOfFormulaOwner)
				{
					TableCalcReferenceBase tableCalcReferenceBase = Clone(cellCalcReference.Row);
					tableCalcReferenceBase.ResolveReference(ref context, splitArraysForValueParameters, out errorValue);
					return tableCalcReferenceBase;
				}
			}
			return base.ResolveReference(ref context, splitArraysForValueParameters, out errorValue);
		}

		protected abstract TableCalcReferenceBase Clone(WorksheetRow formulaOwnerRow);

		private WorksheetRegion GetTableRegion(WorksheetTable table, StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType keywordType)
		{
			switch (keywordType)
			{
			case StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.All:
				return table.WholeTableRegion;
			default:
				return table.DataAreaRegion;
			case StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Headers:
				return table.HeaderRowRegion;
			case StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Totals:
				return table.TotalsRowRegion;
			case StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.ThisRow:
			{
				if (_rowOfFormulaOwner == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				WorksheetRegion dataAreaRegion = table.DataAreaRegion;
				if (dataAreaRegion == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (dataAreaRegion.Worksheet == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (_rowOfFormulaOwner.Index < dataAreaRegion.FirstRow || dataAreaRegion.LastRow < _rowOfFormulaOwner.Index)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return dataAreaRegion.Worksheet.GetCachedRegion(_rowOfFormulaOwner.Index, dataAreaRegion.FirstColumn, _rowOfFormulaOwner.Index, dataAreaRegion.LastColumn);
			}
			}
		}

		protected bool EqualsHelper(TableCalcReferenceBase other)
		{
			StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? firstAreaKeyword = _firstAreaKeyword;
			StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? firstAreaKeyword2 = other._firstAreaKeyword;
			if (firstAreaKeyword.GetValueOrDefault() != firstAreaKeyword2.GetValueOrDefault() || firstAreaKeyword.HasValue != firstAreaKeyword2.HasValue || _lastAreaKeyword != other._lastAreaKeyword)
			{
				return false;
			}
			StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? firstAreaKeyword3 = _firstAreaKeyword;
			if (firstAreaKeyword3 == StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.ThisRow && firstAreaKeyword3.HasValue && _rowOfFormulaOwner != other._rowOfFormulaOwner)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TableCalcReference : TableCalcReferenceBase
	{
		private WorksheetTable _table;

		public sealed override string ElementName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.FirstAreaKeyword.HasValue)
				{
					return _table.Name;
				}
				string keywordText = FormulaParser.GetKeywordText(base.FirstAreaKeyword.Value);
				if (!base.LastAreaKeyword.HasValue)
				{
					return $"{_table.Name}[{keywordText}]";
				}
				string keywordText2 = FormulaParser.GetKeywordText(base.LastAreaKeyword.Value);
				return $"{_table.Name}[[{keywordText}],[{keywordText2}]]";
			}
		}

		public override WorksheetRegion Region => base.TableRegion;

		public override WorksheetTable Table => _table;

		public TableCalcReference(WorksheetRow rowOfFormulaOwner, WorksheetTable table, StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? firstAreaKeyword, StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? lastAreaKeyword)
			: base(rowOfFormulaOwner, firstAreaKeyword, lastAreaKeyword)
		{
			_table = table;
		}

		protected override TableCalcReferenceBase Clone(WorksheetRow formulaOwnerRow)
		{
			return new TableCalcReference(formulaOwnerRow, _table, base.FirstAreaKeyword, base.LastAreaKeyword);
		}

		protected override bool EqualsReferenceHelper(IExcelCalcReference resolvedReference)
		{
			if (!(resolvedReference is TableCalcReference tableCalcReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_table == tableCalcReference._table)
			{
				return EqualsHelper(tableCalcReference);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _table.GetHashCode() ^ base.FirstAreaKeyword.GetHashCode() ^ base.LastAreaKeyword.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

		}

	internal sealed class TableColumnRangeCalcReference : TableCalcReferenceBase
	{

		private WorksheetTableColumn _lastColumn;

		public sealed override string ElementName

					return $"{table.Name}[[{_firstColumn.Name}]:[{_lastColumn.Name}]]";

				string keywordText = FormulaParser.GetKeywordText(base.FirstAreaKeyword.Value);

				{
					return $"{table.Name}[[{keywordText}],[{_firstColumn.Name}]:[{_lastColumn.Name}]]";
				}
				string keywordText2 = FormulaParser.GetKeywordText(base.LastAreaKeyword.Value);
				return $"{table.Name}[[{keywordText}],[{keywordText2}],[{_firstColumn.Name}]:[{_lastColumn.Name}]]";
			}
		}

		public override WorksheetRegion Region
		{
			get
			{
				WorksheetRegion tableRegion = base.TableRegion;
				if (tableRegion == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				WorksheetRegion columnPortionOfTableRegion = _firstColumn.GetColumnPortionOfTableRegion(tableRegion);
				WorksheetRegion columnPortionOfTableRegion2 = _lastColumn.GetColumnPortionOfTableRegion(tableRegion);
				return WorksheetRegion.Union(columnPortionOfTableRegion, columnPortionOfTableRegion2);
			}
		}

		public override WorksheetTable Table => _lastColumn.Table;

		public TableColumnRangeCalcReference(WorksheetRow rowOfFormulaOwner, WorksheetTableColumn firstColumn, WorksheetTableColumn lastColumn, StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? firstAreaKeyword, StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? lastAreaKeyword)
			: base(rowOfFormulaOwner, firstAreaKeyword, lastAreaKeyword)

		protected override bool EqualsReferenceHelper(IExcelCalcReference resolvedReference)
		{
			if (!(resolvedReference is TableColumnRangeCalcReference tableColumnRangeCalcReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_firstColumn == tableColumnRangeCalcReference._firstColumn && _lastColumn == tableColumnRangeCalcReference._lastColumn)
			{
				return EqualsHelper(tableColumnRangeCalcReference);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.FormulaUtilities
{
	internal struct CellAddress
	{
		private readonly int row;

		private readonly bool rowAddressIsRelative;

		private readonly short column;

		private readonly bool columnAddressIsRelative;

		public short Column => column;

		public bool ColumnAddressIsRelative => columnAddressIsRelative;

		public bool HasRelativeAddresses
		{
			get
			{
				if (!columnAddressIsRelative)
				{
					return rowAddressIsRelative;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public int Row => row;

		public bool RowAddressIsRelative => rowAddressIsRelative;

		public CellAddress(int row, bool rowAddressIsRelative, short column, bool columnAddressIsRelative)
		{
			this.row = row;
			this.rowAddressIsRelative = rowAddressIsRelative;
			this.column = column;
			this.columnAddressIsRelative = columnAddressIsRelative;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CellAddress? cellAddress = obj as CellAddress?;
			if (cellAddress.HasValue)
			{
				return this == cellAddress.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = (column << 16) | row;
			if (rowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				num <<= 1;
			}
			if (columnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				num <<= 2;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(CellAddress a, CellAddress b)
		{
			if (a.row == b.row && a.rowAddressIsRelative == b.rowAddressIsRelative && a.column == b.column)
			{
				return a.columnAddressIsRelative == b.columnAddressIsRelative;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(CellAddress a, CellAddress b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public static string GetCellReferenceString(int row, int column, WorkbookFormat format = WorkbookFormat.Excel2007, bool rowAddressIsRelative = true, bool columnAddressIsRelative = true, int sourceCellRowIndex = -1, short sourceCellColumnIndex = -1, bool relativeAddressesAreOffsets = false, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode = CellReferenceMode.A1)
		{
			string rowString = GetRowString(row, rowAddressIsRelative, format, sourceCellRowIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, cellReferenceMode);
			string columnString = GetColumnString(column, columnAddressIsRelative, format, sourceCellColumnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, cellReferenceMode);
			if (cellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.A1)
			{
				return columnString + rowString;
			}
			return rowString + columnString;
		}

		public static string GetColumnString(int column, bool columnAddressIsRelative, WorkbookFormat format, short sourceCellColumnIndex, bool relativeAddressesAreOffsets, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			int maxColumnCount = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(format);
			return GetColumnString(column, columnAddressIsRelative, maxColumnCount, sourceCellColumnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, cellReferenceMode);
		}

		public static string GetColumnString(int column, bool columnAddressIsRelative, int maxColumnCount, short sourceCellColumnIndex, bool relativeAddressesAreOffsets, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			column %= maxColumnCount;
			int num = Math.Max(0, (int)sourceCellColumnIndex);
			if (columnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				if (relativeAddressesAreOffsets)
				{
					if (column + num < 0)
					{
						column += maxColumnCount;
					}
					else if (column + num >= maxColumnCount)
					{
						column -= maxColumnCount;
					}
				}
				else if (column < 0)
				{
					column += maxColumnCount;
				}
			}
			if (cellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.A1)
			{
				if (columnAddressIsRelative && relativeAddressesAreOffsets)
				{
					column += num;
				}
				string text = string.Empty;
				bool flag = true;
				do
				{
					char c = (char)(65 + column % 26);
					column /= 26;
					if (!flag)
					{
						if (c == 'A')
						{
							c = 'Z';
							column--;
						}
						else
						{
							c = (char)(c - 1);
						}
					}
					text = c + text;
					flag = false;
				}
				while (column > 0);
				if (!columnAddressIsRelative)
				{
					return "$" + text;
				}
				return text;
			}
			if (!columnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				return "C" + (column + 1);
			}
			if (!relativeAddressesAreOffsets)
			{
				column -= num;
			}
			if (column == 0)
			{
				return "C";
			}
			return "C[" + column + "]";
		}

		public static string GetRowString(int row, bool rowAddressIsRelative, WorkbookFormat format, int sourceCellRowIndex, bool relativeAddressesAreOffsets, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			int maxRowCount = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(format);
			return GetRowString(row, rowAddressIsRelative, maxRowCount, sourceCellRowIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, cellReferenceMode);
		}

		public static string GetRowString(int row, bool rowAddressIsRelative, int maxRowCount, int sourceCellRowIndex, bool relativeAddressesAreOffsets, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			row %= maxRowCount;
			int num = 0;
			if (sourceCellRowIndex != -1)
			{
				num = sourceCellRowIndex;
			}
			if (rowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				if (relativeAddressesAreOffsets)
				{
					if (row + num < 0)
					{
						row += maxRowCount;
					}
					else if (row + num >= maxRowCount)
					{
						row -= maxRowCount;
					}
				}
				else if (row < 0)
				{
					row += maxRowCount;
				}
			}
			if (cellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.A1)
			{
				if (!rowAddressIsRelative)
				{
					return "$" + (row + 1);
				}
				if (relativeAddressesAreOffsets)
				{
					row += num;
				}
				return (row + 1).ToString();
			}
			if (!rowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				return "R" + (row + 1);
			}
			if (!relativeAddressesAreOffsets)
			{
				row -= num;
			}
			if (row == 0)
			{
				return "R";
			}
			return "R[" + row + "]";
		}

		public CellAddress Offset(FormulaContext context, Point offset, bool allowRollover = true)
		{
			if ((!columnAddressIsRelative || offset.X == 0) && (!rowAddressIsRelative || offset.Y == 0))
			{
				return this;
			}
			short num = column;
			if (columnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				num += (short)offset.X;
				if (allowRollover)
				{
					short maxColumnCountInternal = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCountInternal(context.Format);
					if (num < 0)
					{
						num += maxColumnCountInternal;
					}
					else if (maxColumnCountInternal <= num)
					{
						num -= maxColumnCountInternal;
					}
				}
			}
			int num2 = row;
			if (rowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				num2 += offset.Y;
				if (allowRollover)
				{
					int maxRowCount = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(context.Format);
					if (num2 < 0)
					{
						num2 += maxRowCount;
					}
					else if (maxRowCount <= num2)
					{
						num2 -= maxRowCount;
					}
				}
			}
			return new CellAddress(num2, rowAddressIsRelative, num, columnAddressIsRelative);
		}

		public CellAddress ToAbsolute(FormulaContext context)
		{
			int num = row;
			short num2 = column;
			if (rowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				if (context.OwningCellAddress != WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference)
				{
					num = context.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex + row;
				}
				int maxRowCount = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(context.Format);
				num %= maxRowCount;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num += maxRowCount;
				}
			}
			if (columnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				if (context.OwningCellAddress != WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference)
				{
					num2 = (short)(context.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex + column);
				}
				short maxColumnCountInternal = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCountInternal(context.Format);
				num2 %= maxColumnCountInternal;
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					num2 += maxColumnCountInternal;
				}
			}
			return new CellAddress(num, rowAddressIsRelative, num2, columnAddressIsRelative);
		}

		public WorksheetCellAddress ToAbsoluteAddress(FormulaContext context, bool relativeAddressesAreOffsets, bool allowRollover = true)
		{
			short num = Column;
			int num2 = Row;
			if (relativeAddressesAreOffsets)
			{
				if (ColumnAddressIsRelative)
				{
					if (!context.OwningCellAddress.IsValid)
					{
						return WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference;
					}
					num += context.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex;
					if (allowRollover)
					{
						short maxColumnCountInternal = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCountInternal(context.Format);
						if (num < 0)
						{
							num += maxColumnCountInternal;
						}
						else if (maxColumnCountInternal <= num)
						{
							num -= maxColumnCountInternal;
						}
					}
				}
				if (RowAddressIsRelative)
				{
					if (!context.OwningCellAddress.IsValid)
					{
						return WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference;
					}
					num2 += context.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex;
					if (allowRollover)
					{
						int maxRowCount = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(context.Format);
						if (num2 < 0)
						{
							num2 += maxRowCount;
						}
						else if (maxRowCount <= num2)
						{
							num2 -= maxRowCount;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return new WorksheetCellAddress(num2, num);
		}

		public CellAddress ToOffset(FormulaContext context)
		{
			int num = row;
			short num2 = column;
			if (rowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				if (context.OwningCellAddress != WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference)
				{
					num = row - context.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex;
				}
				int maxRowCount = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(context.Format);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num += maxRowCount;
				}
			}
			if (columnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				if (context.OwningCellAddress != WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference)
				{
					num2 = (short)(column - context.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex);
				}
				short maxColumnCountInternal = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCountInternal(context.Format);
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					num2 += maxColumnCountInternal;
				}
			}
			return new CellAddress(num, rowAddressIsRelative, num2, columnAddressIsRelative);
		}

		public string ToString(int sourceCellRowIndex, short sourceCellColumnIndex, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			return ToString(sourceCellRowIndex, sourceCellColumnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets: false, cellReferenceMode, format);
		}

		public string ToString(int sourceCellRowIndex, short sourceCellColumnIndex, bool relativeAddressesAreOffsets, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			return GetCellReferenceString(row, column, format, rowAddressIsRelative, columnAddressIsRelative, sourceCellRowIndex, sourceCellColumnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, cellReferenceMode);
		}

		public void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat, ignoreColumnIndex: false, ignoreRowIndex: false);
		}

		public void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat, bool ignoreColumnIndex, bool ignoreRowIndex)
		{
			if (!ignoreColumnIndex)
			{
				int num = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(testFormat) - 1;
				if (num < Math.Abs(column))
				{
					limitErrors.AddError(string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_FormatLimitError_MaxColumnIndex"), column, num));
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!ignoreRowIndex)
			{
				int num2 = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(testFormat) - 1;
				if (num2 < Math.Abs(row))
				{
					limitErrors.AddError(string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_FormatLimitError_MaxRowIndex"), row, num2));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal struct CellAddressRange
	{
		private readonly CellAddress topLeftCellAddress;

		private readonly CellAddress bottomRightCellAddress;

		public CellAddress BottomRightCellAddress => bottomRightCellAddress;

		public bool HasRelativeAddresses
		{
			get
			{
				if (!bottomRightCellAddress.HasRelativeAddresses)
				{
					return topLeftCellAddress.HasRelativeAddresses;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public CellAddress TopLeftCellAddress => topLeftCellAddress;

		public CellAddressRange(CellAddress cell1, CellAddress cell2)
		{
			int row;
			bool rowAddressIsRelative;
			int row2;
			bool rowAddressIsRelative2;
			if (cell1.Row <= cell2.Row)
			{
				row = cell1.Row;
				rowAddressIsRelative = cell1.RowAddressIsRelative;
				row2 = cell2.Row;
				rowAddressIsRelative2 = cell2.RowAddressIsRelative;
			}
			else
			{
				row = cell2.Row;
				rowAddressIsRelative = cell2.RowAddressIsRelative;
				row2 = cell1.Row;
				rowAddressIsRelative2 = cell1.RowAddressIsRelative;
			}
			short column;
			bool columnAddressIsRelative;
			short column2;
			bool columnAddressIsRelative2;
			if (cell1.Column <= cell2.Column)
			{
				column = cell1.Column;
				columnAddressIsRelative = cell1.ColumnAddressIsRelative;
				column2 = cell2.Column;
				columnAddressIsRelative2 = cell2.ColumnAddressIsRelative;
			}
			else
			{
				column = cell2.Column;
				columnAddressIsRelative = cell2.ColumnAddressIsRelative;
				column2 = cell1.Column;
				columnAddressIsRelative2 = cell1.ColumnAddressIsRelative;
			}
			topLeftCellAddress = new CellAddress(row, rowAddressIsRelative, column, columnAddressIsRelative);
			bottomRightCellAddress = new CellAddress(row2, rowAddressIsRelative2, column2, columnAddressIsRelative2);
		}

		public CellAddressRange(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			topLeftCellAddress = new CellAddress(region.FirstRow, rowAddressIsRelative: false, region.FirstColumnInternal, columnAddressIsRelative: false);
			bottomRightCellAddress = new CellAddress(region.LastRow, rowAddressIsRelative: false, region.LastColumnInternal, columnAddressIsRelative: false);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CellAddressRange? cellAddressRange = obj as CellAddressRange?;
			if (cellAddressRange.HasValue)
			{
				return this == cellAddressRange.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return topLeftCellAddress.GetHashCode() ^ (bottomRightCellAddress.GetHashCode() << 1);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(CellAddressRange a, CellAddressRange b)
		{
			if (a.topLeftCellAddress == b.topLeftCellAddress)
			{
				return a.bottomRightCellAddress == b.bottomRightCellAddress;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(CellAddressRange a, CellAddressRange b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public WorksheetRegion GetTargetRegion(FormulaContext context, bool relativeAddressesAreOffsets)
		{
			WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress = ToAbsoluteAddress(context, relativeAddressesAreOffsets);
			if (!regionAddress.IsValid || context.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return context.Worksheet.GetCachedRegion(regionAddress);
		}

		public WorksheetRegion GetTargetRegion(Worksheet worksheet, int formulaOwnerRowIndex, short formulaOwnerColumnIndex, bool relativeAddressesAreOffsets)
		{
			WorkbookFormat format = WorkbookFormat.Excel2007;
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				format = worksheet.CurrentFormat;
			}
			return GetTargetRegion(new FormulaContext(worksheet, formulaOwnerRowIndex, formulaOwnerColumnIndex, format, null), relativeAddressesAreOffsets);
		}

		public CellAddressRange Offset(FormulaContext context, Point offset, bool allowRollover = true)
		{
			CellAddress cellAddress = bottomRightCellAddress.Offset(context, offset, allowRollover);
			CellAddress cellAddress2 = topLeftCellAddress.Offset(context, offset, allowRollover);
			if (cellAddress == bottomRightCellAddress && cellAddress2 == topLeftCellAddress)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new CellAddressRange(cellAddress2, cellAddress);
		}

		public CellAddressRange OnCurrentFormatChanged(WorkbookFormat oldFormat, WorkbookFormat currentFormat)
		{
			short? num = null;
			int? num2 = null;
			if (topLeftCellAddress.Column == 0 && !topLeftCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative && bottomRightCellAddress.Column == Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(oldFormat) - 1 && !bottomRightCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				num = (short)(Workbook.GetMaxColumnCountInternal(currentFormat) - 1);
			}
			if (topLeftCellAddress.Row == 0 && !topLeftCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative && bottomRightCellAddress.Row == Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(oldFormat) - 1 && !bottomRightCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				num2 = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(currentFormat) - 1;
			}
			if (!((int?)num).HasValue && !num2.HasValue)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new CellAddressRange(topLeftCellAddress, new CellAddress(num2 ?? bottomRightCellAddress.Row, bottomRightCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative, num ?? bottomRightCellAddress.Column, bottomRightCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative));
		}

		public CellAddressRange ToAbsolute(FormulaContext context)
		{
			return new CellAddressRange(topLeftCellAddress.ToAbsolute(context), bottomRightCellAddress.ToAbsolute(context));
		}

		public WorksheetRegionAddress ToAbsoluteAddress(FormulaContext context, bool relativeAddressesAreOffsets, bool allowRollover = true)
		{
			WorksheetCellAddress cell = TopLeftCellAddress.ToAbsoluteAddress(context, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, allowRollover);
			WorksheetCellAddress cell2 = BottomRightCellAddress.ToAbsoluteAddress(context, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, allowRollover);
			return new WorksheetRegionAddress(cell, cell2);
		}

		public CellAddressRange ToOffset(FormulaContext context)
		{
			return new CellAddressRange(topLeftCellAddress.ToOffset(context), bottomRightCellAddress.ToOffset(context));
		}

		public string ToString(int sourceCellRowIndex, short sourceCellColumnIndex, bool relativeAddressesAreOffsets, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			if (topLeftCellAddress.Column == 0 && bottomRightCellAddress.Column == Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(format) - 1)
			{
				string rowString = CellAddress.GetRowString(topLeftCellAddress.Row, topLeftCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative, format, sourceCellRowIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, cellReferenceMode);
				string rowString2 = CellAddress.GetRowString(bottomRightCellAddress.Row, bottomRightCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative, format, sourceCellRowIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, cellReferenceMode);
				if (cellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.R1C1 && topLeftCellAddress.Row == bottomRightCellAddress.Row)
				{
					return rowString;
				}
				return rowString + ':' + rowString2;
			}
			if (topLeftCellAddress.Row == 0 && bottomRightCellAddress.Row == Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(format) - 1)
			{
				string columnString = CellAddress.GetColumnString(topLeftCellAddress.Column, topLeftCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative, format, sourceCellColumnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, cellReferenceMode);
				string columnString2 = CellAddress.GetColumnString(bottomRightCellAddress.Column, bottomRightCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative, format, sourceCellColumnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, cellReferenceMode);
				if (cellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.R1C1 && topLeftCellAddress.Column == bottomRightCellAddress.Column)
				{
					return columnString;
				}
				return columnString + ':' + columnString2;
			}
			return topLeftCellAddress.ToString(sourceCellRowIndex, sourceCellColumnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, cellReferenceMode, format) + ':' + bottomRightCellAddress.ToString(sourceCellRowIndex, sourceCellColumnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets, cellReferenceMode, format);
		}

		public void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			topLeftCellAddress.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			bool ignoreColumnIndex = false;
			bool ignoreRowIndex = false;
			if (topLeftCellAddress.Column == 0 && !topLeftCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative && bottomRightCellAddress.Column == limitErrors.Workbook.MaxColumnCount - 1 && !bottomRightCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				ignoreColumnIndex = true;
			}
			if (topLeftCellAddress.Row == 0 && !topLeftCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative && bottomRightCellAddress.Row == limitErrors.Workbook.MaxRowCount - 1 && !bottomRightCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				ignoreRowIndex = true;
			}
			bottomRightCellAddress.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat, ignoreColumnIndex, ignoreRowIndex);
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.FormulaUtilities.Constants
{
	internal abstract class Constant
	{
		public abstract object CalcValue { get; }

		public abstract byte ConstantCode { get; }

		public abstract void Load(BiffRecordStream stream, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex);

		public abstract void Save(BiffRecordStream stream);

		public abstract string ToString(CultureInfo culture);

		public static Constant GetNextConstant(BiffRecordStream stream, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex)
		{
			return stream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex) switch
			{
				0 => new EmptyConstant(), 
				1 => new NumberConstant(), 
				2 => new StringConstant(), 
				4 => new BooleanConstant(), 
				16 => new ErrorConstant(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public sealed override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(Utilities.CurrentCulture);
		}
	}
	internal class BooleanConstant : Constant
	{
		private bool value;

		public override byte ConstantCode => 4;

		public override object CalcValue => value;

		public BooleanConstant()
		{
		}

		public BooleanConstant(bool value)
		{
			this.value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is BooleanConstant booleanConstant)
			{
				return booleanConstant.value == value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override void Load(BiffRecordStream stream, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex)
		{
			value = stream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex) != 0;
			stream.ReadBytesFromBuffer(7, ref data, ref dataIndex);
		}

		public override void Save(BiffRecordStream stream)
		{
			stream.Write((byte)(value ? 1u : 0u));
			stream.Write(new byte[7]);
		}

		public override string ToString(CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!value)
			{
				return "FALSE";
			}
			return "TRUE";
		}
	}
	internal class EmptyConstant : Constant
	{
		public override byte ConstantCode => 0;

		public override object CalcValue => null;

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return obj is EmptyConstant;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		public override void Load(BiffRecordStream stream, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex)
		{
			stream.ReadBytesFromBuffer(8, ref data, ref dataIndex);
		}

		public override void Save(BiffRecordStream stream)
		{
			stream.Write(new byte[8]);
		}

		public override string ToString(CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}

	{
		private ErrorValue value;

		public override byte ConstantCode => 16;

		public override object CalcValue => value.ToCalcErrorValue();

		public ErrorConstant()
		{
		}

		public ErrorConstant(ErrorValue value)
		{
			this.value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ErrorConstant errorConstant)
			{
				return errorConstant.value == value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override void Load(BiffRecordStream stream, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex)
		{
			value = ErrorValue.FromValue(stream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex));
			stream.ReadBytesFromBuffer(7, ref data, ref dataIndex);
		}

		public override void Save(BiffRecordStream stream)
		{
			stream.Write(value.Value);
			stream.Write(new byte[7]);
		}

		public override string ToString(CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value.ToString();
		}

	internal struct EvaluationResult<T>
	{
		private readonly T result;

		private readonly bool completed;

		private readonly ushort? tokenWithErrorIndex;

		public bool Completed => completed;

		public T Result => result;

		public ushort? TokenWithErrorIndex => tokenWithErrorIndex;

		public EvaluationResult(T result)
		{
			completed = true;
			this.result = result;
			tokenWithErrorIndex = null;
		}

		public EvaluationResult(ushort? tokenWithErrorIndex)
		{
			completed = false;
			result = default(T);
			this.tokenWithErrorIndex = tokenWithErrorIndex;
		}
	}
	internal class FormulaContext
	{
		private readonly CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode = CellReferenceMode.A1;

		private readonly CultureInfo culture;

		private readonly WorkbookFormat format = WorkbookFormat.Excel2007;

		private readonly Formula formula;

		private readonly WorksheetCellAddress owningCellAddress = WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference;

		private readonly Workbook workbook;

		private readonly Worksheet worksheet;

		public CellReferenceMode CellReferenceMode => cellReferenceMode;

		public CultureInfo Culture => culture;

		public WorkbookFormat Format => format;

		public Formula Formula => formula;

		public WorksheetCellAddress OwningCellAddress => owningCellAddress;

		public WorksheetRow OwningRow
		{
			get
			{
				if (worksheet == null || owningCellAddress == WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return worksheet.Rows[owningCellAddress.RowIndex];
			}
		}

		public Workbook Workbook => workbook;

		public Worksheet Worksheet => worksheet;

		public FormulaContext(Workbook workbook)
		{
			this.workbook = workbook;
			if (this.workbook != null)
			{
				format = this.workbook.CurrentFormat;
				culture = this.workbook.CultureResolved;
			}
			else
			{
				culture = Utilities.CurrentCulture;
			}
		}

		public FormulaContext(Workbook workbook, Formula formula)
			: this(workbook ?? formula.Workbook)
		{
			this.formula = formula;
			worksheet = this.formula.Worksheet;
			if (this.formula.OwningCellRow != null)
			{
				owningCellAddress = new WorksheetCellAddress(this.formula.OwningCellRow.Index, this.formula.OwningCellColumnIndex);
			}
			if (this.workbook == null)
			{
				format = formula.CurrentFormat;
			}
		}

		public FormulaContext(Formula formula, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
			: this(null, formula)
		{
			this.culture = culture ?? Utilities.CurrentCulture;
			this.cellReferenceMode = cellReferenceMode;
		}

		public FormulaContext(Workbook workbook, Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow owningCellRow, short owningCellColumnIndex, Formula formula)
			: this(workbook)
		{
			this.formula = formula;
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
			if (owningCellRow != null)
			{
				owningCellAddress = new WorksheetCellAddress(owningCellRow.Index, owningCellColumnIndex);
			}
		}

		public FormulaContext(Worksheet worksheet, int owningCellRowIndex, short owningCellColumnIndex, WorkbookFormat format, Formula formula)
			: this(worksheet?.Workbook)
		{
			this.format = format;
			this.formula = formula;
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
			if (0 <= owningCellRowIndex && 0 <= owningCellColumnIndex)
			{
				owningCellAddress = new WorksheetCellAddress(owningCellRowIndex, owningCellColumnIndex);
			}
		}

		public FormulaContext(Workbook workbook, Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow owningCellRow, short owningCellColumnIndex, Formula formula, CultureInfo culture, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			this.cellReferenceMode = cellReferenceMode;
			this.culture = culture ?? Utilities.CurrentCulture;
			this.format = format;
			this.formula = formula;
			this.workbook = workbook;
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
			if (owningCellRow != null)
			{
				owningCellAddress = new WorksheetCellAddress(owningCellRow.Index, owningCellColumnIndex);
			}
		}
