	internal class FormulaParser
	{
		private struct FormulaTokenInfo
		{
			public readonly FormulaToken Token;

			public AttrSpaceToken[] PreceedingWhitespace;

			public int StartIndex;

			public FormulaTokenInfo(FormulaToken token, int startIndex, AttrSpaceToken[] preceedingWhitespace)
			{
				Token = token;
				StartIndex = startIndex;
				PreceedingWhitespace = preceedingWhitespace;
			}

			public void AddPreceedingWhitespace(AttrSpaceToken[] preceedingWhitespace)
			{
				if (PreceedingWhitespace == null)
				{
					PreceedingWhitespace = preceedingWhitespace;
					return;
				}
				AttrSpaceToken[] preceedingWhitespace2 = PreceedingWhitespace;
				PreceedingWhitespace = new AttrSpaceToken[preceedingWhitespace2.Length + preceedingWhitespace.Length];
				Array.Copy(preceedingWhitespace2, PreceedingWhitespace, preceedingWhitespace2.Length);
				Array.Copy(preceedingWhitespace, 0, PreceedingWhitespace, preceedingWhitespace2.Length, preceedingWhitespace.Length);
			}
		}

		private struct SelectorFunctionOptimizationInfo
		{
			public readonly List<AttrSkipToken> SkipTokens;

			public readonly ISelectorFunctionOptimizationToken OptimizationToken;

			public SelectorFunctionOptimizationInfo(ISelectorFunctionOptimizationToken optimizationToken)
			{
				SkipTokens = new List<AttrSkipToken>(1);
				OptimizationToken = optimizationToken;
			}
		}

		private struct PositionInfo
		{
			private readonly TextSpan nextWhitespace;

			private readonly int startIndex;

			private readonly int tokenCount;

			public TextSpan NextWhitespace => nextWhitespace;

			public int StartIndex => startIndex;

			public int TokenCount => tokenCount;

			public PositionInfo(int startIndex, int tokenCount, TextSpan nextWhitespace)
			{
				this.startIndex = startIndex;
				this.tokenCount = tokenCount;
				this.nextWhitespace = nextWhitespace;
			}
		}

		private class StructuredTableReferenceParser
		{
			private FormulaParser _owner;

			public StructuredTableReferenceParser(FormulaParser owner)
			{
				_owner = owner;
			}

			public bool Parse(string filePath, string tableName, TextSpan whitespaceBeforeReference)
			{
				if (Utilities.Is2003Format(_owner._context.Format))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (_owner.ParseException != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				PositionInfo position = _owner.SavePosition();
				StructuredTableReference structuredTableReference = null;
				try
				{
					if (ParseSpacedLBracket(out var hasSpace))
					{
						StructuredTableReference.InnerReference innerReference = ParseInnerReference();
						if (innerReference != null && ParseSpacedRBracket(out var hasSpace2))
						{
							innerReference.HasSpaceBefore = hasSpace;
							innerReference.HasSpaceAfter = hasSpace2;
							structuredTableReference = ((!innerReference.IsSimpleColumnReference) ? new StructuredTableReference(filePath, tableName, innerReference, _owner._context.Format) : new StructuredTableReference(filePath, tableName, innerReference.FirstColumnName, _owner._context.Format));
							return true;
						}
						_owner.RestorePosition(position);
					}
					StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? structuredTableReferenceKeywordType = ParseKeyword();
					if (structuredTableReferenceKeywordType.HasValue)
					{
						structuredTableReference = new StructuredTableReference(filePath, tableName, structuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Value, _owner._context.Format);
						return true;
					}
					if (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('['))
					{
						int startIndex = _owner.startIndex;
						string simpleColumnName = ParseSimpleColumnName(isColumnNameBracketed: true);
						if (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(']'))
						{
							structuredTableReference = new StructuredTableReference(filePath, tableName, simpleColumnName, _owner._context.Format);
							return true;
						}
						_owner.ParseException = new FormulaParseException(position.StartIndex, _owner.formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_InvalidStructuredTableReference"), _owner.formula.Substring(position.StartIndex, startIndex - position.StartIndex));
					}
					return false;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (structuredTableReference != null)
					{
						_owner.AddTokenAndWhitespace(structuredTableReference, position.StartIndex, _owner.startIndex - position.StartIndex, whitespaceBeforeReference, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
					}
				}
			}

			private bool ParseAnyColumnCharacter(bool isColumnNameBracketed, out char columnCharacter)
			{
				if (ParseAnyNospaceColumnCharacter(isColumnNameBracketed, out columnCharacter))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(' '))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private bool ParseAnyNospaceColumnCharacter(bool isColumnNameBracketed, out char columnCharacter)
			{
				if (ParseUnescapedColumnCharacter(isColumnNameBracketed, out columnCharacter))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('\'') && _owner.startIndex < _owner.formula.Length - 1)
				{
					columnCharacter = _owner.formula[_owner.startIndex];
					_owner.startIndex++;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private string ParseColumn()
			{
				string text = ParseSimpleColumnName(isColumnNameBracketed: false);
				if (text != null)
				{
					return text;
				}
				if (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('['))
				{
					PositionInfo position = _owner.SavePosition();
					text = ParseSimpleColumnName(isColumnNameBracketed: true);
					if (text != null && _owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(']'))
					{
						return text;
					}
					_owner.RestorePosition(position);
					return null;
				}
				return null;
			}

			private bool ParseColumnRange(out string firstColumn, out string lastColumn)
			{
				lastColumn = null;
				firstColumn = ParseColumn();
				if (firstColumn == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				PositionInfo position = _owner.SavePosition();
				if (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(':'))
				{
					lastColumn = ParseColumn();
					if (lastColumn != null)
					{
						return true;
					}
					_owner.RestorePosition(position);
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private StructuredTableReference.InnerReference ParseInnerReference()
			{
				PositionInfo position = _owner.SavePosition();
				string firstColumn;
				string lastColumn;
				if (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('@'))
				{
					while (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(' '))
					{
					}
					if (ParseColumnRange(out firstColumn, out lastColumn))
					{
						return new StructuredTableReference.InnerReference(StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.ThisRow, hasSpaceAfterFirstKeyword: false, null, hasSpaceAfterKeywordList: false, firstColumn, lastColumn);
					}
					_owner.RestorePosition(position);
					return null;
				}
				if (ParseKeywordList(out var firstKeyword, out var lastKeyword, out var hasSpaceAfterComma))
				{
					position = _owner.SavePosition();
					if (!ParseSpacedComma(out var hasSpaceAfterComma2))
					{
						return new StructuredTableReference.InnerReference(firstKeyword.Value, hasSpaceAfterComma, lastKeyword);
					}
					if (ParseColumnRange(out firstColumn, out lastColumn))
					{
						return new StructuredTableReference.InnerReference(firstKeyword.Value, hasSpaceAfterComma, lastKeyword, hasSpaceAfterComma2, firstColumn, lastColumn);
					}
					_owner.RestorePosition(position);
					return null;
				}
				if (ParseColumnRange(out firstColumn, out lastColumn))
				{
					return new StructuredTableReference.InnerReference(firstColumn, lastColumn);
				}
				return null;
			}

			private StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? ParseKeyword()
			{
				if (_owner.ParseException != null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				PositionInfo position = _owner.SavePosition();
				if (!_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('['))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('@'))
				{
					if (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(']'))
					{
						return StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.ThisRow;
					}
				}
				else if (_owner.TestCurrentChar('#'))
				{
					StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? result = (_owner.TestForStringAndAdvance("#All") ? new StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType?(StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.All) : (_owner.TestForStringAndAdvance("#Data") ? new StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType?(StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Data) : (_owner.TestForStringAndAdvance("#Headers") ? new StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType?(StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Headers) : (_owner.TestForStringAndAdvance("#Totals") ? new StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType?(StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Totals) : ((!_owner.TestForStringAndAdvance("#This Row")) ? ((StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType?)null) : new StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType?(StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.ThisRow))))));
					if (result.HasValue && _owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(']'))
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
				_owner.RestorePosition(position);
				return null;
			}

			private bool ParseKeywordList(out StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? firstKeyword, out StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? lastKeyword, out bool hasSpaceAfterComma)
			{
				lastKeyword = null;
				hasSpaceAfterComma = false;
				firstKeyword = ParseKeyword();
				if (!firstKeyword.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (firstKeyword == StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Headers || firstKeyword == StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Data)
				{
					PositionInfo position = _owner.SavePosition();
					if (!ParseSpacedComma(out hasSpaceAfterComma))
					{
						return true;
					}
					lastKeyword = ParseKeyword();
					if (lastKeyword.HasValue)
					{
						StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? structuredTableReferenceKeywordType = firstKeyword;
						if (structuredTableReferenceKeywordType == StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Headers && structuredTableReferenceKeywordType.HasValue && lastKeyword.Value == StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Data)
						{
							return true;
						}
						StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? structuredTableReferenceKeywordType2 = firstKeyword;
						if (structuredTableReferenceKeywordType2 == StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Data && structuredTableReferenceKeywordType2.HasValue && lastKeyword.Value == StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.Totals)
						{
							return true;
						}
						lastKeyword = null;
					}
					_owner.RestorePosition(position);
					return true;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private string ParseSimpleColumnName(bool isColumnNameBracketed)
			{
				PositionInfo position = _owner.SavePosition();
				if (ParseAnyNospaceColumnCharacter(isColumnNameBracketed, out var columnCharacter))
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(columnCharacter.ToString());
					if (ParseAnyColumnCharacter(isColumnNameBracketed, out columnCharacter))
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(columnCharacter);
						while (ParseAnyColumnCharacter(isColumnNameBracketed, out columnCharacter))
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(columnCharacter);
						}
						_owner.startIndex--;
						if (!ParseAnyNospaceColumnCharacter(isColumnNameBracketed, out columnCharacter))
						{
							_owner.RestorePosition(position);
							return null;
						}
					}
					return stringBuilder.ToString();
				}
				_owner.RestorePosition(position);
				return null;
			}

			private bool ParseSpacedComma(out bool hasSpaceAfterComma)
			{
				hasSpaceAfterComma = false;
				PositionInfo position = _owner.SavePosition();
				while (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(' '))
				{
				}
				if (!_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(_owner.unionOperatorResolved))
				{
					_owner.RestorePosition(position);
					return false;
				}
				while (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(' '))
				{
					hasSpaceAfterComma = true;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private bool ParseSpacedLBracket(out bool hasSpace)
			{
				hasSpace = false;
				if (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('['))
				{
					while (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(' '))
					{
						hasSpace = true;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private bool ParseSpacedRBracket(out bool hasSpace)
			{
				hasSpace = false;
				PositionInfo position = _owner.SavePosition();
				while (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(' '))
				{
					hasSpace = true;
				}
				if (_owner.TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(']'))
				{
					return true;
				}
				_owner.RestorePosition(position);
				return false;
			}

			private bool ParseUnescapedColumnCharacter(bool isColumnNameBracketed, out char columnCharacter)
			{
				columnCharacter = '\0';
				char c = _owner.formula[_owner.startIndex];
				if (IsEscapeTableColumnCharacter(c))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!isColumnNameBracketed && c == ':')
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = c;
				if (num == 9 || num == 10 || num == 13 || (32 <= num && num <= 55295) || (57344 <= num && num <= 65533) || (65536 <= num && num <= 1114111))
				{
					_owner.startIndex++;
					columnCharacter = c;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private struct TextSpan
		{
			public static readonly TextSpan Empty = default(TextSpan);

			public readonly int Length;

			public readonly int StartIndex;

			public bool IsEmpty => Length == 0;

			public TextSpan(int startIndex, int length)
			{
				StartIndex = startIndex;
				Length = length;
			}
		}

			public string FirstWorksheetName;

			public string LastWorksheetName;

			public bool IsOleLink;
		}

					_instance = new FormulaParser();

				return _instance;
			}

		private int MaxFormulaLength
		{
			get
			{
				if (Utilities.Is2003Format(_context.Format))
				{
					return 1024;
				}
				return 8192;
			}
		}

		private int MaxFunctionNesting
		{
			get
			{
				if (Utilities.Is2003Format(_context.Format))
				{
					return 8;
				}
				return 64;
			}
		}

		private FormulaParseException ParseException
		{
			get
			{
				return parseException;
			}
			set
			{
				parseException = value;
			}
		}

		private Regex ColumnAddressR1C1Regex
		{
			get
			{
				if (columnAddressR1C1Regex == null)
				{
					columnAddressR1C1Regex = new Regex("\\GC(?![\\p{L}_])((\\[[-+]?[0-9]{1,6}])|([0-9]{1,6}(?![0-9])))?", RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return columnAddressR1C1Regex;
			}
		}

		private Regex ErrorRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (errorRegex == null)
				{
					errorRegex = new Regex("\\G(#NULL!|#DIV/0!|#VALUE!|#REF!|#NAME\\?|#NUM!|#N/A)", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return errorRegex;
			}
		}

		private Regex EndQuoteRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (endQuoteRegex == null)
				{
					endQuoteRegex = new Regex("(?<=(?<!')('')*)'(?!')", RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return endQuoteRegex;
			}
		}

		private Regex FileNameBracketedSafeRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (fileNameBracketedSafeRegex == null)
				{
					fileNameBracketedSafeRegex = new Regex("\\G\\[[_a-zA-Z0-9‘’“”][_a-zA-Z0-9‘’“”.]*\\]", RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return fileNameBracketedSafeRegex;
			}
		}

		private Regex FileNameQuotedRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (fileNameQuotedRegex == null)
				{
					fileNameQuotedRegex = new Regex("\\G([^\\\\/:*?\"<>|[\\]']|(''))+", RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return fileNameQuotedRegex;
			}
		}

		private Regex LocalPathRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (localPathRegex == null)
				{
					localPathRegex = new Regex("\\G(([a-zA-Z]:)|\\\\)\\\\(([^\\\\/:*?\"<>|[\\]']|(''))*\\\\)*", RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return localPathRegex;
			}
		}

		private Regex RowAddressR1C1Regex
		{
			get
			{
				if (rowAddressR1C1Regex == null)
				{
					rowAddressR1C1Regex = new Regex("\\G((R(?![\\p{L}_])((\\[[-+]?[0-9]{1,7}])|([0-9]{1,7}(?![0-9])))?)|(R(?=C(?![\\p{L}_]))))", RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return rowAddressR1C1Regex;
			}
		}

		private Regex UrlPathRegex
		{
			get
			{
				if (urlPathRegex == null)
				{
					urlPathRegex = new Regex("\\G(ht|f)tp(s?)\\:(\\\\|/){2}([0-9a-zA-Z]([-.\\w\\s]*[0-9a-zA-Z])*(\\\\|/)?)*(:(0-9)*)*(/?)([a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\.\\?\\,'/\\\\\\+&%\\$#_]*)?(\\\\|/)", RegexOptions.Compiled);
				}
				return urlPathRegex;
			}
		}

		public static ErrorValue ParseError(string value, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ErrorValue errorValue = null;
			return value.ToUpper(culture) switch
			{
				"#NULL!" => ErrorValue.EmptyCellRangeIntersection, 
				"#DIV/0!" => ErrorValue.DivisionByZero, 
				"#VALUE!" => ErrorValue.WrongOperandType, 
				"#REF!" => ErrorValue.InvalidCellReference, 
				"#NAME?" => ErrorValue.WrongFunctionName, 
				"#NUM!" => ErrorValue.ValueRangeOverflow, 
				"#N/A" => ErrorValue.ArgumentOrFunctionNotAvailable, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal static Formula ParseFormula(string formula, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, FormulaType type, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, CultureInfo culture, List<WorkbookReferenceBase> indexedReferencesDuringLoad, out FormulaParseException parseException)
		{
			if (_instance == null)
			{
				_instance = new FormulaParser();
			}
			FormulaContext context = CreateFormulaContext(cellReferenceMode, type, culture, currentFormat);
			_instance.Intialize(formula, type, context);
			_instance.indexedReferencesDuringLoad = indexedReferencesDuringLoad;
			Formula result = _instance.ParseFormula();
			parseException = _instance.ParseException;
			return result;
		}

		internal static Formula ParseFormula(string formula, FormulaType type, FormulaContext context, List<WorkbookReferenceBase> indexedReferencesDuringLoad, out FormulaParseException parseException)
		{
			if (_instance == null)
			{
				_instance = new FormulaParser();
			}
			_instance.Intialize(formula, type, context);
			_instance.indexedReferencesDuringLoad = indexedReferencesDuringLoad;
			Formula result = _instance.ParseFormula();
			parseException = _instance.ParseException;
			return result;
		}

		private FormulaParser()
		{
			infixTokenList = new List<FormulaTokenInfo>();
			postfixTokenList = new List<FormulaTokenInfo>();
			stringParseResult = new StringBuilder();
			structuredTableReferenceParserHelper = new StructuredTableReferenceParser(this);
			worksheetNameQuotedBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			selectorFunctionOptimizationInfoStack = new Stack<SelectorFunctionOptimizationInfo>();
			functionParamIndicies = new Stack<byte>();
			operatorStack = new Stack<FormulaTokenInfo>();
			whitespaceTokensTemp = new List<AttrSpaceToken>();
			_workbookReferences = new Dictionary<string, WorkbookReferenceBase>();
		}

		private void Intialize(string formula, FormulaType type, FormulaContext context)
		{
			parseException = null;
			isVolitile = false;
			nextWhitespace = TextSpan.Empty;
			startIndex = 0;
			functionNesting = 0;
			infixTokenList.Clear();
			postfixTokenList.Clear();
			selectorFunctionOptimizationInfoStack.Clear();
			functionParamIndicies.Clear();
			operatorStack.Clear();
			_workbookReferences.Clear();
			_context = context;
			if (context.Workbook != null)
			{
				_nullFilePathWorkbook = _context.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference;
				context.Formula.IsConnected = true;
			}
			else
			{
				_nullFilePathWorkbook = new WorkbookReferenceUnconnected(null);
			}
			this.formula = formula;
			this.type = type;
			cachedDecimalSeparator = _context.Culture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator;
			unionOperatorResolved = GetUnionOperatorResolved(cachedDecimalSeparator);
			matrixValueSeparatorResolved = GetMatrixValueSeparatorResolved(cachedDecimalSeparator);
		}

		private Formula ParseFormula()
		{
			if (formula.Length > MaxFormulaLength)
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(0, formula, string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_TooLong"), MaxFormulaLength), formula);
				return null;
			}
			startIndex = 0;
			if (!TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('='))
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(0, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_NoEqualsSign"), formula);
				return null;
			}
			ParseNextWhitespace();
			if (!ParseExpression(allowListOperator: true))
			{
				if (ParseException == null)
				{
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(0, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_NoExpressions"), formula.Substring(1));
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (startIndex != formula.Length)
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(startIndex, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_ExtraExpressions"), formula.Substring(startIndex));
				return null;
			}
			if (isVolitile)
			{
				_context.Formula.RecalculateAlways = true;
				postfixTokenList.Add(new FormulaTokenInfo(new AttrVolatileToken(), 0, null));
			}
			ConvertInfixToPostfix();
			_context.Formula.PostfixTokenList = new FormulaToken[postfixTokenList.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < postfixTokenList.Count; i++)
			{
				_context.Formula.PostfixTokenList[i] = postfixTokenList[i].Token;
			}
			string[] array = new string[postfixTokenList.Count];
			string portionWithError = null;
			int charIndexOfError = -1;
			TokenClassResolver tokenClassResolver = TokenClassResolver.Initialize(_context, type);
			EvaluationResult<TokenClassResolver.FormulaTokenNode> evaluationResult = tokenClassResolver.Evaluate();
			if (((int?)evaluationResult.TokenWithErrorIndex).HasValue)
			{
				portionWithError = array[evaluationResult.TokenWithErrorIndex.Value];
				charIndexOfError = postfixTokenList[evaluationResult.TokenWithErrorIndex.Value].StartIndex;
			}
			if (!evaluationResult.Completed)
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(charIndexOfError, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_InvalidArguments"), portionWithError);
				return null;
			}
			if (type == FormulaType.NamedReferenceFormula || type == FormulaType.ExternalNamedReferenceFormula)
			{
				for (ushort num = 0; num < postfixTokenList.Count; num++)
				{
					FormulaTokenInfo formulaTokenInfo = postfixTokenList[num];
					if (formulaTokenInfo.Token is CellReferenceToken { Is3DReference: false })
					{
						portionWithError = array[num];
						charIndexOfError = formulaTokenInfo.StartIndex;
						ParseException = new FormulaParseException(charIndexOfError, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_NamedReferenceRefsNeedSheetName"), portionWithError);
						return null;
					}
				}
			}
			_context.Formula.AreTokenReferencesResolved = true;
			return _context.Formula;
		}

		private bool ParseExpression(bool allowListOperator)
		{
			int num = startIndex;
			if (!ParsePrimary())
			{
				PositionInfo position = SavePosition();
				if (ParseBinary(allowListOperator, out var binaryAllowsRollback) && !binaryAllowsRollback)
				{
					ParsePrimary();
					int num2 = startIndex;
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_MissingArgumentBeforeBinary"), formula.Substring(num, num2 - num));
				}
				RestorePosition(position);
				return false;
			}
			PositionInfo position2;
			int charIndexOfError;
			bool binaryAllowsRollback2;
			while (true)
			{
				position2 = SavePosition();
				charIndexOfError = startIndex;
				if (!ParseBinary(allowListOperator, out binaryAllowsRollback2))
				{
					RestorePosition(position2);
					return true;
				}
				int num3 = startIndex;
				if (!ParsePrimary())
				{
					break;
				}
				num = num3;
			}
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!binaryAllowsRollback2)
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(charIndexOfError, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_MissingArgumentAfterBinary"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
				return false;
			}
			RestorePosition(position2);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParsePrimary()
		{
			if (!ParseSecondary())
			{
				return false;
			}
			PositionInfo position;
			do
			{
				if (ParseException != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				position = SavePosition();
			}
			while (ParseUnaryL());
			RestorePosition(position);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseSecondary()
		{
			if (ParseFunction())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ParseBoolean())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ParseReference())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ParseError())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ParseNumber())
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num = startIndex;
			if (ParseUnaryR())
			{
				if (ParseSecondary())
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ParseException == null)
				{
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_MissingArgumentAfterUnary"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (ParseString())
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num2 = startIndex;
			if (ParseOpenParen())
			{
				if (ParseExpression(allowListOperator: true))
				{
					if (ParseCloseParen())
					{
						return true;
					}
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num2, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_UnmatchedOpenParen"), formula.Substring(num2, startIndex - num2));
				}
				if (ParseException == null)
				{
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num2, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_MissingArgumentAfterParen"), formula.Substring(num2, startIndex - num2));
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (ParseArray())
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseArray()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = infixTokenList.Count;
			TextSpan whitespace = nextWhitespace;
			int num = startIndex;
			if (!TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('{'))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ParseNextWhitespace();
			if (!ParseMatrix(num))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('}'))
			{
				int num2 = formula.IndexOf('}', startIndex);
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_ArrayContainsConstants"), formula.Substring(num, num2 - num + 1));
				}
				else
				{
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_UnmatchedOpenBracket"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
				}
				return false;
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			for (int i = count; i < infixTokenList.Count && !(infixTokenList[i].Token is MatrixRowSeparatorToken); i++)
			{
				if (!(infixTokenList[i].Token is UnionOperator))
				{
					num3++;
				}
			}
			if (num3 == 0)
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_ArrayHasEmptyFirstRow"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
				return false;
			}
			int num4 = infixTokenList.Count - count;
			num4 -= num4 / 2;
			FormulaParseException ex = new FormulaParseException(num, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_ArrayHasMisalignedRows"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
			int num5 = num4 / num3;
			Constant[][] array = new Constant[num3][];
			for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
			{
				array[j] = new Constant[num5];
			}
			int num6 = count;
			for (int k = 0; k < num5; k++)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < num3; l++)
				{
					FormulaToken token = infixTokenList[num6].Token;
					NumberToken numberToken = token as NumberToken;
					IntToken intToken = token as IntToken;
					StrToken strToken = token as StrToken;
					BoolToken boolToken = token as BoolToken;
					ErrToken errToken = token as ErrToken;
					if (numberToken != null)
					{
						array[l][k] = new NumberConstant(numberToken.Value);
					}
					else if (intToken != null)
					{
						array[l][k] = new NumberConstant((int)intToken.Value);
					}
					else if (strToken != null)
					{
						array[l][k] = new StringConstant(strToken.Value);
					}
					else if (boolToken != null)
					{
						array[l][k] = new BooleanConstant(boolToken.Value);
					}
					else
					{
						if (errToken == null)
						{
							ParseException = ex;
							return false;
						}
						array[l][k] = new ErrorConstant(errToken.Value);
					}
					num6++;
					if (l == num3 - 1 && k == num5 - 1)
					{
						break;
					}
					token = infixTokenList[num6].Token;
					num6++;
					if (l < num3 - 1)
					{
						if (!(token is UnionOperator))
						{
							ParseException = ex;
							return false;
						}
					}
					else if (!(token is MatrixRowSeparatorToken))
					{
						ParseException = ex;
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num6 != infixTokenList.Count)
			{
				ParseException = ex;
				return false;
			}
			infixTokenList.RemoveRange(count, infixTokenList.Count - count);
			AddTokenAndWhitespace(new ArrayToken(array), num, startIndex - num, whitespace, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseBinary(bool allowListOperator, out bool binaryAllowsRollback)
		{
			binaryAllowsRollback = false;
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (startIndex >= formula.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			OperatorToken operatorToken = null;
			int tokenLength = 1;
			char c = formula[startIndex];
			switch (c)
			{
			case '+':
				operatorToken = AddOperator.Instance;
				break;
			case '-':
				operatorToken = SubOperator.Instance;
				break;
			case '*':
				operatorToken = MulOperator.Instance;
				break;
			case '/':
				operatorToken = DivOperator.Instance;
				break;
			case '^':
				operatorToken = PowerOperator.Instance;
				break;
			case '=':
				operatorToken = EQOperator.Instance;
				break;
			case '<':
				if (startIndex < formula.Length - 1)
				{
					switch (formula[startIndex + 1])
					{
					case '>':
						tokenLength = 2;
						operatorToken = NEOperator.Instance;
						break;
					case '=':
						tokenLength = 2;
						operatorToken = LEOperator.Instance;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (operatorToken == null)
				{
					operatorToken = LTOperator.Instance;
				}
				break;
			case '>':
				if (startIndex < formula.Length - 1 && formula[startIndex + 1] == '=')
				{
					tokenLength = 2;
					operatorToken = GEOperator.Instance;
				}
				else
				{
					operatorToken = GTOperator.Instance;
				}
				break;
			case '&':
				operatorToken = Infragistics.Documents.Excel.FormulaUtilities.Tokens.ConcatOperator.Instance;
				break;
			case ':':
				operatorToken = Infragistics.Documents.Excel.FormulaUtilities.Tokens.RangeOperator.Instance;
				break;
			case ',':
			case ';':
				if (allowListOperator && c == unionOperatorResolved)
				{
					operatorToken = Infragistics.Documents.Excel.FormulaUtilities.Tokens.UnionOperator.Instance;
					break;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (operatorToken == null)
			{
				if (nextWhitespace.Length == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = nextWhitespace.Length - 1;
				while (num >= 0 && formula[num + nextWhitespace.StartIndex] != ' ')
				{
					num--;
				}
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				binaryAllowsRollback = true;
				IsectOperator instance = IsectOperator.Instance;
				startIndex -= nextWhitespace.Length;
				startIndex += num;
				nextWhitespace = new TextSpan(nextWhitespace.StartIndex, num);
				AddTokenAndWhitespace(instance, 1, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
				return true;
			}
			AddTokenAndWhitespace(operatorToken, tokenLength, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseBoolean()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (startIndex >= formula.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (formula[startIndex])
			{
			case 'T':
			case 't':
			{
				if (formula.Length - startIndex < 4)
				{
					return false;
				}
				char c = formula[startIndex + 1];
				if (c != 'r' && c != 'R')
				{
					return false;
				}
				c = formula[startIndex + 2];
				if (c != 'u' && c != 'U')
				{
					return false;
				}
				c = formula[startIndex + 3];
				if (c != 'e' && c != 'E')
				{
					return false;
				}
				AddTokenAndWhitespace(BoolToken.TrueInstance, 4, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
				return true;
			}
			case 'F':
			case 'f':
			{
				if (formula.Length - startIndex < 5)
				{
					return false;
				}
				char c = formula[startIndex + 1];
				if (c != 'a' && c != 'A')
				{
					return false;
				}
				c = formula[startIndex + 2];
				if (c != 'l' && c != 'L')
				{
					return false;
				}
				c = formula[startIndex + 3];
				if (c != 's' && c != 'S')
				{
					return false;
				}
				c = formula[startIndex + 4];
				if (c != 'e' && c != 'E')
				{
					return false;
				}
				AddTokenAndWhitespace(BoolToken.FalseInstance, 5, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
				return true;
			}
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private CellAddress? ParseCellAddress()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PositionInfo position = SavePosition();
			short columnIndex;
			bool isRelative;
			int rowIndex;
			bool isRelative2;
			if (_context.CellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.A1)
			{
				if (!ParseColumnAddressA1(out columnIndex, out isRelative))
				{
					RestorePosition(position);
					return null;
				}
				if (!ParseRowAddressA1(out rowIndex, out isRelative2))
				{
					RestorePosition(position);
					return null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!ParseRowAddressR1C1(out rowIndex, out isRelative2))
				{
					RestorePosition(position);
					return null;
				}
				if (!ParseColumnAddressR1C1(out columnIndex, out isRelative))
				{
					RestorePosition(position);
					return null;
				}
			}
			return new CellAddress(rowIndex, isRelative2, columnIndex, isRelative);
		}

		private CellAddressRange? ParseCellRange(CellAddress topLeft)
		{
			PositionInfo position = SavePosition();
			ParseNextWhitespace();
			if (!TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(':'))
			{
				if (nextWhitespace.Length != 0)
				{
					RestorePosition(position);
				}
				return null;
			}
			ParseNextWhitespace();
			CellAddress? cellAddress = ParseCellAddress();
			if (!cellAddress.HasValue)
			{
				RestorePosition(position);
				return null;
			}
			return new CellAddressRange(topLeft, cellAddress.GetValueOrDefault());
		}

		private bool ParseCloseParen()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!TestCurrentChar(')'))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AddTokenAndWhitespace(new ParenToken(), 1, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeClosingParens);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseColumnAddress(out short columnIndex, out bool isRelative)
		{
			if (_context.CellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.A1)
			{
				return ParseColumnAddressA1(out columnIndex, out isRelative);
			}
			return ParseColumnAddressR1C1(out columnIndex, out isRelative);
		}

		private bool ParseColumnAddressA1(out short columnIndex, out bool isRelative)
		{
			columnIndex = 0;
			isRelative = false;
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ParseColumnAddressA1(formula, startIndex, _context.Format, _context.Culture, ref columnIndex, ref isRelative, out var matchLength))
			{
				return false;
			}
			startIndex += matchLength;
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool ParseColumnAddressA1(string formula, int index, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, CultureInfo culture, ref short columnIndex, ref bool isRelative, out int matchLength)
		{
			matchLength = 0;
			if (index == formula.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			char c = formula[index];
			if (c == '$')
			{
				isRelative = false;
				c = formula[++index];
			}
			else
			{
				isRelative = true;
			}
			columnIndex = 0;
			int num = 0;
			while (num <= 3 && (('A' <= c && c <= 'Z') || ('a' <= c && c <= 'z')))
			{
				columnIndex *= 26;
				if (c < 'a')
				{
					columnIndex += (short)(c - 65 + 1);
				}
				else
				{
					columnIndex += (short)(c - 97 + 1);
				}
				num++;
				if (++index >= formula.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				c = formula[index];
			}
			if (num > 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (--columnIndex < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (index < formula.Length && (c == '_' || char.IsLetter(c)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (columnIndex > Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(currentFormat) - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			matchLength = num;
			if (!isRelative)
			{
				matchLength++;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ParseColumnAddressIndexR1C1(string addressIndex, bool isRelative, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, out short columnIndex)
		{
			if (!short.TryParse(addressIndex, out columnIndex))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!isRelative)
			{
				columnIndex--;
				if (columnIndex < 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (Math.Abs(columnIndex) > Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(currentFormat) - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseColumnAddressR1C1(out short columnIndex, out bool isRelative)
		{
			columnIndex = 0;
			isRelative = false;
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ParseColumnAddressR1C1Helper(formula, startIndex, _context.Format, ref columnIndex, ref isRelative, out var matchLength))
			{
				return false;
			}
			startIndex += matchLength;
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool ParseColumnAddressR1C1(string formula, int index, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, ref short columnIndex, ref bool isRelative, out int matchLength)
		{
			return Instance.ParseColumnAddressR1C1Helper(formula, index, currentFormat, ref columnIndex, ref isRelative, out matchLength);
		}

		private bool ParseColumnAddressR1C1Helper(string formula, int index, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, ref short columnIndex, ref bool isRelative, out int matchLength)
		{
			matchLength = 0;
			Match match = ColumnAddressR1C1Regex.Match(formula, index);
			if (!match.Success)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string value = match.Value;
			if (value.Length == 1)
			{
				isRelative = true;
				columnIndex = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				isRelative = value[1] == '[';
				string addressIndex = (isRelative ? value.Substring(2, value.Length - 3) : value.Substring(1));
				if (!ParseColumnAddressIndexR1C1(addressIndex, isRelative, currentFormat, out columnIndex))
				{
					isRelative = true;
					columnIndex = 0;
					matchLength = 1;
					return true;
				}
			}
			matchLength = match.Length;
			return true;
		}

		private CellAddressRange? ParseColumnRange()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PositionInfo position = SavePosition();
			if (!ParseColumnAddress(out var columnIndex, out var isRelative))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(':'))
			{
				RestorePosition(position);
				return null;
			}
			if (!ParseColumnAddress(out var columnIndex2, out var isRelative2))
			{
				RestorePosition(position);
				return null;
			}
			int row = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(_context.Format) - 1;
			CellAddress cell;
			CellAddress cell2;
			if (columnIndex <= columnIndex2)
			{
				cell = new CellAddress(0, rowAddressIsRelative: false, columnIndex, isRelative);
				cell2 = new CellAddress(row, rowAddressIsRelative: false, columnIndex2, isRelative2);
			}
			else
			{
				cell = new CellAddress(0, rowAddressIsRelative: false, columnIndex2, isRelative2);
				cell2 = new CellAddress(row, rowAddressIsRelative: false, columnIndex, isRelative);
			}
			return new CellAddressRange(cell, cell2);
		}

		private void ParseEmptyOrParameter()
		{
			if (ParseException == null && !ParseExpression(allowListOperator: false))
			{
				AddTokenAndWhitespace(MissArgToken.Instance, 0, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
			}
		}

		private bool ParseError()
		{
			return ParseError(mustBeReferenceError: false);
		}

		private bool ParseError(bool mustBeReferenceError)
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!TestCurrentChar('#'))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Match match = ErrorRegex.Match(formula, startIndex);
			if (!match.Success)
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(startIndex, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_InvalidErrorValue"), formula.Substring(startIndex));
				return false;
			}
			ErrorValue errorValue = ParseError(match.Value, _context.Culture);
			if (errorValue == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (mustBeReferenceError && errorValue != ErrorValue.InvalidCellReference)
			{
				return false;
			}
			AddTokenAndWhitespace(new ErrToken(errorValue), match.Length, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
			return true;
		}

		private string ParseFileNameBracketedQuoted(out bool isOleLink)
		{
			isOleLink = false;
			int num = startIndex;
			string text = ParseFilePath();
			if (!TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('['))
			{
				startIndex = num;
				return null;
			}
			string text2 = ParseFileNameQuoted();
			if (text2 == null)
			{
				int num2 = formula.IndexOf(']', startIndex);
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(startIndex, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_InvalidFileNameInBrackets"), formula.Substring(num, num2 - num + 1));
				}
				else
				{
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(startIndex, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_NoFileNameAfterBracket"), formula.Substring(num));
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (!TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(']'))
			{
				int num3 = formula.IndexOf(']', startIndex);
				if (num3 >= 0)
				{
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(startIndex, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_InvalidFileNameInBrackets"), formula.Substring(num, num3 - num + 1));
				}
				else
				{
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(startIndex, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_UnmatchedOpenSquareBracket"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
				}
				return null;
			}
			string text3 = text + text2;
			if (indexedReferencesDuringLoad != null && int.TryParse(text3, out var result) && result < indexedReferencesDuringLoad.Count)
			{
				WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReferenceBase = indexedReferencesDuringLoad[result];
				text3 = workbookReferenceBase.FileName;
				isOleLink = workbookReferenceBase is OleLinkWorkbookReference;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
			{
				text3 = null;
			}
			return text3;
		}

		private string ParseFileNameBracketedSafe(out bool wasIndexedReference, out bool isOleLink)
		{
			wasIndexedReference = false;
			isOleLink = false;
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!TestCurrentChar('['))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Match match = FileNameBracketedSafeRegex.Match(formula, startIndex);
			if (!match.Success)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = match.Value.Substring(1, match.Length - 2);
			if (indexedReferencesDuringLoad != null && int.TryParse(text, out var result) && result < indexedReferencesDuringLoad.Count)
			{
				wasIndexedReference = true;
				WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReferenceBase = indexedReferencesDuringLoad[result];
				text = workbookReferenceBase.FileName;
				isOleLink = workbookReferenceBase is OleLinkWorkbookReference;
			}
			startIndex += match.Length;
			return text;
		}

		private string ParseFileNameQuoted()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Match match = FileNameQuotedRegex.Match(formula, startIndex);
			if (!match.Success)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string value = match.Value;
			value = value.Replace("''", "'");
			startIndex += match.Length;
			return value;
		}

		private string ParseFilePath()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = ParseLocalPath();
			if (text != null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return ParseUrlPath();
		}

		private bool ParseFunction()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int functionNameStart = startIndex;
			TextSpan whitespaceBeforeFunctionName = nextWhitespace;
			TextSpan textSpan = ParseFunctionName();
			if (textSpan.Length != 0)
			{
				Function function = Function.GetFunction(formula, textSpan.StartIndex, textSpan.Length);
				if (ParseFunctionHelper(function, functionNameStart, whitespaceBeforeFunctionName))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseFunctionHelper(Function function, int functionNameStart, TextSpan whitespaceBeforeFunctionName)
		{
			int num = startIndex;
			int count = infixTokenList.Count;
			functionNesting++;
			int num2 = ParseParameterList();
			bool flag = functionNesting > MaxFunctionNesting;
			functionNesting--;
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ParseCloseParen())
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(functionNameStart, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_FunctionMissingClosingParen"), formula.Substring(functionNameStart, startIndex - functionNameStart));
				return false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(functionNameStart, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_FunctionNestingTooDeep"), formula.Substring(functionNameStart, startIndex - functionNameStart));
				return false;
			}
			if (num2 < function.MinParams || function.GetMaxParams(_context.Format) < num2 || (num2 - function.TuplesStart) % function.TuplesDegree != 0)
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(functionNameStart, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_IncorrectNumberOfArguments"), formula.Substring(functionNameStart, startIndex - functionNameStart));
				return false;
			}
			if (!isVolitile && function.IsVolatile)
			{
				isVolitile = true;
			}
			FunctionOperator functionOperator;
			if (function.IsFuncV)
			{
				functionOperator = new FunctionVOperator(function, function.GetMaxParams(_context.Format));
				functionOperator.ArgumentCount = (byte)num2;
			}
			else
			{
				functionOperator = new FunctionOperator(function);
			}
			int num3 = startIndex;
			TextSpan textSpan = nextWhitespace;
			SavePosition();
			InsertTokenAndWhitespace(count, functionOperator, functionNameStart, num - functionNameStart + 1, whitespaceBeforeFunctionName, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
			startIndex = num3;
			nextWhitespace = textSpan;
			return true;
		}

		private TextSpan ParseFunctionName()
		{
			if (startIndex == formula.Length)
			{
				return TextSpan.Empty;
			}
			int num = startIndex;
			char c = formula[num++];
			if (c == '_')
			{
				if (formula.Length - startIndex < 5)
				{
					return TextSpan.Empty;
				}
				c = formula[num++];
				if (c != 'x')
				{
					return TextSpan.Empty;
				}
				c = formula[num++];
				if (c != 'l')
				{
					return TextSpan.Empty;
				}
				c = formula[num++];
				if (c != 'l')
				{
					return TextSpan.Empty;
				}
				c = formula[num++];
				if (c != '.')
				{
					return TextSpan.Empty;
				}
				if (Utilities.Is2003Format(_context.Format))
				{
					return TextSpan.Empty;
				}
				c = formula[num++];
			}
			if (!char.IsLetter(c))
			{
				return TextSpan.Empty;
			}
			while (num < formula.Length)
			{
				c = formula[num++];
				switch (c)
				{
				case '(':
				{
					int num2 = startIndex;
					startIndex = num;
					ParseNextWhitespace();
					return new TextSpan(num2, num - num2 - 1);
				}
				case '.':
				case '0':
				case '1':
				case '2':
				case '3':
				case '4':
				case '5':
				case '6':
				case '7':
				case '8':
				case '9':
					continue;
				}
				if (!char.IsLetter(c))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return TextSpan.Empty;
		}

		private string ParseLocalPath()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Match match = LocalPathRegex.Match(formula, startIndex);
			if (!match.Success)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string value = match.Value;
			value = value.Replace("''", "'");
			startIndex += match.Length;
			return value;
		}

		private bool ParseMatrix(int arrayStartIndex)
		{
			if (!ParseMatrixRow(arrayStartIndex))
			{
				return false;
			}
			do
			{
				PositionInfo position = SavePosition();
				if (!ParseMatrixRowSeparator())
				{
					RestorePosition(position);
					return true;
				}
			}
			while (ParseMatrixRow(arrayStartIndex));
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseMatrixElement()
		{
			if (ParseNumber())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ParseString())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ParseError())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ParseBoolean())
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseMatrixRow(int arrayStartIndex)
		{
			if (!ParseMatrixElement())
			{
				return true;
			}
			int charIndexOfError;
			do
			{
				PositionInfo position = SavePosition();
				charIndexOfError = startIndex;
				if (!ParseSeparator(matrixValueSeparatorResolved))
				{
					RestorePosition(position);
					return true;
				}
			}
			while (ParseMatrixElement());
			ParseException = new FormulaParseException(charIndexOfError, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_NoElementAfterArraySerapator"), formula.Substring(arrayStartIndex, startIndex - arrayStartIndex));
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseMatrixRowSeparator()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!TestCurrentChar(';'))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AddToken(new MatrixRowSeparatorToken(), 1);
			return true;
		}

		private string ParseName()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = ParseNameHelper(formula, startIndex);
			if (text == null || !IsValidNamedReferenceHelper(text, _context.Format, _context.Culture))
			{
				return null;
			}
			startIndex += text.Length;
			if (text.StartsWith("_xlnm.") && Utilities.Is2007Format(_context.Format))
			{
				text = text.Substring("_xlnm.".Length);
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static string ParseNameHelper(string valueWithName, int startIndex)
		{
			int num = startIndex;
			if (num >= valueWithName.Length)
			{
				return null;
			}
			char c = valueWithName[num];
			if (c == '[')
			{
				while (++num < valueWithName.Length)
				{
					c = valueWithName[num];
					if (!IsValidNamedReferenceCharacter(c, isFirstChracter: false))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (c != ']')
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (++num >= valueWithName.Length)
				{
					return null;
				}
				c = valueWithName[num];
			}
			if (!IsValidNamedReferenceCharacter(c, isFirstChracter: true))
			{
				return null;
			}
			while (++num < valueWithName.Length)
			{
				c = valueWithName[num];
				if (!IsValidNamedReferenceCharacter(c, isFirstChracter: false))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return valueWithName.Substring(startIndex, num - startIndex);
		}

		public static bool IsValidNamedReferenceCharacter(char currentChar, bool isFirstChracter)
		{
			switch (currentChar)
			{
			case '\\':
			case '_':
			case '‘':
			case '’':
			case '“':
			case '”':
				return true;
			case '.':
				return !isFirstChracter;
			case '\u203f':
			case '\u2040':
			case '\u2054':
				return false;
			default:
				if (isFirstChracter)
				{
					return char.IsLetter(currentChar);
				}
				if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(currentChar))
				{
					return true;
				}
				switch (CharUnicodeInfo.GetUnicodeCategory(currentChar))
				{
				case UnicodeCategory.LetterNumber:
				case UnicodeCategory.OtherNumber:
				case UnicodeCategory.ConnectorPunctuation:
				case UnicodeCategory.OtherSymbol:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ParseNextWhitespace()
		{
			int i;
			for (i = startIndex; i < formula.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = formula[i];
				if (c != ' ' && c != '\t' && c != '\r' && c != '\n')
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (i == startIndex)
			{
				nextWhitespace = TextSpan.Empty;
				return;
			}
			nextWhitespace = new TextSpan(startIndex, i - startIndex);
			startIndex = i;
		}

		private bool ParseNumber()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = ParseNumberHelper();
			if (text == null || !MathUtilities.DoubleTryParse(text, _context.Culture, out var value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AddTokenAndWhitespace(CreateNumberOperator(value), text.Length, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseDecimalSeparator(ref int currentIndex, ref char currentChar)
		{
			if (currentChar != cachedDecimalSeparator[0])
			{
				return false;
			}
			int length = cachedDecimalSeparator.Length;
			if (length != 1)
			{
				for (int i = 1; i < length; i++)
				{
					if (formula[i + currentIndex] != cachedDecimalSeparator[i])
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			currentIndex += length;
			if (currentIndex < formula.Length)
			{
				currentChar = formula[currentIndex];
			}
			else
			{
				currentChar = '\0';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string ParseNumberHelper()
		{
			int currentIndex = startIndex;
			int length = formula.Length;
			if (currentIndex >= length)
			{
				return null;
			}
			char currentChar = formula[currentIndex];
			if (currentChar == '-' || currentChar == '+')
			{
				if (++currentIndex == length)
				{
					return null;
				}
				currentChar = formula[currentIndex];
			}
			bool flag = ParseDigitSection(ref currentIndex, ref currentChar);
			if (ParseDecimalSeparator(ref currentIndex, ref currentChar))
			{
				if (!ParseDigitSection(ref currentIndex, ref currentChar))
				{
					return null;
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (currentChar == 'e' || currentChar == 'E')
			{
				if (++currentIndex == length)
				{
					return null;
				}
				currentChar = formula[currentIndex];
				if (currentChar == '-' || currentChar == '+')
				{
					if (++currentIndex == length)
					{
						return null;
					}
					currentChar = formula[currentIndex];
				}
				if (!ParseDigitSection(ref currentIndex, ref currentChar))
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return formula.Substring(startIndex, currentIndex - startIndex);
		}

		private bool ParseDigitSection(ref int currentIndex, ref char currentChar)
		{
			if (!IsDigitCharacter(currentChar))
			{
				return false;
			}
			do
			{
				if (++currentIndex == formula.Length)
				{
					currentChar = '\0';
					break;
				}
				currentChar = formula[currentIndex];
			}
			while (IsDigitCharacter(currentChar));
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsDigitCharacter(char currentChar)
		{
			if ('0' <= currentChar)
			{
				return currentChar <= '9';
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void ParseOleObjectLink(string referenceName, out string progId, out Uri objectLink, char progIdSeparator = '|')
		{
			int num = referenceName.IndexOf(progIdSeparator);
			string text;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				progId = "";
				text = referenceName;
			}
			else
			{
				progId = referenceName.Substring(0, num);
				text = referenceName.Substring(num + 1);
			}
			if (2 <= progId.Length && progId[0] == '\'' && progId[progId.Length - 1] == '\'')
			{
				progId = progId.Substring(1, progId.Length - 2).Replace("''", "'");
			}
			if (2 <= text.Length && text[0] == '\'' && text[text.Length - 1] == '\'')
			{
				text = text.Substring(1, text.Length - 2).Replace("''", "'");
			}
			objectLink = new Uri(text, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
		}

		private bool ParseOleObjectName(ref WorksheetReferenceInfo referenceInfo, int referenceStartIndex)
		{
			string text = null;
			TextSpan textSpan = ParseWorksheetNameSafe();
			if (!textSpan.IsEmpty)
			{
				text = formula.Substring(textSpan.StartIndex, textSpan.Length);
			}
			else if (TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('\''))
			{
				string text2 = ParseFilePath();
				string text3 = ParseFileNameQuoted();
				text = text2 + text3;
				if (!TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('\''))
				{
					text = null;
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(referenceStartIndex, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_NoOleObjectName"), formula.Substring(referenceStartIndex, startIndex - referenceStartIndex));
				return false;
			}
			referenceInfo.IsOleLink = true;
			referenceInfo.FilePath = formula.Substring(referenceStartIndex, startIndex - referenceStartIndex);
			if (!TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('!'))
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(referenceStartIndex, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_NoExclamationAfterOleObjectName"), formula.Substring(referenceStartIndex, startIndex - referenceStartIndex));
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseOpenParen()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!TestCurrentChar('('))
			{
				return false;
			}

			return true;
		}

		private int ParseParameterList()
		{
			PositionInfo position = SavePosition();
			ParseEmptyOrParameter();
			int num = 1;
			PositionInfo position2;
			while (true)
			{
				position2 = SavePosition();
				if (!ParseSeparator(unionOperatorResolved))
				{
					break;
				}
				ParseEmptyOrParameter();
				num++;
			}
			RestorePosition(position2);
			if (num == 1 && infixTokenList[infixTokenList.Count - 1].Token is MissArgToken)
			{
				RestorePosition(position);
				return 0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool ParseReference()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = startIndex;
			TextSpan textSpan = nextWhitespace;
			WorksheetReferenceInfo referenceInfo = default(WorksheetReferenceInfo);
			bool flag = ParseWorksheetReference(ref referenceInfo);
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!flag || referenceInfo.FirstWorksheetName != null)
			{
				CellAddress? cellAddress = ParseCellAddress();
				CellAddressRange? cellAddressRange;
				if (cellAddress.HasValue)
				{
					cellAddressRange = ParseCellRange(cellAddress.GetValueOrDefault());
				}
				else
				{
					cellAddressRange = ParseColumnRange();
					if (!cellAddressRange.HasValue)
					{
						cellAddressRange = ParseRowRange();
					}
				}
				if (cellAddressRange.HasValue)
				{
					CellAddressRange valueOrDefault = cellAddressRange.GetValueOrDefault();
					bool flag2 = _context.CellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.R1C1 && valueOrDefault.HasRelativeAddresses;
					AreaToken token;
					if (!flag)
					{
						token = ((!flag2) ? new AreaToken(valueOrDefault) : new AreaNToken(valueOrDefault));
					}
					else
					{
						WorksheetReference worksheetReference = GetWorksheetReference(ref referenceInfo);
						token = ((!flag2) ? ((AreaToken)new Area3DToken(worksheetReference, valueOrDefault)) : ((AreaToken)new Area3DNToken(worksheetReference, valueOrDefault)));
					}
					AddTokenAndWhitespace(token, num, startIndex - num, textSpan, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
					return true;
				}
				if (cellAddress.HasValue)
				{
					CellAddress valueOrDefault2 = cellAddress.GetValueOrDefault();
					bool flag3 = _context.CellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.R1C1 && valueOrDefault2.HasRelativeAddresses;
					RefToken token2;
					if (!flag)
					{
						token2 = ((!flag3) ? new RefToken(valueOrDefault2) : new RefNToken(valueOrDefault2));
					}
					else
					{
						WorksheetReference worksheetReference2 = GetWorksheetReference(ref referenceInfo);
						token2 = ((!flag3) ? ((RefToken)new Ref3DToken(worksheetReference2, valueOrDefault2)) : ((RefToken)new Ref3DNToken(worksheetReference2, valueOrDefault2)));
					}
					AddTokenAndWhitespace(token2, num, startIndex - num, textSpan, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
					return true;
				}
			}
			string text = ParseName();
			if (text != null)
			{
				if (referenceInfo.FilePath != null && TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('(') && ParseFunctionHelper(Function.GetExternalFunction(referenceInfo.FilePath, text), num, textSpan))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (structuredTableReferenceParserHelper.Parse(referenceInfo.FilePath, text, textSpan))
				{
					return true;
				}
				NameToken token3 = ((!flag) ? new NameToken(text, _context, referenceInfo.IsOleLink ? NameType.OleObject : NameType.Normal) : new NameXToken(referenceInfo.FilePath, referenceInfo.FirstWorksheetName, text, _context, referenceInfo.IsOleLink ? NameType.OleObject : NameType.Normal));
				AddTokenAndWhitespace(token3, num, startIndex - num, textSpan, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
				return true;
			}
			if (referenceInfo.IsOleLink && TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('\''))
			{
				int num2 = startIndex;
				int num3 = startIndex;
				int num4;
				do
				{
					num4 = formula.IndexOf('\'', num3);
					num3 = num4 + 1;
				}
				while (0 < num4 && formula.Length != num4 + 1 && formula[num4 + 1] == '\'');
				if (0 < num4)
				{
					string name = formula.Substring(num2, num4 - num2);
					NameXToken token4 = new NameXToken(referenceInfo.FilePath, null, name, _context, NameType.OleObject);
					startIndex = num4 + 1;
					AddTokenAndWhitespace(token4, num, startIndex - num, textSpan, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (structuredTableReferenceParserHelper.Parse(null, null, textSpan))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_context.CellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.R1C1 && (!flag || referenceInfo.FirstWorksheetName != null))
			{
				if (ParseRowAddressR1C1(out var rowIndex, out var isRelative))
				{
					CellAddress cell = new CellAddress(rowIndex, isRelative, 0, columnAddressIsRelative: false);
					CellAddress cell2 = new CellAddress(rowIndex, isRelative, (short)(Workbook.GetMaxColumnCountInternal(_context.Format) - 1), columnAddressIsRelative: false);
					CellAddressRange valueOrDefault = new CellAddressRange(cell, cell2);
					AreaToken token5;
					if (!flag)
					{
						token5 = ((!valueOrDefault.HasRelativeAddresses) ? new AreaToken(valueOrDefault) : new AreaNToken(valueOrDefault));
					}
					else
					{
						WorksheetReference worksheetReference3 = GetWorksheetReference(ref referenceInfo);
						token5 = ((!valueOrDefault.HasRelativeAddresses) ? ((AreaToken)new Area3DToken(worksheetReference3, valueOrDefault)) : ((AreaToken)new Area3DNToken(worksheetReference3, valueOrDefault)));
					}
					AddTokenAndWhitespace(token5, num, startIndex - num, textSpan, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
					return true;
				}
				if (ParseColumnAddressR1C1(out var columnIndex, out var isRelative2))
				{
					CellAddress cell3 = new CellAddress(0, rowAddressIsRelative: false, columnIndex, isRelative2);
					CellAddress cell4 = new CellAddress(Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(_context.Format) - 1, rowAddressIsRelative: false, columnIndex, isRelative2);
					CellAddressRange valueOrDefault = new CellAddressRange(cell3, cell4);
					AreaToken token6;
					if (!flag)
					{
						token6 = ((!valueOrDefault.HasRelativeAddresses) ? new AreaToken(valueOrDefault) : new AreaNToken(valueOrDefault));
					}
					else
					{
						WorksheetReference worksheetReference4 = GetWorksheetReference(ref referenceInfo);
						token6 = ((!valueOrDefault.HasRelativeAddresses) ? ((AreaToken)new Area3DToken(worksheetReference4, valueOrDefault)) : ((AreaToken)new Area3DNToken(worksheetReference4, valueOrDefault)));
					}
					AddTokenAndWhitespace(token6, num, startIndex - num, textSpan, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (ParseError(mustBeReferenceError: true))
				{
					infixTokenList.RemoveAt(infixTokenList.Count - 1);
					WorksheetReference worksheetReference5 = GetWorksheetReference(ref referenceInfo);
					RefErr3dToken token7 = new RefErr3dToken(worksheetReference5);
					AddTokenAndWhitespace(token7, num, startIndex - num, textSpan, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
					return true;
				}
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_NoValidTermAfterWorksheetName"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
				return false;
			}
			if (ParseWorkbookReferenceQuoted(out var filePath, out var isOleLink))
			{
				string text2 = ParseName();
				if (text2 == null)
				{
					if (ParseCellAddress().HasValue)
					{
						ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_CellReferenceAfterWorkbookName"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
					}
					else
					{
						ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_NoValidTermAfterWorkbookName"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
					}
					return false;
				}
				AddTokenAndWhitespace(new NameXToken(filePath, null, text2, _context, isOleLink ? NameType.OleObject : NameType.Normal), num, startIndex - num, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseRowAddress(out int rowIndex, out bool isRelative)
		{
			if (_context.CellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.A1)
			{
				return ParseRowAddressA1(out rowIndex, out isRelative);
			}
			return ParseRowAddressR1C1(out rowIndex, out isRelative);
		}

		private bool ParseRowAddressA1(out int rowIndex, out bool isRelative)
		{
			rowIndex = 0;
			isRelative = false;
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ParseRowAddressA1(formula, startIndex, _context.Format, ref rowIndex, ref isRelative, out var matchLength))
			{
				return false;
			}
			startIndex += matchLength;
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool ParseRowAddressA1(string formula, int index, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, ref int rowIndex, ref bool isRelative, out int matchLength)
		{
			matchLength = 0;
			if (index == formula.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			char c = formula[index];
			if (c == '$')
			{
				isRelative = false;
				c = formula[++index];
			}
			else
			{
				isRelative = true;
			}
			rowIndex = 0;
			int num = 0;
			while ('0' <= c && c <= '9' && num <= 7)
			{
				rowIndex *= 10;
				rowIndex += c - 48;
				num++;
				if (++index >= formula.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				c = formula[index];
			}
			if (num > 7)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (--rowIndex < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (index < formula.Length && (c == '_' || char.IsLetter(c)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rowIndex > Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(currentFormat) - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			matchLength = num;
			if (!isRelative)
			{
				matchLength++;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ParseRowAddressIndexR1C1(string addressIndex, bool isRelative, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, out int rowIndex)
		{
			if (!int.TryParse(addressIndex, out rowIndex))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!isRelative)
			{
				rowIndex--;
				if (rowIndex < 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (Math.Abs(rowIndex) > Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(currentFormat) - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseRowAddressR1C1(out int rowIndex, out bool isRelative)
		{
			rowIndex = 0;
			isRelative = false;
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ParseRowAddressR1C1Helper(formula, startIndex, _context.Format, ref rowIndex, ref isRelative, out var matchLength))
			{
				return false;
			}
			startIndex += matchLength;
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool ParseRowAddressR1C1(string formula, int index, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, ref int rowIndex, ref bool isRelative, out int matchLength)
		{
			return Instance.ParseRowAddressR1C1Helper(formula, index, currentFormat, ref rowIndex, ref isRelative, out matchLength);
		}

		private bool ParseRowAddressR1C1Helper(string formula, int index, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, ref int rowIndex, ref bool isRelative, out int matchLength)
		{
			matchLength = 0;
			Match match = RowAddressR1C1Regex.Match(formula, index);
			if (!match.Success)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string value = match.Value;
			if (value.Length == 1)
			{
				isRelative = true;
				rowIndex = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				isRelative = value[1] == '[';
				string addressIndex = (isRelative ? value.Substring(2, value.Length - 3) : value.Substring(1));
				if (!ParseRowAddressIndexR1C1(addressIndex, isRelative, currentFormat, out rowIndex))
				{
					isRelative = true;
					rowIndex = 0;
					matchLength = 1;
					return true;
				}
			}
			matchLength = match.Length;
			return true;
		}

		private CellAddressRange? ParseRowRange()
		{
			PositionInfo position = SavePosition();
			if (!ParseRowAddress(out var rowIndex, out var isRelative))
			{
				RestorePosition(position);
				return null;
			}
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(':'))
			{
				RestorePosition(position);
				return null;
			}
			if (!ParseRowAddress(out var rowIndex2, out var isRelative2))
			{
				RestorePosition(position);
				return null;
			}
			short column = (short)(Workbook.GetMaxColumnCountInternal(_context.Format) - 1);
			CellAddress cell;
			CellAddress cell2;
			if (rowIndex <= rowIndex2)
			{
				cell = new CellAddress(rowIndex, isRelative, 0, columnAddressIsRelative: false);
				cell2 = new CellAddress(rowIndex2, isRelative2, column, columnAddressIsRelative: false);
			}
			else
			{
				cell = new CellAddress(rowIndex2, isRelative2, 0, columnAddressIsRelative: false);
				cell2 = new CellAddress(rowIndex, isRelative, column, columnAddressIsRelative: false);
			}
			return new CellAddressRange(cell, cell2);
		}

		private bool ParseString()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!TestCurrentChar('"'))
			{
				return false;
			}
			stringParseResult.Length = 0;
			int num = 0;
			int i;
			for (i = startIndex + 1; i < formula.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = formula[i];
				if (c != '"')
				{
					num++;
					stringParseResult.Append(c);
					continue;
				}
				if (i >= formula.Length - 1 || formula[i + 1] != '"')
				{
					break;
				}
				num += 2;
				i++;
				stringParseResult.Append(c);
			}
			if (i >= formula.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = ((stringParseResult.Length == 0) ? string.Empty : stringParseResult.ToString());
			if (num > 255)
			{
				ParseException = new FormulaParseException(startIndex, formula, string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_StringConstantLengthTooLong"), 255), text);
				return false;
			}
			AddTokenAndWhitespace(new StrToken(text), num + 2, WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken);
			return true;
		}

		private string ParseWorksheetNameQuoted()
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			worksheetNameQuotedBuilder.Length = 0;
			int i;
			for (i = startIndex; i < formula.Length; i++)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				char c = formula[i];
				switch (c)
				{
				case '*':
				case '/':
				case ':':
				case '?':
				case '[':
				case '\\':
				case ']':
				case '^':
					flag = false;
					break;
				case '\'':
					if (i < formula.Length - 1 && formula[i + 1] == '\'')
					{
						i++;
						worksheetNameQuotedBuilder.Append(c);
					}
					else
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					break;
				default:
					worksheetNameQuotedBuilder.Append(c);
					break;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (i == startIndex)
			{
				return null;
			}
			startIndex = i;
			return worksheetNameQuotedBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private TextSpan ParseWorksheetNameSafe()
		{

		private static TextSpan ParseWorksheetNameSafe(string valueWithWorksheetName, ref int startIndex)
		{
			if (startIndex >= valueWithWorksheetName.Length)
			{
				return TextSpan.Empty;
			}
			char value = valueWithWorksheetName[startIndex];
			if (!IsValidWorksheetNameSafeCharacter(value, isFirstCharacter: true))
			{
				return TextSpan.Empty;
			}
			int num = startIndex;
			while (++num < valueWithWorksheetName.Length)
			{
				value = valueWithWorksheetName[num];
				if (!IsValidWorksheetNameSafeCharacter(value, isFirstCharacter: false))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			TextSpan result = new TextSpan(startIndex, num - startIndex);
			startIndex = num;
			return result;
		}

		private static bool IsValidWorksheetNameSafeCharacter(char value, bool isFirstCharacter)
		{
			switch (value)
			{
			case '_':
			case '‘':
			case '’':
			case '“':
			case '”':
				return true;
			case '.':
				return !isFirstCharacter;
			default:
				if (char.IsLetter(value))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!isFirstCharacter && char.IsNumber(value))
				{
					return true;
				}
				switch (CharUnicodeInfo.GetUnicodeCategory(value))
				{
				case UnicodeCategory.NonSpacingMark:
				case UnicodeCategory.LetterNumber:
				case UnicodeCategory.OtherNumber:
				case UnicodeCategory.OtherSymbol:
					return true;
				default:
					if ('゠' <= value && value <= 'ヿ')
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

				}
