		private bool ParseWorksheetReferenceSafe(ref WorksheetReferenceInfo referenceInfo)
		{
			if (ParseException != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PositionInfo position = SavePosition();
			int num = position.StartIndex;
			referenceInfo.FilePath = ParseFileNameBracketedSafe(out var wasIndexedReference, out referenceInfo.IsOleLink);
			TextSpan textSpan = ParseWorksheetNameSafe();
			if (textSpan.IsEmpty && !wasIndexedReference)
			{
				if (referenceInfo.FilePath != null)
				{
					if (!Utilities.Is2003Format(_context.Format))
					{
						referenceInfo.FilePath = null;
						RestorePosition(position);
						return false;
					}
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_NoWorksheetAfterWorkbookName"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
				}
				RestorePosition(position);
				return false;
			}
			TextSpan textSpan2 = TextSpan.Empty;
			if (TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(':'))
			{
				if (referenceInfo.FilePath == null)
				{
					short columnNumber;
					int rowNumber;
					bool columnNumberIsOffset;
					bool rowNumberIsOffset;
					if (_context.CellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.A1)
					{
						if (Utilities.ParseA1CellAddress(formula, textSpan.StartIndex, textSpan.Length, _context.Format, _context.Culture, out columnNumber, out rowNumber) && !TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('!'))
						{
							RestorePosition(position);
							return false;
						}
					}
					else if (Utilities.ParseR1C1CellAddress(formula, textSpan.StartIndex, textSpan.Length, _context.Format, out columnNumber, out columnNumberIsOffset, out rowNumber, out rowNumberIsOffset) && !TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('!'))
					{
						RestorePosition(position);
						return false;
					}
				}
				int charIndexOfError = startIndex;
				textSpan2 = ParseWorksheetNameSafe();
				if (textSpan2.IsEmpty)
				{
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(charIndexOfError, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_WorksheetRangeMissingEndingName"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (referenceInfo.FilePath == null && !textSpan.IsEmpty && textSpan2.IsEmpty && TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('|'))
			{
				return ParseOleObjectName(ref referenceInfo, num);
			}
			if (!TestCurrentCharAndAdvance('!'))
			{
				startIndex = num;
				if (TestCurrentChar('[') && ParseName() != null)
				{
					startIndex = num;
					return false;
				}
				if (referenceInfo.FilePath != null)
				{
					ParseException = new FormulaParseException(num, formula, Utilities.GetString("LE_FormulaParseException_NoExclamationAfterWorksheetName"), formula.Substring(num, startIndex - num));
				}
				RestorePosition(position);
				return false;
			}
			if (!textSpan.IsEmpty)
			{
				referenceInfo.FirstWorksheetName = formula.Substring(textSpan.StartIndex, textSpan.Length);
			}
			if (!textSpan2.IsEmpty)
			{
				referenceInfo.LastWorksheetName = formula.Substring(textSpan2.StartIndex, textSpan2.Length);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool TryParseBoolean(string value, out bool booleanValue)
		{
			booleanValue = false;
			if (value.Equals("FALSE", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (value.Equals("TRUE", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				booleanValue = true;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AddOperatorToPostfixList(FormulaTokenInfo operatorInfo)
		{
			AddTokenToPostfixList(operatorInfo);
			if (!(operatorInfo.Token is FunctionVOperator functionVOperator) || !functionVOperator.Function.IsOptimizableSelector)
			{
				return;
			}
			SelectorFunctionOptimizationInfo selectorFunctionOptimizationInfo = selectorFunctionOptimizationInfoStack.Pop();
			ushort num = (ushort)(postfixTokenList.Count - 1);
			selectorFunctionOptimizationInfo.OptimizationToken.SelectorFunctionTokenIndex = num;
			foreach (AttrSkipToken skipToken in selectorFunctionOptimizationInfo.SkipTokens)
			{
				skipToken.OwningSelectorFunctionIndex = num;
			}
		}

		private void AddOperatorToStack(Stack<FormulaTokenInfo> operatorStack, FormulaTokenInfo currentOperatorInfo)
		{
			OperatorToken operatorToken = (OperatorToken)currentOperatorInfo.Token;
			while (operatorStack.Count > 0)
			{
				OperatorToken operatorToken2 = (OperatorToken)operatorStack.Peek().Token;
				if (operatorToken.IsRightAssociative)
				{
					if (operatorToken.Precedence <= operatorToken2.Precedence)
					{
						break;
					}
					AddOperatorToPostfixList(operatorStack.Pop());
				}
				else
				{
					if (operatorToken.Precedence < operatorToken2.Precedence)
					{
						break;
					}
					AddOperatorToPostfixList(operatorStack.Pop());
				}
			}
			operatorStack.Push(currentOperatorInfo);
		}

		private void AddSkipTokenToOptimizationFunction()
		{
			AttrSkipToken attrSkipToken = new AttrSkipToken();
			SelectorFunctionOptimizationInfo selectorFunctionOptimizationInfo = selectorFunctionOptimizationInfoStack.Peek();
			selectorFunctionOptimizationInfo.SkipTokens.Add(attrSkipToken);
			selectorFunctionOptimizationInfo.OptimizationToken.SkipTokenIndexes.Add((ushort)postfixTokenList.Count);
			AddTokenToPostfixList(new FormulaTokenInfo(attrSkipToken, -1, null));
		}

		private void AddTokenToPostfixList(FormulaTokenInfo tokenInfo)
		{
			AddWhitespaceToPostfixList(tokenInfo.PreceedingWhitespace);
			postfixTokenList.Add(tokenInfo);
		}

		private void AddWhitespaceChars(int numChars, bool shouldBeSpaces, WhitespaceType whitespaceType)
		{
			whitespaceType = GetCorrectWhitespaceType(whitespaceType, shouldBeSpaces);
			while (numChars > 0)
			{
				byte b = (byte)Math.Min(numChars, 255);
				whitespaceTokensTemp.Add(AttrSpaceToken.Create(b, whitespaceType));
				numChars -= b;
			}
		}

		private void AddWhitespaceToPostfixList(AttrSpaceToken[] preceedingWhitespace)
		{
			if (preceedingWhitespace == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AttrSpaceToken attrSpaceToken in preceedingWhitespace)
			{
				if (postfixTokenList.Count == 1 && postfixTokenList[0].Token is AttrVolatileToken)
				{
					postfixTokenList[0] = new FormulaTokenInfo(new AttrSpaceVolitileToken(attrSpaceToken), 0, null);
				}
				else
				{
					postfixTokenList.Add(new FormulaTokenInfo(attrSpaceToken, 0, null));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ConvertInfixToPostfix()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = infixTokenList.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				FormulaTokenInfo formulaTokenInfo = infixTokenList[i];
				FormulaToken token = formulaTokenInfo.Token;
				flag2 = flag;
				flag = false;
				if (token is FunctionOperator functionOperator)
				{
					if (functionOperator.Function.ID == 359)
					{
						_context.Formula.HasHyperlink = true;
					}
					flag = true;
					functionParamIndicies.Push(0);
					operatorStack.Push(formulaTokenInfo);
					if (functionOperator.Function.IsAddIn)
					{
						NameToken token2 = ((!functionOperator.Function.IsInternalAddInFunction) ? new NameXToken(functionOperator.Function.WorkbookPath, null, functionOperator.Function.Name, _context, NameType.AddInFunctionName) : new NameToken(functionOperator.Function.Name, _context, NameType.AddInFunctionName));
						AddTokenToPostfixList(new FormulaTokenInfo(token2, formulaTokenInfo.StartIndex, null));
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (token is OpenParenOperator)
				{
					operatorStack.Push(formulaTokenInfo);
					continue;
				}
				if (token is Infragistics.Documents.Excel.FormulaUtilities.Tokens.UnionOperator)
				{
					bool flag3 = false;
					foreach (FormulaTokenInfo item in operatorStack)
					{
						OperatorToken operatorToken = (OperatorToken)item.Token;
						if (operatorToken is OpenParenOperator)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (!(operatorToken is FunctionOperator))
						{
							continue;
						}
						flag3 = true;
						while (!(operatorStack.Peek().Token is FunctionOperator))
						{
							AddOperatorToPostfixList(operatorStack.Pop());
						}
						FunctionOperator functionOperator2 = (FunctionOperator)operatorStack.Peek().Token;
						if (functionOperator2.Function.IsOptimizableSelector)
						{
							if (functionParamIndicies.Peek() == 0)
							{
								object obj;
								if (functionOperator2.Function.ID != 1)
								{
									ISelectorFunctionOptimizationToken selectorFunctionOptimizationToken = new AttrChooseToken();
									obj = selectorFunctionOptimizationToken;
								}
								else
								{
									obj = new AttrIfToken();
								}
								ISelectorFunctionOptimizationToken selectorFunctionOptimizationToken2 = (ISelectorFunctionOptimizationToken)obj;
								selectorFunctionOptimizationInfoStack.Push(new SelectorFunctionOptimizationInfo(selectorFunctionOptimizationToken2));
								AddTokenToPostfixList(new FormulaTokenInfo((FormulaToken)selectorFunctionOptimizationToken2, -1, null));
							}
							else
							{
								AddSkipTokenToOptimizationFunction();
							}
						}
						byte b = functionParamIndicies.Pop();
						b++;
						functionParamIndicies.Push(b);
						break;
					}
					if (flag3)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (token is ParenToken)
				{
					while (!(operatorStack.Peek().Token is FunctionOperator) && !(operatorStack.Peek().Token is OpenParenOperator))
					{
						AddOperatorToPostfixList(operatorStack.Pop());
					}
					FormulaTokenInfo operatorInfo = operatorStack.Pop();
					OperatorToken operatorToken2 = (OperatorToken)operatorInfo.Token;
					if (operatorToken2 is FunctionOperator functionOperator3)
					{
						if (formulaTokenInfo.PreceedingWhitespace != null)
						{
							operatorInfo.AddPreceedingWhitespace(formulaTokenInfo.PreceedingWhitespace);
						}
						if (functionOperator3.Function.IsOptimizableSelector)
						{
							AddWhitespaceToPostfixList(operatorInfo.PreceedingWhitespace);
							AddSkipTokenToOptimizationFunction();
						}
						byte b2 = functionParamIndicies.Pop();
						if (!flag2)
						{
							b2++;
						}
						if (b2 == 1 && functionOperator3.Function.ID == 4)
						{
							AttrSumToken token3 = new AttrSumToken();
							AddTokenToPostfixList(new FormulaTokenInfo(token3, operatorInfo.StartIndex, operatorInfo.PreceedingWhitespace));
							continue;
						}
						AddOperatorToPostfixList(operatorInfo);
						if (functionOperator3 is FunctionVOperator functionVOperator)
						{
							functionVOperator.ArgumentCount = b2;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						formulaTokenInfo.StartIndex = operatorInfo.StartIndex;
						if (operatorInfo.PreceedingWhitespace != null)
						{
							formulaTokenInfo.AddPreceedingWhitespace(operatorInfo.PreceedingWhitespace);
						}
						AddTokenToPostfixList(formulaTokenInfo);
					}
				}
				else if (token is OperatorToken)
				{
					AddOperatorToStack(operatorStack, formulaTokenInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					AddTokenToPostfixList(formulaTokenInfo);
				}
			}
			while (operatorStack.Count > 0)
			{
				AddOperatorToPostfixList(operatorStack.Pop());
			}
		}

		private FormulaToken CreateNumberOperator(double number)
		{
			if (number % 1.0 == 0.0 && 0.0 <= number && number <= 65535.0)
			{
				return new IntToken((ushort)number);
			}
			return new NumberToken(number);
		}

		private AttrSpaceToken[] CreateWhitespaceOperators(TextSpan whitespace, WhitespaceType whitespaceType)
		{
			if (whitespace.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			whitespaceTokensTemp.Clear();
			int num = 0;
			int num2;
			for (num2 = whitespace.StartIndex; num < whitespace.Length; num++, num2++)
			{
				int num3 = 1;
				char c = formula[num2];
				switch (c)
				{
				case '\t':
				case '\n':
				case ' ':
					num++;
					num2++;
					while (num < whitespace.Length && formula[num2] == c)
					{
						num3++;
						num++;
						num2++;
					}
					switch (c)
					{
					case ' ':
						AddWhitespaceChars(num3, shouldBeSpaces: true, whitespaceType);
						break;
					case '\t':
						AddWhitespaceChars(num3 * 4, shouldBeSpaces: true, whitespaceType);
						break;
					case '\n':
						AddWhitespaceChars(num3, shouldBeSpaces: false, whitespaceType);
						break;
					}
					continue;
				case '\r':
					num2++;
					switch ((++num != whitespace.Length) ? formula[num2] : '\0')
					{
					case '\r':
						num3++;
						num++;
						num2++;
						while (num < whitespace.Length && formula[num2] == c)
						{
							num3++;
							num++;
							num2++;
						}
						break;
					case '\n':
						num++;
						num2++;
						while (num < whitespace.Length && formula[num2] == '\r' && formula[num2 + 1] == '\n')
						{
							num3++;
							num++;
							num2++;
						}
						break;
					}
					AddWhitespaceChars(num3, shouldBeSpaces: false, whitespaceType);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
			return whitespaceTokensTemp.ToArray();
		}

		private static WhitespaceType GetCorrectWhitespaceType(WhitespaceType whitespaceType, bool shouldBeSpaces)
		{
			switch (whitespaceType)
			{
			case WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken:
			case WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeNextToken:
				if (shouldBeSpaces)
				{
					return WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken;
				}
				return WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeNextToken;
			case WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeOpeningParens:
			case WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeOpeningParens:
				if (shouldBeSpaces)
				{
					return WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeOpeningParens;
				}
				return WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeOpeningParens;
			case WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeClosingParens:
			case WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeClosingParens:
				if (shouldBeSpaces)
				{
					return WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeClosingParens;
				}
				return WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeClosingParens;
			case WhitespaceType.SpacesFollowEqualitySign:
				return WhitespaceType.SpacesFollowEqualitySign;
			default:
				return WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken;
			}
		}

		}

		private bool IsValidNamedReferenceHelper(string name, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			bool isRelative = false;
			short columnIndex = 0;
			bool isRelative2 = false;
			int rowIndex = 0;
			if (ParseColumnAddressA1(name, 0, currentFormat, culture, ref columnIndex, ref isRelative, out var matchLength) && ParseRowAddressA1(name, matchLength, currentFormat, ref rowIndex, ref isRelative2, out var matchLength2) && matchLength + matchLength2 == name.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ParseRowAddressR1C1Helper(name, 0, currentFormat, ref rowIndex, ref isRelative2, out matchLength2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ParseColumnAddressR1C1Helper(name, 0, currentFormat, ref columnIndex, ref isRelative, out matchLength))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool TestCurrentChar(char expectedChar)
		{
			if (startIndex >= formula.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return formula[startIndex] == expectedChar;
		}

		private bool TestCurrentCharAndAdvance(char expectedChar)
		{
			if (startIndex >= formula.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (formula[startIndex] != expectedChar)
			{
				return false;
			}
			startIndex++;
			return true;
		}

		private bool TestForStringAndAdvance(string expectedString)
		{
			return TestForStringAndAdvance(expectedString, ignoreCase: true);
		}

		private bool TestForStringAndAdvance(string expectedString, bool ignoreCase)
		{
			if (startIndex + expectedString.Length > formula.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < expectedString.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = formula[startIndex + i];
				char c2 = expectedString[i];
				if (ignoreCase)
				{
					c = char.ToLowerInvariant(c);
					c2 = char.ToLowerInvariant(c2);
				}
				if (c != c2)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			startIndex += expectedString.Length;
			return true;
		}

	internal class FormulaStringGenerator : FormulaTokenEvaluator<string>
	{
		private const string EqualsSign = "=";

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static FormulaStringGenerator _instance;

		private string _cachedDecimalSeparator;

		private bool _ignoreWhitespace;

		private string[] _tokenPortionsInFormula;

		private char _unionOperatorResolved;

		private List<AttrSpaceToken> _whitespaceTokens;

		protected virtual bool ShouldIncludeEqualsSign => true;

		protected FormulaStringGenerator()
		{
			_whitespaceTokens = new List<AttrSpaceToken>();
		}

		protected override string CreateFunctionNameStackItem(IFunctionToken token, string functionName)
		{
			return functionName;
		}

		public override EvaluationResult<string> Evaluate()
		{
			_whitespaceTokens.Clear();
			if (_tokenPortionsInFormula != null)
			{
				Array.Clear(_tokenPortionsInFormula, 0, _tokenPortionsInFormula.Length);
			}
			EvaluationResult<string> result = base.Evaluate();
			if (!result.Completed)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (ShouldIncludeEqualsSign)
			{
				return new EvaluationResult<string>("=" + result.Result);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override string EvaluateBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token, string firstOperand, string secondOperand)
		{
			string whitespace = GetWhitespace(WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken, WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeNextToken);
			string text = $"{firstOperand}{whitespace}{GetTokenString(token)}{secondOperand}";
			OnTokenPortionGenerated(token, text);
			return text;
		}

		protected override string EvaluateFunctionToken(IFunctionToken token, string functionName, string[] arguments)
		{
			string whitespace = GetWhitespace(WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeClosingParens, WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeClosingParens);
			string whitespace2 = GetWhitespace(WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken, WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeNextToken);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder($"{whitespace2}{functionName}(");
			for (int i = 0; i < arguments.Length; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(arguments[i]);
				if (i != arguments.Length - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(_unionOperatorResolved);
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append($"{whitespace})");
			string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
			OnTokenPortionGenerated(token.FormulaToken, text);
			return text;
		}

		protected override string EvaluateOperandToken(OperandToken token)
		{
			string whitespace = GetWhitespace(WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken, WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeNextToken);
			string text = whitespace + GetTokenString(token);
			OnTokenPortionGenerated(token, text);
			return text;
		}

		protected override string EvaluateParenToken(ParenToken token, string contents)
		{
			string whitespace = GetWhitespace(WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeOpeningParens, WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeOpeningParens);
			string whitespace2 = GetWhitespace(WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeClosingParens, WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeClosingParens);
			string text = $"{whitespace}({contents}{whitespace2})";
			OnTokenPortionGenerated(token, text);
			return text;
		}

		protected override string EvaluateUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token, string operand)
		{
			string whitespace = GetWhitespace(WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken, WhitespaceType.CarriageReturnsBeforeNextToken);
			string format = (token.IsRightAssociative ? "{0}{1}{2}" : "{2}{0}{1}");
			string text = string.Format(format, whitespace, GetTokenString(token), operand);
			OnTokenPortionGenerated(token, text);
			return text;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_cachedDecimalSeparator = null;
			_ignoreWhitespace = false;
			_tokenPortionsInFormula = null;
			_unionOperatorResolved = '\0';
			_whitespaceTokens.Clear();
			base.Reset();
		}

		public override bool VisitAttrSpaceToken(AttrSpaceToken token)
		{
			if (!_ignoreWhitespace)
			{
				_whitespaceTokens.Add(token);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool VisitExpToken(ExpToken token)
		{
			string tokenString = GetTokenString(token);
			OnTokenPortionGenerated(token, tokenString);
			_stack.Push(tokenString);
			return true;
		}

		public override bool VisitTblToken(TblToken token)
		{
			string tokenString = GetTokenString(token);
			OnTokenPortionGenerated(token, tokenString);
			_stack.Push(tokenString);
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual string GetTokenString(FormulaToken token)
		{
			return token.ToString(base.Context, GetFormulaStringInfo.Default);
		}

		private string GetWhitespace(params WhitespaceType[] whitespaceTypes)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			for (int num = _whitespaceTokens.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				AttrSpaceToken attrSpaceToken = _whitespaceTokens[num];
				foreach (WhitespaceType whitespaceType in whitespaceTypes)
				{
					if (attrSpaceToken.WhitespaceType == whitespaceType)
					{
						_whitespaceTokens.RemoveAt(num);
						text = GetTokenString(attrSpaceToken) + text;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static FormulaStringGenerator Initialize(FormulaContext context)
		{
			return Initialize(context, ignoreWhitespace: false);
		}

		public static FormulaStringGenerator Initialize(FormulaContext context, string[] tokenPortionsInFormula)
		{
			FormulaStringGenerator formulaStringGenerator = Initialize(context);
			formulaStringGenerator._tokenPortionsInFormula = tokenPortionsInFormula;
			return formulaStringGenerator;
		}

		public static FormulaStringGenerator Initialize(FormulaContext context, bool ignoreWhitespace)
		{
			if (_instance == null)
			{
				_instance = new FormulaStringGenerator();
			}
			InitializeHelper(_instance, context, ignoreWhitespace);
			return _instance;
		}

		protected static void InitializeHelper(FormulaStringGenerator generator, FormulaContext context, bool ignoreWhitespace)
		{
			generator._ignoreWhitespace = ignoreWhitespace;
			generator._cachedDecimalSeparator = context.Culture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator;
			generator._unionOperatorResolved = FormulaParser.GetUnionOperatorResolved(generator._cachedDecimalSeparator);
			generator.Context = context;
		}

		private void OnTokenPortionGenerated(FormulaToken currentToken, string tokenPortionInFormula)
		{
			if (_tokenPortionsInFormula != null)
			{
				_tokenPortionsInFormula[_currentTokenIndex] = tokenPortionInFormula;
			}
		}
	}

		public bool IsAddIn => functionID == 255;

		public bool IsFuncV
		{
			get
			{
				if (functionID != 255)
				{
					return minParams != maxParams;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[DebuggerBrowsable(DebuggerBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsInternalAddInFunction
		{
			get
			{
				if (this != AVERAGEIF && this != AVERAGEIFS && this != BAHTTEXT && this != CUBEKPIMEMBER && this != CUBEMEMBER && this != CUBEMEMBERPROPERTY && this != CUBERANKEDMEMBER && this != CUBESET && this != CUBESETCOUNT && this != CUBEVALUE && this != IFERROR && this != RTD)
				{
					return this == SUMIFS;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsOptimizableSelector
		{
			get
			{
				if (functionID != 1)
				{
					return functionID == 100;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private Function(string name, int functionID, byte minParameters, int maxParameters, bool isVolatile, int tuplesStart, int tuplesDegree, int[] forcedReferenceIndices, TokenClass returnClass, params TokenClass[] paramClasses)
		{
			this.name = name;
			if (functionID == -1)
			{
				this.functionID = 255;
				isExcel2007OnlyFunction = true;
				workbookPath = "<AddInFunctions>";
			}
			else
			{
				this.functionID = functionID;
			}
			minParams = minParameters;
			maxParams = maxParameters;
			this.isVolatile = isVolatile;
			this.tuplesStart = tuplesStart;
			this.tuplesDegree = tuplesDegree;
			this.forcedReferenceIndices = forcedReferenceIndices;
			this.returnClass = returnClass;
			this.paramClasses = paramClasses;
			nameLower = this.name.ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			nameUpper = this.name.ToUpper(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		public int CompareTo(Function other)
		{
			int num = functionID - other.functionID;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = string.Compare(name, other.name, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return string.Compare(workbookPath, other.workbookPath, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
		}

		public virtual TokenClass GetExpectedParameterClass(int index)
		{
			if (index < paramClasses.Length)
			{
				return paramClasses[index];
			}
			return paramClasses[paramClasses.Length - 1];
		}

		public byte GetMaxParams(WorkbookFormat format)
		{
			byte b = (byte)(Utilities.Is2003Format(format) ? 30 : byte.MaxValue);
			if (maxParams == -1)
			{
				int num = b - TuplesStart;
				while (num % TuplesDegree != 0)
				{
					num--;
				}
				return (byte)num;
			}
			return (byte)Math.Min(b, maxParams);
		}

		private static void AddFunctionToMap(Function function, Dictionary<int, List<Function>> map)
		{
			if (!map.TryGetValue(function.Name.Length, out var value))
			{
				value = new List<Function>(1);
				map.Add(function.Name.Length, value);
			}
			value.Add(function);
		}

		public static Function GetFunction(string name)
		{
			return GetFunction(name, 0, name.Length);
		}

		public static Function GetFunction(string valueWithFunctionName, int startIndex, int length)
		{
			if (_builtInFunctions == null)
			{
				_builtInFunctions = GenerateBuiltInFunctionMap();
			}
			if (_builtInFunctions.TryGetValue(length, out var value))
			{
				foreach (Function function in value)
				{
					bool flag = true;
					int num = 0;
					int num2 = startIndex;
					while (num < length)
					{
						char c = valueWithFunctionName[num2];
						if (c != function.nameLower[num] && c != function.nameUpper[num])
						{
							flag = false;
							break;
						}
						num++;
						num2++;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						return function;
					}
				}
			}
			string text = valueWithFunctionName.Substring(startIndex, length);
			if (text.StartsWith("_xll."))
			{
				return GetUnknownAddInFunction(text.Substring(5));
			}
			return GetUnknownAddInFunction(text);
		}

		private static Function GetFunction(string name, int functionID, byte minParameters, int maxParameters, bool isVolatile, int tuplesStart, int tuplesDegree, int[] forcedReferenceIndices, TokenClass returnClass, params TokenClass[] paramClasses)
		{
			int? num = null;
			bool flag = (functionID != 255 || name == "<AddIn>") && functionID != -1;
			if (flag)
			{
				num = GetFunctionIndex(functionID);
				if (0 <= num.Value)
				{
					return Functions[num.Value];
				}
			}
			Function function = new Function(name, functionID, minParameters, maxParameters, isVolatile, tuplesStart, tuplesDegree, forcedReferenceIndices, returnClass, paramClasses);
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!num.HasValue)
				{
					num = Functions.BinarySearch(function);
				}
				int valueOrDefault = num.GetValueOrDefault();
				if (valueOrDefault >= 0)
				{
					return Functions[valueOrDefault];
				}
				Functions.Insert(~valueOrDefault, function);
			}
			return function;
		}

		private static int GetFunctionIndex(int functionID)
		{
			List<Function> list = Functions;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = list.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num) / 2;
				Function function = list[num3];
				int num4 = function.functionID - functionID;
				if (num4 == 0)
				{
					return num3;
				}
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
				}
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		public static Function GetUnknownAddInFunction(string name)
		{
			Function function = GetFunction(name, 255, 0, -1, false, 0, 1, null, TokenClass.Reference, TokenClass.Reference);
			function.isUnknownAddInFunction = true;
			function.workbookPath = "<AddInFunctions>";
			return function;
		}
	}
	internal class TokenClassResolver : FormulaTokenEvaluator<TokenClassResolver.FormulaTokenNode>
	{
		public struct FormulaTokenNode
		{
			public static readonly FormulaTokenNode[] EmptyArray = new FormulaTokenNode[0];

			private readonly ushort _formulaTokenIndex;

			private readonly FormulaTokenNode[] _paramNodes;

			public ushort FormulaTokenIndex => _formulaTokenIndex;

			public FormulaTokenNode(ushort formulaTokenIndex, params FormulaTokenNode[] paramNodes)
			{
				_formulaTokenIndex = formulaTokenIndex;
				_paramNodes = paramNodes;
			}

			public void SetTokenClass(TokenClassResolver owner, TokenClass tokenClass, bool forceArrayClass)
			{
				FormulaToken formulaToken = owner.Context.Formula.PostfixTokenList[_formulaTokenIndex];
				switch (tokenClass)
				{
				case TokenClass.Reference:
					switch (owner._formulaType)
					{
					case FormulaType.ArrayFormula:
					case FormulaType.NamedReferenceFormula:
					case FormulaType.ExternalNamedReferenceFormula:
						forceArrayClass = true;
						break;
					}
					if (formulaToken.TokenClass == TokenClass.Value && forceArrayClass)
					{
						owner.SetTokenClass(_formulaTokenIndex, TokenClass.Array);
					}
					break;
				case TokenClass.Value:
					if (forceArrayClass)
					{
						owner.SetTokenClass(_formulaTokenIndex, TokenClass.Array);
					}
					else
					{
						owner.SetTokenClass(_formulaTokenIndex, TokenClass.Value);
					}
					break;
				case TokenClass.Array:
					owner.SetTokenClass(_formulaTokenIndex, TokenClass.Array);
					forceArrayClass = true;
					break;
				}
				if (formulaToken is ParenToken)
				{
					_paramNodes[0].SetTokenClass(owner, tokenClass, forceArrayClass);
					return;
				}
				int i = 0;
				for (int num = _paramNodes.Length; i < num; i++)
				{
					_paramNodes[i].SetTokenClass(owner, formulaToken.Accept(ExpectedParameterClassVisitor.Instance, i), forceArrayClass);
				}
			}

			public TokenClass GetTokenClass(TokenClassResolver owner)
			{
				FormulaToken formulaToken = owner.Context.Formula.PostfixTokenList[_formulaTokenIndex];
				if (formulaToken is ParenToken)
				{
					return _paramNodes[0].GetTokenClass(owner);
				}
				return formulaToken.TokenClass;
			}
		}

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static TokenClassResolver _instance;

		private FormulaType _formulaType;

		private TokenClassResolver()
		{
		}

		public override EvaluationResult<FormulaTokenNode> Evaluate()
		{
			try
			{
				EvaluationResult<FormulaTokenNode> result = Evaluate(shouldResetAfterEvaluation: false);
				if (result.Completed)
				{
					switch (_formulaType)
					{
					case FormulaType.NamedReferenceFormula:
					case FormulaType.ExternalNamedReferenceFormula:
					case FormulaType.ListDataValidationFormula:
						result.Result.SetTokenClass(this, TokenClass.Reference, forceArrayClass: false);
						break;
					default:
						result.Result.SetTokenClass(this, TokenClass.Value, forceArrayClass: false);
						break;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				Reset();
			}
		}

		protected override FormulaTokenNode EvaluateBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token, FormulaTokenNode firstOperand, FormulaTokenNode secondOperand)
		{
			switch (token.Token)
			{
			case Token.Isect:
			case Token.Union:
			case Token.Range:
				if (firstOperand.GetTokenClass(this) != TokenClass.Reference || secondOperand.GetTokenClass(this) != TokenClass.Reference)
				{
					OnError();
					return default(FormulaTokenNode);
				}
				break;
			}
			return new FormulaTokenNode(_currentTokenIndex, firstOperand, secondOperand);
		}

		protected override FormulaTokenNode EvaluateFunctionToken(IFunctionToken token, FormulaTokenNode functionName, FormulaTokenNode[] arguments)
		{
			Function function = token.Function;
			if (function.ForcedReferenceIndices != null)
			{
				int[] forcedReferenceIndices = function.ForcedReferenceIndices;
				foreach (int num in forcedReferenceIndices)
				{
					if (num < arguments.Length && arguments[num].GetTokenClass(this) != TokenClass.Reference)
					{
						ushort formulaTokenIndex = arguments[num].FormulaTokenIndex;
						if (!(base.Context.Formula.PostfixTokenList[formulaTokenIndex] is ErrToken errToken) || errToken.Value != ErrorValue.InvalidCellReference)
						{
							OnError();
							return default(FormulaTokenNode);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return new FormulaTokenNode(_currentTokenIndex, arguments);
		}

		protected override FormulaTokenNode EvaluateOperandToken(OperandToken token)
		{
			return new FormulaTokenNode(_currentTokenIndex, FormulaTokenNode.EmptyArray);
		}

		protected override FormulaTokenNode EvaluateParenToken(ParenToken token, FormulaTokenNode contents)
		{
			return new FormulaTokenNode(_currentTokenIndex, contents);
		}

		protected override FormulaTokenNode EvaluateUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token, FormulaTokenNode operand)
		{
			return new FormulaTokenNode(_currentTokenIndex, operand);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
		}

		public static TokenClassResolver Initialize(FormulaContext context, FormulaType formulaType)
		{
			if (_instance == null)
			{
				_instance = new TokenClassResolver();
			}
			_instance._formulaType = formulaType;
			_instance.Context = context;
			return _instance;
		}

		private void SetTokenClass(ushort tokenIndex, TokenClass tokenClass)
		{
			FormulaToken[] postfixTokenList = base.Context.Formula.PostfixTokenList;
			FormulaToken formulaToken = postfixTokenList[tokenIndex];
			if (formulaToken.TokenClass == tokenClass)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (tokenClass == TokenClass.Array)
			{
				switch (formulaToken.Token)
				{
				case Token.Add:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = AddOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.Concat:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = ConcatOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.Div:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = DivOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.EQ:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = EQOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.LE:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = LEOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.LT:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = LTOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.GE:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = GEOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.GT:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = GTOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.MissArg:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = MissArgToken.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.Mul:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = MulOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.NE:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = NEOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.Percent:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = PercentOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.Power:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = PowerOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.Sub:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = SubOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.Uminus:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = UminusOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				case Token.Uplus:
					postfixTokenList[tokenIndex] = UplusOperator.InstanceArrayClass;
					return;
				}
			}
			formulaToken.TokenClass = tokenClass;
		}
	}
	internal class TokenReferenceResolver : FormulaTokenEvaluator<FormulaToken>
	{
		private struct SkipTokenInfo
		{
			public readonly AttrSkipToken Token;

			public readonly ushort Index;

			public SkipTokenInfo(AttrSkipToken token, ushort index)
			{
				Token = token;
				Index = index;
			}
		}

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static TokenReferenceResolver _instance;

		private Stack<FormulaToken> _ifAndChooseTokens = new Stack<FormulaToken>();

		private FormulaToken[] _postfixTokenList;

		private Stack<SkipTokenInfo> _skipTokens = new Stack<SkipTokenInfo>();

		protected override FormulaToken[] PostfixTokenList => _postfixTokenList;

		private TokenReferenceResolver()
		{
		}

		protected override FormulaToken EvaluateBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token, FormulaToken firstOperand, FormulaToken secondOperand)
		{
			return token;
		}

		protected override FormulaToken EvaluateFunctionToken(IFunctionToken token, FormulaToken functionName, FormulaToken[] arguments)
		{
			if (token is FunctionVOperator functionVOperator && functionVOperator.Function.IsOptimizableSelector)
			{
				if (functionVOperator.Function.ID == 1)
				{
					if (!(_ifAndChooseTokens.Pop() is AttrIfToken attrIfToken))
					{
						OnError();
						return token.FormulaToken;
					}
					attrIfToken.SkipTokenIndexes.Clear();
					attrIfToken.IfFunctionIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
					for (int i = 1; i < arguments.Length; i++)
					{
						SkipTokenInfo skipTokenInfo = _skipTokens.Pop();
						attrIfToken.SkipTokenIndexes.Insert(0, skipTokenInfo.Index);
						skipTokenInfo.Token.OwningSelectorFunctionIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
					}
				}
				else if (functionVOperator.Function.ID == 100)
				{
					if (!(_ifAndChooseTokens.Pop() is AttrChooseToken attrChooseToken))
					{
						return token.FormulaToken;
					}
					attrChooseToken.SkipTokenIndexes.Clear();
					attrChooseToken.ChooseFunctionIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
					for (int j = 1; j < arguments.Length; j++)
					{
						SkipTokenInfo skipTokenInfo2 = _skipTokens.Pop();
						attrChooseToken.SkipTokenIndexes.Insert(0, skipTokenInfo2.Index);
						skipTokenInfo2.Token.OwningSelectorFunctionIndex = _currentTokenIndex;
					}
				}
			}
			return token.FormulaToken;
		}

		protected override FormulaToken EvaluateOperandToken(OperandToken token)
		{
			return token;
		}

		protected override FormulaToken EvaluateParenToken(ParenToken token, FormulaToken contents)
		{
			return token;
		}

		protected override FormulaToken EvaluateUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token, FormulaToken operand)
		{
			return token;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_ifAndChooseTokens.Clear();
			_postfixTokenList = null;
			_skipTokens.Clear();
			base.Reset();
		}

		public override bool VisitAttrChooseToken(AttrChooseToken token)
		{
			_ifAndChooseTokens.Push(token);
			return true;
		}

		public override bool VisitAttrIfToken(AttrIfToken token)
		{
			_ifAndChooseTokens.Push(token);
			return true;
		}

		public override bool VisitAttrSkipToken(AttrSkipToken token)
		{
			_skipTokens.Push(new SkipTokenInfo(token, _currentTokenIndex));
			return true;
		}

		public static TokenReferenceResolver Initialize(FormulaContext context)
		{
			return Initialize(context, context.Formula.PostfixTokenList);
		}

		public static TokenReferenceResolver Initialize(FormulaContext context, FormulaToken[] postfixTokenList)
		{
			if (_instance == null)
			{
				_instance = new TokenReferenceResolver();
			}
			_instance._postfixTokenList = postfixTokenList;
			_instance.Context = context;
			return _instance;
		}
	}
}

{
	[DebuggerDisplay("{GetType().Name,nq}: {ToString(),nq}")]
	internal abstract class FormulaToken
	{
		public static readonly FormulaToken[] EmptyArray = new FormulaToken[0];

		private TokenClass tokenClass;

		public abstract Token Token { get; }

		public virtual TokenClass TokenClass
		{
			get
			{
				return tokenClass;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Token < Token.ArrayR)
				{
					if (this is AttrSumToken)
					{
						tokenClass = value;
					}
					else if (Token == Token.Paren)
					{
						tokenClass = value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					tokenClass = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public FormulaToken(TokenClass tokenClass)
		{
			this.tokenClass = tokenClass;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(new FormulaContext(null), GetFormulaStringInfo.Default);
		}

		public abstract void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor);

		public abstract TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor);

		public abstract TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument);

		public virtual bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			return comparisonToken.GetType() == GetType();
		}

		public abstract string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo);

		public static FormulaToken CreateToken(BiffRecordStream stream, byte tokenCode, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex)
		{
			switch ((Token)tokenCode)
			{
			case Token.Exp:
				return new ExpToken();
			case Token.Tbl:
				return new TblToken();
			case Token.Add:
				return AddOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Sub:
				return SubOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Mul:
				return MulOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Div:
				return DivOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Power:
				return PowerOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Concat:
				return ConcatOperator.Instance;
			case Token.LT:
				return LTOperator.Instance;
			case Token.LE:
				return LEOperator.Instance;
			case Token.EQ:
				return EQOperator.Instance;
			case Token.GE:
				return GEOperator.Instance;
			case Token.GT:
				return GTOperator.Instance;
			case Token.NE:
				return NEOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Isect:
				return IsectOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Union:
				return UnionOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Range:
				return RangeOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Uplus:
				return UplusOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Uminus:
				return UminusOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Percent:
				return PercentOperator.Instance;
			case Token.Paren:
				return new ParenToken();
			case Token.MissArg:
				return MissArgToken.Instance;
			case Token.Str:
				return new StrToken();
			case Token.Attr:
				return AttrTokenBase.CreateOperator(stream, ref data, ref dataIndex);
			case Token.Err:
				return new ErrToken();
			case Token.Bool:
				return new BoolToken();
			case Token.Int:
				return new IntToken();
			case Token.Number:
				return new NumberToken();
			case Token.ArrayR:
			case Token.ArrayV:
			case Token.ArrayA:
				return new ArrayToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.FuncR:
			case Token.FuncV:
			case Token.FuncA:
				return new FunctionOperator(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.FuncVarR:
			case Token.FuncVarV:
			case Token.FuncVarA:
				return new FunctionVOperator(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.NameR:
			case Token.NameV:
			case Token.NameA:
				return new NameToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.RefR:
			case Token.RefV:
			case Token.RefA:
				return new RefToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.AreaR:
			case Token.AreaV:
			case Token.AreaA:
				return new AreaToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.MemAreaR:
			case Token.MemAreaV:
			case Token.MemAreaA:
				return new MemAreaOperator(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.MemErrR:
			case Token.MemErrV:
			case Token.MemErrA:
				return new MemErrOperator(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.MemNoMemR:
			case Token.MemNoMemV:
			case Token.MemNoMemA:
				return new MemNoMemOperator(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.MemFuncR:
			case Token.MemFuncV:
			case Token.MemFuncA:
				return new MemFuncOperator(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.RefErrR:
			case Token.RefErrV:
			case Token.RefErrA:
				return new RefErrToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.AreaErrR:
			case Token.AreaErrV:
			case Token.AreaErrA:
				return new AreaErrToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.RefNR:
			case Token.RefNV:
			case Token.RefNA:
				return new RefNToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.AreaNR:
			case Token.AreaNV:
			case Token.AreaNA:
				return new AreaNToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.NameXR:
			case Token.NameXV:
			case Token.NameXA:
				return new NameXToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.Ref3dR:
			case Token.Ref3dV:
			case Token.Ref3dA:
				return new Ref3DToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.Area3DR:
			case Token.Area3DV:
			case Token.Area3DA:
				return new Area3DToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.RefErr3dR:
			case Token.RefErr3dV:
			case Token.RefErr3dA:
				return new RefErr3dToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			case Token.AreaErr3dR:
			case Token.AreaErr3dV:
			case Token.AreaErr3dA:
				return new AreaErr3DToken(TokenClassFromId(tokenCode));
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal static TokenClass TokenClassFromId(int id)
		{
			return (byte)((id & 0x60) >> 5) switch
			{
				1 => TokenClass.Reference, 
				2 => TokenClass.Value, 
				3 => TokenClass.Array, 
				_ => TokenClass.Reference, 
			};
		}
	}
	internal abstract class OperatorToken : FormulaToken
	{
		protected const int Precendence0 = 0;

		protected const int Precendence1 = 1;

		protected const int Precendence2 = 2;

		protected const int Precendence3 = 3;

		protected const int Precendence4 = 4;

		protected const int Precendence5 = 5;

		protected const int Precendence6 = 6;

		protected const int Precendence7 = 7;

		protected const int Precendence8 = 8;

		public virtual bool IsRightAssociative => false;

		public abstract int Precedence { get; }

		public OperatorToken(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}
	}
	internal abstract class BinaryOperatorToken : OperatorToken
	{
		public virtual bool IsReferenceOperator => false;

		public BinaryOperatorToken(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitBinaryOperatorToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitBinaryOperatorToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitBinaryOperatorToken(this, argument);
		}
	}
	internal class AddOperator : BinaryOperatorToken
	{
		public static readonly AddOperator Instance = new AddOperator(TokenClass.Value);

		public static readonly AddOperator InstanceArrayClass = new AddOperator(TokenClass.Array);

		public override int Precedence => 6;

		public override Token Token => Token.Add;

		public override TokenClass TokenClass
		{
			set
			{
			}
		}

		private AddOperator(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			return "+";
		}
	}
	internal abstract class OperandToken : FormulaToken
	{
		public OperandToken(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}

		public abstract object GetCalcValue(FormulaContext context);
	}
	internal abstract class ReferenceToken : OperandToken
	{
		public virtual bool HasRelativeAddresses => false;

		public virtual bool Is3DReference => WorksheetReference != null;

		public virtual bool IsExternalReference => WorksheetReference?.IsExternal ?? false;

		public virtual WorksheetReference WorksheetReference
		{
			get
			{
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public ReferenceToken(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(WorksheetReference, ((ReferenceToken)comparisonToken).WorksheetReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void SetWorkbookReference(WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReference)
		{
			WorksheetReference worksheetReference = WorksheetReference;
			if (workbookReference != null)
			{
				WorksheetReference = worksheetReference.Connect(workbookReference);
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class CellReferenceToken : ReferenceToken
	{
		public abstract bool AreRelativeAddressesOffsets { get; }

		public virtual bool IsReferenceError => false;

		public CellReferenceToken(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}

		public abstract CellReferenceToken CreateEquivalentRefErrorToken();

		public Worksheet GetWorksheetContainingReference(FormulaContext context)
		{
			if (!Is3DReference)
			{
				return context.Worksheet;
			}
			if (WorksheetReference.IsExternal || WorksheetReference.IsMultiSheet)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(WorksheetReference is WorksheetReferenceLocal worksheetReferenceLocal))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return worksheetReferenceLocal.Worksheet;
		}
	}
	internal class AreaToken : CellReferenceToken
	{
		private CellAddressRange range;

		public override bool AreRelativeAddressesOffsets => false;

		public override bool HasRelativeAddresses => CellAddressRange.HasRelativeAddresses;

		public override Token Token => TokenClass switch
		{
			TokenClass.Array => Token.AreaA, 
			TokenClass.Reference => Token.AreaR, 
			TokenClass.Value => Token.AreaV, 
			_ => Token.AreaV, 
		};

		public CellAddressRange CellAddressRange
		{
			get
			{
				return range;
			}
			set
			{
				range = value;
			}
		}

		public AreaToken(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}

		public AreaToken(CellAddressRange range)
			: this(range, TokenClass.Reference)
		{
		}

		public AreaToken(CellAddressRange range, TokenClass tokenClass)
			: this(tokenClass)
		{
			this.range = range;
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitAreaToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitAreaToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitAreaToken(this, argument);
		}

		public override CellReferenceToken CreateEquivalentRefErrorToken()
		{
			return new AreaErrToken(TokenClass);
		}

		public override object GetCalcValue(FormulaContext context)
		{
			WorksheetRegion targetRegion = CellAddressRange.GetTargetRegion(context, AreRelativeAddressesOffsets);
			if (targetRegion != null)
			{
				return targetRegion.CalcReference;
			}
			return ErrorValue.InvalidCellReference.ToCalcErrorValue();
		}

		public sealed override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AreaToken areaToken = (AreaToken)comparisonToken;
			if (CellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative != areaToken.CellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative != areaToken.CellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative != areaToken.CellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative != areaToken.CellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				return false;
			}
			WorksheetRegion targetRegion = CellAddressRange.GetTargetRegion(sourceContext, AreRelativeAddressesOffsets);
			WorksheetRegion targetRegion2 = areaToken.CellAddressRange.GetTargetRegion(comparisonContext, areaToken.AreRelativeAddressesOffsets);
			int num = 0;
			if (CellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				num = comparisonContext.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex - sourceContext.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			if (CellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				num2 = comparisonContext.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex - sourceContext.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex;
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			if (CellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				num3 = comparisonContext.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex - sourceContext.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex;
			}
			int num4 = 0;
			if (CellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				num4 = comparisonContext.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex - sourceContext.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex;
			}
			if (targetRegion.FirstColumnInternal + num == targetRegion2.FirstColumnInternal && targetRegion.FirstRow + num2 == targetRegion2.FirstRow && targetRegion.LastColumnInternal + num3 == targetRegion2.LastColumnInternal)
			{
				return targetRegion.LastRow + num4 == targetRegion2.LastRow;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			if (IsReferenceError)
			{
				return "#REF!";
			}
			return range.ToString(context.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex, context.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex, AreRelativeAddressesOffsets, context.CellReferenceMode, context.Format);
		}
	}

	internal class Area3DNToken : AreaNToken
	{
		private WorksheetReference worksheetReference;

		public override bool AreRelativeAddressesOffsets => true;

		public override WorksheetReference WorksheetReference
		{
			get
			{
				return worksheetReference;
			}
			set
			{
				worksheetReference = value;
			}
		}

		public Area3DNToken(WorksheetReference worksheetReference, CellAddressRange range)
			: base(range)
		{
			this.worksheetReference = worksheetReference;
		}

		public Area3DNToken(WorksheetReference worksheetReference, CellAddressRange range, TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(range, tokenClass)
		{
			this.worksheetReference = worksheetReference;
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitArea3DNToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitArea3DNToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitArea3DNToken(this, argument);
		}

		public override CellReferenceToken CreateEquivalentRefErrorToken()
		{
			return new AreaErr3DToken(worksheetReference, base.CellAddressRange, TokenClass);
		}

		public override object GetCalcValue(FormulaContext context)
		{
			if (context.OwningCellAddress == WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference)
			{
				return null;
			}
			WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress = base.CellAddressRange.ToAbsoluteAddress(context, AreRelativeAddressesOffsets);
			if (!regionAddress.IsValid)
			{
				return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
			}
			return worksheetReference.GetCalcReference(regionAddress);
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			string referenceName = worksheetReference.GetReferenceName(getFormulaStringInfo);
			if (referenceName == "#REF!")
			{
				return referenceName;
			}
			return referenceName + base.ToString(context, getFormulaStringInfo);
		}
	}

	internal class ArrayToken : OperandToken
	{
		private ExcelCalcValue[,] arrayForCalcManager;

		private Constant[][] values;

		public override Token Token => TokenClass switch
		{
			TokenClass.Array => Token.ArrayA, 
			TokenClass.Reference => Token.ArrayR, 
			TokenClass.Value => Token.ArrayV, 
			_ => Token.ArrayV, 
		};

		public Constant[][] Values
		{
			get
			{
				return values;
			}
			set
			{
				values = value;
			}
		}

		public ArrayToken(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}

		public ArrayToken(Constant[][] values)
			: this(TokenClass.Array)
		{
			this.values = values;
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitArrayToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitArrayToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitArrayToken(this, argument);
		}

		public override object GetCalcValue(FormulaContext context)
		{
			if (arrayForCalcManager == null)
			{
				int num = values.Length;
				int num2 = values[0].Length;
				arrayForCalcManager = new ExcelCalcValue[num, num2];
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
					{
						arrayForCalcManager[j, i] = new ExcelCalcValue(values[j][i].CalcValue);
					}
				}
			}
			return arrayForCalcManager;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ArrayToken arrayToken = (ArrayToken)comparisonToken;
			if (values.Length != arrayToken.values.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (values[0].Length != arrayToken.values[0].Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = values.Length;
			int num2 = values[0].Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					if (!values[j][i].Equals(arrayToken.values[j][i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			string numberDecimalSeparator = context.Culture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator;
			char matrixValueSeparatorResolved = FormulaParser.GetMatrixValueSeparatorResolved(numberDecimalSeparator);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("{");
			int num = values.Length;
			int num2 = values[0].Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(values[j][i].ToString(context.Culture));
					if (j != num - 1)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(matrixValueSeparatorResolved);
					}
				}
				if (i != num2 - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(';');
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append('}');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	internal abstract class AttrTokenBase : SpecialFormulaToken
	{
		public enum AttrType : byte
		{
			Volatile = 1,
			If = 2,
			Choose = 4,
			Skip = 8,
			Sum = 16,
			Assign = 32,
			Space = 64,
			SpaceVolatile = 65
		}

		public override Token Token => Token.Attr;

		public abstract AttrType Type { get; }

		public virtual bool Volatile => false;

		public AttrTokenBase()
			: base(TokenClass.Control)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			return GetType().Name;
		}

		public static AttrTokenBase CreateOperator(BiffRecordStream reader, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex)
		{
			return (AttrType)reader.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex) switch
			{
				AttrType.Volatile => new AttrVolatileToken(), 
				AttrType.If => new AttrIfToken(), 
				AttrType.Choose => new AttrChooseToken(), 
				AttrType.Skip => new AttrSkipToken(), 
				AttrType.Sum => new AttrSumToken(), 
				AttrType.Space => new AttrSpaceToken(), 
				AttrType.SpaceVolatile => new AttrSpaceVolitileToken(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}

	internal class AttrSpaceToken : AttrTokenBase
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<WhitespaceId, AttrSpaceToken> _cachedWhitespace;

		private byte numberOfWhitespaceChars;

		private WhitespaceType whitespaceType;

		public override AttrType Type => AttrType.Space;

		public byte NumberOfWhitespaceChars
		{
			get
			{
				return numberOfWhitespaceChars;
			}
			set
			{
				numberOfWhitespaceChars = value;
			}
		}

		public WhitespaceType WhitespaceType
		{
			get
			{
				return whitespaceType;
			}
			set
			{
				whitespaceType = value;
			}
		}

		public AttrSpaceToken()
		{
		}

		protected AttrSpaceToken(byte numberOfWhitespaceChars, WhitespaceType whitespaceType)
			: this()
		{
			this.numberOfWhitespaceChars = numberOfWhitespaceChars;
			this.whitespaceType = whitespaceType;
		}

		public static AttrSpaceToken Create(byte numberOfWhitespaceChars, WhitespaceType whitespaceType)
		{
			if (_cachedWhitespace == null)
			{
				_cachedWhitespace = new Dictionary<WhitespaceId, AttrSpaceToken>();
			}
			WhitespaceId key = new WhitespaceId(whitespaceType, numberOfWhitespaceChars);
			if (!_cachedWhitespace.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				value = new AttrSpaceToken(numberOfWhitespaceChars, whitespaceType);
				_cachedWhitespace[key] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitAttrSpaceToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitAttrSpaceToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitAttrSpaceToken(this, argument);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AttrSpaceToken attrSpaceToken = (AttrSpaceToken)comparisonToken;
			if (numberOfWhitespaceChars == attrSpaceToken.numberOfWhitespaceChars)
			{
				return whitespaceType == attrSpaceToken.whitespaceType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			switch (whitespaceType)
			{
			case WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeNextToken:
			case WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeOpeningParens:
			case WhitespaceType.SpacesBeforeClosingParens:
			case WhitespaceType.SpacesFollowEqualitySign:
				return new string(' ', numberOfWhitespaceChars);
			default:
				return new string('\n', numberOfWhitespaceChars);
			}
		}
	}
	internal struct WhitespaceId
	{
		private readonly byte NumberOfWhitespaceChars;

		private readonly WhitespaceType WhitespaceType;

		public WhitespaceId(WhitespaceType whitespaceType, byte numberOfWhitespaceChars)
		{
			NumberOfWhitespaceChars = numberOfWhitespaceChars;
			WhitespaceType = whitespaceType;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			WhitespaceId? whitespaceId = obj as WhitespaceId?;
			if (!whitespaceId.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (whitespaceId.GetValueOrDefault().NumberOfWhitespaceChars == NumberOfWhitespaceChars)
			{
				return whitespaceId.GetValueOrDefault().WhitespaceType == WhitespaceType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (NumberOfWhitespaceChars << 8) | (int)WhitespaceType;
		}
	}

	internal class ErrToken : OperandToken
	{
		private ErrorValue value;

		public override Token Token => Token.Err;

		public override TokenClass TokenClass
		{
			get
			{
				if (Value == ErrorValue.InvalidCellReference)
				{
					return TokenClass.Reference;
				}
				return base.TokenClass;
			}
		}

		public ErrorValue Value
		{
			get
			{
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				this.value = value;
			}
		}

		public ErrToken()
			: base(TokenClass.Value)
		{
		}

		public ErrToken(ErrorValue value)
			: this()
		{
			this.value = value;
			if (this.value == ErrorValue.InvalidCellReference)
			{
				TokenClass = TokenClass.Reference;
			}
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitErrToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitErrToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitErrToken(this, argument);
		}

		public override object GetCalcValue(FormulaContext context)
		{
			if (value == ErrorValue.Circularity)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return value.ToCalcErrorValue();
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ErrToken errToken = (ErrToken)comparisonToken;
			return value == errToken.value;
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			return value.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class ExpToken : SpecialFormulaToken
	{
		private CellAddress cellAddress;

		public override bool IsCellReference => true;

		public override Token Token => Token.Exp;

		public CellAddress CellAddress
		{
			get
			{
				return cellAddress;
			}
			set
			{
				cellAddress = value;
			}
		}

		public ExpToken()
			: base(TokenClass.Control)
		{
		}

		public ExpToken(short firstColumn, int firstRow)
			: this(new CellAddress(firstRow, rowAddressIsRelative: false, firstColumn, columnAddressIsRelative: false))
		{
		}

		public ExpToken(CellAddress cellAddress)
			: this()
		{
			this.cellAddress = cellAddress;
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitExpToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitExpToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitExpToken(this, argument);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sourceContext.Worksheet != comparisonContext.Worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ExpToken expToken = (ExpToken)comparisonToken;
			return cellAddress.Equals(expToken.cellAddress);
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			return "<Array Interior Or Shared Formula, Source: " + cellAddress.ToString(context.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex, context.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex, context.CellReferenceMode, context.Format) + ">";
		}
	}

		public override FormulaToken VisitAreaToken(AreaToken token)
		{
			return new AreaToken(token.CellAddressRange, token.TokenClass);
		}

		public override FormulaToken VisitAttrChooseToken(AttrChooseToken token)
		{
			AttrChooseToken attrChooseToken = new AttrChooseToken();
			attrChooseToken.ChooseFunctionIndex = token.ChooseFunctionIndex;
			foreach (ushort skipTokenIndex in token.SkipTokenIndexes)
			{
				attrChooseToken.SkipTokenIndexes.Add(skipTokenIndex);
			}
			return attrChooseToken;
		}

		public override FormulaToken VisitAttrIfToken(AttrIfToken token)
		{
			AttrIfToken attrIfToken = new AttrIfToken();
			attrIfToken.IfFunctionIndex = token.IfFunctionIndex;
			foreach (ushort skipTokenIndex in token.SkipTokenIndexes)
			{
				attrIfToken.SkipTokenIndexes.Add(skipTokenIndex);
			}
			return attrIfToken;
		}

		public override FormulaToken VisitAttrSkipToken(AttrSkipToken token)
		{
			AttrSkipToken attrSkipToken = new AttrSkipToken();
			attrSkipToken.OwningSelectorFunctionIndex = token.OwningSelectorFunctionIndex;
			return attrSkipToken;
		}

		public override FormulaToken VisitExpToken(ExpToken token)
		{
			return new ExpToken(token.CellAddress);
		}

		public override FormulaToken VisitMemAreaOperator(MemAreaOperator token)
		{
			MemAreaOperator memAreaOperator = new MemAreaOperator(token.TokenClass);
			memAreaOperator.SizeOfRefSubExpression = token.SizeOfRefSubExpression;
			memAreaOperator.Ranges = new CellAddressRange[token.Ranges.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < token.Ranges.Length; i++)
			{
				ref CellAddressRange reference = ref memAreaOperator.Ranges[i];
				reference = token.Ranges[i];
			}
			return memAreaOperator;
		}

		public override FormulaToken VisitRefErr3DToken(RefErr3dToken token)
		{
			return new RefErr3dToken(token.WorksheetReference, token.CellAddress, token.TokenClass);
		}

		public override FormulaToken VisitRef3DNToken(Ref3DNToken token)
		{
			return new Ref3DNToken(token.WorksheetReference, token.CellAddress, token.TokenClass);
		}

		public override FormulaToken VisitRef3DToken(Ref3DToken token)
		{
			return new Ref3DToken(token.WorksheetReference, token.CellAddress, token.TokenClass);
		}

		public override FormulaToken VisitRefNToken(RefNToken token)
		{
			return new RefNToken(token.CellAddress, token.TokenClass);
		}

		public override FormulaToken VisitRefToken(RefToken token)
		{
			return new RefToken(token.CellAddress, token.TokenClass);
		}

		public override FormulaToken VisitTblToken(TblToken token)
		{
			return new TblToken(token.CellAddress);
		}
	}
	internal class ExpectedParameterClassVisitor : FormulaTokenVisitor<int, TokenClass>
	{
		public static readonly ExpectedParameterClassVisitor Instance = new ExpectedParameterClassVisitor();

		public override TokenClass DefaultVisit(FormulaToken token, int index)
		{
			return TokenClass.Value;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
		}

		public override TokenClass VisitBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token, int index)
		{
			if (token.IsReferenceOperator)
			{
				return TokenClass.Reference;
			}
			return TokenClass.Value;
		}

		public override TokenClass VisitFunctionToken(IFunctionToken token, int index)
		{
			return token.Function.GetExpectedParameterClass(index);
		}

		public override TokenClass VisitUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token, int index)
		{
			return TokenClass.Value;
		}
	}
	internal class GetCalcFunctionVisitor : FormulaTokenVisitor<UltraCalcFunctionFactory, ExcelCalcFunction>
	{
		public static readonly GetCalcFunctionVisitor Instance = new GetCalcFunctionVisitor();

		public override ExcelCalcFunction DefaultVisit(FormulaToken token, UltraCalcFunctionFactory functionFactory)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
		}

		public override ExcelCalcFunction VisitBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token, UltraCalcFunctionFactory functionFactory)
		{
			return token.Token switch
			{
				Token.Isect => functionFactory["xlintersect"], 
				Token.Range => functionFactory["xlrange"], 
				Token.Union => functionFactory["xlunion"], 
				Token.Add => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.Add), 
				Token.Concat => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.Concatenate), 
				Token.Div => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.Divide), 
				Token.EQ => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.Equal), 
				Token.Power => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.Exponent), 
				Token.GT => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.GreaterThan), 
				Token.GE => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.GreaterThanOrEqual), 
				Token.LT => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.LessThan), 
				Token.LE => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.LessThanOrEqual), 
				Token.Mul => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.Multiply), 
				Token.NE => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.NotEqual), 
				Token.Sub => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.Subtract), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public override ExcelCalcFunction VisitFunctionToken(IFunctionToken token, UltraCalcFunctionFactory functionFactory)
		{
			Function function = token.Function;
			string text = function.Name;
			if (function.ID == 261)
			{
				int num = text.IndexOf('.');
				text = text.Substring(0, num) + text.Substring(num + 1);
			}
			return functionFactory[text];
		}

		public override ExcelCalcFunction VisitParenToken(ParenToken token, UltraCalcFunctionFactory argument)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override ExcelCalcFunction VisitUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token, UltraCalcFunctionFactory functionFactory)
		{
			return token.Token switch
			{
				Token.Percent => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.Percent), 
				Token.Uminus => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.UnaryMinus), 
				Token.Uplus => functionFactory.GetOperator(UltraCalcOperatorFunction.UnaryPlus), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}
	internal class FunctionOperator : OperatorToken, IFunctionToken
	{
		private byte argumentCount;

		private Function function;

		FormulaToken IFunctionToken.FormulaToken => this;

		public override int Precedence => int.MaxValue;

		public override Token Token => TokenClass switch
		{
			TokenClass.Array => Token.FuncA, 
			TokenClass.Reference => Token.FuncR, 
			TokenClass.Value => Token.FuncV, 
			_ => Token.FuncV, 
		};

		public byte ArgumentCount
		{
			get
			{
				return argumentCount;
			}
			set
			{
				argumentCount = value;
			}
		}

		public Function Function
		{
			get
			{
				return function;
			}
			set
			{
				function = value;
			}
		}

		public FunctionOperator(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}

		public FunctionOperator(Function function)
			: this(function, function.MinParams)
		{
		}

		protected FunctionOperator(Function function, byte argumentCount)
			: this(function.ReturnClass)
		{
			this.function = function;
			this.argumentCount = argumentCount;
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitFunctionOperator(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitFunctionOperator(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitFunctionOperator(this, argument);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FunctionOperator functionOperator = (FunctionOperator)comparisonToken;
			if (function == functionOperator.function)
			{
				return argumentCount == functionOperator.argumentCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			return function.Name;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class MemOperatorBase : SpecialFormulaToken
	{
		private ushort sizeOfRefSubExpression;

		public ushort SizeOfRefSubExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return sizeOfRefSubExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				sizeOfRefSubExpression = value;
			}
		}

		public MemOperatorBase(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			MemOperatorBase memOperatorBase = (MemOperatorBase)comparisonToken;
			return sizeOfRefSubExpression == memOperatorBase.sizeOfRefSubExpression;
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			return GetType().Name;
		}
	}
	internal class MemAreaOperator : MemOperatorBase
	{
		private CellAddressRange[] ranges;

		public override Token Token => TokenClass switch
		{
			TokenClass.Array => Token.MemAreaA, 
			TokenClass.Reference => Token.MemAreaR, 
			TokenClass.Value => Token.MemAreaV, 
			_ => Token.MemAreaV, 
		};

		public CellAddressRange[] Ranges
		{
			get
			{
				return ranges;
			}
			set
			{
				ranges = value;
			}
		}

		public MemAreaOperator(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitMemAreaOperator(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitMemAreaOperator(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitMemAreaOperator(this, argument);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			MemAreaOperator memAreaOperator = (MemAreaOperator)comparisonToken;
			if (ranges.Length != memAreaOperator.ranges.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ranges.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!ranges[i].Equals(memAreaOperator.ranges[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
