	internal class NameToken : ReferenceToken
	{
		private NamedReferenceBase namedReference;

		public override Token Token => TokenClass switch
		{
			TokenClass.Array => Token.NameA, 
			TokenClass.Reference => Token.NameR, 
			TokenClass.Value => Token.NameV, 
			_ => Token.NameV, 
		};

		public string Name => namedReference.Name;

		public NamedReferenceBase NamedReference
		{
			get
			{
				return namedReference;
			}
			set
			{
				namedReference = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual object ScopeReference => null;

		public NameToken(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
			namedReference = new NamedReferenceUnconnected(null, WorkbookFormat.Excel2007, NameType.Normal);
		}

		public NameToken(string name, FormulaContext context, NameType type)
			: base(TokenClass.Reference)
		{
			namedReference = new NamedReferenceUnconnected(name, context.Format, type);
			if (context.Workbook != null)
			{
				Formula.ConnectReferencesVisitor.ConnectNameToken(context, this);
			}
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitNameToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitNameToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitNameToken(this, argument);
		}

		public override object GetCalcValue(FormulaContext context)
		{
			return NamedReference.CalcReference;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sourceContext.Worksheet != comparisonContext.Worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NameToken nameToken = (NameToken)comparisonToken;
			return object.Equals(NamedReference, nameToken.NamedReference);
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			return namedReference.ToString(getFormulaStringInfo);
		}
	}

			: this(TokenClass.Reference)
		{
			base.NamedReference = new NamedReferenceUnconnected(name, context.Format, type);
			WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReferenceBase = null;
			if (context.Workbook != null)
			{
				WorkbookReferenceBase value;
				if (workbookFileName == null)
				{
					workbookReferenceBase = context.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference;
				}
				else if (context.Workbook.ExternalWorkbooks != null && context.Workbook.ExternalWorkbooks.TryGetValue(workbookFileName, out value))
				{
					workbookReferenceBase = value;
				}
			}
			if (workbookReferenceBase == null)
			{
				workbookReferenceBase = new WorkbookReferenceUnconnected(workbookFileName, type == NameType.OleObject);
			}
			worksheetReference = workbookReferenceBase.GetWorksheetReference(worksheetName);
			base.NamedReference.ScopeInternal = worksheetReference.NamedReferenceScope;
			if (context.Workbook != null)
			{
				Formula.ConnectReferencesVisitor.ConnectNameXToken(context, this);
			}
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitNameXToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitNameXToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitNameXToken(this, argument);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			NameXToken nameXToken = (NameXToken)comparisonToken;
			return object.Equals(worksheetReference, nameXToken.worksheetReference);
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			return base.NamedReference.ToString(getFormulaStringInfo, forceIncludeScopeName: true);
		}
	}

	internal class RefToken : CellReferenceToken
	{
		private CellAddress cellAddress;

		public override bool AreRelativeAddressesOffsets => false;

		public override bool HasRelativeAddresses => CellAddress.HasRelativeAddresses;

		public override Token Token => TokenClass switch
		{
			TokenClass.Array => Token.RefA, 
			TokenClass.Reference => Token.RefR, 
			TokenClass.Value => Token.RefV, 
			_ => Token.RefV, 
		};

		public CellAddress CellAddress
		{
			get
			{
				return cellAddress;
			}
			set
			{
				cellAddress = value;
			}
		}

		public RefToken(TokenClass tokenClass)
			: base(tokenClass)
		{
		}

		public RefToken(CellAddress cellAddress)
			: this(cellAddress, TokenClass.Reference)
		{
		}

		public RefToken(CellAddress cellAddress, TokenClass tokenClass)
			: this(tokenClass)
		{
			this.cellAddress = cellAddress;
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitRefToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitRefToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitRefToken(this, argument);
		}

		public override CellReferenceToken CreateEquivalentRefErrorToken()
		{
			return new RefErrToken(TokenClass);
		}

		public override object GetCalcValue(FormulaContext context)
		{
			WorksheetCellAddress worksheetCellAddress = CellAddress.ToAbsoluteAddress(context, AreRelativeAddressesOffsets);
			if (!worksheetCellAddress.IsValid)
			{
				return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
			}
			if (context.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
			}
			return context.Worksheet.Rows[worksheetCellAddress.RowIndex].GetCellCalcReference(worksheetCellAddress.ColumnIndex);
		}

		public sealed override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			RefToken refToken = (RefToken)comparisonToken;
			if (CellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative != refToken.CellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative != refToken.CellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative)
			{
				return false;
			}
			WorksheetCellAddress worksheetCellAddress = CellAddress.ToAbsoluteAddress(sourceContext, AreRelativeAddressesOffsets);
			WorksheetCellAddress worksheetCellAddress2 = refToken.CellAddress.ToAbsoluteAddress(comparisonContext, refToken.AreRelativeAddressesOffsets);
			int num = 0;
			if (CellAddress.ColumnAddressIsRelative)
			{
				num = comparisonContext.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex - sourceContext.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			if (CellAddress.RowAddressIsRelative && comparisonContext.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex != -1 && sourceContext.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex != -1)
			{
				num2 = comparisonContext.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex - sourceContext.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex;
			}
			if (worksheetCellAddress.ColumnIndex + num == worksheetCellAddress2.ColumnIndex)
			{
				return worksheetCellAddress.RowIndex + num2 == worksheetCellAddress2.RowIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			if (IsReferenceError)
			{
				return "#REF!";
			}
			return cellAddress.ToString(context.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex, context.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex, AreRelativeAddressesOffsets, context.CellReferenceMode, context.Format);
		}
	}

				return null;

			if (referenceName == "#REF!")
			{
				return referenceName;
			}
			return referenceName + base.ToString(context, getFormulaStringInfo);
		}

	internal class StructuredTableReference : ReferenceToken
	{
		public class InnerReference
		{
			private string _firstColumnName;

			private StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? _firstKeyword;

			private bool _hasSpaceAfter;

			private bool _hasSpaceAfterFirstKeyword;

			private bool _hasSpaceAfterKeywordList;

			private bool _hasSpaceBefore;

			private string _lastColumnName;

			private StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? _lastKeyword;

			public string FirstColumnName => _firstColumnName;

			public bool HasThisRowKeyword
			{
				get
				{
					if (_firstKeyword != StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.ThisRow)
					{
						return _lastKeyword == StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.ThisRow;
					}
					return true;
				}
			}

			public bool HasSpaceAfter
			{
				get
				{
					return _hasSpaceAfter;
				}
				set
				{
					_hasSpaceAfter = value;
				}
			}

			public bool HasSpaceBefore
			{
				get
				{
					return _hasSpaceBefore;
				}
				set
				{
					_hasSpaceBefore = value;
				}
			}

			public bool IsSimpleColumnReference
			{
				get
				{
					if (_firstColumnName != null && _lastColumnName == null && !_firstKeyword.HasValue && !_lastKeyword.HasValue && !_hasSpaceAfterFirstKeyword && !_hasSpaceAfterKeywordList && !_hasSpaceAfter)
					{
						return !_hasSpaceBefore;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public string LastColumnName => _lastColumnName;

			public InnerReference(StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType firstKeyword, bool hasSpaceAfterFirstKeyword, StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? lastKeyword)
			{
				_firstKeyword = firstKeyword;
				_hasSpaceAfterFirstKeyword = hasSpaceAfterFirstKeyword;
				_lastKeyword = lastKeyword;
			}

			public InnerReference(StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType firstKeyword, bool hasSpaceAfterFirstKeyword, StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? lastKeyword, bool hasSpaceAfterKeywordList, string firstColumnName, string lastColumnName)
				: this(firstKeyword, hasSpaceAfterFirstKeyword, lastKeyword)
			{
				_hasSpaceAfterKeywordList = hasSpaceAfterKeywordList;
				_firstColumnName = firstColumnName;
				_lastColumnName = lastColumnName;
			}

			public InnerReference(string firstColumnName, string lastColumnName)
			{
				_firstColumnName = firstColumnName;
				_lastColumnName = lastColumnName;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is InnerReference innerReference && _firstKeyword == innerReference._firstKeyword)
				{
					StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? lastKeyword = _lastKeyword;
					StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? lastKeyword2 = innerReference._lastKeyword;
					if (lastKeyword.GetValueOrDefault() == lastKeyword2.GetValueOrDefault() && lastKeyword.HasValue == lastKeyword2.HasValue && _firstColumnName == innerReference._firstColumnName && _lastColumnName == innerReference._lastColumnName && _hasSpaceAfterFirstKeyword == innerReference._hasSpaceAfterFirstKeyword && _hasSpaceAfterKeywordList == innerReference._hasSpaceAfterKeywordList && _hasSpaceAfter == innerReference._hasSpaceAfter)
					{
						return _hasSpaceBefore == innerReference._hasSpaceBefore;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return _firstColumnName.GetHashCode() ^ _lastColumnName.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return ToString(Utilities.CurrentCulture, GetFormulaStringInfo.Default);
			}

			public string ToString(CultureInfo culture, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
			{
				string text = EscapeColumnName(_firstColumnName);
				string text2 = EscapeColumnName(_lastColumnName);
				if (text != null && text2 == null && !_firstKeyword.HasValue && !_lastKeyword.HasValue)
				{
					return text;
				}
				char unionOperatorResolved = FormulaParser.GetUnionOperatorResolved(culture);
				string text3 = string.Empty;
				if (HasSpaceBefore)
				{
					text3 += " ";
				}
				if (_firstKeyword.HasValue)
				{
					text3 += GetWrapInBrackets(FormulaParser.GetKeywordText(_firstKeyword.Value), getFormulaStringInfo.IsSerializing);
					if (_lastKeyword.HasValue)
					{
						text3 += unionOperatorResolved;
						if (_hasSpaceAfterFirstKeyword)
						{
							text3 += " ";
						}
						text3 += GetWrapInBrackets(FormulaParser.GetKeywordText(_lastKeyword.Value), getFormulaStringInfo.IsSerializing);
					}
				}
				if (text != null)
				{
					if (_firstKeyword.HasValue)
					{
						text3 += unionOperatorResolved;
						if (_hasSpaceAfterKeywordList)
						{
							text3 += " ";
						}
					}
					text3 += GetWrapInBrackets(text, getFormulaStringInfo.IsSerializing);
					if (text2 != null)
					{
						text3 = text3 + ":" + GetWrapInBrackets(text2, getFormulaStringInfo.IsSerializing);
					}
				}
				if (HasSpaceAfter)
				{
					text3 += " ";
				}
				return text3;
			}

			public RefBase GetCalcReference(WorksheetTable table, WorksheetRow formulaOwnerRow)
			{
				if (_lastColumnName != null)
				{
					WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = table.Columns[_firstColumnName];
					WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn2 = table.Columns[_lastColumnName];
					if (worksheetTableColumn != null && worksheetTableColumn2 != null)
					{
						return new TableColumnRangeCalcReference(formulaOwnerRow, worksheetTableColumn, worksheetTableColumn2, _firstKeyword, _lastKeyword);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (_firstColumnName == null)
					{
						return new TableCalcReference(formulaOwnerRow, table, _firstKeyword, _lastKeyword);
					}
					WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn3 = table.Columns[_firstColumnName];
					if (worksheetTableColumn3 != null)
					{
						return new TableColumnCalcReference(formulaOwnerRow, worksheetTableColumn3, _firstKeyword, _lastKeyword);
					}
				}
				return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
			}

			public void OnTableColumnRenamed(WorksheetTable table, string oldName, string newName)
			{
				if (_firstColumnName != null && StringUtilities.StringCompare(oldName, _firstColumnName, table.Culture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					_firstColumnName = newName;
				}
				if (_lastColumnName != null && StringUtilities.StringCompare(oldName, _lastColumnName, table.Culture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					_lastColumnName = newName;
				}
			}
		}

		private InnerReference _innerReference;

		private StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType? _keyword;

		private string _simpleColumnName;

		private NamedReferenceBase _tableReference;

		private WorkbookReferenceBase _workbookReference;

		public override bool Is3DReference => _workbookReference != null;

		public override Token Token => TokenClass switch
		{
			TokenClass.Array => Token.StructuredTableReferenceA, 
			TokenClass.Reference => Token.StructuredTableReferenceR, 
			TokenClass.Value => Token.StructuredTableReferenceV, 
			_ => Token.StructuredTableReferenceV, 
		};

		public bool HasThisRowKeyword
		{
			get
			{
				if (_keyword == StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType.ThisRow)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (_innerReference != null)
				{
					return _innerReference.HasThisRowKeyword;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public InnerReference InnerStructuredReference => _innerReference;

		public string SimpleColumnName => _simpleColumnName;

		public string TableName => _tableReference.Name;

		public NamedReferenceBase TableReference
		{
			get
			{
				return _tableReference;
			}
			set
			{
				_tableReference = value;
			}
		}

		public WorkbookReferenceBase WorkbookReference
		{
			get
			{
				return _workbookReference;
			}
			set
			{
				_workbookReference = value;
			}
		}

		private StructuredTableReference(string workbookFileName, string tableName, WorkbookFormat currentFormat)
			: base(TokenClass.Reference)
		{
			_workbookReference = new WorkbookReferenceUnconnected(workbookFileName);
			_tableReference = new NamedReferenceUnconnected(tableName, _workbookReference, hidden: false, currentFormat);
		}

		public StructuredTableReference(string workbookFileName, string tableName, StructuredTableReferenceKeywordType keyword, WorkbookFormat currentFormat)
			: this(workbookFileName, tableName, currentFormat)
		{
			_keyword = keyword;
		}

		public StructuredTableReference(string workbookFileName, string tableName, string simpleColumnName, WorkbookFormat currentFormat)
			: this(workbookFileName, tableName, currentFormat)
		{
			_simpleColumnName = simpleColumnName;
		}

		public StructuredTableReference(string workbookFileName, string tableName, InnerReference innerReference, WorkbookFormat currentFormat)
			: this(workbookFileName, tableName, currentFormat)
		{
			_innerReference = innerReference;
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitStructuredTableReference(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitStructuredTableReference(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitStructuredTableReference(this, argument);
		}

		public override object GetCalcValue(FormulaContext context)
		{
			WorksheetTable table = GetTable(context);
			if (table == null)
			{
				return ErrorValue.InvalidCellReference.ToCalcErrorValue();
			}
			WorksheetRow owningRow = context.OwningRow;
			if (_innerReference != null)
			{
				return _innerReference.GetCalcReference(table, owningRow);
			}
			if (_keyword.HasValue)
			{
				return new TableCalcReference(owningRow, table, _keyword, null);
			}
			if (_simpleColumnName != null)
			{
				WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = table.Columns[_simpleColumnName];
				if (worksheetTableColumn != null)
				{
					return new TableColumnCalcReference(owningRow, worksheetTableColumn, null, null);
				}
			}
			return table.CalcReference;
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			StructuredTableReference structuredTableReference = (StructuredTableReference)comparisonToken;
			if (_keyword != structuredTableReference._keyword)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_simpleColumnName != structuredTableReference._simpleColumnName)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(_tableReference, structuredTableReference._tableReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(_workbookReference, structuredTableReference._workbookReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(_innerReference, structuredTableReference._innerReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void SetWorkbookReference(WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReference)
		{
			_workbookReference = workbookReference;
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			string text = _tableReference.Name;
			bool forceIncludeTableName;
			string wrapInBrackets = GetWrapInBrackets(GetStructuredTableReferenceString(context.Culture, getFormulaStringInfo, out forceIncludeTableName), getFormulaStringInfo.IsSerializing);
			if (!forceIncludeTableName && text != null && context.Formula != null && context.Formula.OwningCellRow != null)
			{
				WorksheetTable cellAssociatedTable = context.Formula.OwningCellRow.GetCellAssociatedTable(context.Formula.OwningCellColumnIndex);
				if (cellAssociatedTable != null && StringUtilities.StringCompare(cellAssociatedTable.Name, text, context.Culture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					text = null;
				}
			}
			string workbookReferenceString = _workbookReference.GetWorkbookReferenceString(getFormulaStringInfo);
			return workbookReferenceString + (text ?? "") + wrapInBrackets;
		}

		public WorksheetTable GetTable(FormulaContext context)
		{
			if (_workbookReference.IsExternal)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_tableReference.Name == null)
			{
				return context.OwningRow?.GetCellAssociatedTableInternal(context.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex);
			}
			if (context.Workbook != null)
			{
				return context.Workbook.GetTable(_tableReference.Name);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static string EscapeColumnName(string columnName)
		{
			if (columnName == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < columnName.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = columnName[i];
				if (!FormulaParser.IsEscapeTableColumnCharacter(c))
				{
					continue;
				}
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(columnName.Substring(0, i));
				stringBuilder.Append('\'');
				stringBuilder.Append(c);
				for (int j = i + 1; j < columnName.Length; j++)
				{
					c = columnName[j];
					if (FormulaParser.IsEscapeTableColumnCharacter(c))
					{
						stringBuilder.Append('\'');
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return columnName;
		}

		private string GetStructuredTableReferenceString(CultureInfo culture, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, out bool forceIncludeTableName)
		{
			forceIncludeTableName = true;
			if (_innerReference != null)
			{
				return _innerReference.ToString(culture, getFormulaStringInfo);
			}
			if (_keyword.HasValue)
			{
				return FormulaParser.GetKeywordText(_keyword.Value);
			}
			if (_simpleColumnName != null)
			{
				forceIncludeTableName = getFormulaStringInfo.IsSerializing;
				return EscapeColumnName(_simpleColumnName);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static string GetWrapInBrackets(string simpleColumnName, bool isSerializing)
		{
			if (!isSerializing && simpleColumnName == string.Empty)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return '[' + simpleColumnName + ']';
		}

		internal void OnTableColumnsRenamed(WorksheetTable table, List<KeyValuePair<WorksheetTableColumn, string>> changedColumnNames)
		{
			if (_workbookReference.IsExternal || StringUtilities.StringCompare(table.Name, _tableReference.Name, table.Culture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < changedColumnNames.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyValuePair<WorksheetTableColumn, string> keyValuePair = changedColumnNames[i];
				if (_simpleColumnName != null && StringUtilities.StringCompare(keyValuePair.Value, _simpleColumnName, table.Culture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					_simpleColumnName = keyValuePair.Key.Name;
				}
				if (_innerReference != null)
				{
					_innerReference.OnTableColumnRenamed(table, keyValuePair.Value, keyValuePair.Key.Name);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class TblToken : SpecialFormulaToken
	{
		private CellAddress cellAddress;

		public override bool IsCellReference => true;

		public override Token Token => Token.Tbl;

		public CellAddress CellAddress
		{
			get
			{
				return cellAddress;
			}
			set
			{
				cellAddress = value;
			}
		}

		public TblToken()
			: base(TokenClass.Control)
		{
		}

		public TblToken(short firstColumn, int firstRow)
			: this(new CellAddress(firstRow, rowAddressIsRelative: false, firstColumn, columnAddressIsRelative: false))
		{
		}

		public TblToken(CellAddress cellAddress)
			: this()
		{
			this.cellAddress = cellAddress;
		}

		public override void Accept(FormulaTokenVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitTblToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TResult> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitTblToken(this);
		}

		public override TResult Accept<TArgument, TResult>(FormulaTokenVisitor<TArgument, TResult> visitor, TArgument argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitTblToken(this, argument);
		}

		public override bool IsEquivalentTo(FormulaContext sourceContext, FormulaToken comparisonToken, FormulaContext comparisonContext)
		{
			if (!base.IsEquivalentTo(sourceContext, comparisonToken, comparisonContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sourceContext.Worksheet != comparisonContext.Worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TblToken tblToken = (TblToken)comparisonToken;
			return cellAddress.Equals(tblToken.cellAddress);
		}

		public override string ToString(FormulaContext context, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo)
		{
			WorksheetCellAddress worksheetCellAddress = cellAddress.ToAbsoluteAddress(context, relativeAddressesAreOffsets: false);
			if (context.Worksheet != null && worksheetCellAddress.IsValid)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = context.Worksheet.Rows[worksheetCellAddress.RowIndex];
				WorksheetDataTable cellAssociatedDataTableInternal = worksheetRow.GetCellAssociatedDataTableInternal(worksheetCellAddress.ColumnIndex);
				return cellAssociatedDataTableInternal.GetDisplayFormula();
			}
			return "<Data Table Interior, Source: " + cellAddress.ToString(context.OwningCellAddress.RowIndex, context.OwningCellAddress.ColumnIndex, context.CellReferenceMode, context.Format) + ">";
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.FormulaUtilities

	internal class XLSXFormulaStringGenerator : FormulaStringGenerator
	{
		public const string AddInFunctionNamePrefix = "_xll.";

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static XLSXFormulaStringGenerator _instance;

		private GetFormulaStringInfo _getReferenceStringContext;

		protected override bool ShouldIncludeEqualsSign => false;

		private XLSXFormulaStringGenerator()
		{
		}

		protected override string CreateFunctionNameStackItem(IFunctionToken token, string functionName)
		{
			if (token is FunctionOperator functionOperator && functionOperator.Function.IsAddIn && !functionOperator.Function.IsExcel2007OnlyFunction)
			{
				functionName = "_xll." + functionName;
			}
			return functionName;
		}

		protected override string GetTokenString(FormulaToken token)
		{
			if (token is NameToken { NamedReference: { IsBuiltIn: not false, Scope: Worksheet scope } namedReference })
			{
				return Utilities.CreateReferenceString(null, scope.Name) + "_xlnm." + namedReference.Name;
			}
			return token.ToString(base.Context, _getReferenceStringContext);
		}

		public static XLSXFormulaStringGenerator Initialize(Formula formula, GetFormulaStringInfo getReferenceStringContext)
		{
			if (_instance == null)
			{
				_instance = new XLSXFormulaStringGenerator();
			}
			_instance._getReferenceStringContext = getReferenceStringContext;
			FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(formula, CellReferenceMode.A1, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			FormulaStringGenerator.InitializeHelper(_instance, context, ignoreWhitespace: false);
			return _instance;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			_getReferenceStringContext = null;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel

	public abstract class PaneSettingsBase
	{
		private DisplayOptions displayOptions;

		private int firstColumnInRightPane;

		private int firstRowInBottomPane;

		public int FirstColumnInRightPane
		{
			get
			{
				return firstColumnInRightPane;
			}
			set
			{
				if (firstColumnInRightPane != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyColumnIndex(displayOptions.Worksheet, value, "value");
					firstColumnInRightPane = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int FirstRowInBottomPane
		{
			get
			{
				return firstRowInBottomPane;
			}
			set
			{
				if (firstRowInBottomPane != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyRowIndex(displayOptions.Worksheet, value, "value");
					firstRowInBottomPane = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal abstract bool HasHorizontalSplit { get; }

		internal abstract bool HasVerticalSplit { get; }

		internal DisplayOptions DisplayOptions => displayOptions;

		internal PaneSettingsBase(DisplayOptions displayOptions)
		{
			this.displayOptions = displayOptions;
		}

		internal virtual void InitializeFrom(PaneSettingsBase paneSettings)
		{
			firstColumnInRightPane = paneSettings.firstColumnInRightPane;
			firstRowInBottomPane = paneSettings.firstRowInBottomPane;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetCore();
		}

		protected internal virtual void ResetCore()
		{
			firstColumnInRightPane = 0;
			firstRowInBottomPane = 0;
		}

		internal virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (firstColumnInRightPane == 0)
			{
				return firstRowInBottomPane != 0;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class FrozenPaneSettings : PaneSettingsBase
	{
		private int frozenColumns;

		private int frozenRows;

		internal override bool HasHorizontalSplit => frozenRows > 0;

		internal override bool HasVerticalSplit => frozenColumns > 0;

		public int FrozenColumns
		{
			get
			{
				return frozenColumns;
			}
			set
			{
				if (frozenColumns != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyColumnCount(base.DisplayOptions.Worksheet, value, "value");
					frozenColumns = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int FrozenRows
		{
			get
			{
				return frozenRows;
			}
			set
			{
				if (frozenRows != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyRowCount(base.DisplayOptions.Worksheet, value, "value");
					frozenRows = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool KeepSplitIfRemoveFreeze { get; set; }

		internal FrozenPaneSettings(DisplayOptions displayOptions)
			: base(displayOptions)
		{
		}

		internal override void InitializeFrom(PaneSettingsBase paneSettings)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(paneSettings);
			FrozenPaneSettings frozenPaneSettings = (FrozenPaneSettings)paneSettings;
			frozenColumns = frozenPaneSettings.frozenColumns;
			frozenRows = frozenPaneSettings.frozenRows;
			KeepSplitIfRemoveFreeze = frozenPaneSettings.KeepSplitIfRemoveFreeze;
		}

		protected internal override void ResetCore()
		{
			base.ResetCore();
			frozenColumns = 0;
			frozenRows = 0;
			KeepSplitIfRemoveFreeze = false;
		}

		internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && frozenRows == 0)
			{
				return frozenColumns != 0;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class GenericCachedCollection<T> : ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable where T : GenericCacheElement
	{
		internal GenericElementHashSet<T> cache;

		private Workbook workbook;

		private int maxCount;

		int ICollection<T>.Count => Count;

		bool ICollection<T>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => cache.Count;

		public int MaxCount
		{
			get
			{
				return maxCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Count > value)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CollectionLongerThanMaxValue"));
				}
				maxCount = value;
			}
		}

		public Workbook Workbook => workbook;

		public GenericCachedCollection(Workbook workbook, int maxCount)
			: this(workbook, maxCount, 0.2)
		{
		}

		public GenericCachedCollection(Workbook workbook, int maxCount, double maxLoadFactor)
		{
			cache = new GenericElementHashSet<T>(maxLoadFactor);
			this.workbook = workbook;
			this.maxCount = maxCount;
		}

		void ICollection<T>.Add(T item)
		{
			Add(item);
		}

		void ICollection<T>.Clear()
		{
		}

		bool ICollection<T>.Contains(T item)
		{
			T existingElement;
			return cache.Contains(item, out existingElement);
		}

		void ICollection<T>.CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			cache.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<T>.Remove(T item)
		{
			return Remove(item);
		}

		IEnumerator<T> IEnumerable<T>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return cache.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return cache.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(T element)
		{
			if (cache.AddIfItemDoesntExist(element, out var _))
			{
				OnAdded(element);
			}
		}

		public T Find(T element)
		{
			if (cache.Contains(element, out var existingElement))
			{
				return existingElement;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int FindIndex(T element)
		{
			int num = HashHelpers.InternalGetHashCode(element);
			int entryListCount;
			int cumulativeCount;
			GenericElementHashSet<T>.Entry[] entryList = cache.GetEntryList(num, out entryListCount, out cumulativeCount);
			if (entryList != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < entryListCount; i++)
				{
					GenericElementHashSet<T>.Entry entry = entryList[i];
					if (entry.hashCode == num)
					{
						T element2 = entry.element;
						if (element2 == null)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (object.Equals(element, element2))
						{
							return cumulativeCount + i;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void FindOrAdd(T element, out T equivalentElement)
		{
			if (cache.AddIfItemDoesntExist(element, out equivalentElement))
			{
				equivalentElement = element;
				OnAdded(element);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAdded(T element)
		{
			if (cache.Count > maxCount)
			{
				if (element is WorksheetCellFormatData)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_MaxCellFormats", maxCount));
				}
				if (element is StringElement)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_MaxFormattedStrings", maxCount));
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_MaxFonts", maxCount));
			}
		}

		public void OnSaving()
		{
			cache.OnSaving();
		}

		public void OnSaved()
		{
			cache.OnSaved();
		}

		public virtual bool Remove(T element)
		{
			return cache.Remove(element);
		}
	}
	internal interface IGenericCachedCollectionEx
	{
		Workbook Workbook { get; }
	}
	internal class GenericCachedCollectionEx<T> : GenericCachedCollection<T>, IGenericCachedCollectionEx where T : GenericCacheElementEx
	{
		private T defaultElement;

		public T DefaultElement
		{
			get
			{
				return defaultElement;
			}
			set
			{
				if (defaultElement != null)
				{
					GenericCacheElementEx.ReleaseEx(defaultElement);
				}
				if (defaultElement != null && defaultElement.ReferenceCount > 0)
				{
					cache.Remove(defaultElement);
					defaultElement.CopyValues(value);
					defaultElement.IncrementReferenceCount();
					if (!cache.AddIfItemDoesntExist(defaultElement, out var existingElement))
					{
						defaultElement = existingElement;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					defaultElement = GenericCacheElementEx.FindExistingOrAddToCacheEx(value, this);
				}
			}
		}

		public GenericCachedCollectionEx(T defaultElement, Workbook workbook, int maxCount)
			: base(workbook, maxCount)
		{
			if (defaultElement != null)
			{
				DefaultElement = defaultElement;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAdded(T element)
		{
			element.OnAddedToRootCollection(this);
			base.OnAdded(element);
		}

		public override bool Remove(T element)
		{
			if (!base.Remove(element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			element.OnRemovedFromRootCollection();
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class GenericElementHashSet<T> where T : GenericCacheElement
	{
		internal struct Entry
		{
			internal readonly int hashCode;

			internal readonly T element;

			public Entry(T element, int hashCode)
			{
				this.element = element;
				this.hashCode = hashCode;
			}
		}

		private int count;

		private int[] cumulativeCountsForSaving;

		private Entry[][] entryLists;

		private int[] entryListsCounts;

		private bool isFrozen;

		private double maxLoadFactor;

		private int version;

		public int Count => count;

		public GenericElementHashSet(double maxLoadFactor)
		{
			this.maxLoadFactor = maxLoadFactor;
			int min = (int)(5.0 / this.maxLoadFactor);
			int prime = HashHelpers.GetPrime(min);
			entryLists = new Entry[prime][];
			entryListsCounts = new int[prime];
		}

		public bool AddIfItemDoesntExist(T element, out T existingElement)
		{
			existingElement = null;
			if (isFrozen)
			{
				existingElement = element;
				return false;
			}
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = HashHelpers.InternalGetHashCode(element);
			int num2 = num % entryLists.Length;
			Entry[] currentEntryList = entryLists[num2];
			int num3 = entryListsCounts[num2];
			if (currentEntryList != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
				{
					Entry entry = currentEntryList[i];
					if (entry.hashCode == num)
					{
						T element2 = entry.element;
						if (element2.Equals(element))
						{
							existingElement = entry.element;
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				currentEntryList = new Entry[GetDefaultEntryListSize(entryLists.Length)];
				entryLists[num2] = currentEntryList;
			}
			EnsureEntryListCapacity(entryLists, ref currentEntryList, num3, num2);
			ref Entry reference = ref currentEntryList[num3++];
			reference = new Entry(element, num);
			entryListsCounts[num2] = num3;
			count++;
			version++;
			if ((double)num3 > (double)entryLists.Length * maxLoadFactor)
			{
				IncreaseCapacity();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Contains(T element, out T existingElement)
		{
			existingElement = null;
			if (entryLists == null || element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = HashHelpers.InternalGetHashCode(element);
			int num2 = num % entryLists.Length;
			Entry[] array = entryLists[num2];
			if (array != null)
			{
				int num3 = entryListsCounts[num2];
				for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
				{
					Entry entry = array[i];
					if (entry.hashCode == num)
					{
						T element2 = entry.element;
						if (element2.Equals(element))
						{
							existingElement = entry.element;
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			if (array == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("array");
			}
			if (arrayIndex < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("arrayIndex", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			if (arrayIndex > array.Length || count > array.Length - arrayIndex)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_ArrayTooSmall"), "array");
			}
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < entryLists.Length; i++)
			{
				Entry[] array2 = entryLists[i];
				if (array2 != null)
				{
					int num2 = entryListsCounts[i];
					for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
					{
						array[arrayIndex + num] = array2[j].element;
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public Entry[] GetEntryList(int hashCode, out int entryListCount)
		{
			int cumulativeCount;
			return GetEntryList(hashCode, out entryListCount, out cumulativeCount);
		}

		public Entry[] GetEntryList(int hashCode, out int entryListCount, out int cumulativeCount)
		{
			int num = hashCode % entryLists.Length;
			if (cumulativeCountsForSaving == null)
			{
				cumulativeCount = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				cumulativeCount = cumulativeCountsForSaving[num];
			}
			entryListCount = entryListsCounts[num];
			return entryLists[num];
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (entryLists == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			int originalVersion = version;
			for (int i = 0; i < entryLists.Length; i++)
			{
				Entry[] entryList = entryLists[i];
				if (entryList == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int entryListCount = entryListsCounts[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < entryListCount; j++)
				{
					yield return entryList[j].element;
					if (originalVersion != version)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CollectionModifiedWhileEnumerating"));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnSaving()
		{
			cumulativeCountsForSaving = new int[entryListsCounts.Length];
			isFrozen = true;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < entryListsCounts.Length; i++)
			{
				cumulativeCountsForSaving[i] = num;
				num += entryListsCounts[i];
			}
		}

		public void OnSaved()
		{
			cumulativeCountsForSaving = null;
			isFrozen = false;
		}

		public bool Remove(T element)
		{
			if (isFrozen)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (entryLists == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = HashHelpers.InternalGetHashCode(element);
			int num2 = num % entryLists.Length;
			Entry[] array = entryLists[num2];
			if (array != null)
			{
				Entry entry = default(Entry);
				int num3 = entryListsCounts[num2];
				for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
				{
					Entry entry2 = array[i];
					if (entry2.hashCode != num)
					{
						continue;
					}
					T element2 = entry2.element;
					if (element2.Equals(element))
					{
						num3--;
						entryListsCounts[num2] = num3;
						if (i < num3)
						{
							Array.Copy(array, i + 1, array, i, num3 - i);
						}
						array[num3] = entry;
						count--;
						version++;
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void EnsureEntryListCapacity(Entry[][] entryLists, ref Entry[] currentEntryList, int currentEntryListCount, int currentEntryListIndex)
		{
			if (currentEntryListCount >= currentEntryList.Length)
			{
				Entry[] array = new Entry[currentEntryList.Length * 2];
				Array.Copy(currentEntryList, array, currentEntryListCount);
				entryLists[currentEntryListIndex] = array;
				currentEntryList = array;
			}
		}

		private int GetDefaultEntryListSize(int entryListsSize)
		{
			return (int)Math.Ceiling((double)entryListsSize * maxLoadFactor / 2.0) + 1;
		}

		private void IncreaseCapacity()
		{
			int num = entryLists.Length * 2;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = entryLists.Length + 1;
			}
			int prime = HashHelpers.GetPrime(num);
			if (prime <= entryLists.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_HashSetFull"));
			}
			Entry[][] array = new Entry[prime][];
			int[] array2 = new int[prime];
			for (int i = 0; i < entryLists.Length; i++)
			{
				Entry[] array3 = entryLists[i];
				if (array3 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num2 = entryListsCounts[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					Entry entry = array3[j];
					int num3 = entry.hashCode % prime;
					Entry[] currentEntryList = array[num3];
					if (currentEntryList == null)
					{
						currentEntryList = (array[num3] = new Entry[GetDefaultEntryListSize(array.Length)]);
					}
					int num4 = array2[num3];
					EnsureEntryListCapacity(array, ref currentEntryList, num4, num3);
					currentEntryList[num4++] = entry;
					array2[num3] = num4;
				}
				entryLists[i] = null;
			}
			entryLists = array;
			entryListsCounts = array2;
		}
	}
	internal static class HashHelpers
	{
		private static readonly int[] primes = new int[72]
		{
			3, 7, 11, 17, 23, 29, 37, 47, 59, 71,
			89, 107, 131, 163, 197, 239, 293, 353, 431, 521,
			631, 761, 919, 1103, 1327, 1597, 1931, 2333, 2801, 3371,
			4049, 4861, 5839, 7013, 8419, 10103, 12143, 14591, 17519, 21023,
			25229, 30293, 36353, 43627, 52361, 62851, 75431, 90523, 108631, 130363,
			156437, 187751, 225307, 270371, 324449, 389357, 467237, 560689, 672827, 807403,
			968897, 1162687, 1395263, 1674319, 2009191, 2411033, 2893249, 3471899, 4166287, 4999559,
			5999471, 7199369
		};

		public static int GetPrime(int min)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < primes.Length; i++)
			{
				int num = primes[i];
				if (num >= min)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			for (int j = min | 1; j < int.MaxValue; j += 2)
			{
				if (IsPrime(j))
				{
					return j;
				}
			}
			return min;
		}

		public static int InternalGetHashCode(object element)
		{
			return element.GetHashCode() & 0x7FFFFFFF;
		}

		private static bool IsPrime(int candidate)
		{
			if ((candidate & 1) == 0)
			{
				return candidate == 2;
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Sqrt(candidate);
			for (int i = 3; i <= num; i += 2)
			{
				if (candidate % i == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Count = {Count}")]
	public sealed class HiddenColumnCollection : ICollection<WorksheetColumn>, IEnumerable<WorksheetColumn>, IEnumerable
	{
		private Worksheet worksheet;

		private CustomView customView;

		private List<int> columnIndices;

		int ICollection<WorksheetColumn>.Count => Count;

		bool ICollection<WorksheetColumn>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => columnIndices.Count;

		public WorksheetColumn this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
				{
					throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
				}
				return worksheet.Columns[columnIndices[index]];
			}
		}

		public Worksheet Worksheet => worksheet;

		internal HiddenColumnCollection(Worksheet worksheet, CustomView customView)
		{
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
			this.customView = customView;
			columnIndices = new List<int>();
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetColumn>.Add(WorksheetColumn item)
		{
			Add(item);
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetColumn>.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool ICollection<WorksheetColumn>.Contains(WorksheetColumn item)
		{
			return Contains(item);
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetColumn>.CopyTo(WorksheetColumn[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < columnIndices.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i + arrayIndex] = worksheet.Columns[columnIndices[i]];
			}
		}

		bool ICollection<WorksheetColumn>.Remove(WorksheetColumn item)
		{
			return Remove(item);
		}

		IEnumerator<WorksheetColumn> IEnumerable<WorksheetColumn>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (int columnIndex in columnIndices)
			{
				yield return worksheet.Columns[columnIndex];
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<WorksheetColumn>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(WorksheetColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("column", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_HiddenColumn"));
			}
			if (column.Worksheet != worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_ColumnFromDifferentWorksheet"), "column");
			}
			AddIndex(column.Index);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = columnIndices.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return columnIndices.BinarySearch(column.Index) >= 0;
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = columnIndices.BinarySearch(column.Index);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			columnIndices.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		internal NamedReference CreateNamedReference()
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("=");
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < columnIndices.Count; i++)
			{
				int num2 = columnIndices[i];
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
				if (i == columnIndices.Count - 1 || num2 + 1 != columnIndices[i + 1])
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}C{1}:C{2},", Utilities.CreateReferenceString(null, worksheet.Name), num + 1, num2 + 1);
					num = -1;
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Remove(stringBuilder.Length - 1, 1);
			if (!Formula.TryParse(stringBuilder.ToString(), CellReferenceMode.R1C1, FormulaType.NamedReferenceFormula, Worksheet.CurrentFormat, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, null, out var formula, out var _))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string name = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Z_{0}_.wvu.Cols", new object[1] { customView.Id.ToString("D").Replace("-", "_").ToUpper(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
			NamedReference namedReference = new NamedReference(worksheet.Workbook.NamedReferences, worksheet, hidden: true);
			namedReference.FormulaInternal = formula;
			namedReference.Name = name;
			return namedReference;
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			foreach (WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock in worksheet.ColumnBlocks)
			{
				if (columnBlock.Hidden)
				{
					for (int i = columnBlock.FirstColumnIndex; i <= columnBlock.LastColumnIndex; i++)
					{
						Add(worksheet.Columns[i]);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddIndex(int columnIndex)
		{
			int num = columnIndices.BinarySearch(columnIndex);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				columnIndices.Insert(~num, columnIndex);
			}
		}
	}

				return null;
			}
			string name = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Z_{0}_.wvu.Rows", new object[1] { customView.Id.ToString("D").Replace("-", "_").ToUpper(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
			NamedReference namedReference = new NamedReference(worksheet.Workbook.NamedReferences, worksheet, hidden: true);
			namedReference.FormulaInternal = formula;
			namedReference.Name = name;
			return namedReference;
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (worksheet.DefaultRowHidden)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < worksheet.Workbook.MaxRowCount - 1; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRow ifCreated = worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(i);
					if (ifCreated == null || ifCreated.Hidden)
					{
						AddIndex(i);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)worksheet.Rows)
			{
				if (item.Hidden)
				{
					Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddIndex(int rowIndex)
		{
			int num = rowIndices.BinarySearch(rowIndex);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				rowIndices.Insert(~num, rowIndex);
			}
		}
	}

	internal interface IBinaryTreeNodeOwner<T>
	{

	internal class LoadOnDemandTree<T> : ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, IBinaryTreeNodeOwner<T>
	{
		protected class ChangeAdjustmentPoint
		{
			protected readonly LoadOnDemandTree<T> _tree;

			private int _adjustedStartIndex;

			private int _adjustedCount;

			private int _histortyItemOffset;

			internal readonly ChangeHistoryItem HistoryItem;

			internal int AdjustedStartIndex => _adjustedStartIndex;

			internal int AdjustedEndIndex => _adjustedStartIndex + _adjustedCount - 1;

			internal int AdjustedCount
			{
				get
				{
					return _adjustedCount;
				}
				private set
				{
					if (_adjustedCount != value)
					{
						_adjustedCount = value;
						OnAdjustedCountChanged();
					}
				}
			}

			internal int OriginalCount => HistoryItem.Count;

			internal int HistortyItemOffset => _histortyItemOffset;

			internal bool HasInsertedItems
			{
				get
				{
					if (!IsAdd)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return ((ChangeHistoryItemAdd)HistoryItem).HasInsertedItems;
				}
			}

			internal bool IsAdd => HistoryItem.IsAdd;

			public T this[int index]
			{
				get
				{
					if (!IsAdd)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException("Indexer is only supported on a add operation");
					}
					return ((ChangeHistoryItemAdd)HistoryItem).InsertedItems[index + HistortyItemOffset];
				}
				set
				{
					if (!IsAdd)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException("Indexer is only supported on a add operation");
					}
					ChangeHistoryItemAdd changeHistoryItemAdd = HistoryItem as ChangeHistoryItemAdd;
					changeHistoryItemAdd.InsertedItems[index + HistortyItemOffset] = value;
				}
			}

			internal ChangeAdjustmentPoint(LoadOnDemandTree<T> tree, ChangeHistoryItem historyItem, int offset, int count)
			{
				_tree = tree;
				HistoryItem = historyItem;
				_histortyItemOffset = offset;
				_adjustedStartIndex = historyItem.Index + offset;
				_adjustedCount = count;
			}

			internal void MergeNewChange(ChangeAdjustmentPoint newChange, List<ChangeAdjustmentPoint> returnedChanges, ref bool wasAlreadyReturned)
			{
				returnedChanges.Clear();
				if (Overlaps(newChange))
				{
					if (newChange.HistoryItem.IsAdd)
					{
						MergeOverlappingAddOnAddOrRemoval(newChange, returnedChanges, ref wasAlreadyReturned);
						return;
					}
					if (HistoryItem.IsAdd)
					{
						MergeOverlappingRemovalOnAdd(newChange, returnedChanges, ref wasAlreadyReturned);
						return;
					}
					if (wasAlreadyReturned)
					{
						_adjustedStartIndex -= newChange.AdjustedCount;
					}
					else
					{
						int adjustedStartIndex = Math.Min(_adjustedStartIndex, newChange.AdjustedStartIndex);
						_adjustedStartIndex = adjustedStartIndex;
						AdjustedCount += newChange._adjustedCount;
						wasAlreadyReturned = true;
					}
					returnedChanges.Add(this);
				}
				else if (newChange.AdjustedStartIndex < _adjustedStartIndex)
				{
					if (!wasAlreadyReturned)
					{
						wasAlreadyReturned = true;
						returnedChanges.Add(newChange);
					}
					returnedChanges.Add(this);
					if (newChange.HistoryItem.IsAdd)
					{
						_adjustedStartIndex += newChange.OriginalCount;
					}
					else
					{
						_adjustedStartIndex -= newChange.OriginalCount;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					returnedChanges.Add(this);
					if (!wasAlreadyReturned)
					{
						wasAlreadyReturned = true;
						returnedChanges.Add(newChange);
					}
				}
			}

			private void MergeOverlappingAddOnAddOrRemoval(ChangeAdjustmentPoint addChange, List<ChangeAdjustmentPoint> returnedChanges, ref bool wasAlreadyReturned)
			{
				if (addChange.AdjustedStartIndex <= AdjustedStartIndex)
				{
					if (!wasAlreadyReturned)
					{
						wasAlreadyReturned = true;
						if (!IsAdd && addChange._adjustedStartIndex == _adjustedStartIndex && addChange._adjustedCount == _adjustedCount)
						{
							return;
						}
						returnedChanges.Add(addChange);
					}
					_adjustedStartIndex += addChange.AdjustedCount;
					returnedChanges.Add(this);
				}
				else if (wasAlreadyReturned)
				{
					_adjustedStartIndex += addChange.AdjustedCount;
					returnedChanges.Add(this);
				}
				else
				{
					int offset = addChange.AdjustedStartIndex - AdjustedStartIndex;
					returnedChanges.AddRange(Split(offset, 0, addChange));
					wasAlreadyReturned = true;
				}
			}

			private void MergeOverlappingRemovalOnAdd(ChangeAdjustmentPoint removeChange, List<ChangeAdjustmentPoint> returnedChanges, ref bool wasAlreadyReturned)
			{
				int num = removeChange.AdjustedStartIndex - AdjustedStartIndex;
				if (num == 0)
				{
					wasAlreadyReturned = true;
					if (_adjustedCount != removeChange._adjustedCount)
					{
						if (_adjustedCount < removeChange._adjustedCount)
						{
							removeChange.AdjustedCount -= _adjustedCount;
							returnedChanges.Add(removeChange);
						}
						else
						{
							AdjustedCount -= removeChange._adjustedCount;
							_histortyItemOffset += removeChange._adjustedCount;
							returnedChanges.Add(this);
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					wasAlreadyReturned = true;
					if (removeChange.AdjustedEndIndex <= AdjustedEndIndex)
					{
						returnedChanges.AddRange(Split(num, removeChange.AdjustedCount, null));
						return;
					}
					int adjustedCount = _adjustedCount;
					AdjustedCount = num;
					removeChange.AdjustedCount -= adjustedCount - _adjustedCount;
					returnedChanges.Add(this);
					returnedChanges.Add(removeChange);
					return;
				}
				if (AdjustedEndIndex <= removeChange.AdjustedEndIndex)
				{
					removeChange.AdjustedCount -= _adjustedCount;
					if (!wasAlreadyReturned)
					{
						returnedChanges.Add(removeChange);
						wasAlreadyReturned = true;
					}
					return;
				}
				num *= -1;
				int adjustedCount2 = _adjustedCount;
				_adjustedStartIndex -= num;
				AdjustedCount -= removeChange._adjustedCount - num;
				_histortyItemOffset += adjustedCount2 - _adjustedCount;
				removeChange.AdjustedCount = num;
				if (!wasAlreadyReturned)
				{
					returnedChanges.Add(removeChange);
					wasAlreadyReturned = true;
				}
				returnedChanges.Add(this);
			}

			protected virtual void OnAdjustedCountChanged()
			{
			}

			internal bool Overlaps(ChangeAdjustmentPoint other)
			{
				return Overlaps(other.AdjustedStartIndex, other.AdjustedEndIndex);
			}

			internal bool Overlaps(int startIndex, int endIndex)
			{
				int num = Math.Max(startIndex, _adjustedStartIndex);
				int num2 = Math.Min(endIndex, AdjustedEndIndex);
				return num <= num2;
			}

			private List<ChangeAdjustmentPoint> Split(int offset, int removeCount, ChangeAdjustmentPoint insertBetween)
			{
				List<ChangeAdjustmentPoint> list = new List<ChangeAdjustmentPoint>(3);
				ChangeAdjustmentPoint changeAdjustmentPoint = _tree.CreateAdjustmentPoint(HistoryItem, HistortyItemOffset, offset);
				ChangeAdjustmentPoint changeAdjustmentPoint2 = _tree.CreateAdjustmentPoint(HistoryItem, HistortyItemOffset + offset + removeCount, AdjustedCount - (offset + removeCount));
				if (changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedCount > 0)
				{
					list.Add(changeAdjustmentPoint);
				}
				if (insertBetween != null)
				{
					insertBetween._adjustedStartIndex = changeAdjustmentPoint._adjustedStartIndex + offset;
					list.Add(insertBetween);
					changeAdjustmentPoint2._adjustedStartIndex = insertBetween.AdjustedEndIndex + 1;
				}
				if (changeAdjustmentPoint2.AdjustedCount > 0)
				{
					changeAdjustmentPoint2._adjustedStartIndex -= removeCount;
					list.Add(changeAdjustmentPoint2);
				}
				return list;
			}

			internal void Truncate(int newCount)
			{
				HistoryItem.Truncate(newCount + HistortyItemOffset);
				AdjustedCount = newCount;
			}
		}

		protected abstract class ChangeHistoryItem
		{
			internal readonly int Index;

			protected int _count;

			internal int Count => _count;

			internal abstract bool IsAdd { get; }

			internal ChangeHistoryItem(int index, int count)
			{
				Index = index;
				_count = count;
			}

			internal virtual int GetItemExtent(int index, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAsVisible)
			{
				return 0;
			}

			internal virtual int GetTotalExtent(int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				return 0;
			}

			internal abstract void Truncate(int newCount);
		}

		protected class ChangeHistoryItemAdd : ChangeHistoryItem
		{
			private T[] _insertedItems;

			internal bool HasInsertedItems => _insertedItems != null;

			internal override bool IsAdd => true;

			internal T[] InsertedItems
			{
				get
				{
					if (_insertedItems == null)
					{
						_insertedItems = new T[base.Count];
					}
					return _insertedItems;
				}
			}

			internal ChangeHistoryItemAdd(int index, int count)
				: base(index, count)
			{
			}

			internal override void Truncate(int newCount)
			{
				_count = newCount;
				if (_insertedItems != null)
				{
					T[] insertedItems = _insertedItems;
					_insertedItems = new T[_count];
					Array.Copy(insertedItems, 0, _insertedItems, 0, _count);
				}
			}
		}

		protected class ChangeHistoryItemRemove : ChangeHistoryItem
		{
			internal override bool IsAdd => false;

			internal ChangeHistoryItemRemove(int index, int count)
				: base(index, count)
			{
			}

			internal override void Truncate(int newCount)
			{
				_count = newCount;
			}
		}

		internal class BinaryTreeNode : IBinaryTreeNodeOwner<T>
		{
			private int height;

			private int firstItemIndex;

			private IBinaryTreeNodeOwner<T> parent;

			private BinaryTreeNode leftChild;

			private BinaryTreeNode rightChild;

			protected T[] values;

			public int FirstItemIndex => firstItemIndex;

			public BinaryTreeNode LeftChild
			{
				get
				{
					return leftChild;
				}
				set
				{
					if (leftChild != value)
					{
						leftChild = value;
						if (leftChild != null)
						{
							leftChild.parent = this;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			public IBinaryTreeNodeOwner<T> Parent => parent;

			public BinaryTreeNode RightChild
			{
				get
				{
					return rightChild;
				}
				set
				{
					if (rightChild != value)
					{
						rightChild = value;
						if (rightChild != null)
						{
							rightChild.parent = this;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			public T[] Values => values;

			public BinaryTreeNode(int index, IBinaryTreeNodeOwner<T> parent, LoadOnDemandTree<T> tree)
			{
				firstItemIndex = index;
				values = new T[32];
				this.parent = parent;
			}

			public bool VerifyBalanceOfChild(BinaryTreeNode node)
			{
				if (node == leftChild)
				{
					return EnsureBalance(ref leftChild);
				}
				if (node == rightChild)
				{
					return EnsureBalance(ref rightChild);
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal static bool EnsureBalance(ref BinaryTreeNode parentNode)
			{
				BinaryTreeNode binaryTreeNode = parentNode.leftChild;
				BinaryTreeNode binaryTreeNode2 = parentNode.rightChild;
				int nodeHeight = GetNodeHeight(binaryTreeNode);
				int nodeHeight2 = GetNodeHeight(binaryTreeNode2);
				if (nodeHeight < nodeHeight2 - 1)
				{
					BinaryTreeNode binaryTreeNode3 = binaryTreeNode2.leftChild;
					BinaryTreeNode node = binaryTreeNode2.rightChild;
					int nodeHeight3 = GetNodeHeight(binaryTreeNode3);
					int nodeHeight4 = GetNodeHeight(node);
					if (nodeHeight3 < nodeHeight4)
					{
						BinaryTreeNode binaryTreeNode4 = binaryTreeNode2.leftChild;
						binaryTreeNode2.parent = parentNode.parent;
						parentNode.RightChild = binaryTreeNode4;
						binaryTreeNode2.LeftChild = parentNode;
						parentNode.RecalculateHeight();
						parentNode = binaryTreeNode2;
					}
					else
					{
						BinaryTreeNode binaryTreeNode5 = binaryTreeNode3.leftChild;
						BinaryTreeNode binaryTreeNode6 = binaryTreeNode3.rightChild;
						binaryTreeNode3.parent = parentNode.parent;
						binaryTreeNode3.LeftChild = parentNode;
						binaryTreeNode3.RightChild = binaryTreeNode2;
						parentNode.RightChild = binaryTreeNode5;
						binaryTreeNode2.LeftChild = binaryTreeNode6;
						parentNode.RecalculateHeight();
						binaryTreeNode2.RecalculateHeight();
						binaryTreeNode3.RecalculateHeight();
						parentNode = binaryTreeNode3;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (nodeHeight2 < nodeHeight - 1)
				{
					BinaryTreeNode node2 = binaryTreeNode.leftChild;
					BinaryTreeNode binaryTreeNode7 = binaryTreeNode.rightChild;
					int nodeHeight5 = GetNodeHeight(node2);
					int nodeHeight6 = GetNodeHeight(binaryTreeNode7);
					if (nodeHeight6 < nodeHeight5)
					{

						binaryTreeNode.parent = parentNode.parent;
						parentNode.LeftChild = binaryTreeNode8;
						binaryTreeNode.RightChild = parentNode;

						binaryTreeNode.RecalculateHeight();
						binaryTreeNode7.RecalculateHeight();

					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public BinaryTreeNode FindOrAdd(int externalIndex, int internalTreeIndex, bool createNodeIfNotFound, bool createItemIfNotFound, LoadOnDemandTree<T> tree, out FindState state)
			{
				if (createItemIfNotFound)
				{
					createNodeIfNotFound = true;
				}
				int num = internalTreeIndex % 32;
				int num2 = internalTreeIndex - num;
				state = FindState.ValueNotFound;
				BinaryTreeNode binaryTreeNode = this;
				BinaryTreeNode binaryTreeNode2 = null;
				while (true)
				{
					if (num2 == binaryTreeNode.firstItemIndex)
					{
						if (binaryTreeNode.Values[num] == null)
						{
							if (createItemIfNotFound)
							{
								binaryTreeNode.Values[num] = tree.owner.CreateValue(externalIndex);
								state = FindState.ValueInserted;
							}
							else
							{
								state = FindState.ValueNotFound;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							state = FindState.ValueFound;
						}
						return binaryTreeNode;
					}
					BinaryTreeNode binaryTreeNode3 = binaryTreeNode;
					if (num2 < binaryTreeNode.firstItemIndex)
					{
						binaryTreeNode = binaryTreeNode.leftChild;
						if (binaryTreeNode != null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (createNodeIfNotFound)
						{
							binaryTreeNode2 = tree.CreateNode(num2, this);
							if (createItemIfNotFound)
							{
								binaryTreeNode2.Values[num] = tree.owner.CreateValue(externalIndex);
								state = FindState.ValueInserted;
							}
							else
							{
								state = FindState.ValueNotFound;
							}
							binaryTreeNode = (binaryTreeNode3.LeftChild = binaryTreeNode2);
						}
						break;
					}
					binaryTreeNode = binaryTreeNode.rightChild;
					if (binaryTreeNode != null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (createNodeIfNotFound)
					{
						binaryTreeNode2 = tree.CreateNode(num2, this);
						if (createItemIfNotFound)
						{
							binaryTreeNode2.Values[num] = tree.owner.CreateValue(externalIndex);
							state = FindState.ValueInserted;
						}
						else
						{
							state = FindState.ValueNotFound;
						}
						binaryTreeNode = (binaryTreeNode3.RightChild = binaryTreeNode2);
					}
					break;
				}
				if (state == FindState.ValueInserted)
				{
					IBinaryTreeNodeOwner<T> binaryTreeNodeOwner = binaryTreeNode.parent;
					while (binaryTreeNode != null)
					{
						binaryTreeNodeOwner = binaryTreeNode.parent;
						if (binaryTreeNodeOwner.VerifyBalanceOfChild(binaryTreeNode) || !binaryTreeNodeOwner.RecalculateHeight())
						{
							break;
						}
						binaryTreeNode = binaryTreeNodeOwner as BinaryTreeNode;
					}
				}
				return binaryTreeNode2;
			}

			private static int GetNodeHeight(BinaryTreeNode node)
			{
				return node?.height ?? (-1);
			}

			public bool RecalculateHeight()
			{
				int nodeHeight = GetNodeHeight(leftChild);
				int nodeHeight2 = GetNodeHeight(rightChild);
				int num = height;
				if (nodeHeight < nodeHeight2)
				{
					height = nodeHeight2 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					height = nodeHeight + 1;
				}
				return height != num;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<T> GetEnumeratorHelper(int startIndex, int endIndex, bool enumerateForwards)
		{
			endIndex = Math.Min(endIndex, _maxItems - 1);
			IEnumerator<T> addedItemEnumerator = null;
			T addedItem = default(T);
			int addedItemIndex = -1;
			int treeStartIndex = startIndex;
			int treeEndindex = endIndex;
			if (_changeAdjustments != null && _changeAdjustments.Count > 0)
			{
				treeStartIndex = ConvertItemIndexToTreeIndex(startIndex);
				treeEndindex = ConvertItemIndexToTreeIndex(endIndex);
				IEnumerable<T> addedItemEnumerator2 = GetAddedItemEnumerator(startIndex, endIndex, enumerateForwards);
				addedItemEnumerator = addedItemEnumerator2.GetEnumerator();
				if (addedItemEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					addedItem = addedItemEnumerator.Current;
					addedItemIndex = owner.GetItemIndex(addedItem);
				}
			}
			Func<int, int, bool> addedItemIndexComparer = (enumerateForwards ? ((Func<int, int, bool>)((int add, int num) => add < num)) : ((Func<int, int, bool>)((int add, int num) => add > num)));
			foreach (BinaryTreeNode currentNode in GetNodesEnumerator(treeStartIndex, treeEndindex, enumerateForwards))
			{
				T[] values = currentNode.Values;
				int nodeStartIndex = 0;
				if (currentNode.FirstItemIndex < treeStartIndex)
				{
					nodeStartIndex = treeStartIndex - currentNode.FirstItemIndex;
				}
				int nodeEndIndex = Math.Min(treeEndindex - currentNode.FirstItemIndex, 31);
				int start;
				int stopAt;
				int step;
				if (enumerateForwards)
				{
					start = nodeStartIndex;
					stopAt = nodeEndIndex + 1;
					step = 1;
				}
				else
				{
					start = nodeEndIndex;
					stopAt = nodeStartIndex - 1;
					step = -1;
				}
				for (int i = start; i != stopAt; i += step)
				{
					T value = values[i];
					if (value == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					int? itemIndex = null;
					if (_changeHistory != null)
					{
						itemIndex = owner.GetItemIndex(value);
						if (itemIndex.Value < 0)
						{
							values[i] = default(T);
							continue;
						}
						while (addedItem != null && addedItemIndexComparer(addedItemIndex, itemIndex.Value) && addedItemIndex >= startIndex && addedItemIndex <= endIndex)
						{
							yield return addedItem;
							if (!addedItemEnumerator.MoveNext())
							{
								addedItem = default(T);
								break;
							}
							addedItem = addedItemEnumerator.Current;
							addedItemIndex = owner.GetItemIndex(addedItem);
						}
					}
					bool isinRange = !(itemIndex < startIndex) && !(itemIndex > endIndex);
					if (!itemIndex.HasValue)
					{
						if (isinRange)
						{
							yield return value;
						}
					}
					else if (isinRange)
					{
						yield return value;
					}
					else if (itemIndex < 0 || itemIndex >= _maxItems)
					{
						values[i] = default(T);
						owner.InitializeItemIndex(value, -1, _applyingChangesToTree);
					}
				}
			}
			while (addedItem != null)
			{
				addedItemIndex = owner.GetItemIndex(addedItem);
				if (addedItemIndex >= 0)
				{
					if (addedItemIndex < startIndex || addedItemIndex > endIndex)
					{
						break;
					}
					yield return addedItem;
				}
				if (addedItemEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					addedItem = addedItemEnumerator.Current;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal int AdjustIndex(int index, byte version)
		{
			if (version == _lastRolloverVersion)
			{
				version = 0;
			}
			if (version == _changeVersion || index < 0)
			{
				return index;
			}
			int num = ((_lastApplyChangesToTreeVersion <= version) ? (version - _lastApplyChangesToTreeVersion) : version);
			List<ChangeHistoryItem> changeHistory = ChangeHistory;
			int num2 = changeHistory.Count;
			int num3 = index;
			for (int i = num; i < num2; i++)
			{
				ChangeHistoryItem changeHistoryItem = changeHistory[i];
				if (changeHistoryItem.IsAdd)
				{
					if (changeHistoryItem.Index <= num3)
					{
						num3 += changeHistoryItem.Count;
					}
					continue;
				}
				int num4 = changeHistoryItem.Index + changeHistoryItem.Count - 1;
				if (num4 < num3)
				{
					num3 -= changeHistoryItem.Count;
				}
				else if (changeHistoryItem.Index <= num3 && num4 >= num3)
				{
					return -1;
				}
			}
			return num3;
		}

		internal int ConvertItemIndexToTreeIndex(int itemIndex)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = ((_changeAdjustments != null) ? _changeAdjustments.Count : 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				ChangeAdjustmentPoint changeAdjustmentPoint = _changeAdjustments[i];
				if (changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex > itemIndex)
				{
					break;
				}
				num = ((!changeAdjustmentPoint.IsAdd) ? (num + changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedCount) : ((changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedEndIndex < itemIndex) ? (num - changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedCount) : (num + (changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex - itemIndex))));
			}
			return itemIndex + num;
		}

		internal int ConvertTreeIndexToItemIndex(int treeIndex)
		{
			int num = treeIndex;
			int num2 = ((_changeAdjustments != null) ? _changeAdjustments.Count : 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				ChangeAdjustmentPoint changeAdjustmentPoint = _changeAdjustments[i];
				if (changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex > num)
				{
					break;
				}
				num = ((!changeAdjustmentPoint.IsAdd) ? (num - changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedCount) : (num + changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedCount));
			}
			return num;
		}
