		private IEnumerable<T> GetAddedItemEnumerator(int startIndex, int endIndex, bool enumerateForwards)
		{
			if (_changeAdjustments == null || _changeAdjustments.Count <= 0)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			int adjustmentIndex;
			int stopAtAdjustmentIndex;
			int step;
			if (enumerateForwards)
			{
				adjustmentIndex = 0;
				stopAtAdjustmentIndex = _changeAdjustments.Count;
				step = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				adjustmentIndex = _changeAdjustments.Count - 1;
				stopAtAdjustmentIndex = -1;
				step = -1;
			}
			for (ChangeAdjustmentPoint currentAdjustment = _changeAdjustments[adjustmentIndex]; currentAdjustment != null; currentAdjustment = ((adjustmentIndex != stopAtAdjustmentIndex) ? _changeAdjustments[adjustmentIndex] : null))
			{
				if (currentAdjustment.HasInsertedItems && currentAdjustment.Overlaps(startIndex, endIndex))
				{
					int startItemIndex;
					int stopAtItemIndex;
					if (enumerateForwards)
					{
						startItemIndex = Math.Max(0, startIndex);
						stopAtItemIndex = Math.Min(currentAdjustment.AdjustedEndIndex, endIndex) + 1;
					}
					else
					{
						startItemIndex = Math.Min(currentAdjustment.AdjustedEndIndex, endIndex);
						stopAtItemIndex = Math.Max(0, startIndex) - 1;
					}
					for (int i = startItemIndex; i != stopAtItemIndex; i += step)
					{
						if (currentAdjustment.Overlaps(i, i))
						{
							T item = currentAdjustment[i - currentAdjustment.AdjustedStartIndex];
							if (item != null && owner.GetItemIndex(item) >= 0)
							{
								yield return item;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				adjustmentIndex += step;
			}
		}

		protected IEnumerable<BinaryTreeNode> GetNodesEnumerator()
		{
			return GetNodesEnumerator(0, int.MaxValue, enumerateForwards: true);
		}

		protected IEnumerable<BinaryTreeNode> GetNodesEnumerator(int startIndex, int endIndex, bool enumerateForwards)
		{
			Stack<BinaryTreeNode> valueNodes = new Stack<BinaryTreeNode>();
			BinaryTreeNode nextNode = head;
			while (true)
			{
				PushNodeAndRecursiveBranch(nextNode, valueNodes, enumerateForwards);
				if (valueNodes.Count != 0)
				{
					BinaryTreeNode currentNode = valueNodes.Pop();
					if (startIndex < currentNode.FirstItemIndex + 32 && currentNode.FirstItemIndex <= endIndex)
					{
						yield return currentNode;
					}
					nextNode = ((!enumerateForwards) ? currentNode.LeftChild : currentNode.RightChild);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal T GetValue(int index, bool createdIfNotFound, out FindState state)
		{
			int num = ((_changeAdjustments != null) ? _changeAdjustments.Count : 0);
			int num2 = index;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				ChangeAdjustmentPoint changeAdjustmentPoint = _changeAdjustments[i];
				if (changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex > index)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (changeAdjustmentPoint.IsAdd)
				{
					if (changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedEndIndex >= index)
					{
						state = FindState.ValueNotFound;
						if (!createdIfNotFound && !changeAdjustmentPoint.HasInsertedItems)
						{
							return default(T);
						}
						int index2 = index - changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex;
						T val = changeAdjustmentPoint[index2];
						if (val == null)
						{
							if (createdIfNotFound)
							{
								val = (changeAdjustmentPoint[index2] = owner.CreateValue(index));
								state = FindState.ValueInserted;
								count++;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							state = FindState.ValueFound;
						}
						return val;
					}
					num2 -= changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedCount;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 += changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedCount;
				}
			}
			int num3 = num2 % 32;
			int num4 = num2 - num3;
			BinaryTreeNode binaryTreeNode = null;
			if (head == null)
			{
				if (!createdIfNotFound)
				{
					state = FindState.ValueNotFound;
					return default(T);
				}
				state = FindState.ValueInserted;
				binaryTreeNode = (head = CreateNode(num4, this));
				binaryTreeNode.Values[num3] = owner.CreateValue(index);
			}
			else
			{
				if (lastAccessedNode != null)
				{
					if (num4 == lastAccessedNode.FirstItemIndex)
					{
						binaryTreeNode = lastAccessedNode;
					}
					else if (num4 == lastAccessedNode.FirstItemIndex + 32)
					{
						binaryTreeNode = lastAccessedNode.RightChild;
						if (binaryTreeNode != null)
						{
							while (true)
							{
								BinaryTreeNode leftChild = binaryTreeNode.LeftChild;
								if (leftChild == null)
								{
									break;
								}
								binaryTreeNode = leftChild;
							}
						}
					}
					else if (num4 == lastAccessedNode.FirstItemIndex - 32)
					{
						binaryTreeNode = lastAccessedNode.LeftChild;
						if (binaryTreeNode != null)
						{
							while (true)
							{
								BinaryTreeNode rightChild = binaryTreeNode.RightChild;
								if (rightChild == null)
								{
									break;
								}
								binaryTreeNode = rightChild;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (binaryTreeNode == null)
				{
					binaryTreeNode = head;
				}
				binaryTreeNode = binaryTreeNode.FindOrAdd(index, num2, createdIfNotFound, createdIfNotFound, this, out state);
			}
			if (binaryTreeNode == null)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			lastAccessedNode = binaryTreeNode;
			if (state == FindState.ValueInserted)
			{
				count++;
			}
			T val3 = binaryTreeNode.Values[num3];
			if (val3 != null && !owner.IsItemStillValid(val3))
			{
				val3 = ((!createdIfNotFound) ? default(T) : owner.CreateValue(index));
				binaryTreeNode.Values[num3] = val3;
			}
			return val3;
		}

		internal void InsertItems(int index, int count)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(_maxItems - count, index + count);
			int num2 = _maxItems - 1;
			if (num <= num2)
			{
				foreach (T item in GetEnumeratorHelper(num, num2, enumerateForwards: true))
				{
					_ = item;
					this.count--;
				}
			}
			AddChangeHistoryItem(CreateHistoryItemAdd(index, count));
		}

		private static void PushNodeAndRecursiveBranch(BinaryTreeNode node, Stack<BinaryTreeNode> valueNodes, bool useLeftBranch)
		{
			while (node != null)
			{
				valueNodes.Push(node);
				node = ((!useLeftBranch) ? node.RightChild : node.LeftChild);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveItems(int index, int count)
		{
			foreach (T item in GetEnumeratorHelper(index, index + count - 1, enumerateForwards: true))
			{
				_ = item;
				this.count--;
			}
			AddChangeHistoryItem(CreateHistoryItemRemove(index, count));
		}

		internal T SetItemAtIndex(T item, int index)
		{
			int num = ((_changeAdjustments != null) ? _changeAdjustments.Count : 0);
			int num2 = index;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				ChangeAdjustmentPoint changeAdjustmentPoint = _changeAdjustments[i];
				if (changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex > index)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (changeAdjustmentPoint.IsAdd)
				{
					if (changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedEndIndex >= index)
					{
						int index2 = index - changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex;
						T result = changeAdjustmentPoint[index2];
						changeAdjustmentPoint[index2] = item;
						return result;
					}
					num2 -= changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedCount;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 += changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedCount;
				}
			}
			BinaryTreeNode node = null;
			int existingSlotIndex;
			return ReslotItemInTree(ref node, item, index, out existingSlotIndex);
		}

		public bool TryGetValue(int index, out T value)

			return state == FindState.ValueFound;

		private void AddChangeHistoryItem(ChangeHistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			lastAccessedNode = null;
			List<ChangeHistoryItem> changeHistory = ChangeHistory;
			changeHistory.Add(historyItem);
			_changeVersion++;
			MaintainChangePoints(historyItem);
			VerifyChangeHistortyLimit();
			if (_changeAdjustments == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = _changeAdjustments.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				ChangeAdjustmentPoint changeAdjustmentPoint = _changeAdjustments[num];
				if (changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedEndIndex < _maxItems)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex < _maxItems)
				{
					changeAdjustmentPoint.Truncate(_maxItems - changeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex);
				}
				else
				{
					_changeAdjustments.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			int num2 = _changeAdjustments.Count;
			int num3 = 0;
			for (int num = 0; num < num2; num++)
			{
				ChangeAdjustmentPoint changeAdjustmentPoint2 = _changeAdjustments[num];
				num3 = ((!changeAdjustmentPoint2.IsAdd) ? (num3 - changeAdjustmentPoint2.AdjustedCount) : (num3 + changeAdjustmentPoint2.AdjustedCount));
			}
			if (num3 < 0)
			{
				int index = _maxItems + num3;
				ChangeHistoryItem changeHistoryItem = CreateHistoryItemAdd(index, -num3);
				changeHistory.Add(changeHistoryItem);
				_changeVersion++;
				_changeAdjustments.Add(CreateAdjustmentPoint(changeHistoryItem));
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyChangeHistoryToTree()
		{
			if (_changeHistory == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_applyingChangesToTree = true;
			try
			{
				List<T> list = new List<T>(GetAddedItemEnumerator(0, _maxItems, enumerateForwards: true));
				List<BinaryTreeNode> list2 = new List<BinaryTreeNode>(GetNodesEnumerator());
				BinaryTreeNode node = null;
				int num = list2.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					node = list2[i];
					for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++)
					{
						T val = node.Values[j];
						if (val == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						int num2 = node.FirstItemIndex + j;
						int itemIndex = owner.GetItemIndex(val);
						owner.InitializeItemIndex(val, itemIndex, applyingChangesToTree: true);
						if (itemIndex < 0)
						{
							node.Values[j] = default(T);
						}
						else
						{
							if (num2 == itemIndex)
							{
								continue;
							}
							node.Values[j] = default(T);
							BinaryTreeNode node2 = node;
							int existingSlotIndex;
							for (T val2 = ReslotItemInTree(ref node2, val, itemIndex, out existingSlotIndex); val2 != null; val2 = ReslotItemInTree(ref node2, val2, existingSlotIndex, out existingSlotIndex))
							{
								if (existingSlotIndex < 0)
								{
									owner.InitializeItemIndex(val2, itemIndex, applyingChangesToTree: true);
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (T item in list)
				{
					int itemIndex2 = owner.GetItemIndex(item);
					if (itemIndex2 < 0)
					{
						owner.InitializeItemIndex(item, itemIndex2, applyingChangesToTree: true);
					}
					else
					{
						ReslotItemInTree(ref node, item, itemIndex2, out var _);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_applyingChangesToTree = false;
				_changeAdjustments = null;
				_changeHistory = null;
				if (_changeVersion >= 150)
				{
					_lastRolloverVersion = _changeVersion;
					_changeVersion = 0;
				}
				_lastApplyChangesToTreeVersion = _changeVersion;
			}
		}

		private void MaintainChangePoints(ChangeHistoryItem newHistoryItem)
		{
			ChangeAdjustmentPoint changeAdjustmentPoint = CreateAdjustmentPoint(newHistoryItem);
			if (_changeAdjustments == null)
			{
				_changeAdjustments = new List<ChangeAdjustmentPoint>();
				_changeAdjustments.Add(changeAdjustmentPoint);
				return;
			}
			bool wasAlreadyReturned = false;
			List<ChangeAdjustmentPoint> list = new List<ChangeAdjustmentPoint>(3);
			int num = _changeAdjustments.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				ChangeAdjustmentPoint changeAdjustmentPoint2 = _changeAdjustments[i];
				if (changeAdjustmentPoint2.AdjustedStartIndex + changeAdjustmentPoint2.AdjustedCount > newHistoryItem.Index)
				{
					changeAdjustmentPoint2.MergeNewChange(changeAdjustmentPoint, list, ref wasAlreadyReturned);
					if (list.Count == 1)
					{
						_changeAdjustments[i] = list[0];
						continue;
					}
					_changeAdjustments.RemoveAt(i);
					_changeAdjustments.InsertRange(i, list);
					num += list.Count - 1;
					i += list.Count - 1;
				}
			}
			if (!wasAlreadyReturned)
			{
				_changeAdjustments.Add(changeAdjustmentPoint);
			}
		}

		private T ReslotItemInTree(ref BinaryTreeNode node, T item, int itemIndex, out int existingSlotIndex)
		{
			existingSlotIndex = -1;
			int num = (_applyingChangesToTree ? itemIndex : ConvertItemIndexToTreeIndex(itemIndex));
			if (node == null || node.FirstItemIndex > num || node.FirstItemIndex + 32 <= num)
			{
				node = GetNodeContainingItemIndex(node, itemIndex, num);
			}
			if (node == null)
			{
				owner.InitializeItemIndex(item, -1, _applyingChangesToTree);
				return default(T);
			}
			int num2 = num - node.FirstItemIndex;
			T val = node.Values[num2];
			node.Values[num2] = item;
			owner.InitializeItemIndex(item, itemIndex, _applyingChangesToTree);
			if (val == null || object.Equals(val, item))
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			existingSlotIndex = owner.GetItemIndex(val);
			if (existingSlotIndex == itemIndex)
			{
				if (Debugger.IsLogging())
				{
					Debugger.Log(40, "global", $"Duplicate items for slot: {itemIndex}" + Environment.NewLine);
				}
				return default(T);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private BinaryTreeNode GetNodeContainingItemIndex(BinaryTreeNode node, int itemIndex, int treeIndex)
		{
			if (itemIndex < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (node == null || treeIndex < node.FirstItemIndex || treeIndex >= node.FirstItemIndex + 32)
			{
				if (head == null)
				{
					int num = treeIndex % 32;
					int nodeStartIndex = treeIndex - num;
					node = (head = CreateNode(nodeStartIndex, this));
				}
				else
				{
					node = head.FindOrAdd(itemIndex, treeIndex, createNodeIfNotFound: true, createItemIfNotFound: false, this, out var _);
				}
			}
			return node;
		}

		private void VerifyChangeHistortyLimit()
		{
			List<ChangeHistoryItem> changeHistory = ChangeHistory;
			if (changeHistory.Count != 0 && (changeHistory.Count > 60 || changeHistory[changeHistory.Count - 1].Count > 100))
			{
				ApplyChangeHistoryToTree();
			}
		}
	}

		internal static void LoadPrintAreas(NamedReference reference, PrintOptions printOptions)
		{
			Worksheet associatedWorksheet = printOptions.AssociatedWorksheet;
			List<CellAddressRange> rangesFromFormula = Utilities.GetRangesFromFormula(reference.FormulaInternal);
			for (int i = 0; i < rangesFromFormula.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRegion targetRegion = rangesFromFormula[i].GetTargetRegion(associatedWorksheet, -1, -1, relativeAddressesAreOffsets: false);
				if (targetRegion != null)
				{
					printOptions.PrintAreas.AddHelper(targetRegion);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void LoadPrintTitles(NamedReference reference, PrintOptions printOptions)
		{
			Worksheet associatedWorksheet = printOptions.AssociatedWorksheet;
			List<CellAddressRange> rangesFromFormula = Utilities.GetRangesFromFormula(reference.FormulaInternal);
			for (int i = 0; i < rangesFromFormula.Count; i++)
			{
				CellAddressRange cellAddressRange = rangesFromFormula[i];
				if (cellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.Column == 0 && cellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.Column == associatedWorksheet.Columns.MaxCount - 1)
				{
					printOptions.RowsToRepeatAtTop = new RepeatTitleRange(cellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.Row, cellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.Row);
				}
				if (cellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.Row == 0 && cellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.Row == associatedWorksheet.Rows.MaxCount - 1)
				{
					printOptions.ColumnsToRepeatAtLeft = new RepeatTitleRange(cellAddressRange.TopLeftCellAddress.Column, cellAddressRange.BottomRightCellAddress.Column);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static string NameFromBuiltInName(BuiltInName name)
		{
			return name switch
			{
				BuiltInName.ConsolidateArea => "Consolidate_Area", 
				BuiltInName.AutoOpen => "Auto_Open", 
				BuiltInName.AutoClose => "Auto_Close", 
				BuiltInName.Extract => "Extract", 
				BuiltInName.Database => "Database", 
				BuiltInName.Criteria => "Criteria", 
				BuiltInName.PrintArea => "Print_Area", 
				BuiltInName.PrintTitles => "Print_Titles", 
				BuiltInName.Recorder => "Recorder", 
				BuiltInName.DataForm => "Data_Form", 
				BuiltInName.AutoActivate => "Auto_Activate", 
				BuiltInName.AutoDeactivate => "Auto_Deactivate", 
				BuiltInName.SheetTitle => "Sheet_Title", 
				BuiltInName.FilterDatabase => "_FilterDatabase", 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal void OnNameChanged(string oldName)
		{
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			if (workbook != null && oldName != null && StringUtilities.StringCompare(Name, oldName, workbook.CultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) != 0)
			{
				workbook.OnNamedReferenceRenamed(this, oldName);
			}
			CheckForBuiltInName();
		}

		internal void OnNameChanging(string newName)
		{
			Workbook?.VerifyItemName(newName, this);
		}

		internal static void ParseBuiltInNameInfo(NamedReference reference, PrintOptions printOptions)
		{
			switch (reference.BuiltInName)
			{
			case BuiltInName.PrintArea:
				LoadPrintAreas(reference, printOptions);
				break;
			case BuiltInName.PrintTitles:
				LoadPrintTitles(reference, printOptions);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void SetNameInternal(string value, bool validateName)
		{
			SetNameInternal(value, "value", CurrentFormat, validateName);
		}

		internal void SetNameInternal(string value, string paramName, WorkbookFormat currentFormat)
		{
			SetNameInternal(value, paramName, currentFormat, validateName: true);
		}

		internal void SetNameInternal(string value, string paramName, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, bool validateName)
		{
			if (validateName)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(paramName, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_NamedReferenceNameCantBeNull"));
				}
				if (value.Length > 255)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_NamedReferenceNameTooLong"), paramName);
				}
				if (Type != NameType.OleObject && !FormulaParser.IsValidNamedReference(value, currentFormat, Culture))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidNamedReferenceName"), paramName);
				}
			}
			OnNameChanging(value);
			string oldName = name;
			name = value;
			OnNameChanged(oldName);
		}

		internal virtual string ToString(GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, bool forceIncludeScopeName = false)
		{
			return ToString();
		}

		private static BuiltInName BuiltInNameFromName(string name)
		{
			if (string.Compare(name, "Consolidate_Area", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.ConsolidateArea;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Auto_Open", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.AutoOpen;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Auto_Close", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.AutoClose;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Extract", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.Extract;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Database", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.Database;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Criteria", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.Criteria;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Print_Area", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.PrintArea;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Print_Titles", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.PrintTitles;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Recorder", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.Recorder;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Data_Form", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.DataForm;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Auto_Activate", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.AutoActivate;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Auto_Deactivate", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.AutoDeactivate;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Sheet_Title", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.SheetTitle;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "_FilterDatabase", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return BuiltInName.FilterDatabase;
			}
			return BuiltInName.PrintArea;
		}

		private void CheckForBuiltInName()
		{
			isBuiltIn = IsBuiltInName(Name);
			if (isBuiltIn)
			{
				builtInName = BuiltInNameFromName(Name);
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsBuiltInName(string name)
		{
			if (string.Compare(name, "Consolidate_Area", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Auto_Open", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Auto_Close", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Extract", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Database", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Criteria", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Print_Area", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Print_Titles", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Recorder", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Data_Form", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Auto_Activate", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Auto_Deactivate", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Sheet_Title", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "_FilterDatabase", StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void SetFormulaInternal(Formula value, bool synchronizeBuiltInReferences)
		{
			if (formula != value)
			{
				if (formula != null)
				{
					formula.DisconnectReferences();
				}
				formula = value;
				if (formula != null)
				{
					formula.ReconnectReferences(new FormulaContext(Workbook, scope as Worksheet, null, -1, formula));
				}
				OnFormulaChanged(synchronizeBuiltInReferences);
			}
		}

	public class NamedReference : NamedReferenceBase
	{
		private struct FormulaInfo
		{
			internal readonly NamedReference _namedReference;

			internal readonly NamedReferenceCollection _collection;

			internal readonly CellReferenceMode _cellRefMode;

			internal readonly CultureInfo _culture;

			internal FormulaInfo(NamedReference namedReference, CellReferenceMode cellRefMode, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				_namedReference = namedReference;
				_collection = namedReference.collection;
				_cellRefMode = cellRefMode;
				_culture = culture;
			}
		}

		private NamedCalcReference calcReference;

		private NamedReferenceCollection collection;

		private bool isInitializing;

		private string _formulaBeingSet;

		internal override CultureInfo Culture
		{
			get
			{
				Workbook workbook = Workbook;
				if (workbook != null)
				{
					return workbook.CultureResolved;
				}
				return Utilities.CurrentCulture;
			}
		}

		internal override WorkbookReferenceBase WorkbookReference => Workbook?.CurrentWorkbookReference;

		internal override bool CanUndo
		{
			get
			{
				if (collection != null && collection.Workbook != null)
				{
					return !IsInitializing;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public string Formula
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.FormulaInternal == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				Workbook workbook = Workbook;
				if (workbook == null)
				{
					return base.FormulaInternal.ToString();
				}
				return base.FormulaInternal.ToString(workbook.CellReferenceMode, workbook.CultureResolved);
			}
		}

		public bool IsSimpleReferenceFormula => GetReferenceHelper(evaluateComplexFormulas: false) != null;

		public WorksheetCell ReferencedCell
		{
			get
			{
				CellCalcReference parsedCellReference = GetReferenceHelper(evaluateComplexFormulas: true) as CellCalcReference;

			}
		}

		public WorksheetRegion ReferencedRegion
		{
			get

		{

		}

		internal override RefBase CalcReference => CalcReferenceInternal;

		internal NamedCalcReference CalcReferenceInternal
		{

				{
					calcReference = new NamedCalcReference(this);
					Workbook?.AddNamedReference(calcReference);
				}
				return calcReference;
			}
		}

			set

			}
		}

		internal override Workbook Workbook
		{
			get
			{
				if (collection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return collection.Workbook;
			}

		internal NamedReference(NamedReferenceCollection collection, object scope)
			: this(collection, scope, hidden: false)
		{
		}

		internal NamedReference(NamedReferenceCollection collection, object scope, bool hidden)
			: base(scope, hidden)
		{
			this.collection = collection;
		}

		internal override void OnFormulaChanged(bool synchronizeBuiltInReferences)
		{
			if (!IsInitializing && base.FormulaInternal != null && base.FormulaInternal.PostfixTokenList.Length != 0)
			{
				CalcReference?.SetAndCompileFormula(base.FormulaInternal, canClearPreviouslyCalculatedValue: false);
				if (synchronizeBuiltInReferences)
				{
					SynchronizeBuildInReferences(clearExisting: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (base.Scope is Workbook)
			{
				return base.Name;
			}
			if (base.Scope is Worksheet worksheet)
			{
				return Utilities.CreateReferenceString(null, worksheet.Name) + base.Name;
			}
			return base.Name;
		}

		internal WorksheetRegionAddress[] GetAddresses(bool evaluateComplexFormulas, Worksheet worksheet = null)
		{
			RefBase referenceHelper = GetReferenceHelper(evaluateComplexFormulas);
			if (referenceHelper != null)
			{
				if (referenceHelper is CellCalcReference)
				{
					CellCalcReference cellCalcReference = (CellCalcReference)referenceHelper;
					if (worksheet == null || cellCalcReference.Worksheet == worksheet)
					{
						return new WorksheetRegionAddress[1]
						{
							new WorksheetRegionAddress(cellCalcReference.Row.Index, cellCalcReference.Row.Index, cellCalcReference.ColumnIndex, cellCalcReference.ColumnIndex)
						};
					}
				}
				else if (referenceHelper is RegionCalcReferenceBase)
				{
					RegionCalcReferenceBase regionCalcReferenceBase = (RegionCalcReferenceBase)referenceHelper;
					if (worksheet == null || regionCalcReferenceBase.Worksheet == worksheet)
					{
						return new WorksheetRegionAddress[1] { regionCalcReferenceBase.Region.Address };
					}
				}
				else if (referenceHelper is RegionGroupCalcReference)
				{
					RegionGroupCalcReference regionGroupCalcReference = (RegionGroupCalcReference)referenceHelper;
					if (worksheet == null || regionGroupCalcReference.Worksheet == worksheet)
					{
						WorksheetRegionAddress[] array = new WorksheetRegionAddress[regionGroupCalcReference.Regions.Count];
						for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
						{
							ref WorksheetRegionAddress reference = ref array[i];
							reference = regionGroupCalcReference.Regions[i].Address;
						}
						return array;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal RefBase GetReferenceHelper(bool evaluateComplexFormulas, RefBase complexFormulaOwner = null)
		{
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			Formula formula = base.FormulaInternal;
			if (formula == null || workbook == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (complexFormulaOwner != null && !formula.IsSharedFormula && formula.DoesHaveRelativeReferences() && (complexFormulaOwner.Row.Index != 0 || complexFormulaOwner.ColumnIndex != 0))
			{
				formula = formula.Clone();
				formula.OffsetReferences(workbook, formula.OwningCellRow, formula.OwningCellColumnIndex, new Point(complexFormulaOwner.Row.Index, complexFormulaOwner.ColumnIndex));
			}
			FormulaContext context = ((complexFormulaOwner != null && formula.IsSharedFormula) ? new FormulaContext(workbook, complexFormulaOwner.Worksheet, complexFormulaOwner.Row, complexFormulaOwner.ColumnIndex, formula) : new FormulaContext(workbook, formula));
			bool isNamedReference;
			RefBase refBase = workbook.ParseReference(context, out isNamedReference);
			if (refBase != null)
			{
				return refBase;
			}
			if (!evaluateComplexFormulas)
			{
				return null;
			}
			workbook.EnsureAllCalculationsCurrent();
			ExcelCalcNumberStack excelCalcNumberStack = new ExcelCalcNumberStack(complexFormulaOwner ?? CalcReferenceInternal, null);
			excelCalcNumberStack.Push(new ExcelCalcValue(CalcReferenceInternal));
			ExcelCalcValue excelCalcValue = excelCalcNumberStack.Pop();
			return excelCalcValue.Value as RefBase;
		}

		internal void InitializeCollection(NamedReferenceCollection collection)
		{
			if (this.collection != collection)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
			}
		}

		public void SetFormula(string formula)
		{
			CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode = CellReferenceMode.A1;
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				cellReferenceMode = workbook.CellReferenceMode;
			}
			SetFormula(formula, cellReferenceMode);
		}

		public void SetFormula(string formula, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			SetFormula(formula, cellReferenceMode, Culture);
		}

		public void SetFormula(string formula, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formula))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("formula", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_FormulaCantBeNull"));
			}
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CellReferenceMode), cellReferenceMode))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("cellReferenceMode", (int)cellReferenceMode, typeof(CellReferenceMode));
			}
			SetFormula(new FormulaInfo(this, cellReferenceMode, culture), formula);
		}

		private static void SetFormula(FormulaInfo formulaInfo, string formula)
		{
			if (!(formula == formulaInfo._namedReference._formulaBeingSet))
			{
				formulaInfo._namedReference._formulaBeingSet = formula;
				NamedReference namedReference = formulaInfo._namedReference;
				if (!Infragistics.Documents.Excel.Formula.TryParse(formula, formulaInfo._cellRefMode, FormulaType.NamedReferenceFormula, namedReference.CurrentFormat, formulaInfo._culture, null, out var formula2, out var exception))
				{
					throw Utilities.CreateArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidFormula"), "formula", exception);
				}
				FormatLimitErrors formatLimitErrors = namedReference.Workbook.InitializeFormatLimitErrors();
				formula2.VerifyFormatLimits(namedReference.Workbook, formatLimitErrors, namedReference.CurrentFormat, formulaInfo._cellRefMode, parseFormula: false, null, -1);
				if (formatLimitErrors.HasErrors)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_FormulaReferencesInvalidCells"), "formula");
				}
				if (namedReference.Workbook != null)
				{
					namedReference.Workbook.VerifyFormula(formula2, null, -1);
				}
				namedReference.FormulaInternal = formula2;
				formulaInfo._namedReference._formulaBeingSet = null;
			}
		}

		internal void OnAddedToCollection()
		{
			SynchronizeBuildInReferences(clearExisting: false);
		}

		internal void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			if (base.FormulaInternal != null)
			{
				base.FormulaInternal.DisconnectReferences();
			}
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			workbook?.RemoveNamedReference(CalcReferenceInternal);
			if (base.IsBuiltIn)
			{
				if (base.Scope is Worksheet worksheet)
				{
					switch (base.BuiltInName)
					{
					case BuiltInName.PrintArea:
						worksheet.PrintOptions.PrintAreas.Clear();
						break;
					case BuiltInName.PrintTitles:
						worksheet.PrintOptions.ColumnsToRepeatAtLeft = null;
						worksheet.PrintOptions.RowsToRepeatAtTop = null;
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (base.Scope == workbook)
				{
					workbook.OnNamedReferenceRemoved(this);
				}
			}
			collection = null;
		}

		private void SynchronizeBuildInReferences(bool clearExisting)
		{
			if (isInitializing || !base.IsBuiltIn)
			{
				return;
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = base.Scope as Worksheet;
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			if (worksheet == null || workbook == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (base.BuiltInName)
			{
			case BuiltInName.PrintArea:
			{
				PrintAreasCollection printAreas = worksheet.PrintOptions.PrintAreas;
				printAreas.SynchronizeWithNamedReference(GetReferenceHelper(evaluateComplexFormulas: true), clearExisting);
				break;
			}
			case BuiltInName.PrintTitles:
			{
				PrintOptions printOptions = worksheet.PrintOptions;
				RefBase referenceHelper = GetReferenceHelper(evaluateComplexFormulas: true);
				RepeatTitleRange columnsToRepeat = null;
				RepeatTitleRange rowsToRepeat = null;
				if (referenceHelper is RegionGroupCalcReference)
				{
					WorksheetRegion[] referencedRegions = GetReferencedRegions(referenceHelper as RegionGroupCalcReference);
					for (int i = 0; i < referencedRegions.Length; i++)
					{
						ConvertRegionToRange(referencedRegions[i], ref columnsToRepeat, ref rowsToRepeat);
					}
				}
				else if (referenceHelper is RegionCalcReference)
				{
					WorksheetRegion referencedRegion = GetReferencedRegion(referenceHelper as RegionCalcReference);
					ConvertRegionToRange(referencedRegion, ref columnsToRepeat, ref rowsToRepeat);
				}
				else
				{
					_ = referenceHelper is CellCalcReference;
				}
				printOptions.SetColumnsToRepeatAtLeft(columnsToRepeat, suppressNotifications: true);
				printOptions.SetRowsToRepeatAtTop(rowsToRepeat, suppressNotifications: true);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private static void ConvertRegionToRange(WorksheetRegion region, ref RepeatTitleRange columnsToRepeat, ref RepeatTitleRange rowsToRepeat)
		{
			int num = region.LastColumn - region.FirstColumn;
			int num2 = region.LastRow - region.FirstRow;
			if (num < num2)
			{
				columnsToRepeat = new RepeatTitleRange(region.FirstColumn, region.LastColumn);
			}
			else
			{
				rowsToRepeat = new RepeatTitleRange(region.FirstRow, region.LastRow);
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			Formula formulaInternal = base.FormulaInternal;
			if (formulaInternal != null)
			{
				CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode = ((Workbook == null) ? CellReferenceMode.A1 : Workbook.CellReferenceMode);
				formulaInternal.VerifyFormatLimits(Workbook, limitErrors, testFormat, cellReferenceMode, parseFormula: true, null, -1);
			}
		}

		internal static WorksheetCell GetReferencedCell(CellCalcReference parsedCellReference)
		{
			return parsedCellReference?.Row.Cells[parsedCellReference.ColumnIndex];
		}

		internal static WorksheetRegion GetReferencedRegion(RegionCalcReferenceBase parsedRegionReference)
		{
			return parsedRegionReference?.Region;
		}

		internal static WorksheetRegion[] GetReferencedRegions(RegionGroupCalcReference parsedRegionGroupReference)
		{
			if (parsedRegionGroupReference == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			WorksheetRegion[] array = new WorksheetRegion[parsedRegionGroupReference.Regions.Count];
			parsedRegionGroupReference.Regions.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Count = {Count}")]
	public sealed class NamedReferenceCollection : ICollection<NamedReference>, IEnumerable<NamedReference>, IEnumerable
	{
		private Workbook workbook;

		private List<NamedReference> namedReferences;

		int ICollection<NamedReference>.Count => Count;

		bool ICollection<NamedReference>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => namedReferences.Count;

		public NamedReference this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
				{
					throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
				}
				return namedReferences[index];
			}
		}

		public Workbook Workbook => workbook;

		internal NamedReferenceCollection(Workbook workbook)
		{
			this.workbook = workbook;
			namedReferences = new List<NamedReference>();
		}

		void ICollection<NamedReference>.Add(NamedReference item)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantAddNamedReference"));
		}

		void ICollection<NamedReference>.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool ICollection<NamedReference>.Contains(NamedReference item)
		{
			return Contains(item);
		}

		void ICollection<NamedReference>.CopyTo(NamedReference[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			namedReferences.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<NamedReference>.Remove(NamedReference item)
		{
			return Remove(item);
		}

		IEnumerator<NamedReference> IEnumerable<NamedReference>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return namedReferences.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<NamedReference>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public NamedReference Add(string name, string formula)
		{
			return Add(name, formula, workbook.CellReferenceMode);
		}

		public NamedReference Add(string name, string formula, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			return AddHelper(name, formula, cellReferenceMode, workbook);
		}

		public NamedReference Add(string name, string formula, Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			return Add(name, formula, workbook.CellReferenceMode, worksheet);
		}

		public NamedReference Add(string name, string formula, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("worksheet", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_WorksheetScope"));
			}
			if (worksheet.Workbook != workbook)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_WorksheetScopeFromOtherWorkbook"), "worksheet");
			}
			return AddHelper(name, formula, cellReferenceMode, worksheet);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = namedReferences.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(NamedReference namedReference)
		{
			return namedReferences.Contains(namedReference);
		}

		public NamedReference Find(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_FindNamedReference"));
			}
			return Workbook.GetWorkbookScopedNamedItem(name) as NamedReference;
		}

		public NamedReference Find(string name, Worksheet worksheetScope)
		{
			if (worksheetScope == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("worksheetScope", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_WorksheetScope"));
			}
			return Find(name, (object)worksheetScope);
		}

		public NamedReference[] FindAll(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_FindNamedReference"));
			}
			List<NamedReference> list = new List<NamedReference>();
			foreach (NamedReference namedReference in namedReferences)
			{
				if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(name, namedReference.Name, workbook.CultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					list.Add(namedReference);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public bool Remove(NamedReference namedReference)
		{
			if (namedReference == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = namedReferences.IndexOf(namedReference);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			NamedReference namedReference = namedReferences[index];
			namedReferences.RemoveAt(index);
			namedReference.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			Workbook.OnNamedReferenceRemoved(namedReference);
		}

		internal void AddInternal(NamedReference namedReference)
		{
			AddInternal(namedReference, updateDataFromBuiltInReferences: true);
		}

		internal void AddInternal(NamedReference namedReference, bool updateDataFromBuiltInReferences)
		{
			InternalInsert(namedReferences.Count, namedReference, updateDataFromBuiltInReferences);
		}

		internal void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			foreach (NamedReference item in (IEnumerable<NamedReference>)this)
			{
				item.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			}
		}

		private NamedReference AddHelper(string name, string formula, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, object scope)
		{
			NamedReference namedReference = new NamedReference(this, scope);
			namedReference.IsInitializing = true;
			namedReference.SetNameInternal(name, "name", Workbook.CurrentFormat);
			namedReference.SetFormula(formula, cellReferenceMode);
			AddInternal(namedReference);
			namedReference.IsInitializing = false;
			namedReference.OnFormulaChanged(synchronizeBuiltInReferences: true);
			return namedReference;
		}

		private NamedReference Find(string name, object scope)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_FindNamedReference"));
			}
			foreach (NamedReference namedReference in namedReferences)
			{
				if (namedReference.Scope == scope && StringUtilities.StringCompare(name, namedReference.Name, workbook.CultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return namedReference;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void InternalInsert(int index, NamedReference namedReference, bool updateDataFromBuiltInReferences)
		{
			namedReferences.Insert(index, namedReference);
			namedReference.InitializeCollection(this);
			Workbook.OnNamedReferenceAdded(namedReference);
			_ = namedReference.CalcReference;
			if (updateDataFromBuiltInReferences && namedReference.IsBuiltIn && namedReference.Scope is Worksheet worksheet)
			{
				NamedReferenceBase.ParseBuiltInNameInfo(namedReference, worksheet.PrintOptions);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class NamedReferenceUnconnected : NamedReferenceBase
	{
		private NamedCalcReferenceUnconnected _calcReference;

		private WorkbookFormat _currentFormat;

		private NameType _type;

		internal override RefBase CalcReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (_calcReference == null)
				{
					_calcReference = new NamedCalcReferenceUnconnected(this);
				}
				return _calcReference;
			}
		}

		internal override bool CanUndo => false;

		internal override CultureInfo Culture => Utilities.CurrentCulture;

		internal override WorkbookFormat CurrentFormat => _currentFormat;

		internal override bool IsConnected => false;

		internal override NameType Type => _type;

		internal override Workbook Workbook => null;

		internal override WorkbookReferenceBase WorkbookReference => base.Scope as WorkbookReferenceBase;

		public NamedReferenceUnconnected(string name, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, NameType type)
			: base(null, hidden: false)
		{
			_type = type;
			_currentFormat = currentFormat;
			base.Name = name;
		}

		public NamedReferenceUnconnected(string name, object scope, bool hidden, WorkbookFormat currentFormat)
			: base(scope, hidden)
		{
			_type = NameType.Normal;
			_currentFormat = currentFormat;
			base.Name = name;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is NamedReferenceUnconnected namedReferenceUnconnected && base.Name == namedReferenceUnconnected.Name)
			{
				return base.ScopeInternal == namedReferenceUnconnected.ScopeInternal;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.Name.GetHashCode();
		}

		internal override string ToString(GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, bool forceIncludeScopeName)
		{
			if (Type == NameType.OleObject)
			{
				string text = base.Name;
				if (!FormulaParser.IsValidNamedReference(text, CurrentFormat, Culture))
				{
					text = string.Format("'{0}'", text.Replace("'", "''"));
				}
				return WorkbookReference.FileName + "!" + text;
			}
			if (base.Scope is WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReferenceBase)
			{
				return workbookReferenceBase.GetWorkbookReferenceString(getFormulaStringInfo, forceIncludeScopeName) + base.Name;
			}
			if (base.Scope is WorksheetReference worksheetReference)
			{
				return worksheetReference.GetReferenceName(getFormulaStringInfo, forceIncludeScopeName) + base.Name;
			}
			if (forceIncludeScopeName)
			{
				Workbook workbook = base.Scope as Workbook;
				if (workbook != null)
				{
					return workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.GetWorkbookReferenceString(getFormulaStringInfo, forceIncludeScopeName) + base.Name;
				}
				if (base.Scope is Worksheet { Workbook: not null } worksheet)
				{
					return workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.GetWorksheetReference(worksheet.Name).GetReferenceName(getFormulaStringInfo, forceIncludeScopeName) + base.Name;
				}
			}
			return base.Name;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PageBreak
	{
		private bool createdByPivotTable;

		private int id;

		private bool manuallyCreated = true;

		private readonly int? max;

		private readonly int? min;

		private WorksheetRegion printArea;

		public WorksheetRegion PrintArea
		{
			get
			{
				return printArea;
			}
			internal set
			{
				printArea = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool CreatedByPivotTable
		{
			get
			{
				return createdByPivotTable;
			}
			set
			{
				createdByPivotTable = value;
			}
		}

		internal int Id
		{
			get
			{
				return id;
			}
			set
			{
				id = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool ManuallyCreated
		{
			get
			{
				return manuallyCreated;
			}
			set
			{
				manuallyCreated = value;
			}
		}

		internal int? Max => max;

		internal int MaxResolved
		{
			get
			{
				int? num = Max;
				if (!num.HasValue)
				{
					return int.MaxValue;
				}
				return num.Value;
			}
		}

		internal int? Min => min;

		internal int MinResolved
		{
			get
			{
				int? num = Min;
				if (!num.HasValue)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return num.Value;
			}
		}

		internal PageBreak(int id, int? min, int? max)
		{
			this.id = id;
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GetType() != obj.GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			PageBreak pageBreak = (PageBreak)obj;
			if (createdByPivotTable != pageBreak.createdByPivotTable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (manuallyCreated != pageBreak.manuallyCreated)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CompareToHelper(pageBreak) == 0;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (createdByPivotTable)
			{
				num |= 0x1000;
			}
			if (manuallyCreated)
			{
				num |= 0x2000;
			}
			return num ^ (Id ^ MaxResolved ^ MinResolved);
		}

		internal int CompareToHelper(PageBreak other)
		{
			int num = Id - other.Id;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = MinResolved - other.MinResolved;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = MaxResolved - other.MaxResolved;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (printArea == other.printArea)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (printArea == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (other.printArea == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return ((IComparer<WorksheetRegion>)WorksheetRegion.HorizontalSorter.Instance).Compare(printArea, other.printArea);
		}
	}
	public sealed class HorizontalPageBreak : PageBreak, IComparable<HorizontalPageBreak>
	{
		public int FirstRowOnPage => base.Id;

		public HorizontalPageBreak(int firstRowOnPage)
			: this(firstRowOnPage, null, null)
		{
		}

		public HorizontalPageBreak(int firstRowOnPage, WorksheetRegion printArea)
			: this(firstRowOnPage, GetMinMax(printArea, getMin: true), GetMinMax(printArea, getMin: false))
		{
			base.PrintArea = printArea;
			if (printArea != null && (firstRowOnPage <= printArea.FirstRow || printArea.LastRow < firstRowOnPage))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_MustBeWithinPrintArea"), "printArea");
			}
		}

		internal HorizontalPageBreak(int firstRowOnPage, int? min, int? max)
			: base(firstRowOnPage, min, max)
		{
		}

		int IComparable<HorizontalPageBreak>.CompareTo(HorizontalPageBreak other)
		{
			return CompareToHelper(other);
		}

		private static int? GetMinMax(WorksheetRegion printArea, bool getMin)
		{
			if (printArea == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (getMin)
			{
				return printArea.FirstColumn;
			}
			return printArea.LastColumn;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PageBreakCollection<T> : IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable where T : PageBreak
	{
		private PrintOptions owner;

		private List<T> pageBreaks;

		T IList<T>.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_CantSetBreakAtIndex"));
			}
		}

		bool ICollection<T>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => pageBreaks.Count;

		public T this[int index] => pageBreaks[index];

		internal abstract bool IsVertical { get; }

		internal Worksheet Worksheet => owner.AssociatedWorksheet;

		internal PageBreakCollection(PrintOptions owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			pageBreaks = new List<T>();
		}

		void IList<T>.Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_CantInsertBreakAtIndex"));
		}

		void ICollection<T>.CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			pageBreaks.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		IEnumerator<T> IEnumerable<T>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return pageBreaks.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<T>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(T pageBreak)
		{
			AddInternal(pageBreak, throwIfPresent: true);
		}

		internal bool AddInternal(T pageBreak, bool throwIfPresent)
		{
			if (pageBreak == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pageBreak");
			}
			if (pageBreak.PrintArea != null)
			{
				if (pageBreak.PrintArea.Worksheet == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PrintAreaShiftedOffWorksheet"), "pageBreak");
				}
				if (pageBreak.PrintArea.Worksheet != Worksheet)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_PrintAreaMustBeOnSameWorksheet"), "pageBreak");
				}
				if (!owner.PrintAreas.Contains(pageBreak.PrintArea))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_PrintAreaMustBeInPrintAreas"), "pageBreak");
				}
			}
			int num = pageBreaks.BinarySearch(pageBreak);
			if (0 <= num)
			{
				if (throwIfPresent)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_PageBreaksCannotOverlap"), "pageBreak");
				}
				return false;
			}
			num = ~num;
			if (0 < num)
			{
				PageBreak pageBreak2 = pageBreaks[num - 1];
				if (pageBreak.Id == pageBreak2.Id && pageBreak.MinResolved <= pageBreak2.MaxResolved)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_PageBreaksCannotOverlap"), "pageBreak");
				}
			}
			if (num < pageBreaks.Count)
			{
				PageBreak pageBreak3 = pageBreaks[num];
				if (pageBreak.Id == pageBreak3.Id && pageBreak3.MinResolved <= pageBreak.MaxResolved)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_PageBreaksCannotOverlap"), "pageBreak");
				}
			}
			pageBreaks.Insert(num, pageBreak);
			return true;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			pageBreaks.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(T pageBreak)
		{
			if (pageBreak == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pageBreak");
			}
			return pageBreaks.Contains(pageBreak);
		}

		public int IndexOf(T pageBreak)
		{
			if (pageBreak == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pageBreak");
			}
			return pageBreaks.IndexOf(pageBreak);
		}

		public bool Remove(T pageBreak)
		{
			if (pageBreak == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pageBreak");
			}
			return pageBreaks.Remove(pageBreak);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			pageBreaks.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		internal int GetManualBreakCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < pageBreaks.Count; i++)
			{
				T val = pageBreaks[i];
				if (val.ManuallyCreated)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public sealed class HorizontalPageBreakCollection : PageBreakCollection<HorizontalPageBreak>
	{
		internal override bool IsVertical => false;

		internal HorizontalPageBreakCollection(PrintOptions owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		internal void ShiftPageBreaksVertically(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride)
		{
			List<HorizontalPageBreak> list = new List<HorizontalPageBreak>(this);
			foreach (HorizontalPageBreak item in list)
			{
				WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress;
				if (item.PrintArea == null)
				{
					regionAddress = new WorksheetRegionAddress(item.FirstRowOnPage, item.FirstRowOnPage, 0, (short)(base.Worksheet.Columns.MaxCount - 1));
				}
				else
				{
					WorksheetRegion printArea = item.PrintArea;
					if (printArea.Worksheet == null)
					{
						Remove(item);
						continue;
					}
					regionAddress = new WorksheetRegionAddress(item.FirstRowOnPage, item.FirstRowOnPage, printArea.FirstColumnInternal, printArea.LastColumnInternal);
				}
				ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult = shiftOperation.ShiftRegionAddress(ref regionAddress, operationOverride, leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet: true);
				if (shiftAddressResult.DidShift)
				{
					Remove(item);
					if (!shiftAddressResult.IsDeleted)
					{
						item.Id = regionAddress.FirstRowIndex;
						AddInternal(item, throwIfPresent: false);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class VerticalPageBreakCollection : PageBreakCollection<VerticalPageBreak>
	{
		internal override bool IsVertical => true;

		internal VerticalPageBreakCollection(PrintOptions owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}
	}
	public sealed class VerticalPageBreak : PageBreak, IComparable<VerticalPageBreak>
	{
		public int FirstColumnOnPage => base.Id;

		public VerticalPageBreak(int firstColumOnPage)
			: this(firstColumOnPage, null, null)
		{
		}

		public VerticalPageBreak(int firstColumOnPage, WorksheetRegion printArea)
			: this(firstColumOnPage, GetMinMax(printArea, getMin: true), GetMinMax(printArea, getMin: false))
		{
			base.PrintArea = printArea;
			if (printArea != null && (firstColumOnPage <= printArea.FirstColumn || printArea.LastColumn < firstColumOnPage))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_MustBeWithinPrintArea"), "printArea");
			}
		}

		internal VerticalPageBreak(int firstColumOnPage, int? min, int? max)
			: base(firstColumOnPage, min, max)
		{
		}

		int IComparable<VerticalPageBreak>.CompareTo(VerticalPageBreak other)
		{
			return CompareToHelper(other);
		}

		private static int? GetMinMax(WorksheetRegion printArea, bool getMin)
		{
			if (printArea == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (getMin)
			{
				return printArea.FirstRow;
			}
			return printArea.LastRow;
		}
	}

		public WorksheetCell BottomRightCornerCell
		{
			get
			{
				if (bottomRightCornerCellWorksheet == null || bottomRightCornerCell == WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return bottomRightCornerCellWorksheet.Rows[bottomRightCornerCell.RowIndex].Cells[bottomRightCornerCell.ColumnIndex];
			}
			set
			{
				Worksheet worksheet;
				WorksheetCellAddress worksheetCellAddress;
				if (value == null || value.Worksheet == null)
				{
					worksheet = null;
					worksheetCellAddress = WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference;
				}
				else
				{
					worksheet = value.Worksheet;
					worksheetCellAddress = value.Address;
				}
				if (worksheet != bottomRightCornerCellWorksheet || worksheetCellAddress != bottomRightCornerCell)
				{
					VerifyAnchorCell(value);
					WorksheetCellAddress oldBottomRightCornerCell = bottomRightCornerCell;
					bottomRightCornerCellWorksheet = worksheet;
					bottomRightCornerCell = worksheetCellAddress;
					OnBoundsChanged(worksheet, topLeftCornerCell, topLeftCornerPosition, oldBottomRightCornerCell, bottomRightCornerPosition);
				}
			}
		}

		public PointF BottomRightCornerPosition
		{
			get

			}
			set

				{
					VerifyAnchorPosition(value);
					PointF oldBottomRightCornerPosition = bottomRightCornerPosition;
					bottomRightCornerPosition = value;
					OnBoundsChanged(bottomRightCornerCellWorksheet, topLeftCornerCell, topLeftCornerPosition, bottomRightCornerCell, oldBottomRightCornerPosition);

		public static WorksheetShape CreatePredefinedShape(PredefinedShapeType shapeType)
		{
			return CreatePredefinedShape(shapeType, initializeDefaults: true);
		}

		internal static WorksheetShape CreatePredefinedShape(PredefinedShapeType shapeType, bool initializeDefaults)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(PredefinedShapeType), shapeType))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("shapeType", (int)shapeType, typeof(PredefinedShapeType));
			}
			return shapeType switch
			{
				PredefinedShapeType.Diamond => new DiamondShape(initializeDefaults), 
				PredefinedShapeType.Heart => new HeartShape(initializeDefaults), 
				PredefinedShapeType.IrregularSeal1 => new IrregularSeal1Shape(initializeDefaults), 
				PredefinedShapeType.IrregularSeal2 => new IrregularSeal2Shape(initializeDefaults), 
				PredefinedShapeType.LightningBolt => new LightningBoltShape(initializeDefaults), 
				PredefinedShapeType.Line => new LineShape(initializeDefaults), 
				PredefinedShapeType.Ellipse => new EllipseShape(initializeDefaults), 
				PredefinedShapeType.Pentagon => new PentagonShape(initializeDefaults), 
				PredefinedShapeType.Rectangle => new RectangleShape(initializeDefaults), 
				PredefinedShapeType.RightTriangle => new RightTriangleShape(initializeDefaults), 
				PredefinedShapeType.StraightConnector1 => new StraightConnector1Shape(initializeDefaults), 
				_ => new RectangleShape(initializeDefaults), 
			};
		}

		public virtual Rectangle GetBoundsInTwips(PositioningOptions options)
		{
			if (topLeftCornerCellWorksheet == null || bottomRightCornerCellWorksheet == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_GetBoundsBeforeAnchorsSet"));
			}
			return GetBoundsInTwips(topLeftCornerCellWorksheet, TopLeftCornerCellInternal, TopLeftCornerPosition, BottomRightCornerCellInternal, BottomRightCornerPosition, options);
		}

		private static void SetBoundsInTwips(Worksheet worksheet, Rectangle bounds, out WorksheetCellAddress topLeftCornerCell, out PointF topLeftCornerPosition, out WorksheetCellAddress bottomRightCornerCell, out PointF bottomRightCornerPosition, PositioningOptions options)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("worksheet");
			}
			bool treatAllAsVisible = (options & PositioningOptions.IgnoreHiddenRowsAndColumns) != 0;
			int distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths = worksheet.ConvertToCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(bounds.Left, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Twip, snapToPixels: false);
			int distanceToRightColumnIn256ths = worksheet.ConvertToCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(bounds.Right, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Twip, snapToPixels: false);
			worksheet.Columns.GetIndexesOfColumnsIn256ths(ref distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths, ref distanceToRightColumnIn256ths, out var leftColumnIndex, out var rightColumnIndex, treatAllAsVisible);
			float x = (float)distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths * 100f / (float)worksheet.GetColumnWidthIn256ths(leftColumnIndex, treatAllAsVisible: true);
			float x2 = (float)distanceToRightColumnIn256ths * 100f / (float)worksheet.GetColumnWidthIn256ths(rightColumnIndex, treatAllAsVisible: true);
			long distanceToTopRow = bounds.Top;
			long distanceToBottomRow = bounds.Bottom;
			worksheet.Rows.GetIndexesOfRows(ref distanceToTopRow, ref distanceToBottomRow, out var topRowIndex, out var bottomRowIndex, treatAllAsVisible);
			float y = (float)distanceToTopRow * 100f / (float)worksheet.GetRowHeightInTwips(topRowIndex, treatAllAsVisible: true);
			float y2 = (float)distanceToBottomRow * 100f / (float)worksheet.GetRowHeightInTwips(bottomRowIndex, treatAllAsVisible: true);
			topLeftCornerPosition = new PointF(x, y);
			bottomRightCornerPosition = new PointF(x2, y2);
			int num = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(worksheet.CurrentFormat) - 1;
			int num2 = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(worksheet.CurrentFormat) - 1;
			if (num < topRowIndex)
			{
				topRowIndex = num;
			}
			if (num < bottomRowIndex)
			{
				bottomRowIndex = num;
			}
			if (num2 < leftColumnIndex)
			{
				leftColumnIndex = num2;
			}
			if (num2 < rightColumnIndex)
			{
				rightColumnIndex = num2;
			}
			topLeftCornerCell = new WorksheetCellAddress(topRowIndex, (short)leftColumnIndex);
			bottomRightCornerCell = new WorksheetCellAddress(bottomRowIndex, (short)rightColumnIndex);
		}

		private void SetBoundsInTwips(Worksheet worksheet, Rectangle bounds, PositioningOptions options, bool callOnBoundsChanged)
		{
			PointF pointF = topLeftCornerPosition;
			PointF pointF2 = bottomRightCornerPosition;
			WorksheetCellAddress worksheetCellAddress = topLeftCornerCell;
			WorksheetCellAddress worksheetCellAddress2 = bottomRightCornerCell;
			SetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, bounds, out topLeftCornerCell, out topLeftCornerPosition, out bottomRightCornerCell, out bottomRightCornerPosition, options);
			bottomRightCornerCellWorksheet = worksheet;
			topLeftCornerCellWorksheet = worksheet;
			if (callOnBoundsChanged)
			{
				callOnBoundsChanged = worksheetCellAddress2 != bottomRightCornerCell || worksheetCellAddress != topLeftCornerCell || pointF != topLeftCornerPosition || pointF2 != bottomRightCornerPosition;
			}
			if (callOnBoundsChanged)
			{
				OnBoundsChanged(worksheet, worksheetCellAddress, pointF, worksheetCellAddress2, pointF2);
			}
		}

		internal abstract TResult Accept<TArg, TResult>(IWorksheetShapeVisitor<TArg, TResult> visitor, TArg argument = default(TArg));

		internal static ST_ShapeType? ConvertShapeType(ShapeType excel2003ShapeType)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (excel2003ShapeType == ShapeType.NotPrimitive)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!excel2007ShapeTypeByExcel2003ShapeType.TryGetValue(excel2003ShapeType, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal static ShapeType? ConvertShapeType(ST_ShapeType excel2007ShapeType)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!excel2003ShapeTypeByExcel2007ShapeType.TryGetValue(excel2007ShapeType, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal static Rectangle GetBoundsInTwips(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetCellAddress topLeftCornerCell, PointF topLeftCornerPosition, WorksheetCellAddress bottomRightCornerCell, PointF bottomRightCornerPosition)
		{
			return GetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, topLeftCornerCell, topLeftCornerPosition, bottomRightCornerCell, bottomRightCornerPosition, PositioningOptions.None);
		}

		internal static Rectangle GetBoundsInTwips(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetCellAddress topLeftCornerCell, PointF topLeftCornerPosition, WorksheetCellAddress bottomRightCornerCell, PointF bottomRightCornerPosition, PositioningOptions options)
		{
			if (topLeftCornerCell == WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference || bottomRightCornerCell == WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference)
			{
				return new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			return GetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, topLeftCornerCell.RowIndex, topLeftCornerCell.ColumnIndex, topLeftCornerPosition, bottomRightCornerCell.RowIndex, bottomRightCornerCell.ColumnIndex, bottomRightCornerPosition, options);
		}

		internal static Rectangle GetBoundsInTwips(Worksheet worksheet, int topRowIndex, short leftColumnIndex, PointF topLeftCornerPosition, int bottomRowIndex, short rightColumnIndex, PointF bottomRightCornerPosition, PositioningOptions options)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			bool treatAllAsVisible = (options & PositioningOptions.IgnoreHiddenRowsAndColumns) != 0;
			worksheet.Columns.GetDistanceToLeftOfColumnsIn256ths(leftColumnIndex, rightColumnIndex, out var distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths, out var distanceToRightColumnIn256ths, treatAllAsVisible);
			float value = (float)worksheet.GetColumnWidthIn256ths(leftColumnIndex, treatAllAsVisible) * Math.Min(topLeftCornerPosition.X, 100f) / 100f;
			distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths += (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value);
			float value2 = (float)worksheet.GetColumnWidthIn256ths(rightColumnIndex, treatAllAsVisible) * Math.Min(bottomRightCornerPosition.X, 100f) / 100f;
			distanceToRightColumnIn256ths += (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value2);
			int num = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(worksheet.ConvertFromCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Twip, snapToPixels: false));
			int num2 = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(worksheet.ConvertFromCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(distanceToRightColumnIn256ths, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Twip, snapToPixels: false));
			worksheet.Rows.GetDistanceToTopOfRows(topRowIndex, bottomRowIndex, out var distanceToTopRow, out var distanceToBottomRow, treatAllAsVisible);
			float value3 = (float)worksheet.GetRowHeightInTwips(topRowIndex, treatAllAsVisible) * Math.Min(topLeftCornerPosition.Y, 100f) / 100f;
			distanceToTopRow += (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value3);
			float value4 = (float)worksheet.GetRowHeightInTwips(bottomRowIndex, treatAllAsVisible) * Math.Min(bottomRightCornerPosition.Y, 100f) / 100f;
			distanceToBottomRow += (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value4);
			return new Rectangle(num, (int)Math.Min(distanceToTopRow, 2147483647L), num2 - num, (int)Math.Min(distanceToBottomRow - distanceToTopRow, 2147483647L));
		}

		internal virtual void InitializeDefaults()
		{
			if (IsConnector)
			{
				Outline = ShapeOutline.FromColor(Color.FromArgb(255, 74, 126, 187));
			}
			else if (HasFillAndOutlineInitially)
			{
				Fill = ShapeFill.FromColor(Color.FromArgb(255, 79, 129, 189));
				Outline = ShapeOutline.FromColor(Color.FromArgb(255, 56, 93, 138));
			}
			FLocksText = true;
			FLocksWithSheet = true;
			FPrintsWithSheet = true;
		}
