		internal virtual void OnAddingToCollection(WorksheetShapeCollection collection)
		{
			if (this.collection != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ShapeInAnotherCollection"));
			}
			IsLoading(collection);
			Worksheet worksheet = collection.Worksheet;
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				OnSitedOnWorksheet(worksheet);
			}
			this.collection = collection;
		}

		internal void OnAfterWorksheetElementResize(WorksheetElementResizeContext context)
		{
			PointF pointF = TopLeftCornerPosition;
			PointF pointF2 = BottomRightCornerPosition;
			float topLeftPosition;
			float bottomRightPosition;
			if (context.IsVertical)
			{
				topLeftPosition = pointF.Y;
				bottomRightPosition = pointF2.Y;
			}
			else
			{
				topLeftPosition = pointF.X;
				bottomRightPosition = pointF2.X;
			}
			CalculateAdjustmentsForWorksheetElementResize(context, ref topLeftPosition, ref bottomRightPosition, out var absolutePositionOffsetInTwips, out var absoluteExtentOffsetInTwips);
			Rectangle rectangle = boundsBeforeWorksheetElementResizeInTwips;
			if (context.IsVertical)
			{
				pointF = new PointF(pointF.X, topLeftPosition);
				pointF2 = new PointF(pointF2.X, bottomRightPosition);
				rectangle = new Rectangle(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y + absolutePositionOffsetInTwips, rectangle.Width, Math.Max(0, rectangle.Height + absoluteExtentOffsetInTwips));
			}
			else
			{
				pointF = new PointF(topLeftPosition, pointF.Y);
				pointF2 = new PointF(bottomRightPosition, pointF2.Y);
				rectangle = new Rectangle(rectangle.X + absolutePositionOffsetInTwips, rectangle.Y, Math.Max(0, rectangle.Width + absoluteExtentOffsetInTwips), rectangle.Height);
			}
			switch (PositioningMode)
			{
			case ShapePositioningMode.DontMoveOrSizeWithCells:
				SetBoundsInTwips(Worksheet, rectangle);
				break;
			case ShapePositioningMode.MoveAndSizeWithCells:
			{
				PointF oldTopLeftCornerPosition2 = TopLeftCornerPosition;
				PointF oldBottomRightCornerPosition2 = BottomRightCornerPosition;
				topLeftCornerPosition = pointF;
				bottomRightCornerPosition = pointF2;
				OnBoundsChanged(Worksheet, TopLeftCornerCellInternal, oldTopLeftCornerPosition2, BottomRightCornerCellInternal, oldBottomRightCornerPosition2);
				break;
			}
			case ShapePositioningMode.MoveWithCells:
			{
				WorksheetCellAddress worksheetCellAddress = topLeftCornerCell;
				PointF oldTopLeftCornerPosition = topLeftCornerPosition;
				WorksheetCellAddress oldBottomRightCornerCell = bottomRightCornerCell;
				PointF oldBottomRightCornerPosition = bottomRightCornerPosition;
				SetBoundsInTwips(Worksheet, rectangle, PositioningOptions.None, callOnBoundsChanged: false);
				if (topLeftCornerCell != worksheetCellAddress || 100f < topLeftCornerPosition.X || 100f < topLeftCornerPosition.Y)
				{
					topLeftCornerCell = worksheetCellAddress;
					topLeftCornerPosition = pointF;
				}
				OnBoundsChanged(Worksheet, worksheetCellAddress, oldTopLeftCornerPosition, oldBottomRightCornerCell, oldBottomRightCornerPosition);
				break;
			}
			}
			boundsBeforeWorksheetElementResizeInTwips = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
		}

		internal bool OnBeforeShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, WorksheetRegionAddress deletedRegionAddress)
		{
			if (PositioningMode != ShapePositioningMode.MoveAndSizeWithCells)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (topLeftCornerCell.ColumnIndex >= deletedRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex && topLeftCornerCell.RowIndex >= deletedRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex && bottomRightCornerCell.ColumnIndex <= deletedRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex && bottomRightCornerCell.RowIndex <= deletedRegionAddress.LastRowIndex)
			{
				Worksheet.Shapes.Remove(this);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnBeforeWorksheetElementResize()
		{
			if (PositioningMode != ShapePositioningMode.MoveAndSizeWithCells)
			{
				boundsBeforeWorksheetElementResizeInTwips = GetBoundsInTwips();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnBoundsChanged(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetCellAddress oldTopLeftCornerCell, PointF oldTopLeftCornerPosition, WorksheetCellAddress oldBottomRightCornerCell, PointF oldBottomRightCornerPosition)
		{
			if (collection != null)
			{
				collection.Owner.OnChildShapeBoundsChanged(this);
			}
		}

		internal void OnDrawingProperties1Changed()
		{
			if (DrawingProperties1 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue item in DrawingProperties1)
			{
				PropertyType propertyType = item.PropertyType;
				if (propertyType == PropertyType.GroupShapePrint && item.Value is uint)
				{
					uint num = (uint)item.Value;
					Visible = (num & 2) == 0;
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			collection = null;
		}

		internal virtual void OnSitedOnWorksheet(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (topLeftCornerCellWorksheet != worksheet)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_TopLeftAnchorFromOtherWorksheet"));
			}
			if (bottomRightCornerCellWorksheet != worksheet)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_BottomRightAnchorFromOtherWorksheet"));
			}
		}

		internal void PopulateColorProperties(WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo, PropertyType colorPropertyType, PropertyType opacityPropertyType)
		{
			PropertyTable1.EncodeColor(DrawingProperties1, colorInfo.GetResolvedColorInternal(Worksheet.Workbook, forceOpaque: false).ToNative(), colorPropertyType, opacityPropertyType);
		}

		internal virtual void PopulateObjRecords()
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = new Obj(this);
			}
		}

		internal void SetAnchors(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetCellAddress topLeftCell, PointF topLeftPosition, WorksheetCellAddress bottomRightCell, PointF bottomRightPosition)
		{
			WorksheetCellAddress oldTopLeftCornerCell = topLeftCornerCell;
			PointF oldTopLeftCornerPosition = topLeftCornerPosition;
			WorksheetCellAddress oldBottomRightCornerCell = bottomRightCornerCell;
			PointF oldBottomRightCornerPosition = bottomRightCornerPosition;
			topLeftCornerCellWorksheet = worksheet;
			bottomRightCornerCellWorksheet = worksheet;
			topLeftCornerCell = topLeftCell;
			topLeftCornerPosition = topLeftPosition;
			bottomRightCornerCell = bottomRightCell;
			bottomRightCornerPosition = bottomRightPosition;
			OnBoundsChanged(worksheet, oldTopLeftCornerCell, oldTopLeftCornerPosition, oldBottomRightCornerCell, oldBottomRightCornerPosition);
		}

		internal void SetPositioningMode(ShapePositioningMode value, bool verifyIsDefined)
		{
			positioningModeHasBeenSet = true;
			if (positioningMode != value)
			{
				if (verifyIsDefined && !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ShapePositioningMode), value))
				{
					throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(ShapePositioningMode));
				}
				VerifyPositioningMode(value);
				positioningMode = value;
			}
		}

		internal ShiftAddressResult ShiftShape(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride, Rectangle originalBounds)
		{
			WorksheetCellAddress shiftedTopLeftCellAddress;
			PointF shiftedTopLeftCellPosition;
			WorksheetCellAddress shiftedBottomRightCellAddress;
			PointF shiftedBottomRightCellPosition;
			ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult = ShiftShapeHelper(shiftOperation, operationOverride, originalBounds, out shiftedTopLeftCellAddress, out shiftedTopLeftCellPosition, out shiftedBottomRightCellAddress, out shiftedBottomRightCellPosition);
			if (shiftAddressResult.DidShift && !shiftAddressResult.IsDeleted)
			{
				SetAnchors(topLeftCornerCellWorksheet, shiftedTopLeftCellAddress, shiftedTopLeftCellPosition, shiftedBottomRightCellAddress, shiftedBottomRightCellPosition);
			}
			return shiftAddressResult;
		}

		internal ShiftAddressResult ShiftShapeHelper(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride, Rectangle originalBounds, out WorksheetCellAddress shiftedTopLeftCellAddress, out PointF shiftedTopLeftCellPosition, out WorksheetCellAddress shiftedBottomRightCellAddress, out PointF shiftedBottomRightCellPosition)
		{
			shiftedBottomRightCellAddress = bottomRightCornerCell;
			shiftedBottomRightCellPosition = bottomRightCornerPosition;
			shiftedTopLeftCellAddress = topLeftCornerCell;
			shiftedTopLeftCellPosition = topLeftCornerPosition;
			if (PositioningMode == ShapePositioningMode.DontMoveOrSizeWithCells)
			{
				SetBoundsInTwips(shiftOperation.Worksheet, originalBounds, out shiftedTopLeftCellAddress, out shiftedTopLeftCellPosition, out shiftedBottomRightCellAddress, out shiftedBottomRightCellPosition, PositioningOptions.None);
				if (shiftedTopLeftCellAddress == topLeftCornerCell && shiftedTopLeftCellPosition == topLeftCornerPosition && shiftedBottomRightCellAddress == bottomRightCornerCell && shiftedBottomRightCellPosition == bottomRightCornerPosition)
				{
					return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
				}
				return ShiftAddressResult.DidShiftResult;
			}
			WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress = new WorksheetRegionAddress(shiftedTopLeftCellAddress.RowIndex, shiftedTopLeftCellAddress.RowIndex, shiftedTopLeftCellAddress.ColumnIndex, shiftedBottomRightCellAddress.ColumnIndex);
			WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress2 = new WorksheetRegionAddress(shiftedBottomRightCellAddress.RowIndex, shiftedBottomRightCellAddress.RowIndex, shiftedTopLeftCellAddress.ColumnIndex, shiftedBottomRightCellAddress.ColumnIndex);
			ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult = shiftOperation.ShiftRegionAddress(ref regionAddress, operationOverride, leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet: false);
			ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult2 = shiftOperation.ShiftRegionAddress(ref regionAddress2, operationOverride, leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet: false);
			if (shiftAddressResult.DidShift)
			{
				ShiftShapeEdge(shiftOperation, regionAddress.FirstRowIndex, shiftAddressResult, ref shiftedTopLeftCellAddress, ref shiftedTopLeftCellPosition);
				if (PositioningMode == ShapePositioningMode.MoveWithCells)
				{
					Rectangle boundsInTwips = GetBoundsInTwips(shiftOperation.Worksheet, shiftedTopLeftCellAddress, shiftedTopLeftCellPosition, shiftedTopLeftCellAddress, shiftedTopLeftCellPosition, PositioningOptions.None);
					SetBoundsInTwips(bounds: new Rectangle(boundsInTwips.X, boundsInTwips.Y, originalBounds.Width, originalBounds.Height), worksheet: shiftOperation.Worksheet, topLeftCornerCell: out shiftedTopLeftCellAddress, topLeftCornerPosition: out shiftedTopLeftCellPosition, bottomRightCornerCell: out shiftedBottomRightCellAddress, bottomRightCornerPosition: out shiftedBottomRightCellPosition, options: PositioningOptions.None);
					return ShiftAddressResult.DidShiftResult;
				}
				if (shiftAddressResult2.DidShift)
				{
					if (shiftAddressResult2.IsDeleted && (shiftAddressResult.IsDeleted || shiftAddressResult2.DeleteReason == CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetBottom))
					{
						shiftedTopLeftCellAddress = WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference;
						shiftedBottomRightCellAddress = WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference;
						return shiftAddressResult2;
					}
					ShiftShapeEdge(shiftOperation, regionAddress2.FirstRowIndex, shiftAddressResult2, ref shiftedBottomRightCellAddress, ref shiftedBottomRightCellPosition);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (PositioningMode == ShapePositioningMode.MoveWithCells)
				{
					return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
				}
				if (!shiftAddressResult2.DidShift)
				{
					return ShiftAddressResult.NoShiftResult;
				}
				ShiftShapeEdge(shiftOperation, regionAddress2.FirstRowIndex, shiftAddressResult2, ref shiftedBottomRightCellAddress, ref shiftedBottomRightCellPosition);
			}
			if (shiftedBottomRightCellAddress.RowIndex < shiftedTopLeftCellAddress.RowIndex)
			{
				shiftedBottomRightCellAddress = shiftedBottomRightCellAddress.WithRowIndex(shiftedTopLeftCellAddress.RowIndex);
				shiftedBottomRightCellPosition = new PointF(shiftedBottomRightCellPosition.X, shiftedTopLeftCellPosition.Y);
			}
			return shiftAddressResult2;
		}

		private static void ShiftShapeEdge(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, int newRowIndex, ShiftAddressResult shiftResult, ref WorksheetCellAddress anchorCellAddress, ref PointF anchorCellPosition)
		{
			if (shiftResult.IsDeleted)
			{
				if (shiftResult.DeleteReason == CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftUpCoveredAddress || shiftResult.DeleteReason == CellShiftDeleteReason.ShiftedOffWorksheetTop)
				{
					anchorCellAddress = anchorCellAddress.WithRowIndex(shiftOperation.RegionAddressAfterShift.FirstRowIndex);
					anchorCellPosition = new PointF(anchorCellPosition.X, 0f);
				}
				else
				{
					anchorCellAddress = anchorCellAddress.WithRowIndex(shiftOperation.RegionAddressAfterShift.LastRowIndex);
					anchorCellPosition = new PointF(anchorCellPosition.X, 100f);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				anchorCellAddress = anchorCellAddress.WithRowIndex(newRowIndex);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void VerifyOrientationChange()
		{
		}

		internal virtual void VerifyPositioningMode(ShapePositioningMode value)
		{
		}

		private static void AddMapping(ShapeType excel2003ShapeType, ST_ShapeType excel2007ShapeType)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (excel2003ShapeType != ShapeType.NotPrimitive)
			{
				excel2003ShapeTypeByExcel2007ShapeType.Add(excel2007ShapeType, excel2003ShapeType);
				excel2007ShapeTypeByExcel2003ShapeType.Add(excel2003ShapeType, excel2007ShapeType);
			}
		}

		private int AdjustPositionInAnchorCellForWorksheetElementResize(WorksheetElementResizeContext context, int anchorCellIndex, ref float position)
		{
			bool originalHiddenState = context.GetOriginalHiddenState(anchorCellIndex);
			int originalNativeExtent = context.GetOriginalNativeExtent(anchorCellIndex, treatAllAsVisible: true);
			bool currentHiddenState = context.GetCurrentHiddenState(anchorCellIndex);
			int num = ((!originalHiddenState) ? originalNativeExtent : 0);
			int currentNativeExtent = context.GetCurrentNativeExtent(anchorCellIndex, treatAllAsVisible: true);
			int num2 = ((!currentHiddenState) ? currentNativeExtent : 0);
			float num3 = (float)originalNativeExtent * position / 100f;
			int num4 = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(Math.Min(num, num3));
			int num5 = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(Math.Min(num2, num3));
			position = 100f * num3 / (float)currentNativeExtent;
			if (originalHiddenState && !currentHiddenState)
			{
				return context.ConvertNativeExtentToTwips(num5);
			}
			if (!originalHiddenState && currentHiddenState)
			{
				return -context.ConvertNativeExtentToTwips(num4);
			}
			if (currentHiddenState)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (num4 <= num5)
			{
				return context.ConvertNativeExtentToTwips(num5 - num4);
			}
			return -context.ConvertNativeExtentToTwips(num4 - num5);
		}

		private void CalculateAdjustmentsForWorksheetElementResize(WorksheetElementResizeContext context, ref float topLeftPosition, ref float bottomRightPosition, out int absolutePositionOffsetInTwips, out int absoluteExtentOffsetInTwips)
		{
			absolutePositionOffsetInTwips = 0;
			absoluteExtentOffsetInTwips = 0;
			if (PositioningMode == ShapePositioningMode.MoveAndSizeWithCells || PositioningMode == ShapePositioningMode.MoveWithCells)
			{
				int num = (context.IsVertical ? TopLeftCornerCell.RowIndex : TopLeftCornerCell.ColumnIndex);
				if (context.FirstIndex < num)
				{
					int firstIndex = context.FirstIndex;
					int lastIndex = Math.Min(context.LastIndex, num - 1);
					int num2 = context.ConvertNativeExtentToTwips(context.GetOriginalNativeExtent(firstIndex, lastIndex));
					int num3 = context.ConvertNativeExtentToTwips(context.GetCurrentNativeExtent(firstIndex, lastIndex));
					absolutePositionOffsetInTwips += num3 - num2;
				}
				if (context.FirstIndex <= num && num <= context.LastIndex)
				{
					absolutePositionOffsetInTwips += AdjustPositionInAnchorCellForWorksheetElementResize(context, num, ref topLeftPosition);
				}
			}
			if (PositioningMode == ShapePositioningMode.MoveAndSizeWithCells)
			{
				int num4 = (context.IsVertical ? BottomRightCornerCell.RowIndex : BottomRightCornerCell.ColumnIndex);
				if (context.FirstIndex <= num4 && num4 <= context.LastIndex)
				{
					absoluteExtentOffsetInTwips = AdjustPositionInAnchorCellForWorksheetElementResize(context, num4, ref bottomRightPosition);
				}
			}
		}

		private static int GetNumberOfMissingRowsOrColumns(int missingExtent, int defaultItemExtent, int maxItems)
		{
			if (defaultItemExtent <= 0)
			{
				return maxItems;
			}
			return missingExtent / defaultItemExtent;
		}

		private void VerifyAnchorCell(WorksheetCell value)
		{
			if (value == null && collection != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_AnchorCell"));
			}
			if (value != null && value.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"), "cell");
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = Worksheet;
			if (worksheet != null && value != null && value.Worksheet != worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_AnchorCellFromOtherWorksheet"), "value");
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyAnchorPosition(PointF value)
		{
			if ((double)value.X < 0.0 || (double)value.Y < 0.0)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_AnchorPosition"));
			}
		}

		private bool IsLoading(WorksheetShapeCollection collection)
		{
			return ((collection != null) ? (collection.Owner as WorksheetShapeGroup) : null)?.Loading ?? false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class WorksheetShapeWithText : WorksheetShape, IFormattedTextOwner, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver
	{
		internal const int DefaultHorizontalMargin = 144;

		internal const int DefaultVerticalMargin = 72;

		internal const int MaxExcelTextLength = 32767;

		private int bottomMargin = 72;

		private int leftMargin = 144;

		private int rightMargin = 144;

		private FormattedText text;

		private int topMargin = 72;

		internal bool HasText
		{
			get
			{
				if (text != null)
				{
					return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text.ToString());
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public FormattedText Text
		{
			get
			{
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				if (text != value)
				{
					value?.VerifyNewOwner(this);
					if (text != null)
					{
						text.Owner = null;
					}
					text = value;
					if (text != null)
					{
						text.Owner = this;
					}
					((IFormattedTextOwner)this).OnUnformattedStringChanged(text);
				}
			}
		}

		internal int LeftMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return leftMargin;
			}
			set
			{
				leftMargin = value;
			}
		}

		internal int TopMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return topMargin;
			}
			set
			{
				topMargin = value;
			}
		}

		internal int RightMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return rightMargin;
			}
			set
			{
				rightMargin = value;
			}
		}

		internal int BottomMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return bottomMargin;
			}
			set
			{
				bottomMargin = value;
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetShapeWithText()
			: this(initializeDefaults: true)
		{
		}

		internal WorksheetShapeWithText(bool initializeDefaults)
			: base(initializeDefaults)
		{
		}

		internal WorksheetShapeWithText(WorksheetShape shape)
			: base(shape)
		{
			if (shape is WorksheetShapeWithText worksheetShapeWithText)
			{
				bottomMargin = worksheetShapeWithText.bottomMargin;
				leftMargin = worksheetShapeWithText.leftMargin;
				rightMargin = worksheetShapeWithText.rightMargin;
				topMargin = worksheetShapeWithText.topMargin;
				if (worksheetShapeWithText.Text != null)
				{
					Text = worksheetShapeWithText.Text.Clone();
				}
			}
		}

		void IFormattedTextOwner.OnFormattingChanged(FormattedText sender)
		{
		}

		void IFormattedTextOwner.OnUnformattedStringChanged(FormattedText sender)
		{
			if (this.text != null)
			{
				string text = this.text.ToString();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text.Length > 32767)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_TextLengthGreaterThanMax"), 32767));
				}
			}
			VerifyTextFormattingRuns();
		}

		void IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver.ResolveDefaults(WorkbookFontData font)
		{
			if (font.ColorInfo == null)
			{
				font.ColorInfo = new WorkbookColorInfo(WorkbookThemeColorType.Light1);
			}
			UltimateFontDefaultsResolver.Instance.ResolveDefaults(font);
		}

		internal override void OnAddingToCollection(WorksheetShapeCollection collection)
		{
			base.OnAddingToCollection(collection);
			VerifyTextFormattingRuns();
		}

		internal override void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			if (text != null)
			{
				text.SetWorksheet(null);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnSitedOnWorksheet(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			base.OnSitedOnWorksheet(worksheet);
			if (text != null)
			{
				text.SetWorksheet(worksheet);
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyTextFormattingRuns()
		{
			if (text != null && text.Paragraphs.Count <= 0 && Worksheet != null)
			{
				text.Paragraphs.Add(string.Empty);
			}
		}
	}
}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel
{
	public class PrintAreasCollection : ICollection<WorksheetRegion>, IEnumerable<WorksheetRegion>, IEnumerable
	{
		private bool _isUpdatingNamedReference;

		private List<WorksheetRegion> regions;

		private PrintOptions owner;

		bool ICollection<WorksheetRegion>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => regions.Count;

		public WorksheetRegion this[int index] => regions[index];

		internal PrintAreasCollection(PrintOptions owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			regions = new List<WorksheetRegion>();
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetRegion>.CopyTo(WorksheetRegion[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			regions.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		IEnumerator<WorksheetRegion> IEnumerable<WorksheetRegion>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return regions.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<WorksheetRegion>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(WorksheetRegion printArea)
		{
			if (printArea == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("printArea");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < regions.Count; i++)
			{
				if (regions[i].IntersectsWith(printArea))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PA_PrintAreasCannotOverlap"));
				}
			}
			InternalAdd(printArea, suppressNotifications: false);
		}

		internal void InternalAdd(WorksheetRegion printArea, bool suppressNotifications)
		{
			InternalInsert(regions.Count, printArea, suppressNotifications);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (Count != 0)
			{
				for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					RemoveHelper(num, calledFromClear: true);
				}
				NotifyPrintAreaNamedReference(suppressNotifications: false);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetRegion printArea)
		{
			if (printArea == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return regions.Contains(printArea);
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetRegion printArea)
		{
			if (printArea == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("printArea");
			}
			int num = regions.IndexOf(printArea);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			RemoveHelper(index, calledFromClear: false);
			NotifyPrintAreaNamedReference(suppressNotifications: false);
		}

		internal void AddHelper(WorksheetRegion printArea)
		{
			regions.Add(printArea);
		}

		internal void ClearInternal()
		{
			regions.Clear();
		}

		internal WorksheetRegion GetPrintArea(int indexInPrintArea, int? min, int? max, bool isVertical)
		{
			if (!min.HasValue && !max.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Worksheet associatedWorksheet = owner.AssociatedWorksheet;
			if (min.HasValue)
			{
				_ = min.Value;
			}
			if (!max.HasValue)
			{
				if (!isVertical)
				{
					_ = associatedWorksheet.Columns.MaxCount;
				}
				else
				{
					_ = associatedWorksheet.Rows.MaxCount;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_ = max.Value;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < regions.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = regions[i];
				if (isVertical)
				{
					if (worksheetRegion.FirstRow == min)
					{
						int lastRow = worksheetRegion.LastRow;
						int? num = max;
						if (lastRow == num.GetValueOrDefault() && num.HasValue && worksheetRegion.FirstColumn <= indexInPrintArea && indexInPrintArea <= worksheetRegion.LastColumn)
						{
							return worksheetRegion;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (worksheetRegion.FirstColumn == min)
				{
					int lastColumn = worksheetRegion.LastColumn;
					int? num2 = max;
					if (lastColumn == num2.GetValueOrDefault() && num2.HasValue && worksheetRegion.FirstRow <= indexInPrintArea && indexInPrintArea <= worksheetRegion.LastRow)
					{
						return worksheetRegion;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void SynchronizeWithNamedReference(RefBase reference, bool clearExisting)
		{
			if (_isUpdatingNamedReference)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (clearExisting)
			{
				ClearInternal();
			}
			if (reference is RegionGroupCalcReference)
			{
				WorksheetRegion[] referencedRegions = NamedReference.GetReferencedRegions(reference as RegionGroupCalcReference);
				for (int i = 0; i < referencedRegions.Length; i++)
				{
					InternalAdd(referencedRegions[i], suppressNotifications: true);
				}
			}
			else if (reference is RegionCalcReference)
			{
				WorksheetRegion referencedRegion = NamedReference.GetReferencedRegion(reference as RegionCalcReference);
				InternalAdd(referencedRegion, suppressNotifications: true);
			}
			else if (reference is CellCalcReference)
			{
				WorksheetCell referencedCell = NamedReference.GetReferencedCell(reference as CellCalcReference);
				InternalAdd(referencedCell.GetCachedRegion(), suppressNotifications: true);
			}
		}

		private void InternalInsert(int index, WorksheetRegion value, bool suppressNotifications)
		{
			regions.Insert(index, value);
			NotifyPrintAreaNamedReference(suppressNotifications);
		}

		private void NotifyPrintAreaNamedReference(bool suppressNotifications)
		{
			_isUpdatingNamedReference = true;
			try
			{
				owner.UpdatePrintAreasNamedReference(suppressNotifications);
			}
			finally
			{
				_isUpdatingNamedReference = false;
			}
		}

		private void RemoveHelper(int index, bool calledFromClear)
		{
			WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = this[index];
			for (int num = owner.HorizontalPageBreaks.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (owner.HorizontalPageBreaks[num].PrintArea == worksheetRegion)
				{
					owner.HorizontalPageBreaks.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			for (int num2 = owner.VerticalPageBreaks.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if (owner.VerticalPageBreaks[num2].PrintArea == worksheetRegion)
				{
					owner.VerticalPageBreaks.RemoveAt(num2);
				}
			}
			regions.RemoveAt(index);
		}
	}

		public void ClearPageBreaks()
		{
			if (horizontalPageBreaks != null)
			{
				horizontalPageBreaks.Clear();
			}
			if (verticalPageBreaks != null)
			{
				verticalPageBreaks.Clear();
			}
		}

		public void InsertPageBreak(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			if (cell == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("cell");
			}
			if (cell.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"), "cell");
			}
			int columnIndex = cell.ColumnIndex;
			int rowIndex = cell.RowIndex;
			if (columnIndex == 0 && rowIndex == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_PageBreakCantBeA1Cell"));
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = cell.Worksheet;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			_ = worksheet.Columns.MaxCount;
			_ = worksheet.Rows.MaxCount;
			WorksheetRegion printArea = null;
			if (printAreas != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < printAreas.Count; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = printAreas[i];
					if (worksheetRegion.Contains(cell))
					{
						num = worksheetRegion.FirstColumn;
						num2 = worksheetRegion.FirstRow;
						_ = worksheetRegion.LastColumn;
						_ = worksheetRegion.LastRow;
						printArea = worksheetRegion;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (columnIndex > num)
			{
				VerticalPageBreaks.AddInternal(new VerticalPageBreak(columnIndex, printArea), throwIfPresent: false);
			}
			if (rowIndex > num2)
			{
				HorizontalPageBreaks.AddInternal(new HorizontalPageBreak(rowIndex, printArea), throwIfPresent: false);
			}
		}

		public void InsertPageBreak(WorksheetColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("column");
			}
			if (column.Index == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_PageBreakCantBeBeforeLeftColumn"));
			}
			WorksheetRegion printArea = null;
			WorksheetRegion cachedRegion = associatedWorksheet.GetCachedRegion(0, column.Index, associatedWorksheet.Rows.MaxCount - 1, column.Index);
			if (printAreas != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < printAreas.Count; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = printAreas[i];
					if (worksheetRegion.Contains(cachedRegion))
					{
						if (worksheetRegion.FirstColumn == column.Index)
						{
							return;
						}
						printArea = worksheetRegion;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			VerticalPageBreaks.AddInternal(new VerticalPageBreak(column.Index, printArea), throwIfPresent: false);
		}

		public void InsertPageBreak(WorksheetRow row)
		{
			if (row == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("row");
			}
			if (row.Index == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_PB_PageBreakCantBeBeforeTopRow"));
			}
			WorksheetRegion printArea = null;
			WorksheetRegion cachedRegion = associatedWorksheet.GetCachedRegion(row.Index, 0, row.Index, associatedWorksheet.Columns.MaxCount - 1);
			if (printAreas != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < printAreas.Count; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = printAreas[i];
					if (worksheetRegion.Contains(cachedRegion))
					{
						if (worksheetRegion.FirstRow == row.Index)
						{
							return;
						}
						printArea = worksheetRegion;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			HorizontalPageBreaks.AddInternal(new HorizontalPageBreak(row.Index, printArea), throwIfPresent: false);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			bottomMargin = 0.75;
			centerHorizontally = false;
			centerVertically = false;
			columnsToRepeatAtLeft = null;
			draftQuality = false;
			footer = string.Empty;
			footerMargin = 0.3;
			header = string.Empty;
			headerMargin = 0.3;
			leftMargin = 0.7;
			maxPagesHorizontally = 1;
			maxPagesVertically = 1;
			numberOfCopies = 1;
			orientation = Orientation.Default;
			pageOrder = PageOrder.DownThenOver;
			pageNumbering = PageNumbering.Automatic;
			paperSize = PaperSize.Letter;
			printErrors = PrintErrors.PrintAsDisplayed;
			printGridlines = false;
			printInBlackAndWhite = false;
			printNotes = PrintNotes.DontPrint;
			printRowAndColumnHeaders = false;
			resolution = 600;
			rightMargin = 0.7;
			rowsToRepeatAtTop = null;
			scalingFactor = 100;
			scalingType = ScalingType.UseScalingFactor;
			startPageNumber = 1;
			topMargin = 0.75;
			verticalResolution = 600;
			AlignHeadersAndFootersWithMargins = true;
			ScaleHeadersAndFootersWithDocument = true;
			ClearPageBreaks();
			if (printAreas != null)
			{
				printAreas.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(PrintOptions printOptions)
		{
			bottomMargin = printOptions.bottomMargin;
			centerHorizontally = printOptions.centerHorizontally;
			centerVertically = printOptions.centerVertically;
			columnsToRepeatAtLeft = printOptions.columnsToRepeatAtLeft;
			draftQuality = printOptions.draftQuality;
			footer = printOptions.footer;
			footerMargin = printOptions.footerMargin;
			header = printOptions.header;
			headerMargin = printOptions.headerMargin;
			leftMargin = printOptions.leftMargin;
			maxPagesHorizontally = printOptions.maxPagesHorizontally;
			maxPagesVertically = printOptions.maxPagesVertically;
			numberOfCopies = printOptions.numberOfCopies;
			orientation = printOptions.orientation;
			pageOrder = printOptions.pageOrder;
			pageNumbering = printOptions.pageNumbering;
			paperSize = printOptions.paperSize;
			printErrors = printOptions.printErrors;
			printGridlines = printOptions.printGridlines;
			printInBlackAndWhite = printOptions.printInBlackAndWhite;
			printNotes = printOptions.printNotes;
			printRowAndColumnHeaders = printOptions.printRowAndColumnHeaders;
			resolution = printOptions.resolution;
			rightMargin = printOptions.rightMargin;
			rowsToRepeatAtTop = printOptions.rowsToRepeatAtTop;
			scalingFactor = printOptions.scalingFactor;
			scalingType = printOptions.scalingType;
			startPageNumber = printOptions.startPageNumber;
			topMargin = printOptions.topMargin;
			verticalResolution = printOptions.verticalResolution;
			AlignHeadersAndFootersWithMargins = printOptions.AlignHeadersAndFootersWithMargins;
			ScaleHeadersAndFootersWithDocument = printOptions.ScaleHeadersAndFootersWithDocument;
			ClearPageBreaks();
			if (printAreas != null)
			{
				printAreas.Clear();
			}
			if (printOptions.HasPrintAreas)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < printOptions.PrintAreas.Count; i++)
				{
					PrintAreas.Add(printOptions.PrintAreas[i]);
				}
			}
			if (printOptions.HasHorizontalPageBreaks)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < printOptions.HorizontalPageBreaks.Count; j++)
				{
					HorizontalPageBreaks.Add(printOptions.HorizontalPageBreaks[j]);
				}
			}
			if (printOptions.HasVerticalPageBreaks)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < printOptions.VerticalPageBreaks.Count; k++)
				{
					VerticalPageBreaks.Add(printOptions.VerticalPageBreaks[k]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetScalingFactor(int value, bool throwOnError)
		{
			if (scalingFactor == value)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (throwOnError)
			{
				if (value < 10 || 400 < value)
				{
					throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_ScalingFactor"));
				}
			}
			else if (value == 0)
			{
				value = 100;
			}
			else if (value < 10)
			{
				value = 10;
			}
			else if (400 < value)
			{
				value = 400;
			}
			if (value != scalingFactor)
			{
				scalingFactor = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializePageSetupInfo()
		{
			if (paperSize == PaperSize.Letter && scalingFactor == 100 && startPageNumber == 1 && maxPagesHorizontally == 1 && maxPagesVertically == 1 && pageOrder == PageOrder.DownThenOver && orientation == Orientation.Default && !printInBlackAndWhite && !draftQuality && printNotes == PrintNotes.DontPrint && pageNumbering == PageNumbering.Automatic && printErrors == PrintErrors.PrintAsDisplayed && resolution == 600 && verticalResolution == 600)
			{
				return numberOfCopies != 1;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void UpdatePrintAreasNamedReference(bool suppressNotifications)
		{
			Workbook workbook = associatedWorksheet.Workbook;
			if (workbook == null || _isOwnedByCustomView)
			{
				return;
			}
			NamedReference namedRef = workbook.NamedReferences.Find("Print_Area", associatedWorksheet);
			if (!HasPrintAreas)
			{
				if (namedRef != null)
				{
					workbook.NamedReferences.Remove(namedRef);
				}
				return;
			}
			UpdatePrintAreasNamedReference(workbook, "Print_Area", suppressNotifications, ref namedRef, out var shouldAdd);
			if (shouldAdd)
			{
				workbook.NamedReferences.AddInternal(namedRef, updateDataFromBuiltInReferences: false);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdatePrintAreasNamedReference(Workbook workbook, string name, bool suppressNotifications, ref NamedReference namedRef, out bool shouldAdd)
		{
			shouldAdd = namedRef == null;
			Utilities.CreateReferenceString(null, associatedWorksheet.Name);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("=");
			char unionOperatorResolved = FormulaParser.GetUnionOperatorResolved(workbook.CultureResolved);
			for (int i = 0; i < PrintAreas.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = PrintAreas[i];
				stringBuilder.Append(worksheetRegion.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: true, useRelativeColumn: false, useRelativeRow: false));
				if (i != PrintAreas.Count - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(unionOperatorResolved);
				}
			}
			UpdateSyncedNamedReference(name, stringBuilder.ToString(), suppressNotifications, ref namedRef);
		}

		internal void UpdatePrintTitlesNamedReference(Workbook workbook, string name, bool suppressNotifications, ref NamedReference namedRef, out bool shouldAdd)
		{
			shouldAdd = namedRef == null;
			string text = "=";
			if (columnsToRepeatAtLeft != null)
			{
				WorksheetRegion cachedRegion = associatedWorksheet.GetCachedRegion(0, columnsToRepeatAtLeft.StartIndex, associatedWorksheet.Rows.MaxCount - 1, columnsToRepeatAtLeft.EndIndex);
				text += cachedRegion.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: true, useRelativeColumn: false, useRelativeRow: false);
				if (rowsToRepeatAtTop != null)
				{
					text += FormulaParser.GetUnionOperatorResolved(AssociatedWorksheet.Culture);
				}
			}
			if (rowsToRepeatAtTop != null)
			{
				WorksheetRegion cachedRegion2 = associatedWorksheet.GetCachedRegion(rowsToRepeatAtTop.StartIndex, 0, rowsToRepeatAtTop.EndIndex, associatedWorksheet.Columns.MaxCount - 1);
				text += cachedRegion2.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: true, useRelativeColumn: false, useRelativeRow: false);
			}
			UpdateSyncedNamedReference(name, text, suppressNotifications, ref namedRef);
		}

		private void UpdateSyncedNamedReference(string name, string formula, bool suppressNotifications, ref NamedReference namedRef)
		{
			if (namedRef == null)
			{
				NamedReferenceCollection collection = null;
				if (associatedWorksheet.Workbook != null)
				{
					collection = associatedWorksheet.Workbook.NamedReferences;
				}
				namedRef = new NamedReference(collection, associatedWorksheet);
				namedRef.IsInitializing = true;
				namedRef.SetFormula(formula, CellReferenceMode.A1);
				namedRef.Name = name;
				namedRef.IsInitializing = false;
			}
			else
			{
				if (suppressNotifications)
				{
					namedRef.IsInitializing = true;
				}
				namedRef.SetFormula(formula, CellReferenceMode.A1);
				if (suppressNotifications)
				{
					namedRef.IsInitializing = false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			if (columnsToRepeatAtLeft != null)
			{
				int maxColumnCount = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(testFormat);
				if (columnsToRepeatAtLeft.EndIndex >= maxColumnCount)
				{
					limitErrors.AddError(Utilities.GetString("LE_ColumnsToRepeatAtLeftAreOutsideAvailableRange"));
				}
			}
			if (rowsToRepeatAtTop != null)
			{
				int maxRowCount = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(testFormat);
				if (rowsToRepeatAtTop.EndIndex >= maxRowCount)
				{
					limitErrors.AddError(Utilities.GetString("LE_RowsToRepeatAtTopAreOutsideAvailableRange"));
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePrintTitlesNamedReference(bool suppressNotifications)
		{
			Workbook workbook = associatedWorksheet.Workbook;
			if (workbook == null || _isOwnedByCustomView)
			{
				return;
			}
			NamedReference namedRef = workbook.NamedReferences.Find("Print_Titles", associatedWorksheet);
			if (columnsToRepeatAtLeft == null && rowsToRepeatAtTop == null)
			{
				if (namedRef != null)
				{
					workbook.NamedReferences.Remove(namedRef);
				}
				return;
			}
			UpdatePrintTitlesNamedReference(workbook, "Print_Titles", suppressNotifications: false, ref namedRef, out var shouldAdd);
			if (shouldAdd)
			{
				workbook.NamedReferences.AddInternal(namedRef, suppressNotifications);
			}
		}

		internal void SetColumnsToRepeatAtLeft(RepeatTitleRange value, bool suppressNotifications)
		{
			if (columnsToRepeatAtLeft != value)
			{
				columnsToRepeatAtLeft = value;
				UpdatePrintTitlesNamedReference(suppressNotifications);
			}
		}

		private static void SetColumnsToRepeatAtLeftCore(PrintOptions printOptions, RepeatTitleRange value)
		{
			printOptions.columnsToRepeatAtLeft = value;
			printOptions.UpdatePrintTitlesNamedReference(suppressNotifications: false);
		}

		internal void SetRowsToRepeatAtTop(RepeatTitleRange value, bool suppressNotifications)
		{
			if (rowsToRepeatAtTop != value)
			{
				rowsToRepeatAtTop = value;
				UpdatePrintTitlesNamedReference(suppressNotifications);
			}
		}

		private static void SetRowsToRepeatAtTopCore(PrintOptions printOptions, RepeatTitleRange value)
		{
			printOptions.rowsToRepeatAtTop = value;
			printOptions.UpdatePrintTitlesNamedReference(suppressNotifications: false);
		}
	}
	public enum WorksheetProtectedSelectionMode
	{
		AllCells,
		UnlockedCells,
		NoCells
	}
	[Flags]
	internal enum WorksheetProtectionType
	{
		Objects = 1,
		Scenarios = 2,
		FormatCells = 4,
		FormatColumns = 8,
		FormatRows = 0x10,
		InsertColumns = 0x20,
		InsertRows = 0x40,
		InsertHyperlinks = 0x80,
		DeleteColumns = 0x100,
		DeleteRows = 0x200,
		Sort = 0x400,
		AutoFilter = 0x800,
		PivotTables = 0x1000
	}
	public class WorkbookProtection
	{
		private bool _allowEditStructure = true;

		private bool _allowEditWindows = true;

		private Workbook _workbook;

		internal readonly WorkbookPasswordInfo PasswordInfo;

		public bool AllowEditStructure
		{
			get
			{
				return _allowEditStructure;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_allowEditStructure = value;
			}
		}

		public bool AllowEditWindows
		{
			get
			{
				return _allowEditWindows;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_allowEditWindows = value;
			}
		}

		internal WorkbookProtection(Workbook workbook)
		{
			_workbook = workbook;
			PasswordInfo = new WorkbookPasswordInfo(OnIsProtectedChanged);
		}

		internal void Protect(object password, bool allowEditStructure = false, bool allowEditWindows = true)
		{
			if (!PasswordInfo.IsProtected)
			{
				AllowEditStructure = allowEditStructure;
				AllowEditWindows = allowEditWindows;
				if (!AllowEditStructure || !AllowEditWindows)
				{
					PasswordInfo.Protect(password);
				}
				else
				{
					PasswordInfo.Unprotect();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnIsProtectedChanged()
		{
			if (!PasswordInfo.IsProtected)
			{
				AllowEditStructure = true;
				AllowEditWindows = true;
			}
			_workbook.OnIsProtectedChanged();
		}
	}
	internal class WorksheetProtectedRangeRegionCollection : ICollection<WorksheetRegion>, IEnumerable<WorksheetRegion>, IEnumerable
	{
		private WorksheetProtectedRange _owner;

		private List<WorksheetRegion> _items;

		public int Count => _items.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		internal WorksheetProtectedRangeRegionCollection(WorksheetProtectedRange owner)
		{
			_owner = owner;
			_items = new List<WorksheetRegion>();
		}

		public void Add(WorksheetRegion item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			if (_owner.Worksheet != null && item.Worksheet != _owner.Worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RangeFromOtherWorksheetThanProtectedRange"), "item");
			}
			_items.Add(item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_items.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetRegion item)
		{
			return _items.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(WorksheetRegion[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_items.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetRegion item)
		{
			return _items.Remove(item);
		}

		public IEnumerator<WorksheetRegion> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _items.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public class WorksheetProtectedRangeCollection : ICollection<WorksheetProtectedRange>, IEnumerable<WorksheetProtectedRange>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly List<WorksheetProtectedRange> _ranges;

		private readonly Worksheet _worksheet;

		public int Count => _ranges.Count;

		public WorksheetProtectedRange this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
				{
					throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
				}
				return _ranges[index];
			}
		}

		bool ICollection<WorksheetProtectedRange>.IsReadOnly => false;

		internal WorksheetProtectedRangeCollection(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			_worksheet = worksheet;
			_ranges = new List<WorksheetProtectedRange>();
		}

		public void Add(WorksheetProtectedRange item)
		{
			Insert(Count, item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			VerifyCanChange();
			for (int num = _ranges.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveAtHelper(num);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetProtectedRange range)
		{
			return _ranges.Contains(range);
		}

		public IEnumerator<WorksheetProtectedRange> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _ranges.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Insert(int index, WorksheetProtectedRange range)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count < index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			if (range == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("range");
			}
			if (range.Worksheet != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_EditRangeAlreadyOwned"), "range");
			}
			foreach (WorksheetRegion range2 in range.Ranges)
			{
				if (range2.Worksheet != _worksheet)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_EditRangeHasRangeFromOtherWorksheet"));
				}
			}
			if (Find(range.Title) != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DuplicateWorksheetProtectedRangeTitle", range.Title));
			}
			_ranges.Insert(index, range);
			range.Worksheet = _worksheet;
			range.IsProtected = _worksheet.IsProtected && range.HasPassword;
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetProtectedRange range)
		{
			int num = _ranges.IndexOf(range);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAtHelper(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			RemoveAtHelper(index);
		}

		internal WorksheetProtectedRange Find(string caseInsensitiveTitle)
		{
			using (IEnumerator<WorksheetProtectedRange> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					WorksheetProtectedRange current = enumerator.Current;
					if (string.Equals(caseInsensitiveTitle, current.Title, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						return current;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void RemoveAtHelper(int index)
		{
			WorksheetProtectedRange worksheetProtectedRange = _ranges[index];
			_ranges.RemoveAt(index);
			worksheetProtectedRange.Worksheet = null;
			worksheetProtectedRange.IsProtected = false;
		}

		private void VerifyCanChange()
		{
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetProtectedRange>.CopyTo(WorksheetProtectedRange[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_ranges.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}
	}
	public class WorksheetProtection
	{
		private Worksheet _worksheet;

		private WorksheetProtectedSelectionMode _selectionMode;

		private WorksheetProtectedRangeCollection _allowedEditRanges;

		private WorksheetProtectionType _flags;

		internal readonly WorkbookPasswordInfo PasswordInfo;

		public bool AllowDeletingColumns
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.DeleteColumns);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.DeleteColumns, value);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowDeletingRows
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.DeleteRows);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.DeleteRows, value);
			}
		}

		public WorksheetProtectedRangeCollection AllowedEditRanges => _allowedEditRanges;

		public bool AllowEditObjects
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.Objects);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.Objects, value);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowEditScenarios
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.Scenarios);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.Scenarios, value);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowFiltering
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.AutoFilter);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.AutoFilter, value);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowFormattingCells
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.FormatCells);
			}
			internal set

				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.FormatCells, value);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowFormattingColumns
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.FormatColumns);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.FormatColumns, value);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowFormattingRows
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.FormatRows);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.FormatRows, value);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowInsertingColumns
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.InsertColumns);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.InsertColumns, value);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowInsertingHyperlinks
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.InsertHyperlinks);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.InsertHyperlinks, value);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowInsertingRows
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.InsertRows);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.InsertRows, value);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowSorting
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.Sort);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.Sort, value);
			}
		}

		public bool AllowUsingPivotTables
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.PivotTables);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType.PivotTables, value);
			}
		}

		public WorksheetProtectedSelectionMode SelectionMode
		{
			get
			{
				return _selectionMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _selectionMode)
				{
					_selectionMode = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetProtectionType AllowedFeatures => _flags;

		internal bool SelectLockedCells => SelectionMode == WorksheetProtectedSelectionMode.AllCells;

		internal bool SelectUnlockedCells => SelectionMode != WorksheetProtectedSelectionMode.NoCells;

		internal WorksheetProtection(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			_worksheet = worksheet;
			_allowedEditRanges = new WorksheetProtectedRangeCollection(worksheet);
			PasswordInfo = new WorkbookPasswordInfo(OnIsProtectedChanged);
		}

		internal void InitializeIsProtectedOfRanges()
		{
			foreach (WorksheetProtectedRange allowedEditRange in AllowedEditRanges)
			{
				allowedEditRange.IsProtected = _worksheet.IsProtected && allowedEditRange.HasPassword;
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeSelectionMode(bool selectLockedCells, bool selectUnlockedCells)
		{
			SelectionMode = ((!selectLockedCells) ? (selectUnlockedCells ? WorksheetProtectedSelectionMode.UnlockedCells : WorksheetProtectedSelectionMode.NoCells) : WorksheetProtectedSelectionMode.AllCells);
		}

		internal void Protect(object password, bool? allowDeletingColumns = null, bool? allowDeletingRows = null, bool? allowEditObjects = null, bool? allowEditScenarios = null, bool? allowFiltering = null, bool? allowFormattingCells = null, bool? allowFormattingColumns = null, bool? allowFormattingRows = null, bool? allowInsertingColumns = null, bool? allowInsertingHyperlinks = null, bool? allowInsertingRows = null, bool? allowSorting = null, bool? allowUsingPivotTables = null)
		{
			if (!PasswordInfo.IsProtected)
			{
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.DeleteColumns, allowDeletingColumns);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.DeleteRows, allowDeletingRows);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.Objects, allowEditObjects);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.Scenarios, allowEditScenarios);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.AutoFilter, allowFiltering);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.FormatCells, allowFormattingCells);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.FormatColumns, allowFormattingColumns);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.FormatRows, allowFormattingRows);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.InsertColumns, allowInsertingColumns);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.InsertHyperlinks, allowInsertingHyperlinks);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.InsertRows, allowInsertingRows);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.Sort, allowSorting);
				SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType.PivotTables, allowUsingPivotTables);
				PasswordInfo.Protect(password);
			}
		}

		private bool GetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType flag)
		{
			return (_flags & flag) == flag;
		}

		private void OnIsProtectedChanged()
		{
			InitializeIsProtectedOfRanges();
			_worksheet.OnIsProtectedChanged();
		}

		private void SetFlag(WorksheetProtectionType flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_flags &= ~flag;
			}
		}

		private void SetProperty(WorksheetProtectionType flag, bool? newValue)
		{
			if (newValue.HasValue)
			{
				SetFlag(flag, newValue.Value);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RegionLookupTable<T>
	{
		public struct Result : IDisposable
		{
			public static readonly Result Empty = new Result(null, null);

			private readonly RegionLookupTable<T> _owner;

			public readonly List<T> Items;

			public bool HasItems
			{
				get
				{
					if (Items != null)
					{
						return Items.Count != 0;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public Result(RegionLookupTable<T> owner, List<T> result)
			{
				_owner = owner;
				Items = result;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if (Items != null)
				{
					Items.Clear();
					_owner._listPool.OnItemReleased(Items);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly ObjectPool<HashSet<T>> _hashSetPool = new ObjectPool<HashSet<T>>(() => new HashSet<T>());

		private readonly ObjectPool<List<T>> _listPool = new ObjectPool<List<T>>(() => new List<T>());

		public readonly Func<HashSet<T>> HashSetFactory;

		public readonly Func<List<T>> ListFactory;

		private FixedLengthSegmentTree<T> columnLookupTable;

		private FixedLengthSegmentTree<T> rowLookupTable;

		private Worksheet worksheet;

		public bool IsEmpty => columnLookupTable.IsEmpty;

		public RegionLookupTable(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			HashSetFactory = _hashSetPool.GetItem;
			ListFactory = _listPool.GetItem;
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
			columnLookupTable = new FixedLengthSegmentTree<T>(this, 16384);
			rowLookupTable = new FixedLengthSegmentTree<T>(this, 1048576);
		}

		internal void Add(WorksheetRegion region, T item)
		{
			if (region.Worksheet == worksheet)
			{
				Add(region.Address, item);
			}
		}

		internal void Add(WorksheetRegionAddress address, T item)
		{
			columnLookupTable.Insert(item, address.FirstColumnIndex, address.LastColumnIndex);
			rowLookupTable.Insert(item, address.FirstRowIndex, address.LastRowIndex);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			columnLookupTable.Clear();
			rowLookupTable.Clear();
		}

		public void GetBoundingIndexes(out int firstRowIndex, out int firstColumnIndex, out int lastRowIndex, out int lastColumnIndex)
		{
			rowLookupTable.GetBoundingIndexes(out firstRowIndex, out lastRowIndex);
			columnLookupTable.GetBoundingIndexes(out firstColumnIndex, out lastColumnIndex);
		}

		public Result GetItemsContainingCell(int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
		{
			HashSet<T> itemsContainingValueSet = columnLookupTable.GetItemsContainingValueSet(columnIndex);
			if (itemsContainingValueSet == null)
			{
				return Result.Empty;
			}
			List<T> itemsContainingValue = rowLookupTable.GetItemsContainingValue(rowIndex, itemsContainingValueSet);
			itemsContainingValueSet.Clear();
			_hashSetPool.OnItemReleased(itemsContainingValueSet);
			return new Result(this, itemsContainingValue);
		}

		public Result GetItemsContainingRange(WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			HashSet<T> itemsContainingRangeSet = columnLookupTable.GetItemsContainingRangeSet(region.FirstColumnIndex, region.LastColumnIndex);
			if (itemsContainingRangeSet == null)
			{
				return Result.Empty;
			}
			List<T> itemsContainingRange = rowLookupTable.GetItemsContainingRange(region.FirstRowIndex, region.LastRowIndex, itemsContainingRangeSet);
			itemsContainingRangeSet.Clear();
			_hashSetPool.OnItemReleased(itemsContainingRangeSet);
			return new Result(this, itemsContainingRange);
		}

		public Result GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			return GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(region.FirstRowIndex, region.FirstColumnIndex, region.LastRowIndex, region.LastColumnIndex);
		}

		public Result GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(int firstRow, int firstColumn, int lastRow, int lastColumn)
		{
			HashSet<T> itemsIntersectingWithRangeSet = columnLookupTable.GetItemsIntersectingWithRangeSet(firstColumn, lastColumn);
			if (itemsIntersectingWithRangeSet == null)
			{
				return Result.Empty;
			}
			List<T> itemsIntersectingWithRange = rowLookupTable.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(firstRow, lastRow, itemsIntersectingWithRangeSet);
			itemsIntersectingWithRangeSet.Clear();
			_hashSetPool.OnItemReleased(itemsIntersectingWithRangeSet);
			return new Result(this, itemsIntersectingWithRange);
		}

		internal void Remove(WorksheetRegion region, T item)
		{
			if (region.Worksheet == worksheet)
			{
				Remove(region.Address, item);
			}
		}

		internal void Remove(WorksheetRegionAddress address, T item)
		{
			columnLookupTable.Remove(item, address.FirstColumnIndex, address.LastColumnIndex);
			rowLookupTable.Remove(item, address.FirstRowIndex, address.LastRowIndex);
		}
	}
	public class RepeatTitleRange
	{
		private readonly int endIndex;

		private readonly int startIndex;

		public int EndIndex => endIndex;

		public int StartIndex => startIndex;

		public RepeatTitleRange(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			if (startIndex < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_StartIndexLessThanZero"), "startIndex");
			}
			if (endIndex < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_EndIndexLessThanZero"), "endIndex");
			}
			this.startIndex = Math.Min(startIndex, endIndex);
			this.endIndex = Math.Max(startIndex, endIndex);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is RepeatTitleRange repeatTitleRange))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (repeatTitleRange.startIndex == startIndex)
			{
				return repeatTitleRange.endIndex == endIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return startIndex.GetHashCode() ^ (endIndex.GetHashCode() >> 3);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Repeat range from {startIndex} to {endIndex}";
		}
	}

	public sealed class ExcelResourceCustomizer

			return null;
		}

		public void ResetAllCustomizedStrings()
		{
			if (customizedStrings != null)
			{
				customizedStrings.Clear();
			}

		public void ResetCustomizedString(string name)
		{
			SetCustomizedString(name, null);
		}

		public void SetCustomizedString(string name, string customizedText)
		{
			if (CustomizedStrings.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				CustomizedStrings.Remove(name);
			}
			if (customizedText != null)
			{
				CustomizedStrings.Add(name, customizedText);
			}
		}

	internal abstract class RowColumnBinaryTreeNode<T> : LoadOnDemandTree<T>.BinaryTreeNode where T : RowColumnBase
	{
		private int totalExtent = -1;

		private int totalExtentTreatAllAsVisible = -1;

		public RowColumnBinaryTreeNode(int index, IBinaryTreeNodeOwner<T> parent, LoadOnDemandTree<T> tree)
			: base(index, parent, tree)
		{
		}

		public int CalculateCumulativeHeight(int numberOfItems, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < numberOfItems; i++)
			{
				T val = values[i];
				if (val == null)
				{
					num += unallocatedItemExtent;
				}
				else if (treatAllAsVisible || !val.Hidden)
				{
					int itemExtent = GetItemExtent(val, i);
					num = ((itemExtent >= 0) ? (num + itemExtent) : (num + defaultItemExtent));
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal abstract int GetItemExtent(T item, int relativeIndex);

		public int GetTotalExtent(int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
		{
			if (treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				if (totalExtentTreatAllAsVisible < 0)
				{
					totalExtentTreatAllAsVisible = CalculateCumulativeHeight(32, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible: true);
				}
				return totalExtentTreatAllAsVisible;
			}
			if (totalExtent < 0)
			{
				totalExtent = CalculateCumulativeHeight(32, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible: false);
			}
			return totalExtent;
		}

		public virtual void ResetExtentCache(bool onlyVisibilityChanged)
		{
			totalExtent = -1;
			if (!onlyVisibilityChanged)
			{
				totalExtentTreatAllAsVisible = -1;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class WorksheetItemCollection<T> : ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, ILoadOnDemandTreeOwner<T> where T : class
	{
		private LoadOnDemandTree<T> items;

		private int maxCount;

		private Worksheet worksheet;

		private int lastLoadedIndex = -1;

		int ICollection<T>.Count => Count;

		bool ICollection<T>.IsReadOnly => true;

		protected internal abstract int MaxCount { get; }

		internal byte ChangeVersion => items.ChangeVersion;

		internal virtual int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (items == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return items.Count;
			}
		}

		internal LoadOnDemandTree<T> ItemsInternal => items;

		internal int LastLoadedIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return lastLoadedIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				lastLoadedIndex = value;
			}
		}

		internal Worksheet Worksheet => worksheet;

		internal WorksheetItemCollection(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
			maxCount = MaxCount;
			items = CreateLoadOnDemandTree();
		}

		void ICollection<T>.Add(T item)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantModifyCollection"));
		}

		void ICollection<T>.Clear()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantModifyCollection"));
		}

		bool ICollection<T>.Contains(T item)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((ICollection<T>)items).Contains(item);
		}

		void ICollection<T>.CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			if (items != null)
			{
				((ICollection<T>)items).CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
			}
		}

		bool ICollection<T>.Remove(T item)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantModifyCollection"));
		}

		IEnumerator<T> IEnumerable<T>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumeratorHelper();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<T>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		T ILoadOnDemandTreeOwner<T>.CreateValue(int index)
		{
			return CreateValue(index);
		}

		int ILoadOnDemandTreeOwner<T>.GetItemIndex(T item)
		{
			return GetItemIndex(item);
		}

		void ILoadOnDemandTreeOwner<T>.InitializeItemIndex(T item, int index, bool applyingChangesToTree)
		{
			InitializeItemIndex(item, index, applyingChangesToTree);
		}

		bool ILoadOnDemandTreeOwner<T>.IsItemStillValid(T item)
		{
			return IsItemStillValid(item);
		}

		internal abstract T CreateValue(int index);

		internal abstract int GetItemIndex(T item);

		internal abstract void InitializeItemIndex(T item, int index, bool applyingChangesToTree);

		internal abstract bool IsItemStillValid(T item);

		internal abstract void ThrowIndexOutOfRangeException(int index);

		internal abstract void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat);

		internal int AdjustIndex(int index, byte version)
		{
			return items.AdjustIndex(index, version);
		}

		internal virtual LoadOnDemandTree<T> CreateLoadOnDemandTree()
		{
			return new LoadOnDemandTree<T>(this, maxCount);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<T> GetAllItemsEnumerator()
		{
			if (items != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < maxCount; i++)
				{
					yield return items[i];
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual IEnumerator<T> GetEnumeratorHelper()
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return GetAllItemsEnumerator().GetEnumerator();
			}
			return ((IEnumerable<T>)items).GetEnumerator();
		}

		internal IEnumerable<T> GetItemsInRange(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			return GetItemsInRange(startIndex, endIndex, enumerateForwards: true);
		}

		internal virtual IEnumerable<T> GetItemsInRange(int startIndex, int endIndex, bool enumerateForwards)
		{
			return GetTreeItemsInRange(startIndex, endIndex, enumerateForwards);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<T> GetTreeItemsInRange(int startIndex, int endIndex, bool enumerateForwards = true)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return GetAllItemsEnumerator();
			}
			return items.GetEnumeratorHelper(startIndex, endIndex, enumerateForwards);
		}

		internal T GetItem(int index, bool createIfNotFound = true)
		{
			LoadOnDemandTree<T>.FindState state;
			return items.GetValue(index, createIfNotFound, out state);
		}

		internal void InsertItems(int index, int count)
		{
			items.InsertItems(index, count);
		}

		internal virtual T InternalIndexer(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_IndexNegative"));
			}
			if (index >= maxCount)
			{
				ThrowIndexOutOfRangeException(index);
			}
			return items[index];
		}

		internal virtual void OnCurrentFormatChanged()
		{
			maxCount = MaxCount;
		}

		internal void RemoveItems(int index, int count)
		{
			items.RemoveItems(index, count);
		}

		internal void ProcessCellShiftResult(CellShiftResult shiftResult)
		{
			switch (shiftResult)
			{
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotShift_LossOfData"));
			case CellShiftResult.ErrorLossOfObject:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotShift_LossOfObject"));
			case CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitTable:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotShift_SplitTable"));
			case CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitMergedRegion:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotShift_SplitMergedRegion"));
			case CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitBlockingValue:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotShift_SplitBlockingValue"));
			case CellShiftResult.Success:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal virtual T SetItemAtIndex(T item, int index)
		{
			return items.SetItemAtIndex(item, index);
		}
	}

	internal class RowColumnLoadOnDemandTree<T> : LoadOnDemandTree<T> where T : RowColumnBase
	{
		protected Worksheet worksheet;

		public RowColumnLoadOnDemandTree(RowColumnCollectionBase<T> owner)
			: base((ILoadOnDemandTreeOwner<T>)owner, owner.MaxCount)
		{
			worksheet = owner.Worksheet;
		}

		public void ResetExtentCache(bool onlyVisibilityChanged)
		{
			foreach (RowColumnBinaryTreeNode<T> item in GetNodesEnumerator())
			{
				item.ResetExtentCache(onlyVisibilityChanged);
			}
		}

		public void ResetExtentCache(int index, bool onlyVisibilityChanged)
		{
			if (head != null)
			{
				FindState state;
				RowColumnBinaryTreeNode<T> rowColumnBinaryTreeNode = (RowColumnBinaryTreeNode<T>)head.FindOrAdd(index, ConvertItemIndexToTreeIndex(index), createNodeIfNotFound: false, createItemIfNotFound: false, this, out state);
				if (state == FindState.ValueFound)
				{
					rowColumnBinaryTreeNode.ResetExtentCache(onlyVisibilityChanged);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal abstract class WorkbookReferenceBase
	{
		private Dictionary<Tuple<WorksheetReferenceSingle, WorksheetReferenceSingle>, WorksheetReferenceMulti> multiSheetReferences;

		private Dictionary<string, Dictionary<object, NamedReferenceBase>> namedReferences;

		private ReadOnlyCollection<NamedReferenceBase> namedReferencesReadOnly;

		private List<NamedReferenceBase> namedReferencesOrdered;

		private Workbook targetWorkbook;

		private Dictionary<int, WorksheetReferenceSingle> worksheetReferences;

		public virtual string FileName => null;

		public virtual bool IsConnected => true;

		public abstract bool IsExternal { get; }

		protected abstract FormulaType NamedReferenceFormulaType { get; }

		protected List<NamedReferenceBase> NamedReferencesOrdered
		{
			get
			{
				if (namedReferencesOrdered == null)
				{
					namedReferencesOrdered = new List<NamedReferenceBase>();
				}
				return namedReferencesOrdered;
			}
		}

		public ReadOnlyCollection<NamedReferenceBase> NamedReferences
		{
			get
			{
				if (namedReferencesReadOnly == null)
				{
					namedReferencesReadOnly = NamedReferencesOrdered.AsReadOnly();
				}
				return namedReferencesReadOnly;
			}
		}

		public Workbook TargetWorkbook => targetWorkbook;

		internal virtual object WorkbookScope => this;

		protected WorkbookReferenceBase(Workbook targetWorkbook)
		{
			this.targetWorkbook = targetWorkbook;
		}

		public abstract NamedReferenceBase CreateNamedReference(string name, object scope);

		public abstract WorksheetReferenceSingle CreateWorksheetReference(int worksheetIndex);

		public abstract string GetWorksheetName(int worksheetIndex);

		public abstract WorksheetReferenceSingle GetWorksheetReference(string worksheetName);

		public abstract string GetWorksheetReferenceString(int firstWorksheetIndex, int lastWorksheetIndex, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, bool forceIncludeScopeName);

		public void ClearNamedReferences()
		{
			namedReferences = null;
			namedReferencesOrdered = null;
			namedReferencesReadOnly = null;
		}

		internal virtual WorkbookReferenceBase Connect(FormulaContext context)
		{
			return this;
		}

		internal virtual WorkbookReferenceUnconnected Disconnect()
		{
			return new WorkbookReferenceUnconnected(FileName);
		}

		public WorksheetReference GetMultiSheetReference(WorksheetReferenceSingle firstReference, WorksheetReferenceSingle lastReference)
		{
			Tuple<WorksheetReferenceSingle, WorksheetReferenceSingle> key = Tuple.Create(firstReference, lastReference);
			if (multiSheetReferences == null)
			{
				multiSheetReferences = new Dictionary<Tuple<WorksheetReferenceSingle, WorksheetReferenceSingle>, WorksheetReferenceMulti>();
			}
			if (!multiSheetReferences.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				value = new WorksheetReferenceMulti(firstReference, lastReference);
				multiSheetReferences[key] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public NamedReferenceBase GetNamedReference(string name, object scope, bool createIfNotPresent)
		{
			Dictionary<object, NamedReferenceBase> scopeDictionary = GetScopeDictionary(name);
			if (!scopeDictionary.TryGetValue(scope, out var value) && createIfNotPresent)
			{
				value = CreateNamedReference(name, scope);
				value.SetFormulaInternal(new Formula(1, NamedReferenceFormulaType), synchronizeBuiltInReferences: false);
				scopeDictionary.Add(scope, value);
				NamedReferencesOrdered.Add(value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public string GetWorkbookReferenceString(GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, bool forceIncludeScopeName = false)
		{
			return GetWorksheetReferenceString(-2, -2, getFormulaStringInfo, forceIncludeScopeName);
		}

		public WorksheetReference GetWorksheetReference(string firstWorksheetName, string lastWorksheetName)
		{
			WorksheetReferenceSingle worksheetReference = GetWorksheetReference(firstWorksheetName);
			if (lastWorksheetName == null)
			{
				return worksheetReference;
			}
			WorksheetReferenceSingle worksheetReference2 = GetWorksheetReference(lastWorksheetName);
			return GetMultiSheetReference(worksheetReference, worksheetReference2);
		}

		public WorksheetReferenceSingle GetWorksheetReference(int worksheetIndex)
		{
			if (worksheetReferences == null)
			{
				worksheetReferences = new Dictionary<int, WorksheetReferenceSingle>();
			}
			if (!worksheetReferences.TryGetValue(worksheetIndex, out var value))
			{
				value = CreateWorksheetReference(worksheetIndex);
				worksheetReferences.Add(worksheetIndex, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void OnWorksheetIndexesChanged()
		{
			if (worksheetReferences != null)
			{
				List<WorksheetReferenceSingle> list = new List<WorksheetReferenceSingle>(worksheetReferences.Values);
				worksheetReferences.Clear();
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					WorksheetReferenceSingle worksheetReferenceSingle = list[i];
					worksheetReferences[worksheetReferenceSingle.FirstWorksheetIndex] = worksheetReferenceSingle;
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnWorksheetRemoved(int oldIndex)
		{
			if (worksheetReferences == null || !worksheetReferences.TryGetValue(oldIndex, out var value))
			{
				return;
			}
			worksheetReferences.Remove(oldIndex);
			if (multiSheetReferences != null)
			{
				List<Tuple<WorksheetReferenceSingle, WorksheetReferenceSingle>> list = new List<Tuple<WorksheetReferenceSingle, WorksheetReferenceSingle>>();
				foreach (Tuple<WorksheetReferenceSingle, WorksheetReferenceSingle> key in multiSheetReferences.Keys)
				{
					if (key.Item1 == value || key.Item2 == value)
					{
						list.Add(key);
					}
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					multiSheetReferences.Remove(list[i]);
				}
			}
			OnWorksheetIndexesChanged();
		}

		protected string GetResolvedFileName(GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, out bool isIndexed)
		{
			if (getFormulaStringInfo.ExternalReferences != null && getFormulaStringInfo.ExternalReferences.TryGetValue(this, out var value))
			{
				isIndexed = true;
				return $"[{value}]";
			}
			isIndexed = false;
			return FileName;
		}

		protected Dictionary<object, NamedReferenceBase> GetScopeDictionary(string name)
		{
			if (namedReferences == null)
			{
				CultureInfo culture = Utilities.CurrentCulture;
				if (TargetWorkbook != null)
				{
					culture = TargetWorkbook.CultureResolved;
				}
				namedReferences = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<object, NamedReferenceBase>>(Utilities.StringComparerCreate(culture, ignoreCase: true));
			}
			if (!namedReferences.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				value = new Dictionary<object, NamedReferenceBase>();
				namedReferences.Add(name, value);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

			get

				return parentStream;
			}
			set
			{
				parentStream = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool CanRead => true;

		public override bool CanSeek => true;

		public override bool CanWrite => true;

		public override long Length => length;

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				return position;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isOpen && position != value && value >= 0)
				{
					int num = (int)(value - position);
					int num2 = positionInCurrentBlock + num;
					position = (int)value;
					if (cachedWorkbookStreamPosition == ownerStream.Position && 0 <= num2 && num2 < blocks[currentBlock].BlockLength)
					{
						positionInCurrentBlock = num2;
						cachedWorkbookStreamPosition += num;
						ownerStream.Position = cachedWorkbookStreamPosition;
					}
					else
					{
						SyncPositionMembers();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract int MaximumBlockSize { get; }

		public int BytesAvailableInCurrentBlock
		{

				SyncWorkbookStreamPosition();
				return blocks[currentBlock].MaximumBlockLength - positionInCurrentBlock;
			}
		}

		public long EndUnderlyingStreamPosition
		{
			get
			{
				long num = blocks[blocks.Count - 1].BlockEnd;
				if (subStreams != null)
				{
					foreach (IBiffRecordStream subStream in subStreams)
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, subStream.EndUnderlyingStreamPosition);
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}
