		protected BiffRecordStream(InPlaceTransform transform)
		{
			readBuffer = new byte[8];
			_transform = transform ?? InPlaceTransform.NoTransform;
		}

		protected BiffRecordStream(WorkbookLoadManager loadManager, Stream ownerStream, BinaryReader ownerStreamReader, InPlaceTransform transform)
			: this(transform)
		{
			isFirstBlockHeaderWritten = true;
			isOpen = true;
			LoadManager = loadManager;
			this.ownerStream = ownerStream;
			this.ownerStreamReader = ownerStreamReader;
			recordType = ReadBlockType(ownerStreamReader);
			if (recordType == DefaultRecordId)
			{
				blocks.Add(CreateRecordBlock(this.ownerStream.Position, 0));
				return;
			}
			int blockLength = ReadBlockLength(this.ownerStreamReader);
			cachedWorkbookStreamPosition = this.ownerStream.Position;
			length = blockLength;
			blocks.Add(CreateRecordBlock(this.ownerStream.Position, blockLength));
			this.ownerStream.Position = cachedWorkbookStreamPosition + length;
			AppendContinueBlocks();
			this.ownerStream.Position = cachedWorkbookStreamPosition;
			SetCurrentBlock(0);
		}

		protected BiffRecordStream(WorkbookSaveManager saveManager, Stream ownerStream, int recordType, InPlaceTransform transform)
			: this(transform)
		{
			isOpen = true;
			SaveManager = saveManager;
			this.ownerStream = ownerStream;
			this.recordType = recordType;
			blocks.Add(CreateRecordBlock(this.ownerStream.Position + BlockLengthSize + BlockTypeSize, 0));
			cachedWorkbookStreamPosition = this.ownerStream.Position;
			SetCurrentBlock(0);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				if (disposing)
				{
					CloseCurrentBlock();
					if (_transform.SupportsPostProcessingBlocks && !_transform.IsEncryptionSuspended)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < blocks.Count; i++)
						{
							RecordBlockInfo recordBlockInfo = blocks[i];
							ownerStream.Position = recordBlockInfo.BlockStart;
							_transform.PostProcessBlock(ownerStream, recordBlockInfo.BlockLength);
						}
						_transform.OnPostProcessComplete();
					}
					ownerStream.Position = EndUnderlyingStreamPosition;
					if (parentStream != null)
					{
						parentStream.isOpen = true;
					}
				}
				isOpen = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (!isOpen)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (offset < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (count < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (offset + count > buffer.Length)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = Math.Min(count, length - position);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < num; i += ReadFromCurrentBlock(buffer, offset + i, num - i))
			{
			}
			return i;
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			switch (origin)
			{
			case SeekOrigin.Begin:
				Position = offset;
				break;
			case SeekOrigin.Current:
				Position += offset;
				break;
			case SeekOrigin.End:
				Position = Length + offset;
				break;
			}
			return position;
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			if (value == length || value < length)
			{
				return;
			}
			long num = value - length;
			length = (int)value;
			bool flag = false;
			long num2 = ownerStream.Position;
			RecordBlockInfo recordBlockInfo;
			int blockLength;
			while (true)
			{
				int index = blocks.Count - 1;
				recordBlockInfo = blocks[index];
				blockLength = recordBlockInfo.BlockLength;
				if (blockLength + num <= recordBlockInfo.MaximumBlockLength)
				{
					break;
				}
				int num3 = recordBlockInfo.MaximumBlockLength - recordBlockInfo.BlockLength;
				num -= num3;
				recordBlockInfo.BlockLength = recordBlockInfo.MaximumBlockLength;
				ownerStream.Position += num3;
				WriteNewBlock(GetNextBlockType());
				flag = true;
			}
			recordBlockInfo.BlockLength = (ushort)(blockLength + num);
			if (flag)
			{
				ownerStream.Position = num2;
			}
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (buffer != null && offset >= 0 && count >= 0 && offset + count <= buffer.Length)
			{
				int i = 0;
				bool flag = true;
				if (!isFirstBlockHeaderWritten)
				{
					WriteFirstBlockHeader(Math.Min(count, blocks[0].MaximumBlockLength));
					flag = false;
				}
				long num = position + count;
				if (num > Length)
				{
					SetLength(num);
				}
				for (; i < count; i += WriteToCurrentBlock(buffer, offset + i, count - i))
				{
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					currentBlockWasModified = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddSubStream(IBiffRecordStream record)
		{
			if (subStreams == null)
			{
				subStreams = new List<IBiffRecordStream>();
			}
			subStreams.Add(record);
			record.ParentStreamRaw = this;
			isOpen = false;
			blocks[currentBlock].CapBlock();
		}

		public bool AppendNextRecordIfType(int type)
		{
			if (!AppendNextBlockIfType(type))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ownerStream.Seek(blocks[blocks.Count - 1].BlockLength, SeekOrigin.Current);
			AppendContinueBlocks();
			return true;
		}

		public void CapCurrentBlock()
		{
			SyncWorkbookStreamPosition();
			blocks[currentBlock].CapBlock();
		}

		public int GetDataSize(long startPosition, LengthType lengthType, string value)
		{
			long num = Position;
			try
			{
				Position = startPosition;
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				BiffRecordStream biffRecordStream = CopyForAlternateStream(memoryStream, -startPosition);
				if (biffRecordStream.length < startPosition)
				{
					biffRecordStream.SetLength(startPosition);
				}
				biffRecordStream.Position = startPosition;
				biffRecordStream.Write(value, lengthType);
				return (int)memoryStream.Position;
			}
			finally
			{
				Position = num;
			}
		}

		public long GetStartOfRecord()
		{
			return blocks[0].BlockStart - BlockLengthSize - BlockTypeSize;
		}

		public byte ReadByteFromBuffer(ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex)
		{
			if (dataIndex == data.Length)
			{
				CacheNextBlock(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			}
			return data[dataIndex++];
		}

		public byte[] ReadBytes(int count)
		{
			if (count < 0)
			{
				return new byte[0];
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[count];
			int num = Read(array, 0, count);
			if (num == count)
			{
				return array;
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return new byte[0];
			}
			byte[] array2 = new byte[num];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(array, 0, array2, 0, num);
			return array2;
		}

		public byte[] ReadBytesFromBuffer(int count, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex)
		{
			if (count < 0)
			{
				return new byte[0];
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[count];
			int num = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				int num2 = Math.Min(count - num, data.Length - dataIndex);
				Buffer.BlockCopy(data, dataIndex, array, num, num2);
				dataIndex += num2;
				num += num2;
				if (num == count)
				{
					return array;
				}
				if (Position == Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				CacheNextBlock(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			}
			byte[] array2 = new byte[num];
			Buffer.BlockCopy(array, 0, array2, 0, num);
			return array2;
		}

		public double ReadDouble()

		public EncryptionHeader ReadEncryptionHeader()
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			EncryptionHeader result = default(EncryptionHeader);
			result.Flags = EncryptionHeaderFlags.op_Implicit(ReadUInt32());
			result.SizeExtra = ReadUInt32();
			result.AlgId = ReadInt32();
			result.AlgIdHash = ReadInt32();
			result.KeySize = ReadUInt32();
			result.ProviderType = ReadUInt32();
			ReadUInt32();
			ReadUInt32();
			result.CSPName = ReadNullTerminatedUnicodeString();
			return result;
		}

		public EncryptionVerifier ReadEncryptionVerifier(int encryptedVerifierHashSize)
		{
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			uint count = ReadUInt32();
			EncryptionVerifier result = default(EncryptionVerifier);
			result.Salt = ReadBytes((int)count);
			result.EncryptedVerifier = ReadBytes(16);
			result.VerifierHashSize = ReadUInt32();
			result.EncryptedVerifierHash = ReadBytes(encryptedVerifierHashSize);
			return result;
		}

		public StringElement ReadFormattedString(LengthType lengthType)
		{
			if (lengthType != LengthType.EightBit && lengthType != LengthType.SixteenBit)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ushort stringLength = ((lengthType == LengthType.EightBit) ? ((byte)ReadByte()) : ReadUInt16());
			return ReadFormattedString(stringLength);
		}

		public StringElement ReadFormattedString(ushort stringLength)
		{
			if (!TryReadFormattedString(stringLength, out var value))
			{
				throw new EndOfStreamException();
			}
			return value;
		}

		public bool TryReadFormattedString(ushort stringLength, out StringElement value)
		{
			value = null;
			FormattedStringInfo formattedStringInfo = ReadFormattedStringHelper(stringLength);
			if (formattedStringInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (formattedStringInfo.HasRichText)
			{
				FormattedStringElement formattedStringElement = new FormattedStringElement(formattedStringInfo.UnformattedText);
				ReadFormattingRuns(formattedStringElement, formattedStringInfo.RichTextFormattingRuns);
				value = formattedStringElement;
			}
			else
			{
				value = new StringElement(formattedStringInfo.UnformattedText);
			}
			ReadAsianPhoneticSettingsBlock(formattedStringInfo.AsianPhoneticSettingsSize);
			return true;
		}

		public WorkItem ReadFormattedStringBlock(uint stringCount, List<StringElement> formattedStrings)
		{
			if (stringCount == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			byte[] data = new byte[0];
			int dataIndex = 0;
			CacheNextBlock(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			int stringsRead = 0;
			return Async.ForSlice(0, (int)stringCount, 1, (Func<int, bool>)delegate
			{
				formattedStrings.Add(ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(LengthType.SixteenBit, ref data, ref dataIndex));
				stringsRead++;
				if (1000 < stringsRead)
				{
					stringsRead = 0;
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			});
		}

		public StringElement ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(LengthType lengthType, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex)
		{
			ushort stringLength = ((lengthType == LengthType.EightBit) ? ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex) : ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex));
			return ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(stringLength, ref data, ref dataIndex);
		}

		public StringElement ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(ushort stringLength, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex)
		{
			FormattedStringInfo formattedStringInfo = ReadFormattedStringFromBufferHelper(stringLength, ref data, ref dataIndex);
			StringElement result;
			if (formattedStringInfo.HasRichText)
			{
				FormattedStringElement formattedStringElement = new FormattedStringElement(formattedStringInfo.UnformattedText);
				ReadFormattingRunsFromBuffer(formattedStringElement, formattedStringInfo.RichTextFormattingRuns, ref data, ref dataIndex);
				result = formattedStringElement;
			}
			else
			{
				result = new StringElement(formattedStringInfo.UnformattedText);
			}
			ReadAsianPhoneticSettingsBlockFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex, formattedStringInfo.AsianPhoneticSettingsSize);
			return result;
		}

			CellAddress cell = CellAddressFromEncodedValues(encodedRow, encodedColumn);

		}

		public string ReadNullTerminatedUnicodeString()
		{
			List<byte> list = new List<byte>();
			while (true)
			{
				int num = ReadByte();
				int num2 = ReadByte();
				if (num <= 0 && num2 <= 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add((byte)num);
				list.Add((byte)num2);
			}
			return Encoding.Unicode.GetString(list.ToArray());
		}

		public void WriteNullTerminatedUnicodeString(string value)
		{
			Write(Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(value));
			WriteByte(0);
			WriteByte(0);
		}

		public int Write(List<CellAddressRange> rangeList, bool allowContinueRecords = true)
		{
			long num = Position;
			Write((ushort)0);
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < rangeList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!allowContinueRecords && BytesAvailableInCurrentBlock < 8)
				{
					break;
				}
				Write(rangeList[i]);
			}
			long num2 = Position;
			Position = num;
			Write((ushort)i);
			Position = num2;
			return i;
		}

			}
		}

		public void Write(MemoryStream memoryStream)
		{
			short num = (short)memoryStream.Length;
			RecordBlockInfo recordBlockInfo = blocks[0];
			if (isFirstBlockHeaderWritten || memoryStream.Length > recordBlockInfo.MaximumBlockLength)
			{
				Write(memoryStream.GetBuffer(), 0, num);

		private static CellAddress CellAddressFromEncodedValues(ushort encodedRow, ushort encodedColumn)

		private static void CellAddressToEncodedValues(CellAddress address, out ushort encodedRow, out ushort encodedColumn)
		{

		}

		}

			}
			if (BytesAvailableInCurrentBlock < num4)

				AppendNewBlock();
			}
			int num5 = BytesAvailableInCurrentBlock - num3;
			if (writeHeader && writeLength)
			{

				{
					Write((byte)value.UnformattedString.Length);
				}
				else
				{
					Write((ushort)value.UnformattedString.Length);
				}
			}
			int val = value.UnformattedString.Length - startPosition;
			string text;
			bool flag2;
			if (allowCharCompression)
			{

		protected override FormattedStringInfo ReadFormattedStringHelper(int remainingLength)
		{

			{
				AppendNextBlockIfType(60);
			}
			return base.ReadFormattedStringHelper(remainingLength);
		}

		protected override int ReadBlockLength(BinaryReader ownerStreamReader)
		{
			return ownerStreamReader.ReadUInt16();
		}

		protected override int ReadBlockType(BinaryReader ownerStreamReader)
		{
			return ownerStreamReader.ReadUInt16();
		}

		protected override bool ShouldAppendNextBlockIfType(int expectedType, int actualType)
		{
			if (RecordType == BIFF8RecordType.TXO && IsAllTXODataAppended())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.ShouldAppendNextBlockIfType(expectedType, actualType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			BIFF8RecordType bIFF8RecordType = (BIFF8RecordType)actualType;
			if (bIFF8RecordType == Biff8RecordBase.GetContinuationBlockType((BIFF8RecordType)expectedType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (RecordType == BIFF8RecordType.MSODRAWINGGROUP && bIFF8RecordType == BIFF8RecordType.MSODRAWINGGROUP)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void WriteBlockLength(Stream ownerStream, int length, bool isAfterLengthPosition)
		{
			if (isAfterLengthPosition)
			{
				ownerStream.Seek(-2L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			}
			ownerStream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)length), 0, 2);
		}

		protected override void WriteBlockType(Stream ownerStream, int type)
		{
			ownerStream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)type), 0, 2);
		}

		protected override int WriteToCurrentBlock(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (!allowWriteForTXORecord)
			{
				return count;
			}
			return base.WriteToCurrentBlock(buffer, offset, count);
		}

		private static bool ExtractFixedValue(CustomFilterCondition condition, FixedValuesFilter fixedValuesFilter)
		{
			if (condition != null)
			{
				if (condition.ComparisonOperator != ExcelComparisonOperator.Equals || condition.HasWildcards)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!(condition.Value is string text))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (text.Length == 0)
				{
					fixedValuesFilter.IncludeBlanks = true;
				}
				else
				{
					fixedValuesFilter.DisplayValues.Add(Utilities.UnescapeWildcards(text));
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static WorkbookColorInfo GetColorInfoFromRawValues(Workbook workbook, XColorType colorType, uint xClrValue, double? tint)
		{
			switch (colorType)
			{
			case XColorType.Auto:
				return WorkbookColorInfo.Automatic;
			case XColorType.Indexed:
				return new WorkbookColorInfo(workbook.Palette.GetColorAtAbsoluteIndex((int)xClrValue), null, tint, isLoading: true);
			case XColorType.RGB:
			{
				Color value = Utilities.DecodeLongRGBA(xClrValue);
				return new WorkbookColorInfo(value, null, tint, isLoading: true);
			}
			case XColorType.Themed:
				return new WorkbookColorInfo(null, (WorkbookThemeColorType)xClrValue, tint, isLoading: true);
			case XColorType.NotSet:
				return null;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		}

		private void GetRawColorInfoValues(WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo, ColorableItem item, out XColorType colorType, out double tint, out uint xClrValue)
		{
			tint = 0.0;
			xClrValue = 0u;
			if (colorInfo == null)
			{
				colorType = XColorType.NotSet;
				return;
			}
			if (colorInfo.Tint.HasValue)
			{
				tint = colorInfo.Tint.Value;
			}
			if (colorInfo.IsAutomatic)
			{
				colorType = XColorType.Auto;
			}
			else if (colorInfo.Color.HasValue)
			{
				Color value = colorInfo.Color.Value;
				if (Utilities.ColorIsSystem(value))
				{
					colorType = XColorType.Indexed;
					xClrValue = (uint)colorInfo.GetIndex(base.SaveManager.Workbook, item);
				}
				else
				{
					colorType = XColorType.RGB;
					xClrValue = Utilities.EncodeLongRGBA(colorInfo.Color.Value);
				}
			}
			else if (colorInfo.ThemeColorType.HasValue)
			{
				colorType = XColorType.Themed;
				xClrValue = (uint)colorInfo.ThemeColorType.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				colorType = XColorType.NotSet;
			}
		}

		private static CustomFilterCondition InterpretAFDOper(AFDOper doper)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch (doper.vt)
			{
			case 2:
			case 4:
			case 6:
			case 8:
				return CustomFilterCondition.CreateCustomFilterCondition(doper.grbitSign, doper.ResolvedValue);
			case 12:
				return CustomFilterCondition.CreateCustomFilterCondition((ST_FilterOperator)2, string.Empty);
			case 14:
				return CustomFilterCondition.CreateCustomFilterCondition((ST_FilterOperator)5, string.Empty);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				Position = num2;
				base.OwnerStream.Position = num;
			}
		}

		private AFDOper ReadAFDOper(bool isInAutoFilter12Record)

			{

				{

		public void ReadDXFFntD(IWorkbookFont font, bool fIfntNinch)
		{
			byte b = (byte)ReadByte();
			long num = Position;
			string name = null;
			if (b != 0)
			{
				name = ReadXLUnicodeStringNoCch(b);
			}
			long num2 = Position;
			ReadBytes(63 - (int)(num2 - num));
			Stxp stxp = ReadStxp();
			int num3 = ReadInt32();
			ReadUInt32();
			Ts ts = ReadTs();
			uint num4 = ReadUInt32();
			uint num5 = ReadUInt32();
			uint num6 = ReadUInt32();
			ReadUInt32();
			ReadInt32();
			ReadInt32();
			ushort num7 = ReadUInt16();
			if (fIfntNinch || num7 > 0)
			{
				font.Name = name;
			}
			if (stxp.twpHeight != -1)
			{
				font.Height = stxp.twpHeight;
			}
			if (!ts.ftsItalic)
			{
				font.Italic = Utilities.ToDefaultableBoolean(stxp.ts.ftsItalic);
			}
			if (!ts.ftsStrikeout)
			{
				font.Strikeout = Utilities.ToDefaultableBoolean(stxp.ts.ftsStrikeout);
			}
			if (num6 == 0)
			{
				ushort bls = stxp.bls;
				if (bls == 400)
				{
					goto IL_0115;
				}
				if (bls != 700)
				{
					if (bls == ushort.MaxValue)
					{
						goto IL_0137;
					}
					if (stxp.bls < 400)
					{
						goto IL_0115;
					}
				}
				font.Bold = ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True;
			}
			goto IL_0137;
			IL_0137:
			if (num4 == 0 && stxp.sss != ushort.MaxValue)
			{
				FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle sss = (FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle)stxp.sss;
				if (Enum.IsDefined(typeof(FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle), sss))
				{
					font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle = sss;
				}
			}
			if (num5 == 0 && stxp.uls != byte.MaxValue)
			{
				FontUnderlineStyle uls = (FontUnderlineStyle)stxp.uls;
				if (Enum.IsDefined(typeof(FontUnderlineStyle), uls))
				{
					font.UnderlineStyle = uls;
				}
			}
			if (num3 != -1)
			{
				font.ColorInfo = new WorkbookColorInfo(base.LoadManager.Workbook.Palette.GetColorAtAbsoluteIndex(num3));
			}
			return;
			IL_0115:
			font.Bold = ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False;
			goto IL_0137;
		}

		public void WriteDXFFntD(IWorkbookFont font)
		{
			long num = Position + 1;
			if (font.Name == null)
			{
				WriteByte(0);
			}
			else
			{
				WriteByte((byte)font.Name.Length);
				WriteXLUnicodeStringNoCch(font.Name, force2BytesPerChar: true);
			}
			int num2 = 63 - (int)(Position - num);
			Write(new byte[num2]);
			Ts ts = new Ts();
			ts.ftsItalic = font.Italic == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True;
			ts.ftsStrikeout = font.Strikeout == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True;
			Stxp stxp = new Stxp();
			stxp.twpHeight = font.Height;
			stxp.ts = ts;
			switch (font.Bold.ToInt())
			{
			case 0:
				stxp.bls = ushort.MaxValue;
				break;
			case 2:
				stxp.bls = 400;
				break;
			case 1:
				stxp.bls = 700;
				break;
			}
			stxp.sss = (ushort)font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle;
			stxp.uls = (byte)font.UnderlineStyle;
			WriteStxp(stxp);
			int value = -1;
			if (font.ColorInfo != null)
			{
				value = font.ColorInfo.GetIndex(base.SaveManager.Workbook, ColorableItem.CellFont);
			}
			Write(value);
			Write(0u);
			Ts ts2 = new Ts();
			ts2.ftsItalic = font.Italic == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default;
			ts2.ftsStrikeout = font.Strikeout == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default;
			WriteTs(ts2);
			uint value2 = ((font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle == FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.Default) ? 1u : 0u);
			Write(value2);
			uint value3 = ((font.UnderlineStyle == FontUnderlineStyle.Default) ? 1u : 0u);
			Write(value3);
			uint value4 = ((font.Bold == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default) ? 1u : 0u);
			Write(value4);
			Write(0u);
			Write(0);
			Write(0);
			if (font.Name == null)
			{
				Write((ushort)0);
			}
			else
			{
				Write((ushort)1);
			}
		}

		public WorksheetCellFormatData ReadDXFN()
		{
			uint value = ReadUInt32();
			bool alchNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 0);
			bool alcvNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 1);
			bool wrapNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 2);
			bool trotNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 3);
			bool kintoNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 4);
			bool cIndentNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 5);
			bool fShrinkNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 6);
			bool fMergeCellNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 7);
			bool lockedNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 8);
			bool hiddenNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 9);
			bool glLeftNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 10);
			bool glRightNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 11);
			bool glTopNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 12);
			bool glBottomNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 13);
			bool glDiagDownNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 14);
			bool glDiagUpNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 15);
			bool flsNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 16);
			bool icvFNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 17);
			bool icvBNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 18);
			bool ifmtNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 19);
			bool fIfntNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 20);
			Utilities.TestBit(value, 21);
			Utilities.GetBits(value, 22, 24);
			bool flag = Utilities.TestBit(value, 25);
			bool flag2 = Utilities.TestBit(value, 26);
			bool flag3 = Utilities.TestBit(value, 27);
			bool flag4 = Utilities.TestBit(value, 28);
			bool flag5 = Utilities.TestBit(value, 29);
			bool flag6 = Utilities.TestBit(value, 30);
			bool iReadingOrderNinch = Utilities.TestBit(value, 31);
			ushort value2 = ReadUInt16();
			bool fIfmtUser = Utilities.TestBit(value2, 0);
			Utilities.TestBit(value2, 1);
			Utilities.TestBit(value2, 2);
			Utilities.GetBits(value2, 3, 14);
			Utilities.TestBit(value2, 15);
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = base.LoadManager.Workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat);
			if (flag)
			{
				ReadDXFNum(worksheetCellFormatData, fIfmtUser, ifmtNinch);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				ReadDXFFntD(worksheetCellFormatData.Font, fIfntNinch);
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				ReadDXFALC(worksheetCellFormatData, alchNinch, alcvNinch, wrapNinch, trotNinch, kintoNinch, cIndentNinch, fShrinkNinch, fMergeCellNinch, iReadingOrderNinch);
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				ReadDXFBdr(worksheetCellFormatData, glLeftNinch, glRightNinch, glTopNinch, glBottomNinch, glDiagDownNinch, glDiagUpNinch);
			}
			if (flag5)
			{
				ReadDXFPat(worksheetCellFormatData, flsNinch, icvFNinch, icvBNinch);
			}
			if (flag6)
			{
				ReadDXFProt(worksheetCellFormatData, lockedNinch, hiddenNinch);
			}
			return worksheetCellFormatData;
		}

			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, flag17, 16);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, flag18, 17);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, flag19, 18);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, testValue, 19);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, testValue: true, 20);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, testValue: true, 21);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, flag21, 25);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, flag22, 26);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, flag23, 27);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, flag24, 28);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, flag25, 29);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, flag26, 30);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, flag20, 31);
			Write(value);
			bool flag27 = false;
			if (flag21)
			{
				flag27 = !base.SaveManager.Workbook.Formats.IsStandardFormat(format.FormatStringIndexResolved);
			}
			ushort value2 = 0;
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value2, flag27, 0);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value2, testValue: true, 1);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value2, testValue: false, 2);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value2, testValue: true, 15);

		public void WriteDXFNumIFmt(WorksheetCellFormatData format)

		private string ReadFileMoniker()
		{
			ushort num = ReadUInt16();

			}

			{
				return text;
			}
			uint count = ReadUInt32();
			ReadUInt16();

		}

		private void WriteFileMoniker(string value)
		{
			int num = 0;
			while (value.StartsWith("..\\"))
			{
				value = value.Substring(3);
				num++;
			}
			Write((ushort)num);
			byte[] bytes = Workbook.InvariantCompressedTextEncoding.GetBytes(value);
			Write((uint)(bytes.Length + 1));
			Write(bytes);
			WriteByte(0);
			Write(ushort.MaxValue);
			Write((ushort)57005);
			Write(new byte[16]);
			Write(0u);
			if (num == 0 && Workbook.InvariantCompressedTextEncoding.GetString(bytes) == value)
			{
				Write(0u);
				return;
			}
			int value2 = value.Length * 2 + 6;
			Write((uint)value2);
			int value3 = value.Length * 2;
			Write((uint)value3);
			Write((ushort)3);
			Write(Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(value));
		}

		public string ReadHyperlinkMoniker()
		{
			Guid guid = new Guid(ReadBytes(16));
			if (guid == UrlMonikerClsid)
			{
				return ReadURLMoniker();
			}
			if (guid == FileMonikerClsid)
			{
				return ReadFileMoniker();
			}
			if (!(guid == CompositeMonikerClsid) && !(guid == AntiMonikerClsid))
			{
				_ = guid == ItemMonikerClsid;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void WriteHyperlinkMoniker(string value)
		{
			Uri uri = new Uri(value, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
			if (!uri.IsAbsoluteUri || uri.Scheme.ToLower() == "file")
			{
				Write(FileMonikerClsid.ToByteArray());
				WriteFileMoniker(value);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(UrlMonikerClsid.ToByteArray());
				WriteURLMoniker(uri);
			}
		}

		public void WriteSortCond12(WorksheetTableColumn column, SortCondition sortCondition)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			WriteFrtRefHeader(null, BIFF8RecordType.CONTINUEFRT12);
			ushort value = 0;
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, sortCondition.SortDirection == SortDirection.Descending, 0);
			Utilities.AddBits(ref value, (int)sortCondition.SortByValue, 1, 4);
			Write(value);
			WriteRFX(column.SortRegion);
			ST_SortBy sortByValue = sortCondition.SortByValue;
			switch ((int)sortByValue)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case 0:
			case 1:
			case 2:
				WriteCondDataValue(column, sortCondition);
				break;
			case 3:
				if (sortCondition is IconSortCondition iconSortCondition)
				{
					WriteCFFlag(iconSortCondition.IconSet, iconSortCondition.IconIndex.GetValueOrDefault());
				}
				break;

			}
			string listString = customListSortCondition.GetListString();
			Write(listString.Length);

		}

		public static CellFillGradient ResolveXFExtGradient(Workbook workbook, XFExtGradientInfo info)
		{
			CellFillGradientStop[] array = new CellFillGradientStop[info.rgGradStops.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = ResolveGradStop(workbook, info.rgGradStops[i]);
			}
			if (info.type == 1)
			{
				return new CellFillRectangularGradient(info.numFillToLeft, info.numFillToTop, info.numFillToRight, info.numFillToBottom, array);
			}
			return new CellFillLinearGradient(info.numDegree, array);
		}

			CellFillRectangularGradient cellFillRectangularGradient = gradientFill as CellFillRectangularGradient;
			if (cellFillLinearGradient != null)
			{
				value = 0;
				value2 = cellFillLinearGradient.Angle;
			}
			else if (cellFillRectangularGradient != null)
			{
				value = 1;
				value3 = cellFillRectangularGradient.Left;
				value4 = cellFillRectangularGradient.Right;
				value5 = cellFillRectangularGradient.Top;
				value6 = cellFillRectangularGradient.Bottom;
			}
			Write(value);

			Write(value3);
			Write(value4);
			Write(value5);

			{
				WriteGradStop(gradientFill.Stops[i]);
			}
		}

		public XFProp ReadXFProp()
		{
			XFPropType xFPropType = (XFPropType)ReadUInt16();
			ReadUInt16();
			switch (xFPropType)
			{
			case XFPropType.TopBorder:
			case XFPropType.BottomBorder:
			case XFPropType.LeftBorder:
			case XFPropType.RightBorder:
			case XFPropType.DiagonalBorder:
			case XFPropType.VerticalBorder:
			case XFPropType.HorizontalBorder:
			{
				ReadXFPropBorder(out var borderColor, out var borderStyle);
				return new XFPropBorderLoaded(xFPropType, borderColor, borderStyle);
			}
			case XFPropType.DiagonalUpBorder:
			case XFPropType.DiagonalDownBorder:
			case XFPropType.WrappedText:
			case XFPropType.JustifyDistributed:
			case XFPropType.ShrinkToFit:
			case XFPropType.CellMerged:
			case XFPropType.FontItalic:
			case XFPropType.FontStrikethrough:
			case XFPropType.FontOutline:
			case XFPropType.FontShadow:
			case XFPropType.FontCondensed:
			case XFPropType.FontExtended:
			case XFPropType.Locked:
			case XFPropType.Hidden:
				return new XFPropBool(xFPropType, (byte)ReadByte());
			case XFPropType.ForegroundColor:
			case XFPropType.BackgroundColor:
			case XFPropType.FontColor:
				return new XFPropColorLoaded(xFPropType, ReadXFPropColor());
			case XFPropType.FontBold:
				return new XFPropFontBold(ReadUInt16());
			case XFPropType.ReadingOrder:
			case XFPropType.FontCharacterSet:
			case XFPropType.FontFamily:
				return new XFPropByte(xFPropType, (byte)ReadByte());
			case XFPropType.FontHeight:
				return new XFPropFontHeight(ReadUInt32());
			case XFPropType.FontName:
				return new XFPropFontName(ReadLPWideString());
			case XFPropType.FontUnderline:
				return new XFPropFontUnderline(ReadUnderline());
			case XFPropType.FontScheme:
				return new XFPropFontScheme(ReadFontScheme());
			case XFPropType.FontSubscriptSuperscript:
				return new XFPropFontSubscriptSuperscript(ReadScript());
			case XFPropType.GradientFill:
				return ReadXFPropGradientFill();
			case XFPropType.GradientStop:
				return ReadXFPropGradientStop();
			case XFPropType.HorizontalAlignment:
				return new XFPropHorizontalAlignment(ReadHorizAlign());
			case XFPropType.NumberFormat:
			{
				ReadFormat(out var numFmtId, out var format);
				return new XFPropNumberFormat(numFmtId, format);
			}
			case XFPropType.NumberFormatId:
				return new XFPropNumberFormatId(ReadUInt16());
			case XFPropType.PatternFill:
			{
				FillPatternStyle fillPattern = (FillPatternStyle)ReadByte();
				return new XFPropFillPattern(fillPattern);
			}
			case XFPropType.TextIndentationLevel:
				return new XFPropTextIndentationLevel(ReadUInt16());
			case XFPropType.TextIndentationLevelRelative:
				return new XFPropTextIndentationLevelRelative(ReadInt16());
			case XFPropType.TextRotation:
				return new XFPropTextRotation((byte)ReadByte());
			case XFPropType.VerticalAlignment:
				return new XFPropVerticalAlignment(ReadVertAlign());
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public void WriteXFProp(XFProp xfProp)
		{
			long num = Position;
			Write((ushort)xfProp.Type);
			Write((ushort)0);
			switch (xfProp.Type)
			{
			case XFPropType.TopBorder:
			case XFPropType.BottomBorder:
			case XFPropType.LeftBorder:
			case XFPropType.RightBorder:
			case XFPropType.DiagonalBorder:
			case XFPropType.VerticalBorder:
			case XFPropType.HorizontalBorder:
			{
				XFPropBorder xFPropBorder = (XFPropBorder)xfProp;
				WorkbookColorInfo borderColor = xFPropBorder.GetBorderColor(base.SaveManager.Workbook);
				CellBorderLineStyle borderStyle = xFPropBorder.BorderStyle;
				WriteXFPropBorder(borderColor, borderStyle);
				break;
			}
			case XFPropType.DiagonalUpBorder:
			case XFPropType.DiagonalDownBorder:
			case XFPropType.WrappedText:
			case XFPropType.JustifyDistributed:
			case XFPropType.ShrinkToFit:
			case XFPropType.CellMerged:
			case XFPropType.FontItalic:
			case XFPropType.FontStrikethrough:
			case XFPropType.FontOutline:
			case XFPropType.FontShadow:
			case XFPropType.FontCondensed:
			case XFPropType.FontExtended:
			case XFPropType.Locked:
			case XFPropType.Hidden:
				Write(((XFPropBool)xfProp).ValueByte);
				break;
			case XFPropType.ForegroundColor:
			case XFPropType.BackgroundColor:
				WriteXFPropColor(((XFPropColor)xfProp).ColorInfo, ColorableItem.CellFill);
				break;
			case XFPropType.FontBold:
				Write(((XFPropFontBold)xfProp).FontWeight);
				break;
			case XFPropType.ReadingOrder:
			case XFPropType.FontCharacterSet:
			case XFPropType.FontFamily:
				Write(((XFPropByte)xfProp).Value);
				break;
			case XFPropType.FontColor:
				WriteXFPropColor(((XFPropColor)xfProp).ColorInfo, ColorableItem.CellFont);
				break;
			case XFPropType.FontHeight:
				Write(((XFPropFontHeight)xfProp).FontHeight);
				break;
			case XFPropType.FontName:
				WriteLPWideString(((XFPropFontName)xfProp).FontName);
				break;
			case XFPropType.FontUnderline:
				WriteUnderline(((XFPropFontUnderline)xfProp).UnderlineStyle);
				break;
			case XFPropType.FontScheme:
				WriteFontScheme(((XFPropFontScheme)xfProp).FontScheme);
				break;
			case XFPropType.FontSubscriptSuperscript:
				WriteScript(((XFPropFontSubscriptSuperscript)xfProp).Style);
				break;
			case XFPropType.GradientFill:
				WriteXFPropGradientFill((XFPropGradientFill)xfProp);
				break;
			case XFPropType.GradientStop:
				WriteXFPropGradientStop((XFPropGradientStop)xfProp);
				break;
			case XFPropType.HorizontalAlignment:
				WriteHorizAlign(((XFPropHorizontalAlignment)xfProp).Alignment);
				break;
			case XFPropType.NumberFormat:
			{
				XFPropNumberFormat xFPropNumberFormat = xfProp as XFPropNumberFormat;
				ushort numFmtId = xFPropNumberFormat.NumFmtId;
				string format = xFPropNumberFormat.Format;
				ReadFormat(out numFmtId, out format);
				break;
			}
			case XFPropType.NumberFormatId:
				Write(((XFPropNumberFormatId)xfProp).FmtId);
				break;
			case XFPropType.PatternFill:
				Write((byte)((XFPropFillPattern)xfProp).FillPattern);
				break;
			case XFPropType.TextIndentationLevel:
				Write(((XFPropTextIndentationLevel)xfProp).Indent);
				break;
			case XFPropType.TextIndentationLevelRelative:
				Write(((XFPropTextIndentationLevelRelative)xfProp).IndentOffset);
				break;
			case XFPropType.TextRotation:
				Write(((XFPropTextRotation)xfProp).Rotation);
				break;
			case XFPropType.VerticalAlignment:
				WriteVertAlign(((XFPropVerticalAlignment)xfProp).VerticalAlignment);
				break;
			}
			long num2 = Position;
			ushort value = (ushort)(num2 - num);
			Position = num + 2;
			Write(value);
			Position = num2;
		}

		private void ReadXFPropBorder(out XFPropColorInfo borderColor, out CellBorderLineStyle borderStyle)
		{
			borderColor = ReadXFPropColor();
			borderStyle = (CellBorderLineStyle)ReadUInt16();
		}

		private void WriteXFPropBorder(WorkbookColorInfo borderColor, CellBorderLineStyle borderStyle)
		{
			WriteXFPropColor(borderColor, ColorableItem.CellBorder);
			Write((ushort)borderStyle);
		}

		public XFPropColorInfo ReadXFPropColor()
		{
			XFPropColorInfo xFPropColorInfo = new XFPropColorInfo();
			xFPropColorInfo.temp8 = (byte)ReadByte();
			xFPropColorInfo.icv = (byte)ReadByte();
			xFPropColorInfo.nTintShade = ReadInt16();
			xFPropColorInfo.dwRgba = ReadUInt32();
			return xFPropColorInfo;
		}

		public static WorkbookColorInfo ResolveXFPropColor(Workbook workbook, XFPropColorInfo info)
		{
			if (info == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Utilities.TestBit(info.temp8, 0);
			XColorType xColorType = (XColorType)Utilities.GetBits(info.temp8, 1, 7);
			double? tint = null;
			if (info.nTintShade != 0)
			{
				tint = (double)info.nTintShade / 32767.0;
			}
			uint xClrValue;
			switch (xColorType)
			{
			case XColorType.Indexed:
			case XColorType.Themed:
				xClrValue = info.icv;
				break;
			case XColorType.RGB:
				xClrValue = info.dwRgba;
				break;
			default:
				xClrValue = 0u;
				break;
			}
			return GetColorInfoFromRawValues(workbook, xColorType, xClrValue, tint);
		}

		public void WriteXFPropColor(WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo, ColorableItem item)
		{
			GetRawColorInfoValues(colorInfo, item, out var colorType, out var tint, out var xClrValue);
			byte value = byte.MaxValue;
			uint value2 = xClrValue;
			if (colorType == XColorType.Themed || colorType == XColorType.Indexed)
			{
				value = (byte)xClrValue;
			}
			short value3 = (short)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(tint * 32767.0);
			byte value4 = 0;
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value4, testValue: true, 0);
			Utilities.AddBits(ref value4, (int)colorType, 1, 7);
			Write(value4);
			Write(value);
			Write(value3);
			Write(value2);
		}

		public XFPropGradientFill ReadXFPropGradientFill()
		{
			uint num = ReadUInt32();
			double numDegree = ReadDouble();
			double numFillToLeft = ReadDouble();
			double numFillToRight = ReadDouble();
			double numFillToTop = ReadDouble();
			double numFillToBottom = ReadDouble();
			return new XFPropGradientFill(num != 0, numDegree, numFillToLeft, numFillToRight, numFillToTop, numFillToBottom);
		}

		public void WriteXFPropGradientFill(XFPropGradientFill xfProp)
		{
			Write(xfProp.IsRectangular ? 1u : 0u);
			Write(xfProp.NumDegree);
			Write(xfProp.NumFillToLeft);
			Write(xfProp.NumFillToRight);
			Write(xfProp.NumFillToTop);
			Write(xfProp.NumFillToBottom);
		}

		public XFPropGradientStopLoaded ReadXFPropGradientStop()
		{
			ReadUInt16();
			double numPosition = ReadDouble();
			XFPropColorInfo colorInfo = ReadXFPropColor();
			return new XFPropGradientStopLoaded(colorInfo, numPosition);
		}

		public void WriteXFPropGradientStop(XFPropGradientStop xfProp)
		{
			Write((ushort)0);
			Write(xfProp.NumPosition);
			WriteXFPropColor(xfProp.GetColor(base.SaveManager.Workbook), ColorableItem.CellFill);
		}

		public XFProp[] ReadXFProps()
		{
			ReadUInt16();
			ushort num = ReadUInt16();
			XFProp[] array = new XFProp[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = ReadXFProp();
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static void ApplyXFProps(Workbook workbook, WorksheetCellFormatData format, bool fUIFill, XFProp[] props)
		{
			FillPatternStyle? fillPatternStyle = null;
			WorkbookColorInfo workbookColorInfo = null;
			WorkbookColorInfo workbookColorInfo2 = null;
			XFPropGradientFill xFPropGradientFill = null;
			List<CellFillGradientStop> list = new List<CellFillGradientStop>();
			foreach (XFProp xFProp in props)
			{
				if (xFProp != null)
				{
					switch (xFProp.Type)
					{
					case XFPropType.PatternFill:
						fillPatternStyle = ((XFPropFillPattern)xFProp).FillPattern;
						break;
					case XFPropType.BackgroundColor:
						workbookColorInfo = ((XFPropColorBase)xFProp).GetColor(workbook);
						break;
					case XFPropType.ForegroundColor:
						workbookColorInfo2 = ((XFPropColorBase)xFProp).GetColor(workbook);
						break;
					case XFPropType.GradientFill:
						xFPropGradientFill = (XFPropGradientFill)xFProp;
						break;
					case XFPropType.GradientStop:
					{
						XFPropGradientStopBase xFPropGradientStopBase = (XFPropGradientStopBase)xFProp;
						list.Add(new CellFillGradientStop(xFPropGradientStopBase.GetColor(workbook), xFPropGradientStopBase.NumPosition));
						break;
					}
					default:
						xFProp.ApplyTo(workbook, format);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (xFPropGradientFill != null && list.Count >= 2)
			{
				if (xFPropGradientFill.IsRectangular)
				{
					format.Fill = new CellFillRectangularGradient(xFPropGradientFill.NumFillToLeft, xFPropGradientFill.NumFillToTop, xFPropGradientFill.NumFillToRight, xFPropGradientFill.NumFillToBottom, list.ToArray());
				}
				else
				{
					format.Fill = new CellFillLinearGradient(xFPropGradientFill.NumDegree, list.ToArray());
				}
			}
			else if (fillPatternStyle.HasValue || workbookColorInfo != null || workbookColorInfo2 != null)
			{
				if (!fillPatternStyle.HasValue)
				{
					fillPatternStyle = FillPatternStyle.Solid;
				}
				format.Fill = new CellFillPattern(workbookColorInfo, workbookColorInfo2, fillPatternStyle.Value, format, isCreatedInternally: true);
			}
		}

		public void WriteXFProps(WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			Write((ushort)0);
			List<XFProp> xFProps = format.GetXFProps();
			Write((ushort)xFProps.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < xFProps.Count; i++)
			{
				WriteXFProp(xFProps[i]);
			}
		}

		public string ReadXLUnicodeString()
		{
			ushort cch = ReadUInt16();
			return ReadXLUnicodeStringNoCch(cch);
		}

		public void WriteXLUnicodeString(string value)
		{
			Write((ushort)value.Length);
			WriteXLUnicodeStringNoCch(value);
		}

		public string ReadXLUnicodeStringNoCch(ushort cch)
		{
			byte value = (byte)ReadByte();
			bool flag = Utilities.TestBit(value, 0);
			Utilities.GetBits(value, 1, 7);
			byte[] array = new byte[cch * 2];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (byte)ReadByte();
				if (!flag)
				{
					array[++i] = 0;
				}
			}
			return Encoding.Unicode.GetString(array);
		}

		public void WriteXLUnicodeStringNoCch(string value)
		{
			WriteXLUnicodeStringNoCch(value, force2BytesPerChar: false);
		}

		public void WriteXLUnicodeStringNoCch(string value, bool force2BytesPerChar)
		{
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(value);
			bool flag = false;
			byte[] array = new byte[bytes.Length / 2];
			if (force2BytesPerChar)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 1; i < bytes.Length; i += 2)
				{
					if (bytes[i] != 0)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					array[i / 2] = bytes[i - 1];
				}
			}
			byte[] buffer = (flag ? bytes : array);
			WriteByte(Convert.ToByte(flag));
			Write(buffer);
		}

		private double ReadXnum()
		{
			return ReadDouble();
		}

		private void WriteXnum(double value)
		{
			Write(value);
		}

		private void WriteDXFN12ListAndSizeField(long cbPosition, WorksheetCellFormatData dxf)
		{
			if (dxf != null)
			{
				long num = Position;
				WriteDXFN12List(dxf);
				long num2 = Position;
				int value = (int)(num2 - num);
				Position = cbPosition;
				Write(value);
				Position = num2;
			}
		}

	internal class ARRAYRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.ARRAY;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			byte[] data = new byte[0];
			int dataIndex = 0;
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			ushort num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			byte b = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			byte b2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			ushort num3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			bool isDirtyOnLoad = (num3 & 2) == 2;
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			ArrayFormula arrayFormula = loadManager.LoadArrayFormula(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			arrayFormula.IsDirtyOnLoad = isDirtyOnLoad;
			arrayFormula.ApplyTo(worksheet.GetCachedRegion(num, b, num2, b2));
			List<KeyValuePair<WorksheetCellAddress, ExcelCalcValue>> list = new List<KeyValuePair<WorksheetCellAddress, ExcelCalcValue>>(loadManager.PendingSharedFormulaRoots);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<WorksheetCellAddress, ExcelCalcValue> item in list)
			{
				WorksheetCellAddress key = item.Key;
				ExcelCalcValue value = item.Value;
				int rowIndex = key.RowIndex;
				short columnIndex = key.ColumnIndex;
				if (num <= rowIndex && rowIndex <= num2 && b <= columnIndex && columnIndex <= b2)
				{
					loadManager.PendingSharedFormulaRoots.Remove(key);
					worksheet.Rows[rowIndex].SetCachedCalculatedValue(columnIndex, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003.CellContext currentCellContext = saveManager.CurrentCellContext;
			if (currentCellContext.Value is ArrayFormula arrayFormula)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)arrayFormula.CellRange.FirstRow);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)arrayFormula.CellRange.LastRow);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)arrayFormula.CellRange.FirstColumn);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)arrayFormula.CellRange.LastColumn);
				ushort num = 0;
				if (arrayFormula.RecalculateAlways)
				{
					num |= 1;
				}
				if (currentCellContext.Row.GetCellCalcReference(saveManager.CurrentCellDataContext.ColumnIndex).ShouldBeRecalculatedOnNextLoad())
				{
					num |= 2;
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(0u);
				saveManager.SaveFormula(arrayFormula, writeSize: true, isForExternalNamedReference: false);
			}
		}
	}

		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.AUTOFILTER12;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			//IL_01bf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ba: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_03de: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0237: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_023d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0262: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0268: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01d7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01dc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFrtRefHeader(worksheet);
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			uint num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			uint num3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			uint num4 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			uint num5 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			ushort value = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			Utilities.TestBit(value, 3);
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			uint num6 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			if (num6 == uint.MaxValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetTable tableById = worksheet.Tables.GetTableById(num6);
			if (tableById == null || tableById.Columns.Count <= num)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = tableById.Columns[num];
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadBytes(16);
			Filter filter = null;
			double? value2 = null;
			double? maxValue = null;
			switch (num3)
			{
			case 1u:
			case 2u:
			{
				Biff8RecordStream.AFDOper aFDOper3 = null;
				if (num4 >= 1)
				{
					aFDOper3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadAF12Criteria(worksheet);
				}
				ST_FilterOperator val = ((num3 != 1) ? ((ST_FilterOperator)1) : ((ST_FilterOperator)4));
				if (aFDOper3 != null && aFDOper3.vt == 4 && aFDOper3.grbitSign == val)
				{
					value2 = (double)aFDOper3.vtValue;
				}
				break;
			}
			case 8u:

	internal abstract class CellValueRecordBase : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		protected abstract void LoadCellValue(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex, out object cellValue, out object lastCalculatedCellValue);

		protected abstract void SaveCellValue(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, MemoryStream initialData);

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			byte[] data = new byte[0];
			int dataIndex = 0;
			ushort rowIndex = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			short num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			WorksheetRow row = loadManager.GetRow(worksheet, rowIndex);
			ushort num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			WorksheetCellFormatData data2 = ((num2 >= loadManager.Formats.Count) ? loadManager.Workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement : loadManager.Formats[num2]);
			row.SetCellFormatWhileLoading(num, data2);
			LoadCellValue(loadManager, ref data, ref dataIndex, out var cellValue, out var lastCalculatedCellValue);
			if (cellValue is Formula formula)
			{
				if (!formula.IsSpecialFormula)
				{
					formula.ApplyTo(row, num);
					row.SetCachedCalculatedValue(num, CalcUtilities.CreateExcelCalcValue(lastCalculatedCellValue));
				}
				else if (formula.PostfixTokenList[0] is ExpToken { CellAddress: { Column: var column }, CellAddress: { Row: var row2 } })
				{
					WorksheetCellAddress key = new WorksheetCellAddress(row2, column);
					if (loadManager.SharedFormulasInCurrentWorksheet.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
					{
						value.ApplyTo(row, num);
						row.SetCachedCalculatedValue(num, CalcUtilities.CreateExcelCalcValue(lastCalculatedCellValue));
					}
					else if (row2 == row.Index && column == num)
					{
						loadManager.PendingSharedFormulaRoots[key] = CalcUtilities.CreateExcelCalcValue(lastCalculatedCellValue);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				row.SetCellValueRaw(num, cellValue);
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003.CellContext currentCellContext = saveManager.CurrentCellContext;
			CellDataContext currentCellDataContext = saveManager.CurrentCellDataContext;
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(32);
			memoryStream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)currentCellContext.Row.Index), 0, 2);
			memoryStream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(currentCellDataContext.ColumnIndex), 0, 2);
			int num = saveManager.GetCellFormatIndex(currentCellDataContext.CellFormatData);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			memoryStream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)num), 0, 2);
			SaveCellValue(saveManager, memoryStream);
		}
	}

	internal class BOFRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		private enum BiffVersion
		{
			Biff2_1 = 0,
			Biff2_2 = 7,
			Biff2_3 = 512,
			Biff3 = 768,
			Biff4 = 1024,
			Biff5 = 1280,
			Biff7 = 1280,
			Biff8 = 1536
		}

		public override bool CanBeEncrypted => false;

		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.BOF;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			string text = null;
			switch ((BiffVersion)num)
			{
			case BiffVersion.Biff2_1:
			case BiffVersion.Biff2_2:
			case BiffVersion.Biff2_3:
				text = "BIFF2";
				break;
			case BiffVersion.Biff3:
				text = "BIFF3";
				break;
			case BiffVersion.Biff4:
				text = "BIFF4";
				break;
			case BiffVersion.Biff5:
				text = "BIFF5/BIFF7";
				break;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_UnknownBIFFFormat"));
			case BiffVersion.Biff8:
				break;
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_UnsupportedBIFFFormat", text));
			}
			SubstreamType substreamType = (SubstreamType)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			switch (substreamType)
			{
			case SubstreamType.WorkbookGlobals:
				loadManager.ContextStack.Push((object)loadManager.Workbook);
				break;
			case SubstreamType.Worksheet:
			{
				Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.Workbook.Worksheets[loadManager.NextWorksheetIndex];
				loadManager.ContextStack.Push((object)worksheet.DisplayOptions);
				loadManager.ContextStack.Push((object)worksheet.PrintOptions);
				loadManager.ContextStack.Push((object)worksheet);
				break;
			}
			default:
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Length;
				while (true)
				{
					using Biff8RecordStream biff8RecordStream = new Biff8RecordStream(loadManager);
					biff8RecordStream.Position = biff8RecordStream.Length;
					if (biff8RecordStream.RecordType == BIFF8RecordType.EOF || loadManager.WorkbookStream.Position == loadManager.WorkbookStream.Length)
					{
						break;
					}
					continue;
				}
				loadManager.NextWorksheetIndex++;
				break;
			}
			if (loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position != loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Length)
			{
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)1536);
			object current = saveManager.ContextStack.Current;
			if (current is Worksheet)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)16);
			}
			else
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)5);
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)3515);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)1996);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(0u);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(1536u);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class BOOLERRRecord : CellValueRecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.BOOLERR;

		protected override void LoadCellValue(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex, out object cellValue, out object lastCalculatedCellValue)
		{
			byte value = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			if (loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex) == 1)
			{
				cellValue = ErrorValue.FromValue(value);
			}
			else
			{
				cellValue = Convert.ToBoolean(value);
			}
			lastCalculatedCellValue = cellValue;
		}

		protected override void SaveCellValue(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, MemoryStream initialData)
		{
			object value = saveManager.CurrentCellContext.Value;
			if (value is ErrorValue errorValue)
			{
				initialData.WriteByte(errorValue.Value);
				initialData.WriteByte(1);
			}
			else if (value is bool)
			{
				initialData.WriteByte(Convert.ToByte((bool)value));
				initialData.WriteByte(0);
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(initialData);
		}
	}

				ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				ushort num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				ushort width = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				ushort num3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				if (num3 < 0)
				{
					num3 = 0;
				}
				ushort num4 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				bool hidden = (num4 & 1) == 1;
				int num5 = (num4 & 0x700) >> 8;
				WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = loadManager.Formats[num3];
				if (num2 == 256)
				{
					worksheet.DefaultColumnFormat = worksheetCellFormatData.CloneInternal();
				}
				if (num != 256)
				{
					num2 = Math.Min((ushort)255, num2);
					worksheet.OnColumnBlockLoaded((short)num, (short)num2, width, hidden, (byte)num5, worksheetCellFormatData);
				}
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Seek(2L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<WorksheetColumnBlock>();
			if (worksheetColumnBlock == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheetColumnBlock.FirstColumnIndex);
				ushort num = (ushort)worksheetColumnBlock.LastColumnIndex;
				if (num == 255)
				{
					num = 256;
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
				if (worksheetColumnBlock.Width < 0)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheet.DefaultColumnWidth);
				}
				else
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheetColumnBlock.Width);
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(saveManager.GetCellFormatIndex(worksheetColumnBlock.CellFormat));
				ushort num2 = 2;
				if (worksheetColumnBlock.Hidden)
				{
					num2 |= 1;
				}
				num2 |= (ushort)(worksheetColumnBlock.OutlineLevel << 8);
				if (saveManager.DoesColumnBlockHaveCollapseIndicator(worksheetColumnBlock))
				{
					num2 |= 0x1000;
				}

				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			}
		}

	internal class DVRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.DV;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			byte[] buffer = new byte[0];
			int bufferPosition = 0;
			uint num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32FromBuffer(ref buffer, ref bufferPosition);
			DataValidationType dataValidationType = (DataValidationType)(num & 0xF);
			ErrorAlertStyle errorStyle = (ErrorAlertStyle)((num & 0x70) >> 4);
			bool flag = (num & 0x80) != 0;
			bool allowNullInternal = (num & 0x100) != 0;
			bool flag2 = (num & 0x200) != 0;
			bool showInputMessage = (num & 0x40000) != 0;
			bool showErrorMessageForInvalidValue = (num & 0x80000) != 0;
			DataValidationOperatorType dataValidationOperatorType = (DataValidationOperatorType)((num & 0xF00000) >> 20);
			DataValidationRule dataValidationRule;
			switch (dataValidationType)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case DataValidationType.AnyValue:
				dataValidationRule = new AnyValueDataValidationRule();
				break;
			case DataValidationType.List:
			{
				ListDataValidationRule listDataValidationRule = new ListDataValidationRule();
				listDataValidationRule.ShowDropdown = !flag2;
				dataValidationRule = listDataValidationRule;
				break;
			}
			case DataValidationType.Formula:
				dataValidationRule = new CustomDataValidationRule();
				break;
			case DataValidationType.WholeNumber:
			case DataValidationType.Decimal:
			case DataValidationType.Date:
			case DataValidationType.Time:
			case DataValidationType.TextLength:
				switch (dataValidationOperatorType)
				{
				default:
					return;
				case DataValidationOperatorType.Between:
				case DataValidationOperatorType.NotBetween:
					dataValidationRule = new TwoConstraintDataValidationRule((TwoConstraintDataValidationOperator)dataValidationOperatorType, (DataValidationCriteria)dataValidationType);
					break;
				case DataValidationOperatorType.Equal:
				case DataValidationOperatorType.NotEqual:
				case DataValidationOperatorType.GreaterThan:
				case DataValidationOperatorType.LessThan:
				case DataValidationOperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual:
				case DataValidationOperatorType.LessThanOrEqual:
					dataValidationRule = new OneConstraintDataValidationRule((OneConstraintDataValidationOperator)dataValidationOperatorType, (DataValidationCriteria)dataValidationType);
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			dataValidationRule.AllowNullInternal = allowNullInternal;
			dataValidationRule.ErrorStyle = (DataValidationErrorStyle)errorStyle;
			dataValidationRule.ShowInputMessage = showInputMessage;
			dataValidationRule.ShowErrorMessageForInvalidValue = showErrorMessageForInvalidValue;
			string promptBoxTitle = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(LengthType.SixteenBit, ref buffer, ref bufferPosition).UnformattedString;
			DecodeDVString(ref promptBoxTitle);
			dataValidationRule.InputMessageTitle = promptBoxTitle;
			string promptBoxTitle2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(LengthType.SixteenBit, ref buffer, ref bufferPosition).UnformattedString;
			DecodeDVString(ref promptBoxTitle2);
			dataValidationRule.ErrorMessageTitle = promptBoxTitle2;
			string promptBoxTitle3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(LengthType.SixteenBit, ref buffer, ref bufferPosition).UnformattedString;
			DecodeDVString(ref promptBoxTitle3);
			dataValidationRule.InputMessageDescription = promptBoxTitle3;
			string promptBoxTitle4 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(LengthType.SixteenBit, ref buffer, ref bufferPosition).UnformattedString;
			DecodeDVString(ref promptBoxTitle4);
			dataValidationRule.ErrorMessageDescription = promptBoxTitle4;
			ushort rpnTokenArraySize = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref buffer, ref bufferPosition);
			bufferPosition += 2;
			Formula formula = loadManager.LoadFormula(dataValidationRule.FormulaType, rpnTokenArraySize, ref buffer, ref bufferPosition);
			dataValidationRule.SetFormula1(formula, null);
			if (flag && formula != null && formula.PostfixTokenList.Length == 1 && formula.PostfixTokenList[0] is StrToken strToken)
			{
				formula.PostfixTokenList[0] = new StrToken(strToken.Value.Replace('\0', ','));
			}
			ushort rpnTokenArraySize2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref buffer, ref bufferPosition);
			bufferPosition += 2;
			Formula formula2 = loadManager.LoadFormula(dataValidationRule.FormulaType, rpnTokenArraySize2, ref buffer, ref bufferPosition);
			dataValidationRule.SetFormula2(formula2, null);
			List<CellAddressRange> list = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormulaCellAddressRangeListFromBuffer(ref buffer, ref bufferPosition);
			WorksheetReferenceCollection worksheetReferenceCollection = new WorksheetReferenceCollection(worksheet);
			foreach (CellAddressRange item in list)
			{
				WorksheetRegion targetRegion = item.GetTargetRegion(worksheet, -1, -1, relativeAddressesAreOffsets: false);
				if (targetRegion != null)
				{
					worksheetReferenceCollection.Add(targetRegion);
				}
			}
			worksheet.DataValidationRules.AddInternal(dataValidationRule, worksheetReferenceCollection);
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			DataValidationRule dataValidationRule = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<DataValidationRule>();
			List<CellAddressRange> list = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<List<CellAddressRange>>();
			if (dataValidationRule != null && list != null)
			{
				ListDataValidationRule listDataValidationRule = dataValidationRule as ListDataValidationRule;
				Formula formula = dataValidationRule.GetFormula1(null);
				uint num = 0u;
				num |= (uint)dataValidationRule.ValidationType;
				num |= (uint)((int)dataValidationRule.ErrorStyle << 4);
				if (listDataValidationRule != null && formula != null && formula.PostfixTokenList.Length == 1 && formula.PostfixTokenList[0] is StrToken)
				{
					formula = formula.Clone();
					StrToken strToken = (StrToken)formula.PostfixTokenList[0];
					formula.PostfixTokenList[0] = new StrToken(strToken.Value.Replace(",", "\0"));
					num |= 0x80;
				}
				if (dataValidationRule.AllowNullInternal)
				{
					num |= 0x100;
				}
				if (listDataValidationRule != null && !listDataValidationRule.ShowDropdown)
				{
					num |= 0x200;
				}
				if (dataValidationRule.ShowInputMessage)
				{
					num |= 0x40000;
				}
				if (dataValidationRule.ShowErrorMessageForInvalidValue)
				{
					num |= 0x80000;
				}
				num |= (uint)dataValidationRule.OperatorType << 20;
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
				string promptBoxTitle = dataValidationRule.InputMessageTitle;
				EncodeDVString(ref promptBoxTitle);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(promptBoxTitle, LengthType.SixteenBit);
				string promptBoxTitle2 = dataValidationRule.ErrorMessageTitle;
				EncodeDVString(ref promptBoxTitle2);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(promptBoxTitle2, LengthType.SixteenBit);
				string inputMessageDescription = dataValidationRule.InputMessageDescription;
				inputMessageDescription = Utilities.RemoveCarriageReturns(inputMessageDescription);
				EncodeDVString(ref inputMessageDescription);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(inputMessageDescription, LengthType.SixteenBit);
				string errorMessageDescription = dataValidationRule.ErrorMessageDescription;
				errorMessageDescription = Utilities.RemoveCarriageReturns(errorMessageDescription);
				EncodeDVString(ref errorMessageDescription);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(errorMessageDescription, LengthType.SixteenBit);
				long position = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position;
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				if (formula != null)
				{
					int value = saveManager.SaveFormula(formula, writeSize: false, isForExternalNamedReference: false, resolveSharedReferences: false);
					long position2 = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position;
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = position;
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value);
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = position2;
				}
				long position3 = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position;
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				Formula formula2 = dataValidationRule.GetFormula2(null);
				if (formula2 != null)
				{
					int value2 = saveManager.SaveFormula(formula2, writeSize: false, isForExternalNamedReference: false, resolveSharedReferences: false);
					long position4 = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position;
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = position3;
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value2);
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = position4;
				}
				int count = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(list, allowContinueRecords: false);
				list.RemoveRange(0, count);
			}
		}

		private static void DecodeDVString(ref string promptBoxTitle)
		{
			if (promptBoxTitle.Length == 1 && promptBoxTitle[0] == '\0')
			{
				promptBoxTitle = string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private static void EncodeDVString(ref string promptBoxTitle)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(promptBoxTitle))
			{
				promptBoxTitle = "\0";
			}
		}
	}

	internal class EXTERNNAMERecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.EXTERNNAME;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			byte[] data = new byte[0];
			int dataIndex = 0;
			ushort value = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			bool flag = Utilities.TestBit(value, 0);
			bool advise = Utilities.TestBit(value, 1);
			bool preferPic = Utilities.TestBit(value, 2);
			Utilities.TestBit(value, 3);
			if (Utilities.TestBit(value, 4))
			{
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				string unformattedString = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(LengthType.EightBit, ref data, ref dataIndex).UnformattedString;
				loadManager.CurrentExternalWorkbookReference.GetNamedReference(unformattedString, loadManager.CurrentExternalWorkbookReference, createIfNotPresent: true);
				if (loadManager.CurrentExternalWorkbookReference is OleLinkWorkbookReference oleLinkWorkbookReference)
				{
					oleLinkWorkbookReference.Items.Add(new OleItem(unformattedString, icon: false, advise, preferPic));
				}
				return;
			}
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			List<WorkbookReferenceBase> workbookReferences = loadManager.WorkbookReferences;
			WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReferenceBase = workbookReferences[workbookReferences.Count - 1];
			string text = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(LengthType.EightBit, ref data, ref dataIndex).UnformattedString;
			Formula value2 = loadManager.LoadFormula(FormulaType.ExternalNamedReferenceFormula, ref data, ref dataIndex);
			object scope = workbookReferenceBase;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				scope = workbookReferenceBase.GetWorksheetReference(num - 1);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				text = NamedReferenceBase.NameFromBuiltInName((BuiltInName)text[0]);
			}
			NamedReferenceBase namedReference = workbookReferenceBase.GetNamedReference(text, scope, createIfNotPresent: true);
			namedReference.SetFormulaInternal(value2, synchronizeBuiltInReferences: false);
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			NamedReferenceBase namedReferenceBase = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<NamedReferenceBase>();
			if (namedReferenceBase == null || namedReferenceBase.FormulaInternal == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			OleItem oleItem = null;
			OleLinkNamedReference oleLinkNamedReference = namedReferenceBase as OleLinkNamedReference;
			if (oleLinkNamedReference != null && oleLinkNamedReference.WorkbookReference is OleLinkWorkbookReference oleLinkWorkbookReference)
			{
				oleItem = oleLinkWorkbookReference.Items.FirstOrDefault((OleItem i) => StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(i.Name, oleLinkNamedReference.Name));
				if (oleItem == null)
				{
					oleItem = new OleItem(oleLinkNamedReference.Name, icon: false, advise: true, preferPic: false);
					oleLinkWorkbookReference.Items.Add(oleItem);
				}
			}
			string value = namedReferenceBase.Name;
			if (namedReferenceBase.IsBuiltIn)
			{
				value = ((char)namedReferenceBase.BuiltInName).ToString();
			}
			ushort value2 = 0;
			if (namedReferenceBase.IsBuiltIn)
			{
				Utilities.SetBit(ref value2, testValue: true, 0);
			}
			if (oleItem != null && oleItem.Advise)
			{
				Utilities.SetBit(ref value2, testValue: true, 1);
			}
			if (oleItem != null && oleItem.PreferPic)
			{
				Utilities.SetBit(ref value2, testValue: true, 2);
			}
			if (namedReferenceBase.Type == NameType.OleObject)
			{
				Utilities.SetBit(ref value2, testValue: true, 4);
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value2);
			if (namedReferenceBase.Type == NameType.OleObject)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(0u);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value, LengthType.EightBit);
				return;
			}
			if (namedReferenceBase.Scope is WorkbookReferenceBase)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			}
			else
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)(((WorksheetReference)namedReferenceBase.Scope).FirstWorksheetIndex + 1));
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value, LengthType.EightBit);
			saveManager.SaveFormula(namedReferenceBase.FormulaInternal, writeSize: true, isForExternalNamedReference: true);
		}
	}

				Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
				Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream;
				currentRecordStream.ReadByte();
				int num = currentRecordStream.ReadInt32();

				{
					byte[] array = currentRecordStream.ReadBytes((int)(currentRecordStream.Length - currentRecordStream.Position));

					protection.AllowEditScenarios = (array[0] & 2) != 0;
					protection.AllowFormattingCells = (array[0] & 4) != 0;
					protection.AllowFormattingColumns = (array[0] & 8) != 0;
					protection.AllowFormattingRows = (array[0] & 0x10) != 0;
					protection.AllowInsertingColumns = (array[0] & 0x20) != 0;
					protection.AllowInsertingRows = (array[0] & 0x40) != 0;
					protection.AllowInsertingHyperlinks = (array[0] & 0x80) != 0;
					protection.AllowDeletingColumns = (array[1] & 1) != 0;
					protection.AllowDeletingRows = (array[1] & 2) != 0;
					bool selectLockedCells = (array[1] & 4) != 0;
					protection.AllowSorting = (array[1] & 8) != 0;
					protection.AllowFiltering = (array[1] & 0x10) != 0;
					protection.AllowUsingPivotTables = (array[1] & 0x20) != 0;
					bool selectUnlockedCells = (array[1] & 0x40) != 0;
					protection.InitializeSelectionMode(selectLockedCells, selectUnlockedCells);
				}
			}
		}

		{

			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteFrtHeader();
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)2);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteByte(1);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(uint.MaxValue);
				WorksheetProtection protection = worksheet.Protection;
				byte value = (byte)((protection.AllowEditObjects ? 1 : 0) | (protection.AllowEditScenarios ? 2 : 0) | (protection.AllowFormattingCells ? 4 : 0) | (protection.AllowFormattingColumns ? 8 : 0) | (protection.AllowFormattingRows ? 16 : 0) | (protection.AllowInsertingColumns ? 32 : 0) | (protection.AllowInsertingRows ? 64 : 0) | (protection.AllowInsertingHyperlinks ? 128 : 0));
				byte value2 = (byte)((protection.AllowDeletingColumns ? 1 : 0) | (protection.AllowDeletingRows ? 2 : 0) | (protection.SelectLockedCells ? 4 : 0) | (protection.AllowSorting ? 8 : 0) | (protection.AllowFiltering ? 16 : 0) | (protection.AllowUsingPivotTables ? 32 : 0) | (protection.SelectUnlockedCells ? 64 : 0));
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteByte(value);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteByte(value2);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteByte(0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteByte(0);
			}
		}
