	internal class FONTRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.FONT;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			FONTRecordInfo fONTRecordInfo = new FONTRecordInfo();
			fONTRecordInfo.dyHeight = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			fONTRecordInfo.temp1 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			fONTRecordInfo.icv = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			fONTRecordInfo.bls = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			fONTRecordInfo.sss = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			fONTRecordInfo.uls = (byte)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			fONTRecordInfo.bFamily = (byte)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			fONTRecordInfo.bCharSet = (byte)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			fONTRecordInfo.fontName = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedString(LengthType.EightBit).UnformattedString;
			loadManager.DeferredFONTRecords.Add(fONTRecordInfo);
		}

		public static void LoadHelper(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, FONTRecordInfo info)
		{
			WorkbookFontData workbookFontData = (WorkbookFontData)loadManager.Workbook.CreateNewWorkbookFont();
			if (info.dyHeight < 20)
			{
				info.dyHeight = 20;
			}
			workbookFontData.Height = info.dyHeight;
			workbookFontData.Italic = (((info.temp1 & 2) == 2) ? ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True : ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False);
			workbookFontData.Strikeout = (((info.temp1 & 8) == 8) ? ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True : ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False);
			workbookFontData.ColorInfo = new WorkbookColorInfo(loadManager.Workbook, info.icv);
			workbookFontData.Bold = ((info.bls >= 700) ? ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True : ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False);
			workbookFontData.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle = (FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle)info.sss;
			workbookFontData.UnderlineStyle = (FontUnderlineStyle)info.uls;
			workbookFontData.Name = info.fontName;
			if (loadManager.Fonts.Count == 4)
			{
				loadManager.Fonts.Add(null);
			}
			if (loadManager.Fonts.Count == 0)
			{
				loadManager.Workbook.Fonts.DefaultElement = workbookFontData;
			}
			loadManager.Fonts.Add(workbookFontData);
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorkbookFontData workbookFontData = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<WorkbookFontData>();
			if (workbookFontData != null)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)workbookFontData.Height);
				ushort num = 0;
				if (workbookFontData.Italic == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True)
				{
					num |= 2;
				}
				if (workbookFontData.Strikeout == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True)
				{
					num |= 8;
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)workbookFontData.ColorInfo.GetIndex(saveManager.Workbook, ColorableItem.CellFont));
				ushort value = (ushort)((workbookFontData.Bold == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True) ? 700u : 400u);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)workbookFontData.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)workbookFontData.UnderlineStyle);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)Utilities.GetFontFamilyInternal(workbookFontData.Name));
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(workbookFontData.Name, LengthType.EightBit, allowCharCompression: false);
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class FORMULARecord : CellValueRecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.FORMULA;

		protected override void LoadCellValue(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex, out object cellValue, out object lastCalculatedCellValue)
		{
			lastCalculatedCellValue = DecodeCacheValue(loadManager, data, dataIndex);
			dataIndex += 8;
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			bool isDirtyOnLoad = (num & 2) == 2;
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			Formula formula = loadManager.LoadFormula(FormulaType.Formula, ref data, ref dataIndex);
			formula.IsDirtyOnLoad = isDirtyOnLoad;
			cellValue = formula;
		}

		protected override void SaveCellValue(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, MemoryStream initialData)
		{
			WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003.CellContext currentCellContext = saveManager.CurrentCellContext;
			Formula formula = Utilities.FormulaFromCellValueRaw(currentCellContext.Value);
			if (formula != null)
			{
				CellDataContext currentCellDataContext = saveManager.CurrentCellDataContext;
				object serializableCellValue = saveManager.GetSerializableCellValue(currentCellContext.Row, currentCellDataContext, getCalculatedFormulaValues: true);
				if (formula is ArrayFormula arrayFormula)
				{
					formula = arrayFormula.InteriorCellFormula;
				}
				string stringValue;
				byte[] array = EncodeCacheValue(saveManager.Workbook, serializableCellValue, out stringValue);
				initialData.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
				ushort num = 0;
				if (formula.RecalculateAlways)
				{
					num |= 1;
				}
				if (currentCellContext.Row.GetCellCalcReference(currentCellDataContext.ColumnIndex).ShouldBeRecalculatedOnNextLoad())
				{
					num |= 2;
				}
				initialData.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(num), 0, 2);
				initialData.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(0u), 0, 4);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(initialData);
				saveManager.SaveFormula(formula, writeSize: true, isForExternalNamedReference: false);
				if (stringValue != null)
				{
					saveManager.ContextStack.Push((object)stringValue);
					saveManager.WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.STRING);
					saveManager.ContextStack.Pop();
				}
			}
		}

		private static object DecodeCacheValue(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, byte[] data, int dataIndex)
		{
			double num = BitConverter.ToDouble(data, dataIndex);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return num;
			}
			switch (data[dataIndex])
			{
			case 0:
			{
				long position = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position;
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Length;
				try
				{
					using Biff8RecordStream biff8RecordStream = new Biff8RecordStream(loadManager);
					if (biff8RecordStream.RecordType == BIFF8RecordType.SHRFMLA || biff8RecordStream.RecordType == BIFF8RecordType.ARRAY)
					{
						WorkItemExtensions.ExecuteSynchronously(loadManager.LoadCurrentRecord());
						using Biff8RecordStream stream = new Biff8RecordStream(loadManager);
						return DecodeCachedValueFromStringStream(stream);
					}
					return DecodeCachedValueFromStringStream(biff8RecordStream);
				}
				finally
				{
					loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = position;
				}
			}
			case 1:
				return BitConverter.ToBoolean(data, dataIndex + 2);
			case 2:
				return ErrorValue.FromValue(data[dataIndex + 2]);
			case 3:
				return string.Empty;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static string DecodeCachedValueFromStringStream(Biff8RecordStream stream)
		{
			if (stream.RecordType != BIFF8RecordType.STRING)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManagerBiff = stream.LoadManagerBiff8;
			WorkItemExtensions.ExecuteSynchronously(loadManagerBiff.LoadCurrentRecord());
			if (loadManagerBiff.ContextStack.Current is string result)
			{
				loadManagerBiff.ContextStack.Pop();
				return result;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static byte[] EncodeCacheValue(Workbook workbook, object value, out string stringValue)
		{
			return GetCacheValueBytes(workbook, value, out stringValue);
		}

		private static byte[] GetCacheValueBytes(Workbook workbook, object value, out string stringValue)
		{
			stringValue = null;
			if (value is bool)
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[8] { 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 255, 255 };
				array[2] = Convert.ToByte((bool)value);
				return array;
			}
			if (value is ErrorValue errorValue)
			{
				byte[] array2 = new byte[8] { 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 255, 255 };
				array2[2] = errorValue.Value;
				return array2;
			}
			string text = value as string;
			if (text == null && value is StringElement stringElement)
			{
				text = stringElement.UnformattedString;
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				stringValue = text;
				return new byte[8] { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 255, 255 };
			}
			if (value is DateTime)
			{
				double? num = ExcelCalcValue.DateTimeToExcelDate(workbook, (DateTime)value);
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					return BitConverter.GetBytes(num.Value);
				}
				return new byte[8];
			}
			try
			{
				double value2 = Convert.ToDouble(value, workbook.CultureResolved);
				return BitConverter.GetBytes(value2);
			}
			catch
			{
				return new byte[8];
			}
		}
	}

	internal class LIST12Record : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public enum LIST12DataType
		{
			BlockLevelFormatting,
			StyleInfo,
			DisplayName
		}

		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.LIST12;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFrtHeader();
			LIST12DataType lIST12DataType = (LIST12DataType)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			uint id = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			WorksheetTable tableById = worksheet.Tables.GetTableById(id);
			if (tableById != null)
			{
				switch (lIST12DataType)
				{
				case LIST12DataType.BlockLevelFormatting:
					loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadList12BlockLevel(tableById);
					break;
				case LIST12DataType.StyleInfo:
					loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadList12TableStyleClientInfo(tableById);
					break;
				case LIST12DataType.DisplayName:
					loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadList12DisplayName(tableById);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorksheetTable worksheetTable = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<WorksheetTable>();
			LIST12DataType lIST12DataType = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<LIST12DataType>();
			if (worksheetTable != null)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteFrtHeader();
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)lIST12DataType);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(worksheetTable.Id);
				switch (lIST12DataType)
				{
				case LIST12DataType.BlockLevelFormatting:
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteList12BlockLevel(worksheetTable);
					break;
				case LIST12DataType.StyleInfo:
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteList12TableStyleClientInfo(worksheetTable);
					break;
				case LIST12DataType.DisplayName:
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteList12DisplayName(worksheetTable);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

	internal class MERGEDCELLSRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.MERGEDCELLS;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HashSet<Rectangle> hashSet = Utilities.CreateRectangleHashSet();
			while (loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position < loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Length)
			{
				ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					ushort num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
					ushort num3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
					ushort num4 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
					ushort num5 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
					Rectangle item = Utilities.CreateRectangle(num4, num2, num5 - num4, num3 - num2);
					if (hashSet.Add(item))
					{
						worksheet.MergedCellsRegions.Add(num2, num4, num3, num5);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using IEnumerator<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion> enumerator = saveManager.GetMergedCellRegions(worksheet).GetEnumerator();
			bool flag = enumerator.MoveNext();
			do
			{
				long position = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position;
				int num = 0;
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				while (flag && saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.BytesAvailableInCurrentBlock >= 8)
				{
					WorksheetMergedCellsRegion current = enumerator.Current;
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)current.FirstRow);
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)current.LastRow);
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)current.FirstColumn);
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)current.LastColumn);
					num++;
					flag = enumerator.MoveNext();
				}
				long position2 = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position;
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = position;
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)num);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = position2;
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.CapCurrentBlock();
			}
			while (flag);
		}
	}

	internal abstract class MultipleCellValueRecordBase : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		protected abstract CellDefinition[] LoadCellValues(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, int numberOfCells, ref byte[] data, ref int dataIndex);

		protected abstract void SaveCellValues(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, CellDefinition[] value);

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				byte[] data = new byte[0];
				int dataIndex = 0;
				ushort rowIndex = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				short num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				ushort num2;
				if (data.Length == loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Length)
				{
					num2 = BitConverter.ToUInt16(data, data.Length - 2);
				}
				else
				{
					loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Length - 2;
					num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				}
				CellDefinition[] array = LoadCellValues(loadManager, num2 - num + 1, ref data, ref dataIndex);
				WorksheetRow row = loadManager.GetRow(worksheet, rowIndex);
				short num3 = 0;
				for (short num4 = num; num4 <= num2; num4++)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatData data2 = loadManager.Formats[array[num3].FormatIndex];
					row.SetCellFormatWhileLoading(num4, data2);
					row.SetCellValueRaw(num4, array[num3].Value);
					num3++;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			MultipleCellValueInfo multipleCellValueInfo = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<MultipleCellValueInfo>();
			if (multipleCellValueInfo != null)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)multipleCellValueInfo.RowIndex);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)multipleCellValueInfo.FirstColumnIndex);
				CellDefinition[] array = new CellDefinition[multipleCellValueInfo.NumberOfCells];
				for (int i = 0; i < multipleCellValueInfo.NumberOfCells; i++)
				{
					ref CellDefinition reference = ref array[i];
					reference = new CellDefinition(saveManager.GetCellFormatIndex(multipleCellValueInfo.GetCellFormat(i)), multipleCellValueInfo.GetValue(i));
				}
				SaveCellValues(saveManager, array);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)multipleCellValueInfo.LastColumnIndex);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class NAMERecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.NAME;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			byte[] data = new byte[0];
			int dataIndex = 0;
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			bool hidden = (num & 1) == 1;
			bool flag = (num & 2) == 2;
			bool isMacroName = (num & 8) == 8;
			bool flag2 = (num & 0x20) == 32;
			if ((num & 0x1000) != 4096)
			{
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				byte stringLength = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				ushort rpnTokenArraySize = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				ushort num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				byte b = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				byte b2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				byte b3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				byte b4 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
				string text = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(stringLength, ref data, ref dataIndex).UnformattedString;
				if (flag && text.StartsWith("_xlfn."))
				{
					text = text.Substring(6);
				}
				Formula formula = loadManager.LoadFormula(FormulaType.NamedReferenceFormula, rpnTokenArraySize, ref data, ref dataIndex);
				if (b > 0)
				{
					loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(b, ref data, ref dataIndex);
				}
				if (b2 > 0)
				{
					loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(b2, ref data, ref dataIndex);
				}
				if (b3 > 0)
				{
					loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(b3, ref data, ref dataIndex);
				}
				if (b4 > 0)
				{
					loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringFromBuffer(b4, ref data, ref dataIndex);
				}
				object scope = loadManager.Workbook;
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					scope = loadManager.Workbook.Worksheets[num2 - 1];
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					text = NamedReferenceBase.NameFromBuiltInName((BuiltInName)text[0]);
				}
				NamedReference namedReference = new NamedReference(loadManager.Workbook.NamedReferences, scope, hidden);
				namedReference.SetNameInternal(text, validateName: false);
				loadManager.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.AddNamedReference(namedReference);
				namedReference.IsFunction = flag;
				namedReference.IsMacroName = isMacroName;
				loadManager.FinalizeNamedReference(namedReference, formula, hidden);
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			NamedReferenceBase namedReferenceBase = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<NamedReferenceBase>();
			if (namedReferenceBase != null)
			{
				string text = namedReferenceBase.Name;
				if (namedReferenceBase.IsBuiltIn)
				{
					text = ((char)namedReferenceBase.BuiltInName).ToString();
				}
				ushort num = 0;
				if (namedReferenceBase.Hidden)
				{
					num |= 1;
				}
				if (namedReferenceBase.IsFunction)
				{
					text = "_xlfn." + text;
					num |= 2;
				}
				if (namedReferenceBase.IsMacroName)
				{
					num |= 8;
				}
				if (namedReferenceBase.IsBuiltIn)
				{
					num |= 0x20;
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)text.Length);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				if (namedReferenceBase.Scope is Workbook)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				}
				else
				{
					int num2 = saveManager.Worksheets.IndexOf((Worksheet)namedReferenceBase.Scope);
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)(num2 + 1));
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(text);
				int num3 = 0;
				if (namedReferenceBase.FormulaInternal != null)
				{
					num3 = saveManager.SaveFormula(namedReferenceBase.FormulaInternal, writeSize: false, isForExternalNamedReference: false);
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = 4L;
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)num3);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Length;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class NOTERecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.NOTE;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ushort index = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			short columnIndex = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadInt16();
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = worksheet.Rows[index];
			ushort noteOptionFlags = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			StringElement stringElement = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedString(LengthType.SixteenBit);
			for (int i = 0; i < loadManager.LoadedComments.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetCellComment worksheetCellComment = loadManager.LoadedComments[i];
				if (worksheetCellComment.Type2003.HasValue && worksheetCellComment.Type2003.Value == ShapeType.TextBox && worksheetCellComment.Obj != null && worksheetCellComment.Obj.Cmo != null && worksheetCellComment.Obj.Cmo.Id == num)
				{
					worksheetCellComment.Author = stringElement.UnformattedString;
					worksheetCellComment.NoteOptionFlags = noteOptionFlags;
					worksheetRow.SetCellCommentInternal(columnIndex, worksheetCellComment);
					loadManager.LoadedComments.RemoveAt(i);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorksheetCell worksheetCell = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<WorksheetCell>();
			if (!(worksheetCell == null) && worksheetCell.Worksheet != null && worksheetCell.Comment != null && (worksheetCell.Comment.Obj != null || worksheetCell.Comment.Obj.Cmo != null))
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheetCell.RowIndex);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheetCell.ColumnIndex);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(worksheetCell.Comment.NoteOptionFlags);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(worksheetCell.Comment.Obj.Cmo.Id);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(worksheetCell.Comment.Author, LengthType.SixteenBit);
				if (saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Length % 2 == 0)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)0);
				}
			}
		}
	}

				worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FrozenRows = num2;
			}
			else
			{
				if (num > 0)
				{
					worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstColumnInLeftPane = worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstColumnInRightPane;
					worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstColumnInRightPane = firstColumnInRightPane;
				}
				if (num2 > 0)

					worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstRowInTopPane = worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstRowInBottomPane;
					worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstRowInBottomPane = firstRowInBottomPane;

				worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.TopPaneHeight = num2;

				ushort num2 = (ushort)worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FrozenColumns;

				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
				if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FrozenRows > 0)
				{

					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value);
				}
				else

					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);

				if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FrozenColumns > 0)
				{

					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value2);
				}
				else
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				}
			}
			else

				ushort num4 = (ushort)worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.TopPaneHeight;

				else

				}

	internal class ROWRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.ROW;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			byte[] data = new byte[0];
			int dataIndex = 0;
			ushort index = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = worksheet.Rows[index];
			loadManager.OnRowLoaded(worksheetRow);
			dataIndex += 4;
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			dataIndex += 4;
			uint num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			worksheetRow.OutlineLevel = (byte)(num2 & 7);
			bool hidden = (num2 & 0x20) == 32;
			bool flag = (num2 & 0x40) == 64;
			bool flag2 = (num2 & 0x80) == 128;
			int index2 = (ushort)((num2 & 0xFFF0000) >> 16);
			worksheetRow.HasThickTop = (num2 & 0x10000000) == 268435456;
			worksheetRow.HasThickBottom = (num2 & 0x20000000) == 536870912;
			if (flag)
			{
				worksheetRow.Height = num;
			}
			else if (worksheet.HasCustomDefaultRowHeight)
			{
				worksheetRow.HeightInternal = (short)num;
			}
			worksheetRow.Hidden = hidden;
			if (flag2)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = loadManager.Formats[index2];
				if (!worksheetCellFormatData.EqualsInternal(loadManager.Workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement))
				{
					worksheetRow.CellFormat.SetFormatting(worksheetCellFormatData);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<WorksheetRow>();
			if (worksheetRow == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetRowSerializationCache serializationCache = saveManager.GetSerializationCache(worksheetRow);
			if (serializationCache != null)
			{
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(16);
				memoryStream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)worksheetRow.Index), 0, 2);
				memoryStream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(serializationCache.FirstCell), 0, 2);
				memoryStream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(serializationCache.FirstCellInUndefinedTail), 0, 2);
				int num = ((worksheetRow.HeightInternal >= 0) ? (num = worksheetRow.HeightInternal) : (num = worksheetRow.Worksheet.DefaultRowHeight));
				memoryStream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)num), 0, 2);
				memoryStream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(0u), 0, 4);
				uint num2 = 256u;
				num2 |= (uint)worksheetRow.OutlineLevel;
				if (serializationCache.HasCollapseIndicator)
				{
					num2 |= 0x10;
				}
				if (worksheetRow.Hidden)
				{
					num2 |= 0x20;
				}
				WorksheetCellFormatData defaultElement = saveManager.Workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement;
				WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = (worksheetRow.HasCellFormat ? worksheetRow.CellFormatInternal.Element : defaultElement);
				if (worksheetRow.HasCustomHeight)
				{
					num2 |= 0x40;
				}
				int num3 = saveManager.GetCellFormatIndex(worksheetCellFormatData);
				if (num3 < 0)
				{
					num3 = 0;
				}
				if (!worksheetCellFormatData.EqualsInternal(defaultElement))
				{
					num2 |= 0x80;
				}
				num2 |= (uint)(num3 << 16);
				if (worksheetRow.HasThickTop)
				{
					num2 |= 0x10000000;
				}
				if (worksheetRow.HasThickBottom)
				{
					num2 |= 0x20000000;
				}
				memoryStream.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(num2), 0, 4);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(memoryStream);
			}
		}
	}

			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort resolution = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort verticalResolution = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			printOptions.HeaderMargin = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadDouble();
			printOptions.FooterMargin = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadDouble();
			ushort numberOfCopies = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			printOptions.PageOrder = (PageOrder)(num & 1);
			Orientation orientation = (Orientation)((num & 2) >> 1);
			bool flag = (num & 4) == 4;
			printOptions.PrintInBlackAndWhite = (num & 8) == 8;
			printOptions.DraftQuality = (num & 0x10) == 16;
			bool flag2 = (num & 0x20) == 32;
			bool flag3 = (num & 0x40) == 64;
			printOptions.PageNumbering = (PageNumbering)((num & 0x80) >> 7);
			bool flag4 = (num & 0x200) == 512;
			printOptions.PrintErrors = (PrintErrors)((num & 0xC00) >> 10);
			if (flag)
			{
				paperSize = PaperSize.Letter;
				value = 100;
				orientation = Orientation.Portrait;
				resolution = 600;
				verticalResolution = 600;
				numberOfCopies = 1;
			}
			else if (flag3)
			{
				orientation = Orientation.Portrait;
			}
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(PaperSize), paperSize))
			{
				paperSize = PaperSize.Letter;
			}
			printOptions.PaperSize = paperSize;
			printOptions.SetScalingFactor(value, throwOnError: false);
			printOptions.Resolution = resolution;
			printOptions.VerticalResolution = verticalResolution;
			printOptions.NumberOfCopies = numberOfCopies;
			printOptions.Orientation = orientation;
			if (flag2)
			{
				if (flag4)
				{
					printOptions.PrintNotes = PrintNotes.PrintAtEndOfSheet;
				}
				else
				{
					printOptions.PrintNotes = PrintNotes.PrintAsDisplayed;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				printOptions.PrintNotes = PrintNotes.DontPrint;
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			PrintOptions printOptions = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<PrintOptions>();
			if (printOptions != null)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)printOptions.PaperSize);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)printOptions.ScalingFactor);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)printOptions.StartPageNumber);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)printOptions.MaxPagesHorizontally);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)printOptions.MaxPagesVertically);
				ushort num = 0;
				num |= (ushort)printOptions.PageOrder;
				num |= (ushort)((ushort)printOptions.OrientationResolved << 1);
				if (printOptions.PrintInBlackAndWhite)
				{
					num |= 8;
				}
				if (printOptions.DraftQuality)
				{
					num |= 0x10;
				}
				if (printOptions.PrintNotes != PrintNotes.DontPrint)
				{
					num |= 0x20;
				}
				num |= (ushort)((ushort)printOptions.PageNumbering << 7);
				if (printOptions.PrintNotes == PrintNotes.PrintAtEndOfSheet)
				{
					num |= 0x200;
				}
				num |= (ushort)((ushort)printOptions.PrintErrors << 10);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)printOptions.Resolution);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)printOptions.VerticalResolution);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(printOptions.HeaderMargin);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(printOptions.FooterMargin);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)printOptions.NumberOfCopies);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SHEETEXTRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		private const uint SHEETEXTRecordSize = 40u;

		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.SHEETEXT;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFrtHeader();
				uint num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
				uint value = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
				int bits = Utilities.GetBits(value, 0, 6);
				if (num < 40)
				{
					worksheet.DisplayOptions.TabColorInfo = new WorkbookColorInfo(loadManager.Workbook, bits);
					return;
				}
				uint value2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
				Utilities.GetBits(value2, 0, 6);
				Utilities.TestBit(value2, 7);
				Utilities.TestBit(value2, 8);
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.TabColorInfo = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadCFColor();
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteFrtHeader();
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(40u);
				WorkbookColorInfo tabColorInfo = worksheet.DisplayOptions.TabColorInfo;
				int index = tabColorInfo.GetIndex(saveManager.Workbook, ColorableItem.WorksheetTab);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(index);
				uint value = 0u;
				Utilities.AddBits(ref value, index, 0, 6);
				Utilities.SetBit(ref value, testValue: true, 7);
				Utilities.SetBit(ref value, testValue: false, 8);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteCFColor(tabColorInfo, ColorableItem.WorksheetTab);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SHRFMLARecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.SHRFMLA;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			byte[] data = new byte[0];
			int dataIndex = 0;
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			ushort num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16FromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			byte b = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			byte b2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByteFromBuffer(ref data, ref dataIndex);
			Formula formula = loadManager.LoadFormula(FormulaType.Formula, ref data, ref dataIndex);
			_ = worksheet.Rows[num];
			loadManager.SharedFormulasInCurrentWorksheet[new WorksheetCellAddress(num, b)] = formula;
			List<KeyValuePair<WorksheetCellAddress, ExcelCalcValue>> list = new List<KeyValuePair<WorksheetCellAddress, ExcelCalcValue>>(loadManager.PendingSharedFormulaRoots);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<WorksheetCellAddress, ExcelCalcValue> item in list)
			{
				WorksheetCellAddress key = item.Key;
				ExcelCalcValue value = item.Value;
				int rowIndex = key.RowIndex;
				short columnIndex = key.ColumnIndex;
				if (num <= rowIndex && rowIndex <= num2 && b <= columnIndex && columnIndex <= b2)
				{
					loadManager.PendingSharedFormulaRoots.Remove(key);
					WorksheetRow worksheetRow = worksheet.Rows[rowIndex];
					formula.ApplyTo(worksheetRow, columnIndex);
					worksheetRow.SetCachedCalculatedValue(columnIndex, value);
					Formula cellFormulaInternal = worksheetRow.GetCellFormulaInternal(columnIndex);
					loadManager.SharedFormulasInCurrentWorksheet[new WorksheetCellAddress(rowIndex, columnIndex)] = cellFormulaInternal;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
		}
	}
	internal class SORTDATA12Record : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.SORTDATA12;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFrtHeader();
			ushort value = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			Utilities.TestBit(value, 0);
			bool caseSensitive = Utilities.TestBit(value, 1);
			bool flag = Utilities.TestBit(value, 2);
			int bits = Utilities.GetBits(value, 3, 5);
			if (bits != 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadRFX(worksheet);
			uint num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			uint id = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			WorksheetTable tableById = worksheet.Tables.GetTableById(id);
			if (tableById != null)
			{
				tableById.SortSettings.CaseSensitive = caseSensitive;
				tableById.SortSettings.SortMethod = ((!flag && !(loadManager.Workbook.CultureResolved.Name == "zh-TW")) ? SortMethod.PinYin : SortMethod.Stroke);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadSortCond12(tableById);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorksheetTable worksheetTable = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<WorksheetTable>();
			if (worksheetTable == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SortSettings<WorksheetTableColumn> sortSettings = worksheetTable.SortSettings;
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteFrtHeader();
			int valueToAdd = 1;
			bool hasAlternateSortMethod = worksheetTable.SortSettings.HasAlternateSortMethod;
			ushort value = 0;
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, testValue: false, 0);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, sortSettings.CaseSensitive, 1);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref value, hasAlternateSortMethod, 2);
			Utilities.AddBits(ref value, valueToAdd, 3, 5);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteRFX(worksheetTable.SortAndHeadersRegion);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((uint)sortSettings.SortConditions.Count);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(worksheetTable.Id);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<WorksheetTableColumn, SortCondition> item in (IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<WorksheetTableColumn, SortCondition>>)sortSettings.SortConditions)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.CapCurrentBlock();
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteSortCond12(item.Key, item.Value);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SSTRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override bool IsAsyncLoadingSupported => true;

		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.SST;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
		}

		public override WorkItem LoadAsync(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			if (loadManager.AreRecordsWaitingForAssociatedExtRecords)
			{
				loadManager.DeferredSstRecordPosition = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.GetStartOfRecord();
				return null;
			}
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then(loadManager.VerifyFormatsLoaded(), (Func<WorkItem>)delegate
			{
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
				uint stringCount = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
				return loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedStringBlock(stringCount, loadManager.SharedStringTable);
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		public override WorkItem SaveAsync(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(saveManager.TotalStringsUsedInDocument);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((uint)saveManager.TotalSharedStringCount);
			bool removeCarriageReturns = saveManager.Workbook.ShouldRemoveCarriageReturnsOnSave;
			int stringIndex = 0;
			int stringCount = 0;
			return Async.ForEachSlice<StringElement>(saveManager.GetSharedStrings(), (Func<StringElement, bool>)delegate(StringElement element)
			{
				SaveStringElement(saveManager, element, removeCarriageReturns, ref stringIndex);
				stringCount++;
				if (1000 < stringCount)
				{
					stringCount = 0;
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			});
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
		}

		private static void SaveStringElement(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, StringElement element, bool removeCarriageReturns, ref int stringIndex)
		{
			if (stringIndex % 8 == 0)
			{
				WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003.ExtSstItem item = new WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003.ExtSstItem
				{
					AbsolutePosition = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position,
					OffsetInRecordBlock = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.PositionInCurrentBlock
				};
				saveManager.ExtSstData.Add(item);
			}
			if (removeCarriageReturns)
			{
				element = element.RemoveCarriageReturns(saveManager.Workbook);
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(element, LengthType.SixteenBit);
			stringIndex++;
		}
	}

	internal class STYLEEXTRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.STYLEEXT;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			STYLEEXTRecordInfo sTYLEEXTRecordInfo = new STYLEEXTRecordInfo();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFrtHeader();
			sTYLEEXTRecordInfo.temp8 = (byte)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			sTYLEEXTRecordInfo.iCategory = (byte)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			sTYLEEXTRecordInfo.builtInData = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			sTYLEEXTRecordInfo.stName = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadLPWideString();
			sTYLEEXTRecordInfo.props = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadXFProps();
			loadManager.DeferredSTYLEEXTRecords.Add(sTYLEEXTRecordInfo);
		}

		public static void LoadHelper(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, STYLEEXTRecordInfo info)
		{
			WorkbookStyleCollection styles = loadManager.Workbook.Styles;
			List<WorkbookStyle> loadedStyles = loadManager.LoadedStyles;
			bool flag = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp8, 0);
			bool flag2 = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp8, 1);
			bool isCustomized = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp8, 2);
			byte outlineLevel = (byte)(info.builtInData >> 8);
			byte b = (byte)(info.builtInData & 0xFF);
			WorkbookStyle workbookStyle = null;
			if (flag)
			{
				workbookStyle = styles.GetBuiltInStyle((BuiltInStyleType)b);
			}
			if (workbookStyle == null)
			{
				workbookStyle = styles[info.stName];
			}
			if (workbookStyle == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				styles.Remove(workbookStyle);
			}
			WorkbookBuiltInStyle workbookBuiltInStyle = workbookStyle as WorkbookBuiltInStyle;
			if (flag && Enum.IsDefined(typeof(BuiltInStyleType), (BuiltInStyleType)b) && workbookBuiltInStyle == null)
			{
				int num = loadedStyles.IndexOf(workbookStyle);
				workbookBuiltInStyle = new WorkbookBuiltInStyle(loadManager.Workbook, workbookStyle.StyleFormatInternal, (BuiltInStyleType)b, outlineLevel);
				styles.Remove(workbookStyle);
				styles.Add(workbookBuiltInStyle);
				workbookStyle = workbookBuiltInStyle;
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					loadedStyles[num] = workbookStyle;
				}
			}
			Biff8RecordStream.ApplyXFProps(loadManager.Workbook, workbookStyle.StyleFormatInternal, fUIFill: false, info.props);
			if (workbookBuiltInStyle != null)
			{
				workbookBuiltInStyle.IsCustomized = isCustomized;
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorkbookStyle workbookStyle = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<WorkbookStyle>();
			if (workbookStyle != null)
			{
				WorkbookBuiltInStyle workbookBuiltInStyle = workbookStyle as WorkbookBuiltInStyle;
				bool testValue = workbookBuiltInStyle?.IsCustomized ?? false;
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteFrtHeader();
				byte value = 0;
				Utilities.SetBit(ref value, workbookStyle.IsBuiltIn, 0);
				Utilities.SetBit(ref value, testValue: false, 1);
				Utilities.SetBit(ref value, testValue, 2);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)workbookStyle.Category);
				ushort value2 = ushort.MaxValue;
				if (workbookBuiltInStyle != null)
				{
					value2 = (ushort)((workbookBuiltInStyle.OutlineLevel << 8) | (byte)workbookBuiltInStyle.Type);
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value2);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteLPWideString(workbookStyle.Name);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteXFProps(workbookStyle.StyleFormatInternal);
			}
		}
	}

		public byte iCategory;

		public string stName;

	internal class STYLERecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.STYLE;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			STYLERecordInfo sTYLERecordInfo = new STYLERecordInfo();
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			sTYLERecordInfo.styleXFIndex = num & 0xFFF;
			sTYLERecordInfo.isBuiltIn = (num & 0x8000) == 32768;
			if (sTYLERecordInfo.isBuiltIn)
			{
				sTYLERecordInfo.type = (BuiltInStyleType)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
				sTYLERecordInfo.outlineLevel = (byte)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			}
			else
			{
				sTYLERecordInfo.name = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedString(LengthType.SixteenBit).UnformattedString;
			}
			loadManager.DeferredSTYLERecords.Add(sTYLERecordInfo);
		}

		public static void LoadHelper(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, STYLERecordInfo info)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatData styleFormat = loadManager.Formats[info.styleXFIndex];
			WorkbookStyle style = (info.isBuiltIn ? new WorkbookBuiltInStyle(loadManager.Workbook, styleFormat, info.type, info.outlineLevel) : ((!WorkbookStyleCollection.StyleTypesByName.TryGetValue(info.name, out var value)) ? ((WorkbookStyle)new WorkbookUserDefinedStyle(loadManager.Workbook, styleFormat, info.name)) : ((WorkbookStyle)new WorkbookBuiltInStyle(loadManager.Workbook, styleFormat, value.Type, value.OutlineLevel))));
			style = loadManager.Workbook.Styles.Add(style);
			loadManager.LoadedStyles.Add(style);
			if (!loadManager.ChildrenXfsByStyleId.TryGetValue(info.styleXFIndex, out var value2))
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatData styleFormatInternal = style.StyleFormatInternal;
			for (int i = 0; i < value2.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = value2[i];
				worksheetCellFormatData.Style = style;
				WorksheetCellFormatOptions worksheetCellFormatOptions = worksheetCellFormatData.FormatOptions;
				if (!Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting) && (worksheetCellFormatData.AlignmentResolved != styleFormatInternal.AlignmentResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.IndentResolved != styleFormatInternal.IndentResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.RotationResolved != styleFormatInternal.RotationResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.ShrinkToFitResolved != styleFormatInternal.ShrinkToFitResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.VerticalAlignmentResolved != styleFormatInternal.VerticalAlignmentResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.WrapTextResolved != styleFormatInternal.WrapTextResolved))
				{
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting;
				}
				if (!Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting) && (worksheetCellFormatData.BottomBorderColorInfoResolved != styleFormatInternal.BottomBorderColorInfoResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.BottomBorderStyleResolved != styleFormatInternal.BottomBorderStyleResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.DiagonalBorderColorInfoResolved != styleFormatInternal.DiagonalBorderColorInfoResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.DiagonalBordersResolved != styleFormatInternal.DiagonalBordersResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.DiagonalBorderStyleResolved != styleFormatInternal.DiagonalBorderStyleResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.LeftBorderColorInfoResolved != styleFormatInternal.LeftBorderColorInfoResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.LeftBorderStyleResolved != styleFormatInternal.LeftBorderStyleResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.RightBorderColorInfoResolved != styleFormatInternal.RightBorderColorInfoResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.RightBorderStyleResolved != styleFormatInternal.RightBorderStyleResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.TopBorderColorInfoResolved != styleFormatInternal.TopBorderColorInfoResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.TopBorderStyleResolved != styleFormatInternal.TopBorderStyleResolved))
				{
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting;
				}
				if (!Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting) && !object.Equals(worksheetCellFormatData.FillResolved, styleFormatInternal.FillResolved))
				{
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting;
				}
				if (!Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting) && (worksheetCellFormatData.FontBoldResolved != styleFormatInternal.FontBoldResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.FontColorInfoResolved != styleFormatInternal.FontColorInfoResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.FontHeightResolved != styleFormatInternal.FontHeightResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.FontItalicResolved != styleFormatInternal.FontItalicResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.FontNameResolved != styleFormatInternal.FontNameResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.FontStrikeoutResolved != styleFormatInternal.FontStrikeoutResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyleResolved != styleFormatInternal.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyleResolved || worksheetCellFormatData.FontUnderlineStyleResolved != styleFormatInternal.FontUnderlineStyleResolved))
				{
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting;
				}
				if (!Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting) && worksheetCellFormatData.FormatStringResolved != styleFormatInternal.FormatStringResolved)
				{
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting;
				}
				if (!Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting) && worksheetCellFormatData.LockedResolved != styleFormatInternal.LockedResolved)
				{
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting;
				}
				worksheetCellFormatData.FormatOptions = worksheetCellFormatOptions;
				worksheetCellFormatData.CacheResolvedFormatOptionsValues(worksheetCellFormatOptions, styleFormatInternal);
				worksheetCellFormatData.ResetFormatOptions(WorksheetCellFormatOptions.All & ~worksheetCellFormatOptions);
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorkbookStyle workbookStyle = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<WorkbookStyle>();
			if (workbookStyle != null)
			{
				int num = saveManager.GetStyleFormatIndex(workbookStyle);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				WorkbookBuiltInStyle workbookBuiltInStyle = workbookStyle as WorkbookBuiltInStyle;
				bool flag = workbookBuiltInStyle?.IsBuiltInStyleIn2003 ?? false;
				ushort num2 = 0;
				num2 |= (ushort)num;
				Utilities.SetBit(ref num2, flag, 15);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num2);
				if (flag)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)workbookBuiltInStyle.Type);

	internal class SUPBOOKRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		private const char ProgIdSeparator = '\u0003';

		private const int CurrentWorkbookID = 1025;

		private const int AddInFunctionListID = 14849;

		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.SUPBOOK;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReferenceBase;
			switch (num2)
			{
			case 1025:
				workbookReferenceBase = loadManager.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference;
				break;
			case 14849:
				workbookReferenceBase = loadManager.Workbook.AddInFunctionsWorkbookReference;
				break;
			default:
			{
				string unformattedString = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedString(num2).UnformattedString;
				unformattedString = Utilities.DecodeURL(loadManager.FilePath, unformattedString);
				int num3 = unformattedString?.IndexOf('\u0003') ?? (-1);
				if (0 <= num3)
				{
					FormulaParser.ParseOleObjectLink(unformattedString, out var progId, out var objectLink, '\u0003');
					workbookReferenceBase = loadManager.Workbook.GetWorkbookReference(progId, objectLink);
					break;
				}
				string[] array = new string[num];
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					array[i] = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedString(LengthType.SixteenBit).UnformattedString;
				}
				workbookReferenceBase = loadManager.Workbook.GetWorkbookReference(unformattedString);
				if (workbookReferenceBase is ExternalWorkbookReference externalWorkbookReference)
				{
					externalWorkbookReference.WorksheetNames.AddRange(array);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			loadManager.WorkbookReferences.Add(workbookReferenceBase);
			loadManager.PrepareForDataFromExternalWorkbook(workbookReferenceBase);
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReferenceBase = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<WorkbookReferenceBase>();
			if (workbookReferenceBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (workbookReferenceBase is CurrentWorkbookReference)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)saveManager.Worksheets.Count);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)1025);
				return;
			}
			if (workbookReferenceBase is AddInFunctionsWorkbookReference)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)1);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)14849);
				return;
			}
			if (workbookReferenceBase is ExternalWorkbookReference externalWorkbookReference)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)externalWorkbookReference.WorksheetNames.Count);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(Utilities.EncodeURL(externalWorkbookReference.FileName), LengthType.SixteenBit);
				{
					foreach (string worksheetName in externalWorkbookReference.WorksheetNames)
					{
						saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(worksheetName, LengthType.SixteenBit);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (workbookReferenceBase is OleLinkWorkbookReference oleLinkWorkbookReference)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(oleLinkWorkbookReference.ProgId + '\u0003' + oleLinkWorkbookReference.ObjectLink.OriginalString, LengthType.SixteenBit);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class TXORecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.TXO;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();

			int bits2 = Utilities.GetBits(num, 4, 6);
			ushort txoRotation = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Seek(6L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			ushort num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort num3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Seek(4L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			WorksheetShape worksheetShape = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<WorksheetShape>();
			WorksheetCellComment worksheetCellComment = worksheetShape as WorksheetCellComment;
			WorksheetShapeWithText worksheetShapeWithText = worksheetShape as WorksheetShapeWithText;
			if (worksheetCellComment != null)

				}
				else
				{
					StringElement stringElement = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFormattedString(num2);
					formattedStringElement = new FormattedStringElement(stringElement.UnformattedString);
					int num4 = num3 / 8;
					for (int i = 0; i < num4; i++)
					{

						ushort fontIndex = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();

							formattedStringElement.FormattingRuns.Add(formattedStringRun);
						}
					}
				}
				worksheetCellComment.Text = new FormattedString(loadManager.Workbook, formattedStringElement, isElementInCache: false, addElementToCache: false);
			}
			else if (worksheetShapeWithText != null)
			{
				FormattedText formattedText;
				if (num2 == 0)

					formattedText = new FormattedText(string.Empty);

		private static WorkbookFontData ResolveFont(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, int fontIndex, bool isComment)
		{
			WorkbookFontData workbookFontData = loadManager.Fonts[fontIndex];
			if (workbookFontData.ColorInfo != null && workbookFontData.ColorInfo.IsSystemColor)
			{
				int num = loadManager.Workbook.Palette.FindIndex(workbookFontData.ColorInfo, ColorableItem.CellFont);
				if (isComment)
				{
					if (num == 81)
					{
						return workbookFontData;
					}
				}
				else if (num == 64 || num == 64)
				{
					return workbookFontData;
				}
				if (64 <= num && num <= 81)
				{
					workbookFontData = workbookFontData.CloneInternal(loadManager.Workbook);
					workbookFontData.ColorInfo = new WorkbookColorInfo(isComment ? SystemColorsInternal.InfoTextColor : SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColor);
					return workbookFontData;
				}
			}
			return workbookFontData;
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorksheetShape worksheetShape = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<WorksheetShape>();
			if (worksheetShape == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetCellComment worksheetCellComment = worksheetShape as WorksheetCellComment;
			WorksheetShapeWithText worksheetShapeWithText = worksheetShape as WorksheetShapeWithText;
			ushort value = worksheetShape.TxoOptionFlags;
			if (worksheetShapeWithText != null && worksheetShapeWithText.Text != null)
			{
				value &= 0xFF81;
				Utilities.AddBits(ref value, worksheetShapeWithText.Text.VerticalAlignment switch
				{
					VerticalTextAlignment.Top => 1, 
					VerticalTextAlignment.Center => 2, 
					VerticalTextAlignment.Bottom => 3, 
					_ => 2, 
				}, 4, 6);
				int valueToAdd = 2;
				if (worksheetShapeWithText.Text.Paragraphs.Count != 0)
				{
					switch (worksheetShapeWithText.Text.Paragraphs[0].Alignment)
					{
					case HorizontalTextAlignment.Left:
						valueToAdd = 1;
						break;
					case HorizontalTextAlignment.Center:
						valueToAdd = 2;
						break;
					case HorizontalTextAlignment.Right:
						valueToAdd = 3;
						break;
					case HorizontalTextAlignment.Justified:
					case HorizontalTextAlignment.JustifiedLow:
						valueToAdd = 4;
						break;
					case HorizontalTextAlignment.Distributed:
					case HorizontalTextAlignment.ThaiDistributed:
						valueToAdd = 7;
						break;
					default:
					{
						int num = 2;
						break;
					}
					}
				}
				Utilities.AddBits(ref value, valueToAdd, 1, 3);
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(worksheetShape.TxoRotation);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(new byte[6]);
			if (worksheetCellComment != null)
			{
				FormattedStringElement formattedStringElement = worksheetCellComment.Text.Element as FormattedStringElement;
				if (formattedStringElement == null)
				{
					formattedStringElement = worksheetCellComment.Text.ConvertToFormattedStringElement();
				}
				List<FormattingRunBase> list = new List<FormattingRunBase>(formattedStringElement.FormattingRuns);
				if (list.Count == 0)
				{
					list.Add(new FormattedStringRun(formattedStringElement, 0));
				}
				SaveText(saveManager, formattedStringElement.UnformattedString, list);
			}
			else
			{
				if (worksheetShapeWithText == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (worksheetShapeWithText.Text == null)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
					return;
				}
				List<FormattingRunBase> list2 = new List<FormattingRunBase>();
				for (int i = 0; i < worksheetShapeWithText.Text.Paragraphs.Count; i++)
				{
					FormattedTextParagraph formattedTextParagraph = worksheetShapeWithText.Text.Paragraphs[i];
					list2.AddRange(formattedTextParagraph.GetFormattingRuns(saveManager.Workbook));
				}
				if (list2.Count == 0)
				{
					FormattedTextParagraph paragraph = ((worksheetShapeWithText.Text.Paragraphs.Count != 0) ? worksheetShapeWithText.Text.Paragraphs[0] : worksheetShapeWithText.Text.Paragraphs.Add(string.Empty));
					list2.Add(new FormattedTextRun(paragraph, 0));
				}
				SaveText(saveManager, worksheetShapeWithText.Text.ToString(), list2);
			}
		}

		private static void SaveText(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, string unformattedString, List<FormattingRunBase> formattingRuns)
		{
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)unformattedString.Length);
			int count = formattingRuns.Count;
			if (unformattedString.Length == 0)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			}
			else
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)(8 * (count + 1)));
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(new byte[4]);
			if (unformattedString.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.CapCurrentBlock();
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(unformattedString);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.CapCurrentBlock();
			foreach (FormattingRunBase formattingRun in formattingRuns)
			{
				WorkbookFontProxy fontInternal = formattingRun.GetFontInternal(saveManager.Workbook);
				ushort valueOrDefault = fontInternal.SaveIndex.GetValueOrDefault();
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)formattingRun.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(valueOrDefault);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(new byte[4]);
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)unformattedString.Length);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(new byte[4]);
		}
	}

	internal class VERTICALPAGEBREAKSRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.VERTICALPAGEBREAKS;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			if (loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			PrintOptions printOptions = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<PrintOptions>();
			if (printOptions != null)
			{
				ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					ushort num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
					ushort value = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
					ushort value2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
					new ushort?(value);
					new ushort?(value2);
					_ = loadManager.Workbook.MaxRowCount - 1;
					printOptions.VerticalPageBreaks.Add(new VerticalPageBreak(num2, printOptions.PrintAreas.GetPrintArea(num2, value, value2, isVertical: true)));
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			PrintOptions printOptions = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<PrintOptions>();
			if (printOptions != null)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)printOptions.VerticalPageBreaks.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < printOptions.VerticalPageBreaks.Count; i++)
				{
					PageBreak pageBreak = printOptions.VerticalPageBreaks[i];
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)pageBreak.Id);
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)pageBreak.MinResolved);
					int num = Math.Min(pageBreak.MaxResolved, saveManager.Workbook.MaxRowCount - 1);
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)num);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WINDOW1Record : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.WINDOW1;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			short x = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadInt16();
			short y = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadInt16();
			ushort width = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort height = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.Workbook.WindowOptions.BoundsInTwips = Utilities.CreateRectangle(x, y, width, height);
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.Workbook.WindowOptions.Minimized = (num & 2) == 2;
			bool flag = (num & 8) == 8;
			bool flag2 = (num & 0x10) == 16;
			loadManager.Workbook.WindowOptions.TabBarVisible = (num & 0x20) == 32;
			ScrollBars scrollBars = ScrollBars.None;
			scrollBars = (ScrollBars)((int)scrollBars | (flag ? 1 : 0));
			scrollBars = (ScrollBars)((int)scrollBars | (flag2 ? 2 : 0));
			loadManager.Workbook.WindowOptions.ScrollBars = scrollBars;
			loadManager.Workbook.WindowOptions.SelectedWorksheetIndex = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.Workbook.WindowOptions.FirstVisibleTabIndex = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.Workbook.WindowOptions.TabBarWidth = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			WorkbookWindowOptions windowOptions = saveManager.Workbook.WindowOptions;
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(Utilities.ConstrainShort(windowOptions.BoundsInTwips.Left));
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(Utilities.ConstrainShort(windowOptions.BoundsInTwips.Top));
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(Utilities.ConstrainUShort(windowOptions.BoundsInTwips.Width));
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(Utilities.ConstrainUShort(windowOptions.BoundsInTwips.Height));
			ushort num = 0;
			if (windowOptions.Minimized)
			{
				num |= 2;
			}
			if ((windowOptions.ScrollBars & ScrollBars.Horizontal) != ScrollBars.None)
			{
				num |= 8;
			}
			if ((windowOptions.ScrollBars & ScrollBars.Vertical) != ScrollBars.None)
			{
				num |= 0x10;
			}
			if (windowOptions.TabBarVisible)
			{
				num |= 0x20;
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
			int num2 = saveManager.Worksheets.IndexOf(windowOptions.SelectedWorksheet);
			int num3 = Math.Min(windowOptions.FirstVisibleTabIndex, saveManager.Worksheets.Count - 1);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)num2);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)num3);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)1);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)windowOptions.TabBarWidth);
		}
	}
	internal class WINDOW2Record : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.WINDOW2;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowFormulasInCells = (num & 1) == 1;
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowGridlines = (num & 2) == 2;
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowRowAndColumnHeaders = (num & 4) == 4;
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.PanesAreFrozen = (num & 8) == 8;
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowZeroValues = (num & 0x10) == 16;
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.UseAutomaticGridlineColor = (num & 0x20) == 32;
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.OrderColumnsRightToLeft = (num & 0x40) == 64;
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowOutlineSymbols = (num & 0x80) == 128;
				bool flag = (num & 0x100) == 256;
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.IsTabSelected = (num & 0x200) == 512;
				if ((num & 0x800) == 2048)
				{
					worksheet.DisplayOptions.View = WorksheetView.PageBreakPreview;
				}
				ushort firstRowInBottomPane = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				ushort firstColumnInRightPane = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.PanesAreFrozen)
				{
					worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.KeepSplitIfRemoveFreeze = !flag;
					worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FirstColumnInRightPane = firstColumnInRightPane;
					worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FirstRowInBottomPane = firstRowInBottomPane;
				}
				else
				{
					worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstColumnInRightPane = firstColumnInRightPane;
					worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstRowInBottomPane = firstRowInBottomPane;
				}
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.GridlineColorIndex = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				int magnification = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				if (magnification == 0)
				{
					magnification = 60;
				}
				Utilities.EnsureMagnificationIsValid(ref magnification);
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.MagnificationInPageBreakView = magnification;
				int magnification2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				if (magnification2 == 0)
				{
					magnification2 = 100;
				}
				Utilities.EnsureMagnificationIsValid(ref magnification2);
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.MagnificationInNormalView = magnification2;
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ushort num = 0;
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowFormulasInCells)
			{
				num |= 1;
			}
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowGridlines)
			{
				num |= 2;
			}
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowRowAndColumnHeaders)
			{
				num |= 4;
			}
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.PanesAreFrozen)
			{
				num |= 8;
			}
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowZeroValues)
			{
				num |= 0x10;
			}
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.UseAutomaticGridlineColor)
			{
				num |= 0x20;
			}
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.OrderColumnsRightToLeft)
			{
				num |= 0x40;
			}
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowOutlineSymbols)
			{
				num |= 0x80;
			}
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.PanesAreFrozen && !worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.KeepSplitIfRemoveFreeze)
			{
				num |= 0x100;
			}
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.IsTabSelected)
			{
				num |= 0x200;
			}
			if (worksheet == worksheet.Workbook.WindowOptions.SelectedWorksheet)
			{
				num |= 0x200;
				num |= 0x400;
			}
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.View == WorksheetView.PageBreakPreview)
			{
				num |= 0x800;
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.PanesAreFrozen)
			{
				if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FrozenRows == 0)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FirstRowInBottomPane);
				}
				else
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstRowInTopPane);
				}
				if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FrozenColumns == 0)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheet.DisplayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FirstColumnInRightPane);
				}
				else
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstColumnInLeftPane);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.TopPaneHeight == 0)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstRowInBottomPane);
				}
				else
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstRowInTopPane);
				}
				if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.LeftPaneWidth == 0)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstColumnInRightPane);
				}
				else
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheet.DisplayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.FirstColumnInLeftPane);
				}
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)worksheet.DisplayOptions.GridlineColorIndex);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			int num2 = worksheet.DisplayOptions.MagnificationInPageBreakView;
			if (num2 == 60 && worksheet.DisplayOptions.View != WorksheetView.PageBreakPreview)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)num2);
			int num3 = worksheet.DisplayOptions.MagnificationInNormalView;
			if (num3 == 100 && worksheet.DisplayOptions.View != WorksheetView.Normal)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)num3);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(0u);
		}
	}

	internal class WSBOOLRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.WSBOOL;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				worksheet.ShowExpansionIndicatorBelowGroup = (num & 0x40) == 64;
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowExpansionIndicatorBelowGroupedRows = (worksheet.ShowExpansionIndicatorBelowGroup ? ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True : ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False);
				worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowExpansionIndicatorToRightOfGroupedColumns = (((num & 0x80) == 128) ? ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True : ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False);
				if ((num & 0x100) == 256)
				{
					worksheet.PrintOptions.ScalingType = ScalingType.FitToPages;
				}
				else
				{
					worksheet.PrintOptions.ScalingType = ScalingType.UseScalingFactor;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				ushort num = 1025;
				if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowExpansionIndicatorBelowGroupedRowsResolved)
				{
					num |= 0x40;
				}
				if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowExpansionIndicatorToRightOfGroupedColumnsResolved)
				{
					num |= 0x80;
				}
				if (worksheet.PrintOptions.ScalingType == ScalingType.FitToPages)
				{
					num |= 0x100;
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class XFCRCRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.XFCRC;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFrtHeader();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			uint num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			if (loadManager.XfRecordData != null && num != Utilities.ComputeMsoCrc32(0u, loadManager.XfRecordData))
			{
				loadManager.IgnoreXfExtData = true;
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			if (saveManager.XfRecordData != null)
			{
				uint value = Utilities.ComputeMsoCrc32(0u, saveManager.XfRecordData);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteFrtHeader();
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)saveManager.Formats.Count);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class XFEXTRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.XFEXT;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			XFEXTRecordInfo xFEXTRecordInfo = new XFEXTRecordInfo();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadFrtHeader();
			xFEXTRecordInfo.reserved1 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			xFEXTRecordInfo.ixfe = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			xFEXTRecordInfo.reserved2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			xFEXTRecordInfo.props = new ExtProp[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				xFEXTRecordInfo.props[i] = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadExtProp();
			}
			loadManager.DeferredXFEXTRecords.Add(xFEXTRecordInfo);
		}

		public static void LoadHelper(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, XFEXTRecordInfo info)
		{
			if (!loadManager.IgnoreXfExtData && loadManager.Formats.Count > info.ixfe)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = loadManager.Formats[info.ixfe];
				WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptions = worksheetCellFormatData.FormatOptions;
				for (int i = 0; i < info.props.Length; i++)
				{
					info.props[i].ApplyTo(loadManager, worksheetCellFormatData);
				}
				worksheetCellFormatData.SetFormatOptionsInternal(formatOptions);
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			XFRecord.XFContext xFContext = saveManager.ContextStack.Get<XFRecord.XFContext>();
			if (xFContext != null)
			{
				_ = xFContext.FormatData;
				List<ExtProp> extProps = xFContext.ExtProps;
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteFrtHeader();
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(xFContext.XfId);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)extProps.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < extProps.Count; i++)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteExtProp(extProps[i]);
				}
			}
		}
	}
