		public ushort ixfe;

		public ushort reserved2;

		public ExtProp[] props;
	}
	internal class XFRecord : Biff8RecordBase
	{
		public sealed class XFContext
		{
			public readonly WorksheetCellFormatData FormatData;

			public readonly ushort XfId;

			public readonly List<ExtProp> ExtProps;

			public XFContext(WorksheetCellFormatData formatData, ushort xfid, List<ExtProp> extProps)
			{
				FormatData = formatData;
				XfId = xfid;
				ExtProps = extProps;
			}
		}

		public override BIFF8RecordType Type => BIFF8RecordType.XF;

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			XFRecordInfo xFRecordInfo = new XFRecordInfo();
			xFRecordInfo.ifnt = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			xFRecordInfo.ifmt = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			xFRecordInfo.temp1 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			xFRecordInfo.temp2 = (byte)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			xFRecordInfo.trot = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			xFRecordInfo.temp3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			xFRecordInfo.temp4 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			xFRecordInfo.temp5 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			xFRecordInfo.temp6 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			xFRecordInfo.temp7 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			loadManager.DeferredXFRecords.Add(xFRecordInfo);
		}

		public static void LoadHelper(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, XFRecordInfo info)
		{
			bool value = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp1, 0);
			Utilities.TestBit(info.temp1, 1);
			bool flag = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp1, 2);
			Utilities.TestBit(info.temp1, 3);
			int bits = Utilities.GetBits(info.temp1, 4, 15);
			HorizontalCellAlignment bits2 = (HorizontalCellAlignment)Utilities.GetBits(info.temp2, 0, 2);
			bool value2 = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp2, 3);
			VerticalCellAlignment bits3 = (VerticalCellAlignment)Utilities.GetBits(info.temp2, 4, 6);
			bool addIndent = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp2, 7);
			int bits4 = Utilities.GetBits(info.temp3, 0, 3);
			bool value3 = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp3, 4);
			Utilities.TestBit(info.temp3, 5);
			Utilities.GetBits(info.temp3, 6, 7);
			bool flag2 = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp3, 10);
			bool flag3 = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp3, 11);
			bool flag4 = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp3, 12);
			bool flag5 = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp3, 13);
			bool flag6 = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp3, 14);
			bool flag7 = Utilities.TestBit(info.temp3, 15);
			CellBorderLineStyle bits5 = (CellBorderLineStyle)Utilities.GetBits(info.temp4, 0, 3);
			CellBorderLineStyle bits6 = (CellBorderLineStyle)Utilities.GetBits(info.temp4, 4, 7);
			CellBorderLineStyle bits7 = (CellBorderLineStyle)Utilities.GetBits(info.temp4, 8, 11);
			CellBorderLineStyle bits8 = (CellBorderLineStyle)Utilities.GetBits(info.temp4, 12, 15);
			int bits9 = Utilities.GetBits(info.temp5, 0, 6);
			int bits10 = Utilities.GetBits(info.temp5, 7, 13);
			int bits11 = Utilities.GetBits(info.temp5, 14, 15);
			int bits12 = Utilities.GetBits(info.temp6, 0, 6);
			int bits13 = Utilities.GetBits(info.temp6, 7, 13);
			int bits14 = Utilities.GetBits(info.temp6, 14, 20);
			CellBorderLineStyle bits15 = (CellBorderLineStyle)Utilities.GetBits(info.temp6, 21, 24);
			Utilities.TestBit(info.temp6, 25);
			FillPatternStyle bits16 = (FillPatternStyle)Utilities.GetBits(info.temp6, 26, 31);
			int bits17 = Utilities.GetBits(info.temp7, 0, 6);

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.Serialization.BIFF8.EscherRecords
{
	internal abstract class EscherRecordContainerBase : EscherRecordBase
	{
		private List<EscherRecordBase> childRecords;

		public int ChildRecordCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (childRecords != null)
				{
					return childRecords.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		protected EscherRecordContainerBase(byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
			: base(version, instance, recordLength)
		{
		}

		public void AddChildRecord(EscherRecordBase record)
		{
			if (childRecords == null)
			{
				childRecords = new List<EscherRecordBase>();
			}
			if (ValidateChildRecord(record))
			{
				record.ParentRecord = this;
				childRecords.Add(record);
				base.RecordLength += 8 + record.RecordLength;
			}
		}

		public T GetChildRecord<T>() where T : EscherRecordBase
		{
			if (childRecords == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (EscherRecordBase childRecord in childRecords)
			{
				if (typeof(T).IsAssignableFrom(childRecord.GetType()))
				{
					return (T)childRecord;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			childRecords = new List<EscherRecordBase>();
			long num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position + base.RecordLength;
			while (loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position < num && loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Position != loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Length)
			{
				EscherRecordBase escherRecordBase = EscherRecordBase.LoadRecord(loadManager, this);
				if (escherRecordBase != null)
				{
					if (ValidateChildRecord(escherRecordBase))
					{
						childRecords.Add(escherRecordBase);
					}
					else
					{
						escherRecordBase.ParentRecord = null;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			base.Save(saveManager);
			if (childRecords == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (EscherRecordBase childRecord in childRecords)
			{
				childRecord.Save(saveManager);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append(base.ToString());
			stringBuilder.Append("\n\n");
			if (childRecords != null)
			{
				foreach (EscherRecordBase childRecord in childRecords)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("\t");
					stringBuilder.Append(childRecord.ToString().Replace("\n", "\n\t"));
					stringBuilder.Append("\n");
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected abstract bool ValidateChildRecord(EscherRecordBase childRecord);
	}
	internal sealed class BLIPStoreContainer : EscherRecordContainerBase
	{
		public override EscherRecordType Type => EscherRecordType.BLIPStoreContainer;

		public BLIPStoreContainer(List<WorkbookSerializationDataExcel2003.ImageHolder> images)
			: base(15, (ushort)images.Count, 0u)

			{
				BLIP blip = new BLIP(image.Image);

			}

			: base(version, instance, recordLength)
		{
		}

		protected override bool ValidateChildRecord(EscherRecordBase childRecord)
		{
			if (childRecord.Type == EscherRecordType.BLIPStoreEntry)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (61464 <= (int)childRecord.Type && (int)childRecord.Type <= 61719)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class BLIPStoreEntry : EscherRecordBase
	{
		private BLIPType typeForWin32;

		private BLIPType typeForMacOS;

		private Guid blipId;

		private ushort tag;

		private uint blipStreamSize;

		private uint referenceCountOnTheBlip;

		private uint fileOffsetInDelayStream;

		private BLIPUsage usage;

		private BLIP blip;

		public override EscherRecordType Type => EscherRecordType.BLIPStoreEntry;

		public BLIPStoreEntry(BLIP blip, uint referenceCountOnTheBlip)
			: base(2, (ushort)blip.BlipType, 44 + blip.RecordLength)
		{
			typeForWin32 = blip.BlipType;
			typeForMacOS = blip.BlipType;
			blipId = blip.SecondaryID;
			tag = 255;
			blipStreamSize = blip.RecordLength + 8;
			this.referenceCountOnTheBlip = referenceCountOnTheBlip;
			usage = BLIPUsage.Default;
			this.blip = blip;
		}

		public BLIPStoreEntry(byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
			: base(version, instance, recordLength)
		{
		}

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			typeForWin32 = (BLIPType)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			typeForMacOS = (BLIPType)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			blipId = new Guid(loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadBytes(16));
			tag = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			blipStreamSize = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			referenceCountOnTheBlip = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			fileOffsetInDelayStream = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			usage = (BLIPUsage)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			if (blipStreamSize != 0)
			{
				blip = (BLIP)EscherRecordBase.LoadRecord(loadManager);
				loadManager.Images.Add(new WorkbookSerializationDataExcel2003.ImageHolder(blip.Image, referenceCountOnTheBlip));
			}
			else
			{
				loadManager.Images.Add(new WorkbookSerializationDataExcel2003.ImageHolder(null, referenceCountOnTheBlip));
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			base.Save(saveManager);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)typeForWin32);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)typeForMacOS);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(blipId.ToByteArray());
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(tag);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(blipStreamSize);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(referenceCountOnTheBlip);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(fileOffsetInDelayStream);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)usage);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)0);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)0);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((byte)0);
			if (blip != null)
			{
				blip.Save(saveManager);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append(base.ToString());
			stringBuilder.Append("\n\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("Reference Count on the BLIP: " + referenceCountOnTheBlip);
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	internal class ClientAnchor : EscherRecordBase
	{
		private ShapePositioningMode positioningMode;

		private Point topLeft;

		private Point topLeftOffset;

		private Point bottomRight;

		private Point bottomRightOffset;

		public override EscherRecordType Type => EscherRecordType.ClientAnchor;

		public ClientAnchor(WorksheetShape shape)
			: base(0, 0, 18u)
		{
			positioningMode = shape.PositioningMode;
			if (shape.TopLeftCornerCell.Worksheet != null && shape.BottomRightCornerCell.Worksheet != null)
			{
				topLeft = new Point(shape.TopLeftCornerCell.ColumnIndex, shape.TopLeftCornerCell.RowIndex);
				bottomRight = new Point(shape.BottomRightCornerCell.ColumnIndex, shape.BottomRightCornerCell.RowIndex);
				topLeftOffset = CellOffsetToClientAnchorPoint(shape.TopLeftCornerPosition);
				bottomRightOffset = CellOffsetToClientAnchorPoint(shape.BottomRightCornerPosition);
			}
		}

		public ClientAnchor(byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
			: base(version, instance, recordLength)
		{
		}

		private static Point CellOffsetToClientAnchorPoint(PointF cellOffset)
		{
			return new Point((int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(cellOffset.X / 100f * 1024f), (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(cellOffset.Y / 100f * 256f));
		}

		private static PointF ClientAnchorPointToCellOffset(Point anchorPoint)
		{
			float x = Math.Max(0f, (float)anchorPoint.X * 100f / 1024f);
			float y = Math.Max(0f, (float)anchorPoint.Y * 100f / 256f);
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			positioningMode = (ShapePositioningMode)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort x = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort x2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort y = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort y2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort x3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort x4 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort y3 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort y4 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			topLeft = new Point(x, y);
			topLeftOffset = new Point(x2, y2);
			bottomRight = new Point(x3, y3);
			bottomRightOffset = new Point(x4, y4);
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				WorksheetShape worksheetShape = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<WorksheetShape>();
				if (worksheetShape != null)
				{
					worksheetShape.SetPositioningMode(positioningMode, verifyIsDefined: false);
					worksheetShape.BottomRightCornerPosition = ClientAnchorPointToCellOffset(bottomRightOffset);
					worksheetShape.TopLeftCornerPosition = ClientAnchorPointToCellOffset(topLeftOffset);
					worksheetShape.BottomRightCornerCell = worksheet.Rows[bottomRight.Y].Cells[bottomRight.X];
					worksheetShape.TopLeftCornerCell = worksheet.Rows[topLeft.Y].Cells[topLeft.X];
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			base.Save(saveManager);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)positioningMode);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)topLeft.X);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)topLeftOffset.X);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)topLeft.Y);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)topLeftOffset.Y);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)bottomRight.X);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)bottomRightOffset.X);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)bottomRight.Y);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((ushort)bottomRightOffset.Y);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append(base.ToString());
			stringBuilder.Append("\n\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("Top Left Cell: " + topLeft);
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("Top Left Offset: " + topLeftOffset);
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("Bottom Right Cell: " + bottomRight);
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("Bottom Right Offset: " + bottomRightOffset);
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class ClientData : EscherRecordBase
	{
		private const int BRAIRecordFormulaOffset = 6;

		private WorksheetShape shape;

		public override EscherRecordType Type => EscherRecordType.ClientData;

		public ClientData(WorksheetShape shape)
			: base(0, 0, 0u)
		{
			this.shape = shape;
		}

		public ClientData(byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
			: base(version, instance, recordLength)
		{
		}

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Obj obj = LoadObjRecordData(loadManager);
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.AppendNextRecordIfType(236);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetShape worksheetShape = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<WorksheetShape>();
			if (worksheetShape != null)
			{
				worksheetShape.Obj = obj;
				if (obj != null && obj.Cmo != null && obj.Cmo.Ot == ObjectType.Comment && worksheetShape is UnknownShape unknownShape)
				{
					WorksheetCellComment worksheetCellComment = new WorksheetCellComment(unknownShape);
					loadManager.ContextStack.ReplaceItem((object)unknownShape, (object)worksheetCellComment);
					loadManager.LoadedComments.Add(worksheetCellComment);
				}
			}
		}

		private Obj LoadObjRecordData(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			if (loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadNextBlockType() != 93)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Obj obj = new Obj();
			using (new Biff8RecordStream(loadManager))
			{
				obj.Load(loadManager);
			}
			if (obj.Cmo != null && obj.Cmo.Ot == ObjectType.Chart)
			{
				long position = loadManager.WorkbookStream.Position;
				using (new Biff8RecordStream(loadManager))
				{
				}
				List<FontXInfo> list = new List<FontXInfo>();
				List<Formula> list2 = new List<Formula>();
				while (true)
				{
					using Biff8RecordStream biff8RecordStream = new Biff8RecordStream(loadManager);
					switch (biff8RecordStream.RecordType)
					{
					case BIFF8RecordType.BRAI:
					{
						byte[] data = biff8RecordStream.ReadBytes((int)biff8RecordStream.Length);
						int dataIndex = 6;
						Formula item = loadManager.LoadFormula(FormulaType.Formula, ref data, ref dataIndex);
						list2.Add(item);
						break;
					}
					case BIFF8RecordType.FONTX:
					{
						ushort ifont = biff8RecordStream.ReadUInt16();
						list.Add(new FontXInfo(ifont, loadManager));
						break;
					}
					}
					if (biff8RecordStream.RecordType == BIFF8RecordType.EOF)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				long position2 = loadManager.WorkbookStream.Position;
				loadManager.WorkbookStream.Position = position;
				byte[] array = new byte[position2 - position];
				loadManager.WorkbookStream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				WorksheetChart worksheetChart = ((loadManager.ContextStack.Pop() is UnknownShape unknownShape) ? new WorksheetChart(unknownShape) : new WorksheetChart());
				worksheetChart.Excel2003RoundTripData = new BinaryData(array);
				worksheetChart.FontXInfos = list;
				worksheetChart.BraiFormulas = list2;
				loadManager.ContextStack.Push((object)worksheetChart);
			}
			LoadObjRecordData(loadManager);
			return obj;
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			base.Save(saveManager);
			if (shape.Obj == null)
			{
				shape.Obj = new Obj(shape);
			}
			FtCmo cmo = shape.Obj.Cmo;
			using (new Biff8RecordStream(saveManager, BIFF8RecordType.OBJ))
			{
				shape.Obj.Save(saveManager);
			}
			if (cmo != null && cmo.Ot == ObjectType.Chart && shape is WorksheetChart { Excel2003RoundTripData: not null } worksheetChart)
			{
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				byte[] buffer = worksheetChart.Excel2003RoundTripData.Buffer;
				ushort num3;
				for (int i = 0; i < buffer.Length; i += 4 + num3)
				{
					BIFF8RecordType bIFF8RecordType = (BIFF8RecordType)BitConverter.ToUInt16(buffer, i);
					num3 = BitConverter.ToUInt16(buffer, i + 2);
					int offset = i + 4;
					using Biff8RecordStream biff8RecordStream = new Biff8RecordStream(saveManager, bIFF8RecordType);
					switch (bIFF8RecordType)
					{
					case BIFF8RecordType.BRAI:
					{
						if (worksheetChart.BraiFormulas.Count <= num2)
						{
							break;
						}
						Formula formula = worksheetChart.BraiFormulas[num2++];
						biff8RecordStream.Write(buffer, offset, 6);
						saveManager.SaveFormula(formula, writeSize: true, isForExternalNamedReference: false);
						goto end_IL_00d2;
					}
					case BIFF8RecordType.FONTX:
					{
						if (worksheetChart.FontXInfos.Count <= num)
						{
							break;
						}
						FontXInfo fontXInfo = worksheetChart.FontXInfos[num++];
						biff8RecordStream.Write(fontXInfo.GetIFontValue(saveManager));
						goto end_IL_00d2;
					}
					}
					biff8RecordStream.Write(buffer, offset, num3);
					end_IL_00d2:;
				}
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.NextBlockType = BIFF8RecordType.MSODRAWING;
		}
	}

				num += saveManager.GetSerializationCache(worksheet).NumberOfShapes;
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(saveManager.MaxShapeId);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((uint)(saveManager.Worksheets.Count + 1));
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((uint)saveManager.Worksheets.Count);
			foreach (Worksheet worksheet2 in saveManager.Worksheets)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write((uint)worksheet2.SheetId);
				WorksheetSerializationCache serializationCache = saveManager.GetSerializationCache(worksheet2);

	internal sealed class GroupContainer : EscherRecordContainerBase
	{
		public override EscherRecordType Type => EscherRecordType.GroupContainer;

		public GroupContainer(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, Worksheet worksheet)
			: base(15, 0, 0u)
		{
			AddChildRecord(new ShapeContainer(saveManager, new Shape.PatriarchShape(saveManager, worksheet)));
			AddChildShapes(saveManager, worksheet.Shapes);
			WorksheetSerializationCache serializationCache = saveManager.GetSerializationCache(worksheet);
			foreach (WorksheetCellComment commentShape in serializationCache.CommentShapes)
			{
				AddChildRecord(new ShapeContainer(saveManager, commentShape));
			}
		}

		public GroupContainer(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, WorksheetShapeGroup group)
			: base(15, 0, 0u)
		{
			AddChildRecord(new ShapeContainer(saveManager, group));
			AddChildShapes(saveManager, group.Shapes);
		}

		public GroupContainer(byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
			: base(version, instance, recordLength)
		{
		}

		private void AddChildShapes(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, WorksheetShapeCollection shapes)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < shapes.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetShape resolvedShape = saveManager.GetResolvedShape(shapes[i]);
				if (resolvedShape != null)
				{
					if (resolvedShape is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
					{
						AddChildRecord(new GroupContainer(saveManager, worksheetShapeGroup));
					}
					else
					{
						AddChildRecord(new ShapeContainer(saveManager, resolvedShape));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			base.Load(loadManager);
			if (loadManager.ContextStack.Pop() is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
			{
				worksheetShapeGroup.OnLoadComplete();
			}
		}

		protected override bool ValidateChildRecord(EscherRecordBase childRecord)
		{
			switch (childRecord.Type)
			{
			case EscherRecordType.GroupContainer:
			case EscherRecordType.ShapeContainer:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class GroupShape : EscherRecordBase
	{
		private Rectangle rectInEMUs;

		public override EscherRecordType Type => EscherRecordType.GroupShape;

		public Rectangle RectInEMUs => rectInEMUs;

		public GroupShape(WorksheetShapeGroup group)
			: base(1, 0, 16u)
		{
			rectInEMUs = Utilities.TwipsToEMU(group.GetBoundsInTwips());
		}

		public GroupShape(byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
			: base(version, instance, recordLength)
		{
		}

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			rectInEMUs = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadRect();
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			base.Save(saveManager);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.WriteEMURect(rectInEMUs);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append(base.ToString());
			stringBuilder.Append("\n\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("Group Bounds (EMUS): " + rectInEMUs);
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal abstract class PropertyTableBase : EscherRecordBase
	{
		[DebuggerDisplay("{propertyType} = {value}")]
		public class PropertyValue : IComparable<PropertyValue>
		{
			private PropertyType propertyType;

			private bool isComplex;

			private bool isBlipId;

			private object value;

			public bool IsBlipId => isBlipId;

			public bool IsComplex => isComplex;

			public bool IsIMsoArray
			{
				get
				{
					if (!isComplex)
					{
						return false;
					}
					switch (propertyType)
					{
					case PropertyType.GeometryVertices:
					case PropertyType.GeometrySegmentInfo:
					case PropertyType.GeometryConnectionSites:
					case PropertyType.GeometryConnectionSitesDirection:
					case PropertyType.GeometryAdjustHandles:
					case PropertyType.GeometryGuides:
					case PropertyType.GeometryInscribe:
					case PropertyType.GeometryFragments:
					case PropertyType.FillStyleShadeColors:
					case PropertyType.LineStyleDashStyle:
					case PropertyType.GroupShapeWrapPolygonVertices:
					case PropertyType.DiagramRelationTable:
					case PropertyType.LineLeftStyleDashStyle:
					case PropertyType.LineTopStyleDashStyle:
					case PropertyType.LineRightStyleDashStyle:
					case PropertyType.LineBottomStyleDashStyle:
					case PropertyType.LineColumnStyleDashStyle:
					case PropertyType.ClipVertices:
					case PropertyType.ClipSegmentsInfo:
						return true;
					default:
						return false;
					}
				}
			}

			public PropertyType PropertyType => propertyType;

			public object Value
			{
				get
				{
					return value;
				}
				set
				{
					this.value = value;
				}
			}

			public PropertyValue(PropertyType propertyType, object value)
				: this(propertyType, value, isComplex: false, isBlipId: false)
			{
			}

			public PropertyValue(PropertyType propertyType, object value, bool isComplex, bool isBlipId)
			{
				this.propertyType = propertyType;
				this.value = value;
				this.isComplex = isComplex;
				this.isBlipId = isBlipId;
			}

			public int CompareTo(PropertyValue other)
			{
				return propertyType - other.propertyType;
			}
		}

		private List<PropertyValue> properties;

		protected List<PropertyValue> Properties => properties;

		public PropertyTableBase(List<PropertyValue> properties)
			: this(3, (ushort)properties.Count, 0u)
		{
			this.properties = properties;
			uint num = 0u;
			foreach (PropertyValue property in this.properties)
			{
				num += 6;
				if (property.IsComplex)
				{
					num += (uint)((BinaryData)property.Value).Buffer.Length;
				}
			}
			base.RecordLength = num;
		}

		public PropertyTableBase(byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
			: base(version, instance, recordLength)
		{
		}

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			WorksheetShape worksheetShape = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<WorksheetShape>();
			properties = new List<PropertyValue>();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Instance; i++)
			{
				ushort num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				uint num2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
				PropertyType propertyType = (PropertyType)(num & 0x3FFF);
				bool flag = (num & 0x8000) == 32768;
				bool flag2 = (num & 0x4000) == 16384 && !flag;
				PropertyValue item = new PropertyValue(propertyType, num2, flag, flag2);
				if (flag2 && worksheetShape != null && worksheetShape is IWorksheetImage worksheetImage)
				{
					worksheetImage.Image = loadManager.Images[(int)(num2 - 1)].Image;
				}
				properties.Add(item);
			}
			properties.Sort();
			foreach (PropertyValue property in properties)
			{
				if (!property.IsComplex)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num3 = (int)(uint)property.Value;
				if (num3 == 0)
				{
					property.Value = new BinaryData(new byte[0]);
				}
				else if (property.IsIMsoArray)
				{
					if (num3 < 6)
					{
						property.Value = new BinaryData(loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadBytes(num3));
						continue;
					}
					byte[] array = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadBytes(6);
					ushort num4 = BitConverter.ToUInt16(array, 0);
					BitConverter.ToUInt16(array, 2);
					ushort num5 = BitConverter.ToUInt16(array, 4);
					int num6 = ((num5 == 65520) ? 4 : num5);
					int val = num4 * num6;
					int val2 = num3 - 6;
					int count = Math.Max(val, val2);
					byte[] array2 = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadBytes(count);
					byte[] array3 = new byte[array.Length + array2.Length];
					Buffer.BlockCopy(array, 0, array3, 0, array.Length);
					Buffer.BlockCopy(array2, 0, array3, array.Length, array2.Length);
					property.Value = new BinaryData(array3);
				}
				else
				{
					property.Value = new BinaryData(loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadBytes(num3));
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			base.Save(saveManager);
			foreach (PropertyValue property in properties)
			{
				uint value = 0u;
				ushort num = 0;
				num = (ushort)((uint)num | (uint)property.PropertyType);
				if (property.IsComplex)
				{
					num |= 0xC000;
					if (property.Value is BinaryData binaryData)
					{
						value = (uint)binaryData.Buffer.Length;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					value = (uint)property.Value;
				}
				if (property.IsBlipId)
				{
					num |= 0x4000;
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value);
			}
			foreach (PropertyValue property2 in properties)
			{
				if (property2.IsComplex && property2.Value is BinaryData binaryData2)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(binaryData2.Buffer);
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append(base.ToString());
			stringBuilder.Append("\n\n");
			if (properties != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < properties.Count; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("Property {0}: {1}\n", i, properties[i].PropertyType);
					if (properties[i].PropertyType == PropertyType.BLIPName || properties[i].PropertyType == PropertyType.GroupShapeName || properties[i].PropertyType == PropertyType.GroupShapeDescription)
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat("\tValue: {0}\n", Encoding.Unicode.GetString((byte[])properties[i].Value, 0, ((byte[])properties[i].Value).Length - 2));
					}
					else if (properties[i].Value is byte[])
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat("\tValue: {0}\n", BitConverter.ToString((byte[])properties[i].Value));
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat("\tValue: {0}\n", properties[i].Value);
					}
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class PropertyTable1 : PropertyTableBase
	{
		public override EscherRecordType Type => EscherRecordType.PropertyTable1;

		public PropertyTable1(WorksheetShape shape)
			: base(shape.DrawingProperties1)
		{

		private static Color? DecodeColor(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, PropertyValue colorPropertyValue, PropertyValue opacityPropertyValue)
		{
			//IL_00ce: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012c: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			uint? num = null;
			uint? num2 = null;
			if (colorPropertyValue != null)
			{
				num = (uint)colorPropertyValue.Value;
			}
			if (opacityPropertyValue != null)
			{
				num2 = (uint)opacityPropertyValue.Value;
			}
			Color? color = default(Color).ToNullable();
			byte? b = default(byte?);
			EscherSysIndex? val = default(EscherSysIndex?);
			short? num3 = default(short?);
			Utilities.DecodeEscherColor(num, num2, ref color, ref b, ref val, ref num3);
			if (color.HasValue)
			{
				return color.Value;
			}
			if (((int?)b).HasValue)
			{
				return loadManager.Workbook.Palette.GetColorAtAbsoluteIndex(b.Value).ToNative();
			}
			if (val.HasValue)
			{
				EscherSysIndex value = val.Value;
				switch ((int)value)
				{
				case 0:
					return SystemColorsInternal.ButtonFaceColor;
				case 1:
					return SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColor;
				case 2:
					return SystemColorsInternal.MenuColor;
				case 3:
					return SystemColorsInternal.HighlightColor;
				case 4:
					return SystemColorsInternal.HighlightTextColor;
				case 5:
					return SystemColorsInternal.ActiveCaptionTextColor;
				case 6:
					return SystemColorsInternal.ActiveCaptionColor;
				case 7:
					return SystemColorsInternal.ButtonHighlightColor;
				case 8:
					return SystemColorsInternal.ButtonShadowColor;
				case 9:
					return SystemColorsInternal.ControlTextColor;
				case 10:
					return SystemColorsInternal.GrayTextColor;
				case 11:
					return SystemColorsInternal.InactiveCaptionColor;
				case 12:
					return SystemColorsInternal.InactiveCaptionTextColor;
				case 13:
					return SystemColorsInternal.InfoColor;
				case 14:
					return SystemColorsInternal.InfoTextColor;
				case 15:
					return SystemColorsInternal.MenuTextColor;
				case 16:
					return SystemColorsInternal.ScrollBarColor;
				case 17:
					return SystemColorsInternal.WindowColor;
				case 18:
					return SystemColorsInternal.WindowFrameColor;
				case 19:
					return SystemColorsInternal.ControlLightColor;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static void EncodeColor(List<PropertyValue> propertyTable, Color color, PropertyType colorPropertyType, PropertyType opacityPropertyType)
		{
			byte? b = null;
			EscherSysIndex? val = null;
			short? num = null;
			if (Utilities.ColorIsSystem(color))
			{
				if (color == SystemColorsInternal.ButtonFaceColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)0;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)1;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.MenuColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)2;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.HighlightColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)3;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.HighlightTextColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)4;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.ActiveCaptionTextColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)5;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.ActiveCaptionColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)6;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.ButtonHighlightColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)7;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.ButtonShadowColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)8;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.ControlTextColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)9;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.GrayTextColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)10;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.InactiveCaptionColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)11;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.InactiveCaptionTextColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)12;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.InfoColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)13;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.InfoTextColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)14;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.MenuTextColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)15;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.ScrollBarColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)16;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.WindowColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)17;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.WindowFrameColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)18;
				}
				else if (color == SystemColorsInternal.ControlLightColor)
				{
					val = (EscherSysIndex)19;
				}
			}
			Color? color2 = ((!val.HasValue) ? color.ToNullable() : ((Color?)null));
			uint? num2 = default(uint?);
			uint? num3 = default(uint?);
			Utilities.EncodeEscherColor(color2, b, val, num, ref num2, ref num3);
			if (num2.HasValue)
			{
				propertyTable.Add(new PropertyValue(colorPropertyType, num2.Value));
			}
			if (num3.HasValue)
			{
				propertyTable.Add(new PropertyValue(opacityPropertyType, num3.Value));
			}
		}

		private void ParseLoadedPropertyValues(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			PropertyValue propertyValue = null;
			PropertyValue opacityPropertyValue = null;
			PropertyValue propertyValue2 = null;
			PropertyValue propertyValue3 = null;
			PropertyValue opacityPropertyValue2 = null;
			PropertyValue propertyValue4 = null;
			WorksheetShapeWithText worksheetShapeWithText = shape as WorksheetShapeWithText;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Properties.Count; i++)
			{
				PropertyValue propertyValue5 = base.Properties[i];
				switch (propertyValue5.PropertyType)
				{
				case PropertyType.TransformRotation:
					shape.Rotation = Utilities.FromFixedPoint16_16Value((uint)propertyValue5.Value);
					break;
				case PropertyType.TextLeft:
					if (worksheetShapeWithText != null)
					{
						worksheetShapeWithText.LeftMargin = Utilities.EMUToTwips((int)(uint)propertyValue5.Value);
					}
					break;
				case PropertyType.TextTop:
					if (worksheetShapeWithText != null)
					{
						worksheetShapeWithText.TopMargin = Utilities.EMUToTwips((int)(uint)propertyValue5.Value);
					}
					break;
				case PropertyType.TextRight:
					if (worksheetShapeWithText != null)
					{
						worksheetShapeWithText.RightMargin = Utilities.EMUToTwips((int)(uint)propertyValue5.Value);
					}
					break;
				case PropertyType.TextBottom:
					if (worksheetShapeWithText != null)
					{
						worksheetShapeWithText.BottomMargin = Utilities.EMUToTwips((int)(uint)propertyValue5.Value);
					}
					break;
				case PropertyType.FillStyleColor:
					propertyValue = propertyValue5;
					break;
				case PropertyType.FillStyleOpacity:
					opacityPropertyValue = propertyValue5;
					break;
				case PropertyType.FillStyleNoFillHitTest:
					propertyValue2 = propertyValue5;
					break;
				case PropertyType.LineStyleColor:
					propertyValue3 = propertyValue5;
					break;
				case PropertyType.LineStyleOpacity:
					opacityPropertyValue2 = propertyValue5;
					break;
				case PropertyType.LineStyleNoLineDrawDash:
					propertyValue4 = propertyValue5;
					break;
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = propertyValue2 != null || propertyValue != null;
			if (propertyValue2 != null && propertyValue2.Value is uint && Utilities.TestBit((uint)propertyValue2.Value, 20))
			{
				flag2 = Utilities.TestBit((uint)propertyValue2.Value, 4);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				shape.Fill = ShapeFill.FromColor(DecodeColor(loadManager, propertyValue, opacityPropertyValue) ?? SystemColorsInternal.WindowColor);
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = propertyValue4 != null || propertyValue3 != null;
			if (propertyValue4 != null && propertyValue4.Value is uint && Utilities.TestBit((uint)propertyValue4.Value, 19))
			{
				flag4 = Utilities.TestBit((uint)propertyValue4.Value, 3);
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				shape.Outline = ShapeOutline.FromColor(DecodeColor(loadManager, propertyValue3, opacityPropertyValue2) ?? SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColor);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class Regroup : EscherRecordBase
	{
		private ushort[] fridNews;

		private ushort[] fridOlds;

		public override EscherRecordType Type => EscherRecordType.Regroup;

		public Regroup(byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
			: base(version, instance, recordLength)
		{
		}

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			fridNews = new ushort[base.Instance];
			fridOlds = new ushort[base.Instance];
			for (int i = 0; i < fridNews.Length; i++)
			{
				fridNews[i] = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				fridOlds[i] = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			}
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			base.Save(saveManager);
			if (fridNews != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < fridNews.Length; i++)
				{
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(fridNews[i]);
					saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(fridOlds[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append(base.ToString());
			stringBuilder.Append("\n\n");
			if (fridNews != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < fridNews.Length; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(i);
					stringBuilder.Append(": ");
					stringBuilder.Append(fridNews[i]);
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					stringBuilder.Append(fridOlds[i]);
					stringBuilder.AppendLine();
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	internal class Shape : EscherRecordBase
	{
		public class PatriarchShape : WorksheetShapeGroup
		{
			private uint shapeId;

			internal override bool IsTopMost => true;

			internal override uint ShapeId
			{
				get
				{
					return shapeId;
				}
				set
				{
				}
			}

			public PatriarchShape(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, Worksheet worksheet)
			{
				shapeId = saveManager.GetSerializationCache(worksheet).PatriarchShapeId;
			}

			public override Rectangle GetBoundsInTwips(PositioningOptions options)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
		}

		private uint shapeId;

		private WorksheetShape shape;

		public override EscherRecordType Type => EscherRecordType.Shape;

		public Shape(WorksheetShape shape)
			: base(2, (ushort)shape.Type2003.Value, 8u)
		{
			this.shape = shape;
			shapeId = shape.ShapeId;
		}

		public Shape(byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
			: base(version, instance, recordLength)
		{
		}

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			shapeId = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			uint num = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			bool flag = (num & 1) == 1;
			bool flag2 = (num & 4) == 4;
			bool flag3 = (num & 8) == 8;
			bool isOleShape = (num & 0x10) == 16;
			bool flippedHorizontally = (num & 0x40) == 64;
			bool flippedVertically = (num & 0x80) == 128;
			if (flag3)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				loadManager.ContextStack.Push((object)loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>());
				return;
			}
			WorksheetShape worksheetShape;
			if (flag)
			{
				WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup = new WorksheetShapeGroup(loading: true);
				worksheetShape = worksheetShapeGroup;
				if (base.ParentRecord != null)
				{
					GroupShape childRecord = base.ParentRecord.GetChildRecord<GroupShape>();
					if (childRecord != null)
					{
						loadManager.SetGroupShapeChildBoundsInEmus(worksheetShapeGroup, childRecord.RectInEMUs);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ShapeType shapeType = (ShapeType)base.Instance;
				switch (shapeType)
				{
				case ShapeType.PictureFrame:
					worksheetShape = new WorksheetImage(initializeDefaults: false);
					break;
				case ShapeType.TextBox:
					worksheetShape = new UnknownShape(shapeType, num);
					break;
				default:
				{
					PredefinedShapeType predefinedShapeType = (PredefinedShapeType)shapeType;
					worksheetShape = ((!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(PredefinedShapeType), predefinedShapeType)) ? new UnknownShape(shapeType, num) : WorksheetShape.CreatePredefinedShape(predefinedShapeType, initializeDefaults: false));
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			if (worksheetShape is UnknownShape unknownShape)
			{
				unknownShape.IsOleShape = isOleShape;
			}
			worksheetShape.ShapeId = shapeId;
			worksheetShape.FlippedHorizontally = flippedHorizontally;
			worksheetShape.FlippedVertically = flippedVertically;
			loadManager.ContextStack.Push((object)worksheetShape);
		}

		public override void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			base.Save(saveManager);
			uint num = 0u;
			UnknownShape unknownShape = shape as UnknownShape;
			if (unknownShape != null)
			{
				num = (uint)(unknownShape.ShapeRecordOptionFlags & -2568);
			}
			else if (shape is WorksheetChart worksheetChart)
			{
				num = (uint)(worksheetChart.ShapeRecordOptionFlags & -2568);
			}
			if (shape is WorksheetShapeGroup)
			{
				num |= 1;
			}
			if (!shape.IsTopMost)
			{
				num |= 2;
			}
			if (shape is PatriarchShape)
			{
				num |= 4;
			}
			if (unknownShape != null && unknownShape.IsOleShape)
			{
				num |= 0x10;
			}
			if (shape.FlippedHorizontally)
			{
				num |= 0x40;
			}
			if (shape.FlippedVertically)
			{
				num |= 0x80;
			}
			if (shape.IsConnector)
			{
				num |= 0x100;
			}
			if (!(shape is PatriarchShape))
			{
				num |= 0x200;
			}
			if (base.Instance != 0)
			{
				num |= 0x800;
			}
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(shapeId);
			saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(num);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append(base.ToString());
			stringBuilder.Append("\n\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("Shape Type: " + base.Instance);
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("Shape ID: " + shapeId);
			stringBuilder.Append("\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("------------------------------");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel

	public class WorksheetShapeGroup : WorksheetShape, IWorksheetShapeOwner
	{
		private WorksheetShapeCollection shapes;

		private bool loading;

		private bool resizeShapesOnBoundsChanged = true;

		private bool resizeBoundsOnChildShapeBoundsChanged = true;

		internal override bool CanHaveFill => false;

		internal override bool CanHaveOutline => false;

		internal override bool HasFillAndOutlineInitially => false;

		internal override ShapeType? Type2003 => ShapeType.NotPrimitive;

		internal override ST_ShapeType? Type2007 => null;

		bool IWorksheetShapeOwner.AreChildrenTopMost
		{
			get
			{
				if (shapes != null && shapes.Count == 1)
				{
					return IsTopMost;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetShapeCollection Shapes
		{
			get
			{
				if (shapes == null)
				{
					shapes = new WorksheetShapeCollection(this);
				}
				return shapes;
			}
		}

		internal bool Loading => loading;

		public WorksheetShapeGroup()
		{
		}

		internal WorksheetShapeGroup(bool loading)
			: this()
		{
			this.loading = loading;
		}

		internal override TResult Accept<TArg, TResult>(IWorksheetShapeVisitor<TArg, TResult> visitor, TArg argument = default(TArg))
		{
			return visitor.VisitWorksheetShapeGroup(this, argument);
		}

		internal override void OnAddingToCollection(WorksheetShapeCollection collection)
		{
			if (collection != null && collection == shapes)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_GroupAddedToSelf"));
			}
			base.OnAddingToCollection(collection);
		}

		internal override void OnBoundsChanged(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetCellAddress oldTopLeftCornerCell, PointF oldTopLeftCornerPosition, WorksheetCellAddress oldBottomRightCornerCell, PointF oldBottomRightCornerPosition)
		{
			if (resizeShapesOnBoundsChanged && worksheet != null && base.TopLeftCornerCellInternal != WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference && base.BottomRightCornerCellInternal != WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference && oldTopLeftCornerCell != WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference && oldBottomRightCornerCell != WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference)
			{
				try
				{
					resizeBoundsOnChildShapeBoundsChanged = false;
					Rectangle boundsInTwips = WorksheetShape.GetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, oldTopLeftCornerCell, oldTopLeftCornerPosition, oldBottomRightCornerCell, oldBottomRightCornerPosition);
					Rectangle boundsInTwips2 = GetBoundsInTwips();
					if (boundsInTwips != boundsInTwips2)
					{
						float num = ((boundsInTwips.Width == 0) ? 1f : ((float)boundsInTwips2.Width / (float)boundsInTwips.Width));
						float num2 = ((boundsInTwips.Height == 0) ? 1f : ((float)boundsInTwips2.Height / (float)boundsInTwips.Height));
						foreach (WorksheetShape item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)Shapes)
						{
							Rectangle boundsInTwips3 = item.GetBoundsInTwips();
							Rectangle rectangle = boundsInTwips3;
							Utilities.OffsetRectangle(ref rectangle, -boundsInTwips.X, -boundsInTwips.Y);
							item.SetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, new Rectangle((int)((float)rectangle.Left * num) + boundsInTwips2.Left, (int)((float)rectangle.Top * num2) + boundsInTwips2.Top, (int)((float)rectangle.Width * num), (int)((float)rectangle.Height * num2)));
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					resizeBoundsOnChildShapeBoundsChanged = true;
				}
			}
			base.OnBoundsChanged(worksheet, oldTopLeftCornerCell, oldTopLeftCornerPosition, oldBottomRightCornerCell, oldBottomRightCornerPosition);
		}

		internal override void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			if (shapes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetShape item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)shapes)
			{
				item.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			}
		}

		internal override void OnSitedOnWorksheet(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			base.OnSitedOnWorksheet(worksheet);
			if (shapes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetShape item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)shapes)
			{
				item.OnSitedOnWorksheet(worksheet);
			}
		}

		void IWorksheetShapeOwner.OnChildShapeBoundsChanged(WorksheetShape childShape)
		{
			if (resizeBoundsOnChildShapeBoundsChanged)
			{
				RecalculateBounds();
			}
		}

		void IWorksheetShapeOwner.OnShapeAdded(WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			RecalculateBounds();
		}

		void IWorksheetShapeOwner.OnShapeRemoved(WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			RecalculateBounds();
		}

		internal WorksheetShape GetShapeById(uint shapeId, out WorksheetShapeCollection ownerCollection)
		{
			return Worksheet.GetShapeById(shapes, shapeId, out ownerCollection);
		}

		internal void GetSolverRecords(List<EscherRecordBase> records)
		{
			Worksheet.GetSolverRecords(shapes, records);
		}

		internal void OnLoadComplete()
		{
			loading = false;
		}

		private void RecalculateBounds()
		{
			if (loading)
			{
				return;
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = Worksheet;
			int count = Shapes.Count;
			int leftCellIndex = ((count > 0) ? int.MaxValue : 0);
			int topCellIndex = ((count > 0) ? int.MaxValue : 0);
			int rightCellIndex = 0;
			int bottomCellIndex = 0;
			float leftCellPosition = 100f;
			float topCellPosition = 100f;
			float rightCellPosition = ((count > 0) ? 0f : leftCellPosition);
			float bottomCellPosition = ((count > 0) ? 0f : topCellPosition);
			foreach (WorksheetShape item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)Shapes)
			{
				WorksheetCell worksheetCell = item.TopLeftCornerCell;
				WorksheetCell worksheetCell2 = item.BottomRightCornerCell;
				if (!(worksheetCell == null) && !(worksheetCell2 == null))
				{
					if (worksheet == null)
					{
						worksheet = worksheetCell.Worksheet;
					}
					PointF pointF = item.TopLeftCornerPosition;
					PointF pointF2 = item.BottomRightCornerPosition;
					ResolveLeftAnchor(ref leftCellIndex, ref leftCellPosition, worksheetCell, pointF);
					ResolveLeftAnchor(ref leftCellIndex, ref leftCellPosition, worksheetCell2, pointF2);
					ResolveTopAnchor(ref topCellIndex, ref topCellPosition, worksheetCell, pointF);
					ResolveTopAnchor(ref topCellIndex, ref topCellPosition, worksheetCell2, pointF2);
					ResolveRightAnchor(ref rightCellIndex, ref rightCellPosition, worksheetCell, pointF);
					ResolveRightAnchor(ref rightCellIndex, ref rightCellPosition, worksheetCell2, pointF2);
					ResolveBottomAnchor(ref bottomCellIndex, ref bottomCellPosition, worksheetCell, pointF);
					ResolveBottomAnchor(ref bottomCellIndex, ref bottomCellPosition, worksheetCell2, pointF2);
				}
			}
			try
			{
				resizeShapesOnBoundsChanged = false;
				SetAnchors(worksheet, new WorksheetCellAddress(topCellIndex, (short)leftCellIndex), new PointF(leftCellPosition, topCellPosition), new WorksheetCellAddress(bottomCellIndex, (short)rightCellIndex), new PointF(rightCellPosition, bottomCellPosition));
			}
			finally
			{
				resizeShapesOnBoundsChanged = true;
			}
		}

		private static void ResolveBottomAnchor(ref int bottomCellIndex, ref float bottomCellPosition, WorksheetCell bottomRightCell, PointF bottomRightPosition)
		{
			int rowIndex = bottomRightCell.RowIndex;
			if (rowIndex == bottomCellIndex)
			{
				bottomCellPosition = Math.Max(bottomRightPosition.Y, bottomCellPosition);
			}
			else if (bottomCellIndex < rowIndex)
			{
				bottomCellIndex = rowIndex;
				bottomCellPosition = bottomRightPosition.Y;
			}
		}

		private static void ResolveLeftAnchor(ref int leftCellIndex, ref float leftCellPosition, WorksheetCell topLeftCell, PointF topLeftPosition)
		{
			if (topLeftCell.ColumnIndex == leftCellIndex)
			{
				leftCellPosition = Math.Min(topLeftPosition.X, leftCellPosition);
			}
			else if (topLeftCell.ColumnIndex < leftCellIndex)
			{
				leftCellIndex = topLeftCell.ColumnIndex;
				leftCellPosition = topLeftPosition.X;
			}
		}

		private static void ResolveRightAnchor(ref int rightCellIndex, ref float rightCellPosition, WorksheetCell bottomRightCell, PointF bottomRightPosition)
		{
			if (bottomRightCell.ColumnIndex == rightCellIndex)
			{
				rightCellPosition = Math.Max(bottomRightPosition.X, rightCellPosition);
			}
			else if (rightCellIndex < bottomRightCell.ColumnIndex)
			{
				rightCellIndex = bottomRightCell.ColumnIndex;
				rightCellPosition = bottomRightPosition.X;
			}
		}

		private static void ResolveTopAnchor(ref int topCellIndex, ref float topCellPosition, WorksheetCell topLeftCell, PointF topLeftPosition)
		{
			int rowIndex = topLeftCell.RowIndex;
			if (rowIndex == topCellIndex)
			{
				topCellPosition = Math.Min(topLeftPosition.Y, topCellPosition);
			}
			else if (rowIndex < topCellIndex)
			{
				topCellIndex = rowIndex;
				topCellPosition = topLeftPosition.Y;
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.Serialization.BIFF8.EscherRecords

	internal sealed class ShapeContainer : EscherRecordContainerBase
	{
		public override EscherRecordType Type => EscherRecordType.ShapeContainer;

		public ShapeContainer(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, WorksheetShape shape)
			: base(15, 0, 0u)
		{
			if (!shape.Type2003.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			saveManager.PopuplateDrawingProperties(shape);
			if (shape is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
			{
				AddChildRecord(new GroupShape(worksheetShapeGroup));
				if (worksheetShapeGroup is Shape.PatriarchShape)
				{
					AddChildRecord(new Shape(worksheetShapeGroup));
					return;
				}
			}
			AddChildRecord(new Shape(shape));
			if (shape.HasDrawingProperties1)
			{
				shape.DrawingProperties1.Sort();
				AddChildRecord(new PropertyTable1(shape));
			}
			if (shape.HasDrawingProperties2)
			{
				shape.DrawingProperties2.Sort();
				AddChildRecord(new PropertyTable2(shape));
			}
			if (shape.HasDrawingProperties3)
			{
				shape.DrawingProperties3.Sort();
				AddChildRecord(new PropertyTable3(shape));
			}
			AddChildRecord(GetAnchorRecord(shape));
			AddChildRecord(new ClientData(shape));
			WorksheetShapeWithText worksheetShapeWithText = shape as WorksheetShapeWithText;
			WorksheetCellComment worksheetCellComment = shape as WorksheetCellComment;
			if ((worksheetShapeWithText != null && worksheetShapeWithText.HasText) || worksheetCellComment != null)
			{
				AddChildRecord(new ClientTextBox(shape));
			}
		}

		public ShapeContainer(byte version, ushort instance, uint recordLength)
			: base(version, instance, recordLength)
		{
		}

		public override void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			base.Load(loadManager);
			if (!(loadManager.ContextStack.Current is WorksheetShape))
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetShape worksheetShape = (WorksheetShape)loadManager.ContextStack.Pop();
			Worksheet worksheet = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<Worksheet>();
			IWorksheetShapeOwner worksheetShapeOwner = loadManager.ContextStack.Get<IWorksheetShapeOwner>();
			if (worksheet == null || worksheetShapeOwner == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ChildAnchor childRecord = GetChildRecord<ChildAnchor>();
			if (worksheetShapeOwner is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
			{
				if (childRecord != null && worksheet != null)
				{
					CT_Transform2D shapeTransform = TransformFromEmus(childRecord.RectInEMUs);
					Rectangle boundsInTwips = worksheetShapeGroup.GetBoundsInTwips();
					Rectangle groupShapeChildBoundsInEmus = loadManager.GetGroupShapeChildBoundsInEmus(worksheetShapeGroup);
					CT_GroupTransform2D groupTransform = GroupTransformFromEmus(boundsInTwips, groupShapeChildBoundsInEmus);
					Rectangle absoluteShapeBoundsInTwips = loadManager.GetAbsoluteShapeBoundsInTwips(shapeTransform, worksheetShape.Rotation, groupTransform, boundsInTwips);
					worksheetShape.SetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, absoluteShapeBoundsInTwips);
				}
			}
			else if (childRecord != null)
			{
				worksheetShape.SetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, Utilities.EMUToTwips(childRecord.RectInEMUs));
			}
			if (!(worksheetShape.TopLeftCornerCell == null))
			{
				worksheetShapeOwner.Shapes.Add(worksheetShape, verifyCanBeAdded: false);
				if (worksheetShape is WorksheetShapeGroup)
				{
					loadManager.ContextStack.Push((object)worksheetShape);
				}
			}
		}

		private static EscherRecordBase GetAnchorRecord(WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			if (shape.IsTopMost)
			{
				return new ClientAnchor(shape);
			}
			return new ChildAnchor(shape);
		}

		protected override bool ValidateChildRecord(EscherRecordBase childRecord)
		{
			switch (childRecord.Type)
			{
			case EscherRecordType.GroupShape:
			case EscherRecordType.Shape:
			case EscherRecordType.PropertyTable1:
			case EscherRecordType.Textbox:
			case EscherRecordType.ClientTextbox:
			case EscherRecordType.Anchor:
			case EscherRecordType.ChildAnchor:
			case EscherRecordType.ClientAnchor:
			case EscherRecordType.ClientData:
			case EscherRecordType.DeletedPSPL:
			case EscherRecordType.OLEObject:
			case EscherRecordType.PropertyTable2:
			case EscherRecordType.PropertyTable3:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static CT_GroupTransform2D GroupTransformFromEmus(Rectangle mainTransform, Rectangle childrenTransform)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0073: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a7: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00b1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CT_GroupTransform2D val = new CT_GroupTransform2D();
			CT_Point2D val2 = new CT_Point2D();
			val2.X = ST_Coordinate.op_Implicit((long)mainTransform.X);
			val2.Y = ST_Coordinate.op_Implicit((long)mainTransform.Y);
			((CT_Transform2D)val).Offset = val2;
			CT_PositiveSize2D val3 = new CT_PositiveSize2D();
			val3.CX = ST_PositiveCoordinate.op_Implicit((long)mainTransform.Width);
			val3.CY = ST_PositiveCoordinate.op_Implicit((long)mainTransform.Height);
			((CT_Transform2D)val).Extents = val3;
			CT_Point2D val4 = new CT_Point2D();
			val4.X = ST_Coordinate.op_Implicit((long)childrenTransform.X);
			val4.Y = ST_Coordinate.op_Implicit((long)childrenTransform.Y);
			val.ChildOffset = val4;
			CT_PositiveSize2D val5 = new CT_PositiveSize2D();
			val5.CX = ST_PositiveCoordinate.op_Implicit((long)childrenTransform.Width);
			val5.CY = ST_PositiveCoordinate.op_Implicit((long)childrenTransform.Height);
			val.ChildExtents = val5;
			return val;
		}

		private static CT_Transform2D TransformFromEmus(Rectangle transform)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CT_Transform2D val = new CT_Transform2D();
			CT_Point2D val2 = new CT_Point2D();
			val2.X = ST_Coordinate.op_Implicit((long)transform.X);
			val2.Y = ST_Coordinate.op_Implicit((long)transform.Y);

			val3.CX = ST_PositiveCoordinate.op_Implicit((long)transform.Width);
			val3.CY = ST_PositiveCoordinate.op_Implicit((long)transform.Height);
			val.Extents = val3;
			return val;
		}

	internal sealed class SolverContainer : EscherRecordContainerBase

		}

			case EscherRecordType.AlignRule:
			case EscherRecordType.ArcRule:
			case EscherRecordType.ClientRule:

				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

	internal abstract class ExtProp
	{
		public abstract ExtPropType ExtType { get; }

		public abstract void ApplyTo(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, WorksheetCellFormatData formatData);

		public abstract void Save(Biff8RecordStream stream);
	}
	internal abstract class ExtPropColorBase : ExtProp
	{
		private ExtPropType _extType;

		public override ExtPropType ExtType => _extType;

		protected ExtPropColorBase(ExtPropType extType)
		{
			_extType = extType;
		}

		public override void ApplyTo(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, WorksheetCellFormatData formatData)
		{
			WorkbookColorInfo color = GetColor(loadManager.Workbook);
			switch (ExtType)
			{
			case ExtPropType.ForegroundColor:
			case ExtPropType.BackgroundColor:
				if (formatData.Fill is CellFillPattern cellFillPattern)
				{
					WorkbookColorInfo backgroundColorInfo = cellFillPattern.GetFileFormatBackgroundColorInfo(formatData);
					WorkbookColorInfo patternColorInfo = cellFillPattern.GetFileFormatForegroundColorInfo(formatData);
					if (ExtType == ExtPropType.BackgroundColor)
					{
						backgroundColorInfo = color;
					}
					else
					{
						patternColorInfo = color;
					}
					formatData.Fill = new CellFillPattern(backgroundColorInfo, patternColorInfo, cellFillPattern.PatternStyle, formatData, isCreatedInternally: true);
				}
				break;
			case ExtPropType.BottomBorderColor:
				formatData.BottomBorderColorInfo = color;
				break;
			case ExtPropType.CellTextColor:
				formatData.Font.ColorInfo = color;
				break;
			case ExtPropType.DiagonalBorderColor:
				formatData.DiagonalBorderColorInfo = color;
				break;
			case ExtPropType.LeftBorderColor:
				formatData.LeftBorderColorInfo = color;
				break;
			case ExtPropType.RightBorderColor:
				formatData.RightBorderColorInfo = color;
				break;
			case ExtPropType.TopBorderColor:
				formatData.TopBorderColorInfo = color;
				break;
			case ExtPropType.GradientFill:
			case (ExtPropType)12:
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void Save(Biff8RecordStream stream)
		{
			ColorableItem item;
			switch (ExtType)
			{
			case ExtPropType.ForegroundColor:
			case ExtPropType.BackgroundColor:
				item = ColorableItem.CellFill;
				break;
			case ExtPropType.TopBorderColor:
			case ExtPropType.BottomBorderColor:
			case ExtPropType.LeftBorderColor:
			case ExtPropType.RightBorderColor:
			case ExtPropType.DiagonalBorderColor:
				item = ColorableItem.CellBorder;
				break;
			case ExtPropType.CellTextColor:
				item = ColorableItem.CellFont;
				break;
			default:
				item = ColorableItem.CellFill;
				break;
			}
			stream.WriteFullColorExt(GetColor(stream.SaveManager.Workbook), item);
		}

		public abstract WorkbookColorInfo GetColor(Workbook workbook);
	}
	internal class ExtPropColor : ExtPropColorBase

	internal class FtCbls
	{
		private const ushort RecordSize = 12;

		private uint unused1;

		private uint unused2;

		private uint unused3;

		private FtCbls()
		{
		}

		public static FtCbls Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			if (!ObjUtilities.ReadAndVerifyFt(loadManager, OBJRecordType.CheckBoxLink))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			FtCbls ftCbls = new FtCbls();
			currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ftCbls.unused1 = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			ftCbls.unused2 = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			ftCbls.unused3 = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			return ftCbls;
		}

		internal void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)10);
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)12);
			currentRecordStream.Write(unused1);
			currentRecordStream.Write(unused2);
			currentRecordStream.Write(unused3);
		}
	}
	internal class FtCblsData
	{
		private const ushort RecordSize = 8;

		private ushort fChecked;

		private ushort accel;

		private bool fNo3d;

		private FtCblsData()
		{
		}

		public static FtCblsData Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, Obj owner)
		{
			if (!ObjUtilities.ReadAndVerifyFt(loadManager, OBJRecordType.CheckBoxData))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			FtCblsData ftCblsData = new FtCblsData();
			currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ftCblsData.fChecked = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ftCblsData.accel = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort num = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ftCblsData.fNo3d = (num & 1) == 1;
			return ftCblsData;
		}

		internal void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, Obj obj)
		{
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			ushort num = 0;
			if (fNo3d)
			{
				num |= 1;
			}
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)18);
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)8);
			currentRecordStream.Write(fChecked);
			currentRecordStream.Write(accel);
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			currentRecordStream.Write(num);
		}

	internal class FtCmo
	{
		private const ushort RecordSize = 18;

		private const ushort FLockedBit = 1;

		private const ushort FDefaultSizeBit = 4;

		private const ushort FPublishedBit = 4;

		private const ushort FPrintBit = 8;

		private const ushort FDisabledBit = 128;

		private const ushort FUIObjBit = 256;

		private const ushort FRecalcObjBit = 512;

		private const ushort FRecalcObjAlwaysBit = 4096;

		private ObjectType ot;

		private ushort id;

		private ushort optionFlags;

		private uint unused1;

		private uint unused2;

		private uint unused3;

		public bool FDefaultSize => (optionFlags & 4) == 4;

		public bool FDisabled => (optionFlags & 0x80) == 128;

		public bool FLocked => (optionFlags & 1) == 1;

		public bool FPrint => (optionFlags & 8) == 8;

		public bool FPublished => (optionFlags & 4) == 4;

		public bool FRecalcObj => (optionFlags & 0x200) == 512;

		public bool FRecalcObjAlways => (optionFlags & 0x1000) == 4096;

		public bool FUIObj => (optionFlags & 0x100) == 256;

		public ushort Id
		{
			get
			{
				return id;
			}
			set
			{
				id = value;
			}
		}

		public ObjectType Ot => ot;

		private FtCmo()
		{
		}

		public FtCmo(ObjectType objectType)
		{
			ot = objectType;
			if (objectType == ObjectType.Comment)
			{
				optionFlags = 16401;
			}
			else
			{
				optionFlags = 24593;
			}
		}

		public static FtCmo Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			if (!ObjUtilities.ReadAndVerifyFt(loadManager, OBJRecordType.CommonObjectData))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			FtCmo ftCmo = new FtCmo();
			currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ftCmo.ot = (ObjectType)currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ftCmo.id = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ftCmo.optionFlags = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ftCmo.unused1 = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			ftCmo.unused2 = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			ftCmo.unused3 = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			return ftCmo;
		}

		public void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)21);
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)18);
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)ot);
			currentRecordStream.Write(id);
			currentRecordStream.Write(optionFlags);
			currentRecordStream.Write(unused1);
			currentRecordStream.Write(unused2);
			currentRecordStream.Write(unused3);
		}

	internal class FtLbsData
	{
		private ushort cbFContinued;

		private ObjFmla fmla;

		private ushort cLines;

		private ushort iSel;

		private ushort flags;

		private ushort idEdit;

		private LbsDropData dropData;

		private string[] rgLines;

		private bool[] bsels;

		public ObjFmla Fmla => fmla;

		private FtLbsData()
		{
		}

		public static FtLbsData Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, Obj owner)
		{
			if (!ObjUtilities.ReadAndVerifyFt(loadManager, OBJRecordType.ListBoxData))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			FtLbsData ftLbsData = new FtLbsData();
			ftLbsData.cbFContinued = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			if (ftLbsData.cbFContinued != 0)
			{
				ftLbsData.fmla = ObjFmla.Load(loadManager);
				ftLbsData.cLines = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				ftLbsData.iSel = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				ftLbsData.flags = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				bool flag = (ftLbsData.flags & 2) == 2;
				byte b = (byte)((ftLbsData.flags & 0x30) >> 4);
				ftLbsData.idEdit = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
				if (owner.Cmo.Ot == ObjectType.ComboBox)
				{
					ftLbsData.dropData = LbsDropData.Load(loadManager);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					ftLbsData.rgLines = new string[ftLbsData.cLines];
					for (int i = 0; i < ftLbsData.cLines; i++)
					{
						ftLbsData.rgLines[i] = currentRecordStream.ReadXLUnicodeString();
					}
				}
				if (b != 0)
				{
					ftLbsData.bsels = new bool[ftLbsData.cLines];
					for (int j = 0; j < ftLbsData.cLines; j++)
					{
						byte b2 = (byte)currentRecordStream.ReadByte();
						ftLbsData.bsels[j] = b2 != 0;
					}
				}
			}
			return ftLbsData;
		}

		public void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, Obj owner)
		{
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)19);
			currentRecordStream.Write(cbFContinued);
			if (cbFContinued == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			fmla.Save(saveManager);
			currentRecordStream.Write(cLines);
			currentRecordStream.Write(iSel);
			currentRecordStream.Write(flags);
			currentRecordStream.Write(idEdit);
			if (owner.Cmo.Ot == ObjectType.ComboBox && dropData != null)
			{
				dropData.Save(currentRecordStream);
			}
			if (rgLines != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < cLines; i++)
				{
					currentRecordStream.WriteXLUnicodeString(rgLines[i]);
				}
			}
			if (bsels != null)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < cLines; j++)
				{
					currentRecordStream.Write((byte)(bsels[j] ? 1u : 0u));
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class FtPictFmla
	{
		private ObjFmla fmla;

		private uint lPosInCtlStm;

		private uint cbBufInCtlStm;

		private PictFmlaKey key;

		public ObjFmla Fmla => fmla;

		public PictFmlaKey Key => key;

		private FtPictFmla()
		{
		}

		public Formula GetFormula()
		{
			if (fmla == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return fmla.GetFormula();
		}

		public void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, Obj owner)
		{
			if (fmla == null || (owner.PictFlags.FCtl && key == null))
			{
				return;
			}
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)9);
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			long position = currentRecordStream.Position;
			fmla.Save(saveManager);
			Formula formula = GetFormula();
			if (formula != null && formula.PostfixTokenList.Length >= 1 && formula.PostfixTokenList[0] is TblToken)
			{
				currentRecordStream.Write(lPosInCtlStm);
				if (owner.PictFlags.FPrstm)
				{
					currentRecordStream.Write(cbBufInCtlStm);
				}
			}
			if (owner.PictFlags.FCtl)
			{
				key.Save(saveManager);
			}
			long position2 = currentRecordStream.Position;
			ushort value = (ushort)(position2 - position);
			currentRecordStream.Position = position - 2;
			currentRecordStream.Write(value);
			currentRecordStream.Position = position2;
		}

		public static FtPictFmla TryLoad(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, Obj owner)
		{
			if (!ObjUtilities.ReadAndVerifyFt(loadManager, OBJRecordType.PictureFormulaStyleMacro, isRequired: false))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			FtPictFmla ftPictFmla = new FtPictFmla();
			currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			_ = currentRecordStream.Position;
			ftPictFmla.fmla = ObjFmla.Load(loadManager);
			Formula formula = ftPictFmla.GetFormula();
			if (formula != null && formula.PostfixTokenList.Length >= 1 && formula.PostfixTokenList[0] is TblToken)
			{
				ftPictFmla.lPosInCtlStm = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
				if (owner.PictFlags.FPrstm)
				{
					ftPictFmla.cbBufInCtlStm = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
				}
			}
			if (owner.PictFlags.FCtl)
			{
				ftPictFmla.key = PictFmlaKey.Load(loadManager);
			}
			return ftPictFmla;
		}
	}
