	internal class LbsDropData
	{
		private byte wStyle;

		private ushort cLine;

		private ushort dxMin;

		private string str;

		private LbsDropData()
		{
		}

		public static LbsDropData Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			LbsDropData lbsDropData = new LbsDropData();
			ushort num = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			lbsDropData.wStyle = (byte)(num & 3);
			lbsDropData.cLine = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			lbsDropData.dxMin = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			long position = currentRecordStream.Position;
			lbsDropData.str = currentRecordStream.ReadXLUnicodeString();
			long num2 = currentRecordStream.Position - position;
			if (num2 % 2 == 1)
			{
				currentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			}
			return lbsDropData;
		}

		public void Save(Biff8RecordStream stream)
		{
			ushort num = 0;
			num |= wStyle;
			stream.Write(num);
			stream.Write(cLine);
			stream.Write(dxMin);
			long position = stream.Position;
			stream.WriteXLUnicodeString(str);
			long num2 = stream.Position - position;
			if (num2 % 2 == 1)
			{
				stream.WriteByte(0);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class Obj
	{
		private FtCmo cmo;

		private FtGmo gmo;

		private FtCf pictFormat;

		private FtPioGrbit pictFlags;

		private FtCbls cbls;

		private FtRbo rbo;

		private FtSbs sbs;

		private FtNts nts;

		private FtMacro macro;

		private FtPictFmla pictFmla;

		private ObjLinkFmla linkFmla;

		private FtCblsData checkBox;

		private FtRboData radioButton;

		private FtEdoData edit;

		private FtLbsData list;

		private FtGboData gbo;

		public FtCmo Cmo => cmo;

		public ObjLinkFmla LinkFmla => linkFmla;

		public FtLbsData List => list;

		public FtMacro Macro => macro;

		public FtPioGrbit PictFlags => pictFlags;

		public FtPictFmla PictFmla => pictFmla;

		public FtRboData RadioButton => radioButton;

		public Obj()
		{
		}

		public Obj(WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			if (shape is WorksheetCellComment)
			{
				cmo = new FtCmo(ObjectType.Comment);
				nts = new FtNts();
			}
			else if (shape is WorksheetImage)
			{
				cmo = new FtCmo(ObjectType.Picture);
				pictFormat = new FtCf();
				pictFlags = new FtPioGrbit();
			}
			else if (shape is WorksheetShapeGroup)
			{
				cmo = new FtCmo(ObjectType.Group);
				gmo = new FtGmo();
			}
			else if (shape is WorksheetChart)
			{
				cmo = new FtCmo(ObjectType.Chart);
			}
			else if (shape is RectangleShape)
			{
				cmo = new FtCmo(ObjectType.Rectangle);
			}
			else if (shape is LineShape)
			{
				cmo = new FtCmo(ObjectType.Line);
			}
			else if (shape is EllipseShape)
			{
				cmo = new FtCmo(ObjectType.Oval);
			}
			else if (Enum.IsDefined(typeof(PredefinedShapeType), (PredefinedShapeType)shape.Type2003.Value))
			{
				cmo = new FtCmo(ObjectType.MicrosoftOfficeDrawing);
			}
			else
			{
				cmo = new FtCmo(ObjectType.Polygon);
			}
		}

		public void Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			cmo = FtCmo.Load(loadManager);
			ObjectType ot = cmo.Ot;
			switch (ot)
			{
			case ObjectType.Group:
				gmo = FtGmo.Load(loadManager);
				break;
			case ObjectType.Picture:
				pictFormat = FtCf.Load(loadManager);
				pictFlags = FtPioGrbit.Load(loadManager);
				break;
			case ObjectType.CheckBox:
			case ObjectType.OptionButton:
				cbls = FtCbls.Load(loadManager);
				if (ot == ObjectType.OptionButton)
				{
					rbo = FtRbo.Load(loadManager);
				}
				break;
			case ObjectType.Spinner:
			case ObjectType.ScrollBar:
			case ObjectType.ListBox:
			case ObjectType.ComboBox:
				sbs = FtSbs.Load(loadManager);
				break;
			case ObjectType.Comment:
				nts = FtNts.Load(loadManager);
				break;
			}
			macro = FtMacro.TryLoad(loadManager);
			switch (ot)
			{
			case ObjectType.Picture:
				pictFmla = FtPictFmla.TryLoad(loadManager, this);
				break;
			case ObjectType.CheckBox:
			case ObjectType.OptionButton:
				linkFmla = ObjLinkFmla.TryLoad(loadManager, this);
				checkBox = FtCblsData.Load(loadManager, this);
				if (ot == ObjectType.OptionButton)
				{
					radioButton = FtRboData.Load(loadManager);
				}
				break;
			case ObjectType.Spinner:
			case ObjectType.ScrollBar:
			case ObjectType.ListBox:
			case ObjectType.ComboBox:
				linkFmla = ObjLinkFmla.TryLoad(loadManager, this);
				if (ot == ObjectType.ListBox || ot == ObjectType.ComboBox)
				{
					list = FtLbsData.Load(loadManager, this);
				}
				break;
			case ObjectType.EditBox:
				edit = FtEdoData.Load(loadManager);
				break;
			case ObjectType.GroupBox:
				gbo = FtGboData.Load(loadManager);
				break;
			}
			if (ot != ObjectType.ListBox && ot != ObjectType.ComboBox)
			{
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			}
		}

		public void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			if (cmo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			cmo.Save(saveManager);
			ObjectType ot = cmo.Ot;
			switch (ot)
			{
			case ObjectType.Group:
				if (gmo == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				gmo.Save(saveManager);
				break;
			case ObjectType.Picture:
				if (pictFormat == null || pictFlags == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				pictFormat.Save(saveManager);
				pictFlags.Save(saveManager);
				break;
			case ObjectType.CheckBox:
			case ObjectType.OptionButton:
				if (cbls == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				cbls.Save(saveManager);
				if (ot == ObjectType.OptionButton)
				{
					if (rbo == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					rbo.Save(saveManager);
				}
				break;
			case ObjectType.Spinner:
			case ObjectType.ScrollBar:
			case ObjectType.ListBox:
			case ObjectType.ComboBox:
				if (sbs == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				sbs.Save(saveManager);
				break;
			case ObjectType.Comment:
				if (nts == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				nts.Save(saveManager);
				break;
			}
			if (macro != null)
			{
				macro.Save(saveManager);
			}
			switch (ot)
			{
			case ObjectType.Picture:
				if (pictFmla != null)
				{
					pictFmla.Save(saveManager, this);
				}
				break;
			case ObjectType.CheckBox:
			case ObjectType.OptionButton:
				if (linkFmla != null)
				{
					linkFmla.Save(saveManager, this);
				}
				if (checkBox == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				checkBox.Save(saveManager, this);
				if (ot == ObjectType.OptionButton)
				{
					if (radioButton == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					radioButton.Save(saveManager);
				}
				break;
			case ObjectType.Spinner:
			case ObjectType.ScrollBar:
			case ObjectType.ListBox:
			case ObjectType.ComboBox:
				if (linkFmla != null)
				{
					linkFmla.Save(saveManager, this);
				}
				if (ot == ObjectType.ListBox || ot == ObjectType.ComboBox)
				{
					if (list == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					list.Save(saveManager, this);
				}
				break;
			case ObjectType.EditBox:
				if (edit == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				edit.Save(saveManager);
				break;
			case ObjectType.GroupBox:
				if (gbo == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				gbo.Save(saveManager);
				break;
			}
			if (ot != ObjectType.ListBox && ot != ObjectType.ComboBox)
			{
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(0u);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ObjectParsedFormula
	{
		private uint unused;

		private Rgce rgce;

		private ObjectParsedFormula()
		{
		}

		public Formula GetFormula()
		{
			if (rgce == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return rgce.Formula;
		}

		public static ObjectParsedFormula Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			ObjectParsedFormula objectParsedFormula = new ObjectParsedFormula();
			ushort num = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			ushort length = (ushort)(num & 0xEFFF);
			objectParsedFormula.unused = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			objectParsedFormula.rgce = Rgce.Load(loadManager, length);
			return objectParsedFormula;
		}

		public void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			if (rgce != null)
			{
				Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream;
				currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
				currentRecordStream.Write(unused);
				long position = currentRecordStream.Position;
				rgce.Save(saveManager);
				long position2 = currentRecordStream.Position;
				ushort value = (ushort)(position2 - position);
				currentRecordStream.Position = position - 6;
				currentRecordStream.Write(value);
				currentRecordStream.Position = position2;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ObjFmla
	{
		private ObjectParsedFormula fmla;

		private PictFmlaEmbedInfo embedInfo;

		public PictFmlaEmbedInfo EmbedInfo => embedInfo;

		public ObjectParsedFormula Fmla => fmla;

		private ObjFmla()
		{
		}

		public Formula GetFormula()
		{
			if (fmla == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return fmla.GetFormula();
		}

		public static ObjFmla Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			ObjFmla objFmla = new ObjFmla();
			ushort num = currentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			long position = currentRecordStream.Position;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				objFmla.fmla = ObjectParsedFormula.Load(loadManager);
				Formula formula = objFmla.GetFormula();
				if (formula != null && formula.PostfixTokenList.Length >= 1 && formula.PostfixTokenList[0] is TblToken)
				{
					objFmla.embedInfo = PictFmlaEmbedInfo.Load(loadManager);
				}
			}
			int count = num - (int)(currentRecordStream.Position - position);
			currentRecordStream.ReadBytes(count);
			return objFmla;
		}

		public void IterateFormulas(Worksheet owningWorksheet, Action<Worksheet, Formula> callback)
		{
			Formula formula = GetFormula();
			if (formula != null)
			{
				callback(owningWorksheet, formula);
			}
		}

		public void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			Formula formula = GetFormula();
			bool flag = formula != null && formula.PostfixTokenList.Length >= 1 && formula.PostfixTokenList[0] is TblToken;
			if (flag && embedInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream;
			currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			if (fmla != null)
			{
				long position = currentRecordStream.Position;
				fmla.Save(saveManager);
				if (flag)
				{
					embedInfo.Save(currentRecordStream);
				}
				long position2 = currentRecordStream.Position;
				long num = position2 - position;
				if (num % 4 != 0)
				{
					int num2 = (int)(4 - num % 4);
					currentRecordStream.Write(new byte[num2]);
					num += num2;
				}
				currentRecordStream.Position = position - 2;
				currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)num);
				currentRecordStream.Seek(num, SeekOrigin.Current);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ObjLinkFmla
	{
		private ObjFmla fmla;

		public ObjFmla Fmla => fmla;

		private ObjLinkFmla()
		{
		}

		public void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, Obj owner)
		{
			if (fmla != null)
			{
				ushort value;
				switch (owner.Cmo.Ot)
				{
				default:
					return;
				case ObjectType.CheckBox:
				case ObjectType.OptionButton:
					value = 20;
					break;
				case ObjectType.Spinner:
				case ObjectType.ScrollBar:
				case ObjectType.ListBox:
				case ObjectType.ComboBox:
					value = 14;
					break;
				case ObjectType.EditBox:
				case ObjectType.Label:
				case ObjectType.DialogBox:
				case ObjectType.GroupBox:
					return;
				}
				saveManager.CurrentRecordStream.Write(value);
				fmla.Save(saveManager);
			}
		}

		public static ObjLinkFmla TryLoad(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, Obj owner)
		{
			switch (owner.Cmo.Ot)
			{
			case ObjectType.CheckBox:
			case ObjectType.OptionButton:
				if (!ObjUtilities.ReadAndVerifyFt(loadManager, OBJRecordType.CheckBoxLinkFormulaStyleMacro, isRequired: false))
				{
					return null;
				}
				break;
			case ObjectType.Spinner:
			case ObjectType.ScrollBar:
			case ObjectType.ListBox:
			case ObjectType.ComboBox:
				if (!ObjUtilities.ReadAndVerifyFt(loadManager, OBJRecordType.ScrollBarFormulaStyleMacro, isRequired: false))
				{
					return null;
				}
				break;
			default:
				return null;
			}
			ObjLinkFmla objLinkFmla = new ObjLinkFmla();
			objLinkFmla.fmla = ObjFmla.Load(loadManager);
			return objLinkFmla;
		}
	}
	internal static class ObjUtilities
	{
		public static bool ReadAndVerifyFt(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, OBJRecordType expectedFt)
		{
			return ReadAndVerifyFt(loadManager, expectedFt, isRequired: true);
		}

		public static bool ReadAndVerifyFt(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, OBJRecordType expectedFt, bool isRequired)
		{
			OBJRecordType oBJRecordType = (OBJRecordType)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt16();
			if (oBJRecordType != expectedFt)
			{
				loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.Seek(-2L, SeekOrigin.Current);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class PictFmlaEmbedInfo
	{
		private string strClass;

		public string StrClass => strClass;

		private PictFmlaEmbedInfo()
		{
		}

		public static PictFmlaEmbedInfo Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			PictFmlaEmbedInfo pictFmlaEmbedInfo = new PictFmlaEmbedInfo();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			byte b = (byte)loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadByte();
			if (b != 0)
			{
				pictFmlaEmbedInfo.strClass = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadXLUnicodeStringNoCch(b);
			}
			return pictFmlaEmbedInfo;
		}

		public void Save(Biff8RecordStream stream)
		{
			byte value = 0;
			if (strClass != null)
			{
				value = (byte)strClass.Length;
			}
			stream.WriteByte(3);
			stream.WriteByte(value);
			stream.WriteByte(0);
			stream.WriteXLUnicodeStringNoCch(strClass);
		}
	}
	internal class PictFmlaKey
	{
		private byte[] keyBuf;

		private ObjFmla fmlaLinkedCell;

		private ObjFmla fmlaListFillRange;

		public ObjFmla FmlaLinkedCell => fmlaLinkedCell;

		public ObjFmla FmlaListFillRange => fmlaListFillRange;

		private PictFmlaKey()
		{
		}

		public static PictFmlaKey Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager)
		{
			PictFmlaKey pictFmlaKey = new PictFmlaKey();
			uint count = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadUInt32();
			pictFmlaKey.keyBuf = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadBytes((int)count);
			pictFmlaKey.fmlaLinkedCell = ObjFmla.Load(loadManager);
			pictFmlaKey.fmlaListFillRange = ObjFmla.Load(loadManager);
			return pictFmlaKey;
		}

		public void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			if (fmlaLinkedCell != null && fmlaListFillRange != null)
			{
				Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = saveManager.CurrentRecordStream;
				currentRecordStream.Write((uint)keyBuf.Length);
				currentRecordStream.Write(keyBuf);
				fmlaLinkedCell.Save(saveManager);
				fmlaListFillRange.Save(saveManager);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class Rgce
	{
		private Formula formula;

		public Formula Formula => formula;

		private Rgce()
		{
		}

		public static Rgce Load(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003 loadManager, ushort length)
		{
			Rgce rgce = new Rgce();
			int dataIndex = 0;
			byte[] data = loadManager.CurrentRecordStream.ReadBytes(length);
			rgce.formula = loadManager.LoadFormula(FormulaType.NamedReferenceFormula, length, ref data, ref dataIndex);
			return rgce;
		}

		public void Save(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			if (formula != null)
			{
				saveManager.SaveFormula(formula, writeSize: false, isForExternalNamedReference: false);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class TableColumnFilterData
	{
		public readonly IList<string> AllowedTextValues;

		public readonly WorksheetTableColumn Column;

		public readonly bool NeedsAUTOFILTER12Record;

		public readonly bool ShouldSaveIn2003Formats;

		public TableColumnFilterData(WorksheetTableColumn column)
		{
			Column = column;
			if (Column.Filter == null)
			{
				ShouldSaveIn2003Formats = false;
			}
			else
			{
				ShouldSaveIn2003Formats = Column.Filter.ShouldSaveIn2003Formats(out NeedsAUTOFILTER12Record, out AllowedTextValues);
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class XFProp
	{
		public abstract XFPropType Type { get; }

		public abstract void ApplyTo(Workbook workbook, WorksheetCellFormatData format);
	}
	internal class XFPropBool : XFProp
	{
		private bool _value;

		private XFPropType _type;

		public override XFPropType Type => _type;

		public bool Value => _value;

		public byte ValueByte => (byte)(_value ? 1u : 0u);

		public XFPropBool(XFPropType type, bool value)
		{
			_type = type;
			_value = value;
		}

		public XFPropBool(XFPropType type, ExcelDefaultableBoolean value)
			: this(type, value == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True)
		{
		}

		public XFPropBool(XFPropType type, byte value)
		{
			_type = type;
			_value = ((value != 0) ? true : false);
		}

		public override void ApplyTo(Workbook workbook, WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			ExcelDefaultableBoolean excelDefaultableBoolean = Utilities.ToDefaultableBoolean(_value);
			switch (_type)
			{
			case XFPropType.DiagonalDownBorder:
				if (_value)
				{
					format.DiagonalBorders |= DiagonalBorders.DiagonalDown;
				}
				else
				{
					format.DiagonalBorders &= (DiagonalBorders)(-4);
				}
				break;
			case XFPropType.DiagonalUpBorder:
				if (_value)
				{
					format.DiagonalBorders |= DiagonalBorders.DiagonalUp;
				}
				else
				{
					format.DiagonalBorders &= (DiagonalBorders)(-6);
				}
				break;
			case XFPropType.FontItalic:
				format.Font.Italic = excelDefaultableBoolean;
				break;
			case XFPropType.FontStrikethrough:
				format.Font.Strikeout = excelDefaultableBoolean;
				break;
			case XFPropType.Locked:
				format.Locked = excelDefaultableBoolean;
				break;
			case XFPropType.ShrinkToFit:
				format.ShrinkToFit = excelDefaultableBoolean;
				break;
			case XFPropType.WrappedText:
				format.WrapText = excelDefaultableBoolean;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class XFPropBorderBase : XFProp
	{
		private CellBorderLineStyle _borderStyle;

		private XFPropType _type;

		public override XFPropType Type => _type;

		public CellBorderLineStyle BorderStyle => _borderStyle;

		protected XFPropBorderBase(XFPropType type, CellBorderLineStyle borderStyle)
		{
			_borderStyle = borderStyle;
			_type = type;
		}

		public override void ApplyTo(Workbook workbook, WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			WorkbookColorInfo borderColor = GetBorderColor(workbook);
			switch (Type)
			{
			case XFPropType.BottomBorder:
				format.BottomBorderColorInfo = borderColor;
				format.BottomBorderStyle = _borderStyle;
				break;
			case XFPropType.DiagonalBorder:
				format.DiagonalBorderColorInfo = borderColor;
				format.DiagonalBorderStyle = _borderStyle;
				break;
			case XFPropType.LeftBorder:
				format.LeftBorderColorInfo = borderColor;
				format.LeftBorderStyle = _borderStyle;
				break;
			case XFPropType.RightBorder:
				format.RightBorderColorInfo = borderColor;
				format.RightBorderStyle = _borderStyle;
				break;
			case XFPropType.TopBorder:
				format.TopBorderColorInfo = borderColor;
				format.TopBorderStyle = _borderStyle;
				break;
			case XFPropType.VerticalBorder:
			case XFPropType.HorizontalBorder:
				break;
			}
		}

		public abstract WorkbookColorInfo GetBorderColor(Workbook workbook);
	}
	internal class XFPropBorder : XFPropBorderBase
	{
		private WorkbookColorInfo _borderColor;

		public XFPropBorder(XFPropType type, WorkbookColorInfo borderColor, CellBorderLineStyle borderStyle)
			: base(type, borderStyle)

			_borderColor = borderColor;
		}

		public override WorkbookColorInfo GetBorderColor(Workbook workbook)

	}

	internal abstract class XFPropColorBase : XFProp
	{
		public override void ApplyTo(Workbook workbook, WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			switch (Type)
			{
			case XFPropType.FontColor:
				format.Font.ColorInfo = GetColor(workbook);
				break;
			case XFPropType.ForegroundColor:
			case XFPropType.BackgroundColor:
			case XFPropType.GradientFill:
			case XFPropType.GradientStop:
				break;
			}
		}

	internal class CurrentWorkbookReference : WorkbookReferenceBase
	{
		private string lastAccessedWorksheetName;

		private WorksheetReferenceLocal lastAccessedWorksheetReference;

		public override string FileName => base.TargetWorkbook.LoadingPath;

		public override bool IsExternal => false;

		protected override FormulaType NamedReferenceFormulaType => FormulaType.NamedReferenceFormula;

		internal override object WorkbookScope => base.TargetWorkbook;

		public CurrentWorkbookReference(Workbook targetWorkbook)
			: base(targetWorkbook)
		{
		}

		public override NamedReferenceBase CreateNamedReference(string name, object scope)
		{
			NamedReferenceBase namedReferenceBase = null;
			if (scope == base.TargetWorkbook)
			{
				namedReferenceBase = base.TargetWorkbook.GetWorkbookScopedNamedItem(name);
			}
			else if (scope is Worksheet worksheetScope)
			{
				namedReferenceBase = base.TargetWorkbook.NamedReferences.Find(name, worksheetScope);
			}
			if (namedReferenceBase != null)
			{
				return namedReferenceBase;
			}
			return new NamedReferenceUnconnected(name, scope, hidden: false, base.TargetWorkbook.CurrentFormat);
		}

		public override WorksheetReferenceSingle CreateWorksheetReference(int worksheetIndex)
		{
			switch (worksheetIndex)
			{
			case -1:
				return new WorksheetReferenceError(this);
			case -2:
				return new WorksheetReferenceToWorkbook(this);
			default:
			{
				WorksheetCollection worksheets = base.TargetWorkbook.Worksheets;
				if (worksheets.Count <= worksheetIndex)
				{
					return new WorksheetReferenceError(this);
				}
				return new WorksheetReferenceLocal(this, worksheets[worksheetIndex]);
			}
			}
		}

		public override string GetWorksheetName(int worksheetIndex)
		{
			switch (worksheetIndex)
			{
			case -1:
				return "#REF!";
			case -2:
				return null;
			default:
			{
				WorksheetCollection worksheets = base.TargetWorkbook.Worksheets;
				if (worksheets.Count <= worksheetIndex)
				{
					return GetIndexBasedWorksheetName(worksheetIndex);
				}
				return worksheets[worksheetIndex].Name;
			}
			}
		}

		public override WorksheetReferenceSingle GetWorksheetReference(string worksheetName)
		{
			WorksheetReferenceSingle worksheetReferenceHelper;
			if (lastAccessedWorksheetName != worksheetName || lastAccessedWorksheetReference == null || lastAccessedWorksheetReference.Worksheet.Workbook == null || lastAccessedWorksheetReference.Name != worksheetName)
			{
				lastAccessedWorksheetName = worksheetName;
				worksheetReferenceHelper = GetWorksheetReferenceHelper(worksheetName);
				lastAccessedWorksheetReference = worksheetReferenceHelper as WorksheetReferenceLocal;
			}
			else
			{
				worksheetReferenceHelper = lastAccessedWorksheetReference;
			}
			return worksheetReferenceHelper;
		}

		public WorksheetReferenceSingle GetWorksheetReferenceHelper(string worksheetName)
		{
			if (worksheetName == null)
			{
				return GetWorksheetReference(-2);
			}
			CultureInfo cultureResolved = base.TargetWorkbook.CultureResolved;
			if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(worksheetName, "#REF!", cultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return GetWorksheetReference(-1);
			}
			WorksheetCollection worksheets = base.TargetWorkbook.Worksheets;
			for (int i = 0; i < worksheets.Count; i++)
			{
				Worksheet worksheet = worksheets[i];
				if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(worksheet.Name, worksheetName, cultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return GetWorksheetReference(i);
				}
			}
			return GetWorksheetReference(-1);
		}

		public override string GetWorksheetReferenceString(int firstWorksheetIndex, int lastWorksheetIndex, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, bool forceIncludeScopeName)
		{
			string workbookFilePath = null;
			if (forceIncludeScopeName)
			{
				workbookFilePath = GetResolvedFileName(getFormulaStringInfo, out var _);
			}
			if (firstWorksheetIndex == lastWorksheetIndex)
			{
				return Utilities.CreateReferenceString(workbookFilePath, GetWorksheetName(firstWorksheetIndex));
			}
			return Utilities.CreateReferenceString(workbookFilePath, GetWorksheetName(firstWorksheetIndex), GetWorksheetName(lastWorksheetIndex));
		}

		public void AddNamedReference(NamedReference namedReference)
		{
			Dictionary<object, NamedReferenceBase> scopeDictionary = GetScopeDictionary(namedReference.Name);
			scopeDictionary[namedReference.Scope] = namedReference;
			base.NamedReferencesOrdered.Add(namedReference);
		}

		private string GetIndexBasedWorksheetName(int worksheetIndex)
		{
			return "?" + worksheetIndex;
		}

		public void UpdateWorksheetReference(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Documents.Excel.Serialization.Excel2007

	internal class AlignmentInfo
	{
		internal const HorizontalCellAlignment DEFAULT_HORIZONTAL = HorizontalCellAlignment.General;

		internal const int DEFAULT_INDENT = 0;

		internal const bool DEFAULT_JUSTIFYLASTLINE = false;

		internal const int DEFAULT_READINGORDER = 0;

		internal const int DEFAULT_RELATIVEINDENT = 0;

		internal const bool DEFAULT_SHRINKTOFIT = false;

		internal const int DEFAULT_TEXTROTATION = 0;

		internal const VerticalCellAlignment DEFAULT_VERTICAL = VerticalCellAlignment.Bottom;

		internal const bool DEFAULT_WRAPTEXT = false;

		public static readonly AlignmentInfo Default = new AlignmentInfo();

		private HorizontalCellAlignment horizontal;

		private uint? indent;

		private bool justifyLastLine;

		private uint? readingOrder;

		private int? relativeIndent;

		private bool shrinkToFit;

		private uint? textRotation;

		private VerticalCellAlignment vertical = VerticalCellAlignment.Bottom;

		private bool wrapText;

		public HorizontalCellAlignment Horizontal
		{
			get
			{
				return horizontal;
			}
			set
			{
				horizontal = value;
			}
		}

		public uint? Indent
		{
			get
			{
				return indent;
			}
			set
			{
				indent = value;
			}
		}

		public bool JustifyLastLine
		{
			get
			{
				return justifyLastLine;
			}
			set
			{
				justifyLastLine = value;
			}
		}

		public uint? ReadingOrder
		{
			get
			{
				return readingOrder;
			}
			set
			{
				readingOrder = value;
			}
		}

		public int? RelativeIndent
		{
			get
			{
				return relativeIndent;
			}
			set
			{
				relativeIndent = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShrinkToFit
		{
			get
			{
				return shrinkToFit;
			}
			set
			{
				shrinkToFit = value;
			}
		}

		public uint? TextRotation
		{
			get
			{
				return textRotation;
			}
			set
			{
				textRotation = value;
			}
		}

		public VerticalCellAlignment Vertical
		{
			get
			{
				return vertical;
			}
			set
			{
				vertical = value;
			}
		}

		public bool WrapText
		{
			get
			{
				return wrapText;
			}
			set
			{
				wrapText = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (horizontal == HorizontalCellAlignment.General && !indent.HasValue && !justifyLastLine && !readingOrder.HasValue && !relativeIndent.HasValue && !shrinkToFit && !textRotation.HasValue && vertical == VerticalCellAlignment.Bottom)
				{
					return !wrapText;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public AlignmentInfo()
		{
		}

		private AlignmentInfo(HorizontalCellAlignment HorizontalAlignment, uint? Indent, bool JustifyLastLine, uint? ReadingOrder, int? RelativeIndent, uint? TextRotation, ExcelDefaultableBoolean ShrinkToFit, VerticalCellAlignment VerticalAlignment, ExcelDefaultableBoolean WrapText)
		{
			horizontal = HorizontalAlignment;
			indent = Indent;
			justifyLastLine = JustifyLastLine;
			readingOrder = ReadingOrder;
			relativeIndent = RelativeIndent;
			shrinkToFit = ShrinkToFit == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True;
			textRotation = TextRotation;
			vertical = VerticalAlignment;
			wrapText = WrapText == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return HasSameData(this, obj as AlignmentInfo);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num ^= (int)horizontal;
			num ^= (int)(indent.Value << 1);
			num ^= Convert.ToInt32(justifyLastLine) << 2;
			num ^= (int)(readingOrder.Value << 3);
			num ^= relativeIndent.Value << 4;
			num ^= Convert.ToInt32(shrinkToFit) << 5;
			num ^= (int)(textRotation.Value << 6);
			num ^= (int)vertical << 7;
			return num ^ (Convert.ToInt32(wrapText) << 8);
		}

		internal void ApplyTo(WorksheetCellFormatData formatData, bool forceApply = true)
		{
			formatData.AddIndent = JustifyLastLine;
			if (forceApply || formatData.AlignmentResolved != Horizontal)
			{
				formatData.Alignment = Horizontal;
			}
			int num = (int)(TextRotation ?? 0);
			if (forceApply || formatData.RotationResolved != num)
			{
				formatData.Rotation = num;
			}
			ExcelDefaultableBoolean excelDefaultableBoolean = WrapText.ToExcelDefaultableBoolean();
			if (forceApply || formatData.WrapTextResolved != excelDefaultableBoolean)
			{
				formatData.WrapText = excelDefaultableBoolean;
			}
			if (forceApply || formatData.VerticalAlignmentResolved != Vertical)
			{
				formatData.VerticalAlignment = Vertical;
			}
			int num2 = (int)(Indent ?? 0);
			if (forceApply || formatData.IndentResolved != num2)
			{
				formatData.Indent = num2;
			}
			ExcelDefaultableBoolean excelDefaultableBoolean2 = ShrinkToFit.ToExcelDefaultableBoolean();
			if (forceApply || formatData.ShrinkToFitResolved != excelDefaultableBoolean2)
			{
				formatData.ShrinkToFit = excelDefaultableBoolean2;
			}
		}

		public static AlignmentInfo CreateAlignmentInfo(WorksheetCellFormatData formatData)
		{
			return CreateAlignmentInfo(formatData, forceCreate: false);
		}

		public static AlignmentInfo CreateAlignmentInfo(WorksheetCellFormatData formatData, bool forceCreate)
		{
			bool addIndent = formatData.AddIndent;
			HorizontalCellAlignment alignmentResolved = formatData.AlignmentResolved;
			uint? num = (uint)formatData.IndentResolved;
			uint? num2 = (uint)formatData.RotationResolved;
			ExcelDefaultableBoolean shrinkToFitResolved = formatData.ShrinkToFitResolved;
			VerticalCellAlignment verticalAlignmentResolved = formatData.VerticalAlignmentResolved;
			ExcelDefaultableBoolean wrapTextResolved = formatData.WrapTextResolved;
			if (!forceCreate && !addIndent && alignmentResolved == HorizontalCellAlignment.General)
			{
				uint? num3 = num;
				if (num3.GetValueOrDefault() == 0 && num3.HasValue)
				{
					uint? num4 = num2;
					if (num4.GetValueOrDefault() == 0 && num4.HasValue && shrinkToFitResolved == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False && wrapTextResolved == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False && verticalAlignmentResolved == VerticalCellAlignment.Bottom)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
			}
			return new AlignmentInfo(alignmentResolved, num, addIndent, 0u, 0, num2, shrinkToFitResolved, verticalAlignmentResolved, wrapTextResolved);
		}

		internal static bool HasSameData(AlignmentInfo align1, AlignmentInfo align2)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(align1, null) && object.ReferenceEquals(align2, null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(align1, null) || object.ReferenceEquals(align2, null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (align1.horizontal == align2.horizontal)
			{
				uint? num = align1.indent;
				uint? num2 = align2.indent;
				if (num.GetValueOrDefault() == num2.GetValueOrDefault() && num.HasValue == num2.HasValue && align1.justifyLastLine == align2.justifyLastLine && align1.readingOrder == align2.readingOrder)
				{
					int? num3 = align1.relativeIndent;
					int? num4 = align2.relativeIndent;
					if (num3.GetValueOrDefault() == num4.GetValueOrDefault() && num3.HasValue == num4.HasValue && align1.shrinkToFit == align2.shrinkToFit)
					{
						uint? num5 = align1.textRotation;
						uint? num6 = align2.textRotation;
						if (num5.GetValueOrDefault() == num6.GetValueOrDefault() && num5.HasValue == num6.HasValue && align1.vertical == align2.vertical)
						{
							return align1.wrapText == align2.wrapText;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class BorderInfo
	{
		private BorderStyleInfo left = new BorderStyleInfo();

		private BorderStyleInfo right = new BorderStyleInfo();

		private BorderStyleInfo top = new BorderStyleInfo();

		private BorderStyleInfo bottom = new BorderStyleInfo();

		private BorderStyleInfo diagonal = new BorderStyleInfo();

		private BorderStyleInfo horizontal = new BorderStyleInfo();

		private BorderStyleInfo vertical = new BorderStyleInfo();

		private bool diagonalDown;

		private bool diagonalUp;

		private bool outline;

		public BorderStyleInfo Left => left;

		public BorderStyleInfo Right => right;

		public BorderStyleInfo Top => top;

		public BorderStyleInfo Bottom => bottom;

		public BorderStyleInfo Diagonal => diagonal;

		public BorderStyleInfo Horizontal => horizontal;

		public BorderStyleInfo Vertical => vertical;

		public bool DiagonalDown
		{
			get
			{
				return diagonalDown;
			}
			set
			{
				diagonalDown = value;
			}
		}

		public bool DiagonalUp
		{
			get
			{
				return diagonalUp;
			}
			set
			{
				diagonalUp = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Outline
		{
			get
			{
				return outline;
			}
			set
			{
				outline = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is BorderInfo borderInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (diagonalDown == borderInfo.diagonalDown && diagonalUp == borderInfo.diagonalUp && outline == borderInfo.outline && object.Equals(bottom, borderInfo.bottom) && object.Equals(diagonal, borderInfo.diagonal) && object.Equals(horizontal, borderInfo.horizontal) && object.Equals(left, borderInfo.left) && object.Equals(right, borderInfo.right) && object.Equals(top, borderInfo.top))
			{
				return object.Equals(vertical, borderInfo.vertical);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = diagonalDown.GetHashCode() ^ diagonalUp.GetHashCode() ^ outline.GetHashCode();
			if (bottom != null)
			{
				num ^= bottom.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (diagonal != null)
			{
				num ^= diagonal.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (horizontal != null)
			{
				num ^= horizontal.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (left != null)
			{
				num ^= left.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (right != null)
			{
				num ^= right.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (top != null)
			{
				num ^= top.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (vertical != null)
			{
				num ^= vertical.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void ApplyTo(WorksheetCellFormatData formatData, WorkbookLoadManager loadManager)
		{
			if (Bottom != null && !Bottom.IsDefault)
			{
				formatData.BottomBorderColorInfo = Bottom.ColorInfo.ResolveColorInfo(loadManager);
				formatData.BottomBorderStyle = Bottom.BorderStyle;
			}
			if (Top != null && !Top.IsDefault)
			{
				formatData.TopBorderColorInfo = Top.ColorInfo.ResolveColorInfo(loadManager);
				formatData.TopBorderStyle = Top.BorderStyle;
			}
			if (Left != null && !Left.IsDefault)
			{
				formatData.LeftBorderColorInfo = Left.ColorInfo.ResolveColorInfo(loadManager);
				formatData.LeftBorderStyle = Left.BorderStyle;
			}
			if (Right != null && !Right.IsDefault)
			{
				formatData.RightBorderColorInfo = Right.ColorInfo.ResolveColorInfo(loadManager);
				formatData.RightBorderStyle = Right.BorderStyle;
			}
			if (Diagonal != null && !Diagonal.IsDefault)
			{
				formatData.DiagonalBorderColorInfo = Diagonal.ColorInfo.ResolveColorInfo(loadManager);
				formatData.DiagonalBorderStyle = Diagonal.BorderStyle;
			}
			DiagonalBorders diagonalBorders = DiagonalBorders.None;
			if (DiagonalDown)
			{
				diagonalBorders |= DiagonalBorders.DiagonalDown;
			}
			if (DiagonalUp)
			{
				diagonalBorders |= DiagonalBorders.DiagonalUp;
			}
			formatData.DiagonalBorders = diagonalBorders;
		}

		public static BorderInfo CreateBorderInfo(WorkbookSaveManager saveManager, WorksheetCellFormatData formatData)
		{
			BorderInfo borderInfo = new BorderInfo();
			CreateBorderInfoHelper(saveManager, borderInfo.Bottom, formatData.BottomBorderStyleResolved, formatData.BottomBorderColorInfo, formatData.BottomBorderColorInfoResolved);
			CreateBorderInfoHelper(saveManager, borderInfo.Top, formatData.TopBorderStyleResolved, formatData.TopBorderColorInfo, formatData.TopBorderColorInfoResolved);
			CreateBorderInfoHelper(saveManager, borderInfo.Left, formatData.LeftBorderStyleResolved, formatData.LeftBorderColorInfo, formatData.LeftBorderColorInfoResolved);
			CreateBorderInfoHelper(saveManager, borderInfo.Right, formatData.RightBorderStyleResolved, formatData.RightBorderColorInfo, formatData.RightBorderColorInfoResolved);
			CreateBorderInfoHelper(saveManager, borderInfo.Diagonal, formatData.DiagonalBorderStyleResolved, formatData.DiagonalBorderColorInfo, formatData.DiagonalBorderColorInfoResolved);
			DiagonalBorders diagonalBordersResolved = formatData.DiagonalBordersResolved;
			if (Utilities.IsDiagonalDownSet(diagonalBordersResolved))
			{
				borderInfo.DiagonalDown = true;
			}
			if (Utilities.IsDiagonalUpSet(diagonalBordersResolved))
			{
				borderInfo.DiagonalUp = true;
			}
			return borderInfo;
		}

		private static void CreateBorderInfoHelper(WorkbookSaveManager saveManager, BorderStyleInfo borderStyleInfo, CellBorderLineStyle borderLineStyle, WorkbookColorInfo borderColorInfo, WorkbookColorInfo borderColorInfoResolved)
		{
			WorkbookColorInfo workbookColorInfo = ((borderLineStyle == CellBorderLineStyle.None) ? borderColorInfo : borderColorInfoResolved);
			borderStyleInfo.BorderStyle = borderLineStyle;
			borderStyleInfo.ColorInfo = ColorInfo.CreateColorInfo(saveManager, workbookColorInfo, ColorableItem.CellBorder);
		}
	}

	internal class ColorInfo
	{
		private static readonly ColorInfo Empty = new ColorInfo();

		public bool? Auto { get; set; }

		public uint? Indexed { get; set; }

		public ST_UnsignedIntHex? RGB { get; set; }

		public uint? Theme { get; set; }

		public double Tint { get; set; }

		public bool IsDefault => Equals(Empty);

		public WorkbookFontData FontDataObject { get; set; }

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj is ColorInfo colorInfo && Auto == colorInfo.Auto)
			{
				uint? indexed = Indexed;
				uint? indexed2 = colorInfo.Indexed;
				if (indexed.GetValueOrDefault() == indexed2.GetValueOrDefault() && indexed.HasValue == indexed2.HasValue && RGB.Equals(colorInfo.RGB) && Theme == colorInfo.Theme)
				{
					return Tint == colorInfo.Tint;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Auto.GetHashCode() ^ Indexed.GetHashCode() ^ RGB.GetHashCode() ^ Theme.GetHashCode() ^ Tint.GetHashCode();
		}

		public static ColorInfo CreateColorInfo(WorkbookSaveManager saveManager, WorkbookColorInfo workbookColorInfo, ColorableItem item)
		{
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ColorInfo colorInfo = new ColorInfo();
			if (workbookColorInfo != null)
			{
				if (workbookColorInfo.IsAutomatic)
				{
					colorInfo.Auto = true;
				}
				if (workbookColorInfo.Color.HasValue)
				{
					Color value = workbookColorInfo.Color.Value;
					if (Utilities.ColorIsSystem(value))
					{
						colorInfo.Indexed = (uint)saveManager.Workbook.Palette.FindIndex(workbookColorInfo, item);
					}
					else
					{
						colorInfo.RGB = ST_UnsignedIntHex.op_Implicit((uint)Utilities.ColorToArgb(value));
					}
				}
				if (workbookColorInfo.ThemeColorType.HasValue)
				{
					colorInfo.Theme = (uint)workbookColorInfo.ThemeColorType.Value;
				}
				if (workbookColorInfo.Tint.HasValue)
				{
					colorInfo.Tint = workbookColorInfo.Tint.Value;
				}
			}
			return colorInfo;
		}

		internal WorkbookColorInfo ResolveColorInfo(WorkbookLoadManager loadManager)
		{
			//IL_0128: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_014c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsDefault)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (Auto == true)
			{
				return WorkbookColorInfo.Automatic;
			}
			double? tint = null;
			if (Tint != 0.0)
			{
				tint = Tint;
			}
			if (loadManager == null)
			{
				return WorkbookColorInfo.Automatic;
			}
			if (Theme.HasValue && Theme < loadManager.Workbook.ThemeColors.Length)
			{
				return new WorkbookColorInfo(null, (WorkbookThemeColorType)Theme.Value, tint, isLoading: true);
			}
			if (Indexed.HasValue)
			{
				return new WorkbookColorInfo(loadManager.Workbook.Palette.GetColorAtAbsoluteIndex((int)Indexed.Value), null, tint, isLoading: true);
			}
			ST_UnsignedIntHex? rGB = RGB;
			if ((rGB.HasValue ? new uint?(ST_UnsignedIntHex.op_Implicit(rGB.GetValueOrDefault())) : ((uint?)null)).HasValue)
			{
				if ((ST_UnsignedIntHex.op_Implicit(RGB.Value) & 0xFF000000u) == 4278190080u)
				{
					return new WorkbookColorInfo(Utilities.ColorFromArgb((int)ST_UnsignedIntHex.op_Implicit(RGB.Value)), null, tint, isLoading: true);
				}
				return null;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class DxfInfo
	{
		public AlignmentInfo Alignment { get; set; }

		public BorderInfo Border { get; set; }

		public FillInfo Fill { get; set; }

		public IWorkbookFont Font { get; set; }

		public ColorInfo FontColorInfo { get; set; }

		public SerializationNumberFormatInfo NumberFormat { get; set; }

		public ProtectionInfo Protection { get; set; }

		public DxfInfo()
		{
		}

		public DxfInfo(WorkbookSaveManager saveManager, WorksheetCellFormatData formatData)
		{
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatData.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting))
			{
				Alignment = AlignmentInfo.CreateAlignmentInfo(formatData, forceCreate: true);
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatData.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting))
			{
				Border = BorderInfo.CreateBorderInfo(saveManager, formatData);
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatData.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting))
			{
				Fill = FillInfo.CreateFillInfo(saveManager, formatData);
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatData.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting))
			{
				NumberFormat = SerializationNumberFormatInfo.CreateNumberFormatInfo(formatData);
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatData.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting))
			{
				Protection = ProtectionInfo.CreateProtectionInfo(formatData, forceCreate: true);
			}
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(formatData.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting))
			{
				Font = formatData.FontInternal.Element.ResolvedFontData(formatData);
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetCellFormatData ToCellFormat(WorkbookLoadManager loadManager)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = loadManager.Workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat);
			if (Alignment != null)
			{
				Alignment.ApplyTo(worksheetCellFormatData);
			}
			if (Border != null)
			{
				Border.ApplyTo(worksheetCellFormatData, loadManager);
			}
			if (Fill != null)
			{
				Fill.ApplyTo(worksheetCellFormatData, loadManager);
			}
			if (Font != null)
			{
				worksheetCellFormatData.Font.SetFontFormatting(Font);
			}
			if (FontColorInfo != null)
			{
				worksheetCellFormatData.Font.ColorInfo = FontColorInfo.ResolveColorInfo(loadManager);
			}
			if (NumberFormat != null)
			{
				NumberFormat.ApplyTo(worksheetCellFormatData);
			}
			if (Protection != null)
			{
				Protection.ApplyTo(worksheetCellFormatData);
			}
			return worksheetCellFormatData;
		}
	}

			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;

			if (object.Equals(patternFillInfo, fillInfo.patternFillInfo))

		internal WorksheetCellFormatData CreateWorksheetCellFormatData(WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2007 loadManager, bool isStyleFormat, bool forceApplyProperties)
		{
			Workbook workbook = loadManager.Workbook;
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(isStyleFormat ? WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat : WorksheetCellFormatType.CellFormat);
			WorksheetCellFormatOptions worksheetCellFormatOptions = FormatOptions;
			bool flag = Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting);
			bool flag2 = Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting);
			bool flag3 = Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting);
			bool flag4 = Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting);
			bool flag5 = Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting);
			bool flag6 = Utilities.TestFlag(worksheetCellFormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting);
			if (worksheetCellFormatData.Type != WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat)
			{
				int num = (int)(CellStyleXfId ?? 0);
				FormatInfo formatInfo = loadManager.CellStyleXfs[num];
				if (!loadManager.StylesByCellStyleXfId.TryGetValue(num, out var value))
				{
					int num2 = 1;
					string name;
					do
					{
						name = $"Style {num2++}";
					}
					while (workbook.Styles[name] != null);
					value = workbook.Styles.AddUserDefinedStyle(formatInfo.FormatDataObject, name);
					loadManager.StylesByCellStyleXfId.Add(num, value);
				}
				worksheetCellFormatData.Style = value;
				if (!flag && !object.Equals(Alignment, formatInfo.Alignment))
				{
					flag = true;
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting;
				}
				if (!flag2 && BorderId.HasValue && BorderId != formatInfo.BorderId)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting;
				}
				if (!flag3 && FillId.HasValue && FillId != formatInfo.FillId)
				{
					flag3 = true;
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFillFormatting;
				}
				if (!flag4 && FontId.HasValue && FontId != formatInfo.FontId)
				{
					flag4 = true;
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting;
				}
				if (!flag5 && numFmtId.HasValue && numFmtId != formatInfo.numFmtId)
				{
					flag5 = true;
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting;
				}
				if (!flag6 && !object.Equals(Protection, formatInfo.Protection))
				{
					flag6 = true;
					worksheetCellFormatOptions |= WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting;
				}
			}
			worksheetCellFormatData.FormatOptions = worksheetCellFormatOptions;
			if ((flag4 || forceApplyProperties) && FontId.HasValue && FontId.Value < loadManager.Fonts.Count)
			{
				WorkbookFontData fontFormatting = loadManager.Fonts[(int)FontId.Value].ResolvedFontData(worksheetCellFormatData);
				worksheetCellFormatData.Font.SetFontFormatting(fontFormatting);
			}
			if ((flag5 || forceApplyProperties) && NumFmtId.HasValue)
			{
				worksheetCellFormatData.FormatString = workbook.Formats[(int)NumFmtId.Value];
			}
			if ((flag6 || forceApplyProperties) && Protection != null)
			{
				Protection.ApplyTo(worksheetCellFormatData);
			}
			if (flag || forceApplyProperties)
			{
				if (Alignment != null)
				{
					Alignment.ApplyTo(worksheetCellFormatData);
				}
				else
				{
					AlignmentInfo.Default.ApplyTo(worksheetCellFormatData, forceApply: false);
				}
			}
			if ((flag2 || forceApplyProperties) && BorderId.HasValue && BorderId.Value < loadManager.Borders.Count)
			{
				BorderInfo borderInfo = loadManager.Borders[(int)BorderId.Value];
				borderInfo.ApplyTo(worksheetCellFormatData, loadManager);
			}
			if ((flag3 || forceApplyProperties) && FillId.HasValue && FillId.Value < loadManager.Fills.Count)
			{
				FillInfo fillInfo = loadManager.Fills[(int)FillId.Value];
				fillInfo.ApplyTo(worksheetCellFormatData, loadManager);
			}
			worksheetCellFormatData.SetFormatOptionsInternal(worksheetCellFormatOptions);
			return worksheetCellFormatData;
		}
	}
	internal class GradientFillInfo
	{
		public const double DefaultValueBottom = 0.0;

		public const double DefaultValueTop = 0.0;

		public const double DefaultValueRight = 0.0;

		public const double DefaultValueLeft = 0.0;

		public const double DefaultValueDegree = 0.0;

		public const ST_GradientType DefaultFillType = (ST_GradientType)0;

		private List<StopInfo> stops = new List<StopInfo>();

		private double bottom;

		private double top;

		private double right;

		private double left;

		private double degree;

		private ST_GradientType fillType;

		{
			get

				return degree;

				degree = value;

		public ST_GradientType FillType
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return fillType;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				fillType = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is GradientFillInfo gradientFillInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (bottom != gradientFillInfo.bottom || degree != gradientFillInfo.degree || fillType != gradientFillInfo.fillType || left != gradientFillInfo.left || right != gradientFillInfo.right || top != gradientFillInfo.top || stops.Count != gradientFillInfo.stops.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < stops.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(stops[i], gradientFillInfo.stops[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = bottom.GetHashCode() ^ top.GetHashCode() ^ right.GetHashCode() ^ left.GetHashCode() ^ degree.GetHashCode() ^ ((object)fillType).GetHashCode() ^ stops.Count;
			if (stops.Count != 0)
			{
				num ^= stops[0].GetHashCode();
				num ^= stops[stops.Count - 1].GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static GradientFillInfo CreateGradientFillInfo(WorkbookSaveManager saveManager, CellFillGradient gradientFill)
		{
			GradientFillInfo gradientFillInfo = new GradientFillInfo();
			for (int i = 0; i < gradientFill.Stops.Count; i++)
			{
				gradientFillInfo.Stops.Add(StopInfo.CreateStopInfo(saveManager, gradientFill.Stops[i]));
			}
			CellFillLinearGradient cellFillLinearGradient = gradientFill as CellFillLinearGradient;
			CellFillRectangularGradient cellFillRectangularGradient = gradientFill as CellFillRectangularGradient;
			if (cellFillLinearGradient != null)
			{
				gradientFillInfo.FillType = (ST_GradientType)0;
				gradientFillInfo.Degree = cellFillLinearGradient.Angle;
			}
			else if (cellFillRectangularGradient != null)
			{
				gradientFillInfo.FillType = (ST_GradientType)1;
				gradientFillInfo.Bottom = cellFillRectangularGradient.Bottom;
				gradientFillInfo.Left = cellFillRectangularGradient.Left;
				gradientFillInfo.Right = cellFillRectangularGradient.Right;
				gradientFillInfo.Top = cellFillRectangularGradient.Top;
			}
			return gradientFillInfo;
		}

		internal CellFill ToCellFill(WorkbookLoadManager loadManager)
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			CellFillGradientStop[] array = new CellFillGradientStop[Stops.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = Stops[i].ToCellFillGradientStop(loadManager);
			}
			ST_GradientType val = FillType;
			return (int)val switch
			{
				0 => CellFill.CreateLinearGradientFill(Degree, array), 
				1 => CellFill.CreateRectangularGradientFill(Left, Top, Right, Bottom, array), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}

		public void InitializeAnchorData(WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			_shape = shape;
			Worksheet worksheet = shape.Worksheet;
			if (shape.TopLeftCornerCell.Worksheet != null && shape.BottomRightCornerCell.Worksheet != null)
			{
				_anchorData[0] = shape.TopLeftCornerCell.ColumnIndex;
				_anchorData[2] = shape.TopLeftCornerCell.RowIndex;
				_anchorData[4] = shape.BottomRightCornerCell.ColumnIndex;
				_anchorData[6] = shape.BottomRightCornerCell.RowIndex;
				double columnWidthInPixels = worksheet.GetColumnWidthInPixels(shape.TopLeftCornerCell.ColumnIndex);
				double value = columnWidthInPixels * (double)shape.TopLeftCornerPosition.X / 100.0;
				_anchorData[1] = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value);
				double rowHeightInPixels = worksheet.GetRowHeightInPixels(shape.TopLeftCornerCell.RowIndex);
				double value2 = rowHeightInPixels * (double)shape.TopLeftCornerPosition.Y / 100.0;
				_anchorData[3] = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value2);
				double columnWidthInPixels2 = worksheet.GetColumnWidthInPixels(shape.BottomRightCornerCell.ColumnIndex);
				double value3 = columnWidthInPixels2 * (double)shape.BottomRightCornerPosition.X / 100.0;
				_anchorData[5] = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value3);
				double rowHeightInPixels2 = worksheet.GetRowHeightInPixels(shape.BottomRightCornerCell.RowIndex);
				double value4 = rowHeightInPixels2 * (double)shape.BottomRightCornerPosition.Y / 100.0;
				_anchorData[7] = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value4);
			}
		}

	internal class PatternFillInfo
	{
		private ColorInfo bgColor;

		private ColorInfo fgColor;

		private FillPatternStyle? patternStyle;

		public ColorInfo BackgroundColor
		{
			get
			{
				return bgColor;
			}
			set
			{
				bgColor = value;
			}
		}

		public ColorInfo ForegroundColor
		{
			get
			{
				return fgColor;
			}
			set
			{
				fgColor = value;
			}
		}

		public FillPatternStyle? PatternStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return patternStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				patternStyle = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is PatternFillInfo patternFillInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FillPatternStyle? fillPatternStyle = patternStyle;
			FillPatternStyle? fillPatternStyle2 = patternFillInfo.patternStyle;
			if (fillPatternStyle.GetValueOrDefault() == fillPatternStyle2.GetValueOrDefault() && fillPatternStyle.HasValue == fillPatternStyle2.HasValue && object.Equals(bgColor, patternFillInfo.bgColor))
			{
				return object.Equals(fgColor, patternFillInfo.fgColor);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = patternStyle.GetHashCode();
			if (bgColor != null)
			{
				num ^= bgColor.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (fgColor != null)
			{
				num ^= fgColor.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static PatternFillInfo CreatePatternFillInfo(WorkbookSaveManager saveManager, WorksheetCellFormatData formatData, CellFillPattern patternFill)
		{
			PatternFillInfo patternFillInfo = new PatternFillInfo();
			patternFillInfo.PatternStyle = patternFill.PatternStyle;
			if (patternFill.PatternStyle == FillPatternStyle.None)
			{
				return patternFillInfo;
			}
			WorkbookColorInfo fileFormatForegroundColorInfo = patternFill.GetFileFormatForegroundColorInfo(formatData);
			if (fileFormatForegroundColorInfo != WorkbookColorInfo.Automatic)
			{
				patternFillInfo.ForegroundColor = ColorInfo.CreateColorInfo(saveManager, fileFormatForegroundColorInfo, ColorableItem.CellFill);
			}
			WorkbookColorInfo fileFormatBackgroundColorInfo = patternFill.GetFileFormatBackgroundColorInfo(formatData);
			if (fileFormatBackgroundColorInfo != new WorkbookColorInfo(SystemColorsInternal.WindowColor))
			{
				patternFillInfo.BackgroundColor = ColorInfo.CreateColorInfo(saveManager, fileFormatBackgroundColorInfo, ColorableItem.CellFill);
			}
			return patternFillInfo;
		}

		internal CellFillPattern ToCellFill(WorkbookLoadManager loadManager, WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			FillPatternStyle fillPatternStyle = FillPatternStyle.None;
			WorkbookColorInfo backgroundColorInfo = new WorkbookColorInfo(SystemColorsInternal.WindowColor);
			if (BackgroundColor != null)
			{
				fillPatternStyle = FillPatternStyle.Solid;
				backgroundColorInfo = BackgroundColor.ResolveColorInfo(loadManager);
			}
			WorkbookColorInfo patternColorInfo = WorkbookColorInfo.Automatic;
			if (ForegroundColor != null)
			{
				fillPatternStyle = FillPatternStyle.Solid;
				patternColorInfo = ForegroundColor.ResolveColorInfo(loadManager);
			}
			if (PatternStyle.HasValue)
			{
				fillPatternStyle = PatternStyle.Value;
			}
			return new CellFillPattern(backgroundColorInfo, patternColorInfo, fillPatternStyle, format, isCreatedInternally: true);
		}
	}
	internal class ProtectionInfo
	{
		private bool? hidden;

		private bool? locked;

		public bool? Hidden
		{
			get
			{
				return hidden;
			}
			set
			{
				hidden = value;
			}
		}

		public bool? Locked
		{
			get
			{
				return locked;
			}
			set
			{
				locked = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (!hidden.HasValue)
				{
					return !locked.HasValue;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return HasSameData(this, obj as ProtectionInfo);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num ^= Convert.ToInt32(hidden);
			return num ^ (Convert.ToInt32(locked) << 1);
		}

		internal void ApplyTo(WorksheetCellFormatData formatData)
		{
			formatData.Locked = Locked.ToExcelDefaultableBoolean();
		}

		public static ProtectionInfo CreateProtectionInfo(WorksheetCellFormatData formatData)
		{
			return CreateProtectionInfo(formatData, forceCreate: false);
		}

		public static ProtectionInfo CreateProtectionInfo(WorksheetCellFormatData formatData, bool forceCreate)
		{
			ExcelDefaultableBoolean lockedResolved = formatData.LockedResolved;
			if (!forceCreate && lockedResolved == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ProtectionInfo protectionInfo = new ProtectionInfo();
			protectionInfo.Locked = lockedResolved == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True;
			return protectionInfo;
		}

		internal static bool HasSameData(ProtectionInfo prot1, ProtectionInfo prot2)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(prot1, null) && object.ReferenceEquals(prot2, null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(prot1, null) || object.ReferenceEquals(prot2, null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (prot1.hidden == prot2.hidden)
			{
				return prot1.locked == prot2.locked;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

			{
				if (workbookBuiltInStyle.OutlineLevel == byte.MaxValue)

		private ObjectModelWorkbookPartManagerBase GetWorkbookPartManager()
		{
			switch (Workbook.CurrentFormat)
			{
			case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007:
			case WorkbookFormat.StrictOpenXml:
				return ObjectModelWorkbookPartManager.Instance;
			case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007MacroEnabled:
				return ObjectModelMacroEnabledWorkbookPartManager.Instance;
			case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007MacroEnabledTemplate:
				return ObjectModelMacroEnabledTemplatePartManager.Instance;
			case WorkbookFormat.Excel2007Template:
				return ObjectModelTemplatePartManager.Instance;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private WorkItem SaveCustomXmlParts()
		{

			if (customXmlParts == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = Math.Min(customXmlPropertiesParts.Count, customXmlParts.Count);
			return Async.For(0, num, 1, (Func<int, WorkItem>)((int i) => (WorkItem)(object)((OfficeDocumentManager)this).CreatePart((PartManagerBase)(object)ObjectModelCustomXmlItemPartManager.Instance, (object)Tuple.Create(customXmlParts[i], customXmlPropertiesParts[i]), (string)null)));
		}

		{

			[ThreadStatic]
			private static DoubleValueCache _instance;

			private readonly Dictionary<string, object> _cache = new Dictionary<string, object>();

			private readonly string[] _cachedSources = new string[512];

			private int _nextSourceIndex;

			public static object Get(string value)
			{
				DoubleValueCache doubleValueCache = _instance ?? (_instance = new DoubleValueCache());
				if (!doubleValueCache._cache.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
				{

					}

				}
				return value2;
			}
		}

		public static WorkbookColorInfo LoadColorInfo(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ReadCT_ColorElementCallback callback)
		{

			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			callback(partManager, out var autoValue, out var indexedValue, out var rgbValue, out var themeValue, out var tintValue);

			}

		}

		public static object LoadVElementHelper(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, short columnIndex)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string text = default(string);
			SpreadsheetMLMain.ReadVElement(partManager, ref text);
			ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager excelDocumentManager = GetExcelDocumentManager(partManager);
			ST_CellType val = partManager.ContextStack.Get<ST_CellType>();
			ST_CellType val2 = val;
			switch ((int)val2)
			{
			case 0:
				return ST_OnOff.op_Implicit(ST_OnOff.Parse(text));
			case 1:
				return DateTime.Parse(text);
			case 3:
				return FormulaParser.ParseError(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case 2:
				if (text == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return text switch
				{
					"0" => KnownBoxes.Double_Zero, 
					"1" => KnownBoxes.Double_One, 
					_ => DoubleValueCache.Get(text), 
				};
			default:
				return text ?? string.Empty;
			case 4:
			{
				if (text == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!int.TryParse(text, out var result))
				{
					return null;
				}
				WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2007 loadManager = excelDocumentManager.LoadManager;
				if (result >= loadManager.SharedStringTable.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				StringElement stringElement = loadManager.SharedStringTable[result];
				if (stringElement is FormattedStringElement { HasFormatting: not false } formattedStringElement)
				{
					return new FormattedString(excelDocumentManager.Workbook, formattedStringElement);
				}
				return stringElement;
			}
			}
		}

		public static void SaveColorInfo(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo, ColorableItem item, Action<XmlPartManagerBase, bool?, uint?, ST_UnsignedIntHex?, uint?, double> saveMethod)
		{
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Workbook workbook = GetExcelDocumentManager(partManager).Workbook;
			bool? arg = null;
			uint? arg2 = null;
			ST_UnsignedIntHex? arg3 = null;
			uint? arg4 = null;
			double arg5 = 0.0;
			if (colorInfo.IsAutomatic)
			{
				arg = true;
			}
			else if (colorInfo.Color.HasValue)
			{
				Color value = colorInfo.Color.Value;
				if (Utilities.ColorIsSystem(value))
				{
					arg2 = (uint)colorInfo.GetIndex(workbook, item);
				}
				else
				{
					arg3 = new ST_UnsignedIntHex((uint)Utilities.ColorToArgb(value));
				}
			}
			else if (colorInfo.ThemeColorType.HasValue)
			{
				arg4 = (uint)colorInfo.ThemeColorType.Value;
			}
			if (colorInfo.Tint.HasValue)
			{
				arg5 = colorInfo.Tint.Value;
			}
			saveMethod(partManager, arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public static void SaveColorInfo(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ColorInfo colorInfo, Action<XmlPartManagerBase, bool?, uint?, ST_UnsignedIntHex?, uint?, double> saveMethod)
		{
			if (colorInfo != null && !colorInfo.IsDefault)
			{
				saveMethod(partManager, colorInfo.Auto, colorInfo.Indexed, colorInfo.RGB, colorInfo.Theme, colorInfo.Tint);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private static void SaveDefinedNameElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, NamedReferenceBase namedReferenceBase)
		{
			string text = namedReferenceBase.Name;
			if (namedReferenceBase is NamedReference namedReference)
			{
				if (namedReference.IsBuiltIn)
				{
					text = "_xlnm." + text;
				}
				uint? num = null;
				if (namedReference.Scope is Worksheet item)
				{
					num = (uint)GetExcelDocumentManager(partManager).SaveManager.Worksheets.IndexOf(item);
				}
				string text2 = null;
				if (namedReference.FormulaInternal != null)
				{
					text2 = GetExcelDocumentManager(partManager).SaveManager.GetSerializableFormula(namedReference.FormulaInternal);
				}
				SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteDefinedNameElement(partManager, text2, text, namedReference.Comment, (string)null, (string)null, (string)null, (string)null, num, namedReference.Hidden, namedReference.IsFunction, false, false, (uint?)null, (string)null, false, false);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
			else
			{
				SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteDefinedNameElement(partManager, namedReferenceBase.Name, (string)null, (uint?)null);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		public static void SaveDefinedNamesElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReference)
		{
			if (workbookReference.NamedReferences.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteDefinedNamesElement(partManager);
			foreach (NamedReferenceBase namedReference in workbookReference.NamedReferences)
			{
				if (namedReference.FormulaInternal != null && namedReference.FormulaInternal.PostfixTokenList.Length != 0)
				{
					partManager.SaveDefinedNameElement(namedReference);
				}
			}
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public static void SaveFontElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, IWorkbookFont font)
		{
			partManager.SaveFontElementHelper(font, (Action<XmlPartManagerBase>)SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteFontElement, (Action<XmlPartManagerBase, string>)SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteNameElement);
		}

		private static void SaveFontElementHelper(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, IWorkbookFont font, Action<XmlPartManagerBase> writeRootElement, Action<XmlPartManagerBase, string> writeFontNameElement)
		{
			//IL_0105: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0132: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0174: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0170: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0175: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0179: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (font != null)
			{
				writeRootElement(partManager);
				FontFamilyInternal fontFamilyInternal = FontFamilyInternal.Swiss;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(font.Name))
				{
					writeFontNameElement(partManager, font.Name);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
					fontFamilyInternal = Utilities.GetFontFamilyInternal(font.Name);
				}
				if (fontFamilyInternal != FontFamilyInternal.DontCare)
				{
					SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteFamilyElement(partManager, (int)fontFamilyInternal);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				if (font.Bold == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True)
				{
					SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteBElement(partManager, true);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				if (font.Italic == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True)
				{
					SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteIElement(partManager, true);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				if (font.Strikeout == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True)
				{
					SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteStrikeElement(partManager, true);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				if (font.ColorInfo != null)
				{
					SaveColorInfo(partManager, font.ColorInfo, ColorableItem.CellFont, (Action<XmlPartManagerBase, bool?, uint?, ST_UnsignedIntHex?, uint?, double>)SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteColorElement);
				}
				SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteSzElement(partManager, (double)font.Height / 20.0);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				if (font.UnderlineStyle != FontUnderlineStyle.None && font.UnderlineStyle != FontUnderlineStyle.Default)
				{
					SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteUElement(partManager, font.UnderlineStyle.ToST_UnderlineValues());
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				if (font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle != FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.None && font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle != FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.Default)
				{
					SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteVertAlignElement(partManager, font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle.ToST_VerticalAlignRun());
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				ST_FontScheme val = ((font.Name == "Calibri") ? ((ST_FontScheme)2) : ((!(font.Name == "Cambria")) ? ((ST_FontScheme)0) : ((ST_FontScheme)1)));
				if ((int)val != 0)
				{
					SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteSchemeElement(partManager, val);
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		public static void SaveFormattedStringElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager, StringElement element, Action<XmlPartManagerBase> writeStartElement)
		{
			writeStartElement(partManager);
			string unformattedString = element.UnformattedString;
			if (element is FormattedStringElement { HasFormatting: not false, FormattingRuns: var formattingRuns })
			{
				int firstFormattedCharAbsolute = formattingRuns[0].FirstFormattedCharAbsolute;
				if (0 < firstFormattedCharAbsolute)
				{
					SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteTElement(partManager, unformattedString.Substring(0, firstFormattedCharAbsolute));
					partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < formattingRuns.Count; i++)
				{
					partManager.SaveRElement(saveManager, (FormattedStringRun)formattingRuns[i]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteTElement(partManager, unformattedString);
				partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static void SaveRElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager, FormattedStringRun run)
		{
			SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteRElement(partManager);
			WorkbookFontProxy fontInternal = run.GetFontInternal(saveManager.Workbook);
			if ((run.FirstFormattedCharAbsolute != 0 || fontInternal.SaveIndex.GetValueOrDefault() != 0) && fontInternal.SaveIndex < saveManager.Fonts.Count)
			{
				WorkbookFontData font = saveManager.Fonts[fontInternal.SaveIndex.Value];
				partManager.SaveRPrElement(font);
			}
			SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteTElement(partManager, run.UnformattedString);
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			partManager.XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public static void SaveRPrElement(this XmlPartManagerBase partManager, IWorkbookFont font)
		{
			partManager.SaveFontElementHelper(font, (Action<XmlPartManagerBase>)SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteRPrElement, (Action<XmlPartManagerBase, string>)SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteRFontElement);
		}
	}

			{
				string name = ((shape is WorksheetImage) ? "WorksheetShapeSerialization_ImageName" : ((!(shape is WorksheetShapeGroup)) ? "WorksheetShapeSerialization_ShapeName" : "WorksheetShapeSerialization_GroupName"));
				return $"{Utilities.GetString(name)} {id}";

		{

		private class ShapeLoader : IGraphicalObjectContentVisitor<ShapeLoadContext, WorksheetShape>
		{
			private class RunCreator : IEG_TextRunVisitor<FormattedTextParagraph, FormattedTextRun>
			{
				private readonly ObjectModelDrawingPartManager _partManager;

				private readonly WorkbookColorInfo _styleFontColor;

				private readonly Workbook _workbook;

				public RunCreator(ObjectModelDrawingPartManager partManager, WorkbookColorInfo styleFontColor)
				{
					_partManager = partManager;
					_styleFontColor = styleFontColor;
					_workbook = _partManager.ExcelDocumentManager.Workbook;
				}

				FormattedTextRun IEG_TextRunVisitor<FormattedTextParagraph, FormattedTextRun>.VisitCT_RegularTextRun(CT_RegularTextRun value, FormattedTextParagraph paragraph)
				{
					//IL_011b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0145: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_01d7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0204: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					FormattedTextRun formattedTextRun = new FormattedTextRun(paragraph, paragraph.UnformattedString.Length);
					formattedTextRun.RoundTrip2007Properties = value.RPr;
					FormattedTextRun formattedTextRun2 = formattedTextRun;
					paragraph.AddFormattingRun(formattedTextRun2);
					paragraph.UnformattedString += value.T;
					IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver defaultsResolver = ((XmlPartManagerBase)_partManager).ContextStack.Get<IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver>();
					WorkbookFontProxy fontInternal = formattedTextRun2.GetFontInternal(_workbook);
					if (_styleFontColor != null)
					{
						fontInternal.ColorInfo = _styleFontColor;
					}
					WorkbookFontData workbookFontData = fontInternal.Element.ResolvedFontData(defaultsResolver);
					CT_TextCharacterProperties rPr = value.RPr;
					if (rPr != null)
					{
						if (rPr.Sz.HasValue)
						{
							workbookFontData.Height = (int)Math.Ceiling((float)rPr.Sz.Value / 100f * 20f);
						}
						if (rPr.B.HasValue)
						{
							workbookFontData.Bold = rPr.B.Value.ToExcelDefaultableBoolean();
						}
						if (rPr.Baseline.HasValue)
						{
							if (ST_Percentage.op_Implicit(rPr.Baseline.Value) >= 30.0)
							{
								workbookFontData.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle = FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.Superscript;
							}
							else if (ST_Percentage.op_Implicit(rPr.Baseline.Value) <= -25.0)
							{
								workbookFontData.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle = FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.Subscript;
							}
							else
							{
								workbookFontData.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle = FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.None;
							}
						}
						if (rPr.Fill != null)
						{
							workbookFontData.ColorInfo = rPr.Fill.ToWorkbookColorInfo(_workbook);
						}
						if (rPr.I.HasValue)
						{
							workbookFontData.Italic = rPr.I.Value.ToExcelDefaultableBoolean();
						}
						if (rPr.U.HasValue)
						{
							workbookFontData.UnderlineStyle = rPr.U.Value.ToFontUnderlineStyle();
						}
						if (rPr.Strike.HasValue)
						{
							workbookFontData.Strikeout = (((int)rPr.Strike.Value != 0) ? ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True : ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False);
						}
						if (rPr.Latin != null && rPr.Latin.Typeface != null)
						{
							workbookFontData.Name = rPr.Latin.Typeface;
						}
					}
					fontInternal.SetFontFormatting(workbookFontData);
					return formattedTextRun2;
				}
			}

			private class ShapeTypeCreator : IEG_GeometryVisitor<bool, WorksheetShape>

				WorksheetShape IEG_GeometryVisitor<bool, WorksheetShape>.VisitCT_PresetGeometry2D(CT_PresetGeometry2D value, bool argument)
				{
					//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					ShapeType? type = WorksheetShape.ConvertShapeType(value.Prst);
					if (type.HasValue)
					{
						PredefinedShapeType value2 = (PredefinedShapeType)type.Value;
						if (Enum.IsDefined(typeof(PredefinedShapeType), value2))
						{
							return WorksheetShape.CreatePredefinedShape(value2, initializeDefaults: false);
						}
					}
					UnknownShape unknownShape = new UnknownShape();
					unknownShape.SetType(type, value.Prst);
					return unknownShape;
				}

			private ShapeOutline UpdateShapeOutline(ShapeOutline outline, CT_LineProperties lineProperties, ShapeLoadContext context)

				if (lineProperties != null)
