		protected override WorkItem<object> LoadCore()
		{
			_rootLevelShapes = new List<WorksheetShape>();
			ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager excelDocumentManager = ExcelDocumentManager;
			WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2007 loadManager = excelDocumentManager.LoadManager;
			loadManager.RootLevelShapesByDrawingPartName.Add(((OfficeDocumentManager)excelDocumentManager).ActivePart.Uri.ToString(), _rootLevelShapes);
			return ((XmlPartManagerBase)this).LoadCore();
		}

		protected override WorkItem SaveCore(object context)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = context as Worksheet;
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager = ExcelDocumentManager.SaveManager;
			CacheShapeIdentityInfo(saveManager, worksheet);
			Dictionary<Image, string> imageRelationshipIds = new Dictionary<Image, string>();
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then(saveManager.SaveAllImages(worksheet.Shapes, imageRelationshipIds), (Func<WorkItem>)delegate
			{
				((XmlPartManagerBase)this).ContextStack.Push((object)imageRelationshipIds);
				WorksheetShapeCollection shapes = worksheet.Shapes;
				List<WorksheetShape> list = new List<WorksheetShape>(shapes.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < shapes.Count; i++)
				{
					WorksheetShape resolvedShape = saveManager.GetResolvedShape(shapes[i]);
					if (resolvedShape != null)
					{
						list.Add(resolvedShape);
					}
				}
				DrawingMLSpreadsheetDrawing.WriteWsDrElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this);
				return WorkItemExtensions.Then(Async.ForEach<WorksheetShape>((IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)list, (Func<WorksheetShape, WorkItem>)((WorksheetShape shape) => SaveTwoCellAnchorElement(saveManager, shape))), (Action)delegate
				{
					((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		private void CacheShapeIdentityInfo(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager, Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			_shapeIds = new Dictionary<WorksheetShape, ShapeIdentity>();
			uint currentId = 1u;
			CacheShapeIdentityInfo(saveManager, worksheet.Shapes, ref currentId);
		}

		private void CacheShapeIdentityInfo(WorkbookSaveManager saveManager, WorksheetShapeCollection shapes, ref uint currentId)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < shapes.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetShape resolvedShape = saveManager.GetResolvedShape(shapes[i]);
				if (resolvedShape != null)
				{
					_shapeIds.Add(resolvedShape, new ShapeIdentity(resolvedShape, currentId++));
					if (resolvedShape is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
					{
						CacheShapeIdentityInfo(saveManager, worksheetShapeGroup.Shapes, ref currentId);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private WorkItem<IGraphicalObjectContent> CreateRootGraphicalObjectContentHelper(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager, WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			if (shape is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
			{
				return CreateCT_GroupShape(saveManager, worksheetShapeGroup);
			}
			if (shape is WorksheetImage image)
			{
				return WorkItem.FromResult<IGraphicalObjectContent>((IGraphicalObjectContent)(object)CreateCT_Picture(image));
			}
			if (shape is WorksheetChart chart)
			{
				return CreateCT_GraphicalObjectFrame(chart);
			}
			if (shape.UseCxnShapePropertiesElement)
			{
				return WorkItem.FromResult<IGraphicalObjectContent>((IGraphicalObjectContent)(object)CreateCT_Connector(shape));
			}
			return WorkItem.FromResult<IGraphicalObjectContent>((IGraphicalObjectContent)(object)CreateCT_Shape(shape));
		}

		private static void GetOffsetsInCell(WorksheetCell cell, PointF position, out long colOffsetEmus, out long rowOffsetEmus)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = cell.Worksheet;
			int columnWidthInTwips = worksheet.GetColumnWidthInTwips(cell.ColumnIndex);
			int rowHeightInTwips = worksheet.GetRowHeightInTwips(cell.RowIndex);
			float num = position.X / 100f;
			float num2 = position.Y / 100f;
			colOffsetEmus = Utilities.TwipsToEMU(MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num * (float)columnWidthInTwips));
			rowOffsetEmus = Utilities.TwipsToEMU(MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num2 * (float)rowHeightInTwips));
		}

			{
				SaveOleLinkElement(oleLinkReference);
			}

			return null;
		}

		private void SaveExternalBookElement(ExternalWorkbookReference externalWorkbookReference)
		{
			//IL_025c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager excelDocumentManager = ExcelDocumentManager;
			WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager = excelDocumentManager.SaveManager;
			Workbook workbook = saveManager.Workbook;
			string text = Uri.EscapeUriString(externalWorkbookReference.FileName.Replace(Utilities.PathDirectorySeparatorChar, '/'));
			bool flag = text.StartsWith("file://");
			Uri uri;
			if (flag)
			{
				uri = new Uri(text, UriKind.Absolute);
			}
			else if (saveManager.FilePath != null)
			{
				if (!Path.IsPathRooted(text) || Path.GetPathRoot(text) == Path.GetPathRoot(saveManager.FilePath))
				{
					string text2 = PackageUtilities.GetRelativePath(saveManager.FilePath, externalWorkbookReference.FileName, Utilities.PathDirectorySeparatorChar, true);
					if (text2.StartsWith("//"))
					{
						text2 = text2.Substring(1);
					}
					uri = new Uri(Uri.EscapeUriString(text2), UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
				}
				else if (text.StartsWith("/"))
				{
					uri = new Uri(text, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						text = text.Insert(0, "file:///");
					}
					uri = new Uri(text, UriKind.Absolute);
				}
			}
			else if (Path.IsPathRooted(text))
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					text = text.Insert(0, "file:///");
				}
				uri = new Uri(text, UriKind.Absolute);
			}
			else
			{
				uri = new Uri(text, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
			}
			string text3 = ((OfficeDocumentManager)excelDocumentManager).CreateExternalRelationship(uri, ((ExcelDocumentManager)excelDocumentManager).GetExternalLinkPathRelationshipType());
			SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteExternalBookElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, text3);
			if (externalWorkbookReference.WorksheetNames.Count > 0)
			{
				SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteSheetNamesElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this);
				foreach (string worksheetName in externalWorkbookReference.WorksheetNames)
				{
					SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteSheetNameElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, worksheetName);
					((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
			if (externalWorkbookReference.NamedReferences.Count > 0)
			{
				((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this).SaveDefinedNamesElement(externalWorkbookReference);
			}
			if (externalWorkbookReference.WorksheetNames.Count > 0)
			{
				SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteSheetDataSetElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this);
				for (int i = 0; i < externalWorkbookReference.WorksheetNames.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!(externalWorkbookReference.GetWorksheetReference(i) is WorksheetReferenceExternal worksheetReferenceExternal))
					{
						continue;
					}
					SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteSheetDataElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, (uint)i, false);
					foreach (WorksheetReferenceExternal.RowValues cachedRowValue in worksheetReferenceExternal.CachedRowValues)
					{
						SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteRowElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, (uint)(cachedRowValue.RowIndex + 1));
						foreach (KeyValuePair<short, object> cachedValue in cachedRowValue.CachedValues)
						{
							WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007.GetCellValueInfo(cachedValue.Value, out var cellType, out var valueToWrite);
							SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteCellElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, CellAddress.GetCellReferenceString(cachedRowValue.RowIndex, cachedValue.Key, workbook.CurrentFormat, rowAddressIsRelative: true, columnAddressIsRelative: true, -1, -1), cellType, 0u);
							SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteVElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, valueToWrite);
							((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
							((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
						}
						((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
					}
					((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
				}
				((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
			((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveOleLinkElement(OleLinkWorkbookReference oleLinkReference)
		{
			ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager excelDocumentManager = ExcelDocumentManager;
			WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager = excelDocumentManager.SaveManager;
			_ = saveManager.Workbook;
			string text = ((OfficeDocumentManager)excelDocumentManager).CreateExternalRelationship(oleLinkReference.ObjectLink, ((ExcelDocumentManager)excelDocumentManager).GetOleObjectRelationshipType());
			SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteOleLinkElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, text, oleLinkReference.ProgId);
			SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteOleItemsElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this);
			foreach (OleItem item in oleLinkReference.Items)
			{
				SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteOleItemElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, item.Name, item.Icon, item.Advise, item.PreferPic);
				((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			}
			((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private RoundTripControlData GetAssociatedPivotCacheDefinition()

			OfficeDocumentManager documentManager = ((PartManagerBase)this).DocumentManager;

			bool shouldRemoveCarriageReturns = saveManager.Workbook.ShouldRemoveCarriageReturnsOnSave;

		}

		private ObjectModelSlicerCachePartManager()
		{
		}

		public override WorkItem<object> Load()
		{
			return WorkItem.FromResult<object>((object)new BinaryData(Utilities.StreamToArray(((PartManagerBase)this).PartStream)));
		}

		public override WorkItem Save(object context)
		{
			if (!(context is BinaryData binaryData))
			{
				return null;
			}
			((PartManagerBase)this).PartStream.Write(binaryData.Buffer, 0, binaryData.Buffer.Length);
			return null;
		}

		protected override WorkItem SaveCore(object context)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		private static ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager GetExcelDocumentManager(PartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			return (ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager)(object)partManager.DocumentManager;
		}
	}

		private static void LoadAlignmentElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			FormatInfo formatInfo = partManager.ContextStack.Get<FormatInfo>();
			DxfInfo dxfInfo = partManager.ContextStack.Get<DxfInfo>();
			if (formatInfo != null || dxfInfo != null)
			{
				ST_HorizontalAlignment? horizontalAlignment = default(ST_HorizontalAlignment?);
				ST_VerticalAlignment? verticalAlignment = default(ST_VerticalAlignment?);
				uint? textRotation = default(uint?);
				bool wrapText = default(bool);
				uint? indent = default(uint?);
				int? relativeIndent = default(int?);
				bool justifyLastLine = default(bool);
				bool shrinkToFit = default(bool);
				uint? readingOrder = default(uint?);
				SpreadsheetMLMain.ReadAlignmentElement(partManager, ref horizontalAlignment, ref verticalAlignment, ref textRotation, ref wrapText, ref indent, ref relativeIndent, ref justifyLastLine, ref shrinkToFit, ref readingOrder);
				AlignmentInfo alignmentInfo = new AlignmentInfo();
				alignmentInfo.Horizontal = horizontalAlignment.ToHorizontalCellAlignment();
				alignmentInfo.Vertical = verticalAlignment.ToVerticalCellAlignment();
				alignmentInfo.TextRotation = textRotation;
				alignmentInfo.WrapText = wrapText;
				alignmentInfo.Indent = indent;
				alignmentInfo.RelativeIndent = relativeIndent;
				alignmentInfo.JustifyLastLine = justifyLastLine;
				alignmentInfo.ShrinkToFit = shrinkToFit;
				alignmentInfo.ReadingOrder = readingOrder;
				AlignmentInfo alignment = alignmentInfo;
				if (formatInfo != null)
				{
					formatInfo.Alignment = alignment;
				}
				if (dxfInfo != null)
				{
					dxfInfo.Alignment = alignment;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void LoadBgColorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			PatternFillInfo patternFillInfo = partManager.ContextStack.Get<PatternFillInfo>();
			if (patternFillInfo != null)
			{
				patternFillInfo.BackgroundColor = ObjectModelCommonPartHelpers.LoadColorInfoInternal(partManager, (ObjectModelCommonPartHelpers.ReadCT_ColorElementCallback)SpreadsheetMLMain.ReadBgColorElement);
			}
		}

		private static void LoadBorderElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			bool diagonalUp = default(bool);
			bool diagonalDown = default(bool);
			bool outline = default(bool);
			SpreadsheetMLMain.ReadBorderElement(partManager, ref diagonalUp, ref diagonalDown, ref outline);
			BorderInfo borderInfo = new BorderInfo();
			borderInfo.DiagonalUp = diagonalUp;
			borderInfo.DiagonalDown = diagonalDown;
			borderInfo.Outline = outline;
			BorderInfo borderInfo2 = borderInfo;
			ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager excelDocumentManager = GetExcelDocumentManager(partManager);
			DxfInfo dxfInfo = partManager.ContextStack.Get<DxfInfo>();
			if (dxfInfo != null)
			{
				dxfInfo.Border = borderInfo2;
			}
			else if (excelDocumentManager.LoadManager.Borders.Count == 0)
			{
				BorderInfo borderInfo3 = new BorderInfo();
				borderInfo3.Bottom.BorderStyle = CellBorderLineStyle.None;
				borderInfo3.Diagonal.BorderStyle = CellBorderLineStyle.None;
				borderInfo3.Left.BorderStyle = CellBorderLineStyle.None;
				borderInfo3.Right.BorderStyle = CellBorderLineStyle.None;
				borderInfo3.Top.BorderStyle = CellBorderLineStyle.None;
				excelDocumentManager.LoadManager.Borders.Add(borderInfo3);
			}
			else
			{
				excelDocumentManager.LoadManager.Borders.Add(borderInfo2);
			}
			partManager.ContextStack.Push((object)borderInfo2);
		}

		private static void LoadBordersElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			uint? num = default(uint?);
			SpreadsheetMLMain.ReadBordersElement(partManager, ref num);
		}

		private static void LoadBorderSideElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager, ReadCT_BorderElement readElement, Func<BorderInfo, BorderStyleInfo> getBorderStyleInfo, ST_ConformanceClass? expectedConformance = null)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			_ = expectedConformance.HasValue;
			BorderInfo borderInfo = partManager.ContextStack.Get<BorderInfo>();
			if (borderInfo != null)
			{
				readElement(partManager, out var style);
				BorderStyleInfo borderStyleInfo = getBorderStyleInfo(borderInfo);
				borderStyleInfo.BorderStyle = style.ToCellBorderLineStyle();
				partManager.ContextStack.Push((object)borderStyleInfo.ColorInfo);
			}
		}

		private static void LoadCellStyleElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			uint cellStyleXfId = default(uint);
			string name = default(string);
			uint? builtinId = default(uint?);
			uint? outlineStyle = default(uint?);
			bool hidden = default(bool);
			bool customBuiltin = default(bool);
			SpreadsheetMLMain.ReadCellStyleElement(partManager, ref cellStyleXfId, ref name, ref builtinId, ref outlineStyle, ref hidden, ref customBuiltin);
			ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager excelDocumentManager = GetExcelDocumentManager(partManager);
			excelDocumentManager.LoadManager.CellStyles.Add(new StyleInfo
			{
				CellStyleXfId = (int)cellStyleXfId,
				Name = name,
				BuiltinId = builtinId,
				OutlineStyle = outlineStyle,
				Hidden = hidden,
				CustomBuiltin = customBuiltin
			});
		}

		private static void LoadFontElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager excelDocumentManager = GetExcelDocumentManager(partManager);
			Workbook workbook = excelDocumentManager.Workbook;
			WorkbookFontData workbookFontData = new WorkbookFontData(workbook);
			partManager.ContextStack.Push((object)workbookFontData);
			ColorInfo colorInfo = new ColorInfo();
			colorInfo.FontDataObject = workbookFontData;
			partManager.ContextStack.Push((object)colorInfo);
			DxfInfo dxfInfo = partManager.ContextStack.Get<DxfInfo>();
			if (dxfInfo != null)
			{
				dxfInfo.FontColorInfo = colorInfo;
				dxfInfo.Font = workbookFontData;
			}
			else
			{
				excelDocumentManager.LoadManager.FontColorInfos.Add(colorInfo);
			}
		}

		private static void LoadGradientFillElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FillInfo fillInfo = partManager.ContextStack.Get<FillInfo>();
			if (fillInfo != null)
			{
				ST_GradientType fillType = default(ST_GradientType);
				double degree = default(double);
				double left = default(double);
				double right = default(double);
				double top = default(double);
				double bottom = default(double);
				SpreadsheetMLMain.ReadGradientFillElement(partManager, ref fillType, ref degree, ref left, ref right, ref top, ref bottom);
				GradientFillInfo gradientFillInfo = new GradientFillInfo();
				gradientFillInfo.FillType = fillType;
				gradientFillInfo.Degree = degree;
				gradientFillInfo.Left = left;
				gradientFillInfo.Right = right;
				gradientFillInfo.Top = top;
				gradientFillInfo.Bottom = bottom;
				GradientFillInfo gradientFillInfo2 = (fillInfo.GradientFill = gradientFillInfo);
				partManager.ContextStack.Push((object)gradientFillInfo2);
			}
		}

		private static void LoadIndexedColorsElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			partManager.ContextStack.Push((object)new List<Color>());
		}

		private static void LoadIndexedColorsEndElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			List<Color> list = partManager.ContextStack.Get<List<Color>>();
			if (list != null)
			{
				WorkbookColorPalette palette = GetExcelDocumentManager(partManager).Workbook.Palette;
				for (int i = 8; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					palette[i - 8] = list[i];
				}
			}
		}

		private static void LoadNumFmtElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			uint num = default(uint);
			string formatCode = default(string);
			SpreadsheetMLMain.ReadNumFmtElement(partManager, ref num, ref formatCode);
			SerializationNumberFormatInfo serializationNumberFormatInfo = new SerializationNumberFormatInfo();
			DxfInfo dxfInfo = partManager.ContextStack.Get<DxfInfo>();
			if (dxfInfo != null)
			{
				dxfInfo.NumberFormat = serializationNumberFormatInfo;
				num = WorkbookFormatCollection.FromDxfIndex(num);
			}
			serializationNumberFormatInfo.FormatCode = formatCode;
			serializationNumberFormatInfo.FormatId = num;
			Workbook workbook = GetExcelDocumentManager(partManager).Workbook;
			workbook.Formats.AddLoadedFormat((int)serializationNumberFormatInfo.FormatId, serializationNumberFormatInfo.FormatCode);
		}

		private static void LoadRgbColorElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)

	internal sealed class ObjectModelTablePartManager : TablePartManager
	{
		private class CustomFilterContext
		{
			private readonly ConditionalOperator conditionalOperator;

			private CustomFilterCondition condition1;

			private CustomFilterCondition condition2;

			public CustomFilterContext(ConditionalOperator conditionalOperator)
			{
				this.conditionalOperator = conditionalOperator;
			}

			public void AddCondition(CustomFilterCondition condition)
			{
				if (condition1 == null)
				{
					condition1 = condition;
				}
				else if (condition2 == null)
				{
					condition2 = condition;
				}
			}

			public CustomFilter CreateFilter()
			{
				if (condition1 == null && condition2 == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new CustomFilter(null, condition1, condition2, conditionalOperator);
			}
		}

		private class FilterColumnElementContext
		{
			private readonly int columnIndex;

			private Filter filter;

			public int ColumnIndex => columnIndex;

			public Filter Filter
			{
				get
				{
					return filter;
				}
				set
				{
					filter = value;
				}
			}

			public FilterColumnElementContext(int columnIndex)
			{
				this.columnIndex = columnIndex;
			}
		}

		private class TableContext
		{
			private Dictionary<int, Filter> _columnFilters;

			private List<KeyValuePair<short, SortCondition>> _columnSortConditions;

			private readonly WorksheetTable _table;

			public TableContext(WorksheetTable table)
			{
				_table = table;
			}

			public void AddFilter(int columnIdex, Filter filter)
			{
				if (filter != null)
				{
					if (_columnFilters == null)
					{
						_columnFilters = new Dictionary<int, Filter>();
					}
					_columnFilters[columnIdex] = filter;
				}
			}

			public void AddSortCondition(short columnIndex, SortCondition sortCondition)
			{
				if (_columnSortConditions == null)
				{
					_columnSortConditions = new List<KeyValuePair<short, SortCondition>>();
				}
				_columnSortConditions.Add(new KeyValuePair<short, SortCondition>(columnIndex, sortCondition));
			}

			public void OnLoaded()
			{
				if (_columnFilters != null)
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<int, Filter> columnFilter in _columnFilters)
					{
						int key = columnFilter.Key;
						if (key >= 0 && _table.Columns.Count > key)
						{
							WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = _table.Columns[key];
							if (worksheetTableColumn != null)
							{
								Filter value = columnFilter.Value;
								value.SetOwner(worksheetTableColumn);
								worksheetTableColumn.Filter = value;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (_columnSortConditions == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<short, SortCondition> columnSortCondition in _columnSortConditions)
				{
					int num = columnSortCondition.Key - _table.WholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex;
					if (num >= 0 && _table.Columns.Count > num)
					{
						WorksheetTableColumn sortableItem = _table.Columns[num];
						_table.SortSettings.SortConditions.Add(sortableItem, columnSortCondition.Value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override WorkItem SaveCore(object context)
		{
			if (!(context is WorksheetTable worksheetTable))
			{
				return null;
			}
			WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager = ExcelDocumentManager.SaveManager;
			SaveAreaFormat(saveManager, worksheetTable.AreaFormats, WorksheetTableArea.DataArea, out var styleAttributeName, out var dxfIdAttributeName);
			SaveAreaFormat(saveManager, worksheetTable.AreaFormats, WorksheetTableArea.HeaderRow, out var styleAttributeName2, out var dxfIdAttributeName2, out var borderDxfIdAttributeName, CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo, CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle);
			SaveAreaFormat(saveManager, worksheetTable.AreaFormats, WorksheetTableArea.WholeTable, out var _, out var _, out var borderDxfIdAttributeName2, CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo, CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle, CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo, CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle, CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo, CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle, CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo, CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle);
			SaveAreaFormat(saveManager, worksheetTable.AreaFormats, WorksheetTableArea.TotalsRow, out var styleAttributeName4, out var dxfIdAttributeName4, out var borderDxfIdAttributeName3, CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo, CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle);
			SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteTableElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, worksheetTable.Id, worksheetTable.Name, worksheetTable.Name, worksheetTable.Comment, worksheetTable.WholeTableRegion.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: true, useRelativeRow: true), (ST_TableType)0, worksheetTable.IsHeaderRowVisible ? 1u : 0u, worksheetTable.IsInsertRowVisible, worksheetTable.WereCellsShiftedToShowInsertRow, worksheetTable.IsTotalsRowVisible ? 1u : 0u, worksheetTable.HasTotalsRowEverBeenVisible, worksheetTable.Published, dxfIdAttributeName2, dxfIdAttributeName, dxfIdAttributeName4, borderDxfIdAttributeName, borderDxfIdAttributeName2, borderDxfIdAttributeName3, styleAttributeName2, styleAttributeName, styleAttributeName4, (uint?)null);
			if (worksheetTable.IsFilterUIVisible)
			{
				SaveAutoFilterElement(saveManager, worksheetTable);
			}
			if (worksheetTable.SortSettings.HasData)
			{
				SaveSortStateElement(saveManager, worksheetTable);
			}
			SaveTableColumnsElement(saveManager, worksheetTable);
			SaveTableStyleInfo(worksheetTable);
			((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			return null;
		}

		private static void LoadAreaFormat<T>(ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager manager, WorksheetTableAreaFormatsCollection<T> areaFormats, T area, Func<T, CellFormatValue, bool> callback, string styleName, uint? dxfId, uint? borderDxfId, params CellFormatValue[] borderValues)
		{
			Workbook workbook = manager.Workbook;
			WorkbookStyle style = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(styleName))

				style = workbook.Styles[styleName];

			if (borderDxfId.HasValue)
			{
				dxfBorders = manager.LoadManager.Dxfs[(int)borderDxfId.Value].CloneInternal();
			}
			manager.LoadManager.SetAreaFormatInfo(areaFormats, area, callback, style, dxf, dxfBorders, borderValues);
		}

		public class UpdateLegacyShapeData : WorksheetShapeVisitor<LegacyShapeData, bool>
		{
			public static readonly UpdateLegacyShapeData Instance = new UpdateLegacyShapeData();

			private UpdateLegacyShapeData()
			{
			}

			public override bool VisitWorksheetCellComment(WorksheetCellComment value, LegacyShapeData shapeData)
			{
				//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (shapeData == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				Worksheet worksheet = value.Cell.Worksheet;
				if (worksheet == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				shapeData.ColHidden = worksheet.IsColumnHidden(value.Cell.ColumnIndexInternal);
				shapeData.Column = value.Cell.ColumnIndexInternal;
				shapeData.RowHidden = worksheet.IsRowHidden(value.Cell.RowIndex);
				shapeData.Row = value.Cell.RowIndex;
				shapeData.HasShadow = true;
				shapeData.InsetMode = (ST_InsetMode)0;
				shapeData.ObjectType = (ST_ObjectType)10;
				shapeData.Type = "#_x0000_t202";
				base.VisitWorksheetCellComment(value, shapeData);
				shapeData.Visible = value.Visible;
				return true;
			}

			public override bool VisitWorksheetShape(WorksheetShape value, LegacyShapeData shapeData)
			{
				if (shapeData == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				shapeData.InitializeAnchorData(value);
				shapeData.SpId = "_x0000_s" + (int)value.ShapeId;
				shapeData.Visible = null;
				if (!value.Visible || !shapeData.VisibleResolved)
				{
					string text = shapeData.Style ?? "";
					int num = text.IndexOf("visibility:");
					if (0 <= num)
					{
						int num2 = text.IndexOf(";", num);
						text = ((num2 >= 0) ? text.Remove(num, num2 - num + 1) : text.Remove(num));
					}
					if (text.Length != 0)
					{
						text += ";";
					}
					text += "visibility:hidden";
					shapeData.Style = text;
				}
				switch (value.PositioningMode)
				{
				case ShapePositioningMode.DontMoveOrSizeWithCells:
					shapeData.MoveWithCells = true;
					shapeData.SizeWithCells = true;
					break;
				default:
					shapeData.MoveWithCells = null;
					shapeData.SizeWithCells = null;
					break;
				case ShapePositioningMode.MoveWithCells:
					shapeData.MoveWithCells = null;
					shapeData.SizeWithCells = true;
					break;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private void SaveClientDataElement(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager, LegacyShapeData shapeData)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ExcelNamespace.WriteClientDataElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, shapeData.ObjectType);
			SavePathElement(shapeData.PathElement);
			SaveLockElement(shapeData.LockElement);
			if (shapeData.TextBoxCache != null)
			{
				((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteUnknownStructure(shapeData.TextBoxCache);
			}
			SaveMoveWithCellsElement(shapeData);
			SaveSizeWithCellsElement(shapeData);
			SaveAnchorElement(shapeData);
			SaveRowElement(shapeData);
			SaveColumnElement(shapeData);
			SaveVisibleElement(shapeData);
			SaveRowHiddenElement(shapeData);
			SaveColHiddenElement(shapeData);
			SaveDefaultSizeElement(shapeData);
			SavePrintObjectElement(shapeData);
			SaveAutoFillElement(shapeData);
			SaveAutoLineElement(shapeData);
			SaveCFElement(shapeData);
			SaveAutoPictElement(shapeData);
			SaveMapOCXElement(shapeData);
			SaveFmlaMacroElement(saveManager, shapeData);
			SaveTextHAlignElement(shapeData);
			SaveTextVAlignElement(shapeData);
			SaveNoThreeDElement(shapeData);
			SaveFirstButtonElement(shapeData);
			((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private void SaveXmlElement(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager)
		{
			List<WorksheetShape> list = ((XmlPartManagerBase)this).ContextStack.Get<List<WorksheetShape>>();
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_ = ExcelDocumentManager;
			List<LegacyShapeData> list2 = new List<LegacyShapeData>();
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			foreach (WorksheetShape item in list)
			{
				UnknownShape unknownShape = item as UnknownShape;
				LegacyShapeData legacyShapeData = null;
				if (unknownShape != null)
				{
					legacyShapeData = unknownShape.ShapeData2007;
				}
				else if (item is WorksheetCellComment)
				{
					legacyShapeData = new LegacyShapeData();
				}
				if (legacyShapeData != null)
				{
					if (item is WorksheetCellComment)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					item.Accept(UpdateLegacyShapeData.Instance, legacyShapeData);
					list2.Add(legacyShapeData);
				}
			}
			List<LegacyShapeTypeData> list3 = new List<LegacyShapeTypeData>();
			if (flag)
			{
				LegacyShapeTypeData legacyShapeTypeData = new LegacyShapeTypeData();
				legacyShapeTypeData.Id = "_x0000_t202";
				legacyShapeTypeData.Coordsize = "21600,21600";
				legacyShapeTypeData.Spt = 202f;
				legacyShapeTypeData.Path = "m,l,21600r21600,l21600,xe";
				legacyShapeTypeData.StrokeElement = new LegacyShapeStrokeData();
				legacyShapeTypeData.StrokeElement.JoinStyle = (ST_StrokeJoinStyle)2;
				legacyShapeTypeData.PathElement = new LegacyShapePathData();
				legacyShapeTypeData.PathElement.GradientShapeOk = true;
				legacyShapeTypeData.PathElement.ConnectType = (ST_ConnectType)1;
				list3.Add(legacyShapeTypeData);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				LegacyShapeTypeData legacyShapeTypeData2 = new LegacyShapeTypeData();
				legacyShapeTypeData2.Id = "_x0000_t201";
				legacyShapeTypeData2.Coordsize = "21600,21600";
				legacyShapeTypeData2.Spt = 201f;
				legacyShapeTypeData2.Path = "m,l,21600r21600,l21600,xe";
				legacyShapeTypeData2.StrokeElement = new LegacyShapeStrokeData();
				legacyShapeTypeData2.StrokeElement.JoinStyle = (ST_StrokeJoinStyle)2;
				legacyShapeTypeData2.PathElement = new LegacyShapePathData();
				legacyShapeTypeData2.PathElement.ShadowOk = false;
				legacyShapeTypeData2.PathElement.ExtrusionOk = false;
				legacyShapeTypeData2.PathElement.StrokeOk = false;
				legacyShapeTypeData2.PathElement.FillOk = false;
				legacyShapeTypeData2.PathElement.ConnectType = (ST_ConnectType)1;
				legacyShapeTypeData2.LockElement = new LegacyShapeLockData();
				legacyShapeTypeData2.LockElement.Ext = (ST_Ext)1;
				legacyShapeTypeData2.LockElement.ShapeType = true;
				list3.Add(legacyShapeTypeData2);
			}
			EmptyNamespace.WriteXmlElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, (decimal?)null, (decimal?)null);
			list3.ForEach(SaveShapetypeElement);
			list2.ForEach(delegate(LegacyShapeData s)
			{
				SaveShapeElement(saveManager, s);
			});
			((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager GetExcelDocumentManager(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			return (ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager)(object)((PartManagerBase)partManager).DocumentManager;
		}
	}

	internal interface IWorksheetShapeVisitor<TArg, TResult>
	{
		TResult VisitDiamondShape(DiamondShape value, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitEllipseShape(EllipseShape ellipseShape, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitHeartShape(HeartShape heartShape, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitIrregularSeal1Shape(IrregularSeal1Shape irregularSeal1Shape, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitIrregularSeal2Shape(IrregularSeal2Shape irregularSeal2Shape, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitLightningBoltShape(LightningBoltShape lightningBoltShape, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitLineShape(LineShape lineShape, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitPentagonShape(PentagonShape pentagonShape, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitRectangleShape(RectangleShape rectangleShape, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitRightTriangleShape(RightTriangleShape rightTriangleShape, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitStraightConnector1Shape(StraightConnector1Shape straightConnector1Shape, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitUnknownShape(UnknownShape unknownShape, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitWorksheetCellComment(WorksheetCellComment worksheetCellComment, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitWorksheetChart(WorksheetChart worksheetChart, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitWorksheetImage(WorksheetImage worksheetImage, TArg argument);

		TResult VisitWorksheetShapeGroup(WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup, TArg argument);
	}
	internal class WorksheetShapeVisitor<TArg, TResult> : IWorksheetShapeVisitor<TArg, TResult>
	{

		{

			return VisitWorksheetShapeWithText(value, argument);
		}

		public virtual TResult VisitIrregularSeal1Shape(IrregularSeal1Shape value, TArg argument)
		{
			return VisitWorksheetShapeWithText(value, argument);
		}

		public virtual TResult VisitIrregularSeal2Shape(IrregularSeal2Shape value, TArg argument)
		{
			return VisitWorksheetShapeWithText(value, argument);
		}

		public virtual TResult VisitLightningBoltShape(LightningBoltShape value, TArg argument)
		{
			return VisitWorksheetShapeWithText(value, argument);
		}

		public virtual TResult VisitLineShape(LineShape value, TArg argument)
		{
			return VisitWorksheetShape(value, argument);
		}

		public virtual TResult VisitPentagonShape(PentagonShape value, TArg argument)
		{
			return VisitWorksheetShapeWithText(value, argument);
		}

		public virtual TResult VisitRectangleShape(RectangleShape value, TArg argument)
		{

		}

		{
			return VisitWorksheetShapeWithText(value, argument);
		}

		public virtual TResult VisitStraightConnector1Shape(StraightConnector1Shape value, TArg argument)
		{
			return VisitWorksheetShape(value, argument);
		}

		public virtual TResult VisitUnknownShape(UnknownShape value, TArg argument)
		{
			return VisitWorksheetShapeWithText(value, argument);
		}

		public virtual TResult VisitWorksheetCellComment(WorksheetCellComment value, TArg argument)
		{
			return VisitWorksheetShape(value, argument);
		}

		public virtual TResult VisitWorksheetChart(WorksheetChart value, TArg argument)
		{
			return VisitWorksheetShape(value, argument);

			return default(TResult);
		}

		{

			}

		}

		private static string DataValidationUnescapeDescription(string description)

			}

		}

		private static void LoadVElement(XmlPartManagerBase partManager)
		{
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = partManager.ContextStack.Get<WorksheetRow>();
			ST_CellType? val = partManager.ContextStack.Get<ST_CellType?>();
			if (worksheetRow != null && val.HasValue)
			{
				ObjectModelWorksheetPartManager objectModelWorksheetPartManager = (ObjectModelWorksheetPartManager)(object)partManager;
				object obj = partManager.LoadVElementHelper(objectModelWorksheetPartManager._currentColumnIndex);
				WorksheetCellBlock cellBlock = worksheetRow.GetCellBlock(objectModelWorksheetPartManager._currentColumnIndex);
				object cellValueRaw = cellBlock.GetCellValueRaw(worksheetRow, objectModelWorksheetPartManager._currentColumnIndex);
				if (cellValueRaw is Formula || cellValueRaw is WorksheetDataTable)
				{
					worksheetRow.SetCachedCalculatedValue(objectModelWorksheetPartManager._currentColumnIndex, CalcUtilities.CreateExcelCalcValue(obj));
					return;
				}
				cellBlock.SetCellValueRaw(worksheetRow, objectModelWorksheetPartManager._currentColumnIndex, obj, checkForBlockingValues: false, out var replacementBlock);
				cellBlock = replacementBlock ?? cellBlock;
			}
		}

		private static uint? ParseShapeId(string id)
		{
			if (id == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!id.StartsWith("_x0000_s"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string s = id.Substring(8);
			if (!int.TryParse(s, out var result))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (uint)result;
		}

		public void PopulateLegacyShapeAndControlCollections(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetSerializationCache cache)
		{
			_controlShapesInCurrentWorksheet = new List<UnknownShape>();
			_legacyShapesInCurrentWorksheet = new List<WorksheetShape>();
			foreach (WorksheetCellComment commentShape in cache.CommentShapes)
			{
				_legacyShapesInCurrentWorksheet.Add(commentShape);
			}
			PopulateLegacyShapeAndControlCollections(worksheet.Shapes);
		}

		private void PopulateLegacyShapeAndControlCollections(WorksheetShapeCollection shapes)
		{
			foreach (WorksheetShape item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)shapes)
			{
				if (item is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
				{
					PopulateLegacyShapeAndControlCollections(worksheetShapeGroup.Shapes);
				}
				else if (item is UnknownShape { ShapeData2007: not null } unknownShape)
				{
					_legacyShapesInCurrentWorksheet.Add(unknownShape);
					if (unknownShape.ControlData2007 != null && unknownShape.ControlData2007.ContentType == "application/vnd.ms-office.activeX+xml")
					{
						_controlShapesInCurrentWorksheet.Add(unknownShape);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void SaveFElement(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object cellValue)
		{
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0147: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0120: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0103: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0125: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Formula formula = cellValue as Formula;
			WorksheetDataTable worksheetDataTable = cellValue as WorksheetDataTable;
			if ((formula == null || formula.OwningCellRow != row || formula.OwningCellColumnIndex != columnIndex) && (worksheetDataTable == null || worksheetDataTable.InteriorCells.FirstRow != row.Index || worksheetDataTable.InteriorCells.FirstColumnInternal != columnIndex))
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayFormula arrayFormula = null;
			string text = null;
			ST_CellFormulaType val = (ST_CellFormulaType)0;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			string text2 = null;
			string text3 = null;
			if (worksheetDataTable != null)
			{
				val = (ST_CellFormulaType)2;
				text = worksheetDataTable.InteriorCells.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: true, useRelativeRow: true);
				WorksheetCell columnInputCell = worksheetDataTable.ColumnInputCell;
				WorksheetCell rowInputCell = worksheetDataTable.RowInputCell;
				bool flag3 = columnInputCell != null && rowInputCell != null;
				flag = flag3;
				flag2 = rowInputCell != null;
				text2 = (rowInputCell ?? columnInputCell).ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: true, useRelativeRow: true);
				if (flag3)
				{
					text3 = columnInputCell.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: true, useRelativeRow: true);
				}
			}
			else if (formula != null)
			{
				switch (formula.Type)
				{
				case FormulaType.ArrayFormula:
					val = (ST_CellFormulaType)1;
					arrayFormula = (ArrayFormula)formula;
					text = arrayFormula.CellRange.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: true, useRelativeRow: true);
					break;
				default:
					val = (ST_CellFormulaType)0;
					break;
				case FormulaType.ExternalNamedReferenceFormula:
					val = (ST_CellFormulaType)0;
					break;
				}
			}
			bool flag4 = row.GetCellCalcReference(columnIndex).ShouldBeRecalculatedOnNextLoad();
			string text4 = null;
			if (formula != null)
			{
				text4 = saveManager.GetSerializableFormula(formula);
			}
			SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteFElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, text4, val, false, text, flag, flag2, false, false, text2, text3, flag4, (uint?)null, false);

		private int SaveRowElement(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 saveManager, WorksheetRow row, WorksheetRowSerializationCache rowCache)
		{
			uint num = 0u;

			{
				num = saveManager.GetCellFormatIndex(row.CellFormatInternal.Element);
				flag = true;
			}
			double? num2 = null;
			int height = row.GetHeight(treatAsVisible: true);
			if (height > -1)
			{
				num2 = (double)height / 20.0;
			}
			else if (_worksheet.HasCustomDefaultRowHeight)
			{
				num2 = (double)_worksheet.DefaultRowHeight / 20.0;
			}
			SpreadsheetMLMain.WriteRowElement((XmlPartManagerBase)(object)this, (uint?)(uint)(row.Index + 1), (List<string>)null, num, flag, num2, row.Hidden, row.HasCustomHeight, (byte)row.OutlineLevel, rowCache.HasCollapseIndicator, row.HasThickTop, row.HasThickBottom, false);
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = (row.HasCellFormat ? row.CellFormatInternal.Element : null);
			string rowString = CellAddress.GetRowString(row.Index, rowAddressIsRelative: true, saveManager.Workbook.CurrentFormat, row.Index, relativeAddressesAreOffsets: false, CellReferenceMode.A1);
			int num3 = 0;
			foreach (CellDataContext cellsWithDatum in row.GetCellsWithData())
			{
				if (cellsWithDatum.CellFormatData == null)
				{
					cellsWithDatum.CellFormatData = worksheetCellFormatData ?? _worksheet.GetColumnBlock(cellsWithDatum.ColumnIndex).CellFormat;
				}
				SaveCElement(saveManager, row, rowCache, rowString, cellsWithDatum);
				num3++;
			}
			((XmlPartManagerBase)this).XmlWriteManager.WriteEndElement();
			return num3;
		}

	internal class ExternalNamedReference : NamedReferenceBase
	{
		private ExternalNamedCalcReference calcReference;

		private ExternalWorkbookReference workbook;

		internal override RefBase CalcReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (calcReference == null)
				{
					calcReference = new ExternalNamedCalcReference(this);
					workbook.TargetWorkbook.AddNamedReference(calcReference);
				}
				return calcReference;
			}
		}

		internal override CultureInfo Culture => workbook.TargetWorkbook.CultureResolved;

		internal override WorkbookFormat CurrentFormat => workbook.TargetWorkbook.CurrentFormat;

		internal override Workbook Workbook => null;

		internal override WorkbookReferenceBase WorkbookReference => workbook;

		internal override bool CanUndo => false;

		public ExternalNamedReference(ExternalWorkbookReference workbook, object scope)
			: base(scope, hidden: false)
		{
			this.workbook = workbook;
		}

		internal override void OnFormulaChanged(bool synchronizeBuiltInReferences)
		{
			if (base.FormulaInternal != null && base.FormulaInternal.PostfixTokenList.Length != 0)
			{
				CalcReference.SetAndCompileFormula(base.FormulaInternal, canClearPreviouslyCalculatedValue: false);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(GetFormulaStringInfo.Default);
		}

		internal override string ToString(GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, bool forceIncludeScopeName = false)
		{
			if (base.Scope is WorkbookReferenceBase)
			{
				return workbook.GetWorkbookReferenceString(getFormulaStringInfo, forceIncludeScopeName) + base.Name;
			}
			if (base.Scope is WorksheetReference worksheetReference)
			{
				return worksheetReference.GetReferenceName(getFormulaStringInfo, forceIncludeScopeName) + base.Name;
			}
			return base.Name;
		}
	}
	internal class ExternalWorkbookReference : WorkbookReferenceBase
	{
		private string workbookFileName;

		private List<string> worksheetNames;

		public override string FileName => workbookFileName;

		public override bool IsExternal => true;

		protected override FormulaType NamedReferenceFormulaType => FormulaType.ExternalNamedReferenceFormula;

		public List<string> WorksheetNames => worksheetNames;

		public ExternalWorkbookReference(string workbookFileName, Workbook targetWorkbook)
			: base(targetWorkbook)
		{
			this.workbookFileName = workbookFileName;
			worksheetNames = new List<string>();
		}

		public override NamedReferenceBase CreateNamedReference(string name, object scope)
		{
			ExternalNamedReference externalNamedReference = new ExternalNamedReference(this, scope);
			externalNamedReference.SetNameInternal(name, validateName: false);
			return externalNamedReference;
		}

		public override WorksheetReferenceSingle CreateWorksheetReference(int worksheetIndex)
		{
			return worksheetIndex switch
			{
				-1 => new WorksheetReferenceError(this), 
				-2 => new WorksheetReferenceToWorkbook(this), 
				_ => new WorksheetReferenceExternal(this, worksheetIndex), 
			};
		}

		public override string GetWorksheetName(int worksheetIndex)
		{
			return worksheetIndex switch
			{
				-1 => "#REF!", 
				-2 => null, 
				_ => worksheetNames[worksheetIndex], 
			};
		}

		public override WorksheetReferenceSingle GetWorksheetReference(string worksheetName)
		{
			if (worksheetName == null)
			{
				return GetWorksheetReference(-2);
			}
			CultureInfo cultureResolved = base.TargetWorkbook.CultureResolved;
			if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(worksheetName, "#REF!", cultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return GetWorksheetReference(-1);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < worksheetNames.Count; i++)
			{
				string text = worksheetNames[i];
				if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(text, worksheetName, cultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return GetWorksheetReference(i);
				}
			}
			worksheetNames.Add(worksheetName);
			return GetWorksheetReference(worksheetNames.Count - 1);
		}

		public override string GetWorksheetReferenceString(int firstWorksheetIndex, int lastWorksheetIndex, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, bool forceIncludeScopeName)
		{
			bool isIndexed;
			string resolvedFileName = GetResolvedFileName(getFormulaStringInfo, out isIndexed);
			if (firstWorksheetIndex == lastWorksheetIndex)
			{
				return Utilities.CreateReferenceString(resolvedFileName, isIndexed, GetWorksheetName(firstWorksheetIndex), null);
			}
			return Utilities.CreateReferenceString(resolvedFileName, isIndexed, GetWorksheetName(firstWorksheetIndex), GetWorksheetName(lastWorksheetIndex));
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return workbookFileName;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class MultipleCellValueInfo
	{
		public delegate bool ShouldIncludeInMultipleCellValueCallback(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, WorksheetRow row, CellDataContext cellDataContext, out object value);

		private WorksheetRow row;

		private WorksheetRowSerializationCache rowCache;

		private List<WorksheetCellFormatData> cellFormats;

		private List<short> columnIndexes;

		private List<object> values;

		public int FirstColumnIndex => columnIndexes[0];

		public int LastColumnIndex => columnIndexes[columnIndexes.Count - 1];

		public int NumberOfCells => columnIndexes.Count;

		public WorksheetRowSerializationCache RowCache => rowCache;

		public int RowIndex => row.Index;

		protected MultipleCellValueInfo(WorksheetRow row, WorksheetRowSerializationCache rowCache, List<WorksheetCellFormatData> cellFormats, List<short> columnIndexes, List<object> values)
		{
			this.row = row;
			this.rowCache = rowCache;
			this.cellFormats = cellFormats;
			this.columnIndexes = columnIndexes;
			this.values = values;
		}

		public WorksheetCellFormatData GetCellFormat(int index)
		{
			return cellFormats[index];
		}

		private static WorksheetCellFormatData GetCellFormat(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, WorksheetCellFormatData rowFormat)
		{
			return row.TryGetCellFormat(columnIndex) ?? rowFormat;
		}

		public static bool GetMultipleCellInfoHelper(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, ShouldIncludeInMultipleCellValueCallback callback, out List<WorksheetCellFormatData> cellFormats, out List<short> columnIndexes, out List<object> values)
		{
			cellFormats = null;
			columnIndexes = null;
			values = null;
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = saveManager.CurrentCellContext.Row;
			if (!callback(saveManager, worksheetRow, saveManager.CurrentCellDataContext, out var value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Workbook workbook = worksheetRow.Worksheet.Workbook;
			WorksheetCellFormatData rowFormat = ((!worksheetRow.HasCellFormat) ? workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement : worksheetRow.CellFormatInternal.Element);
			cellFormats = new List<WorksheetCellFormatData>();
			columnIndexes = new List<short>();
			values = new List<object>();
			short columnIndex = saveManager.CurrentCellDataContext.ColumnIndex;
			cellFormats.Add(GetCellFormat(worksheetRow, columnIndex, rowFormat));
			columnIndexes.Add(columnIndex);
			values.Add(value);
			int maxColumnCountInternal = workbook.MaxColumnCountInternal;
			for (short num = (short)(columnIndex + 1); num < maxColumnCountInternal; num++)
			{
				CellDataContext cellDataContext = worksheetRow.GetCellDataContext(num);
				if (cellDataContext == null || !callback(saveManager, worksheetRow, cellDataContext, out value))
				{
					break;
				}
				cellFormats.Add(GetCellFormat(worksheetRow, num, rowFormat));
				columnIndexes.Add(num);
				values.Add(value);
			}
			return columnIndexes.Count >= 2;
		}

		public object GetValue(int index)
		{
			return values[index];
		}
	}
	internal class MultipleCellBlankInfo : MultipleCellValueInfo
	{
		private static readonly ShouldIncludeInMultipleCellValueCallback ShouldIncludeValueCallback = ShouldIncludeValue;

		private MultipleCellBlankInfo(WorksheetRow row, WorksheetRowSerializationCache rowCache, List<WorksheetCellFormatData> cellFormats, List<short> columnIndexes, List<object> values)
			: base(row, rowCache, cellFormats, columnIndexes, values)
		{
		}

		public static MultipleCellBlankInfo GetMultipleCellBlankInfo(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			if (!MultipleCellValueInfo.GetMultipleCellInfoHelper(saveManager, ShouldIncludeValueCallback, out var list, out var list2, out var list3))
			{
				return null;
			}
			WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003.CellContext currentCellContext = saveManager.CurrentCellContext;
			return new MultipleCellBlankInfo(currentCellContext.Row, currentCellContext.RowCache, list, list2, list3);
		}

		private static bool ShouldIncludeValue(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, WorksheetRow row, CellDataContext cellDataContext, out object value)
		{
			value = saveManager.GetSerializableCellValue(row, cellDataContext);
			return Utilities.IsNullResolved(value);
		}
	}
	internal class MultipleCellRKInfo : MultipleCellValueInfo
	{
		private static readonly ShouldIncludeInMultipleCellValueCallback ShouldIncludeValueCallback = ShouldIncludeValue;

		private MultipleCellRKInfo(WorksheetRow row, WorksheetRowSerializationCache rowCache, List<WorksheetCellFormatData> cellFormats, List<short> columnIndexes, List<object> values)
			: base(row, rowCache, cellFormats, columnIndexes, values)
		{
		}

		public static MultipleCellRKInfo GetMultipleCellRKInfo(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
		{
			if (!MultipleCellValueInfo.GetMultipleCellInfoHelper(saveManager, ShouldIncludeValueCallback, out var list, out var list2, out var list3))
			{
				return null;
			}
			WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003.CellContext currentCellContext = saveManager.CurrentCellContext;
			return new MultipleCellRKInfo(currentCellContext.Row, currentCellContext.RowCache, list, list2, list3);
		}

		private static bool ShouldIncludeValue(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, WorksheetRow row, CellDataContext cellDataContext, out object value)
		{
			value = null;
			object serializableCellValue = saveManager.GetSerializableCellValue(row, cellDataContext);
			if (!Utilities.IsNumber(serializableCellValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			double value2 = Convert.ToDouble(serializableCellValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			if (!Utilities.TryEncodeRKValue(value2, out var rkValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = rkValue;
			return true;
		}
	}

				return true;
			}

			bool IEG_AnchorVisitor<Tuple<Worksheet, WorksheetShape>, bool>.VisitCT_TwoCellAnchor(CT_TwoCellAnchor value, Tuple<Worksheet, WorksheetShape> argument)
			{
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Worksheet item = argument.Item1;
				WorksheetShape item2 = argument.Item2;
				item2.PositioningMode = value.EditAs.ToShapePositioningMode();
				if (value.From == null || value.To == null)
				{
					item2.SetBoundsInTwips(item, Utilities.CreateRectangle(0, 0, 1, 1));
					return false;
				}
				Tuple<WorksheetCellAddress, PointF> tuple = value.From.ToWorksheetCellAndPosition(item);
				Tuple<WorksheetCellAddress, PointF> tuple2 = value.To.ToWorksheetCellAndPosition(item);
				item2.SetAnchors(item, tuple.Item1, tuple.Item2, tuple2.Item1, tuple2.Item2);
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class UpdateIndexedWorkbookReferencesVisitor : FormulaTokenVisitor
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static UpdateIndexedWorkbookReferencesVisitor _instance;

			private WorkbookLoadManager _loadManager;

			private UpdateIndexedWorkbookReferencesVisitor()
			{
			}

			public override void Reset()
			{
				_loadManager = null;
				base.Reset();
			}

			public override void VisitCellReferenceToken(CellReferenceToken token)
			{
				WorksheetReference worksheet = token.WorksheetReference;
				if (UpdateIndexedWorkbookReference(ref worksheet))
				{
					token.WorksheetReference = worksheet;
				}
			}

			public static UpdateIndexedWorkbookReferencesVisitor Initialize(FormulaContext context, WorkbookLoadManager loadManager)
			{
				if (_instance == null)
				{
					_instance = new UpdateIndexedWorkbookReferencesVisitor();
				}
				_instance._loadManager = loadManager;
				_instance.Context = context;
				return _instance;
			}

			private bool UpdateIndexedWorkbookReference(ref WorksheetReference worksheet)
			{
				if (worksheet == null || worksheet.IsConnected || worksheet.WorkbookReference == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(worksheet.WorkbookReference.FileName))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!int.TryParse(worksheet.WorkbookReference.FileName, out var result))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (result < 0 || _loadManager.WorkbookReferences.Count <= result)
				{
					return false;
				}
				WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReference = _loadManager.WorkbookReferences[result];
				worksheet = worksheet.Connect(workbookReference);
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override void OnAfterLoadGlobalSettings()
		{
			foreach (NamedReferenceInfo namedReferenceInfo in NamedReferenceInfos)
			{
				AddInternalNamedReference(namedReferenceInfo.Reference, namedReferenceInfo.Hidden);
			}
			base.OnAfterLoadGlobalSettings();
			base.Workbook.IterateFormulas(delegate(Worksheet ws, Formula f)
			{
				FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(base.Workbook, f);
				UpdateIndexedWorkbookReferencesVisitor updateIndexedWorkbookReferencesVisitor = UpdateIndexedWorkbookReferencesVisitor.Initialize(context, this);
				updateIndexedWorkbookReferencesVisitor.VisitAll();
			}, base.Workbook.NamedReferences, base.Workbook.Worksheets);
		}

		public void AttachRootLevelShapeToWorksheet(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			EG_Anchor shapeAnchor = GetShapeAnchor(shape);
			shapeAnchor.Accept<Tuple<Worksheet, WorksheetShape>, bool>((IEG_AnchorVisitor<Tuple<Worksheet, WorksheetShape>, bool>)ShapeAnchorApplicator.Instance, Tuple.Create(worksheet, shape));
			PrepareShapeToBeAttached(worksheet, shape);
			worksheet.Shapes.Add(shape);
		}

			return value;
		}

			_worksheetsByPartName.TryGetValue(partPath, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public static void PreprocessLoadedFormula(ref string value)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && !value.StartsWith("="))
			{
				value = value.Insert(0, "=");
			}
		}

		}

		public static bool TryGetDxf(UnknownElementCache formatElement, ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager manager, out WorksheetCellFormatData dxf)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			dxf = null;
			AttributeValue? attribute = formatElement.GetAttribute("dxfId", (OfficeDocumentManager)(object)manager);
			if (!attribute.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!int.TryParse(attribute.Value.Value, out var result))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (result < 0 || manager.LoadManager.Dxfs.Count <= result)
			{
				return false;
			}
			dxf = manager.LoadManager.Dxfs[result];
			return true;
		}

		private void PrepareShapeToBeAttached(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			if (!(shape is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetShape item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)worksheetShapeGroup.Shapes)
			{
				SetChildShapeBoundsFromTransform(worksheet, item, worksheetShapeGroup);
				PrepareShapeToBeAttached(worksheet, item);
			}
			worksheetShapeGroup.OnLoadComplete();
		}

		private void SetChildShapeBoundsFromTransform(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetShape shape, WorksheetShapeGroup owningGroup)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CT_Transform2D shapeTransform = GetShapeTransform(shape);
			CT_GroupTransform2D groupTransform = (CT_GroupTransform2D)GetShapeTransform(owningGroup);
			Rectangle absoluteShapeBoundsInTwips = GetAbsoluteShapeBoundsInTwips(shapeTransform, shape.Rotation, groupTransform, owningGroup.GetBoundsInTwips());
			shape.SetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, absoluteShapeBoundsInTwips);
		}
	}
	internal class WorkbookReferenceUnconnected : WorkbookReferenceBase
	{
		private readonly bool _isOleObjectLink;

		private readonly string _workbookFileName;

		public override string FileName => _workbookFileName;

		public override bool IsConnected => false;

		public override bool IsExternal => _workbookFileName != null;

		protected override FormulaType NamedReferenceFormulaType
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsExternal)
				{
					return FormulaType.ExternalNamedReferenceFormula;
				}
				return FormulaType.NamedReferenceFormula;
			}
		}

		public WorkbookReferenceUnconnected(string workbookFileName, bool isOleObjectLink = false)
			: base(null)
		{
			_isOleObjectLink = isOleObjectLink;
			_workbookFileName = workbookFileName;
		}

		internal override WorkbookReferenceBase Connect(FormulaContext context)
		{
			if (context.Workbook == null)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (_isOleObjectLink)
			{
				FormulaParser.ParseOleObjectLink(_workbookFileName, out var progId, out var objectLink);
				return context.Workbook.GetWorkbookReference(progId, objectLink);
			}
			return context.Workbook.GetWorkbookReference(_workbookFileName);
		}

		public override NamedReferenceBase CreateNamedReference(string name, object scope)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override WorksheetReferenceSingle CreateWorksheetReference(int worksheetIndex)
		{
			return worksheetIndex switch
			{
				-1 => new WorksheetReferenceError(this), 
				-2 => new WorksheetReferenceToWorkbook(this), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal override WorkbookReferenceUnconnected Disconnect()
		{
			return this;
		}

		public override string GetWorksheetName(int worksheetIndex)
		{
			return worksheetIndex switch
			{
				-1 => "#REF!", 
				-2 => null, 
				_ => worksheetIndex.ToString(), 
			};
		}

		public override WorksheetReferenceSingle GetWorksheetReference(string worksheetName)
		{
			if (worksheetName == null)
			{
				return GetWorksheetReference(-2);
			}
			if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(worksheetName, "#REF!", Utilities.CurrentCulture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return GetWorksheetReference(-1);
			}
			return new WorksheetReferenceSingleUnconnected(this, worksheetName);
		}

		public override string GetWorksheetReferenceString(int firstWorksheetIndex, int lastWorksheetIndex, GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, bool forceIncludeScopeName)
		{
			if (firstWorksheetIndex == lastWorksheetIndex)
			{
				return Utilities.CreateReferenceString(FileName, GetWorksheetName(firstWorksheetIndex));
			}
			return Utilities.CreateReferenceString(FileName, GetWorksheetName(firstWorksheetIndex), GetWorksheetName(lastWorksheetIndex));
		}
	}

	internal abstract class WorkbookSaveManager : WorkbookSerializationManager, IColorFilterVisitor<bool, WorksheetCellFormatData>, IColorSortConditionVisitor<WorksheetTableColumn, bool>
	{
		private class InitSerializationCacheFormulaHelper : FormulaTokenVisitor
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static InitSerializationCacheFormulaHelper _instance;

			private WorkbookSaveManager _saveManager;

			private InitSerializationCacheFormulaHelper()
			{
			}

			public override void Reset()
			{
				_saveManager = null;
				base.Reset();
			}

			public override void VisitNameToken(NameToken token)
			{
				NamedReferenceBase namedReferenceBase = token.NamedReference;
				RetainNamedReference(ref namedReferenceBase);
				token.NamedReference = namedReferenceBase;
				VisitReferenceToken(token);
			}

			public override void VisitReferenceToken(ReferenceToken token)
			{
				RetainWorksheetReference(token.WorksheetReference);
			}

			public override void VisitStructuredTableReference(StructuredTableReference token)
			{
				RetainWorkbookReference(token.WorkbookReference);
				VisitReferenceToken(token);
			}

			public static InitSerializationCacheFormulaHelper Initialize(FormulaContext context, WorkbookSaveManager saveManager)
			{
				if (_instance == null)
				{
					_instance = new InitSerializationCacheFormulaHelper();
				}
				_instance._saveManager = saveManager;
				_instance.Context = context;
				return _instance;
			}

			private void RetainNamedReference(ref NamedReferenceBase namedReferenceBase)
			{
				RetainWorkbookReference(namedReferenceBase.WorkbookReference);
				WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReferenceBase = namedReferenceBase.WorkbookReference ?? _saveManager.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference;
				object scope = namedReferenceBase.Scope ?? workbookReferenceBase.WorkbookScope;
				namedReferenceBase = workbookReferenceBase.GetNamedReference(namedReferenceBase.Name, scope, createIfNotPresent: true);
			}

			private void RetainWorkbookReference(WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReference)
			{
				if (workbookReference != null && !_saveManager.WorkbookReferences.Contains(workbookReference))
				{
					_saveManager.WorkbookReferences.Add(workbookReference);
				}
			}

			private void RetainWorksheetReference(WorksheetReference worksheetReference)
			{
				if (worksheetReference != null)
				{
					RetainWorkbookReference(worksheetReference.WorkbookReference);
					if (!_saveManager.WorksheetReferences.Contains(worksheetReference))
					{
						_saveManager.WorksheetReferences.Add(worksheetReference);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private class InitSerializationCacheHelper : WorksheetShapeVisitor<WorkbookSaveManager, bool>, IStringElementVisitor<Tuple<WorkbookSaveManager, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver>, bool>
		{
			public static readonly InitSerializationCacheHelper Instance = new InitSerializationCacheHelper();

			private InitSerializationCacheHelper()
			{
			}

			bool IStringElementVisitor<Tuple<WorkbookSaveManager, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver>, bool>.VisitFormattedStringElement(FormattedStringElement value, Tuple<WorkbookSaveManager, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver> argument)
			{
				if (!value.HasFormatting)
				{
					return true;
				}
				WorkbookSaveManager item = argument.Item1;
				IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver item2 = argument.Item2;
				foreach (FormattingRunBase formattingRun in value.FormattingRuns)
				{
					if (formattingRun.HasFont)
					{
						item.AddFont(formattingRun.GetFontInternal(item.Workbook), item2);
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IStringElementVisitor<Tuple<WorkbookSaveManager, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver>, bool>.VisitStringElement(StringElement value, Tuple<WorkbookSaveManager, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver> argument)
			{
				return true;
			}

			public override bool VisitWorksheetCellComment(WorksheetCellComment value, WorkbookSaveManager saveManager)
			{
				if (value.Text != null)
				{
					value.Text.Element.Accept(this, Tuple.Create(saveManager, (IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver)value));
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override bool VisitWorksheetChart(WorksheetChart value, WorkbookSaveManager saveManager)
			{
				if (value.FontXInfos != null)
				{
					foreach (FontXInfo fontXInfo in value.FontXInfos)
					{
						if (fontXInfo.WorkbookFont != null && !saveManager.Fonts.Contains(fontXInfo.WorkbookFont))
						{
							saveManager.Fonts.Add(fontXInfo.WorkbookFont);
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override bool VisitWorksheetShapeGroup(WorksheetShapeGroup value, WorkbookSaveManager saveManager)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetShape item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)value.Shapes)
				{
					item.Accept(this, saveManager);
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override bool VisitWorksheetShapeWithText(WorksheetShapeWithText value, WorkbookSaveManager saveManager)
			{
				if (value.Text != null)
				{
					saveManager.InitFormattedText(value.Text, value);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		WorksheetCellFormatData IColorFilterVisitor<bool, WorksheetCellFormatData>.VisitFillFilter(FillFilter value, bool argument)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = base.Workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat);
			worksheetCellFormatData.IsForFillOrSortCondition = true;
			worksheetCellFormatData.Fill = value.Fill.ToResolvedColorFill(base.Workbook);
			return worksheetCellFormatData;
		}

		WorksheetCellFormatData IColorFilterVisitor<bool, WorksheetCellFormatData>.VisitFontColorFilter(FontColorFilter value, bool argument)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = base.Workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat);
			worksheetCellFormatData.IsForFillOrSortCondition = true;
			Color resolvedColorInternal = value.FontColorInfo.GetResolvedColorInternal(base.Workbook);
			worksheetCellFormatData.Fill = new CellFillPattern(new WorkbookColorInfo(resolvedColorInternal), new WorkbookColorInfo(ColorsInternal.White), FillPatternStyle.Solid, null, isCreatedInternally: true);
			return worksheetCellFormatData;
		}

		bool IColorSortConditionVisitor<WorksheetTableColumn, bool>.VisitFillSortCondition(FillSortCondition value, WorksheetTableColumn column)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = base.Workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat);
			worksheetCellFormatData.IsForFillOrSortCondition = true;
			worksheetCellFormatData.Fill = value.Fill;
			_columnSortConditionDxfIds[column] = AddDxf(worksheetCellFormatData);
			return true;
		}

		bool IColorSortConditionVisitor<WorksheetTableColumn, bool>.VisitFontColorSortCondition(FontColorSortCondition value, WorksheetTableColumn column)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = base.Workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat);
			worksheetCellFormatData.IsForFillOrSortCondition = true;
			worksheetCellFormatData.Font.ColorInfo = value.FontColorInfo;
			_columnSortConditionDxfIds[column] = AddDxf(worksheetCellFormatData);
			return true;
		}

		public void AddFont(WorkbookFontProxy fontProxy, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver defaultsResolver)
		{
			WorkbookFontData workbookFontData = fontProxy.Element.ResolvedFontData(defaultsResolver);
			if (!_fontIndexHash.TryGetValue(workbookFontData, out var value))
			{
				value = (ushort)base.Fonts.Count;
				base.Fonts.Add(workbookFontData);
				_fontIndexHash.Add(workbookFontData, value);
			}
			fontProxy.SaveIndex = value;
		}

		public void GetAreaFormatInfo<T>(WorksheetTableAreaFormatsCollection<T> areaFormats, T area, out WorkbookStyle style, out WorksheetCellFormatData dxf)
		{
			GetAreaFormatInfo(areaFormats, area, out style, out dxf, out var _);
		}

		public void GetAreaFormatInfo<T>(WorksheetTableAreaFormatsCollection<T> areaFormats, T area, out WorkbookStyle style, out WorksheetCellFormatData dxf, out WorksheetCellFormatData borderDxf, params CellFormatValue[] borderValues)
		{
			style = null;
			dxf = null;
			borderDxf = null;
			WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<T> worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy = areaFormats.TryGetFormatProxy(area);
			if (worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy.Element;
			style = worksheetCellFormatData.Style;
			if (borderValues.Length != 0)
			{
				worksheetCellFormatData = worksheetCellFormatData.CloneInternal();
				borderDxf = base.Workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat);
				foreach (CellFormatValue value in borderValues)
				{
					Utilities.CopyCellFormatValue(worksheetCellFormatData, borderDxf, value);
					worksheetCellFormatData.ResetValue(value);
				}
				if (borderDxf.IsEmpty)
				{
					borderDxf = null;
				}
				if (!worksheetCellFormatData.IsAnyBorderPropertySet())
				{
					worksheetCellFormatData.FormatOptions &= ~WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting;
				}
			}
			if (!worksheetCellFormatData.IsEmpty)
			{
				dxf = worksheetCellFormatData;
			}
		}

		public object GetSerializableCellValue(WorksheetRow row, CellDataContext cellDataContext, bool getCalculatedFormulaValues = false)
		{
			short columnIndex = cellDataContext.ColumnIndex;
			WorksheetMergedCellsRegion cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal = row.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal(columnIndex);
			if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal != null && (row.Index != cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal.FirstRow || columnIndex != cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal.FirstColumnInternal))
			{
				return null;
			}
			WorksheetCellBlock cellBlock = cellDataContext.CellBlock;
			if (cellBlock == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (getCalculatedFormulaValues && cellBlock.DoesCellUseCalculations(cellDataContext.DataType, cellDataContext.CellValue))
			{
				return GetSerializableCellValue(cellBlock.GetCalculatedValue(row, columnIndex));
			}
			return GetSerializableCellValue(cellBlock.GetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex, this, cellDataContext.DataType, cellDataContext.CellValue));
		}

		private static object GetSerializableCellValue(object cellValue)
		{
			ErrorValue errorValue = cellValue as ErrorValue;
			if (errorValue == ErrorValue.Circularity)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return cellValue;
		}

		public WorkItem Save()
		{
			Workbook workbook = base.Workbook;
			foreach (Worksheet item in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)workbook.Worksheets)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetRow item2 in GetRowsToSave(item))
				{
					item2.VerifyThicknesses();
				}
			}
			workbook.SharedStringTable.OnSaving();
			workbook.CellFormats.OnSaving();
			return Async.Try((Func<WorkItem>)delegate
			{
				if (workbook.CalculationMode == CalculationMode.Manual && workbook.RecalculateBeforeSave)
				{
					workbook.Recalculate();
				}
				InitializeCellFormats();
				InitStrings();
				workbook.CustomTableStyles.ForEach(InitWorksheetTableStyle);
				Worksheets.ForEach(InitWorksheet);
				if (_workbookHasCharts)
				{
					foreach (Worksheet worksheet in Worksheets)
					{
						workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.GetWorksheetReference(worksheet.Name, null);
					}
				}
				InitShapes();
				InitReferences();
				return SaveCore();
			}, (Action)delegate
			{
				workbook.SharedStringTable.OnSaved();
				workbook.CellFormats.OnSaved();
			});
		}

		public static void SeparateHyperlinkInfo(WorksheetHyperlink hyperlink, out string targetAddress, out string location, out string displayValue)
		{
			displayValue = hyperlink.DisplayText;
			if (displayValue == null)
			{
				if (hyperlink.SourceCell != null)
				{
					displayValue = hyperlink.SourceCell.GetText(TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth);
				}
				else
				{
					displayValue = hyperlink.SourceRegion.TopRow.GetCellTextInternal(hyperlink.SourceRegion.FirstColumnInternal, TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth);
				}
			}
			string targetAddress2 = hyperlink.TargetAddress;
			if (hyperlink.Target is string && !hyperlink.IsInvalidTargetLocation)
			{
				int num = targetAddress2.IndexOf('#');
				if (0 <= num)
				{
					targetAddress = targetAddress2.Substring(0, num);
					location = targetAddress2.Substring(num + 1);
				}
				else
				{
					targetAddress = targetAddress2;
					location = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				targetAddress = null;
				location = targetAddress2;
			}
		}

		private void InitNamedReferences()
		{

		private void InitNamedReferencesFromCustomView(CustomView customView)
		{
			if (!customView.SaveHiddenRowsAndColumns && !customView.SavePrintOptions)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Worksheet worksheet in Worksheets)
			{
				if (customView.SaveHiddenRowsAndColumns)
				{
					HiddenColumnCollection hiddenColumns = customView.GetHiddenColumns(worksheet);
					if (hiddenColumns != null)
					{
						NamedReference namedReference = hiddenColumns.CreateNamedReference();
						if (namedReference != null)
						{
							base.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.AddNamedReference(namedReference);
						}
					}
					HiddenRowCollection hiddenRows = customView.GetHiddenRows(worksheet);
					if (hiddenRows != null)
					{
						NamedReference namedReference2 = hiddenRows.CreateNamedReference();
						if (namedReference2 != null)
						{
							base.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.AddNamedReference(namedReference2);
						}
					}
				}
				if (customView.SavePrintOptions)
				{
					PrintOptions printOptions = customView.GetPrintOptions(worksheet);
					if (printOptions.ColumnsToRepeatAtLeft != null || printOptions.RowsToRepeatAtTop != null)
					{
						string name = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Z_{0}_.wvu.PrintTitles", new object[1] { customView.Id.ToString("D").Replace("-", "_").ToUpper(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
						NamedReference namedRef = null;
						printOptions.UpdatePrintTitlesNamedReference(base.Workbook, name, suppressNotifications: false, ref namedRef, out var _);
						namedRef.Hidden = true;
						base.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.AddNamedReference(namedRef);
					}
					if (printOptions.HasPrintAreas)
					{
						string name2 = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Z_{0}_.wvu.PrintArea", new object[1] { customView.Id.ToString("D").Replace("-", "_").ToUpper(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) });
						NamedReference namedRef2 = null;
						printOptions.UpdatePrintAreasNamedReference(base.Workbook, name2, suppressNotifications: false, ref namedRef2, out var _);
						namedRef2.Hidden = true;
						base.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.AddNamedReference(namedRef2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		}

		private void InitShapes(Worksheet worksheet, ref uint nextShapeId, ref ushort nextObjId)
		{

			InitShapesHelper(serializationCache, serializationCache.CommentShapes, shouldAssignIds: true, ref nextShapeId, ref nextObjId);
			serializationCache.MaxAssignedShapeId = nextShapeId - 1;
		}

		private void InitShapesHelper(WorksheetSerializationCache cache, IEnumerable<WorksheetShape> shapes, bool shouldAssignIds, ref uint nextShapeId, ref ushort nextObjId)
		{
			foreach (WorksheetShape shape2 in shapes)
			{

				PrepareShapeForSerialization(ref shape);
				if (shape != null)
				{
					_resolvedShapeMap[shape2] = shape;
					_workbookHasShapes = true;

					{
						_workbookHasCharts = true;
					}
					cache.NumberOfShapes++;
					if (shouldAssignIds)
					{
						shape.ShapeId = nextShapeId++;
						AssignObjId(shape, ref nextObjId);
					}
					if (shape is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
					{

					}

			}

		private void InitWorksheetTableStyle(WorksheetTableStyle tableStyle)

			foreach (WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableStyleArea> formatProxy in tableStyle.AreaFormats.GetFormatProxies())
			{
				tableStyleDxfIds.Add(formatProxy.Area, AddDxf(formatProxy.Element));
			}
			InitWorksheetTableStyleHelper(tableStyle, tableStyle.ColumnStripeWidth != 1, WorksheetTableStyleArea.ColumnStripe);
			InitWorksheetTableStyleHelper(tableStyle, tableStyle.AlternateColumnStripeWidth != 1, WorksheetTableStyleArea.AlternateColumnStripe);
			InitWorksheetTableStyleHelper(tableStyle, tableStyle.RowStripeHeight != 1, WorksheetTableStyleArea.RowStripe);
			InitWorksheetTableStyleHelper(tableStyle, tableStyle.AlternateRowStripeHeight != 1, WorksheetTableStyleArea.AlternateRowStripe);
		}

		private void InitWorksheetTableStyleHelper(WorksheetTableStyle tableStyle, bool forceWrite, WorksheetTableStyleArea area)
		{
			SortedList<WorksheetTableStyleArea, uint> tableStyleDxfIds = GetTableStyleDxfIds(tableStyle);
			if (forceWrite && !tableStyleDxfIds.ContainsKey(area))
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatData dxf = base.Workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat);
				tableStyleDxfIds.Add(area, AddDxf(dxf));
			}
		}
	}
