		private class PopuplateShapeKnownPropertiesVisitor : WorksheetShapeVisitor<WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003, bool>
		{
			public static readonly PopuplateShapeKnownPropertiesVisitor Instance = new PopuplateShapeKnownPropertiesVisitor();

			private PopuplateShapeKnownPropertiesVisitor()
			{
			}

			public override bool VisitWorksheetShape(WorksheetShape shape, WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (shape.DrawingProperties1 == null)
				{
					shape.DrawingProperties1 = new List<PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue>();
				}
				else
				{
					for (int num = shape.DrawingProperties1.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue propertyValue = shape.DrawingProperties1[num];
						switch (propertyValue.PropertyType)
						{
						case PropertyType.TransformRotation:
						case PropertyType.TextLeft:
						case PropertyType.TextTop:
						case PropertyType.TextRight:
						case PropertyType.TextBottom:
						case PropertyType.FillStyleColor:
						case PropertyType.FillStyleOpacity:
						case PropertyType.FillStyleNoFillHitTest:
						case PropertyType.LineStyleColor:
						case PropertyType.LineStyleOpacity:
						case PropertyType.LineStyleNoLineDrawDash:
							shape.DrawingProperties1.RemoveAt(num);
							break;
						case PropertyType.TextFitToShape:
						{
							if (!(propertyValue.Value is uint))
							{
								shape.DrawingProperties1.RemoveAt(num);
								break;
							}
							uint num3 = (uint)propertyValue.Value;
							propertyValue.Value = num3;
							break;
						}
						case PropertyType.GroupShapePrint:
						{
							if (!(propertyValue.Value is uint))
							{
								shape.DrawingProperties1.RemoveAt(num);
								break;
							}
							flag = true;
							uint num2 = (uint)propertyValue.Value;
							num2 = ((!shape.Visible) ? (num2 | 2) : (num2 & 0xFFFFFFFDu));
							propertyValue.Value = num2;
							break;
						}
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					uint num4 = 131072u;
					if (!shape.Visible)
					{
						num4 |= 2;
					}
					shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.GroupShapePrint, num4));
				}
				if (shape.CanHaveFill)
				{
					shape.FillResolved.PopulateDrawingProperties2003(shape);
				}
				if (shape.CanHaveOutline)
				{
					shape.OutlineResolved.PopulateDrawingProperties2003(shape);
				}
				if (shape.Rotation != 0f)
				{
					uint num5 = Utilities.ToFixedPoint16_16Value(shape.Rotation);
					shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.TransformRotation, num5));
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override bool VisitWorksheetShapeWithText(WorksheetShapeWithText shape, WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)
			{
				base.VisitWorksheetShapeWithText(shape, saveManager);
				if (shape.LeftMargin != 144)
				{
					shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.TextLeft, (uint)Utilities.TwipsToEMU(shape.LeftMargin)));
				}
				if (shape.TopMargin != 72)
				{
					shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.TextTop, (uint)Utilities.TwipsToEMU(shape.TopMargin)));
				}
				if (shape.RightMargin != 144)
				{
					shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.TextRight, (uint)Utilities.TwipsToEMU(shape.RightMargin)));
				}
				if (shape.BottomMargin != 72)
				{
					shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.TextBottom, (uint)Utilities.TwipsToEMU(shape.BottomMargin)));
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

			public override bool VisitWorksheetShape(WorksheetShape shape, WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager)

				{
					PopulateDrawingPropertiesForPredefinedShapes(shape);
				}
				shape.Accept(PopuplateShapeKnownPropertiesVisitor.Instance, saveManager);
				return true;
			}

			private static void PopuplateBLIPIdDrawingProperty(WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003 saveManager, Image image, ref List<PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue> drawingProperties1)
			{
				if (drawingProperties1 != null)
				{
					for (int num = drawingProperties1.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						if (drawingProperties1[num].IsBlipId)
						{
							drawingProperties1.RemoveAt(num);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					drawingProperties1 = new List<PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue>();
				}
				int num2 = saveManager.Images.IndexOf(new WorkbookSerializationDataExcel2003.ImageHolder(image));
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					drawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.BLIPId, (uint)(num2 + 1), isComplex: false, isBlipId: true));
				}
			}

			private void PopulateDrawingPropertiesForPredefinedShapes(WorksheetShape shape)
			{
				if (shape.DrawingProperties1 == null)
				{
					shape.DrawingProperties1 = new List<PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue>();
				}
				if (shape.DrawingProperties1.Count == 0)
				{
					if (shape.IsConnector)
					{
						shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.GeometryFillOK, 65536u, isComplex: false, isBlipId: false));
						shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue((PropertyType)771, 0u, isComplex: false, isBlipId: false));
					}
					else
					{
						if (shape is WorksheetShapeWithText { HasText: not false })
						{
							shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.ProtectionLockAgainstGrouping, 262144u, isComplex: false, isBlipId: false));
							shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.TextAnchorText, 1u, isComplex: false, isBlipId: false));
							shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.TextDirection, 2u, isComplex: false, isBlipId: false));
						}
						shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.TextFitToShape, 2031640u, isComplex: false, isBlipId: false));
						shape.DrawingProperties1.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.LineStyleWidth, 25400u, isComplex: false, isBlipId: false));
					}
				}
				if (shape.DrawingProperties3 == null)
				{
					shape.DrawingProperties3 = new List<PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue>();
				}
				if (shape.DrawingProperties3.Count == 0)
				{
					if (shape.IsConnector)
					{
						shape.DrawingProperties3.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.LineStyleNoLineDrawDash, 4194304u, isComplex: false, isBlipId: false));
					}
					else
					{
						shape.DrawingProperties3.Add(new PropertyTableBase.PropertyValue(PropertyType.LineStyleNoLineDrawDash, 4194304u, isComplex: false, isBlipId: false));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private class SaveAdditionalDataTokenVisitor : FormulaTokenVisitor
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static SaveAdditionalDataTokenVisitor _instance;

			private BiffRecordStream _stream;

			private SaveAdditionalDataTokenVisitor()
			{
			}

			public override void Reset()
			{
				_stream = null;
				base.Reset();
			}

			public override void VisitArrayToken(ArrayToken token)
			{
				int num = token.Values.Length;
				int num2 = token.Values[0].Length;
				_stream.Write((byte)(num - 1));
				_stream.Write((ushort)(num2 - 1));
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
					{
						Constant constant = token.Values[j][i];
						_stream.Write(constant.ConstantCode);
						constant.Save(_stream);
					}
				}
			}

			public override void VisitMemAreaOperator(MemAreaOperator token)
			{
				_stream.Write((ushort)token.Ranges.Length);
				for (int i = 0; i < token.Ranges.Length; i++)
				{
					_stream.Write(token.Ranges[i]);
				}
			}

			public static SaveAdditionalDataTokenVisitor Initialize(FormulaContext context, BiffRecordStream stream)
			{
				if (_instance == null)
				{
					_instance = new SaveAdditionalDataTokenVisitor();
				}
				_instance.Context = context;
				_instance._stream = stream;
				return _instance;
			}
		}

		private class SaveTokenVisitor : FormulaTokenVisitor
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static SaveTokenVisitor _instance;

			private static readonly byte[] _empty7Bytes = new byte[7];

			private static readonly byte[] _empty8Bytes = new byte[8];

			private bool _isForExternalNamedReference;

			private FormulaToken[] _resolvedTokenList;

			private BiffRecordStream _stream;

			private long[] _tokenPositionsInRecordStream;

			private SaveTokenVisitor()
			{
			}

			public override void DefaultVisit(FormulaToken token)
			{
			}

			public override void Reset()
			{
				_isForExternalNamedReference = false;
				_resolvedTokenList = null;
				_stream = null;
				_tokenPositionsInRecordStream = null;
				base.Reset();
			}

			public override void VisitAll()
			{
				int num = _resolvedTokenList.Length;
				base.CurrentTokenIndex = 0;
				while (base.CurrentTokenIndex < num)
				{
					FormulaToken formulaToken = _resolvedTokenList[base.CurrentTokenIndex];
					_stream.Write((byte)formulaToken.Token);
					formulaToken.Accept(this);
					base.CurrentTokenIndex++;
				}
				Reset();
			}

			public override void VisitArea3DToken(Area3DToken token)
			{
				Save3DData(token.WorksheetReference);
				VisitAreaToken(token);
			}

			public override void VisitAreaErrToken(AreaErrToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write(_empty8Bytes);
			}

			public override void VisitAreaToken(AreaToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write(token.CellAddressRange);
			}

			public override void VisitArrayToken(ArrayToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write(_empty7Bytes);
			}

			public override void VisitAttrChooseToken(AttrChooseToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write((byte)token.Type);
				_stream.Write((ushort)token.SkipTokenIndexes.Count);
				long num = _tokenPositionsInRecordStream[base.CurrentTokenIndex];
				byte attrChooseTokenSize = GetSizeTokenVisitor.GetAttrChooseTokenSize(token);
				_stream.Write((ushort)(attrChooseTokenSize - 4));
				for (int i = 0; i < token.SkipTokenIndexes.Count; i++)
				{
					long num2 = _tokenPositionsInRecordStream[token.SkipTokenIndexes[i]];
					_stream.Write((ushort)(num2 - num));
				}
			}

			public override void VisitAttrIfToken(AttrIfToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write((byte)token.Type);
				if (token.SkipTokenIndexes.Count == 0)
				{
					_stream.Write((ushort)0);
					return;
				}
				long num = _tokenPositionsInRecordStream[base.CurrentTokenIndex];
				long num2 = num + 4;
				long num3 = _tokenPositionsInRecordStream[token.SkipTokenIndexes[0]];
				long num4 = num3 + 4;
				_stream.Write((ushort)(num4 - num2));
			}

			public override void VisitAttrSkipToken(AttrSkipToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write((byte)token.Type);
				long num = _tokenPositionsInRecordStream[base.CurrentTokenIndex];
				long num2 = num + 4;
				long num3 = _tokenPositionsInRecordStream[token.OwningSelectorFunctionIndex];
				long num4 = num3 + 4;
				_stream.Write((ushort)(num4 - num2 - 1));
			}

			public override void VisitAttrSpaceToken(AttrSpaceToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write((byte)token.Type);
				_stream.Write((byte)token.WhitespaceType);
				_stream.Write(token.NumberOfWhitespaceChars);
			}

			public override void VisitAttrSumToken(AttrSumToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write((byte)token.Type);
				_stream.Write((ushort)0);
			}

			public override void VisitAttrVolatileToken(AttrVolatileToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write((byte)token.Type);
				_stream.Write((ushort)0);
			}

			public override void VisitBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorToken token)
			{
			}

			public override void VisitBoolToken(BoolToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write((byte)(token.Value ? 1u : 0u));
			}

			public override void VisitErrToken(ErrToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write(token.Value.Value);
			}

			public override void VisitExpToken(ExpToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write((ushort)token.CellAddress.Row);
				_stream.Write((ushort)token.CellAddress.Column);
			}

			public override void VisitFunctionOperator(FunctionOperator token)
			{
				_stream.Write((ushort)token.Function.ID);
			}

			public override void VisitFunctionVOperator(FunctionVOperator token)
			{
				byte b = token.ArgumentCount;
				if (token.Function.IsAddIn)
				{
					b++;
				}
				_stream.Write(b);
				VisitFunctionOperator(token);
			}

			public override void VisitIntToken(IntToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write(token.Value);
			}

			public override void VisitMemAreaOperator(MemAreaOperator token)
			{
				_stream.Write(0u);
				_stream.Write(token.SizeOfRefSubExpression);
			}

			public override void VisitMemErrOperator(MemErrOperator token)
			{
				_stream.Write(0u);
				_stream.Write(token.SizeOfRefSubExpression);
			}

			public override void VisitMemFuncOperator(MemFuncOperator token)
			{
				_stream.Write(token.SizeOfRefSubExpression);
			}

			public override void VisitMemNoMemOperator(MemNoMemOperator token)
			{
				_stream.Write(0u);
				_stream.Write(token.SizeOfRefSubExpression);
			}

			public override void VisitMissArgToken(MissArgToken token)
			{
			}

			public override void VisitNameToken(NameToken token)
			{
				int num = _stream.SaveManager.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.NamedReferences.IndexOf(token.NamedReference);
				_stream.Write((ushort)(num + 1));
				_stream.Write((ushort)0);
			}

			public override void VisitNameXToken(NameXToken token)
			{
				Save3DData(token.WorksheetReference);
				int num = token.WorksheetReference.WorkbookReference.NamedReferences.IndexOf(token.NamedReference);
				_stream.Write((ushort)(num + 1));
				_stream.Write((ushort)0);
			}

			public override void VisitNumberToken(NumberToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write(token.Value);
			}

			public override void VisitParenToken(ParenToken token)
			{
			}

			public override void VisitRef3DToken(Ref3DToken token)
			{
				Save3DData(token.WorksheetReference);
				VisitRefToken(token);
			}

			public override void VisitRefErrToken(RefErrToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write(0u);
			}

			public override void VisitRefToken(RefToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write(token.CellAddress);
			}

			public override void VisitStrToken(StrToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write(token.Value, LengthType.EightBit);
			}

			public override void VisitStructuredTableReference(StructuredTableReference token)
			{
			}

			public override void VisitTblToken(TblToken token)
			{
				_stream.Write((ushort)token.CellAddress.Row);
				_stream.Write((ushort)token.CellAddress.Column);
			}

			public override void VisitUnaryOperatorToken(UnaryOperatorToken token)
			{
			}

			public static SaveTokenVisitor Initialize(FormulaContext context, BiffRecordStream stream, bool isForExternalNamedReference, FormulaToken[] resolvedTokenList, long[] tokenPositionsInRecordStream)
			{
				if (_instance == null)
				{
					_instance = new SaveTokenVisitor();
				}
				_instance.Context = context;
				_instance._stream = stream;
				_instance._isForExternalNamedReference = isForExternalNamedReference;
				_instance._resolvedTokenList = resolvedTokenList;
				_instance._tokenPositionsInRecordStream = tokenPositionsInRecordStream;
				return _instance;
			}

			private void Save3DData(WorksheetReference worksheetReference)
			{
				if (_isForExternalNamedReference)
				{
					_stream.Write((ushort)worksheetReference.FirstWorksheetIndex);
					_stream.Write((ushort)worksheetReference.LastWorksheetIndex);
				}
				else
				{
					int num = _stream.SaveManager.WorksheetReferences.IndexOf(worksheetReference);
					_stream.Write((ushort)num);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (CurrentRecordStream != null)
				{
					CurrentRecordStream.Dispose();
					CurrentRecordStream = null;
				}
				WorkbookStream.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public override ushort GetCellFormatIndex(WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatCollection cellFormats = base.Workbook.CellFormats;
			WorksheetCellFormatData defaultElement = cellFormats.DefaultElement;
			if (cellFormat == defaultElement)
			{
				return 15;
			}
			int num = cellFormats.FindIndex(defaultElement);
			int num2 = cellFormats.FindIndex(cellFormat);
			if (num2 > num)
			{
				num2--;
			}
			return (ushort)(_firstCellFormatXfId + num2);
		}

		public override ushort GetStyleFormatIndex(WorkbookStyle style)
		{
			base.StyleFormatXfIds.TryGetValue(style, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public override void InitializeCellFormats()
		{
			WorkbookStyleCollection styles = base.Workbook.Styles;
			WorkbookStyle normalStyle = styles.NormalStyle;
			WorksheetCellFormatData styleFormatInternal = normalStyle.StyleFormatInternal;
			AddFont(styleFormatInternal.FontInternal, styleFormatInternal);
			List<WorkbookFontData> fonts = base.Fonts;
			fonts.Add(fonts[0]);
			fonts.Add(fonts[0]);
			fonts.Add(fonts[0]);
			fonts.Add(null);
			AddStyle(normalStyle);
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX, 0));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX, 0));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX, 1));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX, 1));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX, 2));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX, 2));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX, 3));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX, 3));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX, 4));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX, 4));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX, 5));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX, 5));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX, 6));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX, 6));
			AddFormat(base.Workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement);
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.Comma));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.Comma0));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.Currency));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.Currency0));
			AddStyle(styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.Percent));
			foreach (WorkbookStyle item in (IEnumerable<WorkbookStyle>)base.Workbook.Styles)
			{
				if (!item.ShouldSaveIn2003)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (item is WorkbookBuiltInStyle workbookBuiltInStyle)
				{
					switch (workbookBuiltInStyle.Type)
					{
					case BuiltInStyleType.Normal:
					case BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX:
					case BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX:
					case BuiltInStyleType.Comma:
					case BuiltInStyleType.Currency:
					case BuiltInStyleType.Percent:
					case BuiltInStyleType.Comma0:
					case BuiltInStyleType.Currency0:
						Styles.Add(item);
						continue;
					}
				}
				Styles.Add(item);
				AddStyle(item);
			}
			_firstCellFormatXfId = Formats.Count;
			WorksheetCellFormatCollection cellFormats = base.Workbook.CellFormats;
			foreach (WorksheetCellFormatData item2 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetCellFormatData>)cellFormats)
			{
				if (item2 != cellFormats.DefaultElement)
				{
					AddFormat(item2);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void InitImageShape(IWorksheetImage imageShape)
		{
			base.InitImageShape(imageShape);
			Image image = imageShape.Image;
			if (image != null)
			{
				WorkbookSerializationDataExcel2003.ImageHolder item = new WorkbookSerializationDataExcel2003.ImageHolder(image);
				int num = Images.IndexOf(item);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					Images.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					Images[num].ReferenceCount++;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareShapeForSerialization(ref WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			base.PrepareShapeForSerialization(ref shape);
			if (shape != null)
			{
				if (shape == null || !shape.Type2003.HasValue || shape.SlicerName2007 != null)
				{
					shape = null;
				}
				else if (shape is WorksheetChart { Excel2003RoundTripData: null })
				{
					shape = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override WorkItem SaveCore()
		{
			List<uint> worksheetStreamPositions = new List<uint>();
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then(WorkItemExtensions.Then(WriteWorkbookGlobals(), (Func<WorkItem>)(() => Async.ForEach<Worksheet>((IEnumerable<Worksheet>)base.Worksheets, (Func<Worksheet, WorkItem>)delegate(Worksheet worksheet)
			{
				worksheetStreamPositions.Add((uint)WorkbookStream.Position);
				return SaveWorksheet(worksheet);
			})), (WorkItemContinuationType)0), (Action)delegate
			{
				UpdateBoundSheetValues(worksheetStreamPositions);
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

				CurrentRecordStream.AddSubStream(stream);

			CurrentRecordStream = stream;
		}

		public int SaveFormula(Formula formula, bool writeSize, bool isForExternalNamedReference, bool resolveSharedReferences = true)
		{
			Biff8RecordStream currentRecordStream = CurrentRecordStream;
			int result = 0;
			if (writeSize)
			{
				currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)0);
			}
			if (formula.PostfixTokenList.Length == 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			long position = currentRecordStream.Position;
			if (formula.OwningCellRow != null)
			{
				_ = formula.OwningCellRow.Index;
			}
			FormulaContext context = new FormulaContext(currentRecordStream.SaveManager.Workbook, formula);
			FormulaToken[] array = formula.PostfixTokenList;
			if (resolveSharedReferences)
			{
				array = (FormulaToken[])array.Clone();
				Formula.SharedTokenConverter sharedTokenConverter = Formula.SharedTokenConverter.Initialize(context, getSharedTokens: false);
				for (int i = 0; i < formula.PostfixTokenList.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = formula.PostfixTokenList[i].Accept(sharedTokenConverter);
				}
				sharedTokenConverter.Reset();
			}
			if (!formula.IsSpecialFormula)
			{
				TokenReferenceResolver tokenReferenceResolver = TokenReferenceResolver.Initialize(context, array);
				tokenReferenceResolver.Evaluate();
			}
			long[] array2 = new long[array.Length];
			GetSizeTokenVisitor getSizeTokenVisitor = GetSizeTokenVisitor.Initialize(context, currentRecordStream, isForExternalNamedReference, array2);
			long num = position;
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				FormulaToken formulaToken = array[j];
				array2[j] = num;
				num += formulaToken.Accept(getSizeTokenVisitor);
			}
			getSizeTokenVisitor.Reset();
			SaveTokenVisitor saveTokenVisitor = SaveTokenVisitor.Initialize(context, currentRecordStream, isForExternalNamedReference, array, array2);
			saveTokenVisitor.VisitAll();
			long position2 = currentRecordStream.Position;
			result = (int)(position2 - position);
			if (writeSize)
			{
				currentRecordStream.Position = position - 2;
				currentRecordStream.Write((ushort)result);
				currentRecordStream.Position = position2;
			}
			SaveAdditionalDataTokenVisitor saveAdditionalDataTokenVisitor = SaveAdditionalDataTokenVisitor.Initialize(context, currentRecordStream);
			saveAdditionalDataTokenVisitor.VisitAll();
			return result;
		}

		public void WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType type)
		{
			using Biff8RecordStream biff8RecordStream = new Biff8RecordStream(this, type);
			Biff8RecordBase biffRecord = _commonData.GetBiffRecord(type);
			if (!biffRecord.CanBeEncrypted)
			{
				biff8RecordStream.Transform.SuspendTransformations();
			}
			biffRecord.Save(this);
			if (!biffRecord.CanBeEncrypted)
			{
				biff8RecordStream.Transform.ResumeTransformations();
			}
		}

		public WorkItem WriteRecordAsync(BIFF8RecordType type)
		{
			return Async.Using<Biff8RecordStream>(new Biff8RecordStream(this, type), (Func<Biff8RecordStream, WorkItem>)delegate(Biff8RecordStream stream)
			{
				Biff8RecordBase record = _commonData.GetBiffRecord(type);
				if (!record.CanBeEncrypted)
				{
					stream.Transform.SuspendTransformations();
				}
				return WorkItemExtensions.Then(record.SaveAsync(this), (Action)delegate
				{
					if (!record.CanBeEncrypted)
					{
						stream.Transform.ResumeTransformations();
					}
				}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
			});
		}

		private void AddFormat(WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			AddFont(format.FontInternal, format);
			Formats.Add(format);
		}

		private void AddStyle(WorkbookStyle style)
		{
			if (style != null)
			{
				base.StyleFormatXfIds.Add(style, (ushort)Formats.Count);
				AddFormat(style.StyleFormatInternal);
			}
			else
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatData format = new WorksheetCellFormatData(base.Workbook, WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat);
				AddFormat(format);
			}
		}

		private void CorrectINDEXRecord(long indexRecordPosition, long defColWidthAddress, List<uint> dbcellRecordPositions)
		{
			long position = WorkbookStream.Position;
			WorkbookStream.Position = indexRecordPosition;
			BinaryReader reader = new BinaryReader(WorkbookStream);
			using (Biff8RecordStream biff8RecordStream = new Biff8RecordStream(this, WorkbookStream, reader))
			{
				biff8RecordStream.Position = 12L;
				biff8RecordStream.Write((uint)defColWidthAddress);
				biff8RecordStream.Position = 16L;
				foreach (uint dbcellRecordPosition in dbcellRecordPositions)
				{
					biff8RecordStream.Write(dbcellRecordPosition);
				}
			}
			WorkbookStream.Position = position;
		}

		private WorkItem SaveWorksheet(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			ContextStack.Push((object)worksheet.DisplayOptions);
			ContextStack.Push((object)worksheet.PrintOptions);
			ContextStack.Push((object)worksheet);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.BOF);
			long indexRecordPosition = WorkbookStream.Position;
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.INDEX);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.CALCMODE);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.CALCCOUNT);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.REFMODE);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.ITERATION);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.DELTA);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.SAVERECALC);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.PRINTHEADERS);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.PRINTGRIDLINES);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.GRIDSET);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.GUTS);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.DEFAULTROWHEIGHT);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.WSBOOL);
			if (worksheet.PrintOptions.HasHorizontalPageBreaks)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.HORIZONTALPAGEBREAKS);
			}
			if (worksheet.PrintOptions.HasVerticalPageBreaks)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.VERTICALPAGEBREAKS);
			}
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.HEADER);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FOOTER);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.HCENTER);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.VCENTER);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.LEFTMARGIN);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.RIGHTMARGIN);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.TOPMARGIN);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.BOTTOMMARGIN);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.SETUP);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.HEADERFOOTER);
			if (worksheet.ImageBackground != null)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.BITMAP);
			}
			if (worksheet.IsProtected)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.PROTECT);
				if (!worksheet.Protection.AllowEditScenarios)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.SCENPROTECT);
				}
				if (!worksheet.Protection.AllowEditObjects)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.OBJPROTECT);
				}
				ushort? xorPasswordValue = worksheet.Protection.PasswordInfo.GetXorPasswordValue();
				if (xorPasswordValue.HasValue && xorPasswordValue.Value != 0)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.PASSWORD);
				}
			}
			long defColWidthAddress = WorkbookStream.Position;
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.DEFCOLWIDTH);
			WriteColumnRecords(worksheet);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.DIMENSIONS);
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then<List<uint>>(WriteWorksheetRowBlocks(worksheet), (Action<WorkItem<List<uint>>>)delegate(WorkItem<List<uint>> t)
			{
				List<uint> result = WorkItemExtensions.GetResult<List<uint>>(t);
				CorrectINDEXRecord(indexRecordPosition, defColWidthAddress, result);
				if (base.WorkbookHasShapes)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.MSODRAWING);
				}
				WriteWorksheetCellComments(worksheet);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.WINDOW2);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.PAGELAYOUTINFO);
				WritePaneInformation(worksheet);
				WriteMagnificationLevels(worksheet);
				WriteSelection(worksheet.DisplayOptions);
				WriteCustomViewOptions(worksheet);
				if (worksheet.ShouldSaveDefaultColumnWidths256th)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.STANDARDWIDTH);
				}
				if (HasMergedCellRegions(worksheet))
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.MERGEDCELLS);
				}
				if (worksheet.HasHyperlinks)
				{
					foreach (WorksheetHyperlink hyperlink in worksheet.Hyperlinks)
					{
						ContextStack.Push((object)hyperlink);
						WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.HLINK);
						if (hyperlink.ToolTip != null)
						{
							WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.HLINKTOOLTIP);
						}
						ContextStack.Pop();
					}
				}
				if (worksheet.HasDataValidationRules)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.DVAL);
					foreach (KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection> item in (IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataValidationRule, WorksheetReferenceCollection>>)worksheet.DataValidationRules)
					{
						List<CellAddressRange> list = new List<CellAddressRange>();
						foreach (WorksheetRegion item2 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRegion>)item.Value)
						{
							list.Add(new CellAddressRange(item2));
						}
						ContextStack.Push((object)item.Key);
						ContextStack.Push((object)list);
						while (list.Count != 0)
						{
							WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.DV);
						}
						ContextStack.Pop();
						ContextStack.Pop();
					}
				}
				if (base.Workbook.Has2003VBACode && worksheet.VBAObjectName != null)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.VBAOBJECTNAME);
				}
				if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.TabColorInfo != null)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.SHEETEXT);
				}
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FEATHEADR);
				WorksheetProtectedRangeCollection allowedEditRanges = worksheet.Protection.AllowedEditRanges;
				for (int num = allowedEditRanges.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					ContextStack.Push((object)allowedEditRanges[num]);
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FEAT);
					ContextStack.Pop();
				}
				WriteWorksheetTables(worksheet);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.EOF);
				ContextStack.Pop();
				ContextStack.Pop();
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		private static bool ShouldWriteFEAT12Record(WorksheetTable table)
		{
			if (!table.IsHeaderRowVisible)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return table.Columns.Any((WorksheetTableColumn c) => c.TotalFormula != null || c.TotalLabel != null);
		}

		private void UpdateBoundSheetValues(List<uint> worksheetStreamPositions)
		{
			if (_boundSheetStreamPositions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BinaryReader reader = new BinaryReader(WorkbookStream);
			for (int i = 0; i < worksheetStreamPositions.Count; i++)
			{
				WorkbookStream.Position = _boundSheetStreamPositions[i];
				using Biff8RecordStream biff8RecordStream = new Biff8RecordStream(this, WorkbookStream, reader);
				biff8RecordStream.Transform.SuspendTransformations();
				biff8RecordStream.Write(worksheetStreamPositions[i]);
				biff8RecordStream.Transform.ResumeTransformations();
			}
			_boundSheetStreamPositions = null;
		}

		private void WriteBoundSheetRecords()
		{
			_boundSheetStreamPositions = new List<uint>();
			foreach (Worksheet worksheet in base.Worksheets)
			{
				_boundSheetStreamPositions.Add((uint)WorkbookStream.Position);
				ContextStack.Push((object)worksheet);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.BOUNDSHEET);
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}
		}

		private int WriteCellRecord()
		{
			object serializableCellValue = GetSerializableCellValue(CurrentCellContext.Row, CurrentCellDataContext);
			short columnIndex = CurrentCellDataContext.ColumnIndex;
			CurrentCellContext.Value = serializableCellValue;
			if (Utilities.IsNullResolved(serializableCellValue))
			{
				MultipleCellBlankInfo multipleCellBlankInfo = MultipleCellBlankInfo.GetMultipleCellBlankInfo(this);
				if (multipleCellBlankInfo != null)
				{
					ContextStack.Push((object)multipleCellBlankInfo);
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.MULBLANK);
					ContextStack.Pop();
					return multipleCellBlankInfo.LastColumnIndex;
				}
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.BLANK);
				return columnIndex;
			}
			if (Utilities.IsNumber(serializableCellValue))
			{
				double value = Convert.ToDouble(serializableCellValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				if (Utilities.TryEncodeRKValue(value, out var _))
				{
					MultipleCellRKInfo multipleCellRKInfo = MultipleCellRKInfo.GetMultipleCellRKInfo(this);
					if (multipleCellRKInfo != null)
					{
						ContextStack.Push((object)multipleCellRKInfo);
						WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.MULRK);
						ContextStack.Pop();
						return multipleCellRKInfo.LastColumnIndex;
					}
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.RK);
				}
				else
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.NUMBER);
				}
				return columnIndex;
			}
			if (serializableCellValue is bool || serializableCellValue is ErrorValue)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.BOOLERR);
				return columnIndex;
			}
			if (serializableCellValue is StringElementIndex)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.LABELSST);
				return columnIndex;
			}
			if (serializableCellValue is ArrayFormula arrayFormula)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FORMULA);
				if (arrayFormula.CellRange.FirstRow == CurrentCellContext.Row.Index && arrayFormula.CellRange.FirstColumn == columnIndex)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.ARRAY);
				}
				return columnIndex;
			}
			if (serializableCellValue is Formula)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FORMULA);
				return columnIndex;
			}
			if (serializableCellValue is WorksheetDataTable worksheetDataTable)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FORMULA);
				WorksheetRegion cellsInTable = worksheetDataTable.CellsInTable;
				if (cellsInTable.FirstRow == CurrentCellContext.Row.Index - 1 && cellsInTable.FirstColumn == columnIndex - 1)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.TABLE);
				}
				return columnIndex;
			}
			return columnIndex;
		}

		private void WriteColumnRecords(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			List<WorksheetColumnBlock> list = new List<WorksheetColumnBlock>(worksheet.ColumnBlocks);
			if (list.Count == 1 && list[0].IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetColumnBlock item in list)
			{
				if (!item.IsEmpty)
				{
					ContextStack.Push((object)item);
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.COLINFO);
					ContextStack.Pop();
				}
			}
		}

		private void WriteCustomViewOptions(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (!base.Workbook.HasCustomViews)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CustomView item in (IEnumerable<CustomView>)base.Workbook.CustomViews)
			{
				if (item.SavePrintOptions)
				{
					ContextStack.Push((object)item.GetPrintOptions(worksheet));
				}
				ContextStack.Push((object)item.GetDisplayOptions(worksheet));
				ContextStack.Push((object)item);
				WriteCustomViewWorksheetData(item.SavePrintOptions);
				ContextStack.Pop();
				ContextStack.Pop();
				if (item.SavePrintOptions)
				{
					ContextStack.Pop();
				}
			}
		}

		private void WriteCustomViews()
		{
			if (!base.Workbook.HasCustomViews)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CustomView item in (IEnumerable<CustomView>)base.Workbook.CustomViews)
			{
				ContextStack.Push((object)item);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.USERBVIEW);
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}
		}

		private void WriteCustomViewWorksheetData(bool savePrintOptions)
		{
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.USERSVIEWBEGIN);
			WriteSelection(ContextStack.Get<DisplayOptions>());
			if (savePrintOptions)
			{
				PrintOptions printOptions = ContextStack.Get<PrintOptions>();
				if (printOptions.HasHorizontalPageBreaks)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.HORIZONTALPAGEBREAKS);
				}
				if (printOptions.HasVerticalPageBreaks)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.VERTICALPAGEBREAKS);
				}
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.HEADER);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FOOTER);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.HCENTER);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.VCENTER);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.LEFTMARGIN);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.RIGHTMARGIN);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.TOPMARGIN);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.BOTTOMMARGIN);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.SETUP);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.HEADERFOOTER);
			}
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.USERSVIEWEND);
		}

		private void WriteExternalReferences()
		{
			List<WorkbookReferenceBase> workbookReferences = base.WorkbookReferences;
			if (workbookReferences.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorkbookReferenceBase item in workbookReferences)
			{
				ContextStack.Push((object)item);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.SUPBOOK);
				if (!(item is CurrentWorkbookReference))
				{
					foreach (NamedReferenceBase namedReference in item.NamedReferences)
					{
						ContextStack.Push((object)namedReference);
						WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.EXTERNNAME);
						ContextStack.Pop();
					}
				}
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.EXTERNSHEET);
		}

		private void WriteMagnificationLevels(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.CurrentMagnificationLevel != 100)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.SCL);
			}
		}

		private void WriteNamedReferences()
		{
			foreach (NamedReferenceBase namedReference in base.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference.NamedReferences)
			{
				ContextStack.Push((object)namedReference);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.NAME);
				if (namedReference.Comment != null && namedReference.Comment.Length > 0)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.NAMEEXT);
				}
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}
		}

		private void WriteNumberFormat(int index)
		{
			ContextStack.Push((object)new FormatHolder(index, base.Workbook.Formats.GetFormatForSave(index)));
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FORMAT);
			ContextStack.Pop();
		}

		private void WriteNumberFormats()
		{
			WriteNumberFormat(5);
			WriteNumberFormat(6);
			WriteNumberFormat(7);
			WriteNumberFormat(8);
			WriteNumberFormat(42);
			WriteNumberFormat(41);
			WriteNumberFormat(44);
			WriteNumberFormat(43);
			if (!base.Workbook.HasFormats)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (int customFormatIndex in base.Workbook.Formats.GetCustomFormatIndices())
			{
				WriteNumberFormat(customFormatIndex);
			}
		}

		private void WritePaneInformation(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			WorksheetDisplayOptions displayOptions = worksheet.DisplayOptions;
			if ((!displayOptions.PanesAreFrozen) ? (displayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.LeftPaneWidth != 0 || displayOptions.UnfrozenPaneSettings.TopPaneHeight != 0) : (displayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FrozenColumns != 0 || displayOptions.FrozenPaneSettings.FrozenRows != 0))
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.PANE);
			}
		}

		private void WriteSelection(DisplayOptions displayOptions)
		{
			displayOptions.VerifySelectionInfo();
			if (displayOptions.HasSelection && displayOptions.Selection.PaneSelections.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetPaneSelection paneSelection in displayOptions.Selection.PaneSelections)
				{
					ContextStack.Push((object)paneSelection);
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.SELECTION);
					ContextStack.Pop();
				}
				return;
			}
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.SELECTION);
		}

		private void WriteWorkbookFonts()
		{
			foreach (WorkbookFontData font in base.Fonts)
			{
				if (font != null)
				{
					ContextStack.Push((object)font);
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FONT);
					ContextStack.Pop();
				}
			}
		}

		private WorkItem WriteWorkbookGlobals()
		{
			ContextStack.Push((object)base.Workbook);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.BOF);
			if (base.Workbook.HasFileWriteProtectionPassword)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.WRITEPROT);
			}
			if (base.Workbook.HasOpenPassword)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FILEPASS);
			}
			if (base.Workbook.CurrentFormat == WorkbookFormat.Excel97To2003Template)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.TEMPLATE);
			}
			if (base.Workbook.HasFileWriteProtectionPassword)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FILESHARING);
			}
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.CODEPAGE);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.DSF);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.EXCEL9FILE);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.TABID);
			if (base.Workbook.Has2003VBACode)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.OBPROJ);
				if (base.Workbook.Has2003ActiveXMarker)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.ACTIVEXMARKER);
				}
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.VBAOBJECTNAME);
			}
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FNGROUPCOUNT);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.WINDOWPROTECT);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.PROTECT);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.PASSWORD);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.WINDOW1);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.BACKUP);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.HIDEOBJ);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.Record1904);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.PRECISION);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.REFRESHALL);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.BOOKBOOL);
			WriteWorkbookFonts();
			WriteNumberFormats();
			long position = WorkbookStream.Position;
			List<XFRecord.XFContext> list = new List<XFRecord.XFContext>();
			for (ushort num = 0; num < Formats.Count; num++)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = Formats[num];
				XFRecord.XFContext xFContext = new XFRecord.XFContext(worksheetCellFormatData, num, worksheetCellFormatData.GetXFEXTProps());
				ContextStack.Push((object)xFContext);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.XF);
				ContextStack.Pop();
				if (xFContext.ExtProps.Count != 0)
				{
					list.Add(xFContext);
				}
			}
			_commonData.CacheXFRecordData(position);
			if (list.Count != 0)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.XFCRC);
				foreach (XFRecord.XFContext item in list)
				{
					ContextStack.Push((object)item);
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.XFEXT);
					ContextStack.Pop();
				}
			}
			foreach (WorksheetCellFormatData dxf in base.Dxfs)
			{
				ContextStack.Push((object)dxf);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.DXF);
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}
			WriteWorkbookStyles();
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.TABLESTYLES);
			foreach (WorksheetTableStyle item2 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetTableStyle>)base.Workbook.CustomTableStyles)
			{
				WriteWorksheetTableStyle(item2);
			}
			WriteCustomViews();
			if (base.Workbook.Palette.IsCustom)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.PALETTE);
			}
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.USESELFS);
			WriteBoundSheetRecords();
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.COUNTRY);
			WriteExternalReferences();
			WriteNamedReferences();
			if (base.WorkbookHasShapes)
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.MSODRAWINGGROUP);
			}
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then(WriteRecordAsync(BIFF8RecordType.SST), (Action)delegate
			{
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.EXTSST);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.THEME);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.EOF);
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		private void WriteWorkbookStyles()
		{
			if (_styles.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorkbookStyle style in _styles)
			{
				ContextStack.Push((object)style);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.STYLE);
				if (style.StyleFormatInternal.GetXFProps().Count != 0)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.STYLEEXT);
				}
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}
		}

		private void WriteWorksheetCellComments(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			WorksheetSerializationCache serializationCache = GetSerializationCache(worksheet);
			foreach (WorksheetCellComment commentShape in serializationCache.CommentShapes)
			{
				ContextStack.Push((object)commentShape.Cell);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.NOTE);
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}
		}

		private WorkItem<uint> WriteWorksheetRowBlock(Worksheet worksheet, List<WorksheetRow> rowsInBlock)
		{
			uint firstRowPosition = (uint)WorkbookStream.Position;
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in rowsInBlock)
			{
				ContextStack.Push((object)item);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.ROW);
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}
			List<uint> firstCellInRowPositions = new List<uint>();
			int cellCount = 0;
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then<uint>(Async.ForEach<WorksheetRow>((IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)rowsInBlock, (Func<WorksheetRow, WorkItem>)delegate(WorksheetRow row)
			{
				firstCellInRowPositions.Add((uint)WorkbookStream.Position);
				WorksheetCellFormatData rowFormat = (row.HasCellFormat ? row.CellFormatInternal.Element : null);
				WorksheetRowSerializationCache serializationCache = GetSerializationCache(row);
				CurrentCellContext = new CellContext(row, serializationCache);
				int ignoreUpToIndex = -1;
				return WorkItemExtensions.Then(Async.ForEachSlice<CellDataContext>(row.GetCellsWithData(), (Func<CellDataContext, bool>)delegate(CellDataContext cellDataContext)
				{
					if (cellDataContext.ColumnIndex <= ignoreUpToIndex)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (cellDataContext.CellFormatData == null)
					{
						cellDataContext.CellFormatData = rowFormat ?? worksheet.GetColumnBlock(cellDataContext.ColumnIndex).CellFormat;
					}
					CurrentCellDataContext = cellDataContext;
					ignoreUpToIndex = WriteCellRecord();
					cellCount += ignoreUpToIndex + 1 - cellDataContext.ColumnIndex;
					if (1000 < cellCount)
					{
						cellCount = 0;
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}), (Action)delegate
				{
					CurrentCellContext = null;
					CurrentCellDataContext = null;
				}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
			}), (Func<uint>)delegate
			{
				uint result = (uint)WorkbookStream.Position;
				DBCELLRecord.DBCELLInfo dBCELLInfo = new DBCELLRecord.DBCELLInfo(firstRowPosition, firstCellInRowPositions);
				ContextStack.Push((object)dBCELLInfo);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.DBCELL);
				ContextStack.Pop();
				return result;
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		private WorkItem<List<uint>> WriteWorksheetRowBlocks(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			List<uint> dbcellRecordPositions = new List<uint>();
			List<WorksheetRow> rowsInBlock = new List<WorksheetRow>();
			int firstRowInBlock = -1;
			return WorkItemExtensions.Then<List<uint>>(WorkItemExtensions.Then(Async.ForEach<WorksheetRow>(GetRowsToSave(worksheet), (Func<WorksheetRow, WorkItem>)delegate(WorksheetRow row)
			{
				WorksheetRowSerializationCache serializationCache = GetSerializationCache(row);
				if (serializationCache == null)
				{
					return (WorkItem)null;
				}
				if (firstRowInBlock < 0)
				{
					firstRowInBlock = row.Index;
				}
				return WorkItemExtensions.Then(Async.If(row.Index - firstRowInBlock > 31, (Func<WorkItem>)(() => WorkItemExtensions.Then<uint>(WriteWorksheetRowBlock(worksheet, rowsInBlock), (Action<WorkItem<uint>>)delegate(WorkItem<uint> t)
				{
					dbcellRecordPositions.Add(WorkItemExtensions.GetResult<uint>(t));
					rowsInBlock.Clear();
					firstRowInBlock = row.Index;
				}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0)), (Func<WorkItem>)null), (Action)delegate
				{
					rowsInBlock.Add(row);
				}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
			}), (Func<WorkItem>)(() => Async.If(rowsInBlock.Count > 0, (Func<WorkItem>)(() => WorkItemExtensions.Then<uint>(WriteWorksheetRowBlock(worksheet, rowsInBlock), (Action<WorkItem<uint>>)delegate(WorkItem<uint> t)
			{
				dbcellRecordPositions.Add(WorkItemExtensions.GetResult<uint>(t));
			}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0)), (Func<WorkItem>)null)), (WorkItemContinuationType)0), (Func<List<uint>>)(() => dbcellRecordPositions), (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
		}

		private void WriteWorksheetTables(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (worksheet.Tables.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FEATHEADR11);
			foreach (WorksheetTable item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetTable>)worksheet.Tables)
			{
				SortedList<int, TableColumnFilterData> sortedList = new SortedList<int, TableColumnFilterData>(Utilities.Int32Comparer.Instance);
				for (int i = 0; i < item.Columns.Count; i++)
				{
					WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = item.Columns[i];
					TableColumnFilterData tableColumnFilterData = new TableColumnFilterData(worksheetTableColumn);
					if (tableColumnFilterData.ShouldSaveIn2003Formats)
					{
						sortedList.Add(worksheetTableColumn.Index, tableColumnFilterData);
					}
				}
				ContextStack.Push((object)item);
				ContextStack.Push((object)sortedList);
				if (ShouldWriteFEAT12Record(item))
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FEAT12);
				}
				else
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.FEAT11);
				}
				ContextStack.Push((object)LIST12Record.LIST12DataType.BlockLevelFormatting);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.LIST12);
				ContextStack.Pop();
				foreach (TableColumnFilterData value in sortedList.Values)
				{
					if (value.NeedsAUTOFILTER12Record)
					{
						ContextStack.Push((object)value);
						WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.AUTOFILTER12);
						ContextStack.Pop();
					}
				}
				ContextStack.Push((object)LIST12Record.LIST12DataType.StyleInfo);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.LIST12);
				ContextStack.Pop();
				ContextStack.Push((object)LIST12Record.LIST12DataType.DisplayName);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.LIST12);
				ContextStack.Pop();
				if (item.SortSettings.HasData)
				{
					WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.SORTDATA12);
				}
				ContextStack.Pop();
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}
		}

		private void WriteWorksheetTableStyle(WorksheetTableStyle customStyle)
		{
			ContextStack.Push((object)customStyle);
			WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.TABLESTYLE);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<WorksheetTableStyleArea, uint> tableStyleDxfId in GetTableStyleDxfIds(customStyle))
			{
				ContextStack.Push((object)tableStyleDxfId.Key);
				ContextStack.Push((object)tableStyleDxfId.Value);
				WriteRecord(BIFF8RecordType.TABLESTYLEELEMENT);
				ContextStack.Pop();
				ContextStack.Pop();
			}
			ContextStack.Pop();
		}
	}
	internal class WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007 : WorkbookSaveManager
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<WorksheetCellFormatData, ushort> _cellFormatXfIds;

		private WorkbookSerializationDataExcel2007 _commonData;

		private readonly Dictionary<WorkbookReferenceBase, int> _externalReferences;

		private readonly Dictionary<Image, Uri> _imagesSavedInPackage;

		private readonly List<SerializationNumberFormatInfo> _numberFormats;

		protected override bool OnlyAssignShapeIdsToCommentShapes => true;

		public List<BorderInfo> Borders => _commonData.Borders;

		public List<StyleInfo> CellStyles => _commonData.CellStyles;

		public List<FormatInfo> CellStyleXfs => _commonData.CellStyleXfs;

		public List<FormatInfo> CellXfs => _commonData.CellXfs;

		public ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager DocumentManager => _commonData.DocumentManager;

		public Dictionary<WorkbookReferenceBase, int> ExternalReferences => _externalReferences;

		public List<FillInfo> Fills => _commonData.Fills;

		public List<SerializationNumberFormatInfo> NumberFormats => _numberFormats;

		public WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2007(Workbook workbook, Stream stream, WorkbookSaveOptions saveOptions, ST_ConformanceClass conformance)
			: base(workbook, Utilities.GetFileName(stream), saveOptions)
		{
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			_cellFormatXfIds = new Dictionary<WorksheetCellFormatData, ushort>();
			_externalReferences = new Dictionary<WorkbookReferenceBase, int> { { workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference, 0 } };
			_imagesSavedInPackage = new Dictionary<Image, Uri>();
			_numberFormats = new List<SerializationNumberFormatInfo>();
			_commonData = new WorkbookSerializationDataExcel2007(new ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager(this, saveOptions.PackageFactoryResolved, stream, conformance));
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				((IDisposable)DocumentManager).Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public override ushort GetCellFormatIndex(WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat)
		{
			_cellFormatXfIds.TryGetValue(cellFormat, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public override ushort GetStyleFormatIndex(WorkbookStyle style)
		{
			base.StyleFormatXfIds.TryGetValue(style, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public override void InitializeCellFormats()
		{
			Dictionary<FillInfo, int> sharedFillInfos = new Dictionary<FillInfo, int>();
			Dictionary<BorderInfo, int> sharedBorderInfos = new Dictionary<BorderInfo, int>();
			AddFill(new FillInfo
			{
				PatternFill = new PatternFillInfo
				{
					PatternStyle = FillPatternStyle.None
				}
			}, sharedFillInfos);
			AddFill(new FillInfo
			{
				PatternFill = new PatternFillInfo
				{
					PatternStyle = FillPatternStyle.Gray12percent
				}
			}, sharedFillInfos);
			AddBorder(BorderInfo.CreateBorderInfo(this, new WorksheetCellFormatData(null, WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat)), sharedBorderInfos);
			WorkbookStyle normalStyle = base.Workbook.Styles.NormalStyle;
			AddStyle(normalStyle, sharedFillInfos, sharedBorderInfos);
			CellStyles.Add(new StyleInfo(this, normalStyle));
			foreach (WorkbookStyle item in (IEnumerable<WorkbookStyle>)base.Workbook.Styles)
			{
				if (item != normalStyle && item.ShouldSaveIn2007)
				{
					AddStyle(item, sharedFillInfos, sharedBorderInfos);
					CellStyles.Add(new StyleInfo(this, item));
				}
			}
			foreach (WorkbookBuiltInStyle hiddenBuiltInStyle in base.Workbook.Styles.GetHiddenBuiltInStyles())
			{
				if (hiddenBuiltInStyle != normalStyle)
				{
					AddStyle(hiddenBuiltInStyle, sharedFillInfos, sharedBorderInfos);
					CellStyles.Add(new StyleInfo(this, hiddenBuiltInStyle));
				}
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatCollection cellFormats = base.Workbook.CellFormats;
			AddFormat(cellFormats.DefaultElement, sharedFillInfos, sharedBorderInfos);
			foreach (WorksheetCellFormatData item2 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetCellFormatData>)cellFormats)
			{
				if (item2 != cellFormats.DefaultElement)
				{
					AddFormat(item2, sharedFillInfos, sharedBorderInfos);
				}
			}
			if (!base.Workbook.HasFormats)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (int customFormatIndex in base.Workbook.Formats.GetCustomFormatIndices())
			{
				_numberFormats.Add(new SerializationNumberFormatInfo
				{
					FormatId = (uint)customFormatIndex,
					FormatCode = base.Workbook.Formats.GetFormatForSave(customFormatIndex)
				});
			}
		}

		public override void InitReferences()
		{
			base.InitReferences();
			if (base.Workbook.ExternalWorkbooks == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 1;
			foreach (WorkbookReferenceBase value in base.Workbook.ExternalWorkbooks.Values)
			{
				ExternalReferences.Add(value, num++);
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareShapeForSerialization(ref WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			base.PrepareShapeForSerialization(ref shape);
			if (shape is WorksheetChart worksheetChart)
			{
				if (worksheetChart.Excel2007RoundTripData == null)
				{
					shape = null;
				}
			}
			else if (shape is UnknownShape unknownShape)
			{
				if (unknownShape.ShapeData2007 != null && unknownShape.ControlData2007 != null)
				{
					shape = null;
				}
				else if (unknownShape.Excel2007GraphicalObjectContent == null)
				{
					shape = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override WorkItem SaveCore()
		{
			return ((OfficeDocumentManager)DocumentManager).Save();
		}

		public string GetSerializableFormula(Formula formula)
		{
			GetFormulaStringInfo getReferenceStringContext = new GetFormulaStringInfo(ExternalReferences, isSerializing: true);
			XLSXFormulaStringGenerator xLSXFormulaStringGenerator = XLSXFormulaStringGenerator.Initialize(formula, getReferenceStringContext);
			EvaluationResult<string> evaluationResult = xLSXFormulaStringGenerator.Evaluate();
			if (!evaluationResult.Completed)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return evaluationResult.Result;
		}

		public static void GetCellValueInfo(object cellValue, out ST_CellType cellType, out string valueToWrite)
		{
			if (Utilities.IsNullResolved(cellValue))
			{
				cellType = (ST_CellType)2;
				valueToWrite = null;
				return;
			}
			if (cellValue is StringElementIndex stringElementIndex)
			{
				cellType = (ST_CellType)4;
				valueToWrite = stringElementIndex.IndexInSharedStringTable.ToString();
				return;
			}
			if (Utilities.IsNumericType(cellValue))
			{
				cellType = (ST_CellType)2;
				try
				{
					valueToWrite = Convert.ToDouble(cellValue).ToString(Workbook.InvariantFormatProvider);
					return;
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException)
				{
					valueToWrite = cellValue.ToString();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (cellValue is bool)
			{
				cellType = (ST_CellType)0;
				valueToWrite = Convert.ToInt32((bool)cellValue).ToString();
				return;
			}
			if (cellValue is ErrorValue)
			{
				cellType = (ST_CellType)3;
			}
			else
			{
				cellType = (ST_CellType)5;
			}
			valueToWrite = cellValue.ToString();
		}

		public WorkItem SaveAllImages(WorksheetShapeCollection shapes, Dictionary<Image, string> imageRelationshipIds)
		{
			return Async.ForEach<WorksheetShape>((IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)shapes, (Func<WorksheetShape, WorkItem>)delegate(WorksheetShape shape)
			{
				WorksheetShapeGroup group = shape as WorksheetShapeGroup;
				return Async.If(group != null, (Func<WorkItem>)(() => SaveAllImages(group.Shapes, imageRelationshipIds)), (Func<WorkItem>)delegate
				{
					IWorksheetImage imageShape = shape as IWorksheetImage;
					if (imageShape == null)
					{
						return (WorkItem)null;
					}
					Image image = imageShape.Image;
					if (image == null)
					{
						return (WorkItem)null;
					}
					string rId = null;
					Uri imagePartPath;
					return WorkItemExtensions.Then(Async.If(_imagesSavedInPackage.TryGetValue(image, out imagePartPath), (Func<WorkItem>)delegate
					{
						if (!imageRelationshipIds.TryGetValue(image, out rId))
						{
							rId = ((OfficeDocumentManager)DocumentManager).CreateInternalRelationship(imagePartPath, DocumentManager.GetImageRelationshipType());
						}
						return (WorkItem)null;
					}, (Func<WorkItem>)(() => WorkItemExtensions.Then<Tuple<Uri, string>>(DocumentManager.CreateImagePart(image, imageShape.PreferredFormat), (Action<WorkItem<Tuple<Uri, string>>>)delegate(WorkItem<Tuple<Uri, string>> t)
					{
						Tuple<Uri, string> result = WorkItemExtensions.GetResult<Tuple<Uri, string>>(t);
						imagePartPath = result.Item1;
						rId = result.Item2;
						_imagesSavedInPackage.Add(image, imagePartPath);
					}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0))), (Action)delegate
					{
						imageRelationshipIds[image] = rId;
					}, (WorkItemContinuationType)0);
				});
			});
		}

		private int AddBorder(BorderInfo borderInfo, Dictionary<BorderInfo, int> sharedBorderInfos)
		{
			if (sharedBorderInfos.TryGetValue(borderInfo, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = (sharedBorderInfos[borderInfo] = Borders.Count);
			Borders.Add(borderInfo);
			return value;
		}

		private int AddFill(FillInfo fillInfo, Dictionary<FillInfo, int> sharedFillInfos)
		{
			if (sharedFillInfos.TryGetValue(fillInfo, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = (sharedFillInfos[fillInfo] = Fills.Count);
			Fills.Add(fillInfo);
			return value;
		}

		private void AddFormat(WorksheetCellFormatData format, Dictionary<FillInfo, int> sharedFillInfos, Dictionary<BorderInfo, int> sharedBorderInfos)
		{
			AddFont(format.FontInternal, format);
			FormatInfo formatInfo = new FormatInfo();
			formatInfo.FillId = (uint)AddFill(FillInfo.CreateFillInfo(this, format), sharedFillInfos);
			formatInfo.BorderId = (uint)AddBorder(BorderInfo.CreateBorderInfo(this, format), sharedBorderInfos);
			formatInfo.FormatOptions = format.FormatOptions;
			formatInfo.Alignment = AlignmentInfo.CreateAlignmentInfo(format);
			formatInfo.FontId = format.FontInternal.SaveIndex.Value;
			formatInfo.Protection = ProtectionInfo.CreateProtectionInfo(format);
			formatInfo.NumFmtId = (uint)format.FormatStringIndexResolved;
			FormatInfo formatInfo2 = formatInfo;
			if (format.Type == WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat)
			{
				CellStyleXfs.Add(formatInfo2);
				return;
			}
			if (format.Style != null)
			{
				formatInfo2.CellStyleXfId = GetStyleFormatIndex(format.Style);
			}
			_cellFormatXfIds.Add(format, (ushort)CellXfs.Count);
			CellXfs.Add(formatInfo2);
		}

		private void AddStyle(WorkbookStyle style, Dictionary<FillInfo, int> sharedFillInfos, Dictionary<BorderInfo, int> sharedBorderInfos)
		{
			base.StyleFormatXfIds.Add(style, (ushort)CellStyleXfs.Count);
			AddFormat(style.StyleFormatInternal, sharedFillInfos, sharedBorderInfos);
		}
	}
	internal struct WorkbookSerializationDataExcel2003
	{
		public class ImageHolder
		{
			public Image Image { get; private set; }

			public uint ReferenceCount { get; set; }

			public ImageHolder(Image image, uint referenceCount = 1u)
			{
				Image = image;
				ReferenceCount = referenceCount;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is ImageHolder imageHolder)
				{
					return Image.Equals(imageHolder.Image);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return Image.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		public const bool DebugWriteLoadedCellValues = false;

		public const bool DebugWriteRecords = false;

		public const bool DebugWriteFullRecords = false;

		public const int DefaultCellFormatXfId = 15;

		private readonly BOOLERRRecord _boolerrRecord;

		private readonly BLANKRecord _blankRecord;

		private readonly LABELSSTRecord _labelsstRecord;

		private readonly FORMULARecord _formulaRecord;

		private readonly NUMBERRecord _numberRecord;

		private readonly RKRecord _rkRecord;

		private readonly ROWRecord _rowRecord;

		public readonly ContextStack ContextStack;

		public Biff8RecordStream CurrentRecordStream;

		public readonly List<WorksheetCellFormatData> Formats;

		public readonly List<ImageHolder> Images;

		public readonly SeekableBufferedStream WorkbookStream;

		public byte[] XfRecordData;

		public WorkbookSerializationDataExcel2003(Stream workbookStream)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ContextStack = new ContextStack();
			CurrentRecordStream = null;
			Formats = new List<WorksheetCellFormatData>();
			Images = new List<ImageHolder>();
			WorkbookStream = new SeekableBufferedStream(workbookStream);
			XfRecordData = null;
			_boolerrRecord = new BOOLERRRecord();
			_blankRecord = new BLANKRecord();
			_labelsstRecord = new LABELSSTRecord();
			_formulaRecord = new FORMULARecord();
			_numberRecord = new NUMBERRecord();
			_rkRecord = new RKRecord();
			_rowRecord = new ROWRecord();
		}

		public void CacheXFRecordData(long xfRecordsStart)
		{
			long position = ((Stream)(object)WorkbookStream).Position;
			try
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[(int)(((Stream)(object)WorkbookStream).Position - xfRecordsStart)];
				((Stream)(object)WorkbookStream).Position = xfRecordsStart;
				((Stream)(object)WorkbookStream).Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				int num = array.Length / 24;
				XfRecordData = new byte[num * 20];
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					int srcOffset = i * 24 + 4;
					int dstOffset = i * 20;
					Buffer.BlockCopy(array, srcOffset, XfRecordData, dstOffset, 20);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((Stream)(object)WorkbookStream).Position = position;
			}
		}

		public Biff8RecordBase GetBiffRecord(BIFF8RecordType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				BIFF8RecordType.BOOLERR => _boolerrRecord, 
				BIFF8RecordType.BLANK => _blankRecord, 
				BIFF8RecordType.LABELSST => _labelsstRecord, 
				BIFF8RecordType.FORMULA => _formulaRecord, 
				BIFF8RecordType.NUMBER => _numberRecord, 
				BIFF8RecordType.RK => _rkRecord, 
				BIFF8RecordType.ROW => _rowRecord, 
				_ => (Biff8RecordBase)BiffRecordBase<BIFF8RecordType, WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2003, WorkbookSaveManagerExcel2003>.GetBiffRecord(type, Biff8RecordBase.CreateBiffRecordCallback), 
			};
		}
	}

	internal abstract class WorksheetReference
	{
		private WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReference;

		public abstract int FirstWorksheetIndex { get; }

		public virtual bool IsConnected => true;

		public abstract bool IsExternal { get; }

		public abstract bool IsMultiSheet { get; }

		public virtual int LastWorksheetIndex => FirstWorksheetIndex;

		public virtual object NamedReferenceScope => this;

		public string ReferenceName => GetReferenceName(GetFormulaStringInfo.Default);

		public WorkbookReferenceBase WorkbookReference => workbookReference;

		protected WorksheetReference(WorkbookReferenceBase workbook)
		{
			workbookReference = workbook;
		}

		internal WorksheetReference Connect(FormulaContext context)
		{
			if (IsConnected)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (WorkbookReference == null)
			{
				if (context.Workbook == null)
				{
					return this;
				}
				return Connect(context.Workbook.CurrentWorkbookReference);
			}
			return Connect(WorkbookReference.Connect(context));
		}

		internal virtual WorksheetReference Connect(WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReference)
		{
			return this;
		}

		public abstract WorksheetReference Disconnect();

		public abstract IExcelCalcReference GetCalcReference(WorksheetCellAddress cellAddress);

		public abstract IExcelCalcReference GetCalcReference(WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress);

		public abstract string GetReferenceName(GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, bool forceIncludeScopeName = false);

		public abstract NamedReferenceBase GetNamedReference(string name);
	}

		}

		public override WorksheetReference Disconnect()
		{
			string workbookFileName = null;
			WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReferenceBase = base.WorkbookReference;
			if (workbookReferenceBase != null)
			{
				workbookFileName = workbookReferenceBase.FileName;
			}
			return new WorksheetReferenceSingleUnconnected(workbookFileName, Name);
		}

		public override string GetReferenceName(GetFormulaStringInfo getFormulaStringInfo, bool forceIncludeScopeName)
		{
			return base.WorkbookReference.GetWorksheetReferenceString(FirstWorksheetIndex, LastWorksheetIndex, getFormulaStringInfo, forceIncludeScopeName);
		}

		public abstract IExcelCalcReference GetMultiSheetCalcReference(WorksheetReference lastSheetReference, WorksheetCellAddress cellAddress);

		public abstract IExcelCalcReference GetMultiSheetCalcReference(WorksheetReference lastSheetReference, WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress);
	}

	internal class WorksheetReferenceExternal : WorksheetReferenceSingle
	{
		public class RowValues
		{
			private SortedList<short, object> cellValues;

			private SortedList<short, ExternalCellCalcReference> calcReferences;

			private WorksheetReferenceExternal owner;

			private int rowIndex;

			public IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<short, object>> CachedValues
			{
				get
				{
					if (cellValues == null)
					{
						return Enumerable.Empty<KeyValuePair<short, object>>();
					}
					return cellValues;
				}
			}

			public int RowIndex => rowIndex;

			public RowValues(WorksheetReferenceExternal owner, int rowIndex)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.rowIndex = rowIndex;
			}

			public object GetCachedValue(short columnIndex)
			{
				if (cellValues != null)
				{
					int num = cellValues.IndexOfKey(columnIndex);
					if (0 <= num)
					{
						return cellValues.Values[num];
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public IExcelCalcReference GetCalcReference(short columnIndex)
			{
				if (calcReferences == null)
				{
					calcReferences = new SortedList<short, ExternalCellCalcReference>(Utilities.Int16Comparer.Instance);
				}
				int num = calcReferences.IndexOfKey(columnIndex);
				ExternalCellCalcReference externalCellCalcReference;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					externalCellCalcReference = new ExternalCellCalcReference(owner, rowIndex, columnIndex);
					calcReferences[columnIndex] = externalCellCalcReference;
				}
				else
				{
					externalCellCalcReference = calcReferences.Values[num];
				}
				return externalCellCalcReference;
			}

			public void SetCachedValue(short columnIndex, object value)
			{
				if (cellValues == null)
				{
					cellValues = new SortedList<short, object>(Utilities.Int16Comparer.Instance);
				}
				cellValues[columnIndex] = value;
			}
		}

		private SortedList<int, RowValues> rowValues;

		private SortedList<WorksheetRegionAddress, ExternalRegionCalcReference> regionReferences;

		private int worksheetIndex;

		public override int FirstWorksheetIndex => worksheetIndex;

		public override bool IsExternal => true;

		public override string Name => base.WorkbookReference.GetWorksheetName(worksheetIndex);

		public IEnumerable<RowValues> CachedRowValues
		{
			get
			{
				if (rowValues == null)
				{
					return Enumerable.Empty<RowValues>();
				}
				return rowValues.Values;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetReferenceExternal(WorkbookReferenceBase workbook, int worksheetIndex)
			: base(workbook)
		{
			this.worksheetIndex = worksheetIndex;
		}

		public override IExcelCalcReference GetCalcReference(WorksheetCellAddress cellAddress)
		{
			return GetRowValues(cellAddress.RowIndex).GetCalcReference(cellAddress.ColumnIndex);
		}

		public override IExcelCalcReference GetCalcReference(WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress)
		{
			if (regionReferences == null)
			{
				regionReferences = new SortedList<WorksheetRegionAddress, ExternalRegionCalcReference>();
			}
			int num = regionReferences.IndexOfKey(regionAddress);
			ExternalRegionCalcReference externalRegionCalcReference;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				externalRegionCalcReference = new ExternalRegionCalcReference(this, regionAddress);
				regionReferences[regionAddress] = externalRegionCalcReference;
			}
			else
			{
				externalRegionCalcReference = regionReferences.Values[num];
			}
			return externalRegionCalcReference;
		}

		public override IExcelCalcReference GetMultiSheetCalcReference(WorksheetReference lastSheetReference, WorksheetCellAddress cellAddress)
		{
			if (!(lastSheetReference is WorksheetReferenceExternal lastWorksheetReference))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new MultiSheetExternalCellCalcReference(this, lastWorksheetReference, cellAddress);
		}

		public override IExcelCalcReference GetMultiSheetCalcReference(WorksheetReference lastSheetReference, WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress)
		{
			if (!(lastSheetReference is WorksheetReferenceExternal lastWorksheetReference))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new MultiSheetExternalRegionCalcReference(this, lastWorksheetReference, regionAddress);
		}

		public override NamedReferenceBase GetNamedReference(string name)
		{
			return base.WorkbookReference.GetNamedReference(name, this, createIfNotPresent: true);
		}

		public object GetCachedValue(int rowIndex, short columnIndex)
		{
			if (rowValues != null)
			{
				int num = rowValues.IndexOfKey(rowIndex);
				if (0 <= num)
				{
					return rowValues.Values[num].GetCachedValue(columnIndex);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public RowValues GetRowValues(int rowIndex)
		{
			if (this.rowValues == null)
			{
				this.rowValues = new SortedList<int, RowValues>(Utilities.Int32Comparer.Instance);
			}
			int num = this.rowValues.IndexOfKey(rowIndex);
			RowValues rowValues;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				rowValues = new RowValues(this, rowIndex);
				this.rowValues[rowIndex] = rowValues;
			}
			else
			{
				rowValues = this.rowValues.Values[num];
			}
			return rowValues;
		}

		public void SetCachedValue(int rowIndex, short columnIndex, object value)
		{
			GetRowValues(rowIndex).SetCachedValue(columnIndex, value);
		}

		public RowValues TryGetRowValues(int rowIndex)
		{
			if (rowValues != null)
			{
				int num = rowValues.IndexOfKey(rowIndex);
				if (0 <= num)
				{
					return rowValues.Values[num];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class WorksheetReferenceLocal : WorksheetReferenceSingle
	{
		private Worksheet worksheet;

		{
			get
			{
				if (worksheet == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return worksheet.Index;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsExternal => false;

		public override string Name
		{
			get
			{
				if (worksheet == null)
				{
					return "#REF!";
				}
				return worksheet.Name;
			}
		}

		public override object NamedReferenceScope => worksheet;

		public Worksheet Worksheet => worksheet;

		}

		{
			if (worksheet == null || worksheet.Workbook == null)
			{
				return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
			}
			return worksheet.Rows[cellAddress.RowIndex].GetCellCalcReference(cellAddress.ColumnIndex);
		}

		public override IExcelCalcReference GetCalcReference(WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress)
		{
			if (worksheet == null || worksheet.Workbook == null)
			{
				return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
			}
			WorksheetRegion cachedRegion = worksheet.GetCachedRegion(regionAddress);
			return cachedRegion.CalcReference;
		}

		{
			if (!(lastSheetReference is WorksheetReferenceLocal worksheetReferenceLocal))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new MultiSheetCellCalcReference(worksheet, worksheetReferenceLocal.worksheet, cellAddress);
		}

		public override IExcelCalcReference GetMultiSheetCalcReference(WorksheetReference lastSheetReference, WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress)
		{
			if (!(lastSheetReference is WorksheetReferenceLocal worksheetReferenceLocal))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new MultiSheetRegionCalcReference(worksheet, worksheetReferenceLocal.worksheet, regionAddress);
		}

		public override NamedReferenceBase GetNamedReference(string name)
		{
			if (worksheet == null || worksheet.Workbook == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return worksheet.Workbook.NamedReferences.Find(name, worksheet);
		}
	}

	internal class WorksheetReferenceMulti : WorksheetReference
	{
		private WorksheetReferenceSingle firstWorksheetReference;

		private WorksheetReferenceSingle lastWorksheetReference;

		public override int FirstWorksheetIndex => firstWorksheetReference.FirstWorksheetIndex;

		public override bool IsConnected => firstWorksheetReference.IsConnected;

		public override bool IsExternal => firstWorksheetReference.IsExternal;

		public override bool IsMultiSheet => true;

		public override int LastWorksheetIndex => lastWorksheetReference.FirstWorksheetIndex;

		public override object NamedReferenceScope => firstWorksheetReference.NamedReferenceScope;

		public WorksheetReferenceSingle FirstWorksheetReference => firstWorksheetReference;

		public WorksheetReferenceSingle LastWorksheetReference => lastWorksheetReference;

		public WorksheetReferenceMulti(WorksheetReferenceSingle firstWorksheetReference, WorksheetReferenceSingle lastWorksheetReference)
			: base(firstWorksheetReference.WorkbookReference)
		{
			this.firstWorksheetReference = firstWorksheetReference;
			this.lastWorksheetReference = lastWorksheetReference;
		}

		internal override WorksheetReference Connect(WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReference)
		{
			return workbookReference.GetWorksheetReference(firstWorksheetReference.Name, lastWorksheetReference.Name);
		}

		public sealed override WorksheetReference Disconnect()
		{
			if (!IsConnected)
			{
				return this;
			}
			string workbookFileName = null;
			WorkbookReferenceBase workbookReferenceBase = base.WorkbookReference;
			if (workbookReferenceBase != null)
