	internal sealed class SharedStringTable : GenericCachedCollection<StringElement>
	{
		internal struct KeyGap : IComparable<KeyGap>
		{
			internal readonly uint startIndex;

			internal readonly uint endIndex;

			public KeyGap(uint startIndex, uint endIndex)
			{
				this.startIndex = startIndex;
				this.endIndex = endIndex;
			}

			public int CompareTo(KeyGap other)
			{
				return startIndex.CompareTo(other.startIndex);
			}
		}

		private uint nextKey = 1u;

		private List<KeyGap> availableKeysSorted = new List<KeyGap>();

		public SharedStringTable(Workbook workbook)
			: base(workbook, int.MaxValue, 0.005)
		{
		}

		private uint FindNextSharedElementKey(ref uint nextKey)
		{
			if (nextKey == uint.MaxValue)
			{
				if (availableKeysSorted.Count != 0)
				{
					uint startIndex = availableKeysSorted[0].startIndex;
					OnKeyUnavialable(startIndex);
					return startIndex;
				}
				return 0u;
			}
			return nextKey++;
		}

		protected override void OnAdded(StringElement element)
		{
			base.OnAdded(element);
			if (element.Key == 0)
			{
				element.Key = FindNextSharedElementKey(ref nextKey);
			}
		}

		private void OnKeyAvialable(uint key)
		{
			KeyGap item = new KeyGap(key, key);
			int num = availableKeysSorted.BinarySearch(item);
			KeyGap? keyGap = null;
			KeyGap? keyGap2 = null;
			int num2;
			int num3;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				num2 = num - 1;
				if (0 <= num2)
				{
					keyGap = availableKeysSorted[num2];
				}
				num3 = num;
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = num;
				keyGap = availableKeysSorted[num2];
				num3 = num + 1;
			}
			if (num3 < availableKeysSorted.Count)
			{
				keyGap2 = availableKeysSorted[num3];
			}
			bool flag = keyGap.HasValue && keyGap.Value.endIndex + 1 == key;
			bool flag2 = keyGap2.HasValue && keyGap2.Value.startIndex - 1 == key;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					availableKeysSorted.RemoveRange(num2, 2);
					availableKeysSorted.Insert(num2, new KeyGap(keyGap.Value.startIndex, keyGap2.Value.endIndex));
				}
				else
				{
					availableKeysSorted[num2] = new KeyGap(keyGap.Value.startIndex, key);
				}
			}
			else if (flag2)
			{
				availableKeysSorted[num3] = new KeyGap(key, keyGap2.Value.endIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				availableKeysSorted.Insert(num, item);
			}
		}

		private void OnKeyUnavialable(uint key)
		{
			int num = availableKeysSorted.BinarySearch(new KeyGap(key, key));
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num - 1;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				KeyGap keyGap = availableKeysSorted[num];
				if (keyGap.endIndex >= key)
				{
					if (keyGap.endIndex == key)
					{
						availableKeysSorted[num] = new KeyGap(keyGap.startIndex, keyGap.endIndex - 1);
						return;
					}
					availableKeysSorted.RemoveAt(num);
					availableKeysSorted.InsertRange(num, new KeyGap[2]
					{
						new KeyGap(keyGap.startIndex, key - 1),
						new KeyGap(key + 1, keyGap.endIndex)
					});
				}
			}
			else
			{
				KeyGap keyGap2 = availableKeysSorted[num];
				if (keyGap2.startIndex == keyGap2.endIndex)
				{
					availableKeysSorted.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					availableKeysSorted[num] = new KeyGap(keyGap2.startIndex + 1, keyGap2.endIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool Remove(StringElement element)
		{
			if (!base.Remove(element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			OnKeyAvialable(element.Key);
			element.Key = 0u;
			return true;
		}

		public StringElement Find(int hashCode, uint key)
		{
			int entryListCount;
			GenericElementHashSet<StringElement>.Entry[] entryList = cache.GetEntryList(hashCode, out entryListCount);
			if (entryList != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < entryListCount; i++)
				{
					GenericElementHashSet<StringElement>.Entry entry = entryList[i];
					if (entry.hashCode == hashCode)
					{
						StringElement element = entry.element;
						if (element.Key == key)
						{
							return element;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int FindStringIndex(StringElement element)
		{
			return FindStringIndex(HashHelpers.InternalGetHashCode(element), element.Key);
		}

		internal int FindStringIndex(int hashCode, uint key)
		{
			int entryListCount;
			int cumulativeCount;
			GenericElementHashSet<StringElement>.Entry[] entryList = cache.GetEntryList(hashCode, out entryListCount, out cumulativeCount);
			if (entryList != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < entryListCount; i++)
				{
					GenericElementHashSet<StringElement>.Entry entry = entryList[i];
					if (entry.hashCode == hashCode)
					{
						StringElement element = entry.element;
						if (element == null)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (element.Key == key)
						{
							return cumulativeCount + i;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}

	public abstract class SortCondition
	{
		private readonly SortDirection _sortDirection;

		public SortDirection SortDirection => _sortDirection;

		internal abstract ST_SortBy SortByValue { get; }

		internal SortCondition()
			: this(SortDirection.Ascending)
		{
		}

		internal SortCondition(SortDirection sortDirection)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(sortDirection);
			_sortDirection = sortDirection;
		}

		internal abstract int CompareCells<T>(SortSettings<T> owner, Worksheet worksheet, int rowIndexX, int rowIndexY, short columnIndex) where T : class, ISortable;

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is SortCondition sortCondition))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _sortDirection == sortCondition._sortDirection;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _sortDirection.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class CustomListSortCondition : SortCondition
	{
		private ReadOnlyCollection<string> _list;

		internal override ST_SortBy SortByValue => (ST_SortBy)0;

		public IEnumerable<string> List => _list;

		public CustomListSortCondition(params string[] list)
			: this(SortDirection.Ascending, list)
		{
		}

		public CustomListSortCondition(IEnumerable<string> list)
			: this(SortDirection.Ascending, list)
		{
		}

		public CustomListSortCondition(SortDirection sortDirection, params string[] list)
			: base(sortDirection)
		{
			Initialize(list);
		}

		public CustomListSortCondition(SortDirection sortDirection, IEnumerable<string> list)
			: base(sortDirection)
		{
			Initialize(list);
		}

		private void Initialize(IEnumerable<string> list)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("list");
			}
			List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					string text = item.Trim();
					if (text.Length != 0)
					{
						list2.Add(text);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list2.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_EmptyCustomList"), "list");
			}
			_list = new ReadOnlyCollection<string>(list2);
		}

		internal override int CompareCells<T>(SortSettings<T> owner, Worksheet worksheet, int rowIndexX, int rowIndexY, short columnIndex)
		{
			WorksheetRow ifCreated = worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(rowIndexX);
			WorksheetRow ifCreated2 = worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(rowIndexY);
			object cellValue = WorksheetRow.GetCellValue(ifCreated, columnIndex);
			object cellValue2 = WorksheetRow.GetCellValue(ifCreated2, columnIndex);
			if (cellValue == null)
			{
				if (cellValue2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 1;
			}
			if (cellValue2 == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num;
			if (cellValue is bool)
			{
				num = ((!(cellValue2 is bool)) ? 1 : ((bool)cellValue).CompareTo((bool)cellValue2));
			}
			else if (cellValue2 is bool)
			{
				num = -1;
			}
			else
			{
				GetCellTextParameters getCellTextParameters = new GetCellTextParameters(columnIndex);
				getCellTextParameters.TextFormatMode = TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth;
				getCellTextParameters.PreventTextFormattingTypes = PreventTextFormattingTypes.String;
				string text = ifCreated.GetCellTextInternal(getCellTextParameters).Text;
				string text2 = ifCreated2.GetCellTextInternal(getCellTextParameters).Text;
				int num2 = IndexOf(worksheet, text, owner.CaseSensitive);
				int num3 = IndexOf(worksheet, text2, owner.CaseSensitive);
				num = ((num2 == -1) ? ((num3 != -1) ? 1 : OrderedSortCondition.CompareValues(owner, worksheet, cellValue, cellValue2)) : ((num3 != -1) ? num2.CompareTo(num3) : (-1)));
			}
			if (base.SortDirection == SortDirection.Descending)
			{
				return -num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is CustomListSortCondition customListSortCondition) || !base.Equals((object)customListSortCondition))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_list.Count != customListSortCondition._list.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_list[i] != customListSortCondition._list[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = _list.Count;
			if (_list.Count != 0)
			{
				num ^= _list[0].GetHashCode() ^ _list[_list.Count - 1].GetHashCode();
			}
			return num ^ base.GetHashCode();
		}

		internal string GetListString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(_list.Count * 2);
			for (int i = 0; i < _list.Count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(_list[i]);
				stringBuilder.Append(",");
			}
			stringBuilder.Length--;
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private int IndexOf(Worksheet worksheet, string value, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			CompareOptions compareOptions = ((!caseSensitive) ? CompareOptions.IgnoreCase : CompareOptions.None);
			CultureInfo culture = worksheet.Culture;
			for (int i = 0; i < _list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(_list[i], value, culture, compareOptions) == 0)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}

			_fill = fill;
		}

		TResult IColorSortCondition.Accept<TArg, TResult>(IColorSortConditionVisitor<TArg, TResult> visitor, TArg argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitFillSortCondition(this, argument);
		}

		internal override int CompareCells<T>(SortSettings<T> owner, Worksheet worksheet, int rowIndexX, int rowIndexY, short columnIndex)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormatElementReadOnly = worksheet.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(rowIndexX), columnIndex);
			WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormatElementReadOnly2 = worksheet.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(rowIndexY), columnIndex);
			Workbook workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
			bool flag = Utilities.CompareFillsForSortOrFilter(workbook, cellFormatElementReadOnly, Fill);
			bool flag2 = Utilities.CompareFillsForSortOrFilter(workbook, cellFormatElementReadOnly2, Fill);
			if (flag == flag2)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = ((!flag) ? 1 : (-1));
			if (base.SortDirection == SortDirection.Descending)
			{
				return -num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is FillSortCondition fillSortCondition))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (object.Equals(_fill, fillSortCondition._fill))
			{
				return base.Equals((object)fillSortCondition);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _fill.GetHashCode() ^ base.GetHashCode();
		}

		internal static FillSortCondition CreateFillSortCondition(WorkbookLoadManager loadManager, uint? dxfId, SortDirection sortDirection)
		{
			if (!dxfId.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (loadManager.Dxfs.Count <= dxfId.Value)
			{
				return null;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = loadManager.Dxfs[(int)dxfId.Value];
			if (worksheetCellFormatData.Fill == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new FillSortCondition(worksheetCellFormatData.Fill, sortDirection);
		}
	}

	public class OrderedSortCondition : SortCondition
	{
		internal override ST_SortBy SortByValue => (ST_SortBy)0;

		public OrderedSortCondition()
		{
		}

		public OrderedSortCondition(SortDirection sortDirection)
			: base(sortDirection)
		{
		}

		internal override int CompareCells<T>(SortSettings<T> owner, Worksheet worksheet, int rowIndexX, int rowIndexY, short columnIndex)
		{
			WorksheetRow ifCreated = worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(rowIndexX);
			WorksheetRow ifCreated2 = worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(rowIndexY);
			object cellValue = WorksheetRow.GetCellValue(ifCreated, columnIndex);
			object cellValue2 = WorksheetRow.GetCellValue(ifCreated2, columnIndex);
			if (cellValue == null)
			{
				if (cellValue2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 1;
			}
			if (cellValue2 == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = CompareValues(owner, worksheet, cellValue, cellValue2);
			if (base.SortDirection == SortDirection.Descending)
			{
				return -num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static int CompareValues<T>(SortSettings<T> owner, Worksheet worksheet, object valueX, object valueY) where T : class, ISortable
		{
			double numericValue;
			bool flag = Utilities.TryGetNumericValue(worksheet.Workbook, valueX, out numericValue);
			double numericValue2;
			bool flag2 = Utilities.TryGetNumericValue(worksheet.Workbook, valueY, out numericValue2);
			if (flag)
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					return numericValue.CompareTo(numericValue2);
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			bool flag3 = valueX is bool;
			bool flag4 = valueY is bool;
			string text = null;
			if (!(valueX is ErrorValue) && !flag3)
			{
				text = valueX.ToString();
			}
			string text2 = null;
			if (!(valueY is ErrorValue) && !flag4)
			{
				text2 = valueY.ToString();
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				if (text2 != null)
				{
					return StringUtilities.StringCompare(text, text2, owner.SortCulture, (!owner.CaseSensitive) ? CompareOptions.IgnoreCase : CompareOptions.None);
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (text2 != null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				if (flag4)
				{
					return ((bool)valueX).CompareTo((bool)valueY);
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("SortConditionCollection: Count - {Count}")]
	public class SortConditionCollection<T> : IDictionary<T, SortCondition>, IList<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>, IEnumerable where T : class, ISortable
	{
		private class KeysCollection : ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable
		{
			private SortConditionCollection<T> _owner;

			int ICollection<T>.Count => _owner.Count;

			bool ICollection<T>.IsReadOnly => true;

			public KeysCollection(SortConditionCollection<T> owner)
			{
				_owner = owner;
			}

			private void ThrowOnModified()
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotModifyKeysCollection"));
			}

			void ICollection<T>.Add(T item)
			{
				ThrowOnModified();
			}

			void ICollection<T>.Clear()
			{
				ThrowOnModified();
			}

			bool ICollection<T>.Contains(T item)
			{
				return _owner.Contains(item);
			}

			void ICollection<T>.CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _owner.Count; i++)
				{
					array[arrayIndex + i] = _owner._sortConditons[i].Key;
				}
			}

			bool ICollection<T>.Remove(T item)
			{
				ThrowOnModified();
				return false;
			}

			public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> pair in (IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>)_owner)
				{
					KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> keyValuePair = pair;
					yield return keyValuePair.Key;
				}
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		private class ValuesCollection : ICollection<SortCondition>, IEnumerable<SortCondition>, IEnumerable
		{
			private SortConditionCollection<T> _owner;

			int ICollection<SortCondition>.Count => _owner.Count;

			bool ICollection<SortCondition>.IsReadOnly => true;

			public ValuesCollection(SortConditionCollection<T> owner)

			private void ThrowOnModified()

				ThrowOnModified();

			void ICollection<SortCondition>.Clear()

				ThrowOnModified();

			bool ICollection<SortCondition>.Contains(SortCondition item)
			{
				return _owner.Contains(item);

			void ICollection<SortCondition>.CopyTo(SortCondition[] array, int arrayIndex)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _owner.Count; i++)
				{
					array[arrayIndex + i] = _owner._sortConditons[i].Value;

			bool ICollection<SortCondition>.Remove(SortCondition item)
			{
				ThrowOnModified();
				return false;
			}

			public IEnumerator<SortCondition> GetEnumerator()

				foreach (KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> pair in (IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>)_owner)
				{
					KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> keyValuePair = pair;
					yield return keyValuePair.Value;
				}
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		private const int MaxCount = 64;

		private KeysCollection _keys;

		private SortSettings<T> _owner;

		private List<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>> _sortConditons = new List<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>();

		private ValuesCollection _values;

		ICollection<T> IDictionary<T, SortCondition>.Keys
		{
			get
			{
				if (_keys == null)
				{
					_keys = new KeysCollection(this);
				}
				return _keys;
			}
		}

		ICollection<SortCondition> IDictionary<T, SortCondition>.Values
		{
			get
			{
				if (_values == null)
				{
					_values = new ValuesCollection(this);
				}
				return _values;
			}
		}

		bool ICollection<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => _sortConditons.Count;

		public KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _sortConditons[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (value.Key == null || value.Value == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
				}
				int num = IndexOf(value.Key);
				if (num != index || _sortConditons[num].Value != value.Value)
				{
					if (num >= 0 && num != index)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_DuplicateItemSorted"), "value");
					}
					ReplaceHelper(index, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public SortCondition this[T sortableItem]
		{
			get
			{
				if (sortableItem == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("sortableItem");
				}
				int num = IndexOf(sortableItem);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _sortConditons[num].Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (sortableItem == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("sortableItem");
				}
				int num = IndexOf(sortableItem);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					if (value != null)
					{
						Add(sortableItem, value);
					}
				}
				else if (value == null)
				{
					RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					ReplaceHelper(num, new KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>(sortableItem, value));
				}
			}
		}

		internal SortConditionCollection(SortSettings<T> owner)
		{
			_owner = owner;
		}

		bool IDictionary<T, SortCondition>.ContainsKey(T key)
		{
			return Contains(key);
		}

		bool IDictionary<T, SortCondition>.TryGetValue(T key, out SortCondition value)
		{
			value = this[key];
			return value != null;
		}

		int IList<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>.IndexOf(KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item.Key);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (_sortConditons[num].Value != item.Value)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return num;
		}

		void IList<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>.Insert(int index, KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> item)
		{
			Insert(index, item.Key, item.Value);
		}

		void ICollection<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>.Add(KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> item)
		{
			Add(item.Key, item.Value);
		}

		bool ICollection<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>.Contains(KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item.Value);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return object.Equals(this[num].Key, item.Key);
		}

		void ICollection<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>.CopyTo(KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_sortConditons.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>.Remove(KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item.Value);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(this[num].Key, item.Key))
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>> IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _sortConditons.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(T sortableItem, SortCondition sortCondition)
		{
			InsertHelper(Count, new KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>(sortableItem, sortCondition));
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (_sortConditons.Count != 0)
			{
				_sortConditons.Clear();
				OnSortConditionsModified();
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(T sortableItem)
		{
			return IndexOf(sortableItem) >= 0;
		}

		public bool Contains(SortCondition sortCondition)
		{
			return IndexOf(sortCondition) >= 0;
		}

		public int IndexOf(T sortableItem)
		{
			if (sortableItem == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("sortableItem");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _sortConditons.Count; i++)
			{
				if (object.ReferenceEquals(_sortConditons[i].Key, sortableItem))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public int IndexOf(SortCondition sortCondition)
		{
			if (sortCondition == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("sortCondition");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _sortConditons.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_sortConditons[i].Value == sortCondition)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, T sortableItem, SortCondition sortCondition)
		{
			InsertHelper(index, new KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition>(sortableItem, sortCondition));
		}

		public bool Remove(T sortableItem)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(sortableItem);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public bool Remove(SortCondition sortCondition)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(sortCondition);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || _sortConditons.Count <= index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_InvalidRemoveAtIndex_SortConditions"));
			}
			RemoveHelper(index);
		}

		private void InsertHelper(int index, KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> item, bool raiseNotification = true)
		{
			ValidateNewPair(item.Key, item.Value);
			_sortConditons.Insert(index, item);
			if (raiseNotification)
			{
				OnSortConditionsModified();
			}
		}

		private void OnSortConditionsModified()
		{
			_owner.OnSortSettingsModified();
		}

		private void RemoveHelper(int index, bool raiseNotification = true)
		{
			_sortConditons.RemoveAt(index);
			if (raiseNotification)
			{
				OnSortConditionsModified();
			}
		}

		private void ReplaceHelper(int index, KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> item)
		{
			RemoveHelper(index, raiseNotification: false);
			InsertHelper(index, item, raiseNotification: false);
			OnSortConditionsModified();
		}

		private void ValidateNewPair(T sortableItem, SortCondition sortCondition)
		{
			if (sortableItem == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("sortableItem");
			}
			if (sortCondition == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("sortCondition");
			}
			if (Contains(sortableItem))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_DuplicateItemSorted"), "sortableItem");
			}
			if (Count == 64)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_MaxSortConditions", 64));
			}
		}
	}
	public class SortSettings<T> where T : class, ISortable
	{
		private class RowIndexComparer : IComparer<int>
		{
			private short _columnIndexOffset;

			private SortSettings<T> _owner;

			private Worksheet _worksheet;

			public RowIndexComparer(SortSettings<T> owner, Worksheet worksheet, short columnIndexOffset)
			{
				_columnIndexOffset = columnIndexOffset;
				_owner = owner;
				_worksheet = worksheet;
			}

			int IComparer<int>.Compare(int x, int y)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _owner.SortConditions.Count; i++)
				{
					KeyValuePair<T, SortCondition> keyValuePair = _owner.SortConditions[i];
					SortCondition value = keyValuePair.Value;
					SortSettings<T> owner = _owner;
					Worksheet worksheet = _worksheet;
					short columnIndexOffset = _columnIndexOffset;
					T key = keyValuePair.Key;
					int num = value.CompareCells(owner, worksheet, x, y, (short)(columnIndexOffset + key.Index));
					if (num != 0)
					{
						return num;
					}
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private class VisibleRowIndexBlock
		{
			public int Size;

			public readonly int StartIndex;

			public int EndIndex => StartIndex + Size - 1;

			public VisibleRowIndexBlock(int startIndex)
			{
				StartIndex = startIndex;
				Size = 1;
			}
		}

		private bool _caseSensitive;

		private ISortSettingsOwner _owner;

		private SortConditionCollection<T> _sortConditions;

		private CultureInfo _sortCulture;

		private SortMethod _sortMethod;

		public bool CaseSensitive
		{
			get
			{
				return _caseSensitive;
			}
			set
			{
				if (CaseSensitive != value)
				{
					_caseSensitive = value;
					OnSortSettingsModified();
				}
			}
		}

		public SortConditionCollection<T> SortConditions
		{
			get
			{
				if (_sortConditions == null)
				{
					_sortConditions = new SortConditionCollection<T>(this);
				}
				return _sortConditions;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasAlternateSortMethod
		{
			get
			{
				if (_owner.Culture.Name == "zh-TW")
				{
					return SortMethod == SortMethod.PinYin;
				}
				return SortMethod == SortMethod.Stroke;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasData
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_caseSensitive && _sortMethod == SortMethod.Default)
				{
					if (_sortConditions != null)
					{
						return _sortConditions.Count != 0;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal ISortSettingsOwner Owner => _owner;

		internal CultureInfo SortCulture
		{
			get
			{
				if (_sortCulture == null)
				{
					_sortCulture = _owner.Culture;
					Utilities.UpdateSortCulture(ref _sortCulture, SortMethod);
				}
				return _sortCulture;
			}
		}

		internal SortMethod SortMethod
		{
			get
			{
				return _sortMethod;
			}
			set
			{
				if (SortMethod != value)
				{
					_sortMethod = value;
					_sortCulture = null;

			}

		internal void ReapplySortConditionsToRows()
		{
			WorksheetRegion sortRegion = _owner.SortRegion;
			if (sortRegion == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = sortRegion.Worksheet;
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int height = sortRegion.Height;
			if (height == 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			Workbook workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
			if ((workbook != null && workbook.IsLoading) || SortConditions.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<int> list = new List<int>(height);
			List<VisibleRowIndexBlock> list2 = new List<VisibleRowIndexBlock>();
			WorksheetRegionAddress address = sortRegion.Address;
			VisibleRowIndexBlock visibleRowIndexBlock = null;
			for (int i = address.FirstRowIndex; i <= address.LastRowIndex; i++)
			{
				if (worksheet.IsRowHidden(i))
				{
					if (visibleRowIndexBlock != null)
					{
						list2.Add(visibleRowIndexBlock);
						visibleRowIndexBlock = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (visibleRowIndexBlock == null)
					{
						visibleRowIndexBlock = new VisibleRowIndexBlock(i);
					}
					else
					{
						visibleRowIndexBlock.Size++;
					}
					list.Add(i);
				}
			}
			if (visibleRowIndexBlock != null)
			{
				list2.Add(visibleRowIndexBlock);
			}
			RowIndexComparer rowIndexComparer = new RowIndexComparer(this, worksheet, address.FirstColumnIndex);
			Utilities.SortMergeGeneric<int>(list, (IComparer<int>)rowIndexComparer);
			int index = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
			{
				VisibleRowIndexBlock visibleRowIndexBlock2 = list2[j];
				for (int k = visibleRowIndexBlock2.StartIndex; k <= visibleRowIndexBlock2.EndIndex; k++)
				{
					int index2 = index++;
					int num = list[index2];
					if (k != num)
					{
						int num2 = list.IndexOf(k, index);
						if (num2 >= 0)
						{
							int index3 = (list[index2] = list[num2]);
							list[num2] = num;
							WorksheetRow firstRow = worksheet.Rows[num];
							WorksheetRow secondRow = worksheet.Rows[index3];
							SwapRows(firstRow, secondRow, address.FirstColumnIndex, address.LastColumnIndex);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SwapCellFormats(WorksheetRow firstRow, WorksheetRow secondRow, short columnIndex)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormatInternal = firstRow.GetCellFormatInternal(columnIndex);
			WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormatInternal2 = secondRow.GetCellFormatInternal(columnIndex);
			WorksheetCellFormatData formatting = cellFormatInternal.Element.CloneInternal();
			cellFormatInternal.SetFormatting(cellFormatInternal2);
			cellFormatInternal2.SetFormatting(formatting);
		}

		private static void SwapCells(WorksheetRow firstRow, WorksheetRow secondRow, CellDataContext firstCellContext)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = firstRow.Worksheet;
			short columnIndex = firstCellContext.ColumnIndex;
			WorksheetCellBlock cellBlock = secondRow.GetCellBlock(columnIndex);
			if (firstCellContext.HasValue || cellBlock.DoesCellHaveValue(columnIndex))
			{
				WorksheetCellBlock worksheetCellBlock = firstCellContext.CellBlock ?? firstRow.GetCellBlock(columnIndex);
				object cellValueRaw = worksheetCellBlock.GetCellValueRaw(firstRow, columnIndex);
				object cellValueRaw2 = cellBlock.GetCellValueRaw(secondRow, columnIndex);
				worksheetCellBlock.SetCellValueRaw(firstRow, columnIndex, null, out var replacementBlock);
				cellBlock.SetCellValueRaw(secondRow, columnIndex, null, out replacementBlock);
				worksheetCellBlock.SetCellValueRaw(firstRow, columnIndex, cellValueRaw2, out replacementBlock);
				cellBlock.SetCellValueRaw(secondRow, columnIndex, cellValueRaw, out replacementBlock);
				Formula formula = cellValueRaw as Formula;
				ArrayFormula arrayFormula = formula as ArrayFormula;
				if (formula != null)
				{
					CellShiftOperation shiftOperation = new CellShiftOperation(worksheet, CellShiftType.VerticalShift, firstRow.Index, firstRow.Index, columnIndex, columnIndex, secondRow.Index - firstRow.Index);
					arrayFormula?.CellRange.ShiftRegion(shiftOperation, null, leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet: false);
					formula.OnCellsShifted(worksheet, shiftOperation, null, ReferenceShiftType.MaintainRelativeReferenceOffset);
				}
				Formula formula2 = cellValueRaw2 as Formula;
				ArrayFormula arrayFormula2 = formula2 as ArrayFormula;
				if (formula2 != null)
				{
					CellShiftOperation shiftOperation2 = new CellShiftOperation(worksheet, CellShiftType.VerticalShift, secondRow.Index, secondRow.Index, columnIndex, columnIndex, firstRow.Index - secondRow.Index);
					arrayFormula2?.CellRange.ShiftRegion(shiftOperation2, null, leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet: false);
					formula2.OnCellsShifted(worksheet, shiftOperation2, null, ReferenceShiftType.MaintainRelativeReferenceOffset);
				}
			}
			SwapCellFormats(firstRow, secondRow, columnIndex);
		}

		private static void SwapRows(WorksheetRow firstRow, WorksheetRow secondRow, short firstColumnIndex, short lastColumnIndex)
		{
			_ = firstRow.Worksheet;
			int num = lastColumnIndex - firstColumnIndex + 1;
			BitArray bitArray = new BitArray(num);
			bool flag = true;
			int num2 = firstColumnIndex;
			foreach (CellDataContext cellsWithDatum in firstRow.GetCellsWithData(firstColumnIndex, lastColumnIndex))
			{
				if (num2 != cellsWithDatum.ColumnIndex)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				bitArray[cellsWithDatum.ColumnIndex - firstColumnIndex] = true;
				SwapCells(firstRow, secondRow, cellsWithDatum);
				num2 = cellsWithDatum.ColumnIndex + 1;
			}
			if (num2 != lastColumnIndex + 1)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CellDataContext cellsWithDatum2 in secondRow.GetCellsWithData(firstColumnIndex, lastColumnIndex))
			{
				int index = cellsWithDatum2.ColumnIndex - firstColumnIndex;
				if (!bitArray[index])
				{
					bitArray[index] = true;
					SwapCells(secondRow, firstRow, cellsWithDatum2);
				}
			}
			if (!firstRow.HasCellFormat && !secondRow.HasCellFormat)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (short num3 = 0; num3 < num; num3++)
			{
				if (!bitArray[num3])
				{
					SwapCellFormats(secondRow, firstRow, num3);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public void Add(WorksheetTableStyle style)
		{
			if (style == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("style");
			}
			if (!style.IsCustom)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CannotAddStandardTableStyle"), "style");
			}
			if (style.CustomCollection != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DuplicateTableStyle"), "style");
			}
			if (this[style.Name] != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DuplicateTableStyleName_New"), "style");
			}
			InternalInsert(_styles.Count, style);
		}

		{

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyCollectionIndex(index, Count);
			WorksheetTableStyle worksheetTableStyle = this[index];
			_styles.RemoveAt(index);
			worksheetTableStyle.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			if (worksheetTableStyle == Workbook.DefaultTableStyle)
			{
				Workbook.DefaultTableStyle = null;
			}
			foreach (Worksheet item in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)Workbook.Worksheets)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetTable item2 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetTable>)item.Tables)
				{
					if (item2.Style == worksheetTableStyle)
					{
						item2.Style = Workbook.DefaultTableStyle;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InternalInsert(int index, WorksheetTableStyle style)
		{

			style.OnAddedToCollection(this);
		}

					return null;

					value = ((workbook != null) ? workbook.DefaultTableStyle : StandardTableStyleCollection.Instance.DefaultTableStyle);
				}
				if (_style != value)
				{
					if (value.IsCustom && (value.CustomCollection == null || (workbook != null && value.CustomCollection.Workbook != workbook)))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_TableStyleFromOtherWorkbook"), "value");
					}
					_style = value;
				}
			}
		}

		void IWorksheetCellFormatProxyOwner.OnCellFormatValueChanging(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue values)
		{
			WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableArea> worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy = (WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableArea>)sender;
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue << 1))
			{
				if ((values & cellFormatValue) != 0)
				{
					VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSet(worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy.Area, cellFormatValue);
				}
			}
		}

			{

			}
		}

			}

				ResumeFiltering();
			}
		}

		public void ReapplyFilters()
		{
			if (0 < _suspendFilteringCount)
			{
				RefilterRequired = true;
			}
			else
			{
				if (_worksheet == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				GetDataAreaRowIndexes(out var dataAreaTopRowIndex, out var dataAreaBottomRowIndex);
				List<IFilterable> list = new List<IFilterable>();

					WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = Columns[i];

					{
						list.Add(worksheetTableColumn);
					}
				}
				_worksheet.ReapplyFilters(dataAreaTopRowIndex, dataAreaBottomRowIndex, list);
			}
		}

		public void Resize(string headerAndDataRegionAddress)
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ResizedTableMustBeOnWorksheet"));
			}
			ResizeHelper(Worksheet.GetRegion(headerAndDataRegionAddress), "headerAndDataRegionAddress");
		}

		public void Resize(string headerAndDataRegionAddress, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ResizedTableMustBeOnWorksheet"));
			}
			ResizeHelper(Worksheet.GetRegion(headerAndDataRegionAddress, cellReferenceMode), "headerAndDataRegionAddress");
		}

		public void Resize(WorksheetRegion headerAndDataRegion)
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_ResizedTableMustBeOnWorksheet"));
			}
			if (headerAndDataRegion == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("headerAndDataRegion");
			}
			if (headerAndDataRegion.Worksheet != Worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_NewTableRegionFromWrongWorksheet"), "headerAndDataRegion");
			}
			ResizeHelper(headerAndDataRegion, "headerAndDataRegion");
		}

		private void ResizeHelper(WorksheetRegion region, string paramName)
		{
			WorksheetRegion wholeTableRegion = WholeTableRegion;
			if (wholeTableRegion == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = Worksheet;
			if (worksheet == null || region.TopRow != wholeTableRegion.TopRow)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_NewTableRegionCannotMoveHeaders"), paramName);
			}
			if (IsHeaderRowVisible && region.Height == 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_NewTableRegionMustHaveDataRows"), paramName);
			}
			if (!wholeTableRegion.IntersectsWith(region))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_NewTableRegionOverlapOld"), paramName);
			}
			WorksheetRegionAddress address = region.Address;
			try
			{
				IsResizing = true;
				WorksheetRegionAddress address2 = DataAreaRegion.Address;
				WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = address;
				List<WorksheetTableColumn> list = new List<WorksheetTableColumn>();
				WorksheetTableColumnCollection columns = Columns;
				if (_wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex < worksheetRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex)
				{
					for (short num = _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex; num < worksheetRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex; num++)
					{
						list.Add(columns[num - _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex]);
					}
				}
				if (worksheetRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex < _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex)
				{
					for (short num2 = (short)(worksheetRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex + 1); num2 < _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex; num2++)
					{
						list.Add(columns[num2 - _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex]);
					}
				}
				WorksheetTableResizeOperation tableResizeOperation = new WorksheetTableResizeOperation(this, worksheetRegionAddress);
				CellShiftOperation? cellShiftOperation = null;
				if (IsTotalsRowVisible)
				{
					int index = TotalsRow.Index;
					if (worksheetRegionAddress.LastRowIndex < index)
					{
						worksheetRegionAddress = new WorksheetRegionAddress(worksheetRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex, worksheetRegionAddress.LastRowIndex + 1, worksheetRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, worksheetRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex);
						tableResizeOperation = new WorksheetTableResizeOperation(this, worksheetRegionAddress);
					}
					if (index < worksheetRegionAddress.LastRowIndex)
					{
						cellShiftOperation = new CellShiftOperation(worksheet, CellShiftType.VerticalRotate, tableResizeOperation, index, worksheetRegionAddress.LastRowIndex, _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex, -1, rowInstancesShift: false);
					}
					else if (worksheetRegionAddress.LastRowIndex < index)
					{
						cellShiftOperation = new CellShiftOperation(worksheet, CellShiftType.VerticalRotate, tableResizeOperation, worksheetRegionAddress.LastRowIndex, index, _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex, 1, rowInstancesShift: false);
					}
				}
				if (!cellShiftOperation.HasValue)
				{
					cellShiftOperation = new CellShiftOperation(worksheet, CellShiftType.TableResizedWithoutShift, tableResizeOperation, _wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex, _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex, 0, rowInstancesShift: false);
				}
				switch (worksheet.ShiftCells(cellShiftOperation.Value, CellShiftInitializeFormatType.UseDefaultFormat).Result)
				{
				case CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitTable:
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_NewTableRegionOverlapsOtherTable"));
				case CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitMergedRegion:
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_NewTableRegionOverlapsMergedRegion"));
				case CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitBlockingValue:
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_NewTableRegionOverlapsBlockingValue"));
				}
				List<Formula> list2 = new List<Formula>();
				Workbook workbook = Workbook;
				workbook?.OnTableResizing(this, list, list2);
				WorksheetRegionAddress wholeTableAddress = _wholeTableAddress;
				_wholeTableAddress = worksheetRegionAddress;
				int i = 0;
				int firstColumnIndex = wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex;
				int firstColumnIndex2 = _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex;
				if (firstColumnIndex < firstColumnIndex2)
				{
					for (short num3 = wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex; num3 < _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex; num3++)
					{
						columns.InternalRemoveAt(0);
					}
				}
				else if (firstColumnIndex2 < firstColumnIndex)
				{
					int num4 = firstColumnIndex - firstColumnIndex2;
					WorksheetTableColumn[] array = new WorksheetTableColumn[num4];
					int num5 = 0;
					short num6 = _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex;
					while (num6 < wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex)
					{
						InitializeInsertedColumnAreaFormats(InsertColumnAt(i, array[num5]));
						num6++;
						i++;
						num5++;
					}
				}
				if (_wholeTableAddress.Width < columns.Count)
				{
					for (; i < _wholeTableAddress.Width; i++)
					{
						columns[i].ResetCache();
					}
					while (_wholeTableAddress.Width < columns.Count)
					{
						columns.InternalRemoveAt(columns.Count - 1);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					for (; i < columns.Count; i++)
					{
						columns[i].ResetCache();
					}
					int num7 = _wholeTableAddress.Width - columns.Count;
					WorksheetTableColumn[] array2 = new WorksheetTableColumn[num7];
					int num8 = 0;
					while (i < _wholeTableAddress.Width)
					{
						InitializeInsertedColumnAreaFormats(InsertColumnAt(columns.Count, array2[num8]));
						i++;
						num8++;
					}
				}
				AssignUniqueColumnNames();
				if (IsHeaderRowVisible)
				{
					ApplyColumnNamesToHeaderCells();
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
				{
					list2[j].OnTableResized();
				}
				workbook?.NotifyTableDirtied(this);
				WorksheetRegion dataAreaRegion = DataAreaRegion;
				WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = null;
				if (address2.LastRowIndex < dataAreaRegion.LastRow)
				{
					worksheetRegion = worksheet.GetCachedRegion(address2.LastRowIndex + 1, dataAreaRegion.FirstColumn, dataAreaRegion.LastRow, dataAreaRegion.LastColumn);
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < Columns.Count; k++)
				{
					WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = Columns[k];
					if (worksheetTableColumn.WorksheetColumnIndex < address2.FirstColumnIndex || address2.LastRowIndex < worksheetTableColumn.WorksheetColumnIndex)
					{
						if (IsHeaderRowVisible)
						{
							worksheetTableColumn.SynchronizeAreaFormatWithCells(WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell);
						}
						worksheetTableColumn.SynchronizeAreaFormatWithCells(WorksheetTableColumnArea.DataArea);
						if (IsTotalsRowVisible)
						{
							worksheetTableColumn.SynchronizeAreaFormatWithCells(WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell);
						}
					}
					else if (worksheetRegion != null)
					{
						worksheetTableColumn.SynchronizeAreaFormatWithCells(worksheetTableColumn.AreaFormats.TryGetFormatProxy(WorksheetTableColumnArea.DataArea), CellFormatValue.AllFormattingProperties, onlyApplyNonDefaultValues: true, worksheetRegion, null);
					}
				}
				if (IsInsertRowVisible && 1 < DataAreaRegion.Height)
				{
					IsInsertRowVisible = false;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IsResizing = false;
			}
		}

			WorksheetTableStyle style = Style;

			}
		}

		internal void AssignUniqueColumnNames()
		{
			if (PreventAssigningUniqueColumnNames)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				PreventAssigningUniqueColumnNames = true;
				Dictionary<WorksheetTableColumn, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<WorksheetTableColumn, string>();
				List<KeyValuePair<WorksheetTableColumn, string>> list = new List<KeyValuePair<WorksheetTableColumn, string>>();
				string text = Utilities.GetString("GenerateTableColumnName");
				int num = 1;
				Dictionary<string, bool> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, bool>(StringComparer.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
				CultureInfo culture = Culture;
				for (int i = 0; i < Columns.Count; i++)
				{
					WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = Columns[i];
					string text2 = worksheetTableColumn.Name;
					string text3 = text2;
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
					{
						text2 = text;
						bool flag;
						do
						{
							text3 = text2 + num++;
							flag = false;
							for (int j = i + 1; j < Columns.Count; j++)
							{
								if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(text3, Columns[j].Name, culture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
								{
									flag = true;
									break;
								}
							}
						}
						while (flag);
					}
					while (dictionary2.ContainsKey(text3))
					{
						if (num == 1)
						{
							num++;
						}
						text3 = text2 + num++;
					}
					worksheetTableColumn.Name = text3;
					dictionary2.Add(text3, value: true);
					dictionary.Add(worksheetTableColumn, text3);
					if (_columnNames != null && _columnNames.TryGetValue(worksheetTableColumn, out var value) && value != text3)
					{
						list.Add(new KeyValuePair<WorksheetTableColumn, string>(worksheetTableColumn, value));
					}
				}
				_columnNames = dictionary;
				if (list.Count != 0)
				{
					Workbook?.OnTableColumnsRenamed(this, list);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				PreventAssigningUniqueColumnNames = false;
			}
		}
