		internal void GetDataAreaRowIndexes(out int dataAreaTopRowIndex, out int dataAreaBottomRowIndex)
		{
			GetDataAreaRowIndexes(_wholeTableAddress, out dataAreaTopRowIndex, out dataAreaBottomRowIndex);
		}

		internal void GetDataAreaRowIndexes(WorksheetRegionAddress wholeTableAddress, out int dataAreaTopRowIndex, out int dataAreaBottomRowIndex)
		{
			dataAreaTopRowIndex = wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex;
			if (IsHeaderRowVisible)
			{
				dataAreaTopRowIndex++;
			}
			dataAreaBottomRowIndex = wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex;
			if (IsTotalsRowVisible)
			{
				dataAreaBottomRowIndex--;
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetTableArea GetTableAreaOfRow(WorksheetRow row)
		{
			if (IsHeaderRowVisible && row.Index == _wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex)
			{
				return WorksheetTableArea.HeaderRow;
			}
			if (IsTotalsRowVisible && row.Index == _wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex)
			{
				return WorksheetTableArea.TotalsRow;
			}
			return WorksheetTableArea.DataArea;
		}

		internal void InitializeAreaFormats()
		{
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			for (int i = 0; i < Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				Columns[i].InitializeAreaFormats();
			}
			WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = Columns[0];
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = worksheetTableColumn.AreaFormats.TryGetFormatElement(WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell);
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData2 = worksheetTableColumn.AreaFormats.TryGetFormatElement(WorksheetTableColumnArea.DataArea);
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData3 = worksheetTableColumn.AreaFormats.TryGetFormatElement(WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell);
			for (int j = 1; j < Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn2 = Columns[j];
				if (worksheetCellFormatData != null)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatData obj = worksheetTableColumn2.AreaFormats.TryGetFormatElement(WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell);
					if (!worksheetCellFormatData.Equals(obj))
					{
						worksheetCellFormatData = null;
					}
				}
				if (worksheetCellFormatData2 != null)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatData obj2 = worksheetTableColumn2.AreaFormats.TryGetFormatElement(WorksheetTableColumnArea.DataArea);
					if (!worksheetCellFormatData2.Equals(obj2))
					{
						worksheetCellFormatData2 = null;
					}
				}
				if (worksheetCellFormatData3 != null)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatData obj3 = worksheetTableColumn2.AreaFormats.TryGetFormatElement(WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell);
					if (!worksheetCellFormatData3.Equals(obj3))
					{
						worksheetCellFormatData3 = null;
					}
				}
			}
			try
			{
				SuspendAreaFormatSynchronization = true;
				if (worksheetCellFormatData != null)
				{
					AreaFormats[WorksheetTableArea.HeaderRow].SetFormatting(worksheetCellFormatData);
				}
				if (worksheetCellFormatData2 != null)
				{
					AreaFormats[WorksheetTableArea.DataArea].SetFormatting(worksheetCellFormatData2);
				}
				if (worksheetCellFormatData3 != null)
				{
					AreaFormats[WorksheetTableArea.TotalsRow].SetFormatting(worksheetCellFormatData3);
				}
				Dictionary<CellFormatValue, object> edgeBorderValues = WorksheetMergedCellsRegion.GetEdgeBorderValues(Worksheet, WholeTableAddress, null, resolveExternalBorders: false);
				if (edgeBorderValues == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				WorksheetCellFormatProxy formatProxy = AreaFormats.GetFormatProxy(workbook, WorksheetTableArea.WholeTable);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<CellFormatValue, object> item in edgeBorderValues)
				{
					formatProxy.SetValue(item.Key, item.Value);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SuspendAreaFormatSynchronization = false;
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeInsertedColumnAreaFormats(WorksheetTableColumn newColumn)
		{
			newColumn.InitializeAreaFormats();
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			WorksheetCellFormatProxy worksheetCellFormatProxy = AreaFormats.TryGetFormatProxy(WorksheetTableArea.HeaderRow);
			if (worksheetCellFormatProxy != null)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatProxy formatProxy = newColumn.AreaFormats.GetFormatProxy(workbook, WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell);
				formatProxy.FormatOptions &= ~worksheetCellFormatProxy.FormatOptions;
				Utilities.CopyCellFormatValues(worksheetCellFormatProxy, formatProxy, CellFormatValue.AllFormattingProperties, onlyCopyNonDefaultValues: true);
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatProxy worksheetCellFormatProxy2 = AreaFormats.TryGetFormatProxy(WorksheetTableArea.DataArea);
			if (worksheetCellFormatProxy2 != null)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatProxy formatProxy2 = newColumn.AreaFormats.GetFormatProxy(workbook, WorksheetTableColumnArea.DataArea);
				formatProxy2.FormatOptions &= ~worksheetCellFormatProxy2.FormatOptions;
				Utilities.CopyCellFormatValues(worksheetCellFormatProxy2, formatProxy2, CellFormatValue.AllFormattingProperties, onlyCopyNonDefaultValues: true);
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatProxy worksheetCellFormatProxy3 = AreaFormats.TryGetFormatProxy(WorksheetTableArea.TotalsRow);
			if (worksheetCellFormatProxy3 != null)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatProxy formatProxy3 = newColumn.AreaFormats.GetFormatProxy(workbook, WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell);
				formatProxy3.FormatOptions &= ~worksheetCellFormatProxy3.FormatOptions;
				Utilities.CopyCellFormatValues(worksheetCellFormatProxy3, formatProxy3, CellFormatValue.AllFormattingProperties, onlyCopyNonDefaultValues: true);
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeColumnFormulas()
		{
			WorksheetRegion dataAreaRegion = DataAreaRegion;
			if (dataAreaRegion == null || dataAreaRegion.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = Columns[i];
				Formula formula = null;
				int num = dataAreaRegion.Height / 2 + 1;
				int num2 = dataAreaRegion.LastRow - num + 1;
				for (int j = num2; j <= dataAreaRegion.LastRow; j++)
				{
					WorksheetRow ifCreated = _worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(j);
					if (ifCreated == null)
					{
						formula = null;
					}
					else
					{
						Formula cellFormulaInternal = ifCreated.GetCellFormulaInternal(worksheetTableColumn.WorksheetColumnIndex);
						if (formula == null)
						{
							formula = cellFormulaInternal;
						}
						else if (cellFormulaInternal == null || !cellFormulaInternal.IsEquivalentTo(formula))
						{
							formula = null;
						}
					}
					if (formula == null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (formula != null)
				{
					formula = formula.Clone();
					formula.OffsetReferences(Workbook, dataAreaRegion.TopRow, worksheetTableColumn.WorksheetColumnIndex, Utilities.CreatePoint(0, dataAreaRegion.FirstRow - num2));
					worksheetTableColumn.SetInitialColumnFormula(formula);
				}
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetTableColumn InsertColumn()
		{
			return InsertColumnHelper(Columns.Count, _nextColumnId);
		}

		internal WorksheetTableColumn InsertColumn(uint id)
		{
			return InsertColumnHelper(Columns.Count, id);
		}

		private WorksheetTableColumn InsertColumnHelper(int index, uint id)
		{
			_nextColumnId = Math.Max(id + 1, _nextColumnId);
			int num = _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex + index;
			WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = new WorksheetTableColumn(this, id, (short)num);
			_columns.InternalInsert(index, worksheetTableColumn);
			return worksheetTableColumn;
		}

		internal WorksheetTableColumn InsertColumnAt(int index)
		{
			return InsertColumnHelper(index, _nextColumnId);
		}

		internal WorksheetTableColumn InsertColumnAt(int index, WorksheetTableColumn columnToReuse)
		{
			if (columnToReuse == null)
			{
				return InsertColumnAt(index);
			}
			int num = _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex + index;
			_columns.InternalInsert(index, columnToReuse);
			columnToReuse.OnReAddedToTable(this, (short)num);
			return columnToReuse;
		}

		internal bool IsOperationValid(ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride)
		{
			if (operationOverride == null || !operationOverride.PerformsShift || !operationOverride.IsRemoveOperation || !operationOverride.ShiftsRows)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsHeaderRowVisible && !Utilities.DoesOperationCompletelyContainRange(operationOverride, WholeTableAddress) && Utilities.DoesOperationIntersectWithRange(operationOverride, HeaderRowRegion.Address))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool OnBeforeShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, WorksheetRegionAddress deletedRegionAddress)
		{
			if (_wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex >= deletedRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex && _wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex >= deletedRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex && _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex <= deletedRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex && _wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex <= deletedRegionAddress.LastRowIndex)
			{
				Worksheet.Tables.Remove(this);
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				Columns[i].SuspendCellValueSynchronizations();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnRemovedFromWorkbook(Workbook oldWorkbook)
		{
			oldWorkbook?.OnTableRemoved(this);
			if (_areaFormats != null)
			{
				_areaFormats.OnUnrooted();
			}
			if (_columns != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _columns.Count; i++)
				{
					_columns[i].OnUnrooted();
				}
			}
			base.ScopeInternal = null;
			Style = null;
		}

		internal void OnRemovedFromWorksheet(bool convertToRange)
		{
			ClearFilters();
			if (convertToRange)
			{
				ApplyStyleAreaFormatsToCells();
			}
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			WorksheetRow headerRow = HeaderRow;
			if (headerRow != null)
			{
				for (short num = _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex; num <= _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex; num++)
				{
					headerRow.SetCellIsSpecial(num, isSpecial: false);
				}
			}
			WorksheetRow totalsRow = TotalsRow;
			if (totalsRow != null)
			{
				for (short num2 = _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex; num2 <= _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex; num2++)
				{
					totalsRow.SetCellIsSpecial(num2, isSpecial: false);
				}
			}
			if (_columns != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _columns.Count; i++)
				{
					_columns[i].OnTableRemovedFromCollection();
				}
			}
			OnRemovedFromWorkbook(workbook);
			_worksheet = null;
		}

		internal void OnRooted(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			_worksheet = worksheet;
			Workbook workbook = _worksheet.Workbook;
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				base.ScopeInternal = workbook;
				workbook.OnNamedReferenceAdded(this);
				if (_areaFormats != null)
				{
					_areaFormats.OnRooted(workbook);
				}
			}
			if (_columns != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _columns.Count; i++)
				{
					_columns[i].OnRooted(workbook);
				}
			}
			AssignUniqueColumnNames();
			if (IsHeaderRowVisible)
			{
				ApplyColumnNamesToHeaderCells();
			}
			if (IsTotalsRowVisible)
			{
				ApplyTotalsToTotalCells();
			}
		}

		internal static void ProcessCellShiftResult(CellShiftResult shiftResult, string rowDescription)
		{
			switch (shiftResult)
			{
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotInsertTableRow_LossOfData", rowDescription));
			case CellShiftResult.ErrorLossOfObject:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotInsertTableRow_LossOfObject", rowDescription));
			case CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitTable:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotInsertTableRow_SplitTable", rowDescription));
			case CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitMergedRegion:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotInsertTableRow_SplitMergedRegion", rowDescription));
			case CellShiftResult.ErrorSplitBlockingValue:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotInsertTableRow_SplitBlockingValue", rowDescription));
			case CellShiftResult.Success:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void ResumeFiltering()
		{
			_suspendFilteringCount--;
			if (_suspendFilteringCount <= 0 && RefilterRequired)
			{
				RefilterRequired = false;
				ReapplyFilters();
			}
		}

		internal ShiftAddressResult ShiftTable(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride)
		{
			WorksheetRegionAddress value = new WorksheetRegionAddress(_wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex, _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex);
			ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult = shiftOperation.ShiftRegionAddress(ref _wholeTableAddress, operationOverride, leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet: false);
			if (shiftAddressResult.DidShift && operationOverride != null && operationOverride.ShiftsColumns && !operationOverride.IsUndoOperation)
			{
				Workbook workbook = Workbook;
				if (workbook != null && value.Width != _wholeTableAddress.Width)
				{
					int num = _wholeTableAddress.Width - value.Width;
					if (num < 0)
					{
						int index = Math.Max(0, shiftOperation.RegionAddressAfterShift.FirstColumnIndex - _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex);
						RemoveColumns(index, -num, temporarilySuspendUndo: true, value);
					}
					else
					{
						int index2 = shiftOperation.RegionAddressBeforeShift.FirstColumnIndex - value.FirstColumnIndex;
						InsertColumns(index2, num, null, temporarilySuspendUndo: true, value);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				Columns[i].ResumeCellValueSynchronizations();
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				Columns[j].SetAbsoluteColumnIndex((short)(j + _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex));
			}
			return shiftAddressResult;
		}

		internal void SuspendFiltering()
		{
			_suspendFilteringCount++;
		}

		private void ApplyColumnNamesToHeaderCells()
		{
			WorksheetRow headerRow = HeaderRow;
			if (headerRow == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				flag = workbook.IsLoading;
			}
			try
			{
				PreventAssigningUniqueColumnNames = true;
				for (short num = 0; num < Columns.Count; num++)
				{
					WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = Columns[num];
					short columnIndex = (short)(num + _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex);
					headerRow.SetCellIsSpecial(columnIndex, isSpecial: true);
					if (!flag)
					{
						headerRow.SetCellValue(columnIndex, worksheetTableColumn.NameInternal);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				PreventAssigningUniqueColumnNames = false;
			}
		}

		private void ApplyStyleAreaFormatsToCell(int rowIndex, short columnIndex, WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormat, SortedList<int, WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableStyleArea>> styleAreaFormats, WorksheetRegion dataAreaRegion)
		{
			for (int num = styleAreaFormats.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableStyleArea> worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy = styleAreaFormats.Values[num];
				if (IsCellInStyleArea(rowIndex, columnIndex, worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy.Area, dataAreaRegion))
				{
					if (worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy.Area == WorksheetTableStyleArea.WholeTable)
					{
						CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.FontFormattingProperties | CellFormatValue.AlignmentFormattingProperties | CellFormatValue._UndoElementData | CellFormatValue.FillFormattingProperties | CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo | CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders | CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle | CellFormatValue.FormatString | CellFormatValue.Locked;
						if (rowIndex == _wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex)
						{
							cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo;
							cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle;
						}
						if (rowIndex == _wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex)
						{
							cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo;
							cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle;
						}
						if (columnIndex == _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex)
						{
							cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo;
							cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle;
						}
						if (columnIndex == _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex)
						{
							cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo;
							cellFormatValue |= CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle;
						}
						InitializeDefaultFormatValues(cellFormat, worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy, cellFormatValue);
					}
					else
					{
						InitializeDefaultFormatValues(cellFormat, worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void ApplyStyleAreaFormatsToCells()
		{
			WorksheetTableStyle style = Style;
			if (style == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SortedList<int, WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableStyleArea>> styleAreaFormatsSorted = style.GetStyleAreaFormatsSorted();
			WorksheetRegion dataAreaRegion = DataAreaRegion;
			foreach (WorksheetCell item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetCell>)WholeTableRegion)
			{
				ApplyStyleAreaFormatsToCell(item.RowIndex, item.ColumnIndexInternal, item.CellFormatInternal, styleAreaFormatsSorted, dataAreaRegion);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyTotalsToTotalCells()
		{
			WorksheetRow totalsRow = TotalsRow;
			if (totalsRow == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				flag = workbook.IsLoading;
			}
			for (short num = 0; num < Columns.Count; num++)
			{
				WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = Columns[num];
				short columnIndex = (short)(num + _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex);
				totalsRow.SetCellIsSpecial(columnIndex, isSpecial: true);
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (worksheetTableColumn.TotalFormulaInternal != null)
					{
						worksheetTableColumn.TotalFormulaInternal.ApplyTo(totalsRow, columnIndex);
					}
					else
					{
						string totalLabelInternal = worksheetTableColumn.TotalLabelInternal;
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(totalLabelInternal))
						{
							totalsRow.SetCellValue(columnIndex, totalLabelInternal);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearHeaderOrTotalCells(int headerOrTotalRowIndex)
		{
			WorksheetRow ifCreated = Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(headerOrTotalRowIndex);
			if (ifCreated == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (short num = _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex; num <= _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex; num++)
			{
				ifCreated.SetCellIsSpecial(num, isSpecial: false);
				ifCreated.SetCellValue(num, null);
				WorksheetCellFormatProxy worksheetCellFormatProxy = ifCreated.TryGetCellFormatProxy(num);
				if (worksheetCellFormatProxy != null)
				{
					worksheetCellFormatProxy.Style = null;
					worksheetCellFormatProxy.FormatOptions = WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool GetFlag(TableFlags flag)
		{
			return (_flags & flag) == flag;
		}

		private static void InitializeDefaultFormatValues(WorksheetCellFormatProxy target, WorksheetCellFormatProxy other, CellFormatValue values = CellFormatValue.AllFormattingProperties)
		{
			GenericCachedCollection<WorksheetCellFormatData> collection = target.BeforeSet();
			WorkbookStyle style = target.Style;
			WorksheetCellFormatOptions worksheetCellFormatOptions = ((style != null && !style.IsNormalStyle) ? style.StyleFormatInternal.FormatOptionsResolved : WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None);
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = target.Element.Workbook?.Styles.NormalStyle.StyleFormatInternal;
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue << 1))
			{
				if ((values & cellFormatValue) == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!target.IsValueDefault(cellFormatValue))
				{
					CellFormatValue cellFormatValue2 = cellFormatValue;
					if (cellFormatValue2 <= CellFormatValue.Fill)
					{
						if (cellFormatValue2 != CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle && cellFormatValue2 != CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle && cellFormatValue2 != CellFormatValue.Fill)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						switch (cellFormatValue2)
						{
						case CellFormatValue.FontColorInfo:
						case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
						case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
						case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
							break;
						default:
							continue;
						}
					}
					if (worksheetCellFormatData == null || !object.Equals(worksheetCellFormatData.GetValue(cellFormatValue), target.GetValue(cellFormatValue)))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				WorksheetCellFormatOptions worksheetCellFormatOptions2 = WorksheetCellFormatData.FormatOptionForValue(cellFormatValue);
				if ((worksheetCellFormatOptions & worksheetCellFormatOptions2) == 0 || (target.FormatOptions & worksheetCellFormatOptions2) != WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None)
				{
					object value = other.GetValue(cellFormatValue);
					if (!WorksheetCellFormatData.IsValueDefault(cellFormatValue, value))
					{
						target.SetValue(cellFormatValue, value, callBeforeAndAfterSet: false, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.DefaultBehavior);
					}
				}
			}
			target.AfterSet(collection);
		}

		private bool IsCellInStyleArea(int rowIndex, short columnIndex, WorksheetTableStyleArea area, WorksheetRegion dataAreaRegion)
		{
			switch (area)
			{
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.WholeTable:
				return true;
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.ColumnStripe:
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.AlternateColumnStripe:
			{
				if (!DisplayBandedColumns || !dataAreaRegion.Contains(rowIndex, columnIndex))
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = Style.ColumnStripeWidth + Style.AlternateColumnStripeWidth;
				int num2 = (columnIndex - WholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex) % num;
				if (area == WorksheetTableStyleArea.ColumnStripe)
				{
					return num2 < Style.ColumnStripeWidth;
				}
				return Style.ColumnStripeWidth <= num2;
			}
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.RowStripe:
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.AlternateRowStripe:
			{
				if (!DisplayBandedRows || !dataAreaRegion.Contains(rowIndex, columnIndex))
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num3 = Style.RowStripeHeight + Style.AlternateRowStripeHeight;
				int num4 = (rowIndex - dataAreaRegion.FirstRow) % num3;
				if (area == WorksheetTableStyleArea.RowStripe)
				{
					return num4 < Style.RowStripeHeight;
				}
				return Style.RowStripeHeight <= num4;
			}
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.LastColumn:
				if (!DisplayLastColumnFormatting)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return columnIndex == WholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex;
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.FirstColumn:
				if (!DisplayFirstColumnFormatting)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return columnIndex == WholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex;
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.HeaderRow:
				if (IsHeaderRowVisible)
				{
					return rowIndex == WholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex;
				}
				return false;
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.TotalRow:
				if (IsTotalsRowVisible)
				{
					return rowIndex == WholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex;
				}
				return false;
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.FirstHeaderCell:
				if (!DisplayFirstColumnFormatting)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsHeaderRowVisible && rowIndex == WholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex)
				{
					return columnIndex == WholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex;
				}
				return false;
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.LastHeaderCell:
				if (!DisplayLastColumnFormatting)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsHeaderRowVisible && rowIndex == WholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex)
				{
					return columnIndex == WholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex;
				}
				return false;
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.FirstTotalCell:
				if (!DisplayFirstColumnFormatting)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsTotalsRowVisible && rowIndex == WholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex)
				{
					return columnIndex == WholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex;
				}
				return false;
			case WorksheetTableStyleArea.LastTotalCell:
				if (!DisplayLastColumnFormatting)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsTotalsRowVisible && rowIndex == WholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex)
				{
					return columnIndex == WholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void InsertColumns(int index, int count, WorksheetTableColumn[] oldColumns = null, bool temporarilySuspendUndo = false, WorksheetRegionAddress? oldAddress = null)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			int maxColumnCount = Workbook.MaxColumnCount;
			if (index + count > maxColumnCount)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Max columns exceeded");
			}
			_ = Worksheet?.Workbook;
			bool preventAssigningUniqueColumnNames = PreventAssigningUniqueColumnNames;
			PreventAssigningUniqueColumnNames = true;
			for (int i = index; i < Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				Columns[i].OnRemovedFromTable(isTemporaryRemoval: true);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				if (oldColumns != null)
				{
					InsertColumnAt(index + j, oldColumns[j]);
				}
				else
				{
					InsertColumnAt(index + j);
				}
			}
			for (int k = index + count; k < Columns.Count; k++)
			{
				Columns[k].OnReAddedToTable(this, (short)(_wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex + k), isTemporaryRemoval: true);
			}
			WorksheetTableColumn[] array = new WorksheetTableColumn[count];
			for (int l = 0; l < count; l++)
			{
				array[l] = Columns[index + l];
			}
			if (oldColumns == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(oldColumns[0].NameInternal))
			{
				bool flag = false;
				int m = 0;
				string text = Utilities.GetString("GenerateTableColumnName");
				if (index > 0)
				{
					string text2 = Columns[index - 1].Name;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
					{
						int num = 0;
						for (int num2 = text2.Length - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
						{
							char c = text2[num2];
							if (c < '0' || c > '9')
							{
								break;
							}
							num++;
						}
						if (num > 0 && num < 10 && int.TryParse(text2.Substring(text2.Length - num), out m))
						{
							text = text2.Substring(0, text2.Length - num);
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					for (; Columns[text + (m + 1)] != null; m++)
					{
					}
				}
				string text3 = null;
				bool flag2 = false;
				WorksheetTableColumn[] array2 = array;
				foreach (WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn in array2)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						m++;
						string text4 = text + m;
						flag2 = Columns[text4] != null;
						if (flag2)
						{
							if (text3 == null)
							{
								flag2 = false;
								text += m - 1;
								m = 2;
								while (text3 == null)
								{
									text4 = text + m;
									if (Columns[text4] == null)
									{
										text3 = text4;
										break;
									}
									m++;
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							text3 = text4;
						}
					}
					worksheetTableColumn.Name = text3;
				}
			}
			PreventAssigningUniqueColumnNames = preventAssigningUniqueColumnNames;
			AssignUniqueColumnNames();
		}

		private void RemoveColumns(int index, int count, bool temporarilySuspendUndo = false, WorksheetRegionAddress? oldAddress = null)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (index + count > Columns.Count)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Max columns exceeded");
			}
			_ = Worksheet?.Workbook;
			for (int i = index + count; i < Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				Columns[i].OnRemovedFromTable(isTemporaryRemoval: true);
			}
			WorksheetTableColumn[] array = new WorksheetTableColumn[count];
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				array[j] = Columns[index];
				Columns.InternalRemoveAt(index);
			}
			for (int k = index; k < Columns.Count; k++)
			{
				Columns[k].OnReAddedToTable(this, (short)(_wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex + k), isTemporaryRemoval: true);
			}
		}

		private void OnIsHeaderRowVisibleChanged()
		{
			IsFilterUIVisible = IsHeaderRowVisible;
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Workbook?.NotifyTableDirtied(this);
			if (IsHeaderRowVisible)
			{
				if (ShouldInsertHeaderCells())
				{
					_ = Worksheet.InsertCellsAndShiftDown(_wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex, _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex, CellShiftInitializeFormatType.UseDefaultFormat).Result;
				}
				_wholeTableAddress = _wholeTableAddress.WithFirstRowIndex(_wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex - 1);
				ApplyColumnNamesToHeaderCells();
				{
					foreach (WorksheetTableColumn item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetTableColumn>)Columns)
					{
						item.OnHeaderRowShown();
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			ClearFilters();
			int firstRowIndex = _wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex;
			_wholeTableAddress = _wholeTableAddress.WithFirstRowIndex(firstRowIndex + 1);
			ClearHeaderOrTotalCells(firstRowIndex);
		}

		private void OnIsHeaderRowVisibleChanging()
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsHeaderRowVisible)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetTableColumn item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetTableColumn>)Columns)
				{
					item.OnHeaderRowHiding();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (ShouldInsertHeaderCells())
			{
				string text = Utilities.GetString("TableHeaderRowDescription");
				int num = Worksheet.Rows.MaxCount - 1;
				if (num == _wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotInsertTableRow_TableOnBottomOfWorksheet", text));
				}
				CellShiftResult shiftResult = Worksheet.VerifyCellShift(_wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex + 1, num - 1, _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex, 1, CellShiftType.VerticalShift);
				ProcessCellShiftResult(shiftResult, text);
			}
		}

		private void OnTotalsRowHidden()
		{
			if (Worksheet != null)
			{
				Workbook?.NotifyTableDirtied(this);
				int lastRowIndex = _wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex;
				_wholeTableAddress = _wholeTableAddress.WithLastRowIndex(_wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex - 1);
				if (Worksheet.DeleteCellsAndShiftUp(lastRowIndex, _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex).Result != CellShiftResult.Success)
				{
					ClearHeaderOrTotalCells(lastRowIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnTotalsRowHiding()
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetTableColumn item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetTableColumn>)Columns)
			{
				item.OnTotalsRowHiding();
			}
		}

		private void OnTotalsRowShowing(out bool shouldTotalsRowBeInserted)
		{
			//IL_0143: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ba: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			shouldTotalsRowBeInserted = true;
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			int num = Worksheet.Rows.MaxCount - 1;
			if (_wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex == num)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_TotalsRowCannotBeShownInLastRow"));
			}
			string rowDescription = Utilities.GetString("TableTotalsRowDescription");
			CellShiftResult cellShiftResult = Worksheet.VerifyCellShift(_wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex + 1, num - 1, _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex, 1, CellShiftType.VerticalShift);
			if (cellShiftResult != CellShiftResult.Success)
			{
				if (Worksheet.AreCellsNonTrivial(_wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex + 1, _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex))
				{
					ProcessCellShiftResult(cellShiftResult, rowDescription);
				}
				shouldTotalsRowBeInserted = false;
			}
			if (workbook == null || HasTotalsRowEverBeenVisible)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Columns.Count > 1)
			{
				WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = Columns[0];
				if (worksheetTableColumn.TotalFormula == null && worksheetTableColumn.TotalLabel == null)
				{
					worksheetTableColumn.TotalLabel = Utilities.GetString("DefaultTotalLabel");
				}
			}
			WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn2 = Columns[Columns.Count - 1];
			if (worksheetTableColumn2.TotalFormula != null || worksheetTableColumn2.TotalLabel != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ST_TotalsRowFunction totalsRowFunction = (ST_TotalsRowFunction)2;
			GetDataAreaRowIndexes(out var dataAreaTopRowIndex, out var dataAreaBottomRowIndex);
			Worksheet worksheet = Worksheet;
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(dataAreaTopRowIndex, dataAreaBottomRowIndex))
			{
				object cellValueInternal = item.GetCellValueInternal(worksheetTableColumn2.WorksheetColumnIndex);
				if (cellValueInternal != null)
				{
					if (!Utilities.IsNumber(cellValueInternal) || worksheet.TryGetDateTimeFromCell(item, worksheetTableColumn2.WorksheetColumnIndex, out var _))
					{
						totalsRowFunction = (ST_TotalsRowFunction)2;
						break;
					}
					totalsRowFunction = (ST_TotalsRowFunction)6;
				}
			}
			worksheetTableColumn2.TotalFormula = workbook.GetTotalFormula(worksheetTableColumn2, totalsRowFunction);
		}

		private void OnTotalsRowShown(bool shouldTotalsRowBeInserted)
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Workbook?.NotifyTableDirtied(this);
			if (shouldTotalsRowBeInserted)
			{
				Worksheet.InsertCellsAndShiftDown(_wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex + 1, _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex, CellShiftInitializeFormatType.UseDefaultFormat);
			}
			_wholeTableAddress = _wholeTableAddress.WithLastRowIndex(_wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex + 1);
			ApplyTotalsToTotalCells();
			HasTotalsRowEverBeenVisible = true;
			foreach (WorksheetTableColumn item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetTableColumn>)Columns)
			{
				item.OnTotalsRowShown();
			}
		}

		private void SetFlag(TableFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_flags &= (TableFlags)(ushort)(~(int)flag);
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldInsertHeaderCells()
		{
			if (_wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex != 0)
			{
				return Worksheet.AreCellsNonTrivial(_wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex - 1, _wholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, _wholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SynchronizeAreaFormatWithColumns(WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableArea> areaFormatProxy, CellFormatValue values)
		{
			if (SuspendAreaFormatSynchronization || areaFormatProxy == null || areaFormatProxy.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			if (workbook != null && workbook.IsLoading)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetTableArea area = areaFormatProxy.Area;
			WorksheetTableColumnArea area2;
			switch (area)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case WorksheetTableArea.DataArea:
				area2 = WorksheetTableColumnArea.DataArea;
				break;
			case WorksheetTableArea.HeaderRow:
				area2 = WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell;
				break;
			case WorksheetTableArea.TotalsRow:
				area2 = WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell;
				break;
			}
			CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)0;
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue2 = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue2 != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue2 = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue2 << 1))
			{
				if ((values & cellFormatValue2) != 0 && CanAreaFormatValueBeSet(area, cellFormatValue2) && !areaFormatProxy.IsValueDefault(cellFormatValue2))
				{
					cellFormatValue |= cellFormatValue2;
				}
			}
			if (cellFormatValue != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Columns.Count; i++)
				{
					Utilities.CopyCellFormatValues(areaFormatProxy, Columns[i].AreaFormats.GetFormatProxy(workbook, area2), cellFormatValue);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSet(WorksheetTableArea area, CellFormatValue value)
		{
			if (!VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSetHelper(area, value, out var message))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
			}
		}

		private static bool VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSetHelper(WorksheetTableArea area, CellFormatValue value, out string message)
		{
			switch (area)
			{
			case WorksheetTableArea.WholeTable:
				switch (value)
				{
				case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
				case CellFormatValue.FormatOptions:
				case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
				case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
				case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
					message = null;
					return true;
				default:
					message = Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidWholeTableAreaFormatProperty");
					return false;
				}
			default:
				message = null;
				return true;
			case WorksheetTableArea.HeaderRow:
				if (value == CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo || value == CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle)
				{
					message = Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidHeaderRowAreaFormatProperty");
					return false;
				}
				message = null;
				return true;
			case WorksheetTableArea.TotalsRow:
				switch (value)
				{
				case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
					message = Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidTotalsRowAreaFormatProperty");
					return false;
				default:
					message = null;
					return true;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WorksheetTableResizeOperation
	{
		public readonly WorksheetRegionAddress NewDataAreaAddress;

		public readonly WorksheetRegionAddress NewWholeTableAddress;

		public readonly WorksheetRegionAddress OldDataAreaAddress;

		public readonly WorksheetRegionAddress OldWholeTableAddress;

		public WorksheetTableResizeOperation(WorksheetTable table, WorksheetRegionAddress newWholeTableAddress)
		{
			table.GetDataAreaRowIndexes(newWholeTableAddress, out var dataAreaTopRowIndex, out var dataAreaBottomRowIndex);
			NewDataAreaAddress = new WorksheetRegionAddress(dataAreaTopRowIndex, dataAreaBottomRowIndex, newWholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, newWholeTableAddress.LastColumnIndex);
			NewWholeTableAddress = newWholeTableAddress;
			OldDataAreaAddress = table.DataAreaRegion.Address;
			OldWholeTableAddress = table.WholeTableAddress;
		}
	}

		private WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<TArea> GetFormatProxyHelper(Workbook workbook, TArea area, bool shouldCreateIfNotPresent)
		{

			{
				WorksheetCellFormatData data = ((workbook != null) ? workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat) : new WorksheetCellFormatData(null, WorksheetCellFormatType.DifferentialFormat));

				_formats[area] = value;
				value.Element.OnAddedToRootCollection(_owner);
				_owner.OnAreaFormatAdded(area, value.Element);

			return value;

		internal WorksheetTable Add(WorksheetRegion region, bool tableHasHeaders, WorksheetTableStyle tableStyle)
		{
			Workbook workbook = _worksheet.Workbook;
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotAddTableToRemovedWorksheet"));
			}
			if (tableStyle == null)
			{
				tableStyle = workbook.DefaultTableStyle;
			}
			else if (tableStyle.IsCustom && !workbook.CustomTableStyles.Contains(tableStyle))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_TableStyleFromOtherWorkbook"));
			}
			List<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion> list = null;
			foreach (WorksheetCell item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetCell>)region)
			{
				WorksheetMergedCellsRegion associatedMergedCellsRegion = item.AssociatedMergedCellsRegion;
				if (associatedMergedCellsRegion != null)
				{
					if (list == null)
					{
						list = new List<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>();
					}
					if (!list.Contains(associatedMergedCellsRegion))
					{
						list.Add(associatedMergedCellsRegion);
						region = WorksheetRegion.Union(region, associatedMergedCellsRegion);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (WorksheetCell item2 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetCell>)region)
			{
				if (item2.AssociatedTable != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_OverlappingTable"));
				}
				if (item2.Value is IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue worksheetRegionBlockingValue)
				{
					worksheetRegionBlockingValue.ThrowBlockingException();
				}
			}
			if (list != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					_worksheet.MergedCellsRegions.Remove(list[i]);
				}
			}
			string text = Utilities.GetString("GenerateTableName");
			int num = 1;
			string name;
			do
			{
				name = text + num++;
			}
			while (workbook.GetWorkbookScopedNamedItem(name) != null);
			bool isInsertRowVisible = false;
			bool wereCellsShiftedToShowInsertRow = false;
			int firstRow = region.FirstRow;
			int num2 = region.LastRow;
			short firstColumnInternal = region.FirstColumnInternal;
			short lastColumnInternal = region.LastColumnInternal;
			region = null;
			if (!tableHasHeaders)
			{
				string text2 = Utilities.GetString("TableHeaderRowDescription");
				if (num2 == workbook.MaxRowCount - 1)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotInsertTableRow_TableOnBottomOfWorksheet", text2));
				}
				WorksheetTable.ProcessCellShiftResult(((!_worksheet.AreCellsNonTrivial(num2 + 1, firstColumnInternal, lastColumnInternal)) ? _worksheet.ShiftCellsVertically(firstRow, num2, firstColumnInternal, lastColumnInternal, 1, CellShiftInitializeFormatType.FromShiftedCellsAdjacentToInsertRegion) : _worksheet.InsertCellsAndShiftDown(firstRow, firstColumnInternal, lastColumnInternal, CellShiftInitializeFormatType.FromShiftedCellsAdjacentToInsertRegion)).Result, text2);
				num2++;
				tableHasHeaders = true;
			}
			else if (firstRow == num2)
			{
				string text3 = Utilities.GetString("TableInsertRowDescription");
				if (num2 == workbook.MaxRowCount - 1)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotInsertTableRow_TableOnBottomOfWorksheet", text3));
				}
				if (_worksheet.AreCellsNonTrivial(num2 + 1, firstColumnInternal, lastColumnInternal))
				{
					WorksheetTable.ProcessCellShiftResult(_worksheet.InsertCellsAndShiftDown(num2 + 1, firstColumnInternal, lastColumnInternal, CellShiftInitializeFormatType.FromStationaryCellsAdjacentToInsertRegion).Result, text3);
					wereCellsShiftedToShowInsertRow = true;
				}
				num2++;
				isInsertRowVisible = true;
			}
			WorksheetTable worksheetTable = new WorksheetTable(name, workbook.GetNewTableId(), firstRow, num2, firstColumnInternal, lastColumnInternal);
			_ = Count;
			int num3 = lastColumnInternal - firstColumnInternal + 1;
			for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
			{
				worksheetTable.InsertColumn();
			}
			AddCore(Count, worksheetTable, tableStyle, tableHasHeaders, isInsertRowVisible, wereCellsShiftedToShowInsertRow, convertToRange: false);
			return worksheetTable;
		}

		private void AddCore(int insertAtIndex, WorksheetTable table, WorksheetTableStyle tableStyle, bool tableHasHeaders, bool isInsertRowVisible, bool wereCellsShiftedToShowInsertRow, bool convertToRange)

			table.InitializeColumnFormulas();
		}

		public bool Exists(string name)

			{
				return false;
			}
			CultureInfo culture = _worksheet.Culture;
			foreach (WorksheetTable table in _tables)
			{
				if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(table.Name, name, culture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public int IndexOf(WorksheetTable table)
		{
			return _tables.IndexOf(table);
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetTable table, bool convertToRange = true)
		{
			int num = _tables.IndexOf(table);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num, convertToRange);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index, bool convertToRange = true)
		{
			WorksheetTable worksheetTable = _tables[index];
			_tables.RemoveAt(index);
			_tablesById.Remove(worksheetTable.Id);
			worksheetTable.OnRemovedFromWorksheet(convertToRange);
		}

		internal WorksheetTable GetTableById(uint id)
		{
			_tablesById.TryGetValue(id, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		internal void InternalAdd(WorksheetTable table)
		{
			InternalInsert(Count, table);
		}

		internal void InternalInsert(int index, WorksheetTable table)
		{
			Workbook workbook = _worksheet.Workbook;
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				workbook.VerifyItemName(table.Name, table);
				workbook.NextTableId = Math.Max(workbook.NextTableId, table.Id + 1);
			}
			_tables.Insert(index, table);
			_tablesById[table.Id] = table;
			table.OnRooted(_worksheet);
		}

		private void ThrowOnDirectInsert()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotAddTableDirectly"));
		}
	}

					return;

				VerifyIsValid();
				if (Filter == value)

					return;

				if (value != null && Table != null && !Table.IsFilterUIVisible)

		void IAreaFormatsOwner<WorksheetTableColumnArea>.OnAreaFormatAdded(WorksheetTableColumnArea area, WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			switch (area)
			{
			case WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell:
			{
				WorksheetCell headerCell = HeaderCell;
				if (headerCell != null)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData2 = headerCell.Row.TryGetCellFormat(headerCell.ColumnIndexInternal);
					if (worksheetCellFormatData2 != null)
					{
						worksheetCellFormatData2 = worksheetCellFormatData2.CloneInternal();
						worksheetCellFormatData2.ResetValue(CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo);
						worksheetCellFormatData2.ResetValue(CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle);
						format.SetFormatting(worksheetCellFormatData2);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell:
			{
				WorksheetCell totalCell = TotalCell;
				if (totalCell != null)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = totalCell.Row.TryGetCellFormat(totalCell.ColumnIndexInternal);
					if (worksheetCellFormatData != null)
					{
						worksheetCellFormatData = worksheetCellFormatData.CloneInternal();
						worksheetCellFormatData.ResetValue(CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo);
						worksheetCellFormatData.ResetValue(CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle);
						format.SetFormatting(worksheetCellFormatData);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case WorksheetTableColumnArea.DataArea:
				break;
			}
		}

		void IWorksheetCellFormatProxyOwner.OnCellFormatValueChanging(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue values)
		{
			WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableColumnArea> worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy = (WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableColumnArea>)sender;
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue << 1))
			{
				if ((values & cellFormatValue) != 0)
				{
					VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSet(worksheetTableAreaFormatProxy.Area, cellFormatValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public FixedValuesFilter ApplyFixedValuesFilter(bool includeBlanks, IEnumerable<string> displayValues)
		{
			if (displayValues == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("displayValues");
			}
			FixedValuesFilter fixedValuesFilter = new FixedValuesFilter(this);
			fixedValuesFilter.IncludeBlanks = includeBlanks;
			foreach (string displayValue in displayValues)
			{
				fixedValuesFilter.DisplayValues.Add(displayValue);
			}
			if (fixedValuesFilter.IsEmpty)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_FixedValuesFilterMustAcceptAValue"));
			}
			Filter = fixedValuesFilter;
			return fixedValuesFilter;
		}

		public FixedValuesFilter ApplyFixedValuesFilter(bool includeBlanks, CalendarType calendarType, IEnumerable<FixedDateGroup> dateGroups)

			fixedValuesFilter.IncludeBlanks = includeBlanks;

			Filter = fixedValuesFilter;
			return fixedValuesFilter;
		}
