		public void SetColumnFormula(Formula formula, bool overwriteExistingValues)
		{
			VerifyIsValid();
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.OverwriteExistingValues, overwriteExistingValues);
			SetColumnFormula(formula);
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.OverwriteExistingValues, value: false);
		}

		private void SetColumnFormula(Formula formula)
		{
			if (formula != null && formula.OwningCellRow != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_ColumnFormulaAlreadyAppliedToCell"));
			}
			bool flag = GetFlag(InternalFlags.OverwriteExistingValues);
			if (_columnFormula == formula)
			{
				return;
			}
			ClearAppliedColumnFormulas();
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = null;
			short num = -1;
			WorksheetRegion dataAreaRegion = DataAreaRegion;
			if (dataAreaRegion != null)
			{
				if (dataAreaRegion.Worksheet == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				worksheetRow = dataAreaRegion.TopRow;
				num = dataAreaRegion.FirstColumnInternal;
				for (int i = dataAreaRegion.FirstRow; i <= dataAreaRegion.LastRow; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRow worksheetRow2 = dataAreaRegion.Worksheet.Rows[i];
					if (!flag && !Utilities.IsNullResolved(worksheetRow2.GetCellValueRaw(num)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (formula == null)
					{
						worksheetRow2.SetCellValueRaw(num, null);
						continue;
					}
					Formula item = formula.ApplyTo(worksheetRow, num, worksheetRow2, num);
					if (_appliedColumnFormulas == null)
					{
						_appliedColumnFormulas = new List<Formula>();
					}
					_appliedColumnFormulas.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (_columnFormula != null)
			{
				_columnFormula.SetOwningCell(null, -1);
			}
			_columnFormula = formula;
			if (_columnFormula != null)
			{
				_columnFormula.SetOwningCell(worksheetRow, num);
			}
		}

		internal static bool CanAreaFormatValueBeSet(WorksheetTableColumnArea area, CellFormatValue value)
		{
			string message;
			return VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSetHelper(area, value, out message);
		}

		internal WorksheetTableColumnArea GetColumnAreaOfRow(WorksheetRow row)
		{
			if (Table == null)
			{
				return WorksheetTableColumnArea.DataArea;
			}
			WorksheetRegionAddress wholeTableAddress = Table.WholeTableAddress;
			if (Table.IsHeaderRowVisible && row.Index == wholeTableAddress.FirstRowIndex)
			{
				return WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell;
			}
			if (Table.IsTotalsRowVisible && row.Index == wholeTableAddress.LastRowIndex)
			{
				return WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell;
			}
			return WorksheetTableColumnArea.DataArea;
		}

		internal WorksheetRegion GetColumnPortionOfTableRegion(WorksheetRegion tableRegion)
		{
			if (tableRegion == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (tableRegion.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			short num = (short)(tableRegion.FirstColumnInternal + Index);
			return tableRegion.Worksheet.GetCachedRegion(tableRegion.FirstRow, num, tableRegion.LastRow, num);
		}

		internal void InitializeAreaFormats()
		{
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.HasBeenInitialized, value: true);
			if (Table.IsHeaderRowVisible)
			{
				_ = AreaFormats[WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell];
			}
			if (Table.IsTotalsRowVisible)
			{
				_ = AreaFormats[WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell];
			}
			WorksheetRegion dataAreaRegion = DataAreaRegion;
			if (dataAreaRegion == null || dataAreaRegion.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<WorksheetCellFormatData, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<WorksheetCellFormatData, int>();
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = null;
			WorksheetRow ifCreated = dataAreaRegion.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(dataAreaRegion.FirstRow);
			if (ifCreated != null)
			{
				worksheetCellFormatData = ifCreated.TryGetCellFormat(dataAreaRegion.FirstColumnInternal);
				if (worksheetCellFormatData != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add(worksheetCellFormatData, 1);
				}
			}
			for (int i = dataAreaRegion.FirstRow + 1; i <= dataAreaRegion.LastRow; i++)
			{
				ifCreated = dataAreaRegion.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(i);
				if (ifCreated == null)
				{
					worksheetCellFormatData = null;
					continue;
				}
				WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData2 = ifCreated.TryGetCellFormat(dataAreaRegion.FirstColumnInternal);
				if (worksheetCellFormatData2 == null)
				{
					worksheetCellFormatData = null;
					continue;
				}
				if (worksheetCellFormatData != null && !worksheetCellFormatData.Equals(worksheetCellFormatData2))
				{
					worksheetCellFormatData = null;
				}
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(worksheetCellFormatData2, out var value))
				{
					dictionary.Add(worksheetCellFormatData2, 1);
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary[worksheetCellFormatData2] = value + 1;
				}
			}
			if (!Table.IsTotalsRowVisible)
			{
				int num = ((dataAreaRegion.Height >= 4) ? (dataAreaRegion.Height / 2 + 1) : dataAreaRegion.Height);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<WorksheetCellFormatData, int> item in dictionary)
				{
					if (num <= item.Value)
					{
						WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData3 = item.Key.CloneInternal();
						worksheetCellFormatData3.ResetValue(CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo);
						worksheetCellFormatData3.ResetValue(CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle);
						AreaFormats[WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell].SetFormatting(worksheetCellFormatData3);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (worksheetCellFormatData != null)
			{
				AreaFormats[WorksheetTableColumnArea.DataArea].SetFormatting(worksheetCellFormatData);
			}
		}

		internal void OnFilterModified()
		{
			if (Table != null)
			{
				Table.ReapplyFilters();
			}
		}

		internal void OnHeaderRowHiding()
		{
			VerifyNameCache();
		}

		internal void OnHeaderRowShown()
		{
			SynchronizeAreaFormatWithCells(WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell);
		}

		internal void OnInsertedInTable()
		{
			WorksheetCell headerCell = HeaderCell;
			if (headerCell != null)
			{
				headerCell.Row.SetCellIsSpecial(WorksheetColumnIndex, isSpecial: true);
			}
			WorksheetCell totalCell = TotalCell;
			if (totalCell != null)
			{
				totalCell.Row.SetCellIsSpecial(WorksheetColumnIndex, isSpecial: true);
			}
		}

		internal void OnReAddedToTable(WorksheetTable table, short absolteColumnIndex, bool isTemporaryRemoval = false)
		{
			_table = table;
			_absoluteColumnIndex = absolteColumnIndex;
			ResetCache();
			if (isTemporaryRemoval)
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.HasBeenInitialized, GetFlag(InternalFlags.HoldHasBeenInitialized));
			}
			else if (table.Workbook != null)
			{
				OnRooted(table.Workbook);
			}
			WorksheetCell headerCell = HeaderCell;
			if (headerCell != null)
			{
				headerCell.Row.SetCellIsSpecial(WorksheetColumnIndex, isSpecial: true);
			}
			WorksheetCell totalCell = TotalCell;
			if (totalCell != null)
			{
				totalCell.Row.SetCellIsSpecial(WorksheetColumnIndex, isSpecial: true);
			}
		}

		internal void OnRemovedFromTable(bool isTemporaryRemoval = false)
		{
			WorksheetCell headerCell = HeaderCell;
			if (headerCell != null)
			{
				headerCell.Row.SetCellIsSpecial(WorksheetColumnIndex, isSpecial: false);
			}
			WorksheetCell totalCell = TotalCell;
			if (totalCell != null)
			{
				totalCell.Row.SetCellIsSpecial(WorksheetColumnIndex, isSpecial: false);
			}
			_table = null;
			_absoluteColumnIndex = -1;
			ResetCache();
			if (isTemporaryRemoval)
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.HoldHasBeenInitialized, GetFlag(InternalFlags.HasBeenInitialized));
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.HasBeenInitialized, value: false);
			}
			else
			{
				OnUnrooted();
			}
		}

		internal void OnRooted(Workbook workbook)
		{
			if (_areaFormats != null)
			{
				_areaFormats.OnRooted(workbook);
			}
			SetInitialColumnFormula(_columnFormula);
		}

		internal void OnTableRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			if (_columnFormula != null)
			{
				_columnFormula.SetOwningCell(null, -1);
			}
			_appliedColumnFormulas = null;
		}

		internal void OnTotalsRowHiding()
		{
			VerifyTotalCache();
		}

		internal void OnTotalsRowShown()
		{
			SynchronizeAreaFormatWithCells(WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell);
		}

		internal void OnUnrooted()
		{
			if (_areaFormats != null)
			{
				_areaFormats.OnUnrooted();
			}
		}

		internal void ResetCache()
		{
			_cachedIndex = -1;
		}

		internal void ResumeCellValueSynchronizations()
		{
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.SuspendCellValueSynchronizations, value: false);
		}

		internal void SetAbsoluteColumnIndex(short absoluteColumnIndex)
		{
			_absoluteColumnIndex = absoluteColumnIndex;
		}

		internal void SetInitialColumnFormula(Formula columnFormula)
		{
			_columnFormula = columnFormula;
			if (_columnFormula == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetRegion dataAreaRegion = Table.DataAreaRegion;
			if (dataAreaRegion == null || dataAreaRegion.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetRow topRow = dataAreaRegion.TopRow;
			_columnFormula.SetOwningCell(topRow, WorksheetColumnIndex);
			for (int i = dataAreaRegion.FirstRow; i <= dataAreaRegion.LastRow; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = dataAreaRegion.Worksheet.Rows[i];
				Formula cellFormulaInternal = worksheetRow.GetCellFormulaInternal(WorksheetColumnIndex);
				if (cellFormulaInternal != null && _columnFormula.IsEquivalentTo(cellFormulaInternal))
				{
					if (_appliedColumnFormulas == null)
					{
						_appliedColumnFormulas = new List<Formula>();
					}
					_appliedColumnFormulas.Add(cellFormulaInternal);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SuspendCellValueSynchronizations()
		{
			if (Table != null && !Table.IsChangingHeaderOrTotalRowVisibility)
			{
				VerifyNameCache();
				VerifyTotalCache();
			}
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.SuspendCellValueSynchronizations, value: true);
		}

		internal void SynchronizeAreaFormatWithCells(WorksheetTableColumnArea area)
		{
			if (_areaFormats != null)
			{
				SynchronizeAreaFormatWithCells(AreaFormats.TryGetFormatProxy(area), CellFormatValue.AllFormattingProperties, onlyApplyNonDefaultValues: true);
			}
		}

		internal void SynchronizeAreaFormatWithCells(WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableColumnArea> areaFormatProxy, CellFormatValue values, bool onlyApplyNonDefaultValues, WorksheetRegion areaRegion, WorksheetCell areaCell)
		{
			if (areaFormatProxy == null || areaFormatProxy.IsEmpty || ((areaRegion == null || areaRegion.Worksheet == null) && (areaCell == null || areaCell.Row == null)) || values == (CellFormatValue)0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (areaRegion != null)
			{
				for (int i = areaRegion.FirstRow; i <= areaRegion.LastRow; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRow worksheetRow = areaRegion.Worksheet.Rows[i];
					Utilities.CopyCellFormatValues(areaFormatProxy, worksheetRow.GetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetColumnIndex), values, onlyApplyNonDefaultValues);
				}
			}
			else if (areaCell != null)
			{
				Utilities.CopyCellFormatValues(areaFormatProxy, areaCell.CellFormatInternal, values, onlyApplyNonDefaultValues);
			}
		}

		private void ClearAppliedColumnFormulas()
		{
			if (_appliedColumnFormulas != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _appliedColumnFormulas.Count; i++)
				{
					Formula formula = _appliedColumnFormulas[i];
					WorksheetRow owningCellRow = formula.OwningCellRow;
					short owningCellColumnIndex = formula.OwningCellColumnIndex;
					owningCellRow?.SetCellValueRaw(owningCellColumnIndex, null);
				}
				_appliedColumnFormulas = null;
			}
		}

		private bool GetFlag(InternalFlags flag)
		{
			return (_flags & flag) == flag;
		}

		private void SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_flags &= (InternalFlags)(byte)(~(int)flag);
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeAreaFormatWithCells(WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableColumnArea> areaFormatProxy, CellFormatValue values, bool onlyApplyNonDefaultValues)
		{
			if (areaFormatProxy == null || areaFormatProxy.IsEmpty || Table == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Workbook workbook = Table.Workbook;
			if (workbook == null || !workbook.IsLoading)
			{
				WorksheetTableColumnArea area = areaFormatProxy.Area;
				WorksheetRegion areaRegion = null;
				WorksheetCell areaCell = null;
				switch (area)
				{
				default:
					return;
				case WorksheetTableColumnArea.DataArea:
					areaRegion = DataAreaRegion;
					break;
				case WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell:
					areaCell = HeaderCell;
					break;
				case WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell:
					areaCell = TotalCell;
					break;
				}
				SynchronizeAreaFormatWithCells(areaFormatProxy, values, onlyApplyNonDefaultValues, areaRegion, areaCell);
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSet(WorksheetTableColumnArea area, CellFormatValue value)
		{
			if (!VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSetHelper(area, value, out var message))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
			}
		}

		private static bool VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSetHelper(WorksheetTableColumnArea area, CellFormatValue value, out string message)
		{
			switch (area)
			{
			default:
				message = null;
				return true;
			case WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell:
				if (value == CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo || value == CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle)
				{
					message = Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidHeaderCellColumnAreaFormatProperty");
					return false;
				}
				message = null;
				return true;
			case WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell:
				switch (value)
				{
				case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
					message = Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidTotalsCellColumnAreaFormatProperty");
					return false;
				default:
					message = null;
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyIsValid()
		{
			if (GetFlag(InternalFlags.HasBeenInitialized) && _table == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_TableColumnRemovedFromTable"));
			}
		}

		private void VerifyNameCache()
		{
			if (!GetFlag(InternalFlags.SuspendCellValueSynchronizations))
			{
				WorksheetCell headerCell = HeaderCell;
				if (headerCell != null)
				{
					GetCellTextParameters getCellTextParameters = new GetCellTextParameters(headerCell.ColumnIndexInternal);
					getCellTextParameters.TextFormatMode = TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth;
					getCellTextParameters.PreventTextFormattingTypes = PreventTextFormattingTypes.String;
					_name = headerCell.Row.GetCellTextInternal(getCellTextParameters).Text;
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyTotalCache()
		{
			if (GetFlag(InternalFlags.SuspendCellValueSynchronizations))
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetCell totalCell = TotalCell;
			if (totalCell != null)
			{
				_totalFormula = totalCell.Formula;
				if (_totalFormula == null && totalCell.Value != null)
				{
					GetCellTextParameters getCellTextParameters = new GetCellTextParameters(totalCell.ColumnIndexInternal);
					getCellTextParameters.TextFormatMode = TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth;
					getCellTextParameters.PreventTextFormattingTypes = PreventTextFormattingTypes.String;
					_totalLabel = totalCell.Row.GetCellTextInternal(getCellTextParameters).Text;
				}
				else
				{
					_totalLabel = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SetSortCondition(WorksheetTableColumn column, SortCondition value)
		{
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Count = {Count}")]
	public class WorksheetTableColumnCollection : IEnumerable<WorksheetTableColumn>, IEnumerable
	{
		private List<WorksheetTableColumn> _columns;

		private WorksheetTable _table;

		public int Count => _columns.Count;

		public WorksheetTableColumn this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
				}
				return _columns[index];
			}
		}

		public WorksheetTableColumn this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				CultureInfo culture = _table.Culture;
				foreach (WorksheetTableColumn column in _columns)
				{
					if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(column.Name, name, culture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
					{
						return column;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetTableColumnCollection(WorksheetTable table)
		{
			_columns = new List<WorksheetTableColumn>();
			_table = table;
		}

		IEnumerator<WorksheetTableColumn> IEnumerable<WorksheetTableColumn>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _columns.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<WorksheetTableColumn>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetTableColumn column)
		{
			return _columns.Contains(column);
		}

		public int IndexOf(WorksheetTableColumn column)
		{
			return _columns.IndexOf(column);
		}

		internal void InternalInsert(int index, WorksheetTableColumn column)
		{
			_columns.Insert(index, column);
			column.OnInsertedInTable();
		}

		internal void InternalRemoveAt(int index)
		{
			WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = _columns[index];
			worksheetTableColumn.OnRemovedFromTable();
			_columns.RemoveAt(index);
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("WorksheetTableStyle: {Name,nq}")]
	public class WorksheetTableStyle : IAreaFormatsOwner<WorksheetTableStyleArea>, IWorksheetCellFormatProxyOwner, IGenericCachedCollectionEx
	{
		private const CellFormatValue DisallowedAreaFormatValues = CellFormatValue.AlignmentFormattingProperties | CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo | CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders | CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle | CellFormatValue.FontHeight | CellFormatValue.FontName | CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle | CellFormatValue.FormatString | CellFormatValue.Locked | CellFormatValue.Style;

		private int _alternateColumnStripeWidth = 1;

		private int _alternateRowStripeHeight = 1;

		private WorksheetTableAreaFormatsCollection<WorksheetTableStyleArea> _areaFormats;

		private int _columnStripeWidth = 1;

		private readonly bool _isCustom;

		private bool _isLoading;

		private string _name;

		private CustomTableStyleCollection _customCollection;

		private int _rowStripeHeight = 1;

		bool IAreaFormatsOwner<WorksheetTableStyleArea>.IsReadOnly => IsReadOnly;

		Workbook IGenericCachedCollectionEx.Workbook => Workbook;

		public int AlternateColumnStripeWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return _alternateColumnStripeWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanBeModified();
				if (_alternateColumnStripeWidth != value)
				{
					VerifyStripeExtent(value, "AlternateColumnStripeWidth");
					_alternateColumnStripeWidth = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int AlternateRowStripeHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return _alternateRowStripeHeight;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanBeModified();
				if (_alternateRowStripeHeight != value)
				{
					VerifyStripeExtent(value, "AlternateRowStripeHeight");
					_alternateRowStripeHeight = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public WorksheetTableAreaFormatsCollection<WorksheetTableStyleArea> AreaFormats
		{
			get
			{
				if (_areaFormats == null)
				{
					_areaFormats = new WorksheetTableAreaFormatsCollection<WorksheetTableStyleArea>(this);
				}
				return _areaFormats;
			}
		}

		public int ColumnStripeWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return _columnStripeWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanBeModified();
				if (_columnStripeWidth != value)
				{
					VerifyStripeExtent(value, "ColumnStripeWidth");
					_columnStripeWidth = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsCustom => _isCustom;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _name;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanBeModified();
				if (!(_name == value))
				{
					if (_customCollection != null)
					{
						_customCollection.OnTableStyleNameChanging(this, value);
					}
					_name = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int RowStripeHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return _rowStripeHeight;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyCanBeModified();
				if (_rowStripeHeight != value)
				{
					VerifyStripeExtent(value, "ColumnStripeWidth");
					_rowStripeHeight = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal CustomTableStyleCollection CustomCollection => _customCollection;

		internal bool IsLoading
		{
			get
			{
				return _isLoading;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_isLoading == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				_isLoading = value;
				if (_isLoading != value)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableStyleArea> formatProxy in AreaFormats.GetFormatProxies())
				{
					formatProxy.Element.Freeze();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsReadOnly
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_isCustom)
				{
					return !_isLoading;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal Workbook Workbook
		{
			get
			{
				if (_customCollection != null)
				{
					return _customCollection.Workbook;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetTableStyle(string name)
			: this(name, isCustom: true)
		{
		}

		internal WorksheetTableStyle(string name, bool isCustom)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			_isCustom = isCustom;
			_name = name;
		}

		void IAreaFormatsOwner<WorksheetTableStyleArea>.OnAreaFormatAdded(WorksheetTableStyleArea area, WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
		}

		void IAreaFormatsOwner<WorksheetTableStyleArea>.VerifyCanBeModified()
		{
			VerifyCanBeModified();
		}

		WorksheetCellFormatData IWorksheetCellFormatProxyOwner.GetAdjacentFormatForBorderResolution(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue borderValue)
		{
			return null;
		}

		void IWorksheetCellFormatProxyOwner.OnCellFormatValueChanged(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue values, CellFormatValueChangedOptions options)
		{
		}

		void IWorksheetCellFormatProxyOwner.OnCellFormatValueChanging(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue values)
		{
			VerifyCanBeModified();
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue << 1))
			{
				if ((values & cellFormatValue) != 0)
				{
					VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSet(cellFormatValue);
				}
			}
		}

		void IWorksheetCellFormatProxyOwner.VerifyFormatOptions(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, WorksheetCellFormatOptions formatOptions)
		{
			if ((formatOptions & (WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyNumberFormatting | WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyAlignmentFormatting | WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyProtectionFormatting)) != WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidTableStyleAreaFormatOptions"));
			}
		}

		public WorksheetTableStyle Clone(string name)
		{
			WorksheetTableStyle worksheetTableStyle = new WorksheetTableStyle(name, isCustom: true);
			worksheetTableStyle._alternateColumnStripeWidth = _alternateColumnStripeWidth;
			worksheetTableStyle._alternateRowStripeHeight = _alternateRowStripeHeight;
			worksheetTableStyle._columnStripeWidth = _columnStripeWidth;
			worksheetTableStyle._rowStripeHeight = _rowStripeHeight;
			if (_areaFormats != null)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<WorksheetTableStyleArea, IWorksheetCellFormat> item in (IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<WorksheetTableStyleArea, IWorksheetCellFormat>>)_areaFormats)
				{
					worksheetTableStyle.AreaFormats[item.Key].SetFormatting(item.Value);
				}
			}
			return worksheetTableStyle;
		}

		internal static bool CanAreaFormatValueBeSet(CellFormatValue value)
		{
			return (value & (CellFormatValue.AlignmentFormattingProperties | CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo | CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders | CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle | CellFormatValue.FontHeight | CellFormatValue.FontName | CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle | CellFormatValue.FormatString | CellFormatValue.Locked | CellFormatValue.Style)) == 0;
		}

		internal static int GetAreaPrecedence(WorksheetTableStyleArea area)
		{
			return area switch
			{
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.WholeTable => 0, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.ColumnStripe => 1, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.AlternateColumnStripe => 2, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.RowStripe => 3, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.AlternateRowStripe => 4, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.LastColumn => 5, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.FirstColumn => 6, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.HeaderRow => 7, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.TotalRow => 8, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.FirstHeaderCell => 9, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.LastHeaderCell => 10, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.FirstTotalCell => 11, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.LastTotalCell => 12, 
				_ => 13, 
			};
		}

		internal uint? GetAreaSize(WorksheetTableStyleArea area)
		{
			return area switch
			{
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.ColumnStripe => (uint)ColumnStripeWidth, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.AlternateColumnStripe => (uint)AlternateColumnStripeWidth, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.RowStripe => (uint)RowStripeHeight, 
				WorksheetTableStyleArea.AlternateRowStripe => (uint)AlternateRowStripeHeight, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal SortedList<int, WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableStyleArea>> GetStyleAreaFormatsSorted()
		{
			SortedList<int, WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableStyleArea>> sortedList = new SortedList<int, WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableStyleArea>>(Utilities.Int32Comparer.Instance);
			foreach (WorksheetTableAreaFormatProxy<WorksheetTableStyleArea> formatProxy in AreaFormats.GetFormatProxies())
			{
				sortedList[GetAreaPrecedence(formatProxy.Area)] = formatProxy;
			}
			return sortedList;
		}

		internal void OnAddedToCollection(CustomTableStyleCollection collection)
		{
			_customCollection = collection;
			if (_areaFormats != null)
			{
				_areaFormats.OnRooted(collection.Workbook);
			}
		}

		internal void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			_customCollection = null;
		}

		internal void VerifyCanBeModified()
		{
			if (IsReadOnly)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotModifyStandardTableStyle"));
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSet(CellFormatValue value)
		{
			if (!VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSetHelper(value, out var message))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
			}
		}

		private static bool VerifyAreaFormatValueCanBeSetHelper(CellFormatValue value, out string message)
		{
			switch (value)
			{
			case CellFormatValue.Alignment:
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders:
			case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.FormatString:
			case CellFormatValue.Indent:
			case CellFormatValue.Locked:
			case CellFormatValue.Rotation:
			case CellFormatValue.ShrinkToFit:
			case CellFormatValue.Style:
			case CellFormatValue.VerticalAlignment:
			case CellFormatValue.WrapText:
				message = Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidTableStyleAreaFormatProperty", value);
				return false;
			case CellFormatValue.FontHeight:
			case CellFormatValue.FontName:
			case CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle:
				message = Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidTableStyleAreaFontProperty", value);
				return false;
			default:
				message = null;
				return true;
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyStripeExtent(int value, string description)
		{
			if (value < 1 || 9 < value)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_InvalidTableStyleAreaStripeExtent", description));
			}
		}
	}
	public class UnfrozenPaneSettings : PaneSettingsBase
	{
		private int leftPaneWidth;

		private int topPaneHeight;

		private int firstColumnInLeftPane;

		private int firstRowInTopPane;

		private Tuple<int, int, int> cachedZoomExtents;

		internal override bool HasHorizontalSplit => topPaneHeight > 0;

		internal override bool HasVerticalSplit => leftPaneWidth > 0;

		public int FirstColumnInLeftPane
		{
			get
			{
				return firstColumnInLeftPane;
			}
			set
			{
				if (firstColumnInLeftPane != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyColumnIndex(base.DisplayOptions.Worksheet, value, "value");
					firstColumnInLeftPane = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int FirstRowInTopPane
		{
			get
			{
				return firstRowInTopPane;
			}
			set
			{
				if (firstRowInTopPane != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyRowIndex(base.DisplayOptions.Worksheet, value, "value");
					firstRowInTopPane = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int LeftPaneWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return leftPaneWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				if (leftPaneWidth != value)
				{
					if (value < 0 || 65535 < value)
					{
						throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_LeftPaneWidth", (ushort)0, ushort.MaxValue));
					}
					SetWidthOrHeight(ref leftPaneWidth, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public int TopPaneHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return topPaneHeight;
			}
			set
			{
				if (topPaneHeight != value)
				{
					if (value < 0 || 65535 < value)
					{
						throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_TopPaneHeight", (ushort)0, ushort.MaxValue));
					}
					SetWidthOrHeight(ref topPaneHeight, value);
				}
			}
		}

		internal UnfrozenPaneSettings(DisplayOptions displayOptions)
			: base(displayOptions)
		{
		}

		internal override void InitializeFrom(PaneSettingsBase paneSettings)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(paneSettings);
			UnfrozenPaneSettings unfrozenPaneSettings = (UnfrozenPaneSettings)paneSettings;
			leftPaneWidth = unfrozenPaneSettings.leftPaneWidth;
			topPaneHeight = unfrozenPaneSettings.topPaneHeight;
			firstColumnInLeftPane = unfrozenPaneSettings.firstColumnInLeftPane;
			firstRowInTopPane = unfrozenPaneSettings.firstRowInTopPane;
			cachedZoomExtents = null;
		}

		protected internal override void ResetCore()
		{
			base.ResetCore();
			leftPaneWidth = 0;
			topPaneHeight = 0;
			firstColumnInLeftPane = 0;
			firstRowInTopPane = 0;
			cachedZoomExtents = null;
		}

		private void SetWidthOrHeight(ref int member, int newValue)
		{
			cachedZoomExtents = null;
			member = newValue;
		}

		internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && leftPaneWidth == 0 && topPaneHeight == 0 && firstColumnInLeftPane == 0)
			{
				return firstRowInTopPane != 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void UpdateExtentsForZoomChange(int oldZoom, int newZoom)
		{
			int num = oldZoom;
			int item = leftPaneWidth;
			int item2 = topPaneHeight;
			Tuple<int, int, int> tuple = cachedZoomExtents;
			if (tuple == null)
			{
				tuple = Tuple.Create(oldZoom, item, item2);
			}
			else
			{
				num = tuple.Item1;
				item = tuple.Item2;
				item2 = tuple.Item3;
			}
			int num2 = (int)Math.Min(65535.0, MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero((double)item2 / (double)num * (double)newZoom));
			int num3 = (int)Math.Min(65535.0, MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero((double)item / (double)num * (double)newZoom));
			TopPaneHeight = num2;
			LeftPaneWidth = num3;
			cachedZoomExtents = tuple;
		}
	}

		private bool _isCustom;

		private Color[] _userColors;

		private readonly Workbook _workbook;

		bool ICollection<Color>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => _userColors.Length;

		public Color this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				ValidateUserIndex(index);
				return _userColors[index];
			}
			set
			{
				ValidateUserIndex(index);
				if (Utilities.ColorIsEmpty(value) || Utilities.ColorIsSystem(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidPaletteColor_EmptyOrSystem"));
				}
				if (value.A != byte.MaxValue)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidPaletteColor_NonOpaque"));
				}
				Color color = _userColors[index];
				_userColors[index] = value;
				if (!AreEquivalent(color, value))
				{
					_isCustom = true;
					_workbook.OnPaletteColorChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsCustom => _isCustom;

		internal WorkbookColorPalette(Workbook workbook)
		{
			_workbook = workbook;
			_userColors = (Color[])ExcelStandardColors.Clone();
		}

		void ICollection<Color>.Add(Color item)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotAddColorsToPaletteDirectly"));
		}

		void ICollection<Color>.Clear()
		{
			Reset();
		}

		void ICollection<Color>.CopyTo(Color[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_userColors.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<Color>.Remove(Color item)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotRemoveColorsToPaletteDirectly"));
		}

		IEnumerator<Color> IEnumerable<Color>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _userColors.Length; i++)
			{
				yield return _userColors[i];
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<Color>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public bool Contains(Color color)
		{
			int indexOfNearestColor = GetIndexOfNearestColor(color);
			return AreEquivalent(color, this[indexOfNearestColor]);
		}

		public int GetIndexOfNearestColor(Color color)
		{
			int result = 0;
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			Utilities.RGBToCIELAB(color, out var l, out var a, out var b);
			for (int i = 0; i < _userColors.Length; i++)
			{
				Color color2 = _userColors[i];
				Utilities.RGBToCIELAB(color2, out var l2, out var a2, out var b2);
				double num2 = Math.Pow(l - l2, 2.0) + Math.Pow(a - a2, 2.0) + Math.Pow(b - b2, 2.0);
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					result = i;
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			if (_isCustom)
			{
				_userColors = (Color[])ExcelStandardColors.Clone();
				_isCustom = false;
			}
		}

		internal int FindIndex(WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo, ColorableItem item)
		{
			try
			{
				return FindIndexHelper(colorInfo, item);
			}
			catch (UnauthorizedAccessException innerException)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_SystemColorsAccessedFromWrongThread"), innerException);
			}
		}

		private int FindIndexHelper(WorkbookColorInfo colorInfo, ColorableItem item)
		{
			Color resolvedColorInternal = colorInfo.GetResolvedColorInternal(_workbook);
			if (Utilities.ColorIsEmpty(resolvedColorInternal))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (item == ColorableItem.WorksheetTab)
			{
				if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, BlackColor))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, WhiteColor))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, RedColor))
				{
					return 2;
				}
				if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, LimeColor))
				{
					return 3;
				}
				if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, BlueColor))
				{
					return 4;
				}
				if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, YellowColor))
				{
					return 5;
				}
				if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, MagentaColor))
				{
					return 6;
				}
				if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, CyanColor))
				{
					return 7;
				}
			}
			if (Utilities.ColorIsSystem(resolvedColorInternal))
			{
				if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColorStorage))
				{
					if (item == ColorableItem.CellFont)
					{
						return 32767;
					}
					return 64;
				}
				if (item != ColorableItem.WorksheetGrid && item != ColorableItem.WorksheetTab)
				{
					if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.WindowColorStorage))
					{
						return 65;
					}
					if (!Utilities.Is2003Format(_workbook.CurrentFormat) && item != ColorableItem.CellBorder && AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.ControlColorStorage))
					{
						return 67;
					}
					if (item != ColorableItem.CellFill)
					{
						if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.WindowFrameColorStorage))
						{
							return 66;
						}
						if (item != ColorableItem.CellBorder)
						{
							if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.ControlColorStorage))
							{
								return 67;
							}
							if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.ControlTextColorStorage))
							{
								return 68;
							}
							if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.ControlLightLightColorStorage))
							{
								return 69;
							}
							if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.ControlDarkColorStorage))
							{
								return 70;
							}
							if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.HighlightColorStorage))
							{
								return 71;
							}
							if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.ScrollBarColorStorage))
							{
								return 73;
							}
							if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, InvertStorageColor(SystemColorsInternal.ScrollBarColorStorage)))
							{
								return 74;
							}
							if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.InfoColorStorage))
							{
								return 80;
							}
							if (AreEquivalent(resolvedColorInternal, SystemColorsInternal.InfoTextColorStorage))
							{
								return 81;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return GetIndexOfNearestColor(resolvedColorInternal.ToNative()) + 8;
		}

		internal Color GetColorAtAbsoluteIndex(int index)
		{
			try
			{
				return GetColorAtAbsoluteIndexHelper(index);
			}
			catch (UnauthorizedAccessException innerException)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_SystemColorsAccessedFromWrongThread"), innerException);
			}
		}

		private Color GetColorAtAbsoluteIndexHelper(int index)
		{
			switch (index)
			{
			case 0:
				return BlackColor;
			case 1:
				return WhiteColor;
			case 2:
				return RedColor;
			case 3:
				return LimeColor;
			case 4:
				return BlueColor;
			case 5:
				return YellowColor;
			case 6:
				return MagentaColor;
			case 7:
				return CyanColor;
			case 64:
				return SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColorStorage;
			case 65:
				return SystemColorsInternal.WindowColorStorage;
			case 66:
				return SystemColorsInternal.WindowFrameColorStorage;
			case 67:
				return SystemColorsInternal.ControlColorStorage;
			case 68:
				return SystemColorsInternal.ControlTextColorStorage;
			case 69:
				return SystemColorsInternal.ControlLightLightColorStorage;
			case 70:
				return SystemColorsInternal.ControlDarkColorStorage;
			case 71:
				return SystemColorsInternal.HighlightColorStorage;
			case 72:
				return SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColorStorage;
			case 73:
				return SystemColorsInternal.ScrollBarColorStorage;
			case 74:
				return InvertStorageColor(SystemColorsInternal.ScrollBarColorStorage);
			case 75:
				return SystemColorsInternal.WindowColorStorage;
			case 76:
				return SystemColorsInternal.WindowFrameColorStorage;
			case 77:
				return SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColorStorage;
			case 78:
				return SystemColorsInternal.WindowColorStorage;
			case 79:
				return BlackColor;
			case 80:
				return SystemColorsInternal.InfoColorStorage;
			case 81:
				return SystemColorsInternal.InfoTextColorStorage;
			case 32767:
				return SystemColorsInternal.WindowTextColorStorage;
			default:
			{
				if (81 < index)
				{
					return SystemColorsInternal.WindowColorStorage;
				}
				int num = index - 8;
				if (num < 0 || 56 <= num)
				{
					return ColorsInternal.Empty.ToStorage();
				}
				return this[num].ToStorage();
			}
			}
		}

		internal static bool AreEquivalent(Color color1, Color color2)
		{
			if (Utilities.ColorIsSystem(color1) || Utilities.ColorIsSystem(color2))
			{
				return color1 == color2;
			}
			if (Utilities.ColorIsEmpty(color1) != Utilities.ColorIsEmpty(color2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Utilities.ColorToArgb(color1) == Utilities.ColorToArgb(color2);
		}

		private static Color InvertStorageColor(Color color)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(color.A, (byte)(~color.R), (byte)(~color.G), (byte)(~color.B));
		}

		private void ValidateUserIndex(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || _userColors.Length <= index)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
		}
	}
	internal class UltimateFontDefaultsResolver : IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver
	{
		public static readonly UltimateFontDefaultsResolver Instance = new UltimateFontDefaultsResolver();

		private UltimateFontDefaultsResolver()
		{
		}

		public void ResolveDefaults(WorkbookFontData font)
		{
			if (font.Bold == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
			{
				font.Bold = ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False;
			}
			if (font.ColorInfo == null)
			{
				font.ColorInfo = WorkbookColorInfo.Automatic;
			}
			if (font.Height < 0)
			{
				font.Height = 220;
			}
			if (font.Italic == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
			{
				font.Italic = ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False;
			}
			if (font.Name == null)
			{
				font.Name = "Calibri";
			}
			if (font.Strikeout == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
			{
				font.Strikeout = ExcelDefaultableBoolean.False;
			}
			if (font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle == FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.Default)
			{
				font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle = FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle.None;
			}
			if (font.UnderlineStyle == FontUnderlineStyle.Default)
			{
				font.UnderlineStyle = FontUnderlineStyle.None;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WorkbookFormatCollection
	{
		internal const int FormatTableOffset = 164;

		internal const int ShortDateFormatIndex = 14;

		internal const int ShortDateAndTimeFormatIndex = 22;

		internal const string ShortTimePatternSuffix = " h:mm";

		internal const int GeneralFormatIndex = 0;

		internal const string GeneralFormatPattern = "General";

		private static Dictionary<uint, uint> dxfIndexToIndexMap;

		private static Dictionary<uint, uint> indexToDxfIndexMap;

		private Dictionary<string, int> formatHashByFormat;

		private Dictionary<int, string> formatHashByIndex;

		private int customFormatCount;

		private CultureInfo cultureUsedWhenFormattersCached;

		private Dictionary<int, ValueFormatter> valueFormattersByIndex;

		private Workbook workbook;

		private string currencySymbolAtInitialization;

		private string decimalSeparatorAtInitialization;

		private string groupSeparatorAtInitialization;

		private bool isVerifyingBuiltInFormats;

		private CultureInfo cultureAtInitialization;

		private readonly Dictionary<int, List<int>> _invariantStringLiteralPositionsByIndex;

		internal int Count => customFormatCount;

		internal string this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (index == 14 || index == 22)
				{
					if (index == 14)
					{
						return GetShortDatePattern(workbook.CultureResolved);
					}
					return GetShortDateAndTimePattern(workbook.CultureResolved);
				}
				VerifyBuiltInFormats();
				if (formatHashByIndex.TryGetValue(index, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				if (27 <= index && index <= 36)
				{
					if (index == 32 || index == 33)
					{
						return "h:mm:ss";
					}
					return "m/d/yyyy";
				}
				if (50 <= index && index <= 81)
				{
					return "m/d/yyyy";
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal WorkbookFormatCollection(Workbook workbook)
		{
			this.workbook = workbook;
			formatHashByIndex = new Dictionary<int, string>();
			formatHashByFormat = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCulture);
			_invariantStringLiteralPositionsByIndex = new Dictionary<int, List<int>>();
			VerifyBuiltInFormats();
		}

		internal int Add(string formatString)
		{
			VerifyBuiltInFormats();
			if (formatHashByFormat.TryGetValue(formatString, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			string shortDatePattern = GetShortDatePattern(workbook.CultureResolved);
			if (string.Equals(shortDatePattern, formatString, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCulture))
			{
				return 14;
			}
			if (string.Equals(shortDatePattern + " h:mm", formatString, StringUtilities.StringComparisonInvariantCulture))
			{
				return 22;
			}
			value = 164 + customFormatCount;
			AddFormat(value, formatString);
			return value;
		}

		internal void AddFormat(int index, string format)
		{
			AddFormat(index, format, allowDuplicates: false);
		}

		internal void AddFormat(int index, string format, bool allowDuplicates)
		{
			AddFormat(index, format, allowDuplicates, updateInvariantStringLiteralPositions: true);
		}

		private void AddFormat(int index, string format, bool allowDuplicates, bool updateInvariantStringLiteralPositions)
		{
			VerifyBuiltInFormats();
			if (index == 14 || index == 22)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (formatHashByIndex.TryGetValue(index, out var value))
			{
				if (StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Compare(format, value) == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				formatHashByIndex.Remove(index);
				formatHashByFormat.Remove(value);
			}
			if (index >= 164)
			{
				customFormatCount++;
			}
			if (allowDuplicates)
			{
				formatHashByFormat.Remove(format);
			}
			formatHashByFormat.Add(format, index);
			formatHashByIndex.Add(index, format);
			if (updateInvariantStringLiteralPositions)
			{
				CacheInvariantStringLiteralPositions(index, format);
			}
		}

		public void AddLoadedFormat(int index, string format)
		{
			AddFormat(index, ConvertFormatString(workbook, index, format, Workbook.InvariantCultureForSerialization, workbook.CultureResolved, preventCurrencyConversion: true), allowDuplicates: true);
		}

		private void CacheInvariantStringLiteralPositions(int index, string format)
		{
			_invariantStringLiteralPositionsByIndex.Remove(index);
			NumberFormatInfo numberFormat = workbook.CultureResolved.NumberFormat;
			string currencySymbol = numberFormat.CurrencySymbol;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(currencySymbol))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<int> list = null;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < format.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (format[i])
				{
				case '\\':
					i++;
					break;
				case '[':
					for (; i < format.Length && format[i] != ']'; i++)
					{
					}
					break;
				case '"':
				{
					int num2 = i + 1;
					for (i++; i < format.Length; i++)
					{
						if (format[i] == '\\')
						{
							i++;
						}
						else
						{
							if (format[i] != '"')
							{
								continue;
							}
							string text = format.Substring(num2, i - num2);
							if (text != currencySymbol)
							{
								if (list == null)
								{
									list = new List<int>();
								}
								list.Add(num);
							}
							num++;
							break;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			if (list != null && list.Count != 0)
			{
				_invariantStringLiteralPositionsByIndex[index] = list;
			}
		}

		private string ConvertFormatString(Workbook workbook, int index, string original, CultureInfo originalCulture, CultureInfo currentCulture, bool preventCurrencyConversion)
		{
			NumberFormatInfo numberFormat = originalCulture.NumberFormat;
			string text = numberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator;
			string text2 = numberFormat.NumberGroupSeparator;
			string text3 = numberFormat.CurrencySymbol;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = "\0";
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				text2 = "\0";
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
			{
				text3 = "\0";
			}
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormat = originalCulture.DateTimeFormat;
			string text4 = dateTimeFormat.GetDateSeparator();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4))
			{
				text4 = "\0";
			}
			if (original.IndexOfAny(new char[4]
			{
				text[0],
				text2[0],
				text3[0],
				text4[0]
			}) < 0)
			{
				return original;
			}
			ValueFormatter valueFormatter = new ValueFormatter(workbook, original, originalCulture);
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			_invariantStringLiteralPositionsByIndex.TryGetValue(index, out var value);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < original.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = original[i];
				switch (c)
				{
				case ';':
					num++;
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
					continue;
				case '*':
				case '\\':
				case '_':
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
					i++;
					if (i < original.Length)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(original[i]);
					}
					continue;
				case '[':
					for (; i < original.Length; i++)
					{
						c = original[i];
						stringBuilder.Append(c);
						if (c == ']')
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					continue;
				case '"':
					if (flag)
					{
						string text5 = stringBuilder.ToString(num3, stringBuilder.Length - num3);
						if (!preventCurrencyConversion && text5 == text3 && (value == null || !value.Contains(num2)))
						{
							stringBuilder.Length = num3;
							stringBuilder.Append(currentCulture.NumberFormat.CurrencySymbol);
						}
						flag = false;
						num2++;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
						num3 = stringBuilder.Length + 1;
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
					continue;
				}
				switch (valueFormatter.GetSectionType(num))
				{
				case ValueFormatter.SectionType.Number:
					if (string.Compare(original, i, text, 0, text.Length) == 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(currentCulture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator);
						i += text.Length - 1;
						continue;
					}
					if (string.Compare(original, i, text2, 0, text2.Length) != 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(currentCulture.NumberFormat.NumberGroupSeparator);
					i += text2.Length - 1;
					continue;
				case ValueFormatter.SectionType.Date:
					if (string.Compare(original, i, text4, 0, text4.Length) != 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(currentCulture.DateTimeFormat.GetDateSeparator());
					i += text4.Length - 1;
					continue;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(c);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static uint FromDxfIndex(uint dxfIndex)
		{
			InitializeDxfMaps();
			if (dxfIndexToIndexMap.TryGetValue(dxfIndex, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return dxfIndex;
		}

		public IEnumerable<int> GetCustomFormatIndices()
		{
			VerifyBuiltInFormats();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, string> formatByIndex in formatHashByIndex)
			{
				KeyValuePair<int, string> keyValuePair = formatByIndex;
				int index = keyValuePair.Key;
				if (!IsStandardFormat(index))
				{
					yield return index;
				}
			}
		}

		public string GetFormatForSave(int index)
		{
			string text = this[index];
			if (Workbook.InvariantCultureForSerialization == cultureAtInitialization)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return ConvertFormatString(workbook, index, text, cultureAtInitialization, Workbook.InvariantCultureForSerialization, preventCurrencyConversion: true);
		}

		internal static string GetShortDatePattern(CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return culture.DateTimeFormat.ShortDatePattern.Replace("M", "m");
		}

		internal static string GetShortDateAndTimePattern(CultureInfo culture)
		{
			string shortDatePattern = GetShortDatePattern(culture);
			return shortDatePattern + " h:mm";
		}

		internal ValueFormatter GetValueFormatter(int index)
		{
			if (valueFormattersByIndex == null)
			{
				valueFormattersByIndex = new Dictionary<int, ValueFormatter>();
			}
			CultureInfo cultureResolved = workbook.CultureResolved;
			if (cultureUsedWhenFormattersCached != cultureResolved)
			{
				valueFormattersByIndex.Clear();
				cultureUsedWhenFormattersCached = cultureResolved;
			}
			if (!valueFormattersByIndex.TryGetValue(index, out var value))
			{
				string format = this[index] ?? "General";
				value = new ValueFormatter(workbook, format, cultureResolved);
				valueFormattersByIndex[index] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void InitializeDxfMaps()
		{
			if (dxfIndexToIndexMap == null)
			{
				dxfIndexToIndexMap = new Dictionary<uint, uint>();
				indexToDxfIndexMap = new Dictionary<uint, uint>();
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(0u, 0u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(1u, 1u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(2u, 2u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(3u, 3u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(4u, 4u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(5u, 9u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(6u, 10u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(7u, 11u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(8u, 12u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(9u, 13u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(10u, 14u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(11u, 15u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(12u, 17u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(13u, 18u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(14u, 19u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(15u, 20u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(16u, 21u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(17u, 22u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(18u, 23u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(19u, 24u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(20u, 25u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(21u, 26u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(22u, 27u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(37u, 5u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(38u, 6u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(39u, 7u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(40u, 8u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(41u, 33u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(42u, 32u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(43u, 35u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(44u, 34u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(45u, 28u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(46u, 31u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(47u, 29u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(48u, 16u);
				InitializeDxfMapsHelper(49u, 30u);
			}
		}

		private static void InitializeDxfMapsHelper(uint index, uint dxfIndex)
		{
			dxfIndexToIndexMap.Add(dxfIndex, index);
			indexToDxfIndexMap.Add(index, dxfIndex);
		}

		public bool IsStandardFormat(int formatIndex)
		{
			if (0 <= formatIndex && formatIndex <= 22)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (37 <= formatIndex && formatIndex <= 49)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static uint ToDxfIndex(uint index)
		{
			InitializeDxfMaps();
			if (indexToDxfIndexMap.TryGetValue(index, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return index;
		}

		private void VerifyBuiltInFormats()
		{
			if (isVerifyingBuiltInFormats)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isVerifyingBuiltInFormats = true;
				NumberFormatInfo numberFormat = workbook.CultureResolved.NumberFormat;
				string numberDecimalSeparator = numberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator;
				string numberGroupSeparator = numberFormat.NumberGroupSeparator;
				string currencySymbol = numberFormat.CurrencySymbol;
				if (currencySymbol == currencySymbolAtInitialization && numberDecimalSeparator == decimalSeparatorAtInitialization && numberGroupSeparator == groupSeparatorAtInitialization)
				{
					return;
				}
				currencySymbolAtInitialization = currencySymbol;
				decimalSeparatorAtInitialization = numberDecimalSeparator;
				groupSeparatorAtInitialization = numberGroupSeparator;
				CultureInfo originalCulture = cultureAtInitialization ?? CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
				cultureAtInitialization = workbook.CultureResolved;
				List<KeyValuePair<int, string>> list = new List<KeyValuePair<int, string>>(formatHashByIndex);
				formatHashByFormat.Clear();
				formatHashByIndex.Clear();
				AddFormat(0, "General");
				AddFormat(1, "0");
				AddFormat(2, $"0{decimalSeparatorAtInitialization}00");
				AddFormat(3, $"#{groupSeparatorAtInitialization}##0");
				AddFormat(4, $"#{groupSeparatorAtInitialization}##0{decimalSeparatorAtInitialization}00");
				AddFormat(5, string.Format("\"{0}\"#{1}##0_);\\(\"{0}\"#{1}##0\\)", currencySymbolAtInitialization, groupSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(6, string.Format("\"{0}\"#{1}##0_);[Red]\\(\"{0}\"#{1}##0\\)", currencySymbolAtInitialization, groupSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(7, string.Format("\"{0}\"#{1}##0{2}00_);\\(\"{0}\"#{1}##0{2}00\\)", currencySymbolAtInitialization, groupSeparatorAtInitialization, decimalSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(8, string.Format("\"{0}\"#{1}##0{2}00_);[Red]\\(\"{0}\"#{1}##0{2}00\\)", currencySymbolAtInitialization, groupSeparatorAtInitialization, decimalSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(9, "0%");
				AddFormat(10, $"0{decimalSeparatorAtInitialization}00%");
				AddFormat(11, $"0{decimalSeparatorAtInitialization}00E+00");
				AddFormat(12, "# ?/?");
				AddFormat(13, "# ??/??");
				AddFormat(15, "d-mmm-yy");
				AddFormat(16, "d-mmm");
				AddFormat(17, "mmm-yy");
				AddFormat(18, "h:mm AM/PM");
				AddFormat(19, "h:mm:ss AM/PM");
				AddFormat(20, "h:mm");
				AddFormat(21, "h:mm:ss");
				AddFormat(37, string.Format("#{0}##0_);(#{0}##0)", groupSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(38, string.Format("#{0}##0_);[Red](#{0}##0)", groupSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(39, string.Format("#{0}##0{1}00_);(#{0}##0{1}00)", groupSeparatorAtInitialization, decimalSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(40, string.Format("#{0}##0{1}00_);[Red](#{0}##0{1}00)", groupSeparatorAtInitialization, decimalSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(41, string.Format("_(* #{0}##0_);_(* \\(#{0}##0\\);_(* \"-\"_);_(@_)", groupSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(42, string.Format("_(\"{0}\"* #{1}##0_);_(\"{0}\"* \\(#{1}##0\\);_(\"{0}\"* \"-\"_);_(@_)", currencySymbolAtInitialization, groupSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(43, string.Format("_(* #{0}##0{1}00_);_(* \\(#{0}##0{1}00\\);_(* \"-\"??_);_(@_)", groupSeparatorAtInitialization, decimalSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(44, string.Format("_(\"{0}\"* #{1}##0{2}00_);_(\"{0}\"* \\(#{1}##0{2}00\\);_(\"{0}\"* \"-\"??_);_(@_)", currencySymbolAtInitialization, groupSeparatorAtInitialization, decimalSeparatorAtInitialization));
				AddFormat(45, "mm:ss");
				AddFormat(46, "[h]:mm:ss");
				AddFormat(47, $"mm:ss{decimalSeparatorAtInitialization}0");
				AddFormat(48, $"##0{decimalSeparatorAtInitialization}0E+0");
				AddFormat(49, "@");
				AddCultureSpecificFormats(workbook.CultureResolved);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<int, string> item in list)
				{
					if (!formatHashByIndex.ContainsKey(item.Key))
					{
						AddFormat(item.Key, ConvertFormatString(workbook, item.Key, item.Value, originalCulture, cultureAtInitialization, preventCurrencyConversion: false), allowDuplicates: true, updateInvariantStringLiteralPositions: false);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isVerifyingBuiltInFormats = false;
			}
		}

		private void AddCultureSpecificFormats(CultureInfo culture)
		{
			switch (culture.Name)
			{
			case "zh-TW":
				AddFormat(27, "[$-404]e/m/d", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(28, "[$-404]e\"年\"m\"月\"d\"日\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(29, "[$-404]e\"年\"m\"月\"d\"日\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(30, "m/d/yy", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(31, "yyyy\"年\"m\"月\"d\"日\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(32, "hh\"時\"mm\"分\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(33, "hh\"時\"mm\"分\"ss\"秒\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(34, "上午/下午hh\"時\"mm\"分\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(35, "上午/下午hh\"時\"mm\"分\"ss\"秒\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(36, "[$-404]e/m/d", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(50, "[$-404]e/m/d", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(51, "[$-404]e\"年\"m\"月\"d\"日\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(52, "上午/下午hh\"時\"mm\"分\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(53, "上午/下午hh\"時\"mm\"分\"ss\"秒\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(54, "[$-404]e\"年\"m\"月\"d\"日\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(55, "上午/下午hh\"時\"mm\"分\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(56, "上午/下午hh\"時\"mm\"分\"ss\"秒\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(57, "[$-404]e/m/d", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(58, "[$-404]e\"年\"m\"月\"d\"日\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				break;
			case "zh-CN":
				AddFormat(27, "yyyy\"年\"m\"月\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(28, "m\"月\"d\"日\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(29, "m\"月\"d\"日\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(30, "m-d-yy", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(31, "yyyy\"年\"m\"月\"d\"日\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(32, "h\"时\"mm\"分\"", allowDuplicates: true);
				AddFormat(33, "h\"时\"mm\"分\"ss\"秒\"", allowDuplicates: true);
