	public class WorkbookSaveOptions : WorkbookOptionsBase
	{
		private WorkbookSaveFilter _filter;

		internal WorkbookSaveFilter Filter
		{
			get
			{
				return _filter;
			}
			set
			{
				_filter = value;
			}
		}

		public WorkbookSaveOptions(IPackageFactory packageFactory = null)
			: base(packageFactory)
		{
		}

		internal static WorkbookSaveFilter GetFilter(WorkbookSaveOptions options)
		{
			if (options != null)
			{
				return options._filter ?? WorkbookSaveFilter.Default;
			}
			return WorkbookSaveFilter.Default;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class WorkbookSaveFilter
	{
		private class DefaultWorkbookSaveFilter : WorkbookSaveFilter
		{
			public override int GetAllocatedRowCount(Worksheet worksheet)
			{
				return worksheet.Rows.Count;
			}

			public override int GetMaxRowCount(Worksheet worksheet)
			{
				return worksheet.Rows.MaxCount;
			}

			public override IEnumerable<WorksheetRow> GetRows(Worksheet worksheet, bool forceRowAllocation)
			{
				if (forceRowAllocation)
				{
					return worksheet.Rows.GetAllItemsEnumerator();
				}
				return worksheet.Rows;
			}

			public override IList<Worksheet> GetWorksheets(Workbook workbook)
			{
				return workbook.Worksheets;
			}
		}

		internal static readonly WorkbookSaveFilter Default = new DefaultWorkbookSaveFilter();

		public abstract int GetAllocatedRowCount(Worksheet worksheet);

		public abstract int GetMaxRowCount(Worksheet worksheet);

		public virtual IEnumerable<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion> GetMergedCells(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			return worksheet.MergedCellsRegions;
		}

		public abstract IEnumerable<WorksheetRow> GetRows(Worksheet worksheet, bool forceRowAllocation);

		public abstract IList<Worksheet> GetWorksheets(Workbook workbook);
	}
	public abstract class WorkbookStyle
	{
		internal const int MaxNameLength = 255;

		private bool _isHidden;

		private int _referenceCount;

		private WorksheetCellFormatData _styleFormat;

		private Workbook _workbook;

		public abstract bool IsBuiltIn { get; }

		public abstract string Name { get; set; }

		public IWorksheetCellFormat StyleFormat => StyleFormatInternal;

		internal abstract StyleCategory Category { get; }

		internal virtual bool IsAutomatic => false;

		internal bool IsHidden
		{
			get
			{
				return _isHidden;
			}
			set
			{
				_isHidden = value;
			}
		}

		internal abstract bool IsNormalStyle { get; }

		internal virtual bool ShouldSaveIn2003 => _referenceCount > 0;

		internal virtual bool ShouldSaveIn2007 => _referenceCount > 0;

		internal WorksheetCellFormatData StyleFormatInternal => _styleFormat;

		internal Workbook Workbook => _workbook;

		internal WorkbookStyle(Workbook workbook, IWorksheetCellFormat styleFormat)
		{
			_workbook = workbook;
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = styleFormat as WorksheetCellFormatData;
			if (worksheetCellFormatData == null)
			{
				if (styleFormat is WorksheetCellFormatProxy worksheetCellFormatProxy)
				{
					worksheetCellFormatData = worksheetCellFormatProxy.Element;
				}
				else
				{
					worksheetCellFormatData = workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement;
					worksheetCellFormatData.SetFormatting(styleFormat);
				}
			}
			if (worksheetCellFormatData.ReferenceCount != 0 || _workbook != worksheetCellFormatData.Workbook)
			{
				worksheetCellFormatData = worksheetCellFormatData.CloneInternal(workbook);
			}
			_styleFormat = worksheetCellFormatData;
			_styleFormat.Type = WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat;
			_styleFormat.ValueChangeCallback = OnCellFormatValueChanged;
		}

		public abstract void Reset();

		internal void OnAddedToCollection()
		{
			_styleFormat.IncrementReferenceCount();
		}

		internal virtual void OnCellFormatValueChanged(WorksheetCellFormatOptions associatedStyleOption)
		{
			Workbook workbook = Workbook;
			if (workbook == null || (associatedStyleOption & WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting) == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsNormalStyle)
			{
				BorderThickness thickness = StyleFormat.TopBorderStyle.GetThickness();
				BorderThickness thickness2 = StyleFormat.BottomBorderStyle.GetThickness();
				bool defaultRowHasThickTop;
				bool defaultRowHasThickBottom;
				if (thickness == BorderThickness.Thick || thickness2 == BorderThickness.Thick)
				{
					defaultRowHasThickTop = true;
					defaultRowHasThickBottom = true;
				}
				else if (thickness == BorderThickness.Medium || thickness2 == BorderThickness.Medium)
				{
					defaultRowHasThickTop = false;
					defaultRowHasThickBottom = true;
				}
				else
				{
					defaultRowHasThickTop = false;
					defaultRowHasThickBottom = false;
				}
				foreach (Worksheet item in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)workbook.Worksheets)
				{
					item.DefaultRowHasThickTop = defaultRowHasThickTop;
					item.DefaultRowHasThickBottom = defaultRowHasThickBottom;
				}
			}
			foreach (Worksheet item2 in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)workbook.Worksheets)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetRow item3 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)item2.Rows)
				{
					item3.DirtyThicknesses(dirtyNeighbors: false);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnChildFormatAttached()
		{
			_referenceCount++;
		}

		internal void OnChildFormatDetached()
		{
			_referenceCount--;
		}

		internal void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			_styleFormat.DecrementReferenceCount();
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Built in style: {Name,nq}")]
	internal class WorkbookBuiltInStyle : WorkbookStyle, IComparable<WorkbookBuiltInStyle>
	{
		private bool _isCustomized;

		private WorksheetCellFormatData _originalBuiltInStyle;

		private readonly byte _outlineLevel;

		private readonly BuiltInStyleType _type;

		internal override StyleCategory Category
		{
			get
			{
				switch (Type)
				{
				case BuiltInStyleType.Normal:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Good:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Bad:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Neutral:
					return StyleCategory.GoodBadNeutral;
				case BuiltInStyleType.Hyperlink:
				case BuiltInStyleType.FollowedHyperlink:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Note:
				case BuiltInStyleType.WarningText:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Emphasis1:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Emphasis2:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Emphasis3:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Input:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Output:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Calculation:
				case BuiltInStyleType.CheckCell:
				case BuiltInStyleType.LinkedCell:
				case BuiltInStyleType.ExplanatoryText:
					return StyleCategory.DataModel;
				case BuiltInStyleType.Title:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Heading1:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Heading2:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Heading3:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Heading4:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Total:
					return StyleCategory.TitleAndHeading;
				case BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX:
				case BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent1:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent1pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent1pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent1pct60:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent2:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent2pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent2pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent2pct60:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent3:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent3pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent3pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent3pct60:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent4:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent4pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent4pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent4pct60:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent5:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent5pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent5pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent5pct60:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent6:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent6pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent6pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent6pct60:
					return StyleCategory.Themed;
				case BuiltInStyleType.Comma:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Currency:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Percent:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Comma0:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Currency0:
					return StyleCategory.NumberFormat;
				default:
					return StyleCategory.Custom;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsAutomatic
		{
			get
			{
				switch (Type)
				{
				case BuiltInStyleType.Normal:
				case BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX:
				case BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Hyperlink:
				case BuiltInStyleType.FollowedHyperlink:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool IsBuiltIn => true;

		internal override bool IsNormalStyle => _type == BuiltInStyleType.Normal;

		public override string Name
		{
			get
			{
				switch (Type)
				{
				case BuiltInStyleType.Normal:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Comma:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Currency:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Percent:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Hyperlink:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Note:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Title:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Input:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Output:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Calculation:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Total:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Good:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Bad:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Neutral:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent1:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent2:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent3:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent4:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent5:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent6:
					return Type.ToString();
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent1pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent1pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent1pct60:
				{
					int num6 = (int)(Type - 29);
					return $"{num6 * 20}% - Accent1";
				}
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent2pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent2pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent2pct60:
				{
					int num5 = (int)(Type - 33);
					return $"{num5 * 20}% - Accent2";
				}
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent3pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent3pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent3pct60:
				{
					int num4 = (int)(Type - 37);
					return $"{num4 * 20}% - Accent3";
				}
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent4pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent4pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent4pct60:
				{
					int num3 = (int)(Type - 41);
					return $"{num3 * 20}% - Accent4";
				}
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent5pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent5pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent5pct60:
				{
					int num2 = (int)(Type - 45);
					return $"{num2 * 20}% - Accent5";
				}
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent6pct20:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent6pct40:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Accent6pct60:
				{
					int num = (int)(Type - 49);
					return $"{num * 20}% - Accent6";
				}
				case BuiltInStyleType.CheckCell:
					return "Check Cell";
				case BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX:
					return "ColLevel_" + OutlineLevel;
				case BuiltInStyleType.Comma0:
					return "Comma [0]";
				case BuiltInStyleType.Currency0:
					return "Currency [0]";
				case BuiltInStyleType.Emphasis1:
					return "Emphasis 1";
				case BuiltInStyleType.Emphasis2:
					return "Emphasis 2";
				case BuiltInStyleType.Emphasis3:
					return "Emphasis 3";
				case BuiltInStyleType.ExplanatoryText:
					return "Explanatory Text";
				case BuiltInStyleType.FollowedHyperlink:
					return "Followed Hyperlink";
				case BuiltInStyleType.Heading1:
					return "Heading 1";
				case BuiltInStyleType.Heading2:
					return "Heading 2";
				case BuiltInStyleType.Heading3:
					return "Heading 3";
				case BuiltInStyleType.Heading4:
					return "Heading 4";
				case BuiltInStyleType.LinkedCell:
					return "Linked Cell";
				case BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX:
					return "RowLevel_" + OutlineLevel;
				case BuiltInStyleType.WarningText:
					return "Warning Text";
				default:
					return Type.ToString();
				}
			}
			set
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_BuiltInStyleNameCannotBeChanged"));
			}
		}

		internal override bool ShouldSaveIn2003
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ShouldSaveIn2003 || IsCustomized)
				{
					return true;
				}
				switch (Type)
				{
				case BuiltInStyleType.Normal:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Comma:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Currency:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Percent:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Comma0:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Currency0:
					return true;
				default:
					if (!IsBuiltInStyleIn2003)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool ShouldSaveIn2007
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.ShouldSaveIn2007 && !IsNormalStyle)
				{
					return IsCustomized;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsBuiltInStyleIn2003
		{
			get
			{
				switch (Type)
				{
				case BuiltInStyleType.Normal:
				case BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX:
				case BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Comma:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Currency:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Percent:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Comma0:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Currency0:
				case BuiltInStyleType.Hyperlink:
				case BuiltInStyleType.FollowedHyperlink:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsCustomized
		{
			get
			{
				return _isCustomized;
			}
			set
			{
				_isCustomized = value;
			}
		}

		public byte OutlineLevel => _outlineLevel;

		internal BuiltInStyleType Type => _type;

		internal bool UsesOutlineLevel
		{
			get
			{
				if (Type != BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX)
				{
					return Type == BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal WorkbookBuiltInStyle(Workbook workbook, IWorksheetCellFormat styleFormat, BuiltInStyleType type, byte outlineLevel)
			: base(workbook, styleFormat)
		{
			_type = type;
			if (UsesOutlineLevel)
			{
				_outlineLevel = outlineLevel;
			}
			else
			{
				_outlineLevel = byte.MaxValue;
			}
			_originalBuiltInStyle = base.StyleFormatInternal.CloneInternal();
		}

		int IComparable<WorkbookBuiltInStyle>.CompareTo(WorkbookBuiltInStyle other)
		{
			if (UsesOutlineLevel && other.UsesOutlineLevel)
			{
				int num = _outlineLevel - other._outlineLevel;
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return _type - other._type;
		}

		internal override void OnCellFormatValueChanged(WorksheetCellFormatOptions associatedStyleOption)
		{
			base.OnCellFormatValueChanged(associatedStyleOption);
			_isCustomized = !base.StyleFormatInternal.Equals(_originalBuiltInStyle);
			Workbook workbook = base.Workbook;
			if (workbook != null && (associatedStyleOption & WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting) != WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None && IsNormalStyle)
			{
				workbook.OnDefaultFontChanged();
			}
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.StyleFormatInternal.SetFormatting(_originalBuiltInStyle);
		}

		internal WorkbookBuiltInStyle Clone(Workbook workbook)
		{
			return new WorkbookBuiltInStyle(workbook, base.StyleFormatInternal, Type, OutlineLevel);
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("User defined style: {Name,nq}")]
	internal class WorkbookUserDefinedStyle : WorkbookStyle
	{
		private string _name;

		internal override StyleCategory Category => StyleCategory.Custom;

		public override bool IsBuiltIn => false;

		internal override bool IsNormalStyle => false;

		public override string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(_name == value))
				{
					if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(_name, value, base.Workbook.CultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) != 0)
					{
						base.Workbook.Styles.ValidateNewStyleName(value, "value");
					}
					string name = _name;
					_name = value;
					base.Workbook.Styles.OnStyleRenamed(this, name);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool ShouldSaveIn2003 => true;

		internal override bool ShouldSaveIn2007 => true;

		internal WorkbookUserDefinedStyle(Workbook workbook, IWorksheetCellFormat styleFormat, string name)
			: base(workbook, styleFormat)
		{
			_name = name;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.StyleFormatInternal.FormatOptions = WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None;
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Count = {Count}")]
	public sealed class WorkbookStyleCollection : ICollection<WorkbookStyle>, IEnumerable<WorkbookStyle>, IEnumerable
	{
		internal struct BuiltInStyleInfo
		{
			public readonly BuiltInStyleType Type;

			public readonly byte OutlineLevel;

			public BuiltInStyleInfo(BuiltInStyleType type, byte outlineLevel)
			{
				Type = type;
				OutlineLevel = outlineLevel;
			}
		}

		private enum RemovalType
		{
			HideBuiltInStyles,
			RemoveBuiltInStyles,
			ResetBuiltInStyles
		}

		private static readonly object PresetCellStylesLock = new object();

		private static List<WorkbookBuiltInStyle> _presetCellStyles;

		private static Dictionary<string, BuiltInStyleInfo> _styleTypesByName;

		private WorkbookStyle[] colLevelStyles;

		private Dictionary<BuiltInStyleType, WorkbookBuiltInStyle> hiddenStylesByType;

		private WorkbookStyle[] rowLevelStyles;

		private List<WorkbookStyle> styles;

		private Dictionary<string, WorkbookStyle> stylesByName;

		private Dictionary<BuiltInStyleType, WorkbookStyle> stylesByType;

		private Workbook workbook;

		private List<WorkbookUserDefinedStyle> _hiddenUserDefinedStyles;

		bool ICollection<WorkbookStyle>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => styles.Count;

		public WorkbookStyle this[int index] => styles[index];

		public WorkbookStyle this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				if (name == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
				}
				stylesByName.TryGetValue(name, out var value);
				return value;
			}
		}

		public WorkbookStyle NormalStyle => GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.Normal);

		internal static List<WorkbookBuiltInStyle> PresetCellStyles
		{
			get
			{
				if (_presetCellStyles == null)
				{
					lock (PresetCellStylesLock)
					{
						if (_presetCellStyles == null)
						{
							InitializePresetCellStyles();
						}
					}
				}
				return _presetCellStyles;
			}
		}

		internal static Dictionary<string, BuiltInStyleInfo> StyleTypesByName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_styleTypesByName == null)
				{
					lock (PresetCellStylesLock)
					{
						if (_styleTypesByName == null)
						{
							Dictionary<string, BuiltInStyleInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, BuiltInStyleInfo>(StringComparer.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
							List<WorkbookBuiltInStyle> presetCellStyles = PresetCellStyles;
							for (int i = 0; i < presetCellStyles.Count; i++)
							{
								WorkbookBuiltInStyle workbookBuiltInStyle = presetCellStyles[i];
								dictionary[workbookBuiltInStyle.Name] = new BuiltInStyleInfo(workbookBuiltInStyle.Type, workbookBuiltInStyle.OutlineLevel);
							}
							_styleTypesByName = dictionary;
						}
					}
				}
				return _styleTypesByName;
			}
		}

		internal WorkbookStyleCollection(Workbook workbook)
		{
			colLevelStyles = new WorkbookStyle[8];
			rowLevelStyles = new WorkbookStyle[8];
			styles = new List<WorkbookStyle>();
			stylesByName = new Dictionary<string, WorkbookStyle>(Utilities.StringComparerCreate(workbook.CultureResolved, ignoreCase: true));
			stylesByType = new Dictionary<BuiltInStyleType, WorkbookStyle>();
			this.workbook = workbook;
			List<WorkbookBuiltInStyle> presetCellStyles = PresetCellStyles;
			for (int i = 0; i < presetCellStyles.Count; i++)
			{
				Add(presetCellStyles[i].Clone(this.workbook));
			}
			EnsureNormalStyle();
		}

		void ICollection<WorkbookStyle>.Add(WorkbookStyle item)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Styles cannot be added directly to the collection.");
		}

		void ICollection<WorkbookStyle>.CopyTo(WorkbookStyle[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			styles.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		IEnumerator<WorkbookStyle> IEnumerable<WorkbookStyle>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return styles.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<WorkbookStyle>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public WorkbookStyle AddUserDefinedStyle(string name)
		{
			return AddUserDefinedStyle(workbook.CreateNewWorksheetCellFormatInternal(WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat), name);
		}

		public WorkbookStyle AddUserDefinedStyle(IWorksheetCellFormat styleFormat, string name)
		{
			ValidateNewStyleName(name, "name");
			BuiltInStyleInfo value;
			WorkbookStyle workbookStyle = ((!StyleTypesByName.TryGetValue(name, out value)) ? ((WorkbookStyle)new WorkbookUserDefinedStyle(workbook, styleFormat, name)) : ((WorkbookStyle)new WorkbookBuiltInStyle(workbook, styleFormat, value.Type, value.OutlineLevel)));
			Add(workbookStyle);
			return workbookStyle;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			Reset(RemovalType.HideBuiltInStyles);
		}

		public bool Contains(WorkbookStyle style)
		{
			if (stylesByName.TryGetValue(style.Name, out var value))
			{
				return style == value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Remove(WorkbookStyle style)
		{
			if (style == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = styles.IndexOf(style);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveAt(index, RemovalType.HideBuiltInStyles);
		}

		private void RemoveAt(int index, RemovalType removalType)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			WorkbookStyle workbookStyle = styles[index];
			WorkbookBuiltInStyle workbookBuiltInStyle = workbookStyle as WorkbookBuiltInStyle;
			if (workbookBuiltInStyle != null && workbookBuiltInStyle.IsNormalStyle)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CannotRemoveNormalStyle"));
			}
			workbookStyle.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			styles.RemoveAt(index);
			stylesByName.Remove(workbookStyle.Name);
			if (workbookStyle.IsBuiltIn || !workbookStyle.IsHidden)
			{
				stylesByName.Remove(workbookStyle.Name);
			}
			else if (_hiddenUserDefinedStyles != null)
			{
				_hiddenUserDefinedStyles.Remove((WorkbookUserDefinedStyle)workbookStyle);
			}
			if (workbookBuiltInStyle != null)
			{
				workbookBuiltInStyle.IsHidden = true;
				switch (workbookBuiltInStyle.Type)
				{
				case BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX:
					colLevelStyles[workbookBuiltInStyle.OutlineLevel] = null;
					break;
				case BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX:
					rowLevelStyles[workbookBuiltInStyle.OutlineLevel] = null;
					break;
				default:
					stylesByType.Remove(workbookBuiltInStyle.Type);
					if (removalType == RemovalType.HideBuiltInStyles)
					{
						if (hiddenStylesByType == null)
						{
							hiddenStylesByType = new Dictionary<BuiltInStyleType, WorkbookBuiltInStyle>();
						}
						hiddenStylesByType.Add(workbookBuiltInStyle.Type, workbookBuiltInStyle);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			workbook.OnStyleRemoved(workbookStyle);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Reset(RemovalType.ResetBuiltInStyles);
			if (hiddenStylesByType != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<WorkbookBuiltInStyle> values = hiddenStylesByType.Values;
				hiddenStylesByType = null;
				foreach (WorkbookBuiltInStyle item in values)
				{
					item.Reset();
					Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (_hiddenUserDefinedStyles != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<WorkbookUserDefinedStyle> hiddenUserDefinedStyles = _hiddenUserDefinedStyles;
				_hiddenUserDefinedStyles = null;
				foreach (WorkbookUserDefinedStyle item2 in hiddenUserDefinedStyles)
				{
					item2.Reset();
					Add(item2);
				}
			}
			List<WorkbookBuiltInStyle> presetCellStyles = PresetCellStyles;
			for (int i = 0; i < presetCellStyles.Count; i++)
			{
				WorkbookBuiltInStyle workbookBuiltInStyle = presetCellStyles[i];
				if (!ContainsBuiltInStyle(workbookBuiltInStyle.Type))
				{
					Add(workbookBuiltInStyle.Clone(workbook));
				}
			}
		}

		private void Reset(RemovalType removalType)
		{
			for (int num = styles.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				WorkbookStyle workbookStyle = styles[num];
				if (workbookStyle.IsBuiltIn && (removalType == RemovalType.ResetBuiltInStyles || workbookStyle.IsNormalStyle))
				{
					workbookStyle.Reset();
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveAt(num, removalType);
				}
			}
		}

		internal WorkbookStyle Add(WorkbookStyle style)
		{
			if (style.IsBuiltIn || !style.IsHidden)
			{
				WorkbookStyle workbookStyle = this[style.Name];
				if (workbookStyle != null)
				{
					if (workbookStyle.IsBuiltIn)
					{
						workbookStyle.IsHidden = false;
						workbookStyle.StyleFormatInternal.SetFormatting(style.StyleFormatInternal);
						workbookStyle.StyleFormatInternal.SetFormatOptionsInternal(style.StyleFormatInternal.FormatOptions);
						return workbookStyle;
					}
					Remove(workbookStyle);
				}
			}
			styles.Add(style);
			style.OnAddedToCollection();
			if (style.IsBuiltIn || !style.IsHidden)
			{
				stylesByName[style.Name] = style;
			}
			else
			{
				if (_hiddenUserDefinedStyles == null)
				{
					_hiddenUserDefinedStyles = new List<WorkbookUserDefinedStyle>();
				}
				_hiddenUserDefinedStyles.Add((WorkbookUserDefinedStyle)style);
			}
			if (style is WorkbookBuiltInStyle workbookBuiltInStyle)
			{
				switch (workbookBuiltInStyle.Type)
				{
				case BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX:
					colLevelStyles[workbookBuiltInStyle.OutlineLevel] = workbookBuiltInStyle;
					break;
				case BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX:
					rowLevelStyles[workbookBuiltInStyle.OutlineLevel] = workbookBuiltInStyle;
					break;
				default:
					stylesByType[workbookBuiltInStyle.Type] = workbookBuiltInStyle;
					break;
				}
				if (hiddenStylesByType != null)
				{
					hiddenStylesByType.Remove(workbookBuiltInStyle.Type);
				}
			}
			return style;
		}

		internal WorkbookStyle AddHiddenStyle(WorkbookBuiltInStyle style)
		{
			WorkbookStyle workbookStyle = this[style.Name];
			if (workbookStyle != null)
			{
				workbookStyle.StyleFormatInternal.SetFormatting(style.StyleFormatInternal);
				workbookStyle.StyleFormatInternal.FormatOptions = style.StyleFormatInternal.FormatOptions;
				workbookStyle.IsHidden = true;
				Remove(workbookStyle);
				return workbookStyle;
			}
			if (style.UsesOutlineLevel)
			{
				return style;
			}
			if (hiddenStylesByType == null)
			{
				hiddenStylesByType = new Dictionary<BuiltInStyleType, WorkbookBuiltInStyle>();
			}
			if (hiddenStylesByType.TryGetValue(style.Type, out var value))
			{
				value.StyleFormatInternal.SetFormatting(style.StyleFormatInternal);
				value.StyleFormatInternal.FormatOptions = style.StyleFormatInternal.FormatOptions;
				return value;
			}
			hiddenStylesByType.Add(style.Type, style);
			return style;
		}

		internal WorkbookStyle AddHiddenUserDefinedStyle(IWorksheetCellFormat styleFormat, string name)
		{
			WorkbookUserDefinedStyle workbookUserDefinedStyle = new WorkbookUserDefinedStyle(workbook, styleFormat, name);
			workbookUserDefinedStyle.IsHidden = true;
			return Add(workbookUserDefinedStyle);
		}

		internal bool ContainsBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType builtInStyleType)
		{
			foreach (WorkbookStyle style in styles)
			{
				if (style is WorkbookBuiltInStyle workbookBuiltInStyle && workbookBuiltInStyle.Type == builtInStyleType)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal WorkbookStyle GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType type)
		{
			stylesByType.TryGetValue(type, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		internal WorkbookStyle GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType type, int outlineLevel)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				BuiltInStyleType.ColLevelX => colLevelStyles[outlineLevel], 
				BuiltInStyleType.RowLevelX => rowLevelStyles[outlineLevel], 
				_ => GetBuiltInStyle(type), 
			};
		}

		internal IEnumerable<WorkbookBuiltInStyle> GetHiddenBuiltInStyles()
		{
			if (hiddenStylesByType == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (WorkbookBuiltInStyle value in hiddenStylesByType.Values)
			{
				yield return value;
			}
		}

		internal void OnStyleRenamed(WorkbookUserDefinedStyle style, string oldName)
		{
			stylesByName.Remove(oldName);
			stylesByName.Add(style.Name, style);
		}

		internal void ValidateNewStyleName(string name, string paramName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(paramName, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_StyleName"));
			}
			if (255 < name.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_StyleNameTooLong"), paramName);
			}
			if (stylesByName.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_StyleNameAlreadyExists", name), paramName);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureNormalStyle()
		{
			if (!ContainsBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.Normal))
			{
				Add(new WorkbookBuiltInStyle(workbook, new WorksheetCellFormatData(workbook, WorksheetCellFormatType.StyleFormat), BuiltInStyleType.Normal, 0));
			}
		}

		private static void InitializePresetCellStyles()
		{
			_presetCellStyles = new List<WorkbookBuiltInStyle>();
			Workbook workbook = new Workbook(WorkbookFormat.Excel2007);
			using WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2007 workbookLoadManagerExcel = new WorkbookLoadManagerExcel2007(workbook, null, new WorkbookLoadOptions(), (ST_ConformanceClass)0);
			((OfficeDocumentManager)workbookLoadManagerExcel.DocumentManager).Initialize();
			XmlPartManagerBase val = LoadPresetCellStylesDocument(workbookLoadManagerExcel.DocumentManager);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorkItemScheduler.Synchronous().Execute((WorkItem)(object)((PartManagerBase)val).Load());
			foreach (WorkbookStyle item2 in (IEnumerable<WorkbookStyle>)workbook.Styles)
			{
				if (item2 is WorkbookBuiltInStyle item)
				{
					_presetCellStyles.Add(item);
				}
			}
			_presetCellStyles.Sort();
			_styleTypesByName = null;
		}

		private static XmlPartManagerBase LoadPresetCellStylesDocument(ObjectModelExcelDocumentManager manager)
		{
			//IL_007a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Expected O, but got Unknown
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using (Stream stream = Utilities.GetEmbeddedResourceStream("presetCellStyles.xml.gz"))
			{
				if (stream == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				try
				{
					using GZipStream gZipStream = new GZipStream(stream, CompressionMode.Decompress);
					byte[] array = new byte[4096];
					while (true)
					{
						int num = gZipStream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
						if (num != 0)
						{
							memoryStream.Write(array, 0, num);
							continue;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			return (XmlPartManagerBase)((PartManagerBase)ObjectModelStylesPartManager.Instance).CloneForSerialization((OfficeDocumentManager)(object)manager, (Stream)memoryStream);
		}
	}
	public class WorkbookWindowOptions : WindowOptions
	{
		private Rectangle boundsInTwips = new Rectangle(1000, 1000, 15000, 10000);

		private int firstVisibleTabIndex;

		private bool minimized;

		private int selectedWorksheetIndex;

		internal override bool AllowNullSelectedWorksheet => base.Workbook.Worksheets.Count == 0;

		public Rectangle BoundsInTwips
		{
			get
			{
				return boundsInTwips;
			}
			set
			{
				if (boundsInTwips != value)
				{
					if (value.Width < 0 || value.Height < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_WidthHeightWindowBounds"), "value");
					}
					boundsInTwips = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int FirstVisibleTabIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return firstVisibleTabIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				if (firstVisibleTabIndex != value)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_FirstVisibleTabIndex"));
					}
					firstVisibleTabIndex = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Minimized
		{
			get
			{
				return minimized;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != minimized)
				{
					minimized = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal int SelectedWorksheetIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return selectedWorksheetIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				selectedWorksheetIndex = value;
			}
		}

		internal WorkbookWindowOptions(Workbook workbook)
			: base(workbook)
		{
		}

		internal override DisplayOptions GetDisplayOptionsForWorksheet(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			return worksheet.DisplayOptions;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			boundsInTwips = new Rectangle(1000, 1000, 15000, 10000);
			firstVisibleTabIndex = 0;
			minimized = false;
			selectedWorksheetIndex = 0;
			base.Reset();
		}

		internal override void ResetSelection()
		{
			foreach (Worksheet item in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)base.Workbook.Worksheets)
			{
				item.DisplayOptions.IsTabSelected = item == base.SelectedWorksheet;
			}
		}
	}
	internal struct WorksheetCellShiftResult
	{
		internal readonly CellShiftResult Result;

		internal readonly List<ValueTuple<Formula, FormulaToken[]>> AlteredFormulas;

		internal readonly List<WorksheetTable> TablesModified;

		internal WorksheetCellShiftResult(CellShiftResult result, CellShiftOperation operation, List<WorksheetTable> tablesModified)
		{
			Result = result;
			TablesModified = tablesModified;
			if (result == CellShiftResult.Success && operation.RequiresFormulaUndoSupport)
			{
				AlteredFormulas = new List<ValueTuple<Formula, FormulaToken[]>>();
			}
			else
			{
				AlteredFormulas = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public sealed class WorksheetCell : ICellFormatOwner, IComparable<WorksheetCell>, IFormattedStringOwner
	{
		internal static readonly WorksheetCell InvalidReference = new WorksheetCell(null, -1);

		private WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormatProxy;

		private int cellShiftHistoryVersion;

		private short columnIndex;

		private WorksheetRow row;

		private static readonly HashSet<Type> _supportedCellTypes = new HashSet<Type>
		{
			typeof(bool),
			typeof(byte),
			typeof(sbyte),
			typeof(short),
			typeof(ushort),
			typeof(int),
			typeof(uint),
			typeof(long),
			typeof(ulong),
			typeof(float),
			typeof(double),
			typeof(decimal),
			typeof(char),
			typeof(string),
			typeof(Enum),
			typeof(DateTime),
			typeof(TimeSpan),
			typeof(StringBuilder),
			typeof(Guid),
			typeof(ErrorValue),
			typeof(FormattedString),
			typeof(StringElement),
			typeof(FormattedStringElement),
			typeof(Formula),
			typeof(ArrayFormula),
			typeof(WorksheetDataTable),
			typeof(DBNull)
		};

		WorksheetCellFormatProxy ICellFormatOwner.CellFormatInternal => CellFormatInternal;

		bool ICellFormatOwner.HasCellFormat => HasCellFormat;

		public WorksheetDataTable AssociatedDataTable => Row?.GetCellAssociatedDataTableInternal(columnIndex);

		public WorksheetMergedCellsRegion AssociatedMergedCellsRegion => Row?.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal(columnIndex);

		public WorksheetTable AssociatedTable => Row?.GetCellAssociatedTableInternal(columnIndex);

		public IWorksheetCellFormat CellFormat => CellFormatInternal;

		internal WorksheetCellFormatProxy CellFormatInternal
		{
			get
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;
				if (worksheetRow == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (cellFormatProxy == null)
				{
					cellFormatProxy = worksheetRow.GetCellFormatInternal(columnIndex);
				}
				return cellFormatProxy;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool HasCellFormat
		{
			get
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;
				if (worksheetRow == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return worksheetRow.TryGetCellFormat(columnIndex) != null;
			}
		}

		public int ColumnIndex => ColumnIndexInternal;

		internal short ColumnIndexInternal
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCellAddress();
				return columnIndex;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetCellComment Comment
		{
			get
			{
				return Row?.GetCellCommentInternal(columnIndex);
			}
			set
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;
				if (worksheetRow == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"));
				}
				worksheetRow.SetCellCommentInternal(columnIndex, value);
			}
		}

		public DataValidationRule DataValidationRule
		{
			get
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;
				if (worksheetRow == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				Worksheet worksheet = worksheetRow.Worksheet;
				if (!worksheet.HasDataValidationRules)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return worksheet.DataValidationRules.FindRule(this);
			}
			set
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;
				if (worksheetRow == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"));
				}
				Worksheet worksheet = worksheetRow.Worksheet;
				if (value == null)
				{
					if (worksheet.HasDataValidationRules)
					{
						worksheet.DataValidationRules.Remove(this);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					worksheet.DataValidationRules.Add(value, WorksheetReferenceCollection.CreateFromCell(this));
				}
			}
		}

		public bool HasComment
		{
			get
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;
				if (worksheetRow == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return worksheetRow.GetCellCommentInternal(columnIndex) != null;
			}
		}

		public Formula Formula => Row?.GetCellFormulaInternal(columnIndex);

		public int RowIndex => Row?.Index ?? (-1);

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return Row?.GetCellValueInternal(columnIndex);
			}
			set
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;
				if (worksheetRow == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"));
				}
				worksheetRow.SetCellValue(columnIndex, value);
			}
		}

		public Worksheet Worksheet => Row?.Worksheet;

		internal WorksheetCellAddress Address
		{
			get
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;
				if (worksheetRow == null)
				{
					return WorksheetCellAddress.InvalidReference;
				}
				return new WorksheetCellAddress(worksheetRow.Index, columnIndex);
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetRegionAddress RegionAddress
		{
			get
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;
				if (worksheetRow == null)
				{
					return WorksheetRegionAddress.InvalidReference;
				}
				return new WorksheetRegionAddress(worksheetRow.Index, worksheetRow.Index, columnIndex, columnIndex);
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetRow Row
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCellAddress();
				return row;
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetCell(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			this.columnIndex = columnIndex;
			this.row = row;
			if (this.row != null)
			{
				cellShiftHistoryVersion = this.row.Worksheet.CellShiftHistoryVersion;
			}
		}

		int IComparable<WorksheetCell>.CompareTo(WorksheetCell other)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, other))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (other == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow2 = other.Row;
			if (worksheetRow == null && worksheetRow2 == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (worksheetRow == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (worksheetRow2 == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = worksheetRow.Index - worksheetRow2.Index;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return columnIndex - other.columnIndex;
		}

		void IFormattedStringOwner.OnUnformattedStringChanged(FormattedString sender)
		{
			Row?.UpdateFormattedStringElementOnCell(columnIndex, sender.Element);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return ((IComparable<WorksheetCell>)this).CompareTo(obj as WorksheetCell) == 0;
		}

		{
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;

				return 0;

		}

		{
			if (cellType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("cellType");

			{
				return cellType.IsEnum();
			}

		}

		internal WorksheetRegion GetCachedRegion()
		{
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = Row;
			if (worksheetRow == null || worksheetRow.Worksheet == null)

		}

		private void OnShiftedOffWorksheet()
		{
			row = null;
			columnIndex = -1;
		}

		private void VerifyCellAddress()
		{
			if (row != null)
			{
				Worksheet worksheet = row.Worksheet;
				if (worksheet == null || !worksheet.VerifyCellAddress(ref row, ref columnIndex, ref cellShiftHistoryVersion))
				{
					OnShiftedOffWorksheet();
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool operator ==(WorksheetCell a, WorksheetCell b)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(a, b))
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool flag = (object)a == null;
			bool flag2 = (object)b == null;
			if (flag && flag2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			a.VerifyCellAddress();
			b.VerifyCellAddress();
			if (a.row == b.row)
			{
				return a.columnIndex == b.columnIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(WorksheetCell a, WorksheetCell b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}
	}
	internal struct WorksheetCellAddress
	{
		public static readonly WorksheetCellAddress InvalidReference = new WorksheetCellAddress(-1, -1);

		private readonly short columnIndex;

		private readonly int rowIndex;

		public short ColumnIndex => columnIndex;

		public bool IsValid => rowIndex >= 0;

		public int RowIndex => rowIndex;

		public WorksheetCellAddress(int rowIndex, short columnIndex)
		{
			this.rowIndex = rowIndex;
			this.columnIndex = columnIndex;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is WorksheetCellAddress worksheetCellAddress))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rowIndex != worksheetCellAddress.rowIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return columnIndex == worksheetCellAddress.columnIndex;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return rowIndex ^ (columnIndex << 16);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(useRelativeRow: false, useRelativeColumn: false, WorkbookFormat.Excel2007, CellReferenceMode.A1);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(WorksheetCellAddress a, WorksheetCellAddress b)
		{
			if (a.columnIndex == b.columnIndex)
			{
				return a.rowIndex == b.rowIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(WorksheetCellAddress a, WorksheetCellAddress b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public string ToString(bool useRelativeRow, bool useRelativeColumn, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			if (!IsValid)
			{
				return "#REF!";
			}
			return CellAddress.GetCellReferenceString(rowIndex, columnIndex, format, useRelativeRow, useRelativeColumn, rowIndex, columnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets: false, cellReferenceMode);
		}

		public WorksheetCellAddress WithColumnIndex(short columnIndex)
		{
			if (columnIndex == this.columnIndex)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new WorksheetCellAddress(rowIndex, columnIndex);
		}

		public WorksheetCellAddress WithRowIndex(int rowIndex)
		{
			if (rowIndex == this.rowIndex)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new WorksheetCellAddress(rowIndex, columnIndex);
		}
	}

				FormattedStringKey = element.Key;
			}
		}

		internal enum DataType : byte
		{
			Null,
			Int64,
			UInt64,
			Double,
			DateTime,
			String,
			FormattedString,
			Encoded
		}

		internal enum DataTypeEncoded : byte
		{
			Byte,
			SByte,
			Int16,
			UInt16,
			Int32,
			UInt32,
			Single,
			Boolean,
			DBNull,
			ErrorValue,
			Formula,
			ArrayFormulaReference,
			WorksheetDataTable,
			WorksheetDataTableReference,
			Decimal,
			StringBuilder,
			TimeSpan,
			Char,
			DateTimeNotConvertible,
			Enum,
			Guid
		}

		protected struct DataTypesCompressed
		{
			private byte value1;

			private byte value2;

			private byte value3;

			public DataType GetDataType(int offset)
			{
				return offset switch
				{
					0 => (DataType)((value1 & 0xE0) >> 5), 
					1 => (DataType)((value1 & 0x1C) >> 2), 
					2 => (DataType)(((value1 & 3) << 1) | ((value2 & 0x80) >> 7)), 
					3 => (DataType)((value2 & 0x70) >> 4), 
					4 => (DataType)((value2 & 0xE) >> 1), 
					5 => (DataType)(((value2 & 1) << 2) | ((value3 & 0xC0) >> 6)), 
					6 => (DataType)((value3 & 0x38) >> 3), 
					7 => (DataType)(value3 & 7), 
					_ => DataType.Null, 
				};
			}

			public void SetDataType(int offset, DataType type)
			{
				byte b = (byte)type;
				switch (offset)
				{
				case 0:
					value1 = (byte)((b << 5) | (value1 & 0x1F));
					break;
				case 1:
					value1 = (byte)((b << 2) | (value1 & 0xE3));
					break;
				case 2:
					value1 = (byte)((b >> 1) | (value1 & 0xFC));
					value2 = (byte)(((b << 7) & 0x80) | (value2 & 0x7F));
					break;
				case 3:
					value2 = (byte)((b << 4) | (value2 & 0x8F));
					break;
				case 4:
					value2 = (byte)((b << 1) | (value2 & 0xF1));
					break;
				case 5:
					value2 = (byte)((b >> 2) | (value2 & 0xFE));
					value3 = (byte)(((b << 6) & 0xC0) | (value3 & 0x3F));
					break;
				case 6:
					value3 = (byte)((b << 3) | (value3 & 0xC7));
					break;
				case 7:
					value3 = (byte)(b | (value3 & 0xF8));
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal enum ValueCoercionType : byte
		{
			None,
			TableHeaderCell,
			TableTotalCell
		}
