		public static void ApplyBlockingValue(IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue value)
		{
			ApplyValueToRegion(value.BlockedRegion, value, checkForBlockingValues: true);
		}

		private static void ApplyValueToRegion(WorksheetRegion region, object value, bool checkForBlockingValues)
		{
			if (region == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = region.Worksheet;
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = region.LastRow; num >= region.FirstRow; num--)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = worksheet.Rows[num];
				for (short num2 = region.LastColumnInternal; num2 >= region.FirstColumnInternal; num2--)
				{
					worksheetRow.SetCellValueRaw(num2, value, checkForBlockingValues);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ClearBlockingValue(IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue value)
		{
			ApplyValueToRegion(value.BlockedRegion, null, checkForBlockingValues: false);
		}

		private static bool IsCellValueSavedAsString(DataType dataType, CellValue cellValue)
		{
			switch (dataType)
			{
			case DataType.Null:
				return false;
			case DataType.String:
			case DataType.FormattedString:
				return true;
			case DataType.Encoded:
				switch (cellValue.DataTypeEncoded)
				{
				case DataTypeEncoded.StringBuilder:
				case DataTypeEncoded.Char:
				case DataTypeEncoded.Enum:
				case DataTypeEncoded.Guid:
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsGeneralFormat(string formatString)
		{
			if (formatString != null)
			{
				return StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Compare(formatString, "General") == 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool ShouldValueSetDefaultFormatString(object value)
		{
			if (value is DateTime)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (value is TimeSpan)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void VerifyDirectSetValue(object value)
		{
			if (value != null && !(value is ValueType))
			{
				if (value is Formula)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantSetFormulaDirectly"));
				}
				if (value is WorksheetDataTable)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantSetDataTableDirectly"));
				}
				if (value as ErrorValue == ErrorValue.Circularity)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantSetCircularityErrorDirectly"));
				}
			}
		}

		public static void VerifyRegionForBlockingValue(IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue value, WorksheetRegion fullRegion, WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = region.Worksheet;
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionShiftedOffWorksheet"));
			}
			if (!(value is ArrayFormula) || !region.IsSingleCell)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetCell item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetCell>)fullRegion)
				{
					if (item.AssociatedTable != null)
					{
						value.ThrowExceptionWhenTableInRegion();
					}
				}
			}
			for (int i = region.FirstRow; i <= region.LastRow; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = worksheet.Rows[i];
				for (short num = (short)region.FirstColumn; num <= region.LastColumn; num++)
				{
					if (worksheet.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion(i, num) != null)
					{
						value.ThrowExceptionWhenMergedCellsInRegion();
					}
					if (worksheetRow.GetCellValueRaw(num) is IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue worksheetRegionBlockingValue && worksheetRegionBlockingValue != value)
					{
						WorksheetRegion blockedRegion = worksheetRegionBlockingValue.BlockedRegion;
						if (blockedRegion != null)
						{
							if (region.Contains(blockedRegion))
							{
								worksheetRegionBlockingValue.RemoveFromRegion();
							}
							else
							{
								worksheetRegionBlockingValue.ThrowBlockingException();
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void VerifyStringLength(object newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null && !(newValue is ValueTuple))
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (newValue is string text)
				{
					num = text.Length;
				}
				else if (newValue is FormattedString formattedString)
				{
					num = formattedString.UnformattedStringLength;
				}
				else if (newValue is StringElement stringElement)
				{
					num = stringElement.UnformattedStringLength;
				}
				else if (newValue is StringBuilder stringBuilder)
				{
					num = stringBuilder.Length;
				}
				if (32767 < num)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellValueStringLength"), 32767));
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearCell(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			SetIsSpecial(row, columnIndex, isInTableHeaderOrTotalRow: false, out var replacementBlock);
			SetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex, null, out replacementBlock);
		}

		public bool DoesCellHaveData(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			if (DoesCellHaveValue(columnIndex))
			{
				return true;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = row.TryGetCellFormat(columnIndex);
			if (worksheetCellFormatData != null)
			{
				Workbook workbook = row.Worksheet.Workbook;
				if (workbook == null || !worksheetCellFormatData.EqualsInternal(workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool DoesCellHaveValue(short columnIndex)
		{
			return GetDataType(columnIndex) != DataType.Null;
		}

		public bool DoesCellHaveValue(short columnIndex, out DataType dataType, out CellValue cellValue)
		{
			AllInfoCache allInfo = GetAllInfo(columnIndex);
			dataType = allInfo.DataType;
			cellValue = allInfo.CellValue;
			return dataType != DataType.Null;
		}

		public bool DoesCellUseCalculations(short columnIndex)
		{
			AllInfoCache allInfo = GetAllInfo(columnIndex);
			return DoesCellUseCalculations(allInfo.DataType, allInfo.CellValue);
		}

		public bool DoesCellUseCalculations(DataType dataType, CellValue cellValue)
		{
			if (dataType == DataType.Encoded)
			{
				switch (cellValue.DataTypeEncoded)
				{
				case DataTypeEncoded.Formula:
				case DataTypeEncoded.ArrayFormulaReference:
				case DataTypeEncoded.WorksheetDataTable:
				case DataTypeEncoded.WorksheetDataTableReference:
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object GetCalculatedValue(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, bool getHyperlinkFriendlyName = true)
		{
			CellCalcReference cellCalcReference = row.TryGetCellCalcReference(columnIndex);
			cellCalcReference?.EnsureCalculated();
			if (cellCalcReference != null && cellCalcReference.AppliedFormula != null)
			{
				ExcelCalcValue calculatedValue = cellCalcReference.AppliedFormula.CalculatedValue;
				if (calculatedValue != null)
				{
					return CalcUtilities.GetValueFormExcelCalcValue(calculatedValue.Value, getHyperlinkFriendlyName);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public GetCellTextResult GetCellTextInternal(WorksheetRow row, GetCellTextParameters paramters)
		{
			bool? useCalculatedValues = paramters.UseCalculatedValues;
			if (useCalculatedValues != true && useCalculatedValues.HasValue && DoesCellUseCalculations(paramters.ColumnIndex))
			{
				Formula cellFormulaInternal = row.GetCellFormulaInternal(paramters.ColumnIndex);
				if (cellFormulaInternal != null)
				{
					return new GetCellTextResult(cellFormulaInternal.ToString(row.Worksheet.CellReferenceMode));
				}
			}
			object cellValue = GetCellValue(row, paramters.ColumnIndex);
			return GetCellTextInternal(row.Worksheet, row, paramters, cellValue);
		}

		public static GetCellTextResult GetCellTextInternal(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRow row, GetCellTextParameters paramters, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return new GetCellTextResult("");
			}
			string defaultValueText = GetDefaultValueText(value);
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(paramters.PreventTextFormattingTypes, PreventTextFormattingTypes.String) && IsStringValue(value))
			{
				return new GetCellTextResult(defaultValueText);
			}
			Workbook workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
			double value2 = double.NaN;
			if (Utilities.TryGetNumericValue(workbook, value, out var numericValue))
			{
				value2 = numericValue;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = null;
			bool useExpandedFractionLimit = false;
			ValueFormatter valueFormatter;
			if (worksheet.DisplayOptions.ShowFormulasInCells)
			{
				useExpandedFractionLimit = true;
				paramters.TextFormatMode = TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth;
				valueFormatter = ((workbook == null) ? new ValueFormatter(workbook, "General", worksheet.Culture) : workbook.Formats.GetValueFormatter(0));
			}
			else
			{
				worksheetCellFormatData = worksheet.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(row, paramters.ColumnIndex);
				valueFormatter = ((workbook == null) ? new ValueFormatter(workbook, worksheetCellFormatData.FormatStringResolved, worksheet.Culture) : workbook.Formats.GetValueFormatter(worksheetCellFormatData.FormatStringIndexResolved));
			}
			if (!valueFormatter.IsValid)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InvalidFormatString_GetTextCall"));
			}
			int availablePixels = -1;
			if (paramters.TextFormatMode == TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth)
			{
				worksheetCellFormatData = null;
			}
			else
			{
				WorksheetMergedCellsRegion cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal = row.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal(paramters.ColumnIndex);
				double num = 0.0;
				if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal != null)
				{
					for (int i = cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal.FirstColumnInternal; i <= cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal.LastColumnInternal; i++)
					{
						num += worksheet.GetColumnWidthInPixels(i);
					}
					worksheetCellFormatData = cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal.CellFormatInternal.Element;
				}
				else
				{
					if (worksheetCellFormatData == null)
					{
						worksheetCellFormatData = worksheet.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(row, paramters.ColumnIndex);
					}
					num = worksheet.GetColumnWidthInPixels(paramters.ColumnIndex);
					if (worksheetCellFormatData.AlignmentResolved == HorizontalCellAlignment.CenterAcrossSelection)
					{
						short num2 = (short)(paramters.ColumnIndex + 1);
						while (num2 < worksheet.Columns.MaxCount && worksheet.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(row, num2).AlignmentResolved == HorizontalCellAlignment.CenterAcrossSelection && row.GetCellValueRaw(num2) == null)
						{
							num += worksheet.GetColumnWidthInPixels(num2);
							num2++;
						}
					}
				}
				availablePixels = Math.Max(0, (int)num - worksheet.GetColumnWidthPadding());
			}
			using TextMetricsProviderBase metricsProvider = ((worksheetCellFormatData == null) ? null : ((paramters.MetricsProviderFactory != null) ? paramters.MetricsProviderFactory() : Workbook.CreateDefaultTextMetricsProvider(workbook)));
			return valueFormatter.FormatValue(value2, defaultValueText, value, availablePixels, metricsProvider, worksheetCellFormatData, useExpandedFractionLimit);
		}

		public object GetCellValue(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			AllInfoCache allInfo = GetAllInfo(columnIndex);
			if (DoesCellUseCalculations(allInfo.DataType, allInfo.CellValue))
			{
				return GetCalculatedValue(row, columnIndex);
			}
			object cellValueRaw = GetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex, null, allInfo.DataType, allInfo.CellValue);
			if (cellValueRaw is StringElement stringElement)
			{
				return stringElement.UnformattedString;
			}
			if (cellValueRaw is FormattedStringValueReference formattedStringValueReference)
			{
				return formattedStringValueReference.Value;
			}
			return cellValueRaw;
		}

		public StringElement GetCellValueIfFormattedString(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			AllInfoCache allInfo = GetAllInfo(columnIndex);
			if (allInfo.DataType != DataType.FormattedString)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetFormattedStringElement(row, columnIndex, allInfo.CellValue);
		}

		public StringBuilder GetCellValueIfStringBuilder(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, DataType type, CellValue cellValue)
		{
			if (type != DataType.Encoded)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (cellValue.DataTypeEncoded != DataTypeEncoded.StringBuilder)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetValueObject(row, columnIndex) as StringBuilder;
		}

		public object GetCellValueRaw(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			return GetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex, null);
		}

		public object GetCellValueRaw(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, WorkbookSaveManager saveManager)
		{
			AllInfoCache allInfo = GetAllInfo(columnIndex);
			return GetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex, saveManager, allInfo.DataType, allInfo.CellValue);
		}

		public object GetCellValueRaw(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, WorkbookSaveManager saveManager, DataType type, CellValue cellValue)
		{
			bool flag = saveManager != null;
			object cellValueRaw = GetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex, flag, type, cellValue);
			if (flag)
			{
				if (cellValueRaw is FormattedStringValueReference valueReference)
				{
					return GetStringElementIndex(row, columnIndex, valueReference);
				}
				if (cellValueRaw is StringBuilder key)
				{
					return new StringElementIndex(saveManager.StringBuilderToSharedStringIndexMap[key]);
				}
				if (cellValueRaw is DateTime)
				{
					double? num = ExcelCalcValue.DateTimeToExcelDate(saveManager.Workbook, (DateTime)cellValueRaw);
					if (num.HasValue)
					{
						return num;
					}
					return 0;
				}
				if (type == DataType.Encoded && cellValue.DataTypeEncoded == DataTypeEncoded.TimeSpan)
				{
					return ExcelCalcValue.TimeOfDayToExcelDate((TimeSpan)cellValueRaw, useDayInfo: true);
				}
			}
			return cellValueRaw;
		}

		private object GetCellValueRaw(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, bool isForSaving, DataType type, CellValue cellValue)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case DataType.Null:
				return null;
			case DataType.Int64:
				return (long)cellValue.UInt64Value;
			case DataType.UInt64:
				return cellValue.UInt64Value;
			case DataType.Double:
				return cellValue.DoubleValue;
			case DataType.DateTime:
			{
				ulong uInt64Value = cellValue.UInt64Value;
				DateTimeKind kind = (DateTimeKind)(uInt64Value >> 62);
				long ticks = (long)(uInt64Value & 0x3FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFL);
				return new DateTime(ticks, kind);
			}
			case DataType.String:
				if (isForSaving)
				{
					return GetStringElementIndex(row, columnIndex, cellValue);
				}
				return GetFormattedStringElement(row, columnIndex, cellValue);
			case DataType.FormattedString:
			{
				if (isForSaving)
				{
					return GetStringElementIndex(row, columnIndex, cellValue);
				}
				StringElement formattedStringElement = GetFormattedStringElement(row, columnIndex, cellValue);
				if (formattedStringElement != null)
				{
					FormattedString formattedString = new FormattedString(row.Worksheet.Workbook, formattedStringElement, isElementInCache: true, addElementToCache: false);
					formattedString.SetOwningCell(row, columnIndex);
					return formattedString;
				}
				return null;
			}
			case DataType.Encoded:
				switch (cellValue.DataTypeEncoded)
				{
				case DataTypeEncoded.Byte:
					return (byte)cellValue.EncodedUIntValue;
				case DataTypeEncoded.SByte:
					return (sbyte)cellValue.EncodedUIntValue;
				case DataTypeEncoded.Int16:
					return (short)cellValue.EncodedUIntValue;
				case DataTypeEncoded.UInt16:
					return (ushort)cellValue.EncodedUIntValue;
				case DataTypeEncoded.Int32:
					return (int)cellValue.EncodedUIntValue;
				case DataTypeEncoded.UInt32:
					return cellValue.EncodedUIntValue;
				case DataTypeEncoded.Single:
					return cellValue.EncodedSingleValue;
				case DataTypeEncoded.Boolean:
					return cellValue.EncodedUIntValue != 0;
				case DataTypeEncoded.DBNull:
					return DBNull.Value;
				case DataTypeEncoded.ErrorValue:
					return ErrorValue.FromValue((byte)cellValue.EncodedUIntValue);
				case DataTypeEncoded.Formula:
					return row.GetCellCalcReference(columnIndex).ExcelFormula;
				case DataTypeEncoded.WorksheetDataTable:
				case DataTypeEncoded.Decimal:
				case DataTypeEncoded.StringBuilder:
				case DataTypeEncoded.TimeSpan:
					return GetValueObject(row, columnIndex);
				case DataTypeEncoded.Char:
				case DataTypeEncoded.DateTimeNotConvertible:
				case DataTypeEncoded.Enum:
				case DataTypeEncoded.Guid:
					return GetValueObject(row, columnIndex);
				case DataTypeEncoded.ArrayFormulaReference:
				case DataTypeEncoded.WorksheetDataTableReference:
					return row.Worksheet.Rows[cellValue.RowIndex].GetCellValueRaw(cellValue.ColumnIndex);
				default:
					return null;
				}
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static string GetDefaultValueText(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is bool)
			{
				return value.ToString().ToUpper();
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		public bool GetIsSpecial(short columnIndex)
		{
			return IsSpecial(columnIndex);
		}

		private ValueCoercionType GetValueCoercionType(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, out WorksheetTable table)
		{
			return GetValueCoercionType(row, columnIndex, IsSpecial(columnIndex), out table);
		}

		private ValueCoercionType GetValueCoercionType(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, bool isSpecial, out WorksheetTable table)
		{
			table = null;
			if (!isSpecial)
			{
				return ValueCoercionType.None;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetTable item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetTable>)row.Worksheet.Tables)
			{
				if (item.Contains(row, columnIndex))
				{
					WorksheetRegion headerRowRegion = item.HeaderRowRegion;
					if (headerRowRegion != null && headerRowRegion.Contains(row, columnIndex))
					{
						table = item;
						return ValueCoercionType.TableHeaderCell;
					}
					WorksheetRegion totalsRowRegion = item.TotalsRowRegion;
					if (totalsRowRegion != null && totalsRowRegion.Contains(row, columnIndex))
					{
						table = item;
						return ValueCoercionType.TableTotalCell;
					}
				}
			}
			return ValueCoercionType.None;
		}

		public bool IsCellValueSavedAsString(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			AllInfoCache allInfo = GetAllInfo(columnIndex);
			return IsCellValueSavedAsString(allInfo.DataType, allInfo.CellValue);
		}

		public static bool IsStringValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(value is string) && !(value is FormattedString) && !(value is StringElement) && !(value is FormattedStringValueReference) && !(value is char) && !(value is Guid) && !(value is StringBuilder))
			{
				return value.GetType().IsEnum();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void RegenerateFormulas(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object valueRaw)
		{
			row.SetFormulaOnCalcReference(columnIndex, valueRaw, canClearPreviouslyCalculatedValue: true);
			row.DirtyCellCalcReference(columnIndex);
		}

		public void SetIsSpecial(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, bool isInTableHeaderOrTotalRow, out WorksheetCellBlock replacementBlock)
		{
			SetIsSpecial(row, columnIndex, isInTableHeaderOrTotalRow, shouldUpdateCurrentValue: true, out replacementBlock);
		}

		public void SetIsSpecial(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, bool isInTableHeaderOrTotalRow, bool shouldUpdateCurrentValue, out WorksheetCellBlock replacementBlock)
		{
			if (!isInTableHeaderOrTotalRow)
			{
				replacementBlock = null;
			}
			else if (ConvertToLargerBlockIfFull(out replacementBlock))
			{
				row.ReplaceCellBlock(columnIndex, replacementBlock);
				replacementBlock.SetIsSpecial(row, columnIndex, isInTableHeaderOrTotalRow, out var _);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = IsSpecial(columnIndex);
			if (flag == isInTableHeaderOrTotalRow)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetIsSpecial(columnIndex, isInTableHeaderOrTotalRow);
			if (!shouldUpdateCurrentValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetTable table;
			ValueCoercionType valueCoercionType = GetValueCoercionType(row, columnIndex, isInTableHeaderOrTotalRow, out table);
			switch (valueCoercionType)
			{
			case ValueCoercionType.None:
				return;
			case ValueCoercionType.TableTotalCell:
				if (DoesCellUseCalculations(columnIndex))
				{
					return;
				}
				break;
			}
			object cellValue = GetCellValue(row, columnIndex);
			if (!(cellValue is string) && (valueCoercionType != ValueCoercionType.TableTotalCell || cellValue != null))
			{
				SetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex, cellValue, checkForBlockingValues: false, forceSet: true, out replacementBlock);
			}
		}

		public void SetCellValueRaw(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object newValueRaw, out WorksheetCellBlock replacementBlock)
		{
			SetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex, newValueRaw, checkForBlockingValues: true, out replacementBlock);
		}

		public void SetCellValueRaw(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object newValueRaw, bool checkForBlockingValues, out WorksheetCellBlock replacementBlock)
		{
			SetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex, newValueRaw, checkForBlockingValues, forceSet: false, out replacementBlock);
		}

		private void SetCellValueRaw(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object newValueRaw, bool checkForBlockingValues, bool forceSet, out WorksheetCellBlock replacementBlock)
		{
			replacementBlock = null;
			AllInfoCache allInfo = GetAllInfo(columnIndex);
			object cellValueRaw = GetCellValueRaw(row, columnIndex, isForSaving: false, allInfo.DataType, allInfo.CellValue);
			if (!forceSet && (object.Equals(newValueRaw, cellValueRaw) || (newValueRaw is string && cellValueRaw is StringElement { HasFormatting: false } stringElement && stringElement.UnformattedString == (string)newValueRaw)))
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetMergedCellsRegion cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal = row.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal(columnIndex);
			if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal != null && (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal.FirstRow != row.Index || cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal.FirstColumn != columnIndex))
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetTable table;
			ValueCoercionType valueCoercionType = GetValueCoercionType(row, columnIndex, out table);
			if (valueCoercionType != ValueCoercionType.None)
			{
				newValueRaw = CoerceValue(row, columnIndex, newValueRaw, valueCoercionType);
			}
			VerifyNewCellValue(row, columnIndex, cellValueRaw, newValueRaw, checkForBlockingValues);
			SetCellValueRawDirect(row, columnIndex, newValueRaw, cellValueRaw, allInfo.DataType, allInfo.CellValue, out replacementBlock);
			bool flag = false;
			Workbook workbook = row.Worksheet.Workbook;
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				flag = workbook.IsLoading;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (newValueRaw != null && !row.Worksheet.GetColumnBlock(columnIndex).CellFormat.IsEmpty)
				{
					row.GetCellFormatInternal(columnIndex);
				}
				if (ShouldValueSetDefaultFormatString(newValueRaw) && ShouldModifyFormatString(row, columnIndex, out var cellFormat))
				{
					if (cellFormat == null)
					{
						cellFormat = row.GetCellFormatInternal(columnIndex);
					}
					DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormat = row.Worksheet.Culture.DateTimeFormat;
					if (newValueRaw is DateTime { TimeOfDay: var timeOfDay })
					{
						if (timeOfDay.TotalHours != 0.0)
						{
							cellFormat.FormatString = WorkbookFormatCollection.GetShortDateAndTimePattern(row.Worksheet.Culture);
						}
						else
						{
							cellFormat.FormatString = WorkbookFormatCollection.GetShortDatePattern(row.Worksheet.Culture);
						}
					}
					else if (newValueRaw is TimeSpan)
					{
						cellFormat.FormatString = dateTimeFormat.ShortTimePattern.Replace("tt", "AM/PM");
					}
				}
				if ((newValueRaw is string || newValueRaw is FormattedString || newValueRaw is StringElement) && !row.Worksheet.PreventImplicitSetCellValueChanges)
				{
					string text = newValueRaw.ToString();
					if (text.IndexOf('\n') >= 0)
					{
						WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormatInternal = row.GetCellFormatInternal(columnIndex);
						if (cellFormatInternal.WrapText == ExcelDefaultableBoolean.Default)
						{
							cellFormatInternal.WrapText = ExcelDefaultableBoolean.True;
						}
					}
				}
				if (Utilities.IsNullResolved(newValueRaw) && !row.Worksheet.PreventImplicitSetCellValueChanges)
				{
					WorksheetHyperlinkCollection hyperlinks = row.Worksheet.Hyperlinks;
					for (int num = hyperlinks.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						if (hyperlinks[num].SourceRegion.Contains(row, columnIndex))
						{
							hyperlinks.RemoveAtHelper(num, removeHyperlinkStyle: false);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (table != null && valueCoercionType == ValueCoercionType.TableHeaderCell)
			{
				table.AssignUniqueColumnNames();
			}
		}

		public void SetCellValueRawDirect(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object newValueRaw, object oldValueRaw, DataType oldType, CellValue oldCellValue, out WorksheetCellBlock replacementBlock)
		{
			SetCellValueRawDirect(row, columnIndex, newValueRaw, oldValueRaw, oldType, oldCellValue, isShiftingCells: false, out replacementBlock);
		}

		public void SetCellValueRawDirect(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object newValueRaw, object oldValueRaw, DataType oldType, CellValue oldCellValue, bool isShiftingCells, out WorksheetCellBlock replacementBlock)
		{
			if (newValueRaw == null)
			{
				replacementBlock = null;
			}
			else if (ConvertToLargerBlockIfFull(out replacementBlock))
			{
				row.ReplaceCellBlock(columnIndex, replacementBlock);
				replacementBlock.SetCellValueRawDirect(row, columnIndex, newValueRaw, oldValueRaw, oldType, oldCellValue, isShiftingCells, out var _);
				return;
			}
			if (oldValueRaw != null)
			{
				ClearValueObject(row, columnIndex, oldType, oldCellValue);
				if (oldValueRaw is IWorksheetCellOwnedValue worksheetCellOwnedValue)
				{
					if (!isShiftingCells && worksheetCellOwnedValue.IsOwnedByAllCellsAppliedTo)
					{
						worksheetCellOwnedValue.SetOwningCell(null, -1);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					StringElement stringElement = oldValueRaw as StringElement;
					if (stringElement == null && oldValueRaw is FormattedStringValueReference formattedStringValueReference)
					{
						stringElement = formattedStringValueReference.Element;
					}
					if (stringElement != null)
					{
						GenericCacheElement.Release(stringElement, row.SharedStringTable);
					}
				}
				if (!isShiftingCells && oldValueRaw is Formula { HasHyperlink: not false })
				{
					row.Worksheet.RemoveVisitedHyperlink(row, columnIndex);
				}
			}
			SetCellValueRawHelper(row, columnIndex, newValueRaw, out var type, out var cellValue);
			SetDataTypeAndCellValue(columnIndex, type, cellValue);
			if (oldType == DataType.Null || type == DataType.Null)
			{
				row.DirtyCellCount();
			}
			if (IsCellValueSavedAsString(oldType, oldCellValue) || IsCellValueSavedAsString(type, cellValue))
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormatElementReadOnly = row.Worksheet.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(row, columnIndex);
				if (cellFormatElementReadOnly.ComputedWrapText)
				{
					row.ResetResolvedRowHeight();
				}
			}
			if (newValueRaw is IWorksheetCellOwnedValue { IsOwnedByAllCellsAppliedTo: not false } worksheetCellOwnedValue2)
			{
				worksheetCellOwnedValue2.SetOwningCell(row, columnIndex);
			}
			if (!isShiftingCells || !(newValueRaw is WorksheetDataTable))
			{
				RegenerateFormulas(row, columnIndex, newValueRaw);
			}
		}

		private void SetCellValueRawHelper(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object valueRaw, out DataType type, out CellValue cellValue)
		{
			type = DataType.Null;
			cellValue = default(CellValue);
			if (valueRaw == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (valueRaw is double)
			{
				type = DataType.Double;
				cellValue.DoubleValue = (double)valueRaw;
				return;
			}
			Workbook workbook = row.Worksheet.Workbook;
			StringElement stringElement;
			if (valueRaw is string value)
			{
				string unformattedString = Utilities.FixupCellString(value);
				type = DataType.String;
				stringElement = new StringElement(unformattedString);
				GenericCachedCollection<StringElement> genericCachedCollection = workbook?.SharedStringTable;
				if (genericCachedCollection == null)
				{
					SetValueObject(row, columnIndex, stringElement);
					return;
				}
				stringElement = GenericCacheElement.FindExistingOrAddToCache(stringElement, genericCachedCollection);
				cellValue.SetFormattedStringInfo(stringElement);
				return;
			}
			stringElement = valueRaw as StringElement;
			if (stringElement != null)
			{
				type = DataType.String;
				if (workbook == null)
				{
					if (stringElement.ReferenceCount > 0)
					{
						stringElement = (StringElement)stringElement.Clone(null);
					}
					SetValueObject(row, columnIndex, stringElement);
				}
				else
				{
					stringElement = GenericCacheElement.FindExistingOrAddToCache(stringElement, workbook.SharedStringTable);
					cellValue.SetFormattedStringInfo(stringElement);
				}
			}
			else if (valueRaw is FormattedString formattedString)
			{
				type = DataType.FormattedString;
				if (workbook == null)
				{
					SetValueObject(row, columnIndex, formattedString.Element);
					return;
				}
				formattedString.OnRooted(workbook.SharedStringTable);
				cellValue.SetFormattedStringInfo(formattedString.Element);
			}
			else if (valueRaw is Formula formula)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				if (formula is ArrayFormula { CellRange: var cellRange })
				{
					if (cellRange.Worksheet == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (cellRange.TopRow != row || cellRange.FirstColumnInternal != columnIndex)
					{
						cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.ArrayFormulaReference;
						cellValue.RowIndex = cellRange.FirstRow;
						cellValue.ColumnIndex = cellRange.FirstColumnInternal;
						return;
					}
				}
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.Formula;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is int)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.Int32;
				cellValue.EncodedUIntValue = (uint)(int)valueRaw;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is bool)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.Boolean;
				cellValue.EncodedUIntValue = (((bool)valueRaw) ? 1u : 0u);
			}
			else if (valueRaw is ErrorValue errorValue)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.ErrorValue;
				cellValue.EncodedUIntValue = errorValue.Value;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is DateTime dateValue)
			{
				if (ExcelCalcValue.DateTimeToExcelDate(workbook, dateValue).HasValue)
				{
					type = DataType.DateTime;
					cellValue.UInt64Value = (ulong)(dateValue.Ticks | ((long)dateValue.Kind << 62));
				}
				else
				{
					type = DataType.Encoded;
					cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.DateTimeNotConvertible;
					SetValueObject(row, columnIndex, new FormattedStringValueReference(valueRaw, workbook));
				}
			}
			else if (valueRaw is WorksheetDataTable worksheetDataTable)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				WorksheetRegion interiorCells = worksheetDataTable.InteriorCells;
				if (interiorCells != null && interiorCells.Worksheet != null)
				{
					if (interiorCells.TopRow == row && interiorCells.FirstColumnInternal == columnIndex)
					{
						cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.WorksheetDataTable;
						SetValueObject(row, columnIndex, worksheetDataTable);
					}
					else
					{
						cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.WorksheetDataTableReference;
						cellValue.RowIndex = interiorCells.FirstRow;
						cellValue.ColumnIndex = interiorCells.FirstColumnInternal;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (valueRaw is float)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.Single;
				cellValue.EncodedSingleValue = (float)valueRaw;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is long)
			{
				type = DataType.Int64;
				cellValue.UInt64Value = (ulong)(long)valueRaw;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is byte)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.Byte;
				cellValue.EncodedUIntValue = (byte)valueRaw;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is sbyte)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.SByte;
				cellValue.EncodedUIntValue = (byte)(sbyte)valueRaw;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is short)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.Int16;
				cellValue.EncodedUIntValue = (ushort)(short)valueRaw;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is ushort)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.UInt16;
				cellValue.EncodedUIntValue = (ushort)valueRaw;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is uint)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.UInt32;
				cellValue.EncodedUIntValue = (uint)valueRaw;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is ulong)
			{
				type = DataType.UInt64;
				cellValue.UInt64Value = (ulong)valueRaw;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is DBNull)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.DBNull;
			}
			else if (valueRaw is char)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.Char;
				SetValueObject(row, columnIndex, new FormattedStringValueReference(valueRaw, workbook));
			}
			else if (valueRaw is decimal)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.Decimal;
				SetValueObject(row, columnIndex, valueRaw);
			}
			else if (valueRaw is Guid)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.Guid;
				SetValueObject(row, columnIndex, new FormattedStringValueReference(valueRaw, workbook));
			}
			else if (valueRaw.GetType().IsEnum())
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.Enum;
				SetValueObject(row, columnIndex, new FormattedStringValueReference(valueRaw, workbook));
			}
			else if (valueRaw is StringBuilder)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.StringBuilder;
				SetValueObject(row, columnIndex, valueRaw);
			}
			else if (valueRaw is TimeSpan)
			{
				type = DataType.Encoded;
				cellValue.DataTypeEncoded = DataTypeEncoded.TimeSpan;
				SetValueObject(row, columnIndex, valueRaw);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateFormattedStringElement(short columnIndex, StringElement element)
		{
			CellValue value = default(CellValue);
			value.SetFormattedStringInfo(element);
			SetCellValue(columnIndex, value, isNull: false);
		}

		public void VerifyNewCellValue(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object oldValueRaw, object newValueRaw, bool checkForBlockingValues)
		{
			VerifyStringLength(newValueRaw);
			if (checkForBlockingValues && oldValueRaw is IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue { BlockedRegion: var blockedRegion } worksheetRegionBlockingValue)
			{
				if (blockedRegion.FirstRow == blockedRegion.LastRow && blockedRegion.FirstColumn == blockedRegion.LastColumn)
				{
					worksheetRegionBlockingValue.RemoveFromRegion();
				}
				else
				{
					worksheetRegionBlockingValue.ThrowBlockingException();
				}
			}
			if (newValueRaw != null && !WorksheetCell.IsCellTypeSupported(newValueRaw.GetType()))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Utilities.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_CellType", newValueRaw.GetType()));
			}
			if (newValueRaw is IWorksheetCellOwnedValue worksheetCellOwnedValue)
			{
				worksheetCellOwnedValue.VerifyNewOwner(row, columnIndex);
			}
		}

		private void ClearValueObject(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, DataType dataType, CellValue cellValue)
		{
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (dataType == DataType.Encoded)
			{
				switch (cellValue.DataTypeEncoded)
				{
				case DataTypeEncoded.WorksheetDataTable:
				case DataTypeEncoded.Decimal:
				case DataTypeEncoded.StringBuilder:
				case DataTypeEncoded.TimeSpan:
				case DataTypeEncoded.Char:
				case DataTypeEncoded.DateTimeNotConvertible:
				case DataTypeEncoded.Enum:
				case DataTypeEncoded.Guid:
					row.Worksheet.CellValues.Remove(ValueTuple.Create<WorksheetRow, short>(row, columnIndex));
					break;
				case DataTypeEncoded.WorksheetDataTableReference:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private object CoerceValue(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object value, ValueCoercionType valueCoercionType)
		{
			if (valueCoercionType == ValueCoercionType.None)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (value is Formula || value is WorksheetDataTable)
			{
				switch (valueCoercionType)
				{
				case ValueCoercionType.TableTotalCell:
					return value;
				case ValueCoercionType.TableHeaderCell:
					value = 0.0;
					break;
				default:
					value = null;
					break;
				}
			}
			GetCellTextParameters getCellTextParameters = new GetCellTextParameters(columnIndex);
			getCellTextParameters.TextFormatMode = TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth;
			switch (valueCoercionType)
			{
			case ValueCoercionType.TableTotalCell:
				if (value is FormattedString && row.Worksheet != null)
				{
					bool hasTableStyle;
					string formatString = row.Worksheet.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(row, row.Index, columnIndex, out hasTableStyle).FormatString;
					if (formatString == null || StringUtilities.StringComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase.Equals(formatString, "General"))
					{
						return value;
					}
				}
				getCellTextParameters.PreventTextFormattingTypes = PreventTextFormattingTypes.None;
				return GetCellTextInternal(row.Worksheet, row, getCellTextParameters, value).Text;
			case ValueCoercionType.TableHeaderCell:
				if (value == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (value is FormattedString)
				{
					return value;
				}
				getCellTextParameters.PreventTextFormattingTypes = PreventTextFormattingTypes.String;
				return GetCellTextInternal(row.Worksheet, row, getCellTextParameters, value).Text;
			default:
				return value;
			}
		}

		private StringElement GetFormattedStringElement(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, CellValue value)
		{
			Workbook workbook = row.Worksheet.Workbook;
			if (workbook == null)
			{
				return GetValueObject(row, columnIndex) as StringElement;
			}
			return workbook.SharedStringTable.Find(value.FormattedStringHashCodeInCache, value.FormattedStringKey);
		}

		private object GetStringElementIndex(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, CellValue value)
		{
			Workbook workbook = row.Worksheet.Workbook;
			return new StringElementIndex(workbook.SharedStringTable.FindStringIndex(value.FormattedStringHashCodeInCache, value.FormattedStringKey));
		}

		private object GetStringElementIndex(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, FormattedStringValueReference valueReference)
		{
			Workbook workbook = row.Worksheet.Workbook;
			int hashCode = HashHelpers.InternalGetHashCode(valueReference.Element);
			return new StringElementIndex(workbook.SharedStringTable.FindStringIndex(hashCode, valueReference.Element.Key));
		}

		private object GetValueObject(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!row.Worksheet.HasCellValues)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (row.Worksheet.CellValues.TryGetValue(ValueTuple.Create<WorksheetRow, short>(row, columnIndex), out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SetValueObject(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, object value)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			row.Worksheet.CellValues[ValueTuple.Create<WorksheetRow, short>(row, columnIndex)] = value;
		}

		private static bool ShouldModifyFormatString(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, out WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormat)
		{
			if (IsGeneralFormat(row.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(columnIndex).FormatStringResolved))
			{
				cellFormat = row.GetCellFormatInternal(columnIndex);
				return true;
			}
			cellFormat = null;
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal class WorksheetCellBlockHalf : WorksheetCellBlock
	{
		private const int BlockSize = 16;

		private const int ColumnOffsetSize = 5;

		private ushort columnOffsets00Thru02;

		private ushort columnOffsets03Thru05;

		private ushort columnOffsets06Thru08;

		private ushort columnOffsets09Thru11;

		private ushort columnOffsets12Thru14;

		private ushort columnOffsets15;

		private DataTypesCompressed dataTypes00Thru07;

		private DataTypesCompressed dataTypes08Thru15;

		private ushort isSpecialFlags;

		private uint usedCells;

		private ushort usedMembers;

		private CellValue value00;

		private CellValue value01;

		private CellValue value02;

		private CellValue value03;

		private CellValue value04;

		private CellValue value05;

		private CellValue value06;

		private CellValue value07;

		private CellValue value08;

		private CellValue value09;

		private CellValue value10;

		private CellValue value11;

		private CellValue value12;

		private CellValue value13;

		private CellValue value14;

		private CellValue value15;

		public WorksheetCellBlockHalf(short blockIndex)
			: base(blockIndex)
		{
		}

		protected override bool ConvertToLargerBlockIfFull(out WorksheetCellBlock replacementBlock)
		{
			if (usedMembers != ushort.MaxValue)
			{
				replacementBlock = null;
				return false;
			}
			replacementBlock = new WorksheetCellBlockFull(base.BlockIndex);
			for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
			{
				short columOffset = GetColumOffset(i);
				CellValue cellValueHelper = GetCellValueHelper(i);
				DataType dataTypeHelper = GetDataTypeHelper(i);
				bool value = IsSpecialHelper(i);
				replacementBlock.SetDataTypeAndCellValue(columOffset, dataTypeHelper, cellValueHelper);
				replacementBlock.SetIsSpecial(columOffset, value);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override AllInfoCache GetAllInfo(short columnIndex)
		{
			AllInfoCache allInfo = WorksheetCellBlock._allInfo;
			int memberIndex = GetMemberIndex(columnIndex, allocateNew: false);
			if (memberIndex == -1)
			{
				allInfo.CellValue = default(CellValue);
				allInfo.DataType = DataType.Null;
				allInfo.IsSpecial = false;
				return allInfo;
			}
			allInfo.CellValue = GetCellValueHelper(memberIndex);
			allInfo.DataType = GetDataTypeHelper(memberIndex);
			allInfo.IsSpecial = Utilities.TestBit(isSpecialFlags, memberIndex);
			return allInfo;
		}

		protected override CellValue GetCellValue(short columnIndex)
		{
			int memberIndex = GetMemberIndex(columnIndex, allocateNew: false);
			if (memberIndex == -1)
			{
				return default(CellValue);
			}
			return GetCellValueHelper(memberIndex);
		}

		private CellValue GetCellValueHelper(int memberIndex)
		{
			return memberIndex switch
			{
				0 => value00, 
				1 => value01, 
				2 => value02, 
				3 => value03, 
				4 => value04, 
				5 => value05, 
				6 => value06, 
				7 => value07, 
				8 => value08, 
				9 => value09, 
				10 => value10, 
				11 => value11, 
				12 => value12, 
				13 => value13, 
				14 => value14, 
				15 => value15, 
				_ => default(CellValue), 
			};
		}

		protected override DataType GetDataType(short columnIndex)
		{
			int memberIndex = GetMemberIndex(columnIndex, allocateNew: false);
			if (memberIndex == -1)
			{
				return DataType.Null;
			}
			return GetDataTypeHelper(memberIndex);
		}

		private DataType GetDataTypeHelper(int memberIndex)
		{
			return (memberIndex & 8) switch
			{
				0 => dataTypes00Thru07.GetDataType(memberIndex & 7), 
				8 => dataTypes08Thru15.GetDataType(memberIndex & 7), 
				_ => DataType.Null, 
			};
		}

		public override bool IsSpecial(short columnIndex)
		{
			int memberIndex = GetMemberIndex(columnIndex, allocateNew: false);
			if (memberIndex == -1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsSpecialHelper(memberIndex);
		}

		private bool IsSpecialHelper(int memberIndex)
		{
			return Utilities.TestBit(isSpecialFlags, memberIndex);
		}

		protected override void SetCellValue(short columnIndex, CellValue value, bool isNull)
		{
			int memberIndex = GetMemberIndex(columnIndex, !isNull);
			if (memberIndex >= 0)
			{
				SetCellValueHelper(memberIndex, value);
			}
		}

		private void SetCellValueHelper(int memberIndex, CellValue value)
		{
			switch (memberIndex)
			{
			case 0:
				value00 = value;
				break;
			case 1:
				value01 = value;
				break;
			case 2:
				value02 = value;
				break;
			case 3:
				value03 = value;
				break;
			case 4:
				value04 = value;
				break;
			case 5:
				value05 = value;
				break;
			case 6:
				value06 = value;
				break;
			case 7:
				value07 = value;
				break;
			case 8:
				value08 = value;
				break;
			case 9:
				value09 = value;
				break;
			case 10:
				value10 = value;
				break;
			case 11:
				value11 = value;
				break;
			case 12:
				value12 = value;
				break;
			case 13:
				value13 = value;
				break;
			case 14:
				value14 = value;
				break;
			case 15:
				value15 = value;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void SetDataType(short columnIndex, DataType dataType)
		{
			int memberIndex = GetMemberIndex(columnIndex, dataType != DataType.Null);
			if (memberIndex >= 0)
			{
				SetDataTypeHelper(columnIndex, memberIndex, dataType);
			}
		}

		private void SetDataTypeHelper(short columnIndex, int memberIndex, DataType dataType)
		{
			switch (memberIndex & 8)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case 0:
				dataTypes00Thru07.SetDataType(memberIndex & 7, dataType);
				break;
			case 8:
				dataTypes08Thru15.SetDataType(memberIndex & 7, dataType);
				break;
			}
			if (dataType == DataType.Null && !IsSpecialHelper(memberIndex))
			{
				ClearMemberIndex(columnIndex, memberIndex);
			}
		}

		public override void SetDataTypeAndCellValue(short columnIndex, DataType dataType, CellValue cellValue)
		{
			int memberIndex = GetMemberIndex(columnIndex, dataType != DataType.Null);
			if (memberIndex >= 0)
			{
				SetCellValueHelper(memberIndex, cellValue);
				SetDataTypeHelper(columnIndex, memberIndex, dataType);
			}
		}

		public override void SetIsSpecial(short columnIndex, bool value)
		{
			int memberIndex = GetMemberIndex(columnIndex, value);
			if (memberIndex >= 0)
			{
				Utilities.SetBit(ref isSpecialFlags, value, memberIndex);
				if (!value && GetDataType(columnIndex) == DataType.Null)
				{
					ClearMemberIndex(columnIndex, memberIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearColumnOffset(int memberIndex)
		{
			int num = memberIndex / 3;
			int num2 = memberIndex % 3 * 5;
			int lastBitIndex = num2 + 5 - 1;
			switch (num)
			{
			case 0:
				Utilities.ClearBits(ref columnOffsets00Thru02, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			case 1:
				Utilities.ClearBits(ref columnOffsets03Thru05, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			case 2:
				Utilities.ClearBits(ref columnOffsets06Thru08, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			case 3:
				Utilities.ClearBits(ref columnOffsets09Thru11, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			case 4:
				Utilities.ClearBits(ref columnOffsets12Thru14, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			case 5:
				Utilities.ClearBits(ref columnOffsets15, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ClearMemberIndex(short columnIndex, int memberIndex)
		{
			int bitIndex = columnIndex & 0x1F;
			Utilities.SetBit(ref usedMembers, testValue: false, memberIndex);
			Utilities.SetBit(ref usedCells, testValue: false, bitIndex);
			ClearColumnOffset(memberIndex);
		}

		private short GetColumOffset(int memberIndex)
		{
			int num = memberIndex / 3;
			int num2 = memberIndex % 3 * 5;
			int lastBitIndex = num2 + 5 - 1;
			return num switch
			{
				0 => (short)Utilities.GetBits(columnOffsets00Thru02, num2, lastBitIndex), 
				1 => (short)Utilities.GetBits(columnOffsets03Thru05, num2, lastBitIndex), 
				2 => (short)Utilities.GetBits(columnOffsets06Thru08, num2, lastBitIndex), 
				3 => (short)Utilities.GetBits(columnOffsets09Thru11, num2, lastBitIndex), 
				4 => (short)Utilities.GetBits(columnOffsets12Thru14, num2, lastBitIndex), 
				5 => (short)Utilities.GetBits(columnOffsets15, num2, lastBitIndex), 
				_ => 0, 
			};
		}

		private int GetMemberIndex(short columnIndex, bool allocateNew)
		{
			short num = (short)(columnIndex & 0x1F);
			int num2 = -1;
			if (usedCells == 0)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag = Utilities.TestBit(usedCells, num);
				if (flag || allocateNew)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
					{
						bool flag2 = Utilities.TestBit(usedMembers, i);
						if (flag)
						{
							if (flag2 && GetColumOffset(i) == num)
							{
								return i;
							}
						}
						else if (!flag2 && num2 < 0)
						{
							num2 = i;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (allocateNew && num2 >= 0)
			{
				Utilities.SetBit(ref usedMembers, testValue: true, num2);
				SetColumnOffset(num2, num);
				return num2;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void SetColumnOffset(int memberIndex, short columnOffset)
		{
			int num = memberIndex / 3;
			int num2 = memberIndex % 3 * 5;
			int lastBitIndex = num2 + 5 - 1;
			switch (num)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case 0:
				Utilities.AddBits(ref columnOffsets00Thru02, columnOffset, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			case 1:
				Utilities.AddBits(ref columnOffsets03Thru05, columnOffset, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			case 2:
				Utilities.AddBits(ref columnOffsets06Thru08, columnOffset, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			case 3:
				Utilities.AddBits(ref columnOffsets09Thru11, columnOffset, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			case 4:
				Utilities.AddBits(ref columnOffsets12Thru14, columnOffset, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			case 5:
				Utilities.AddBits(ref columnOffsets15, columnOffset, num2, lastBitIndex);
				break;
			}
			Utilities.SetBit(ref usedCells, testValue: true, columnOffset);
		}
	}

	public class WorksheetCellComment : WorksheetShape, IFormattedStringOwner, IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver

		public override Worksheet Worksheet

		}

		public string Author

				return author;
			}
			set

				}
				author = value;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetCell Cell
		{
			get
			{
				return cell;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (!(cell == value))
				{
					cell = value;
					VerifyTextFormattingRuns();
				}
			}
		}

		internal ushort NoteOptionFlags
		{
			get
			{
				return noteOptionFlags;
			}
			set

			}
		}

		public FormattedString Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = new FormattedString(string.Empty);
					text.Owner = this;
				}
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				if (text != value)
				{
					value?.VerifyNewOwner(this);
					if (text != null)
					{
						text.Owner = null;
					}
					text = value;
					if (text != null)
					{
						text.Owner = this;
					}
					((IFormattedStringOwner)this).OnUnformattedStringChanged(text);
				}
			}
		}

		public WorksheetCellComment()
		{
			Initialize();
		}

		internal WorksheetCellComment(WorksheetShapeWithText shapeWithText)
			: base(shapeWithText)
		{
			Initialize();
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			base.Fill = ShapeFill.FromColor(SystemColorsInternal.InfoColor);
			if (!base.PositioningModeHasBeenSet)
			{
				base.PositioningMode = ShapePositioningMode.DontMoveOrSizeWithCells;
			}
			base.Visible = false;
			base.TxoOptionFlags = 530;
		}

		internal override TResult Accept<TArg, TResult>(IWorksheetShapeVisitor<TArg, TResult> visitor, TArg argument = default(TArg))
		{
			return visitor.VisitWorksheetCellComment(this, argument);
		}

		internal override void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			base.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			if (text != null)
			{
				text.SetWorksheet(null);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnSitedOnWorksheet(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			base.OnSitedOnWorksheet(worksheet);
			if (text != null)
			{
				text.SetWorksheet(worksheet);
			}
		}

		internal override void PopulateObjRecords()
		{
			if (base.Obj == null)
			{
				base.Obj = new Obj(this);
			}
		}

		internal override void VerifyPositioningMode(ShapePositioningMode value)
		{
		}

		void IFormattedStringOwner.OnUnformattedStringChanged(FormattedString sender)
		{
			if (text != null)
			{
				string unformattedString = text.UnformattedString;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(unformattedString) && unformattedString.Length > 32767)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_TextLengthGreaterThanMax"), 32767));
				}
			}
			VerifyTextFormattingRuns();
		}

		void IWorkbookFontDefaultsResolver.ResolveDefaults(WorkbookFontData font)
		{
			if (font.ColorInfo == null)
			{
				font.ColorInfo = new WorkbookColorInfo(SystemColorsInternal.InfoTextColor);
			}
			UltimateFontDefaultsResolver.Instance.ResolveDefaults(font);
		}

		internal void VerifyTextFormattingRuns()
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			StringElement element = text.Element;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(element.UnformattedString))
			{
				return;
			}
			FormattedStringElement formattedStringElement = element as FormattedStringElement;
			if ((formattedStringElement == null || !formattedStringElement.HasFormatting) && Worksheet != null)
			{
				text.BeforeSet();
				if (formattedStringElement == null)
				{
					formattedStringElement = text.ConvertToFormattedStringElement();
				}
				formattedStringElement.FormattingRuns.Add(new FormattedStringRun(formattedStringElement, 0));
				text.AfterSet();
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class WorksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy : WorksheetCellFormatProxy
	{
		private WorksheetCellFormatData[] cellFormatBlock;

		private int cellShiftHistoryVersion;

		private short columnIndex;

		protected internal override Worksheet Worksheet
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Owner is WorksheetRow worksheetRow))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return worksheetRow.Worksheet;
			}
		}

		public override WorksheetCellFormatData Element
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCellAddress();
				element = cellFormatBlock[columnIndex % 32];
				return element;
			}
		}

		public short ColumnIndex => columnIndex;

		public WorksheetCellFormatData ElementInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return element;
			}
			set
			{
				element = value;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy(WorksheetCellFormatData element, WorksheetCellFormatCollection parentCollection, WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, WorksheetCellFormatData[] cellFormatBlock)
			: base(element, parentCollection, row)
		{
			this.columnIndex = columnIndex;
			this.cellFormatBlock = cellFormatBlock;
			cellShiftHistoryVersion = row.Worksheet.CellShiftHistoryVersion;
		}

		public override void AfterSet(GenericCachedCollection<WorksheetCellFormatData> collection)
		{
			base.AfterSet(collection);
			UpdateCellFormatKeyOnCell();
		}

		public override GenericCachedCollection<WorksheetCellFormatData> BeforeSet(bool needsElementAfter)
		{
			VerifyCellAddress();
			if (!needsElementAfter)
			{
				return base.BeforeSet(needsElementAfter);
			}
			GenericCachedCollection<WorksheetCellFormatData> result = base.BeforeSet(needsElementAfter);
			UpdateCellFormatKeyOnCell();
			return result;
		}

		internal override WorksheetCellAddress? GetResolutionAddress()
		{
			VerifyCellAddress();
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = (WorksheetRow)base.Owner;
			return new WorksheetCellAddress(worksheetRow.Index, columnIndex);
		}

		internal override void ResyncWithResolutionAddress(WorksheetCellAddress? resolutionAddress)
		{
			if (!resolutionAddress.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = (WorksheetRow)base.Owner;
			if (worksheetRow != null)
			{
				Worksheet worksheet = worksheetRow.Worksheet;
				if (worksheet != null)
				{
					cellShiftHistoryVersion = worksheet.CellShiftHistoryVersion;
					SetOwner(worksheet.Rows[resolutionAddress.Value.RowIndex]);
					columnIndex = resolutionAddress.Value.ColumnIndex;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCellFormatKeyOnCell()
		{
			cellFormatBlock[columnIndex % 32] = element;
		}

		private void VerifyCellAddress()
		{
			if (cellFormatBlock != null)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = (WorksheetRow)base.Owner;
				short num = columnIndex;
				WorksheetRow row = (WorksheetRow)base.Owner;
				Worksheet worksheet = row.Worksheet;
				if (worksheet == null || !worksheet.VerifyCellAddress(ref row, ref columnIndex, ref cellShiftHistoryVersion))
				{
					SetOwner(null);
					columnIndex = -1;
					cellFormatBlock = null;
					element = null;
				}
				else if (row != worksheetRow || columnIndex != num)
				{
					SetOwner(row);
					cellFormatBlock = row.GetCellFormatBlock(columnIndex);
					element = row.GetCellFormatInternal(cellFormatBlock, columnIndex).Element;
				}
			}
			if (cellFormatBlock == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"));
			}
		}
	}

	internal class FontXInfo
	{
		private readonly bool _useChartFont;

		private readonly WorkbookFontData _workbookFont;

		private readonly int _offsetValue;

		public WorkbookFontData WorkbookFont => _workbookFont;

		public FontXInfo(int ifont, WorkbookLoadManager loadManager)
		{
			if (ifont == 0)
			{
				_useChartFont = true;
			}
			else if (ifont < loadManager.Fonts.Count)
			{
				_workbookFont = loadManager.Fonts[ifont];
			}
			else
			{
				_offsetValue = ifont - loadManager.Fonts.Count;
			}
		}

		public ushort GetIFontValue(WorkbookSaveManager saveManager)
		{
			if (_useChartFont)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (_workbookFont != null)
			{
				int num = saveManager.Fonts.IndexOf(_workbookFont);
				return (ushort)num;
			}
			return (ushort)(_offsetValue + saveManager.Fonts.Count);
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Column: Index - {GetIndexString(),nq}")]
	public class WorksheetColumn : RowColumnBase
	{
		private enum InternalFlags : byte
		{
			WasRemoved = 1
		}

		private short index;

		private byte _collectionChangeVersion;

		private InternalFlags _flags;

		internal override bool HiddenInternal
		{
			get
			{
				short num = (short)Index;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.Worksheet?.GetColumnBlock(num).Hidden ?? false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Hidden != value)
				{
					VerifyIsValid();
					OnBeforeColumnChange();
					base.Worksheet.GetColumnBlock((short)Index).Hidden = value;
					OnAfterColumnChange();
				}
			}
		}

		public override int Index
		{
			get
			{
				Worksheet worksheet = base.Worksheet;
				if (worksheet == null || GetFlag(InternalFlags.WasRemoved))
				{
					return -1;
				}
				WorksheetColumnCollection columns = worksheet.Columns;
				byte changeVersion = columns.ChangeVersion;
				if (changeVersion != _collectionChangeVersion)
				{
					int num = columns.AdjustIndex(index, _collectionChangeVersion);
					_collectionChangeVersion = changeVersion;
					if (num < 0)
					{
						OnRemovedFromCollection();
						return -1;
					}
					index = (short)num;
				}
				return index;
			}
		}

		internal override byte OutlineLevelInternal
		{
			get
			{
				short num = (short)Index;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return base.Worksheet?.GetColumnBlock(num).OutlineLevel ?? 0;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.OutlineLevel != value)
				{
					VerifyIsValid();
					OnBeforeColumnChange();
					base.Worksheet.GetColumnBlock((short)Index).OutlineLevel = value;
					OnAfterColumnChange();
				}
			}
		}

		public int Width
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Hidden)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				Worksheet worksheet = base.Worksheet;
				if (worksheet == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				short num = (short)Index;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return worksheet.GetColumnBlock(num).Width;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyIsValid();
				if (value == 0)
				{
					base.Hidden = true;
				}
				else if (Width != value)
				{
					if (value < -1)
					{
						value = -1;
					}
					if (65535 < value)
					{
						value = 65535;
					}
					WorksheetElementResizeContext worksheetElementResizeContext = null;
					if (base.Worksheet.DoesNeedElementResizeNotification)
					{
						worksheetElementResizeContext = WorksheetElementResizeContext.Create(this);
					}
					OnBeforeColumnChange();
					WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock = base.Worksheet.GetColumnBlock((short)Index);
					columnBlock.Width = value;
					if (HiddenInternal)
					{
						columnBlock.Hidden = false;
						OnHiddenChanged();
					}
					OnAfterColumnChange();
					worksheetElementResizeContext?.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		internal int IndexCached
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetFlag(InternalFlags.WasRemoved))
				{
					return index;
				}
				return Index;
			}
		}

		internal short IndexInternal => index;

		internal bool WasRemoved => GetFlag(InternalFlags.WasRemoved);

		internal WorksheetColumn(Worksheet worksheet, short index)
			: base(worksheet)
		{
			this.index = index;
			_collectionChangeVersion = worksheet.Columns.ChangeVersion;
		}

		internal override WorksheetCellFormatProxy CreateCellFormatProxy(GenericCachedCollectionEx<WorksheetCellFormatData> cellFormatCollection)
		{
			return new WorksheetColumnOwnedFormatProxy(cellFormatCollection, this);
		}

		internal override WorksheetCellFormatData GetAdjacentFormatForBorderResolution(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue borderValue)
		{
			switch (borderValue)
			{
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
				return null;
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
				if (Index == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.Worksheet.GetColumnBlock((short)(IndexInternal - 1)).CellFormat;
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
				if (Index == base.Worksheet.Columns.MaxCount - 1)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.Worksheet.GetColumnBlock((short)(IndexInternal + 1)).CellFormat;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal override void OnCellFormatValueChanged(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue values, CellFormatValueChangedOptions options)
		{
			if (base.Worksheet == null || base.Worksheet.IsLoading)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (WorksheetRow.DoesAffectResolvedheight(values))
			{
				foreach (WorksheetRow item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)base.Worksheet.Rows)
				{
					if (item.GetCellValueRaw((short)Index) != null)
					{
						item.ResetResolvedRowHeight();
					}
				}
			}
			short num = (short)Index;
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue << 1))
			{
				if ((values & cellFormatValue) == 0 || base.CellFormatInternal.IsValueDefault(cellFormatValue))
				{
					continue;
				}
				object value = sender.GetValue(cellFormatValue);
				switch (cellFormatValue)
				{
				case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
				case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
				{
					CellFormatValue oppositeBorderValue = Utilities.GetOppositeBorderValue(cellFormatValue);
					short? num2 = null;
					if (cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo || cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle)
					{
						if (0 < num)
						{
							num2 = (short)(num - 1);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						int num3 = base.Worksheet.Columns.MaxCount - 1;
						if (num < num3)
						{
							num2 = (short)(num + 1);
						}
					}
					if (num2.HasValue && (options & CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventAdjacentBorderSyncronization) == 0)
					{
						WorksheetColumn worksheetColumn = base.Worksheet.Columns[num2.Value];
						Utilities.SynchronizeOverlappingBorderProperties(sender, worksheetColumn.CellFormatInternal, cellFormatValue, value, options);
					}
					foreach (WorksheetRow item2 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)base.Worksheet.Rows)
					{
						WorksheetMergedCellsRegion cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion = item2.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion(Index);
						if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion != null && cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion.Width != 1)
						{
							continue;
						}
						WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization = GetCellFormatForGeneralSynchronization(item2, num, cellFormatValue);
						if (cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization != null)
						{
							cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization.SetValue(cellFormatValue, value, callBeforeAndAfterSet: true, options);
						}
						else if ((options & CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventAdjacentBorderSyncronization) == 0 && num2.HasValue)
						{
							cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization = GetCellFormatForGeneralSynchronization(item2, num2.Value, oppositeBorderValue);
							if (cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization != null && cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization.GetValue(oppositeBorderValue) != value)
							{
								cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization.ResetValue(oppositeBorderValue, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventAdjacentBorderSyncronization);
								cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization.ResetValue(Utilities.GetAssociatedBorderValue(oppositeBorderValue), CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventAdjacentBorderSyncronization);
							}
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				case CellFormatValue.FontHeight:
				case CellFormatValue.FontName:
					base.Worksheet.ResetMeasuredRowHeight();
					break;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				DiagonalBorders diagonalBorders = DiagonalBorders.None;
				if (cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders)
				{
					diagonalBorders = (DiagonalBorders)value;
					DiagonalBorders previousDiagonalBorders = sender.Element.PreviousDiagonalBorders;
					flag = !Utilities.IsDiagonalDownSet(diagonalBorders) && Utilities.IsDiagonalDownSet(previousDiagonalBorders);
					flag2 = !Utilities.IsDiagonalUpSet(diagonalBorders) && Utilities.IsDiagonalUpSet(previousDiagonalBorders);
				}
				if ((options & CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventOwnerToCellSynchronization) != CellFormatValueChangedOptions.DefaultBehavior)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (WorksheetRow item3 in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)base.Worksheet.Rows)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization2 = GetCellFormatForGeneralSynchronization(item3, num, cellFormatValue);
					if (cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization2 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					WorksheetMergedCellsRegion cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion2 = item3.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion(Index);
					if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion2 != null && cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion2.Width != 1)
					{
						continue;
					}
					object value2 = value;
					if (cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders)
					{
						DiagonalBorders diagonalBorders2 = diagonalBorders | cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization2.DiagonalBorders;
						if (flag)
						{
							Utilities.RemoveDiagonalDownBit(ref diagonalBorders2);
						}
						if (flag2)
						{
							Utilities.RemoveDiagonalUpBit(ref diagonalBorders2);
						}
						value2 = diagonalBorders2;
					}
					cellFormatForGeneralSynchronization2.SetValue(cellFormatValue, value2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal int CalculateAutoFitWidth()
		{
			bool hasCellValues;
			return CalculateAutoFitWidth(out hasCellValues);
		}

		internal int CalculateAutoFitWidth(out bool hasCellValues)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = base.Worksheet;
			if (worksheet != null && worksheet.Workbook != null)
			{
				Workbook workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
				using TextMetricsProviderBase metricsProvider = Workbook.CreateDefaultTextMetricsProvider(workbook);
				CellSizeMeasurementContext measureContext = new CellSizeMeasurementContext(workbook, metricsProvider);
				return CalculateAutoFitWidth(0, worksheet.Rows.MaxCount, measureContext, out hasCellValues);
			}
			hasCellValues = false;
			return Width;
		}

		internal int CalculateAutoFitWidth(int startRowIndex, int endRowIndex, CellSizeMeasurementContext measureContext, out bool hasCellValues)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = base.Worksheet;
			hasCellValues = false;
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return Width;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			short indexInternal = IndexInternal;
			int columnWidthIn256ths = worksheet.GetColumnWidthIn256ths(indexInternal);
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor((double)base.Worksheet.ZeroCharacterWidth * 0.35);
			int num3 = (int)base.Worksheet.ConvertFromCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(columnWidthIn256ths, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Pixel);
			int num4 = num3 - worksheet.GetColumnWidthPadding() - num2;
			GetCellTextParameters getCellTextParameters = new GetCellTextParameters(indexInternal);
			getCellTextParameters.TextFormatMode = TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth;
			getCellTextParameters.PreventTextFormattingTypes = PreventTextFormattingTypes.None;
			_ = worksheet.Workbook;
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(startRowIndex, endRowIndex))
			{
				WorksheetCellBlock worksheetCellBlock = item.TryGetCellBlock(indexInternal);
				if (worksheetCellBlock == null || !worksheetCellBlock.DoesCellHaveValue(indexInternal))
				{
					continue;
				}
				WorksheetMergedCellsRegion cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal = item.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal(indexInternal);
				if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal != null && cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal.Width != 1)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text = item.GetCellTextInternal(worksheetCellBlock, getCellTextParameters).Text;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormatElementReadOnly = item.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(indexInternal);
					int num5 = (cellFormatElementReadOnly.ComputedLeftIndent + cellFormatElementReadOnly.ComputedRightIndent) * base.Worksheet.IndentWidth;
					int columnWidthInPixels = num4 - num5;
					int resolvedHeight = item.GetResolvedHeight(treatAllAsVisible: true);
					double num6 = measureContext.GetAutoFitWidth(cellFormatElementReadOnly, text, resolvedHeight, columnWidthInPixels) + (double)num5;
					if (num6 > num)
					{
						num = num6;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return Width;
			}
			hasCellValues = true;
			num += (double)(num3 - num4);
			if (num >= 91.0)
			{
				int num7 = (int)((num - 91.0) / 28.0 + 1.0);
				num = MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num + (double)num7);
			}
			return base.Worksheet.ConvertToCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(num, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Pixel);
		}

		}

			{
				return row.GetCellFormatInternal(columnIndex);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool GetFlag(InternalFlags flag)
		{
			return (_flags & flag) == flag;
		}

		}

		private void SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_flags &= (InternalFlags)(byte)(~(int)flag);
			}
		}

	internal class WorksheetColumnBlock
	{
		private WorksheetCellFormatData _cellFormat;

		private short _firstColumnIndex;

		private bool _hidden;

		private short _lastColumnIndex;

		private byte _outlineLevel;

		private int _width = -1;

		public WorksheetCellFormatData CellFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return _cellFormat;
			}
			set
			{
				_cellFormat = value;
			}
		}

		public int CountOfColumns => _lastColumnIndex + 1 - _firstColumnIndex;

		public short FirstColumnIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return _firstColumnIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				_firstColumnIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Hidden
		{
			get
			{
				return _hidden;
			}
			set
			{
				_hidden = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_hidden && _outlineLevel == 0 && _width == -1)
				{
					return _cellFormat.IsEmpty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public short LastColumnIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return _lastColumnIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				_lastColumnIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public byte OutlineLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return _outlineLevel;
			}
			set
			{
				_outlineLevel = value;
			}
		}

		public int Width
		{
			get
			{
				return _width;
			}
			set
			{
				_width = value;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetColumnBlock(short firstColumnIndex, short lastColumnIndex, WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat)
		{
			_firstColumnIndex = firstColumnIndex;
			_lastColumnIndex = lastColumnIndex;
			_cellFormat = cellFormat;
		}

		public WorksheetColumnBlock(short firstColumnIndex, short lastColumnIndex, WorksheetColumnBlock initializeFrom)
			: this(firstColumnIndex, lastColumnIndex, initializeFrom._cellFormat)
		{
			_hidden = initializeFrom._hidden;
			_outlineLevel = initializeFrom._outlineLevel;
			_width = initializeFrom._width;
			_cellFormat.IncrementReferenceCount();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_hidden == worksheetColumnBlock._hidden && _outlineLevel == worksheetColumnBlock._outlineLevel && _width == worksheetColumnBlock._width)
			{
				return _cellFormat.Equals(worksheetColumnBlock._cellFormat);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _hidden.GetHashCode() ^ _outlineLevel.GetHashCode() ^ _width.GetHashCode() ^ _cellFormat.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat("FirstColumn: {0}, LastColumn: {1}", _firstColumnIndex, _lastColumnIndex);
			if (_width >= 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat(", Width: {0}", _width);
			}
			if (_hidden)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(", Hidden");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal WorksheetColumnBlock Clone(Workbook workbook)
		{
			return Clone(workbook, FirstColumnIndex, LastColumnIndex);
		}

		internal WorksheetColumnBlock Clone(Workbook workbook, short firstColumn, short lastColumn)
		{
			WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = new WorksheetColumnBlock(firstColumn, lastColumn, CellFormat.CloneInternal(workbook));
			worksheetColumnBlock._hidden = _hidden;
			worksheetColumnBlock._outlineLevel = _outlineLevel;
			worksheetColumnBlock._width = _width;
			return worksheetColumnBlock;
		}

		internal bool ContainsColumn(short columnIndex)
		{
			if (columnIndex >= _firstColumnIndex)
			{
				return columnIndex <= _lastColumnIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public double GetWidth(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit units, bool treatAllAsVisible = false)
		{
			if (!treatAllAsVisible && Hidden)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return worksheet.ConvertFromCharacter256thsIntHorizontal((Width < 0) ? worksheet.DefaultColumnWidth : Width, units);
		}

		internal void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			if (!IsEmpty)
			{
				int num = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(testFormat) - 1;
				if (num < FirstColumnIndex)
				{
					limitErrors.AddError(string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_FormatLimitError_MaxColumnIndex"), Math.Max(FirstColumnIndex, num + 1), num));
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class WorksheetColumnCollection : RowColumnCollectionBase<WorksheetColumn>
	{
		private class InsertRemoveOperationWrapper : ICellShiftOperationOverride
		{
			private readonly WorksheetColumnCollection _collection;

			private readonly int _count;

			private readonly int _index;

			internal readonly WorksheetColumn[] _deletedColumns;

			internal readonly bool IsInsert;

			internal readonly bool IsUndo;

			public int Count => _count;

			public int Index => _index;

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.ShiftsColumns => true;

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.ShiftsRows => false;

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.IsRemoveOperation => !IsInsert;

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.IsUndoOperation => IsUndo;

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.PerformsShift => true;

			public Worksheet Worksheet => _collection.Worksheet;

			internal InsertRemoveOperationWrapper(WorksheetColumnCollection collection, int index, int count, bool isInsert, WorksheetColumn[] deletedColumns, bool isUndo)
			{
				_collection = collection;
				_count = count;
				_index = index;
				IsInsert = isInsert;
				IsUndo = isUndo;
				_deletedColumns = deletedColumns;
			}

			void ICellShiftOperationOverride.OnBeforeShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation)
			{
			}

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.PerformShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation)
			{
				WorksheetColumnCollection collection = _collection;
				if (IsInsert)
				{
					collection.InsertItems(Index, Count);
					Worksheet.OnColumnsInserted((short)Index, (short)Count);
				}
				else
				{
					collection.RemoveItems(Index, Count);
					Worksheet.OnColumnsRemoved((short)Index, (short)Count);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override int MaxCount => Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(base.Worksheet.CurrentFormat);

		public WorksheetColumn this[int index] => InternalIndexer(index);

		private InsertRemoveOperationWrapper CreateInsertRemoveOperation(int index, int count, bool isInsert)

			List<WorksheetColumn> list = new List<WorksheetColumn>(GetTreeItemsInRange(num2, num2 + count - 1));
