		internal void GetDistanceToLeftOfColumnsIn256ths(int leftColumnIndex, int rightColumnIndex, out int distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths, out int distanceToRightColumnIn256ths, bool treatAllAsVisible = false)
		{
			distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths = 0;
			distanceToRightColumnIn256ths = 0;
			int defaultColumnWidth = base.Worksheet.DefaultColumnWidth;
			foreach (WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock in base.Worksheet.ColumnBlocks)
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (treatAllAsVisible || !columnBlock.Hidden)
				{
					num = ((columnBlock.Width >= 0) ? columnBlock.Width : defaultColumnWidth);
				}
				int num2 = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(columnBlock.LastColumnIndex, leftColumnIndex - 1) - columnBlock.FirstColumnIndex + 1);
				int num3 = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(columnBlock.LastColumnIndex, rightColumnIndex - 1) - columnBlock.FirstColumnIndex + 1);
				if (num2 != 0 || num3 != 0)
				{
					distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths += num2 * num;
					distanceToRightColumnIn256ths += num3 * num;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void GetIndexesOfColumnsIn256ths(ref int distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths, ref int distanceToRightColumnIn256ths, out int leftColumnIndex, out int rightColumnIndex, bool treatAllAsVisible = false)
		{
			leftColumnIndex = 0;
			rightColumnIndex = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			int defaultColumnWidth = base.Worksheet.DefaultColumnWidth;
			foreach (WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock in base.Worksheet.ColumnBlocks)
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (treatAllAsVisible || !columnBlock.Hidden)
				{
					num = ((columnBlock.Width >= 0) ? columnBlock.Width : defaultColumnWidth);
				}
				int num2 = columnBlock.LastColumnIndex - columnBlock.FirstColumnIndex + 1;
				int num3 = num * num2;
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths < num3)
					{
						int num4 = distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths / num;
						leftColumnIndex += num4;
						distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths -= num4 * num;
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths -= num3;
						leftColumnIndex += num2;
					}
				}
				if (distanceToRightColumnIn256ths < num3)
				{
					int num5 = distanceToRightColumnIn256ths / num;
					rightColumnIndex += num5;
					distanceToRightColumnIn256ths -= num5 * num;
					return;
				}
				distanceToRightColumnIn256ths -= num3;
				rightColumnIndex += num2;
			}
			if (rightColumnIndex >= MaxCount)
			{
				rightColumnIndex = MaxCount - 1;
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(HiddenColumnCollection hiddenColumns)
		{
			HashSet<WorksheetColumn> hashSet = new HashSet<WorksheetColumn>();
			foreach (WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock in base.Worksheet.ColumnBlocks)
			{
				if (columnBlock.Hidden)
				{
					for (int i = columnBlock.FirstColumnIndex; i <= columnBlock.LastColumnIndex; i++)
					{
						hashSet.Add(this[i]);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (WorksheetColumn item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetColumn>)hiddenColumns)
			{
				hashSet.Remove(item);
				item.Hidden = true;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetColumn item2 in hashSet)
			{
				item2.Hidden = false;
			}
		}

		public void Insert(int index, int count = 1)
		{
			VerifyWorkbook();
			int num = MaxCount;
			if (index < 0)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (index + count > num)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Max columns exceeded");
			}
			InsertRemoveOperationWrapper operationWrapper = CreateInsertRemoveOperation(index, count, isInsert: true);
			PerformCellShift(index, count, isInsert: true, operationWrapper);
		}

		private InsertRemoveOperationWrapper PerformCellShift(int index, int count, bool isInsert, InsertRemoveOperationWrapper operationWrapper)
		{
			short firstColumnIndex = (isInsert ? ((short)index) : ((short)(index + count)));
			short lastColumnIndex = (isInsert ? ((short)(MaxCount - (1 + count))) : ((short)(MaxCount - 1)));
			int shiftAmount = (isInsert ? count : (-count));
			CellShiftOperation shiftOperation = new CellShiftOperation(base.Worksheet, CellShiftType.HorizontalShift, null, 0, Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(base.Worksheet.CurrentFormat) - 1, firstColumnIndex, lastColumnIndex, shiftAmount, rowInstancesShift: false);
			ProcessCellShiftResult(base.Worksheet.ShiftCells(shiftOperation, CellShiftInitializeFormatType.FromStationaryCellsAdjacentToInsertRegion, operationWrapper).Result);
			WorksheetColumn[] deletedColumns = operationWrapper._deletedColumns;
			foreach (WorksheetColumn worksheetColumn in deletedColumns)
			{
				worksheetColumn.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			}
			Workbook wb = base.Worksheet.Workbook;
			if (wb != null)
			{
				wb.IterateFormulas(delegate(Worksheet ws, Formula f)
				{
					f.ReconnectReferences(wb);
				});
			}
			base.Worksheet.RemoveDisconnectedVisitedHyperlinks();
			return operationWrapper;
		}

		public void Remove(int index, int count = 1)
		{
			VerifyWorkbook();
			int num = MaxCount;
			if (index < 0)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (index + count > num)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Max columns exceeded");
			}
			InsertRemoveOperationWrapper operationWrapper = CreateInsertRemoveOperation(index, count, isInsert: false);
			PerformCellShift(index, count, isInsert: false, operationWrapper);
		}

		private void VerifyWorkbook()
		{
			if (base.Worksheet.Workbook == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The worrksheet has been deleted");
			}
		}
	}
	public class WorksheetDataTable : IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue
	{
		private Worksheet worksheet;

		private WorksheetRegionAddress cellsInTableAddress;

		private bool columnInputCellIsValid;

		private int columnInputCellRowIndex;

		private short columnInputCellColumnIndex;

		private bool rowInputCellIsValid;

		private int rowInputCellRowIndex;

		private short rowInputCellColumnIndex;

		private Formula interiorCellFormula;

		WorksheetRegion IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue.BlockedRegion => InteriorCells;

		public WorksheetRegion CellsInTable
		{
			get
			{
				if (worksheet == null || !cellsInTableAddress.IsValid)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return worksheet.GetCachedRegion(cellsInTableAddress);
			}
			set
			{
				WorksheetRegion cellsInTable = CellsInTable;
				if (!object.Equals(cellsInTable, value))
				{
					VerifyTableElements(worksheet, value, "value", ColumnInputCell, null, RowInputCell, null);
					SetCellsInTableInternal(value);
				}
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetRegionAddress CellsInTableAddress => cellsInTableAddress;

		public WorksheetCell ColumnInputCell
		{
			get
			{
				if (worksheet == null || columnInputCellRowIndex == -1)
				{
					if (columnInputCellIsValid)
					{
						return WorksheetCell.InvalidReference;
					}
					return null;
				}
				return worksheet.Rows[columnInputCellRowIndex].Cells[columnInputCellColumnIndex];
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColumnInputCell != value)
				{
					VerifyTableElements(worksheet, CellsInTable, null, value, "value", RowInputCell, null);
					SetColumnInputCell(value);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool HasColumnInputCell => columnInputCellIsValid;

		internal bool HasRowInputCell => rowInputCellIsValid;

		internal Formula InteriorCellFormula => interiorCellFormula;

		internal WorksheetRegion InteriorCells
		{
			get
			{
				if (worksheet == null || !cellsInTableAddress.IsValid)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return worksheet.GetCachedRegion(cellsInTableAddress.FirstRowIndex + 1, cellsInTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex + 1, cellsInTableAddress.LastRowIndex, cellsInTableAddress.LastColumnIndex);
			}
		}

		public WorksheetCell RowInputCell
		{
			get
			{
				if (worksheet == null || rowInputCellRowIndex == -1)
				{
					if (rowInputCellIsValid)
					{
						return WorksheetCell.InvalidReference;
					}
					return null;
				}
				return worksheet.Rows[rowInputCellRowIndex].Cells[rowInputCellColumnIndex];
			}
			set
			{
				if (RowInputCell != value)
				{
					VerifyTableElements(worksheet, CellsInTable, null, ColumnInputCell, null, value, "value");
					SetRowInputCell(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public Worksheet Worksheet => worksheet;

		internal WorksheetDataTable(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRegion cellsInTable, WorksheetCell columnInputCell, WorksheetCell rowInputCell)
		{
			Initialize(worksheet, cellsInTable, columnInputCell, rowInputCell);
		}

		void IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue.RemoveFromRegion()
		{
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				worksheet.DataTables.Remove(this);
			}
		}

		void IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue.ThrowBlockingException()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantChangeDataTable"));
		}

		void IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue.ThrowExceptionWhenMergedCellsInRegion()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_DataTableInMergedCell"));
		}

		void IWorksheetRegionBlockingValue.ThrowExceptionWhenTableInRegion()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_DataTableAppliedInTable"));
		}

		internal RefBase GetColumnInputCellReference()
		{
			if (worksheet == null || columnInputCellRowIndex == -1)
			{
				return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
			}
			return worksheet.Rows[columnInputCellRowIndex].GetCellCalcReference(columnInputCellColumnIndex);
		}

		internal string GetDisplayFormula()
		{
			CultureInfo culture = Utilities.CurrentCulture;
			CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode = CellReferenceMode.A1;
			if (Worksheet != null)
			{
				cellReferenceMode = Worksheet.CellReferenceMode;
				culture = Worksheet.Culture;
			}
			char unionOperatorResolved = FormulaParser.GetUnionOperatorResolved(culture);
			string arg = null;
			WorksheetCell rowInputCell = RowInputCell;
			if (rowInputCell != null)
			{
				arg = rowInputCell.ToString(cellReferenceMode, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: true, useRelativeRow: true);
			}
			string arg2 = null;
			WorksheetCell columnInputCell = ColumnInputCell;
			if (columnInputCell != null)
			{
				arg2 = columnInputCell.ToString(cellReferenceMode, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: true, useRelativeRow: true);
			}
			return $"TABLE({arg}{unionOperatorResolved}{arg2})";
		}

		internal RefBase GetRowInputCellReference()
		{
			if (worksheet == null || rowInputCellRowIndex == -1)
			{
				return ExcelReferenceError.Instance;
			}
			return worksheet.Rows[rowInputCellRowIndex].GetCellCalcReference(rowInputCellColumnIndex);
		}

		internal bool IsInExteriorArea(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, out bool isCellInTable)
		{
			WorksheetRegion cellsInTable = CellsInTable;
			if (cellsInTable == null)
			{
				isCellInTable = false;
				return false;
			}
			isCellInTable = cellsInTable.Contains(row, columnIndex);
			if (!isCellInTable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = row.Index == cellsInTable.FirstRow;
			bool flag2 = columnIndex == cellsInTable.FirstColumnInternal;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					if (columnInputCellIsValid)
					{
						return rowInputCellIsValid;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool OnCellsShifted(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (columnInputCellRowIndex >= 0)
			{
				ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult = shiftOperation.ShiftCellAddress(ref columnInputCellRowIndex, ref columnInputCellColumnIndex);
				flag |= shiftAddressResult.DidShift;
				if (shiftAddressResult.IsDeleted)
				{
					columnInputCellRowIndex = -1;
					columnInputCellColumnIndex = -1;
				}
			}
			if (rowInputCellRowIndex >= 0)
			{
				ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult = shiftOperation.ShiftCellAddress(ref rowInputCellRowIndex, ref rowInputCellColumnIndex);
				flag |= shiftAddressResult.DidShift;
				if (shiftAddressResult.IsDeleted)
				{
					rowInputCellRowIndex = -1;
					rowInputCellColumnIndex = -1;
				}
			}
			if (cellsInTableAddress.IsValid)
			{
				ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult = shiftOperation.ShiftRegionAddress(ref cellsInTableAddress, operationOverride, leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet: false);
				flag |= shiftAddressResult.DidShift;
				SetCellsInTableInternal(worksheet.GetCachedRegion(cellsInTableAddress));
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal bool OnCellsShifting(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, WorksheetRegionAddress? deletedRegionAddress)
		{
			if (deletedRegionAddress.HasValue && cellsInTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex >= deletedRegionAddress.Value.FirstColumnIndex && cellsInTableAddress.FirstRowIndex >= deletedRegionAddress.Value.FirstRowIndex && cellsInTableAddress.LastColumnIndex <= deletedRegionAddress.Value.LastColumnIndex && cellsInTableAddress.LastRowIndex <= deletedRegionAddress.Value.LastRowIndex)
			{
				Worksheet.DataTables.Remove(this);
				return true;
			}
			if (cellsInTableAddress.IsValid && shiftOperation.RegionAddressBeforeShift.Contains(cellsInTableAddress))
			{
				WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = cellsInTableAddress;
				SetCellsInTableInternal(null);
				cellsInTableAddress = worksheetRegionAddress;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnReAddedToCollection(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRegionAddress cellsInTableAddress, WorksheetCellAddress? columnInputCellAddress, WorksheetCellAddress? rowInputCellAddress)
		{
			WorksheetRegion cellsInTable = new WorksheetRegion(worksheet, cellsInTableAddress.FirstRowIndex, cellsInTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex, cellsInTableAddress.LastRowIndex, cellsInTableAddress.LastColumnIndex);
			WorksheetCell columnInputCell = null;
			if (columnInputCellAddress.HasValue)
			{
				columnInputCell = new WorksheetCell(worksheet.Rows[columnInputCellAddress.Value.RowIndex], columnInputCellAddress.Value.ColumnIndex);
			}
			WorksheetCell rowInputCell = null;
			if (rowInputCellAddress.HasValue)
			{
				rowInputCell = new WorksheetCell(worksheet.Rows[rowInputCellAddress.Value.RowIndex], rowInputCellAddress.Value.ColumnIndex);
			}
			Initialize(worksheet, cellsInTable, columnInputCell, rowInputCell);
		}

		internal void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			SetCellsInTableInternal(null);
			SetColumnInputCell(null);
			SetRowInputCell(null);
			worksheet = null;
		}

		internal static void VerifyTableElements(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRegion cellsInTable, string cellsInTableParam, WorksheetCell columnInputCell, string columnInputCellParam, WorksheetCell rowInputCell, string rowInputCellParam)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_DataTableRemoved"));
			}
			if (cellsInTable == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(cellsInTableParam);
			}
			if (cellsInTable.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionShiftedOffWorksheet"), cellsInTableParam);
			}
			if (cellsInTable.Worksheet != worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellsInTableFromOtherWorksheet"), cellsInTableParam);
			}
			if (columnInputCell != null)
			{
				if (columnInputCell.Worksheet == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"), columnInputCellParam);
				}
				if (columnInputCell.Worksheet != worksheet)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_ColumnInputCellFromOtherWorksheet"), columnInputCellParam);
				}
			}
			if (rowInputCell != null)
			{
				if (rowInputCell.Worksheet == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"), rowInputCellParam);
				}
				if (rowInputCell.Worksheet != worksheet)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RowInputCellFromOtherWorksheet"), rowInputCellParam);
				}
			}
			if (columnInputCell == null && rowInputCell == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InputCellsBothNull"));
			}
			if (columnInputCell == rowInputCell)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InputCellsSame"));
			}
			VerifyCellOutsideRange(cellsInTable, columnInputCell);
			VerifyCellOutsideRange(cellsInTable, rowInputCell);
		}

		private void Initialize(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRegion cellsInTable, WorksheetCell columnInputCell, WorksheetCell rowInputCell)
		{
			cellsInTableAddress = WorksheetRegionAddress.InvalidReference;
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
			SetColumnInputCell(columnInputCell);
			SetRowInputCell(rowInputCell);
			CellsInTable = cellsInTable;
		}

		private void SetCellsInTableInternal(WorksheetRegion value)
		{
			WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = null;
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (value.FirstRow == value.LastRow || value.FirstColumn == value.LastColumn)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CellsInTableMinSize"), "value");
				}
				short firstColumnInternal = value.FirstColumnInternal;
				for (int i = value.FirstRow + 1; i <= value.LastRow; i++)
				{
					WorksheetMergedCellsRegion cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion = this.worksheet.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion(i, firstColumnInternal);
					if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion != null && (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion.FirstColumn < firstColumnInternal || firstColumnInternal < cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion.LastColumn || cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion.FirstRow < value.FirstRow || value.LastRow < cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion.LastRow))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_MergedCellCrossesDataTableLeftColumn"));
					}
				}
				Worksheet worksheet = value.Worksheet;
				if (worksheet == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (short num = (short)(value.FirstColumnInternal + 1); num <= value.LastColumnInternal; num++)
				{
					WorksheetMergedCellsRegion cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion2 = worksheet.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion(value.FirstRow, num);
					if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion2 != null && (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion2.FirstRow < value.FirstRow || value.FirstRow < cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion2.LastRow || cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion2.FirstColumn < value.FirstColumn || value.LastColumn < cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion2.LastColumn))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_MergedCellCrossesDataTableTopRow"));
					}
				}
				WorksheetMergedCellsRegion cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion3 = worksheet.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion(value.FirstRow, value.FirstColumnInternal);
				if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion3 != null)
				{
					if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion3.FirstRow == cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion3.LastRow)
					{
						if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion3.FirstColumn < value.FirstColumn || value.LastColumn < cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion3.LastColumn)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_MergedCellCrossesDataTableTopRow"));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion3.FirstColumn != cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion3.LastColumn)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_MergedCellCrossesDataTableTopLeftCell"));
						}
						if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion3.FirstRow < value.FirstRow || value.LastRow < cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion3.LastRow)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_MergedCellCrossesDataTableLeftColumn"));
						}
					}
				}
				worksheetRegion = this.worksheet.GetCachedRegion(value.FirstRow + 1, value.FirstColumn + 1, value.LastRow, value.LastColumn);
				WorksheetCellBlock.VerifyRegionForBlockingValue(this, value, worksheetRegion);
			}
			SetCellsInTableHelper(cellsInTableAddress, isBeingApplied: false);
			WorksheetCellBlock.ClearBlockingValue(this);
			if (value == null)
			{
				cellsInTableAddress = WorksheetRegionAddress.InvalidReference;
			}
			else
			{
				cellsInTableAddress = value.Address;
			}
			UpdateInteriorCellFormula();
			SetCellsInTableHelper(cellsInTableAddress, isBeingApplied: true);
			WorksheetCellBlock.ApplyBlockingValue(this);
		}

		private void SetCellsInTableHelper(WorksheetRegionAddress cellsInTableRegion, bool isBeingApplied)
		{
			if (!cellsInTableRegion.IsValid || Worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Workbook workbook = Worksheet.Workbook;
			WorksheetRowCollection rows = Worksheet.Rows;
			int firstRowIndex = cellsInTableRegion.FirstRowIndex;
			short firstColumnIndex = cellsInTableRegion.FirstColumnIndex;
			for (int i = firstRowIndex; i <= cellsInTableRegion.LastRowIndex; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = rows[i];
				for (short num = firstColumnIndex; num <= cellsInTableRegion.LastColumnIndex; num++)
				{
					worksheetRow.SetCellIsSpecial(num, isBeingApplied);
					if (i != firstRowIndex && num != firstColumnIndex)
					{
						CellCalcReference cellCalcReference = worksheetRow.GetCellCalcReference(num);
						AppliedFormula appliedFormulaInternal = null;
						if (isBeingApplied && workbook != null)
						{
							appliedFormulaInternal = new AppliedFormula(this, cellCalcReference, workbook);
						}
						cellCalcReference.SetAppliedFormulaInternal(appliedFormulaInternal);
					}
				}
			}
			workbook?.OnDataTableModified(this);
		}

		private void UpdateInteriorCellFormula()
		{
			if (interiorCellFormula != null)
			{
				interiorCellFormula.SetOwningCell(null, -1);
				interiorCellFormula = null;
			}
			WorksheetRegion interiorCells = InteriorCells;
			if (interiorCells != null)
			{
				interiorCellFormula = new Formula(this);
				interiorCellFormula.SetOwningCell(interiorCells.TopRow, interiorCells.FirstColumnInternal);
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyCellOutsideRange(WorksheetRegion range, WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			if (!(cell == null))
			{
				int columnIndex = cell.ColumnIndex;
				int rowIndex = cell.RowIndex;
				if (range.FirstColumn <= columnIndex && columnIndex <= range.LastColumn && range.FirstRow <= rowIndex && rowIndex <= range.LastRow)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_InputCellsInTable"));
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetColumnInputCell(WorksheetCell value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				columnInputCellIsValid = false;
				columnInputCellRowIndex = -1;
				columnInputCellColumnIndex = -1;
			}
			else
			{
				columnInputCellIsValid = true;
				columnInputCellRowIndex = value.RowIndex;
				columnInputCellColumnIndex = value.ColumnIndexInternal;
			}
		}

		private void SetRowInputCell(WorksheetCell value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				rowInputCellIsValid = false;
				rowInputCellRowIndex = -1;
				rowInputCellColumnIndex = -1;
			}
			else
			{
				rowInputCellIsValid = true;
				rowInputCellRowIndex = value.RowIndex;
				rowInputCellColumnIndex = value.ColumnIndexInternal;
			}
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Count = {Count}")]
	public sealed class WorksheetDataTableCollection : ICollection<WorksheetDataTable>, IEnumerable<WorksheetDataTable>, IEnumerable
	{
		private List<WorksheetDataTable> dataTables;

		private Worksheet worksheet;

		int ICollection<WorksheetDataTable>.Count => Count;

		bool ICollection<WorksheetDataTable>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => dataTables.Count;

		public WorksheetDataTable this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
				{
					throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
				}
				return dataTables[index];
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetDataTableCollection(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
			dataTables = new List<WorksheetDataTable>();
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetDataTable>.Add(WorksheetDataTable item)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantAddDataTable"));
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetDataTable>.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool ICollection<WorksheetDataTable>.Contains(WorksheetDataTable item)
		{
			return dataTables.Contains(item);
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetDataTable>.CopyTo(WorksheetDataTable[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			dataTables.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<WorksheetDataTable>.Remove(WorksheetDataTable item)
		{
			return Remove(item);
		}

		IEnumerator<WorksheetDataTable> IEnumerable<WorksheetDataTable>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return dataTables.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<WorksheetDataTable>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public WorksheetDataTable Add(WorksheetRegion cellsInTable, WorksheetCell columnInputCell, WorksheetCell rowInputCell)
		{
			WorksheetDataTable.VerifyTableElements(worksheet, cellsInTable, "cellsInTable", columnInputCell, "columnInputCell", rowInputCell, "rowInputCell");
			WorksheetDataTable dataTable = null;
			InsertInternal(-1, delegate
			{
				dataTable = new WorksheetDataTable(worksheet, cellsInTable, columnInputCell, rowInputCell);
				return dataTable;
			});
			return dataTable;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (dataTables.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int num = dataTables.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetDataTable dataTable)
		{
			int num = dataTables.IndexOf(dataTable);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			WorksheetDataTable worksheetDataTable = dataTables[index];
			dataTables.RemoveAt(index);
			worksheetDataTable.OnRemovedFromCollection();
		}

		private void InsertInternal(int index, Func<WorksheetDataTable> dataTableFunc)
		{
			WorksheetDataTable item = dataTableFunc();
			if (index < 0)
			{
				index = dataTables.Count;
			}
			dataTables.Insert(index, item);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class WorksheetElementResizeContext
	{
		private class MultiElementVisibilityChange : WorksheetElementResizeContext
		{
			private readonly List<IndexRange> _changedRanges;

			private readonly int _firstIndex;

			private readonly int _lastIndex;

			public override List<IndexRange> ChangedRanges => _changedRanges;

			public override int FirstIndex => _firstIndex;

			public override int LastIndex => _lastIndex;

			public MultiElementVisibilityChange(Worksheet worksheet, bool isVertical, int firstIndex, int lastIndex, List<IndexRange> changedRanges)
			{
				Initialize(worksheet, isVertical);
				_changedRanges = changedRanges;
				_firstIndex = firstIndex;
				_lastIndex = lastIndex;
			}

			public override bool GetOriginalHiddenState(int index)
			{
				bool currentHiddenState = GetCurrentHiddenState(index);
				for (int i = 0; i < _changedRanges.Count; i++)
				{
					IndexRange indexRange = _changedRanges[i];
					if (indexRange.FirstIndex <= index && index <= indexRange.LastIndex)
					{
						return !currentHiddenState;
					}
				}
				return currentHiddenState;
			}

			public override int GetOriginalNativeExtent(int index, bool treatAllAsVisible = false)
			{
				if (!treatAllAsVisible && GetOriginalHiddenState(index))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return GetCurrentNativeExtent(index, treatAllAsVisible: true);
			}

			public override int GetOriginalNativeExtent(int firstIndex, int lastIndex)
			{
				int num = GetCurrentNativeExtent(firstIndex, lastIndex);
				for (int i = 0; i < _changedRanges.Count; i++)
				{
					IndexRange indexRange = _changedRanges[i];
					if (indexRange.LastIndex >= firstIndex)
					{
						if (lastIndex < indexRange.FirstIndex)
						{
							break;
						}
						int currentNativeExtent = GetCurrentNativeExtent(Math.Max(indexRange.FirstIndex, firstIndex), Math.Min(indexRange.LastIndex, lastIndex), treatAllAsVisible: true);
						num = ((!GetCurrentHiddenState(indexRange.FirstIndex)) ? (num - currentNativeExtent) : (num + currentNativeExtent));
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private class SingleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange : WorksheetElementResizeContext
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			internal static SingleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange _reusableContext;

			private int _index;

			private bool _originalHidden;

			private int _originalExtentTreatedAsVisible;

			public override List<IndexRange> ChangedRanges
			{
				get
				{
					List<IndexRange> list = new List<IndexRange>();
					list.Add(new IndexRange(_index, _index));
					return list;
				}
			}

			public override int FirstIndex => _index;

			public override int LastIndex => _index;

			public override void Close()
			{
				if (_originalHidden != GetCurrentHiddenState(_index) || _originalExtentTreatedAsVisible != GetCurrentNativeExtent(_index, treatAllAsVisible: true))
				{
					base.Close();
				}
				if (_reusableContext == null)
				{
					_reusableContext = this;
				}
				base.Worksheet = null;
			}

			public void Initialize(RowColumnBase element)
			{
				Initialize(element.Worksheet, element is WorksheetRow);
				_index = element.Index;
				_originalHidden = element.Hidden;
				_originalExtentTreatedAsVisible = GetCurrentNativeExtent(_index, treatAllAsVisible: true);
			}

			public override bool GetOriginalHiddenState(int index)
			{
				if (_index == index)
				{
					return _originalHidden;
				}
				return GetCurrentHiddenState(index);
			}

			public override int GetOriginalNativeExtent(int index, bool treatAllAsVisible = false)
			{
				if (_index == index)
				{
					if (!treatAllAsVisible && _originalHidden)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return _originalExtentTreatedAsVisible;
				}
				return GetCurrentNativeExtent(index, treatAllAsVisible);
			}

			public override int GetOriginalNativeExtent(int firstIndex, int lastIndex)
			{
				if (firstIndex == _index && lastIndex == _index)
				{
					return GetOriginalNativeExtent(_index);
				}
				int currentNativeExtent = GetCurrentNativeExtent(firstIndex, lastIndex);
				int num = GetCurrentNativeExtent(_index) - GetOriginalNativeExtent(_index);
				return currentNativeExtent - num;
			}
		}

		public abstract List<IndexRange> ChangedRanges { get; }

		public abstract int FirstIndex { get; }

		public bool IsVertical { get; private set; }

		public abstract int LastIndex { get; }

		public Worksheet Worksheet { get; protected set; }

		public static WorksheetElementResizeContext Create(RowColumnBase element)
		{
			SingleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange singleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange;
			if (SingleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange._reusableContext == null)
			{
				singleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange = new SingleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange();
			}
			else
			{
				singleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange = SingleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange._reusableContext;
				SingleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange._reusableContext = null;
			}
			singleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange.Initialize(element);
			singleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange.OnBeforeResize();
			return singleElementResizeOrVisibilityChange;
		}

		public static WorksheetElementResizeContext CreateForMultiColumnsVisibilityChange(Worksheet worksheet, int firstIndex, int lastIndex, bool newHiddenState, List<IndexRange> changedRanges = null)
		{
			changedRanges = changedRanges ?? GetChangeRangesForMultiColumnsVisibilityChange(worksheet, firstIndex, lastIndex, newHiddenState);
			MultiElementVisibilityChange multiElementVisibilityChange = new MultiElementVisibilityChange(worksheet, isVertical: false, firstIndex, lastIndex, changedRanges);
			multiElementVisibilityChange.OnBeforeResize();
			return multiElementVisibilityChange;
		}

		public static WorksheetElementResizeContext CreateForMultiRowsVisibilityChange(Worksheet worksheet, int firstIndex, int lastIndex, bool? newHiddenState, bool wasDefaultHiddenStateChanged, List<IndexRange> changedRanges = null)
		{
			changedRanges = changedRanges ?? GetChangeRangesForMultiRowsVisibilityChange(worksheet, firstIndex, lastIndex, newHiddenState, wasDefaultHiddenStateChanged);
			MultiElementVisibilityChange multiElementVisibilityChange = new MultiElementVisibilityChange(worksheet, isVertical: true, firstIndex, lastIndex, changedRanges);
			multiElementVisibilityChange.OnBeforeResize();
			return multiElementVisibilityChange;
		}

		public static List<IndexRange> GetChangeRangesForMultiColumnsVisibilityChange(Worksheet worksheet, int firstIndex, int lastIndex, bool newHiddenState)
		{
			List<IndexRange> list = new List<IndexRange>();
			foreach (WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock in worksheet.ColumnBlocks)
			{
				if (columnBlock.LastColumnIndex >= firstIndex)
				{
					if (lastIndex < columnBlock.FirstColumnIndex)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (columnBlock.Hidden != newHiddenState)
					{
						list.Add(new IndexRange(Math.Max(columnBlock.FirstColumnIndex, firstIndex), Math.Min(columnBlock.LastColumnIndex, lastIndex)));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static List<IndexRange> GetChangeRangesForMultiRowsVisibilityChange(Worksheet worksheet, int firstIndex, int lastIndex, bool? newHiddenState, bool wasDefaultHiddenStateChanged)
		{
			List<IndexRange> list = new List<IndexRange>();
			if (wasDefaultHiddenStateChanged || (newHiddenState.HasValue && newHiddenState != worksheet.DefaultRowHidden))
			{
				int num = firstIndex;
				foreach (WorksheetRow item in worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(firstIndex, lastIndex))
				{
					if (!newHiddenState.HasValue || item.Hidden == newHiddenState)
					{
						if (item.Index != num)
						{
							list.Add(new IndexRange(num, item.Index - 1));
						}
						num = item.Index + 1;
					}
				}
				if (num != lastIndex + 1)
				{
					list.Add(new IndexRange(num, lastIndex));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int? num2 = null;
				int lastIndex2 = 0;
				foreach (WorksheetRow item2 in worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(firstIndex, lastIndex))
				{
					if (newHiddenState.HasValue && item2.Hidden != newHiddenState)
					{
						if (!num2.HasValue)
						{
							num2 = item2.Index;
						}
						else if (num2 != item2.Index + 1)
						{
							list.Add(new IndexRange(num2.Value, lastIndex2));
							num2 = item2.Index;
						}
						lastIndex2 = item2.Index;
					}
				}
				if (num2.HasValue)
				{
					list.Add(new IndexRange(num2.Value, lastIndex2));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected void Initialize(Worksheet worksheet, bool isVertical)
		{
			Worksheet = worksheet;
			IsVertical = isVertical;
		}

		public virtual void Close()
		{
			OnAfterResize();
			Worksheet = null;
		}

		public int ConvertNativeExtentToTwips(int extent)
		{
			if (extent == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				return extent;
			}
			return (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(Worksheet.ConvertFromCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(extent, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Twip, snapToPixels: false));
		}

		public bool GetCurrentHiddenState(int index)
		{
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				return Worksheet.IsRowHidden(index);
			}
			return Worksheet.IsColumnHidden((short)index);
		}

		public int GetCurrentNativeExtent(int index, bool treatAllAsVisible = false)
		{
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				return Worksheet.GetRowHeightInTwips(index, treatAllAsVisible);
			}
			return Worksheet.GetColumnWidthIn256ths(index, treatAllAsVisible);
		}

		public int GetCurrentNativeExtent(int firstIndex, int lastIndex, bool treatAllAsVisible = false)
		{
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				Worksheet.Rows.GetDistanceToTopOfRows(firstIndex, lastIndex + 1, out var distanceToTopRow, out var distanceToBottomRow, treatAllAsVisible);
				return (int)(distanceToBottomRow - distanceToTopRow);
			}
			Worksheet.Columns.GetDistanceToLeftOfColumnsIn256ths(firstIndex, lastIndex + 1, out var distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths, out var distanceToRightColumnIn256ths, treatAllAsVisible);
			return distanceToRightColumnIn256ths - distanceToLeftColumnIn256ths;
		}

		public abstract bool GetOriginalHiddenState(int index);

		public abstract int GetOriginalNativeExtent(int index, bool treatAllAsVisible = false);

		public abstract int GetOriginalNativeExtent(int firstIndex, int lastIndex);

		internal void OnAfterResize()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Worksheet.Shapes.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetShape worksheetShape = Worksheet.Shapes[i];
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					if (worksheetShape.BottomRightCornerCell.RowIndex < FirstIndex)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				else if (worksheetShape.BottomRightCornerCell.ColumnIndex < FirstIndex)
				{
					continue;
				}
				worksheetShape.OnAfterWorksheetElementResize(this);
			}
			foreach (WorksheetCellComment value in Worksheet.CellOwnedComments.Values)
			{
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					if (value.BottomRightCornerCell.RowIndex < FirstIndex)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				else if (value.BottomRightCornerCell.ColumnIndex < FirstIndex)
				{
					continue;
				}
				value.OnAfterWorksheetElementResize(this);
			}
		}

		internal void OnBeforeResize()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Worksheet.Shapes.Count; i++)
			{
				WorksheetShape worksheetShape = Worksheet.Shapes[i];
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					if (worksheetShape.BottomRightCornerCell.RowIndex < FirstIndex)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				else if (worksheetShape.BottomRightCornerCell.ColumnIndex < FirstIndex)
				{
					continue;
				}
				worksheetShape.OnBeforeWorksheetElementResize();
			}
			foreach (WorksheetCellComment value in Worksheet.CellOwnedComments.Values)
			{
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					if (value.BottomRightCornerCell.RowIndex < FirstIndex)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				else if (value.BottomRightCornerCell.ColumnIndex < FirstIndex)
				{
					continue;
				}
				value.OnBeforeWorksheetElementResize();
			}
		}
	}
	internal struct IndexRange
	{
		public readonly int FirstIndex;

		public readonly int LastIndex;

		public IndexRange(int firstIndex, int lastIndex)
		{
			FirstIndex = firstIndex;
			LastIndex = lastIndex;
		}
	}
	public sealed class WorksheetHyperlink
	{
		private const int MaxDisplayTextLength = 2084;

		private const int MaxTargetAddressLength = 256;

		private const int MaxToolTipLength = 256;

		private string _displayText;

		private bool _isSourceSpecifiedAsString;

		private readonly bool _isSealed;

		private string _sourceAddress;

		private WorksheetCell _sourceCell;

		private WorksheetRegion _sourceRegion;

		private object _target;

		private string _toolTip;

		private Worksheet _worksheet;

		public string DisplayText
		{
			get
			{
				return _displayText;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyIsMutable();
				if (!(DisplayText == value))
				{
					VerifyDisplayText(value, "value");
					SetDisplayTextCore(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsSealed => _isSealed;

		public string SourceAddress
		{
			get
			{
				if (_worksheet != null)
				{
					UpdateSourceCellFromRegion();
					if (_sourceCell != null)
					{
						_sourceAddress = GetSourceAddress(_sourceCell);
					}
					else if (_sourceRegion != null)
					{
						_sourceAddress = GetSourceAddress(_sourceRegion);
					}
				}
				return _sourceAddress;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyIsMutable();
				if (!_isSourceSpecifiedAsString || !(SourceAddress == value))
				{
					SetSourceAddressCore(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public WorksheetCell SourceCell
		{
			get
			{
				if (_worksheet != null)
				{
					UpdateSourceCellFromRegion();
				}
				return _sourceCell;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyIsMutable();
				if (_isSourceSpecifiedAsString || !(_sourceCell == value))
				{
					Utilities.VerifyNotNull((object)value, "value");
					if (_worksheet != null && value.Worksheet != _worksheet)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_SourceFromOtherWorksheetThanHyperlink"), "value");
					}
					SetSourceCellCore(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public WorksheetRegion SourceRegion
		{
			get
			{
				return _sourceRegion;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyIsMutable();
				if (_isSourceSpecifiedAsString || _sourceRegion != value)
				{
					Utilities.VerifyNotNull((object)value, "value");
					if (_worksheet != null && value.Worksheet != _worksheet)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_SourceFromOtherWorksheetThanHyperlink"), "value");
					}
					SetSourceRegionCore(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public object Target
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsInvalidTargetLocation && _worksheet != null && _worksheet.Workbook != null)
				{
					object obj = WorkbookLoadManager.CombineHyperlinkTargetAndLocation(_worksheet.Workbook, null, _target as string);
					if (obj != _target)
					{
						Target = obj;
					}
				}
				return _target;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyIsMutable();
				if (_target != value)
				{
					VerifyTarget(value, "value");
					IsInvalidTargetLocation = false;
					_target = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public string TargetAddress
		{
			get
			{
				if (Target is string result)
				{
					return result;
				}
				WorksheetCell worksheetCell = Target as WorksheetCell;
				if (worksheetCell != null)
				{
					return worksheetCell.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: true, useRelativeColumn: true, useRelativeRow: true);
				}
				if (Target is WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion)
				{
					return worksheetRegion.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: true, useRelativeColumn: true, useRelativeRow: true);
				}
				if (Target is NamedReference namedReference)
				{
					return namedReference.ToString();
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				Target = value;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetCell TargetCell
		{
			get
			{
				return Target as WorksheetCell;
			}
			set
			{
				Target = value;
			}
		}

		public NamedReference TargetNamedReference
		{
			get
			{
				return Target as NamedReference;
			}
			set
			{
				Target = value;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetRegion TargetRegion
		{
			get
			{
				return Target as WorksheetRegion;
			}
			set
			{
				Target = value;
			}
		}

		public string ToolTip
		{
			get
			{
				return _toolTip;
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyIsMutable();
				VerifyToolTipText(value, "value");
				_toolTip = value;
			}
		}

		public Worksheet Worksheet => _worksheet;

		internal bool IsInvalidTargetLocation { get; set; }

		private bool IsVisited { get; set; }

		private CellReferenceMode CellReferenceMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (_worksheet != null)
				{
					return _worksheet.CellReferenceMode;
				}
				return CellReferenceMode.A1;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetHyperlink(string sourceAddress, object target, string displayText = null, string toolTip = null)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyNotNull((object)sourceAddress, "sourceAddress");
			VerifyTarget(target, "target");
			VerifyDisplayText(displayText, "displayText");
			VerifyToolTipText(toolTip, "toolTip");
			_displayText = displayText;
			_target = target;
			_toolTip = toolTip;
			SetSourceAddressCore(sourceAddress);
		}

		public WorksheetHyperlink(WorksheetCell sourceCell, object target, string displayText = null, string toolTip = null)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyNotNull((object)sourceCell, "sourceCell");
			_displayText = displayText;
			_target = target;
			_toolTip = toolTip;
			SetSourceCellCore(sourceCell);
			VerifyTarget(target, "target");
		}

		public WorksheetHyperlink(WorksheetRegion sourceRegion, object target, string displayText = null, string toolTip = null)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyNotNull((object)sourceRegion, "sourceRegion");
			_displayText = displayText;
			_target = target;
			_toolTip = toolTip;
			SetSourceRegionCore(sourceRegion);
			VerifyTarget(target, "target");
		}

		internal WorksheetHyperlink(WorksheetCell sourceCell, string target, string displayText, bool isSealed)
		{
			_displayText = displayText;
			_isSealed = isSealed;
			_target = target;
			SetSourceCellCore(sourceCell);
			if (isSealed && sourceCell != null)
			{
				_worksheet = sourceCell.Worksheet;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (DisplayText != null)
			{
				return $"Hyperlink: {DisplayText} [{TargetAddress}]";
			}
			return $"Hyperlink: {TargetAddress}";
		}

		private void ApplyToSourceRegion(bool applyCellValue = true, bool applyFormat = true)
		{
			if (_worksheet == null || _worksheet.IsLoading)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (applyCellValue)
			{
				WorksheetRow topRow = _sourceRegion.TopRow;
				short firstColumnInternal = _sourceRegion.FirstColumnInternal;
				object cellValueRaw = topRow.GetCellValueRaw(firstColumnInternal);
				if (Utilities.IsNullResolved(cellValueRaw) || (DisplayText != null && WorksheetCellBlock.IsStringValue(cellValueRaw)))
				{
					topRow.SetCellValue(firstColumnInternal, DisplayText ?? TargetAddress);
				}
			}
			if (applyFormat)
			{
				ApplyHyperlinkStyleToRegion(_sourceRegion);
			}
		}

		internal static void ApplyHyperlinkStyleToRegion(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = region.Worksheet;
			if (worksheet.Workbook == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorkbookStyleCollection styles = worksheet.Workbook.Styles;
			WorkbookStyle workbookStyle = styles.GetBuiltInStyle(BuiltInStyleType.Hyperlink);
			if (workbookStyle == null)
			{
				workbookStyle = styles.Add(WorkbookStyleCollection.PresetCellStyles.First((WorkbookBuiltInStyle s) => s.Type == BuiltInStyleType.Hyperlink).Clone(worksheet.Workbook));
			}
			for (int num = region.FirstRow; num <= region.LastRow; num++)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = worksheet.Rows[num];
				for (short num2 = region.FirstColumnInternal; num2 <= region.LastColumnInternal; num2++)
				{
					worksheetRow.GetCellFormatInternal(num2).Style = workbookStyle;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool GetIsVisitedResolved()
		{
			if (IsVisited)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsSealed && _sourceCell != null)
			{
				Worksheet worksheet = _sourceCell.Worksheet;
				if (worksheet != null && worksheet.VisitedHyperlinkCells.Contains(_sourceCell))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private string GetSourceAddress(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			if (CellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.A1)
			{
				return cell.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: true, useRelativeRow: true);
			}
			return cell.ToString(CellReferenceMode.R1C1, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: false, useRelativeRow: false);
		}

		private string GetSourceAddress(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			if (CellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.A1)
			{
				return region.ToString(CellReferenceMode.A1, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: true, useRelativeRow: true);
			}
			return region.ToString(CellReferenceMode.R1C1, includeWorksheetName: false, useRelativeColumn: false, useRelativeRow: false);
		}

		internal void OnVisited()
		{
			if (IsSealed)
			{
				if (_sourceCell != null)
				{
					Worksheet worksheet = _sourceCell.Worksheet;
					if (worksheet != null && !worksheet.VisitedHyperlinkCells.Contains(_sourceCell))
					{
						worksheet.VisitedHyperlinkCells.Add(_sourceCell);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (!IsVisited)
			{
				IsVisited = true;
			}
		}

		internal void SetWorksheet(Worksheet value, bool changeStyle = true, bool applyCellValue = true)
		{
			if (changeStyle && value == null && _worksheet != null)
			{
				RemoveStyleFromSourceRange();
			}
			if (_isSourceSpecifiedAsString)
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					_sourceCell = null;
					_sourceRegion = null;
				}
				else
				{
					_sourceRegion = value.GetRegion(_sourceAddress);
					UpdateSourceCellFromRegion();
				}
			}
			_worksheet = value;
			ApplyToSourceRegion(applyCellValue, changeStyle);
		}

		private void RemoveStyleFromSourceRange()
		{
			if (_sourceRegion.Worksheet == null || _worksheet.Workbook == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorkbookStyle normalStyle = _worksheet.Workbook.Styles.NormalStyle;
			for (int i = _sourceRegion.FirstRow; i <= _sourceRegion.LastRow; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = _worksheet.Rows[i];
				for (short num = _sourceRegion.FirstColumnInternal; num <= _sourceRegion.LastColumnInternal; num++)
				{
					worksheetRow.GetCellFormatInternal(num).Style = normalStyle;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSourceCellFromRegion()
		{
			if (_sourceRegion.IsSingleCell)
			{
				if (_sourceCell == null || _sourceCell.Worksheet == null)
				{
					_sourceCell = _sourceRegion.TopRow.Cells[_sourceRegion.FirstColumn];
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_sourceCell = null;
			}
		}

		private void VerifyDisplayText(string displayText, string paramName)
		{
			if (displayText != null && displayText.Length > 2084)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DisplayTextTooLongS"), paramName);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyIsMutable()
		{
			if (_isSealed)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_HyperlinkSealed"));
			}
		}

		private void VerifyTarget(object target, string paramName)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyNotNull(target, paramName);
			WorksheetCell worksheetCell = target as WorksheetCell;
			WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = target as WorksheetRegion;
			NamedReference namedReference = target as NamedReference;
			if (target is string text)
			{
				if (text.Length > 256)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_TargetTooLong"), paramName);
				}
			}
			else if (worksheetCell == null && worksheetRegion == null && namedReference == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidTarget"), paramName);
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = _worksheet;
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				if (_sourceCell != null)
				{
					worksheet = _sourceCell.Worksheet;
				}
				else if (_sourceRegion != null)
				{
					worksheet = _sourceRegion.Worksheet;
				}
			}
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (namedReference != null)
				{
					flag = namedReference.Workbook != worksheet.Workbook;
				}
				else if (worksheetCell != null)
				{
					flag = worksheetCell.Worksheet != null && worksheetCell.Worksheet.Workbook != worksheet.Workbook;
				}
				else if (worksheetRegion != null)
				{
					flag = worksheetRegion.Worksheet != null && worksheetRegion.Worksheet.Workbook != worksheet.Workbook;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_HyperlinkTargetFromOtherWorkbook"), paramName);
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyToolTipText(string toolTip, string paramName)
		{
			if (toolTip != null && toolTip.Length > 256)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_ToolTipTooLong"), paramName);
			}
		}

		private void SetDisplayTextCore(string value)
		{
			_displayText = value;
			ApplyToSourceRegion(applyCellValue: true, applyFormat: false);
		}

		private void SetSourceAddressCore(string value)
		{
			if (SourceAddress == value)
			{
				_isSourceSpecifiedAsString = true;
				_sourceCell = null;
				_sourceRegion = null;
				return;
			}
			if (_worksheet == null)
			{
				_sourceAddress = value;
				_sourceCell = null;
				_sourceRegion = null;
			}
			else
			{
				RemoveStyleFromSourceRange();
				WorksheetRegion region = _worksheet.GetRegion(value);
				_sourceAddress = value;
				_sourceRegion = region;
				if (_sourceRegion.IsSingleCell)
				{
					_sourceCell = _sourceRegion.TopRow.Cells[_sourceRegion.FirstColumn];
				}
				else
				{
					_sourceCell = null;
				}
			}
			_isSourceSpecifiedAsString = true;
			ApplyToSourceRegion();
		}

		private void SetSourceCellCore(WorksheetCell value)
		{
			if (_sourceCell == value)
			{
				_isSourceSpecifiedAsString = false;
				return;
			}
			if (_worksheet != null)
			{
				RemoveStyleFromSourceRange();
			}
			_sourceCell = value;
			_sourceAddress = GetSourceAddress(_sourceCell);
			_sourceRegion = _sourceCell.GetCachedRegion();
			_isSourceSpecifiedAsString = false;
			ApplyToSourceRegion();
		}

		private void SetSourceRegionCore(WorksheetRegion value)
		{
			if (_sourceRegion == value)
			{
				_isSourceSpecifiedAsString = false;
				return;
			}
			if (_worksheet != null)
			{
				RemoveStyleFromSourceRange();
			}
			_sourceRegion = value;
			_sourceAddress = GetSourceAddress(_sourceRegion);
			UpdateSourceCellFromRegion();
			_isSourceSpecifiedAsString = false;
			ApplyToSourceRegion();
		}
	}
	public sealed class WorksheetHyperlinkCollection : ICollection<WorksheetHyperlink>, IEnumerable<WorksheetHyperlink>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly List<WorksheetHyperlink> _hyperlinks;

		private readonly Worksheet _worksheet;

		bool ICollection<WorksheetHyperlink>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => _hyperlinks.Count;

		public WorksheetHyperlink this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
				{
					throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
				}
				return _hyperlinks[index];
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetHyperlinkCollection(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			_hyperlinks = new List<WorksheetHyperlink>();
			_worksheet = worksheet;
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetHyperlink>.CopyTo(WorksheetHyperlink[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_hyperlinks.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(WorksheetHyperlink hyperlink)
		{
			Insert(Count, hyperlink);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = _hyperlinks.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveAtHelper(num);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetHyperlink hyperlink)
		{
			return _hyperlinks.Contains(hyperlink);
		}

		public IEnumerator<WorksheetHyperlink> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _hyperlinks.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Insert(int index, WorksheetHyperlink hyperlink)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (index < 0 || Count < index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			if (hyperlink == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("hyperlink");
			}
			if (hyperlink.Worksheet != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_HyperlinkAlreadyOwned"), "hyperlink");
			}
			WorksheetCell sourceCell = hyperlink.SourceCell;
			if (sourceCell != null && sourceCell.Worksheet != _worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_HyperlinkAlreadyOwned"), "hyperlink");
			}
			WorksheetRegion sourceRegion = hyperlink.SourceRegion;
			if (sourceRegion != null && sourceRegion.Worksheet != _worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_HyperlinkAlreadyOwned"), "hyperlink");
			}
			_hyperlinks.Add(hyperlink);
			hyperlink.SetWorksheet(_worksheet, changeStyle: true, !flag);
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetHyperlink hyperlink)
		{
			int num = _hyperlinks.IndexOf(hyperlink);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAtHelper(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			RemoveAtHelper(index);
		}

		internal void RemoveAtHelper(int index, bool removeHyperlinkStyle = true)
		{
			WorksheetHyperlink worksheetHyperlink = _hyperlinks[index];
			_hyperlinks.RemoveAt(index);
			worksheetHyperlink.SetWorksheet(null, removeHyperlinkStyle);
		}
	}

			}
			set

				preferredFormat = value;
			}
		}

		internal override bool HasFillAndOutlineInitially => false;

		internal override ShapeType? Type2003 => ShapeType.PictureFrame;

		internal override ST_ShapeType? Type2007 => null;

		{
			get

				return image;

				image = value;
			}

		{
		}

		internal WorksheetImage(bool initializeDefaults)
			: base(initializeDefaults)

		}

		public WorksheetImage(Image image)

			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("image", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_Image"));
			}
			this.image = image;
		}

		internal override TResult Accept<TArg, TResult>(IWorksheetShapeVisitor<TArg, TResult> visitor, TArg argument = default(TArg))
		{
			return visitor.VisitWorksheetImage(this, argument);

		public void SetBoundsInTwips(Worksheet worksheet, Rectangle bounds, bool maintainAspectRatio)
		{
			SetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, bounds, maintainAspectRatio, PositioningOptions.None);
		}

		public void SetBoundsInTwips(Worksheet worksheet, Rectangle bounds, bool maintainAspectRatio, PositioningOptions options)
		{
			if (!maintainAspectRatio)
			{
				SetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, bounds, options);
				return;
			}
			float num = (float)image.Height / (float)image.Width;
			Size size = new Size((int)((float)bounds.Height / num), bounds.Height);
			Size size2 = new Size(bounds.Width, (int)((float)bounds.Width * num));
			Size size3 = ((size.Width > bounds.Width) ? size2 : size);
			Point location = new Point(bounds.X + (bounds.Width - size3.Width) / 2, bounds.Y + (bounds.Height - size3.Height) / 2);
			SetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, new Rectangle(location, size3), options);
		}
	}
	internal struct WorksheetItemPosition : IEquatable<WorksheetItemPosition>
	{
		private readonly int _extent;

		private readonly int _index;

		private readonly long _offset;

		internal long End => _offset + _extent;

		public int Extent => _extent;

		public int Index => _index;

		public long Offset => _offset;

		public WorksheetItemPosition(int index, long offset, int extent)
		{
			_index = index;
			_extent = extent;
			_offset = offset;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is WorksheetItemPosition)
			{
				return Equals((WorksheetItemPosition)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (_index + _extent.GetHashCode()) ^ _offset.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Index {Index}: Offset {Offset}, Extent {Extent}";
		}

		public static bool operator ==(WorksheetItemPosition d1, WorksheetItemPosition d2)
		{
			return d1.Equals(d2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(WorksheetItemPosition d1, WorksheetItemPosition d2)
		{
			return !(d1 == d2);
		}

		public bool Equals(WorksheetItemPosition other)
		{
			if (other._index == _index && other._offset == _offset)
			{
				return other._extent == _extent;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class WorksheetRegion : IEnumerable<WorksheetCell>, IEnumerable
	{
		internal class HorizontalSorter : IComparer<WorksheetRegion>
		{
			public static readonly HorizontalSorter Instance = new HorizontalSorter();

			private HorizontalSorter()
			{
			}

			public int Compare(WorksheetRegion x, WorksheetRegion y)
			{
				return HorizontalAddressSorter.Instance.Compare(x.Address, y.Address);
			}
		}

		internal class HorizontalAddressSorter : IComparer<WorksheetRegionAddress>
		{
			public static readonly HorizontalAddressSorter Instance = new HorizontalAddressSorter();

			private HorizontalAddressSorter()
			{
			}

			public static int CompareHelper(WorksheetRegionAddress x, WorksheetRegionAddress y)
			{
				return x.FirstColumnIndex - y.FirstColumnIndex;
			}

			public static int CompareHelperLast(WorksheetRegionAddress x, WorksheetRegionAddress y)
			{
				return x.LastColumnIndex - y.LastColumnIndex;
			}

			public int Compare(WorksheetRegionAddress x, WorksheetRegionAddress y)
			{
				int num = CompareHelper(x, y);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num = VerticalAddressSorter.CompareHelper(x, y);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num = CompareHelperLast(x, y);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return VerticalAddressSorter.CompareHelperLast(x, y);
			}
		}

		internal class HorizontalWeakSorter : IComparer<WeakReference>
		{
			public static readonly HorizontalWeakSorter Instance = new HorizontalWeakSorter();

			private HorizontalWeakSorter()
			{
			}

			int IComparer<WeakReference>.Compare(WeakReference x, WeakReference y)
			{
				WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion = (WorksheetRegion)Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(x);
				WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion2 = (WorksheetRegion)Utilities.GetWeakReferenceTarget(y);
				if (worksheetRegion == null && worksheetRegion2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (worksheetRegion == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (worksheetRegion2 == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return HorizontalSorter.Instance.Compare(worksheetRegion, worksheetRegion2);
			}
		}

		internal class VerticalSorter : IComparer<WorksheetRegion>
		{
			public static readonly VerticalSorter Instance = new VerticalSorter();

			private VerticalSorter()
			{
			}

			int IComparer<WorksheetRegion>.Compare(WorksheetRegion x, WorksheetRegion y)
			{
				return VerticalAddressSorter.Instance.Compare(x.Address, y.Address);
			}
		}

		internal class VerticalAddressSorter : IComparer<WorksheetRegionAddress>
		{
			public static readonly VerticalAddressSorter Instance = new VerticalAddressSorter();

			private VerticalAddressSorter()
			{
			}

			public static int CompareHelper(WorksheetRegionAddress x, WorksheetRegionAddress y)
			{
				return x.FirstRowIndex - y.FirstRowIndex;
			}

			public static int CompareHelperLast(WorksheetRegionAddress x, WorksheetRegionAddress y)
			{
				return x.LastRowIndex - y.LastRowIndex;
			}

			public int Compare(WorksheetRegionAddress x, WorksheetRegionAddress y)
			{
				int num = CompareHelper(x, y);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return HorizontalAddressSorter.CompareHelper(x, y);
			}
		}

		internal static readonly WorksheetRegion[] EmptyArray = new WorksheetRegion[0];

		private RefBase calcReference;

		private WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress;

		private WorksheetRow topRow;

		private Worksheet worksheet;

		internal WorksheetRegionAddress Address => regionAddress;

		internal RefBase CalcReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (worksheet == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (calcReference == null)
				{
					if (IsSingleCell)
					{
						calcReference = TopRow.GetCellCalcReference(FirstColumnInternal);
					}
					else
					{
						calcReference = new RegionCalcReference(this);
					}
				}
				return calcReference;
			}
		}

		public int FirstColumn => FirstColumnInternal;

		internal short FirstColumnInternal => regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex;

		public int FirstRow => regionAddress.FirstRowIndex;

		internal int Height => LastRow - FirstRow + 1;

		internal bool IsSingleCell
		{
			get
			{
				if (FirstRow == LastRow)
				{
					return FirstColumn == LastColumn;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int LastColumn => LastColumnInternal;

		internal short LastColumnInternal => regionAddress.LastColumnIndex;

		public int LastRow => regionAddress.LastRowIndex;

		internal WorksheetRow TopRow
		{
			get
			{
				if (topRow == null && worksheet != null)
				{
					topRow = Worksheet.Rows[FirstRow];
				}
				return topRow;
			}
		}

		internal int Width => LastColumn - FirstColumn + 1;

		public Worksheet Worksheet => worksheet;

		public WorksheetRegion(Worksheet worksheet, int firstRow, int firstColumn, int lastRow, int lastColumn)
			: this(worksheet, firstRow, firstColumn, lastRow, lastColumn, addCachedRegion: true)
		{
		}

		internal WorksheetRegion(Worksheet worksheet, int firstRow, int firstColumn, int lastRow, int lastColumn, bool addCachedRegion)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("worksheet");
			}
			VerifyRowOrder(firstRow, lastRow);
			VerifyColumnOrder(firstColumn, lastColumn);
			Utilities.VerifyRowIndex(worksheet, firstRow, "firstRow");
			Utilities.VerifyRowIndex(worksheet, lastRow, "lastRow");
			Utilities.VerifyColumnIndex(worksheet, firstColumn, "firstColumn");
			Utilities.VerifyColumnIndex(worksheet, lastColumn, "lastColumn");
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
			regionAddress = new WorksheetRegionAddress(firstRow, lastRow, (short)firstColumn, (short)lastColumn);
			if (addCachedRegion)
			{
				this.worksheet.AddCachedRegion(this, out var _);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (object.ReferenceEquals(this, obj))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is WorksheetRegion worksheetRegion))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (worksheet != worksheetRegion.worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return regionAddress == worksheetRegion.regionAddress;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int hashCode = worksheet.GetHashCode();
			return hashCode ^ regionAddress.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode = CellReferenceMode.A1;
			if (worksheet != null)
			{
				cellReferenceMode = worksheet.CellReferenceMode;
			}
			return ToString(cellReferenceMode, includeWorksheetName: true);
		}

		IEnumerator<WorksheetCell> IEnumerable<WorksheetCell>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			for (int rowIndex = regionAddress.FirstRowIndex; rowIndex <= regionAddress.LastRowIndex; rowIndex++)
			{
				WorksheetRow row = worksheet.Rows[rowIndex];
				for (int columnIndex = regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex; columnIndex <= regionAddress.LastColumnIndex; columnIndex++)
				{
					yield return row.Cells[columnIndex];
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<WorksheetCell>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void ApplyArrayFormula(string value)
		{
			VerifyRegion();
			ArrayFormula arrayFormula = ArrayFormula.Parse(value, worksheet.Workbook);
			arrayFormula.ApplyTo(this);
		}

		public void ApplyFormula(string value)
		{
			VerifyRegion();
			Workbook workbook = Worksheet.Workbook;
			bool flag = false;
			if (workbook != null && workbook.CellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.R1C1)
			{
				if (workbook.ParsedR1C1Formulas.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
				{
					value2.ApplyTo(this);
					return;
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			Formula formula = Formula.Parse(value, workbook);
			if (flag)
			{
				workbook.ParsedR1C1Formulas.Add(value, formula);
			}
			formula.ApplyTo(this);
		}

		public WorksheetTable FormatAsTable(bool tableHasHeaders)
		{
			return FormatAsTable(tableHasHeaders, null);
		}

		public WorksheetTable FormatAsTable(bool tableHasHeaders, WorksheetTableStyle tableStyle)
		{
			VerifyRegion();
			return Worksheet.Tables.Add(this, tableHasHeaders, tableStyle);
		}

		public Rectangle GetBoundsInTwips()
		{
			return GetBoundsInTwips(PositioningOptions.None);
		}

		public Rectangle GetBoundsInTwips(PositioningOptions options)
		{
			VerifyRegion();
			return WorksheetShape.GetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, regionAddress.FirstRowIndex, regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, Utilities.PointFEmpty, regionAddress.LastRowIndex, regionAddress.LastColumnIndex, new PointF(100f, 100f), options);
		}

		public string ToString(CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, bool includeWorksheetName)
		{
			return ToString(cellReferenceMode, includeWorksheetName, useRelativeColumn: false, useRelativeRow: false);
		}

		public string ToString(CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, bool includeWorksheetName, bool useRelativeColumn, bool useRelativeRow)
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				return ErrorValue.InvalidCellReference.ToString();
			}
			return $"{(includeWorksheetName ? Utilities.CreateReferenceString(null, worksheet.Name) : string.Empty)}{regionAddress.ToString(useRelativeRow, useRelativeColumn, worksheet.CurrentFormat, cellReferenceMode)}";
		}

		internal virtual void ApplyFormulaToRegion(Formula formula, ref WorksheetRow firstAppliedToRow, ref short firstAppliedToColumnIndex)
		{
			for (int i = FirstRow; i <= LastRow; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = worksheet.Rows[i];
				for (short num = FirstColumnInternal; num <= LastColumnInternal; num++)
				{
					if (firstAppliedToRow == null)
					{
						firstAppliedToRow = worksheetRow;
						firstAppliedToColumnIndex = num;
					}
					formula.ApplyTo(firstAppliedToRow, firstAppliedToColumnIndex, worksheetRow, num);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool Contains(int rowIndex, short columnIndex)
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return regionAddress.Contains(rowIndex, columnIndex);
		}

		internal bool Contains(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			WorksheetRow row = cell.Row;
			if (row == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Contains(row, cell.ColumnIndexInternal);
		}

		internal bool Contains(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (region.Worksheet != Worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return regionAddress.Contains(region.regionAddress);
		}

		internal bool Contains(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex)
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row.Worksheet != Worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return regionAddress.Contains(row.Index, columnIndex);
		}

		internal bool IntersectsWith(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Worksheet != region.Worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return regionAddress.IntersectsWith(region.regionAddress);
		}

		internal bool IntersectsWith(int firstRow, int firstColumn, int lastRow, int lastColumn)
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return regionAddress.IntersectsWith(new WorksheetRegionAddress(firstRow, lastRow, (short)firstColumn, (short)lastColumn));
		}

		internal virtual ShiftAddressResult ShiftRegion(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride, bool leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet)
		{
			ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult = shiftOperation.ShiftRegionAddress(ref regionAddress, operationOverride, leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet);
			if (shiftAddressResult.DidShift)
			{
				topRow = null;
				if (shiftAddressResult.IsDeleted)
				{
					OnShiftedOffWorksheet();
				}
			}
			return shiftAddressResult;
		}

		internal static WorksheetRegion Union(WorksheetRegion region1, WorksheetRegion region2)
		{
			if (region1 == null)
			{
				return region2;
			}
			if (region2 == null)
			{
				return region1;
			}
			if (region1.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return region1;
			}
			return region1.Worksheet.GetCachedRegion(Math.Min(region1.FirstRow, region2.FirstRow), Math.Min(region1.FirstColumn, region2.FirstColumn), Math.Max(region1.LastRow, region2.LastRow), Math.Max(region1.LastColumn, region2.LastColumn));
		}

		internal static void VerifyColumnOrder(int firstColumn, int lastColumn)
		{
			if (lastColumn < firstColumn)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_LastColumnBeforeFirst"));
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			int num = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(testFormat) - 1;
			if (num < regionAddress.LastColumnIndex)
			{
				limitErrors.AddError(string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_FormatLimitError_MaxColumnIndex"), regionAddress.LastColumnIndex, num));
				return;
			}
			int num2 = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(testFormat) - 1;
			if (num2 < regionAddress.LastRowIndex)
			{
				limitErrors.AddError(string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_FormatLimitError_MaxRowIndex"), regionAddress.LastRowIndex, num2));
			}
		}

		internal static void VerifyRowOrder(int firstRow, int lastRow)
		{
			if (lastRow < firstRow)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_LastRowBeforeFirst"));
			}
		}

		{
			worksheet = null;
			topRow = null;
			calcReference = null;
			regionAddress = WorksheetRegionAddress.InvalidReference;
		}

		private void VerifyRegion()
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionShiftedOffWorksheet"), "region");
			}
		}

		void IWorksheetCellFormatProxyOwner.OnCellFormatValueChanged(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue values, CellFormatValueChangedOptions options)
		{
			if (base.Worksheet == null || (options & CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventMergedRegionToCellSyncronization) != CellFormatValueChangedOptions.DefaultBehavior)
			{
				return;
			}
			Workbook workbook = base.Worksheet.Workbook;
			if (workbook != null && workbook.IsLoading)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue << 1))
			{
				if ((values & cellFormatValue) != 0)
				{
					switch (cellFormatValue)
					{
					case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
					{
						WorksheetRow worksheetRow2 = base.Worksheet.Rows[base.LastRow];
						for (short num2 = base.FirstColumnInternal; num2 <= base.LastColumnInternal; num2++)
						{
							Utilities.CopyCellFormatValue(CellFormatInternal, worksheetRow2.GetCellFormatInternal(num2), cellFormatValue, callBeforeAndAfterSet: true, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventCellToMergedRegionSyncronization);
						}
						break;
					}
					case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
					{
						for (int j = base.FirstRow; j <= base.LastRow; j++)
						{
							Utilities.CopyCellFormatValue(CellFormatInternal, base.Worksheet.Rows[j].GetCellFormatInternal(base.FirstColumnInternal), cellFormatValue, callBeforeAndAfterSet: true, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventCellToMergedRegionSyncronization);
						}
						break;
					}
					case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
					{
						for (int k = base.FirstRow; k <= base.LastRow; k++)
						{
							Utilities.CopyCellFormatValue(CellFormatInternal, base.Worksheet.Rows[k].GetCellFormatInternal(base.LastColumnInternal), cellFormatValue, callBeforeAndAfterSet: true, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventCellToMergedRegionSyncronization);
						}
						break;
					}
					case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
					{
						WorksheetRow worksheetRow3 = base.TopRow;
						for (short num3 = base.FirstColumnInternal; num3 <= base.LastColumnInternal; num3++)
						{
							Utilities.CopyCellFormatValue(CellFormatInternal, worksheetRow3.GetCellFormatInternal(num3), cellFormatValue, callBeforeAndAfterSet: true, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventCellToMergedRegionSyncronization);
						}
						break;
					}
					default:
					{
						for (int i = base.FirstRow; i <= base.LastRow; i++)
						{
							WorksheetRow worksheetRow = base.Worksheet.Rows[i];
							for (short num = base.FirstColumnInternal; num <= base.LastColumnInternal; num++)

								}
							}
						}
						break;
					}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CombineBorderValues(WorkbookColorInfo borderColorInfo, DiagonalBorders diagonalBorders, CellBorderLineStyle borderStyle, ref WorkbookColorInfo commonBorderColorInfo, ref DiagonalBorders commonDiagonalBorders, ref CellBorderLineStyle commonBorderStyle)
		{
