		internal static Dictionary<CellFormatValue, object> GetEdgeBorderValues(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress, CellFormatValue? value, bool resolveExternalBorders)
		{
			Dictionary<CellFormatValue, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<CellFormatValue, object>();
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return dictionary;
			}
			WorkbookFormat currentFormat = worksheet.CurrentFormat;
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = worksheet.Rows[regionAddress.FirstRowIndex];
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow2 = worksheet.Rows[regionAddress.LastRowIndex];
			short firstColumnIndex = regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex;
			short lastColumnIndex = regionAddress.LastColumnIndex;
			if (!value.HasValue || value == CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo || value == CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle)
			{
				WorksheetRow exteriorBorderingRow = ((resolveExternalBorders && regionAddress.FirstRowIndex > 0) ? worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(regionAddress.FirstRowIndex - 1) : null);
				if (!value.HasValue || value == CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo)
				{
					ResolveHorizontalBorderValue(worksheet, regionAddress, dictionary, worksheetRow, exteriorBorderingRow, worksheetRow, firstColumnIndex, CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo);
				}
				if (!value.HasValue || value == CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle)
				{
					ResolveHorizontalBorderValue(worksheet, regionAddress, dictionary, worksheetRow, exteriorBorderingRow, worksheetRow, firstColumnIndex, CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle);
				}
			}
			if (!value.HasValue || value == CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo || value == CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle)
			{
				WorksheetRow exteriorBorderingRow2 = ((resolveExternalBorders && regionAddress.LastRowIndex + 1 < Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(currentFormat)) ? worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(regionAddress.LastRowIndex + 1) : null);
				if (!value.HasValue || value == CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo)
				{
					ResolveHorizontalBorderValue(worksheet, regionAddress, dictionary, worksheetRow2, exteriorBorderingRow2, worksheetRow2, firstColumnIndex, CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo);
				}
				if (!value.HasValue || value == CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle)
				{
					ResolveHorizontalBorderValue(worksheet, regionAddress, dictionary, worksheetRow2, exteriorBorderingRow2, worksheetRow2, firstColumnIndex, CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle);
				}
			}
			if (!value.HasValue || value == CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo || value == CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle || value == CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo || value == CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle)
			{
				short exteriorBorderingColumnIndex = (short)((resolveExternalBorders && regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex > 0) ? (regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex - 1) : (-1));
				short exteriorBorderingColumnIndex2 = (short)((resolveExternalBorders && regionAddress.LastColumnIndex + 1 < Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(currentFormat)) ? (regionAddress.LastColumnIndex + 1) : (-1));
				if (!value.HasValue || value == CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo)
				{
					ResolveVerticalBorderValue(worksheet, regionAddress, dictionary, regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, exteriorBorderingColumnIndex, worksheetRow, firstColumnIndex, CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo);
				}
				if (!value.HasValue || value == CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle)
				{
					ResolveVerticalBorderValue(worksheet, regionAddress, dictionary, regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, exteriorBorderingColumnIndex, worksheetRow, firstColumnIndex, CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle);
				}
				if (!value.HasValue || value == CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo)
				{
					ResolveVerticalBorderValue(worksheet, regionAddress, dictionary, regionAddress.LastColumnIndex, exteriorBorderingColumnIndex2, worksheetRow, lastColumnIndex, CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo);
				}
				if (!value.HasValue || value == CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle)
				{
					ResolveVerticalBorderValue(worksheet, regionAddress, dictionary, regionAddress.LastColumnIndex, exteriorBorderingColumnIndex2, worksheetRow, lastColumnIndex, CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		internal void Initialize(bool isUndoing)
		{
			int firstRow = base.FirstRow;
			int firstColumn = base.FirstColumn;
			int lastRow = base.LastRow;
			int lastColumn = base.LastColumn;
			WorkbookColorInfo commonBorderColorInfo = null;
			CellBorderLineStyle commonBorderStyle = CellBorderLineStyle.Default;
			WorkbookColorInfo commonBorderColorInfo2 = null;
			DiagonalBorders commonDiagonalBorders = DiagonalBorders.Default;
			CellBorderLineStyle commonBorderStyle2 = CellBorderLineStyle.Default;
			WorkbookColorInfo commonBorderColorInfo3 = null;
			CellBorderLineStyle commonBorderStyle3 = CellBorderLineStyle.Default;
			WorkbookColorInfo commonBorderColorInfo4 = null;
			CellBorderLineStyle commonBorderStyle4 = CellBorderLineStyle.Default;
			WorkbookColorInfo commonBorderColorInfo5 = null;
			CellBorderLineStyle commonBorderStyle5 = CellBorderLineStyle.Default;
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = base.TopRow;
			WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = worksheetRow.GetCellFormatInternal(base.FirstColumnInternal).Element.CloneInternal();
			object obj = null;
			Worksheet worksheet = base.Worksheet;
			if (!isUndoing)
			{
				for (int i = firstRow; i <= lastRow; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRow worksheetRow2 = worksheet.Rows[i];
					for (short num = (short)firstColumn; num <= lastColumn; num++)
					{
						WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormatInternal = worksheetRow2.GetCellFormatInternal(num);
						WorksheetCellFormatDataResolved worksheetCellFormatDataResolved = new WorksheetCellFormatDataResolved(cellFormatInternal);
						if (obj == null)
						{
							obj = worksheetRow2.GetCellValueRaw(num);
							if (obj != null)
							{
								worksheetCellFormatData = cellFormatInternal.Element.CloneInternal();
							}
						}
						if (i == firstRow)
						{
							CombineBorderValues(worksheetCellFormatDataResolved.TopBorderColorInfo, worksheetCellFormatDataResolved.TopBorderStyle, ref commonBorderColorInfo5, ref commonBorderStyle5);
						}
						if (i == lastRow)
						{
							CombineBorderValues(worksheetCellFormatDataResolved.BottomBorderColorInfo, worksheetCellFormatDataResolved.BottomBorderStyle, ref commonBorderColorInfo, ref commonBorderStyle);
						}
						if (num == firstColumn)
						{
							CombineBorderValues(worksheetCellFormatDataResolved.LeftBorderColorInfo, worksheetCellFormatDataResolved.LeftBorderStyle, ref commonBorderColorInfo3, ref commonBorderStyle3);
						}
						if (num == lastColumn)
						{
							CombineBorderValues(worksheetCellFormatDataResolved.RightBorderColorInfo, worksheetCellFormatDataResolved.RightBorderStyle, ref commonBorderColorInfo4, ref commonBorderStyle4);
						}
						CombineBorderValues(worksheetCellFormatDataResolved.DiagonalBorderColorInfo, worksheetCellFormatDataResolved.DiagonalBorders, worksheetCellFormatDataResolved.DiagonalBorderStyle, ref commonBorderColorInfo2, ref commonDiagonalBorders, ref commonBorderStyle2);
					}
				}
			}
			Workbook workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
			bool flag = workbook == null || !workbook.IsLoading;
			bool preventImplicitSetCellValueChanges = worksheet.PreventImplicitSetCellValueChanges;
			try
			{
				worksheet.PreventImplicitSetCellValueChanges = true;
				for (int j = firstRow; j <= lastRow; j++)
				{
					WorksheetRow worksheetRow3 = worksheet.Rows[j];
					for (short num2 = (short)firstColumn; num2 <= lastColumn; num2++)
					{
						worksheetRow3.SetMergedCellOnCell(num2, this);
						if (flag && !isUndoing)
						{
							WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormatInternal2 = worksheetRow3.GetCellFormatInternal(num2);
							cellFormatInternal2.Style = worksheetCellFormatData.Style;
							cellFormatInternal2.FormatOptions = WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None;
						}
					}
				}
				WorksheetHyperlinkCollection hyperlinks = worksheet.Hyperlinks;
				for (int num3 = hyperlinks.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					WorksheetRegion sourceRegion = hyperlinks[num3].SourceRegion;
					if (Contains(sourceRegion) && (sourceRegion.FirstRow != base.FirstRow || sourceRegion.FirstColumnInternal != base.FirstColumnInternal))
					{
						hyperlinks.RemoveAt(num3);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				worksheet.PreventImplicitSetCellValueChanges = preventImplicitSetCellValueChanges;
			}
			if (isUndoing)
			{
				isOnWorksheet = true;
				if (cellFormat != null)
				{
					cellFormat.OnRooted(base.Worksheet.Workbook.CellFormats);
				}
				return;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormatInternal3 = CellFormatInternal;
			cellFormatInternal3.SetFormatting(worksheetCellFormatData);
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (Utilities.TestFlag(cellFormatInternal3.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyBorderFormatting))

				{

				{
					flag2 = false;

			}

				}

				{
					cellFormatInternal3.BottomBorderStyle = commonBorderStyle;
				}
				if (cellFormatInternal3.Element.DiagonalBorderColorInfoResolved != commonBorderColorInfo2)
				{
					cellFormatInternal3.DiagonalBorderColorInfo = commonBorderColorInfo2;
				}
				if (cellFormatInternal3.Element.DiagonalBordersResolved != commonDiagonalBorders)
				{
					cellFormatInternal3.DiagonalBorders = commonDiagonalBorders;
				}
				if (cellFormatInternal3.Element.DiagonalBorderStyleResolved != commonBorderStyle2)
				{
					cellFormatInternal3.DiagonalBorderStyle = commonBorderStyle2;
				}
				if (cellFormatInternal3.Element.LeftBorderColorInfoResolved != commonBorderColorInfo3)
				{
					cellFormatInternal3.LeftBorderColorInfo = commonBorderColorInfo3;
				}
				if (cellFormatInternal3.Element.LeftBorderStyleResolved != commonBorderStyle3)
				{
					cellFormatInternal3.LeftBorderStyle = commonBorderStyle3;
				}
				if (cellFormatInternal3.Element.RightBorderColorInfoResolved != commonBorderColorInfo4)
				{
					cellFormatInternal3.RightBorderColorInfo = commonBorderColorInfo4;
				}
				if (cellFormatInternal3.Element.RightBorderStyleResolved != commonBorderStyle4)
				{
					cellFormatInternal3.RightBorderStyle = commonBorderStyle4;
				}
				if (cellFormatInternal3.Element.TopBorderColorInfoResolved != commonBorderColorInfo5)
				{
					cellFormatInternal3.TopBorderColorInfo = commonBorderColorInfo5;
				}
				if (cellFormatInternal3.Element.TopBorderStyleResolved != commonBorderStyle5)

					cellFormatInternal3.TopBorderStyle = commonBorderStyle5;

		internal bool OnBeforeShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, WorksheetRegionAddress deletedRegionAddress)
		{
			if (base.FirstColumn >= deletedRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex && base.FirstRow >= deletedRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex && base.LastColumn <= deletedRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex && base.LastRow <= deletedRegionAddress.LastRowIndex)
			{
				base.Worksheet.MergedCellsRegions.Remove(this);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnCellBorderValueChanged(WorksheetRow row, short columnIndex, CellFormatValue value)
		{
			switch (value)
			{
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
				if (row.Index != base.LastRow)
				{
					return;
				}
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
				if (columnIndex != base.FirstColumn)
				{
					return;
				}
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
				if (columnIndex != base.LastColumn)
				{
					return;
				}
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
				if (row.Index != base.FirstRow)
				{
					return;
				}
				break;
			}
			Dictionary<CellFormatValue, object> mergedCellBorderValues = GetMergedCellBorderValues(value, resolveExternalBorders: false);
			CellFormatInternal.SetValue(value, mergedCellBorderValues[value], callBeforeAndAfterSet: true, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventMergedRegionToCellSyncronization);
		}

		internal void OnRemovedFromCollection()
		{
			if (base.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = base.FirstRow; i <= base.LastRow; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = base.Worksheet.Rows[i];
				for (short num = base.FirstColumnInternal; num <= base.LastColumnInternal; num++)
				{
					worksheetRow.SetMergedCellOnCell(num, null);
				}
			}
			isOnWorksheet = false;
			if (cellFormat != null)
			{
				cellFormat.OnUnrooted();
			}
		}

		internal void ResetResolvedHeightsOfIntersectingRows()
		{
			if (base.Worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in base.Worksheet.Rows.GetItemsInRange(base.FirstRow, base.LastRow))
			{
				item.ResetResolvedRowHeight();
			}
		}

		private static void ResolveHorizontalBorderValue(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress, Dictionary<CellFormatValue, object> borders, WorksheetRow interiorRow, WorksheetRow exteriorBorderingRow, WorksheetRow leftCornerInteriorCellRow, short leftCornerInteriorCellColumnIndex, CellFormatValue value)
		{
			object obj = Utilities.ResolveCellBorderValue(worksheet, leftCornerInteriorCellRow, leftCornerInteriorCellColumnIndex, exteriorBorderingRow, regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, value);
			object obj2 = Utilities.ResolveCellOwnerBorderValue(interiorRow, exteriorBorderingRow, value);
			object obj3 = obj;
			if (WorksheetCellFormatData.IsValueDefault(value, obj3))
			{
				obj3 = obj2;
			}
			if (!WorksheetCellFormatData.IsValueDefault(value, obj3))
			{
				for (short num = (short)(regionAddress.FirstColumnIndex + 1); num <= regionAddress.LastColumnIndex; num++)
				{
					object obj4 = Utilities.ResolveCellBorderValue(worksheet, interiorRow, num, exteriorBorderingRow, num, value);
					if (WorksheetCellFormatData.IsValueDefault(value, obj4))
					{
						obj4 = obj2;
					}
					if (!object.Equals(obj4, obj3))
					{
						obj3 = WorksheetCellFormatData.GetDefaultValue(value);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			borders.Add(value, obj3);
		}

		private static void ResolveVerticalBorderValue(Worksheet worksheet, WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress, Dictionary<CellFormatValue, object> borders, short interiorColumnIndex, short exteriorBorderingColumnIndex, WorksheetRow topCornerInteriorCellRow, short topCornerInteriorCellColumnIndex, CellFormatValue value)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int maxCount = worksheet.Columns.MaxCount;
			WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock = null;
			if (0 <= interiorColumnIndex && interiorColumnIndex < maxCount)
			{
				worksheetColumnBlock = worksheet.GetColumnBlock(interiorColumnIndex);
			}
			WorksheetColumnBlock worksheetColumnBlock2 = null;
			if (0 <= exteriorBorderingColumnIndex && exteriorBorderingColumnIndex < maxCount)
			{
				worksheetColumnBlock2 = worksheet.GetColumnBlock(exteriorBorderingColumnIndex);
			}
			WorksheetRow adjacentRow = worksheet.Rows[regionAddress.FirstRowIndex];
			object obj = Utilities.ResolveCellBorderValue(worksheet, topCornerInteriorCellRow, topCornerInteriorCellColumnIndex, adjacentRow, exteriorBorderingColumnIndex, value);
			object obj2 = ((worksheetColumnBlock != null) ? worksheetColumnBlock.CellFormat.GetValue(value) : ((worksheetColumnBlock2 == null) ? WorksheetCellFormatData.GetDefaultValue(value) : worksheetColumnBlock2.CellFormat.GetValue(Utilities.GetOppositeBorderValue(value))));
			object obj3 = obj;
			if (WorksheetCellFormatData.IsValueDefault(value, obj3))
			{
				obj3 = obj2;
			}
			if (!WorksheetCellFormatData.IsValueDefault(value, obj3))
			{
				for (int i = regionAddress.FirstRowIndex + 1; i <= regionAddress.LastRowIndex; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRow worksheetRow = worksheet.Rows[i];
					object obj4 = Utilities.ResolveCellBorderValue(worksheet, worksheetRow, interiorColumnIndex, worksheetRow, exteriorBorderingColumnIndex, value);
					if (WorksheetCellFormatData.IsValueDefault(value, obj4))
					{
						obj4 = obj2;
					}
					if (!object.Equals(obj4, obj3))
					{
						obj3 = WorksheetCellFormatData.GetDefaultValue(value);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			borders.Add(value, obj3);
		}
	}

	[DebuggerDisplay("Count = {Count}")]
	public sealed class WorksheetMergedCellsRegionCollection : ICollection<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>, IEnumerable<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>, IEnumerable
	{
		private List<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion> mergedRegions;

		private Worksheet parentWorksheet;

		int ICollection<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>.Count => Count;

		bool ICollection<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => mergedRegions.Count;

		public WorksheetMergedCellsRegion this[int index] => mergedRegions[index];

		internal WorksheetMergedCellsRegionCollection(Worksheet parentWorksheet)
		{
			this.parentWorksheet = parentWorksheet;
			mergedRegions = new List<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>();
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>.Add(WorksheetMergedCellsRegion item)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantAddMergedRegion"));
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool ICollection<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>.Contains(WorksheetMergedCellsRegion item)

		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>.CopyTo(WorksheetMergedCellsRegion[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			mergedRegions.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>.Remove(WorksheetMergedCellsRegion item)

		IEnumerator<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion> IEnumerable<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>.GetEnumerator()

		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public WorksheetMergedCellsRegion Add(int firstRow, int firstColumn, int lastRow, int lastColumn)
		{
			VerifyMergedRegionArea(firstRow, (short)firstColumn, lastRow, (short)lastColumn);
			WorksheetMergedCellsRegion worksheetMergedCellsRegion = new WorksheetMergedCellsRegion(parentWorksheet, firstRow, firstColumn, lastRow, lastColumn);
			InternalInsert(mergedRegions.Count, worksheetMergedCellsRegion, calledFromUndo: false);
			worksheetMergedCellsRegion.ResetResolvedHeightsOfIntersectingRows();
			return worksheetMergedCellsRegion;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = mergedRegions.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		private void InternalInsert(int index, WorksheetMergedCellsRegion region, bool calledFromUndo)
		{
			region.Initialize(calledFromUndo);
			mergedRegions.Insert(index, region);
		}

		public bool IsOverlappingWithMergedRegion(int firstRow, int firstColumn, int lastRow, int lastColumn)
		{
			if (parentWorksheet.MergedCellsRegions.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			WorksheetRegion.VerifyRowOrder(firstRow, lastRow);
			WorksheetRegion.VerifyColumnOrder(firstColumn, lastColumn);
			Utilities.VerifyRowIndex(parentWorksheet, firstRow, "firstRow");
			Utilities.VerifyRowIndex(parentWorksheet, lastRow, "lastRow");
			Utilities.VerifyColumnIndex(parentWorksheet, firstColumn, "firstColumn");
			Utilities.VerifyColumnIndex(parentWorksheet, lastColumn, "lastColumn");
			for (int i = firstRow; i <= lastRow; i++)
			{
				for (short num = (short)firstColumn; num <= lastColumn; num++)
				{
					if (parentWorksheet.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegion(i, num) != null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetMergedCellsRegion region)
		{
			if (region == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = mergedRegions.IndexOf(region);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			WorksheetMergedCellsRegion worksheetMergedCellsRegion = mergedRegions[index];
			mergedRegions.RemoveAt(index);
			worksheetMergedCellsRegion.ResetResolvedHeightsOfIntersectingRows();
			worksheetMergedCellsRegion.OnRemovedFromCollection();
		}

		internal void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			foreach (WorksheetMergedCellsRegion item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetMergedCellsRegion>)this)
			{
				item.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyMergedRegionArea(int firstRow, short firstColumn, int lastRow, short lastColumn)
		{
			if (parentWorksheet.HasDataTables)
			{
				foreach (WorksheetDataTable item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetDataTable>)parentWorksheet.DataTables)
				{
					WorksheetRegion cellsInTable = item.CellsInTable;
					if (!cellsInTable.IntersectsWith(firstRow, firstColumn, lastRow, lastColumn))
					{
						continue;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					if (firstRow == cellsInTable.FirstRow && lastRow == cellsInTable.FirstRow)
					{
						if (firstColumn < cellsInTable.FirstColumn || cellsInTable.LastColumn < lastColumn)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else if (firstColumn == cellsInTable.FirstColumn && lastColumn == cellsInTable.FirstColumn)
					{
						if (firstRow < cellsInTable.FirstRow || cellsInTable.LastRow < lastRow)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantOverlapDataTableInterior"));
					}
				}
			}
			for (int i = firstRow; i <= lastRow; i++)
			{
				WorksheetRow worksheetRow = parentWorksheet.Rows[i];
				for (short num = firstColumn; num <= lastColumn; num++)
				{
					if (worksheetRow.GetCellAssociatedTable(num) != null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_MergedCellsAppliedInTable"));
					}
					if (worksheetRow.GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal(num) != null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LER_Exception_MergedRegionsOverlap"));
					}
					if (worksheetRow.GetCellValueRaw(num) is ArrayFormula)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantOverlapArrayFormula"));
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class WorksheetReferenceCollection : ICollection<WorksheetCell>, IEnumerable<WorksheetCell>, ICollection<WorksheetRegion>, IEnumerable<WorksheetRegion>, IEnumerable
	{
		private int? cachedCellsCount;

		private string cachedA1StringValue;

		private string cachedR1C1StringValue;

		private List<WorksheetRegionAddress> regionsSortedHorizontally;

		private RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress> regionLookupTable;

		private Worksheet worksheet;

		int ICollection<WorksheetCell>.Count => CellsCount;

		bool ICollection<WorksheetCell>.IsReadOnly => false;

		int ICollection<WorksheetRegion>.Count => regionsSortedHorizontally.Count;

		bool ICollection<WorksheetRegion>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public int CellsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!cachedCellsCount.HasValue)
				{
					int num = 0;
					for (int i = 0; i < regionsSortedHorizontally.Count; i++)
					{
						WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = regionsSortedHorizontally[i];
						num += worksheetRegionAddress.Height * worksheetRegionAddress.Width;
					}
					cachedCellsCount = num;
				}
				return cachedCellsCount.Value;
			}
		}

		public Worksheet Worksheet => worksheet;

		internal List<WorksheetRegionAddress> Regions => regionsSortedHorizontally;

		internal WorksheetCell TopLeftCell
		{
			get
			{
				if (regionsSortedHorizontally.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = regionsSortedHorizontally[0];
				return worksheet.Rows[worksheetRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex].Cells[worksheetRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex];
			}
		}

		public WorksheetReferenceCollection(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("worksheet");
			}
			Initialize(worksheet);
		}

		public WorksheetReferenceCollection(Worksheet worksheet, string references)
			: this(worksheet)
		{
			Add(references);
		}

		public WorksheetReferenceCollection(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			if (cell == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("cell");
			}
			if (cell.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"), "cell");
			}
			Initialize(cell.Worksheet);
			AddDirect(cell.RegionAddress);
		}

		public WorksheetReferenceCollection(WorksheetRegion region)

			if (region == null)

				throw new ArgumentNullException("region");

			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionShiftedOffWorksheet"), "region");
			}
			Initialize(region.Worksheet);
			AddDirect(region.Address);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(Worksheet.CellReferenceMode);
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetCell>.CopyTo(WorksheetCell[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			int num = arrayIndex;
			foreach (WorksheetCell item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetCell>)this)
			{
				array[num++] = item;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<WorksheetCell> IEnumerable<WorksheetCell>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress in regionsSortedHorizontally)
			{
				WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = regionAddress;
				int rowIndex = worksheetRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex;
				while (true)
				{
					int num = rowIndex;
					WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress2 = regionAddress;
					if (num > worksheetRegionAddress2.LastRowIndex)
					{
						break;
					}
					WorksheetRow row = worksheet.Rows[rowIndex];
					WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress3 = regionAddress;
					int columnIndex = worksheetRegionAddress3.FirstColumnIndex;
					while (true)
					{
						int num2 = columnIndex;
						WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress4 = regionAddress;
						if (num2 > worksheetRegionAddress4.LastColumnIndex)
						{
							break;
						}
						yield return row.Cells[columnIndex];
						columnIndex++;
					}
					rowIndex++;
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress in regionsSortedHorizontally)
			{
				WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = regionAddress;
				if (worksheetRegionAddress.IsSingleCell)
				{
					WorksheetRowCollection rows = worksheet.Rows;
					WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress2 = regionAddress;
					WorksheetCellCollection cells = rows[worksheetRegionAddress2.FirstRowIndex].Cells;
					WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress3 = regionAddress;
					yield return cells[worksheetRegionAddress3.FirstColumnIndex];
				}
				else
				{
					yield return worksheet.GetCachedRegion(regionAddress);
				}
			}
		}

		void ICollection<WorksheetRegion>.CopyTo(WorksheetRegion[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			int num = arrayIndex;
			foreach (WorksheetRegion item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRegion>)this)
			{
				array[num++] = item;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<WorksheetRegion> IEnumerable<WorksheetRegion>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress in regionsSortedHorizontally)
			{
				yield return worksheet.GetCachedRegion(regionAddress);
			}
		}

		public void Add(string references)
		{
			Add(references, worksheet.CellReferenceMode);
		}

		public void Add(string references, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			if (references == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("references");
			}
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CellReferenceMode), cellReferenceMode))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("cellReferenceMode", (int)cellReferenceMode, typeof(CellReferenceMode));
			}
			List<WorksheetRegion> regions = GetRegions(references, cellReferenceMode, worksheet.Culture);
			if (regions.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < regions.Count; i++)
			{
				flag |= AddRegionHelper(regions[i].Address, out var touchesOtherRegions);
				flag2 = flag2 || touchesOtherRegions;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					Condense();
				}
				else
				{
					ResetCache();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Add(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			if (cell == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("cell");
			}
			if (cell.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"), "cell");
			}
			if (cell.Worksheet != worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellMustBeOnSameWorksheetAsReferencesCollection"), "cell");
			}
			Add(cell.GetCachedRegion());
		}

		public void Add(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			if (region == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("region");
			}
			if (region.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionShiftedOffWorksheet"), "region");
			}
			if (region.Worksheet != worksheet)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionMustBeOnSameWorksheetAsReferencesCollection"), "region");
			}
			if (AddRegionHelper(region.Address, out var touchesOtherRegions))
			{
				if (touchesOtherRegions)
				{
					Condense();
				}
				else
				{
					ResetCache();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			regionLookupTable.Clear();
			regionsSortedHorizontally.Clear();
			ResetCache();
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			if (cell == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("cell");
			}
			if (cell.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"), "cell");
			}
			if (cell.Worksheet != Worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Contains(cell.RegionAddress);
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			if (region == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("region");
			}
			if (region.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionShiftedOffWorksheet"), "region");
			}
			if (region.Worksheet != Worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Contains(region.Address);
		}

		private bool Contains(WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			using (RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.Result result = regionLookupTable.GetItemsContainingRange(region))
			{
				if (result.HasItems)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.Result itemsIntersectingWithRange = regionLookupTable.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(region);
			try
			{
				if (itemsIntersectingWithRange.HasItems)
				{
					SubtractRegion(region, itemsIntersectingWithRange.Items[0], out var regionsNotInSubtractedArea);
					for (int i = 0; i < regionsNotInSubtractedArea.Count; i++)
					{
						if (!Contains(regionsNotInSubtractedArea[i]))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)itemsIntersectingWithRange/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Dispose();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IntersectsWith(WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			using RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.Result result = regionLookupTable.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(region);
			return result.HasItems;
		}

		public bool Remove(string references)
		{
			return Remove(references, worksheet.CellReferenceMode);
		}

		public bool Remove(string references, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			if (references == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("references");
			}
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CellReferenceMode), cellReferenceMode))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("cellReferenceMode", (int)cellReferenceMode, typeof(CellReferenceMode));
			}
			List<WorksheetRegion> regions = GetRegions(references, cellReferenceMode, worksheet.Culture);
			if (regions.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < regions.Count; i++)
			{
				flag |= SubtractRegionHelper(regions[i].Address);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Condense();
			return true;
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetCell cell)
		{
			if (cell == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("cell");
			}
			if (cell.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CellShiftedOffWorksheet"), "cell");
			}
			if (cell.Worksheet != worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.Result itemsContainingCell = regionLookupTable.GetItemsContainingCell(cell.RowIndex, cell.ColumnIndexInternal);
			try
			{
				if (itemsContainingCell.HasItems)
				{
					WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = itemsContainingCell.Items[0];
					RemoveDirect(worksheetRegionAddress);
					int index = cell.Row.Index;
					short columnIndexInternal = cell.ColumnIndexInternal;
					WorksheetRegionAddress regionToSubtract = new WorksheetRegionAddress(index, index, columnIndexInternal, columnIndexInternal);
					SubtractRegion(worksheetRegionAddress, regionToSubtract, out var regionsNotInSubtractedArea);
					if (regionsNotInSubtractedArea.Count > 0)
					{
						AddRangeDirect(regionsNotInSubtractedArea);
						regionsSortedHorizontally.Sort(WorksheetRegion.HorizontalAddressSorter.Instance);
					}
					Condense();
					return true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)itemsContainingCell/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Dispose();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetRegion region)
		{
			if (region == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("region");
			}
			if (region.Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_RegionShiftedOffWorksheet"), "region");
			}
			if (region.Worksheet != worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Remove(region.Address);
		}

		internal bool Remove(WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			if (SubtractRegionHelper(region))
			{
				Condense();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public string ToString(CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CellReferenceMode), cellReferenceMode))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("cellReferenceMode", (int)cellReferenceMode, typeof(CellReferenceMode));
			}
			if (cellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.A1)
			{
				return ToStringHelper(cellReferenceMode, ref cachedA1StringValue);
			}
			return ToStringHelper(cellReferenceMode, ref cachedR1C1StringValue);
		}

			return worksheetReferenceCollection;
		}

		internal void GetBoundingCells(out WorksheetCell topLeftCell, out WorksheetCell bottomRightCell)
		{
			regionLookupTable.GetBoundingIndexes(out var firstRowIndex, out var firstColumnIndex, out var lastRowIndex, out var lastColumnIndex);
			if (firstRowIndex == -1 || firstColumnIndex == -1 || lastRowIndex == -1 || lastColumnIndex == -1)
			{
				topLeftCell = (bottomRightCell = null);
				return;
			}
			topLeftCell = worksheet.Rows[firstRowIndex].Cells[firstColumnIndex];
			bottomRightCell = worksheet.Rows[lastRowIndex].Cells[lastColumnIndex];
		}

		internal bool OnBeforeShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, WorksheetRegionAddress deletedRegionAddress)
		{
			foreach (WorksheetRegionAddress region in Regions)
			{
				if (region.FirstColumnIndex < deletedRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex || region.FirstRowIndex < deletedRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex || region.LastColumnIndex > deletedRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex || region.LastRowIndex > deletedRegionAddress.LastRowIndex)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void OnCellsShifted(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation, ICellShiftOperationOverride operationOverride, out bool isDeleted)
		{
			List<WorksheetRegionAddress> list = new List<WorksheetRegionAddress>();
			for (int num = regionsSortedHorizontally.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				WorksheetRegionAddress regionAddress = regionsSortedHorizontally[num];
				List<WorksheetRegionAddress> splitRegionAddresses;
				ShiftAddressResult shiftAddressResult = shiftOperation.ShiftRegionAddress(ref regionAddress, operationOverride, leaveAttachedToBottomOfWorksheet: true, allowSplitShift: true, out splitRegionAddresses);
				if (shiftAddressResult.DidShift)
				{
					RemoveAtDirect(regionsSortedHorizontally[num], num);
					if (!shiftAddressResult.IsDeleted)
					{
						if (regionAddress.IsValid)
						{
							list.Add(regionAddress);
						}
						if (splitRegionAddresses != null)
						{
							for (int i = 0; i < splitRegionAddresses.Count; i++)
							{
								WorksheetRegionAddress item = splitRegionAddresses[i];
								if (item.IsValid)
								{
									list.Add(item);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count != 0)
			{
				AddRangeDirect(list);
				Condense();
			}
			isDeleted = regionsSortedHorizontally.Count == 0;
		}

		internal void Add(WorksheetReferenceCollection references)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < references.regionsSortedHorizontally.Count; i++)
			{
				flag |= AddRegionHelper(references.regionsSortedHorizontally[i], out var touchesOtherRegions);
				flag2 = flag2 || touchesOtherRegions;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					Condense();
				}
				else
				{
					ResetCache();
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddDirect(WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			regionsSortedHorizontally.Add(region);
			regionLookupTable.Add(region, region);
		}

		private void AddRangeDirect(IEnumerable<WorksheetRegionAddress> regions)
		{
			foreach (WorksheetRegionAddress region in regions)
			{
				AddDirect(region);
			}
		}

		private bool AddRegionHelper(WorksheetRegionAddress region, out bool touchesOtherRegions)
		{
			touchesOtherRegions = false;
			using (RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.Result result = regionLookupTable.GetItemsContainingRange(region))
			{
				if (result.HasItems)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			using (RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.Result result2 = regionLookupTable.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(region.FirstRowIndex, (short)(region.FirstColumnIndex - 1), region.LastRowIndex, (short)(region.LastColumnIndex + 1)))
			{
				if (result2.HasItems)
				{
					touchesOtherRegions = true;
				}
			}
			if (!touchesOtherRegions)
			{
				using RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.Result result3 = regionLookupTable.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(region.FirstRowIndex - 1, region.FirstColumnIndex, region.LastRowIndex + 1, region.LastColumnIndex);
				if (result3.HasItems)
				{
					touchesOtherRegions = true;
				}
			}
			SubtractRegionHelper(region);
			InsertSorted(region);
			return true;
		}

		private void Condense()
		{
			if (regionsSortedHorizontally.Count > 1)
			{
				CondenseHelper(worksheet, expandRightFirst: true);
			}
			ResetCache();
		}

		private void CondenseHelper(Worksheet worksheet, bool expandRightFirst)
		{
			Dictionary<WorksheetRegionAddress, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<WorksheetRegionAddress, bool>();
			bool flag;
			do
			{
				flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < regionsSortedHorizontally.Count; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = regionsSortedHorizontally[i];
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(worksheetRegionAddress))
					{
						WorksheetRegionAddress combinedRegion = new WorksheetRegionAddress(worksheetRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex, worksheetRegionAddress.LastRowIndex, worksheetRegionAddress.FirstColumnIndex, worksheetRegionAddress.LastColumnIndex);
						combinedRegion = Expand(combinedRegion, i, expandRightFirst);
						if (!combinedRegion.Equals(worksheetRegionAddress))
						{
							dictionary[worksheetRegionAddress] = false;
							SubtractRegionHelper(combinedRegion);
							InsertSorted(combinedRegion);
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			while (flag);
		}

		private WorksheetRegionAddress Expand(WorksheetRegionAddress combinedRegion, int originalRegionIndex, bool expandRightFirst)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>(combinedRegion.Width);
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>(combinedRegion.Height);
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			while (!flag || !flag2)
			{
				list.Clear();
				list2.Clear();
				_ = combinedRegion.LastRowIndex;
				_ = combinedRegion.LastColumnIndex;
				if (!flag2)
				{
					for (int i = combinedRegion.FirstColumnIndex; i <= combinedRegion.LastColumnIndex; i++)
					{
						list.Add(i);
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					for (int j = combinedRegion.FirstRowIndex; j <= combinedRegion.LastRowIndex; j++)
					{
						list2.Add(j);
					}
				}
				RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.Result itemsIntersectingWithRange = regionLookupTable.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(combinedRegion.FirstRowIndex, combinedRegion.LastColumnIndex + 1, combinedRegion.LastRowIndex, combinedRegion.LastColumnIndex + 1);
				RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.Result itemsIntersectingWithRange2 = regionLookupTable.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(combinedRegion.LastRowIndex + 1, combinedRegion.FirstColumnIndex, combinedRegion.LastRowIndex + 1, combinedRegion.LastColumnIndex);
				if (itemsIntersectingWithRange.HasItems)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < itemsIntersectingWithRange.Items.Count; k++)
					{
						WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = itemsIntersectingWithRange.Items[k];
						int num = list2.BinarySearch(worksheetRegionAddress.FirstRowIndex);
						if (0 > num)
						{
							continue;
						}
						int height = worksheetRegionAddress.Height;
						for (int l = 0; l < height; l++)
						{
							if (num >= list2.Count)
							{
								break;
							}
							list2.RemoveAt(num);
						}
					}
				}
				if (itemsIntersectingWithRange2.HasItems)
				{
					for (int m = 0; m < itemsIntersectingWithRange2.Items.Count; m++)
					{
						WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress2 = itemsIntersectingWithRange2.Items[m];
						int num2 = list.BinarySearch(worksheetRegionAddress2.FirstColumnIndex);
						if (0 > num2)
						{
							continue;
						}
						int width = worksheetRegionAddress2.Width;
						for (int n = 0; n < width; n++)
						{
							if (num2 >= list.Count)
							{
								break;
							}
							list.RemoveAt(num2);
						}
					}
				}
				itemsIntersectingWithRange.Dispose();
				itemsIntersectingWithRange2.Dispose();
				flag2 |= list.Count > 0;
				flag |= list2.Count > 0;
				if (!flag2 && !flag)
				{
					using RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.Result result = regionLookupTable.GetItemsContainingCell(combinedRegion.LastRowIndex + 1, combinedRegion.LastColumnIndex + 1);
					combinedRegion = (result.HasItems ? new WorksheetRegionAddress(combinedRegion.FirstRowIndex, combinedRegion.LastRowIndex + 1, combinedRegion.FirstColumnIndex, (short)(combinedRegion.LastColumnIndex + 1)) : ((!expandRightFirst) ? combinedRegion.WithLastRowIndex(combinedRegion.LastRowIndex + 1) : combinedRegion.WithLastColumnIndex((short)(combinedRegion.LastColumnIndex + 1))));
				}
				else if (!flag)
				{
					combinedRegion = combinedRegion.WithLastColumnIndex((short)(combinedRegion.LastColumnIndex + 1));
				}
				else if (!flag2)
				{
					combinedRegion = combinedRegion.WithLastRowIndex(combinedRegion.LastRowIndex + 1);
				}
			}
			return combinedRegion;
		}

		private List<WorksheetRegion> GetRegions(string references, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return GetRegions(Worksheet, references, cellReferenceMode, culture);
		}

		internal static List<WorksheetRegion> GetRegions(Worksheet worksheet, string references, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			_ = worksheet.CurrentFormat;
			string[] array = references.Split(new char[1] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			List<WorksheetRegion> list = new List<WorksheetRegion>(array.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				string address = array[i].Trim();
				WorksheetRegion region = worksheet.GetRegion(address, cellReferenceMode);
				if (region == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidReferencesString"), "references");
				}
				list.Add(region);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void Initialize(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			this.worksheet = worksheet;
			regionsSortedHorizontally = new List<WorksheetRegionAddress>();
			regionLookupTable = new RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>(this.worksheet);
		}

		private void InsertDirect(int index, WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			regionsSortedHorizontally.Insert(index, region);
			regionLookupTable.Add(region, region);
		}

		private void InsertSorted(WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			int num = regionsSortedHorizontally.BinarySearch(region, WorksheetRegion.HorizontalAddressSorter.Instance);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				InsertDirect(~num, region);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveAtDirect(WorksheetRegionAddress region, int index)
		{
			regionsSortedHorizontally.RemoveAt(index);
			regionLookupTable.Remove(region, region);
		}

		private void RemoveDirect(WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			int num = regionsSortedHorizontally.BinarySearch(region, WorksheetRegion.HorizontalAddressSorter.Instance);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAtDirect(region, num);
			}
		}

		private bool SubtractRegionHelper(WorksheetRegionAddress region)
		{
			RegionLookupTable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.Result itemsIntersectingWithRange = regionLookupTable.GetItemsIntersectingWithRange(region);
			try
			{
				if (!itemsIntersectingWithRange.HasItems)
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				for (int num = itemsIntersectingWithRange.Items.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					WorksheetRegionAddress worksheetRegionAddress = itemsIntersectingWithRange.Items[num];
					RemoveDirect(worksheetRegionAddress);
					SubtractRegion(worksheetRegionAddress, region, out var regionsNotInSubtractedArea);
					AddRangeDirect(regionsNotInSubtractedArea);
					flag |= regionsNotInSubtractedArea.Count > 0;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					regionsSortedHorizontally.Sort(WorksheetRegion.HorizontalAddressSorter.Instance);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)itemsIntersectingWithRange/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Dispose();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ResetCache()
		{
			cachedCellsCount = null;
			cachedA1StringValue = null;
			cachedR1C1StringValue = null;
		}

		private static void SubtractRegion(WorksheetRegionAddress sourceRegion, WorksheetRegionAddress regionToSubtract, out List<WorksheetRegionAddress> regionsNotInSubtractedArea)
		{
			regionsNotInSubtractedArea = new List<WorksheetRegionAddress>();
			if (sourceRegion.FirstRowIndex < regionToSubtract.FirstRowIndex)
			{
				regionsNotInSubtractedArea.Add(new WorksheetRegionAddress(sourceRegion.FirstRowIndex, regionToSubtract.FirstRowIndex - 1, sourceRegion.FirstColumnIndex, sourceRegion.LastColumnIndex));
			}
			if (regionToSubtract.LastRowIndex < sourceRegion.LastRowIndex)
			{
				regionsNotInSubtractedArea.Add(new WorksheetRegionAddress(regionToSubtract.LastRowIndex + 1, sourceRegion.LastRowIndex, sourceRegion.FirstColumnIndex, sourceRegion.LastColumnIndex));
			}
			int firstRowIndex = Math.Max(regionToSubtract.FirstRowIndex, sourceRegion.FirstRowIndex);
			int lastRowIndex = Math.Min(regionToSubtract.LastRowIndex, sourceRegion.LastRowIndex);
			if (sourceRegion.FirstColumnIndex < regionToSubtract.FirstColumnIndex)
			{
				regionsNotInSubtractedArea.Add(new WorksheetRegionAddress(firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex, sourceRegion.FirstColumnIndex, (short)(regionToSubtract.FirstColumnIndex - 1)));
			}
			if (regionToSubtract.LastColumnIndex < sourceRegion.LastColumnIndex)
			{
				regionsNotInSubtractedArea.Add(new WorksheetRegionAddress(firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex, (short)(regionToSubtract.LastColumnIndex + 1), sourceRegion.LastColumnIndex));
			}
		}

		private string ToStringHelper(CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, ref string cachedString)
		{
			if (cachedString == null)
			{
				cachedString = ToStringHelper(cellReferenceMode, Worksheet, regionsSortedHorizontally);
			}
			return cachedString;
		}

		internal static string ToStringHelper(CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode, Worksheet worksheet, IEnumerable<WorksheetRegionAddress> addresses)
		{
			bool flag = cellReferenceMode == CellReferenceMode.A1;
			WorkbookFormat currentFormat = worksheet.CurrentFormat;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (WorksheetRegionAddress address in addresses)
			{
				if (stringBuilder.Length != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" ");
				}
				if (address.IsSingleCell)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(new WorksheetCellAddress(address.FirstRowIndex, address.FirstColumnIndex).ToString(flag, flag, currentFormat, cellReferenceMode));
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(address.ToString(flag, flag, currentFormat, cellReferenceMode));
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal struct WorksheetRegionAddress : IComparable<WorksheetRegionAddress>
	{
		internal static readonly WorksheetRegionAddress InvalidReference = new WorksheetRegionAddress(-1, -1, -1, -1);

		private readonly short _firstColumnIndex;

		private readonly int _firstRowIndex;

		private readonly short _lastColumnIndex;

		private readonly int _lastRowIndex;

		private readonly int _hashCode;

		public short FirstColumnIndex => _firstColumnIndex;

		public int FirstRowIndex => _firstRowIndex;

		public int Height => _lastRowIndex - _firstRowIndex + 1;

		public bool IsSingleCell
		{
			get
			{
				if (_firstRowIndex == _lastRowIndex)
				{
					return _firstColumnIndex == _lastColumnIndex;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsValid => _firstRowIndex >= 0;

		public short LastColumnIndex => _lastColumnIndex;

		public int LastRowIndex => _lastRowIndex;

		public int Width => _lastColumnIndex - _firstColumnIndex + 1;

		public WorksheetRegionAddress(int firstRowIndex, int lastRowIndex, short firstColumnIndex, short lastColumnIndex)
		{
			_firstColumnIndex = firstColumnIndex;
			_firstRowIndex = firstRowIndex;
			_lastColumnIndex = lastColumnIndex;
			_lastRowIndex = lastRowIndex;
			_hashCode = CalculateHashCode(_firstRowIndex, _lastRowIndex, _firstColumnIndex, _lastColumnIndex);
		}

		public WorksheetRegionAddress(WorksheetCellAddress cell1, WorksheetCellAddress cell2)
		{
			_firstColumnIndex = Math.Min(cell1.ColumnIndex, cell2.ColumnIndex);
			_firstRowIndex = Math.Min(cell1.RowIndex, cell2.RowIndex);
			_lastColumnIndex = Math.Max(cell1.ColumnIndex, cell2.ColumnIndex);
			_lastRowIndex = Math.Max(cell1.RowIndex, cell2.RowIndex);
			_hashCode = CalculateHashCode(_firstRowIndex, _lastRowIndex, _firstColumnIndex, _lastColumnIndex);
		}

		int IComparable<WorksheetRegionAddress>.CompareTo(WorksheetRegionAddress other)
		{
			int num = _firstColumnIndex - other._firstColumnIndex;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = _firstRowIndex - other._firstRowIndex;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = _lastColumnIndex - other._lastColumnIndex;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = _lastRowIndex - other._lastRowIndex;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is WorksheetRegionAddress))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == (WorksheetRegionAddress)obj;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _hashCode;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(useRelativeRow: false, useRelativeColumn: false, WorkbookFormat.Excel2007, CellReferenceMode.A1);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(WorksheetRegionAddress a, WorksheetRegionAddress b)
		{
			if (a._firstColumnIndex == b._firstColumnIndex && a._firstRowIndex == b._firstRowIndex && a._lastColumnIndex == b._lastColumnIndex)
			{
				return a._lastRowIndex == b._lastRowIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(WorksheetRegionAddress a, WorksheetRegionAddress b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		private static int CalculateHashCode(int firstRowIndex, int lastRowIndex, short firstColumnIndex, short lastColumnIndex)
		{
			return firstRowIndex ^ (lastRowIndex << 5) ^ (firstColumnIndex << 10) ^ (lastColumnIndex << 15);
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetCellAddress address)
		{
			return Contains(address.RowIndex, address.ColumnIndex);
		}

		public bool Contains(int rowIndex, short columnIndex)
		{
			if (!IsValid)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rowIndex < _firstRowIndex || _lastRowIndex < rowIndex || columnIndex < _firstColumnIndex || _lastColumnIndex < columnIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetRegionAddress other)
		{
			if (!IsValid)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (other._firstRowIndex < _firstRowIndex || other._firstColumnIndex < _firstColumnIndex || _lastRowIndex < other._lastRowIndex || _lastColumnIndex < other._lastColumnIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IntersectsWith(WorksheetRegionAddress other)
		{
			if (other._lastRowIndex < _firstRowIndex || other._lastColumnIndex < _firstColumnIndex || _lastRowIndex < other._firstRowIndex || _lastColumnIndex < other._firstColumnIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public string ToString(bool useRelativeRow, bool useRelativeColumn, WorkbookFormat format, CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode)
		{
			if (!IsValid)
			{
				return "#REF!";
			}
			int firstRowIndex = _firstRowIndex;
			short firstColumnIndex = _firstColumnIndex;
			return $"{CellAddress.GetCellReferenceString(_firstRowIndex, _firstColumnIndex, format, useRelativeRow, useRelativeColumn, firstRowIndex, firstColumnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets: false, cellReferenceMode)}{':'}{CellAddress.GetCellReferenceString(_lastRowIndex, _lastColumnIndex, format, useRelativeRow, useRelativeColumn, firstRowIndex, firstColumnIndex, relativeAddressesAreOffsets: false, cellReferenceMode)}";
		}

		public WorksheetRegionAddress WithFirstColumnIndex(short firstColumnIndex)
		{
			if (firstColumnIndex == _firstColumnIndex)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new WorksheetRegionAddress(_firstRowIndex, _lastRowIndex, firstColumnIndex, _lastColumnIndex);
		}

		public WorksheetRegionAddress WithFirstRowIndex(int firstRowIndex)
		{
			if (firstRowIndex == _firstRowIndex)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new WorksheetRegionAddress(firstRowIndex, _lastRowIndex, _firstColumnIndex, _lastColumnIndex);
		}

		public WorksheetRegionAddress WithLastColumnIndex(short lastColumnIndex)
		{
			if (lastColumnIndex == _lastColumnIndex)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new WorksheetRegionAddress(_firstRowIndex, _lastRowIndex, _firstColumnIndex, lastColumnIndex);
		}

		public WorksheetRegionAddress WithLastRowIndex(int lastRowIndex)
		{
			if (lastRowIndex == _lastRowIndex)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new WorksheetRegionAddress(_firstRowIndex, lastRowIndex, _firstColumnIndex, _lastColumnIndex);
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Row: Index - {GetIndexString(),nq}")]
	public class WorksheetRow : RowColumnBase
	{
		private enum InternalFlags : byte
		{
			Hidden = 1,
			HasThickTop = 2,
			HasThickBottom = 4,
			HasThickTopIsDirty = 8,
			HasThickBottomIsDirty = 16,
			HasCustomHeight = 32,
			WasRemoved = 64,
			ClonableFlags = 32
		}

		internal const int CellBlockSize = 32;

		internal const int MaxRowHeight = 8192;

		private const CellFormatValue ValuesAffectingResolvedHeight = CellFormatValue.Alignment | CellFormatValue.FontBold | CellFormatValue.FontHeight | CellFormatValue.FontItalic | CellFormatValue.FontName | CellFormatValue.FontStrikeout | CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle | CellFormatValue.FontUnderlineStyle | CellFormatValue.Style | CellFormatValue.WrapText;

		private WorksheetCellCollection cells;

		private short height = -1;

		private WorksheetCellBlock[] cellBlocks;

		private SortedList<short, CellCalcReference[]> _cellCalcReferences;

		private WorksheetCellFormatBlock[] cellFormatsForCells;

		private short resolvedRowHeight;

		private int index;

		private byte _collectionChangeVersion;

		private byte outlineLevel;

		private InternalFlags _flags;

		private byte _previousFormatOptions;

		internal override bool HasDataIgnoreHidden
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.HasDataIgnoreHidden)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (HasCustomHeight)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal override bool HiddenInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(InternalFlags.Hidden);
			}
			set
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.Hidden, value);
			}
		}

		public override int Index
		{
			get
			{
				Worksheet worksheet = base.Worksheet;
				if (worksheet == null || GetFlag(InternalFlags.WasRemoved))
				{
					return -1;
				}
				WorksheetRowCollection rows = worksheet.Rows;
				byte changeVersion = rows.ChangeVersion;
				if (changeVersion != _collectionChangeVersion)
				{
					int num = rows.AdjustIndex(index, _collectionChangeVersion);
					_collectionChangeVersion = changeVersion;
					if (num < 0)
					{
						SetFlag(InternalFlags.WasRemoved, value: true);
						return -1;
					}
					index = num;
				}
				return index;
			}
		}

		internal int IndexCached
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetFlag(InternalFlags.WasRemoved))
				{
					return index;
				}
				return Index;
			}
		}

		internal override byte OutlineLevelInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return outlineLevel;
			}
			set
			{
				outlineLevel = value;
			}
		}

		public WorksheetCellCollection Cells
		{
			get
			{
				if (cells == null)
				{
					cells = new WorksheetCellCollection(this);
				}
				return cells;
			}
		}

		public int Height
		{
			get
			{
				return GetHeight();
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyIsValid();
				if (Height == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value == 0)
				{
					base.Hidden = true;
					return;
				}
				if (value < -1)
				{
					value = -1;
				}
				if (8192 < value)
				{
					value = 8192;
				}
				WorksheetElementResizeContext worksheetElementResizeContext = null;
				if (base.Worksheet.DoesNeedElementResizeNotification)
				{
					worksheetElementResizeContext = WorksheetElementResizeContext.Create(this);
				}
				height = (short)value;
				if (HiddenInternal)
				{
					HiddenInternal = false;
					OnHiddenChanged();
				}
				HasCustomHeight = value >= 0;
				ResetResolvedRowHeight(notifyWorksheet: false);
				worksheetElementResizeContext?.Close();
			}
		}

				ResetResolvedRowHeight();

		internal override WorksheetCellFormatProxy CreateCellFormatProxy(GenericCachedCollectionEx<WorksheetCellFormatData> cellFormatCollection)
		{
			WorksheetCellFormatData otherFormat = cellFormatCollection?.DefaultElement;
			foreach (WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock in base.Worksheet.ColumnBlocks)
			{
				if (columnBlock.CellFormat.EqualsInternal(otherFormat))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (CellDataContext cellsWithDatum in GetCellsWithData(columnBlock.FirstColumnIndex, columnBlock.LastColumnIndex))
				{
					GetCellFormatInternal(cellsWithDatum.ColumnIndex);
				}
			}
			return new WorksheetRowOwnedCellFormatProxy(cellFormatCollection, this);
		}

		internal override WorksheetCellFormatData GetAdjacentFormatForBorderResolution(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue borderValue)
		{
			if (sender is WorksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy worksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = null;
				switch (borderValue)
				{
				case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
				{
					if (Index == 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					WorksheetRow ifCreated2 = base.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(Index - 1);
					return base.Worksheet.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(ifCreated2, worksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy.ColumnIndex);
				}
				case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
				{
					if (Index == base.Worksheet.Rows.MaxCount - 1)
					{
						return null;
					}
					WorksheetRow ifCreated = base.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(Index + 1);
					return base.Worksheet.GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(ifCreated, worksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy.ColumnIndex);
				}
				case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
					if (worksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy.ColumnIndex == 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return GetCellFormatElementReadOnly((short)(worksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy.ColumnIndex - 1));
				case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
				case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
					if (worksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy.ColumnIndex == base.Worksheet.Columns.MaxCount - 1)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return GetCellFormatElementReadOnly((short)(worksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy.ColumnIndex + 1));
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}
			switch (borderValue)
			{
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
			{
				if (Index == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				WorksheetRow ifCreated4 = base.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(Index - 1);
				if (ifCreated4 == null || !ifCreated4.HasCellFormat)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ifCreated4.CellFormatInternal.Element;
			}
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
			{
				if (Index == base.Worksheet.Rows.MaxCount - 1)
				{
					return null;
				}
				WorksheetRow ifCreated3 = base.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(Index + 1);
				if (ifCreated3 == null || !ifCreated3.HasCellFormat)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ifCreated3.CellFormatInternal.Element;
			}
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
				return null;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal override void OnCellFormatValueChanged(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue values, CellFormatValueChangedOptions options)
		{
			if (base.Worksheet.IsLoading)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (sender is WorksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy sender2)
			{
				OnCellOwnedFormatValueChanged(sender2, values, options);
				return;
			}
			if (DoesAffectResolvedheight(values))
			{
				ResetResolvedRowHeight();
			}
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue << 1))
			{
				if ((values & cellFormatValue) != 0 && !base.CellFormatInternal.IsValueDefault(cellFormatValue))
				{
					object value = sender.GetValue(cellFormatValue);
					switch (cellFormatValue)
					{
					case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
					case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
					{
						if (cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle || cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle)
						{
							VerifyNeighboringRowsAllocatedForBorderUpdate(sender, cellFormatValue);
							DirtyThicknesses();
						}
						if ((options & CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventAdjacentBorderSyncronization) != CellFormatValueChangedOptions.DefaultBehavior)
						{
							break;
						}
						int? num = null;
						if (cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo || cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle)
						{
							if (0 < Index)
							{
								num = Index - 1;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							int num2 = base.Worksheet.Rows.MaxCount - 1;
							if (Index < num2)
							{
								num = Index + 1;
							}
						}
						WorksheetRow worksheetRow = (num.HasValue ? base.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(num.Value) : null);
						if (worksheetRow == null)
						{
							break;
						}
						CellFormatValue oppositeBorderValue = Utilities.GetOppositeBorderValue(cellFormatValue);
						if (worksheetRow.HasCellFormat)
						{
							Utilities.SynchronizeOverlappingBorderProperties(sender, worksheetRow.CellFormatInternal, cellFormatValue, value, options);
						}
						CellFormatValue associatedBorderValue = Utilities.GetAssociatedBorderValue(oppositeBorderValue);
						foreach (CellFormatContext item in worksheetRow.GetCellFormatsForRowFormatValueSynchronization(oppositeBorderValue))
						{
							WorksheetCellFormatProxy proxy = item.GetProxy(worksheetRow);
							if (proxy.GetValue(oppositeBorderValue) != value)
							{
								proxy.ResetValue(oppositeBorderValue, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventAdjacentBorderSyncronization);
								proxy.ResetValue(associatedBorderValue, CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventAdjacentBorderSyncronization);
							}
						}
						break;
					}
					}
					bool flag = false;
					bool flag2 = false;
					DiagonalBorders diagonalBorders = DiagonalBorders.None;
					if (cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders)
					{
						diagonalBorders = (DiagonalBorders)value;
						DiagonalBorders previousDiagonalBorders = sender.Element.PreviousDiagonalBorders;
						flag = !Utilities.IsDiagonalDownSet(diagonalBorders) && Utilities.IsDiagonalDownSet(previousDiagonalBorders);
						flag2 = !Utilities.IsDiagonalUpSet(diagonalBorders) && Utilities.IsDiagonalUpSet(previousDiagonalBorders);
					}
					if ((options & CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventOwnerToCellSynchronization) == 0)
					{
						foreach (CellFormatContext item2 in GetCellFormatsForRowFormatValueSynchronization(cellFormatValue))
						{
							WorksheetMergedCellsRegion cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal = GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal(item2.ColumnIndex);
							if (cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal != null && cellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal.Height != 1)
							{
								continue;
							}
							WorksheetCellFormatProxy proxy2 = item2.GetProxy(this);
							object value2 = value;
							if (cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders)
							{
								DiagonalBorders diagonalBorders2 = diagonalBorders | proxy2.DiagonalBorders;
								if (flag)
								{
									Utilities.RemoveDiagonalDownBit(ref diagonalBorders2);
								}
								if (flag2)
								{
									Utilities.RemoveDiagonalUpBit(ref diagonalBorders2);
								}
								value2 = diagonalBorders2;
							}
							proxy2.SetValue(cellFormatValue, value2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatOptions worksheetCellFormatOptions = (WorksheetCellFormatOptions)((int)sender.FormatOptions & ~_previousFormatOptions);
			if (worksheetCellFormatOptions == WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock in base.Worksheet.ColumnBlocks)
			{
				if ((columnBlock.CellFormat.FormatOptions & worksheetCellFormatOptions) != WorksheetCellFormatOptions.None)
				{
					for (short num3 = columnBlock.FirstColumnIndex; num3 <= columnBlock.LastColumnIndex; num3++)
					{
						GetCellFormatInternal(num3);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnCellFormatValueChanging(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue values)
		{
			if (!(sender is WorksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy))
			{
				_previousFormatOptions = (byte)sender.FormatOptions;
			}
		}

		internal override void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			base.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			Workbook workbook = base.Worksheet.Workbook;
			foreach (CellDataContext cellsWithDatum in GetCellsWithData())
			{
				VerifyFormatLimitsOnCell(workbook, cellsWithDatum, limitErrors, testFormat);
			}
			int num = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(testFormat) - 1;
			if (num < Index)
			{
				limitErrors.AddError(string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_FormatLimitError_MaxRowIndex"), Index, num));
			}
		}

		}

		public void ApplyCellFormula(int columnIndex, string formula, CellReferenceMode? cellReferenceMode = null)
		{
			VerifyIsValid();
			Utilities.VerifyColumnIndex(base.Worksheet, columnIndex, "columnIndex");
			short columnIndex2 = (short)columnIndex;
			Workbook workbook = base.Worksheet.Workbook;
			bool flag = false;
			CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode2 = cellReferenceMode ?? workbook?.CellReferenceMode ?? CellReferenceMode.A1;
			if (cellReferenceMode2 == CellReferenceMode.R1C1)
			{
				if (workbook.ParsedR1C1Formulas.TryGetValue(formula, out var value))
				{
					value.ApplyTo(this, columnIndex2);
					return;
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			Formula formula2 = Formula.Parse(formula, workbook, cellReferenceMode2);
			if (flag)
			{
				workbook.ParsedR1C1Formulas.Add(formula, formula2);
			}
			formula2.ApplyTo(this, columnIndex2);
		}

				WorksheetCellBlock cellBlock = GetCellBlock(columnIndexResolved);

					return new WorksheetHyperlink(Cells[columnIndexResolved], hyperlinkResult.LinkLocation, hyperlinkResult.FriendlyName, isSealed: true);

		}

				foreach (WorksheetDataTable item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetDataTable>)worksheet.DataTables)
				{
					if (item.IsInExteriorArea(this, columnIndex, out var isCellInTable))
					{
						return item;

					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void SetCellCommentInternal(short columnIndex, WorksheetCellComment comment)
		{
			WorksheetCellComment cellCommentInternal = GetCellCommentInternal(columnIndex);
			if (cellCommentInternal == comment)
			{
				return;
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = base.Worksheet;
			if (comment != null)
			{
				if (comment.TopLeftCornerCell == null && comment.BottomRightCornerCell == null)
				{
					InitializeDefaultCommentBounds(columnIndex, comment);
				}
				if (comment.TopLeftCornerCell == null || comment.BottomRightCornerCell == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_AnchorCommentBeforeApplyingToCell"));
				}
				comment.OnSitedOnWorksheet(worksheet);
			}
			if (cellCommentInternal != null)
			{
				cellCommentInternal.Cell = null;
			}
			WorksheetCellAddress key = new WorksheetCellAddress(Index, columnIndex);
			if (comment == null)
			{
				if (worksheet.HasCellOwnedComments)
				{
					worksheet.CellOwnedComments.Remove(key);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				worksheet.CellOwnedComments[key] = comment;
			}
			Workbook workbook = worksheet.Workbook;
			if (comment == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			comment.Cell = Cells[columnIndex];
			if (comment.Author == null)
			{
				if (workbook != null && workbook.DocumentProperties.Author != null)
				{
					comment.Author = workbook.DocumentProperties.Author;
				}
				else
				{
					comment.Author = string.Empty;
				}
			}
		}

		private short CalculateHeight()
		{
			Workbook workbook = base.Worksheet.Workbook;
			int num = 0;
			if (HasThickTop || HasThickBottom)
			{
				double num2 = Workbook.GetTwipsPerPixel(workbook, vertical: true);
				if (HasThickTop && HasThickBottom)
				{
					num2 *= 2.0;
				}
				num = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num2);
			}
			int num3;
			if (HeightInternal < 0)
			{
				num3 = base.Worksheet.MeasuredRowHeight;
				if (base.Worksheet.DefaultRowHasThickTop || base.Worksheet.DefaultRowHasThickBottom)
				{
					double num4 = Workbook.GetTwipsPerPixel(workbook, vertical: true);
					if (base.Worksheet.DefaultRowHasThickTop && base.Worksheet.DefaultRowHasThickBottom)
					{
						num4 *= 2.0;
					}
					num3 -= (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num4);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = HeightInternal - num;
			}
			using (TextMetricsProviderBase metricsProvider = Workbook.CreateDefaultTextMetricsProvider(workbook))
			{
				CellSizeMeasurementContext cellSizeMeasurementContext = new CellSizeMeasurementContext(base.Worksheet.Workbook, metricsProvider);
				if (base.HasCellFormat)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatData element = base.CellFormatInternal.Element;
					num3 = cellSizeMeasurementContext.GetDefaultRowHeightInTwips(element);
				}
				int num5 = (int)Math.Floor((double)base.Worksheet.ZeroCharacterWidth * 0.35);
				int maxColumnCount = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(base.Worksheet.CurrentFormat);
				foreach (CellDataContext cellsWithDatum in GetCellsWithData())
				{
					short columnIndex = cellsWithDatum.ColumnIndex;
					WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = cellsWithDatum.CellFormatData ?? GetCellFormatElementReadOnly(columnIndex);
					short num6 = columnIndex;
					if (worksheetCellFormatData.AlignmentResolved == HorizontalCellAlignment.CenterAcrossSelection)
					{
						num6 = GetNextClippingColumn(columnIndex, maxColumnCount, HorizontalCellAlignment.CenterAcrossSelection);
					}
					int num7 = 0;
					for (int i = columnIndex; i <= num6; i++)
					{
						num7 += base.Worksheet.GetColumnWidthIn256ths(i);
					}
					int val = (int)base.Worksheet.ConvertFromCharacter256thsIntHorizontal(num7, WorksheetColumnWidthUnit.Pixel) - (worksheetCellFormatData.ComputedLeftIndent + worksheetCellFormatData.ComputedRightIndent) * base.Worksheet.IndentWidth - base.Worksheet.GetColumnWidthPadding() - num5;
					val = Math.Max(val, 0);
					string cellTextToMeasure = GetCellTextToMeasure(columnIndex, cellsWithDatum.CellBlock, worksheetCellFormatData);
					int val2 = ((cellTextToMeasure == null) ? cellSizeMeasurementContext.GetDefaultRowHeightInTwips(worksheetCellFormatData) : cellSizeMeasurementContext.GetHeightInTwips(worksheetCellFormatData, cellTextToMeasure, val));
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, val2);
				}
			}
			return (short)Math.Min(num3 + num, 8192);
		}

		private string GetCellTextToMeasure(short columnIndex, WorksheetCellBlock cellBlock, WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat)
		{
			if (cellBlock != null && cellFormat.ComputedWrapText && cellBlock.IsCellValueSavedAsString(this, columnIndex) && GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal(columnIndex) == null)
			{

				getCellTextParameters.TextFormatMode = TextFormatMode.IgnoreCellWidth;
				getCellTextParameters.PreventTextFormattingTypes = PreventTextFormattingTypes.None;
				return GetCellTextInternal(cellBlock, getCellTextParameters).Text;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void ClearCells(short firstColumnIndex, short lastColumnIndex, WorksheetRow rowForInitializingCellFormats = null, int? columnIndexForInitializingCellFormats = null)
		{

				{
					cellsWithDatum.CellBlock.ClearCell(this, cellsWithDatum.ColumnIndex);
				}
			}
			for (short num = firstColumnIndex; num <= lastColumnIndex; num++)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormatInternal = GetCellFormatInternal(num);

				}
				else if (rowForInitializingCellFormats != null)

					cellFormatInternal.SetFormatting(rowForInitializingCellFormats.GetCellFormatInternal(num));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DirtyThicknesses(bool dirtyNeighbors = true)
		{
			if (HasThickBottomIsDirty && HasThickTopIsDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			HasThickBottomIsDirty = true;
			HasThickTopIsDirty = true;
			ResetResolvedRowHeight();

			{
				if (0 < Index)
				{
					base.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(Index - 1)?.DirtyThicknesses(dirtyNeighbors: false);
				}
				int num = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(base.Worksheet.CurrentFormat) - 1;
				if (Index < num)
				{
					base.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(Index + 1)?.DirtyThicknesses(dirtyNeighbors: false);
				}
			}
		}
