		internal IEnumerable<CellDataContext> GetCellsWithData(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			WorksheetCellBlock[] cacheBlocks = cellBlocks;
			int index = -1;
			IEnumerator<WorksheetCellFormatBlock> cellFormatBlocks = null;
			WorksheetCellFormatData defaultCellFormat = null;
			Workbook workbook = base.Worksheet.Workbook;
			if (workbook != null)
			{
				if (HasCellFormatsForCells)
				{
					cellFormatBlocks = ((IEnumerable<WorksheetCellFormatBlock>)CellFormatsForCells).GetEnumerator();
				}
				defaultCellFormat = workbook.CellFormats.DefaultElement;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatData rowFormat = defaultCellFormat;
			if (base.HasCellFormat)
			{
				rowFormat = base.CellFormatInternal.Element;
			}
			WorksheetCellBlock nextCellBlock = null;
			WorksheetCellFormatBlock? nextCellFormatBlockPair = null;
			while (cacheBlocks != null || cellFormatBlocks != null)
			{
				if (nextCellBlock == null && cacheBlocks != null)
				{
					int num;
					index = (num = index + 1);
					if (num < cellBlocks.Length)
					{
						nextCellBlock = cellBlocks[index];
					}
					if (nextCellBlock == null)
					{
						cacheBlocks = null;
					}
				}
				if (!nextCellFormatBlockPair.HasValue && cellFormatBlocks != null)
				{
					if (cellFormatBlocks.MoveNext() && cellFormatBlocks.Current.CellFormats != null)
					{
						nextCellFormatBlockPair = cellFormatBlocks.Current;
					}
					else
					{
						cellFormatBlocks.Dispose();
						cellFormatBlocks = null;
					}
				}
				short currentBlockIndex = short.MaxValue;
				if (nextCellBlock != null)
				{
					currentBlockIndex = Math.Min(currentBlockIndex, nextCellBlock.BlockIndex);
				}
				if (nextCellFormatBlockPair.HasValue)
				{
					currentBlockIndex = Math.Min(currentBlockIndex, nextCellFormatBlockPair.Value.BlockIndex);
				}
				WorksheetCellBlock currentCellBlock = null;
				if (nextCellBlock != null && nextCellBlock.BlockIndex == currentBlockIndex)
				{
					currentCellBlock = nextCellBlock;
					nextCellBlock = null;
				}
				WorksheetCellFormatData[] currentCellFormatBlock = null;
				if (nextCellFormatBlockPair.HasValue && nextCellFormatBlockPair.Value.BlockIndex == currentBlockIndex)
				{
					currentCellFormatBlock = nextCellFormatBlockPair.Value.CellFormats;
					nextCellFormatBlockPair = null;
				}
				int startColumnIndex = currentBlockIndex * 32;
				if (endIndex < startColumnIndex)
				{
					break;
				}
				for (int i = Math.Max(0, startIndex - startColumnIndex); i < 32; i++)
				{
					short columnIndex = (short)(startColumnIndex + i);
					if (endIndex < columnIndex)
					{
						yield break;
					}
					CellDataContext cellDataContext = GetCellDataContext(currentCellBlock, (currentCellFormatBlock == null) ? null : currentCellFormatBlock[i], rowFormat, defaultCellFormat, columnIndex);
					if (cellDataContext != null)
					{
						yield return cellDataContext;
						currentCellBlock = cellDataContext.CellBlock;
						if (cellDataContext.CellFormatDataWasCleared && currentCellFormatBlock != null)
						{
							currentCellFormatBlock[i] = null;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void RehookCells(Worksheet sheet, Dictionary<WorksheetCellAddress, Formula> cellFormulas)
		{

		internal void OnCellOwnedFormatValueChanged(WorksheetCellOwnedFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue values, CellFormatValueChangedOptions options)
		{
			if (cells != null)
			{
				cells.DirtyCellCount();
			}
			if (DoesAffectResolvedheight(values))
			{
				ResetResolvedRowHeight();
			}
			WorksheetMergedCellsRegion worksheetMergedCellsRegion = null;
			if ((options & CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventCellToMergedRegionSyncronization) == 0)
			{
				worksheetMergedCellsRegion = GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal(sender.ColumnIndex);
			}
			Dictionary<CellFormatValue, WorksheetCellFormatProxy> dictionary = new Dictionary<CellFormatValue, WorksheetCellFormatProxy>(8);
			WorksheetCellBlock worksheetCellBlock = TryGetCellBlock(sender.ColumnIndex);
			for (CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.Alignment; cellFormatValue != CellFormatValue._EndValue; cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue << 1))
			{
				if ((values & cellFormatValue) != 0)
				{
					switch (cellFormatValue)
					{
					case CellFormatValue.Alignment:
					case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorders:
					case CellFormatValue.DiagonalBorderStyle:
					case CellFormatValue.Fill:
					case CellFormatValue.FormatOptions:
					case CellFormatValue.FormatString:
					case CellFormatValue.Indent:
					case CellFormatValue.Locked:
					case CellFormatValue.Rotation:
					case CellFormatValue.ShrinkToFit:
					case CellFormatValue.VerticalAlignment:
					case CellFormatValue.WrapText:
						if (worksheetMergedCellsRegion != null)
						{
							Utilities.CopyCellFormatValue(sender, worksheetMergedCellsRegion.CellFormatInternal, cellFormatValue);
						}
						break;
					case CellFormatValue.Style:
					{
						if (worksheetMergedCellsRegion != null)
						{
							Utilities.CopyCellFormatValue(sender, worksheetMergedCellsRegion.CellFormatInternal, cellFormatValue);
						}
						WorkbookStyle style = sender.Style;
						if (style != null && Utilities.TestFlag(style.StyleFormatInternal.FormatOptions, WorksheetCellFormatOptions.ApplyFontFormatting) && worksheetCellBlock != null && worksheetCellBlock.GetCellValueIfFormattedString(this, sender.ColumnIndex) is FormattedStringElement formattedStringElement2)
						{
							formattedStringElement2.ClearFormatting();
						}
						break;
					}
					case CellFormatValue.FontBold:
					case CellFormatValue.FontColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.FontHeight:
					case CellFormatValue.FontItalic:
					case CellFormatValue.FontName:
					case CellFormatValue.FontStrikeout:
					case CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle:
					case CellFormatValue.FontUnderlineStyle:
					{
						if (worksheetMergedCellsRegion != null)
						{
							Utilities.CopyCellFormatValue(sender, worksheetMergedCellsRegion.CellFormatInternal, cellFormatValue);
						}
						if (worksheetCellBlock == null)
						{
							break;
						}
						StringElement element = worksheetCellBlock.GetCellValueIfFormattedString(this, sender.ColumnIndex);
						if (element == null || !element.HasFormatting)
						{
							break;
						}
						Workbook workbook = base.Worksheet.Workbook;
						SharedStringTable collection = workbook?.SharedStringTable;
						GenericCacheElement.BeforeSet(collection, ref element, willModifyElement: true);
						FormattedStringElement formattedStringElement = (FormattedStringElement)element;
						foreach (FormattedStringRun formattingRun in formattedStringElement.FormattingRuns)
						{
							if (formattingRun.HasFont)
							{
								IWorkbookFont font = formattingRun.GetFont(workbook);
								switch (cellFormatValue)
								{
								case CellFormatValue.FontBold:
									font.Bold = sender.Font.Bold;
									break;
								case CellFormatValue.FontColorInfo:
									font.ColorInfo = sender.Font.ColorInfo;
									break;
								case CellFormatValue.FontHeight:
									font.Height = sender.Font.Height;
									break;
								case CellFormatValue.FontItalic:
									font.Italic = sender.Font.Italic;
									break;
								case CellFormatValue.FontName:
									font.Name = sender.Font.Name;
									break;
								case CellFormatValue.FontStrikeout:
									font.Strikeout = sender.Font.Strikeout;
									break;
								case CellFormatValue.FontSuperscriptSubscriptStyle:
									font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle = sender.Font.SuperscriptSubscriptStyle;
									break;
								case CellFormatValue.FontUnderlineStyle:
									font.UnderlineStyle = sender.Font.UnderlineStyle;
									break;
								}
							}
						}
						GenericCacheElement.AfterSet(collection, ref element);
						worksheetCellBlock.UpdateFormattedStringElement(sender.ColumnIndex, element);
						break;
					}
					case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
					case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
					case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
					case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
					case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
						if (cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle || cellFormatValue == CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle)
						{
							VerifyNeighboringRowsAllocatedForBorderUpdate(sender, cellFormatValue);
							DirtyThicknesses();
						}
						worksheetMergedCellsRegion?.OnCellBorderValueChanged(this, sender.ColumnIndex, cellFormatValue);
						if ((options & CellFormatValueChangedOptions.PreventAdjacentBorderSyncronization) == 0 && !sender.IsValueDefault(cellFormatValue))
						{
							if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(cellFormatValue, out var value))
							{
								value = (dictionary[cellFormatValue] = GetAdjacentBorderCellFormat(sender.ColumnIndex, cellFormatValue, base.Worksheet.CurrentFormat));
								dictionary[Utilities.GetAssociatedBorderValue(cellFormatValue)] = value;
							}
							if (value != null)
							{
								Utilities.SynchronizeOverlappingBorderProperties(sender, value, cellFormatValue, sender.GetValue(cellFormatValue), options);
							}
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (worksheetCellBlock == null || !worksheetCellBlock.GetIsSpecial(sender.ColumnIndex))
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetTable cellAssociatedTableInternal = GetCellAssociatedTableInternal(sender.ColumnIndex);
			if (cellAssociatedTableInternal == null || cellAssociatedTableInternal.IsResizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = sender.ColumnIndex - cellAssociatedTableInternal.WholeTableAddress.FirstColumnIndex;
			if (num < 0 || cellAssociatedTableInternal.Columns.Count <= num)
			{
				return;
			}
			CellFormatValue cellFormatValue2 = values;
			Workbook workbook2 = base.Worksheet.Workbook;
			WorksheetTableColumn worksheetTableColumn = cellAssociatedTableInternal.Columns[num];
			WorksheetCell headerCell = worksheetTableColumn.HeaderCell;
			if (headerCell != null && headerCell.Row == this && headerCell.ColumnIndex == sender.ColumnIndex)
			{
				cellFormatValue2 &= ~CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo;
				cellFormatValue2 &= ~CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle;
				Utilities.CopyCellFormatValues(sender, worksheetTableColumn.AreaFormats.GetFormatProxy(workbook2, WorksheetTableColumnArea.HeaderCell), cellFormatValue2);
				return;
			}
			WorksheetCell totalCell = worksheetTableColumn.TotalCell;
			if (totalCell != null && totalCell.Row == this && totalCell.ColumnIndex == sender.ColumnIndex)
			{
				cellFormatValue2 &= ~CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo;
				cellFormatValue2 &= ~CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle;
				Utilities.CopyCellFormatValues(sender, worksheetTableColumn.AreaFormats.GetFormatProxy(workbook2, WorksheetTableColumnArea.TotalCell), cellFormatValue2);
			}
		}

		internal CellCalcReference TryGetCellCalcReference(short columnIndex, bool createReferenceIfCellHasValue = false)

			}

		}

		private WorksheetCellFormatData TryGetCellFormat(short columnIndex, out WorksheetCellFormatData[] cellFormatBlock)
		{

				return null;
			}
			short blockIndex = (short)(columnIndex / 32);
			int num = BinarySearchForCellFormatBlock(blockIndex);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				cellFormatBlock = null;
				return null;
			}
			cellFormatBlock = cellFormatsForCells[num].CellFormats;
			short num2 = (short)(columnIndex % 32);
			return cellFormatBlock[num2];
		}

		internal void UnrootAllCellFormatsForCells()
		{
			if (!HasCellFormatsForCells)
			{
				return;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatBlock[] array = CellFormatsForCells;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatBlock worksheetCellFormatBlock = array[i];
				WorksheetCellFormatData[] cellFormats = worksheetCellFormatBlock.CellFormats;
				if (cellFormats == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				for (short num = 0; num < 32; num++)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatData worksheetCellFormatData = cellFormats[num];
					if (worksheetCellFormatData != null)
					{
						GenericCacheElementEx.ReleaseEx(worksheetCellFormatData);
						if (worksheetCellFormatData.ReferenceCount > 0)
						{
							cellFormats[num] = worksheetCellFormatData.CloneInternal();
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UnhookCells(SharedStringTable stringTable)
		{
			if (base.HasCellFormat)
			{
				base.CellFormatInternal.OnUnrooted();
			}
			UnrootAllCellFormatsForCells();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<short, WorksheetCellBlock> cellBlocksWithValue in GetCellBlocksWithValues())
			{
				WorksheetCellBlock value = cellBlocksWithValue.Value;
				short key = cellBlocksWithValue.Key;
				WorksheetCellBlock.AllInfoCache allInfo = value.GetAllInfo(key);
				object cellValueRaw = value.GetCellValueRaw(this, key, null, allInfo.DataType, allInfo.CellValue);
				StringElement element = Utilities.GetFormattedStringElement(cellValueRaw);
				if (element != null)
				{
					if (cellValueRaw is IFormattedString formattedString)
					{
						formattedString.SetWorkbook(null);
						element = Utilities.GetFormattedStringElement(formattedString);
					}
					else
					{
						GenericCachedCollection<StringElement> collection = stringTable;
						GenericCacheElement.SetCollection(null, ref collection, ref element);
					}
					if (allInfo.DataType == WorksheetCellBlock.DataType.FormattedString || allInfo.DataType == WorksheetCellBlock.DataType.String)
					{
						value.UpdateFormattedStringElement(key, element);
					}
				}
			}
			if (_cellCalcReferences == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CellCalcReference[] value2 in _cellCalcReferences.Values)
			{
				foreach (CellCalcReference cellCalcReference in value2)
				{
					if (cellCalcReference != null && cellCalcReference.IsPrimaryOwnerOfFormula)
					{
						Formula excelFormula = cellCalcReference.ExcelFormula;
						if (excelFormula != null)
						{
							excelFormula.DisconnectReferences();
							cellCalcReference.SetAndCompileFormula(null, canClearPreviouslyCalculatedValue: false);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private int BinarySearchForCellBlock(short blockIndex)
		{
			if (cellBlocks == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = cellBlocks.Length - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num) / 2;
				WorksheetCellBlock worksheetCellBlock = cellBlocks[num3];
				if (worksheetCellBlock == null)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				int num4 = worksheetCellBlock.BlockIndex - blockIndex;
				if (num4 == 0)
				{
					return num3;
				}
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
				}
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		private int BinarySearchForCellFormatBlock(short blockIndex)
		{
			if (cellFormatsForCells == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = cellFormatsForCells.Length - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num) / 2;
				WorksheetCellFormatBlock worksheetCellFormatBlock = cellFormatsForCells[num3];
				if (worksheetCellFormatBlock.CellFormats == null)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				int num4 = worksheetCellFormatBlock.BlockIndex - blockIndex;
				if (num4 == 0)
				{
					return num3;
				}
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
				}
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		private void GetAdjacentBorderCellFormatHelper(short columnIndex, CellFormatValue value, WorkbookFormat currentFormat, bool getMergedRegion, bool getProxy, out WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormatData, out WorksheetCellFormatProxy cellFormatProxy, out WorksheetMergedCellsRegion associatedMergedCellsRegion)
		{
			cellFormatData = null;
			cellFormatProxy = null;
			associatedMergedCellsRegion = null;
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = null;
			short columnIndex2 = 0;
			switch (value)
			{
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.BottomBorderStyle:
				if (Index + 1 < Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(currentFormat))
				{
					worksheetRow = base.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(Index + 1);
					columnIndex2 = columnIndex;
				}
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.LeftBorderStyle:
				if (columnIndex > 0)
				{
					worksheetRow = this;
					columnIndex2 = (short)(columnIndex - 1);
				}
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.RightBorderStyle:
				if (columnIndex + 1 < Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(currentFormat))
				{
					worksheetRow = this;
					columnIndex2 = (short)(columnIndex + 1);
				}
				break;
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderColorInfo:
			case CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle:
				if (Index > 0)
				{
					worksheetRow = base.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(Index - 1);
					columnIndex2 = columnIndex;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (worksheetRow != null)
			{
				if (getMergedRegion)
				{
					associatedMergedCellsRegion = GetCellAssociatedMergedCellsRegionInternal(columnIndex);
				}
				if (getProxy)
				{
					cellFormatProxy = worksheetRow.TryGetCellFormatProxy(columnIndex2);
				}
				else
				{
					cellFormatData = worksheetRow.TryGetCellFormat(columnIndex2);
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<CellFormatContext> GetCellFormatsForRowFormatValueSynchronization(CellFormatValue value)
		{
			try
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatBlock[] array = CellFormatsForCells;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatBlock pair = array[i];
					WorksheetCellFormatData[] cellFormatBlock = pair.CellFormats;
					if (cellFormatBlock == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					int startColumnIndex = pair.BlockIndex * 32;
					for (short indexInBlock = 0; indexInBlock < 32; indexInBlock++)
					{
						WorksheetCellFormatData data = cellFormatBlock[indexInBlock];
						if (data != null)
						{
							short currentColumnIndex = (short)(startColumnIndex + indexInBlock);
							yield return new CellFormatContext(currentColumnIndex, data, cellFormatBlock);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
			}
		}

		private void InitializeDefaultCellProxyData(short columnIndex, WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = base.Worksheet;
			WorksheetColumnBlock columnBlock = worksheet.GetColumnBlock(columnIndex);
			CellFormatValue cellFormatValue = CellFormatValue.Alignment;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (cellFormatValue)
				{
				default:
					if (!ResolveCellFormatPropertyFromOwner(cellFormat, this, cellFormatValue))
					{
						ResolveCellFormatPropertyFromOwner(cellFormat, columnBlock.CellFormat, cellFormatValue);
					}
					break;
				case CellFormatValue.FormatOptions:
					break;
				case CellFormatValue._EndValue:
					return;
				}
				cellFormatValue = (CellFormatValue)((int)cellFormatValue << 1);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeDefaultCommentBounds(short columnIndex, WorksheetCellComment comment)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = base.Worksheet;
			WorkbookFormat currentFormat = worksheet.CurrentFormat;
			int maxRowCount = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(currentFormat);
			int maxColumnCount = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(currentFormat);
			Rectangle cellBoundsInTwipsInternal = GetCellBoundsInTwipsInternal(columnIndex);
			int num = cellBoundsInTwipsInternal.Right + 240;
			int num2 = Math.Max(30, cellBoundsInTwipsInternal.Top - 150);
			int right = worksheet.Rows[0].GetCellBoundsInTwipsInternal((short)(maxColumnCount - 1)).Right;
			if (num + 2160 + 30 > right)
			{
				num = cellBoundsInTwipsInternal.Left - 240 - 2160;
			}
			int bottom = worksheet.Rows[maxRowCount - 1].GetCellBoundsInTwipsInternal(0).Bottom;
			if (num2 + 1185 + 30 > bottom)
			{
				int num3 = Math.Min(bottom - 30, cellBoundsInTwipsInternal.Top + 120);
				num2 = num3 - 1185;
			}
			Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(num, num2, 2160, 1185);
			comment.SetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, bounds);
		}

		private void InsertCellBlock(int index, WorksheetCellBlock cellBlock)
		{
			if (cellBlocks == null)
			{
				cellBlocks = new WorksheetCellBlock[1] { cellBlock };
				return;
			}
			if (cellBlocks[cellBlocks.Length - 1] == null)
			{
				Array.Copy(cellBlocks, index, cellBlocks, index + 1, cellBlocks.Length - index - 1);
				cellBlocks[index] = cellBlock;
				return;
			}
			WorksheetCellBlock[] array = new WorksheetCellBlock[cellBlocks.Length * 2];
			Array.Copy(cellBlocks, array, index);
			array[index] = cellBlock;
			Array.Copy(cellBlocks, index, array, index + 1, cellBlocks.Length - index);
			cellBlocks = array;
		}

		private void InsertCellFormatBlock(int index, WorksheetCellFormatBlock cellFormatBlock)
		{
			if (cellFormatsForCells == null)
			{
				cellFormatsForCells = new WorksheetCellFormatBlock[1] { cellFormatBlock };
				return;
			}
			if (cellFormatsForCells[cellFormatsForCells.Length - 1].CellFormats == null)
			{
				Array.Copy(cellFormatsForCells, index, cellFormatsForCells, index + 1, cellFormatsForCells.Length - index - 1);
				cellFormatsForCells[index] = cellFormatBlock;
				return;
			}
			WorksheetCellFormatBlock[] array = new WorksheetCellFormatBlock[cellFormatsForCells.Length * 2];
			Array.Copy(cellFormatsForCells, array, index);
			array[index] = cellFormatBlock;
			Array.Copy(cellFormatsForCells, index, array, index + 1, cellFormatsForCells.Length - index);
			cellFormatsForCells = array;
		}

		private static bool ResolveCellFormatPropertyFromOwner(WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat, ICellFormatOwner owner, CellFormatValue valueToSync)
		{
			if (!owner.HasCellFormat)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ResolveCellFormatPropertyFromOwner(cellFormat, owner.CellFormatInternal.Element, valueToSync);
		}

		private static bool ResolveCellFormatPropertyFromOwner(WorksheetCellFormatData cellFormat, WorksheetCellFormatData ownerCellFormat, CellFormatValue valueToSync)
		{
			if (WorksheetCellFormatData.IsValueDefault(valueToSync, ownerCellFormat.GetValue(valueToSync)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Utilities.CopyCellFormatValue(ownerCellFormat, cellFormat, valueToSync);
			return true;
		}

		private void SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_flags &= (InternalFlags)(byte)(~(int)flag);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateThicknesses()
		{
			BorderThickness maxTopThickness = BorderThickness.Thin;
			BorderThickness maxBottomThickness = BorderThickness.Thin;
			int maxRowCount = Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(base.Worksheet.CurrentFormat);
			bool flag = 0 < Index;
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = (flag ? base.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(Index - 1) : null);
			bool flag2 = Index < maxRowCount - 1;
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow2 = (flag2 ? base.Worksheet.Rows.GetIfCreated(Index + 1) : null);
			UpdateThicknessesFromCurrentRow(ref maxTopThickness, ref maxBottomThickness, maxRowCount);
			if (maxTopThickness == BorderThickness.Thin)
			{
				UpdateThicknessesFromNeighborRow(worksheetRow, ref maxTopThickness, maxRowCount, (WorksheetCellFormatData format) => format.BottomBorderStyleResolved);
			}
			if (maxBottomThickness == BorderThickness.Thin)
			{
				UpdateThicknessesFromNeighborRow(worksheetRow2, ref maxBottomThickness, maxRowCount, (WorksheetCellFormatData format) => format.TopBorderStyleResolved);
			}
			HasThickTop = maxTopThickness == BorderThickness.Thick;
			HasThickBottom = (int)maxBottomThickness >= 1;
			if (flag)
			{
				bool flag3 = worksheetRow?.HasThickBottomInternal ?? base.Worksheet.DefaultRowHasThickBottom;
				bool flag4 = (int)maxTopThickness >= 1;
				if (flag3 != flag4)
				{
					base.Worksheet.Rows[Index - 1].HasThickBottom = flag4;
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				bool flag5 = worksheetRow2?.HasThickTopInternal ?? base.Worksheet.DefaultRowHasThickTop;
				bool flag6 = maxBottomThickness == BorderThickness.Thick;
				if (flag5 != flag6)
				{
					base.Worksheet.Rows[Index + 1].HasThickTop = flag6;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateThicknessesFromCurrentRow(ref BorderThickness maxTopThickness, ref BorderThickness maxBottomThickness, int maxRowCount)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int num = 0;
			WorksheetCellFormatBlock[] array = CellFormatsForCells;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				WorksheetCellFormatBlock worksheetCellFormatBlock = array[i];
				if (worksheetCellFormatBlock.CellFormats == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (worksheetCellFormatBlock.BlockIndex != num)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				WorksheetCellFormatData[] cellFormats = worksheetCellFormatBlock.CellFormats;
				for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++)
				{
					if (cellFormats[j] == null)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						if (maxTopThickness != BorderThickness.Thick)
						{
							maxTopThickness = Utilities.Max(maxTopThickness, cellFormats[j].TopBorderStyleResolved.GetThickness());
						}
						if (maxBottomThickness != BorderThickness.Thick)
						{
							maxBottomThickness = Utilities.Max(maxBottomThickness, cellFormats[j].BottomBorderStyleResolved.GetThickness());
						}
					}
					if (maxTopThickness == BorderThickness.Thick && maxBottomThickness == BorderThickness.Thick)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (maxTopThickness == BorderThickness.Thick && maxBottomThickness == BorderThickness.Thick)
				{
					break;
				}
				num = worksheetCellFormatBlock.BlockIndex + 32;
			}
			if (num != maxRowCount)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (maxTopThickness != BorderThickness.Thick && base.HasCellFormat)
				{
					maxTopThickness = Utilities.Max(maxTopThickness, base.CellFormatInternal.Element.TopBorderStyleResolved.GetThickness());
				}
				if (maxBottomThickness != BorderThickness.Thick && base.HasCellFormat)
				{
					maxBottomThickness = Utilities.Max(maxBottomThickness, base.CellFormatInternal.Element.BottomBorderStyleResolved.GetThickness());
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateThicknessesFromNeighborRow(WorksheetRow neighborRow, ref BorderThickness maxTopThickness, int maxRowCount, Func<WorksheetCellFormatData, CellBorderLineStyle> borderStyleGetter)
		{
			if (neighborRow != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				int num = 0;
				WorksheetCellFormatBlock[] array = neighborRow.CellFormatsForCells;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					WorksheetCellFormatBlock worksheetCellFormatBlock = array[i];
					if (worksheetCellFormatBlock.CellFormats == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (worksheetCellFormatBlock.BlockIndex != num)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					WorksheetCellFormatData[] cellFormats = worksheetCellFormatBlock.CellFormats;
					for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++)
					{
						if (maxTopThickness == BorderThickness.Thick)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (cellFormats[j] == null)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							maxTopThickness = Utilities.Max(maxTopThickness, borderStyleGetter(cellFormats[j]).GetThickness());
						}
					}
					if (maxTopThickness == BorderThickness.Thick)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num != maxRowCount)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag && maxTopThickness != BorderThickness.Thick)
				{
					maxTopThickness = Utilities.Max(maxTopThickness, borderStyleGetter(neighborRow.CellFormatInternal.Element).GetThickness());
				}
			}
			else if (base.Worksheet.DefaultRowHasThickTop)
			{
				maxTopThickness = BorderThickness.Thick;
			}
			else if (base.Worksheet.DefaultRowHasThickBottom)
			{
				maxTopThickness = BorderThickness.Medium;
			}
		}

		private void VerifyFormatLimitsOnCell(Workbook workbook, CellDataContext cellDataContext, FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			int num = Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(testFormat) - 1;
			if (num < cellDataContext.ColumnIndex)
			{
				limitErrors.AddError(string.Format(Utilities.GetString("LE_FormatLimitError_MaxColumnIndex"), cellDataContext.ColumnIndex, num));
			}
			if (cellDataContext.HasValue && cellDataContext.CellBlock != null && cellDataContext.CellBlock.GetCellValueRaw(this, cellDataContext.ColumnIndex) is Formula formula)
			{
				CellReferenceMode cellReferenceMode = base.Worksheet.CellReferenceMode;
				formula.VerifyFormatLimits(workbook, limitErrors, testFormat, cellReferenceMode, parseFormula: true, null, -1);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyNeighboringRowsAllocatedForBorderUpdate(WorksheetCellFormatProxy sender, CellFormatValue value)
		{
			if (value == CellFormatValue.TopBorderStyle)
			{
				if (Index != 0 && sender.TopBorderStyle.GetThickness() != BorderThickness.Thin)
				{
					base.Worksheet.Rows.GetItem(Index - 1);
				}
			}
			else if (Index != base.Worksheet.Rows.MaxCount - 1 && sender.TopBorderStyle.GetThickness() == BorderThickness.Thick)
			{
				base.Worksheet.Rows.GetItem(Index + 1);
			}
		}

		internal int GetHeight(bool treatAsVisible = false)
		{
			if (!treatAsVisible && base.Hidden)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (!HasCustomHeight)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return height;
		}
	}
	internal class CellSizeMeasurementContext
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<WorksheetCellFormatData, double> _defaultRowHeightsForFont;

		private readonly TextMetricsProviderBase _metricsProvider;

		private readonly Dictionary<WorksheetCellFormatData, Size> _singleLineSizesByFont;

		private readonly Workbook _workbook;

		public CellSizeMeasurementContext(Workbook workbook, TextMetricsProviderBase metricsProvider)
		{
			_defaultRowHeightsForFont = new Dictionary<WorksheetCellFormatData, double>();
			_singleLineSizesByFont = new Dictionary<WorksheetCellFormatData, Size>();
			_workbook = workbook;
			_metricsProvider = metricsProvider;
		}

		public double GetAutoFitWidth(WorksheetCellFormatData format, string cellText, int rowHeightInTwips, int columnWidthInPixels)
		{
			bool computedWrapText = format.ComputedWrapText;
			int crlfCount = GetCrlfCount(cellText);
			if (computedWrapText)
			{
				return MeasureWrappedText(format, cellText, rowHeightInTwips, Math.Max(columnWidthInPixels, 1), crlfCount);
			}
			int num = _metricsProvider.MeasureText(format, cellText, null, scaleForDpi: true, crlfCount > 0).Width;
			if (crlfCount > 0)
			{
				num += crlfCount * 8;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public int GetDefaultRowHeightInTwips(WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			return (int)Workbook.ConvertPixelsToTwips(_workbook, _metricsProvider.GetDefaultRowHeight(format), vertical: true);
		}

		public int GetHeightInTwips(WorksheetCellFormatData format, string cellText, int columnWidth)
		{
			double heightInPixels = GetHeightInPixels(format, cellText, columnWidth);
			return (int)Math.Ceiling(Workbook.ConvertPixelsToTwips(_workbook, heightInPixels, vertical: true));
		}

		private static int GetCrlfCount(string text)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = -1;
			while ((num2 = text.IndexOf('\r', num2 + 1)) > 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
			num2 = -1;
			while ((num2 = text.IndexOf('\n', num2 + 1)) > 0)
			{
				if (num2 == 0 || text[num2 - 1] != '\r')
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double GetHeightInPixels(WorksheetCellFormatData format, string cellText, int columnWidth)
		{
			try
			{
				return MeasureRowHeight(format, cellText, columnWidth);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return 20.0;
			}
		}

		private Size GetSingleLineSize(WorksheetCellFormatData format)
		{
			if (!_singleLineSizesByFont.TryGetValue(format, out var value))
			{
				value = _metricsProvider.MeasureText(format, "0");
				_singleLineSizesByFont.Add(format, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private double MeasureRowHeight(WorksheetCellFormatData format, string text, int width)
		{
			if (!_defaultRowHeightsForFont.TryGetValue(format, out var value))
			{
				value = _metricsProvider.GetDefaultRowHeight(format);
				_defaultRowHeightsForFont.Add(format, value);
			}
			Size singleLineSize = GetSingleLineSize(format);
			return RoundToIntegralLineRowHeight(_metricsProvider.MeasureText(format, text, new Size(width, int.MaxValue)).Height, singleLineSize.Height, value);
		}

		private double MeasureWrappedText(WorksheetCellFormatData format, string text, int rowHeightInTwips, int columnWidthInPixels, int crlfCount)
		{
			double num = Workbook.ConvertTwipsToPixels(_workbook, rowHeightInTwips, vertical: true, snapToPixels: false);
			int num2 = columnWidthInPixels;
			Size value = new Size(num2, (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(num));
			int height = GetSingleLineSize(format).Height;
			double num3 = num / (double)height;
			Size size = _metricsProvider.MeasureText(format, text, value);
			int num4 = size.Height / height;
			if ((double)size.Height > num)
			{
				if (crlfCount == 0)
				{
					value.Width = int.MaxValue;
					size = _metricsProvider.MeasureText(format, text, value);
					if (num3 > 1.0)
					{
						num2 = (int)Math.Ceiling((float)size.Width / (float)num3);
						do
						{
							value.Width = num2;
							size = _metricsProvider.MeasureText(format, text, value);
							num2 += 2;
						}
						while ((double)size.Height > num);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int num5 = crlfCount + 1;
					if (!((double)num5 > num3))
					{
						value.Width = int.MaxValue;
						size = _metricsProvider.MeasureText(format, text, value);
						if ((double)num5 != num3)
						{
							int num6 = num2;
							int num7 = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(size.Width);
							num4 = size.Height / height;
							while (num6 <= num7)
							{
								num2 = (value.Width = num6 + (num7 - num6) / 2);
								size = _metricsProvider.MeasureText(format, text, value);
								num4 = size.Height / height;
								if ((double)num4 < num3)
								{
									num7 = num2 - 1;
									continue;
								}
								if (!((double)num4 > num3))
								{
									break;
								}
								num6 = num2 + 1;
							}
							for (int num9 = (int)MathUtilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(size.Width) - 1; num9 > num6; num9 -= 2)
							{
								value.Width = num9;
								Size size2 = _metricsProvider.MeasureText(format, text, value);
								num4 = size2.Height / height;
								if ((double)num4 != num3)
								{
									break;
								}
								size = size2;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return size.Width;
		}

		private static double RoundToIntegralLineRowHeight(double textHeight, double singleLineHeight, double singleLineRowHeight)
		{
			return Math.Round(textHeight / singleLineHeight) * singleLineRowHeight;
		}
	}

				internal long GetFirstRowPosition(int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
				{
					VerifyVersion();

				private long GetFirstRowPositionHelper(int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
				{
					int adjustedStartIndex = base.AdjustedStartIndex;

					int lastItemIndex = adjustedStartIndex;
					if (!base.IsAdd)
					{
						num--;
					}

				private int GetTotalExtentHelper(int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)

					if (!base.IsAdd)

					if (base.AdjustedCount == historyItem.Count)

					}
					int num = 0;
					for (int i = 0; i < base.AdjustedCount; i++)
					{
						num += GetRowHeight(i, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					}
					return num;
				}

				private void VerifyVersion()
				{
					if (_positionVersion != ((RowsLoadOnDemandTree)_tree).PositionVersion)
					{
						_positionVersion = ((RowsLoadOnDemandTree)_tree).PositionVersion;
						_firstRowPosition = -1L;
						_firstRowPositionTreatAsVisible = -1L;

			private class RowChangeHistoryItemAdd : ChangeHistoryItemAdd
			{
				private int _totalHeight = -1;

				private int _totalHeightTreatAllAsVisible = -1;

				internal RowChangeHistoryItemAdd(int index, int count)
					: base(index, count)
				{
				}

				internal override int GetItemExtent(int index, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAsVisible)
				{
					if (!base.HasInsertedItems)
					{
						return unallocatedItemExtent;
					}
					WorksheetRow worksheetRow = base.InsertedItems[index];
					if (worksheetRow == null || worksheetRow.WasRemoved)
					{
						return unallocatedItemExtent;
					}
					if (!treatAsVisible && worksheetRow.HiddenInternal)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					int resolvedHeight = worksheetRow.GetResolvedHeight(treatAsVisible);
					if (resolvedHeight < 0)
					{
						return defaultItemExtent;
					}
					return resolvedHeight;
				}

				internal override int GetTotalExtent(int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
				{
					if (treatAllAsVisible)
					{
						if (_totalHeightTreatAllAsVisible < 0)
						{
							_totalHeightTreatAllAsVisible = CalculateCumulativeHeight(_count, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible: true);
						}
						return _totalHeightTreatAllAsVisible;
					}
					if (_totalHeight < 0)
					{
						_totalHeight = CalculateCumulativeHeight(_count, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible: false);
					}
					return _totalHeight;
				}

				private int CalculateCumulativeHeight(int numberOfItems, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
				{
					if (!base.HasInsertedItems)
					{
						return unallocatedItemExtent * numberOfItems;
					}
					int num = 0;
					for (int i = 0; i < numberOfItems; i++)
					{
						WorksheetRow worksheetRow = base.InsertedItems[i];
						if (worksheetRow == null)
						{
							num += unallocatedItemExtent;
						}
						else if (treatAllAsVisible || !worksheetRow.Hidden)
						{
							int itemExtent = GetItemExtent(i, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
							num = ((itemExtent >= 0) ? (num + itemExtent) : (num + defaultItemExtent));
						}
					}
					return num;
				}

				internal void DirtyCachedHeights()
				{
					_totalHeight = -1;
					_totalHeightTreatAllAsVisible = -1;
				}
			}

			private void AdjustIndexForItemInUnallocatedNode(ref int itemIndex, ref long distanceToItem, int unallocatedItemExtent)
			{
				if (unallocatedItemExtent != 0)
				{
					int val = (int)(distanceToItem / unallocatedItemExtent);
					val = Math.Min(val, base.MaxItems - itemIndex - 1);
					itemIndex += val;
					distanceToItem -= (long)val * (long)unallocatedItemExtent;
				}
			}

			internal long CalculateExtentAdjustment(int itemIndex, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				long num = 0L;
				List<ChangeAdjustmentPoint> changeAdjustments = base.ChangeAdjustments;
				int num2 = changeAdjustments?.Count ?? 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					RowChangeAdjustmentPoint rowChangeAdjustmentPoint = changeAdjustments[i] as RowChangeAdjustmentPoint;
					if (rowChangeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex > itemIndex)
					{
						break;
					}
					int num3 = 0;
					if (!rowChangeAdjustmentPoint.IsAdd || rowChangeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedEndIndex < itemIndex)
					{
						num3 = rowChangeAdjustmentPoint.GetTotalAdjustmentHeight(defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					}
					else
					{
						int num4 = itemIndex - rowChangeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex;
						for (int j = 0; j < num4; j++)
						{
							num3 += rowChangeAdjustmentPoint.GetRowHeight(j, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
						}
					}
					num = ((!rowChangeAdjustmentPoint.IsAdd) ? (num - num3) : (num + num3));
				}
				return num;
			}

			public void GetDistanceToTopOfRows(int topRowIndex, int bottomRowIndex, out long distanceToTopRow, out long distanceToBottomRow, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				int defaultRowHeight = worksheet.DefaultRowHeight;
				int unallocatedItemExtent = defaultRowHeight;
				if (!treatAllAsVisible && worksheet.DefaultRowHidden)
				{
					unallocatedItemExtent = 0;
				}
				GetDistanceToBeginningOfItems(topRowIndex, bottomRowIndex, out distanceToTopRow, out distanceToBottomRow, defaultRowHeight, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
			}

			protected void GetDistanceToBeginningOfItems(int firstItemIndex, int lastItemIndex, out long distanceToFirstItem, out long distanceToLastItem, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				distanceToFirstItem = 0L;
				distanceToLastItem = 0L;
				if (firstItemIndex != 0 || lastItemIndex != 0)
				{
					int num = Math.Max(ConvertItemIndexToTreeIndex(firstItemIndex), 0);
					int lastItemIndex2 = ((lastItemIndex == firstItemIndex) ? num : Math.Max(ConvertItemIndexToTreeIndex(lastItemIndex), 0));
					GetDistanceToBeginningOfItemsInTree(num, lastItemIndex2, ref distanceToFirstItem, ref distanceToLastItem, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					distanceToFirstItem += CalculateExtentAdjustment(firstItemIndex, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					if (firstItemIndex == lastItemIndex)
					{
						distanceToLastItem = distanceToFirstItem;
					}
					else
					{
						distanceToLastItem += CalculateExtentAdjustment(lastItemIndex, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					}
				}
			}

			private void GetDistanceToBeginningOfItemsInTree(int firstItemIndex, int lastItemIndex, ref long distanceToFirstItem, ref long distanceToLastItem, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				long num = unallocatedItemExtent * 32;
				int num2 = firstItemIndex - firstItemIndex % 32;
				int num3 = lastItemIndex - lastItemIndex % 32;
				long num4 = unallocatedItemExtent;
				int num5 = num2;
				bool flag = false;
				int num6 = 0;
				foreach (RowBinaryTreeNode item in GetNodesEnumerator())
				{
					int num7;
					if (!flag)
					{
						num7 = (Math.Min(num2, item.FirstItemIndex) - num6) / 32;
						distanceToFirstItem += num7 * num;
					}
					num7 = (Math.Min(num3, item.FirstItemIndex) - num6) / 32;
					distanceToLastItem += num7 * num;
					if (num5 < item.FirstItemIndex)
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							distanceToFirstItem += num4 * (firstItemIndex - num5);
							flag = true;
							num5 = num3;
						}
						if (num5 < item.FirstItemIndex)
						{
							distanceToLastItem += num4 * (lastItemIndex - num5);
							return;
						}
					}
					if (item.FirstItemIndex == num5)
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							distanceToFirstItem += GetDistanceToItemInNode(firstItemIndex, item, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
							flag = true;
							num5 = lastItemIndex - lastItemIndex % 32;
						}
						if (item.FirstItemIndex == num5)
						{
							distanceToLastItem += GetDistanceToItemInNode(lastItemIndex, item, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
							return;
						}
						if (item.FirstItemIndex < num5)
						{
							distanceToLastItem += item.GetTotalExtent(defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
						}
					}
					else if (item.FirstItemIndex < num5)
					{
						int totalExtent = item.GetTotalExtent(defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
						distanceToFirstItem += ((!flag) ? totalExtent : 0);
						distanceToLastItem += totalExtent;
					}
					num6 = item.FirstItemIndex + 32;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					distanceToFirstItem += (firstItemIndex - num6) * num4;
				}
				distanceToLastItem += (lastItemIndex - num6) * num4;
			}

			private static int GetDistanceToItemInNode(int itemIndex, RowBinaryTreeNode currentNode, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				int num = itemIndex - currentNode.FirstItemIndex;
				return num switch
				{
					0 => 0, 
					32 => currentNode.GetTotalExtent(defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible), 
					_ => currentNode.CalculateCumulativeHeight(num, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible), 
				};
			}

			protected void GetItemsInRange(ref long distanceToFirstItem, ref long distanceToLastItem, out int firstItemIndex, out int lastItemIndex, int maxItemIndex, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				firstItemIndex = 0;
				lastItemIndex = 0;
				long distanceToFirstItem2 = distanceToFirstItem;
				long distanceToLastItem2 = distanceToLastItem;
				RowChangeAdjustmentPoint rowChangeAdjustmentPoint = null;
				RowChangeAdjustmentPoint rowChangeAdjustmentPoint2 = null;
				int relativePosition = 0;
				int relativePosition2 = 0;
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				List<ChangeAdjustmentPoint> changeAdjustments = base.ChangeAdjustments;
				int num3 = changeAdjustments?.Count ?? 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
				{
					RowChangeAdjustmentPoint rowChangeAdjustmentPoint3 = changeAdjustments[i] as RowChangeAdjustmentPoint;
					long firstRowPosition = rowChangeAdjustmentPoint3.GetFirstRowPosition(defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					if (firstRowPosition > distanceToFirstItem && firstRowPosition > distanceToLastItem)
					{
						break;
					}
					int totalAdjustmentHeight = rowChangeAdjustmentPoint3.GetTotalAdjustmentHeight(defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					if (rowChangeAdjustmentPoint == null && firstRowPosition <= distanceToFirstItem)
					{
						if (rowChangeAdjustmentPoint3.IsAdd)
						{
							if (firstRowPosition + totalAdjustmentHeight > distanceToFirstItem)
							{
								rowChangeAdjustmentPoint = rowChangeAdjustmentPoint3;
								relativePosition = (int)(distanceToFirstItem - firstRowPosition);
							}
							else
							{
								distanceToFirstItem2 = Math.Max(distanceToFirstItem2 - totalAdjustmentHeight, 0L);
								num += rowChangeAdjustmentPoint3.AdjustedCount;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							distanceToFirstItem2 += totalAdjustmentHeight;
							num -= rowChangeAdjustmentPoint3.AdjustedCount;
						}
					}
					if (rowChangeAdjustmentPoint2 != null || firstRowPosition > distanceToLastItem)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (rowChangeAdjustmentPoint3.IsAdd)
					{
						if (firstRowPosition + totalAdjustmentHeight > distanceToLastItem)
						{
							rowChangeAdjustmentPoint2 = rowChangeAdjustmentPoint3;
							relativePosition2 = (int)(distanceToLastItem - firstRowPosition);
						}
						else
						{
							distanceToLastItem2 = Math.Max(distanceToLastItem2 - totalAdjustmentHeight, 0L);
							num2 += rowChangeAdjustmentPoint3.AdjustedCount;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						distanceToLastItem2 += totalAdjustmentHeight;
						num2 -= rowChangeAdjustmentPoint3.AdjustedCount;
					}
				}
				bool flag = true;
				if (rowChangeAdjustmentPoint != null)
				{
					if (rowChangeAdjustmentPoint2 != null)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						distanceToFirstItem2 = distanceToLastItem2;
					}
				}
				else if (rowChangeAdjustmentPoint2 != null)
				{
					distanceToLastItem2 = distanceToFirstItem2;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					GetItemsInRangeInTree(ref distanceToFirstItem2, ref distanceToLastItem2, ref firstItemIndex, ref lastItemIndex, maxItemIndex, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					distanceToFirstItem = distanceToFirstItem2;
					distanceToLastItem = distanceToLastItem2;
				}
				if (rowChangeAdjustmentPoint != null)
				{
					firstItemIndex = rowChangeAdjustmentPoint.AdjustedStartIndex + rowChangeAdjustmentPoint.GetIndexAtRelativePosition(ref relativePosition, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					distanceToFirstItem = relativePosition;
				}
				else
				{
					firstItemIndex += num;
				}
				if (rowChangeAdjustmentPoint2 != null)
				{
					lastItemIndex = rowChangeAdjustmentPoint2.AdjustedStartIndex + rowChangeAdjustmentPoint2.GetIndexAtRelativePosition(ref relativePosition2, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					distanceToLastItem = relativePosition2;
				}
				else
				{
					lastItemIndex += num2;
				}
			}

			private void GetItemsInRangeInTree(ref long distanceToFirstItem, ref long distanceToLastItem, ref int firstItemIndex, ref int lastItemIndex, int maxItemIndex, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				long num = unallocatedItemExtent * 32;
				bool foundFirstItem = false;
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (RowBinaryTreeNode item in GetNodesEnumerator())
				{
					int num3 = (item.FirstItemIndex - num2) / 32;
					long nodeExtent = num3 * num;
					if (TryFindEndOfBothItems(null, nodeExtent, num3, ref distanceToFirstItem, ref distanceToLastItem, ref firstItemIndex, ref lastItemIndex, ref foundFirstItem, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible))
					{
						return;
					}
					int totalExtent = item.GetTotalExtent(defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					if (TryFindEndOfBothItems(item, totalExtent, 1, ref distanceToFirstItem, ref distanceToLastItem, ref firstItemIndex, ref lastItemIndex, ref foundFirstItem, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible))
					{
						return;
					}
					num2 = item.FirstItemIndex + 32;
				}
				if (unallocatedItemExtent == 0)
				{
					if (!foundFirstItem)
					{
						firstItemIndex = maxItemIndex;
					}
					lastItemIndex = maxItemIndex;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!foundFirstItem)
					{
						AdjustIndexForItemInUnallocatedNode(ref firstItemIndex, ref distanceToFirstItem, unallocatedItemExtent);
					}
					AdjustIndexForItemInUnallocatedNode(ref lastItemIndex, ref distanceToLastItem, unallocatedItemExtent);
				}
			}

			public void GetIndexesOfRows(ref long distanceToTopRow, ref long distanceToBottomRow, out int topRowIndex, out int bottomRowIndex, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				int defaultRowHeight = worksheet.DefaultRowHeight;
				int unallocatedItemExtent = defaultRowHeight;
				if (!treatAllAsVisible && worksheet.DefaultRowHidden)
				{
					unallocatedItemExtent = 0;
				}
				GetItemsInRange(ref distanceToTopRow, ref distanceToBottomRow, out topRowIndex, out bottomRowIndex, Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(worksheet.CurrentFormat) - 1, defaultRowHeight, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
			}

			private static int GetRelativeItemIndex(RowBinaryTreeNode node, ref long distanceToItem, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				WorksheetRow[] values = node.Values;
				for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRow worksheetRow = values[i];
					int num;
					if (worksheetRow == null || worksheetRow.WasRemoved)
					{
						num = unallocatedItemExtent;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!treatAllAsVisible && worksheetRow.Hidden)
						{
							continue;
						}
						num = node.GetItemExtent(worksheetRow, i);
					}
					if (num < 0)
					{
						distanceToItem -= defaultItemExtent;
						continue;
					}
					if (distanceToItem < num)
					{
						return i;
					}
					distanceToItem -= num;
				}
				return 31;
			}

			public void OnRowHeightsChanged()
			{
				_positionVersion++;
			}

			private bool TryFindEndOfBothItems(RowBinaryTreeNode currentNode, long nodeExtent, int nodeCount, ref long distanceToFirstItem, ref long distanceToLastItem, ref int firstItemIndex, ref int lastItemIndex, ref bool foundFirstItem, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				if (!foundFirstItem && TryFindEndOfItem(currentNode, nodeExtent, nodeCount, ref distanceToFirstItem, ref firstItemIndex, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible))
				{
					foundFirstItem = true;
				}
				if (TryFindEndOfItem(currentNode, nodeExtent, nodeCount, ref distanceToLastItem, ref lastItemIndex, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private bool TryFindEndOfItem(RowBinaryTreeNode currentNode, long nodeExtent, int nodeCount, ref long distanceToItem, ref int itemIndex, int defaultItemExtent, int unallocatedItemExtent, bool treatAllAsVisible)
			{
				if (distanceToItem < nodeExtent)
				{
					if (currentNode == null)
					{
						AdjustIndexForItemInUnallocatedNode(ref itemIndex, ref distanceToItem, unallocatedItemExtent);
					}
					else
					{
						itemIndex += GetRelativeItemIndex(currentNode, ref distanceToItem, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					}
					return true;
				}
				int num = nodeCount * 32;
				if (itemIndex + num == base.MaxItems)
				{
					long num2 = distanceToItem - (nodeExtent - 1);
					distanceToItem = nodeExtent - 1;
					itemIndex += GetRelativeItemIndex(currentNode, ref distanceToItem, defaultItemExtent, unallocatedItemExtent, treatAllAsVisible);
					distanceToItem += num2;
				}
				else
				{
					distanceToItem -= nodeExtent;
					itemIndex += num;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class InsertRemoveOperationWrapper : ICellShiftOperationOverride
		{
			private readonly WorksheetRowCollection _collection;

			private readonly int _index;

			private readonly int _count;

			internal readonly bool IsInsert;

			internal readonly bool IsUndo;

			public int Count => _count;

			public int Index => _index;

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.ShiftsColumns => false;

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.ShiftsRows => true;

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.IsRemoveOperation => !IsInsert;

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.IsUndoOperation => IsUndo;

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.PerformsShift => true;

			Worksheet ICellShiftOperationOverride.Worksheet => _collection.Worksheet;

			internal InsertRemoveOperationWrapper(WorksheetRowCollection collection, int index, int count, bool isInsert, bool isUndo)
			{
				_collection = collection;
				_index = index;
				_count = count;
				IsInsert = isInsert;
				IsUndo = isUndo;
			}

			void ICellShiftOperationOverride.OnBeforeShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation)
			{
			}

			bool ICellShiftOperationOverride.PerformShift(CellShiftOperation shiftOperation)
			{
				WorksheetRowCollection collection = _collection;
				if (IsInsert)
				{
					collection.InsertItems(Index, Count);
				}
				else
				{
					collection.RemoveItems(Index, Count);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private RowsLoadOnDemandTree tree;

		protected internal override int MaxCount => Workbook.GetMaxRowCount(base.Worksheet.CurrentFormat);

		public WorksheetRow this[int index] => InternalIndexer(index);

		internal WorksheetRowCollection(Worksheet parentWorksheet)
			: base(parentWorksheet)
		{
		}

		internal override LoadOnDemandTree<WorksheetRow> CreateLoadOnDemandTree()
		{
			tree = new RowsLoadOnDemandTree(this);
			return tree;
		}

		internal override WorksheetRow CreateValue(int index)
		{
			return new WorksheetRow(base.Worksheet, index);
		}

		internal override int GetItemIndex(WorksheetRow row)
		{
			return row.Index;
		}

		internal override void InitializeItemIndex(WorksheetRow row, int index, bool applyingChangesToTree)
		{
			row.InitializeIndex(index, applyingChangesToTree);
		}

		internal override bool IsItemStillValid(WorksheetRow row)
		{
			return !row.WasRemoved;
		}

		internal override void OnCurrentFormatChanged()
		{
			base.OnCurrentFormatChanged();
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)this)
			{
				item.OnCurrentFormatChanged();
			}
		}

		internal override void ThrowIndexOutOfRangeException(int index)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_MaxRows", base.Worksheet.Workbook.MaxRowCount));
		}

		internal override void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)this)
			{
				item.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			}
		}

		internal void GetDistanceToTopOfRows(int topRowIndex, int bottomRowIndex, out long distanceToTopRow, out long distanceToBottomRow, bool treatAllAsVisible = false)
		{
			tree.GetDistanceToTopOfRows(topRowIndex, bottomRowIndex, out distanceToTopRow, out distanceToBottomRow, treatAllAsVisible);
		}

		internal WorksheetRow GetIfCreated(int index)
		{
			if (base.ItemsInternal.TryGetValue(index, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void GetIndexesOfRows(ref long distanceToTopRow, ref long distanceToBottomRow, out int topRowIndex, out int bottomRowIndex, bool treatAllAsVisible = false)
		{
			tree.GetIndexesOfRows(ref distanceToTopRow, ref distanceToBottomRow, out topRowIndex, out bottomRowIndex, treatAllAsVisible);
		}

		internal int? GetNextOrPreviousCellWithValue(int rowIndex, short columnIndex, bool next)
		{
			IEnumerable<WorksheetRow> enumerable = (next ? GetItemsInRange(rowIndex + 1, MaxCount - 1, enumerateForwards: true) : GetItemsInRange(0, rowIndex - 1, enumerateForwards: false));
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in enumerable)
			{
				WorksheetCellBlock worksheetCellBlock = item.TryGetCellBlock(columnIndex);
				if (worksheetCellBlock != null && worksheetCellBlock.DoesCellHaveValue(columnIndex))
				{
					return item.Index;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(HiddenRowCollection hiddenRows)
		{
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in (IEnumerable<WorksheetRow>)this)
			{
				item.Hidden = hiddenRows.Contains(item);
			}
		}

		public void Insert(int index, int count = 1)
		{
			VerifyWorkbook();
			int num = MaxCount;
			if (index < 0)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (index + count > num)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Max rows exceeded");
			}
			InsertInternal(index, count);
		}

		private void InsertInternal(int index, int count)
		{
			int num = MaxCount;
			WorksheetRow worksheetRow = null;
			if (index > 0)
			{
				worksheetRow = GetItem(index - 1, createIfNotFound: false);
			}
			List<WorksheetRow> list = new List<WorksheetRow>(GetItemsInRange(num - count, num - 1));
			InsertRemoveOperationWrapper operationOverride = new InsertRemoveOperationWrapper(this, index, count, isInsert: true, isUndo: false);
			ProcessCellShiftResult(base.Worksheet.ShiftCells(new CellShiftOperation(base.Worksheet, CellShiftType.VerticalShift, null, index, num - (count + 1), 0, (short)(Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(base.Worksheet.CurrentFormat) - 1), count, rowInstancesShift: true), CellShiftInitializeFormatType.FromStationaryCellsAdjacentToInsertRegion, operationOverride).Result);
			if (worksheetRow != null)
			{
				int num2 = index + count;
				for (int i = index; i < num2; i++)
				{
					WorksheetRow worksheetRow2 = this[i];
					worksheetRow2.InitializeFrom(worksheetRow);
				}
			}
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in list)
			{
				item.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			}
			tree.OnRowHeightsChanged();
			tree.ResetExtentCache(onlyVisibilityChanged: false);
			foreach (WorksheetRow item2 in GetItemsInRange(index + count, MaxCount - 1))
			{
				item2.DirtyCellCalcReferences();
			}
			Workbook wb = base.Worksheet.Workbook;
			if (wb != null)
			{
				wb.IterateFormulas(delegate(Worksheet ws, Formula f)
				{
					f.ReconnectReferences(wb);
				});
			}
			base.Worksheet.RemoveDisconnectedVisitedHyperlinks();
		}

		internal void OnDefaultRowHeightChanged()
		{
			tree.OnRowHeightsChanged();
		}

		public void Remove(int index, int count = 1)
		{
			VerifyWorkbook();
			int num = MaxCount;
			if (index < 0)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (index + count > num)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Max rows exceeded");
			}
			RemoveInternal(index, count);
		}

		private void RemoveInternal(int index, int count)
		{
			List<WorksheetRow> list = new List<WorksheetRow>(GetItemsInRange(index, index + count - 1));
			InsertRemoveOperationWrapper operationOverride = new InsertRemoveOperationWrapper(this, index, count, isInsert: false, isUndo: false);
			ProcessCellShiftResult(base.Worksheet.ShiftCells(new CellShiftOperation(base.Worksheet, CellShiftType.VerticalShift, null, index + count, MaxCount - 1, 0, (short)(Workbook.GetMaxColumnCount(base.Worksheet.CurrentFormat) - 1), -count, rowInstancesShift: true), CellShiftInitializeFormatType.UseDefaultFormat, operationOverride).Result);
			foreach (WorksheetRow item in list)
			{
				item.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			}
			tree.OnRowHeightsChanged();
			tree.ResetExtentCache(onlyVisibilityChanged: false);
			foreach (WorksheetRow item2 in GetItemsInRange(index + count, MaxCount - 1))
			{
				item2.DirtyCellCalcReferences();
			}
			Workbook wb = base.Worksheet.Workbook;
			if (wb != null)
			{
				wb.IterateFormulas(delegate(Worksheet ws, Formula f)
				{
					f.ReconnectReferences(wb);
				});
			}
			base.Worksheet.RemoveDisconnectedVisitedHyperlinks();
		}

		internal void ResetHeightCache(bool onlyVisibilityChanged)
		{
			tree.OnRowHeightsChanged();
			tree.ResetExtentCache(onlyVisibilityChanged);
		}

		internal void ResetHeightCache(int rowIndex, bool onlyVisibilityChanged)
		{
			tree.OnRowHeightsChanged();
			tree.ResetExtentCache(rowIndex, onlyVisibilityChanged);
		}

		private void VerifyWorkbook()
		{
			if (base.Worksheet.Workbook == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The worrksheet has been deleted");
			}
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Count = {Count}")]
	public sealed class WorksheetCollection : IList<Worksheet>, ICollection<Worksheet>, IEnumerable<Worksheet>, IEnumerable
	{
		private List<Worksheet> worksheets;

		private Workbook workbook;

		int ICollection<Worksheet>.Count => Count;

		bool ICollection<Worksheet>.IsReadOnly => false;

		Worksheet IList<Worksheet>.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public int Count => worksheets.Count;

		public Worksheet this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
				{
					throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
				}
				return worksheets[index];
			}
		}

		public Worksheet this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (Worksheet worksheet in worksheets)
				{
					if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(worksheet.Name, name, workbook.CultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
					{
						return worksheet;
					}
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LER_Exception_KeyNotFound"));
			}
		}

		internal WorksheetCollection(Workbook parentWorkbook)
		{
			workbook = parentWorkbook;
			worksheets = new List<Worksheet>();
		}

		void ICollection<Worksheet>.Add(Worksheet item)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_CantAddWorksheet"));
		}

		void ICollection<Worksheet>.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool ICollection<Worksheet>.Contains(Worksheet item)
		{
			return Contains(item);
		}

		void ICollection<Worksheet>.CopyTo(Worksheet[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			worksheets.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<Worksheet>.Remove(Worksheet item)
		{
			return Remove(item);
		}

		IEnumerator<Worksheet> IEnumerable<Worksheet>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return worksheets.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<Worksheet>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		void IList<Worksheet>.Insert(int index, Worksheet item)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public Worksheet Add(string name)
		{
			return Add(name, workbook.GetNewSheetId());
		}

		internal Worksheet Add(string name, ushort sheetId)
		{
			return Insert(worksheets.Count, name, sheetId);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = worksheets.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveAtInternal(num, raiseChangeEvemts: false);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			return worksheets.Contains(worksheet);
		}

		public bool Exists(string name)
		{
			foreach (Worksheet worksheet in worksheets)
			{
				if (StringUtilities.StringCompare(worksheet.Name, name, workbook.CultureResolved, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public int IndexOf(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			return worksheets.IndexOf(worksheet);
		}

		internal Worksheet Insert(int newIndex, string name, ushort sheetId)
		{
			Worksheet.VerifyNameIsValid(name, "name");
			workbook.VerifyWorksheetName(null, name, "name");
			Worksheet worksheet = new Worksheet(name, workbook, sheetId);
			InternalAdd(worksheet, newIndex);
			return worksheet;
		}

		private void InternalAdd(Worksheet worksheet, int index)
		{
			worksheets.Insert(index, worksheet);
			workbook.OnWorksheetAdded(worksheet);
		}

		internal void MoveWorksheet(int index, int newIndex)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = worksheets[index];
			worksheets.RemoveAt(index);
			worksheets.Insert(newIndex, worksheet);
			workbook.OnWorksheetMoved(worksheet, index);
		}

		public bool Remove(Worksheet worksheet)
		{
			int num = worksheets.IndexOf(worksheet);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			RemoveAtInternal(index, raiseChangeEvemts: true);
		}

		private void RemoveAtInternal(int index, bool raiseChangeEvemts)
		{
			Worksheet worksheet = worksheets[index];
			worksheets.RemoveAt(index);
			workbook.OnWorksheetRemoving(worksheet);
			worksheet.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			workbook.OnWorksheetRemoved(worksheet, index);
		}

		internal void VerifyFormatLimits(FormatLimitErrors limitErrors, WorkbookFormat testFormat)
		{
			foreach (Worksheet item in (IEnumerable<Worksheet>)this)
			{
				item.VerifyFormatLimits(limitErrors, testFormat);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WorksheetSelection
	{
		private List<WorksheetPaneSelection> _paneSelections;

		internal IList<WorksheetPaneSelection> PaneSelections => _paneSelections;

		internal WorksheetSelection()
		{
			_paneSelections = new List<WorksheetPaneSelection>();
		}

		internal WorksheetPaneSelection GetSelection(PaneLocation location)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(location);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return _paneSelections[num];
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int IndexOf(PaneLocation location)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < PaneSelections.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_paneSelections[i].Location == location)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(WorksheetSelection source)
		{
			foreach (WorksheetPaneSelection paneSelection in source.PaneSelections)
			{
				int num = IndexOf(paneSelection.Location);
				WorksheetPaneSelection worksheetPaneSelection;
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					worksheetPaneSelection = PaneSelections[num];
				}
				else
				{
					worksheetPaneSelection = new WorksheetPaneSelection();
					PaneSelections.Add(worksheetPaneSelection);
				}
				worksheetPaneSelection.InitializeFrom(paneSelection);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WorksheetPaneSelection
	{
		private List<WorksheetRegionAddress> _ranges;

		internal WorksheetCellAddress ActiveCell { get; set; }

		internal int ActiveCellRangesId { get; set; }

		internal PaneLocation Location { get; set; }

		internal IList<WorksheetRegionAddress> Ranges => _ranges;

		internal WorksheetPaneSelection()
		{
			_ranges = new List<WorksheetRegionAddress>();
		}

		internal static WorksheetPaneSelection CreateDefault(PaneLocation location = PaneLocation.TopLeft)
		{
			WorksheetPaneSelection worksheetPaneSelection = new WorksheetPaneSelection();
			worksheetPaneSelection.ActiveCell = new WorksheetCellAddress(0, 0);
			worksheetPaneSelection.Location = location;
			worksheetPaneSelection.Ranges.Add(new WorksheetRegionAddress(0, 0, 0, 0));
			return worksheetPaneSelection;
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(WorksheetPaneSelection source)
		{
			Location = source.Location;
			ActiveCell = source.ActiveCell;
			ActiveCellRangesId = source.ActiveCellRangesId;
			Ranges.Clear();
			_ranges.AddRange(source.Ranges);
		}
	}

			shapes.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<WorksheetShape>.Remove(WorksheetShape item)
		{
			return Remove(item);
		}

		IEnumerator<WorksheetShape> IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return shapes.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<WorksheetShape>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public WorksheetShape Add(PredefinedShapeType shapeType, Rectangle boundsInTwips)
		{
			if (Worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_NoWorksheetContextToSetShapeBounds"));
			}
			return Add(shapeType, Worksheet, boundsInTwips);
		}

		public WorksheetShape Add(PredefinedShapeType shapeType, Worksheet worksheet, Rectangle boundsInTwips)
		{
			if (worksheet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("worksheet");
			}
			WorksheetShape worksheetShape = WorksheetShape.CreatePredefinedShape(shapeType);
			if (worksheetShape == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			worksheetShape.SetBoundsInTwips(worksheet, boundsInTwips);
			Add(worksheetShape);
			return worksheetShape;
		}

		public WorksheetShape Add(PredefinedShapeType shapeType, WorksheetCell topLeftCornerCell, PointF topLeftCornerPosition, WorksheetCell bottomRightCornerCell, PointF bottomRightCornerPosition)
		{
			WorksheetShape worksheetShape = WorksheetShape.CreatePredefinedShape(shapeType);
			if (worksheetShape == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (topLeftCornerCell == null || bottomRightCornerCell == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_AnchorShapeBeforeAddingToCollection"));
			}
			if (topLeftCornerCell.Worksheet != Worksheet)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_TopLeftAnchorFromOtherWorksheet"));
			}
			if (bottomRightCornerCell.Worksheet != Worksheet)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_BottomRightAnchorFromOtherWorksheet"));
			}
			worksheetShape.SetAnchors(topLeftCornerCell.Worksheet, topLeftCornerCell.Address, topLeftCornerPosition, bottomRightCornerCell.Address, bottomRightCornerPosition);
			Add(worksheetShape);
			return worksheetShape;
		}

		public void Add(WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			Add(shape, verifyCanBeAdded: true);
		}

		internal void Add(WorksheetShape shape, bool verifyCanBeAdded)
		{
			if (shape == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("shape", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_Shape"));
			}
			if (verifyCanBeAdded && !shape.CanBeAddedToShapesCollection)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_ShapeCannotBeAdded"), "shape");
			}
			InternalInsert(shapes.Count, shape);
		}

		private void InternalInsert(int index, WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			shape.OnAddingToCollection(this);
			shapes.Insert(index, shape);
			owner.OnShapeAdded(shape);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = shapes.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			return shapes.Contains(shape);
		}

		public bool Remove(WorksheetShape shape)
		{
			int num = shapes.IndexOf(shape);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw Utilities.CreateArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_CollectionIndex"));
			}
			WorksheetShape worksheetShape = shapes[index];
			shapes.RemoveAt(index);
			worksheetShape.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			owner.OnShapeRemoved(worksheetShape);
		}

		internal void ClearPivotTableData()
		{
			for (int num = shapes.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				WorksheetShape worksheetShape = shapes[num];
				if (worksheetShape is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
				{
					worksheetShapeGroup.Shapes.ClearPivotTableData();
				}
				else if (worksheetShape.SlicerName2007 != null)
				{
					shapes.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveInvalidShapes()
		{
			for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				WorksheetShape worksheetShape = this[num];
				if (!worksheetShape.CanBeAddedToShapesCollection)
				{
					RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else if (worksheetShape is WorksheetShapeGroup worksheetShapeGroup)
				{
					worksheetShapeGroup.Shapes.RemoveInvalidShapes();
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
